name: matPolyEquiv_coeff_apply_aux_1
statement:
theorem matPolyEquiv_coeff_apply_aux_1 (i j : n) (k : ℕ) (x : R) :
    matPolyEquiv (single i j <| monomial k x) = monomial k (single i j x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [matPolyEquiv, AlgEquiv.trans_apply, matrixEquivTensor_apply_single]
  apply (polyEquivTensor R (Matrix n n R)).injective
  simp only [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.comm_tmul,
    polyEquivTensor_apply, eval₂_monomial]
  simp only [one_pow,
    Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_pow]
  rw [← smul_X_eq_monomial, ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul]
  congr with i' <;> simp [single]

name: matPolyEquiv_coeff_apply_aux_2
statement:
theorem matPolyEquiv_coeff_apply_aux_2 (i j : n) (p : R[X]) (k : ℕ) :
    coeff (matPolyEquiv (single i j p)) k = single i j (coeff p k)
proof:
:= by
  refine Polynomial.induction_on' p ?_ ?_
  · intro p q hp hq
    ext
    simp [hp, hq, coeff_add, Matrix.add_apply, single_add]
  · intro k x
    simp only [matPolyEquiv_coeff_apply_aux_1, coeff_monomial]
    split_ifs <;>
      · funext
        simp

name: matPolyEquiv_coeff_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem matPolyEquiv_coeff_apply (m : Matrix n n R[X]) (k : ℕ) (i j : n) :
    coeff (matPolyEquiv m) k i j = coeff (m i j) k
proof:
:= by
  refine Matrix.induction_on' m ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp
  · intro p q hp hq
    simp [hp, hq]
  · intro i' j' x
    rw [matPolyEquiv_coeff_apply_aux_2]
    dsimp [single]
    split_ifs <;> rename_i h
    · constructor
    · simp

name: matPolyEquiv_symm_apply_coeff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem matPolyEquiv_symm_apply_coeff (p : (Matrix n n R)[X]) (i j : n) (k : ℕ) :
    coeff (matPolyEquiv.symm p i j) k = coeff p k i j
proof:
:= by
  have t : p = matPolyEquiv (matPolyEquiv.symm p) := by simp
  conv_rhs => rw [t]
  simp only [matPolyEquiv_coeff_apply]

name: matPolyEquiv_smul_one
statement:
theorem matPolyEquiv_smul_one (p : R[X]) :
    matPolyEquiv (p • (1 : Matrix n n R[X])) = p.map (algebraMap R (Matrix n n R))
proof:
:= by
  ext m i j
  simp only [matPolyEquiv_coeff_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.one_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_ite,
    mul_one, mul_zero, coeff_map, algebraMap_matrix_apply, Algebra.algebraMap_self,
    RingHom.id_apply]
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: matPolyEquiv_map_smul
statement:
@[simp]
lemma matPolyEquiv_map_smul (p : R[X]) (M : Matrix n n R[X]) :
    matPolyEquiv (p • M) = p.map (algebraMap _ _) * matPolyEquiv M
proof:
:= by
  rw [← one_mul M, ← smul_mul_assoc, map_mul, matPolyEquiv_smul_one, one_mul]

name: matPolyEquiv_symm_map_eval
statement:
theorem matPolyEquiv_symm_map_eval (M : (Matrix n n R)[X]) (r : R) :
    (matPolyEquiv.symm M).map (eval r) = M.eval (scalar n r)
proof:
:= by
  suffices ((aeval r).mapMatrix.comp matPolyEquiv.symm.toAlgHom : (Matrix n n R)[X] →ₐ[R] _) =
      (eval₂AlgHom (AlgHom.id R _) (scalar n r)
        fun x => (scalar_commute _ (Commute.all _) _).symm) from
    DFunLike.congr_fun this M
  ext : 1
  · ext M : 1
    simp [Function.comp_def]
  · simp

name: matPolyEquiv_eval_eq_map
statement:
theorem matPolyEquiv_eval_eq_map (M : Matrix n n R[X]) (r : R) :
    (matPolyEquiv M).eval (scalar n r) = M.map (eval r)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply] using (matPolyEquiv_symm_map_eval (matPolyEquiv M) r).symm

name: matPolyEquiv_eval
statement:
theorem matPolyEquiv_eval (M : Matrix n n R[X]) (r : R) (i j : n) :
    (matPolyEquiv M).eval (scalar n r) i j = (M i j).eval r
proof:
:= by
  rw [matPolyEquiv_eval_eq_map, map_apply]

name: support_subset_support_matPolyEquiv
statement:
theorem support_subset_support_matPolyEquiv (m : Matrix n n R[X]) (i j : n) :
    support (m i j) ⊆ support (matPolyEquiv m)
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  contrapose
  simp only [notMem_support_iff]
  intro hk
  rw [← matPolyEquiv_coeff_apply, hk, Matrix.zero_apply]

name: eval_det
statement:
theorem eval_det {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (M : Matrix n n R[X]) (r : R) :
    Polynomial.eval r M.det = (Polynomial.eval (scalar n r) (matPolyEquiv M)).det
proof:
:= by
  rw [Polynomial.eval, ← coe_eval₂RingHom, RingHom.map_det]
  exact congr_arg det <| ext fun _ _ ↦ matPolyEquiv_eval _ _ _ _ |>.symm

name: eval_det_add_X_smul
statement:
lemma eval_det_add_X_smul {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (A : Matrix n n R[X]) (M : Matrix n n R) :
    (det (A + (X : R[X]) • M.map C)).eval 0 = (det A).eval 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [eval_det, map_zero, map_add, eval_add, Algebra.smul_def, map_mul]
  simp only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, matPolyEquiv_smul_one, map_X, X_mul, eval_mul_X,
    mul_zero, add_zero]

name: leftCancelEquiv_comp_lTensor_comp_symm

theorem leftCancelEquiv_comp_lTensor_comp_symm (f : P →ₗ[R] Q) :

name: rTensorInv_leftInverse
statement: theorem rTensorInv_leftInverse : Function.LeftInverse (rTensorInv P Q e) (.rTensorHom M)
proof:
:=
  fun _ ↦ by
    simp_rw [rTensorInv, LinearEquiv.coe_trans, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_toLinearMap]
    rw [← LinearEquiv.eq_symm_apply]
    ext; simp [LinearEquiv.congrLeft, LinearEquiv.congrRight, LinearEquiv.arrowCongrAddEquiv]

name: rTensorInv_injective

name: bijective_curry
statement: theorem bijective_curry : Function.Bijective (curry e.toLinearMap)
proof:
:= by
  have : curry e.toLinearMap = ((TensorProduct.lid R N).congrLeft _ R ≪≫ₗ e.congrRight) ∘ₗ
      rTensorHom N ∘ₗ (ringLmapEquivSelf R R M).symm.toLinearMap := by
    rw [← LinearEquiv.toLinearMap_symm_comp_eq]; ext
    simp [LinearEquiv.congrLeft, LinearEquiv.congrRight, LinearEquiv.arrowCongrAddEquiv]
  simpa [this] using! (rTensorEquiv R M <| TensorProduct.comm R N M ≪≫ₗ e).bijective

name: right
statement:
protected theorem right : Module.Invertible R N where
  bijective
proof:
:= by
    rw [show contractLeft R N = ((linearEquivDual e).rTensor N).symm ≪≫ₗ e by
      rw [LinearEquiv.coe_trans, LinearEquiv.eq_comp_toLinearMap_symm]; ext; rfl]
    apply LinearEquiv.bijective

name: left
statement: protected theorem left : Module.Invertible R M
proof: := .right (TensorProduct.comm R N M ≪≫ₗ e)

name: congr
statement: protected theorem congr (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) : Module.Invertible R N
proof:
:=
  .right (e.symm.lTensor _ ≪≫ₗ linearEquiv R M)

name: finite_projective
statement: private theorem finite_projective : Module.Finite R M ∧ Projective R M
proof:
:= by
  let N := Dual R M
  let e : M ⊗[R] N ≃ₗ[R] R := TensorProduct.comm .. ≪≫ₗ linearEquiv R M
  have ⟨S, hS⟩ := TensorProduct.exists_finset (e.symm 1)
  let f : (S →₀ N) →ₗ[R] R := Finsupp.lsum R fun i ↦ e.toLinearMap ∘ₗ TensorProduct.mk R M N i.1.1
  have : Function.Surjective f := by
    rw [← LinearMap.range_eq_top, Ideal.eq_top_iff_one]
    use Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm fun i ↦ i.1.2
    simp_rw [f, Finsupp.coe_lsum]
    rw [Finsupp.sum_fintype _ _ fun _ ↦ map_zero _]
    rwa [e.symm_apply_eq, map_sum, ← Finset.sum_coe_sort, eq_comm] at hS
  have ⟨g, hg⟩ := projective_lifting_property f .id this
  classical
  let aux := finsuppRight R _ M N S ≪≫ₗ Finsupp.mapRange.linearEquiv e
  let f' : (S →₀ R) →ₗ[R] M := TensorProduct.rid R M ∘ₗ f.lTensor M ∘ₗ aux.symm
  let g' : M →ₗ[R] S →₀ R := aux ∘ₗ g.lTensor M ∘ₗ (TensorProduct.rid R M).symm
  have : Function.Surjective f' := by simpa [f'] using LinearMap.lTensor_surjective _ this
  refine ⟨.of_surjective f' this, .of_split g' f' <| LinearMap.ext fun m ↦ ?_⟩
  simp [f', g', show f (g 1) = 1 from DFunLike.congr_fun hg 1]

name: lTensor_injective_iff
statement:
theorem lTensor_injective_iff {f : N →ₗ[R] P} :
    Function.Injective (f.lTensor M) ↔ Function.Injective f
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, Flat.lTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap _⟩
  rw [← leftCancelEquiv_comp_lTensor_comp_symm (linearEquiv R M) f]
  simpa using Flat.lTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap _ h

name: rTensor_injective_iff
statement:
theorem rTensor_injective_iff {f : N →ₗ[R] P} :
    Function.Injective (f.rTensor M) ↔ Function.Injective f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.lTensor_inj_iff_rTensor_inj, lTensor_injective_iff]

name: lTensor_surjective_iff
statement:
theorem lTensor_surjective_iff {f : N →ₗ[R] P} :
    Function.Surjective (f.lTensor M) ↔ Function.Surjective f
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, LinearMap.lTensor_surjective _⟩
  rw [← leftCancelEquiv_comp_lTensor_comp_symm (linearEquiv R M) f]
  simpa using LinearMap.lTensor_surjective _ h

name: rTensor_surjective_iff
statement:
theorem rTensor_surjective_iff {f : N →ₗ[R] P} :
    Function.Surjective (f.rTensor M) ↔ Function.Surjective f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.lTensor_surj_iff_rTensor_surj, lTensor_surjective_iff]

name: lTensor_bijective_iff
statement:
theorem lTensor_bijective_iff {f : N →ₗ[R] P} :
    Function.Bijective (f.lTensor M) ↔ Function.Bijective f
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Function.Bijective, lTensor_injective_iff, lTensor_surjective_iff]

name: rTensor_bijective_iff
statement:
theorem rTensor_bijective_iff {f : N →ₗ[R] P} :
    Function.Bijective (f.rTensor M) ↔ Function.Bijective f
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Function.Bijective, rTensor_injective_iff, rTensor_surjective_iff]

name: free_iff_linearEquiv
statement: theorem free_iff_linearEquiv : Free R M ↔ Nonempty (M ≃ₗ[R] R)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun _ ↦ ?_, fun ⟨e⟩ ↦ .of_equiv e.symm⟩
  nontriviality R
  have e := (Free.chooseBasis R M).repr
  have := card_eq_of_linearEquiv R <|
    (finsuppTensorFinsupp' .. ≪≫ₗ linearEquivFunOnFinite R R _).symm ≪≫ₗ TensorProduct.congr
      (linearEquivFunOnFinite R R _ ≪≫ₗ llift R R R _ ≪≫ₗ e.dualMap)
      e.symm ≪≫ₗ linearEquiv R M ≪≫ₗ (.symm <| .funUnique Unit R R)
  have : Unique (Free.ChooseBasisIndex R M) :=
    (Fintype.card_eq_one_iff_nonempty_unique.mp (by simpa using this)).some
  exact ⟨e ≪≫ₗ uniqueLinearEquiv R R default⟩

name: finrank_eq_one
statement: protected theorem finrank_eq_one [Free R M] : finrank R M = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [(free_iff_linearEquiv.mp ‹_›).some.finrank_eq, CommSemiring.finrank_self]

name: rank_eq_one
statement: theorem rank_eq_one [Free R M] : Module.rank R M = 1
proof:
:=
  rank_eq_one_iff_finrank_eq_one.mpr (Invertible.finrank_eq_one R M)

name: toModuleEnd_bijective
statement: theorem toModuleEnd_bijective : Function.Bijective (toModuleEnd R (S := R) M)
proof:
:= by
  have : toModuleEnd R (S := R) M = (lid R M).conj ∘ rTensorEquiv R R
      (comm .. ≪≫ₗ linearEquiv R M) ∘ RingEquiv.moduleEndSelf R ∘ MulOpposite.opEquiv := by
    ext; simp [LinearEquiv.conj, liftAux]
  simpa [this] using MulOpposite.opEquiv.bijective

name: bijective_self_of_surjective
proof:
:= smul_left_injective' (α := M) <| funext fun m ↦ by
    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := hf m
    simp_rw [← map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm _ r, ← smul_eq_mul, map_smul, eq]
  right := hf

name: bijective_of_surjective
statement:
theorem bijective_of_surjective [Module.Invertible R N] {f : M →ₗ[R] N}
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) : Function.Bijective f
proof:
:= by
  simpa [lTensor_bijective_iff] using bijective_self_of_surjective
    (f.lTensor _ ∘ₗ (linearEquiv R M).symm.toLinearMap) (by simpa [lTensor_surjective_iff] using hf)

theorem of_isLocalization (S : Submonoid R) [IsLocalization S A]

name: exists_finset_free_localization
statement:
theorem exists_finset_free_localization :
    ∃ s : Finset R, Ideal.span (s : Set R) = ⊤ ∧
      ∀ r ∈ s, Free (Localization.Away r) (LocalizedModule.Away r M)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := ((linearEquiv R M).symm 1).exists_finset
  refine ⟨S.image fun i ↦ i.1 i.2, ?_, fun r hr ↦ ?_⟩
  
  · simpa [Ideal.eq_top_iff_one, (LinearEquiv.symm_apply_eq _).mp hS, linearEquiv]
      using Ideal.sum_mem _ fun i hi ↦ Ideal.subset_span (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hi)
  
  obtain ⟨⟨f, m⟩, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hr
  
  let f' : Dual (Localization.Away (f m)) (LocalizedModule.Away (f m) M) :=
    .extendScalarsOfIsLocalization (.powers (f m)) _ <| IsLocalizedModule.map
      (.powers (f m)) (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap _ M) (Algebra.linearMap R _) f
  
  have surj : Function.Surjective f' := LinearMap.range_eq_top.mp <| Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem
    _ ⟨_, IsLocalizedModule.map_apply ..⟩ (IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit (f m))
  exact .of_equiv <| .symm <| .ofBijective f' (bijective_of_surjective surj)

name: mk_eq_iff
statement:
theorem mk_eq_iff {N : Pic R} : Pic.mk R M = N ↔ Nonempty (M ≃ₗ[R] N) where
  mp
proof:
:= (· ▸ ⟨(mk.linearEquiv R M).symm⟩)
  mpr := fun ⟨e⟩ ↦ ((equivShrink _).eq_symm_apply).mp <|
    Units.ext <| Quotient.mk_eq_iff_out.mpr ⟨(Finite.reprEquivₛ R M ≪≫ₗ e).toModuleIsoₛ⟩

name: mk_eq_self
statement: theorem mk_eq_self {M : Pic R} : Pic.mk R M = M
proof: := mk_eq_iff.mpr ⟨.refl ..⟩

name: ext_iff
statement: theorem ext_iff {M N : Pic R} : M = N ↔ Nonempty (M ≃ₗ[R] N)

name: mk_eq_mk_iff
statement: theorem mk_eq_mk_iff : Pic.mk R M = Pic.mk R N ↔ Nonempty (M ≃ₗ[R] N)
proof:

  mk_eq_iff.trans ⟨fun ⟨e⟩ ↦ ⟨e ≪≫ₗ eN⟩, fun ⟨e⟩ ↦ ⟨e ≪≫ₗ eN.symm⟩⟩

name: mk_self
statement: theorem mk_self : Pic.mk R R = 1
proof:
:=
  congr_arg (equivShrink _) <| Units.ext <| Quotient.sound ⟨(Finite.reprEquivₛ R R).toModuleIsoₛ⟩

name: mk_eq_one_iff
statement: theorem mk_eq_one_iff : Pic.mk R M = 1 ↔ Nonempty (M ≃ₗ[R] R)

name: mk_eq_one
statement: theorem mk_eq_one [Free R M] : Pic.mk R M = 1

name: mk_tensor
statement: theorem mk_tensor : Pic.mk R (M ⊗[R] N) = Pic.mk R M * Pic.mk R N
proof:
:=
  congr_arg (equivShrink _) <| Units.ext <| by
    simp_rw [Pic.mk, Equiv.toFun_as_coe, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    refine (Quotient.sound ?_).trans (Skeleton.toSkeleton_tensorObj ..)
    exact ⟨(Finite.reprEquivₛ R _ ≪≫ₗ TensorProduct.congr
      (Finite.reprEquivₛ R M).symm (Finite.reprEquivₛ R N).symm).toModuleIsoₛ⟩

name: mk_dual
statement: theorem mk_dual : Pic.mk R (Dual R M) = (Pic.mk R M)⁻¹
proof:
:=
  congr_arg (equivShrink _) <| Units.ext <| by
    rw [Pic.mk, Equiv.toFun_as_coe, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    exact Quotient.sound ⟨(Finite.reprEquivₛ R _ ≪≫ₗ (Finite.reprEquivₛ R _).dualMap).toModuleIsoₛ⟩

name: inv_eq_dual
statement: theorem inv_eq_dual (M : Pic R) : M⁻¹ = Pic.mk R (Dual R M)

name: mul_eq_tensor
statement: theorem mul_eq_tensor (M N : Pic R) : M * N = Pic.mk R (M ⊗[R] N)

name: subsingleton_iff
statement:
theorem subsingleton_iffₛ : Subsingleton (Pic R) ↔
    ∀ (M : Type u) [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M], Module.Invertible R M → Free R M
proof:
:=
  .trans ⟨fun _ M _ _ _ ↦ Subsingleton.elim ..,
      fun h ↦ ⟨fun M N ↦ by rw [← mk_eq_self (M := M), ← mk_eq_self (M := N), h, h]⟩⟩ <|
    forall₄_congr fun _ _ _ _ ↦ mk_eq_one_iff_free

name: subsingleton_iff
statement:
theorem subsingleton_iff {R : Type u} [CommRing R] : Subsingleton (Pic R) ↔
    ∀ (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M], Module.Invertible R M → Free R M
proof:
:=
  subsingleton_iffₛ.trans
    ⟨fun h M ↦ h M, fun h M ↦ let _ := @Module.addCommMonoidToAddCommGroup R; h M⟩

name: mapAlgebra_mapAlgebra

name: mapAlgebra_comp_mapAlgebra

name: mapAlgebra_self

name: mapRingHom_algebraMap

name: relPic_eq_top
statement: theorem relPic_eq_top [Subsingleton (Pic A)] : relPic R A = ⊤
proof:

  top_unique fun _ _ ↦ Subsingleton.elim ..

name: tensorProductComm_eq_refl
statement: theorem tensorProductComm_eq_refl : TensorProduct.comm R M M = .refl ..
proof:
:= by
  let f (P : Ideal R) [P.IsMaximal] := LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap P.primeCompl M
  let ff (P : Ideal R) [P.IsMaximal] := TensorProduct.map (f P) (f P)
  refine LinearEquiv.toLinearMap_injective <| LinearMap.eq_of_localization_maximal _ ff _ ff _ _
    fun P _ ↦ .trans (b := (TensorProduct.comm ..).toLinearMap) ?_ ?_
  · apply IsLocalizedModule.linearMap_ext P.primeCompl (ff P) (ff P)
    ext; exact IsLocalizedModule.map_apply _ (ff P) ..
  let Rp := Localization P.primeCompl
  have ⟨e⟩ := free_iff_linearEquiv.mp (inferInstance : Free Rp (LocalizedModule P.primeCompl M))
  have e := e.restrictScalars R
  ext x y
  refine (congr e e ≪≫ₗ equivOfCompatibleSMul Rp ..).injective ?_
  suffices e y ⊗ₜ[Rp] e x = e x ⊗ₜ e y by simpa [equivOfCompatibleSMul]
  conv_lhs => rw [← mul_one (e y), ← smul_eq_mul, smul_tmul, smul_eq_mul,
    mul_comm, ← smul_eq_mul, ← smul_tmul, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: tmul_comm
statement: theorem tmul_comm {m₁ m₂ : M} : m₁ ⊗ₜ[R] m₂ = m₂ ⊗ₜ m₁
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.congr_fun (tensorProductComm_eq_refl ..) (m₂ ⊗ₜ m₁)

name: projective_units_and_mul'_comp_lTensor_bijective
statement:
private theorem projective_units_and_mul'_comp_lTensor_bijective (I : (Submodule R A)ˣ) :
    Projective R I ∧ Function.Bijective (mul' R A ∘ₗ I.1.subtype.lTensor A)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, T', hT, hT', one_mem⟩ := mem_span_mul_finite_of_mem_mul (I.inv_mul ▸ one_le.mp le_rfl)
  classical
  rw [← Set.image2_mul, ← Finset.coe_image₂, mem_span_finset] at one_mem
  set S := T.image₂ (· * ·) T'
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := one_mem
  choose a ha b hb eq using fun i : S ↦ Finset.mem_image₂.mp i.2
  let f : I →ₗ[R] S → R := .pi fun i ↦ (LinearEquiv.ofInjective
      (Algebra.linearMap R A) (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective R A)).symm.comp <|
    restrict (mulRight R (r i • a i)) fun x hx ↦ by
      rw [← one_eq_range, ← I.mul_inv]; exact mul_mem_mul hx (I⁻¹.1.smul_mem _ <| hT <| ha i)
  have hf (x : I.1) (i : S) : algebraMap R A (f x i) = x * r i • a i := by
    dsimp [f, ← Algebra.linearMap_apply]
    exact LinearEquiv.ofInjective_symm_apply ..
  let g : (S → R) →ₗ[R] I := .lsum _ _ ℕ fun i ↦ .toSpanSingleton _ _ ⟨b i, hT' <| hb i⟩
  have hgf : g ∘ₗ f = .id := LinearMap.ext fun x ↦ Subtype.ext <| by
    simp only [g, lsum_apply, comp_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply, toSpanSingleton_apply, proj_apply]
    simp_rw [coe_sum, coe_smul, Algebra.smul_def, hf, mul_assoc, ← Finset.mul_sum,
      Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, eq, (Finset.sum_coe_sort ..).trans hr.2, mul_one, id_apply]
  set m := mul' R A ∘ₗ I.1.subtype.lTensor A
  have eq : (piScalarRight R R A S).toLinearMap ∘ₗ f.lTensor A =
      (.pi fun i : S ↦ mulRight R (r i • a i)) ∘ₗ m := by
    ext; simp [(Algebra.smul_def ..).trans (Algebra.commutes ..), hf, m, mul_assoc]
  have := (piScalarRight R R A S).injective.comp <| injective_of_comp_eq_id
    (f.lTensor A) (g.lTensor A) <| by rw [← lTensor_comp, hgf, lTensor_id]
  rw [← LinearEquiv.coe_toLinearMap, ← coe_comp, eq, coe_comp] at this
  refine ⟨.of_split f g hgf, .of_comp this, range_eq_top.mp ?_⟩
  rw [show m = mulMap ⊤ I ∘ₗ (topEquiv.symm.rTensor I.1).toLinearMap by ext; rfl, range_comp,
    LinearEquiv.range, map_top, mulMap_range, top_mul_eq_top_of_mul_eq_one I.inv_mul]

name: projective_of_isUnit
statement: theorem projective_of_isUnit {I : Submodule R A} (hI : IsUnit I) : Projective R I
proof:
:=
  projective_units hI.unit

name: ker_unitsToPic
statement:
theorem ker_unitsToPic :
    (unitsToPic R A).ker = (Units.map (spanSingleton R).toMonoidHom).range
proof:
:= by
  ext I; constructor <;> intro h
  · have e := (mk_eq_one_iff.mp h).some.symm
    have e' := (mk_eq_one_iff.mp (inv_mem h)).some.symm
    have h := eq_span_singleton_of_surjective e.surjective
    have h' := eq_span_singleton_of_surjective e'.surjective
    refine ⟨(isUnit_iff_exists_and_exists.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩).unit, Units.ext h.symm⟩
    · have : span R {(e 1).1 * e' 1} = 1 := by simpa [span_mul_span] using congr($h * $h').symm
      have ⟨r, hr⟩ := span_singleton_eq_one_iff.mp this
      exact ⟨e' 1 * algebraMap R A r.inv, by simp [← mul_assoc, hr, ← map_mul]⟩
    · have : span R {(e' 1).1 * e 1} = 1 := by simpa [span_mul_span] using congr($h' * $h).symm
      have ⟨r, hr⟩ := span_singleton_eq_one_iff.mp this
      exact ⟨algebraMap R A r.inv * e' 1, by simp [mul_assoc, hr, ← map_mul]⟩
  · obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := h
    exact mk_eq_one_iff.mpr ⟨.symm <| (.ofInjective (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton R A x) fun _ _ eq ↦
      (faithfulSMul_iff_injective_smul_one R A).mp ‹_› <| by simpa using congr($eq * x.inv)) ≪≫ₗ
      .ofEq _ _ (by ext; simp [mem_span_singleton])⟩

name: mulExact_unitsMap_spanSingleton_unitsToPic
statement:
theorem mulExact_unitsMap_spanSingleton_unitsToPic :
    Function.MulExact (Units.map (spanSingleton R).toMonoidHom) (unitsToPic R A)
proof:
:=
  MonoidHom.mulExact_iff.mpr (ker_unitsToPic R A)

name: toAlgebra_injective
statement: theorem toAlgebra_injective : Function.Injective (toAlgebra e)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [toAlgebra] using
    Flat.rTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap _ (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective R A)

name: top_mul_submoduleAlgebra
statement: theorem top_mul_submoduleAlgebra : ⊤ * submoduleAlgebra e = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Submodule.mulMap_range]
  convert!
    (Submodule.topEquiv.rTensor _ ≪≫ₗ (tensorSubmoduleAlgebraEquiv e).restrictScalars R).range
  ext; rfl

name: Submodule.range_unitsToPic
statement: theorem Submodule.range_unitsToPic : (unitsToPic R A).range = relPic R A
proof:
:= by
  ext M; constructor <;> intro h
  · obtain ⟨I, rfl⟩ := h
    exact mk_eq_one_iff.mpr ⟨AlgebraTensorModule.congr (.refl ..) (unitsToPicEquiv I) ≪≫ₗ
      .ofBijective ((Algebra.TensorProduct.lmul'' R).toLinearMap ∘ₗ AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor A A
        I.1.subtype) (projective_units_and_mul'_comp_lTensor_bijective I).2⟩
  have e := (mk_eq_one_iff.mp h).some
  have f := (mk_eq_one_iff.mp (inv_mem h)).some
  refine ⟨(isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_left (x := submoduleAlgebra e) (y := submoduleAlgebra f) ?_).unit,
    mk_eq_iff.mpr ⟨submoduleAlgebraEquiv e⟩⟩
  have := eq_span_singleton_of_surjective <| LinearEquiv.surjective <|
    (congr (submoduleAlgebraEquiv e) (submoduleAlgebraEquiv f) ≪≫ₗ
    (mk_eq_one_iff.mp <| by simp_rw [mk_tensor, mk_eq_self, mul_inv_cancel]).some).symm ≪≫ₗ
    tensorSubmoduleAlgebraEquivMul f (submoduleAlgebra e)
  rw [this]
  apply_fun (⊤ * ·) at this
  simp_rw [← mul_assoc, top_mul_submoduleAlgebra] at this
  obtain ⟨a, -, eq⟩ := mem_mul_span_singleton.mp (this ▸ mem_top (x := 1))
  exact .map (spanSingleton R).toMonoidHom (.of_mul_eq_one_right _ eq)

name: Submodule.mulExact_unitsToPic_mapAlgebra
statement:
theorem Submodule.mulExact_unitsToPic_mapAlgebra :
    Function.MulExact (unitsToPic R A) (mapAlgebra R A)
proof:
:=
  MonoidHom.mulExact_iff.mpr (range_unitsToPic R A).symm

name: Module.Invertible.exists_linearEquiv_ideal
statement:
theorem Module.Invertible.exists_linearEquiv_ideal [Subsingleton (Pic (FractionRing R))] :
    ∃ I : Ideal R, Nonempty (M ≃ₗ[R] I)
proof:
:=
  have : Pic.mk R M ∈ relPic R (FractionRing R) := Subsingleton.elim ..
  have ⟨I, eq⟩ := Submodule.range_unitsToPic R (FractionRing R) ▸ this
  have ⟨e⟩ := mk_eq_mk_iff.mp eq.symm
  ⟨_, ⟨e ≪≫ₗ FractionalIdeal.equivNumOfIsLocalization
    ⟨_, I.submodule_isFractional (S := nonZeroDivisors R)⟩⟩⟩

name: Ideal.eq_top_of_mk_tensor_eq_one
statement:
theorem Ideal.eq_top_of_mk_tensor_eq_one [IsFractionRing R R] (I J : Ideal R)
    [Module.Invertible R I] [Module.Invertible R J] (h : Pic.mk R (I ⊗[R] J) = 1) :
    I = ⊤ ∧ J = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨e⟩ := mk_eq_one_iff.mp h
  have e := e.symm ≪≫ₗ Submodule.LinearDisjoint.mulMap
    (.of_left_le_one_of_flat I J <| le_top.trans one_eq_top.ge)
  have : IsUnit (e 1 : R) := IsFractionRing.self_iff_nonZeroDivisors_le_isUnit.mp ‹_› <|
      IsRegular.mem_nonZeroDivisors <| isRightRegular_iff_isRegular.mp <| by
    rw [IsRightRegular]
    convert! Subtype.val_injective.comp e.injective using 2
    rw [← smul_eq_mul, ← Submodule.coe_smul, ← map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, Function.comp_apply]
  constructor <;> refine eq_top_of_isUnit_mem _ ?_ this
  exacts [mul_le_left (e 1).2, mul_le_right (e 1).2]

name: eq_smul_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson
statement:
@[stacks 00DV "(2)"]
theorem eq_smul_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson {I J : Ideal R} {N : Submodule R M} (hN : N.FG)
    (hIN : N ≤ I • N) (hIjac : I ≤ jacobson J) : N = J • N
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (Submodule.smul_le.2 fun _ _ _ => Submodule.smul_mem _ _)
  intro n hn
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Submodule.exists_sub_one_mem_and_smul_eq_zero_of_fg_of_le_smul I N hN hIN
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := exists_mul_sub_mem_of_sub_one_mem_jacobson r (hIjac hr.1)
  have : n = -(s * r - 1) • n := by
    rw [neg_sub, sub_smul, mul_smul, hr.2 n hn, one_smul, smul_zero, sub_zero]
  rw [this]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem_smul (Submodule.neg_mem _ hs) hn

name: eq_bot_of_eq_ideal_smul_of_le_jacobson_annihilator
proof:
:=
  (eq_smul_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson hN hIN.le hIjac).trans N.annihilator_smul

name: eq_bot_of_eq_pointwise_smul_of_mem_jacobson_annihilator
proof:
:=
  eq_bot_of_eq_ideal_smul_of_le_jacobson_annihilator hN
    (Eq.trans hrN (ideal_span_singleton_smul r N).symm)
    ((span_singleton_le_iff_mem r _).mpr hrJac)

name: eq_bot_of_set_smul_eq_of_subset_jacobson_annihilator
proof:
:=
  eq_bot_of_eq_ideal_smul_of_le_jacobson_annihilator hN
    (Eq.trans hsN (span_smul_eq s N).symm) (span_le.mpr hsJac)

name: top_ne_ideal_smul_of_le_jacobson_annihilator
statement:
lemma top_ne_ideal_smul_of_le_jacobson_annihilator [Nontrivial M]
    [Module.Finite R M] {I} (h : I ≤ (Module.annihilator R M).jacobson) :
    (⊤ : Submodule R M) ≠ I • ⊤
proof:
:= fun H => top_ne_bot <|
  eq_bot_of_eq_ideal_smul_of_le_jacobson_annihilator Module.Finite.fg_top H <|
    (congrArg (I ≤ Ideal.jacobson ·) annihilator_top).mpr h

name: top_ne_set_smul_of_subset_jacobson_annihilator
statement:
lemma top_ne_set_smul_of_subset_jacobson_annihilator [Nontrivial M]
    [Module.Finite R M] {s : Set R}
    (h : s ⊆ (Module.annihilator R M).jacobson) :
    (⊤ : Submodule R M) ≠ s • ⊤
proof:
:=
  ne_of_ne_of_eq (top_ne_ideal_smul_of_le_jacobson_annihilator (span_le.mpr h))
    (span_smul_eq _ _)

name: top_ne_pointwise_smul_of_mem_jacobson_annihilator
statement:
lemma top_ne_pointwise_smul_of_mem_jacobson_annihilator [Nontrivial M]
    [Module.Finite R M] {r} (h : r ∈ (Module.annihilator R M).jacobson) :
    (⊤ : Submodule R M) ≠ r • ⊤
proof:
:=
  ne_of_ne_of_eq (top_ne_set_smul_of_subset_jacobson_annihilator <|
                    Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr h) (singleton_set_smul ⊤ r)

name: eq_bot_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson_bot
statement:
@[stacks 00DV "(2)"]
theorem eq_bot_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson_bot (I : Ideal R) (N : Submodule R M) (hN : N.FG)
    (hIN : N ≤ I • N) (hIjac : I ≤ jacobson ⊥) : N = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_smul_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson hN hIN hIjac, Submodule.bot_smul]

name: sup_eq_sup_smul_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson
statement:
theorem sup_eq_sup_smul_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson {I J : Ideal R} {N N' : Submodule R M}
    (hN' : N'.FG) (hIJ : I ≤ jacobson J) (hNN : N' ≤ N ⊔ I • N') : N ⊔ N' = N ⊔ J • N'
proof:
:= by
  have hNN' : N ⊔ N' = N ⊔ I • N' :=
    le_antisymm (sup_le le_sup_left hNN)
    (sup_le_sup_left (Submodule.smul_le.2 fun _ _ _ => Submodule.smul_mem _ _) _)
  have h_comap :=
    comap_injective_of_surjective (LinearMap.range_eq_top.1 N.range_mkQ)
  have : (I • N').map N.mkQ = N'.map N.mkQ := by
    simpa only [← h_comap.eq_iff, comap_map_mkQ, sup_comm, eq_comm] using hNN'
  have :=
    @Submodule.eq_smul_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson _ _ _ _ _ I J (N'.map N.mkQ) (hN'.map _)
      (by rw [← map_smul'', this]) hIJ
  rwa [← map_smul'', ← h_comap.eq_iff, comap_map_eq, comap_map_eq, Submodule.ker_mkQ, sup_comm,
    sup_comm (b := N)] at this

name: sup_smul_eq_sup_smul_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson
proof:
:=
  ((sup_le_sup_left smul_le_right _).antisymm (sup_le le_sup_left hNN)).trans
    (sup_eq_sup_smul_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson hN' hIJ hNN)

name: le_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson_bot
statement:
theorem le_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson_bot {R M} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    {I : Ideal R} {N N' : Submodule R M} (hN' : N'.FG)
    (hIJ : I ≤ jacobson ⊥) (hNN : N' ≤ N ⊔ I • N') : N' ≤ N
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sup_eq_left, sup_eq_sup_smul_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson hN' hIJ hNN, bot_smul, sup_bot_eq]

name: smul_le_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson_bot
statement:
@[stacks 00DV "(4)"]
theorem smul_le_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson_bot {I : Ideal R} {N N' : Submodule R M} (hN' : N'.FG)
    (hIJ : I ≤ jacobson ⊥) (hNN : N' ≤ N ⊔ I • N') : I • N' ≤ N
proof:
:=
  smul_le_right.trans (le_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson_bot hN' hIJ hNN)

name: exists_sub_one_mem_and_smul_le_of_fg_of_le_sup
statement:
@[stacks 00DV "(3) see `Submodule.localized₀_le_localized₀_of_smul_le` for the second conclusion."]
lemma exists_sub_one_mem_and_smul_le_of_fg_of_le_sup {I : Ideal R}
    {N N' P : Submodule R M} (hN' : N'.FG) (hN'le : N' ≤ P) (hNN' : P ≤ N ⊔ I • N') :
    ∃ r : R, r - 1 ∈ I ∧ r • P ≤ N
proof:
:= by
  have hNN'' : P ≤ N ⊔ N' := le_trans hNN' (by simpa using le_trans smul_le_right le_sup_right)
  have h1 : P.map N.mkQ = N'.map N.mkQ := by
    refine le_antisymm ?_ (map_mono hN'le)
    simpa using map_mono (f := N.mkQ) hNN''
  have h2 : P.map N.mkQ = (I • N').map N.mkQ := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · simpa using map_mono (f := N.mkQ) hNN'
    · rw [h1]
      simp [smul_le_right]
  have hle : (P.map N.mkQ) ≤ I • P.map N.mkQ := by
    conv_lhs => rw [h2]
    simp [← h1]
  obtain ⟨r, hmem, hr⟩ := exists_sub_one_mem_and_smul_eq_zero_of_fg_of_le_smul I _
    (h1 ▸ hN'.map _) hle
  refine ⟨r, hmem, fun x hx ↦ ?_⟩
  induction hx using Submodule.smul_inductionOn_pointwise with
  | smul₀ p hp =>
    rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, Quotient.mk_smul]
    exact hr _ ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
  | smul₁ _ _ _ h => exact N.smul_mem _ h
  | add _ _ _ _ hx hy => exact N.add_mem hx hy
  | zero => exact N.zero_mem

name: le_of_map_mkQ_le_map_mkQ_of_le_jacobson_bot
statement:
lemma le_of_map_mkQ_le_map_mkQ_of_le_jacobson_bot
    {I : Ideal R} {N N' : Submodule R M} (hN : N.FG) (hIjac : I ≤ jacobson ⊥)
    (hmaple : map (I • N).mkQ N ≤ map (I • N).mkQ N') : N ≤ N'
proof:
:= by
  apply le_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson_bot hN hIjac
  apply_fun comap (I • N).mkQ at hmaple
  on_goal 2 => apply Submodule.comap_mono
  simp only [comap_map_mkQ, smul_le_right, sup_of_le_right] at hmaple
  grw [sup_comm, ← hmaple]

name: eq_of_map_mkQ_eq_map_mkQ_of_le_jacobson_bot
statement:
lemma eq_of_map_mkQ_eq_map_mkQ_of_le_jacobson_bot
    {I : Ideal R} {N N' : Submodule R M} (hN : N.FG) (hIjac : I ≤ jacobson ⊥)
    (hmaple : map (I • N).mkQ N = map (I • N).mkQ N') : N = N'
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact le_of_map_mkQ_le_map_mkQ_of_le_jacobson_bot hN hIjac hmaple.le
  · apply_fun comap (I • N).mkQ at hmaple
    simp only [comap_map_mkQ, smul_le_right, sup_of_le_right] at hmaple
    rw [hmaple]; apply le_sup_right

name: exists_injOn_mkQ_image_span_eq_of_span_eq_map_mkQ_of_le_jacobson_bot
statement:
@[stacks 00DV "(8)"]
theorem exists_injOn_mkQ_image_span_eq_of_span_eq_map_mkQ_of_le_jacobson_bot
    {I : Ideal R} {N : Submodule R M} (s : Set (M ⧸ (I • N)))
    (hN : N.FG) (hIjac : I ≤ jacobson ⊥) (hsspan : span R s = map (I • N).mkQ N) :
    ∃ (t : Set M), t.InjOn (I • N).mkQ ∧ (I • N).mkQ '' t = s ∧ span R t = N
proof:
:= by
  use Quotient.out '' s
  split_ands
  · simp [Set.InjOn]
  · simp [Set.image_image]
  · symm; apply eq_of_map_mkQ_eq_map_mkQ_of_le_jacobson_bot hN hIjac
    simp [← hsspan, map_span, Set.image_image]

name: LinearMap.surjective_of_surjective_comp_mkQ
statement:
lemma LinearMap.surjective_of_surjective_comp_mkQ {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]
    [Module.Finite R N] (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (I : Ideal R) (Ile : I ≤ (⊥ : Ideal R).jacobson)
    (surj : Function.Surjective ((I • (⊤ : Submodule R N)).mkQ ∘ₗ f)) : Function.Surjective f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.range_eq_top, ← top_le_iff]
  apply Submodule.le_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson_bot (Module.finite_def.mp ‹_›) Ile
  rw [top_le_iff, sup_comm, ← Submodule.map_mkQ_eq_top, ← LinearMap.range_comp]
  exact LinearMap.range_eq_top_of_surjective _ surj

name: emultiplicity_eq_top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem emultiplicity_eq_top :
    emultiplicity a b = ⊤ ↔ ¬FiniteMultiplicity a b
proof:
:= by
  simp [emultiplicity]

name: emultiplicity_lt_top
statement: theorem emultiplicity_lt_top {a b : α} : emultiplicity a b < ⊤ ↔ FiniteMultiplicity a b
proof:
:= by
  simp [lt_top_iff_ne_top, emultiplicity_eq_top]

name: finiteMultiplicity_iff_emultiplicity_ne_top
statement:
theorem finiteMultiplicity_iff_emultiplicity_ne_top :
    FiniteMultiplicity a b ↔ emultiplicity a b ≠ ⊤
proof: := by simp

name: finiteMultiplicity_of_emultiplicity_eq_natCast
statement:
theorem finiteMultiplicity_of_emultiplicity_eq_natCast {n : ℕ} (h : emultiplicity a b = n) :
    FiniteMultiplicity a b
proof:
:= by
  by_contra nh
  rw [← emultiplicity_eq_top, h] at nh
  trivial

name: multiplicity_eq_of_emultiplicity_eq_some
statement:
theorem multiplicity_eq_of_emultiplicity_eq_some {n : ℕ} (h : emultiplicity a b = n) :
    multiplicity a b = n
proof:
:= by
  simp [multiplicity, h]

name: emultiplicity_ne_of_multiplicity_ne
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_ne_of_multiplicity_ne {n : ℕ} :
    multiplicity a b ≠ n → emultiplicity a b ≠ n
proof:
:=
  mt multiplicity_eq_of_emultiplicity_eq_some

name: FiniteMultiplicity.emultiplicity_eq_multiplicity
statement:
theorem FiniteMultiplicity.emultiplicity_eq_multiplicity (h : FiniteMultiplicity a b) :
    emultiplicity a b = multiplicity a b
proof:
:= by
  cases hm : emultiplicity a b
  · simp [h] at hm
  rw [multiplicity_eq_of_emultiplicity_eq_some hm]

name: FiniteMultiplicity.emultiplicity_eq_iff_multiplicity_eq
statement:
theorem FiniteMultiplicity.emultiplicity_eq_iff_multiplicity_eq {n : ℕ}
    (h : FiniteMultiplicity a b) : emultiplicity a b = n ↔ multiplicity a b = n
proof:
:= by
  simp [h.emultiplicity_eq_multiplicity]

name: emultiplicity_eq_iff_multiplicity_eq_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_eq_iff_multiplicity_eq_of_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (h : n ≠ 0) :
    emultiplicity a b = n ↔ multiplicity a b = n
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact multiplicity_eq_of_emultiplicity_eq_some
  · intro h₂
    rwa [multiplicity, ENat.toNat_eq_iff h] at h₂

name: emultiplicity_eq_zero_iff_multiplicity_eq_zero
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_eq_zero_iff_multiplicity_eq_zero (h : FiniteMultiplicity a b) :
    emultiplicity a b = 0 ↔ multiplicity a b = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.emultiplicity_eq_multiplicity, cast_eq_zero]

name: multiplicity_eq_zero_of_not_finiteMultiplicity
statement:
@[simp]
theorem multiplicity_eq_zero_of_not_finiteMultiplicity (h : ¬FiniteMultiplicity a b) :
    multiplicity a b = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [multiplicity, emultiplicity_eq_top.mpr h]
  decide

name: multiplicity_le_emultiplicity
statement:
@[simp]
theorem multiplicity_le_emultiplicity :
    multiplicity a b ≤ emultiplicity a b
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : FiniteMultiplicity a b
  · simp [hf.emultiplicity_eq_multiplicity]
  · simp [hf, emultiplicity_eq_top.2]

name: multiplicity_eq_of_emultiplicity_eq
statement:
theorem multiplicity_eq_of_emultiplicity_eq {c d : β}
    (h : emultiplicity a b = emultiplicity c d) : multiplicity a b = multiplicity c d
proof:
:= by
  unfold multiplicity
  rw [h]

name: multiplicity_le_of_emultiplicity_le
statement:
theorem multiplicity_le_of_emultiplicity_le {n : ℕ} (h : emultiplicity a b ≤ n) :
    multiplicity a b ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  exact_mod_cast multiplicity_le_emultiplicity.trans h

name: FiniteMultiplicity.emultiplicity_le_of_multiplicity_le
statement:
theorem FiniteMultiplicity.emultiplicity_le_of_multiplicity_le (hfin : FiniteMultiplicity a b)
    {n : ℕ} (h : multiplicity a b ≤ n) : emultiplicity a b ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [emultiplicity_eq_multiplicity hfin]
  assumption_mod_cast

name: le_emultiplicity_of_le_multiplicity
statement:
theorem le_emultiplicity_of_le_multiplicity {n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ multiplicity a b) :
    n ≤ emultiplicity a b
proof:
:= by
  exact_mod_cast (WithTop.coe_mono h).trans multiplicity_le_emultiplicity

name: FiniteMultiplicity.le_multiplicity_of_le_emultiplicity
statement:
theorem FiniteMultiplicity.le_multiplicity_of_le_emultiplicity (hfin : FiniteMultiplicity a b)
    {n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ emultiplicity a b) : n ≤ multiplicity a b
proof:
:= by
  rw [emultiplicity_eq_multiplicity hfin] at h
  assumption_mod_cast

name: multiplicity_lt_of_emultiplicity_lt
statement:
theorem multiplicity_lt_of_emultiplicity_lt {n : ℕ} (h : emultiplicity a b < n) :
    multiplicity a b < n
proof:
:= by
  exact_mod_cast multiplicity_le_emultiplicity.trans_lt h

name: FiniteMultiplicity.emultiplicity_lt_of_multiplicity_lt
statement:
theorem FiniteMultiplicity.emultiplicity_lt_of_multiplicity_lt (hfin : FiniteMultiplicity a b)
    {n : ℕ} (h : multiplicity a b < n) : emultiplicity a b < n
proof:
:= by
  rw [emultiplicity_eq_multiplicity hfin]
  assumption_mod_cast

name: lt_emultiplicity_of_lt_multiplicity
statement:
theorem lt_emultiplicity_of_lt_multiplicity {n : ℕ} (h : n < multiplicity a b) :
    n < emultiplicity a b
proof:
:= by
  exact_mod_cast (WithTop.coe_strictMono h).trans_le multiplicity_le_emultiplicity

name: FiniteMultiplicity.lt_multiplicity_of_lt_emultiplicity
statement:
theorem FiniteMultiplicity.lt_multiplicity_of_lt_emultiplicity (hfin : FiniteMultiplicity a b)
    {n : ℕ} (h : n < emultiplicity a b) : n < multiplicity a b
proof:
:= by
  rw [emultiplicity_eq_multiplicity hfin] at h
  assumption_mod_cast

name: emultiplicity_pos_iff
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_pos_iff (h : FiniteMultiplicity a b) :
    0 < emultiplicity a b ↔ 0 < multiplicity a b
proof:
:= by
  simp [pos_iff_ne_zero, pos_iff_ne_zero, emultiplicity_eq_zero_iff_multiplicity_eq_zero h]

name: FiniteMultiplicity.def
statement: theorem FiniteMultiplicity.def : FiniteMultiplicity a b ↔ ∃ n : ℕ, ¬a ^ (n + 1) ∣ b
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: FiniteMultiplicity.not_dvd_of_one_right
statement: theorem FiniteMultiplicity.not_dvd_of_one_right : FiniteMultiplicity a 1 → ¬a ∣ 1
proof:
:=
  fun ⟨n, hn⟩ ⟨d, hd⟩ => hn ⟨d ^ (n + 1), (pow_mul_pow_eq_one (n + 1) hd.symm).symm⟩

name: Int.natCast_emultiplicity
statement:
@[norm_cast]
theorem Int.natCast_emultiplicity (a b : ℕ) :
    emultiplicity (a : ℤ) (b : ℤ) = emultiplicity a b
proof:
:= by
  unfold emultiplicity FiniteMultiplicity
  congr! <;> norm_cast

name: Int.natCast_multiplicity
statement:
@[norm_cast]
theorem Int.natCast_multiplicity (a b : ℕ) : multiplicity (a : ℤ) (b : ℤ) = multiplicity a b
proof:
:=
  multiplicity_eq_of_emultiplicity_eq (natCast_emultiplicity a b)

name: FiniteMultiplicity.not_iff_forall
statement: theorem FiniteMultiplicity.not_iff_forall : ¬FiniteMultiplicity a b ↔ ∀ n : ℕ, a ^ n ∣ b
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h n =>
    Nat.casesOn n
      (by
        rw [_root_.pow_zero]
        exact one_dvd _)
      (by simpa [FiniteMultiplicity] using h),
    by simp [FiniteMultiplicity]; tauto⟩

name: FiniteMultiplicity.not_isUnit
statement: theorem FiniteMultiplicity.not_isUnit (h : FiniteMultiplicity a b) : ¬IsUnit a
proof:
:=
  let ⟨n, hn⟩ := h
  hn ∘ IsUnit.dvd ∘ IsUnit.pow (n + 1)

name: FiniteMultiplicity.mul_left
statement:
theorem FiniteMultiplicity.mul_left {c : α} :
    FiniteMultiplicity a (b * c) → FiniteMultiplicity a b
proof:
:= fun ⟨n, hn⟩ =>
  ⟨n, fun h => hn (h.trans (dvd_mul_right _ _))⟩

name: pow_dvd_of_le_emultiplicity
statement:
theorem pow_dvd_of_le_emultiplicity {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ emultiplicity a b) :
    a ^ k ∣ b
proof:
:= by classical
  cases k
  · simp
  unfold emultiplicity at hk
  split at hk
  · norm_cast at hk
    simpa using (Nat.find_min _ (lt_of_succ_le hk))
  · apply FiniteMultiplicity.not_iff_forall.mp ‹_›

name: pow_dvd_of_le_multiplicity
statement:
theorem pow_dvd_of_le_multiplicity {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ multiplicity a b) :
    a ^ k ∣ b
proof: := pow_dvd_of_le_emultiplicity (le_emultiplicity_of_le_multiplicity hk)

name: pow_multiplicity_dvd
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pow_multiplicity_dvd (a b : α) : a ^ (multiplicity a b) ∣ b
proof:
:=
  pow_dvd_of_le_multiplicity le_rfl

name: not_pow_dvd_of_emultiplicity_lt
statement:
theorem not_pow_dvd_of_emultiplicity_lt {m : ℕ} (hm : emultiplicity a b < m) :
    ¬a ^ m ∣ b
proof:
:= fun nh => by
  unfold emultiplicity at hm
  split at hm
  · simp only [ENat.natCast_lt_natCast, find_lt_iff] at hm
    obtain ⟨n, hn1, hn2⟩ := hm
    exact hn2 ((pow_dvd_pow _ hn1).trans nh)
  · simp at hm

name: FiniteMultiplicity.not_pow_dvd_of_multiplicity_lt
statement:
theorem FiniteMultiplicity.not_pow_dvd_of_multiplicity_lt (hf : FiniteMultiplicity a b) {m : ℕ}
    (hm : multiplicity a b < m) : ¬a ^ m ∣ b
proof:
:= by
  apply not_pow_dvd_of_emultiplicity_lt
  rw [hf.emultiplicity_eq_multiplicity]
  norm_cast

name: multiplicity_pos_of_dvd
statement:
theorem multiplicity_pos_of_dvd (hdiv : a ∣ b) (h : FiniteMultiplicity a b) :
    0 < multiplicity a b
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! hdiv
  simpa using h.not_pow_dvd_of_multiplicity_lt (m := 1) (by simpa using hdiv)

name: emultiplicity_pos_of_dvd
statement: theorem emultiplicity_pos_of_dvd (hdiv : a ∣ b) : 0 < emultiplicity a b
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! hdiv
  simpa using not_pow_dvd_of_emultiplicity_lt (m := 1) (by simpa using hdiv)

name: emultiplicity_eq_of_dvd_of_not_dvd
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_eq_of_dvd_of_not_dvd {k : ℕ} (hk : a ^ k ∣ b) (hsucc : ¬a ^ (k + 1) ∣ b) :
    emultiplicity a b = k
proof:
:= by classical
  have : FiniteMultiplicity a b := ⟨k, hsucc⟩
  simp only [emultiplicity, this, ↓reduceDIte, Nat.cast_inj, find_eq_iff, hsucc, not_false_eq_true,
    Decidable.not_not, true_and]
  exact fun n hn ↦ (pow_dvd_pow _ hn).trans hk

name: multiplicity_eq_of_dvd_of_not_dvd
statement:
theorem multiplicity_eq_of_dvd_of_not_dvd {k : ℕ} (hk : a ^ k ∣ b) (hsucc : ¬a ^ (k + 1) ∣ b) :
    multiplicity a b = k
proof:
:=
  multiplicity_eq_of_emultiplicity_eq_some (emultiplicity_eq_of_dvd_of_not_dvd hk hsucc)

name: le_emultiplicity_of_pow_dvd
statement:
theorem le_emultiplicity_of_pow_dvd {k : ℕ} (hk : a ^ k ∣ b) :
    k ≤ emultiplicity a b
proof:
:=
  le_of_not_gt fun hk' => not_pow_dvd_of_emultiplicity_lt hk' hk

name: FiniteMultiplicity.le_multiplicity_of_pow_dvd
statement:
theorem FiniteMultiplicity.le_multiplicity_of_pow_dvd (hf : FiniteMultiplicity a b)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : a ^ k ∣ b) : k ≤ multiplicity a b
proof:
:=
  hf.le_multiplicity_of_le_emultiplicity (le_emultiplicity_of_pow_dvd hk)

name: pow_dvd_iff_le_emultiplicity
statement:
theorem pow_dvd_iff_le_emultiplicity {k : ℕ} :
    a ^ k ∣ b ↔ k ≤ emultiplicity a b
proof:
:=
  ⟨le_emultiplicity_of_pow_dvd, pow_dvd_of_le_emultiplicity⟩

name: FiniteMultiplicity.pow_dvd_iff_le_multiplicity
statement:
theorem FiniteMultiplicity.pow_dvd_iff_le_multiplicity (hf : FiniteMultiplicity a b) {k : ℕ} :
    a ^ k ∣ b ↔ k ≤ multiplicity a b
proof:
:= by
  exact_mod_cast hf.emultiplicity_eq_multiplicity ▸ pow_dvd_iff_le_emultiplicity

name: emultiplicity_lt_iff_not_dvd
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_lt_iff_not_dvd {k : ℕ} :
    emultiplicity a b < k ↔ ¬a ^ k ∣ b
proof: := by rw [pow_dvd_iff_le_emultiplicity, not_le]

name: FiniteMultiplicity.multiplicity_lt_iff_not_dvd
statement:
theorem FiniteMultiplicity.multiplicity_lt_iff_not_dvd {k : ℕ} (hf : FiniteMultiplicity a b) :
    multiplicity a b < k ↔ ¬a ^ k ∣ b
proof: := by rw [hf.pow_dvd_iff_le_multiplicity, not_le]

name: emultiplicity_eq_coe
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_eq_coe {n : ℕ} :
    emultiplicity a b = n ↔ a ^ n ∣ b ∧ ¬a ^ (n + 1) ∣ b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    constructor
    · apply pow_dvd_of_le_emultiplicity
      simp [h]
    · apply not_pow_dvd_of_emultiplicity_lt
      rw [h]
      norm_cast
      simp
  · rw [and_imp]
    apply emultiplicity_eq_of_dvd_of_not_dvd

name: FiniteMultiplicity.multiplicity_eq_iff
statement:
theorem FiniteMultiplicity.multiplicity_eq_iff (hf : FiniteMultiplicity a b) {n : ℕ} :
    multiplicity a b = n ↔ a ^ n ∣ b ∧ ¬a ^ (n + 1) ∣ b
proof:
:= by
  simp [← emultiplicity_eq_coe, hf.emultiplicity_eq_multiplicity]

name: emultiplicity_eq_ofNat
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_eq_ofNat {a b n : ℕ} [n.AtLeastTwo] :
    emultiplicity a b = (ofNat(n) : ℕ∞) ↔ a ^ ofNat(n) ∣ b ∧ ¬a ^ (ofNat(n) + 1) ∣ b
proof:
:=
  emultiplicity_eq_coe

name: FiniteMultiplicity.not_of_isUnit_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem FiniteMultiplicity.not_of_isUnit_left (b : α) (ha : IsUnit a) : ¬FiniteMultiplicity a b
proof:
:=
  (·.not_isUnit ha)

name: FiniteMultiplicity.not_of_one_left
statement: theorem FiniteMultiplicity.not_of_one_left (b : α) : ¬ FiniteMultiplicity 1 b
proof: := by simp

name: emultiplicity_one_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem emultiplicity_one_left (b : α) : emultiplicity 1 b = ⊤
proof:
:=
  emultiplicity_eq_top.2 (FiniteMultiplicity.not_of_one_left _)

name: FiniteMultiplicity.one_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem FiniteMultiplicity.one_right (ha : FiniteMultiplicity a 1) : multiplicity a 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [ha.multiplicity_eq_iff, ha.not_dvd_of_one_right]

name: FiniteMultiplicity.not_of_unit_left
statement: theorem FiniteMultiplicity.not_of_unit_left (a : α) (u : αˣ) : ¬ FiniteMultiplicity (u : α) a
proof:
:=
  FiniteMultiplicity.not_of_isUnit_left a u.isUnit

name: emultiplicity_eq_zero
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_eq_zero :
    emultiplicity a b = 0 ↔ ¬a ∣ b
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : FiniteMultiplicity a b
  · rw [← ENat.natCast_zero, emultiplicity_eq_coe]
    simp
  · simpa [emultiplicity_eq_top.2 hf] using FiniteMultiplicity.not_iff_forall.1 hf 1

name: emultiplicity_eq_zero_of_irreducible_ne
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_eq_zero_of_irreducible_ne {R : Type*} [CommMonoidWithZero R]
    [Subsingleton Rˣ] {a b : R} (ha : Irreducible a) (hb : Irreducible b) (h : a ≠ b) :
    emultiplicity a b = 0
proof:
:=
  emultiplicity_eq_zero.2 ((ha.dvd_irreducible_iff_associated hb).not.2 fun ⟨u, _⟩ ↦ by
    simp_all [Subsingleton.elim u 1])

name: multiplicity_eq_zero
statement:
theorem multiplicity_eq_zero (h : FiniteMultiplicity a b) :
    multiplicity a b = 0 ↔ ¬a ∣ b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← emultiplicity_eq_zero_iff_multiplicity_eq_zero h, emultiplicity_eq_zero]

name: multiplicity_eq_zero_of_not_dvd
statement: theorem multiplicity_eq_zero_of_not_dvd (h : ¬ a ∣ b) : multiplicity a b = 0
proof:
:=
  multiplicity_eq_of_emultiplicity_eq_some (emultiplicity_eq_zero.mpr h)

name: emultiplicity_ne_zero
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_ne_zero :
    emultiplicity a b ≠ 0 ↔ a ∣ b
proof:
:= by
  simp [emultiplicity_eq_zero]

name: multiplicity_ne_zero
statement:
theorem multiplicity_ne_zero (h : FiniteMultiplicity a b) :
    multiplicity a b ≠ 0 ↔ a ∣ b
proof:
:= by
  simp [multiplicity_eq_zero h]

name: FiniteMultiplicity.exists_eq_pow_mul_and_not_dvd
statement:
theorem FiniteMultiplicity.exists_eq_pow_mul_and_not_dvd (hfin : FiniteMultiplicity a b) :
    ∃ c : α, b = a ^ multiplicity a b * c ∧ ¬a ∣ c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := pow_multiplicity_dvd a b
  refine ⟨c, hc, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
  rw [hk, ← mul_assoc, ← _root_.pow_succ] at hc
  have h₁ : a ^ (multiplicity a b + 1) ∣ b := ⟨k, hc⟩
  exact (hfin.multiplicity_eq_iff.1 (by simp)).2 h₁

name: emultiplicity_le_emultiplicity_iff
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_le_emultiplicity_iff {c d : β} :
    emultiplicity a b ≤ emultiplicity c d ↔ ∀ n : ℕ, a ^ n ∣ b → c ^ n ∣ d
proof:
:= by classical
  constructor
  · exact fun h n hab ↦ pow_dvd_of_le_emultiplicity (le_trans (le_emultiplicity_of_pow_dvd hab) h)
  · intro h
    unfold emultiplicity
    
    split
    next h_1 =>
      obtain ⟨w, h_1⟩ := h_1
      split
      next h_2 =>
        simp_all only [ENat.natCast_le_natCast, le_find_iff, lt_find_iff, Decidable.not_not, le_rfl,
          not_true_eq_false, not_false_eq_true, implies_true]
      next h_2 => simp_all only [not_exists, Decidable.not_not, le_top]
    next h_1 =>
      simp_all only [not_exists, Decidable.not_not, not_true_eq_false, top_le_iff,
        dite_eq_right_iff, ENat.natCast_ne_top, imp_false, not_false_eq_true, implies_true]

name: FiniteMultiplicity.multiplicity_le_multiplicity_iff
statement:
theorem FiniteMultiplicity.multiplicity_le_multiplicity_iff {c d : β} (hab : FiniteMultiplicity a b)
    (hcd : FiniteMultiplicity c d) :
    multiplicity a b ≤ multiplicity c d ↔ ∀ n : ℕ, a ^ n ∣ b → c ^ n ∣ d
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ENat.natCast_le_natCast, ← hab.emultiplicity_eq_multiplicity,
    ← hcd.emultiplicity_eq_multiplicity, emultiplicity_le_emultiplicity_iff]

name: emultiplicity_eq_emultiplicity_iff
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_eq_emultiplicity_iff {c d : β} :
    emultiplicity a b = emultiplicity c d ↔ ∀ n : ℕ, a ^ n ∣ b ↔ c ^ n ∣ d
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h n =>
    ⟨emultiplicity_le_emultiplicity_iff.1 h.le n, emultiplicity_le_emultiplicity_iff.1 h.ge n⟩,
    fun h => le_antisymm (emultiplicity_le_emultiplicity_iff.2 fun n => (h n).mp)
      (emultiplicity_le_emultiplicity_iff.2 fun n => (h n).mpr)⟩

name: le_emultiplicity_map
statement:
theorem le_emultiplicity_map {F : Type*} [FunLike F α β] [MonoidHomClass F α β]
    (f : F) {a b : α} :
    emultiplicity a b ≤ emultiplicity (f a) (f b)
proof:
:=
  emultiplicity_le_emultiplicity_iff.2 fun n ↦ by rw [← map_pow]; exact map_dvd f

name: emultiplicity_map_eq
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_map_eq {F : Type*} [EquivLike F α β] [MulEquivClass F α β]
    (f : F) {a b : α} : emultiplicity (f a) (f b) = emultiplicity a b
proof:
:= by
  simp [emultiplicity_eq_emultiplicity_iff, ← map_pow, map_dvd_iff]

name: multiplicity_map_eq
statement:
theorem multiplicity_map_eq {F : Type*} [EquivLike F α β] [MulEquivClass F α β]
    (f : F) {a b : α} : multiplicity (f a) (f b) = multiplicity a b
proof:
:=
  multiplicity_eq_of_emultiplicity_eq (emultiplicity_map_eq f)

name: emultiplicity_le_emultiplicity_of_dvd_right
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_le_emultiplicity_of_dvd_right {a b c : α} (h : b ∣ c) :
    emultiplicity a b ≤ emultiplicity a c
proof:
:=
  emultiplicity_le_emultiplicity_iff.2 fun _ hb => hb.trans h

name: emultiplicity_eq_of_associated_right
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_eq_of_associated_right {a b c : α} (h : Associated b c) :
    emultiplicity a b = emultiplicity a c
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (emultiplicity_le_emultiplicity_of_dvd_right h.dvd)
    (emultiplicity_le_emultiplicity_of_dvd_right h.symm.dvd)

name: multiplicity_eq_of_associated_right
statement:
theorem multiplicity_eq_of_associated_right {a b c : α} (h : Associated b c) :
    multiplicity a b = multiplicity a c
proof:
:=
  multiplicity_eq_of_emultiplicity_eq (emultiplicity_eq_of_associated_right h)

name: dvd_of_emultiplicity_pos
statement: theorem dvd_of_emultiplicity_pos {a b : α} (h : 0 < emultiplicity a b) : a ∣ b
proof:
:=
  pow_one a ▸ pow_dvd_of_le_emultiplicity (Order.add_one_le_of_lt h)

name: dvd_of_multiplicity_pos
statement: theorem dvd_of_multiplicity_pos {a b : α} (h : 0 < multiplicity a b) : a ∣ b
proof:
:=
  dvd_of_emultiplicity_pos (lt_emultiplicity_of_lt_multiplicity h)

name: dvd_iff_multiplicity_pos
statement:
theorem dvd_iff_multiplicity_pos {a b : α} (h : FiniteMultiplicity a b) :
    0 < multiplicity a b ↔ a ∣ b
proof:
:= by
  rw [pos_iff_ne_zero, multiplicity_ne_zero h]

name: dvd_iff_emultiplicity_pos
statement: theorem dvd_iff_emultiplicity_pos {a b : α} : 0 < emultiplicity a b ↔ a ∣ b
proof:
:= by
  rw [pos_iff_ne_zero, emultiplicity_ne_zero]

name: Nat.finiteMultiplicity_iff
statement: theorem Nat.finiteMultiplicity_iff {a b : ℕ} : FiniteMultiplicity a b ↔ a ≠ 1 ∧ 0 < b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← not_iff_not, FiniteMultiplicity.not_iff_forall, not_and_or, not_ne_iff, not_lt,
    Nat.le_zero]
  exact
    ⟨fun h =>
      or_iff_not_imp_right.2 fun hb =>
        have ha : a ≠ 0 := fun ha => hb <| zero_dvd_iff.mp <| by rw [ha] at h; exact h 1
        Classical.by_contradiction fun ha1 : a ≠ 1 =>
          have ha_gt_one : 1 < a :=
            lt_of_not_ge fun _ =>
              match a with
              | 0 => ha rfl
              | 1 => ha1 rfl
              | b+2 => by lia
          not_lt_of_ge (le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hb) (h b)) (b.lt_pow_self ha_gt_one),
      fun h => by cases h <;> simp [*]⟩

name: FiniteMultiplicity.mul_right
statement:
theorem FiniteMultiplicity.mul_right {a b c : α} (hf : FiniteMultiplicity a (b * c)) :
    FiniteMultiplicity a c
proof: := (mul_comm b c ▸ hf).mul_left

name: emultiplicity_of_isUnit_right
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_of_isUnit_right {a b : α} (ha : ¬IsUnit a)
    (hb : IsUnit b) : emultiplicity a b = 0
proof:
:=
  emultiplicity_eq_zero.mpr fun h ↦ ha (isUnit_of_dvd_unit h hb)

name: multiplicity_of_isUnit_right
statement:
theorem multiplicity_of_isUnit_right {a b : α} (ha : ¬IsUnit a)
    (hb : IsUnit b) : multiplicity a b = 0
proof:
:=
  multiplicity_eq_of_emultiplicity_eq_some (emultiplicity_of_isUnit_right ha hb)

name: emultiplicity_of_one_right
statement: theorem emultiplicity_of_one_right {a : α} (ha : ¬IsUnit a) : emultiplicity a 1 = 0
proof:
:=
  emultiplicity_of_isUnit_right ha isUnit_one

name: multiplicity_of_one_right
statement: theorem multiplicity_of_one_right {a : α} (ha : ¬IsUnit a) : multiplicity a 1 = 0
proof:
:=
  multiplicity_of_isUnit_right ha isUnit_one

name: emultiplicity_of_unit_right
statement: theorem emultiplicity_of_unit_right {a : α} (ha : ¬IsUnit a) (u : αˣ) : emultiplicity a u = 0
proof:
:=
  emultiplicity_of_isUnit_right ha u.isUnit

name: multiplicity_of_unit_right
statement: theorem multiplicity_of_unit_right {a : α} (ha : ¬IsUnit a) (u : αˣ) : multiplicity a u = 0
proof:
:=
  multiplicity_of_isUnit_right ha u.isUnit

name: emultiplicity_le_emultiplicity_of_dvd_left
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_le_emultiplicity_of_dvd_left {a b c : α} (hdvd : a ∣ b) :
    emultiplicity b c ≤ emultiplicity a c
proof:
:=
  emultiplicity_le_emultiplicity_iff.2 fun n h => (pow_dvd_pow_of_dvd hdvd n).trans h

name: emultiplicity_eq_of_associated_left
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_eq_of_associated_left {a b c : α} (h : Associated a b) :
    emultiplicity b c = emultiplicity a c
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (emultiplicity_le_emultiplicity_of_dvd_left h.dvd)
    (emultiplicity_le_emultiplicity_of_dvd_left h.symm.dvd)

name: multiplicity_eq_of_associated_left
statement:
theorem multiplicity_eq_of_associated_left {a b c : α} (h : Associated a b) :
    multiplicity b c = multiplicity a c
proof:
:=
  multiplicity_eq_of_emultiplicity_eq (emultiplicity_eq_of_associated_left h)

name: emultiplicity_mk_eq_emultiplicity
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_mk_eq_emultiplicity {a b : α} :
    emultiplicity (Associates.mk a) (Associates.mk b) = emultiplicity a b
proof:
:= by
  simp [emultiplicity_eq_emultiplicity_iff, ← Associates.mk_pow, Associates.mk_dvd_mk]

name: FiniteMultiplicity.ne_zero
statement: theorem FiniteMultiplicity.ne_zero {a b : α} (h : FiniteMultiplicity a b) : b ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  let ⟨n, hn⟩ := h
  fun hb => by simp [hb] at hn

name: emultiplicity_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem emultiplicity_zero (a : α) : emultiplicity a 0 = ⊤
proof:
:=
  emultiplicity_eq_top.2 (fun v ↦ v.ne_zero rfl)

name: multiplicity_zero
statement: theorem multiplicity_zero (a : α) : multiplicity a 0 = 0
proof:
:=
  multiplicity_eq_zero_of_not_finiteMultiplicity fun h ↦ h.ne_zero rfl

name: emultiplicity_zero_eq_zero_of_ne_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem emultiplicity_zero_eq_zero_of_ne_zero (a : α) (ha : a ≠ 0) : emultiplicity 0 a = 0
proof:
:=
  emultiplicity_eq_zero.2 <| mt zero_dvd_iff.1 ha

name: multiplicity_zero_eq_zero_of_ne_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem multiplicity_zero_eq_zero_of_ne_zero (a : α) (ha : a ≠ 0) : multiplicity 0 a = 0
proof:
:=
  multiplicity_eq_of_emultiplicity_eq_some (emultiplicity_zero_eq_zero_of_ne_zero a ha)

name: FiniteMultiplicity.or_of_add
statement:
theorem FiniteMultiplicity.or_of_add {p a b : α} (hf : FiniteMultiplicity p (a + b)) :
    FiniteMultiplicity p a ∨ FiniteMultiplicity p b
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! nh
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hf
  simp_all [dvd_add]

name: min_le_emultiplicity_add
statement:
theorem min_le_emultiplicity_add {p a b : α} :
    min (emultiplicity p a) (emultiplicity p b) ≤ emultiplicity p (a + b)
proof:
:= by
  cases hm : min (emultiplicity p a) (emultiplicity p b)
  · simp only [top_le_iff, min_eq_top, emultiplicity_eq_top] at hm ⊢
    contrapose hm
    simp only [not_and_or, not_not] at hm ⊢
    exact hm.or_of_add
  · apply le_emultiplicity_of_pow_dvd
    simp [dvd_add, pow_dvd_of_le_emultiplicity, ← hm]

name: FiniteMultiplicity.neg_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem FiniteMultiplicity.neg_iff {a b : α} :
    FiniteMultiplicity a (-b) ↔ FiniteMultiplicity a b
proof:
:= by
  unfold FiniteMultiplicity
  congr! 3
  simp only [dvd_neg]

name: emultiplicity_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem emultiplicity_neg (a b : α) : emultiplicity a (-b) = emultiplicity a b
proof:
:= by
  rw [emultiplicity_eq_emultiplicity_iff]
  simp

name: multiplicity_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem multiplicity_neg (a b : α) : multiplicity a (-b) = multiplicity a b
proof:
:=
  multiplicity_eq_of_emultiplicity_eq (emultiplicity_neg a b)

name: Int.emultiplicity_natAbs
statement:
theorem Int.emultiplicity_natAbs (a : ℕ) (b : ℤ) :
    emultiplicity a b.natAbs = emultiplicity (a : ℤ) b
proof:
:= by
  rcases Int.natAbs_eq b with h | h <;> conv_rhs => rw [h]
  · rw [Int.natCast_emultiplicity]
  · rw [emultiplicity_neg, Int.natCast_emultiplicity]

name: Int.multiplicity_natAbs
statement:
theorem Int.multiplicity_natAbs (a : ℕ) (b : ℤ) :
    multiplicity a b.natAbs = multiplicity (a : ℤ) b
proof:
:=
  multiplicity_eq_of_emultiplicity_eq (Int.emultiplicity_natAbs a b)

name: emultiplicity_add_of_gt
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_add_of_gt {p a b : α} (h : emultiplicity p b < emultiplicity p a) :
    emultiplicity p (a + b) = emultiplicity p b
proof:
:= by
  have : FiniteMultiplicity p b := finiteMultiplicity_iff_emultiplicity_ne_top.2 (by simp [·] at h)
  rw [this.emultiplicity_eq_multiplicity] at *
  apply emultiplicity_eq_of_dvd_of_not_dvd
  · apply dvd_add
    · apply pow_dvd_of_le_emultiplicity
      exact h.le
    · simp
  · rw [dvd_add_right]
    · apply this.not_pow_dvd_of_multiplicity_lt
      simp
    apply pow_dvd_of_le_emultiplicity
    exact Order.add_one_le_of_lt h

name: FiniteMultiplicity.multiplicity_add_of_gt
statement:
theorem FiniteMultiplicity.multiplicity_add_of_gt {p a b : α} (hf : FiniteMultiplicity p b)
    (h : multiplicity p b < multiplicity p a) :
    multiplicity p (a + b) = multiplicity p b
proof:
:=
  multiplicity_eq_of_emultiplicity_eq <| emultiplicity_add_of_gt (hf.emultiplicity_eq_multiplicity ▸
      (WithTop.coe_strictMono h).trans_le multiplicity_le_emultiplicity)

name: emultiplicity_sub_of_gt
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_sub_of_gt {p a b : α} (h : emultiplicity p b < emultiplicity p a) :
    emultiplicity p (a - b) = emultiplicity p b
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, emultiplicity_add_of_gt] <;> rw [emultiplicity_neg]; assumption

name: multiplicity_sub_of_gt
statement:
theorem multiplicity_sub_of_gt {p a b : α} (h : multiplicity p b < multiplicity p a)
    (hfin : FiniteMultiplicity p b) : multiplicity p (a - b) = multiplicity p b
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, hfin.neg.multiplicity_add_of_gt] <;> rw [multiplicity_neg]; assumption

name: emultiplicity_add_eq_min
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy (emultiplicity p a) (emultiplicity p b) with (hab | _ | hab)
  · rw [add_comm, emultiplicity_add_of_gt hab, min_eq_left]
    exact le_of_lt hab
  · contradiction
  · rw [emultiplicity_add_of_gt hab, min_eq_right]
    exact le_of_lt hab

name: multiplicity_add_eq_min
statement:
theorem multiplicity_add_eq_min {p a b : α} (ha : FiniteMultiplicity p a)
    (hb : FiniteMultiplicity p b) (h : multiplicity p a ≠ multiplicity p b) :
    multiplicity p (a + b) = min (multiplicity p a) (multiplicity p b)
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy (multiplicity p a) (multiplicity p b) with (hab | _ | hab)
  · rw [add_comm, ha.multiplicity_add_of_gt hab, min_eq_left]
    exact le_of_lt hab
  · contradiction
  · rw [hb.multiplicity_add_of_gt hab, min_eq_right]
    exact le_of_lt hab

name: finiteMultiplicity_mul_aux
statement:
theorem finiteMultiplicity_mul_aux {p : α} (hp : Prime p) {a b : α} :
    ∀ {n m : ℕ}, ¬p ^ (n + 1) ∣ a → ¬p ^ (m + 1) ∣ b → ¬p ^ (n + m + 1) ∣ a * b
  | n, m => fun ha hb ⟨s, hs⟩ =>
    have : p ∣ a * b
proof:
:= ⟨p ^ (n + m) * s, by simp [hs, pow_add, mul_comm, mul_left_comm]⟩
    (hp.2.2 a b this).elim
      (fun ⟨x, hx⟩ =>
        have hn0 : 0 < n :=
          Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun hn0 => by simp [hx, hn0] at ha
        have hpx : ¬p ^ (n - 1 + 1) ∣ x := fun ⟨y, hy⟩ =>
          ha (hx.symm ▸ ⟨y, mul_right_cancel₀ hp.1 <| by
            rw [tsub_add_cancel_of_le (succ_le_of_lt hn0)] at hy
            simp [hy, pow_add, mul_comm, mul_left_comm]⟩)
        have : 1 ≤ n + m := le_trans hn0 (Nat.le_add_right n m)
        finiteMultiplicity_mul_aux hp hpx hb
          ⟨s, mul_right_cancel₀ hp.1 (by
                rw [tsub_add_eq_add_tsub (succ_le_of_lt hn0), tsub_add_cancel_of_le this]
                simp_all [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, pow_add])⟩)
      fun ⟨x, hx⟩ =>
        have hm0 : 0 < m :=
          Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun hm0 => by simp [hx, hm0] at hb
        have hpx : ¬p ^ (m - 1 + 1) ∣ x := fun ⟨y, hy⟩ =>
          hb
            (hx.symm ▸
              ⟨y,
                mul_right_cancel₀ hp.1 <| by
                  rw [tsub_add_cancel_of_le (succ_le_of_lt hm0)] at hy
                  simp [hy, pow_add, mul_comm, mul_left_comm]⟩)
        finiteMultiplicity_mul_aux hp ha hpx
        ⟨s, mul_right_cancel₀ hp.1 (by
              rw [add_assoc, tsub_add_cancel_of_le (succ_le_of_lt hm0)]
              simp_all [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, pow_add])⟩

name: Prime.finiteMultiplicity_mul
statement:
theorem Prime.finiteMultiplicity_mul {p a b : α} (hp : Prime p) :
    FiniteMultiplicity p a → FiniteMultiplicity p b → FiniteMultiplicity p (a * b)
proof:
:=
  fun ⟨n, hn⟩ ⟨m, hm⟩ => ⟨n + m, finiteMultiplicity_mul_aux hp hn hm⟩

name: FiniteMultiplicity.mul_iff
statement:
theorem FiniteMultiplicity.mul_iff {p a b : α} (hp : Prime p) :
    FiniteMultiplicity p (a * b) ↔ FiniteMultiplicity p a ∧ FiniteMultiplicity p b
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => ⟨h.mul_left, h.mul_right⟩, fun h =>
    hp.finiteMultiplicity_mul h.1 h.2⟩

name: FiniteMultiplicity.pow
statement:
theorem FiniteMultiplicity.pow {p a : α} (hp : Prime p)
    (hfin : FiniteMultiplicity p a) {k : ℕ} : FiniteMultiplicity p (a ^ k)
proof:
:=
  match k, hfin with
  | 0, _ => ⟨0, by simp [mt isUnit_iff_dvd_one.2 hp.2.1]⟩
  | k + 1, ha => by rw [_root_.pow_succ']; exact hp.finiteMultiplicity_mul ha (ha.pow hp)

name: multiplicity_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem multiplicity_self {a : α} (ha : FiniteMultiplicity a a) : multiplicity a a = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [ha.multiplicity_eq_iff]
  simp only [pow_one, dvd_refl, reduceAdd, true_and]
  rintro ⟨v, hv⟩
  nth_rw 1 [← mul_one a] at hv
  simp only [sq, mul_assoc, mul_eq_mul_left_iff] at hv
  obtain hv | rfl := hv
  · have : IsUnit a := .of_mul_eq_one v hv.symm
    simpa [this] using ha.not_isUnit
  · simpa using ha.ne_zero

name: FiniteMultiplicity.emultiplicity_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem FiniteMultiplicity.emultiplicity_self {a : α} (hfin : FiniteMultiplicity a a) :
    emultiplicity a a = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [hfin, emultiplicity_eq_multiplicity]

name: multiplicity_mul
statement:
theorem multiplicity_mul {p a b : α} (hp : Prime p) (hfin : FiniteMultiplicity p (a * b)) :
    multiplicity p (a * b) = multiplicity p a + multiplicity p b
proof:
:= by
  have hdiva : p ^ multiplicity p a ∣ a := pow_multiplicity_dvd ..
  have hdivb : p ^ multiplicity p b ∣ b := pow_multiplicity_dvd ..
  have hdiv : p ^ (multiplicity p a + multiplicity p b) ∣ a * b := by
    rw [pow_add]; gcongr
  have hsucc : ¬p ^ (multiplicity p a + multiplicity p b + 1) ∣ a * b :=
    fun h =>
    not_or_intro (hfin.mul_left.not_pow_dvd_of_multiplicity_lt (lt_succ_self _))
      (hfin.mul_right.not_pow_dvd_of_multiplicity_lt (lt_succ_self _))
      (_root_.succ_dvd_or_succ_dvd_of_succ_sum_dvd_mul hp hdiva hdivb h)
  rw [hfin.multiplicity_eq_iff]
  exact ⟨hdiv, hsucc⟩

name: emultiplicity_mul
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_mul {p a b : α} (hp : Prime p) :
    emultiplicity p (a * b) = emultiplicity p a + emultiplicity p b
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hfin : FiniteMultiplicity p (a * b)
  · rw [hfin.emultiplicity_eq_multiplicity, hfin.mul_left.emultiplicity_eq_multiplicity,
      hfin.mul_right.emultiplicity_eq_multiplicity]
    norm_cast
    exact multiplicity_mul hp hfin
  · rw [emultiplicity_eq_top.mpr hfin, eq_comm, ENat.add_eq_top, emultiplicity_eq_top,
      emultiplicity_eq_top]
    simpa only [FiniteMultiplicity.mul_iff hp, not_and_or] using hfin

name: Finset.emultiplicity_prod
statement:
theorem Finset.emultiplicity_prod {β : Type*} {p : α} (hp : Prime p) (s : Finset β) (f : β → α) :
    emultiplicity p (∏ x ∈ s, f x) = ∑ x ∈ s, emultiplicity p (f x)
proof:
:= by classical
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty =>
    simp only [Finset.sum_empty, Finset.prod_empty]
    exact emultiplicity_of_one_right hp.not_isUnit
  | insert a s has ih => simpa [has, ← ih] using emultiplicity_mul hp

name: emultiplicity_pow
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_pow {p a : α} (hp : Prime p) {k : ℕ} :
    emultiplicity p (a ^ k) = k * emultiplicity p a
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [emultiplicity_of_one_right hp.not_isUnit]
  | succ k hk => simp [pow_succ, emultiplicity_mul hp, hk, add_mul]

name: FiniteMultiplicity.multiplicity_pow
statement:
protected theorem FiniteMultiplicity.multiplicity_pow {p a : α} (hp : Prime p)
    (ha : FiniteMultiplicity p a) {k : ℕ} : multiplicity p (a ^ k) = k * multiplicity p a
proof:
:= by
  exact_mod_cast (ha.pow hp).emultiplicity_eq_multiplicity ▸
    ha.emultiplicity_eq_multiplicity ▸ emultiplicity_pow hp

name: emultiplicity_pow_self
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_pow_self {p : α} (h0 : p ≠ 0) (hu : ¬IsUnit p) (n : ℕ) :
    emultiplicity p (p ^ n) = n
proof:
:= by
  apply emultiplicity_eq_of_dvd_of_not_dvd
  · rfl
  · rw [pow_dvd_pow_iff h0 hu]
    apply Nat.not_succ_le_self

name: multiplicity_pow_self
statement:
theorem multiplicity_pow_self {p : α} (h0 : p ≠ 0) (hu : ¬IsUnit p) (n : ℕ) :
    multiplicity p (p ^ n) = n
proof:
:=
  multiplicity_eq_of_emultiplicity_eq_some (emultiplicity_pow_self h0 hu n)

name: emultiplicity_pow_self_of_prime

name: multiplicity_pow_self_of_prime
statement:

proof:

  multiplicity_pow_self hp.ne_zero hp.not_isUnit n

name: multiplicity_eq_zero_of_coprime
statement:
theorem multiplicity_eq_zero_of_coprime {p a b : ℕ} (hp : p ≠ 1)
    (hle : multiplicity p a ≤ multiplicity p b) (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) : multiplicity p a = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos
  intro nh
  have ha : FiniteMultiplicity p a := by grind [multiplicity_eq_zero_of_not_finiteMultiplicity]
  have hb : FiniteMultiplicity p b := by grind [multiplicity_eq_zero_of_not_finiteMultiplicity]
  have da : p ∣ a := by simpa [multiplicity_eq_zero ha] using nh.ne.symm
  have db : p ∣ b := by simpa [multiplicity_eq_zero hb] using (nh.trans_le hle).ne.symm
  have := Nat.dvd_gcd da db
  rw [Coprime.gcd_eq_one hab, Nat.dvd_one] at this
  exact hp this

name: of.injective_of_degree_ne_zero
statement:
theorem of.injective_of_degree_ne_zero [IsDomain R] (hf : f.degree ≠ 0) :
    Function.Injective (AdjoinRoot.of f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro p hp
  rw [AdjoinRoot.of, RingHom.comp_apply, AdjoinRoot.mk_eq_zero] at hp
  by_cases h : f = 0
  · exact C_eq_zero.mp (eq_zero_of_zero_dvd (by rwa [h] at hp))
  · contrapose! hf with h_contra
    rw [← degree_C h_contra]
    apply le_antisymm (degree_le_of_dvd hp (by rwa [Ne, C_eq_zero])) _
    rwa [degree_C h_contra, zero_le_degree_iff]

proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro r hr; by_contra ne_zero
  exact mk_ne_zero_of_degree_lt monic (C_ne_zero.mpr ne_zero) (degree_C ne_zero ▸ deg) hr

    of.injective_of_monic_of_degree_pos monic deg

name: map_of
statement:
@[simp] lemma map_of (f : R →+* S) (p : R[X]) (q : S[X]) (h) (r : R) :
    map f p q h (of p r) = f r
proof: := by simp [map]

name: map_root
statement: @[simp] lemma map_root (f : R →+* S) (p : R[X]) (q : S[X]) (h) : map f p q h (root p) = root q
proof:
:= by
  simp [map]

name: map_comp_map
statement:
lemma map_comp_map (f : R →+* S) (g : S →+* T) (p : R[X]) (q : S[X]) (r : T[X]) (hf hg) :
    (map g q r hg).comp (map f p q hf) =
      map (g.comp f) p r
        (hg.trans <| by simpa [Polynomial.map_map] using Polynomial.map_dvd g hf)
proof: := by ext <;> simp

name: coe_mapRingEquiv
statement:
@[simp] lemma coe_mapRingEquiv (f : R ≃+* S) (p : R[X]) (q : S[X]) (h) :
    ⇑(mapRingEquiv f p q h) = map f p q h.symm.dvd
proof: := rfl

name: symm_mapRingEquiv
statement:
@[simp] lemma symm_mapRingEquiv (f : R ≃+* S) (p : R[X]) (q : S[X]) (h) :
    (mapRingEquiv f p q h).symm = mapRingEquiv f.symm q p (by
      simpa [Polynomial.map_map] using associated_map_map f.symm.toRingHom h.symm)
proof: := rfl

name: coe_mapAlgHom
statement:
@[simp] lemma coe_mapAlgHom (f : S →ₐ[R] T) (p : S[X]) (q : T[X]) (h) :
    ⇑(mapAlgHom f p q h) = map f p q h
proof: := rfl

name: mapAlgHom_comp_mapAlghom
statement:
lemma mapAlgHom_comp_mapAlghom (f : S →ₐ[R] T) (g : T →ₐ[R] U) (p : S[X]) (q : T[X]) (r : U[X])
    (hf hg) :
    (mapAlgHom g q r hg).comp (mapAlgHom f p q hf) =
      mapAlgHom (g.comp f) p r
        (hg.trans <| by simpa [Polynomial.map_map] using! Polynomial.map_dvd g.toRingHom hf)
proof:
:= by
  aesop

name: coe_mapAlgEquiv
statement:
@[simp] lemma coe_mapAlgEquiv (f : S ≃ₐ[R] T) (p : S[X]) (q : T[X]) (h) :
    ⇑(mapAlgEquiv f p q h) = map f p q h.symm.dvd
proof: := rfl

name: symm_mapAlgEquiv
statement:
@[simp] lemma symm_mapAlgEquiv (f : S ≃ₐ[R] T) (p : S[X]) (q : T[X]) (h) :
    (mapAlgEquiv f p q h).symm = mapAlgEquiv f.symm q p (by
      
      have : (RingHomClass.toRingHom f.toRingEquiv.symm).comp (RingHomClass.toRingHom f) =
        .id S := by ext; exact f.symm_apply_apply _
      simpa [Polynomial.map_map, -RingEquiv.symm_mk, this]
        using! associated_map_map f.symm.toRingHom h.symm)
proof: := rfl

name: coe_algHomOfDvd

name: minpoly_root
statement: theorem minpoly_root (hf : f ≠ 0) : minpoly K (root f) = f * C f.leadingCoeff⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have f'_monic : Monic _ := monic_mul_leadingCoeff_inv hf
  refine (minpoly.unique K _ f'_monic ?_ ?_).symm
  · rw [map_mul, aeval_eq, mk_self, zero_mul]
  intro q q_monic q_aeval
  have commutes : (lift (algebraMap K (AdjoinRoot f)) (root f) q_aeval).comp (mk q) = mk f := by
    ext
    · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, mk_C, lift_of]
      rfl
    · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, mk_X, lift_root]
  rw [degree_eq_natDegree f'_monic.ne_zero, degree_eq_natDegree q_monic.ne_zero,
    Nat.cast_le, natDegree_mul hf, natDegree_C, add_zero]
  · apply natDegree_le_of_dvd
    · have : mk f q = 0 := by rw [← commutes, RingHom.comp_apply, mk_self, map_zero]
      exact mk_eq_zero.1 this
    · exact q_monic.ne_zero
  · rwa [Ne, C_eq_zero, inv_eq_zero, leadingCoeff_eq_zero]

name: minpoly_powerBasis_gen
statement:
theorem minpoly_powerBasis_gen (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    minpoly K (powerBasis hf).gen = f * C f.leadingCoeff⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [powerBasis_gen, minpoly_root hf]

name: minpoly_powerBasis_gen_of_monic
statement:
theorem minpoly_powerBasis_gen_of_monic (hf : f.Monic) (hf' : f ≠ 0 := hf.ne_zero) :
    minpoly K (powerBasis hf').gen = f
proof:
:= by
  rw [minpoly_powerBasis_gen hf', hf.leadingCoeff, inv_one, C.map_one, mul_one]

name: _root_.finrank_quotient_span_eq_natDegree
statement:
theorem _root_.finrank_quotient_span_eq_natDegree {f : K[X]} :
    Module.finrank K (K[X] ⧸ Ideal.span {f}) = f.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : f = 0
  · rw [hf, natDegree_zero,
      ((Submodule.quotEquivOfEqBot _ (by simp)).restrictScalars K).finrank_eq]
    exact finrank_of_not_finite Polynomial.not_finite
  rw [PowerBasis.finrank]
  exact AdjoinRoot.powerBasis_dim hf

name: Minpoly.coe_toAdjoin

name: quotientEquivQuotientMinpolyMap_apply_mk

theorem quotientEquivQuotientMinpolyMap_apply_mk (pb : PowerBasis R S) (I : Ideal R) (g : R[X]) :

name: Irreducible.exists_dvd_monic_irreducible_of_isIntegral
proof:
:= by
  have := Fact.mk hf
  have h := hf.ne_zero
  have h2 := isIntegral_trans (R := K) _ (AdjoinRoot.isIntegral_root h)
  have h3 := (AdjoinRoot.minpoly_root h) ▸ minpoly.dvd_map_of_isScalarTower K L (AdjoinRoot.root f)
  exact ⟨_, minpoly.monic h2, minpoly.irreducible h2, dvd_of_mul_right_dvd h3⟩

name: Polynomial.Monic.exists_splits_map.
statement:
lemma Polynomial.Monic.exists_splits_map.{u}
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Nontrivial R] {p : R[X]} (hp : p.Monic) :
    ∃ (S : Type u) (_ : CommRing S) (_ : Algebra R S) (_ : Module.Finite R S) (_ : Module.Free R S)
      (_ : Nontrivial S), (p.map (algebraMap R S)).Splits
proof:
:= by
  induction hn : p.natDegree using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing R with | h n IH =>
  by_cases hpu : IsUnit p
  · obtain rfl := hp.eq_one_of_isUnit hpu
    exact ⟨R, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, by simp⟩
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ : X - C (AdjoinRoot.root p) ∣ p.map (algebraMap _ _) := by
    simp [dvd_iff_isRoot, -AdjoinRoot.algebraMap_eq]
  have hqm : q.Monic := .of_mul_monic_left (monic_X_sub_C (.root _)) (hq ▸ hp.map _)
  have := hp.free_adjoinRoot
  have := hp.finite_adjoinRoot
  have : Nontrivial (AdjoinRoot p) := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr (by simpa)
  obtain ⟨S, _, _, _, _, _, hS⟩ := IH _
    (by rw [← hn, ← hp.natDegree_map (algebraMap R (AdjoinRoot p)), hq,
      Monic.natDegree_mul (monic_X_sub_C _) hqm]; simp) hqm rfl
  algebraize [(algebraMap (AdjoinRoot p) S).comp (algebraMap R (AdjoinRoot p))]
  refine ⟨S, ‹_›, ‹_›, .trans (AdjoinRoot p) _, .trans (S := AdjoinRoot p), ‹_›, ?_⟩
  rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R (AdjoinRoot p), ← Polynomial.map_map, hq, Polynomial.map_mul]
  exact .mul (by simp) hS

name: center_eq_top
statement: theorem center_eq_top [Finite D] (hD : InductionHyp D) : Subring.center D = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases nonempty_fintype D
  set Z := Subring.center D
  
  by_contra! hZ
  let : Field Z := hD.field hZ.lt_top
  set q := card Z with card_Z
  have hq : 1 < q := by rw [card_Z]; exact one_lt_card
  let n := finrank Z D
  have card_D : card D = q ^ n := Module.card_eq_pow_finrank
  have h1qn : 1 ≤ q ^ n := by rw [← card_D]; exact card_pos
  
  
  
  have key := Group.card_center_add_sum_card_noncenter_eq_card (Dˣ)
  rw [card_congr (show _ ≃* Zˣ from Subgroup.centerUnitsEquivUnitsCenter D).toEquiv,
      card_units, ← card_Z, card_units, card_D] at key
  
  
  
  let Φₙ := cyclotomic n ℤ
  apply_fun (Nat.cast : ℕ → ℤ) at key
  rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_sub h1qn, Nat.cast_sub hq.le, Nat.cast_one, Nat.cast_pow] at key
  suffices Φₙ.eval ↑q ∣ ↑(∑ x ∈ (ConjClasses.noncenter Dˣ).toFinset, x.carrier.toFinset.card) by
    have contra : Φₙ.eval _ ∣ _ := eval_dvd (cyclotomic.dvd_X_pow_sub_one n ℤ) (x := (q : ℤ))
    rw [eval_sub, eval_X_pow, eval_one, ← key, Int.dvd_add_left this] at contra
    refine (Nat.le_of_dvd ?_ ?_).not_gt (sub_one_lt_natAbs_cyclotomic_eval (n := n) ?_ hq.ne')
    · exact tsub_pos_of_lt hq
    · convert! Int.natAbs_dvd_natAbs.mpr contra
      clear_value q
      simp only [eq_comm, Int.natAbs_eq_iff, Nat.cast_sub hq.le, Nat.cast_one, neg_sub, true_or]
    · by_contra! h
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := finrank_le_one_iff.mp h
      refine not_le_of_gt hZ.lt_top (fun y _ ↦ Subring.mem_center_iff.mpr fun z ↦ ?_)
      obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := hx y
      obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := hx z
      rw [smul_mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_smul_comm, mul_comm]
  rw [Nat.cast_sum]
  apply Finset.dvd_sum
  rintro ⟨x⟩ hx
  simp -zeta only [ConjClasses.quot_mk_eq_mk, Set.mem_toFinset] at hx ⊢
  set Zx := Subring.centralizer ({↑x} : Set D)
  
  
  
  
  
  
  rw [Set.toFinset_card, ConjClasses.card_carrier, ← card_congr
        (show Zxˣ ≃* _ from unitsCentralizerEquiv _ x).toEquiv, card_units, card_D]
  have hZx : Zx ≠ ⊤ := by
    by_contra! hZx
    refine (ConjClasses.mk_bijOn (Dˣ)).mapsTo (Set.subset_center_units ?_) hx
    exact Subring.centralizer_eq_top_iff_subset.mp hZx <| Set.mem_singleton _
  let : Field Zx := hD.field hZx.lt_top
  let : Algebra Z Zx := (Subring.inclusion <| Subring.center_le_centralizer {(x : D)}).toAlgebra
  let d := finrank Z Zx
  have card_Zx : card Zx = q ^ d := Module.card_eq_pow_finrank
  have h1qd : 1 ≤ q ^ d := by rw [← card_Zx]; exact card_pos
  have : IsScalarTower Z Zx D := ⟨fun x y z ↦ mul_assoc _ _ _⟩
  rw [card_units, card_Zx]
  push_cast [h1qd, h1qn]
  apply Int.dvd_div_of_mul_dvd
  have aux : ∀ {k : ℕ}, ((X : ℤ[X]) ^ k - 1).eval ↑q = (q : ℤ) ^ k - 1 := by
    simp only [eval_X, eval_one, eval_pow, eval_sub, forall_const]
  rw [← aux, ← aux, ← eval_mul]
  refine map_dvd (evalRingHom ↑q) (X_pow_sub_one_mul_cyclotomic_dvd_X_pow_sub_one_of_dvd ℤ ?_)
  refine Nat.mem_properDivisors.mpr ⟨⟨_, (finrank_mul_finrank Z Zx D).symm⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [← Nat.pow_lt_pow_iff_right hq, ← card_D, ← card_Zx]
  obtain ⟨b, -, hb⟩ := SetLike.exists_of_lt hZx.lt_top
  refine card_lt_of_injective_of_notMem _ Subtype.val_injective (?_ : b ∉ _)
  rintro ⟨b, rfl⟩
  exact hb b.2

name: center_eq_top
statement: theorem center_eq_top [Finite D] : Subring.center D = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases nonempty_fintype D
  induction hn : Fintype.card D using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing D with | _ n IH
  apply InductionHyp.center_eq_top
  intro R hR x y hx hy
  suffices (⟨y, hy⟩ : R) ∈ Subring.center R by
    rw [Subring.mem_center_iff] at this
    simpa using this ⟨x, hx⟩
  let R_dr : DivisionRing R := Fintype.divisionRingOfIsDomain R
  rw [IH (Fintype.card R) _ R inferInstance rfl]
  · trivial
  rw [← hn, ← Subring.card_top D]
  convert! Set.card_lt_card hR
