  let _ := Fintype.divisionRingOfIsDomain D
  exact Field.toIsField D

name: span_isStandardOpenImmersion_eq_top
statement:
lemma span_isStandardOpenImmersion_eq_top [Algebra.IsLocalIso R S] :
    Ideal.span {g : S | Algebra.IsStandardOpenImmersion R (Localization.Away g)} = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hms⟩ := Ideal.exists_le_maximal _ hne
  obtain ⟨g, hgm, hstd⟩ :=
    Algebra.IsLocalIso.exists_notMem_isStandardOpenImmersion (R := R) m
  exact hgm (hms (Ideal.subset_span hstd))

name: iff_span_isStandardOpenImmersion_eq_top
statement:
lemma iff_span_isStandardOpenImmersion_eq_top :
    IsLocalIso R S ↔
      Ideal.span {g : S | IsStandardOpenImmersion R (Localization.Away g)} = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun _ ↦ span_isStandardOpenImmersion_eq_top R S, fun h ↦ ⟨fun q hq ↦ ?_⟩⟩
  grind [Ideal.IsPrime.ne_top, Ideal.span_le, SetLike.mem_coe]

name: of_span_range_eq_top
statement:
lemma of_span_range_eq_top {ι : Type*} (f : ι → S) (h : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = ⊤)
    (T : ι → Type*) [∀ i, CommSemiring (T i)] [∀ i, Algebra R (T i)] [∀ i, Algebra S (T i)]
    [∀ i, IsScalarTower R S (T i)] [∀ i, IsLocalization.Away (f i) (T i)]
    [∀ i, IsLocalIso R (T i)] : IsLocalIso R S
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun q hq ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, f i ∉ q := by
    rw [← PrimeSpectrum.iSup_basicOpen_eq_top_iff] at h
    have : ⟨q, hq⟩ ∈ ⨆ i, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (f i) := by simp [h]
    simpa using this
  have : ⟨q, hq⟩ ∈ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (f i) := hi
  rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, ← PrimeSpectrum.localization_away_comap_range (T i)] at this
  obtain ⟨q', hq'⟩ := this
  obtain ⟨g', hg', h⟩ := exists_notMem_isStandardOpenImmersion (R := R) q'.1
  obtain ⟨n, g, hg⟩ := IsLocalization.Away.surj (f i) g'
  refine ⟨g * (f i), ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine Ideal.IsPrime.mul_notMem hq ?_ hi
    simp only [PrimeSpectrum.ext_iff, PrimeSpectrum.comap_asIdeal] at hq'
    rwa [← hq', Ideal.mem_comap, ← hg, Ideal.mul_unit_mem_iff_mem]
    exact (IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit (f i)).pow n
  · have : IsLocalization.Away g' (Localization.Away (algebraMap S (T i) g)) := by
      rw [← hg]
      exact .of_associated
        (associated_mul_unit_right _ _ ((IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit (f i)).pow n)).symm
    let e₁ : Localization.Away (algebraMap S (T i) g) ≃ₐ[S] Localization.Away (g * f i) :=
      IsLocalization.algEquiv (.powers (g * f i)) _ _
    let e₂ : Localization.Away g' ≃ₐ[R] Localization.Away (g * f i) :=
      ((IsLocalization.algEquiv (.powers g') _ _).restrictScalars R).trans (e₁.restrictScalars R)
    exact .of_algEquiv e₂

name: of_span_eq_top
statement:
lemma of_span_eq_top {s : Set S} (h : Ideal.span s = ⊤)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ s, IsLocalIso R (Localization.Away x)) : IsLocalIso R S
proof:
:= by
  have heq : Ideal.span (Set.range fun i : s ↦ i.1) = ⊤ := by simpa
  have (i : s) : IsLocalIso R (Localization.Away i.1) := h _ i.property
  exact .of_span_range_eq_top _ heq fun i ↦ Localization.Away i.1

name: pi_of_finite
statement:
lemma pi_of_finite {ι : Type*} (R : Type*) (S : ι → Type*) [CommSemiring R]
    [∀ i, CommRing (S i)] [∀ i, Algebra R (S i)] [Finite ι] [∀ i, IsLocalIso R (S i)] :
    IsLocalIso R (∀ i, S i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let (i : ι) : Algebra (∀ i, S i) (S i) := (Pi.evalAlgHom R S i).toAlgebra
  have (i : ι) : IsLocalization.Away (Pi.single i (1 : S i)) (S i) := by
    apply IsLocalization.away_of_isIdempotentElem
    · simp [IsIdempotentElem, ← Pi.single_mul_left]
    · apply RingHom.ker_evalRingHom
    · apply (Pi.evalRingHom S i).surjective
  apply of_span_range_eq_top (fun i ↦ Pi.single i (1 : S i)) _ fun i ↦ S i
  exact Ideal.span_single_eq_top _

name: trans
statement:
lemma trans [Algebra S T] [Algebra R T] [IsScalarTower R S T]
    [IsLocalIso R S] [IsLocalIso S T] : IsLocalIso R T
proof:
:= by
  
  let s : Set S := {g : S | IsStandardOpenImmersion R (Localization.Away g)}
  let T' (g : S) := Localization.Away (algebraMap S T g)
  let (g : S) : Algebra (Localization.Away g) (T' g) := localizationAlgebra (.powers g) T
  let T'' (g : S) (x : T) := Localization.Away (algebraMap _ (T' g) x)
  let t (g : S) : Set T := {x : T | IsStandardOpenImmersion (Localization.Away g) (T'' g x)}
  let ι : Type _ := Σ i : s, t i.1
  have (i : ι) : IsStandardOpenImmersion (Localization.Away i.1.1) (T'' i.1 i.2) := i.2.2
  suffices h : Ideal.span (Set.range fun i : ι ↦ algebraMap S T i.1 * i.2) = ⊤ by
    have (i : ι) : IsStandardOpenImmersion R (T'' i.1 i.2) :=
      have : IsScalarTower R (Localization.Away i.1.1) (T' i.1.1) :=
        IsScalarTower.to₁₃₄ _ S _ _
      have : IsStandardOpenImmersion (Localization.Away i.1.1) (T'' i.1.1 i.2.1) := i.2.2
      have : IsStandardOpenImmersion R (Localization.Away i.1.1) := i.1.2
      .trans _ (Localization.Away i.1.1) _
    exact .of_span_range_eq_top _ h fun i : ι ↦ T'' i.1 i.2
  have h1 := congr(Ideal.map (algebraMap S T) $(span_isStandardOpenImmersion_eq_top R S))
  rw [Ideal.map_top, Ideal.map_span] at h1
  nth_rw 1 [_root_.eq_top_iff, ← Ideal.top_mul ⊤, ← h1, ← span_isStandardOpenImmersion_eq_top S T,
    Ideal.span_mul_span, Ideal.span_le, Set.mul_subset_iff]
  simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, SetLike.mem_coe, forall_exists_index, and_imp,
    forall_apply_eq_imp_iff₂]
  intro g hg x hx
  refine Ideal.subset_span ⟨⟨⟨g, hg⟩, ⟨x, ?_⟩⟩, rfl⟩
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, t]
  let : Algebra (Localization.Away x) (T'' g x) :=
    localizationAlgebra (.powers x) (T' g)
  have : IsScalarTower S (Localization.Away x) (T'' g x) :=
    IsScalarTower.to₁₃₄ _ T _ _
  have : IsLocalization (algebraMapSubmonoid (Localization.Away x) (.powers g)) (T'' g x) := by
    have : algebraMapSubmonoid (Localization.Away x) (.powers g) =
      algebraMapSubmonoid (Localization.Away x) (.powers (algebraMap S T g)) := by
        simp [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply S T (Localization.Away x)]
    rw [this]
    exact .commutes _ (T' g) _ (.powers x) (.powers (algebraMap S T g))
  have : IsPushout S (Localization.Away x) (Localization.Away g) (T'' g x) :=
    Algebra.isPushout_of_isLocalization (.powers g) _ _ _
  exact .of_isPushout S (Localization.Away x) _ _

name: of_algEquiv
statement: lemma of_algEquiv [Algebra R T] (e : S ≃ₐ[R] T) [IsLocalIso R S] : IsLocalIso R T
proof:
:= by
  algebraize [e.toAlgHom.toRingHom]
  have : IsStandardOpenImmersion S T := .of_bijective e.bijective
  exact .trans _ S _

lemma IsPrimary.mem_or_mem (h : S.IsPrimary) {r : R} {m : M} (hrm : r • m ∈ S) :

name: IsPrimary.inf
statement:
protected lemma IsPrimary.inf (hS : S.IsPrimary) (hT : T.IsPrimary)
    (h : (S.colon Set.univ).radical = (T.colon Set.univ).radical) :
    (S ⊓ T).IsPrimary
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, hS⟩ := hS
  obtain ⟨_, hT⟩ := hT
  refine ⟨by grind, fun ⟨hS', hT'⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  simp_rw [← mem_colon_iff_le, ← Ideal.mem_radical_iff, inf_colon, Ideal.radical_inf,
    top_coe, h, inf_idem, mem_inf, and_or_right] at hS hT ⊢

name: isPrimary_finsetInf
statement:
lemma isPrimary_finsetInf {ι : Type*} {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → Submodule R M} {i : ι} (hi : i ∈ s)
    (hs : ∀ ⦃y⦄, y ∈ s → (f y).IsPrimary)
    (hs' : ∀ ⦃y⦄, y ∈ s → ((f y).colon Set.univ).radical = ((f i).colon Set.univ).radical) :
    (s.inf f).IsPrimary
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on generalizing i with
  | empty => simp at hi
  | insert a s ha IH =>
    rcases s.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | ⟨y, hy⟩
    · simp only [insert_empty_eq, mem_singleton] at hi
      simpa [hi] using hs
    simp only [inf_insert]
    have H ⦃x⦄ (hx : x ∈ s) : ((f x).colon Set.univ).radical = ((f y).colon Set.univ).radical := by
      rw [hs' (mem_insert_of_mem hx), hs' (mem_insert_of_mem hy)]
    refine IsPrimary.inf (hs (by simp)) (IH hy (fun x hx ↦ hs (by simp [hx])) H) ?_
    rw [colon_finsetInf, Ideal.radical_finset_inf hy H,
      hs' (mem_insert_self _ _), hs' (mem_insert_of_mem hy)]

name: IsPrimary.isPrime_radical_colon
statement: theorem IsPrimary.isPrime_radical_colon (hI : S.IsPrimary) : (S.colon .univ).radical.IsPrime
proof:
:= by
  refine isPrime_iff.mpr <| hI.imp (by simp) fun h x y ⟨n, hn⟩ ↦ ?_
  simp_rw [← mem_colon_iff_le, ← mem_radical_iff] at h
  refine or_iff_not_imp_left.mpr fun hx ↦ ⟨n, ?_⟩
  simp only [mul_pow, mem_colon, Set.mem_univ, true_imp_iff, mul_smul] at hn ⊢
  exact fun p ↦ (h (hn p)).resolve_right (mt mem_radical_of_pow_mem hx)

name: IsPrimary.radical_colon_singleton_of_notMem
statement:
theorem IsPrimary.radical_colon_singleton_of_notMem (hI : S.IsPrimary) {m : M} (hm : m ∉ S) :
    (S.colon {m}).radical = (S.colon Set.univ).radical
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (radical_le_radical_iff.mpr fun _ hy ↦
    (hI.2 (Submodule.mem_colon_singleton.mp hy)).resolve_left hm)
    (radical_mono (Submodule.colon_mono le_rfl (Set.subset_univ {m})))

name: IsPrimary.radical_colon_singleton_eq_ite
statement:
theorem IsPrimary.radical_colon_singleton_eq_ite (hS : S.IsPrimary) (m : M) [Decidable (m ∈ S)] :
    radical (S.colon {m}) = if m ∈ S then ⊤ else radical (S.colon Set.univ)
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with hm
  · rwa [radical_eq_top, colon_eq_top_iff_subset, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
  · exact hS.radical_colon_singleton_of_notMem hm

name: isPrimary_iff_zero_divisor_quotient_imp_nilpotent_smul
statement:
lemma isPrimary_iff_zero_divisor_quotient_imp_nilpotent_smul :
    S.IsPrimary ↔ S ≠ ⊤ ∧ ∀ (r : R) (x : M ⧸ S), x ≠ 0 → r • x = 0 →
      ∃ n : ℕ, r ^ n • (⊤ : Submodule R (M ⧸ S)) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  refine (and_congr_right fun _ ↦ ?_)
  simp_rw [S.mkQ_surjective.forall, ← map_smul, ne_eq, ← LinearMap.mem_ker, ker_mkQ]
  congr! 2
  rw [forall_comm, ← or_iff_not_imp_left,
    ← LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr S.mkQ_surjective, ← map_top]
  simp_rw [eq_bot_iff, ← map_pointwise_smul, map_le_iff_le_comap, comap_bot, ker_mkQ]

name: pow_smul_le
statement: theorem pow_smul_le (i j : ℕ) : I ^ i • F.N j ≤ F.N (i + j)
proof:
:= by
  induction i with
  | zero => simp
  | succ _ ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', mul_smul, add_assoc, add_comm 1, ← add_assoc]
    exact (smul_mono_right _ ih).trans (F.smul_le _)

name: pow_smul_le_pow_smul

proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm, pow_add, mul_smul]
  exact smul_mono_right _ (F.pow_smul_le i j)

name: Stable.exists_pow_smul_eq
statement: theorem Stable.exists_pow_smul_eq (h : F.Stable) : ∃ n₀, ∀ k, F.N (n₀ + k) = I ^ k • F.N n₀
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n₀, hn⟩ := h
  use n₀
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ _ ih => rw [← add_assoc, ← hn, ih, add_comm, pow_add, mul_smul, pow_one]; lia

name: Stable.exists_pow_smul_eq_of_ge
statement:
theorem Stable.exists_pow_smul_eq_of_ge (h : F.Stable) :
    ∃ n₀, ∀ n ≥ n₀, F.N n = I ^ (n - n₀) • F.N n₀
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n₀, hn₀⟩ := h.exists_pow_smul_eq
  use n₀
  intro n hn
  convert! hn₀ (n - n₀)
  rw [add_comm, tsub_add_cancel_of_le hn]

name: stable_iff_exists_pow_smul_eq_of_ge
statement:
theorem stable_iff_exists_pow_smul_eq_of_ge :
    F.Stable ↔ ∃ n₀, ∀ n ≥ n₀, F.N n = I ^ (n - n₀) • F.N n₀
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Stable.exists_pow_smul_eq_of_ge, fun h => ⟨h.choose, fun n hn => ?_⟩⟩
  rw [h.choose_spec n hn, h.choose_spec (n + 1) (by lia), smul_smul, ← pow_succ',
    tsub_add_eq_add_tsub hn]

name: Stable.exists_forall_le
statement:
theorem Stable.exists_forall_le (h : F.Stable) (e : F.N 0 ≤ F'.N 0) :
    ∃ n₀, ∀ n, F.N (n + n₀) ≤ F'.N n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n₀, hF⟩ := h
  use n₀
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => refine (F.antitone ?_).trans e; simp
  | succ n hn =>
    rw [add_right_comm, ← hF]
    · exact (smul_mono_right _ hn).trans (F'.smul_le _)
    simp

name: Stable.bounded_difference
statement:
theorem Stable.bounded_difference (h : F.Stable) (h' : F'.Stable) (e : F.N 0 = F'.N 0) :
    ∃ n₀, ∀ n, F.N (n + n₀) ≤ F'.N n ∧ F'.N (n + n₀) ≤ F.N n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n₁, h₁⟩ := h.exists_forall_le (le_of_eq e)
  obtain ⟨n₂, h₂⟩ := h'.exists_forall_le (le_of_eq e.symm)
  use max n₁ n₂
  intro n
  refine ⟨(F.antitone ?_).trans (h₁ n), (F'.antitone ?_).trans (h₂ n)⟩ <;> simp

name: mem_submodule
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_submodule (f : PolynomialModule R M) : f ∈ F.submodule ↔ ∀ i, f.coeff i ∈ F.N i
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: inf_submodule
statement: theorem inf_submodule : (F ⊓ F').submodule = F.submodule ⊓ F'.submodule
proof:
:= by
  ext
  exact forall_and

name: submodule_closure_single
statement:
theorem submodule_closure_single :
    AddSubmonoid.closure (⋃ i, single R i '' (F.N i : Set M)) = F.submodule.toAddSubmonoid
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [AddSubmonoid.closure_le, Set.iUnion_subset_iff]
    rintro i _ ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩ j
    rw [coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply]
    split_ifs with h
    · rwa [← h]
    · exact (F.N j).zero_mem
  · intro f hf
    rw [← f.ofCoeff_coeff, ← f.coeff.sum_single, ofCoeff_finsuppSum]
    apply AddSubmonoid.sum_mem _ _
    rintro c -
    exact AddSubmonoid.subset_closure (Set.subset_iUnion _ c <| Set.mem_image_of_mem _ (hf c))

name: submodule_span_single
statement:
theorem submodule_span_single :
    Submodule.span (reesAlgebra I) (⋃ i, single R i '' (F.N i : Set M)) = F.submodule
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Submodule.span_closure, submodule_closure_single, Submodule.coe_toAddSubmonoid]
  exact Submodule.span_eq (Filtration.submodule F)

name: submodule_eq_span_le_iff_stable_ge
statement:
theorem submodule_eq_span_le_iff_stable_ge (n₀ : ℕ) :
    F.submodule = Submodule.span _ (⋃ i ≤ n₀, single R i '' (F.N i : Set M)) ↔
      ∀ n ≥ n₀, I • F.N n = F.N (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← submodule_span_single,
    ← (Submodule.span_mono (Set.iUnion₂_subset_iUnion _ _)).ge_iff_eq',
    Submodule.span_le, Set.iUnion_subset_iff]
  constructor
  · intro H n hn
    refine (F.smul_le n).antisymm ?_
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := (Finsupp.mem_span_iff_linearCombination _ _ _).mp (H _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩)
    replace hl := congr_arg (fun f : PolynomialModule R M => f.coeff (n + 1)) hl
    rw [PolynomialModule.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply, ite_eq_left rfl] at hl
    rw [← hl, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, PolynomialModule.coeff_finsuppSum, Finsupp.sum_apply]
    apply Submodule.sum_mem _ _
    rintro ⟨_, _, ⟨n', rfl⟩, _, ⟨hn', rfl⟩, m, hm, rfl⟩ -
    dsimp only [Subtype.coe_mk]
    rw [Subalgebra.smul_def, smul_single_apply, ite_eq_left (show n' ≤ n + 1 by lia)]
    have e : n' ≤ n := by lia
    have := F.pow_smul_le_pow_smul (n - n') n' 1
    rw [tsub_add_cancel_of_le e, pow_one, add_comm _ 1, ← add_tsub_assoc_of_le e, add_comm] at this
    exact this (Submodule.smul_mem_smul ((l _).2 <| n + 1 - n') hm)
  · let F' := Submodule.span (reesAlgebra I) (⋃ i ≤ n₀, single R i '' (F.N i : Set M))
    intro hF i
    have : ∀ i ≤ n₀, single R i '' (F.N i : Set M) ⊆ F' := fun i hi =>
      
      (Set.subset_iUnion₂ (s := fun i _ => (single R i '' (N F i : Set M))) i hi).trans
        Submodule.subset_span
    induction i with
    | zero => exact this _ zero_le
    | succ j hj => ?_
    by_cases hj' : j.succ ≤ n₀
    · exact this _ hj'
    simp only [not_le, Nat.lt_succ_iff] at hj'
    rw [← hF _ hj']
    rintro _ ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩
    refine Submodule.smul_induction_on hm (fun r hr m' hm' => ?_) (fun x y hx hy => ?_)
    · rw [add_comm, ← monomial_smul_single]
      exact F'.smul_mem
        ⟨_, reesAlgebra.monomial_mem.mpr (by rwa [pow_one])⟩ (hj <| Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hm')
    · rw [PolynomialModule.single_add]
      exact F'.add_mem hx hy

name: submodule_fg_iff_stable
statement: theorem submodule_fg_iff_stable (hF' : ∀ i, (F.N i).FG) : F.submodule.FG ↔ F.Stable
proof:
:= by
  classical
  delta Ideal.Filtration.Stable
  simp_rw [← F.submodule_eq_span_le_iff_stable_ge]
  constructor
  · rintro H
    refine H.stabilizes_of_iSup_eq
        ⟨fun n₀ => Submodule.span _ (⋃ (i : ℕ) (_ : i ≤ n₀), single R i '' ↑(F.N i)), ?_⟩ ?_
    · intro n m e
      rw [Submodule.span_le, Set.iUnion₂_subset_iff]
      intro i hi
      refine Set.Subset.trans ?_ Submodule.subset_span
      refine @Set.subset_iUnion₂ _ _ _ (fun i => fun _ => ↑((single R i) '' ((N F i) : Set M))) i ?_
      exact hi.trans e
    · dsimp
      rw [← Submodule.span_iUnion, ← submodule_span_single]
      simp [Set.biUnion_le_eq_iUnion]
  · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
    rw [hn]
    simp_rw [Submodule.span_iUnion₂, ← Finset.mem_range_succ_iff, iSup_subtype']
    apply Submodule.fg_iSup
    rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hF' i
    have : Submodule.span (reesAlgebra I) (s.image (lsingle R i) : Set (PolynomialModule R M)) =
        Submodule.span _ (single R i '' (F.N i : Set M)) := by
      rw [Finset.coe_image, ← Submodule.span_span_of_tower R, ← Submodule.map_span, hs]; rfl
    rw [Subtype.coe_mk, ← this]
    exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: Stable.of_le
statement:
theorem Stable.of_le [IsNoetherianRing R] [Module.Finite R M] (hF : F.Stable)
    {F' : I.Filtration M} (hf : F' ≤ F) : F'.Stable
proof:
:= by
  rw [← submodule_fg_iff_stable] at hF ⊢
  any_goals intro i; exact IsNoetherian.noetherian _
  have := isNoetherian_of_fg_of_noetherian _ hF
  rw [isNoetherian_submodule] at this
  exact this _ (OrderHomClass.mono (submoduleInfHom M I) hf)

name: Stable.inter_right
statement:
theorem Stable.inter_right [IsNoetherianRing R] [Module.Finite R M] (hF : F.Stable) :
    (F ⊓ F').Stable
proof:
:=
  hF.of_le inf_le_left

name: Stable.inter_left
statement:
theorem Stable.inter_left [IsNoetherianRing R] [Module.Finite R M] (hF : F.Stable) :
    (F' ⊓ F).Stable
proof:
:=
  hF.of_le inf_le_right

name: Ideal.exists_pow_inf_eq_pow_smul
statement:
theorem Ideal.exists_pow_inf_eq_pow_smul [IsNoetherianRing R] [Module.Finite R M]
    (N : Submodule R M) : ∃ k : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ k, I ^ n • ⊤ ⊓ N = I ^ (n - k) • (I ^ k • ⊤ ⊓ N)
proof:
:=
  ((I.stableFiltration_stable ⊤).inter_right (I.trivialFiltration N)).exists_pow_smul_eq_of_ge

name: Ideal.mem_iInf_smul_pow_eq_bot_iff
statement:
theorem Ideal.mem_iInf_smul_pow_eq_bot_iff [IsNoetherianRing R] [Module.Finite R M] (x : M) :
    x ∈ (⨅ i : ℕ, I ^ i • ⊤ : Submodule R M) ↔ ∃ r : I, (r : R) • x = x
proof:
:= by
  let N := (⨅ i : ℕ, I ^ i • ⊤ : Submodule R M)
  have hN : ∀ k, (I.stableFiltration ⊤ ⊓ I.trivialFiltration N).N k = N :=
    fun k => inf_eq_right.mpr ((iInf_le _ k).trans <| le_of_eq <| by simp)
  constructor
  · obtain ⟨r, hr₁, hr₂⟩ :=
      Submodule.exists_mem_and_smul_eq_self_of_fg_of_le_smul I N (IsNoetherian.noetherian N) (by
        obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (I.stableFiltration_stable ⊤).inter_right (I.trivialFiltration N)
        have := hk k (le_refl _)
        rw [hN, hN] at this
        exact le_of_eq this.symm)
    intro H
    exact ⟨⟨r, hr₁⟩, hr₂ _ H⟩
  · rintro ⟨r, eq⟩
    rw [Submodule.mem_iInf]
    intro i
    induction i with
    | zero => simp
    | succ i hi =>
      rw [add_comm, pow_add, ← smul_smul, pow_one, ← eq]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem_smul r.prop hi

name: Ideal.iInf_pow_smul_eq_bot_of_le_jacobson
statement:
theorem Ideal.iInf_pow_smul_eq_bot_of_le_jacobson [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [Module.Finite R M] (h : I ≤ Ideal.jacobson ⊥) : (⨅ i : ℕ, I ^ i • ⊤ : Submodule R M) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := (I.mem_iInf_smul_pow_eq_bot_iff x).mp hx
  have := isUnit_of_sub_one_mem_jacobson_bot (1 - r.1) (by simpa using h r.2)
  apply this.smul_left_cancel.mp
  simp [sub_smul, hr]

name: Ideal.iInf_pow_smul_eq_bot_of_isLocalRing
statement:
theorem Ideal.iInf_pow_smul_eq_bot_of_isLocalRing [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [Module.Finite R M] (h : I ≠ ⊤) : (⨅ i : ℕ, I ^ i • ⊤ : Submodule R M) = ⊥
proof:
:=
  Ideal.iInf_pow_smul_eq_bot_of_le_jacobson _
    ((le_maximalIdeal h).trans (maximalIdeal_le_jacobson _))

name: Ideal.iInf_pow_eq_bot_of_isLocalRing
statement:
theorem Ideal.iInf_pow_eq_bot_of_isLocalRing [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsLocalRing R] (h : I ≠ ⊤) :
    ⨅ i : ℕ, I ^ i = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  convert! I.iInf_pow_smul_eq_bot_of_isLocalRing (M := R) h
  ext i
  rw [smul_eq_mul, ← Ideal.one_eq_top, mul_one]

name: Ideal.isIdempotentElem_iff_eq_bot_or_top_of_isLocalRing
statement:
theorem Ideal.isIdempotentElem_iff_eq_bot_or_top_of_isLocalRing {R} [CommRing R]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsLocalRing R] (I : Ideal R) :
    IsIdempotentElem I ↔ I = ⊥ ∨ I = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro H
    by_cases I = ⊤; · exact Or.inr ‹_›
    refine Or.inl (eq_bot_iff.mpr ?_)
    rw [← Ideal.iInf_pow_eq_bot_of_isLocalRing I ‹_›]
    apply le_iInf
    rintro (_ | n) <;> simp [H.pow_succ_eq]
  · rintro (rfl | rfl) <;> simp [IsIdempotentElem]

name: Ideal.iInf_pow_smul_eq_bot_of_isTorsionFree
statement:
theorem Ideal.iInf_pow_smul_eq_bot_of_isTorsionFree [IsDomain R]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [Module.IsTorsionFree R M]
    [Module.Finite R M] (h : I ≠ ⊤) : (⨅ i : ℕ, I ^ i • ⊤ : Submodule R M) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  intro x hx
  by_contra hx'
  have := Ideal.mem_iInf_smul_pow_eq_bot_iff I x
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := this.mp hx
  have := smul_left_injective _ hx' (hr.trans (one_smul _ x).symm)
  exact I.eq_top_iff_one.not.mp h (this ▸ r.prop)

name: Ideal.iInf_pow_eq_bot_of_isDomain
statement:
theorem Ideal.iInf_pow_eq_bot_of_isDomain [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsDomain R] (h : I ≠ ⊤) :
    ⨅ i : ℕ, I ^ i = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  convert! I.iInf_pow_smul_eq_bot_of_isTorsionFree (M := R) h
  simp

name: conductor_eq_of_eq
statement: theorem conductor_eq_of_eq {y : S} (h : (R<x> : Set S) = R<y>) : conductor R x = conductor R y
proof:
:=
  Ideal.ext fun _ => forall_congr' fun _ => Set.ext_iff.mp h _

name: conductor_subset_adjoin
statement: theorem conductor_subset_adjoin : (conductor R x : Set S) ⊆ R<x>
proof:
:= fun y hy => by
  simpa only [mul_one] using! hy 1

name: mem_conductor_iff
statement: theorem mem_conductor_iff {y : S} : y ∈ conductor R x ↔ ∀ b : S, y * b ∈ R<x>
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => h, fun h => h⟩

name: conductor_eq_top_of_adjoin_eq_top
statement: theorem conductor_eq_top_of_adjoin_eq_top (h : R<x> = ⊤) : conductor R x = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Ideal.eq_top_iff_one, mem_conductor_iff, h, mem_top, forall_const]

name: conductor_eq_top_of_powerBasis
statement: theorem conductor_eq_top_of_powerBasis (pb : PowerBasis R S) : conductor R pb.gen = ⊤
proof:
:=
  conductor_eq_top_of_adjoin_eq_top pb.adjoin_gen_eq_top

name: adjoin_eq_top_of_conductor_eq_top
statement:
theorem adjoin_eq_top_of_conductor_eq_top {x : S} (h : conductor R x = ⊤) :
    R[x] = ⊤
proof:
:=
  eq_top_iff.mpr fun y ↦
    one_mul y ▸ mem_conductor_iff.mp ((Ideal.eq_top_iff_one (conductor R x)).mp h) y

name: conductor_eq_top_iff_adjoin_eq_top
statement:
theorem conductor_eq_top_iff_adjoin_eq_top {x : S} :
    conductor R x = ⊤ ↔ R[x] = ⊤
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ adjoin_eq_top_of_conductor_eq_top h, fun h ↦ conductor_eq_top_of_adjoin_eq_top h⟩

name: mem_coeSubmodule_conductor
statement:
lemma mem_coeSubmodule_conductor {L} [CommRing L] [Algebra S L] [Algebra R L]
    [IsScalarTower R S L] [FaithfulSMul S L] {x : S} {y : L} :
    y ∈ coeSubmodule L (conductor R x) ↔ ∀ z : S,
      y * (algebraMap S L) z ∈ R[algebraMap S L x]
proof:
:= by
  trans ∀ z, y * (algebraMap S L) z ∈ (R[x]).map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R S L)
  · simp only [coeSubmodule, Submodule.mem_map, linearMap_apply, Subalgebra.mem_map,
      IsScalarTower.coe_toAlgHom']
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ z
      exact ⟨_, hy z, map_mul _ _ _⟩
    · intro H
      obtain ⟨y, _, e⟩ := H 1
      rw [map_one, mul_one] at e
      subst e
      simp only [← map_mul, (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective S L).eq_iff,
        exists_eq_right] at H
      exact ⟨_, H, rfl⟩
  · rw [AlgHom.map_adjoin, Set.image_singleton]; rfl

name: prod_mem_ideal_map_of_mem_conductor
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.map, Ideal.span, Finsupp.mem_span_image_iff_linearCombination] at hz'
  obtain ⟨l, H, H'⟩ := hz'
  rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply] at H'
  rw [← H', mul_comm, Finsupp.sum_mul]
  have lem : ∀ {a : R}, a ∈ I → l a • algebraMap R S a * algebraMap R S p ∈
      algebraMap R<x> S '' I.map (algebraMap R R<x>) := by
    intro a ha
    rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_assoc, Set.mem_image]
    refine Exists.intro
        (algebraMap R R<x> a * ⟨l a * algebraMap R S p,
          show l a * algebraMap R S p ∈ R<x> from ?h⟩) ?_
    case h =>
      rw [mul_comm]
      exact mem_conductor_iff.mp (Ideal.mem_comap.mp hp) _
    · refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [mul_comm]
        apply Ideal.mul_mem_left (I.map (algebraMap R R<x>)) _ (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ ha)
      · simp only [map_mul, mul_comm (algebraMap R S p) (l a)]
        rfl
  refine Finset.sum_induction _ (fun u => u ∈ algebraMap R<x> S '' I.map (algebraMap R R<x>))
      (fun a b => ?_) ?_ ?_
  · rintro ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    rw [← map_add]
    exact ⟨z + y, Ideal.add_mem _ (SetLike.mem_coe.mp hz) hy, rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨0, SetLike.mem_coe.mpr <| Ideal.zero_mem _, map_zero _⟩
  · intro y hy
    exact lem ((Finsupp.mem_supported _ l).mp H hy)

name: comap_map_eq_map_adjoin_of_coprime_conductor
statement:
theorem comap_map_eq_map_adjoin_of_coprime_conductor
    (hx : (conductor R x).comap (algebraMap R S) ⊔ I = ⊤)
    (h_alg : Function.Injective (algebraMap R<x> S)) :
    (I.map (algebraMap R S)).comap (algebraMap R<x> S) = I.map (algebraMap R R<x>)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · 
    
    
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := y
    obtain ⟨p, hp, q, hq, hpq⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp ((Ideal.eq_top_iff_one _).mp hx)
    have temp : algebraMap R S p * z + algebraMap R S q * z = z := by
      simp only [← add_mul, ← map_add (algebraMap R S), hpq, map_one, one_mul]
    suffices z ∈ algebraMap R<x> S '' I.map (algebraMap R R<x>) ↔
        (⟨z, hz⟩ : R<x>) ∈ I.map (algebraMap R R<x>) by
      rw [← this, ← temp]
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (Set.mem_image _ _ _).mp (prod_mem_ideal_map_of_mem_conductor hp
          (show z ∈ I.map (algebraMap R S) by rwa [Ideal.mem_comap] at hy))
      use a + algebraMap R R<x> q * ⟨z, hz⟩
      refine ⟨Ideal.add_mem (I.map (algebraMap R R<x>)) ha.left ?_, by
          simp only [ha.right, map_add, map_mul, add_right_inj]; rfl⟩
      rw [mul_comm]
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_left (I.map (algebraMap R R<x>)) _ (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hq)
    refine ⟨fun h => ?_,
      fun h => (Set.mem_image _ _ _).mpr (Exists.intro ⟨z, hz⟩ ⟨by simp [h], rfl⟩)⟩
    obtain ⟨x₁, hx₁, hx₂⟩ := (Set.mem_image _ _ _).mp h
    have : x₁ = ⟨z, hz⟩ := by
      apply h_alg
      simp only [hx₂, algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
      rw [Submonoid.mk_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    rwa [← this]
  · 
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R R<x> S, ← Ideal.map_map]
    apply Ideal.le_comap_map

name: quotAdjoinEquivQuotMap_apply_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quotAdjoinEquivQuotMap_apply_mk (hx : (conductor R x).comap (algebraMap R S) ⊔ I = ⊤)
    (h_alg : Function.Injective (algebraMap R<x> S)) (a : R<x>) :
    quotAdjoinEquivQuotMap hx h_alg (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R R<x>)) a) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R S)) ↑a
proof: := rfl

name: Localization.localRingHom_bijective_of_not_conductor_le
statement:
lemma Localization.localRingHom_bijective_of_not_conductor_le
    {P : Ideal S} [P.IsPrime] (hx : ¬ conductor R x ≤ P) {s : Subalgebra R S}
    (hs : s = R<x>) (p : Ideal s) [p.IsPrime] [P.LiesOver p] :
    Function.Bijective (Localization.localRingHom _ _ _ (P.over_def p))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, haP⟩ := SetLike.not_le_iff_exists.mp hx
  replace ha (b : _) : a * b ∈ s := by simpa [hs] using ha b
  exact Localization.localRingHom_bijective_of_saturated_inf_eq_top _
    (top_le_iff.mp fun y _ ↦ ⟨a, ⟨haP, by simpa using ha 1⟩, ha _⟩) _

name: discr_def
statement: theorem discr_def [Fintype ι] (b : ι → B) : discr A b = (traceMatrix A b).det
proof: := rfl

name: discr_eq_discr_of_algEquiv
statement:
theorem discr_eq_discr_of_algEquiv [Fintype ι] (b : ι → B) (f : B ≃ₐ[A] C) :
    Algebra.discr A b = Algebra.discr A (f ∘ b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [discr_def]; congr; ext
  simp_rw [traceMatrix_apply, traceForm_apply, Function.comp, ← map_mul f, trace_eq_of_algEquiv]

name: discr_reindex
statement:
@[simp]
theorem discr_reindex (b : Basis ι A B) (f : ι ≃ ι') : discr A (b ∘ ⇑f.symm) = discr A b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Basis.coe_reindex, discr_def, traceMatrix_reindex, det_reindex_self, ← discr_def]

name: discr_zero_of_not_linearIndependent
statement:
theorem discr_zero_of_not_linearIndependent [IsDomain A] {b : ι → B}
    (hli : ¬LinearIndependent A b) : discr A b = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg, i, hi⟩ := Fintype.not_linearIndependent_iff.1 hli
  have : (traceMatrix A b) *ᵥ g = 0 := by
    ext i
    have : ∀ j, (trace A B) (b i * b j) * g j = (trace A B) (g j • b j * b i) := by
      intro j
      simp [mul_comm]
    simp only [mulVec, dotProduct, traceMatrix_apply, Pi.zero_apply, traceForm_apply, fun j =>
      this j, ← map_sum, ← sum_mul, hg, zero_mul, map_zero]
  by_contra h
  rw [discr_def] at h
  simp [Matrix.eq_zero_of_mulVec_eq_zero h this] at hi

name: discr_of_matrix_vecMul
statement:
theorem discr_of_matrix_vecMul (b : ι → B) (P : Matrix ι ι A) :
    discr A (b ᵥ* P.map (algebraMap A B)) = P.det ^ 2 * discr A b
proof:
:= by
  rw [discr_def, traceMatrix_of_matrix_vecMul, det_mul, det_mul, det_transpose, mul_comm, ←
    mul_assoc, discr_def, pow_two]

name: discr_of_matrix_mulVec
statement:
theorem discr_of_matrix_mulVec (b : ι → B) (P : Matrix ι ι A) :
    discr A (P.map (algebraMap A B) *ᵥ b) = P.det ^ 2 * discr A b
proof:
:= by
  rw [discr_def, traceMatrix_of_matrix_mulVec, det_mul, det_mul, det_transpose, mul_comm, ←
    mul_assoc, discr_def, pow_two]

name: discr_not_zero_of_basis
statement:
theorem discr_not_zero_of_basis [Algebra.IsSeparable K L] (b : Basis ι K L) :
    discr K b ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [discr_def, traceMatrix_of_basis, ← LinearMap.BilinForm.nondegenerate_iff_det_ne_zero]
  exact traceForm_nondegenerate _ _

name: discr_isUnit_of_basis
statement: theorem discr_isUnit_of_basis [Algebra.IsSeparable K L] (b : Basis ι K L) : IsUnit (discr K b)
proof:
:=
  IsUnit.mk0 _ (discr_not_zero_of_basis _ _)

name: discr_eq_det_embeddingsMatrixReindex_pow_two
statement:
theorem discr_eq_det_embeddingsMatrixReindex_pow_two
    [Algebra.IsSeparable K L] (e : ι ≃ (L →ₐ[K] E)) :
    algebraMap K E (discr K b) = (embeddingsMatrixReindex K E b e).det ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [discr_def, RingHom.map_det, RingHom.mapMatrix_apply,
    traceMatrix_eq_embeddingsMatrixReindex_mul_trans, det_mul, det_transpose, pow_two]

name: discr_powerBasis_eq_prod
statement:
theorem discr_powerBasis_eq_prod (e : Fin pb.dim ≃ (L →ₐ[K] E)) [Algebra.IsSeparable K L] :
    algebraMap K E (discr K pb.basis) =
      ∏ i : Fin pb.dim, ∏ j ∈ Ioi i, (e j pb.gen - e i pb.gen) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [discr_eq_det_embeddingsMatrixReindex_pow_two K E pb.basis e,
    embeddingsMatrixReindex_eq_vandermonde, det_transpose, det_vandermonde, ← prod_pow]
  congr; ext i
  rw [← prod_pow]

name: discr_powerBasis_eq_prod'
statement:
theorem discr_powerBasis_eq_prod' [Algebra.IsSeparable K L] (e : Fin pb.dim ≃ (L →ₐ[K] E)) :
    algebraMap K E (discr K pb.basis) =
      ∏ i : Fin pb.dim, ∏ j ∈ Ioi i, -((e j pb.gen - e i pb.gen) * (e i pb.gen - e j pb.gen))
proof:
:= by
  rw [discr_powerBasis_eq_prod _ _ _ e]
  congr; ext i; congr; ext j
  ring

name: discr_powerBasis_eq_prod''
statement:
theorem discr_powerBasis_eq_prod'' [Algebra.IsSeparable K L] (e : Fin pb.dim ≃ (L →ₐ[K] E)) :
    algebraMap K E (discr K pb.basis) =
      (-1) ^ (n * (n - 1) / 2) *
        ∏ i : Fin pb.dim, ∏ j ∈ Ioi i, (e j pb.gen - e i pb.gen) * (e i pb.gen - e j pb.gen)
proof:
:= by
  rw [discr_powerBasis_eq_prod' _ _ _ e]
  simp_rw [fun i j => neg_eq_neg_one_mul ((e j pb.gen - e i pb.gen) * (e i pb.gen - e j pb.gen)),
    prod_mul_distrib]
  congr
  simp only [prod_pow_eq_pow_sum, prod_const]
  congr
  rw [← @Nat.cast_inj ℚ, Nat.cast_sum]
  have : ∀ x : Fin pb.dim, ↑x + 1 ≤ pb.dim := by simp [Fin.is_lt]
  simp_rw [Fin.card_Ioi, Nat.sub_sub, add_comm 1]
  simp only [Nat.cast_sub, this, Finset.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul, sum_const, sum_sub_distrib,
    Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, sum_add_distrib, mul_one]
  rw [← Nat.cast_sum, ← @Finset.sum_range ℕ _ pb.dim fun i => i, sum_range_id]
  have hn : n = pb.dim := by
    rw [← AlgHom.card K L E, ← Fintype.card_fin pb.dim]
    exact card_congr e.symm
  have h₂ : 2 ∣ pb.dim * (pb.dim - 1) := pb.dim.even_mul_pred_self.two_dvd
  have hne : ((2 : ℕ) : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by simp
  have hle : 1 ≤ pb.dim := by
    rw [← hn, Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero, ← zero_lt_iff, Module.finrank_pos_iff]
    infer_instance
  rw [hn, Nat.cast_div h₂ hne, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_sub hle]
  ring

name: discr_powerBasis_eq_norm
statement:
theorem discr_powerBasis_eq_norm [Algebra.IsSeparable K L] :
    discr K pb.basis =
      (-1) ^ (n * (n - 1) / 2) *
      norm K (aeval pb.gen (minpoly K pb.gen).derivative)
proof:
:= by
  let E := AlgebraicClosure L
  let := fun a b : E => Classical.propDecidable (Eq a b)
  have e : Fin pb.dim ≃ (L →ₐ[K] E) := by
    refine equivOfCardEq ?_
    rw [Fintype.card_fin, AlgHom.card]
    exact (PowerBasis.finrank pb).symm
  have hnodup : ((minpoly K pb.gen).aroots E).Nodup :=
    nodup_roots (Separable.map (Algebra.IsSeparable.isSeparable K pb.gen))
  have hroots : ∀ σ : L →ₐ[K] E, σ pb.gen ∈ (minpoly K pb.gen).aroots E := by
    intro σ
    rw [mem_roots, IsRoot.def, eval_map_algebraMap, aeval_algHom_apply]
    repeat' simp [minpoly.ne_zero pb.isIntegral_gen]
  apply (algebraMap K E).injective
  rw [map_mul, map_pow, map_neg, map_one, discr_powerBasis_eq_prod'' _ _ _ e]
  congr
  rw [norm_eq_prod_embeddings, prod_prod_Ioi_mul_eq_prod_prod_off_diag]
  conv_rhs =>
    congr
    rfl
    ext σ
    rw [← aeval_algHom_apply, ← eval_map_algebraMap, ← derivative_map,
      (IsAlgClosed.splits _).eval_root_derivative ((minpoly.monic pb.isIntegral_gen).map _)
      (hroots σ), ← Finset.prod_mk _ (hnodup.erase _)]
  rw [Finset.prod_sigma', Finset.prod_sigma']
  refine prod_bij' (fun i _ ↦ ⟨e i.2, e i.1 pb.gen⟩)
    (fun σ hσ ↦ ⟨e.symm (PowerBasis.lift pb σ.2 ?_), e.symm σ.1⟩) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ (fun i _ ↦ by simp)
    <;> simp only [mem_sigma, mem_univ, Finset.mem_mk, hnodup.mem_erase_iff, IsRoot.def,
      mem_roots', mem_singleton, true_and, mem_compl, Sigma.forall, Equiv.apply_symm_apply,
      PowerBasis.lift_gen, implies_true, Equiv.symm_apply_apply,
      Sigma.ext_iff, Equiv.symm_apply_eq, heq_eq_eq, and_true] at *
  · simpa only [aeval_def, eval₂_eq_eval_map] using hσ.2.2
  · exact fun a b hba ↦ ⟨fun h ↦ hba <| e.injective <| pb.algHom_ext h.symm, hroots _⟩
  · rintro a b hba ha
    rw [ha, PowerBasis.lift_gen] at hba
    exact hba.1 rfl
  · exact fun a b _ ↦ pb.algHom_ext <| pb.lift_gen _ _

name: discr_isIntegral
statement: theorem discr_isIntegral {b : ι → L} (h : ∀ i, IsIntegral R (b i)) : IsIntegral R (discr K b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [discr_def]
  exact IsIntegral.det fun i j ↦ isIntegral_trace ((h i).mul (h j))

name: discr_mul_isIntegral_mem_adjoin
proof:
:= by
  have hinv : IsUnit (traceMatrix K B.basis).det := by
    simpa [← discr_def] using discr_isUnit_of_basis _ B.basis
  have H :
    (traceMatrix K B.basis).det • (traceMatrix K B.basis) *ᵥ (B.basis.equivFun z) =
      (traceMatrix K B.basis).det • fun i => trace K L (z * B.basis i) := by
    congr; exact traceMatrix_of_basis_mulVec _ _
  have cramer := mulVec_cramer (traceMatrix K B.basis) fun i => trace K L (z * B.basis i)
  suffices ∀ i, ((traceMatrix K B.basis).det • B.basis.equivFun z) i ∈ (⊥ : Subalgebra R K) by
    rw [← B.basis.sum_repr z, Finset.smul_sum]
    refine Subalgebra.sum_mem _ fun i _ => ?_
    replace this := this i
    rw [← discr_def, Pi.smul_apply, mem_bot] at this
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := this
    rw [Basis.equivFun_apply] at hr
    rw [← smul_assoc, ← hr, algebraMap_smul]
    refine Subalgebra.smul_mem _ ?_ _
    rw [B.basis_eq_pow i]
    exact Subalgebra.pow_mem _ (subset_adjoin (Set.mem_singleton _)) _
  intro i
  rw [← H, ← mulVec_smul] at cramer
  replace cramer := congr_arg (mulVec (traceMatrix K B.basis)⁻¹) cramer
  rw [mulVec_mulVec, nonsing_inv_mul _ hinv, mulVec_mulVec, nonsing_inv_mul _ hinv, one_mulVec,
    one_mulVec] at cramer
  rw [← congr_fun cramer i, cramer_apply, det_apply]
  refine
    Subalgebra.sum_mem _ fun σ _ => Subalgebra.zsmul_mem _ (Subalgebra.prod_mem _ fun j _ => ?_) _
  by_cases hji : j = i
  · simp only [updateCol_apply, hji, PowerBasis.coe_basis]
    exact mem_bot.2 (IsIntegrallyClosed.isIntegral_iff.1 <| isIntegral_trace (hz.mul <| hint.pow _))
  · simp only [updateCol_apply, hji, PowerBasis.coe_basis]
    exact mem_bot.2
      (IsIntegrallyClosed.isIntegral_iff.1 <| isIntegral_trace <| (hint.pow _).mul (hint.pow _))

name: discr_eq_discr
statement:
theorem discr_eq_discr (b : Basis ι ℤ A) (b' : Basis ι ℤ A) :
    Algebra.discr ℤ b = Algebra.discr ℤ b'
proof:
:= by
  convert! Algebra.discr_of_matrix_vecMul b' (b'.toMatrix b)
  · rw [Basis.toMatrix_map_vecMul]
  · suffices IsUnit (b'.toMatrix b).det by
      rw [Int.isUnit_iff, ← sq_eq_one_iff] at this
      rw [this, one_mul]
    rw [← LinearMap.toMatrix_id_eq_basis_toMatrix b b']
    exact LinearEquiv.isUnit_det (LinearEquiv.refl ℤ A) b b'

name: left_div_gcd_ne_zero
statement: theorem left_div_gcd_ne_zero {p q : R} (hp : p ≠ 0) : p / GCDMonoid.gcd p q ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := GCDMonoid.gcd_dvd_left p q
  obtain ⟨pq0, r0⟩ : GCDMonoid.gcd p q ≠ 0 ∧ r ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero_iff.mp (hr ▸ hp)
  nth_rw 1 [hr]
  rw [mul_comm, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ pq0]
  exact r0

name: right_div_gcd_ne_zero
statement: theorem right_div_gcd_ne_zero {p q : R} (hq : q ≠ 0) : q / GCDMonoid.gcd p q ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := GCDMonoid.gcd_dvd_right p q
  obtain ⟨pq0, r0⟩ : GCDMonoid.gcd p q ≠ 0 ∧ r ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero_iff.mp (hr ▸ hq)
  nth_rw 1 [hr]
  rw [mul_comm, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ pq0]
  exact r0

name: isCoprime_div_gcd_div_gcd
statement:
theorem isCoprime_div_gcd_div_gcd (hq : q ≠ 0) :
    IsCoprime (p / GCDMonoid.gcd p q) (q / GCDMonoid.gcd p q)
proof:
:=
  (gcd_isUnit_iff _ _).1 <|
    isUnit_gcd_of_eq_mul_gcd
        (EuclideanDomain.mul_div_cancel' (gcd_ne_zero_of_right hq) <| gcd_dvd_left _ _).symm
        (EuclideanDomain.mul_div_cancel' (gcd_ne_zero_of_right hq) <| gcd_dvd_right _ _).symm <|
      gcd_ne_zero_of_right hq

name: isCoprime_div_gcd_div_gcd_of_gcd_ne_zero
statement:
theorem isCoprime_div_gcd_div_gcd_of_gcd_ne_zero (hpq : GCDMonoid.gcd p q ≠ 0) :
    IsCoprime (p / GCDMonoid.gcd p q) (q / GCDMonoid.gcd p q)
proof:
:=
  (gcd_isUnit_iff _ _).1 <|
    isUnit_gcd_of_eq_mul_gcd
        (EuclideanDomain.mul_div_cancel' (hpq) <| gcd_dvd_left _ _).symm
        (EuclideanDomain.mul_div_cancel' (hpq) <| gcd_dvd_right _ _).symm <| hpq

name: span_gcd
statement:
theorem span_gcd [DecidableEq α] (x y : α) :
    span ({gcd x y} : Set α) = span ({x, y} : Set α)
proof:
:=
  letI := EuclideanDomain.gcdMonoid α
  _root_.span_gcd x y

name: gcd_isUnit_iff
statement: theorem gcd_isUnit_iff [DecidableEq α] {x y : α} : IsUnit (gcd x y) ↔ IsCoprime x y
proof:
:=
  letI := EuclideanDomain.gcdMonoid α
  _root_.gcd_isUnit_iff x y

name: isCoprime_of_dvd
statement:
theorem isCoprime_of_dvd {x y : α} (nonzero : ¬(x = 0 ∧ y = 0))
    (H : ∀ z ∈ nonunits α, z ≠ 0 → z ∣ x → ¬z ∣ y) : IsCoprime x y
proof:
:=
  letI := Classical.decEq α
  letI := EuclideanDomain.gcdMonoid α
  _root_.isCoprime_of_dvd x y nonzero H

name: dvd_or_coprime
statement:
theorem dvd_or_coprime (x y : α) (h : Irreducible x) :
    x ∣ y ∨ IsCoprime x y
proof:
:=
  letI := Classical.decEq α
  letI := EuclideanDomain.gcdMonoid α
  _root_.dvd_or_isCoprime x y h

name: _root_.Ideal.span_singleton_generator
statement:
@[simp]
theorem _root_.Ideal.span_singleton_generator (I : Ideal R) [I.IsPrincipal] :
    Ideal.span ({generator I} : Set R) = I
proof:
:=
  Eq.symm (Classical.choose_spec (principal I))

name: generator_mem
statement:
@[simp]
theorem generator_mem (S : Submodule R M) [S.IsPrincipal] : generator S ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  have : generator S ∈ span R {generator S} := subset_span (mem_singleton _)
  convert! this
  exact span_singleton_generator S |>.symm

name: mem_iff_eq_smul_generator
statement:
theorem mem_iff_eq_smul_generator (S : Submodule R M) [S.IsPrincipal] {x : M} :
    x ∈ S ↔ ∃ s : R, x = s • generator S
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [@eq_comm _ x, ← mem_span_singleton, span_singleton_generator]

name: eq_bot_iff_generator_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_bot_iff_generator_eq_zero (S : Submodule R M) [S.IsPrincipal] :
    S = ⊥ ↔ generator S = 0
proof: := by rw [← @span_singleton_eq_bot R M, span_singleton_generator]

name: generator_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem generator_bot : generator (⊥ : Submodule R M) = 0
proof:
:=
  (eq_bot_iff_generator_eq_zero ⊥).mp rfl

name: fg
statement: protected lemma fg {S : Submodule R M} (h : S.IsPrincipal) : S.FG
proof:
:=
  ⟨{h.generator}, by simp only [Finset.coe_singleton, span_singleton_generator]⟩

name: associated_generator_span_self
statement:
theorem associated_generator_span_self [IsDomain R] (r : R) :
    Associated (generator <| Ideal.span {r}) r
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Ideal.span_singleton_eq_span_singleton]
  exact Ideal.span_singleton_generator _

name: mem_iff_generator_dvd
statement: theorem mem_iff_generator_dvd (S : Ideal R) [S.IsPrincipal] {x : R} : x ∈ S ↔ generator S ∣ x
proof:
:=
  (mem_iff_eq_smul_generator S).trans (exists_congr fun a => by simp only [mul_comm, smul_eq_mul])

name: prime_generator_of_isPrime
statement:
theorem prime_generator_of_isPrime (S : Ideal R) [S.IsPrincipal] [is_prime : S.IsPrime]
    (ne_bot : S ≠ ⊥) : Prime (generator S)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => ne_bot ((eq_bot_iff_generator_eq_zero S).2 h), fun h =>
    is_prime.ne_top (S.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem (generator_mem S) h), fun _ _ => by
    simpa only [← mem_iff_generator_dvd S] using is_prime.2⟩

name: generator_map_dvd_of_mem
statement:
theorem generator_map_dvd_of_mem {N : Submodule R M} (ϕ : M →ₗ[R] R) [(N.map ϕ).IsPrincipal] {x : M}
    (hx : x ∈ N) : generator (N.map ϕ) ∣ ϕ x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mem_iff_generator_dvd, Submodule.mem_map]
  exact ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩

name: generator_submoduleImage_dvd_of_mem
statement:
theorem generator_submoduleImage_dvd_of_mem {N O : Submodule R M} (hNO : N ≤ O) (ϕ : O →ₗ[R] R)
    [(ϕ.submoduleImage N).IsPrincipal] {x : M} (hx : x ∈ N) :
    generator (ϕ.submoduleImage N) ∣ ϕ ⟨x, hNO hx⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mem_iff_generator_dvd, LinearMap.mem_submoduleImage_of_le hNO]
  exact ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩

name: dvd_generator_span_iff
statement:
theorem dvd_generator_span_iff {r : R} {s : Set R} [(Ideal.span s).IsPrincipal] :
    r ∣ generator (Ideal.span s) ↔ ∀ x ∈ s, r ∣ x where
  mp h x hx
proof:
:= h.trans <| (mem_iff_generator_dvd _).mp (Ideal.subset_span hx)
  mpr h := have : (span R s).IsPrincipal := ‹_›
    span_induction h (dvd_zero _) (fun _ _ _ _ ↦ dvd_add) (fun _ _ _ ↦ (·.mul_left _))
      (generator_mem _)

name: span_gcd
statement: theorem span_gcd : Ideal.span {gcd x y} = Ideal.span {x, y}
proof:
:=
  Ideal.span_singleton_generator _

name: gcd_dvd_left
statement: theorem gcd_dvd_left : gcd x y ∣ x
proof:
:=
  (Submodule.IsPrincipal.mem_iff_generator_dvd _).mp (Ideal.subset_span (by simp))

name: gcd_dvd_right
statement: theorem gcd_dvd_right : gcd x y ∣ y
proof:
:=
  (Submodule.IsPrincipal.mem_iff_generator_dvd _).mp (Ideal.subset_span (by simp))

name: dvd_gcd
statement: theorem dvd_gcd (hx : z ∣ x) (hy : z ∣ y) : z ∣ gcd x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Ideal.span_singleton_le_span_singleton] at hx hy ⊢
  rw [span_gcd, Ideal.span_insert, sup_le_iff]
  exact ⟨hx, hy⟩

name: gcd_eq_sum
statement: theorem gcd_eq_sum : ∃ a b : R, a * x + b * y = gcd x y
proof:
:=
  Ideal.mem_span_pair.mp (by rw [← span_gcd]; apply Ideal.subset_span; simp)

name: _root_.IsRelPrime.isCoprime
statement: theorem _root_.IsRelPrime.isCoprime (h : IsRelPrime x y) : IsCoprime x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Ideal.isCoprime_span_singleton_iff, Ideal.isCoprime_iff_sup_eq, ← Ideal.span_union,
    Set.singleton_union, ← span_gcd, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top]
  exact h (gcd_dvd_left x y) (gcd_dvd_right x y)

name: _root_.isRelPrime_iff_isCoprime
statement: theorem _root_.isRelPrime_iff_isCoprime : IsRelPrime x y ↔ IsCoprime x y
proof:
:=
  ⟨IsRelPrime.isCoprime, IsCoprime.isRelPrime⟩

name: associated_gcd_gcd
statement: theorem associated_gcd_gcd [GCDMonoid R] : Associated (IsBezout.gcd x y) (GCDMonoid.gcd x y)
proof:
:=
  gcd_greatest_associated (gcd_dvd_left _ _) (gcd_dvd_right _ _) (fun _ => dvd_gcd)

name: Finset.gcd_eq_sum_mul
statement:
lemma Finset.gcd_eq_sum_mul {α : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsBezout R] [NormalizedGCDMonoid R]
    (s : Finset α) (f : α → R) :
    ∃ g : α → R, s.gcd f = ∑ a ∈ s, f a * g a
proof:
:= by classical
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simp
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    obtain ⟨x, y, hxy⟩ := IsBezout.gcd_eq_sum (f a) (s.gcd f)
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := IsBezout.associated_gcd_gcd R (x := f a) (y := s.gcd f)
    rw [← hxy, add_mul, mul_comm x, mul_comm y] at hu
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨Function.update (g · * (y * u)) a (x * u), ?_⟩
    rw [gcd_insert, sum_insert ha, ← hu, hg]
    simp only [Function.update_self, add_right_inj, sum_mul, mul_assoc]
    exact sum_congr rfl fun b hb ↦ congrArg (f b * ·) <|
      (Function.update_of_ne (show b ≠ a by grind) (x * u) (g · * (y * u))).symm

name: to_maximal_ideal
statement:
theorem to_maximal_ideal [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsPrincipalIdealRing R] {S : Ideal R}
    [hpi : IsPrime S] (hS : S ≠ ⊥) : IsMaximal S
proof:
:=
  isMaximal_iff.2
    ⟨(ne_top_iff_one S).1 hpi.1, by
      intro T x hST hxS hxT
      obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (mem_iff_generator_dvd _).1 (hST <| generator_mem S)
      cases hpi.mem_or_mem (show generator T * z ∈ S from hz ▸ generator_mem S) with
      | inl h =>
        have hTS : T ≤ S := by
          rwa [← T.span_singleton_generator, Ideal.span_le, singleton_subset_iff]
        exact (hxS <| hTS hxT).elim
      | inr h =>
        obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (mem_iff_generator_dvd _).1 h
        have : generator S ≠ 0 := mt (eq_bot_iff_generator_eq_zero _).2 hS
        rw [← mul_one (generator S), hy, mul_left_comm, mul_right_inj' this] at hz
        exact hz.symm ▸ T.mul_mem_right _ (generator_mem T)⟩

name: mod_mem_iff
statement: theorem mod_mem_iff {S : Ideal R} {x y : R} (hy : y ∈ S) : x % y ∈ S ↔ x ∈ S
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hxy => div_add_mod x y ▸ S.add_mem (S.mul_mem_right _ hy) hxy, fun hx =>
    (mod_eq_sub_mul_div x y).symm ▸ S.sub_mem hx (S.mul_mem_right _ hy)⟩

name: IsField.isPrincipalIdealRing
statement:
theorem IsField.isPrincipalIdealRing {R : Type*} [Ring R] (h : IsField R) :
    IsPrincipalIdealRing R
proof:
:=
  let := h.toField
  inferInstance

name: isMaximal_of_irreducible
statement:
theorem isMaximal_of_irreducible [CommSemiring R] [IsPrincipalIdealRing R] {p : R}
    (hp : Irreducible p) : Ideal.IsMaximal (span R ({p} : Set R))
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨mt Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top.1 hp.1, fun I hI => by
      rcases principal I with ⟨a, rfl⟩
      rw [Ideal.submodule_span_eq, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top]
      rcases Ideal.span_singleton_le_span_singleton.1 (le_of_lt hI) with ⟨b, rfl⟩
      refine (of_irreducible_mul hp).resolve_right (mt (fun hb => ?_) (not_le_of_gt hI))
      rw [Ideal.submodule_span_eq, Ideal.submodule_span_eq,
        Ideal.span_singleton_le_span_singleton, IsUnit.mul_right_dvd hb]⟩⟩

name: _root_.Ideal.irreducible_iff_isMaximal_span_singleton
statement:
theorem _root_.Ideal.irreducible_iff_isMaximal_span_singleton
    [CommSemiring R] [IsPrincipalIdealRing R] [IsDomain R] {p : R} (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    Irreducible p ↔ Ideal.IsMaximal (span R ({p} : Set R))
proof:
:=
  ⟨isMaximal_of_irreducible, Ideal.irreducible_of_isMaximal_span_singleton hp⟩

name: _root_.Ideal.irreducible_iff_isMaximal_span_singleton_of_not_isField
statement:
theorem _root_.Ideal.irreducible_iff_isMaximal_span_singleton_of_not_isField
    [CommSemiring R] [IsPrincipalIdealRing R] [IsDomain R] (h : ¬IsField R) {p : R} :
    Irreducible p ↔ Ideal.IsMaximal (span R ({p} : Set R))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : p = 0
  · simp [hp, ← Ring.isField_iff_maximal_bot, h]
  · exact Ideal.irreducible_iff_isMaximal_span_singleton hp

name: factors_spec
statement:
theorem factors_spec (a : R) (h : a ≠ 0) :
    (∀ b ∈ factors a, Irreducible b) ∧ Associated (factors a).prod a
proof:
:= by
  unfold factors; rw [dite_eq_right h]
  exact Classical.choose_spec (WfDvdMonoid.exists_factors a h)

name: ne_zero_of_mem_factors
statement:
theorem ne_zero_of_mem_factors {R : Type v} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsPrincipalIdealRing R]
    {a b : R} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ∈ factors a) : b ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  Irreducible.ne_zero ((factors_spec a ha).1 b hb)

name: mem_submonoid_of_factors_subset_of_units_subset
statement:
theorem mem_submonoid_of_factors_subset_of_units_subset (s : Submonoid R) {a : R} (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (hfac : ∀ b ∈ factors a, b ∈ s) (hunit : ∀ c : Rˣ, (c : R) ∈ s) : a ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  rcases (factors_spec a ha).2 with ⟨c, hc⟩
  rw [← hc]
  exact mul_mem (multiset_prod_mem _ hfac) (hunit _)

name: ringHom_mem_submonoid_of_factors_subset_of_units_subset
statement:
theorem ringHom_mem_submonoid_of_factors_subset_of_units_subset {R S : Type*} [CommRing R]
    [IsDomain R] [IsPrincipalIdealRing R] [NonAssocSemiring S] (f : R →+* S) (s : Submonoid S)
    (a : R) (ha : a ≠ 0) (h : ∀ b ∈ factors a, f b ∈ s) (hf : ∀ c : Rˣ, f c ∈ s) : f a ∈ s
proof:
:=
  mem_submonoid_of_factors_subset_of_units_subset (s.comap f.toMonoidHom) ha h hf

name: Submodule.IsPrincipal.map
statement:
theorem Submodule.IsPrincipal.map (f : M →ₗ[R] N) {S : Submodule R M}
    (hI : IsPrincipal S) : IsPrincipal (map f S)
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨f (IsPrincipal.generator S), by
      rw [← Set.image_singleton, ← map_span, span_singleton_generator]⟩⟩

name: Submodule.IsPrincipal.of_comap
statement:
theorem Submodule.IsPrincipal.of_comap (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (hf : Function.Surjective f)
    (S : Submodule R N) [hI : IsPrincipal (S.comap f)] : IsPrincipal S
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Submodule.map_comap_eq_of_surjective hf S]
  exact hI.map f

name: Submodule.IsPrincipal.map_ringHom
statement:
theorem Submodule.IsPrincipal.map_ringHom (f : F) {I : Ideal R}
    (hI : IsPrincipal I) : IsPrincipal (Ideal.map f I)
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨f (IsPrincipal.generator I), by
      rw [Ideal.submodule_span_eq, ← Set.image_singleton, ← Ideal.map_span,
      Ideal.span_singleton_generator]⟩⟩

name: Ideal.IsPrincipal.of_comap
statement:
theorem Ideal.IsPrincipal.of_comap (f : F) (hf : Function.Surjective f) (I : Ideal S)
    [hI : IsPrincipal (I.comap f)] : IsPrincipal I
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_comap_of_surjective f hf I]
  exact hI.map_ringHom f

name: IsPrincipalIdealRing.of_surjective
statement:
theorem IsPrincipalIdealRing.of_surjective [IsPrincipalIdealRing R] (f : F)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) : IsPrincipalIdealRing S
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun I => Ideal.IsPrincipal.of_comap f hf I⟩

name: isPrincipalIdealRing_prod_iff
statement:
theorem isPrincipalIdealRing_prod_iff :
    IsPrincipalIdealRing (R × S) ↔ IsPrincipalIdealRing R ∧ IsPrincipalIdealRing S where
  mp h
proof:
:= ⟨h.of_surjective (RingHom.fst R S) Prod.fst_surjective,
    h.of_surjective (RingHom.snd R S) Prod.snd_surjective⟩
  mpr := fun ⟨_, _⟩ ↦ inferInstance

name: isPrincipalIdealRing_pi_iff
statement:
theorem isPrincipalIdealRing_pi_iff {ι} [Finite ι] {R : ι → Type*} [∀ i, Semiring (R i)] :
    IsPrincipalIdealRing (Π i, R i) ↔ ∀ i, IsPrincipalIdealRing (R i) where
  mp h i
proof:
:= h.of_surjective (Pi.evalRingHom R i) (Function.surjective_eval _)
  mpr _ := inferInstance

name: isCoprime_of_dvd
statement:
theorem isCoprime_of_dvd (x y : R) (nonzero : ¬(x = 0 ∧ y = 0))
    (H : ∀ z ∈ nonunits R, z ≠ 0 → z ∣ x → ¬z ∣ y) : IsCoprime x y
proof:
:=
  (isRelPrime_of_no_nonunits_factors nonzero H).isCoprime

name: dvd_or_isCoprime
statement: theorem dvd_or_isCoprime (x y : R) (h : Irreducible x) : x ∣ y ∨ IsCoprime x y
proof:
:=
  h.dvd_or_isRelPrime.imp_right IsRelPrime.isCoprime

name: Irreducible.coprime_iff_not_dvd
statement:
theorem Irreducible.coprime_iff_not_dvd {p n : R} (hp : Irreducible p) :
    IsCoprime p n ↔ ¬p ∣ n
proof: := by rw [← isRelPrime_iff_isCoprime, hp.isRelPrime_iff_not_dvd]

name: Irreducible.dvd_iff_not_isCoprime
statement: theorem Irreducible.dvd_iff_not_isCoprime {p n : R} (hp : Irreducible p) : p ∣ n ↔ ¬IsCoprime p n
proof:
:=
  iff_not_comm.2 hp.coprime_iff_not_dvd

name: Irreducible.coprime_pow_of_not_dvd
statement:
theorem Irreducible.coprime_pow_of_not_dvd {p a : R} (m : ℕ) (hp : Irreducible p) (h : ¬p ∣ a) :
    IsCoprime a (p ^ m)
proof:
:=
  (hp.coprime_iff_not_dvd.2 h).symm.pow_right

name: Irreducible.isCoprime_or_dvd
statement: theorem Irreducible.isCoprime_or_dvd {p : R} (hp : Irreducible p) (i : R) : IsCoprime p i ∨ p ∣ i
proof:
:=
  (_root_.em _).imp_right hp.dvd_iff_not_isCoprime.2

name: IsBezout.span_gcd_eq_span_gcd
statement:
theorem IsBezout.span_gcd_eq_span_gcd (x y : R) :
    span {GCDMonoid.gcd x y} = span {IsBezout.gcd x y}
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.span_singleton_eq_span_singleton]
  exact associated_of_dvd_dvd
    (IsBezout.dvd_gcd (GCDMonoid.gcd_dvd_left _ _) <| GCDMonoid.gcd_dvd_right _ _)
    (GCDMonoid.dvd_gcd (IsBezout.gcd_dvd_left _ _) <| IsBezout.gcd_dvd_right _ _)

name: span_gcd
statement: theorem span_gcd (x y : R) : span {gcd x y} = span {x, y}
proof:
:= by
  rw [← IsBezout.span_gcd, IsBezout.span_gcd_eq_span_gcd]

name: gcd_dvd_iff_exists
statement: theorem gcd_dvd_iff_exists (a b : R) {z} : gcd a b ∣ z ↔ ∃ x y, z = a * x + b * y
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [mul_comm a, mul_comm b, @eq_comm _ z, ← Ideal.mem_span_pair, ← span_gcd,
    Ideal.mem_span_singleton]

name: exists_gcd_eq_mul_add_mul
statement: theorem exists_gcd_eq_mul_add_mul (a b : R) : ∃ x y, gcd a b = a * x + b * y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← gcd_dvd_iff_exists]

name: gcd_isUnit_iff
statement: theorem gcd_isUnit_iff (x y : R) : IsUnit (gcd x y) ↔ IsCoprime x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsCoprime, ← Ideal.mem_span_pair, ← span_gcd, ← span_singleton_eq_top, eq_top_iff_one]

name: Prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd
statement: theorem Prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd {p n : R} (hp : Prime p) : IsCoprime p n ↔ ¬p ∣ n
proof:
:=
  hp.irreducible.coprime_iff_not_dvd

name: exists_associated_pow_of_mul_eq_pow'
statement:
theorem exists_associated_pow_of_mul_eq_pow' {a b c : R} (hab : IsCoprime a b) {k : ℕ}
    (h : a * b = c ^ k) : ∃ d : R, Associated (d ^ k) a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let := IsBezout.toGCDDomain R
  exact exists_associated_pow_of_mul_eq_pow ((gcd_isUnit_iff _ _).mpr hab) h

name: exists_associated_pow_of_associated_pow_mul
statement:
theorem exists_associated_pow_of_associated_pow_mul {a b c : R} (hab : IsCoprime a b) {k : ℕ}
    (h : Associated (c ^ k) (a * b)) : ∃ d : R, Associated (d ^ k) a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := h.symm
  exact exists_associated_pow_of_mul_eq_pow'
    ((isCoprime_mul_unit_right_right u.isUnit a b).mpr hab) <| mul_assoc a _ _ ▸ hu

name: isCoprime_of_irreducible_dvd
statement:
theorem isCoprime_of_irreducible_dvd {x y : R} (nonzero : ¬(x = 0 ∧ y = 0))
    (H : ∀ z : R, Irreducible z → z ∣ x → ¬z ∣ y) : IsCoprime x y
proof:
:=
  (WfDvdMonoid.isRelPrime_of_no_irreducible_factors nonzero H).isCoprime

name: isCoprime_of_prime_dvd
statement:
theorem isCoprime_of_prime_dvd {x y : R} (nonzero : ¬(x = 0 ∧ y = 0))
    (H : ∀ z : R, Prime z → z ∣ x → ¬z ∣ y) : IsCoprime x y
proof:
:=
  isCoprime_of_irreducible_dvd nonzero fun z zi ↦ H z zi.prime

name: nonPrincipals_eq_empty_iff
statement: theorem nonPrincipals_eq_empty_iff : nonPrincipals R = ∅ ↔ IsPrincipalIdealRing R
proof:
:= by
  simp [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem, isPrincipalIdealRing_iff]

name: nonPrincipals_zorn
statement:
theorem nonPrincipals_zorn (hR : ¬IsPrincipalIdealRing R) (c : Set (Ideal R))
    (hs : c ⊆ nonPrincipals R) (hchain : IsChain (· ≤ ·) c) :
    ∃ I ∈ nonPrincipals R, ∀ J ∈ c, J ≤ I
proof:
:= by
  by_cases H : c.Nonempty
  · obtain ⟨K, hKmem⟩ := Set.nonempty_def.1 H
    refine ⟨sSup c, fun ⟨x, hx⟩ ↦ ?_, fun _ ↦ le_sSup⟩
    have hxmem : x ∈ sSup c := hx.symm ▸ Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self x
    obtain ⟨J, hJc, hxJ⟩ := (Submodule.mem_sSup_of_directed ⟨K, hKmem⟩ hchain.directedOn).1 hxmem
    have hsSupJ : sSup c = J := le_antisymm (by simp [hx, Ideal.span_le, hxJ]) (le_sSup hJc)
    exact hs hJc ⟨hsSupJ ▸ ⟨x, hx⟩⟩
  · simpa [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.1 H, isPrincipalIdealRing_iff] using hR

name: exists_maximal_not_isPrincipal
statement:
theorem exists_maximal_not_isPrincipal (hR : ¬IsPrincipalIdealRing R) :
    ∃ I : Ideal R, Maximal (¬·.IsPrincipal) I
proof:
:=
  zorn_le₀ _ (nonPrincipals_zorn hR)

name: span_singleton_inf_span_singleton
statement:
lemma span_singleton_inf_span_singleton [EuclideanDomain R] [GCDMonoid R] (n m : R) :
    span {n} ⊓ span {m} = span {lcm n m}
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.ext_iff]
  intro x
  rw [Ideal.mem_inf]
  simp only [Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
  exact lcm_dvd_iff.symm

name: Ideal.exists_normalized_span_of_isPrincipal
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := ‹I.IsPrincipal›
  refine ⟨normalize x, normalize_idem x, le_antisymm ?_ ?_⟩ <;>
  simp [Ideal.mem_span_singleton]

name: mk_apply
statement: lemma mk_apply (x) : Ideal.Quotient.mk Q (φ x) = x ^ Nat.card (R ⧸ Q.under R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_pow, Ideal.Quotient.eq]
  exact H x

name: finite_quotient
statement: lemma finite_quotient : _root_.Finite (R ⧸ Q.under R)
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! h
  obtain rfl : Q = ⊤ := by simpa [Nat.card_eq_zero_of_infinite, ← Ideal.eq_top_iff_one] using H 0
  simp only [Ideal.comap_top] at h
  exact not_finite (R ⧸ (⊤ : Ideal R))

name: card_pos
statement: lemma card_pos : 0 < Nat.card (R ⧸ Q.under R)
proof:
:=
  have := H.finite_quotient
  Nat.card_pos

name: le_comap
statement: lemma le_comap : Q ≤ Q.comap φ
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  simp_all only [Ideal.mem_comap, ← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem (I := Q), H.mk_apply,
    zero_pow_eq, ite_eq_right_iff, H.card_pos.ne', false_implies]

name: restrict_apply
statement:
lemma restrict_apply (x : S ⧸ Q) :
    H.restrict x = x ^ Nat.card (R ⧸ Q.under R)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
  exact H.mk_apply x

name: restrict_mk
statement: lemma restrict_mk (x : S) : H.restrict ↑x = ↑(φ x)
proof: := rfl

name: restrict_injective
statement:
lemma restrict_injective [Q.IsPrime] :
    Function.Injective H.restrict
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro x hx
  simpa [restrict_apply, H.card_pos.ne'] using hx

name: comap_eq
statement: lemma comap_eq [Q.IsPrime] : Q.comap φ = Q
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (fun x hx ↦ ?_) H.le_comap
  rwa [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, ← H.restrict_injective.eq_iff, map_zero, restrict_mk,
    Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, ← Ideal.mem_comap]

name: apply_of_pow_eq_one
statement:
lemma apply_of_pow_eq_one [IsDomain S] {ζ : S} {m : ℕ} (hζ : ζ ^ m = 1) (hk' : ↑m ∉ Q) :
    φ ζ = ζ ^ Nat.card (R ⧸ Q.under R)
proof:
:= by
  set q := Nat.card (R ⧸ Q.under R)
  have hm : m ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; exact hk' (by simp)
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hζ⟩ := IsPrimitiveRoot.exists_pos hζ hm
  have hk' : ↑k ∉ Q := fun h ↦ hk' (Q.mem_of_dvd (Nat.cast_dvd_cast (hζ.2 m ‹_›)) h)
  have : NeZero k := ⟨hk.ne'⟩
  obtain ⟨i, hi, e⟩ := hζ.eq_pow_of_pow_eq_one (ξ := φ ζ) (by rw [← map_pow, hζ.1, map_one])
  have (j : _) : 1 - ζ ^ ((q + k - i) * j) ∈ Q := by
    rw [← Ideal.mul_unit_mem_iff_mem _ ((hζ.isUnit NeZero.out).pow (i * j)),
      sub_mul, one_mul, ← pow_add, ← add_mul, tsub_add_cancel_of_le (by linarith), add_mul,
        pow_add, pow_mul _ k, hζ.1, one_pow, mul_one, pow_mul, e, ← map_pow, mul_comm, pow_mul]
    exact H _
  have h₁ := sum_mem (t := Finset.range k) fun j _ ↦ this j
  have h₂ := geom_sum_mul (ζ ^ (q + k - i)) k
  rw [pow_right_comm, hζ.1, one_pow, sub_self, mul_eq_zero, sub_eq_zero] at h₂
  rcases h₂ with h₂ | h₂
  · simp [h₂, pow_mul, hk'] at h₁
  replace h₂ := congr($h₂ * ζ ^ i)
  rw [one_mul, ← pow_add, tsub_add_cancel_of_le (by linarith), pow_add, hζ.1, mul_one] at h₂
  rw [h₂, e]

name: localize_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
lemma localize_algebraMap [Q.IsPrime] (x : S) :
    H.localize (algebraMap _ _ x) = algebraMap _ _ (φ x)
proof:
:=
  Localization.localRingHom_to_map _ _ _ H.comap_eq.symm _

name: isArithFrobAt_localize
statement: lemma isArithFrobAt_localize [Q.IsPrime] : H.localize.IsArithFrobAt (maximalIdeal _)
proof:
:= by
  have h : Nat.card (R ⧸ (maximalIdeal _).comap (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime Q))) =
      Nat.card (R ⧸ Q.under R) := by
    congr 2
    rw [← Ideal.under_def, ← Ideal.under_under (B := S), Localization.AtPrime.under_maximalIdeal]
  intro x
  obtain ⟨x, s, rfl⟩ := IsLocalization.exists_mk'_eq Q.primeCompl x
  simp only [localize, coe_mk, Localization.localRingHom_mk', RingHom.coe_coe, h,
    ← IsLocalization.mk'_pow]
  rw [← IsLocalization.mk'_sub,
    IsLocalization.AtPrime.mk'_mem_maximal_iff (Localization.AtPrime Q) Q]
  simp only [SubmonoidClass.coe_pow, ← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
  simp [H.mk_apply]

name: eq_of_isUnramifiedAt
statement:
lemma eq_of_isUnramifiedAt
    (H' : ψ.IsArithFrobAt Q) [Q.IsPrime] (hQ : Q.primeCompl ≤ S⁰)
    [Algebra.IsUnramifiedAt R Q] [IsNoetherianRing S] : φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  have : H.localize = H'.localize := by
    apply Algebra.FormallyUnramified.ext_of_iInf _
      (Ideal.iInf_pow_eq_bot_of_isLocalRing (maximalIdeal _) Ideal.IsPrime.ne_top')
    intro x
    rw [H.isArithFrobAt_localize.mk_apply, H'.isArithFrobAt_localize.mk_apply]
  ext x
  apply IsLocalization.injective (Localization.AtPrime Q) hQ
  rw [← H.localize_algebraMap, ← H'.localize_algebraMap, this]

name: mem_stabilizer
statement: theorem mem_stabilizer [Q.IsPrime] (h : IsArithFrobAt R σ Q) : σ ∈ MulAction.stabilizer G Q
proof:
:= by
  rw [MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff]
  conv_lhs => rw [← h.comap_eq]
  rw [Ideal.pointwise_smul_def]
  exact Q.map_comap_eq_self_of_equiv (MulSemiringAction.toRingEquiv G S σ)

name: mul_inv_mem_inertia
statement:
lemma mul_inv_mem_inertia (H : IsArithFrobAt R σ Q) (H' : IsArithFrobAt R σ' Q) :
    σ * σ'⁻¹ ∈ Q.inertia G
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  simpa [mul_smul] using sub_mem (H (σ'⁻¹ • x)) (H' (σ'⁻¹ • x))

name: conj
statement: lemma conj (H : IsArithFrobAt R σ Q) (τ : G) : IsArithFrobAt R (τ * σ * τ⁻¹) (τ • Q)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  have : (Q.map (MulSemiringAction.toRingEquiv G S τ)).under R = Q.under R := by
    rw [← Ideal.comap_symm, ← Ideal.comap_coe, Ideal.under, Ideal.comap_comap]
    congr 1
    exact (MulSemiringAction.toAlgEquiv R S τ).symm.toAlgHom.comp_algebraMap
  rw [Ideal.pointwise_smul_eq_comap, Ideal.mem_comap]
  simpa [smul_sub, mul_smul, this] using H (τ⁻¹ • x)

name: exists_of_isInvariant
statement: lemma exists_of_isInvariant [Q.IsPrime] [Finite (S ⧸ Q)] : ∃ σ : G, IsArithFrobAt R σ Q
proof:
:= by
  let P := Q.under R
  have := Algebra.IsInvariant.isIntegral R S G
  have : Q.IsMaximal := Ideal.Quotient.maximal_of_isField _ (Finite.isField_of_domain (S ⧸ Q))
  obtain ⟨p, hc⟩ := CharP.exists (R ⧸ P)
  have : Finite (R ⧸ P) := .of_injective _ Ideal.algebraMap_quotient_injective
  cases nonempty_fintype (R ⧸ P)
  obtain ⟨k, hp, hk⟩ := FiniteField.card (R ⧸ P) p
  have := CharP.of_ringHom_of_ne_zero (algebraMap (R ⧸ P) (S ⧸ Q)) p hp.ne_zero
  have : ExpChar (S ⧸ Q) p := .prime hp
  let l : (S ⧸ Q) ≃ₐ[R ⧸ P] S ⧸ Q :=
    { __ := iterateFrobeniusEquiv (S ⧸ Q) p k,
      commutes' r := by
        dsimp [iterateFrobenius_def]
        rw [← map_pow, ← hk, FiniteField.pow_card] }
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.stabilizerHom_surjective G P Q l
  refine ⟨σ, fun x ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, hk]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun hσ (Ideal.Quotient.mk Q x)

name: exists_primesOver_isConj
statement:
lemma exists_primesOver_isConj (P : Ideal R)
    (hP : ∃ Q : Ideal.primesOver P S, Finite (S ⧸ Q.1)) :
    ∃ σ : Ideal.primesOver P S → G, (∀ Q, IsArithFrobAt R (σ Q) Q.1) ∧
      (∀ Q₁ Q₂, IsConj (σ Q₁) (σ Q₂))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨Q, hQ₁, hQ₂⟩, hQ₃⟩ := hP
  have (Q' : Ideal.primesOver P S) : ∃ σ : G, Q'.1 = σ • Q :=
    Algebra.IsInvariant.exists_smul_of_under_eq R S G _ _ (hQ₂.over.symm.trans Q'.2.2.over)
  choose τ hτ using this
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := exists_of_isInvariant R G Q
  refine ⟨fun Q' ↦ τ Q' * σ * (τ Q')⁻¹, fun Q' ↦ hτ Q' ▸ hσ.conj (τ Q'), fun Q₁ Q₂ ↦
    .trans (.symm (isConj_iff.mpr ⟨τ Q₁, rfl⟩)) (isConj_iff.mpr ⟨τ Q₂, rfl⟩)⟩

name: arithFrobAt
statement: protected lemma arithFrobAt [Q.IsPrime] [Finite (S ⧸ Q)] : IsArithFrobAt R (arithFrobAt R G Q) Q
proof:
:=
  (exists_primesOver_isConj S G (Q.under R)
    ⟨⟨Q, ‹_›, ⟨rfl⟩⟩, ‹Finite (S ⧸ Q)›⟩).choose_spec.1 ⟨Q, ‹_›, ⟨rfl⟩⟩

name: arithFrobAt_mem_stabilizer
statement:
theorem arithFrobAt_mem_stabilizer [Q.IsPrime] [Finite (S ⧸ Q)] :
    arithFrobAt R G Q ∈ MulAction.stabilizer G Q
proof:
:=
  mem_stabilizer (.arithFrobAt R G Q)

name: _root_.isConj_arithFrobAt
statement:
lemma _root_.isConj_arithFrobAt
    [Q.IsPrime] [Finite (S ⧸ Q)] (Q' : Ideal S) [Q'.IsPrime] [Finite (S ⧸ Q')]
    (H : Q.under R = Q'.under R) : IsConj (arithFrobAt R G Q) (arithFrobAt R G Q')
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hP, h₁, h₂⟩ : ∃ P : Ideal R, P.IsPrime ∧ P = Q.under R ∧ P = Q'.under R :=
    ⟨Q.under R, inferInstance, rfl, H⟩
  convert!
    (exists_primesOver_isConj S G P ⟨⟨Q, ‹_›, ⟨h₁⟩⟩, ‹Finite (S ⧸ Q)›⟩).choose_spec.2 ⟨Q, ‹_›, ⟨h₁⟩⟩
      ⟨Q', ‹_›, ⟨h₂⟩⟩
  · subst h₁; rfl
  · subst h₂; rfl

name: iff_span_pair_isPrincipal
statement:
theorem iff_span_pair_isPrincipal :
    IsBezout R ↔ ∀ x y : R, (Ideal.span {x, y} : Ideal R).IsPrincipal
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro H x y; infer_instance
  · intro H
    constructor
    apply Submodule.fg_induction
    · exact fun _ => ⟨⟨_, rfl⟩⟩
    · rintro _ _ _ _ ⟨⟨x, rfl⟩⟩ ⟨⟨y, rfl⟩⟩
      rw [← Submodule.span_insert]
      exact H _ _

name: _root_.Function.Surjective.isBezout
statement:
theorem _root_.Function.Surjective.isBezout {S : Type v} [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) [IsBezout R] : IsBezout S
proof:
:= by
  rw [iff_span_pair_isPrincipal]
  intro x y
  obtain ⟨⟨x, rfl⟩, ⟨y, rfl⟩⟩ := hf x, hf y
  use f (gcd x y)
  trans Ideal.map f (Ideal.span {gcd x y})
  · simp [span_gcd, Ideal.map_span]
  · simp [Ideal.map_span]

name: TFAE
statement:
theorem TFAE [IsBezout R] [IsDomain R] :
    List.TFAE
    [IsNoetherianRing R, IsPrincipalIdealRing R, UniqueFactorizationMonoid R, WfDvdMonoid R]
proof:
:= by
  tfae_have 1 → 2
  | _ => inferInstance
  tfae_have 2 → 3
  | _ => inferInstance
  tfae_have 3 → 4
  | _ => inferInstance
  tfae_have 4 → 1
  | ⟨h⟩ => by
    rw [isNoetherianRing_iff, isNoetherian_iff_fg_wellFounded]
    refine ⟨RelEmbedding.wellFounded ?_ h⟩
    have : ∀ I : { J : Ideal R // J.FG }, ∃ x : R, (I : Ideal R) = Ideal.span {x} :=
      fun ⟨I, hI⟩ => (IsBezout.isPrincipal_of_FG I hI).1
    choose f hf using this
    exact
      { toFun := f
        inj' := fun x y e => by ext1; rw [hf, hf, e]
        map_rel_iff' := by
          dsimp
          intro a b
          rw [← Ideal.span_singleton_lt_span_singleton, ← hf, ← hf]
          rfl }
  tfae_finish

name: Algebra.norm_one_add_smul
statement:
lemma Algebra.norm_one_add_smul {A B} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    [Module.Free A B] [Module.Finite A B] (a : A) (x : B) :
    ∃ r : A, Algebra.norm A (1 + a • x) = 1 + Algebra.trace A B x * a + r * a ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let ι := Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex A B
  let b : Basis ι A B := Module.Free.chooseBasis _ _
  have : Fintype ι := inferInstance
  clear_value ι b
  simp_rw [Algebra.norm_eq_matrix_det b, Algebra.trace_eq_matrix_trace b]
  simp only [map_add, map_one, map_smul, Matrix.det_one_add_smul a]
  exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: toFunBilinear_apply_apply
statement:
theorem toFunBilinear_apply_apply (a : A) (p : R[X]) :

name: toFunBilinear_apply_eq_smul

@[simp] theorem toFunBilinear_apply_eq_smul (a : A) (p : R[X]) :

name: toFunBilinear_apply_eq_sum
statement:
theorem toFunBilinear_apply_eq_sum (a : A) (p : R[X]) :
    toFunBilinear R A a p = p.sum fun n r ↦ monomial n (a * algebraMap R A r)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [toFunBilinear_apply_eq_smul, ← p.sum_monomial_eq, sum, Polynomial.map_sum]

name: toFunLinear_tmul_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toFunLinear_tmul_apply (a : A) (p : R[X]) :
    toFunLinear R A (a ⊗ₜ[R] p) = toFunBilinear R A a p
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: toFunLinear_mul_tmul_mul_aux_1
statement:
theorem toFunLinear_mul_tmul_mul_aux_1 (p : R[X]) (k : ℕ) (h : Decidable ¬p.coeff k = 0) (a : A) :
    ite (¬coeff p k = 0) (a * (algebraMap R A) (coeff p k)) 0 =
    a * (algebraMap R A) (coeff p k)
proof: := by split_ifs <;> simp [*]

name: toFunLinear_mul_tmul_mul_aux_2
statement:
theorem toFunLinear_mul_tmul_mul_aux_2 (k : ℕ) (a₁ a₂ : A) (p₁ p₂ : R[X]) :
    a₁ * a₂ * (algebraMap R A) ((p₁ * p₂).coeff k) =
      (Finset.antidiagonal k).sum fun x =>
        a₁ * (algebraMap R A) (coeff p₁ x.1) * (a₂ * (algebraMap R A) (coeff p₂ x.2))
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [mul_assoc, Algebra.commutes, ← Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  congr
  simp_rw [Algebra.commutes (coeff p₂ _), coeff_mul, map_sum, map_mul]

name: toFunLinear_mul_tmul_mul
statement:
theorem toFunLinear_mul_tmul_mul (a₁ a₂ : A) (p₁ p₂ : R[X]) :
    (toFunLinear R A) ((a₁ * a₂) ⊗ₜ[R] (p₁ * p₂)) =
      (toFunLinear R A) (a₁ ⊗ₜ[R] p₁) * (toFunLinear R A) (a₂ ⊗ₜ[R] p₂)
proof:
:= by
  classical
    simp only [toFunLinear_tmul_apply, toFunBilinear_apply_eq_sum]
    ext k
    simp_rw [coeff_sum, coeff_monomial, sum_def, Finset.sum_ite_eq', mem_support_iff, Ne]
    conv_rhs => rw [coeff_mul]
    simp_rw [finsetSum_coeff, coeff_monomial, Finset.sum_ite_eq', mem_support_iff, Ne, mul_ite,
      mul_zero, ite_mul, zero_mul]
    simp_rw [← ite_zero_mul (¬coeff p₁ _ = 0) (a₁ * (algebraMap R A) (coeff p₁ _))]
    simp_rw [← mul_ite_zero (¬coeff p₂ _ = 0) _ (_ * _)]
    simp_rw [toFunLinear_mul_tmul_mul_aux_1, toFunLinear_mul_tmul_mul_aux_2]

name: toFunLinear_one_tmul_one
statement:
theorem toFunLinear_one_tmul_one :
    toFunLinear R A (1 ⊗ₜ[R] 1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [toFunLinear_tmul_apply, toFunBilinear_apply_apply, Polynomial.aeval_one, one_smul]

name: invFun_add
statement:

theorem invFun_add {p q} : invFun R A (p + q) = invFun R A p + invFun R A q

name: invFun_monomial

name: left_inv
statement: theorem left_inv (x : A ⊗ R[X]) : invFun R A ((toFunAlgHom R A) x) = x
proof:
:= by
  refine TensorProduct.inductionOn x ?_ ?_
  · intro a p
    dsimp only [invFun]
    rw [toFunAlgHom_apply_tmul, eval₂_sum]
    simp_rw [eval₂_monomial, AlgHom.coe_toRingHom, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_pow, one_pow,
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, mul_one,
      one_mul, ← Algebra.commutes, ← Algebra.smul_def, smul_tmul, sum_def, ← tmul_sum]
    conv_rhs => rw [← sum_C_mul_X_pow_eq p]
    simp only [Algebra.smul_def]
    rfl
  · intro p q hp hq
    simp only [map_add, invFun_add, hp, hq]

name: right_inv
statement: theorem right_inv (x : A[X]) : (toFunAlgHom R A) (invFun R A x) = x
proof:
:= by
  refine Polynomial.induction_on' x ?_ ?_
  · intro p q hp hq
    simp only [invFun_add, map_add, hp, hq]
  · intro n a
    rw [invFun_monomial, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_pow,
        one_pow, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, mul_one, one_mul, toFunAlgHom_apply_tmul,
        X_pow_eq_monomial, sum_monomial_index] <;>
      simp

  MonoidAlgebra.of_injective.comp fun _ _ =>
    (Multiset.coe_eq_coe.trans List.singleton_perm_singleton).mp

@[simp]

proof: := MonoidAlgebra.single_ne_zero.2 Int.one_ne_zero

proof:

name: induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim, induction_eliminator]
protected theorem induction_on {motive : FreeCommRing α → Prop} (z : FreeCommRing α)
    (neg_one : motive (-1)) (of : ∀ b, motive (of b))
    (add : ∀ x y, motive x → motive y → motive (x + y))
    (mul : ∀ x y, motive x → motive y → motive (x * y)) : motive z
proof:
:=
  have neg : ∀ x, motive x → motive (-x) := fun x ih => neg_one_mul x ▸ mul _ _ neg_one ih
  have one : motive 1 := neg_neg (1 : FreeCommRing α) ▸ neg _ neg_one
  have nsmul (n : ℕ) (x : FreeCommRing α) (hx : motive x) : motive (n • x) := by
    induction n with
    | zero => simpa using add (-1) 1 neg_one one
    | succ n ih => rw [succ_nsmul]; exact add _ _ ih hx
  have zsmul (n : ℤ) (x : FreeCommRing α) (hx : motive x) : motive (n • x) := by
    induction n using Int.negInduction with
    | nat n => rw [natCast_zsmul]; exact nsmul n x hx
    | neg ih n => rw [neg_zsmul]; exact neg _ (ih n)
  MonoidAlgebra.induction_on z
    (Multiplicative.rec (Multiset.induction one
      (fun x xs ih => by
        rw [← Multiset.singleton_add, ofAdd_add, map_mul]
        exact mul _ _ (of x) ih)))
    add zsmul

name: isSupported_upwards
statement: theorem isSupported_upwards (hs : IsSupported x s) (hst : s ⊆ t) : IsSupported x t

  Subring.closure_mono (Set.monotone_image hst) hs

statement: theorem isSupported_add (hxs : IsSupported x s) (hys : IsSupported y s) : IsSupported (x + y) s
proof:
:=
  Subring.add_mem _ hxs hys

proof:
