name: algebraMap_C_mem_adicCompletionIntegers
statement:
lemma algebraMap_C_mem_adicCompletionIntegers (x : K) :
    ((LaurentSeriesRingEquiv K).toRingHom.comp HahnSeries.C) x ∈
      adicCompletionIntegers K⟮X⟯ (idealX K)
proof:
:= by
  have : HahnSeries.C x = ofPowerSeries ℤ K (PowerSeries.C x) := by
    simp [C_apply, ofPowerSeries_C]
  simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe, this]
  apply LaurentSeriesRingEquiv_mem_valuationSubring

name: isOka_isPrincipal
statement:
theorem isOka_isPrincipal : IsOka (Submodule.IsPrincipal (R := R)) where
  top
proof:
:= top_isPrincipal
  oka {I a} := by
    intro ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩
    refine ⟨x * y, le_antisymm ?_ ?_⟩ <;> rw [submodule_span_eq] at *
    · intro i hi
      have hisup : i ∈ I ⊔ span {a} := mem_sup_left hi
      have hasup : a ∈ I ⊔ span {a} := mem_sup_right (mem_span_singleton_self a)
      rw [hx, mem_span_singleton'] at hisup hasup
      obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hisup
      obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := hasup
      obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ : ∃ z, z * y = u := by
        rw [← mem_span_singleton', ← hy, mem_colon_span_singleton, mul_comm v, ← mul_assoc]
        exact mul_mem_right _ _ hi
      exact mem_span_singleton'.2 ⟨z, by rw [mul_assoc, mul_comm y]⟩
    · rw [← span_singleton_mul_span_singleton, ← hx, Ideal.sup_mul, sup_le_iff,
        span_singleton_mul_span_singleton, mul_comm a, span_singleton_le_iff_mem]
      exact ⟨mul_le_left, mem_colon_span_singleton.1 <| hy ▸ mem_span_singleton_self y⟩

name: IsPrincipalIdealRing.of_prime
statement:
theorem IsPrincipalIdealRing.of_prime (H : ∀ P : Ideal R, P.IsPrime → P.IsPrincipal) :
    IsPrincipalIdealRing R
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨isOka_isPrincipal.forall_of_forall_prime (fun I hI ↦ exists_maximal_not_isPrincipal ?_) H⟩
  rw [isPrincipalIdealRing_iff, not_forall]
  exact ⟨I, hI⟩

name: IsPrincipalIdealRing.of_prime_ne_bot
statement:
theorem IsPrincipalIdealRing.of_prime_ne_bot
    (H : ∀ P : Ideal R, P.IsPrime → P ≠ ⊥ → P.IsPrincipal) :
    IsPrincipalIdealRing R
proof:
:=
  .of_prime fun P hp ↦ (eq_or_ne P ⊥).elim (· ▸ inferInstance) <| H _ hp

name: OrthogonalIdempotents.mul_eq
statement:
lemma OrthogonalIdempotents.mul_eq [DecidableEq I] (he : OrthogonalIdempotents e) (i j) :
    e i * e j = if i = j then e i else 0
proof:
:= by
  split
  · simp [*, (he.idem j).eq]
  · exact he.ortho ‹_›

name: OrthogonalIdempotents.iff_mul_eq
statement:
lemma OrthogonalIdempotents.iff_mul_eq [DecidableEq I] :
    OrthogonalIdempotents e ↔ ∀ i j, e i * e j = if i = j then e i else 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨mul_eq, fun H ↦ ⟨fun i ↦ by simpa using! H i i, fun i j e ↦ by simpa [e] using! H i j⟩⟩

name: OrthogonalIdempotents.isIdempotentElem_sum
statement:
lemma OrthogonalIdempotents.isIdempotentElem_sum (he : OrthogonalIdempotents e) {s : Finset I} :
    IsIdempotentElem (∑ i ∈ s, e i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [IsIdempotentElem, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum, he.mul_eq]

name: OrthogonalIdempotents.mul_sum_of_mem
statement:
lemma OrthogonalIdempotents.mul_sum_of_mem (he : OrthogonalIdempotents e)
    {i : I} {s : Finset I} (h : i ∈ s) : e i * ∑ j ∈ s, e j = e i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [Finset.mul_sum, he.mul_eq, h]

name: OrthogonalIdempotents.mul_sum_of_notMem
statement:
lemma OrthogonalIdempotents.mul_sum_of_notMem (he : OrthogonalIdempotents e)
    {i : I} {s : Finset I} (h : i ∉ s) : e i * ∑ j ∈ s, e j = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [Finset.mul_sum, he.mul_eq, h]

name: OrthogonalIdempotents.map
statement:
lemma OrthogonalIdempotents.map (he : OrthogonalIdempotents e) :
    OrthogonalIdempotents (f ∘ e)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [iff_mul_eq, he.mul_eq, ← map_mul f, apply_ite f]

name: OrthogonalIdempotents.map_injective_iff
statement:
lemma OrthogonalIdempotents.map_injective_iff (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    OrthogonalIdempotents (f ∘ e) ↔ OrthogonalIdempotents e
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [iff_mul_eq, ← hf.eq_iff, apply_ite]

name: OrthogonalIdempotents.embedding
statement:
lemma OrthogonalIdempotents.embedding (he : OrthogonalIdempotents e) {J} (i : J ↪ I) :
    OrthogonalIdempotents (e ∘ i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [iff_mul_eq, he.mul_eq]

name: OrthogonalIdempotents.equiv
statement:
lemma OrthogonalIdempotents.equiv {J} (i : J ≃ I) :
    OrthogonalIdempotents (e ∘ i) ↔ OrthogonalIdempotents e
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [iff_mul_eq, i.forall_congr_left]

name: OrthogonalIdempotents.unique
statement:
lemma OrthogonalIdempotents.unique [Unique I] :
    OrthogonalIdempotents e ↔ IsIdempotentElem (e default)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [orthogonalIdempotents_iff, Unique.forall_iff, Subsingleton.pairwise, and_true]

name: OrthogonalIdempotents.option
statement:
lemma OrthogonalIdempotents.option (he : OrthogonalIdempotents e) [Fintype I] (x)
    (hx : IsIdempotentElem x) (hx₁ : x * ∑ i, e i = 0) (hx₂ : (∑ i, e i) * x = 0) :
    OrthogonalIdempotents (Option.elim · x e) where
  idem i
proof:
:= i.rec hx he.idem
  ortho i j ne := by
    classical
    rcases i with - | i <;> rcases j with - | j
    · cases ne rfl
    · simpa only [mul_assoc, Finset.sum_mul, he.mul_eq, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ,
        ↓reduceIte, zero_mul] using! congr_arg (· * e j) hx₁
    · simpa only [Option.elim_some, Option.elim_none, ← mul_assoc, Finset.mul_sum, he.mul_eq,
        Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, ↓reduceIte, mul_zero] using! congr_arg (e i * ·) hx₂
    · exact he.ortho (Option.some_inj.ne.mp ne)

name: CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.iff_ortho_complete
statement:
lemma CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.iff_ortho_complete :
    CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents e ↔ Pairwise (e · * e · = 0) ∧ ∑ i, e i = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [completeOrthogonalIdempotents_iff, orthogonalIdempotents_iff, and_assoc, and_iff_right_of_imp]
  intro ⟨ortho, complete⟩ i
  apply_fun (e i * ·) at complete
  rwa [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_eq_single i (fun _ _ ne ↦ ortho ne.symm) (by simp at ·), mul_one]
    at complete

name: CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.pair_iff'
statement:
lemma CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.pair_iff'ₛ {x y : R} :
    CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents ![x, y] ↔ x * y = 0 ∧ y * x = 0 ∧ x + y = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [iff_ortho_complete, Pairwise, Fin.forall_fin_two, and_assoc]

name: CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.pair_iff
statement:
lemma CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.pair_iffₛ {R} [CommSemiring R] {x y : R} :
    CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents ![x, y] ↔ x * y = 0 ∧ x + y = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [pair_iff'ₛ, and_left_comm, and_iff_right_of_imp]; exact (mul_comm x y ▸ ·.1)

name: CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.unique_iff
statement:
lemma CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.unique_iff [Unique I] :
    CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents e ↔ e default = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [completeOrthogonalIdempotents_iff, OrthogonalIdempotents.unique, Fintype.sum_unique,
    and_iff_right_iff_imp]
  exact (· ▸ IsIdempotentElem.one)

name: CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.single
statement:
lemma CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.single {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (R : I → Type*) [∀ i, Semiring (R i)] :
    CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents (Pi.single (M := R) · 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨by simp [IsIdempotentElem, ← Pi.single_mul], ?_⟩, Finset.univ_sum_single 1⟩
  intro i j hij
  ext k
  by_cases hi : i = k
  · subst hi; simp [hij]
  · simp [hi]

name: CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.map
statement:
lemma CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.map (he : CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents e) :
    CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents (f ∘ e) where
  __
proof:
:= he.toOrthogonalIdempotents.map f
  complete := by simp only [Function.comp_apply, ← map_sum, he.complete, map_one]

name: CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.map_injective_iff
statement:
lemma CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.map_injective_iff (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents (f ∘ e) ↔ CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents e
proof:
:= by
  simp [completeOrthogonalIdempotents_iff, ← hf.eq_iff,
    OrthogonalIdempotents.map_injective_iff f hf]

name: CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.equiv
statement:
lemma CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.equiv {J} [Fintype J] (i : J ≃ I) :
    CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents (e ∘ i) ↔ CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents e
proof:
:= by
  simp only [completeOrthogonalIdempotents_iff, OrthogonalIdempotents.equiv, Function.comp_apply,
    Fintype.sum_equiv i _ e (fun _ ↦ rfl)]

name: CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.of_subsingleton
statement:
@[nontriviality]
lemma CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.of_subsingleton [Subsingleton R] :
    CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents e
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨fun _ ↦ Subsingleton.elim _ _, fun _ _ _ ↦ Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩

name: isIdempotentElem_one_sub_one_sub_pow_pow
statement:
theorem isIdempotentElem_one_sub_one_sub_pow_pow
    (x : R) (n : ℕ) (hx : (x - x ^ 2) ^ n = 0) :
    IsIdempotentElem (1 - (1 - x ^ n) ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  have : (x - x ^ 2) ^ n ∣ (1 - (1 - x ^ n) ^ n) - (1 - (1 - x ^ n) ^ n) ^ 2 := by
    conv_rhs => rw [pow_two, ← mul_one_sub, sub_sub_cancel]
    nth_rw 1 3 [← one_pow n]
    rw [← (Commute.one_left x).mul_geom_sum₂, ← (Commute.one_left (1 - x ^ n)).mul_geom_sum₂]
    simp only [sub_sub_cancel, one_pow, one_mul]
    rw [Commute.mul_pow, Commute.mul_mul_mul_comm, ← Commute.mul_pow, mul_one_sub, ← pow_two]
    · exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
    · simp
    · refine .pow_right (.sub_right (.one_right _) (.sum_left _ _ _ fun _ _ ↦ .pow_left ?_ _)) _
      simp
    · exact .sub_left (.one_left _) (.sum_right _ _ _ fun _ _ ↦ .pow_right rfl _)
  rwa [hx, zero_dvd_iff, sub_eq_zero, eq_comm, pow_two] at this

name: exists_isIdempotentElem_mul_eq_zero_of_ker_isNilpotent_aux
statement:
theorem exists_isIdempotentElem_mul_eq_zero_of_ker_isNilpotent_aux
    (h : ∀ x ∈ RingHom.ker f, IsNilpotent x)
    (e₁ : S) (he : e₁ ∈ f.range) (he₁ : IsIdempotentElem e₁)
    (e₂ : R) (he₂ : IsIdempotentElem e₂) (he₁e₂ : e₁ * f e₂ = 0) :
    ∃ e' : R, IsIdempotentElem e' ∧ f e' = e₁ ∧ e' * e₂ = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e₁, rfl⟩ := he
  cases subsingleton_or_nontrivial R
  · exact ⟨_, Subsingleton.elim _ _, rfl, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩
  let a := e₁ - e₁ * e₂
  have ha : f a = f e₁ := by rw [map_sub, map_mul, he₁e₂, sub_zero]
  have ha' : a * e₂ = 0 := by rw [sub_mul, mul_assoc, he₂.eq, sub_self]
  have hx' : a - a ^ 2 ∈ RingHom.ker f := by
    simp [RingHom.mem_ker, pow_two, ha, he₁.eq]
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := h _ hx'
  refine ⟨_, isIdempotentElem_one_sub_one_sub_pow_pow _ _ hn, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rcases n with - | n
    · simp at hn
    simp only [map_sub, map_one, map_pow, ha, he₁.pow_succ_eq,
      he₁.one_sub.pow_succ_eq, sub_sub_cancel]
  · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (Commute.one_left (MulOpposite.op <| 1 - a ^ n)).sub_dvd_pow_sub_pow n
    apply_fun MulOpposite.unop at hk
    have : 1 - (1 - a ^ n) ^ n = MulOpposite.unop k * a ^ n := by simpa using hk
    rw [this, mul_assoc]
    rcases n with - | n
    · simp at hn
    rw [pow_succ, mul_assoc, ha', mul_zero, mul_zero]

name: exists_isIdempotentElem_mul_eq_zero_of_ker_isNilpotent
statement:
theorem exists_isIdempotentElem_mul_eq_zero_of_ker_isNilpotent
    (h : ∀ x ∈ RingHom.ker f, IsNilpotent x)
    (e₁ : S) (he : e₁ ∈ f.range) (he₁ : IsIdempotentElem e₁)
    (e₂ : R) (he₂ : IsIdempotentElem e₂) (he₁e₂ : e₁ * f e₂ = 0) (he₂e₁ : f e₂ * e₁ = 0) :
    ∃ e' : R, IsIdempotentElem e' ∧ f e' = e₁ ∧ e' * e₂ = 0 ∧ e₂ * e' = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e', h₁, rfl, h₂⟩ := exists_isIdempotentElem_mul_eq_zero_of_ker_isNilpotent_aux
    f h e₁ he he₁ e₂ he₂ he₁e₂
  refine ⟨(1 - e₂) * e', ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [IsIdempotentElem, mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc e', mul_sub, mul_one, h₂, sub_zero, h₁.eq]
  · rw [map_mul, map_sub, map_one, sub_mul, one_mul, he₂e₁, sub_zero]
  · rw [mul_assoc, h₂, mul_zero]
  · rw [← mul_assoc, mul_sub, mul_one, he₂.eq, sub_self, zero_mul]

name: exists_isIdempotentElem_eq_of_ker_isNilpotent
statement:
theorem exists_isIdempotentElem_eq_of_ker_isNilpotent (h : ∀ x ∈ RingHom.ker f, IsNilpotent x)
    (e : S) (he : e ∈ f.range) (he' : IsIdempotentElem e) :
    ∃ e' : R, IsIdempotentElem e' ∧ f e' = e
proof:
:= by
  simpa using exists_isIdempotentElem_mul_eq_zero_of_ker_isNilpotent f h e he he' 0 .zero (by simp)

name: OrthogonalIdempotents.lift_of_isNilpotent_ker_aux
statement:
lemma OrthogonalIdempotents.lift_of_isNilpotent_ker_aux
    (h : ∀ x ∈ RingHom.ker f, IsNilpotent x)
    {n} {e : Fin n → S} (he : OrthogonalIdempotents e) (he' : ∀ i, e i ∈ f.range) :
    ∃ e' : Fin n → R, OrthogonalIdempotents e' ∧ f ∘ e' = e
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => refine ⟨0, ⟨finZeroElim, finZeroElim⟩, funext finZeroElim⟩
  | succ n IH =>
    obtain ⟨e', h₁, h₂⟩ := IH (he.embedding (Fin.succEmb n)) (fun i ↦ he' _)
    have h₂' (i) : f (e' i) = e i.succ := congr_fun h₂ i
    obtain ⟨e₀, h₃, h₄, h₅, h₆⟩ :=
      exists_isIdempotentElem_mul_eq_zero_of_ker_isNilpotent f h _ (he' 0) (he.idem 0) _
      h₁.isIdempotentElem_sum
      (by simp [Finset.mul_sum, h₂', he.mul_eq, eq_comm])
      (by simp [Finset.sum_mul, h₂', he.mul_eq])
    refine ⟨_, (h₁.option _ h₃ h₅ h₆).embedding (finSuccEquiv n).toEmbedding, funext fun i ↦ ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨_ | i, rfl⟩ := (finSuccEquiv n).symm.surjective i <;> simp [*]

name: OrthogonalIdempotents.lift_of_isNilpotent_ker
statement:
lemma OrthogonalIdempotents.lift_of_isNilpotent_ker [Finite I]
    (h : ∀ x ∈ RingHom.ker f, IsNilpotent x)
    {e : I → S} (he : OrthogonalIdempotents e) (he' : ∀ i, e i ∈ f.range) :
    ∃ e' : I → R, OrthogonalIdempotents e' ∧ f ∘ e' = e
proof:
:= by
  cases nonempty_fintype I
  obtain ⟨e', h₁, h₂⟩ := lift_of_isNilpotent_ker_aux f h
    (he.embedding (Fintype.equivFin I).symm.toEmbedding) (fun _ ↦ he' _)
  refine ⟨_, h₁.embedding (Fintype.equivFin I).toEmbedding,
    by ext x; simpa using congr_fun h₂ (Fintype.equivFin I x)⟩

name: CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.pair_iff
statement:
lemma CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.pair_iff {x y : R} :
    CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents ![x, y] ↔ IsIdempotentElem x ∧ y = 1 - x
proof:
:= by
  rw [pair_iff'ₛ, ← eq_sub_iff_add_eq', ← and_assoc, and_congr_left_iff]
  rintro rfl
  simp [mul_sub, sub_mul, IsIdempotentElem, sub_eq_zero, eq_comm]

name: CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.of_isIdempotentElem
statement:
lemma CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.of_isIdempotentElem {e : R} (he : IsIdempotentElem e) :
    CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents ![e, 1 - e]
proof:
:=
  pair_iff.mpr ⟨he, rfl⟩

name: CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.option
statement:
lemma CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.option (he : OrthogonalIdempotents e) :
    CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents (Option.elim · (1 - ∑ i, e i) e) where
  __
proof:
:= he.option _ he.isIdempotentElem_sum.one_sub
    (by simp [sub_mul, he.isIdempotentElem_sum.eq]) (by simp [mul_sub, he.isIdempotentElem_sum.eq])
  complete := by
    rw [Fintype.sum_option]
    exact sub_add_cancel _ _

name: CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.lift_of_isNilpotent_ker_aux
statement:
lemma CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.lift_of_isNilpotent_ker_aux
    (h : ∀ x ∈ RingHom.ker f, IsNilpotent x)
    {n} {e : Fin n → S} (he : CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents e) (he' : ∀ i, e i ∈ f.range) :
    ∃ e' : Fin n → R, CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents e' ∧ f ∘ e' = e
proof:
:= by
  cases subsingleton_or_nontrivial R
  · choose e' he' using he'
    exact ⟨e', .of_subsingleton, funext he'⟩
  cases subsingleton_or_nontrivial S
  · obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := h 1 (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
    simp at hn
  rcases n with - | n
  · simpa using he.complete
  obtain ⟨e', h₁, h₂⟩ := OrthogonalIdempotents.lift_of_isNilpotent_ker f h he.1 he'
  refine ⟨_, (equiv (finSuccEquiv n)).mpr
    (CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.option (h₁.embedding (Fin.succEmb _))), funext fun i ↦ ?_⟩
  have (i : _) : f (e' i) = e i := congr_fun h₂ i
  cases i using Fin.cases with
  | zero => simp [this, Fin.sum_univ_succ, ← he.complete]
  | succ i => simp [this]

name: CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.lift_of_isNilpotent_ker
statement:
lemma CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.lift_of_isNilpotent_ker
    (h : ∀ x ∈ RingHom.ker f, IsNilpotent x)
    {e : I → S} (he : CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents e) (he' : ∀ i, e i ∈ f.range) :
    ∃ e' : I → R, CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents e' ∧ f ∘ e' = e
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e', h₁, h₂⟩ := lift_of_isNilpotent_ker_aux f h
    ((equiv (Fintype.equivFin I).symm).mpr he) (fun _ ↦ he' _)
  refine ⟨_, ((equiv (Fintype.equivFin I)).mpr h₁),
    by ext x; simpa using congr_fun h₂ (Fintype.equivFin I x)⟩

name: eq_of_isNilpotent_sub_of_isIdempotentElem_of_commute
statement:
theorem eq_of_isNilpotent_sub_of_isIdempotentElem_of_commute {e₁ e₂ : R}
    (he₁ : IsIdempotentElem e₁) (he₂ : IsIdempotentElem e₂) (H : IsNilpotent (e₁ - e₂))
    (H' : Commute e₁ e₂) :
    e₁ = e₂
proof:
:= by
  have : (e₁ - e₂) ^ 3 = (e₁ - e₂) := by
    simp only [pow_succ, pow_zero, mul_sub, one_mul, sub_mul, he₁.eq, he₂.eq,
      H'.eq, mul_assoc]
    simp only [← mul_assoc, he₂.eq]
    abel
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := H
  have : (e₁ - e₂) ^ (2 * n + 1) = (e₁ - e₂) := by
    clear hn; induction n <;> simp [mul_add, add_assoc, pow_add _ (2 * _) 3, ← pow_succ, *]
  rwa [pow_succ, two_mul, pow_add, hn, zero_mul, zero_mul, eq_comm, sub_eq_zero] at this

name: CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.of_ker_isNilpotent_of_isMulCentral
statement:
theorem CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.of_ker_isNilpotent_of_isMulCentral
    (h : ∀ x ∈ RingHom.ker f, IsNilpotent x)
    (he : ∀ i, IsIdempotentElem (e i))
    (he' : ∀ i, IsMulCentral (e i))
    (he'' : CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents (f ∘ e)) :
    CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents e
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e', h₁, h₂⟩ := lift_of_isNilpotent_ker f h he'' (fun _ ↦ ⟨_, rfl⟩)
  obtain rfl : e = e' := by
    ext i
    refine eq_of_isNilpotent_sub_of_isIdempotentElem_of_commute
      (he _) (h₁.idem _) (h _ ?_) ((he' i).comm _)
    simpa [RingHom.mem_ker, sub_eq_zero] using congr_fun h₂.symm i
  exact h₁

name: eq_of_isNilpotent_sub_of_isIdempotentElem
proof:
:=
  eq_of_isNilpotent_sub_of_isIdempotentElem_of_commute he₁ he₂ H (.all _ _)

name: existsUnique_isIdempotentElem_eq_of_ker_isNilpotent
statement:
@[stacks 00J9]
theorem existsUnique_isIdempotentElem_eq_of_ker_isNilpotent (h : ∀ x ∈ RingHom.ker f, IsNilpotent x)
    (e : S) (he : e ∈ f.range) (he' : IsIdempotentElem e) :
    ∃! e' : R, IsIdempotentElem e' ∧ f e' = e
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e', he₂, rfl⟩ := exists_isIdempotentElem_eq_of_ker_isNilpotent f h e he he'
  exact ⟨e', ⟨he₂, rfl⟩, fun x ⟨hx, hx'⟩ ↦
    eq_of_isNilpotent_sub_of_isIdempotentElem hx he₂
      (h _ (by rw [RingHom.mem_ker, map_sub, hx', sub_self]))⟩

name: OrthogonalIdempotents.surjective_pi
proof:
:= by
  suffices Pairwise fun i j ↦ IsCoprime (Ideal.span {1 - e i}) (Ideal.span {1 - e j}) by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Ideal.quotientInfToPiQuotient_surj this x
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
    exact ⟨x, by ext i; simp [Ideal.quotientInfToPiQuotient]⟩
  intro i j hij
  rw [Ideal.isCoprime_span_singleton_iff]
  exact ⟨1, e i, by simp [mul_sub, he.ortho hij]⟩

name: OrthogonalIdempotents.prod_one_sub
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction with
  | empty => simp
  | cons a s has ih =>
    simp [ih, sub_mul, mul_sub, he.mul_sum_of_notMem has, sub_sub]

name: CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.of_ker_isNilpotent
statement:
theorem CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.of_ker_isNilpotent (h : ∀ x ∈ RingHom.ker f, IsNilpotent x)
    (he : ∀ i, IsIdempotentElem (e i))
    (he' : CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents (f ∘ e)) :
    CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents e
proof:
:=
  of_ker_isNilpotent_of_isMulCentral f h he
    (fun _ ↦ Semigroup.mem_center_iff.mpr (mul_comm · _)) he'

name: CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.prod_one_sub
statement:
lemma CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.prod_one_sub
    (he : CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents e) :
    ∏ i, (1 - e i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [he.1.prod_one_sub, he.complete, sub_self]

name: CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.of_prod_one_sub
statement:
lemma CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.of_prod_one_sub
    (he : OrthogonalIdempotents e) (he' : ∏ i, (1 - e i) = 0) :
    CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents e where
  __
proof:
:= he
  complete := by rwa [he.prod_one_sub, sub_eq_zero, eq_comm] at he'

name: CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.bijective_pi
statement:
lemma CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.bijective_pi (he : CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents e) :
    Function.Bijective (RingHom.pi fun i ↦ Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {1 - e i}))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨?_, he.1.surjective_pi⟩
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro x hx
  simp only [funext_iff, RingHom.pi_apply, Pi.zero_apply, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem,
    Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hx
  suffices ∀ s : Finset I, (∏ i ∈ s, (1 - e i)) * x = x by
    rw [← this Finset.univ, he.prod_one_sub, zero_mul]
  refine fun s ↦ Finset.induction_on s (by simp) ?_
  intro a s has e'
  suffices (1 - e a) * x = x by simp [has, mul_assoc, e', this]
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hx a
  rw [← mul_assoc, (he.idem a).one_sub.eq]

name: CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.bijective_pi'
statement:
lemma CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.bijective_pi' (he : CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents (1 - e ·)) :
    Function.Bijective (RingHom.pi fun i ↦ Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {e i}))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e', rfl, h⟩ : ∃ e' : I → R, (e' = e) ∧ Function.Bijective (RingHom.pi fun i ↦
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {e' i})) := ⟨_, funext (by simp), he.bijective_pi⟩
  exact h

name: RingHom.pi_bijective_of_isIdempotentElem
statement:
lemma RingHom.pi_bijective_of_isIdempotentElem (e : I → R)
    (he : ∀ i, IsIdempotentElem (e i))
    (he₁ : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → (1 - e i) * (1 - e j) = 0) (he₂ : ∏ i, e i = 0) :
    Function.Bijective (RingHom.pi fun i ↦ Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {e i}))
proof:
:=
  (CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.of_prod_one_sub
      ⟨fun i ↦ (he i).one_sub, he₁⟩ (by simpa using he₂)).bijective_pi'

name: RingHom.prod_bijective_of_isIdempotentElem
statement:
lemma RingHom.prod_bijective_of_isIdempotentElem {e f : R} (he : IsIdempotentElem e)
    (hf : IsIdempotentElem f) (hef₁ : e + f = 1) (hef₂ : e * f = 0) :
    Function.Bijective ((Ideal.Quotient.mk <| Ideal.span {e}).prod
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk <| Ideal.span {f}))
proof:
:= by
  let o (i : Fin 2) : R := match i with
    | 0 => e
    | 1 => f
  change Function.Bijective
    (piFinTwoEquiv _ ∘ RingHom.pi (fun i : Fin 2 ↦ Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {o i})))
  rw [(Equiv.bijective _).of_comp_iff']
  apply pi_bijective_of_isIdempotentElem
  · intro i
    fin_cases i <;> simpa [o]
  · intro i j hij
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp at hij ⊢ <;>
      simp [o, mul_comm, hef₂, ← hef₁]
  · simpa

name: CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.exists_eq_comp_of_ker_eq_span
statement:
lemma CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.exists_eq_comp_of_ker_eq_span
    (f : R →+* S) (e₀ : R) (he₀ : IsIdempotentElem e₀) (hfe₀ : RingHom.ker f = .span {e₀})
    (e : I → S) (he : CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents e) (hef : ∀ i, e i ∈ f.range) :
    ∃ e', CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents (Option.rec e₀ e') ∧ e = f ∘ e'
proof:
:= by
  choose e' he' using hef
  choose k hk using fun i ↦ Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp
      (hfe₀.le (show f (e' i * e' i - e' i) = 0 by simp [he', (he.1.1 i).eq]))
  refine ⟨(1 - e₀) • e', ⟨⟨Option.rec he₀ fun i ↦ ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rintro (_|i) (_|j) h
    · simp at h
    · dsimp; linear_combination - he₀.eq * e' j
    · dsimp; linear_combination - he₀.eq * e' i
    · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp
        (hfe₀.le (show f (e' i * e' j) = 0 by simp [he', he.1.2 (by simpa using h)]))
      dsimp
      rw [mul_mul_mul_comm, hk, he₀.one_sub.eq, ← mul_assoc, he₀.one_sub_mul_self, zero_mul]
  · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp
      (hfe₀.le (show f (∑ i, e' i - 1) = 0 by simpa [he', sub_eq_zero] using he.2))
    simp only [Fintype.sum_option, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum,
      sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp hk]
    linear_combination - he₀.eq * k
  · have : f e₀ = 0 := by simpa using hfe₀.ge (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)
    aesop
  · dsimp [IsIdempotentElem]
    linear_combination congr($(he₀.eq) * ((e' i) ^ 2 - k i) + (1 - e₀) * $(hk i))

name: mem_corner_iff
statement: lemma mem_corner_iff {r : R} : r ∈ corner e ↔ e * r = r ∧ r * e = r
proof:
:=
  ⟨by rintro ⟨r, rfl⟩; simp_rw [← mul_assoc, idem.eq, mul_assoc, idem.eq, true_and],
    (⟨r, by simp_rw [·]⟩)⟩

name: mem_corner_iff_mul_left
statement: lemma mem_corner_iff_mul_left (hc : IsMulCentral e) {r : R} : r ∈ corner e ↔ e * r = r
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_corner_iff idem, and_iff_left_of_imp]; intro; rwa [← hc.comm]

name: mem_corner_iff_mul_right
statement: lemma mem_corner_iff_mul_right (hc : IsMulCentral e) {r : R} : r ∈ corner e ↔ r * e = r
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_corner_iff_mul_left idem hc, hc.comm]

name: mem_corner_iff_mem_range_mul_left
statement:
lemma mem_corner_iff_mem_range_mul_left (hc : IsMulCentral e) {r : R} :
    r ∈ corner e ↔ r ∈ Set.range (e * ·)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [corner, mem_mk, Set.mem_range, ← (hc.comm _).eq, ← mul_assoc, idem.eq]

name: mem_corner_iff_mem_range_mul_right
statement:
lemma mem_corner_iff_mem_range_mul_right (hc : IsMulCentral e) {r : R} :
    r ∈ corner e ↔ r ∈ Set.range (· * e)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [mem_corner_iff_mem_range_mul_left idem hc, (hc.comm _).eq]

name: Ideal.mem_map_span_singleton_iff_of_isIdempotentElem
statement:
lemma Ideal.mem_map_span_singleton_iff_of_isIdempotentElem
    [CommRing R] {e r : R} (he : IsIdempotentElem e) {I : Ideal R} :
    Ideal.Quotient.mk _ r ∈ I.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {e})) ↔ (1 - e) * r ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Ideal.mem_map_iff_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective,
    Ideal.Quotient.mk_eq_mk_iff_sub_mem, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
  refine ⟨?_, fun H ↦ ⟨_, H, by simp [sub_mul]⟩⟩
  intro ⟨s, hs, t, hrst⟩
  convert I.mul_mem_left (1 - e) hs using 1
  linear_combination he.eq * t - (1 - e) * hrst

name: mem_zeroLocus_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_zeroLocus_iff {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)} {x : σ → K} :
    x ∈ zeroLocus K I ↔ ∀ p ∈ I, aeval x p = 0
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: zeroLocus_anti_mono
statement:
theorem zeroLocus_anti_mono {I J : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)} (h : I ≤ J) :
    zeroLocus K J ≤ zeroLocus K I
proof: := fun _ hx p hp => hx p <| h hp

name: zeroLocus_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zeroLocus_bot : zeroLocus K (⊥ : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)) = ⊤
proof:
:=
  eq_top_iff.2 fun x _ _ hp => Trans.trans (congr_arg (aeval x) (mem_bot.1 hp)) (eval x).map_zero

name: zeroLocus_top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zeroLocus_top : zeroLocus K (⊤ : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)) = ⊥
proof:
:=
  eq_bot_iff.2 fun x hx => one_ne_zero
    ((aeval (R := k) x).map_one ▸ hx 1 Submodule.mem_top : (1 : K) = 0)

name: mem_vanishingIdeal_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_vanishingIdeal_iff {V : Set (σ → K)} {p : MvPolynomial σ k} :
    p ∈ vanishingIdeal k V ↔ ∀ x ∈ V, aeval x p = 0
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: vanishingIdeal_anti_mono
statement:
theorem vanishingIdeal_anti_mono {A B : Set (σ → K)} (h : A ≤ B) :
    vanishingIdeal k B ≤ vanishingIdeal k A
proof: := fun _ hp x hx => hp x <| h hx

name: vanishingIdeal_empty
statement: theorem vanishingIdeal_empty : vanishingIdeal k (∅ : Set (σ → K)) = ⊤
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm le_top fun _ _ x hx => absurd hx (Set.notMem_empty x)

name: le_vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus
statement:
theorem le_vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)) :
    I ≤ vanishingIdeal k (zeroLocus K I)
proof: := fun p hp _ hx => hx p hp

name: zeroLocus_vanishingIdeal_le
statement: theorem zeroLocus_vanishingIdeal_le (V : Set (σ → K)) : V ≤ zeroLocus K (vanishingIdeal k V)
proof:
:=
  fun V hV _ hp => hp V hV

name: zeroLocus_vanishingIdeal_galoisConnection
proof:
:=
  GaloisConnection.monotone_intro (fun _ _ ↦ vanishingIdeal_anti_mono)
    (fun _ _ ↦ zeroLocus_anti_mono) le_vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus zeroLocus_vanishingIdeal_le

name: le_zeroLocus_iff_le_vanishingIdeal
statement:
theorem le_zeroLocus_iff_le_vanishingIdeal {V : Set (σ → K)} {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)} :
    V ≤ zeroLocus K I ↔ I ≤ vanishingIdeal k V
proof:
:=
  zeroLocus_vanishingIdeal_galoisConnection.le_iff_le

name: zeroLocus_span
statement:
theorem zeroLocus_span (S : Set (MvPolynomial σ k)) :
    zeroLocus K (Ideal.span S) = { x | ∀ p ∈ S, aeval x p = 0 }
proof:
:=
  eq_of_forall_le_iff fun _ => le_zeroLocus_iff_le_vanishingIdeal.trans <|
    Ideal.span_le.trans forall₂_comm

name: mem_vanishingIdeal_singleton_iff
statement:
theorem mem_vanishingIdeal_singleton_iff (x : σ → K) (p : MvPolynomial σ k) :
    p ∈ (vanishingIdeal k {x} : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)) ↔ aeval x p = 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => h x rfl, fun hpx _ hy => hy.symm ▸ hpx⟩

name: radical_le_vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus
statement:
theorem radical_le_vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)) :
    I.radical ≤ vanishingIdeal k (zeroLocus K I)
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp x hx
  rw [← mem_vanishingIdeal_singleton_iff]
  rw [radical_eq_sInf] at hp
  refine
    (mem_sInf.mp hp)
      ⟨le_trans (le_vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus I)
          (vanishingIdeal_anti_mono fun y hy => hy.symm ▸ hx),
        inferInstance⟩

name: vanishingIdeal_pointToPoint
statement:
@[simp]
theorem vanishingIdeal_pointToPoint (V : Set (σ → K)) :
    PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal (pointToPoint '' V) = MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k V
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm
    (fun _ hp x hx =>
      (((PrimeSpectrum.mem_vanishingIdeal _ _).1 hp) ⟨vanishingIdeal k {x}, by infer_instance⟩
        (⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ : _))
        x rfl)
    fun _ hp =>
    (PrimeSpectrum.mem_vanishingIdeal _ _).2 fun _ hI =>
      let ⟨x, hx⟩ := hI
      hx.2 ▸ fun _ hx' => (Set.mem_singleton_iff.1 hx').symm ▸ hp x hx.1

name: pointToPoint_zeroLocus_le
statement:
theorem pointToPoint_zeroLocus_le (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ K)) :
    pointToPoint (k := K) '' MvPolynomial.zeroLocus K I ≤ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus I
proof:
:= fun J hJ =>
  let ⟨_, hx⟩ := hJ
  (le_trans (le_vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus (K := K) I)
      (hx.2 ▸ vanishingIdeal_anti_mono (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hx.1)) :
    I ≤ J.asIdeal)

name: eq_vanishingIdeal_singleton_of_isMaximal
statement:
theorem eq_vanishingIdeal_singleton_of_isMaximal {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)} (hI : I.IsMaximal) :
    ∃ x : σ → K, I = vanishingIdeal k {x}
proof:
:= by
  let : Field (MvPolynomial σ k ⧸ I) := Quotient.field I
  have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic k (MvPolynomial σ k ⧸ I) := by
    rw [Algebra.isAlgebraic_iff_isIntegral, ← algebraMap_isIntegral_iff]
    exact MvPolynomial.comp_C_integral_of_surjective_of_isJacobsonRing
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let φ : (MvPolynomial σ k ⧸ I) →ₐ[k] K := IsAlgClosed.lift
  let x : σ → K := fun s => φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk I (X s))
  have : aeval x = φ.comp (Quotient.mkₐ k I) := by ext; simp [x]
  use x
  simp [Ideal.ext_iff, this, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]

name: isMaximal_iff_eq_vanishingIdeal_singleton
statement:
theorem isMaximal_iff_eq_vanishingIdeal_singleton {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ K)} :
    I.IsMaximal ↔ ∃ x : σ → K, I = vanishingIdeal K {x}
proof:
:=
  ⟨eq_vanishingIdeal_singleton_of_isMaximal K,
    fun ⟨_, hx⟩ => hx ▸ inferInstance⟩

name: vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus_eq_radical
statement:
@[simp]
theorem vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus_eq_radical (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)) :
    vanishingIdeal k (zeroLocus K I) = I.radical
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (radical_le_vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus _)
  rw [I.radical_eq_jacobson]
  apply le_sInf
  rintro J ⟨hJI, hJ⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := eq_vanishingIdeal_singleton_of_isMaximal K hJ
  refine hx.symm ▸ vanishingIdeal_anti_mono fun y hy p hp => ?_
  rw [← mem_vanishingIdeal_singleton_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff.1 hy, ← hx]
  exact hJI hp

name: IsPrime.vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus
statement:
@[simp high] 
theorem IsPrime.vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus (P : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)) [h : P.IsPrime] :
    vanishingIdeal k (zeroLocus K P) = P
proof:
:=
  Trans.trans (vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus_eq_radical P) h.radical

name: teichmullerAux_sModEq
statement:
theorem teichmullerAux_sModEq (x : Perfection (R ⧸ I) p) (m : ℕ) :
    teichmullerAux x m ≡ teichmullerAux x (m + 1) [SMOD I ^ m]
proof:
:= by
  obtain _ | m := m
  · simp
  symm
  rw [teichmullerAux, pow_succ' p, pow_mul]
  exact .pow_pow_add_one (I.natCast_mem_of_charP_quotient p) (m := m) <| by
    simp [SModEq.idealQuotientMk, coeff_pow_p']

name: exists_teichmullerFun
statement:
theorem exists_teichmullerFun (x : Perfection (R ⧸ I) p) :
    ∃ y : R, ∀ n, teichmullerAux x n ≡ y [SMOD I ^ n • (⊤ : Ideal R)]
proof:
:=
  IsPrecomplete.prec' _ (teichmullerCauchy x).2

name: teichmullerFun_sModEq
proof:
:= by
  have := (exists_teichmullerFun x).choose_spec (n + 1)
  rw [smul_eq_mul, Ideal.mul_top] at this
  exact this.symm.trans <| .pow_pow_add_one (I.natCast_mem_of_charP_quotient p) (m := n) <| by
    simp [SModEq.idealQuotientMk, h]

name: teichmullerFun_spec'
statement:
theorem teichmullerFun_spec' {x : Perfection (R ⧸ I) p} {y : R}
    (h : ∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, ∃ z, Ideal.Quotient.mk I z = coeff _ p n x ∧
      z ^ p ^ n ≡ y [SMOD I ^ (n + 1)]) :
    teichmullerFun x = y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, h⟩ := h
  refine (IsHausdorff.eq_iff_smodEq (I := I)).mpr fun n ↦ ?_
  rw [smul_eq_mul, Ideal.mul_top]
  obtain hn | hn := le_total n N
  · obtain ⟨z, hz₁, hz₂⟩ := h N le_rfl
    exact ((teichmullerFun_sModEq hz₁).trans hz₂).mono <| Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (by omega)
  · obtain ⟨z, hz₁, hz₂⟩ := h n hn
    exact ((teichmullerFun_sModEq hz₁).trans hz₂).mono <| Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (by omega)

proof:
:=
  teichmullerFun_spec' ⟨0, fun n _ ↦ h n⟩

name: isNilpotent_iff_isNilpotent_fst
statement:
lemma isNilpotent_iff_isNilpotent_fst {x : TrivSqZeroExt R M} :
    IsNilpotent x ↔ IsNilpotent x.fst
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
  · refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
    rw [← fst_pow, hn, fst_zero]
  · refine ⟨n * 2, ?_⟩
    rw [pow_mul]
    ext
    · rw [fst_pow, fst_pow, hn, zero_pow two_ne_zero, fst_zero]
    · rw [pow_two, snd_mul, fst_pow, hn, MulOpposite.op_zero, zero_smul, zero_smul, zero_add,
        snd_zero]

name: isUnit_or_isNilpotent_of_isMaximal_isNilpotent

lemma isUnit_or_isNilpotent_of_isMaximal_isNilpotent [CommSemiring R] [AddCommGroup M]

    (h : ∀ I : Ideal R, I.IsMaximal → IsNilpotent I)
    (a : TrivSqZeroExt R M) :
    IsUnit a ∨ IsNilpotent a
proof:

name: ideal_trichotomy
statement:
lemma ideal_trichotomy [DivisionRing K] (I : Ideal K[ε]) :
    I = ⊥ ∨ I = .span {ε} ∨ I = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine (eq_or_ne I ⊥).imp_right fun hb ↦ ?_
  refine (eq_or_ne I ⊤).symm.imp_left fun ht ↦ ?_
  have hd : ∀ x ∈ I, ε ∣ x := by
    intro x hxI
    rcases isUnit_or_isNilpotent x with hx | hx
    · exact absurd (Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem _ hxI hx) ht
    · rwa [← isNilpotent_iff_eps_dvd]
  have hd' : ∀ x ∈ I, x ≠ 0 → ∃ r, ε = r * x := by
    intro x hxI hx0
    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := hd _ hxI
    have : ε * r = (fst r) • ε := by ext <;> simp
    rw [this] at hxI hx0 ⊢
    have hr : fst r ≠ 0 := by
      contrapose hx0
      simp [hx0]
    refine ⟨r⁻¹, ?_⟩
    simp [TrivSqZeroExt.ext_iff, inv_mul_cancel₀ hr]
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_ <;> intro x <;>
    simp_rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton', (commute_eps_right _).eq, eq_comm, ← dvd_def]
  · intro hx
    simp_rw [hd _ hx]
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨y, hyI, hy0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hb
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hd' _ hyI hy0
    rw [(commute_eps_left _).eq, hr, ← mul_assoc]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hyI

name: isMaximal_span_singleton_eps
statement:
lemma isMaximal_span_singleton_eps [DivisionRing K] :
    (Ideal.span {ε} : Ideal K[ε]).IsMaximal
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun I hI ↦ ?_⟩
  · simp [ne_eq, Ideal.eq_top_iff_one, Ideal.mem_span_singleton', TrivSqZeroExt.ext_iff]
  · rcases ideal_trichotomy I with rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
    first | simp at hI | simp

name: exists_mul_left_or_mul_right
statement:
lemma exists_mul_left_or_mul_right [DivisionRing K] (a b : K[ε]) :
    ∃ c, a * c = b ∨ b * c = a
proof:
:= by
  rcases isUnit_or_isNilpotent a with ha | ha
  · lift a to K[ε]ˣ using ha
    exact ⟨a⁻¹ * b, by simp⟩
  rcases isUnit_or_isNilpotent b with hb | hb
  · lift b to K[ε]ˣ using hb
    exact ⟨b⁻¹ * a, by simp⟩
  rw [isNilpotent_iff_eps_dvd] at ha hb
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hb
  suffices ∃ c, fst x * fst c = fst y ∨ fst y * fst c = fst x by
    simpa [TrivSqZeroExt.ext_iff] using this
  rcases eq_or_ne (fst x) 0 with hx | hx
  · refine ⟨ε, Or.inr ?_⟩
    simp [hx]
  refine ⟨inl ((fst x)⁻¹ * fst y), ?_⟩
  simp [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hx]

name: induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim, induction_eliminator]
protected theorem induction_on {motive : FreeRing α → Prop} (z : FreeRing α) (neg_one : motive (-1))
    (of : ∀ b, motive (of b)) (add : ∀ x y, motive x → motive y → motive (x + y))
    (mul : ∀ x y, motive x → motive y → motive (x * y)) :
    motive z
proof:
:=
  have neg (x : FreeRing α) (hx : motive x) : motive (-x) := by simpa using mul (-1) x neg_one hx
  have one : motive 1 := by simpa using neg (-1) neg_one
  have nsmul (n : ℕ) (x : FreeRing α) (hx : motive x) : motive (n • x) := by
    induction n with
    | zero => simpa using add (-1) 1 neg_one one
    | succ n ih => rw [succ_nsmul]; exact add (n • x) x ih hx
  have zsmul (n : ℤ) (x : FreeRing α) (hx : motive x) : motive (n • x) := by
    induction n using Int.negInduction with
    | nat n => rw [natCast_zsmul]; simpa using nsmul n x hx
    | neg ih n => rw [neg_zsmul]; exact neg _ (ih n)
  have fmof (x : FreeMonoid α) : motive (MonoidAlgebra.of ℤ _ x) :=
    FreeMonoid.inductionOn x one of (fun x y hx hy => by rw [map_mul]; exact mul _ _ hx hy)
  MonoidAlgebra.induction_on z fmof add zsmul

name: EssFiniteType.adjoin_mem_finset
statement:
lemma EssFiniteType.adjoin_mem_finset [EssFiniteType R S] :
    adjoin R { x : subalgebra R S | x.1 ∈ finset R S } = ⊤
proof: := adjoin_adjoin_coe_preimage

name: essFiniteType_cond_iff
statement:
lemma essFiniteType_cond_iff (σ : Finset S) :
    IsLocalization ((IsUnit.submonoid S).comap (algebraMap (adjoin R (σ : Set S)) S)) S ↔
    (∀ s : S, ∃ t ∈ Algebra.adjoin R (σ : Set S),
      IsUnit t ∧ s * t ∈ Algebra.adjoin R (σ : Set S))
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro hσ
  · intro s
    obtain ⟨⟨⟨x, hx⟩, ⟨t, ht⟩, ht'⟩, h⟩ := hσ.1.2 s
    exact ⟨t, ht, ht', h ▸ hx⟩
  · constructor; constructor
    · exact fun y ↦ y.prop
    · intro s
      obtain ⟨t, ht, ht', h⟩ := hσ s
      exact ⟨⟨⟨_, h⟩, ⟨t, ht⟩, ht'⟩, rfl⟩
    · intro x y e
      exact ⟨1, by simpa using Subtype.ext e⟩

name: essFiniteType_iff
statement:
lemma essFiniteType_iff :
    EssFiniteType R S ↔ ∃ (σ : Finset S),
      (∀ s : S, ∃ t ∈ Algebra.adjoin R (σ : Set S),
        IsUnit t ∧ s * t ∈ Algebra.adjoin R (σ : Set S))
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← essFiniteType_cond_iff]
  constructor <;> exact fun ⟨a, b⟩ ↦ ⟨a, b⟩

name: EssFiniteType.of_isLocalization
statement:
lemma EssFiniteType.of_isLocalization (M : Submonoid R) [IsLocalization M S] :
    EssFiniteType R S
proof:
:= by
  rw [essFiniteType_iff]
  use ∅
  simp only [Finset.coe_empty, Algebra.adjoin_empty, Algebra.mem_bot,
    Set.mem_range, exists_exists_eq_and]
  intro s
  obtain ⟨⟨x, t⟩, e⟩ := IsLocalization.surj M s
  exact ⟨_, IsLocalization.map_units S t, x, e.symm⟩

name: EssFiniteType.of_id
statement: lemma EssFiniteType.of_id : EssFiniteType R R
proof: := inferInstance

name: EssFiniteType.aux
statement:
lemma EssFiniteType.aux (σ : Subalgebra R S)
    (hσ : ∀ s : S, ∃ t ∈ σ, IsUnit t ∧ s * t ∈ σ)
    (τ : Set T) (t : T) (ht : t ∈ Algebra.adjoin S τ) :
    ∃ s ∈ σ, IsUnit s ∧ s • t ∈ σ.map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R S T) ⊔ Algebra.adjoin R τ
proof:
:= by
  refine Algebra.adjoin_induction ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ht
  · intro t ht
    exact ⟨1, Subalgebra.one_mem _, isUnit_one,
      (one_smul S t).symm ▸ Algebra.mem_sup_right (Algebra.subset_adjoin ht)⟩
  · intro s
    obtain ⟨s', hs₁, hs₂, hs₃⟩ := hσ s
    refine ⟨_, hs₁, hs₂, Algebra.mem_sup_left ?_⟩
    rw [Algebra.smul_def, ← map_mul, mul_comm]
    exact ⟨_, hs₃, rfl⟩
  · rintro x y - - ⟨sx, hsx, hsx', hsx''⟩ ⟨sy, hsy, hsy', hsy''⟩
    refine ⟨_, σ.mul_mem hsx hsy, hsx'.mul hsy', ?_⟩
    rw [smul_add, mul_smul, mul_smul, Algebra.smul_def sx (sy • y), smul_comm,
      Algebra.smul_def sy (sx • x)]
    apply add_mem (mul_mem _ hsx'') (mul_mem _ hsy'') <;>
      exact Algebra.mem_sup_left ⟨_, ‹_›, rfl⟩
  · rintro x y - - ⟨sx, hsx, hsx', hsx''⟩ ⟨sy, hsy, hsy', hsy''⟩
    refine ⟨_, σ.mul_mem hsx hsy, hsx'.mul hsy', ?_⟩
    rw [mul_smul, ← smul_eq_mul, smul_comm sy x, ← smul_assoc, smul_eq_mul]
    exact mul_mem hsx'' hsy''

name: EssFiniteType.comp
statement:
lemma EssFiniteType.comp [h₁ : EssFiniteType R S] [h₂ : EssFiniteType S T] :
    EssFiniteType R T
proof:
:= by
  rw [essFiniteType_iff] at h₁ h₂ ⊢
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := h₂
  use s.image (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R S T) ∪ t
  simp only [Finset.coe_union, Finset.coe_image, Algebra.adjoin_union, Algebra.adjoin_image]
  intro x
  obtain ⟨y, hy₁, hy₂, hy₃⟩ := ht x
  obtain ⟨t₁, h₁, h₂, h₃⟩ := EssFiniteType.aux _ _ _ _ hs _ y hy₁
  obtain ⟨t₂, h₄, h₅, h₆⟩ := EssFiniteType.aux _ _ _ _ hs _ _ hy₃
  refine ⟨t₂ • t₁ • y, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Algebra.smul_def]
    exact mul_mem (Algebra.mem_sup_left ⟨_, h₄, rfl⟩) h₃
  · rw [Algebra.smul_def, Algebra.smul_def]
    exact (h₅.map _).mul ((h₂.map _).mul hy₂)
  · rw [← mul_smul, mul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_comm y, mul_smul, Algebra.smul_def]
    exact mul_mem (Algebra.mem_sup_left ⟨_, h₁, rfl⟩) h₆

name: essFiniteType_iff_exists_subalgebra
statement:
lemma essFiniteType_iff_exists_subalgebra : EssFiniteType R S ↔
    ∃ (S₀ : Subalgebra R S) (M : Submonoid S₀), FiniteType R S₀ ∧ IsLocalization M S
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨subalgebra R S, submonoid R S, inferInstance, inferInstance⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨S₀, M, _, _⟩
  let := of_isLocalization S M
  exact comp R S₀ S

name: EssFiniteType.of_comp
statement: lemma EssFiniteType.of_comp [h : EssFiniteType R T] : EssFiniteType S T
proof:
:= by
  rw [essFiniteType_iff] at h ⊢
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := h
  use σ
  intro x
  obtain ⟨y, hy₁, hy₂, hy₃⟩ := hσ x
  simp_rw [← Algebra.adjoin_adjoin_of_tower R (S := S) (σ : Set T)]
  exact ⟨y, Algebra.subset_adjoin hy₁, hy₂, Algebra.subset_adjoin hy₃⟩

name: EssFiniteType.of_surjective
statement:
lemma EssFiniteType.of_surjective (f : S →ₐ[R] T) (hf : Function.Surjective f)
    [EssFiniteType R S] : EssFiniteType R T
proof:
:= by
  let := f.toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower R S T := .of_algebraMap_eq' f.comp_algebraMap.symm
  have : Module.Finite S T := .of_surjective (Algebra.linearMap S T) hf
  exact .comp R S T

name: EssFiniteType.iff_of_algEquiv
statement:
lemma EssFiniteType.iff_of_algEquiv (f : S ≃ₐ[R] T) :
    EssFiniteType R S ↔ EssFiniteType R T where
  mp _
proof:
:= .of_surjective f.toAlgHom f.surjective
  mpr _ := .of_surjective f.symm.toAlgHom f.symm.surjective

name: EssFiniteType.algHom_ext
statement:
lemma EssFiniteType.algHom_ext [EssFiniteType R S]
    (f g : S →ₐ[R] T) (H : ∀ s ∈ finset R S, f s = g s) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  suffices f.toRingHom = g.toRingHom by ext; exact RingHom.congr_fun this _
  apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (EssFiniteType.submonoid R S)
  suffices f.comp (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R _ S) = g.comp (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R _ S) by
    ext; exact AlgHom.congr_fun this _
  apply AlgHom.ext_of_adjoin_eq_top (s := { x | x.1 ∈ finset R S })
  · exact adjoin_mem_finset R S
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩ hx'; exact H x hx'

name: essFiniteType_algebraMap
statement:
lemma essFiniteType_algebraMap {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [Algebra R S] : (algebraMap R S).EssFiniteType ↔ Algebra.EssFiniteType R S
proof:
:= by
  rw [RingHom.EssFiniteType, toAlgebra_algebraMap]

name: FiniteType.essFiniteType
statement: lemma FiniteType.essFiniteType (hf : f.FiniteType) : f.EssFiniteType
proof:
:= by
  algebraize [f]
  change Algebra.EssFiniteType R S
  infer_instance

name: EssFiniteType.ext
statement:
lemma EssFiniteType.ext (hf : f.EssFiniteType) {g₁ g₂ : S →+* T}
    (h₁ : g₁.comp f = g₂.comp f) (h₂ : ∀ x ∈ hf.finset, g₁ x = g₂ x) : g₁ = g₂
proof:
:= by
  algebraize [f, g₁.comp f]
  ext x
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun (Algebra.EssFiniteType.algHom_ext T
    ⟨g₁, fun _ ↦ rfl⟩ ⟨g₂, DFunLike.congr_fun h₁.symm⟩ h₂) x

name: one_mem_of_ne_bot
statement:
lemma one_mem_of_ne_bot {A : Type*} [NonAssocRing A] [IsSimpleRing A] (I : TwoSidedIdeal A)
    (hI : I ≠ ⊥) : (1 : A) ∈ I
proof:
:=
  (eq_bot_or_eq_top I).resolve_left hI ▸ ⟨⟩

name: one_mem_of_ne_zero_mem
statement:
lemma one_mem_of_ne_zero_mem {A : Type*} [NonAssocRing A] [IsSimpleRing A] (I : TwoSidedIdeal A)
    {x : A} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hxI : x ∈ I) : (1 : A) ∈ I
proof:
:=
  one_mem_of_ne_bot I (by rintro rfl; exact hx hxI)

name: of_eq_bot_or_eq_top
statement:
lemma of_eq_bot_or_eq_top [Nontrivial R] (h : ∀ I : TwoSidedIdeal R, I = ⊥ ∨ I = ⊤) :
    IsSimpleRing R where
  simple.eq_bot_or_eq_top

name: injective_ringHom_or_subsingleton_codomain
statement:
lemma injective_ringHom_or_subsingleton_codomain
    {R S : Type*} [NonAssocRing R] [IsSimpleRing R] [NonAssocSemiring S]
    (f : R →+* S) : Function.Injective f ∨ Subsingleton S
proof:
:=
  simple.eq_bot_or_eq_top (TwoSidedIdeal.ker f) |>.imp (TwoSidedIdeal.ker_eq_bot _ |>.1)
    (fun h => subsingleton_iff_zero_eq_one.1 <| by
      have mem : 1 ∈ TwoSidedIdeal.ker f := h.symm ▸ TwoSidedIdeal.mem_top _
      rwa [TwoSidedIdeal.mem_ker, map_one, eq_comm] at mem)

name: _root_.RingHom.injective
statement:
protected theorem _root_.RingHom.injective
    {R S : Type*} [NonAssocRing R] [IsSimpleRing R] [NonAssocSemiring S] [Nontrivial S]
    (f : R →+* S) : Function.Injective f
proof:
:=
  injective_ringHom_or_subsingleton_codomain f |>.resolve_right fun r => not_subsingleton _ r

name: iff_injective_ringHom_or_subsingleton_codomain
statement:
lemma iff_injective_ringHom_or_subsingleton_codomain (R : Type u) [NonAssocRing R] [Nontrivial R] :
    IsSimpleRing R ↔
    ∀ {S : Type u} [NonAssocSemiring S] (f : R →+* S), Function.Injective f ∨ Subsingleton S where
  mp _ _ _
proof:
:= injective_ringHom_or_subsingleton_codomain
  mpr H := of_eq_bot_or_eq_top fun I => H I.ringCon.mk' |>.imp
    (fun h => le_antisymm
      (fun _ hx => TwoSidedIdeal.ker_eq_bot _ |>.2 h ▸ I.ker_ringCon_mk'.symm ▸ hx) bot_le)
    (fun h => le_antisymm le_top fun x _ => I.mem_iff _ |>.2 (Quotient.eq'.1 (h.elim x 0)))

name: iff_injective_ringHom
statement:
lemma iff_injective_ringHom (R : Type u) [NonAssocRing R] [Nontrivial R] :
    IsSimpleRing R ↔
    ∀ {S : Type u} [NonAssocSemiring S] [Nontrivial S] (f : R →+* S), Function.Injective f
proof:
:=
  iff_injective_ringHom_or_subsingleton_codomain R |>.trans <|
    ⟨fun H _ _ _ f => H f |>.resolve_right (by simpa [not_subsingleton_iff_nontrivial]),
      fun H S _ f => subsingleton_or_nontrivial S |>.recOn Or.inr fun _ => Or.inl <| H f⟩

name: of_surjective
statement:
lemma of_surjective {R S : Type*} [NonAssocRing R] [NonAssocRing S] [Nontrivial S]
    (f : R →+* S) (h : IsSimpleRing R) (hf : Function.Surjective f) : IsSimpleRing S where
  simple
proof:
:= OrderIso.isSimpleOrder (RingEquiv.ofBijective f
    ⟨RingHom.injective f, hf⟩).symm.mapTwoSidedIdeal

name: of_ringEquiv
statement:
lemma of_ringEquiv {R S : Type*} [NonUnitalNonAssocRing R] [NonUnitalNonAssocRing S]
    (f : R ≃+* S) (h : IsSimpleRing R) : IsSimpleRing S where
  simple
proof: := OrderIso.isSimpleOrder f.symm.mapTwoSidedIdeal

name: isSimpleRing_iff_isTwoSided_imp
statement:
theorem isSimpleRing_iff_isTwoSided_imp {R : Type*} [Ring R] :
    IsSimpleRing R ↔ Nontrivial R ∧ ∀ I : Ideal R, I.IsTwoSided → I = ⊥ ∨ I = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  let e := orderIsoIsTwoSided (R := R)
  simp_rw [isSimpleRing_iff, isSimpleOrder_iff, orderIsoRingCon.toEquiv.nontrivial_congr,
    RingCon.nontrivial_iff, e.forall_congr_left, Subtype.forall, ← e.injective.eq_iff]
  simp [e, Subtype.ext_iff]

name: DivisionRing.nonempty_linearEquiv_of_isSimpleModule
statement:
lemma DivisionRing.nonempty_linearEquiv_of_isSimpleModule (N : Type*) [AddCommGroup N]
    [Module S N] [IsSimpleModule S N] : Nonempty (N ≃ₗ[S] S)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨I, hI, ⟨e⟩⟩ := isSimpleModule_iff_quot_maximal.mp ‹_›
  exact ⟨e ≪≫ₗ I.quotEquivOfEqBot ((eq_bot_or_eq_top I).resolve_right hI.ne_top)⟩

name: isSimpleModule_iff_eq_zero_or_injective
statement:
lemma isSimpleModule_iff_eq_zero_or_injective (R : Type u) (M : Type v) [Ring R] [AddCommGroup M]
    [Module R M] : IsSimpleModule R M ↔ (Nontrivial M ∧ ∀ (N : Type v) [AddCommGroup N]
    [Module R N] (f : M →ₗ[R] N), f = 0 ∨ Function.Injective f)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hM ↦ ⟨Submodule.nontrivial_iff _|>.1 hM.1.1, fun N _ _ f ↦ hM.1.2 (LinearMap.ker f)|>.elim
    (fun h ↦ Or.inr <| by rwa [LinearMap.ker_eq_bot] at h) (fun h ↦ Or.inl <|by simp_all)⟩,
  fun ⟨hM1, hM2⟩ ↦ isSimpleModule_iff R M|>.2 ⟨fun p ↦ (hM2 (M ⧸ p) p.mkQ).elim
  (fun h ↦ Or.inr <| by simpa [Submodule.ext_iff, LinearMap.ext_iff] using h)
  (fun h ↦ Or.inl <| eq_bot_iff.2 fun x hx ↦ h (by simp [hx]))⟩⟩

name: IsSimpleModule.obj_of_isEquivalence
statement:
lemma IsSimpleModule.obj_of_isEquivalence
    {R S : Type*} [Ring R] [Ring S] (e : ModuleCat R ⥤ ModuleCat S)
    [e.IsEquivalence] (M : ModuleCat R) [IsSimpleModule R M] :
    IsSimpleModule S (e.obj M)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← simple_iff_isSimpleModule'] at *
  exact simple_obj e M

name: isField_center
statement:
lemma isField_center (A : Type*) [Ring A] [IsSimpleRing A] : IsField (Subring.center A) where
  exists_pair_ne
proof:
:= ⟨0, 1, zero_ne_one⟩
  mul_comm := mul_comm
  mul_inv_cancel := by
    rintro ⟨x, hx1⟩ hx2
    rw [Subring.mem_center_iff] at hx1
    replace hx2 : x ≠ 0 := by simpa [Subtype.ext_iff] using hx2
    
    let I := TwoSidedIdeal.mk' (Set.range (x * ·)) ⟨0, by simp⟩
      (by rintro _ _ ⟨x, rfl⟩ ⟨y, rfl⟩; exact ⟨x + y, mul_add _ _ _⟩)
      (by rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩; exact ⟨-x, by simp⟩)
      (by rintro a _ ⟨c, rfl⟩; exact ⟨a * c, by dsimp; rw [← mul_assoc, ← hx1, mul_assoc]⟩)
      (by rintro _ b ⟨a, rfl⟩; exact ⟨a * b, by dsimp; rw [← mul_assoc, ← hx1, mul_assoc]⟩)
    have mem : 1 ∈ I := one_mem_of_ne_zero_mem I hx2 (by simpa [I, mem_mk'] using ⟨1, by simp⟩)
    simp only [TwoSidedIdeal.mem_mk', Set.mem_range, I] at mem
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := mem
    refine ⟨⟨y, Subring.mem_center_iff.2 fun a ↦ ?_⟩, by ext; exact hy⟩
    calc a * y
      _ = (x * y) * a * y := by rw [hy, one_mul]
      _ = (y * x) * a * y := by rw [hx1]
      _ = y * (x * a) * y := by rw [mul_assoc y x a]
      _ = y * (a * x) * y := by rw [hx1]
      _ = y * ((a * x) * y) := by rw [mul_assoc]
      _ = y * (a * (x * y)) := by rw [mul_assoc a x y]
      _ = y * a := by rw [hy, mul_one]

name: isSimpleRing_iff_isField
statement: lemma isSimpleRing_iff_isField (A : Type*) [CommRing A] : IsSimpleRing A ↔ IsField A
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ ↦ Subring.topEquiv.symm.toMulEquiv.isField <| by
    rw [← Subring.center_eq_top A]; exact IsSimpleRing.isField_center A,
    fun h ↦ letI := h.toField; inferInstance⟩

name: Subgroup.smul_algebraMap
proof:
:=
  smul_algebraMap (⟨g, hg⟩ : H) x

name: IsGaloisGroup.smul_mem_of_normal
statement:
theorem IsGaloisGroup.smul_mem_of_normal (N : Subgroup G) [hN : N.Normal]
    [hC : IsGaloisGroup N C B] (g : G) (x : C) :
    g • algebraMap C B x ∈ Set.range (algebraMap C B)
proof:
:= by
  apply hC.isInvariant.isInvariant (g • algebraMap C B x)
  intro n
  rw [← inv_smul_eq_iff, Subgroup.smul_def, ← mul_smul, ← mul_smul]
  exact Subgroup.smul_algebraMap B (hN.conj_mem' n n.prop g) x

name: IsGaloisGroup.to_isFractionRing_of_isIntegral
statement:
theorem IsGaloisGroup.to_isFractionRing_of_isIntegral
    [Algebra.IsIntegral A B] [hGAB : IsGaloisGroup G A B] :
    IsGaloisGroup G K L where
  faithful
proof:
:=
    have := hGAB.faithful
    IsFractionRing.faithfulSMul G B L
  commutes := IsFractionRing.smulCommClass G A B K L
  isInvariant := IsFractionRing.isInvariant_of_isIntegral G A B K L

name: IsGaloisGroup.to_isFractionRing
statement:
theorem IsGaloisGroup.to_isFractionRing [Finite G] [hGAB : IsGaloisGroup G A B] :
    IsGaloisGroup G K L
proof:
:=
  have := hGAB.isInvariant.isIntegral
  IsGaloisGroup.to_isFractionRing_of_isIntegral G A B K L

name: IsGaloisGroup.of_isFractionRing
statement:
theorem IsGaloisGroup.of_isFractionRing [hGKL : IsGaloisGroup G K L]
    [IsIntegrallyClosed A] [Algebra.IsIntegral A B] : IsGaloisGroup G A B
proof:
:= by
  have hc (a : A) : (algebraMap K L) (algebraMap A K a) = (algebraMap B L) (algebraMap A B a) := by
    simp_rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply]
  refine ⟨⟨fun h ↦ ?_⟩, ⟨fun g x y ↦ IsFractionRing.injective B L ?_⟩, ⟨fun x h ↦ ?_⟩⟩
  · have := hGKL.faithful
    refine eq_of_smul_eq_smul fun (y : L) ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨a, b, hb, rfl⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective B y
    simp only [smul_div₀', ← algebraMap.coe_smul', h]
  · simp [Algebra.smul_def, algebraMap.coe_smul', ← hc]
  · obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hGKL.isInvariant.isInvariant (algebraMap B L x)
      (by simpa [← algebraMap.coe_smul'])
    have hx : IsIntegral A (algebraMap B L x) := (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x).algebraMap
    rw [← hb, isIntegral_algebraMap_iff, IsIntegrallyClosedIn.isIntegral_iff] at hx
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact ⟨a, by rwa [hc, IsFractionRing.coe_inj] at hb⟩

name: IsGaloisGroup.iff_isFractionRing
statement:
theorem IsGaloisGroup.iff_isFractionRing [Finite G] [IsIntegrallyClosed A] :
    IsGaloisGroup G A B ↔ Algebra.IsIntegral A B ∧ IsGaloisGroup G K L
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨h.isInvariant.isIntegral, h.to_isFractionRing G A B K L⟩,
    fun ⟨_, h⟩ ↦ h.of_isFractionRing G A B K L⟩

name: algebraMap_smulOfNormal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem algebraMap_smulOfNormal [N.Normal] [IsGaloisGroup N B C] (g : G) (x : B) :
    letI
proof:
:= smulOfNormal G B C
    algebraMap B C (g • x) = g • algebraMap B C x :=
  (smul_mem_of_normal G C N g x).choose_spec

name: mulSemiringActionQuotient_smul_def
statement:
theorem mulSemiringActionQuotient_smul_def [MulSemiringAction G B] [SMulDistribClass G B C]
    [IsGaloisGroup N B C] [N.Normal] (g : G) (b : B) :
    letI
proof:
:= mulSemiringActionQuotient G B C N
    (g : G ⧸ N) • b = g • b := by
  let := mulSemiringActionOfNormal G B C N
  refine (Quotient.liftOn'_mk'' (· • b) _ g).trans (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective B C ?_)
  rw [algebraMap.smul', algebraMap.smul']

name: smulCommClassQuotient
statement:
theorem smulCommClassQuotient [N.Normal] [Algebra A B] [IsScalarTower A B C] [SMulCommClass G A C]
    [MulSemiringAction G B] [MulAction (G ⧸ N) B] [SMulDistribClass G B C]
    [IsScalarTower G (G ⧸ N) B] :
    SMulCommClass (G ⧸ N) A B
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun g k x ↦ Quotient.inductionOn' g fun g ↦
    FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective B C (by
      simp [algebraMap.smul, algebraMap.smul', smul_comm])⟩

name: of_mulEquiv
statement:
theorem of_mulEquiv [hG : IsGaloisGroup G A B] {H : Type*} [Group H]
    [MulSemiringAction H B] (e : H ≃* G) (he : ∀ h (x : B), (e h) • x = h • x) :
    IsGaloisGroup H A B where
  faithful
proof:
:= ⟨fun h ↦ e.injective <| hG.faithful.eq_of_smul_eq_smul <| by simpa only [he]⟩
  commutes := ⟨fun x a b ↦ by simpa [he] using hG.commutes.smul_comm (e x) a b⟩
  isInvariant := ⟨fun b h ↦
    have he' : ∀ (g : G) (x : B), e.symm g • x = g • x := fun g x ↦ by simp [← he]
    hG.isInvariant.isInvariant b (fun g ↦ by simpa [he'] using h (e.symm g))⟩

name: iff_of_mulEquiv
statement:
theorem iff_of_mulEquiv {H : Type*} [Group H] [MulSemiringAction H B]
    (e : H ≃* G) (he : ∀ h (x : B), e h • x = h • x) :
    IsGaloisGroup H A B ↔ IsGaloisGroup G A B
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ h.of_mulEquiv e.symm fun g x ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ h.of_mulEquiv e he⟩
  rw [← he, e.apply_symm_apply]

name: top_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem top_iff : IsGaloisGroup (⊤ : Subgroup G) A B ↔ IsGaloisGroup G A B
proof:
:=
  iff_of_mulEquiv Subgroup.topEquiv fun _ _ ↦ rfl

name: of_algEquiv
statement:
theorem of_algEquiv [hG : IsGaloisGroup G A B] (B' : Type*) [Semiring B']
    [Algebra A B'] [MulSemiringAction G B'] (e : B ≃ₐ[A] B')
    (he : ∀ (g : G) (x : B), e (g • x) = g • (e x)) :
    IsGaloisGroup G A B' where
  faithful
proof:
:= ⟨fun h ↦ hG.faithful.eq_of_smul_eq_smul fun b ↦ by simpa [← he] using h (e b)⟩
  commutes := ⟨fun g a b' ↦ by
    have h' {x'} : e.symm (g • x') = g • e.symm x' := by
      apply e.injective
      simp [he]
    apply e.symm.injective
    simpa [h', map_smul] using hG.commutes.smul_comm g a (e.symm b')⟩
  isInvariant := ⟨fun x' hx' ↦ by
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hG.isInvariant.isInvariant (e.symm x') (fun g ↦ by
      apply e.injective
      simp [he, hx'])
    exact ⟨a, by rw [← e.commutes, ha, AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]⟩⟩

name: of_ringHom_surjective
statement:
theorem of_ringHom_surjective [hG : IsGaloisGroup G A B] [CommSemiring A']
    [Algebra A' B] (e : A →+* A') (he : ∀ a, algebraMap A' B (e a) = algebraMap A B a)
    (he' : Function.Surjective e) : IsGaloisGroup G A' B where
  faithful
proof:
:= hG.faithful
  commutes := ⟨by
    intro g a' b
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ : ∃ a, e a = a' := he' a'
    rw [Algebra.smul_def, Algebra.smul_def, he, ← Algebra.smul_def, ← Algebra.smul_def]
    exact hG.commutes.smul_comm g a b⟩
  isInvariant := ⟨by
    intro b h
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hG.isInvariant.isInvariant b h
    exact ⟨e a, by rw [he, ha]⟩⟩

name: of_ringEquiv
statement:
theorem of_ringEquiv [hG : IsGaloisGroup G A B] [CommSemiring A'] [Algebra A' B]
    (e : A ≃+* A') (he : ∀ a, algebraMap A' B (e a) = algebraMap A B a) :
    IsGaloisGroup G A' B
proof:
:=
  .of_ringHom_surjective G A A' B e he e.surjective

name: algebraMap_ringEquivFixedPoints_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem algebraMap_ringEquivFixedPoints_symm_apply (x : FixedPoints.subsemiring B G) :
    algebraMap A B ((ringEquivFixedPoints G A B).symm x) = x
proof:
:=
 (hA.isInvariant.isInvariant x x.prop).choose_spec

name: algebraMap_ringEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem algebraMap_ringEquiv_apply (x : A) :
    algebraMap A' B (IsGaloisGroup.ringEquiv G A A' B x) = algebraMap A B x
proof:
:= by
  simp [ringEquiv]

name: algebraMap_ringEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem algebraMap_ringEquiv_symm_apply (x : A') :
    algebraMap A B ((IsGaloisGroup.ringEquiv G A A' B).symm x) = algebraMap A' B x
proof:
:= by
  simp [ringEquiv]

name: UniqueFactorizationMonoid.primeFactors_eq_natPrimeFactors
statement:
lemma UniqueFactorizationMonoid.primeFactors_eq_natPrimeFactors :
    primeFactors = Nat.primeFactors
proof:
:= by
  ext n : 1
  rw [primeFactors, Nat.factors_eq, Nat.primeFactors]
  
  convert! List.toFinset_coe _

name: radical_eq_prod_primeFactors
statement: lemma radical_eq_prod_primeFactors : radical n = ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, p
proof:
:= by
  simp [radical, primeFactors_eq_natPrimeFactors]

name: radical_pos
statement: lemma radical_pos (n) : 0 < radical n
proof: := pos_of_ne_zero radical_ne_zero

name: one_lt_radical_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma one_lt_radical_iff : 1 < radical n ↔ 1 < n
proof:
:= by
  have pp (p) (h : p ∈ n.primeFactors) : 1 ≤ p := pos_of_mem_primeFactors h
  rw [radical_eq_prod_primeFactors, ← @nonempty_primeFactors n, Finset.one_lt_prod_iff_of_one_le pp]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨p, h⟩ ↦ ⟨p, h.1⟩, fun ⟨p, h⟩ ↦ ⟨p, h, (mem_primeFactors.mp h).1.one_lt⟩⟩

name: two_le_radical_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma two_le_radical_iff : 2 ≤ radical n ↔ 2 ≤ n
proof: := one_lt_radical_iff

name: radical_le_one_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma radical_le_one_iff : radical n ≤ 1 ↔ n ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [not_lt] using one_lt_radical_iff.not

name: radical_eq_one_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma radical_eq_one_iff : radical n = 1 ↔ n ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← radical_le_one_iff]
  grind [radical_pos n]

name: radical_le_self_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma radical_le_self_iff : radical n ≤ n ↔ n ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨by aesop, fun h ↦ Nat.le_of_dvd (by lia) radical_dvd_self⟩

name: self_lt_radical_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma self_lt_radical_iff : n < radical n ↔ n = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [not_le, not_not] using radical_le_self_iff.not

name: primeFactors_radical
statement: theorem primeFactors_radical (n : ℕ) : (radical n).primeFactors = n.primeFactors
proof:
:= by
  rw [radical_eq_prod_primeFactors, primeFactors_prod_primeFactors]

name: radical_dvd_iff
statement:
theorem radical_dvd_iff {n k : ℕ} (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    radical n ∣ k ↔ n.primeFactors ⊆ k.primeFactors
proof:
:= by
  rw [radical_eq_prod_primeFactors, prod_primeFactors_dvd_iff hk]

name: dvd_radical_pow_self
statement: theorem dvd_radical_pow_self {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) : n ∣ radical n ^ n
proof:
:= by
  grw [radical_eq_prod_primeFactors, ← dvd_prod_primeFactors_pow_self hn]

name: UniqueFactorizationMonoid.primeFactors_eq_primeFactors_natAbs
statement:
lemma UniqueFactorizationMonoid.primeFactors_eq_primeFactors_natAbs :
    primeFactors z = z.natAbs.primeFactors.map Nat.castEmbedding
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hz := eq_or_ne z 0; · simp
  ext p
  rw [mem_primeFactors, mem_normalizedFactors_iff' hz, irreducible_iff_prime,
    Int.nonneg_iff_normalize_eq_self, Finset.mem_map, Function.Embedding.coeFn_mk]
  refine ⟨fun ⟨pp, nnp, dp⟩ ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · lift p to ℕ using nnp
    rw [← Nat.prime_iff_prime_int] at pp
    rw [Int.natCast_dvd] at dp
    exact ⟨p, by simp_all, rfl⟩
  · simp_rw [Nat.mem_primeFactors, Function.Embedding.toFun_eq_coe, Nat.castEmbedding_apply] at h
    obtain ⟨n, ⟨pn, dn, -⟩, rfl⟩ := h
    rw [Int.natCast_dvd, ← Nat.prime_iff_prime_int]
    exact ⟨pn, by simp, dn⟩

name: radical_natAbs_eq_radical
statement: @[simp] lemma radical_natAbs_eq_radical : radical z.natAbs = radical z
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.radical_eq_prod_primeFactors, radical]
  simp [primeFactors_eq_primeFactors_natAbs]

name: radical_eq_prod_primeFactors
statement: lemma radical_eq_prod_primeFactors : radical z = ∏ p ∈ z.natAbs.primeFactors, p
proof:
:= by
  rw [← radical_natAbs_eq_radical, Nat.radical_eq_prod_primeFactors]

name: radical_pos
statement: lemma radical_pos (z : ℤ) : 0 < radical z
proof:
:= by
  rw [← radical_natAbs_eq_radical, natCast_pos]
  exact Nat.radical_pos _

name: one_lt_radical_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma one_lt_radical_iff : 1 < radical z ↔ 1 < z.natAbs
proof:
:= by
  rw [← radical_natAbs_eq_radical, Nat.one_lt_cast]
  exact Nat.one_lt_radical_iff

name: two_le_radical_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma two_le_radical_iff : 2 ≤ radical z ↔ 2 ≤ z.natAbs
proof: := one_lt_radical_iff

name: radical_le_one_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma radical_le_one_iff : radical z ≤ 1 ↔ z.natAbs ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [not_lt] using one_lt_radical_iff.not

name: radical_eq_one_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma radical_eq_one_iff : radical z = 1 ↔ z.natAbs ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← radical_le_one_iff]
  grind [radical_pos z]

name: radical_natCast
statement: @[simp, norm_cast] lemma radical_natCast {n : ℕ} : radical (n : ℤ) = radical n
proof:
:= by
  simp [Int.radical_eq_prod_primeFactors, Nat.radical_eq_prod_primeFactors]

name: toFinset_normalizedFactors
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toFinset_normalizedFactors [DecidableEq M] :
    (normalizedFactors a).toFinset = primeFactors a
proof:
:= by
  unfold primeFactors
  convert rfl

name: mem_primeFactors
statement: lemma mem_primeFactors : a ∈ primeFactors b ↔ a ∈ normalizedFactors b
proof:
:= by
  simp only [primeFactors, Multiset.mem_toFinset]

name: _root_.Associated.primeFactors_eq
statement:
theorem _root_.Associated.primeFactors_eq {a b : M} (h : Associated a b) :
    primeFactors a = primeFactors b
proof:
:= by
  unfold primeFactors
  rw [h.normalizedFactors_eq]

name: primeFactors_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma primeFactors_zero : primeFactors (0 : M) = ∅
proof: := by simp [primeFactors]

name: primeFactors_one
statement: @[simp] lemma primeFactors_one : primeFactors (1 : M) = ∅
proof: := by simp [primeFactors]

name: pairwise_primeFactors_isRelPrime
statement:
lemma pairwise_primeFactors_isRelPrime :
    Set.Pairwise (primeFactors a : Set M) IsRelPrime
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | ha₀ := eq_or_ne a 0
  · simp
  intro x hx y hy hxy
  simp only [Finset.mem_coe, mem_primeFactors, mem_normalizedFactors_iff' ha₀] at hx hy
  rw [hx.1.isRelPrime_iff_not_dvd]
  contrapose hxy
  have : Associated x y := hx.1.associated_of_dvd hy.1 hxy
  exact this.eq_of_normalized hx.2.1 hy.2.1

name: primeFactors_pow
statement: theorem primeFactors_pow (a : M) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) : primeFactors (a ^ n) = primeFactors a
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [primeFactors, normalizedFactors_pow, Multiset.toFinset_nsmul _ _ hn]

name: primeFactors_pow'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem primeFactors_pow' (a : M) {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] : primeFactors (a ^ n) = primeFactors a
proof:
:=
  primeFactors_pow a NeZero.out

name: normalizedFactors_nodup
statement: lemma normalizedFactors_nodup (ha : IsRadical a) : (normalizedFactors a).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | ha₀ := eq_or_ne a 0
  · simp
  rwa [← squarefree_iff_nodup_normalizedFactors ha₀, ← isRadical_iff_squarefree_of_ne_zero ha₀]

name: primeFactors_of_isUnit
statement: lemma primeFactors_of_isUnit (h : IsUnit a) : primeFactors a = ∅
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [primeFactors, normalizedFactors_of_isUnit h, Multiset.toFinset_zero]

name: primeFactors_eq_empty_iff
statement: theorem primeFactors_eq_empty_iff (ha : a ≠ 0) : primeFactors a = ∅ ↔ IsUnit a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [primeFactors, Multiset.toFinset_eq_empty, normalizedFactors_eq_zero_iff ha]

name: primeFactors_val_eq_normalizedFactors
statement:
lemma primeFactors_val_eq_normalizedFactors (ha : IsRadical a) :
    (primeFactors a).val = normalizedFactors a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [primeFactors, Multiset.toFinset_val, Multiset.dedup_eq_self]
  exact normalizedFactors_nodup ha

name: primeFactors_mul_eq_union
statement:
theorem primeFactors_mul_eq_union [DecidableEq M] (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    primeFactors (a * b) = primeFactors a ∪ primeFactors b
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  simp [mem_normalizedFactors_iff', mem_primeFactors, ha, hb]

name: disjoint_primeFactors
statement:
theorem disjoint_primeFactors (hc : IsRelPrime a b) :
    Disjoint (primeFactors a) (primeFactors b)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact Multiset.disjoint_toFinset.mpr (disjoint_normalizedFactors hc)

name: primeFactors_mul_eq_disjUnion
statement:
theorem primeFactors_mul_eq_disjUnion (hc : IsRelPrime a b) :
    primeFactors (a * b) =
      (primeFactors a).disjUnion (primeFactors b) (disjoint_primeFactors hc)
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | ha := eq_or_ne a 0
  · rw [isRelPrime_zero_left] at hc
    simp only [zero_mul, primeFactors_zero, Finset.empty_disjUnion, primeFactors_of_isUnit hc]
  obtain rfl | hb := eq_or_ne b 0
  · rw [isRelPrime_zero_right] at hc
    simp only [mul_zero, primeFactors_zero, primeFactors_of_isUnit hc, Finset.disjUnion_empty]
  classical
  rw [Finset.disjUnion_eq_union, primeFactors_mul_eq_union ha hb]

name: radical_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem radical_zero : radical (0 : M) = 1
proof: := by simp [radical]

name: radical_one
statement: @[simp] theorem radical_one : radical (1 : M) = 1
proof: := by simp [radical]

name: radical_eq_of_associated
statement: theorem radical_eq_of_associated (h : Associated a b) : radical a = radical b
proof:
:= by
  rw [radical, radical, Associated.primeFactors_eq h]

name: radical_associated
statement:
lemma radical_associated (ha : IsRadical a) (ha' : a ≠ 0) :
    Associated (radical a) a
proof:
:= by
  rw [radical, ← Finset.prod_val, primeFactors_val_eq_normalizedFactors ha]
  exact prod_normalizedFactors ha'

name: _root_.IsRadical.dvd_radical
statement: lemma _root_.IsRadical.dvd_radical (ha : IsRadical a) (ha' : a ≠ 0) : a ∣ radical a
proof:
:=
  (radical_associated ha ha').dvd'

name: radical_of_isUnit
statement: theorem radical_of_isUnit (h : IsUnit a) : radical a = 1
proof:
:=
  (radical_eq_of_associated (associated_one_iff_isUnit.mpr h)).trans radical_one

name: radical_mul_of_isUnit_left
statement: theorem radical_mul_of_isUnit_left (h : IsUnit u) : radical (u * a) = radical a
proof:
:=
  radical_eq_of_associated (associated_unit_mul_left _ _ h)

name: radical_mul_of_isUnit_right
statement: theorem radical_mul_of_isUnit_right (h : IsUnit u) : radical (a * u) = radical a
proof:
:=
  radical_eq_of_associated (associated_mul_unit_left _ _ h)

name: radical_pow
statement: theorem radical_pow (a : M) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) : radical (a ^ n) = radical a
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [radical, primeFactors_pow a hn]

name: radical_pow_dvd
statement: theorem radical_pow_dvd {n : ℕ} : radical (a ^ n) ∣ radical a
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with rfl | hn
  · simp
  · rw [radical_pow _ hn]

name: radical_dvd_self
statement: theorem radical_dvd_self : radical a ∣ a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases ha : a = 0
  · rw [ha]
    apply dvd_zero
  · rw [radical, ← Finset.prod_val, ← (prod_normalizedFactors ha).dvd_iff_dvd_right]
    apply Multiset.prod_dvd_prod_of_le
    rw [primeFactors, Multiset.toFinset_val]
    apply Multiset.dedup_le

name: radical_of_prime
statement: theorem radical_of_prime (ha : Prime a) : radical a = normalize a
proof:
:= by
  rw [radical, primeFactors]
  rw [normalizedFactors_irreducible ha.irreducible]
  simp only [Multiset.toFinset_singleton, id, Finset.prod_singleton]

name: radical_pow_of_prime
statement:
theorem radical_pow_of_prime (ha : Prime a) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    radical (a ^ n) = normalize a
proof:
:= by
  rw [radical_pow a hn]
  exact radical_of_prime ha

name: radical_ne_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem radical_ne_zero [Nontrivial M] : radical a ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [radical, ← Finset.prod_val]
  apply Multiset.prod_ne_zero
  rw [primeFactors]
  simp only [Multiset.toFinset_val, Multiset.mem_dedup]
  exact zero_notMem_normalizedFactors _

name: dvd_radical_iff_of_irreducible
statement:
lemma dvd_radical_iff_of_irreducible (ha : Irreducible a) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    a ∣ radical b ↔ a ∣ b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro ha
    exact ha.trans radical_dvd_self
  · intro ha'
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hc'⟩ := exists_mem_normalizedFactors_of_dvd hb ha ha'
    exact hc'.dvd.trans (Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem _ (by simpa [mem_primeFactors] using hc))

name: isRadical_radical
statement: lemma isRadical_radical : IsRadical (radical a)
proof:
:= by
  intro n p ha
  rw [radical]
  apply Finset.prod_dvd_of_isRelPrime
  · exact pairwise_primeFactors_isRelPrime
  intro i hi
  simp only [mem_primeFactors] at hi
  have : i ∣ radical a := by
    rw [dvd_radical_iff_of_irreducible]
    · exact dvd_of_mem_normalizedFactors hi
    · exact irreducible_of_normalized_factor i hi
    · rintro rfl
      simp only [normalizedFactors_zero, Multiset.notMem_zero] at hi
  exact (prime_of_normalized_factor i hi).isRadical n p (this.trans ha)

name: squarefree_radical
statement: lemma squarefree_radical : Squarefree (radical a)
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality M
  exact isRadical_radical.squarefree (by simp [radical_ne_zero])

name: primeFactors_radical
statement: @[simp] lemma primeFactors_radical : primeFactors (radical a) = primeFactors a
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | ha₀ := eq_or_ne a 0
  · simp [primeFactors]
  have : Nontrivial M := ⟨a, 0, ha₀⟩
  ext p
  simp +contextual [mem_primeFactors, mem_normalizedFactors_iff',
    dvd_radical_iff_of_irreducible, ha₀]

name: radical_eq_iff_primeFactors_eq
statement:
lemma radical_eq_iff_primeFactors_eq :
    radical a = radical b ↔ primeFactors a = primeFactors b
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by rw [← primeFactors_radical, h]; exact primeFactors_radical,
    fun h => by simp [radical, h]⟩

name: radical_eq_one_iff
statement: theorem radical_eq_one_iff : radical a = 1 ↔ a = 0 ∨ IsUnit a
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, (Or.elim · (by simp +contextual) radical_of_isUnit)⟩
  intro h
  rw [or_iff_not_imp_left]
  intro ha
  have : primeFactors a = ∅ := by rw [← primeFactors_radical, h, primeFactors_one]
  rwa [primeFactors_eq_empty_iff ha] at this

name: radical_radical
statement:
@[simp]
lemma radical_radical : radical (radical a) = radical a
proof:
:=
  radical_eq_iff_primeFactors_eq.mpr primeFactors_radical

name: radical_dvd_radical_iff_normalizedFactors_subset_normalizedFactors
statement:
lemma radical_dvd_radical_iff_normalizedFactors_subset_normalizedFactors :
    radical a ∣ radical b ↔ normalizedFactors a ⊆ normalizedFactors b
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | ha₀ := eq_or_ne a 0
  · simp
  have : Nontrivial M := ⟨a, 0, ha₀⟩
  rw [dvd_iff_normalizedFactors_le_normalizedFactors radical_ne_zero radical_ne_zero,
    Multiset.le_iff_subset (normalizedFactors_nodup isRadical_radical)]
  simp only [Multiset.subset_iff, ← mem_primeFactors, primeFactors_radical]

name: radical_dvd_radical_iff_primeFactors_subset_primeFactors
statement:
lemma radical_dvd_radical_iff_primeFactors_subset_primeFactors :
    radical a ∣ radical b ↔ primeFactors a ⊆ primeFactors b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [radical_dvd_radical_iff_normalizedFactors_subset_normalizedFactors, primeFactors,
    primeFactors, Multiset.toFinset_subset]

name: radical_dvd_radical
statement: lemma radical_dvd_radical (h : a ∣ b) (hb₀ : b ≠ 0) : radical a ∣ radical b
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | ha₀ := eq_or_ne a 0
  · simp
  rw [dvd_iff_normalizedFactors_le_normalizedFactors ha₀ hb₀] at h
  rw [radical_dvd_radical_iff_normalizedFactors_subset_normalizedFactors]
  exact Multiset.subset_of_le h

name: dvd_radical_iff
statement: lemma dvd_radical_iff (ha : IsRadical a) (hb₀ : b ≠ 0) : a ∣ radical b ↔ a ∣ b
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ha' ↦ ha'.trans radical_dvd_self, fun hab ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain rfl | ha₀ := eq_or_ne a 0
  · simp_all
  · exact (ha.dvd_radical ha₀).trans (radical_dvd_radical hab hb₀)

name: radical_dvd_iff_primeFactors_subset
statement:
theorem radical_dvd_iff_primeFactors_subset (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    radical a ∣ b ↔ primeFactors a ⊆ primeFactors b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← dvd_radical_iff isRadical_radical hb,
    radical_dvd_radical_iff_primeFactors_subset_primeFactors]

name: exists_dvd_pow_iff_radical_dvd
statement: theorem exists_dvd_pow_iff_radical_dvd (ha : a ≠ 0) : (∃ n, a ∣ b ^ n) ↔ radical a ∣ b
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne b 0 with (rfl | hb)
  · exact ⟨by simp, fun _ ↦ ⟨1, by simp⟩⟩
  refine ⟨fun ⟨n, hdvd⟩ ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ⟨normalizedFactors a |>.card, ?_⟩⟩
  · rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with (rfl | hn)
    · simp [radical_of_isUnit <| isUnit_of_dvd_one <| pow_zero b ▸ hdvd]
    grw [radical_dvd_radical hdvd <| pow_ne_zero _ hb, radical_pow b hn, radical_dvd_self]
  · classical
    rwa [dvd_iff_normalizedFactors_le_normalizedFactors ha <| pow_ne_zero _ hb,
      normalizedFactors_pow, Multiset.le_card_smul_iff_subset, ← Multiset.toFinset_subset,
      toFinset_normalizedFactors, toFinset_normalizedFactors,
      ← radical_dvd_iff_primeFactors_subset hb]

name: exists_dvd_radical_self_pow
statement: theorem exists_dvd_radical_self_pow (ha : a ≠ 0) : ∃ n, a ∣ radical a ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [exists_dvd_pow_iff_radical_dvd ha]

name: radical_mul
statement:
theorem radical_mul (hc : IsRelPrime a b) :
    radical (a * b) = radical a * radical b
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [radical]
  rw [primeFactors_mul_eq_disjUnion hc, Finset.prod_disjUnion (disjoint_primeFactors hc)]

name: radical_prod
statement:
theorem radical_prod {ι : Type*} {f : ι → M} (s : Finset ι)
    (h : Set.Pairwise (s : Set ι) (Function.onFun IsRelPrime f)) :
    radical (∏ i ∈ s, f i) = ∏ i ∈ s, radical (f i)
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction with
  | empty => simp
  | cons i s his ih =>
    simp only [Finset.prod_cons]
    rw [Finset.coe_cons, Set.pairwise_insert_of_symm_of_notMem <| by simpa] at h
    rw [radical_mul, ih h.1]
    exact IsRelPrime.prod_right h.2

name: radical_mul_dvd
statement: theorem radical_mul_dvd : radical (a * b) ∣ radical a * radical b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain rfl | ha := eq_or_ne a 0
  · simp
  obtain rfl | hb := eq_or_ne b 0
  · simp
  nontriviality M
  simp [radical_dvd_iff_primeFactors_subset, primeFactors_mul_eq_union,
    primeFactors_mul_eq_union ha hb, primeFactors_radical]

name: radical_prod_dvd
statement:
theorem radical_prod_dvd {ι : Type*} {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → M} :
    radical (∏ i ∈ s, f i) ∣ ∏ i ∈ s, radical (f i)
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction with
  | empty => simp
  | cons i s h ih =>
    simp only [Finset.prod_cons]
    exact radical_mul_dvd.trans (mul_dvd_mul_left _ ih)

name: radical_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem radical_neg : radical (-a) = radical a
proof:
:=
  radical_eq_of_associated Associated.rfl.neg_left

name: radical_neg_one
statement: theorem radical_neg_one : radical (-1 : R) = 1
proof: := by simp

name: radical_mul_divRadical
statement: theorem radical_mul_divRadical : radical a * divRadical a = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [divRadical, ← EuclideanDomain.mul_div_assoc _ radical_dvd_self,
    mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ radical_ne_zero]

name: divRadical_mul_radical
statement: theorem divRadical_mul_radical : divRadical a * radical a = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm]
  exact radical_mul_divRadical

name: divRadical_ne_zero
statement: theorem divRadical_ne_zero (ha : a ≠ 0) : divRadical a ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← radical_mul_divRadical (a := a)] at ha
  exact right_ne_zero_of_mul ha

name: divRadical_isUnit
statement: theorem divRadical_isUnit (hu : IsUnit u) : IsUnit (divRadical u)
proof:
:= by
  rwa [divRadical, radical_of_isUnit hu, EuclideanDomain.div_one]

name: eq_divRadical
statement: theorem eq_divRadical (h : radical a * x = a) : x = divRadical a
proof:
:= by
  apply EuclideanDomain.eq_div_of_mul_eq_left radical_ne_zero
  rwa [mul_comm]

name: divRadical_mul
statement:
theorem divRadical_mul (hab : IsCoprime a b) :
    divRadical (a * b) = divRadical a * divRadical b
proof:
:= by
  symm; apply eq_divRadical
  rw [UniqueFactorizationMonoid.radical_mul hab.isRelPrime]
  rw [mul_mul_mul_comm, radical_mul_divRadical, radical_mul_divRadical]

name: divRadical_dvd_self
statement: theorem divRadical_dvd_self (a : E) : divRadical a ∣ a
proof:
:=
  ⟨radical a, divRadical_mul_radical.symm⟩

name: _root_.IsCoprime.divRadical
statement:
theorem _root_.IsCoprime.divRadical {a b : E} (h : IsCoprime a b) :
    IsCoprime (divRadical a) (divRadical b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← radical_mul_divRadical (a := a)] at h
  rw [← radical_mul_divRadical (a := b)] at h
  exact h.of_mul_left_right.of_mul_right_right

name: list_sum_mem
statement: protected theorem list_sum_mem {l : List R} : (∀ x ∈ l, x ∈ s) → l.sum ∈ s
proof:
:=
  list_sum_mem

name: multiset_sum_mem
statement:
protected theorem multiset_sum_mem {R} [NonUnitalNonAssocRing R] (s : NonUnitalSubring R)
    (m : Multiset R) : (∀ a ∈ m, a ∈ s) → m.sum ∈ s
proof:
:=
  multiset_sum_mem _

name: sum_mem
statement:
protected theorem sum_mem {R : Type*} [NonUnitalNonAssocRing R] (s : NonUnitalSubring R)
    {ι : Type*} {t : Finset ι} {f : ι → R} (h : ∀ c ∈ t, f c ∈ s) : (∑ i ∈ t, f i) ∈ s
proof:
:=
  sum_mem h

name: mem_top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_top (x : R) : x ∈ (⊤ : NonUnitalSubring R)
proof:
:=
  Set.mem_univ x

name: coe_top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_top : ((⊤ : NonUnitalSubring R) : Set R) = Set.univ
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: toNonUnitalSubsemiring_top
statement:
@[simp]
lemma toNonUnitalSubsemiring_top : (⊤ : NonUnitalSubring R).toNonUnitalSubsemiring = ⊤
proof: := rfl

name: toAddSubgroup_top
statement: @[simp] lemma toAddSubgroup_top : (⊤ : NonUnitalSubring R).toAddSubgroup = ⊤
proof: := rfl

name: toNonUnitalSubsemiring_eq_top
statement:
@[simp]
lemma toNonUnitalSubsemiring_eq_top {S : NonUnitalSubring R} :
    S.toNonUnitalSubsemiring = ⊤ ↔ S = ⊤
proof: := by simp [← SetLike.coe_set_eq]

name: toAddSubgroup_eq_top
