name: adjoin_residue_eq_top_iff_adjoin_eq_top
statement:
lemma adjoin_residue_eq_top_iff_adjoin_eq_top [Algebra.FormallyUnramified R S] (β : S) :
    Algebra.adjoin (ResidueField R) {residue S β} = ⊤ ↔ Algebra.adjoin R {β} = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hβ
    refine eq_top_iff.mpr <| Submodule.le_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson_bot
      (Module.finite_def.mp inferInstance) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_le_jacobson ⊥)
      (?_ : ⊤ ≤ (adjoin R {β}).toSubmodule ⊔ maximalIdeal R • ⊤)
    intro s _
    rw [adjoin_singleton_eq_range_aeval, AlgHom.range_eq_top] at hβ
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hβ (residue S s)
    obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := Polynomial.map_surjective _ residue_surjective p
    rw [Ideal.smul_top_eq_map]
    refine Submodule.mem_sup.mpr ⟨aeval β q, ?_, s - aeval β q, ?_, by ring⟩
    · rw [adjoin_singleton_eq_range_aeval]; exact ⟨q, rfl⟩
    · rw [Algebra.FormallyUnramified.map_maximalIdeal, Submodule.restrictScalars_mem,
        ← Ideal.Quotient.eq]
      
      rw [← map_aeval_eq_aeval_map (ψ := residue S) (φ := residue R) rfl] at hp
      exact hp.symm
  · intro hβ_gen
    rw [Algebra.adjoin_singleton_eq_range_aeval, AlgHom.range_eq_top] at *
    intro x
    obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := residue_surjective (R := S) x
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hβ_gen s
    exact ⟨p.map (residue R), by
      rw [← map_aeval_eq_aeval_map (ψ := residue S) (φ := residue R) rfl p β]⟩

name: exists_adjoin_eq_top
statement:
theorem exists_adjoin_eq_top [Algebra.FormallyUnramified R S] :
    ∃ β : S, Algebra.adjoin R {β} = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨β₀, hβ₀⟩ := Field.exists_primitive_element (ResidueField R) (ResidueField S)
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := residue_surjective (R := S) β₀
  refine ⟨β, adjoin_residue_eq_top_iff_adjoin_eq_top β |>.mp ?_⟩
  rw [hβ,
    ← IntermediateField.adjoin_simple_toSubalgebra_of_isAlgebraic (IsAlgebraic.of_finite _ _),
    hβ₀, IntermediateField.top_toSubalgebra]

name: finrank_eq_finrank_residueField
statement:
lemma finrank_eq_finrank_residueField [Algebra.Etale R S] :
    Module.finrank R S =
      Module.finrank (ResidueField R) (ResidueField S)
proof:
:= by
  have : Module.Free R S := Module.free_of_flat_of_isLocalRing
  have e := AddEquiv.toLinearEquiv (R := R ⧸ maximalIdeal R) (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq <|
      Algebra.FormallyUnramified.map_maximalIdeal (R := R) (S := S)).toAddEquiv
    ?_
  · rw [← finrank_quotient_map (R := R) (S := S)]
    exact e.finrank_eq 
  · intro r x
    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective r
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
    simp only [RingEquiv.toAddEquiv_eq_coe]; rfl

name: minpoly_map_residue
statement:
lemma minpoly_map_residue [Algebra.Etale R S]
    {β : S} (hadj : Algebra.adjoin R {β} = ⊤) :
    (minpoly R β).map (residue R) = minpoly (ResidueField R) (residue S β)
proof:
:= by
  have h := minpoly.monic <| Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral (R := R) β
  
  refine eq_of_monic_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le
    (minpoly.monic <| Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral <| residue S β)
    (h.map _) (minpoly.dvd (ResidueField R) (residue S β) ?_) ?_
  · rw [← map_aeval_eq_aeval_map (ψ := residue S) (φ := residue R) rfl]
    simp
  · have : Module.Free R S := Module.free_of_flat_of_isLocalRing
    have hβ₀ := (adjoin_residue_eq_top_iff_adjoin_eq_top β).mpr hadj
    rw [h.natDegree_map _,
      ← (IsAdjoinRootMonic.mkOfAdjoinEqTop' hadj).finrank,
      finrank_eq_finrank_residueField,
      (IsAdjoinRootMonic.mkOfAdjoinEqTop' hβ₀).finrank]

name: isUnit_aeval_derivative_minpoly_of_adjoin_eq_top
statement:
lemma isUnit_aeval_derivative_minpoly_of_adjoin_eq_top
    [Algebra.Etale R S] {β : S}
    (hadj : Algebra.adjoin R {β} = ⊤) :
    IsUnit (aeval β (minpoly R β).derivative)
proof:
:= by
  apply fun s ↦ (residue_ne_zero_iff_isUnit s).mp
  rw [map_aeval_eq_aeval_map (ψ := residue S) (φ := residue R) rfl,
    ← derivative_map, minpoly_map_residue hadj]
  exact (Algebra.IsSeparable.isSeparable _ _).aeval_derivative_ne_zero (minpoly.aeval _ _)

name: quotient_span_eq_top_iff_span_eq_top
statement:
theorem quotient_span_eq_top_iff_span_eq_top (s : Set S) :
    span (R ⧸ p) ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (I := pS)) '' s) = ⊤ ↔ span R s = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have H : (span (R ⧸ p) ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (I := pS)) '' s)).restrictScalars R =
      (span R s).map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R S (S ⧸ pS) : S →ₗ[R] S ⧸ pS) := by
    rw [map_span, ← restrictScalars_span R (R ⧸ p) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective,
      LinearMap.coe_ofClass, IsScalarTower.coe_toAlgHom', Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq]
  constructor
  · intro hs
    rw [← top_le_iff]
    apply le_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson_bot
    · exact Module.finite_def.mp ‹_›
    · exact (jacobson_eq_maximalIdeal ⊥ bot_ne_top).ge
    · rw [Ideal.smul_top_eq_map]
      rintro x -
      have : LinearMap.ker (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R S (S ⧸ pS) : S →ₗ[R] S ⧸ pS) =
          Submodule.restrictScalars R pS := by
        ext; simp [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
      rw [← this, ← comap_map_eq, mem_comap, ← H, hs, restrictScalars_top]
      exact mem_top
  · intro hs
    rwa [hs, Submodule.map_top, LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr,
      restrictScalars_eq_top_iff] at H
    rw [LinearMap.coe_ofClass, IsScalarTower.coe_toAlgHom', Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq]
    exact Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective

name: finrank_quotient_map
statement:
theorem finrank_quotient_map :
    finrank (R ⧸ p) (S ⧸ pS) = finrank R S
proof:
:= by
  have : Module.Finite (R ⧸ p) (S ⧸ pS) := Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite R _ _
  apply le_antisymm
  · let b := Module.Free.chooseBasis R S
    conv_rhs => rw [finrank_eq_card_chooseBasisIndex]
    apply finrank_le_of_span_eq_top
    rw [Set.range_comp]
    apply (quotient_span_eq_top_iff_span_eq_top _).mpr b.span_eq
  · let b := Module.Free.chooseBasis (R ⧸ p) (S ⧸ pS)
    choose b' hb' using fun i ↦ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (b i)
    conv_rhs => rw [finrank_eq_card_chooseBasisIndex]
    refine finrank_le_of_span_eq_top (v := b') ?_
    apply (quotient_span_eq_top_iff_span_eq_top _).mp
    rw [← Set.range_comp, show Ideal.Quotient.mk pS ∘ b' = ⇑b from funext hb']
    exact b.span_eq

name: basisQuotient_apply
statement:
lemma basisQuotient_apply [Fintype ι] (b : Basis ι R S) (i) :
    (basisQuotient b) i = Ideal.Quotient.mk pS (b i)
proof:
:= by
  delta basisQuotient
  rw [coe_basisOfTopLeSpanOfCardEqFinrank, Function.comp_apply]

name: basisQuotient_repr
statement:
lemma basisQuotient_repr {ι} [Fintype ι] (b : Basis ι R S) (x) (i) :
    (basisQuotient b).repr (Ideal.Quotient.mk pS x) i =
    Ideal.Quotient.mk p (b.repr x i)
proof:
:= by
  refine congr_fun (g := Ideal.Quotient.mk p ∘ b.repr x) ?_ i
  apply (Finsupp.linearEquivFunOnFinite (R ⧸ p) _ _).symm.injective
  apply (basisQuotient b).repr.symm.injective
  simp only [Finsupp.linearEquivFunOnFinite_symm_coe, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply,
    Basis.repr_symm_apply]
  rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_eq_fintype_linearCombination_apply (R ⧸ p),
    Fintype.linearCombination_apply]
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, basisQuotient_apply,
    Ideal.Quotient.mk_smul_mk_quotient_map_quotient, ← Algebra.smul_def]
  rw [← map_sum, Basis.sum_repr b x]

name: exists_maximalIdeal_pow_le_of_isArtinianRing_quotient
statement:
lemma exists_maximalIdeal_pow_le_of_isArtinianRing_quotient
    (I : Ideal R) [IsArtinianRing (R ⧸ I)] : ∃ n, maximalIdeal R ^ n ≤ I
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hI : I = ⊤
  · simp [hI]
  have : Nontrivial (R ⧸ I) := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr hI
  have := IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have := IsLocalHom.of_surjective (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := IsArtinianRing.isNilpotent_jacobson_bot (R := R ⧸ I)
  have : (maximalIdeal R).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) = maximalIdeal (R ⧸ I) := by
    ext x
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
    simp [sup_eq_left.mpr (le_maximalIdeal hI)]
  rw [jacobson_eq_maximalIdeal _ bot_ne_top, ← this, ← Ideal.map_pow, Ideal.zero_eq_bot,
    Ideal.map_eq_bot_iff_le_ker, Ideal.mk_ker] at hn
  exact ⟨n, hn⟩

name: finite_quotient_iff
statement:
lemma finite_quotient_iff [IsNoetherianRing R] [Finite (ResidueField R)] {I : Ideal R} :
    Finite (R ⧸ I) ↔ ∃ n, (maximalIdeal R) ^ n ≤ I
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ ↦ exists_maximalIdeal_pow_le_of_isArtinianRing_quotient I, fun ⟨_, hn⟩ ↦
    .of_surjective _ (Ideal.Quotient.factor_surjective hn)⟩

name: not_isLocalRing_def
statement:
theorem not_isLocalRing_def {R : Type*} [Semiring R] {a b : R} (ha : ¬IsUnit a) (hb : ¬IsUnit b)
    (hab : a + b = 1) : ¬IsLocalRing R
proof:
:=
  fun _ ↦ hb <| (isUnit_or_isUnit_of_add_one hab).resolve_left ha

name: not_isLocalRing_of_nontrivial_pi
statement:
theorem not_isLocalRing_of_nontrivial_pi {ι : Type*} [Nontrivial ι] (R : ι → Type*)
    [∀ i, Semiring (R i)] [∀ i, Nontrivial (R i)] : ¬IsLocalRing (Π i, R i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let ⟨i₁, i₂, hi⟩ := exists_pair_ne ι
  have ha : ¬IsUnit (fun i ↦ if i = i₁ then 0 else 1 : Π i, R i) :=
    fun h ↦ not_isUnit_zero (M₀ := R i₁) (by simpa using h.map (Pi.evalRingHom R i₁))
  have hb : ¬IsUnit (fun i ↦ if i = i₁ then 1 else 0 : Π i, R i) :=
    fun h ↦ not_isUnit_zero (M₀ := R i₂) (by simpa [hi.symm] using h.map (Pi.evalRingHom R i₂))
  exact not_isLocalRing_def ha hb (by ext; dsimp; split <;> simp)

name: not_isLocalRing_of_prod_of_nontrivial
statement:
theorem not_isLocalRing_of_prod_of_nontrivial (R₁ R₂ : Type*) [Semiring R₁] [Semiring R₂]
    [Nontrivial R₁] [Nontrivial R₂] : ¬IsLocalRing (R₁ × R₂)
proof:
:=
  have ha : ¬IsUnit ((1, 0) : R₁ × R₂) :=
    fun h ↦ not_isUnit_zero (M₀ := R₁) (by simpa using h.map (RingHom.snd R₁ R₂))
  have hb : ¬IsUnit ((0, 1) : R₁ × R₂) :=
    fun h ↦ not_isUnit_zero (M₀ := R₂) (by simpa using h.map (RingHom.fst R₁ R₂))
  not_isLocalRing_def ha hb (by simp)

name: not_isLocalRing_tfae
statement:
theorem not_isLocalRing_tfae {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [Nontrivial R] :
    List.TFAE [
      ¬IsLocalRing R,
      Nontrivial (MaximalSpectrum R),
      ∃ m₁ m₂ : Ideal R, m₁.IsMaximal ∧ m₂.IsMaximal ∧ m₁ ≠ m₂]
proof:
:= by
  tfae_have 1 → 2
  | h => not_subsingleton_iff_nontrivial.mp fun _ ↦ h of_singleton_maximalSpectrum
  tfae_have 2 → 3
  | ⟨⟨m₁, hm₁⟩, ⟨m₂, hm₂⟩, h⟩ => ⟨m₁, m₂, ⟨hm₁, hm₂, fun _ ↦ h (by congr)⟩⟩
  tfae_have 3 → 1
  | ⟨m₁, m₂, ⟨hm₁, hm₂, h⟩⟩ => fun _ ↦ h <| (eq_maximalIdeal hm₁).trans (eq_maximalIdeal hm₂).symm
  tfae_finish

name: exists_surjective_of_not_isLocalRing.
statement:
theorem exists_surjective_of_not_isLocalRing.{u} {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Nontrivial R]
    (h : ¬IsLocalRing R) :
    ∃ (K₁ K₂ : Type u) (_ : Field K₁) (_ : Field K₂) (f : R →+* K₁ × K₂),
      Function.Surjective f
proof:
:= by
  /- get two different maximal ideals and project on the product of quotients -/
  obtain ⟨m₁, m₂, _, _, hm₁m₂⟩ := (not_isLocalRing_tfae.out 1 3).mp h
  let e := Ideal.quotientInfEquivQuotientProd m₁ m₂ <| Ideal.isCoprime_of_isMaximal hm₁m₂
  let f := e.toRingHom.comp <| Ideal.Quotient.mk (m₁ ⊓ m₂)
  use R ⧸ m₁, R ⧸ m₂, Ideal.Quotient.field m₁, Ideal.Quotient.field m₂, f
  apply Function.Surjective.comp e.surjective Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective

name: map_pullbackSnd_ker_pullbackFst_eq
statement:
theorem map_pullbackSnd_ker_pullbackFst_eq (f : R →+* T) (g : S →+* T) :
    Ideal.map (f.pullbackSnd g) (RingHom.ker (f.pullbackFst g)) = RingHom.ker g
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    rintro ⟨⟨_, _⟩, h⟩
    simp at h ⊢; grind
  · intro s hs
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (f.pullbackSnd g) (x := ⟨(0, s), by simpa using hs.symm⟩)
      (I := RingHom.ker (f.pullbackFst g)) (by simp)

:=

statement:
@[simp]
lemma coe_C (a : R) :
    ↑(C (σ := ℕ × M) a) = algebraMap R (DividedPowerAlgebra R M) a
proof:
:= by

statement:

lemma mkAlgHom_C (a : R) :
    RingCon.mkₐ R (ringCon R M) (C a) = algebraMap R (DividedPowerAlgebra R M) a

@[deprecated coe_C (since := "2026-06-19")]

name: dp_def
statement:
theorem dp_def (n : ℕ) (m : M) :
  dp R n m = ↑(X (n, m) : MvPolynomial (ℕ × M) R)
proof: := rfl

name: induction_on'
statement:
protected theorem induction_on' {P : DividedPowerAlgebra R M → Prop} (f : DividedPowerAlgebra R M)
    (h_C : ∀ a, P (C a : MvPolynomial (ℕ × M) R)) (h_add : ∀ f g, P f → P g → P (f + g))
    (h_dp : ∀ (f : DividedPowerAlgebra R M) (n : ℕ) (m : M), P f → P (f * dp R n m)) : P f
proof:
:= by
  induction f using Quot.induction_on with | _ F
  dsimp
  induction F using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C a => exact h_C a
  | add g1 g2 hg1 hg2 =>
    rw [RingCon.coe_add]
    exact h_add _ _ hg1 hg2
  | mul_X g nm h =>
    rw [RingCon.coe_mul]
    exact h_dp _ _ _ h

name: induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
protected theorem induction_on {P : DividedPowerAlgebra R M → Prop} (f : DividedPowerAlgebra R M)
    (C : ∀ a, P (algebraMap R _ a)) (add : ∀ f g, P f → P g → P (f + g))
    (dp : ∀ (f : DividedPowerAlgebra R M) (n : ℕ) (m : M), P f → P (f * dp R n m)) : P f
proof:
:=
  DividedPowerAlgebra.induction_on' f C add dp

name: dp_zero
statement: theorem dp_zero {m : M} : dp R 0 m = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [dp_def, ← RingCon.coe_one]
  exact Quotient.sound <| RingCon.le_ringConGen _ _ Rel.zero

name: dp_smul
statement: theorem dp_smul {r : R} {n : ℕ} {m : M} : dp R n (r • m) = r ^ n • dp R n m
proof:
:= by
  rw [dp_def, dp_def, ← RingCon.coe_smul]
  exact Quotient.sound <| RingCon.le_ringConGen _ _ Rel.smul

name: dp_null
statement: theorem dp_null {n : ℕ} : dp R n (0 : M) = if n = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  cases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with
  | inl hn =>
    rw [ite_eq_left hn, hn, dp_zero]
  | inr hn =>
    rw [ite_eq_right (ne_of_gt hn), ← zero_smul R (0 : M), dp_smul]
    rw [zero_pow (Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.mp hn), zero_smul]

name: dp_null_of_ne_zero
statement: theorem dp_null_of_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) : dp R n (0 : M) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [dp_null, ite_eq_right hn]

name: dp_mul
statement:
theorem dp_mul {n p : ℕ} {m : M} :
    dp R n m * dp R p m = (n + p).choose n • dp R (n + p) m
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dp_def, ← RingCon.coe_mul, ← RingCon.coe_nsmul]
  exact Quotient.sound <| RingCon.le_ringConGen _ _ Rel.mul

name: dp_add
statement:
theorem dp_add {n : ℕ} {x y : M} :
    dp R n (x + y) = (antidiagonal n).sum fun k ↦ dp R k.1 x * dp R k.2 y
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [dp_def, ← RingCon.coe_mul, ← RingCon.coe_finsetSum]
  exact Quotient.sound <| RingCon.le_ringConGen _ _ Rel.add

name: dp_sum
statement:
theorem dp_sum {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (q : ℕ) (x : ι → M) :
    dp R q (s.sum x) =
      (Finset.sym s q).sum fun k ↦ s.prod fun i ↦ dp R (Multiset.count i k) (x i)
proof:
:=
  DividedPowers.dpow_sum' (I := ⊤) _ (fun _ ↦ dp_zero)
    (fun _ _ ↦ dp_add) dp_null_of_ne_zero (fun _ _ ↦ trivial)

name: dp_sum_smul
statement:
theorem dp_sum_smul {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (q : ℕ) (a : ι → R) (x : ι → M) :
    dp R q (s.sum fun i ↦ a i • x i) =
      (Finset.sym s q).sum fun k ↦
        (s.prod fun i ↦ a i ^ Multiset.count i k) •
          s.prod fun i ↦ dp R (Multiset.count i k) (x i)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [dp_sum, dp_smul, Algebra.smul_def, map_prod, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]

name: prod_dp
statement:
lemma prod_dp {ι : Type*} {s : Finset ι} {n : ι → ℕ} {m : M} :
    ∏ i ∈ s, (dp R (n i) m) = (Nat.multinomial s n) * dp R (s.sum n) m
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty =>
    simp only [prod_empty, multinomial_empty, cast_one, sum_empty, one_mul, dp_zero]
  | insert _ _ hi hrec =>
    rw [prod_insert hi, hrec, ← mul_assoc, mul_comm (dp R (n _) m),
      mul_assoc, dp_mul, ← sum_insert hi, nsmul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc]
    congr 1
    rw [multinomial_insert hi, mul_comm, cast_mul, sum_insert hi]

name: natFactorial_mul_dp_eq
statement:
theorem natFactorial_mul_dp_eq (n : ℕ) (x : M) :
    n ! * dp R n x = (dp R 1 x) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [dp_zero]
  | succ n h =>
    rw [pow_succ, ← h, mul_assoc, dp_mul, nsmul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc, ← Nat.cast_mul]
    simp [mul_comm _ (n + 1), Nat.factorial_succ]

name: embed_def
statement: theorem embed_def (m : M) : embed R M m = dp R 1 m
proof: := rfl

name: algHom_ext_iff
statement:
theorem algHom_ext_iff {A : Type*} [CommSemiring A] [Algebra R A]
    {f g : DividedPowerAlgebra R M →ₐ[R] A} :
    f = g ↔ ∀ n m, f (dp R n m) = g (dp R n m)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h _ _ ↦ by rw [h], fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [DFunLike.ext'_iff]
  apply Function.Surjective.injective_comp_right mkAlgHom_surjective
  simpa [← AlgHom.coe_comp] using MvPolynomial.algHom_ext fun ⟨n, m⟩ ↦ h n m

name: algHom_ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem algHom_ext {A : Type*} [CommSemiring A] [Algebra R A]
    {f g : DividedPowerAlgebra R M →ₐ[R] A}
    (h : ∀ n m, f (dp R n m) = g (dp R n m)) : f = g
proof:
:=
  algHom_ext_iff.mpr h

name: submodule_span_prod_dp_eq_top
statement:
theorem submodule_span_prod_dp_eq_top (hv : span R (Set.range v) = ⊤) :
    span R (Set.range fun (n : ι →₀ ℕ) ↦ n.prod fun i k ↦ dp R k (v i)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  intro p hp
  clear hp
  induction p using DividedPowerAlgebra.induction_on with
  | C r =>
    simp only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
    exact smul_mem _ _ (subset_span ⟨0, by simp⟩)
  | add x y hx hy => exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
  | dp x k m hx =>
    have hm : m ∈ span R (Set.range v) := by simp [hv, mem_top]
    induction hm using span_induction generalizing x k with
    | zero => rw [dp_null]; split_ifs <;> simp [hx]
    | smul r m hm h => simp [dp_smul, smul_mem _ _ (h x k hx)]
    | mem y hy =>
      obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hy
      induction hx using span_induction with
      | zero => simp
      | mem x hx =>
        obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := hx
        simp only
        rw [← n.mul_prod_erase' i _ (fun i ↦ dp_zero (m := v i)), mul_comm,
          ← mul_assoc, dp_mul, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_assoc, ← nsmul_eq_mul]
        refine smul_of_tower_mem _ _ (mem_span_of_mem ⟨Finsupp.single i k + n, ?_⟩)
        simp only
        rw [← (Finsupp.single i k + n).mul_prod_erase' i _ (fun i ↦ dp_zero (m := v i))]
        simp
      | add x y hxmem hymem hx hy =>
        rw [add_mul]
        exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
      | smul r x hxmem hx =>
        rw [smul_mul_assoc]
        exact smul_mem _ _ hx
    | add m n hm_mem hn_mem hm hn =>
      rw [dp_add, mul_sum]
      apply sum_mem (fun c hc ↦ ?_)
      rw [← mul_assoc]
      exact hn (x * dp R c.1 m) c.2 (hm x c.1 hx)

name: pow_dp
statement:
lemma pow_dp (n : ℕ) (m : M) (k : ℕ) :
    (dp R n m) ^ k = (Multiset.multinomial (k • {n})) * dp R (k * n) m
proof:
:= by
  rw [Multiset.multinomial_nsmul_singleton, ← Fin.prod_const, prod_dp]
  simp [Nat.multinomial]

name: lift'_imp
statement:
private theorem lift'_imp {f : ℕ × M → A} (hf_zero : ∀ m, f (0, m) = 1)
    (hf_smul : ∀ (n : ℕ) (r : R) (m : M), f ⟨n, r • m⟩ = r ^ n • f ⟨n, m⟩)
    (hf_mul : ∀ n p m, f ⟨n, m⟩ * f ⟨p, m⟩ = (n + p).choose n • f ⟨n + p, m⟩)
    (hf_add : ∀ n u v, f ⟨n, u + v⟩ = (antidiagonal n).sum fun (k, l) ↦ f ⟨k, u⟩ * f ⟨l, v⟩)
    (p q : MvPolynomial (ℕ × M) R) (h : (Rel R M) p q) :
    aeval f p = aeval f q
proof:
:= by
  rcases h <;>
  simp_all

name: lift'_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift'_apply {f : ℕ × M → A} (hf_zero : ∀ m, f (0, m) = 1)
    (hf_smul : ∀ (n : ℕ) (r : R) (m : M), f ⟨n, r • m⟩ = r ^ n • f ⟨n, m⟩)
    (hf_mul : ∀ n p m, f ⟨n, m⟩ * f ⟨p, m⟩ = (n + p).choose n • f ⟨n + p, m⟩)
    (hf_add : ∀ n u v, f ⟨n, u + v⟩ = (antidiagonal n).sum fun (k, l) ↦ f ⟨k, u⟩ * f ⟨l, v⟩)
    (p : MvPolynomial (ℕ × M) R) :
    lift' hf_zero hf_smul hf_mul hf_add ↑p = aeval f p
proof:
:= by
  simp [lift', aeval_eq_eval₂Hom]

name: lift'_apply_dp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift'_apply_dp {f : ℕ × M → A} (hf_zero : ∀ m, f (0, m) = 1)
    (hf_smul : ∀ (n : ℕ) (r : R) (m : M), f ⟨n, r • m⟩ = r ^ n • f ⟨n, m⟩)
    (hf_mul : ∀ n p m, f ⟨n, m⟩ * f ⟨p, m⟩ = (n + p).choose n • f ⟨n + p, m⟩)
    (hf_add : ∀ n u v, f ⟨n, u + v⟩ = (antidiagonal n).sum fun (k, l) ↦ f ⟨k, u⟩ * f ⟨l, v⟩)
    (n : ℕ) (m : M) :
    lift' hf_zero hf_smul hf_mul hf_add (dp R n m) = f ⟨n, m⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [dp_def, lift'_apply hf_zero hf_smul hf_mul hf_add, aeval_X]

name: lift_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_apply (p : MvPolynomial (ℕ × M) R) :
    lift hI g hg ↑p = aeval (fun nm : ℕ × M ↦ hI.dpow nm.1 (g nm.2)) p
proof:
:= by
  rw [lift, lift'_apply]

name: lift_apply_dp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_apply_dp (n : ℕ) (m : M) :
    lift hI g hg (dp R n m) = hI.dpow n (g m)
proof: := by rw [lift, lift'_apply_dp]

name: lift_unique
statement:
theorem lift_unique {f : DividedPowerAlgebra R M →ₐ[R] A}
    (hf : ∀ n m, f (dp R n m) = hI.dpow n (g m)) : f = lift hI g hg
proof:
:=
  algHom_ext (fun _ _ ↦ by rw [lift_apply_dp, hf])

name: lift_embed_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_embed_apply (m : M) : lift hI g hg (embed R M m) = g m
proof:
:= by
  simp [embed_def, hI.dpow_one (hg m)]

name: embed_comp_lift
statement:
@[simp]
theorem embed_comp_lift : (lift hI g hg).toLinearMap.comp (embed R M) = g
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp

name: dp_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma dp_zero {a : M} : dp S 0 (f a) = 1
proof: := DividedPowerAlgebra.dp_zero

name: dp_mul
statement:
lemma dp_mul {m n : ℕ} {a : M} :
    dp S m (f a) * dp S n (f a) = (Nat.choose (m + n) m) • dp S (m + n) (f a)
proof:
:=
  DividedPowerAlgebra.dp_mul

name: dp_add
statement:
lemma dp_add {n : ℕ} {a b : M} :
    dp S n (f (a + b)) = (Finset.antidiagonal n).sum fun k ↦ dp S k.1 (f a) * dp S k.2 (f b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_add, DividedPowerAlgebra.dp_add]

name: LinearMap.dp_smul
statement: lemma LinearMap.dp_smul {n : ℕ} {r : R} {a : M} : dp S n (f (r • a)) = r ^ n • dp S n (f a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [f.map_smul, algebra_compatible_smul S r (f a),
    DividedPowerAlgebra.dp_smul, ← map_pow, algebraMap_smul]

name: map_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_apply {p : MvPolynomial (ℕ × M) R} :
    map S f ↑p = aeval (fun nm ↦ dp S nm.fst (f nm.snd)) p
proof:
:= by
  rw [map, lift'_apply]

name: map_apply_dp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_apply_dp {n : ℕ} {a : M} : map S f (dp R n a) = dp S n (f a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map, lift'_apply_dp]

name: map_embed_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_embed_apply {m : M} : map S f (embed R M m) = embed S N (f m)
proof:
:= by
  simp [embed_def, map_apply_dp]

name: lift_comp_embed
statement:
theorem lift_comp_embed :
    (map S f).toLinearMap.comp (embed R M) = ((embed S N).restrictScalars R).comp f
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp

name: lift_surjective
statement:
theorem lift_surjective {f : M →ₗ[R] N} (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    Function.Surjective (map R f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← AlgHom.range_eq_top, ← Algebra.map_top (map R f), eq_top_iff,
    ← (AlgHom.range_eq_top (RingCon.mkₐ R (ringCon R N))).mpr mkAlgHom_surjective,
    ← Algebra.map_top, (Subalgebra.gc_map_comap _).le_iff_le, ← MvPolynomial.adjoin_range_X,
    Algebra.adjoin_le_iff]
  intro
  simp only [Set.mem_range, Prod.exists]
  rintro ⟨n, m, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ := hf m
  simp only [Algebra.map_top, Subalgebra.coe_comap, AlgHom.coe_range, Set.mem_preimage,
    Set.mem_range, RingCon.mkₐ_apply]
  use dp R n l
  rw [map_apply_dp, dp]

name: map_comp
statement:
lemma map_comp (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (g : N →ₗ[R] P) :
    map R (g.comp f) = (map R g).comp (map R f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [algHom_ext_iff]
  intros; simp [map_apply_dp]

name: map_id
statement:
@[simp]
lemma map_id : map R (LinearMap.id (R := R) (M := M)) = AlgHom.id R _
proof:
:= by
  rw [algHom_ext_iff]
  intros
  simp [map_apply_dp]

name: mapEquiv_symm
statement: theorem mapEquiv_symm (g : M ≃ₗ[R] N) : (mapEquiv g).symm = mapEquiv g.symm
proof: := rfl

name: LinearEquiv.coe_lift
statement: theorem LinearEquiv.coe_lift (g : M ≃ₗ[R] N) : mapEquiv g = map R g.toLinearMap
proof: := rfl

name: LinearEquiv.coe_lift_symm
statement:
theorem LinearEquiv.coe_lift_symm (g : M ≃ₗ[R] N) :
    (mapEquiv g).symm = map R g.symm.toLinearMap
proof: := rfl

name: mapEquiv_refl
statement: theorem mapEquiv_refl : mapEquiv (LinearEquiv.refl R M) = AlgEquiv.refl
proof:
:=
  AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom_injective map_id

name: mapEquiv_trans
statement:
theorem mapEquiv_trans (g : M ≃ₗ[R] N) (h : N ≃ₗ[R] P) :
    (mapEquiv g).trans (mapEquiv h) = mapEquiv (g.trans h)
proof:
:=
  AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom_injective (map_comp _ _).symm

name: Algebra.traceForm_toMatrix_powerBasis
statement:
theorem Algebra.traceForm_toMatrix_powerBasis (h : PowerBasis R S) :
    (traceForm R S).toMatrix h.basis = of fun i j => trace R S (h.gen ^ (i.1 + j.1))
proof:
:= by
  ext; rw [traceForm_toMatrix, of_apply, pow_add, h.basis_eq_pow, h.basis_eq_pow]

name: PowerBasis.trace_gen_eq_nextCoeff_minpoly
statement:
theorem PowerBasis.trace_gen_eq_nextCoeff_minpoly [Nontrivial S] (pb : PowerBasis K S) :
    Algebra.trace K S pb.gen = -(minpoly K pb.gen).nextCoeff
proof:
:= by
  have d_pos : 0 < pb.dim := PowerBasis.dim_pos pb
  have d_pos' : 0 < (minpoly K pb.gen).natDegree := by simpa
  have : Nonempty (Fin pb.dim) := ⟨⟨0, d_pos⟩⟩
  rw [trace_eq_matrix_trace pb.basis, trace_eq_neg_charpoly_coeff, charpoly_leftMulMatrix, ←
    pb.natDegree_minpoly, Fintype.card_fin, ← nextCoeff_of_natDegree_pos d_pos']

name: PowerBasis.trace_gen_eq_sum_roots
statement:
theorem PowerBasis.trace_gen_eq_sum_roots [Nontrivial S] (pb : PowerBasis K S)
    (hf : ((minpoly K pb.gen).map (algebraMap K F)).Splits) :
    algebraMap K F (trace K S pb.gen) = ((minpoly K pb.gen).aroots F).sum
proof:
:= by
  rw [PowerBasis.trace_gen_eq_nextCoeff_minpoly, map_neg,
    ← nextCoeff_map_eq, hf.nextCoeff_eq_neg_sum_roots_of_monic
      ((minpoly.monic (PowerBasis.isIntegral_gen _)).map _),
    neg_neg]

name: trace_gen_eq_zero
statement:
theorem trace_gen_eq_zero {x : L} (hx : ¬IsIntegral K x) :
    Algebra.trace K K⟮x⟯ (AdjoinSimple.gen K x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [trace_eq_zero_of_not_exists_basis, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  contrapose hx
  obtain ⟨s, ⟨b⟩⟩ := hx
  refine .of_mem_of_fg K⟮x⟯.toSubalgebra ?_ x ?_
  · exact (Submodule.fg_iff_finiteDimensional _).mpr (b.finiteDimensional_of_finite)
  · exact subset_adjoin K _ (Set.mem_singleton x)

name: trace_gen_eq_sum_roots
statement:
theorem trace_gen_eq_sum_roots (x : L) (hf : ((minpoly K x).map (algebraMap K F)).Splits) :
    algebraMap K F (trace K K⟮x⟯ (AdjoinSimple.gen K x)) =
      ((minpoly K x).aroots F).sum
proof:
:= by
  have injKxL := (algebraMap K⟮x⟯ L).injective
  by_cases hx : IsIntegral K x; swap
  · simp [minpoly.eq_zero hx, trace_gen_eq_zero hx, aroots_def]
  rw [← adjoin.powerBasis_gen hx, (adjoin.powerBasis hx).trace_gen_eq_sum_roots] <;>
    rw [adjoin.powerBasis_gen hx, ← minpoly.algebraMap_eq injKxL] <;>
    try simp only [AdjoinSimple.algebraMap_gen _ _]
  exact hf

name: trace_eq_trace_adjoin
statement:
theorem trace_eq_trace_adjoin [FiniteDimensional K L] (x : L) :
    trace K L x = finrank K⟮x⟯ L • trace K K⟮x⟯ (AdjoinSimple.gen K x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← trace_trace (S := K⟮x⟯)]
  conv in x => rw [← AdjoinSimple.algebraMap_gen K x]
  rw [trace_algebraMap, LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower]

name: trace_adjoinSimpleGen
statement:
theorem trace_adjoinSimpleGen {x : L} (hx : IsIntegral K x) :
    trace K K⟮x⟯ (AdjoinSimple.gen K x) = -(minpoly K x).nextCoeff
proof:
:= by
  simpa [minpoly_gen K x] using PowerBasis.trace_gen_eq_nextCoeff_minpoly <| adjoin.powerBasis hx

name: trace_eq_finrank_mul_minpoly_nextCoeff
statement:
theorem trace_eq_finrank_mul_minpoly_nextCoeff [FiniteDimensional K L] (x : L) :
    trace K L x = finrank K⟮x⟯ L * -(minpoly K x).nextCoeff
proof:
:= by
  rw [trace_eq_trace_adjoin, trace_adjoinSimpleGen (.of_finite K x), Algebra.smul_def]; rfl

name: trace_eq_sum_roots
statement:
theorem trace_eq_sum_roots [FiniteDimensional K L] {x : L}
    (hF : ((minpoly K x).map (algebraMap K F)).Splits) :
    algebraMap K F (Algebra.trace K L x) =
      finrank K⟮x⟯ L • ((minpoly K x).aroots F).sum
proof:
:= by
  rw [trace_eq_trace_adjoin K x, Algebra.smul_def, map_mul, ← Algebra.smul_def,
    IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.trace_gen_eq_sum_roots _ hF, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul]

name: Algebra.isIntegral_trace
statement:
theorem Algebra.isIntegral_trace [FiniteDimensional L F] {x : F} (hx : IsIntegral R x) :
    IsIntegral R (Algebra.trace L F x)
proof:
:= by
  have hx' : IsIntegral L x := hx.tower_top
  rw [← isIntegral_algebraMap_iff (B := AlgebraicClosure F), trace_eq_sum_roots]
  · refine (IsIntegral.multiset_sum ?_).nsmul _
    intro y hy
    rw [mem_roots_map (minpoly.ne_zero hx')] at hy
    use minpoly R x, minpoly.monic hx
    rw [← aeval_def] at hy ⊢
    exact minpoly.aeval_of_isScalarTower R x y hy
  · apply IsAlgClosed.splits

name: Algebra.trace_eq_of_algEquiv
statement:
lemma Algebra.trace_eq_of_algEquiv {A B C : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
    [Algebra A B] [Algebra A C] (e : B ≃ₐ[A] C) (x) :
    Algebra.trace A C (e x) = Algebra.trace A B x
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Algebra.trace_apply, ← LinearMap.trace_conj' _ e.toLinearEquiv]
  congr; ext; simp

name: Algebra.trace_eq_of_ringEquiv
statement:
lemma Algebra.trace_eq_of_ringEquiv {A B C : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
    [Algebra A C] [Algebra B C] (e : A ≃+* B) (he : (algebraMap B C).comp e = algebraMap A C) (x) :
    e (Algebra.trace A C x) = Algebra.trace B C x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases h : ∃ s : Finset C, Nonempty (Basis s B C)
  · obtain ⟨s, ⟨b⟩⟩ := h
    let : Algebra A B := RingHom.toAlgebra e
    let : IsScalarTower A B C := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' he.symm
    rw [Algebra.trace_eq_matrix_trace b,
      Algebra.trace_eq_matrix_trace (b.mapCoeffs e.symm (by simp [Algebra.smul_def, ← he]))]
    rw [AddMonoidHom.map_trace]
    congr
    ext i j
    simp [leftMulMatrix_apply, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply]
  rw [trace_eq_zero_of_not_exists_basis _ h, trace_eq_zero_of_not_exists_basis,
    LinearMap.zero_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply, map_zero]
  intro ⟨s, ⟨b⟩⟩
  exact h ⟨s, ⟨b.mapCoeffs e (by simp [Algebra.smul_def, ← he])⟩⟩

name: Algebra.trace_eq_of_equiv_equiv
statement:
lemma Algebra.trace_eq_of_equiv_equiv {A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ : Type*} [CommRing A₁] [CommRing B₁]
    [CommRing A₂] [CommRing B₂] [Algebra A₁ B₁] [Algebra A₂ B₂] (e₁ : A₁ ≃+* A₂) (e₂ : B₁ ≃+* B₂)
    (he : RingHom.comp (algebraMap A₂ B₂) ↑e₁ = RingHom.comp ↑e₂ (algebraMap A₁ B₁)) (x) :
    Algebra.trace A₁ B₁ x = e₁.symm (Algebra.trace A₂ B₂ (e₂ x))
proof:
:= by
  let := (RingHom.comp (e₂ : B₁ →+* B₂) (algebraMap A₁ B₁)).toAlgebra
  let e' : B₁ ≃ₐ[A₁] B₂ := { e₂ with commutes' := fun _ ↦ rfl }
  rw [← Algebra.trace_eq_of_ringEquiv e₁ he, ← Algebra.trace_eq_of_algEquiv e',
    RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rfl

name: trace_eq_sum_embeddings_gen
statement:
theorem trace_eq_sum_embeddings_gen (pb : PowerBasis K L)
    (hE : ((minpoly K pb.gen).map (algebraMap K E)).Splits) (hfx : IsSeparable K pb.gen) :
    algebraMap K E (Algebra.trace K L pb.gen) =
      (@Finset.univ _ (PowerBasis.AlgHom.fintype pb)).sum fun σ => σ pb.gen
proof:
:= by
  let := Classical.decEq E
  let : Fintype (L →ₐ[K] E) := PowerBasis.AlgHom.fintype pb
  rw [pb.trace_gen_eq_sum_roots hE, Fintype.sum_equiv pb.liftEquiv', Finset.sum_mem_multiset,
    Finset.sum_eq_multiset_sum, Multiset.toFinset_val, Multiset.dedup_eq_self.mpr _,
    Multiset.map_id]
  · exact nodup_roots ((separable_map _).mpr hfx)
  swap
  · intro x; rfl
  · intro σ
    rw [PowerBasis.liftEquiv'_apply_coe, id_def]

name: sum_embeddings_eq_finrank_mul
statement:
theorem sum_embeddings_eq_finrank_mul [FiniteDimensional K F] [Algebra.IsSeparable K F]
    (pb : PowerBasis K L) :
    ∑ σ : F →ₐ[K] E, σ (algebraMap L F pb.gen) =
      finrank L F •
        (@Finset.univ _ (PowerBasis.AlgHom.fintype pb)).sum fun σ : L →ₐ[K] E => σ pb.gen
proof:
:= by
  have : FiniteDimensional L F := FiniteDimensional.right K L F
  have : Algebra.IsSeparable L F := Algebra.isSeparable_tower_top_of_isSeparable K L F
  let : Fintype (L →ₐ[K] E) := PowerBasis.AlgHom.fintype pb
  rw [Fintype.sum_equiv algHomEquivSigma (fun σ : F →ₐ[K] E => _) fun σ => σ.1 pb.gen,
    ← Finset.univ_sigma_univ, Finset.sum_sigma, ← Finset.sum_nsmul]
  · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun σ _ => ?_
    let : Algebra L E := σ.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    simp_rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, ← AlgHom.card L F E]
  · intro σ
    simp only [algHomEquivSigma, Equiv.coe_fn_mk, AlgHom.domRestrict, AlgHom.comp_apply,
      IsScalarTower.coe_toAlgHom']

name: trace_eq_sum_embeddings
statement:
theorem trace_eq_sum_embeddings [FiniteDimensional K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L] {x : L} :
    algebraMap K E (Algebra.trace K L x) = ∑ σ : L →ₐ[K] E, σ x
proof:
:= by
  have hx := Algebra.IsSeparable.isIntegral K x
  let pb := adjoin.powerBasis hx
  rw [trace_eq_trace_adjoin K x, Algebra.smul_def, map_mul, ← adjoin.powerBasis_gen hx,
    trace_eq_sum_embeddings_gen E pb (IsAlgClosed.splits _), ← Algebra.smul_def,
    algebraMap_smul]
  · exact (sum_embeddings_eq_finrank_mul L E pb).symm
  · have := Algebra.isSeparable_tower_bot_of_isSeparable K K⟮x⟯ L
    exact Algebra.IsSeparable.isSeparable K _

name: trace_eq_sum_automorphisms
statement:
theorem trace_eq_sum_automorphisms (x : L) [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L] :
    algebraMap K L (Algebra.trace K L x) = ∑ σ : Gal(L/K), σ x
proof:
:= by
  apply FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective L (AlgebraicClosure L)
  rw [_root_.map_sum (algebraMap L (AlgebraicClosure L))]
  rw [← Fintype.sum_equiv (Normal.algHomEquivAut K (AlgebraicClosure L) L)]
  · rw [← trace_eq_sum_embeddings (AlgebraicClosure L) (x := x)]
    simp only [algebraMap_eq_smul_one, smul_one_smul]
  · intro σ
    simp only [Normal.algHomEquivAut, AlgHom.restrictNormal', Equiv.coe_fn_mk,
      AlgEquiv.coe_ofBijective, AlgHom.restrictNormal_commutes, algebraMap_self, RingHom.id_apply]

name: Algebra.trace_eq_zero_of_not_isSeparable
statement:
lemma Algebra.trace_eq_zero_of_not_isSeparable (H : ¬ Algebra.IsSeparable K L) :
    trace K L = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := ExpChar.exists K
  have := expChar_ne_zero K p
  ext x
  by_cases h₀ : FiniteDimensional K L; swap
  · rw [trace_eq_zero_of_not_exists_basis]
    rintro ⟨s, ⟨b⟩⟩
    exact h₀ (Module.Finite.of_basis b)
  by_cases hx : IsSeparable K x
  · lift x to separableClosure K L using hx
    rw [← IntermediateField.algebraMap_apply, ← trace_trace (S := separableClosure K L),
      trace_algebraMap]
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := IsPurelyInseparable.finrank_eq_pow (separableClosure K L) L p
    cases n with
    | zero =>
      rw [pow_zero, IntermediateField.finrank_eq_one_iff_eq_top, separableClosure.eq_top_iff] at hn
      cases H hn
    | succ n =>
      cases hp with
      | zero =>
        rw [one_pow, IntermediateField.finrank_eq_one_iff_eq_top, separableClosure.eq_top_iff] at hn
        cases H hn
      | prime hprime =>
        rw [hn, pow_succ', mul_smul, LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower, nsmul_eq_mul,
          CharP.cast_eq_zero, zero_mul, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  · rw [trace_eq_finrank_mul_minpoly_nextCoeff]
    obtain ⟨g, hg₁, m, hg₂⟩ :=
      (minpoly.irreducible (IsIntegral.isIntegral (R := K) x)).hasSeparableContraction p
    cases m with
    | zero =>
      obtain rfl : g = minpoly K x := by simpa using hg₂
      cases hx hg₁
    | succ n =>
      rw [nextCoeff, ite_eq_right, ← hg₂, coeff_expand (by positivity),
        ite_eq_right, neg_zero, mul_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
      · rw [natDegree_expand]
        intro h
        have := Nat.dvd_sub (dvd_mul_left (p ^ (n + 1)) g.natDegree) h
        rw [tsub_tsub_cancel_of_le, Nat.dvd_one] at this
        · obtain rfl : g = minpoly K x := by simpa [this] using hg₂
          cases hx hg₁
        · rw [Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero]
          have : g.natDegree ≠ 0 := fun e ↦ by
            have := congr(natDegree $hg₂)
            rw [natDegree_expand, e, zero_mul] at this
            exact (minpoly.natDegree_pos (IsIntegral.isIntegral x)).ne this
          positivity
      · exact (minpoly.natDegree_pos (IsIntegral.isIntegral x)).ne'

name: traceMatrix_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem traceMatrix_apply (b : κ → B) (i j) : traceMatrix A b i j = traceForm A B (b i) (b j)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: traceMatrix_reindex
statement:
theorem traceMatrix_reindex {κ' : Type*} (b : Basis κ A B) (f : κ ≃ κ') :
    traceMatrix A (b.reindex f) = reindex f f (traceMatrix A b)
proof: := by ext (x y); simp

name: traceMatrix_of_matrix_vecMul
statement:
theorem traceMatrix_of_matrix_vecMul [Fintype κ] (b : κ → B) (P : Matrix κ κ A) :
    traceMatrix A (b ᵥ* P.map (algebraMap A B)) = Pᵀ * traceMatrix A b * P
proof:
:= by
  ext (α β)
  rw [traceMatrix_apply, vecMul, dotProduct, vecMul, dotProduct, Matrix.mul_apply,
    BilinForm.sum_left,
    Fintype.sum_congr _ _ fun i : κ =>
      BilinForm.sum_right _ _ (b i * P.map (algebraMap A B) i α) fun y : κ =>
        b y * P.map (algebraMap A B) y β,
    sum_comm]
  congr; ext x
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply, sum_mul]
  congr; ext y
  rw [map_apply, traceForm_apply, mul_comm (b y), ← smul_def]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul, RingHom.id_apply, map_apply, transpose_apply, map_smulₛₗ,
    Algebra.smul_mul_assoc]
  rw [mul_comm (b x), ← smul_def]
  ring_nf
  rw [mul_assoc]
  simp [mul_comm]

name: traceMatrix_of_matrix_mulVec
statement:
theorem traceMatrix_of_matrix_mulVec [Fintype κ] (b : κ → B) (P : Matrix κ κ A) :
    traceMatrix A (P.map (algebraMap A B) *ᵥ b) = P * traceMatrix A b * Pᵀ
proof:
:= by
  refine AddEquiv.injective (transposeAddEquiv κ κ A) ?_
  rw [transposeAddEquiv_apply, transposeAddEquiv_apply, ← vecMul_transpose, ← transpose_map,
    traceMatrix_of_matrix_vecMul, transpose_transpose]

name: traceMatrix_of_basis
statement:
theorem traceMatrix_of_basis [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] (b : Basis κ A B) :
    traceMatrix A b = (traceForm A B).toMatrix b
proof:
:= by
  ext (i j)
  rw [traceMatrix_apply, traceForm_apply, traceForm_toMatrix]

name: traceMatrix_of_basis_mulVec
statement:
theorem traceMatrix_of_basis_mulVec [Fintype ι] (b : Basis ι A B) (z : B) :
    traceMatrix A b *ᵥ b.equivFun z = fun i => trace A B (z * b i)
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  rw [← replicateCol_apply (ι := Fin 1) (traceMatrix A b *ᵥ b.equivFun z) i 0, replicateCol_mulVec,
    Matrix.mul_apply, traceMatrix]
  simp only [replicateCol_apply, traceForm_apply]
  conv_lhs =>
    congr
    rfl
    ext
    rw [mul_comm _ (b.equivFun z _), ← smul_eq_mul, of_apply, ← map_smul]
  rw [← _root_.map_sum]
  congr
  conv_lhs =>
    congr
    rfl
    ext
    rw [← mul_smul_comm]
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, mul_comm z]
  congr
  rw [b.sum_equivFun]

name: embeddingsMatrix_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem embeddingsMatrix_apply (b : κ → B) (i) (σ : B →ₐ[A] C) :
    embeddingsMatrix A C b i σ = σ (b i)

name: embeddingsMatrixReindex_eq_vandermonde
statement:
theorem embeddingsMatrixReindex_eq_vandermonde (pb : PowerBasis A B)
    (e : Fin pb.dim ≃ (B →ₐ[A] C)) :
    embeddingsMatrixReindex A C pb.basis e = (vandermonde fun i => e i pb.gen)ᵀ
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp [embeddingsMatrixReindex, embeddingsMatrix]

name: traceMatrix_eq_embeddingsMatrix_mul_trans
statement:
theorem traceMatrix_eq_embeddingsMatrix_mul_trans : (traceMatrix K b).map (algebraMap K E) =
    embeddingsMatrix K E b * (embeddingsMatrix K E b)ᵀ
proof:
:= by
  ext (i j); simp [trace_eq_sum_embeddings, embeddingsMatrix, Matrix.mul_apply]

name: traceMatrix_eq_embeddingsMatrixReindex_mul_trans
statement:
theorem traceMatrix_eq_embeddingsMatrixReindex_mul_trans [Fintype κ] (e : κ ≃ (L →ₐ[K] E)) :
    (traceMatrix K b).map (algebraMap K E) =
      embeddingsMatrixReindex K E b e * (embeddingsMatrixReindex K E b e)ᵀ
proof:
:= by
  rw [traceMatrix_eq_embeddingsMatrix_mul_trans, embeddingsMatrixReindex, reindex_apply,
    transpose_submatrix, ← submatrix_mul_transpose_submatrix, ← Equiv.coe_refl, Equiv.refl_symm]

name: det_traceMatrix_ne_zero'
statement: theorem det_traceMatrix_ne_zero' [Algebra.IsSeparable K L] : det (traceMatrix K pb.basis) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  suffices algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure L) (det (traceMatrix K pb.basis)) ≠ 0 by
    refine mt (fun ht => ?_) this
    rw [ht, map_zero]
  have : FiniteDimensional K L := pb.finite
  let e : Fin pb.dim ≃ (L →ₐ[K] AlgebraicClosure L) := (Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq ?_).symm
  · rw [RingHom.map_det, RingHom.mapMatrix_apply,
      traceMatrix_eq_embeddingsMatrixReindex_mul_trans K _ _ e,
      embeddingsMatrixReindex_eq_vandermonde, det_mul, det_transpose]
    refine mt mul_self_eq_zero.mp ?_
    simp only [det_vandermonde, Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff, not_exists, sub_eq_zero]
    rintro i ⟨_, j, hij, h⟩
    exact (Finset.mem_Ioi.mp hij).ne' (e.injective <| pb.algHom_ext h)
  · rw [AlgHom.card, pb.finrank]

name: det_traceForm_ne_zero
statement:
theorem det_traceForm_ne_zero [Algebra.IsSeparable K L] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (b : Basis ι K L) :
    det ((traceForm K L).toMatrix b) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have : FiniteDimensional K L := b.finiteDimensional_of_finite
  let pb : PowerBasis K L := Field.powerBasisOfFiniteOfSeparable _ _
  rw [← LinearMap.BilinForm.toMatrix_mul_basis_toMatrix pb.basis b, ←
    det_comm' (pb.basis.toMatrix_mul_toMatrix_flip b) _, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, det_mul]
  swap; · apply Basis.toMatrix_mul_toMatrix_flip
  refine
    mul_ne_zero
      (IsUnit.of_mul_eq_one ((b.toMatrix pb.basis)ᵀ * b.toMatrix pb.basis).det ?_).ne_zero ?_
  · calc
      (pb.basis.toMatrix b * (pb.basis.toMatrix b)ᵀ).det *
            ((b.toMatrix pb.basis)ᵀ * b.toMatrix pb.basis).det =
          (pb.basis.toMatrix b * (b.toMatrix pb.basis * pb.basis.toMatrix b)ᵀ *
              b.toMatrix pb.basis).det := by
        simp only [← det_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.transpose_mul]
      _ = 1 := by
        simp only [Basis.toMatrix_mul_toMatrix_flip, Matrix.transpose_one, Matrix.mul_one,
          Matrix.det_one]
  simpa only [traceMatrix_of_basis] using det_traceMatrix_ne_zero' pb

name: traceForm_nondegenerate
statement:
@[stacks 0BIL "(1) => (3)"]
theorem traceForm_nondegenerate [FiniteDimensional K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L] :
    (traceForm K L).Nondegenerate
proof:
:=
  BilinForm.nondegenerate_of_det_ne_zero (traceForm K L) _
    (det_traceForm_ne_zero (Module.finBasis K L))

name: traceForm_nondegenerate_tfae
statement:
@[stacks 0BIL]
theorem traceForm_nondegenerate_tfae [FiniteDimensional K L] :
    [Algebra.IsSeparable K L, Algebra.trace K L ≠ 0, (traceForm K L).Nondegenerate].TFAE
proof:
:= by
  tfae_have 1 → 3 := fun _ ↦ traceForm_nondegenerate K L
  tfae_have 3 → 2 := fun H₁ H₂ ↦ H₁.ne_zero (by ext; simp [H₂])
  tfae_have 2 → 1 := not_imp_comm.mp Algebra.trace_eq_zero_of_not_isSeparable
  tfae_finish

name: Algebra.trace_ne_zero
statement:
theorem Algebra.trace_ne_zero [FiniteDimensional K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L] :
    Algebra.trace K L ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  ((traceForm_nondegenerate_tfae K L).out 1 2).mp ‹_›

name: Algebra.trace_surjective
statement:
theorem Algebra.trace_surjective [FiniteDimensional K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L] :
    Function.Surjective (Algebra.trace K L)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.range_eq_top]
  apply (IsSimpleOrder.eq_bot_or_eq_top (α := Ideal K) _).resolve_left
  rw [LinearMap.range_eq_bot]
  exact Algebra.trace_ne_zero K L

name: isNilpotent_trace_of_isNilpotent

lemma isNilpotent_trace_of_isNilpotent {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] {x : S}

name: Module.Basis.traceDual_def
statement:
theorem Module.Basis.traceDual_def :

statement:

theorem Module.Basis.trace_traceDual_mul (i j : ι) :

:=

:=

:=

statement:

name: Module.Basis.traceDual_inj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Module.Basis.traceDual_inj {b' : Basis ι K L} :
    b.traceDual = b'.traceDual ↔ b = b'
proof:
:=
  (traceDual_injective K L).eq_iff

name: Module.Basis.traceDual_eq_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Module.Basis.traceDual_eq_iff {v : ι → L} :
    b.traceDual = v ↔ ∀ i j, traceForm K L (v i) (b j) = if j = i then 1 else 0
proof:
:=
  (traceForm K L).dualBasis_eq_iff (traceForm_nondegenerate K L) b v

name: Module.Basis.traceDual_powerBasis_eq
statement:
lemma Module.Basis.traceDual_powerBasis_eq (pb : PowerBasis K L) (i) :
    pb.basis.traceDual i =
      (minpolyDiv K pb.gen).coeff i / aeval pb.gen (derivative <| minpoly K pb.gen)
proof:
:= by
  revert i
  rw [← funext_iff, Basis.traceDual_eq_iff]
  intro i j
  apply (algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure K)).injective
  have := congr_arg (coeff · i) (sum_smul_minpolyDiv_eq_X_pow (AlgebraicClosure K)
    pb.adjoin_gen_eq_top (r := j) (pb.finrank.symm ▸ j.prop))
  simp only [Polynomial.map_smul, map_div₀, map_pow, RingHom.coe_coe, finsetSum_coeff, coeff_smul,
    coeff_map, smul_eq_mul, coeff_X_pow, ← Fin.ext_iff, @eq_comm _ i] at this
  rw [PowerBasis.coe_basis]
  simp only [traceForm_apply, MonoidWithZeroHom.map_ite_one_zero]
  rw [← this, trace_eq_sum_embeddings (E := AlgebraicClosure K)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro σ _
  simp only [map_mul, map_div₀, map_pow]
  ring

name: Algebra.trace_quotient_mk
statement:
lemma Algebra.trace_quotient_mk [IsLocalRing R] (x : S) :
    Algebra.trace (R ⧸ p) (S ⧸ pS) (Ideal.Quotient.mk pS x) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk p (Algebra.trace R S x)
proof:
:= by
  let ι := Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex R S
  let b : Module.Basis ι R S := Module.Free.chooseBasis R S
  rw [trace_eq_matrix_trace b, trace_eq_matrix_trace (basisQuotient b), AddMonoidHom.map_trace]
  congr 1
  ext i j
  simp only [leftMulMatrix_apply, coe_lmul_eq_mul, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply,
    basisQuotient_apply, LinearMap.mul_apply', Matrix.map_apply, ← map_mul,
    basisQuotient_repr]

name: trace_quotient_eq_trace_localization_quotient
statement:
lemma trace_quotient_eq_trace_localization_quotient (x) :
    Algebra.trace (R ⧸ p) (S ⧸ pS) (Ideal.Quotient.mk pS x) =
      (equivQuotMaximalIdeal p Rₚ).symm
        (Algebra.trace (Rₚ ⧸ maximalIdeal Rₚ) (Sₚ ⧸ pSₚ) (algebraMap S _ x))
proof:
:= by
  have : IsScalarTower R (Rₚ ⧸ maximalIdeal Rₚ) (Sₚ ⧸ pSₚ) := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R Rₚ (Rₚ ⧸ _), IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R Rₚ (Sₚ ⧸ _),
      ← RingHom.comp_assoc, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq Rₚ]
  rw [Algebra.trace_eq_of_equiv_equiv (equivQuotMaximalIdeal p Rₚ)
    (equivQuotientMapMaximalIdeal S p Rₚ Sₚ)]
  · congr
  · ext x
    simp only [equivQuotMaximalIdeal, RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective,
      RingEquiv.coe_ringHom_trans, RingHom.coe_comp, RingHom.coe_coe, Function.comp_apply,
      Ideal.quotEquivOfEq_mk, RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfRightInverse.apply, RingHom.kerLift_mk,
      equivQuotientMapMaximalIdeal, Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_quotient_map_quotient]
    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply]

name: Algebra.trace_quotient_eq_of_isDedekindDomain
statement:
lemma Algebra.trace_quotient_eq_of_isDedekindDomain (x) [IsDedekindDomain R] [IsDomain S]
    [Module.IsTorsionFree R S] [Module.Finite R S] [IsIntegrallyClosed S] :
    Algebra.trace (R ⧸ p) (S ⧸ pS) (Ideal.Quotient.mk pS x) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk p (Algebra.intTrace R S x)
proof:
:= by
  let Rₚ := Localization.AtPrime p
  let Sₚ := Localization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid S p.primeCompl)
  have e : Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid S p.primeCompl ≤ S⁰ :=
    Submonoid.map_le_of_le_comap _ <| p.primeCompl_le_nonZeroDivisors.trans
      (nonZeroDivisors_le_comap_nonZeroDivisors_of_injective _
        (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective _ _))
  have : IsIntegrallyClosed Sₚ := isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization _ _ e
  apply (equivQuotMaximalIdeal p Rₚ).injective
  rw [trace_quotient_eq_trace_localization_quotient S p Rₚ Sₚ, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq S Sₚ,
    RingHom.comp_apply, Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq, Algebra.trace_quotient_mk,
    RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply, ← Algebra.intTrace_eq_trace,
    ← Algebra.intTrace_eq_of_isLocalization R S p.primeCompl (Aₘ := Rₚ) (Bₘ := Sₚ) x,
    ← Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply]
  simp

name: trace_apply
statement: theorem trace_apply (x) : trace R S x = LinearMap.trace R S (lmul R S x)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: trace_eq_zero_of_not_exists_basis
statement:
theorem trace_eq_zero_of_not_exists_basis (h : ¬∃ s : Finset S, Nonempty (Basis s R S)) :
    trace R S = 0
proof: := by ext s; simp [trace_apply, LinearMap.trace, h]

name: trace_eq_matrix_trace
statement:
theorem trace_eq_matrix_trace [DecidableEq ι] (b : Basis ι R S) (s : S) :
    trace R S s = Matrix.trace (Algebra.leftMulMatrix b s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [trace_apply, LinearMap.trace_eq_matrix_trace _ b, ← toMatrix_lmul_eq]; rfl

name: trace_algebraMap_of_basis
statement:
theorem trace_algebraMap_of_basis (b : Basis ι R S) (x : R) :
    trace R S (algebraMap R S x) = Fintype.card ι • x
proof:
:= by
  have := Classical.decEq ι
  rw [trace_apply, LinearMap.trace_eq_matrix_trace R b, Matrix.trace]
  convert! Finset.sum_const x
  simp [-coe_lmul_eq_mul]

name: trace_self
statement: @[simp] theorem trace_self : trace R R = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  ext; simpa using trace_algebraMap_of_basis (.singleton (Fin 1) R) 1

name: trace_self_apply
statement: theorem trace_self_apply (a) : trace R R a = a
proof: := by simp

name: trace_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem trace_algebraMap [StrongRankCondition R] [Module.Free R S] (x : R) :
    trace R S (algebraMap R S x) = finrank R S • x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases H : ∃ s : Finset S, Nonempty (Basis s R S)
  · rw [trace_algebraMap_of_basis H.choose_spec.some, finrank_eq_card_basis H.choose_spec.some]
  · simp [trace_eq_zero_of_not_exists_basis R H, finrank_eq_zero_of_not_exists_basis_finset H]

name: trace_trace_of_basis
statement:
theorem trace_trace_of_basis [Algebra S T] [IsScalarTower R S T] {ι κ : Type*} [Finite ι]
    [Finite κ] (b : Basis ι R S) (c : Basis κ S T) (x : T) :
    trace R S (trace S T x) = trace R T x
proof:
:= by
  have := Classical.decEq ι
  have := Classical.decEq κ
  cases nonempty_fintype ι
  cases nonempty_fintype κ
  rw [trace_eq_matrix_trace (b.smulTower c), trace_eq_matrix_trace b, trace_eq_matrix_trace c,
    Matrix.trace, Matrix.trace, Matrix.trace, ← Finset.univ_product_univ, Finset.sum_product]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
  simp only [map_sum, smulTower_leftMulMatrix, Finset.sum_apply, Matrix.diag,
    Finset.sum_apply i (Finset.univ : Finset κ) fun y => leftMulMatrix b (leftMulMatrix c x y y)]

name: trace_comp_trace_of_basis
statement:
theorem trace_comp_trace_of_basis [Algebra S T] [IsScalarTower R S T] {ι κ : Type*} [Finite ι]
    [Finite κ] (b : Basis ι R S) (c : Basis κ S T) :
    (trace R S).comp ((trace S T).restrictScalars R) = trace R T
proof:
:= by
  ext
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.restrictScalars_apply, trace_trace_of_basis b c]

name: trace_trace
statement:
@[simp]
theorem trace_trace [Algebra S T] [IsScalarTower R S T]
    [Module.Free R S] [Module.Finite R S] [Module.Free S T] [Module.Finite S T] (x : T) :
    trace R S (trace S T x) = trace R T x
proof:
:=
  trace_trace_of_basis (Module.Free.chooseBasis R S) (Module.Free.chooseBasis S T) x

name: trace_comp_trace
statement:
@[simp, stacks 0BIJ "Trace"]
theorem trace_comp_trace [Algebra S T] [IsScalarTower R S T]
    [Module.Free R S] [Module.Finite R S] [Module.Free S T] [Module.Finite S T] :
    (trace R S).comp ((trace S T).restrictScalars R) = trace R T
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext trace_trace

name: trace_prod_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem trace_prod_apply [Module.Free R S] [Module.Free R T] [Module.Finite R S] [Module.Finite R T]
    (x : S × T) : trace R (S × T) x = trace R S x.fst + trace R T x.snd
proof:
:= by
  let f := (lmul R S).toLinearMap.prodMap (lmul R T).toLinearMap
  have : (lmul R (S × T)).toLinearMap = (prodMapLinear R S T S T R).comp f :=
    LinearMap.ext₂ Prod.mul_def
  simp_rw [trace, this]
  exact trace_prodMap' _ _

name: Cotangent.span_eq_top_of_span_eq_ker

lemma Cotangent.span_eq_top_of_span_eq_ker {ι : Type*} (s : ι → P.Ring)

    Submodule.span S (.range (fun i ↦ mk ⟨s i, hs.le (Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)⟩)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.span, ← Submodule.span_range_subtype_eq_top_iff] at hs
  · apply Submodule.span_eq_top_of_span_eq_top (R := P.Ring)
    rw [← Function.comp_def, Set.range_comp, ← Submodule.map_span, hs, Submodule.map_top,
      LinearMap.range_eq_top_of_surjective _ mk_surjective]
  · simp [← hs, Ideal.mem_span_range_self]

name: Cotangent.map_surjective_of_comap_eq
proof:
:= fun x ↦ by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Cotangent.mk_surjective x
  obtain ⟨y, y_in, hy⟩ := Ideal.exists_of_comap_eq_ker_sup _ h eq x.prop
  exact ⟨Cotangent.mk ⟨y, y_in⟩, by simp [hy]⟩

name: Cotangent.map_ker_of_surjective
statement:
lemma Cotangent.map_ker_of_surjective {P P' : Extension R S} {f : P.Hom P'}
    (h : Function.Surjective f) (eq : P'.ker.comap f.toRingHom = RingHom.ker f.toRingHom ⊔ P.ker) :
    (Cotangent.map f).ker.restrictScalars P.Ring =
      (Submodule.comap P.ker.subtype (RingHom.ker f.toRingHom ⊓ P.ker)).map Cotangent.mk
proof:
:= by
  have eq_map := Ideal.eq_map_of_comap_eq_ker_sup _ h eq
  refine le_antisymm (fun x hx ↦ ?_) (fun x hx ↦ ?_)
  · obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Cotangent.mk_surjective x
    simp only [Submodule.restrictScalars_mem, LinearMap.mem_ker, map_mk, Hom.toAlgHom_apply,
      mk_eq_zero_iff] at hx
    rw [eq_map, ← Ideal.map_pow, ← Ideal.mem_comap,
      Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective' f.toRingHom h, Submodule.mem_sup] at hx
    rcases hx with ⟨y, y_in, z, z_in, hyz⟩
    suffices ∃ a, a ∈ RingHom.ker f.toRingHom ∧ a ∈ P.ker ∧ a - x ∈ P.ker ^ 2 by
      simpa [mk_eq_mk_iff_sub_mem]
    refine ⟨z, z_in, ?_, by simpa [← hyz]⟩
    rw [← eq_sub_iff_add_eq'] at hyz
    exact hyz ▸ Ideal.sub_mem _ x.prop (Ideal.pow_le_self (show 2 ≠ 0 by lia) y_in)
  · obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Cotangent.mk_surjective x
    obtain ⟨y, y_in, y_in', hy⟩ : ∃ a ∈ RingHom.ker f.toRingHom, a ∈ P.ker ∧
      a - x ∈ P.ker ^ 2 := by simpa [mk_eq_mk_iff_sub_mem] using hx
    suffices f.toRingHom x ∈ P'.ker ^ 2 by simpa [mk_eq_zero_iff]
    rw [eq_map, ← Ideal.map_pow, ← Ideal.mem_comap,
      Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective' f.toRingHom h, Submodule.mem_sup]
    exact ⟨x - y, by rwa [← Submodule.neg_mem_iff, neg_sub], y, y_in, by ring⟩

name: cotangentComplex_comp_h1CotangentEquivCotangent
statement:
theorem cotangentComplex_comp_h1CotangentEquivCotangent (P : Extension.{w} R S) :
    P.cotangentComplex.comp P.h1CotangentEquivCotangent.toLinearMap =
      H1Cotangent.δ R P.Ring S
proof:
:= by
  rw [h1CotangentEquivCotangent, LinearEquiv.coe_trans, LinearEquiv.coe_trans,
    h1CotangentEquivOfSurjective_toLinearMap, ← LinearMap.comp_assoc, ← LinearMap.comp_assoc,
    LinearEquiv.comp_toLinearMap_symm_eq, LinearMap.comp_assoc,
    h1CotangentExtendScalarsEquiv_toLinearMap]
  ext ⟨x, _⟩
  obtain ⟨⟨x : P.Ring, x_in : x ∈ P.ker⟩, rfl⟩ := Cotangent.mk_surjective x
  trans 1 ⊗ₜ[P.Ring] D R P.Ring x; · exact cotangentComplex_mk P ⟨x, x_in⟩
  let u : (Generators.self P.Ring S).toExtension.ker :=
    ⟨algebraMap P.Ring (Generators.self P.Ring S).toExtension.Ring x, by
      rwa [← Ideal.mem_comap, RingHom.comap_ker, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq]⟩
  rw [← Generators.H1Cotangent.δ_C _ _ u.prop]
  congr

name: h1CotangentEquivCotangent_comp_map
statement:
theorem h1CotangentEquivCotangent_comp_map (P : Extension.{w} R S) :
    P.h1CotangentEquivCotangent.toLinearMap.comp (Algebra.H1Cotangent.map R P.Ring S S) =
      h1Cotangentι.comp (H1Cotangent.map P.defaultHom)
proof:
:= by
  rw [h1CotangentEquivCotangent, LinearEquiv.coe_trans, LinearEquiv.coe_trans,
    h1CotangentExtendScalarsEquiv_symm_toLinearMap, h1CotangentEquivOfSurjective_toLinearMap,
    LinearMap.comp_assoc, LinearMap.comp_assoc, Algebra.H1Cotangent.map,
    ← (H1Cotangent.map P.extendScalars.defaultHom).restrictScalars_self, ← H1Cotangent.map_comp,
    eq_comm, ← LinearEquiv.toLinearMap_symm_comp_eq, cotangentExtendScalarsEquiv_symm_toLinearMap,
    ← LinearMap.comp_assoc, Cotangent.map_comp_h1Cotangentι, LinearMap.restrictScalars_self,
    LinearMap.comp_assoc, ← (H1Cotangent.map P.toExtendScalars).restrictScalars_self,
    ← H1Cotangent.map_comp, H1Cotangent.map_eq]

name: H1Cotangent.map_defaultHom_surjective
statement:
theorem H1Cotangent.map_defaultHom_surjective (P : Extension.{w} R S) :
    Function.Surjective (H1Cotangent.map P.defaultHom)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.range_eq_top,
    ← (Submodule.map_injective_of_injective h1Cotangentι_injective).eq_iff,
    ← LinearMap.range_comp, ← P.h1CotangentEquivCotangent_comp_map, LinearMap.range_comp,
    ← (Algebra.H1Cotangent.exact_map_δ R P.Ring S).linearMap_ker_eq, Submodule.map_top,
    ← exact_hCotangentι_cotangentComplex.linearMap_ker_eq, Submodule.map_equiv_eq_comap_symm,
    LinearMap.ker, LinearMap.ker, ← Submodule.comap_comp]
  congr
  rw [LinearEquiv.comp_toLinearMap_symm_eq, P.cotangentComplex_comp_h1CotangentEquivCotangent]

name: Hom.toAlgHom_comp_apply

@[simp]
lemma Hom.toAlgHom_comp_apply
    [Algebra R R''] [IsScalarTower R R' R''] [IsScalarTower R' R'' S'']
    [IsScalarTower R' S' S''] [IsScalarTower S S' S'']
    (f : Hom P P') (g : Hom P' P'') (x) :
    (g.comp f).toAlgHom x = g.toAlgHom (f.toAlgHom x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C r => simp only [← MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq, AlgHom.map_algebraMap]
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]
  | mul_X p i hp => simp only [map_mul, hp, toAlgHom_X, comp_val]; rfl

name: ofComp_toAlgHom_monomial_sumElim
statement:
lemma ofComp_toAlgHom_monomial_sumElim (Q : Generators S T ι') (P : Generators R S ι) (v₁ v₂ a) :
    (Q.ofComp P).toAlgHom (monomial (Finsupp.sumElim v₁ v₂) a) =
      monomial v₁ (aeval P.val (monomial v₂ a))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Hom.toAlgHom_monomial, monomial_eq]
  simp only [ofComp_val, aeval_monomial]
  rw [Finsupp.prod_sumElim]
  simp only [Function.comp_def, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr, ← map_pow, ← map_finsuppProd,
    C_mul, Algebra.smul_def, MvPolynomial.algebraMap_apply, mul_assoc]
  nth_rw 2 [mul_comm]

name: toComp_toAlgHom_monomial
statement:
lemma toComp_toAlgHom_monomial (Q : Generators S T ι') (P : Generators R S ι) (j a) :
    (Q.toComp P).toAlgHom (monomial j a) =
      monomial (Finsupp.sumElim 0 j) a
proof:
:= by
  convert! rename_monomial _ _ _
  · ext f (i₁ | i₂)
    simp [rename_eq_aeval]
    rfl
  · ext f (i₁ | i₂) <;> simp [Finsupp.mapDomain_of_notMem_range, Sum.inr_injective]

name: toAlgHom_ofComp_rename
statement:
@[simp]
lemma toAlgHom_ofComp_rename (Q : Generators S T ι') (P : Generators R S ι) (p : P.Ring) :
    (Q.ofComp P).toAlgHom ((rename Sum.inr) p) = C (algebraMap _ _ p)
proof:
:=
  have : (Q.ofComp P).toAlgHom.comp (rename Sum.inr) =
    (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R S Q.Ring).comp (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R P.Ring S) := by ext; simp
  DFunLike.congr_fun this p

name: toAlgHom_ofComp_surjective
statement:
lemma toAlgHom_ofComp_surjective (Q : Generators S T ι') (P : Generators R S ι) :
    Function.Surjective (Q.ofComp P).toAlgHom
proof:
:= by
  intro p
  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C a =>
      use MvPolynomial.rename Sum.inr (P.σ a)
      simp only [Hom.toAlgHom, ofComp, Generators.comp, MvPolynomial.aeval_rename,
        Sum.elim_comp_inr]
      simp_rw [Function.comp_def, ← MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq, ← IsScalarTower.toAlgHom_apply R,
        ← MvPolynomial.comp_aeval]
      simp
  | add p q hp hq =>
      obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hp
      obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := hq
      use p + q
      simp
  | mul_X p i hp =>
      obtain ⟨(p : MvPolynomial (ι' ⊕ ι) R), rfl⟩ := hp
      use p * MvPolynomial.X (R := R) (Sum.inl i)
      simp [Algebra.Generators.ofComp, Algebra.Generators.Hom.toAlgHom]

name: Hom.toExtensionHom_id

@[simp]
lemma Hom.toExtensionHom_id : Hom.toExtensionHom (.id P) = .id _

name: Hom.toExtensionHom_comp

@[simp]
lemma Hom.toExtensionHom_comp [Algebra R S'] [IsScalarTower R S S']

    [IsScalarTower R S S'] (f : P.Hom P') (x) :
    f.toExtensionHom.toAlgHom x = f.toAlgHom x
proof: := rfl

name: ker_eq_ker_aeval_val
statement: lemma ker_eq_ker_aeval_val : P.ker = RingHom.ker (aeval P.val)
proof:

  rfl

name: ker_mvPolynomial
statement: lemma ker_mvPolynomial : (mvPolynomial R ι).ker = ⊥

name: aeval_val_eq_zero
statement: lemma aeval_val_eq_zero {x} (hx : x ∈ P.ker) : aeval P.val x = 0
proof: := by rwa [← algebraMap_apply]

name: ker_naive
proof:
:=
  I.mk_ker

name: ker_ofAlgHom
statement:
@[simp]
lemma ker_ofAlgHom {I : Type*} (f : MvPolynomial I R →ₐ[R] S) (h : Function.Surjective ⇑f) :
    (ofAlgHom f h).ker = RingHom.ker f.toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  change RingHom.ker _ = _
  congr
  exact MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext (by simp) (by simp [ofAlgHom])

name: ker_ofAlgEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
lemma ker_ofAlgEquiv (P : Generators R S ι) {T : Type*} [CommRing T] [Algebra R T] (e : S ≃ₐ[R] T) :
    (P.ofAlgEquiv e).ker = P.ker
proof:
:= by
  rw [ker_eq_ker_aeval_val, ofAlgEquiv_val, Function.comp_def, ← AlgHom.coe_ofClass,
    ← MvPolynomial.comp_aeval, ← AlgHom.comap_ker, ← RingHom.ker_coe_toRingHom,
    AlgHomClass.toRingHom_ofClass, AlgHom.ker_coe_equiv, ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot,
    ← ker_eq_ker_aeval_val]

name: map_toComp_ker
statement:
lemma map_toComp_ker (Q : Generators S T ι') (P : Generators R S ι) :
    P.ker.map (Q.toComp P).toAlgHom = RingHom.ker (Q.ofComp P).toAlgHom
proof:
:= by
  let : DecidableEq (ι' →₀ ℕ) := Classical.decEq _
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    rintro x (hx : algebraMap P.Ring S x = 0)
    have : (Q.ofComp P).toAlgHom.comp (Q.toComp P).toAlgHom = IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R _ _ := by
      ext1; simp
    simp only [Ideal.mem_comap,
      RingHom.mem_ker, ← AlgHom.comp_apply, this, IsScalarTower.toAlgHom_apply]
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply P.Ring S, hx, map_zero]
  · rintro x (h₂ : (Q.ofComp P).toAlgHom x = 0)
    let e : (ι' ⊕ ι →₀ ℕ) ≃+ (ι' →₀ ℕ) × (ι →₀ ℕ) :=
      Finsupp.sumFinsuppAddEquivProdFinsupp
    suffices ∑ v ∈ (support x).map e, (monomial (e.symm v)) (x.coeff (e.symm v)) ∈
        Ideal.map (Q.toComp P).toAlgHom.toRingHom P.ker by
      simpa only [AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, Finset.sum_map, Equiv.coe_toEmbedding,
        EquivLike.coe_coe, AddEquiv.symm_apply_apply, support_sum_monomial_coeff] using! this
    rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (fun i ↦ Finset.mem_image_of_mem Prod.fst)]
    refine sum_mem fun i hi ↦ ?_
    convert_to monomial (e.symm (i, 0)) 1 * (Q.toComp P).toAlgHom.toRingHom
      (∑ j ∈ (support x).map e.toEmbedding with j.1 = i, monomial j.2 (x.coeff (e.symm j))) ∈ _
    · rw [map_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj ↦ ?_
      obtain rfl := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2
      obtain ⟨i, j⟩ := j
      clear hj hi
      have : (Q.toComp P).toAlgHom (monomial j (x.coeff (e.symm (i, j)))) =
          monomial (e.symm (0, j)) (x.coeff (e.symm (i, j))) :=
        toComp_toAlgHom_monomial ..
      simp only [AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe,
          this]
      rw [monomial_mul_monomial, ← map_add, Prod.mk_add_mk, add_zero, zero_add, one_mul]
    · apply Ideal.mul_mem_left
      refine Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ ?_
      simp only [ker_eq_ker_aeval_val, AddEquiv.toEquiv_eq_coe, RingHom.mem_ker, map_sum]
      rw [show (0 : S) = ((Q.ofComp P).toAlgHom x).coeff i by rw [h₂]; simp]
      clear h₂ hi
      have (x : (Q.comp P).Ring) : (Function.support fun a ↦ if a.1 = i then aeval P.val
          (monomial a.2 (x.coeff (e.symm a))) else 0) ⊆ SetLike.coe ((support x).map e) := by
        rw [← Set.compl_subset_compl]
        intro j
        obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := e.surjective j
        simp_all
      rw [Finset.sum_filter, ← finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ (this x)]
      induction x using MvPolynomial.induction_on' with
      | monomial v a =>
        rw [finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ (this _), ← Finset.sum_filter]
        obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := e.symm.surjective v
        
        conv_rhs => simp only [e, Finsupp.sumFinsuppAddEquivProdFinsupp,
          Finsupp.sumFinsuppEquivProdFinsupp, AddEquiv.symm_mk, AddEquiv.coe_mk,
          Equiv.coe_fn_symm_mk, ofComp_toAlgHom_monomial_sumElim]
        classical
        simp only [coeff_monomial, ← e.injective.eq_iff,
          map_zero, AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply, apply_ite]
        rw [← apply_ite, Finset.sum_ite_eq]
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_map_equiv, AddEquiv.coe_toEquiv_symm,
          mem_support_iff, coeff_monomial, ↓reduceIte, ne_eq, ite_and, ite_not]
        split
        · simp only [*, map_zero, ite_self]
        · congr
      | add p q hp hq =>
        simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, Finsupp.add_apply, map_add, ite_add_zero]
        rw [finsum_add_distrib, hp, hq]
        · refine (((support p).map e).finite_toSet.subset ?_)
          convert! this p
        · refine (((support q).map e).finite_toSet.subset ?_)
          convert! this q

name: ofComp_kerCompPreimage
statement:
lemma ofComp_kerCompPreimage (Q : Generators S T ι') (P : Generators R S ι) (x : Q.ker) :
    (Q.ofComp P).toAlgHom (kerCompPreimage Q P x) = x
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← x.1.support_sum_monomial_coeff]
  rw [kerCompPreimage, map_finsuppSum, Finsupp.sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
  simp only [map_mul, Hom.toAlgHom_monomial]
  rw [one_smul, Finsupp.prod_mapDomain_index_inj Sum.inl_injective]
  rw [rename_eq_aeval, ← AlgHom.comp_apply, comp_aeval]
  simp only [ofComp_val, Sum.elim_inr, Function.comp_apply,
    Sum.elim_inl, monomial_eq, Hom.toAlgHom_X]
  congr 1
  rw [aeval_def, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R S, ← MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq,
    ← coe_eval₂Hom, ← map_aeval, P.aeval_val_σ]

name: map_ofComp_ker
statement:
lemma map_ofComp_ker (Q : Generators S T ι') (P : Generators R S ι) :
    Ideal.map (Q.ofComp P).toAlgHom (Q.comp P).ker = Q.ker
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [Ideal.mem_map_iff_of_surjective _ (toAlgHom_ofComp_surjective Q P)]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    simp only [ker_eq_ker_aeval_val,
      RingHom.mem_ker] at hx ⊢
    rw [← hx, Hom.algebraMap_toAlgHom, algebraMap_self_apply]
  · intro hx
    exact ⟨_, (kerCompPreimage Q P ⟨x, hx⟩).2, ofComp_kerCompPreimage Q P ⟨x, hx⟩⟩

name: ker_comp_eq_sup
statement:
lemma ker_comp_eq_sup (Q : Generators S T ι') (P : Generators R S ι) :
    (Q.comp P).ker =
      Ideal.map (Q.toComp P).toAlgHom P.ker ⊔ Ideal.comap (Q.ofComp P).toAlgHom Q.ker
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_ofComp_ker Q P,
    Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective _ (toAlgHom_ofComp_surjective Q P)]
  rw [← sup_assoc, Algebra.Generators.map_toComp_ker, ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot]
  apply le_antisymm (le_trans le_sup_right le_sup_left)
  simp only [le_sup_left, sup_of_le_left, sup_le_iff, le_refl, and_true]
  intro x hx
  simp only [RingHom.mem_ker] at hx
  rw [Generators.ker_eq_ker_aeval_val, RingHom.mem_ker,
    ← algebraMap_self_apply (MvPolynomial.aeval _ x)]
  rw [← Generators.Hom.algebraMap_toAlgHom (Q.ofComp P), hx, map_zero]

name: toAlgHom_ofComp_localizationAway
statement:
lemma toAlgHom_ofComp_localizationAway (g : S) [IsLocalization.Away g T] :
    ((localizationAway T g).ofComp P).toAlgHom
      (rename Sum.inr (P.σ g) * X (Sum.inl ()) - 1) = C g * X () - 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [Generators.Hom.toAlgHom, Generators.ofComp, aeval_rename]

name: self
statement:
theorem self : IsSubDPIdeal hI I where
  isSubideal
proof:
:= le_rfl
  dpow_mem _ hn _ ha := hI.dpow_mem hn ha

name: dpow_eq
statement:
lemma dpow_eq (n : ℕ) (a : A) :
    (IsSubDPIdeal.dividedPowers hI hJ).dpow n a = if a ∈ J then hI.dpow n a else 0
proof: := rfl

name: dpow_eq_of_mem
statement:
lemma dpow_eq_of_mem {n : ℕ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ J) :
    (IsSubDPIdeal.dividedPowers hI hJ).dpow n a = hI.dpow n a
proof: := by rw [dpow_eq, ite_eq_left ha]

name: isDPMorphism
statement:
theorem isDPMorphism (hJ : IsSubDPIdeal hI J) :
    (IsSubDPIdeal.dividedPowers hI hJ).IsDPMorphism hI (RingHom.id A)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [isDPMorphism_iff, Ideal.map_id, RingHom.id_apply]
    using ⟨hJ.1, fun _ _ _ ha ↦ by rw [dpow_eq_of_mem _ _ ha]⟩

name: isSubDPIdeal_inf_iff
statement:
theorem isSubDPIdeal_inf_iff {A : Type*} [CommRing A] {I : Ideal A} (hI : DividedPowers I)
    {J : Ideal A} : IsSubDPIdeal hI (J ⊓ I) ↔
    ∀ {n : ℕ} {a b : A} (_ : a ∈ I) (_ : b ∈ I) (_ : a - b ∈ J), hI.dpow n a - hI.dpow n b ∈ J
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hIJ n a b ha hb hab ↦ ?_, fun hIJ ↦ ?_⟩
  · have hab' : a - b ∈ I := I.sub_mem ha hb
    rw [← add_sub_cancel b a, hI.dpow_add' hb hab', range_add_one, sum_insert notMem_range_self,
      tsub_self, hI.dpow_zero hab', mul_one, add_sub_cancel_left]
    exact J.sum_mem (fun i hi ↦ SemilatticeInf.inf_le_left J I ((J ⊓ I).smul_mem _
      (hIJ.dpow_mem _ (ne_of_gt (Nat.sub_pos_of_lt (mem_range.mp hi))) ⟨hab, hab'⟩)))
  · refine ⟨SemilatticeInf.inf_le_right J I, fun {n} hn {a} ha ↦ ⟨?_, hI.dpow_mem hn ha.right⟩⟩
    rw [← sub_zero (hI.dpow n a), ← hI.dpow_eval_zero hn]
    exact hIJ ha.right I.zero_mem (J.sub_mem ha.left J.zero_mem)

name: span_isSubDPIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem span_isSubDPIdeal_iff {S : Set A} (hS : S ⊆ I) :
    IsSubDPIdeal hI (span S) ↔ ∀ {n : ℕ} (_ : n ≠ 0), ∀ s ∈ S, hI.dpow n s ∈ span S
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hhI n hn s hs ↦ hhI.dpow_mem n hn (subset_span hs), fun hhI ↦ ?_⟩
  · 
    have hSI := span_le.mpr hS
    apply IsSubDPIdeal.mk hSI
    intro m hm z hz
    induction hz using Submodule.span_induction generalizing m hm with
    | mem x h => exact hhI hm x h
    | zero =>
        rw [hI.dpow_eval_zero hm]
        exact (span S).zero_mem
    | add x y hxI hyI hx hy =>
        rw [hI.dpow_add' (hSI hxI) (hSI hyI)]
        apply Submodule.sum_mem (span S)
        intro m _
        by_cases hm0 : m = 0
        · exact hm0 ▸ mul_mem_left (span S) _ (hy _ hm)
        · exact mul_mem_right _ (span S) (hx _ hm0)
    | smul a x hxI hx =>
        rw [smul_eq_mul, hI.dpow_mul (hSI hxI)]
        exact mul_mem_left (span S) (a ^ m) (hx m hm)

name: isSubDPIdeal_sup
statement:
theorem isSubDPIdeal_sup {J K : Ideal A} (hJ : IsSubDPIdeal hI J) (hK : IsSubDPIdeal hI K) :
    IsSubDPIdeal hI (J ⊔ K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← J.span_eq, ← K.span_eq, ← span_union,
    span_isSubDPIdeal_iff (Set.union_subset_iff.mpr ⟨hJ.1, hK.1⟩)]
  intro n hn a ha
  rcases ha with ha | ha
  · exact span_mono Set.subset_union_left (subset_span (hJ.2 n hn ha))
  · exact span_mono Set.subset_union_right (subset_span (hK.2 n hn ha))

name: isSubDPIdeal_iSup
statement:
theorem isSubDPIdeal_iSup {ι : Type*} {J : ι → Ideal A} (hJ : ∀ i, IsSubDPIdeal hI (J i)) :
    IsSubDPIdeal hI (iSup J)
proof:
:= by
  rw [iSup_eq_span, span_isSubDPIdeal_iff (Set.iUnion_subset_iff.mpr <| fun i ↦ (hJ i).1)]
  simp_rw [Set.mem_iUnion]
  rintro n hn a ⟨i, ha⟩
  exact span_mono (Set.subset_iUnion _ i) (subset_span ((hJ i).2 n hn ha))

name: isSubDPIdeal_iInf
statement:
theorem isSubDPIdeal_iInf {ι : Type*} {J : ι → Ideal A} (hJ : ∀ i, IsSubDPIdeal hI (J i)) :
    IsSubDPIdeal hI (I ⊓ iInf (fun i ↦ J i))
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty ι with
  | inr _ =>
    refine ⟨fun _ hx ↦ hx.1, ?_⟩
    intro n hn x hx
    simp only [Ideal.mem_inf, mem_iInf] at hx ⊢
    exact ⟨hI.dpow_mem hn hx.1, fun i ↦  IsSubDPIdeal.dpow_mem (hJ i) n hn (hx.2 i)⟩
  | inl _ =>
    simp only [iInf_of_empty, le_top, inf_of_le_left]
    exact IsSubDPIdeal.self hI

name: isSubDPIdeal_map_of_isSubDPIdeal
statement:
theorem isSubDPIdeal_map_of_isSubDPIdeal {f : A →+* B} (hf : IsDPMorphism hI hJ f) {K : Ideal A}
    (hK : IsSubDPIdeal hI K) : IsSubDPIdeal hJ (map f K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.map, span_isSubDPIdeal_iff]
  · rintro n hn y ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact hf.2 x (hK.1 hx) ▸ mem_map_of_mem _ (hK.2 _ hn hx)
  · rintro y ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact hf.1 (mem_map_of_mem f (hK.1 hx))

name: isSubDPIdeal_map
statement:
theorem isSubDPIdeal_map {f : A →+* B} (hf : IsDPMorphism hI hJ f) :
    IsSubDPIdeal hJ (Ideal.map f I)
proof:
:=
  isSubDPIdeal_map_of_isSubDPIdeal hf (IsSubDPIdeal.self hI)

@[simp]
theorem memCarrier {s : SubDPIdeal hI} {x : A} : x ∈ s.carrier ↔ x ∈ s

lemma toIsSubDPIdeal (J : SubDPIdeal hI) : IsSubDPIdeal hI J.carrier where
