theorem factors_eq_zero {x : α} (hx : x ≠ 0) : factors x = 0 ↔ IsUnit x
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ by contrapose! h; simpa [eq_zero_iff_forall_notMem] using exists_mem_factors hx h,
    factors_of_isUnit⟩

name: factors_pos
statement:
@[simp]
theorem factors_pos {x : α} (hx : x ≠ 0) : 0 < factors x ↔ ¬IsUnit x
proof:
:=
  bot_lt_iff_ne_bot.trans (not_iff_not.mpr (factors_eq_zero hx))

name: unique'
statement:
theorem unique' {p q : Multiset (Associates α)} :
    (∀ a ∈ p, Irreducible a) → (∀ a ∈ q, Irreducible a) → p.prod = q.prod → p = q
proof:
:= by
  apply Multiset.induction_on_multiset_quot p
  apply Multiset.induction_on_multiset_quot q
  intro s t hs ht eq
  refine Multiset.map_mk_eq_map_mk_of_rel (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.factors_unique ?_ ?_ ?_)
  · exact fun a ha => irreducible_mk.1 <| hs _ <| Multiset.mem_map_of_mem _ ha
  · exact fun a ha => irreducible_mk.1 <| ht _ <| Multiset.mem_map_of_mem _ ha
  have eq' : (Quot.mk Setoid.r : α → Associates α) = Associates.mk := funext quot_mk_eq_mk
  rwa [eq', prod_mk, prod_mk, mk_eq_mk_iff_associated] at eq

name: prod_le_prod_iff_le
statement:
theorem prod_le_prod_iff_le [Nontrivial α] {p q : Multiset (Associates α)}
    (hp : ∀ a ∈ p, Irreducible a) (hq : ∀ a ∈ q, Irreducible a) : p.prod ≤ q.prod ↔ p ≤ q
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, prod_le_prod⟩
  rintro ⟨c, eqc⟩
  refine Multiset.le_iff_exists_add.2 ⟨factors c, unique' hq (fun x hx ↦ ?_) ?_⟩
  · obtain h | h := Multiset.mem_add.1 hx
    · exact hp x h
    · exact irreducible_of_factor _ h
  · rw [eqc, Multiset.prod_add]
    congr
    refine associated_iff_eq.mp (factors_prod fun hc => ?_).symm
    refine not_irreducible_zero (hq _ ?_)
    rw [← prod_eq_zero_iff, eqc, hc, mul_zero]

name: WfDvdMonoid.of_exists_prime_factors
statement: theorem WfDvdMonoid.of_exists_prime_factors : WfDvdMonoid α
proof:
:=
  ⟨by
    refine RelHomClass.wellFounded
      (RelHom.mk ?_ ?_ : (DvdNotUnit : α → α → Prop) →r ((· < ·) : ℕ∞ → ℕ∞ → Prop)) wellFounded_lt
    · intro a
      by_cases h : a = 0
      · exact ⊤
      exact ↑(Multiset.card (Classical.choose (pf a h)))
    rintro a b ⟨ane0, ⟨c, hc, b_eq⟩⟩
    rw [dite_eq_right ane0]
    by_cases h : b = 0
    · simp [h, lt_top_iff_ne_top]
    · rw [dite_eq_right h, ENat.natCast_lt_natCast]
      have cne0 : c ≠ 0 := by
        refine mt (fun con => ?_) h
        rw [b_eq, con, mul_zero]
      calc
        Multiset.card (Classical.choose (pf a ane0)) <
            _ + Multiset.card (Classical.choose (pf c cne0)) :=
          lt_add_of_pos_right _
            (Multiset.card_pos.mpr fun con => hc (associated_one_iff_isUnit.mp ?_))
        _ = Multiset.card (Classical.choose (pf a ane0) + Classical.choose (pf c cne0)) :=
          (Multiset.card_add _ _).symm
        _ = Multiset.card (Classical.choose (pf b h)) :=
          Multiset.card_eq_card_of_rel
          (prime_factors_unique ?_ (Classical.choose_spec (pf _ h)).1 ?_)
      · convert! (Classical.choose_spec (pf c cne0)).2.symm
        rw [con, Multiset.prod_zero]
      · intro x hadd
        rw [Multiset.mem_add] at hadd
        rcases hadd with h | h <;> apply (Classical.choose_spec (pf _ _)).1 _ h <;> assumption
      · rw [Multiset.prod_add]
        trans a * c
        · apply Associated.mul_mul <;> apply (Classical.choose_spec (pf _ _)).2 <;> assumption
        · rw [← b_eq]
          apply (Classical.choose_spec (pf _ _)).2.symm; assumption⟩

name: irreducible_iff_prime_of_exists_prime_factors
statement: theorem irreducible_iff_prime_of_exists_prime_factors {p : α} : Irreducible p ↔ Prime p
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp0 : p = 0
  · simp [hp0]
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, Prime.irreducible⟩
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := pf p hp0
  obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := prime_factors_irreducible h hf
  rw [hq.prime_iff]
  exact hf.1 q (Multiset.mem_singleton_self _)

name: UniqueFactorizationMonoid.of_exists_prime_factors
statement: theorem UniqueFactorizationMonoid.of_exists_prime_factors : UniqueFactorizationMonoid α

name: UniqueFactorizationMonoid.iff_exists_prime_factors
statement:
theorem UniqueFactorizationMonoid.iff_exists_prime_factors [CommMonoidWithZero α]
    [IsCancelMulZero α] :
    UniqueFactorizationMonoid α ↔
      ∀ a : α, a ≠ 0 → ∃ f : Multiset α, (∀ b ∈ f, Prime b) ∧ f.prod ~ᵤ a
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => @UniqueFactorizationMonoid.exists_prime_factors _ _ h,
    UniqueFactorizationMonoid.of_exists_prime_factors⟩

name: MulEquiv.uniqueFactorizationMonoid
statement:
theorem MulEquiv.uniqueFactorizationMonoid (e : α ≃* β) (hα : UniqueFactorizationMonoid α) :
    UniqueFactorizationMonoid β
proof:
:= by
  have := e.isCancelMulZero_iff.mp inferInstance
  rw [UniqueFactorizationMonoid.iff_exists_prime_factors] at hα ⊢
  intro a ha
  obtain ⟨w, hp, u, h⟩ :=
    hα (e.symm a) fun h =>
      ha <| by
        convert! ← map_zero e
        simp [← h]
  exact
    ⟨w.map e, fun b hb =>
        let ⟨c, hc, he⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.1 hb
        he ▸ (prime_iff e).2 (hp c hc),
        Units.map e.toMonoidHom u,
      by
        rw [Multiset.prod_hom, toMonoidHom_eq_coe, Units.coe_map, MonoidHom.coe_coe, ← map_mul e, h,
          apply_symm_apply]⟩

name: MulEquiv.uniqueFactorizationMonoid_iff
statement:
theorem MulEquiv.uniqueFactorizationMonoid_iff (e : α ≃* β) :
    UniqueFactorizationMonoid α ↔ UniqueFactorizationMonoid β
proof:
:=
  ⟨e.uniqueFactorizationMonoid, e.symm.uniqueFactorizationMonoid⟩

name: of_existsUnique_irreducible_factors
statement:
theorem of_existsUnique_irreducible_factors [CommMonoidWithZero α] [IsCancelMulZero α]
    (eif : ∀ a : α, a ≠ 0 → ∃ f : Multiset α, (∀ b ∈ f, Irreducible b) ∧ f.prod ~ᵤ a)
    (uif :
      ∀ f g : Multiset α,
        (∀ x ∈ f, Irreducible x) →
          (∀ x ∈ g, Irreducible x) → f.prod ~ᵤ g.prod → Multiset.Rel Associated f g) :
    UniqueFactorizationMonoid α
proof:
:=
  UniqueFactorizationMonoid.of_exists_prime_factors
    (by
      convert! eif using 7
      simp_rw [irreducible_iff_prime_of_existsUnique_irreducible_factors eif uif])

name: isRelPrime_iff_no_prime_factors
statement:
theorem isRelPrime_iff_no_prime_factors {a b : R} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    IsRelPrime a b ↔ ∀ ⦃d⦄, d ∣ a → d ∣ b → ¬Prime d
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h _ ha hb ↦ (·.not_isUnit <| h ha hb),
    fun h ↦ WfDvdMonoid.isRelPrime_of_no_irreducible_factors
      (ha ·.1) fun _ irr ha hb ↦ h ha hb (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.irreducible_iff_prime.mp irr)⟩

name: dvd_of_dvd_mul_left_of_no_prime_factors
statement:
theorem dvd_of_dvd_mul_left_of_no_prime_factors {a b c : R} (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (h : ∀ ⦃d⦄, d ∣ a → d ∣ c → ¬Prime d) : a ∣ b * c → a ∣ b
proof:
:=
  ((isRelPrime_iff_no_prime_factors ha).mpr h).dvd_of_dvd_mul_right

name: dvd_of_dvd_mul_right_of_no_prime_factors
statement:
theorem dvd_of_dvd_mul_right_of_no_prime_factors {a b c : R} (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (no_factors : ∀ {d}, d ∣ a → d ∣ b → ¬Prime d) : a ∣ b * c → a ∣ c
proof:
:= by
  simpa [mul_comm b c] using dvd_of_dvd_mul_left_of_no_prime_factors ha @no_factors

name: exists_reduced_factors
statement:
theorem exists_reduced_factors :
    ∀ a ≠ (0 : R), ∀ b,
      ∃ a' b' c', IsRelPrime a' b' ∧ c' * a' = a ∧ c' * b' = b
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  refine induction_on_prime a ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intros
    contradiction
  · intro a a_unit _ b
    use a, b, 1
    constructor
    · intro p p_dvd_a _
      exact isUnit_of_dvd_unit p_dvd_a a_unit
    · simp
  · intro a p a_ne_zero p_prime ih_a pa_ne_zero b
    by_cases h : p ∣ b
    · rcases h with ⟨b, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨a', b', c', no_factor, ha', hb'⟩ := ih_a a_ne_zero b
      refine ⟨a', b', p * c', @no_factor, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [mul_assoc, ha']
      · rw [mul_assoc, hb']
    · obtain ⟨a', b', c', coprime, rfl, rfl⟩ := ih_a a_ne_zero b
      refine ⟨p * a', b', c', ?_, mul_left_comm _ _ _, rfl⟩
      intro q q_dvd_pa' q_dvd_b'
      rcases p_prime.left_dvd_or_dvd_right_of_dvd_mul q_dvd_pa' with p_dvd_q | q_dvd_a'
      · have : p ∣ c' * b' := dvd_mul_of_dvd_right (p_dvd_q.trans q_dvd_b') _
        contradiction
      exact coprime q_dvd_a' q_dvd_b'

name: exists_reduced_factors'
statement:
theorem exists_reduced_factors' (a b : R) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    ∃ a' b' c', IsRelPrime a' b' ∧ c' * a' = a ∧ c' * b' = b
proof:
:=
  let ⟨b', a', c', no_factor, hb, ha⟩ := exists_reduced_factors b hb a
  ⟨a', b', c', fun _ hpb hpa => no_factor hpa hpb, ha, hb⟩

name: factors_eq_normalizedFactors
statement:
@[simp]
theorem factors_eq_normalizedFactors {M : Type*} [CommMonoidWithZero M]
    [UniqueFactorizationMonoid M] [Subsingleton Mˣ] (x : M) : factors x = normalizedFactors x
proof:
:= by
  unfold normalizedFactors
  convert (Multiset.map_id (factors x)).symm with p
  exact normalize_eq p

name: prod_normalizedFactors
statement:
theorem prod_normalizedFactors {a : α} (ane0 : a ≠ 0) :
    Associated (normalizedFactors a).prod a
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalizedFactors, factors, dite_eq_right ane0]
  refine Associated.trans ?_ (Classical.choose_spec (exists_prime_factors a ane0)).2
  rw [← Associates.mk_eq_mk_iff_associated, ← Associates.prod_mk, ← Associates.prod_mk,
    Multiset.map_map]
  congr 2
  ext
  rw [Function.comp_apply, Associates.mk_normalize]

name: prod_normalizedFactors_eq
statement:
theorem prod_normalizedFactors_eq {α} [CommMonoidWithZero α] [StrongNormalizationMonoid α]
    [UniqueFactorizationMonoid α] {a : α} (ane0 : a ≠ 0) :
    (normalizedFactors a).prod = normalize a
proof:
:= by
  trans normalize (normalizedFactors a).prod
  · rw [normalizedFactors, ← coe_normalizeHom, ← map_multiset_prod, coe_normalizeHom,
      normalize_idem]
  · exact normalize_eq_normalize_iff.mpr (dvd_dvd_iff_associated.mpr (prod_normalizedFactors ane0))

name: prime_of_normalized_factor
statement: theorem prime_of_normalized_factor {a : α} : ∀ x : α, x ∈ normalizedFactors a → Prime x
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalizedFactors, factors]
  split_ifs with ane0; · simp
  intro x hx; rcases Multiset.mem_map.1 hx with ⟨y, ⟨hy, rfl⟩⟩
  rw [(normalize_associated _).prime_iff]
  exact (Classical.choose_spec (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.exists_prime_factors a ane0)).1 y hy

name: irreducible_of_normalized_factor
statement:
theorem irreducible_of_normalized_factor {a : α} :
    ∀ x : α, x ∈ normalizedFactors a → Irreducible x
proof:
:= fun x h =>
  (prime_of_normalized_factor x h).irreducible

name: normalize_normalized_factor
statement:
theorem normalize_normalized_factor {a : α} :
    ∀ x : α, x ∈ normalizedFactors a → normalize x = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalizedFactors, factors]
  split_ifs with h; · simp
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨y, _, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.1 hx
  apply normalize_idem

name: normalizedFactors_irreducible
statement:
theorem normalizedFactors_irreducible {a : α} (ha : Irreducible a) :
    normalizedFactors a = {normalize a}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, a_assoc, hp⟩ :=
    prime_factors_irreducible ha ⟨prime_of_normalized_factor, prod_normalizedFactors ha.ne_zero⟩
  have p_mem : p ∈ normalizedFactors a := by
    rw [hp]
    exact Multiset.mem_singleton_self _
  convert! hp
  rwa [← normalize_normalized_factor p p_mem, normalize_eq_normalize_iff, dvd_dvd_iff_associated]

name: normalizedFactors_eq_of_dvd
statement:
theorem normalizedFactors_eq_of_dvd (a : α) :
    ∀ᵉ (p ∈ normalizedFactors a) (q ∈ normalizedFactors a), p ∣ q → p = q
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp q hq hdvd
  convert!
    normalize_eq_normalize hdvd
      ((prime_of_normalized_factor _ hp).irreducible.dvd_symm
        (prime_of_normalized_factor _ hq).irreducible hdvd) <;>
    apply (normalize_normalized_factor _ ‹_›).symm

name: exists_mem_normalizedFactors_of_dvd
statement:
theorem exists_mem_normalizedFactors_of_dvd {a p : α} (ha0 : a ≠ 0) (hp : Irreducible p) :
    p ∣ a → ∃ q ∈ normalizedFactors a, p ~ᵤ q
proof:
:= fun ⟨b, hb⟩ =>
  have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := fun hb0 => by simp_all
  have : Multiset.Rel Associated (p ::ₘ normalizedFactors b) (normalizedFactors a) :=
    factors_unique
      (fun _ hx =>
        (Multiset.mem_cons.1 hx).elim (fun h => h.symm ▸ hp) (irreducible_of_normalized_factor _))
      irreducible_of_normalized_factor
      (Associated.symm <|
        calc
          Multiset.prod (normalizedFactors a) ~ᵤ a := prod_normalizedFactors ha0
          _ = p * b := hb
          _ ~ᵤ Multiset.prod (p ::ₘ normalizedFactors b) := by
            rw [Multiset.prod_cons]
            exact (prod_normalizedFactors hb0).symm.mul_left _)
  Multiset.exists_mem_of_rel_of_mem this (by simp)

name: exists_mem_normalizedFactors
statement:
theorem exists_mem_normalizedFactors {x : α} (hx : x ≠ 0) (h : ¬IsUnit x) :
    ∃ p, p ∈ normalizedFactors x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p', hp', hp'x⟩ := WfDvdMonoid.exists_irreducible_factor h hx
  obtain ⟨p, hp, _⟩ := exists_mem_normalizedFactors_of_dvd hx hp' hp'x
  exact ⟨p, hp⟩

name: normalizedFactors_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem normalizedFactors_zero : normalizedFactors (0 : α) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [normalizedFactors, factors]

name: normalizedFactors_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem normalizedFactors_one : normalizedFactors (1 : α) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial α with h | h
  · dsimp [normalizedFactors, factors]
    simp [Subsingleton.elim (1 : α) 0]
  · rw [← Multiset.rel_zero_right]
    apply factors_unique irreducible_of_normalized_factor
    · intro x hx
      exfalso
      apply Multiset.notMem_zero x hx
    · apply prod_normalizedFactors one_ne_zero

name: normalizedFactors_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem normalizedFactors_mul {x y : α} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    normalizedFactors (x * y) = normalizedFactors x + normalizedFactors y
proof:
:= by
  have h : (normalize : α → α) = Associates.out ∘ Associates.mk := by
    ext
    rw [Function.comp_apply, Associates.out_mk]
  rw [← Multiset.map_id' (normalizedFactors (x * y)), ← Multiset.map_id' (normalizedFactors x), ←
    Multiset.map_id' (normalizedFactors y), ← Multiset.map_congr rfl normalize_normalized_factor, ←
    Multiset.map_congr rfl normalize_normalized_factor, ←
    Multiset.map_congr rfl normalize_normalized_factor, ← Multiset.map_add, h, ←
    Multiset.map_map Associates.out, eq_comm, ← Multiset.map_map Associates.out]
  refine congr rfl ?_
  apply Multiset.map_mk_eq_map_mk_of_rel
  apply factors_unique
  · intro x hx
    rcases Multiset.mem_add.1 hx with (hx | hx) <;> exact irreducible_of_normalized_factor x hx
  · exact irreducible_of_normalized_factor
  · rw [Multiset.prod_add]
    exact
      ((prod_normalizedFactors hx).mul_mul (prod_normalizedFactors hy)).trans
        (prod_normalizedFactors (mul_ne_zero hx hy)).symm

name: normalizedFactors_pow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem normalizedFactors_pow {x : α} (n : ℕ) :
    normalizedFactors (x ^ n) = n • normalizedFactors x
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [zero_nsmul]
  | succ n ih =>
    by_cases h0 : x = 0
    · simp [h0, zero_pow n.succ_ne_zero, nsmul_zero]
    rw [pow_succ', succ_nsmul', normalizedFactors_mul h0 (pow_ne_zero _ h0), ih]

name: _root_.Irreducible.normalizedFactors_pow
statement:
theorem _root_.Irreducible.normalizedFactors_pow {p : α} (hp : Irreducible p) (k : ℕ) :
    normalizedFactors (p ^ k) = Multiset.replicate k (normalize p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors_pow, normalizedFactors_irreducible hp,
    Multiset.nsmul_singleton]

name: normalizedFactors_prod_eq
statement:
theorem normalizedFactors_prod_eq (s : Multiset α) (hs : ∀ a ∈ s, Irreducible a) :
    normalizedFactors s.prod = s.map normalize
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Multiset.induction with
  | empty => rw [Multiset.prod_zero, normalizedFactors_one, Multiset.map_zero]
  | cons a s ih =>
    have ia := hs a (Multiset.mem_cons_self a _)
    have ib := fun b h => hs b (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem h)
    obtain rfl | ⟨b, hb⟩ := s.empty_or_exists_mem
    · rw [Multiset.cons_zero, Multiset.prod_singleton, Multiset.map_singleton,
        normalizedFactors_irreducible ia]
    have := nontrivial_of_ne b 0 (ib b hb).ne_zero
    rw [Multiset.prod_cons, Multiset.map_cons,
      normalizedFactors_mul ia.ne_zero (Multiset.prod_ne_zero fun h => (ib 0 h).ne_zero rfl),
      normalizedFactors_irreducible ia, ih ib, Multiset.singleton_add]

name: dvd_iff_normalizedFactors_le_normalizedFactors
statement:
theorem dvd_iff_normalizedFactors_le_normalizedFactors {x y : α} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    x ∣ y ↔ normalizedFactors x ≤ normalizedFactors y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, rfl⟩
    simp [hx, right_ne_zero_of_mul hy]
  · rw [← (prod_normalizedFactors hx).dvd_iff_dvd_left, ←
      (prod_normalizedFactors hy).dvd_iff_dvd_right]
    apply Multiset.prod_dvd_prod_of_le

name: _root_.Associated.normalizedFactors_eq
statement:
theorem _root_.Associated.normalizedFactors_eq {a b : α} (h : Associated a b) :
    normalizedFactors a = normalizedFactors b
proof:
:= by
  unfold normalizedFactors
  have h' : normalize (α := α) = Associates.out ∘ Associates.mk := funext Associates.out_mk
  rw [h', ← Multiset.map_map, ← Multiset.map_map,
    Associates.rel_associated_iff_map_eq_map.mp (factors_rel_of_associated h)]

name: associated_iff_normalizedFactors_eq_normalizedFactors
statement:
theorem associated_iff_normalizedFactors_eq_normalizedFactors {x y : α} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    x ~ᵤ y ↔ normalizedFactors x = normalizedFactors y
proof:
:=
  ⟨Associated.normalizedFactors_eq, fun h =>
    (prod_normalizedFactors hx).symm.trans (_root_.trans (by rw [h]) (prod_normalizedFactors hy))⟩

name: normalizedFactors_of_irreducible_pow
statement:
theorem normalizedFactors_of_irreducible_pow {p : α} (hp : Irreducible p) (k : ℕ) :
    normalizedFactors (p ^ k) = Multiset.replicate k (normalize p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalizedFactors_pow, normalizedFactors_irreducible hp, Multiset.nsmul_singleton]

name: zero_notMem_normalizedFactors
statement: theorem zero_notMem_normalizedFactors (x : α) : (0 : α) ∉ normalizedFactors x
proof:
:= fun h =>
  Prime.ne_zero (prime_of_normalized_factor _ h) rfl

name: ne_zero_of_mem_normalizedFactors
statement: theorem ne_zero_of_mem_normalizedFactors {x a : α} (hx : x ∈ normalizedFactors a) : x ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  ne_of_mem_of_not_mem hx <| zero_notMem_normalizedFactors a

name: dvd_of_mem_normalizedFactors
statement: theorem dvd_of_mem_normalizedFactors {a p : α} (H : p ∈ normalizedFactors a) : p ∣ a
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hcases : a = 0
  · rw [hcases]
    exact dvd_zero p
  · exact dvd_trans (Multiset.dvd_prod H) (Associated.dvd (prod_normalizedFactors hcases))

name: mem_normalizedFactors_iff
statement:
theorem mem_normalizedFactors_iff [Subsingleton αˣ] {p x : α} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    p ∈ normalizedFactors x ↔ Prime p ∧ p ∣ x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨prime_of_normalized_factor p h, dvd_of_mem_normalizedFactors h⟩
  · rintro ⟨hprime, hdvd⟩
    obtain ⟨q, hqmem, hqeq⟩ := exists_mem_normalizedFactors_of_dvd hx hprime.irreducible hdvd
    rw [associated_iff_eq] at hqeq
    exact hqeq ▸ hqmem

name: mem_normalizedFactors_iff'
statement:
theorem mem_normalizedFactors_iff' {p x : α} (h : x ≠ 0) :
    p ∈ normalizedFactors x ↔ Irreducible p ∧ normalize p = p ∧ p ∣ x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨irreducible_of_normalized_factor p h, normalize_normalized_factor p h,
    dvd_of_mem_normalizedFactors h⟩, fun ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hy₁, hy₂⟩ := exists_mem_factors_of_dvd h h₁ h₃
  exact Multiset.mem_map.mpr ⟨y, hy₁, by
    rwa [← h₂, normalize_eq_normalize_iff_associated, Associated.comm]⟩

name: disjoint_normalizedFactors
statement:
theorem disjoint_normalizedFactors {a b : α} (hc : IsRelPrime a b) :
    Disjoint (normalizedFactors a) (normalizedFactors b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Multiset.disjoint_left]
  intro x hxa hxb
  have x_dvd_a := dvd_of_mem_normalizedFactors hxa
  have x_dvd_b := dvd_of_mem_normalizedFactors hxb
  exact (prime_of_normalized_factor x hxa).not_isUnit (hc x_dvd_a x_dvd_b)

name: exists_associated_prime_pow_of_unique_normalized_factor
statement:
theorem exists_associated_prime_pow_of_unique_normalized_factor {p r : α}
    (h : ∀ {m}, m ∈ normalizedFactors r → m = p) (hr : r ≠ 0) : ∃ i : ℕ, Associated (p ^ i) r
proof:
:= by
  use (normalizedFactors r).card
  have := UniqueFactorizationMonoid.prod_normalizedFactors hr
  rwa [Multiset.eq_replicate_of_mem fun b => h, Multiset.prod_replicate] at this

name: normalizedFactors_prod_of_prime
statement:
theorem normalizedFactors_prod_of_prime [Subsingleton αˣ] {m : Multiset α}
    (h : ∀ p ∈ m, Prime p) : normalizedFactors m.prod = m
proof:
:= by
  cases subsingleton_or_nontrivial α
  · obtain rfl : m = 0 := by
      refine Multiset.eq_zero_of_forall_notMem fun x hx ↦ ?_
      simpa [Subsingleton.elim x 0] using h x hx
    simp
  · simpa only [← Multiset.rel_eq, ← associated_eq_eq] using
      prime_factors_unique prime_of_normalized_factor h
        (prod_normalizedFactors (m.prod_ne_zero_of_prime h))

name: mem_normalizedFactors_eq_of_associated
statement:
theorem mem_normalizedFactors_eq_of_associated {a b c : α} (ha : a ∈ normalizedFactors c)
    (hb : b ∈ normalizedFactors c) (h : Associated a b) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← normalize_normalized_factor a ha, ← normalize_normalized_factor b hb,
    normalize_eq_normalize_iff]
  exact Associated.dvd_dvd h

name: normalizedFactors_pos
statement:
@[simp]
theorem normalizedFactors_pos (x : α) (hx : x ≠ 0) : 0 < normalizedFactors x ↔ ¬IsUnit x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h hx
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := Multiset.exists_mem_of_ne_zero h.ne'
    exact
      (prime_of_normalized_factor _ hp).not_isUnit
        (isUnit_of_dvd_unit (dvd_of_mem_normalizedFactors hp) hx)
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := exists_mem_normalizedFactors hx h
    exact
      bot_lt_iff_ne_bot.mpr
        (mt Multiset.eq_zero_iff_forall_notMem.mp (not_forall.mpr ⟨p, not_not.mpr hp⟩))

name: normalizedFactors_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem normalizedFactors_eq_zero_iff {x : α} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    normalizedFactors x = 0 ↔ IsUnit x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← not_iff_not, ← normalizedFactors_pos _ hx, pos_iff_ne_zero]

name: normalizedFactors_of_isUnit
statement:
theorem normalizedFactors_of_isUnit {x : α} (hx : IsUnit x) :
    normalizedFactors x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hx₀ := eq_or_ne x 0
  · simp
  rwa [normalizedFactors_eq_zero_iff hx₀]

name: dvdNotUnit_iff_normalizedFactors_lt_normalizedFactors
statement:
theorem dvdNotUnit_iff_normalizedFactors_lt_normalizedFactors {x y : α} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    DvdNotUnit x y ↔ normalizedFactors x < normalizedFactors y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, c, hc, rfl⟩
    simp only [hx, right_ne_zero_of_mul hy, normalizedFactors_mul, Ne, not_false_iff,
      lt_add_iff_pos_right, normalizedFactors_pos, hc]
  · intro h
    exact
      dvdNotUnit_of_dvd_of_not_dvd
        ((dvd_iff_normalizedFactors_le_normalizedFactors hx hy).mpr h.le)
        (mt (dvd_iff_normalizedFactors_le_normalizedFactors hy hx).mp h.not_ge)

name: normalizedFactors_multiset_prod
statement:
theorem normalizedFactors_multiset_prod (s : Multiset α) (hs : 0 ∉ s) :
    normalizedFactors (s.prod) = (s.map normalizedFactors).sum
proof:
:= by
  cases subsingleton_or_nontrivial α
  · obtain rfl : s = 0 := by
      apply Multiset.eq_zero_of_forall_notMem
      intro _
      convert! hs
    simp
  induction s using Multiset.induction with
  | empty => simp
  | cons _ _ IH =>
    rw [Multiset.prod_cons, Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.sum_cons, normalizedFactors_mul, IH]
    · exact fun h ↦ hs (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem h)
    · exact fun h ↦ hs (h ▸ Multiset.mem_cons_self _ _)
    · apply Multiset.prod_ne_zero
      exact fun h ↦ hs (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem h)

name: normalizedFactorsEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem normalizedFactorsEquiv_apply (he : ∀ x, normalize (f x) = f (normalize x))
    {a p : α} (hp : p ∈ normalizedFactors a) :
    normalizedFactorsEquiv he a ⟨p, hp⟩ = f p
proof: := rfl

name: normalizedFactorsEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem normalizedFactorsEquiv_symm_apply (he : ∀ x, normalize (f x) = f (normalize x))
    {a : α} {q : β} (hq : q ∈ normalizedFactors (f a)) :
    (normalizedFactorsEquiv he a).symm ⟨q, hq⟩ = (MulEquivClass.toMulEquiv f).symm q
proof: := rfl

name: normalizedFactors_prod_eq_self_of_subset
proof:
:=
  normalizedFactors_prod_of_prime fun _ h ↦ prime_of_normalized_factor _ (mem_of_subset hm h)

name: prod_ne_zero_of_subset_normalizedFactors
proof:
:=
  prod_ne_zero_of_prime _ fun _ h ↦ prime_of_normalized_factor _ (mem_of_subset hm h)

name: normalizedFactors_prod_inter_eq_inter
statement:
lemma normalizedFactors_prod_inter_eq_inter [Subsingleton αˣ] (a b : α) :
    normalizedFactors (normalizedFactors a ∩ normalizedFactors b).prod =
      normalizedFactors a ∩ normalizedFactors b
proof:
:=
  normalizedFactors_prod_eq_self_of_subset fun _ h ↦ (mem_inter.mp h).left

name: prod_inter_normalizedFactors_ne_zero
statement:
lemma prod_inter_normalizedFactors_ne_zero [NormalizationMonoid α] [Nontrivial α] (a b : α) :
    (normalizedFactors a ∩ normalizedFactors b).prod ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  prod_ne_zero_of_subset_normalizedFactors fun _ h ↦ (mem_inter.mp h).left

name: Ideal.IsPrime.exists_mem_prime_of_ne_bot
statement:
theorem Ideal.IsPrime.exists_mem_prime_of_ne_bot {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R]
    [UniqueFactorizationMonoid R] {I : Ideal R} (hI₂ : I.IsPrime) (hI : I ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ x ∈ I, Prime x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a : R, ha₁ : a ∈ I, ha₂ : a ≠ 0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hI
  replace ha₁ : (factors a).prod ∈ I := by
    obtain ⟨u : Rˣ, hu : (factors a).prod * u = a⟩ := factors_prod ha₂
    rwa [← hu, mul_unit_mem_iff_mem _ u.isUnit] at ha₁
  obtain ⟨p : R, hp₁ : p ∈ factors a, hp₂ : p ∈ I⟩ :=
    (hI₂.multiset_prod_mem_iff_exists_mem <| factors a).1 ha₁
  exact ⟨p, hp₂, prime_of_factor p hp₁⟩

name: Ideal.setOfPred_isPrincipal_wellFoundedOn_gt
statement:
lemma Ideal.setOfPred_isPrincipal_wellFoundedOn_gt [CommSemiring α] [WfDvdMonoid α] [IsDomain α] :
    {I : Ideal α | I.IsPrincipal}.WellFoundedOn (· > ·)
proof:
:= by
  have : {I : Ideal α | I.IsPrincipal} = ((fun a ↦ Ideal.span {a}) '' Set.univ) := by
    ext
    simp [Submodule.isPrincipal_iff, eq_comm]
  rw [this, Set.wellFoundedOn_image, Set.wellFoundedOn_univ]
  convert! wellFounded_dvdNotUnit (α := α)
  ext
  exact Ideal.span_singleton_lt_span_singleton

name: WfDvdMonoid.of_setOfPred_isPrincipal_wellFoundedOn_gt
statement:
lemma WfDvdMonoid.of_setOfPred_isPrincipal_wellFoundedOn_gt [CommSemiring α] [IsDomain α]
    (h : {I : Ideal α | I.IsPrincipal}.WellFoundedOn (· > ·)) :
    WfDvdMonoid α
proof:
:= by
  have : WellFounded (α := {I : Ideal α // I.IsPrincipal}) (· > ·) := h
  constructor
  convert! InvImage.wf (fun a => ⟨Ideal.span ({ a } : Set α), _, rfl⟩) this
  ext
  exact Ideal.span_singleton_lt_span_singleton.symm

name: wellFounded_dvdNotUnit
statement:
theorem wellFounded_dvdNotUnit {α : Type*} [CommMonoidWithZero α] [h : WfDvdMonoid α] :
    WellFounded (DvdNotUnit (α := α))
proof:
:=
  h.wf

name: exists_irreducible_factor
statement:
theorem exists_irreducible_factor {a : α} (ha : ¬IsUnit a) (ha0 : a ≠ 0) :
    ∃ i, Irreducible i ∧ i ∣ a
proof:
:=
  let ⟨b, hs, hr⟩ := wellFounded_dvdNotUnit.has_min { b | b ∣ a ∧ ¬IsUnit b } ⟨a, dvd_rfl, ha⟩
  ⟨b,
    ⟨hs.2, fun c d he =>
      let h := dvd_trans ⟨d, he⟩ hs.1
      or_iff_not_imp_left.2 fun hc =>
        of_not_not fun hd => hr c ⟨h, hc⟩ ⟨ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero ha0 h, d, hd, he⟩⟩,
    hs.1⟩

name: induction_on_irreducible
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem induction_on_irreducible {motive : α → Prop} (a : α)
    (zero : motive 0) (unit : ∀ u : α, IsUnit u → motive u)
    (mul : ∀ a i : α, a ≠ 0 → Irreducible i → motive a → motive (i * a)) : motive a
proof:
:=
  haveI := Classical.dec
  wellFounded_dvdNotUnit.fix
    (fun a ih =>
      if ha0 : a = 0 then ha0.substr zero
      else
        if hau : IsUnit a then unit a hau
        else
          let ⟨i, i_irred, b, hb⟩ := exists_irreducible_factor hau ha0
          let hb0 : b ≠ 0 := ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero ha0 ⟨i, mul_comm i b ▸ hb⟩
          hb.symm ▸ mul b i hb0 i_irred <| ih b ⟨hb0, i, i_irred.1, mul_comm i b ▸ hb⟩)
    a

name: exists_factors
statement:
theorem exists_factors (a : α) :
    a ≠ 0 → ∃ f : Multiset α, (∀ b ∈ f, Irreducible b) ∧ Associated f.prod a
proof:
:=
  induction_on_irreducible a (fun h => (h rfl).elim)
    (fun _ hu _ => ⟨0, fun _ h => False.elim (Multiset.notMem_zero _ h), hu.unit, one_mul _⟩)
    fun a i ha0 hi ih _ =>
    let ⟨s, hs⟩ := ih ha0
    ⟨i ::ₘ s, fun b H => (Multiset.mem_cons.1 H).elim (fun h => h.symm ▸ hi) (hs.1 b), by
      rw [s.prod_cons i]
      exact hs.2.mul_left i⟩

name: not_isUnit_iff_exists_factors_eq
statement:
theorem not_isUnit_iff_exists_factors_eq (a : α) (hn0 : a ≠ 0) :
    ¬IsUnit a ↔ ∃ f : Multiset α, (∀ b ∈ f, Irreducible b) ∧ f.prod = a ∧ f ≠ ∅
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hnu => by
    obtain ⟨f, hi, u, rfl⟩ := exists_factors a hn0
    obtain ⟨b, h⟩ := Multiset.exists_mem_of_ne_zero fun h : f = 0 => hnu <| by simp [h]
    classical
      refine ⟨(f.erase b).cons (b * u), fun a ha => ?_, ?_, Multiset.cons_ne_zero⟩
      · obtain rfl | ha := Multiset.mem_cons.1 ha
        exacts [Associated.irreducible ⟨u, rfl⟩ (hi b h), hi a (Multiset.mem_of_mem_erase ha)]
      · rw [Multiset.prod_cons, mul_comm b, mul_assoc, Multiset.prod_erase h, mul_comm],
    fun ⟨_, hi, he, hne⟩ =>
    let ⟨b, h⟩ := Multiset.exists_mem_of_ne_zero hne
    not_isUnit_of_not_isUnit_dvd (hi b h).not_isUnit <| he ▸ Multiset.dvd_prod h⟩

name: isRelPrime_of_no_irreducible_factors
statement:
theorem isRelPrime_of_no_irreducible_factors {x y : α} (nonzero : ¬(x = 0 ∧ y = 0))
    (H : ∀ z : α, Irreducible z → z ∣ x → ¬z ∣ y) : IsRelPrime x y
proof:
:=
  isRelPrime_of_no_nonunits_factors nonzero fun _z znu znz zx zy ↦
    have ⟨i, h1, h2⟩ := exists_irreducible_factor znu znz
    H i h1 (h2.trans zx) (h2.trans zy)

name: exists_prime_factors
statement:
theorem exists_prime_factors (a : α) :
    a ≠ 0 → ∃ f : Multiset α, (∀ b ∈ f, Prime b) ∧ f.prod ~ᵤ a
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← UniqueFactorizationMonoid.irreducible_iff_prime]
  apply WfDvdMonoid.exists_factors a

name: exists_prime_iff
statement:
lemma exists_prime_iff :
    (∃ (p : α), Prime p) ↔ ∃ (x : α), x ≠ 0 ∧ ¬ IsUnit x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨p, hp⟩ ↦ ⟨p, hp.ne_zero, hp.not_isUnit⟩, fun ⟨x, hx₀, hxu⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨f, hf, -⟩ := WfDvdMonoid.exists_irreducible_factor hxu hx₀
  exact ⟨f, UniqueFactorizationMonoid.irreducible_iff_prime.mp hf⟩

name: induction_on_prime
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem induction_on_prime {P : α → Prop} (a : α) (h₁ : P 0) (h₂ : ∀ x : α, IsUnit x → P x)
    (h₃ : ∀ a p : α, a ≠ 0 → Prime p → P a → P (p * a)) : P a
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← UniqueFactorizationMonoid.irreducible_iff_prime] at h₃
  exact WfDvdMonoid.induction_on_irreducible a h₁ h₂ h₃

name: of_subsingleton
statement:
theorem of_subsingleton [Subsingleton α] : UniqueFactorizationMonoid α where
  mul_left_cancel_of_ne_zero _ a b _
proof:
:= Subsingleton.elim a b
  mul_right_cancel_of_ne_zero _ a b _ := Subsingleton.elim a b
  wf := ⟨fun a ↦ Acc.intro a fun b ⟨hb, _⟩ ↦ (hb (Subsingleton.elim b 0)).elim⟩
  irreducible_iff_prime {a} := by simp [Subsingleton.elim a 0]

name: factors_prod
statement: theorem factors_prod {a : α} (ane0 : a ≠ 0) : Associated (factors a).prod a
proof:
:= by
  rw [factors, dite_eq_right ane0]
  exact (Classical.choose_spec (exists_prime_factors a ane0)).2

name: factors_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem factors_zero : factors (0 : α) = 0
proof: := by simp [factors]

name: ne_zero_of_mem_factors
statement: theorem ne_zero_of_mem_factors {p a : α} (h : p ∈ factors a) : a ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rintro rfl
  simp at h

name: dvd_of_mem_factors
statement: theorem dvd_of_mem_factors {p a : α} (h : p ∈ factors a) : p ∣ a
proof:
:=
  dvd_trans (Multiset.dvd_prod h) (Associated.dvd (factors_prod (ne_zero_of_mem_factors h)))

name: prime_of_factor
statement: theorem prime_of_factor {a : α} (x : α) (hx : x ∈ factors a) : Prime x
proof:
:= by
  have ane0 := ne_zero_of_mem_factors hx
  rw [factors, dite_eq_right ane0] at hx
  exact (Classical.choose_spec (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.exists_prime_factors a ane0)).1 x hx

name: irreducible_of_factor
statement: theorem irreducible_of_factor {a : α} : ∀ x : α, x ∈ factors a → Irreducible x
proof:
:= fun x h =>
  (prime_of_factor x h).irreducible

name: card_factors_of_irreducible
statement: theorem card_factors_of_irreducible {a : α} (ha : Irreducible a) : (factors a).card = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hf : factors a ≠ 0 := by
    intro hf
    simpa [hf, Associated.comm, ha.not_isUnit] using factors_prod ha.ne_zero
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_mem_of_ne_zero hf
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := exists_cons_of_mem hb
  rw [hf, card_cons, add_eq_right, card_eq_zero, eq_zero_iff_forall_notMem]
  intro c hc
  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := exists_cons_of_mem hc
  replace hb := (irreducible_of_factor b hb).not_isUnit
  replace hc := (irreducible_of_factor c (hf ▸ mem_cons_of_mem hc)).not_isUnit
  simp [← (factors_prod ha.ne_zero).irreducible_iff, hf, irreducible_mul_iff, hb, hc] at ha

name: mem_kaplanskySet_iff
statement: theorem mem_kaplanskySet_iff : P ∈ kaplanskySet S ↔ (P : Set R) ∩ S = ∅
proof:
:=
  disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty

name: exists_mem_kaplanskySet_le
statement:
theorem exists_mem_kaplanskySet_le {C : Set (Ideal R)} (hS : 0 ∉ S) (hC : C ⊆ kaplanskySet S)
      (hC₂ : IsChain (· ≤ ·) C) : ∃ P ∈ kaplanskySet S, ∀ J ∈ C, J ≤ P
proof:
:= by
  rcases C.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | ⟨_, hI⟩
  · exact ⟨⊥, by simpa [mem_kaplanskySet_iff, eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]⟩
  · refine ⟨sSup C, ?_, fun _ hz ↦ le_sSup hz⟩
    rw [mem_kaplanskySet_iff, eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
    intro x hx
    rcases (Submodule.mem_sSup_of_directed ⟨_, hI⟩ hC₂.directedOn).1 hx.1 with ⟨J, hJ₁, hJ₂⟩
    have hx₂ : (J : Set R) ∩ S ≠ ∅ := nonempty_iff_ne_empty.1 ⟨x, hJ₂, hx.2⟩
    exact hx₂ (mem_kaplanskySet_iff.mp (hC hJ₁))

name: exists_mem_kaplanskySet_eq_of_le
statement:
theorem exists_mem_kaplanskySet_eq_of_le (hS : 0 ∉ S) :
    ∃ P ∈ kaplanskySet S, ∀ I ∈ kaplanskySet S, P ≤ I → I = P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := zorn_le₀ (kaplanskySet S) (fun _ ↦ exists_mem_kaplanskySet_le hS)
  exact ⟨P, hP.1, fun _ hI H ↦ le_antisymm (hP.2 hI H) H⟩

name: span_notMem_kaplanskySet
statement:
theorem span_notMem_kaplanskySet {a : R} (ha : a ≠ 0)
      (H : ∀ I ≠ (⊥ : Ideal R), I.IsPrime → ∃ x ∈ I, Prime x) :
    span {a} ∉ kaplanskySet (closure {r : R | Prime r}).toSubsemigroup
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : 0 ∉ closure {r : R | Prime r} := fun h ↦ by
    rcases exists_multiset_of_mem_closure h with ⟨l, hl, hprod⟩
    exact not_prime_zero (hl 0 (Multiset.prod_eq_zero_iff.1 hprod))
  intro h
  rcases exists_mem_kaplanskySet_eq_of_le hzero with ⟨T, hT, hT₂⟩
  have hT₃ : T ≠ ⊥ := fun h₂ ↦ ha (span_singleton_eq_bot.1 ((h₂ ▸ hT₂) _ h zero_le))
  have Tpri := isPrime_of_maximally_disjoint T _ hT (fun J hJ H ↦ hJ.ne (hT₂ J H hJ.le).symm)
  rcases (H T) hT₃ Tpri with ⟨x, H₃, H₄⟩
  rw [mem_kaplanskySet_iff, eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem] at hT
  exact hT x ⟨H₃, subset_closure H₄⟩

name: of_exists_prime_mem_of_isPrime
statement:
theorem of_exists_prime_mem_of_isPrime
    (H : ∀ I ≠ (⊥ : Ideal R), I.IsPrime → ∃ x ∈ I, Prime x) : UniqueFactorizationMonoid R
proof:
:= by
  refine UniqueFactorizationMonoid.of_exists_prime_factors fun a ha ↦ ?_
  have ha₂ := span_notMem_kaplanskySet ha H
  rw [mem_kaplanskySet_iff] at ha₂
  rcases nonempty_iff_ne_empty.2 ha₂ with ⟨x, hx, hx₂⟩
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := mem_span_singleton'.1 hx
  rw [← hb, mul_comm] at hx₂
  have hsubset : closure {r : R | Prime r} ≤ closure {r : R | IsUnit r ∨ Prime r} :=
    closure_mono (by grind)
  have := divisor_closure_eq_closure _ _ (hsubset hx₂)
  clear ha ha₂ hx hb hx₂
  induction this using closure_induction with
  | mem z hz =>
      rcases hz with h | h
      · exact ⟨∅, by simpa using (associated_one_iff_isUnit.2 h).symm⟩
      · exact ⟨{z}, by simpa⟩
  | one => exact ⟨∅, by simp⟩
  | mul z₁ z₂ hz₁ hz₂ h₁ h₂ =>
      obtain ⟨S₁, hS₁pri, hS₁⟩ := h₁
      obtain ⟨S₂, hS₂pri, hS₂⟩ := h₂
      refine ⟨S₁ + S₂, by grind, ?_⟩
      rw [Multiset.prod_add]
      exact hS₁.mul_mul hS₂

name: factorization_eq_count
statement:
theorem factorization_eq_count {n p : α} :
    factorization n p = Multiset.count p (normalizedFactors n)
proof: := by simp [factorization]

name: factorization_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem factorization_zero : factorization (0 : α) = 0
proof: := by simp [factorization]

name: factorization_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem factorization_one : factorization (1 : α) = 0
proof: := by simp [factorization]

name: support_factorization
statement:
@[simp]
theorem support_factorization {n : α} :
    (factorization n).support = (normalizedFactors n).toFinset
proof:
:= by
  simp [factorization, Multiset.toFinsupp_support]

name: factorization_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem factorization_mul {a b : α} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    factorization (a * b) = factorization a + factorization b
proof:
:= by
  simp [factorization, normalizedFactors_mul ha hb]

name: factorization_pow
statement: theorem factorization_pow {x : α} {n : ℕ} : factorization (x ^ n) = n • factorization x
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp [factorization]

name: associated_of_factorization_eq
statement:
theorem associated_of_factorization_eq (a b : α) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (h : factorization a = factorization b) : Associated a b
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [factorization, AddEquiv.apply_eq_iff_eq] at h
  rwa [associated_iff_normalizedFactors_eq_normalizedFactors ha hb]

name: FactorSet.coe_add
statement:
theorem FactorSet.coe_add {a b : Multiset { a : Associates α // Irreducible a }} :
    (↑(a + b) : FactorSet α) = a + b
proof: := by norm_cast

name: FactorSet.sup_add_inf_eq_add
statement:
theorem FactorSet.sup_add_inf_eq_add [DecidableEq (Associates α)] :
    ∀ a b : FactorSet α, a ⊔ b + a ⊓ b = a + b
  | ⊤, b => show ⊤ ⊔ b + ⊤ ⊓ b = ⊤ + b by simp
  | a, ⊤ => show a ⊔ ⊤ + a ⊓ ⊤ = a + ⊤ by simp
  | WithTop.some a, WithTop.some b =>
    show (a : FactorSet α) ⊔ b + (a : FactorSet α) ⊓ b = a + b by
      rw [← WithTop.coe_sup, ← WithTop.coe_inf, ← WithTop.coe_add, ← WithTop.coe_add,
        WithTop.coe_eq_coe]
      exact Multiset.union_add_inter _ _

/
  or `0` if there is none. -/
def FactorSet.prod : FactorSet α → Associates α
  | ⊤ => 0
  | WithTop.some s => (s.map (↑)).prod

@[simp]

name: prod_top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem prod_top : (⊤ : FactorSet α).prod = 0
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: prod_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem prod_coe {s : Multiset { a : Associates α // Irreducible a }} :
    FactorSet.prod (s : FactorSet α) = (s.map (↑)).prod
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: prod_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem prod_add : ∀ a b : FactorSet α, (a + b).prod = a.prod * b.prod
  | ⊤, b => show (⊤ + b).prod = (⊤ : FactorSet α).prod * b.prod by simp
  | a, ⊤ => show (a + ⊤).prod = a.prod * (⊤ : FactorSet α).prod by simp
  | WithTop.some a, WithTop.some b => by
    rw [← FactorSet.coe_add, prod_coe, prod_coe, prod_coe, Multiset.map_add, Multiset.prod_add]

@[gcongr]

name: prod_mono
statement:
@[gcongr]
theorem prod_mono : ∀ {a b : FactorSet α}, a ≤ b → a.prod ≤ b.prod
  | ⊤, b, h => by
    have : b = ⊤
proof:
:= top_unique h
    rw [this, prod_top]
  | a, ⊤, _ => show a.prod ≤ (⊤ : FactorSet α).prod by simp
  | WithTop.some _, WithTop.some _, h =>
    prod_le_prod <| Multiset.map_le_map <| WithTop.coe_le_coe.1 <| h

name: FactorSet.prod_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem FactorSet.prod_eq_zero_iff [IsCancelMulZero α] [Nontrivial α] (p : FactorSet α) :
    p.prod = 0 ↔ p = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  unfold FactorSet at p
  induction p  
  · simp only [Associates.prod_top]
  · rw [prod_coe, Multiset.prod_eq_zero_iff, Multiset.mem_map, eq_false WithTop.coe_ne_top,
      iff_false, not_exists]
    exact fun a => not_and_of_not_right _ a.prop.ne_zero

name: count_some
statement:
@[simp]
theorem count_some (hp : Irreducible p) (s : Multiset _) :
    count p (WithTop.some s) = s.count ⟨p, hp⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp only [count, dite_eq_left hp, bcount]

name: count_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem count_zero (hp : Irreducible p) : count p (0 : FactorSet α) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [count, dite_eq_left hp, bcount, Multiset.count_zero]

name: count_reducible
statement: theorem count_reducible (hp : ¬Irreducible p) : count p = 0
proof: := dite_eq_right hp

name: factorSetMem_eq_mem
statement:
@[simp]
theorem factorSetMem_eq_mem (p : Associates α) (s : FactorSet α) : FactorSetMem s p = (p ∈ s)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: mem_factorSet_top
statement: theorem mem_factorSet_top {p : Associates α} {hp : Irreducible p} : p ∈ (⊤ : FactorSet α)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [Membership.mem]; dsimp only [FactorSetMem]; split_ifs; exact trivial

name: mem_factorSet_some
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [Membership.mem]; dsimp only [FactorSetMem]; split_ifs; rfl

name: reducible_notMem_factorSet
statement:
theorem reducible_notMem_factorSet {p : Associates α} (hp : ¬Irreducible p) (s : FactorSet α) :
    p ∉ s
proof:
:= fun h ↦ by
  rwa [← factorSetMem_eq_mem, FactorSetMem, dite_eq_right hp] at h

name: irreducible_of_mem_factorSet
statement:
theorem irreducible_of_mem_factorSet {p : Associates α} {s : FactorSet α} (h : p ∈ s) :
    Irreducible p
proof:
:=
  by_contra fun hp ↦ reducible_notMem_factorSet hp s h

name: FactorSet.unique
statement: theorem FactorSet.unique [Nontrivial α] {p q : FactorSet α} (h : p.prod = q.prod) : p = q
proof:
:= by
  
  unfold FactorSet at p q
  induction p <;> induction q
  · rfl
  · rw [eq_comm, ← FactorSet.prod_eq_zero_iff, ← h, Associates.prod_top]
  · rw [← FactorSet.prod_eq_zero_iff, h, Associates.prod_top]
  · congr 1
    rw [← Multiset.map_eq_map Subtype.coe_injective]
    apply unique' _ _ h <;>
      · intro a ha
        obtain ⟨⟨a', irred⟩, -, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp ha
        rwa [Subtype.coe_mk]

name: map_subtype_coe_factors'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_subtype_coe_factors' {a : α} :
    (factors' a).map (↑) = (factors a).map Associates.mk
proof:
:= by
  simp [factors', Multiset.map_pmap, Multiset.pmap_eq_map]

name: factors'_cong
statement: theorem factors'_cong {a b : α} (h : a ~ᵤ b) : factors' a = factors' b
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hb := eq_or_ne b 0
  · rw [associated_zero_iff_eq_zero] at h
    rw [h]
  have ha : a ≠ 0 := by
    contrapose hb with ha
    rw [← associated_zero_iff_eq_zero, ← ha]
    exact h.symm
  rw [← Multiset.map_eq_map Subtype.coe_injective, map_subtype_coe_factors',
    map_subtype_coe_factors', ← rel_associated_iff_map_eq_map]
  exact
    factors_unique irreducible_of_factor irreducible_of_factor
      ((factors_prod ha).trans <| h.trans <| (factors_prod hb).symm)

name: factors_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem factors_zero : (0 : Associates α).factors = ⊤
proof:
:=
  dite_eq_left rfl

name: factors_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem factors_mk (a : α) (h : a ≠ 0) : (Associates.mk a).factors = factors' a
proof:
:= by
  apply dite_eq_right
  apply mt mk_eq_zero.1 h

name: factors_prod
statement:
@[simp]
theorem factors_prod (a : Associates α) : a.factors.prod = a
proof:
:= by
  rcases Associates.mk_surjective a with ⟨a, rfl⟩
  rcases eq_or_ne a 0 with rfl | ha
  · simp
  · simp [ha, prod_mk, mk_eq_mk_iff_associated, UniqueFactorizationMonoid.factors_prod]

name: prod_factors
statement:
@[simp]
theorem prod_factors [Nontrivial α] (s : FactorSet α) : s.prod.factors = s
proof:
:=
  FactorSet.unique <| factors_prod _

name: factors_subsingleton
statement:
@[nontriviality]
theorem factors_subsingleton [Subsingleton α] {a : Associates α} : a.factors = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have : Subsingleton (Associates α) := inferInstance
  convert! factors_zero

name: factors_eq_top_iff_zero
statement: theorem factors_eq_top_iff_zero {a : Associates α} : a.factors = ⊤ ↔ a = 0
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality α
  exact ⟨fun h ↦ by rwa [← factors_prod a, FactorSet.prod_eq_zero_iff], fun h ↦ h ▸ factors_zero⟩

name: factors_eq_some_iff_ne_zero
statement:
theorem factors_eq_some_iff_ne_zero {a : Associates α} :
    (∃ s : Multiset { p : Associates α // Irreducible p }, a.factors = s) ↔ a ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [@eq_comm _ a.factors, ← WithTop.ne_top_iff_exists]
  exact factors_eq_top_iff_zero.not

name: eq_of_factors_eq_factors
statement: theorem eq_of_factors_eq_factors {a b : Associates α} (h : a.factors = b.factors) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  have : a.factors.prod = b.factors.prod := by rw [h]
  rwa [factors_prod, factors_prod] at this

name: factors_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem factors_mul (a b : Associates α) : (a * b).factors = a.factors + b.factors
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality α
  refine FactorSet.unique <| eq_of_factors_eq_factors ?_
  rw [prod_add, factors_prod, factors_prod, factors_prod]

name: factors_mono
statement:
@[gcongr]
theorem factors_mono : ∀ {a b : Associates α}, a ≤ b → a.factors ≤ b.factors
  | s, t, ⟨d, eq⟩ => by rw [eq, factors_mul]; exact le_add_of_nonneg_right bot_le

@[simp]

name: factors_le
statement:
@[simp]
theorem factors_le {a b : Associates α} : a.factors ≤ b.factors ↔ a ≤ b
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, factors_mono⟩
  have : a.factors.prod ≤ b.factors.prod := prod_mono h
  rwa [factors_prod, factors_prod] at this

name: eq_factors_of_eq_counts
statement:
theorem eq_factors_of_eq_counts {a b : Associates α} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (h : ∀ p : Associates α, Irreducible p → p.count a.factors = p.count b.factors) :
    a.factors = b.factors
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨sa, h_sa⟩ := factors_eq_some_iff_ne_zero.mpr ha
  obtain ⟨sb, h_sb⟩ := factors_eq_some_iff_ne_zero.mpr hb
  simp_all only [count_some, WithTop.coe_eq_coe]
  ext
  grind

name: eq_of_eq_counts
statement:
theorem eq_of_eq_counts {a b : Associates α} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (h : ∀ p : Associates α, Irreducible p → p.count a.factors = p.count b.factors) : a = b
proof:
:=
  eq_of_factors_eq_factors (eq_factors_of_eq_counts ha hb h)

name: count_le_count_of_factors_le
statement:
theorem count_le_count_of_factors_le {a b p : Associates α} (hb : b ≠ 0) (hp : Irreducible p)
    (h : a.factors ≤ b.factors) : p.count a.factors ≤ p.count b.factors
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : a = 0
  · simp_all
  obtain ⟨sa, h_sa⟩ := factors_eq_some_iff_ne_zero.mpr ha
  obtain ⟨sb, h_sb⟩ := factors_eq_some_iff_ne_zero.mpr hb
  rw [h_sa, h_sb] at h ⊢
  rw [count_some hp, count_some hp]; rw [WithTop.coe_le_coe] at h
  exact Multiset.count_le_of_le _ h

name: count_le_count_of_le
statement:
theorem count_le_count_of_le {a b p : Associates α} (hb : b ≠ 0) (hp : Irreducible p) (h : a ≤ b) :
    p.count a.factors ≤ p.count b.factors
proof:
:=
  count_le_count_of_factors_le hb hp <| factors_mono h

name: prod_le
statement: theorem prod_le [Nontrivial α] {a b : FactorSet α} : a.prod ≤ b.prod ↔ a ≤ b
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, prod_mono⟩
  have : a.prod.factors ≤ b.prod.factors := factors_mono h
  rwa [prod_factors, prod_factors] at this

name: sup_mul_inf
statement: theorem sup_mul_inf (a b : Associates α) : (a ⊔ b) * (a ⊓ b) = a * b
proof:
:=
  show (a.factors ⊔ b.factors).prod * (a.factors ⊓ b.factors).prod = a * b by
    nontriviality α
    refine eq_of_factors_eq_factors ?_
    rw [← prod_add, prod_factors, factors_mul, FactorSet.sup_add_inf_eq_add]

name: dvd_of_mem_factors
statement:
theorem dvd_of_mem_factors {a p : Associates α} (hm : p ∈ factors a) :
    p ∣ a
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne a 0 with rfl | ha0
  · exact dvd_zero p
  obtain ⟨a0, nza, ha'⟩ := exists_non_zero_rep ha0
  rw [← Associates.factors_prod a]
  rw [← ha', factors_mk a0 nza] at hm ⊢
  rw [prod_coe]
  apply Multiset.dvd_prod; apply Multiset.mem_map.mpr
  exact ⟨⟨p, irreducible_of_mem_factorSet hm⟩, mem_factorSet_some.mp hm, rfl⟩

name: dvd_of_mem_factors'
statement:
theorem dvd_of_mem_factors' {a : α} {p : Associates α} {hp : Irreducible p} {hz : a ≠ 0}
    (h_mem : Subtype.mk p hp ∈ factors' a) : p ∣ Associates.mk a
proof:
:= by
  have := Classical.decEq (Associates α)
  apply dvd_of_mem_factors
  rw [factors_mk _ hz]
  apply mem_factorSet_some.2 h_mem

name: mem_factors'_of_dvd
statement:
theorem mem_factors'_of_dvd {a p : α} (ha0 : a ≠ 0) (hp : Irreducible p) (hd : p ∣ a) :
    Subtype.mk (Associates.mk p) (irreducible_mk.2 hp) ∈ factors' a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hpq⟩ := exists_mem_factors_of_dvd ha0 hp hd
  apply Multiset.mem_pmap.mpr; use q; use hq
  exact Subtype.ext (Eq.symm (mk_eq_mk_iff_associated.mpr hpq))

name: mem_factors'_iff_dvd
statement:
theorem mem_factors'_iff_dvd {a p : α} (ha0 : a ≠ 0) (hp : Irreducible p) :
    Subtype.mk (Associates.mk p) (irreducible_mk.2 hp) ∈ factors' a ↔ p ∣ a
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [← mk_dvd_mk]
    apply dvd_of_mem_factors'
    apply ha0
  · apply mem_factors'_of_dvd ha0 hp

name: mem_factors_of_dvd
statement:
theorem mem_factors_of_dvd {a p : α} (ha0 : a ≠ 0) (hp : Irreducible p) (hd : p ∣ a) :
    Associates.mk p ∈ factors (Associates.mk a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [factors_mk _ ha0]
  exact mem_factorSet_some.mpr (mem_factors'_of_dvd ha0 hp hd)

name: mem_factors_iff_dvd
statement:
theorem mem_factors_iff_dvd {a p : α} (ha0 : a ≠ 0) (hp : Irreducible p) :
    Associates.mk p ∈ factors (Associates.mk a) ↔ p ∣ a
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [← mk_dvd_mk]
    apply dvd_of_mem_factors
  · apply mem_factors_of_dvd ha0 hp

name: exists_prime_dvd_of_not_inf_one
statement:
theorem exists_prime_dvd_of_not_inf_one {a b : α} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (h : Associates.mk a ⊓ Associates.mk b ≠ 1) : ∃ p : α, Prime p ∧ p ∣ a ∧ p ∣ b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hz : factors (Associates.mk a) ⊓ factors (Associates.mk b) ≠ 0 := by
    contrapose h with hf
    change (factors (Associates.mk a) ⊓ factors (Associates.mk b)).prod = 1
    rw [hf]
    exact Multiset.prod_zero
  rw [factors_mk a ha, factors_mk b hb, ← WithTop.coe_inf] at hz
  obtain ⟨⟨p0, p0_irr⟩, p0_mem⟩ := Multiset.exists_mem_of_ne_zero ((mt WithTop.coe_eq_coe.mpr) hz)
  rw [Multiset.inf_eq_inter] at p0_mem
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ : ∃ p, Associates.mk p = p0 := Quot.exists_rep p0
  refine ⟨p, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← UniqueFactorizationMonoid.irreducible_iff_prime, ← irreducible_mk]
    exact p0_irr
  · apply dvd_of_mk_le_mk
    apply dvd_of_mem_factors' (Multiset.mem_inter.mp p0_mem).left
    apply ha
  · apply dvd_of_mk_le_mk
    apply dvd_of_mem_factors' (Multiset.mem_inter.mp p0_mem).right
    apply hb

name: coprime_iff_inf_one
statement:
theorem coprime_iff_inf_one {a b : α} (ha0 : a ≠ 0) (hb0 : b ≠ 0) :
    Associates.mk a ⊓ Associates.mk b = 1 ↔ ∀ {d : α}, d ∣ a → d ∣ b → ¬Prime d
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hg p ha hb hp
    refine (Associates.prime_mk.mpr hp).not_isUnit (isUnit_of_dvd_one ?_)
    rw [← hg]
    exact le_inf (mk_le_mk_of_dvd ha) (mk_le_mk_of_dvd hb)
  · contrapose
    intro hg hc
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hpa, hpb⟩ := exists_prime_dvd_of_not_inf_one ha0 hb0 hg
    exact hc hpa hpb hp

name: factors_self
statement:
theorem factors_self [Nontrivial α] {p : Associates α} (hp : Irreducible p) :
    p.factors = WithTop.some {⟨p, hp⟩}
proof:
:=
  FactorSet.unique
    (by rw [factors_prod, FactorSet.prod.eq_def]; dsimp; rw [prod_singleton])

name: factors_prime_pow
statement:
theorem factors_prime_pow [Nontrivial α] {p : Associates α} (hp : Irreducible p) (k : ℕ) :
    factors (p ^ k) = WithTop.some (Multiset.replicate k ⟨p, hp⟩)
proof:
:=
  FactorSet.unique
    (by
      rw [Associates.factors_prod, FactorSet.prod.eq_def]
      dsimp; rw [Multiset.map_replicate, Multiset.prod_replicate, Subtype.coe_mk])

name: prime_pow_le_iff_le_bcount
statement:
theorem prime_pow_le_iff_le_bcount [DecidableEq (Associates α)] {m p : Associates α}
    (h₁ : m ≠ 0) (h₂ : Irreducible p) {k : ℕ} : p ^ k ≤ m ↔ k ≤ bcount ⟨p, h₂⟩ m.factors
proof:
:= by
  rcases Associates.exists_non_zero_rep h₁ with ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩
  have := nontrivial_of_ne _ _ hm
  rw [bcount.eq_def, factors_mk, Multiset.le_count_iff_replicate_le, ← factors_le,
    factors_prime_pow, factors_mk, WithTop.coe_le_coe] <;> assumption

name: factors_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem factors_one [Nontrivial α] : factors (1 : Associates α) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply FactorSet.unique
  rw [Associates.factors_prod]
  exact Multiset.prod_zero

name: pow_factors
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pow_factors [Nontrivial α] {a : Associates α} {k : ℕ} :
    (a ^ k).factors = k • a.factors
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => rw [zero_nsmul, pow_zero]; exact factors_one
  | succ n h => rw [pow_succ, succ_nsmul, factors_mul, h]

name: prime_pow_dvd_iff_le
statement:
theorem prime_pow_dvd_iff_le {m p : Associates α} (h₁ : m ≠ 0) (h₂ : Irreducible p) {k : ℕ} :
    p ^ k ≤ m ↔ k ≤ count p m.factors
proof:
:= by
  rw [count, dite_eq_left h₂, prime_pow_le_iff_le_bcount h₁]

name: le_of_count_ne_zero
statement:
theorem le_of_count_ne_zero {m p : Associates α} (h0 : m ≠ 0) (hp : Irreducible p) :
    count p m.factors ≠ 0 → p ≤ m
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pos_iff_ne_zero]
  intro h
  rw [← pow_one p]
  apply (prime_pow_dvd_iff_le h0 hp).2
  simpa only

name: count_ne_zero_iff_dvd
statement:
theorem count_ne_zero_iff_dvd {a p : α} (ha0 : a ≠ 0) (hp : Irreducible p) :
    (Associates.mk p).count (Associates.mk a).factors ≠ 0 ↔ p ∣ a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Associates.mk_le_mk_iff_dvd]
  refine
    ⟨fun h =>
      Associates.le_of_count_ne_zero (Associates.mk_ne_zero.mpr ha0)
        (Associates.irreducible_mk.mpr hp) h,
      fun h => ?_⟩
  rw [← pow_one (Associates.mk p),
    Associates.prime_pow_dvd_iff_le (Associates.mk_ne_zero.mpr ha0)
      (Associates.irreducible_mk.mpr hp)] at h
  exact (zero_lt_one.trans_le h).ne'

name: count_self
statement:
theorem count_self [Nontrivial α] {p : Associates α}
    (hp : Irreducible p) : p.count p.factors = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [factors_self hp, Associates.count_some hp]

name: count_eq_zero_of_ne
statement:
theorem count_eq_zero_of_ne {p q : Associates α} (hp : Irreducible p)
    (hq : Irreducible q) (h : p ≠ q) : p.count q.factors = 0
proof:
:=
  not_ne_iff.mp fun h' ↦ h <| associated_iff_eq.mp <| hp.associated_of_dvd hq <|
    le_of_count_ne_zero hq.ne_zero hp h'

name: count_mul
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a0, nza, rfl⟩ := exists_non_zero_rep ha
  obtain ⟨b0, nzb, rfl⟩ := exists_non_zero_rep hb
  rw [factors_mul, factors_mk a0 nza, factors_mk b0 nzb, ← FactorSet.coe_add, count_some hp,
    Multiset.count_add, count_some hp, count_some hp]

name: count_of_coprime
proof:
:= by
  rw [or_iff_not_imp_left, ← Ne]
  intro hca
  contrapose! hab with hcb
  exact ⟨p, le_of_count_ne_zero ha hp hca, le_of_count_ne_zero hb hp hcb,
    UniqueFactorizationMonoid.irreducible_iff_prime.mp hp⟩

name: count_mul_of_coprime
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : a = 0
  · simp [ha]
  rcases count_of_coprime ha hb hab hp with hz | hb0; · tauto
  apply Or.intro_right
  rw [count_mul ha hb hp, hb0, add_zero]

name: count_mul_of_coprime'
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : a = 0
  · simp [ha]
  by_cases hb : b = 0
  · simp [hb]
  rw [count_mul ha hb hp]
  rcases count_of_coprime ha hb hab hp with ha0 | hb0
  · apply Or.intro_right
    rw [ha0, zero_add]
  · apply Or.intro_left
    rw [hb0, add_zero]

name: dvd_count_of_dvd_count_mul
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : a = 0
  · simpa [*] using habk
  rcases count_of_coprime ha hb hab hp with hz | h
  · rw [hz]
    exact dvd_zero k
  · rw [count_mul ha hb hp, h] at habk
    exact habk

name: count_pow
statement:
theorem count_pow [Nontrivial α] {a : Associates α} (ha : a ≠ 0)
    {p : Associates α} (hp : Irreducible p) (k : ℕ) :
    count p (a ^ k).factors = k * count p a.factors
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero, factors_one, zero_mul, count_zero hp]
  | succ n h => rw [pow_succ', count_mul ha (pow_ne_zero _ ha) hp, h]; ring

name: dvd_count_pow
statement:
theorem dvd_count_pow [Nontrivial α] {a : Associates α} (ha : a ≠ 0)
    {p : Associates α} (hp : Irreducible p) (k : ℕ) : k ∣ count p (a ^ k).factors
proof:
:= by
  rw [count_pow ha hp]
  apply dvd_mul_right

name: is_pow_of_dvd_count
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality α
  obtain ⟨a0, hz, rfl⟩ := exists_non_zero_rep ha
  rw [factors_mk a0 hz] at hk
  have hk' : ∀ p, p ∈ factors' a0 → k ∣ (factors' a0).count p := by
    rintro p -
    have pp : p = ⟨p.val, p.2⟩ := by simp only [Subtype.coe_eta]
    rw [pp, ← count_some p.2]
    exact hk p.val p.2
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := Multiset.exists_smul_of_dvd_count _ hk'
  use FactorSet.prod (u : FactorSet α)
  apply eq_of_factors_eq_factors
  rw [pow_factors, prod_factors, factors_mk a0 hz, hu]
  exact WithBot.coe_nsmul u k

name: eq_pow_count_factors_of_dvd_pow
statement:
theorem eq_pow_count_factors_of_dvd_pow {p a : Associates α}
    (hp : Irreducible p) {n : ℕ} (h : a ∣ p ^ n) : a = p ^ p.count a.factors
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality α
  have hph := pow_ne_zero n hp.ne_zero
  have ha := ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero hph h
  apply eq_of_eq_counts ha (pow_ne_zero _ hp.ne_zero)
  have eq_zero_of_ne : ∀ q : Associates α, Irreducible q → q ≠ p → _ = 0 := fun q hq h' =>
    Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero <| by
      convert! count_le_count_of_le hph hq h
      symm
      rw [count_pow hp.ne_zero hq, count_eq_zero_of_ne hq hp h', mul_zero]
  intro q hq
  rw [count_pow hp.ne_zero hq]
  by_cases h : q = p
  · rw [h, count_self hp, mul_one]
  · rw [count_eq_zero_of_ne hq hp h, mul_zero, eq_zero_of_ne q hq h]

name: count_factors_eq_find_of_dvd_pow
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine Nat.find_le ⟨1, ?_⟩
    rw [mul_one]
    symm
    exact eq_pow_count_factors_of_dvd_pow hp h
  · have hph := pow_ne_zero (@Nat.find (fun n => a ∣ p ^ n) _ ⟨n, h⟩) hp.ne_zero
    rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial α with hα | hα
    · simp [eq_iff_true_of_subsingleton] at hph
    convert! count_le_count_of_le hph hp (@Nat.find_spec (fun n => a ∣ p ^ n) _ ⟨n, h⟩)
    rw [count_pow hp.ne_zero hp, count_self hp, mul_one]

name: eq_pow_of_mul_eq_pow
statement:
theorem eq_pow_of_mul_eq_pow {a b c : Associates α} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (hab : ∀ d, d ∣ a → d ∣ b → ¬Prime d) {k : ℕ} (h : a * b = c ^ k) :
    ∃ d : Associates α, a = d ^ k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  nontriviality α
  by_cases hk0 : k = 0
  · use 1
    rw [hk0, pow_zero] at h ⊢
    apply (mul_eq_one.1 h).1
  · refine is_pow_of_dvd_count ha fun p hp ↦ ?_
    apply dvd_count_of_dvd_count_mul hb hp hab
    rw [h]
    apply dvd_count_pow _ hp
    rintro rfl
    rw [zero_pow hk0] at h
    cases mul_eq_zero.mp h <;> contradiction

name: eq_pow_find_of_dvd_irreducible_pow
statement:
theorem eq_pow_find_of_dvd_irreducible_pow {a p : Associates α} (hp : Irreducible p)
    [∀ n : ℕ, Decidable (a ∣ p ^ n)] {n : ℕ} (h : a ∣ p ^ n) :
    a = p ^ @Nat.find (fun n => a ∣ p ^ n) _ ⟨n, h⟩
proof:
:= by
  classical rw [count_factors_eq_find_of_dvd_pow hp, ← eq_pow_count_factors_of_dvd_pow hp h]
  exact h

name: extendedHom_quotientMk
statement:
@[simp]
lemma extendedHom_quotientMk (α : (FractionalIdeal A⁰ (FractionRing A))ˣ) :
    extendedHom A B (QuotientGroup.mk α) = QuotientGroup.mk
      (Units.map (FractionalIdeal.extendedHom (FractionRing B) B).toMonoidHom α)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: extendedHom_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem extendedHom_mk (I : (FractionalIdeal A⁰ (FractionRing A))ˣ) :
    extendedHom A B (ClassGroup.mk _ I) = ClassGroup.mk _
        (Units.map (FractionalIdeal.extendedHom (FractionRing B) B).toMonoidHom I)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ClassGroup.Quot_mk_eq_mk, ← ClassGroup.Quot_mk_eq_mk]
  exact extendedHom_quotientMk A B I

name: extendedIdeal_extendedIdeal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem extendedIdeal_extendedIdeal (C : Type*) [CommRing C] [IsDomain C] [Algebra B C]
    [Algebra A C] [IsScalarTower A B C] [Module.IsTorsionFree B C]
    [Module.IsTorsionFree A C] (I : (Ideal A)⁰) :
    extendedIdeal B C (extendedIdeal A B I) = extendedIdeal A C I
proof:
:= by
  simp [Ideal.map_map, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq A B C]

name: extendedHom_mk0'
statement:
theorem extendedHom_mk0' [IsDomain B] (I : (Ideal A)⁰) :
    extendedHom A B (ClassGroup.mk0 I) =
      ClassGroup.mk _ (Units.map (FractionalIdeal.extendedHom (FractionRing B) B).toMonoidHom
      (FractionalIdeal.mk0 (FractionRing A) I))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ClassGroup.mk_mk0 (FractionRing A), extendedHom_mk]

name: extendedHom_mk0
statement:
lemma extendedHom_mk0 (I : (Ideal A)⁰) :
    extendedHom A B (ClassGroup.mk0 I) = ClassGroup.mk0 (extendedIdeal A B I)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk0_eq_quotientMk, mk0_eq_quotientMk, extendedHom_quotientMk]
  congr; ext : 1
  exact FractionalIdeal.extendedHom_coeIdeal_eq_map (L := FractionRing B) (B := B) _

name: extendedHom_comp_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem extendedHom_comp_apply (x : ClassGroup A) :
      extendedHom B C (extendedHom A B x) = extendedHom A C x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨I, rfl⟩ := ClassGroup.mk0_surjective x
  rw [extendedHom_mk0 A B I, extendedHom_mk0 B C (extendedIdeal A B I),
    extendedHom_mk0 A C I, extendedIdeal_extendedIdeal]

name: extendedHom_comp
statement: theorem extendedHom_comp : (extendedHom B C).comp (extendedHom A B) = extendedHom A C
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  exact extendedHom_comp_apply A B C x

name: extendedHom_eq_one_of_forall_isPrincipal
statement:
theorem extendedHom_eq_one_of_forall_isPrincipal
    (h : ∀ I : (Ideal A), (I.map (algebraMap A B)).IsPrincipal) : extendedHom A B = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  obtain ⟨I, rfl⟩ := ClassGroup.mk0_surjective x
  rw [extendedHom_mk0, MonoidHom.one_apply]
  exact (ClassGroup.mk0_eq_one_iff (extendedIdeal A B I).2).mpr (by simpa using h I)

name: coe_toPrincipalIdeal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_toPrincipalIdeal (x : Kˣ) :
    (toPrincipalIdeal R K x : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) = spanSingleton _ (x : K)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [toPrincipalIdeal]; rfl

name: toPrincipalIdeal_eq_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toPrincipalIdeal_eq_iff {I : (FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)ˣ} {x : Kˣ} :
    toPrincipalIdeal R K x = I ↔ spanSingleton R⁰ (x : K) = I
proof:
:= by
  simp only [toPrincipalIdeal]; exact Units.ext_iff

name: mem_principal_ideals_iff
statement:
theorem mem_principal_ideals_iff {I : (FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)ˣ} :
    I ∈ (toPrincipalIdeal R K).range ↔ ∃ x : K, spanSingleton R⁰ x = I
proof:
:= by
  simp only [MonoidHom.mem_range, toPrincipalIdeal_eq_iff]
  constructor <;> rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
  · exact ⟨x, hx⟩
  · refine ⟨Units.mk0 x ?_, hx⟩
    rintro rfl
    simp [I.ne_zero.symm] at hx

name: ClassGroup.mk_def
statement:
lemma ClassGroup.mk_def (I : (FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)ˣ) :
    ClassGroup.mk K I =
      (QuotientGroup.mk' (toPrincipalIdeal R (FractionRing R)).range)
        (Units.map (FractionalIdeal.canonicalEquiv R⁰ K (FractionRing R)) I)
proof: := rfl

name: ClassGroup.Quot_mk_eq_mk
statement:
theorem ClassGroup.Quot_mk_eq_mk (I : (FractionalIdeal R⁰ (FractionRing R))ˣ) :
    Quot.mk _ I = ClassGroup.mk (FractionRing R) I
proof:
:= by
  rw [ClassGroup.mk_def, canonicalEquiv_self, RingEquiv.coe_monoidHom_refl, Units.map_id,
    MonoidHom.id_apply, QuotientGroup.mk'_apply]
  rfl

name: ClassGroup.mk_eq_mk
statement:
theorem ClassGroup.mk_eq_mk {I J : (FractionalIdeal R⁰ <| FractionRing R)ˣ} :
    ClassGroup.mk (FractionRing R) I = ClassGroup.mk (FractionRing R) J ↔
      ∃ x : (FractionRing R)ˣ, I * toPrincipalIdeal R (FractionRing R) x = J
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_def, mk_def, QuotientGroup.mk'_eq_mk']
  simp [RingEquiv.coe_monoidHom_refl, MonoidHom.mem_range, -toPrincipalIdeal_eq_iff]

name: ClassGroup.mk_eq_mk_of_coe_ideal
statement:
theorem ClassGroup.mk_eq_mk_of_coe_ideal {I J : (FractionalIdeal R⁰ <| FractionRing R)ˣ}
    {I' J' : Ideal R} (hI : (I : FractionalIdeal R⁰ <| FractionRing R) = I')
    (hJ : (J : FractionalIdeal R⁰ <| FractionRing R) = J') :
    ClassGroup.mk (FractionRing R) I = ClassGroup.mk (FractionRing R) J ↔
      ∃ x y : R, x ≠ 0 ∧ y ≠ 0 ∧ Ideal.span {x} * I' = Ideal.span {y} * J'
proof:
:= by
  rw [ClassGroup.mk_eq_mk]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
    rw [Units.val_mul, hI, coe_toPrincipalIdeal, mul_comm,
      spanSingleton_mul_coeIdeal_eq_coeIdeal] at hJ
    exact ⟨_, _, sec_fst_ne_zero x.ne_zero,
      sec_snd_ne_zero (R := R) le_rfl (x : FractionRing R), hJ⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, y, hx, hy, h⟩
    have : IsUnit (mk' (FractionRing R) x ⟨y, mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero hy⟩) := by
      simpa only [isUnit_iff_ne_zero, ne_eq, mk'_eq_zero_iff_eq_zero] using hx
    refine ⟨this.unit, ?_⟩
    rw [mul_comm, ← Units.val_inj, Units.val_mul, coe_toPrincipalIdeal]
    convert!
      (mk'_mul_coeIdeal_eq_coeIdeal (FractionRing R) <| mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero hy).2 h

name: ClassGroup.mk_eq_one_of_coe_ideal
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_one (ClassGroup.mk (R := R) (K := FractionRing R)),
    ClassGroup.mk_eq_mk_of_coe_ideal hI]
  any_goals rfl
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, y, hx, hy, h⟩
    rw [Ideal.mul_top] at h
    rcases Ideal.mem_span_singleton_mul.mp ((Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _).mp h.ge) with
      ⟨i, _hi, rfl⟩
    rw [← Ideal.span_singleton_mul_span_singleton, Ideal.span_singleton_mul_right_inj hx] at h
    exact ⟨i, by grobner, h⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨1, x, one_ne_zero, hx, by rw [Ideal.span_singleton_one, Ideal.top_mul, Ideal.mul_top]⟩

name: ClassGroup.induction
proof:
:=
  QuotientGroup.induction_on x fun I => by
    have : I = (Units.mapEquiv (canonicalEquiv R⁰ K (FractionRing R)).toMulEquiv)
      (Units.mapEquiv (canonicalEquiv R⁰ (FractionRing R) K).toMulEquiv I) := by
      simp [← Units.val_inj]
    rw [congr_arg (QuotientGroup.mk (s := (toPrincipalIdeal R (FractionRing R)).range)) this]
    exact h _

name: ClassGroup.equiv_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ClassGroup.equiv_mk (K' : Type*) [Field K'] [Algebra R K'] [IsFractionRing R K']
    (I : (FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)ˣ) :
    ClassGroup.equiv K' (ClassGroup.mk K I) =
      QuotientGroup.mk' _ (Units.mapEquiv (↑(FractionalIdeal.canonicalEquiv R⁰ K K')) I)
proof:
:= by
  
  rw [ClassGroup.equiv, ClassGroup.mk_def]
  simp only [ClassGroup, QuotientGroup.congr_mk']
  congr
  rw [← Units.val_inj, Units.coe_mapEquiv, Units.coe_mapEquiv, Units.coe_map]
  exact FractionalIdeal.canonicalEquiv_canonicalEquiv _ _ _ _ _

name: ClassGroup.mk_canonicalEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ClassGroup.mk_canonicalEquiv (K' : Type*) [Field K'] [Algebra R K'] [IsFractionRing R K']
    (I : (FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)ˣ) :
    ClassGroup.mk K' (Units.map (↑(canonicalEquiv R⁰ K K')) I : (FractionalIdeal R⁰ K')ˣ) =
      ClassGroup.mk K I
proof:
:= by
  rw [ClassGroup.mk_def, ClassGroup.mk_def, ← MonoidHom.comp_apply (Units.map _),
      ← Units.map_comp, ← RingEquiv.coe_monoidHom_trans,
      FractionalIdeal.canonicalEquiv_trans_canonicalEquiv]

name: FractionalIdeal.coe_mk0
statement:
@[simp]
theorem FractionalIdeal.coe_mk0 [IsDedekindDomain R] (I : (Ideal R)⁰) :
    (FractionalIdeal.mk0 K I : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) = I
proof: := rfl

name: FractionalIdeal.canonicalEquiv_mk0
statement:
theorem FractionalIdeal.canonicalEquiv_mk0 [IsDedekindDomain R] (K' : Type*) [Field K']
    [Algebra R K'] [IsFractionRing R K'] (I : (Ideal R)⁰) :
    FractionalIdeal.canonicalEquiv R⁰ K K' (FractionalIdeal.mk0 K I) =
    FractionalIdeal.mk0 K' I
proof:
:= by
  simp only [FractionalIdeal.coe_mk0, FractionalIdeal.canonicalEquiv_coeIdeal]

name: FractionalIdeal.map_canonicalEquiv_mk0
statement:
@[simp]
theorem FractionalIdeal.map_canonicalEquiv_mk0 [IsDedekindDomain R] (K' : Type*) [Field K']
    [Algebra R K'] [IsFractionRing R K'] (I : (Ideal R)⁰) :
    Units.map (↑(FractionalIdeal.canonicalEquiv R⁰ K K')) (FractionalIdeal.mk0 K I) =
      FractionalIdeal.mk0 K' I
proof:
:=
  Units.ext (FractionalIdeal.canonicalEquiv_mk0 K K' I)

name: ClassGroup.mk_mk0
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ClassGroup.mk_mk0 [IsDedekindDomain R] (I : (Ideal R)⁰) :
    ClassGroup.mk K (FractionalIdeal.mk0 K I) = ClassGroup.mk0 I
proof:
:= by
  rw [ClassGroup.mk0, MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← ClassGroup.mk_canonicalEquiv K (FractionRing R),
    FractionalIdeal.map_canonicalEquiv_mk0]

name: ClassGroup.mk0_eq_quotientMk
statement:
theorem ClassGroup.mk0_eq_quotientMk [IsDedekindDomain R] (I : (Ideal R)⁰) :
    (ClassGroup.mk0 I : ClassGroup R) =
      QuotientGroup.mk (FractionalIdeal.mk0 (FractionRing R) I)
proof:
:=
  (ClassGroup.mk_mk0 (K := FractionRing R) I).symm.trans (ClassGroup.Quot_mk_eq_mk _).symm

name: ClassGroup.equiv_mk0
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ClassGroup.equiv_mk0 [IsDedekindDomain R] (I : (Ideal R)⁰) :
    ClassGroup.equiv K (ClassGroup.mk0 I) =
      QuotientGroup.mk' (toPrincipalIdeal R K).range (FractionalIdeal.mk0 K I)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ClassGroup.mk0, MonoidHom.comp_apply, ClassGroup.equiv_mk]
  congr 1
  simp [← Units.val_inj]

name: ClassGroup.mk0_eq_mk0_iff_exists_fraction_ring
statement:
theorem ClassGroup.mk0_eq_mk0_iff_exists_fraction_ring [IsDedekindDomain R] {I J : (Ideal R)⁰} :
    ClassGroup.mk0 I =
      ClassGroup.mk0 J ↔ ∃ (x : _) (_ : x ≠ (0 : K)), spanSingleton R⁰ x * I = J
proof:
:= by
  refine (ClassGroup.equiv K).injective.eq_iff.symm.trans ?_
  simp only [ClassGroup.equiv_mk0, QuotientGroup.mk'_eq_mk', mem_principal_ideals_iff,
    Units.ext_iff, Units.val_mul, FractionalIdeal.coe_mk0, exists_prop]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨X, ⟨x, hX⟩, hx⟩
    refine ⟨x, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rintro rfl; simp [X.ne_zero.symm] at hX
    simpa only [hX, mul_comm] using! hx
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, eq_J⟩
    refine ⟨Units.mk0 _ (spanSingleton_ne_zero_iff.mpr hx), ⟨x, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    simpa only [mul_comm] using! eq_J

name: ClassGroup.mk0_eq_mk0_iff
statement:
theorem ClassGroup.mk0_eq_mk0_iff [IsDedekindDomain R] {I J : (Ideal R)⁰} :
    ClassGroup.mk0 I = ClassGroup.mk0 J ↔
      ∃ (x y : R) (_hx : x ≠ 0) (_hy : y ≠ 0), Ideal.span {x} * (I : Ideal R) =
      Ideal.span {y} * J
proof:
:= by
  refine (ClassGroup.mk0_eq_mk0_iff_exists_fraction_ring (FractionRing R)).trans ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨z, hz, h⟩
    obtain ⟨x, ⟨y, hy⟩, rfl⟩ := IsLocalization.exists_mk'_eq R⁰ z
    refine ⟨x, y, ?_, mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mp hy, ?_⟩
    · rintro hx; apply hz
      rw [hx, IsFractionRing.mk'_eq_div, map_zero, zero_div]
    · exact (FractionalIdeal.mk'_mul_coeIdeal_eq_coeIdeal _ hy).mp h
  · rintro ⟨x, y, hx, hy, h⟩
    have hy' : y ∈ R⁰ := mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hy
    refine ⟨IsLocalization.mk' _ x ⟨y, hy'⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · contrapose hx
      rwa [mk'_eq_iff_eq_mul, zero_mul, ← (algebraMap R (FractionRing R)).map_zero,
        (IsFractionRing.injective R (FractionRing R)).eq_iff] at hx
    · exact (FractionalIdeal.mk'_mul_coeIdeal_eq_coeIdeal _ hy').mpr h

name: FractionalIdeal.isUnit_num
statement:
theorem FractionalIdeal.isUnit_num {I : FractionalIdeal R⁰ (FractionRing R)} :
    IsUnit (I.num : FractionalIdeal R⁰ (FractionRing R)) ↔ IsUnit I
proof:
:= by
  have hden0 : algebraMap R (FractionRing R) I.den ≠ 0 :=
    IsFractionRing.to_map_ne_zero_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors I.den.prop
  let u : (FractionRing R)ˣ := Units.mk0 (algebraMap R (FractionRing R) I.den) hden0
  have hdenUnit : IsUnit (spanSingleton R⁰ (algebraMap R (FractionRing R) I.den)) :=
    ⟨toPrincipalIdeal R (FractionRing R) u, by simp [u]⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hdenUnit
  rw [← den_mul_self_eq_num', ← hc, Units.isUnit_units_mul]

name: ClassGroup.integralRep_mem_nonZeroDivisors
statement:
theorem ClassGroup.integralRep_mem_nonZeroDivisors
    {I : FractionalIdeal R⁰ (FractionRing R)} (hI : I ≠ 0) :
    I.num ∈ (Ideal R)⁰
proof:
:= by
  rwa [mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero, ne_eq, FractionalIdeal.num_eq_zero_iff]

name: ClassGroup.mk0_integralRep
statement:
theorem ClassGroup.mk0_integralRep [IsDedekindDomain R]
    (I : (FractionalIdeal R⁰ (FractionRing R))ˣ) :
    ClassGroup.mk0 ⟨ClassGroup.integralRep I, ClassGroup.integralRep_mem_nonZeroDivisors I.ne_zero⟩
      = ClassGroup.mk (FractionRing R) I
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ClassGroup.mk_mk0 (FractionRing R), eq_comm, ClassGroup.mk_eq_mk]
  have fd_ne_zero : (algebraMap R (FractionRing R)) I.1.den ≠ 0 := by
    exact IsFractionRing.to_map_ne_zero_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors (SetLike.coe_mem _)
  refine ⟨Units.mk0 (algebraMap R _ I.1.den) fd_ne_zero, ?_⟩
  apply Units.ext
  rw [mul_comm, val_mul, coe_toPrincipalIdeal, val_mk0]
  exact FractionalIdeal.den_mul_self_eq_num' R⁰ (FractionRing R) I

name: ClassGroup.mk0_surjective
statement:
theorem ClassGroup.mk0_surjective [IsDedekindDomain R] :
    Function.Surjective (ClassGroup.mk0 : (Ideal R)⁰ → ClassGroup R)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨I⟩
  refine ⟨⟨ClassGroup.integralRep I.1, ClassGroup.integralRep_mem_nonZeroDivisors I.ne_zero⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [ClassGroup.mk0_integralRep, ClassGroup.Quot_mk_eq_mk]

name: ClassGroup.mk_eq_one_iff
statement:
theorem ClassGroup.mk_eq_one_iff {I : (FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)ˣ} :
    ClassGroup.mk K I = 1 ↔ (I : Submodule R K).IsPrincipal
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (ClassGroup.equiv K).injective.eq_iff]
  simp only [equiv_mk, canonicalEquiv_self, RingEquiv.coe_mulEquiv_refl, QuotientGroup.mk'_apply,
    map_one, QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff, MonoidHom.mem_range, Units.ext_iff,
    coe_toPrincipalIdeal, coe_mapEquiv, MulEquiv.refl_apply]
  refine ⟨fun ⟨x, hx⟩ => ⟨⟨x, by rw [← hx, coe_spanSingleton]⟩⟩, ?_⟩
  intro hI
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := @Submodule.IsPrincipal.principal _ _ _ _ _ _ hI
  have hx' : (I : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) = spanSingleton R⁰ x := by
    apply Subtype.coe_injective
    simp only [val_eq_coe, hx, coe_spanSingleton]
  refine ⟨Units.mk0 x ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x_eq; apply Units.ne_zero I; simp [hx', x_eq]
  · simp [hx']

name: FractionalIdeal.isPrincipal.of_isPrincipal_pow_of_coprime
statement:
theorem FractionalIdeal.isPrincipal.of_isPrincipal_pow_of_coprime [IsDedekindDomain R]
    [Fintype (ClassGroup R)] {n : ℕ} (hn : n.Coprime (Fintype.card (ClassGroup R)))
    (I : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) (hI : ((I ^ n : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) : Submodule R K).IsPrincipal) :
    (I : Submodule R K).IsPrincipal
proof:
:= by
  obtain (rfl | ⟨u, rfl⟩) := GroupWithZero.eq_zero_or_unit I
  · simp [bot_isPrincipal]
  rw [← ClassGroup.mk_eq_one_iff, ← orderOf_eq_one_iff, ← Nat.dvd_one, ← hn,
    Nat.dvd_gcd_iff]
  refine ⟨?_, orderOf_dvd_card⟩
  rw [orderOf_dvd_iff_pow_eq_one, ← map_pow, ClassGroup.mk_eq_one_iff]
  exact_mod_cast hI

name: ClassGroup.isPrincipal_coeSubmodule_of_isUnit
statement:
theorem ClassGroup.isPrincipal_coeSubmodule_of_isUnit [Subsingleton (ClassGroup R)]
    (I : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) (hI : IsUnit I) :
    (I : Submodule R K).IsPrincipal
proof:
:= by
  rcases hI with ⟨I, rfl⟩
  rw [← ClassGroup.mk_eq_one_iff, Subsingleton.elim (ClassGroup.mk K I) 1]

name: ClassGroup.isPrincipal_of_isUnit_coeIdeal
statement:
theorem ClassGroup.isPrincipal_of_isUnit_coeIdeal [Subsingleton (ClassGroup R)]
    (I : Ideal R) (hI : IsUnit (I : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)) :
    I.IsPrincipal
proof:
:= by
  have hsub :
      ((I : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) : Submodule R K).IsPrincipal :=
    ClassGroup.isPrincipal_coeSubmodule_of_isUnit (I := (I : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)) hI
  exact (IsFractionRing.coeSubmodule_isPrincipal (R := R) (K := K) (I := I)).1
    (by simpa using hsub)

name: ClassGroup.mk0_eq_one_iff
statement:
theorem ClassGroup.mk0_eq_one_iff [IsDedekindDomain R] {I : Ideal R} (hI : I ∈ (Ideal R)⁰) :
    ClassGroup.mk0 ⟨I, hI⟩ = 1 ↔ I.IsPrincipal
proof:
:=
  ClassGroup.mk_eq_one_iff.trans (coeSubmodule_isPrincipal R _)

name: Ideal.IsPrincipal.of_isPrincipal_pow_of_coprime
statement:
theorem Ideal.IsPrincipal.of_isPrincipal_pow_of_coprime [IsDedekindDomain R]
    [Fintype (ClassGroup R)] {n : ℕ} (hn : n.Coprime (Fintype.card (ClassGroup R)))
    {I : Ideal R} (hI : (I ^ n).IsPrincipal) : I.IsPrincipal
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hI0 : I = 0
  · simp [hI0, bot_isPrincipal]
  rw [← ClassGroup.mk0_eq_one_iff (pow_mem (mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero hI0) n)] at hI
  rw [← ClassGroup.mk0_eq_one_iff (mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero hI0), ← orderOf_eq_one_iff,
    ← Nat.dvd_one, ← hn, Nat.dvd_gcd_iff]
  refine ⟨?_, orderOf_dvd_card⟩
  rwa [orderOf_dvd_iff_pow_eq_one, ← map_pow, SubmonoidClass.mk_pow]

name: ClassGroup.mk0_eq_mk0_inv_iff
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_inv_iff_mul_eq_one, ← map_mul, ClassGroup.mk0_eq_one_iff,
    Submodule.isPrincipal_iff, Submonoid.coe_mul]
  refine ⟨fun ⟨a, ha⟩ ↦ ⟨a, ?_, ha⟩, fun ⟨a, _, ha⟩ ↦ ⟨a, ha⟩⟩
  by_contra!
  rw [this, Submodule.span_zero_singleton] at ha
  exact nonZeroDivisors.coe_ne_zero _ <| J.prop.2 _ ha

name: card_classGroup_eq_one
statement: theorem card_classGroup_eq_one [IsPrincipalIdealRing R] : Fintype.card (ClassGroup R) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.card_eq_one_iff]
  use 1
  refine ClassGroup.induction (R := R) (FractionRing R) (fun I => ?_)
  exact ClassGroup.mk_eq_one_iff.mpr (I : FractionalIdeal R⁰ (FractionRing R)).isPrincipal

name: card_classGroup_eq_one_iff
statement:
theorem card_classGroup_eq_one_iff [IsDedekindDomain R] [Fintype (ClassGroup R)] :
    Fintype.card (ClassGroup R) = 1 ↔ IsPrincipalIdealRing R
proof:
:= by
  constructor; swap; · intros; convert! card_classGroup_eq_one (R := R)
  rw [Fintype.card_eq_one_iff]
  rintro ⟨I, hI⟩
  have eq_one : ∀ J : ClassGroup R, J = 1 := fun J => (hI J).trans (hI 1).symm
  refine ⟨fun I => ?_⟩
  by_cases hI : I = ⊥
  · rw [hI]; exact bot_isPrincipal
  · exact (ClassGroup.mk0_eq_one_iff (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hI)).mp (eq_one _)

name: FractionalIdeal.map_ringEquivOfRingEquiv_toPrincipalIdeal
statement:
theorem FractionalIdeal.map_ringEquivOfRingEquiv_toPrincipalIdeal {S L : Type*} [CommRing S]
    [IsDomain S] [Field L] [Algebra S L] [IsFractionRing S L] (f : R ≃+* S) :
  Subgroup.map ((Units.mapEquiv (ringEquivOfRingEquiv K L f))).toMonoidHom
    (toPrincipalIdeal R K).range = (toPrincipalIdeal S L).range
proof:
:= by
  ext I
  simp only [MulEquiv.toMonoidHom_eq_coe, Subgroup.mem_map, MonoidHom.mem_range,
    toPrincipalIdeal_eq_iff, MonoidHom.coe_coe]
  refine ⟨fun ⟨u, ⟨v, huv⟩, hu⟩ ↦ ?_, fun ⟨u, hu⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  · use Units.map (IsFractionRing.ringEquivOfRingEquiv f (K := K)
      (L := L)).toRingHom v
    rw [← hu]
    simp only [RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, Units.coe_map, MonoidHom.coe_coe, RingHom.coe_coe,
      Units.coe_mapEquiv, ← huv, RingEquiv.coe_toMulEquiv]
    rw [FractionalIdeal.ringEquivOfRingEquiv_spanSingleton]
  · use Units.mapEquiv (FractionalIdeal.ringEquivOfRingEquiv _ _ f).symm.toMulEquiv I
    refine ⟨?_, by simp [← Units.val_inj]⟩
    · use Units.map (IsFractionRing.ringEquivOfRingEquiv f (K := K)
        (L := L)).symm.toRingHom u
      simp only [IsFractionRing.ringEquivOfRingEquiv_symm, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe,
        Units.coe_map, MonoidHom.coe_coe, RingHom.coe_coe, RingEquiv.toMulEquiv_eq_coe,
        RingEquiv.coe_toMulEquiv_symm, Units.coe_mapEquiv]
      rw [← FractionalIdeal.ringEquivOfRingEquiv_spanSingleton,
        ← FractionalIdeal.ringEquivOfRingEquiv_symm_eq, hu]
      rfl

name: rootsOfUnity_eq_top
statement:
lemma rootsOfUnity_eq_top {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] :
    (rootsOfUnity (p - 1) (ZMod p)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simpa [Units.ext_iff] using pow_card_sub_one_eq_one (Units.ne_zero _)

name: isCyclic_units_zero
statement:
theorem isCyclic_units_zero :
    IsCyclic (ZMod 0)ˣ
proof: := inferInstance

name: isCyclic_units_one
statement:
theorem isCyclic_units_one :
    IsCyclic (ZMod 1)ˣ
proof: := inferInstance

name: isCyclic_units_two
statement:
theorem isCyclic_units_two :
    IsCyclic (ZMod 2)ˣ
proof: := inferInstance

name: isCyclic_units_four
statement:
theorem isCyclic_units_four :
    IsCyclic (ZMod 4)ˣ
proof:
:= by
  apply isCyclic_of_prime_card (p := 2)
  simp only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, card_units_eq_totient]
  decide

name: isCyclic_units_prime
statement:
theorem isCyclic_units_prime {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    IsCyclic (ZMod p)ˣ
proof:
:=
  have : Fact (p.Prime) := ⟨hp⟩
  inferInstance

name: not_isCyclic_units_eight
statement:
theorem not_isCyclic_units_eight :
    ¬ IsCyclic (ZMod 8)ˣ
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsCyclic.iff_exponent_eq_card, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, card_units_eq_totient]
  have h : Monoid.exponent (ZMod 8)ˣ ∣ 2 := Monoid.exponent_dvd_of_forall_pow_eq_one (by decide)
  intro (h' : Monoid.exponent (ZMod 8)ˣ = 4)
  simp [h'] at h

name: exists_one_add_mul_pow_prime_eq
statement:
lemma exists_one_add_mul_pow_prime_eq
    (hp : p.Prime) (hvu : v ∣ u) (hpuv : p * u * v ∣ u ^ p) (x : R) :
    ∃ y, (1 + u * x) ^ p = 1 + p * u * (x + v * y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm, add_pow]
  rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase (a := 0) _ _ (by simp)]
  simp_rw [one_pow, pow_zero, Nat.choose_zero_right, Nat.cast_one, mul_one]
  rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase (a := 1) _ _ (by simp [hp.pos])]
  rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add (a := p) _ _ (by 
      simp only [Finset.mem_erase]
      rw [← and_assoc, and_comm (a := ¬ _), ← Nat.two_le_iff]
