  · rw [DirectSum.mk_apply_of_notMem hm, Submodule.coe_zero,
      weightedHomogeneousComponent_eq_zero_of_notMem w φ m hm]

name: weightedDecomposition.decompose'_eq
statement:
theorem weightedDecomposition.decompose'_eq [DecidableEq M] :
    (weightedDecomposition R w).decompose' = fun φ : MvPolynomial σ R =>
      DirectSum.mk (fun i : M => ↥(weightedHomogeneousSubmodule R w i))
        (Finset.image (weight w) φ.support) fun m =>
          ⟨weightedHomogeneousComponent w m φ, weightedHomogeneousComponent_mem w φ m⟩
proof: := rfl

name: weightedDecomposition.decompose'_apply
statement:
theorem weightedDecomposition.decompose'_apply [DecidableEq M]
    (φ : MvPolynomial σ R) (m : M) :
    ((weightedDecomposition R w).decompose' φ m : MvPolynomial σ R) =
      weightedHomogeneousComponent w m φ
proof:
:=
  MvPolynomial.decompose'_apply R w φ m

name: mem_iff_weightedHomogeneousComponent_mem
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← weightedDecomposition.decompose'_apply]
  exact h.mem_iff

name: weightedHomogeneousComponent_mem_of_mem
proof:
:=
  (mem_iff_weightedHomogeneousComponent_mem R w h p).mp hp m

name: C_mul_leadingCoeff_monomial_degree
statement:
@[simp]
lemma C_mul_leadingCoeff_monomial_degree (p : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    MvPolynomial.C (m.leadingCoeff p : R) * MvPolynomial.monomial (m.degree p) (1 : R) =
      m.leadingTerm p
proof:
:= by
  rw [MvPolynomial.C_mul_monomial, mul_one, leadingTerm]

name: Monic.of_subsingleton
statement:
@[nontriviality] theorem Monic.of_subsingleton [Subsingleton R] {f : MvPolynomial σ R} :
    m.Monic f
proof:
:=
  Subsingleton.eq_one (m.leadingCoeff f)

name: Monic.leadingCoeff_eq_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Monic.leadingCoeff_eq_one {f : MvPolynomial σ R} (hf : m.Monic f) : m.leadingCoeff f = 1
proof:
:=
  hf

name: Monic.coeff_degree
statement: theorem Monic.coeff_degree {f : MvPolynomial σ R} (hf : m.Monic f) : f.coeff (m.degree f) = 1
proof:
:=
  hf

name: degree_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem degree_zero : m.degree (0 : MvPolynomial σ R) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [degree]

name: ne_zero_of_degree_ne_zero
statement: theorem ne_zero_of_degree_ne_zero {f : MvPolynomial σ R} (h : m.degree f ≠ 0) : f ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rintro rfl
  exact h m.degree_zero

name: degree_of_subsingleton
statement:
@[simp, nontriviality]
theorem degree_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton R] {f : MvPolynomial σ R} :
    m.degree f = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Subsingleton.eq_zero f, degree_zero]

name: leadingCoeff_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leadingCoeff_zero : m.leadingCoeff (0 : MvPolynomial σ R) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [degree, leadingCoeff]

name: Monic.ne_zero
statement:
theorem Monic.ne_zero [Nontrivial R] {f : MvPolynomial σ R} (hf : m.Monic f) :
    f ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rintro rfl
  simp [Monic, leadingCoeff_zero] at hf

name: degree_monomial_le
statement:
theorem degree_monomial_le {d : σ →₀ ℕ} (c : R) :
    m.degree (monomial d c) ≼[m] d
proof:
:= by
  simp only [degree, AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  apply le_trans (Finset.sup_mono support_monomial_subset)
  simp only [Finset.sup_singleton, le_refl]

name: degree_monomial
statement:
theorem degree_monomial {d : σ →₀ ℕ} (c : R) [Decidable (c = 0)] :
    m.degree (monomial d c) = if c = 0 then 0 else d
proof:
:= by
  simp only [degree, support_monomial]
  split_ifs with hc <;> simp

name: degree_X_le_single
statement: theorem degree_X_le_single {s : σ} : m.degree (X s : MvPolynomial σ R) ≼[m] Finsupp.single s 1
proof:
:=
  degree_monomial_le 1

name: degree_X
statement:
theorem degree_X [Nontrivial R] {s : σ} :
    m.degree (X s : MvPolynomial σ R) = Finsupp.single s 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change m.degree (monomial (Finsupp.single s 1) (1 : R)) = _
  rw [degree_monomial, ite_eq_right one_ne_zero]

name: degree_one
statement: @[simp] theorem degree_one : m.degree (1 : MvPolynomial σ R) = 0
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R
  classical rw [MvPolynomial.one_def, degree_monomial]
  simp

name: leadingCoeff_monomial
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leadingCoeff_monomial {d : σ →₀ ℕ} (c : R) :
    m.leadingCoeff (monomial d c) = c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [leadingCoeff, degree_monomial]
  split_ifs with hc <;> simp [hc]

name: monic_monomial_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem monic_monomial_one {d : σ →₀ ℕ} :
    m.Monic (monomial d (1 : R))
proof:
:=
  m.leadingCoeff_monomial 1

name: monic_monomial
statement:
theorem monic_monomial {d : σ →₀ ℕ} {c : R} :
    m.Monic (monomial d c) ↔ c = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Monic, m.leadingCoeff_monomial]

name: leadingCoeff_X
statement:
theorem leadingCoeff_X {s : σ} :
    m.leadingCoeff (X s : MvPolynomial σ R) = 1
proof:
:=
  m.leadingCoeff_monomial 1

name: monic_X
statement:
@[simp] theorem monic_X {s : σ} :
    m.Monic (X s : MvPolynomial σ R)
proof:
:=
  monic_monomial_one

name: leadingCoeff_one
statement: theorem leadingCoeff_one : m.leadingCoeff (1 : MvPolynomial σ R) = 1
proof:
:=
  m.leadingCoeff_monomial 1

name: monic_C_one
statement: theorem monic_C_one : m.Monic (C 1 : MvPolynomial σ R)
proof:
:=
  monic_monomial_one

name: monic_one
statement:
@[simp]
lemma monic_one : m.Monic (1 : MvPolynomial σ R)
proof: := monic_monomial_one

name: degree_le_iff
statement:
theorem degree_le_iff {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {d : σ →₀ ℕ} :
    m.degree f ≼[m] d ↔ ∀ c ∈ f.support, c ≼[m] d
proof:
:= by
  unfold degree
  simp only [AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply, Finset.sup_le_iff, mem_support_iff, ne_eq]

name: degree_lt_iff
statement:
theorem degree_lt_iff {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {d : σ →₀ ℕ} (hd : 0 ≺[m] d) :
    m.degree f ≺[m] d ↔ ∀ c ∈ f.support, c ≺[m] d
proof:
:= by
  simp only [map_zero] at hd
  unfold degree
  simp only [AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  exact Finset.sup_lt_iff hd

name: le_degree
statement:
theorem le_degree {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {d : σ →₀ ℕ} (hd : d ∈ f.support) :
    d ≼[m] m.degree f
proof:
:= by
  unfold degree
  simp only [AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply, Finset.le_sup hd]

name: coeff_eq_zero_of_lt
statement:
theorem coeff_eq_zero_of_lt {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {d : σ →₀ ℕ} (hd : m.degree f ≺[m] d) :
    f.coeff d = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← not_le] at hd
  by_contra hf
  apply hd (m.le_degree (mem_support_iff.mpr hf))

name: leadingCoeff_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem leadingCoeff_ne_zero_iff {f : MvPolynomial σ R} :
    m.leadingCoeff f ≠ 0 ↔ f ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [not_imp_not]
    intro hf
    rw [hf, leadingCoeff_zero]
  · intro hf
    rw [← support_nonempty] at hf
    rw [leadingCoeff, ← mem_support_iff, degree]
    suffices f.support.sup m.toSyn ∈ m.toSyn '' f.support by
      obtain ⟨d, hd, hd'⟩ := this
      rw [← hd', AddEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
      exact hd
    exact Finset.sup_mem_of_nonempty hf

name: leadingCoeff_eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leadingCoeff_eq_zero_iff {f : MvPolynomial σ R} :
    leadingCoeff m f = 0 ↔ f = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← not_iff_not, leadingCoeff_ne_zero_iff]

name: coeff_degree_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem coeff_degree_ne_zero_iff {f : MvPolynomial σ R} :
    f.coeff (m.degree f) ≠ 0 ↔ f ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  m.leadingCoeff_ne_zero_iff

name: degree_mem_support_iff
statement: theorem degree_mem_support_iff (f : MvPolynomial σ R) : m.degree f ∈ f.support ↔ f ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  mem_support_iff.trans coeff_degree_ne_zero_iff

name: coeff_degree_eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_degree_eq_zero_iff {f : MvPolynomial σ R} :
    f.coeff (m.degree f) = 0 ↔ f = 0
proof:
:=
  m.leadingCoeff_eq_zero_iff

name: degree_mem_support
statement:
lemma degree_mem_support {p : MvPolynomial σ R} (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    m.degree p ∈ p.support
proof:
:= by
  rwa [MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff, coeff_degree_ne_zero_iff]

name: degree_eq_zero_iff_totalDegree_eq_zero
statement:
theorem degree_eq_zero_iff_totalDegree_eq_zero {f : MvPolynomial σ R} :
    m.degree f = 0 ↔ f.totalDegree = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← m.toSyn.injective.eq_iff]
  rw [map_zero, ← m.bot_eq_zero, eq_bot_iff, m.bot_eq_zero, ← m.toSyn.map_zero]
  rw [degree_le_iff]
  rw [totalDegree_eq_zero_iff]
  apply forall_congr'
  intro d
  apply imp_congr (rfl.to_iff)
  rw [map_zero, ← m.bot_eq_zero, ← eq_bot_iff, m.bot_eq_zero]
  simp only [EmbeddingLike.map_eq_zero_iff]
  exact Finsupp.ext_iff

name: degree_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem degree_C (r : R) :
    m.degree (C r) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [degree_eq_zero_iff_totalDegree_eq_zero, totalDegree_C]

name: leadingCoeff_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leadingCoeff_C (c : R) : m.leadingCoeff (C c) = c
proof:
:= by
  simp [leadingCoeff]

name: eq_C_of_degree_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_C_of_degree_eq_zero {f : MvPolynomial σ R} (hf : m.degree f = 0) :
    f = C (m.leadingCoeff f)
proof:
:= by
  ext d
  simp only [leadingCoeff, hf]
  classical
  by_cases hd : d = 0
  · simp [hd]
  · rw [coeff_C, ite_eq_right (Ne.symm hd)]
    apply coeff_eq_zero_of_lt (m := m)
    rw [hf, map_zero, lt_iff_le_and_ne, ne_eq, eq_comm, EmbeddingLike.map_eq_zero_iff]
    exact ⟨bot_le, hd⟩

name: degree_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem degree_eq_zero_iff {f : MvPolynomial σ R} :
    m.degree f = 0 ↔ f = C (m.leadingCoeff f)
proof:
:=
  ⟨MonomialOrder.eq_C_of_degree_eq_zero, fun h => by rw [h, MonomialOrder.degree_C]⟩

name: degree_add_le
statement:
theorem degree_add_le {f g : MvPolynomial σ R} :
    m.toSyn (m.degree (f + g)) ≤ m.toSyn (m.degree f) ⊔ m.toSyn (m.degree g)
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← m.toSyn.apply_symm_apply (_ ⊔ _)]
  rw [degree_le_iff]
  simp only [AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply, le_sup_iff]
  intro b hb
  by_cases hf : b ∈ f.support
  · left
    exact m.le_degree hf
  · right
    apply m.le_degree
    simp only [notMem_support_iff] at hf
    simpa only [mem_support_iff, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, Finsupp.add_apply, hf, zero_add]
      using hb

name: degree_sum_le
statement:
theorem degree_sum_le {α : Type*} {s : Finset α} {f : α → MvPolynomial σ R} :
    (m.toSyn <| m.degree <| ∑ x ∈ s, f x) ≤ s.sup fun x ↦ (m.toSyn <| m.degree <| f x)
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | cons a s haA h =>
    rw [Finset.sum_cons, Finset.sup_cons]
    exact le_trans m.degree_add_le (max_le_max le_rfl h)

name: degree_add_of_lt
statement:
theorem degree_add_of_lt {f g : MvPolynomial σ R} (h : m.degree g ≺[m] m.degree f) :
    m.degree (f + g) = m.degree f
proof:
:= by
  apply m.toSyn.injective
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply le_trans degree_add_le
    simp only [sup_le_iff, le_refl, true_and, le_of_lt h]
  · apply le_degree
    rw [mem_support_iff, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, Finsupp.add_apply, m.coeff_eq_zero_of_lt h,
      add_zero, ← leadingCoeff, leadingCoeff_ne_zero_iff]
    intro hf
    rw [← not_le, hf] at h
    apply h
    simp only [degree_zero, map_zero]
    apply bot_le

name: degree_add_eq_right_of_lt
statement:
theorem degree_add_eq_right_of_lt {f g : MvPolynomial σ R} (h : m.degree f ≺[m] m.degree g) :
    m.degree (f + g) = m.degree g
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm]
  exact degree_add_of_lt h

name: leadingCoeff_add_of_lt
statement:
theorem leadingCoeff_add_of_lt {f g : MvPolynomial σ R} (h : m.degree g ≺[m] m.degree f) :
    m.leadingCoeff (f + g) = m.leadingCoeff f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [leadingCoeff, m.degree_add_of_lt h, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, Finsupp.add_apply,
    coeff_eq_zero_of_lt h, add_zero]

name: Monic.add_of_lt
statement:
theorem Monic.add_of_lt {f g : MvPolynomial σ R} (hf : m.Monic f) (h : m.degree g ≺[m] m.degree f) :
    m.Monic (f + g)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Monic, leadingCoeff_add_of_lt h, hf.leadingCoeff_eq_one]

name: degree_add_of_ne
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h' : m.degree g ≺[m] m.degree f
  · simp [degree_add_of_lt h', le_of_lt h']
  · rw [not_lt, le_iff_eq_or_lt, Classical.or_iff_not_imp_left, EmbeddingLike.apply_eq_iff_eq] at h'
    rw [add_comm, degree_add_of_lt (h' h), right_eq_sup]
    simp only [le_of_lt (h' h)]

name: degree_mul_le
statement:
theorem degree_mul_le {f g : MvPolynomial σ R} :
    m.degree (f * g) ≼[m] m.degree f + m.degree g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [degree_le_iff]
  intro c
  rw [← not_lt, mem_support_iff, not_imp_not]
  intro hc
  rw [coeff_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  rintro ⟨d, e⟩ hde
  simp only [Finset.mem_antidiagonal] at hde
  dsimp only
  by_cases hd : m.degree f ≺[m] d
  · rw [m.coeff_eq_zero_of_lt hd, zero_mul]
  · suffices m.degree g ≺[m] e by
      rw [m.coeff_eq_zero_of_lt this, mul_zero]
    simp only [not_lt] at hd
    apply lt_of_add_lt_add_left (a := m.toSyn d)
    grw [← map_add _ _ e, hd, ← map_add, hde]
    exact hc

name: coeff_mul_of_add_of_degree_le
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [coeff_mul, Finset.sum_eq_single (a, b)]
  · rintro ⟨c, d⟩ hcd h
    simp only [Finset.mem_antidiagonal] at hcd
    by_cases hf : m.degree f ≺[m] c
    · rw [m.coeff_eq_zero_of_lt hf, zero_mul]
    · suffices m.degree g ≺[m] d by
        rw [coeff_eq_zero_of_lt this, mul_zero]
      rw [not_lt] at hf
      rw [← not_le]
      intro hf'
      apply h
      suffices c = a by
        simpa [Prod.mk.injEq, this] using hcd
      apply m.toSyn.injective
      apply le_antisymm (le_trans hf ha)
      apply le_of_add_le_add_right (a := m.toSyn b)
      rw [← map_add, ← hcd, map_add]
      simp only [add_le_add_iff_left]
      exact le_trans hf' hb
  · simp

name: coeff_mul_of_degree_add
statement:
theorem coeff_mul_of_degree_add {f g : MvPolynomial σ R} :
    (f * g).coeff (m.degree f + m.degree g) = m.leadingCoeff f * m.leadingCoeff g
proof:
:=
  coeff_mul_of_add_of_degree_le (le_of_eq rfl) (le_of_eq rfl)

name: degree_mul_of_mul_leadingCoeff_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  apply m.toSyn.injective
  apply le_antisymm degree_mul_le
  apply le_degree
  rw [mem_support_iff, coeff_mul_of_degree_add]
  exact hfg

name: leadingCoeff_mul_of_mul_leadingCoeff_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [leadingCoeff, ← coeff_mul_of_degree_add, degree_mul_of_mul_leadingCoeff_ne_zero hfg]

name: degree_mul_of_left_mem_nonZeroDivisors
proof:
:= by
  apply degree_mul_of_mul_leadingCoeff_ne_zero
  apply not_imp_not.mpr (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff.mp hf |>.1 _)
  simp [hg]

name: degree_mul_of_right_mem_nonZeroDivisors
proof:
:=
  add_comm (m.degree f) (m.degree g) ▸ mul_comm f g ▸ degree_mul_of_left_mem_nonZeroDivisors hg hf

name: leadingCoeff_mul_of_left_mem_nonZeroDivisors
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hg : g = 0
  · simp [hg]
  · simp only [leadingCoeff, degree_mul_of_left_mem_nonZeroDivisors hf hg, coeff_mul_of_degree_add]

name: leadingCoeff_mul_of_right_mem_nonZeroDivisors
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : f = 0
  · simp [hf]
  · simp only [leadingCoeff, degree_mul_of_right_mem_nonZeroDivisors hf hg, coeff_mul_of_degree_add]

name: degree_mul_of_isRegular_left
proof:
:= by
  apply degree_mul_of_mul_leadingCoeff_ne_zero
  simp only [ne_eq, hf, IsRegular.left, IsLeftRegular.mul_left_eq_zero_iff,
    leadingCoeff_eq_zero_iff]
  exact hg

name: leadingCoeff_mul_of_isRegular_left
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hg : g = 0
  · simp [hg]
  · simp only [leadingCoeff, degree_mul_of_isRegular_left hf hg, coeff_mul_of_degree_add]

name: degree_mul_of_isRegular_right
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm, m.degree_mul_of_isRegular_left hg hf, add_comm]

name: leadingCoeff_mul_of_isRegular_right
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : f = 0
  · simp [hf]
  · simp only [leadingCoeff, degree_mul_of_isRegular_right hf hg, coeff_mul_of_degree_add]

name: Monic.mul
statement:
theorem Monic.mul {f g : MvPolynomial σ R} (hf : m.Monic f) (hg : m.Monic g) :
    m.Monic (f * g)
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R
  suffices m.leadingCoeff f * m.leadingCoeff g = 1 by
    rw [Monic, MonomialOrder.leadingCoeff,
      degree_mul_of_mul_leadingCoeff_ne_zero, coeff_mul_of_degree_add, this]
    rw [this]
    exact one_ne_zero
  rw [hf.leadingCoeff_eq_one, hg.leadingCoeff_eq_one, one_mul]

name: degree_mul
statement:
theorem degree_mul [NoZeroDivisors R] {f g : MvPolynomial σ R} (hf : f ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0) :
    m.degree (f * g) = m.degree f + m.degree g
proof:
:= by
  apply degree_mul_of_mul_leadingCoeff_ne_zero
  simp only [ne_eq, mul_eq_zero, leadingCoeff_eq_zero_iff, not_or]
  tauto

name: leadingCoeff_mul
statement:
@[simp] theorem leadingCoeff_mul [NoZeroDivisors R] {f g : MvPolynomial σ R} :
    m.leadingCoeff (f * g) = m.leadingCoeff f * m.leadingCoeff g
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! +distrib h : f = 0 ∨ g = 0
  · cases h <;> simp [*]
  obtain ⟨hf, hg⟩ := h
  rw [leadingCoeff, degree_mul hf hg, ← coeff_mul_of_degree_add]

name: degree_pow_le
statement:
theorem degree_pow_le {f : MvPolynomial σ R} (n : ℕ) :
    m.degree (f ^ n) ≼[m] n • (m.degree f)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [m.degree_one]
  | succ n hrec =>
      simp only [pow_add, pow_one, add_smul, one_smul]
      apply le_trans m.degree_mul_le
      simp only [map_add, add_le_add_iff_right]
      exact hrec

name: coeff_pow_nsmul_degree
statement:
theorem coeff_pow_nsmul_degree (f : MvPolynomial σ R) (n : ℕ) :
    (f ^ n).coeff (n • m.degree f) = m.leadingCoeff f ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n hrec =>
    simp only [add_smul, one_smul, pow_add, pow_one]
    rw [m.coeff_mul_of_add_of_degree_le (m.degree_pow_le _) le_rfl, hrec, leadingCoeff]

name: degree_pow_of_pow_leadingCoeff_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  apply m.toSyn.injective
  apply le_antisymm (m.degree_pow_le n)
  apply le_degree
  rw [mem_support_iff, coeff_pow_nsmul_degree]
  exact hf

name: leadingCoeff_pow_of_pow_leadingCoeff_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [leadingCoeff, degree_pow_of_pow_leadingCoeff_ne_zero hf, coeff_pow_nsmul_degree]

name: leadingTerm_pow_of_pow_leadingCoeff_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  simp [leadingTerm, hf, degree_pow_of_pow_leadingCoeff_ne_zero,
    leadingCoeff_pow_of_pow_leadingCoeff_ne_zero, monomial_pow]

name: Monic.pow
statement:
protected theorem Monic.pow {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {n : ℕ} (hf : m.Monic f) :
    m.Monic (f ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R
  rw [Monic, leadingCoeff_pow_of_pow_leadingCoeff_ne_zero, hf.leadingCoeff_eq_one, one_pow]
  rw [hf.leadingCoeff_eq_one, one_pow]
  exact one_ne_zero

name: degree_pow_of_not_isNilpotent
statement:
theorem degree_pow_of_not_isNilpotent {f : MvPolynomial σ R} (n : ℕ)
    (h : ¬IsNilpotent (m.leadingCoeff f)) :
    m.degree (f ^ n) = n • m.degree f
proof:
:= by
  apply degree_pow_of_pow_leadingCoeff_ne_zero
  contrapose! h
  exact IsNilpotent.mk _ n h

name: leadingCoeff_pow_of_not_isNilpotent
statement:
theorem leadingCoeff_pow_of_not_isNilpotent {f : MvPolynomial σ R} (n : ℕ)
    (h : ¬IsNilpotent (m.leadingCoeff f)) :
    m.leadingCoeff (f ^ n) = m.leadingCoeff f ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [leadingCoeff, degree_pow_of_not_isNilpotent n h, coeff_pow_nsmul_degree]

name: leadingTerm_pow_of_not_isNilpotent
statement:
theorem leadingTerm_pow_of_not_isNilpotent {f : MvPolynomial σ R} (n : ℕ)
    (h : ¬IsNilpotent (m.leadingCoeff f)) :
    m.leadingTerm (f ^ n) = m.leadingTerm f ^ n
proof:
:= by
  simp [leadingTerm, degree_pow_of_not_isNilpotent n h, leadingCoeff_pow_of_not_isNilpotent n h,
    monomial_pow]

name: degree_pow
statement:
theorem degree_pow [IsReduced R] (f : MvPolynomial σ R) (n : ℕ) :
    m.degree (f ^ n) = n • m.degree f
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : f = 0
  · rw [hf, degree_zero, smul_zero]
    by_cases hn : n = 0
    · rw [hn, pow_zero, degree_one]
    · rw [zero_pow hn, degree_zero]
  refine degree_pow_of_not_isNilpotent n ?_
  rwa [isNilpotent_iff_eq_zero, leadingCoeff_eq_zero_iff]

name: leadingCoeff_pow
statement:
theorem leadingCoeff_pow [IsReduced R] (f : MvPolynomial σ R) (n : ℕ) :
    m.leadingCoeff (f ^ n) = m.leadingCoeff f ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [leadingCoeff, degree_pow, coeff_pow_nsmul_degree]

name: leadingTerm_pow
statement:
theorem leadingTerm_pow [IsReduced R] (f : MvPolynomial σ R) (n : ℕ) :
    m.leadingTerm (f ^ n) = m.leadingTerm f ^ n
proof:
:= by
  simp [leadingTerm, degree_pow, leadingCoeff_pow, monomial_pow]

name: degree_smul_le
statement:
theorem degree_smul_le {r : R} {f : MvPolynomial σ R} :
    m.degree (r • f) ≼[m] m.degree f
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_eq_C_mul]
  apply le_of_le_of_eq degree_mul_le
  simp

name: degree_smul_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors
statement:
theorem degree_smul_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors {r : R} (hr : r ∈ nonZeroDivisors _)
    {f : MvPolynomial σ R} :
    m.degree (r • f) = m.degree f
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : f = 0
  · simp [hf]
  apply m.toSyn.injective
  apply le_antisymm degree_smul_le
  apply le_degree
  simp only [mem_support_iff, smul_eq_C_mul]
  rw [← zero_add (degree m f), ← degree_C r, coeff_mul_of_degree_add]
  simp [not_imp_not.mpr ((mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff.mp hr).1 _) <| m.leadingCoeff_ne_zero_iff.mpr hf]

name: degree_smul_of_isRegular
statement:
theorem degree_smul_of_isRegular {r : R} (hr : IsRegular r) {f : MvPolynomial σ R} :
    m.degree (r • f) = m.degree f
proof:
:=
  m.degree_smul_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors hr.mem_nonZeroDivisors

name: degree_prod_le
statement:
theorem degree_prod_le {ι : Type*} {P : ι → MvPolynomial σ R} {s : Finset ι} :
    m.degree (∏ i ∈ s, P i) ≼[m] ∑ i ∈ s, m.degree (P i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    simp only [Finset.prod_empty, Finset.sum_empty]
    rw [← C_1, m.degree_C, map_zero]
  | insert a s has hrec =>
    rw [Finset.prod_insert has, Finset.sum_insert has]
    apply le_trans degree_mul_le
    simp only [map_add, add_le_add_iff_left, hrec]

name: coeff_prod_sum_degree
statement:
theorem coeff_prod_sum_degree {ι : Type*} (P : ι → MvPolynomial σ R) (s : Finset ι) :
    (∏ i ∈ s, P i).coeff (∑ i ∈ s, m.degree (P i)) = ∏ i ∈ s, m.leadingCoeff (P i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert a s has hrec =>
    simp only [Finset.prod_insert has, Finset.sum_insert has]
    rw [coeff_mul_of_add_of_degree_le (le_of_eq rfl) degree_prod_le]
    exact congr_arg₂ _ rfl hrec

name: degree_prod_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors
proof:
:= by
  cases subsingleton_or_nontrivial R with
  | inl _ => simp [Subsingleton.elim _ (0 : MvPolynomial σ R)]
  | inr _ =>
    apply m.toSyn.injective
    refine le_antisymm degree_prod_le (m.le_degree ?_)
    rw [mem_support_iff, m.coeff_prod_sum_degree]
    exact nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero (prod_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors H)

name: degree_prod_of_regular
proof:
:= by
  cases subsingleton_or_nontrivial R with
  | inl _ => simp [Subsingleton.elim _ (0 : MvPolynomial σ R)]
  | inr _ =>
    apply m.toSyn.injective
    refine le_antisymm degree_prod_le (m.le_degree ?_)
    rw [mem_support_iff, m.coeff_prod_sum_degree]
    exact (IsRegular.prod H).ne_zero

name: degree_prod
proof:
:= by
  cases subsingleton_or_nontrivial R with
  | inl _ => simp [Subsingleton.elim _ (0 : MvPolynomial σ R)]
  | inr _ =>
    apply m.toSyn.injective
    refine le_antisymm degree_prod_le (m.le_degree ?_)
    simpa [m.coeff_prod_sum_degree, Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff]

name: degree_mul'
statement:
lemma degree_mul' [NoZeroDivisors R] {f g : MvPolynomial σ R} (hf : f * g ≠ 0) :
    m.degree (f * g) = m.degree f + m.degree g
proof:
:= by
  apply ne_zero_and_ne_zero_of_mul at hf
  exact m.degree_mul hf.1 hf.2

name: notMem_support_of_degree_lt
statement:
lemma notMem_support_of_degree_lt {f g : MvPolynomial σ R} (h : m.degree f ≺[m] m.degree g) :
    m.degree g ∉ f.support
proof:
:= by
  simp [coeff_eq_zero_of_lt h]

name: leadingCoeff_prod_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors
proof:
:= by
  simp only [leadingCoeff, degree_prod_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors H, coeff_prod_sum_degree]

name: leadingCoeff_prod_of_regular
proof:
:= by
  simp only [leadingCoeff, degree_prod_of_regular H, coeff_prod_sum_degree]

name: Monic.prod
proof:
:= by
  rw [Monic, leadingCoeff_prod_of_regular]
  · exact Finset.prod_eq_one H
  · intro i hi
    rw [(H i hi).leadingCoeff_eq_one]
    exact isRegular_one

name: leadingTerm_eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma leadingTerm_eq_zero_iff (p : MvPolynomial σ R) : m.leadingTerm p = 0 ↔ p = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [leadingTerm, monomial_eq_zero, leadingCoeff_eq_zero_iff]

name: leadingTerm_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma leadingTerm_zero : m.leadingTerm (0 : MvPolynomial σ R) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [leadingTerm_eq_zero_iff]

name: leadingTerm_one
statement:
@[simp]
lemma leadingTerm_one : m.leadingTerm (1 : MvPolynomial σ R) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [leadingTerm]

name: leadingTerm_of_subsingleton
statement:
@[simp]
lemma leadingTerm_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton R] {f : MvPolynomial σ R} :
    m.leadingTerm f = f
proof:
:= by
  simp [leadingTerm, (m.degree_eq_zero_iff.mp degree_of_subsingleton).symm]

name: image_leadingTerm_sdiff_singleton_zero
statement:
lemma image_leadingTerm_sdiff_singleton_zero (B : Set (MvPolynomial σ R)) :
    m.leadingTerm '' (B \ {0}) = (m.leadingTerm '' B) \ {0}
proof:
:= by
  aesop

name: image_leadingTerm_insert_zero
statement:
lemma image_leadingTerm_insert_zero (B : Set (MvPolynomial σ R)) :
    m.leadingTerm '' (insert (0 : MvPolynomial σ R) B) = insert 0 (m.leadingTerm '' B)
proof:
:= by
  aesop

name: degree_leadingTerm
statement:
@[simp]
lemma degree_leadingTerm (f : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    m.degree (m.leadingTerm f) = m.degree f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [leadingTerm, degree_monomial, leadingCoeff_eq_zero_iff, ite_eq_right_iff]
  simp_intro h

name: leadingCoeff_leadingTerm
statement:
@[simp]
lemma leadingCoeff_leadingTerm (f : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    m.leadingCoeff (m.leadingTerm f) = m.leadingCoeff f
proof:
:= by
  simp [leadingTerm, leadingCoeff_monomial]

name: leadingTerm_leadingTerm
statement:
@[simp]
lemma leadingTerm_leadingTerm (f : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    m.leadingTerm (m.leadingTerm f) = m.leadingTerm f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases h : f = 0 <;> simp [leadingTerm, h, degree_monomial]

name: leadingTerm_C
statement:
@[simp]
lemma leadingTerm_C (c : R) : m.leadingTerm (C c) = C c
proof:
:= by
  simp [leadingTerm, leadingCoeff_C]

name: leadingTerm_monomial
statement:
@[simp]
lemma leadingTerm_monomial (s : σ →₀ ℕ) (c : R) :
    m.leadingTerm (monomial s c) = monomial s c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases h : c = 0 <;> simp [leadingTerm, degree_monomial, h]

name: leadingTerm_X
statement:
@[simp]
lemma leadingTerm_X {s : σ} : m.leadingTerm (X s : MvPolynomial σ R) = X s
proof:
:= by
  simp [X]

name: degree_leadingTerm_mul
statement:
@[simp]
lemma degree_leadingTerm_mul [NoZeroDivisors R] (p q : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    m.degree (m.leadingTerm p * q) = m.degree (p * q)
proof:
:= by
  wlog! +distrib h : p ≠ 0 ∧ q ≠ 0
  · obtain rfl | rfl := h <;> simp
  classical
  simp [leadingTerm, degree_mul, h, degree_monomial]

name: degree_mul_leadingTerm
statement:
@[simp]
lemma degree_mul_leadingTerm [NoZeroDivisors R] (p q : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    m.degree (p * m.leadingTerm q) = m.degree (p * q)
proof:
:=
  mul_comm _ p ▸ mul_comm _ p ▸ m.degree_leadingTerm_mul q p

name: degree_lt_of_left_ne_zero_of_degree_mul_lt
proof:
:= by
  wlog! hq : q ≠ 0
  · simp [hq] at h
  apply lt_of_le_of_lt' m.degree_mul_le at h
  simpa [m.degree_mul hp hq] using h

name: degree_mul_lt_iff_left_lt_of_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨m.degree_lt_of_left_ne_zero_of_degree_mul_lt hp, ?_⟩
  intro h
  simpa [m.degree_mul hp hq, m.degree_mul (show p' ≠ 0 by contrapose! h; simp [h]) hq] using h

name: monic_leadingTerm
statement:
@[simp]
lemma monic_leadingTerm (p : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    m.Monic (m.leadingTerm p) ↔ m.Monic p
proof: := by simp [leadingTerm, Monic]

name: support_leadingTerm
statement:
lemma support_leadingTerm (p : MvPolynomial σ R) [Decidable (p = 0)] :
    support (m.leadingTerm p) = if p = 0 then ∅ else {m.degree p}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [leadingTerm, support_monomial]

name: support_leadingTerm'
statement:
lemma support_leadingTerm' {p : MvPolynomial σ R} (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    support (m.leadingTerm p) = {m.degree p}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [leadingTerm, support_monomial, hp]

name: le_degree_of_mem_support
statement:
lemma le_degree_of_mem_support {p : MvPolynomial σ R} {a : σ →₀ ℕ}
    (ha : a ∈ p.support) : a ≼[m] m.degree p
proof:
:= by
  simp [degree, Finset.le_sup ha]

name: leadingTerm_eq_leadingTerm_iff
statement:
lemma leadingTerm_eq_leadingTerm_iff {p q : MvPolynomial σ R} :
    m.leadingTerm p = m.leadingTerm q ↔
    m.leadingCoeff p = m.leadingCoeff q ∧ m.degree p = m.degree q
proof:
:= by
  rw [leadingTerm, leadingTerm, monomial_eq_monomial_iff]
  aesop

name: leadingTerm_mul_of_mul_leadingCoeff_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  simp [leadingTerm, hfg, leadingCoeff_mul_of_mul_leadingCoeff_ne_zero,
    degree_mul_of_mul_leadingCoeff_ne_zero]

name: leadingTerm_mul_of_left_mem_nonZeroDivisors
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hg : g = 0
  · simp [hg]
  · simp [leadingTerm, hf, hg, leadingCoeff_mul_of_left_mem_nonZeroDivisors,
      degree_mul_of_left_mem_nonZeroDivisors]

name: leadingTerm_mul_of_right_mem_nonZeroDivisors
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : f = 0
  · simp [hf]
  · simp [leadingTerm, hf, hg, leadingCoeff_mul_of_right_mem_nonZeroDivisors,
      degree_mul_of_right_mem_nonZeroDivisors]

name: leadingTerm_mul_of_isRegular_left
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hg : g = 0
  · simp [hg]
  · simp [leadingTerm, hf, hg, leadingCoeff_mul_of_isRegular_left, degree_mul_of_isRegular_left]

name: leadingTerm_mul_of_isRegular_right
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : f = 0
  · simp [hf]
  · simp [leadingTerm, hf, hg, leadingCoeff_mul_of_isRegular_right, degree_mul_of_isRegular_right]

name: leadingTerm_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leadingTerm_mul [NoZeroDivisors R] (p q : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    m.leadingTerm (p * q) = m.leadingTerm p * m.leadingTerm q
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! h0 : p * q = 0
  · simp [h0, zero_eq_mul.mp]
  simp [leadingTerm, m.degree_mul' h0]

name: leadingTerm_prod_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors
proof:
:= by
  simp [leadingTerm, degree_prod_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors H, monomial_sum_prod,
    leadingCoeff_prod_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors H]

name: leadingTerm_prod_of_regular
proof:
:= by
  simp [leadingTerm, degree_prod_of_regular H, leadingCoeff_prod_of_regular H, monomial_sum_prod]

name: leadingTerm_add_of_lt
statement:
theorem leadingTerm_add_of_lt {f g : MvPolynomial σ R} (h : m.degree g ≺[m] m.degree f) :
    m.leadingTerm (f + g) = m.leadingTerm f
proof:
:= by
  simp [leadingTerm, h, degree_add_of_lt, leadingCoeff_add_of_lt]

name: monic_of_subsingleton
statement:
@[simp, nontriviality]
lemma monic_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton R] (p : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    m.Monic p
proof:
:= by
  simp [Subsingleton.eq_one (α := MvPolynomial σ R)]

name: degree_le_degree_of_support_subset
statement:
lemma degree_le_degree_of_support_subset {p q : MvPolynomial σ R} (h : p.support ⊆ q.support) :
    m.degree p ≼[m] m.degree q
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [degree, m.toSyn.apply_symm_apply]
  exact Finset.sup_mono h

name: toSyn_degree_mul_le
statement:
theorem toSyn_degree_mul_le {f g : MvPolynomial σ R} :
    m.toSyn (m.degree (f * g)) ≤ m.toSyn (m.degree f) + m.toSyn (m.degree g)
proof:
:=
  map_add m.toSyn _ _ ▸ degree_mul_le

name: mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_leadingCoeff_mem_nonZeroDivisors
statement:
lemma mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_leadingCoeff_mem_nonZeroDivisors
    {f : MvPolynomial σ R} (hf : m.leadingCoeff f ∈ R⁰) : f ∈ (MvPolynomial σ R)⁰
proof:
:= by
  rw [← nonZeroDivisorsLeft_eq_nonZeroDivisors, mem_nonZeroDivisorsLeft_iff]
  intro g
  simp [← m.leadingCoeff_eq_zero_iff (f := f * g),
    m.leadingCoeff_mul_of_left_mem_nonZeroDivisors hf, mul_left_mem_nonZeroDivisors_eq_zero_iff hf]

name: withBotDegree_eq
statement:
lemma withBotDegree_eq [Decidable (f = 0)] :
    m.withBotDegree f = if f = 0 then ⊥ else ↑(m.degree f)
proof:
:= by
  simp [withBotDegree, degree]
  by_cases hf : f = 0
  · simp [hf]
  · simp [hf, Finset.max_eq_sup_coe, ← Finset.coe_sup_of_nonempty _ (⇑m.toSyn)]

name: withBotDegree_eq_coe_degree_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma withBotDegree_eq_coe_degree_iff : m.withBotDegree f = m.degree f ↔ f ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [withBotDegree_eq]

name: withBotDegree_eq_bot_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma withBotDegree_eq_bot_iff : m.withBotDegree f = ⊥ ↔ f = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [withBotDegree_eq]

name: degree_eq_unbotD_withBotDegree
statement: lemma degree_eq_unbotD_withBotDegree : m.degree f = (m.withBotDegree f).unbotD 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases h : f = 0 <;> simp [withBotDegree_eq, h]

name: withBotDegree_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma withBotDegree_zero : m.withBotDegree (R := R) 0 = ⊥
proof: := rfl

name: withBotDegree_monomial
statement:
lemma withBotDegree_monomial (d) (c) [Decidable (c = 0)] :
    m.withBotDegree (R := R) (monomial d c) = if c = 0 then ⊥ else ↑d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  split_ifs <;> simp [withBotDegree_eq, *, m.degree_monomial]

name: withBotDegree_C
statement:
lemma withBotDegree_C (c) [Decidable (c = 0)] :
    m.withBotDegree (R := R) (C c) = if c = 0 then ⊥ else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [← monomial_zero', withBotDegree_monomial]

name: withBotDegree_leadingTerm
statement:
@[simp]
lemma withBotDegree_leadingTerm : m.withBotDegree (m.leadingTerm f) = m.withBotDegree f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [withBotDegree_eq]

name: withBotDegree_one
statement:
@[simp]
lemma withBotDegree_one [Nontrivial R] : m.withBotDegree (R := R) 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [withBotDegree_eq]

name: withBotDegree_mul_of_left_mem_nonZeroDivisors
statement:
lemma withBotDegree_mul_of_left_mem_nonZeroDivisors (hf : m.leadingCoeff f ∈ nonZeroDivisors _) :
    m.withBotDegree (f * g) = m.withBotDegree f + m.withBotDegree g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases! h0 : f = 0 ∨ g = 0
  · rcases h0 with h0 | h0 <;> simp [h0]
  suffices f * g ≠ 0 by simp [withBotDegree_eq, m.degree_mul_of_left_mem_nonZeroDivisors hf, *]
  apply mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_leadingCoeff_mem_nonZeroDivisors at hf
  rw [mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_left] at hf
  tauto

name: withBotDegree_mul_of_right_mem_nonZeroDivisors
statement:
lemma withBotDegree_mul_of_right_mem_nonZeroDivisors (hf : m.leadingCoeff g ∈ nonZeroDivisors _) :
    m.withBotDegree (f * g) = m.withBotDegree f + m.withBotDegree g
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm, add_comm, withBotDegree_mul_of_left_mem_nonZeroDivisors (hf := hf)]

name: withBotDegree_mul
statement:
@[simp]
lemma withBotDegree_mul [NoZeroDivisors R] :
    m.withBotDegree (f * g) = m.withBotDegree f + m.withBotDegree g
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R using Subsingleton.eq_zero (α := MvPolynomial σ R)
  by_cases! hf : f = 0
  · simp [hf]
  rw [← m.leadingCoeff_ne_zero_iff, ← mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero] at hf
  exact m.withBotDegree_mul_of_left_mem_nonZeroDivisors hf

name: withBotDegree_mul_le
statement:
lemma withBotDegree_mul_le :
    m.withBotDegree (f * g) ≼'[m] m.withBotDegree f + m.withBotDegree g
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! h0 : f * g = 0
  · simp [h0]
  simp [-map_add, m.withBotDegree_eq_coe_degree_iff _ |>.mpr h0,
    m.withBotDegree_eq_coe_degree_iff f |>.mpr (by grind),
    m.withBotDegree_eq_coe_degree_iff g |>.mpr (by grind), ← WithBot.coe_add, m.degree_mul_le]

name: toWithBotSyn_withBotDegree_mul_le
statement:
lemma toWithBotSyn_withBotDegree_mul_le :
    m.toWithBotSyn (m.withBotDegree (f * g)) ≤
      m.toWithBotSyn (m.withBotDegree f) + m.toWithBotSyn (m.withBotDegree g)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h0 : f * g = 0
  · simp [h0]
  simp [m.withBotDegree_eq_coe_degree_iff f |>.mpr (by grind),
    m.withBotDegree_eq_coe_degree_iff g |>.mpr (by grind),
    m.withBotDegree_eq_coe_degree_iff _ |>.mpr h0, ← WithBot.coe_add,
    m.toSyn_degree_mul_le]

name: withBotDegree_le_withBotDegree_iff
statement:
lemma withBotDegree_le_withBotDegree_iff :
    m.withBotDegree f ≼'[m] m.withBotDegree g ↔
      (m.degree f ≼[m] m.degree g ∧ (g = 0 → f = 0))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases! +distrib h : f ≠ 0 ∧ g ≠ 0
  · simp [m.withBotDegree_eq, h, m.toWithBotSyn_apply]
  rcases h with h | _
  · simp [h]
  · aesop

name: withBotDegree_le_withBotDegree_iff_of_ne_zero
statement:
lemma withBotDegree_le_withBotDegree_iff_of_ne_zero (hg : g ≠ 0) :
    m.withBotDegree f ≼'[m] m.withBotDegree g ↔ m.degree f ≼[m] m.degree g
proof:
:= by
  simp [withBotDegree_le_withBotDegree_iff, hg]

name: withBotDegree_lt_withBotDegree_iff
statement:
lemma withBotDegree_lt_withBotDegree_iff :
    m.withBotDegree f ≺'[m] m.withBotDegree g ↔
      (m.degree f ≺[m] m.degree g ∨ (f = 0 ∧ g ≠ 0))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases! hg : g = 0
  · simp_rw [toWithBotSyn_apply]
    aesop
  by_cases! hf : f = 0
  · simp [hg, hf, bot_lt_iff_ne_bot, toWithBotSyn_apply]
  simp [withBotDegree_eq, hf, hg, toWithBotSyn_apply]

name: withBotDegree_lt_withBotDegree_iff_of_ne_zero
statement:
lemma withBotDegree_lt_withBotDegree_iff_of_ne_zero (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    m.withBotDegree f ≺'[m] m.withBotDegree g ↔ m.degree f ≺[m] m.degree g
proof:
:= by
  simp [withBotDegree_lt_withBotDegree_iff, hf]

name: withBotDegree_eq_withBotDegree_iff
statement:
lemma withBotDegree_eq_withBotDegree_iff :
    m.withBotDegree f = m.withBotDegree g ↔ (m.degree f = m.degree g ∧ (f = 0 ↔ g = 0))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases! +distrib h : f ≠ 0 ∧ g ≠ 0
  · simp [h, m.withBotDegree_eq]
  rcases h with h | h
  all_goals
    simp_rw [h]
    revert f g
    simp [m.withBotDegree_eq, m.degree_zero]

name: withBotDegree_add_le
statement:
lemma withBotDegree_add_le :
    (m.toWithBotSyn <| m.withBotDegree (f + g)) ≤
      (m.toWithBotSyn <| m.withBotDegree f) ⊔ (m.toWithBotSyn <| m.withBotDegree g)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! h : f = 0 ∨ g = 0
  · rcases h with h | h <;> simp [h, m.toWithBotSyn_apply]
  simpa [withBotDegree_le_withBotDegree_iff, h] using degree_add_le (R := R)

name: withBotDegree_add_of_lt
statement:
lemma withBotDegree_add_of_lt (h : m.withBotDegree g ≺'[m] m.withBotDegree f) :
    m.withBotDegree (f + g) = m.withBotDegree f
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hg : g = 0
  · simp [hg]
  simp only [withBotDegree_lt_withBotDegree_iff, hg, ne_eq, false_and, or_false] at h
  simp only [withBotDegree_eq_withBotDegree_iff, show f ≠ 0 by contrapose h; simp [h], iff_false]
  apply (show ∀ {p q}, p → (p → q) → (p ∧ q) by tauto) (m.degree_add_of_lt h)
  intro h'
  contrapose! h
  simp [← h', h]

name: withBotDegree_add_of_right_lt
statement:
lemma withBotDegree_add_of_right_lt (h : m.withBotDegree f ≺'[m] m.withBotDegree g) :
    m.withBotDegree (f + g) = m.withBotDegree g
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm, withBotDegree_add_of_lt h]

name: withBotDegree_sum_le
statement:
lemma withBotDegree_sum_le {α : Type*} {s : Finset α} {f : α → MvPolynomial σ R} :
    (m.toWithBotSyn <| m.withBotDegree <| ∑ x ∈ s, f x) ≤
      s.sup fun x ↦ (m.toWithBotSyn <| m.withBotDegree <| f x)
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | cons a s haA h =>
    rw [Finset.sum_cons, Finset.sup_cons]
    exact le_trans (m.withBotDegree_add_le _ _) (max_le_max le_rfl h)

name: le_withBotDegree
statement:
lemma le_withBotDegree {d : σ →₀ ℕ} (hd : d ∈ f.support) :
    d ≼'[m] m.withBotDegree f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [withBotDegree_eq, toWithBotSyn_apply, ne_zero_iff.mpr ⟨d, by simpa using hd⟩, le_degree hd]

name: withBotDegree_le_withBotDegree_of_support_subset
statement:
lemma withBotDegree_le_withBotDegree_of_support_subset
    (h : f.support ⊆ g.support) :
    m.withBotDegree f ≼'[m] m.withBotDegree g
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hg : g = 0
  · simpa [hg] using h
  rw [m.withBotDegree_le_withBotDegree_iff_of_ne_zero _ hg]
  exact m.degree_le_degree_of_support_subset h

name: sPolynomial_def
statement:
lemma sPolynomial_def (f g : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    m.sPolynomial f g =
      monomial (m.degree f ⊔ m.degree g - m.degree f) (m.leadingCoeff g) * f -
      monomial (m.degree f ⊔ m.degree g - m.degree g) (m.leadingCoeff f) * g
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ f g, m.degree g - m.degree f = m.degree f ⊔ m.degree g - m.degree f by
    rw [sPolynomial, this, this, sup_comm]
  intro f g
  ext a
  obtain (h | h) := le_total (m.degree f a) (m.degree g a) <;> simp [h]

name: degree_ne_zero_of_sub_leadingTerm_ne_zero
statement:
lemma degree_ne_zero_of_sub_leadingTerm_ne_zero {f : MvPolynomial σ R}
    (h : f - m.leadingTerm f ≠ 0) : m.degree f ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  contrapose h
  rw [m.degree_eq_zero_iff.mp h, leadingTerm_C, sub_eq_zero]

name: degree_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem degree_neg {f : MvPolynomial σ R} :
    m.degree (-f) = m.degree f
proof:
:= by
  unfold degree
  rw [support_neg]

name: leadingCoeff_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leadingCoeff_neg {f : MvPolynomial σ R} :
    m.leadingCoeff (-f) = - m.leadingCoeff f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [leadingCoeff, degree_neg, coeff_neg]

name: leadingTerm_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leadingTerm_neg {f : MvPolynomial σ R} :
    m.leadingTerm (-f) = - m.leadingTerm f
proof:
:= by
  simp [leadingTerm]

name: degree_sub_le
statement:
theorem degree_sub_le {f g : MvPolynomial σ R} :
    m.toSyn (m.degree (f - g)) ≤ m.toSyn (m.degree f) ⊔ m.toSyn (m.degree g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
  apply le_of_le_of_eq m.degree_add_le
  rw [degree_neg]

name: degree_sub_of_lt
statement:
theorem degree_sub_of_lt {f g : MvPolynomial σ R} (h : m.degree g ≺[m] m.degree f) :
    m.degree (f - g) = m.degree f
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
  apply degree_add_of_lt
  simp only [degree_neg, h]

name: leadingCoeff_sub_of_lt
statement:
theorem leadingCoeff_sub_of_lt {f g : MvPolynomial σ R} (h : m.degree g ≺[m] m.degree f) :
    m.leadingCoeff (f - g) = m.leadingCoeff f
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
  apply leadingCoeff_add_of_lt
  simp only [degree_neg, h]

name: leadingTerm_sub_of_lt
statement:
theorem leadingTerm_sub_of_lt {f g : MvPolynomial σ R} (h : m.degree g ≺[m] m.degree f) :
    m.leadingTerm (f - g) = m.leadingTerm f
proof:
:= by
  simp [leadingTerm, h, degree_sub_of_lt, leadingCoeff_sub_of_lt]

name: degree_sub_leadingTerm_le
statement:
theorem degree_sub_leadingTerm_le (f : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    m.degree (f - m.leadingTerm f) ≼[m] m.degree f
proof:
:= by
  apply le_trans degree_sub_le
  simp [degree_leadingTerm]

name: degree_sub_leadingTerm_lt_degree
statement:
theorem degree_sub_leadingTerm_lt_degree {f : MvPolynomial σ R} (h : m.degree f ≠ 0) :
    m.degree (f - m.leadingTerm f) ≺[m] m.degree f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hl : f - m.leadingTerm f = 0
  · simpa [hl, toSyn_lt_iff_ne_zero]
  · apply lt_of_le_of_ne (m.degree_sub_leadingTerm_le f)
    by_contra! h'
    simp only [EmbeddingLike.apply_eq_iff_eq] at h'
    apply m.degree_mem_support at hl
    rw [h', mem_support_iff] at hl
    simp [leadingTerm, leadingCoeff] at hl

name: degree_sub_leadingTerm_lt_iff
statement:
theorem degree_sub_leadingTerm_lt_iff {f : MvPolynomial σ R} :
    m.degree (f - m.leadingTerm f) ≺[m] m.degree f ↔ m.degree f ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, degree_sub_leadingTerm_lt_degree⟩
  intro h h'
  simp only [h', map_zero] at h
  exact not_lt_bot h

name: sPolynomial_antisymm
statement:
lemma sPolynomial_antisymm (f g : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    m.sPolynomial f g = - m.sPolynomial g f
proof:
:=
  (neg_sub (_ * g) (_ * f)).symm

name: sPolynomial_left_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma sPolynomial_left_zero (g : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    m.sPolynomial 0 g = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [sPolynomial]

name: sPolynomial_self
statement:
@[simp]
lemma sPolynomial_self (f : MvPolynomial σ R) : m.sPolynomial f f = 0
proof: := sub_self _

name: degree_sPolynomial_le
statement:
lemma degree_sPolynomial_le (f g : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    ((m.degree <| m.sPolynomial f g) ≼[m] m.degree f ⊔ m.degree g)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  wlog! +distrib h0 : f ≠ 0 ∧ g ≠ 0
  · (obtain rfl | rfl := h0) <;> simp
  simp only [sPolynomial_def]
  apply degree_sub_le.trans
  apply (sup_le_sup degree_mul_le degree_mul_le).trans
  simp [degree_monomial, h0.1, h0.2, tsub_add_cancel_of_le, le_sup_left, le_sup_right]

name: coeff_sPolynomial_sup_eq_zero
statement:
lemma coeff_sPolynomial_sup_eq_zero (f g : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    (m.sPolynomial f g).coeff (m.degree f ⊔ m.degree g) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [sPolynomial_def, coeff_sub]
  nth_rewrite 2 [← tsub_add_cancel_of_le le_sup_left]
  rw [coeff_monomial_mul]
  nth_rewrite 2 [← tsub_add_cancel_of_le le_sup_right]
  rw [coeff_monomial_mul]
  unfold leadingCoeff
  ring

name: degree_sPolynomial
statement:
lemma degree_sPolynomial (f g : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    (m.degree <| m.sPolynomial f g) ≺[m] m.degree f ⊔ m.degree g ∨ m.sPolynomial f g = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : m.degree f = 0 ∧ m.degree g = 0
  · rcases hf with ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    right
    suffices C (m.leadingCoeff g) * f - C (m.leadingCoeff f) * g = 0 by simp_all [sPolynomial_def]
    nth_rewrite 1 [degree_eq_zero_iff.mp h₁]
    nth_rewrite 2 [degree_eq_zero_iff.mp h₂]
    ring
  · rw [or_iff_not_imp_right]
    intro hs
    apply (m.degree_sPolynomial_le f g).lt_of_ne
    apply m.toSyn.injective.ne
    contrapose hs
    rw [← m.coeff_degree_eq_zero_iff, hs, m.coeff_sPolynomial_sup_eq_zero]

name: degree_sPolynomial_lt_sup_degree

lemma degree_sPolynomial_lt_sup_degree {f g : MvPolynomial σ R} (h : m.sPolynomial f g ≠ 0) :
    (m.degree <| m.sPolynomial f g) ≺[m] m.degree f ⊔ m.degree g
proof:
:=
  (or_iff_left h).mp <| m.degree_sPolynomial f g

name: sPolynomial_lt_of_degree_ne_zero_of_degree_eq
proof:
:= by
  simpa [h] using m.degree_sPolynomial_lt_sup_degree hs

name: sPolynomial_monomial_mul
statement:
lemma sPolynomial_monomial_mul [NoZeroDivisors R] (p₁ p₂ : MvPolynomial σ R) (d₁ d₂ : σ →₀ ℕ)
    (c₁ c₂ : R) :
    m.sPolynomial ((monomial d₁ c₁) * p₁) ((monomial d₂ c₂) * p₂) =
      monomial ((d₁ + m.degree p₁) ⊔ (d₂ + m.degree p₂) - m.degree p₁ ⊔ m.degree p₂) (c₁ * c₂) *
      m.sPolynomial p₁ p₂
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [sPolynomial_def]
  wlog! +distrib H : c₁ ≠ 0 ∧ c₂ ≠ 0 ∧ p₁ ≠ 0 ∧ p₂ ≠ 0
  · (obtain rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl := H) <;> simp
  rcases H with ⟨hc1, hc2, hp1, hp2⟩
  have hm1 := (monomial_eq_zero (s := d₁)).not.mpr hc1
  have hm2 := (monomial_eq_zero (s := d₂)).not.mpr hc2
  simp_rw [m.degree_mul hm1 hp1, m.degree_mul hm2 hp2,
    mul_sub, ← mul_assoc _ _ p₁, ← mul_assoc _ _ p₂, monomial_mul_monomial,
    m.leadingCoeff_mul, m.leadingCoeff_monomial,
    degree_monomial, hc1, hc2, reduceIte, mul_right_comm, mul_comm c₂ c₁]
  rw [tsub_add_tsub_cancel (sup_le_sup (self_le_add_left _ _) (self_le_add_left _ _)) (by simp),
    tsub_add_tsub_cancel (sup_le_sup (self_le_add_left _ _) (self_le_add_left _ _)) (by simp),
    tsub_add_eq_add_tsub le_sup_left, tsub_add_eq_add_tsub le_sup_right,
    add_comm d₁, add_comm d₂, add_tsub_add_eq_tsub_right, add_tsub_add_eq_tsub_right]

name: sPolynomial_monomial_mul'
statement:
lemma sPolynomial_monomial_mul' [NoZeroDivisors R] (p₁ p₂ : MvPolynomial σ R) (d₁ d₂ : σ →₀ ℕ)
    (c₁ c₂ : R) :
    m.sPolynomial (monomial d₁ c₁ * p₁) (monomial d₂ c₂ * p₂) =
      monomial (m.degree (monomial d₁ c₁ * p₁) ⊔ m.degree (monomial d₂ c₂ * p₂) -
          m.degree p₁ ⊔ m.degree p₂) (c₁ * c₂) *
      m.sPolynomial p₁ p₂
proof:
:= by
  classical
  wlog! +distrib H : c₁ ≠ 0 ∧ c₂ ≠ 0 ∧ p₁ ≠ 0 ∧ p₂ ≠ 0
  · (obtain rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl := H) <;> simp
  simp [H, degree_mul, sPolynomial_monomial_mul, degree_monomial]

name: sPolynomial_leadingTerm_mul
statement:
lemma sPolynomial_leadingTerm_mul [NoZeroDivisors R] (p₁ p₂ q₁ q₂ : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    m.sPolynomial (m.leadingTerm p₁ * q₁) (m.leadingTerm p₂ * q₂) =
    monomial
        ((m.degree p₁ + m.degree q₁) ⊔ (m.degree p₂ + m.degree q₂) - m.degree q₁ ⊔ m.degree q₂)
        (m.leadingCoeff p₁ * m.leadingCoeff p₂) *
      m.sPolynomial q₁ q₂
proof:
:= by
  simp [sPolynomial_monomial_mul, leadingTerm]

name: sPolynomial_leadingTerm_mul'
statement:
lemma sPolynomial_leadingTerm_mul' [NoZeroDivisors R] (p₁ p₂ q₁ q₂ : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    m.sPolynomial (m.leadingTerm p₁ * q₁) (m.leadingTerm p₂ * q₂) =
    monomial
        ((m.degree (p₁ * q₁)) ⊔ (m.degree (p₂ * q₂)) - m.degree q₁ ⊔ m.degree q₂)
        (m.leadingCoeff p₁ * m.leadingCoeff p₂) *
      m.sPolynomial q₁ q₂
proof:
:= by
  wlog! +distrib H : p₁ ≠ 0 ∧ p₂ ≠ 0 ∧ q₁ ≠ 0 ∧ q₂ ≠ 0
  · (obtain rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl := H) <;> simp
  simp [H, leadingTerm, sPolynomial_monomial_mul, degree_mul]

name: sPolynomial_decomposition
statement:
lemma sPolynomial_decomposition {d : m.syn} {ι : Type*}
    {B : Finset ι} {g : ι → MvPolynomial σ R}
    (hd : ∀ b ∈ B,
      (m.toSyn <| m.degree <| g b) = d ∧ IsUnit (m.leadingCoeff <| g b) ∨ g b = 0)
    (hfd : (m.toSyn <| m.degree <| ∑ b ∈ B, g b) < d) :
    ∃ (c : ι → ι → R),
      ∑ b ∈ B, g b = ∑ b₁ ∈ B, ∑ b₂ ∈ B, (c b₁ b₂) • m.sPolynomial (g b₁) (g b₂)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction B using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert b B hb h =>
    by_cases hb0 : g b = 0
    · simp_all
    simp? [Finset.sum_insert hb, hb0] at hfd hd says
      simp only [Finset.sum_insert hb, Finset.mem_insert, forall_eq_or_imp, hb0, or_false]
        at hfd hd
    obtain ⟨⟨rfl, isunit_gb⟩, hd⟩ := hd
    use fun b₁ b₂ ↦ if b₂ = b then ↑isunit_gb.unit⁻¹ else 0
    simp? [Finset.sum_insert hb, hb] says
      simp only [Finset.sum_insert hb, ite_smul, zero_smul, ↓reduceIte, Finset.sum_ite_eq', hb,
        add_zero, sPolynomial_self, smul_zero, zero_add]
    simp only [m.toSyn.injective.eq_iff] at *
    trans ∑ b' ∈ B, (g b' - (m.leadingCoeff (g b') * ↑isunit_gb.unit⁻¹) • g b)
    · suffices (-(∑ i ∈ B, m.leadingCoeff (g i))) = m.leadingCoeff (g b) by
        rw [add_comm, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, sub_eq_add_neg, ← Finset.sum_smul, ← Finset.sum_mul,
          ← neg_smul, ← neg_mul, this, isunit_gb.mul_val_inv, one_smul]
      rw [← add_eq_zero_iff_neg_eq']
      trans (g b).coeff (m.degree <| g b) + ∑ i ∈ B, (g i).coeff (m.degree <| g b)
      · unfold leadingCoeff
        congr 1
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro b' hb'
        rcases hd b' hb' with h | h <;> simp [h]
      · rw [← coeff_sum, ← Finsupp.add_apply, ← AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, ← notMem_support_iff]
        exact m.notMem_support_of_degree_lt hfd
    · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro b' hb'
      rw [sPolynomial]
      obtain (⟨h, -⟩ | h) := hd b' hb' <;>
        simp [h, ← smul_eq_C_mul, smul_sub, ← mul_smul, mul_comm (m.leadingCoeff (g b'))]

name: sPolynomial_decomposition'
statement:
lemma sPolynomial_decomposition' {d : m.syn} {ι : Type*}
    {B : Finset ι} (g : ι → MvPolynomial σ R)
    (hd : ∀ b ∈ B, (m.toSyn <| m.degree <| g b) = d ∨ g b = 0)

name: liftOfRightInverse_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma liftOfRightInverse_apply {f : F} {f_inv : M → A} (hf : Function.RightInverse f_inv f)

name: map_intCast
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_intCast (n : ℤ) : D (n : A) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← zsmul_one, D.map_smul_of_tower n, map_one_eq_zero, smul_zero]

name: leibniz_of_mul_eq_one
statement: theorem leibniz_of_mul_eq_one {a b : A} (h : a * b = 1) : D a = -a ^ 2 • D b
proof:
:= by
  rw [neg_smul]
  refine eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left ?_
  calc
    D a + a ^ 2 • D b = a • b • D a + a • a • D b := by simp only [smul_smul, h, one_smul, sq]
    _ = a • D (a * b) := by rw [leibniz, smul_add, add_comm]
    _ = 0 := by rw [h, map_one_eq_zero, smul_zero]

name: leibniz_invOf
statement: theorem leibniz_invOf [Invertible a] : D (⅟a) = -⅟a ^ 2 • D a
proof:
:=
  D.leibniz_of_mul_eq_one <| invOf_mul_self a

name: leibniz_inv
statement: theorem leibniz_inv (a : K) : D a⁻¹ = -a⁻¹ ^ 2 • D a
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne a 0 with (rfl | ha)
  · simp
  · exact D.leibniz_of_mul_eq_one (inv_mul_cancel₀ ha)

name: leibniz_div
statement: theorem leibniz_div (a b : K) : D (a / b) = b⁻¹ ^ 2 • (b • D a - a • D b)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, leibniz, leibniz_inv, inv_pow, neg_smul, smul_neg, smul_smul, add_comm,
    sub_eq_add_neg, smul_add]
  rw [← inv_mul_mul_self b⁻¹, inv_inv]
  ring_nf

name: leibniz_div_const
statement: theorem leibniz_div_const (a b : K) (h : D b = 0) : D (a / b) = b⁻¹ • D a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [leibniz_div, inv_pow, h, smul_zero, sub_zero, smul_smul]
  rw [← mul_self_mul_inv b⁻¹, inv_inv]
  ring_nf

name: leibniz_zpow
statement: lemma leibniz_zpow (a : K) (n : ℤ) : D (a ^ n) = n • a ^ (n - 1) • D a
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · simp [hn]
  by_cases ha : a = 0
  · simp [ha, zero_zpow n hn]
  rcases Int.natAbs_eq n with h | h
  · rw [h]
    simp only [zpow_natCast, leibniz_pow, natCast_zsmul]
    rw [← zpow_natCast]
    congr
    lia
  · rw [h, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, leibniz_inv, leibniz_pow, inv_pow, ← pow_mul, ← zpow_natCast,
      ← zpow_natCast, ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul K, ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul K, smul_smul, smul_smul,
      smul_smul]
    trans (-n.natAbs * (a ^ ((n.natAbs - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) / (a ^ ((n.natAbs * 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)))) • D a
    · ring_nf
    rw [← zpow_sub₀ ha]
    congr 3
    · norm_cast
    lia

name: apply_aeval_eq'
statement:
theorem apply_aeval_eq' (d' : Derivation R B M') (f : M →ₗ[A] M')
    (h : ∀ a, f (d a) = d' (algebraMap A B a)) (x : B) (p : A[X]) :
    d' (aeval x p) = PolynomialModule.eval x (PolynomialModule.map B f (d.mapCoeffs p)) +
      aeval x (derivative p) • d' x
proof:
:= by
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add => simp_all only [map_add, add_smul]; abel
  | monomial =>
    simp only [aeval_monomial, leibniz, leibniz_pow, mapCoeffs_monomial,
      PolynomialModule.map_single, PolynomialModule.eval_single, derivative_monomial, map_mul,
      _root_.map_natCast, h]
    rw [add_comm, ← smul_smul, ← smul_smul, Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul]

name: apply_aeval_eq
statement:
theorem apply_aeval_eq [IsScalarTower R A B] [IsScalarTower A B M'] (d : Derivation R B M')

    d (aeval x p) =
      (((d.compAlgebraMap A).mapCoeffs p).map B .id).eval x + aeval x (derivative p) • d x
proof:
:=
  apply_aeval_eq' (d.compAlgebraMap A) d LinearMap.id (fun _a ↦ rfl) x p

  convert! apply_aeval_eq d x p
  ext
  rfl

name: algHom_deriv
statement:
lemma algHom_deriv (f : R →ₐ[A] R') (hf : Function.Injective f) (x : R) (h : IsSeparable A x) :
    f (x′) = (f x)′
proof:
:= by
  let p := minpoly A x
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ (a := aeval (f x) (derivative p))
  · rw [Polynomial.aeval_algHom]
    simp only [AlgHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, ne_eq, map_eq_zero_iff f hf]
    apply Separable.aeval_derivative_ne_zero h (minpoly.aeval A x)
  conv => lhs; rw [Polynomial.aeval_algHom]
  simp only [AlgHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, ← map_mul]
  apply add_left_cancel (a := aeval (f x) (mapCoeffs p))
  rw [← deriv_aeval_eq]
  simp only [aeval_algHom, AlgHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, ← map_add, ← deriv_aeval_eq,
    minpoly.aeval, map_zero, p]
