name: IsLocalRing.quotient_artinian_of_mem_minimalPrimes_of_isLocalRing
statement:
lemma IsLocalRing.quotient_artinian_of_mem_minimalPrimes_of_isLocalRing
    [IsLocalRing R] (I : Ideal R) (hp : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R ∈ I.minimalPrimes) :
    IsArtinianRing (R ⧸ I)
proof:
:=
  have : Ring.KrullDimLE 0 (R ⧸ I) := Ring.krullDimLE_zero_iff.mpr fun J prime ↦
    Ideal.isMaximal_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal_under _ <| by
      convert! IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal R
      rw [Ideal.minimalPrimes, Set.mem_ofPred] at hp
      have := prime.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
      exact hp.eq_of_le ⟨this, .trans (by simp) (Ideal.ker_le_comap _)⟩ (le_maximalIdeal this.1)
  IsNoetherianRing.isArtinianRing_of_krullDimLE_zero

name: Ideal.height_le_one_of_isPrincipal_of_mem_minimalPrimes_of_isLocalRing
statement:
lemma Ideal.height_le_one_of_isPrincipal_of_mem_minimalPrimes_of_isLocalRing
    [IsLocalRing R] (I : Ideal R) [I.IsPrincipal]
    (hp : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) ∈ I.minimalPrimes) :
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).height ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  refine Ideal.height_le_iff.mpr fun q h₁ h₂ ↦ ?_
  suffices q.height = 0 by rw [this]; exact zero_lt_one
  rw [← WithBot.coe_inj,
    ← IsLocalization.AtPrime.ringKrullDim_eq_height q (Localization.AtPrime q),
    WithBot.coe_zero, ← ringKrullDimZero_iff_ringKrullDim_eq_zero,
    ← isArtinianRing_iff_krullDimLE_zero, isArtinianRing_iff_isNilpotent_maximalIdeal,
    ← Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal]
  have : IsArtinianRing (R ⧸ I) :=
    IsLocalRing.quotient_artinian_of_mem_minimalPrimes_of_isLocalRing I hp
  let f := algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime q)
  let qs : ℕ →o (Ideal (R ⧸ I))ᵒᵈ :=
    { toFun n := ((q.map f ^ n).comap f).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
      monotone' i j e := Ideal.map_mono (Ideal.comap_mono (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right e)) }
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := IsArtinian.monotone_stabilizes qs
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  apply Submodule.eq_bot_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson_bot (q.map f) _ (IsNoetherian.noetherian _)
  rotate_left
  · rw [IsLocalRing.jacobson_eq_maximalIdeal, Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal]
    exact bot_ne_top
  rw [smul_eq_mul, ← pow_succ',
    ← (IsLocalization.orderEmbedding q.primeCompl (Localization.AtPrime q)).map_rel_iff]
  refine Submodule.le_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson_bot (I := I) (IsNoetherian.noetherian _) ?_ ?_
  · rw [IsLocalRing.jacobson_eq_maximalIdeal]
    exacts [hp.le, bot_ne_top]
  · replace hn := congr(Ideal.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) $(hn _ n.le_succ))
    simp only [qs, OrderHom.coe_mk, ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, Ideal.mk_ker,
      Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective] at hn
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy, z, hz, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp (hn.le (Ideal.mem_sup_left hx))
    refine Submodule.add_mem_sup hy ?_
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := (Submodule.IsPrincipal.mem_iff_eq_smul_generator I).mp hz
    rw [smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
    refine Ideal.mul_mem_mul ?_ (Submodule.IsPrincipal.generator_mem _)
    dsimp [IsLocalization.orderEmbedding] at hx
    rwa [Ideal.mem_comap, f.map_add, f.map_mul, Ideal.add_mem_iff_right _
      (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right n.le_succ hy), mul_comm, Ideal.unit_mul_mem_iff_mem] at hx
    refine IsLocalization.map_units (M := q.primeCompl) _ ⟨_, ?_⟩
    change Submodule.IsPrincipal.generator I ∉ (↑q : Set R)
    rw [← Set.singleton_subset_iff, ← Ideal.span_le, Ideal.span_singleton_generator]
    exact fun e ↦ h₂.not_ge (hp.2 ⟨h₁, e⟩ h₂.le)

name: Ideal.height_le_one_of_isPrincipal_of_mem_minimalPrimes
statement:
lemma Ideal.height_le_one_of_isPrincipal_of_mem_minimalPrimes
    (I : Ideal R) [I.IsPrincipal] (p : Ideal R) (hp : p ∈ I.minimalPrimes) : p.height ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have := hp.isPrime
  let f := algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime p)
  have := Ideal.height_le_one_of_isPrincipal_of_mem_minimalPrimes_of_isLocalRing (I.map f) ?_
  · rwa [← IsLocalization.height_under p.primeCompl,
      Localization.AtPrime.under_maximalIdeal] at this
  · rwa [IsLocalization.minimalPrimes_map p.primeCompl (Localization.AtPrime p) I,
      Set.mem_preimage, Localization.AtPrime.under_maximalIdeal]

name: Ideal.map_height_le_one_of_mem_minimalPrimes
statement:
theorem Ideal.map_height_le_one_of_mem_minimalPrimes {I p : Ideal R} {x : R}
    (hp : p ∈ (I ⊔ span {x}).minimalPrimes) : (p.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).height ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  let f := Ideal.Quotient.mk I
  have : p.IsPrime := hp.isPrime
  have hfp : RingHom.ker f ≤ p := I.mk_ker.trans_le (le_sup_left.trans hp.le)
  height_le_one_of_isPrincipal_of_mem_minimalPrimes ((span {x}).map f) (p.map f)
    ⟨⟨map_isPrime_of_surjective Quotient.mk_surjective hfp,
      map_mono (le_sup_right.trans hp.le)⟩,
        fun _ ⟨hr, hxr⟩ hrp ↦ map_le_iff_le_comap.mpr <| hp.2 ⟨hr.comap f, sup_le_iff.mpr
          ⟨I.mk_ker.symm.trans_le <| ker_le_comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk I), le_comap_of_map_le hxr⟩⟩ <|
            (comap_mono hrp).trans <| Eq.le <|
              (p.comap_map_of_surjective _ Quotient.mk_surjective).trans <| sup_eq_left.mpr hfp⟩

name: Ideal.height_span_singleton_le_one
statement:
lemma Ideal.height_span_singleton_le_one {x : R} (hx' : ¬ IsUnit x) :
    (span {x}).height ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := (span {x}).nonempty_minimalPrimes (by simpa)
  refine le_trans (height_mono hp.1.2) ?_
  exact Ideal.height_le_one_of_isPrincipal_of_mem_minimalPrimes (span {x}) _ hp

name: Ideal.height_span_singleton_eq_one_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors
statement:
lemma Ideal.height_span_singleton_eq_one_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors {x : R}
    (hx : x ∈ nonZeroDivisors R) (hx' : ¬ IsUnit x) : (span {x}).height = 1
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (height_span_singleton_le_one hx')
    (one_le_height_span_singleton_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors hx)

name: Ideal.mem_minimalPrimes_span_of_mem_minimalPrimes_span_insert
statement:
theorem Ideal.mem_minimalPrimes_span_of_mem_minimalPrimes_span_insert {q p : Ideal R} [q.IsPrime]
    (hqp : q < p) (x : R) (s : Set R) (hp : p ∈ (span (insert x s)).minimalPrimes)
    (t : Set R) (htq : t ⊆ q) (hsp : s ⊆ (span (insert x t)).radical) :
    q ∈ (span t).minimalPrimes
proof:
:= by
  let f := Quotient.mk (span t)
  have hf : Function.Surjective f := Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hI'q : span t ≤ q := span_le.mpr htq
  have hI'p : span t ≤ p := hI'q.trans hqp.le
  have := hp.isPrime
  have : (p.map f).IsPrime := map_isPrime_of_surjective hf (by rwa [mk_ker])
  suffices h : (p.map f).height ≤ 1 by
    have h_lt : q.map f < p.map f := (map_mono hqp.le).lt_of_not_ge fun e ↦ hqp.not_ge <| by
      simpa only [comap_map_of_surjective f hf, ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, f, mk_ker,
        sup_eq_left.mpr hI'q, sup_eq_left.mpr hI'p] using comap_mono (f := f) e
    have : (q.map f).IsPrime := map_isPrime_of_surjective hf (by rwa [mk_ker])
    have : (p.map f).FiniteHeight := ⟨Or.inr (h.trans_lt (WithTop.coe_lt_top 1)).ne⟩
    have := (height_strict_mono_of_isPrime_of_isPrime h_lt).trans_le h
    rw [Order.lt_one_iff, height_eq_zero_iff] at this
    have := minimalPrimes_comap_of_surjective hf this
    rwa [comap_map_of_surjective f hf, ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot,
      mk_ker, sup_eq_left.mpr hI'q] at this
  refine height_le_one_of_isPrincipal_of_mem_minimalPrimes ((span {x}).map f) (p.map f) ⟨⟨this,
    map_mono <| span_le.mpr <| Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr <| hp.le <| subset_span <| .inl rfl⟩,
    fun r ⟨hr, hxr⟩ hrp ↦ map_le_iff_le_comap.mpr (hp.2 ⟨hr.comap f, ?_⟩ ?_)⟩
  · rw [span_le, Set.insert_subset_iff]
    have := map_le_iff_le_comap.mp hxr (subset_span rfl)
    refine ⟨this, hsp.trans ((hr.comap f).isRadical.radical_le_iff.mpr ?_)⟩
    rw [span_le, Set.insert_subset_iff]
    exact ⟨this, span_le.mp (mk_ker.symm.trans_le (ker_le_comap _))⟩
  · conv_rhs => rw [← sup_eq_left.mpr hI'p, ← (span t).mk_ker, RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot,
      ← comap_map_of_surjective f hf p]
    exact comap_mono hrp

name: Ideal.height_le_card_of_mem_minimalPrimes_span_finset
proof:
:= by
  trans (Cardinal.toENat (Submodule.spanRank (Ideal.span (s : Set R))))
  · exact Ideal.height_le_spanRank_toENat_of_mem_minimalPrimes _ _ hI
  · simpa using Submodule.spanRank_span_le_card (s : Set R)

name: Ideal.height_span_le_card_of_span_ne_top
statement:
lemma Ideal.height_span_le_card_of_span_ne_top {s : Finset R} (ht : Ideal.span (s : Set R) ≠ ⊤) :
    (Ideal.span (s : Set R)).height ≤ s.card
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := Ideal.nonempty_minimalPrimes ht
  grw [height_mono hp.1.2, height_le_card_of_mem_minimalPrimes_span_finset hp]

name: Ideal.height_le_ncard_of_mem_minimalPrimes_span
proof:
:= by
  rw [s.ncard_eq_toFinset_card hs]
  exact Ideal.height_le_card_of_mem_minimalPrimes_span_finset (by simpa)

name: Ideal.height_span_le_ncard_of_span_ne_top
statement:
lemma Ideal.height_span_le_ncard_of_span_ne_top {s : Set R} (hs : s.Finite)
    (ht : Ideal.span s ≠ ⊤) : (Ideal.span s).height ≤ s.ncard
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := Ideal.nonempty_minimalPrimes ht
  grw [height_mono hp.1.2, height_le_ncard_of_mem_minimalPrimes_span hs hp]

name: Ideal.height_le_encard_of_mem_minimalPrimes_span
statement:
lemma Ideal.height_le_encard_of_mem_minimalPrimes_span {p : Ideal R} {s : Set R}
    (hI : p ∈ (Ideal.span s).minimalPrimes) : p.height ≤ s.encard
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! hs : s.Finite
  · exact hs.cast_ncard_eq ▸ Ideal.height_le_ncard_of_mem_minimalPrimes_span hs hI
  · simp [hs]

name: Ideal.height_span_le_encard_of_span_ne_top
statement:
lemma Ideal.height_span_le_encard_of_span_ne_top {s : Set R} (ht : Ideal.span s ≠ ⊤) :
    (Ideal.span s).height ≤ s.encard
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := Ideal.nonempty_minimalPrimes ht
  grw [height_mono hp.1.2, height_le_encard_of_mem_minimalPrimes_span hp]

name: Ideal.height_le_spanRank_toENat
statement:
lemma Ideal.height_le_spanRank_toENat (I : Ideal R) (hI : I ≠ ⊤) :
    I.height ≤ I.spanRank.toENat
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ := nonempty_minimalPrimes hI
  rw [I.height_eq_inf_minimalPrimes]
  exact (iInf₂_le J hJ).trans (I.height_le_spanRank_toENat_of_mem_minimalPrimes J hJ)

name: Ideal.height_le_spanFinrank
statement:
lemma Ideal.height_le_spanFinrank (I : Ideal R) (hI : I ≠ ⊤) :
    I.height ≤ I.spanFinrank
proof:
:= by
  have : I.spanFinrank = I.spanRank.toENat := by
    rw [Submodule.fg_iff_spanRank_eq_spanFinrank.mpr (IsNoetherian.noetherian I), map_natCast]
  exact this ▸ height_le_spanRank_toENat I hI

name: Ideal.height_le_spanRank
statement:
lemma Ideal.height_le_spanRank (I : Ideal R) (hI : I ≠ ⊤) :
    I.height ≤ I.spanRank
proof:
:= by
  trans ↑I.spanRank.toENat
  · exact_mod_cast I.height_le_spanRank_toENat hI
  · exact I.spanRank.ofENat_toENat_le

name: Ideal.exists_spanRank_eq_and_height_eq
statement:
lemma Ideal.exists_spanRank_eq_and_height_eq (I : Ideal R) (hI : I ≠ ⊤) :
    ∃ J ≤ I, J.spanRank = I.height ∧ J.height = I.height
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨J, hJ₁, hJ₂, hJ₃⟩ := exists_spanRank_le_and_le_height_of_le_height I _
    (ENat.natCast_toNat_le_self I.height)
  rw [ENat.natCast_toNat_eq_self.mpr (Ideal.height_ne_top hI)] at hJ₃
  refine ⟨J, hJ₁, le_antisymm ?_ (le_trans ?_ (J.height_le_spanRank ?_)),
    le_antisymm (Ideal.height_mono hJ₁) hJ₃⟩
  · convert! hJ₂
    exact Cardinal.ofENat_eq_nat.mpr (ENat.natCast_toNat (I.height_ne_top hI)).symm
  · exact Cardinal.ofENat_le_ofENat_of_le hJ₃
  · rintro rfl
    exact hI (top_le_iff.mp hJ₁)

name: Ideal.height_le_iff_exists_minimalPrimes
statement:
lemma Ideal.height_le_iff_exists_minimalPrimes (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime]
    (n : ℕ∞) : p.height ≤ n ↔ ∃ I : Ideal R, p ∈ I.minimalPrimes ∧ I.spanRank ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨I, hI, e₁, e₂⟩ := exists_spanRank_eq_and_height_eq p (IsPrime.ne_top ‹_›)
    refine ⟨I, Ideal.mem_minimalPrimes_of_height_le hI e₂.ge, e₁.symm ▸ ?_⟩
    norm_cast
  · rintro ⟨I, hp, hI⟩
    exact le_trans
      (Ideal.height_le_spanRank_toENat_of_mem_minimalPrimes I p hp)
      (by simpa using (Cardinal.toENat.monotone' hI))

name: Ideal.exists_finset_card_eq_height_of_isNoetherianRing
statement:
lemma Ideal.exists_finset_card_eq_height_of_isNoetherianRing (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime] :
    ∃ s : Finset R, p ∈ (span s).minimalPrimes ∧ s.card = p.height
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨I, hI, hr⟩ := (p.height_le_iff_exists_minimalPrimes <| p.height).mp le_rfl
  have hs : I.generators.Finite := (IsNoetherian.noetherian I).finite_generators
  refine ⟨hs.toFinset, by rwa [hs.coe_toFinset, span, I.span_generators], ?_⟩
  rw [← Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card (hs := hs), (IsNoetherian.noetherian I).generators_ncard]
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · rw [Submodule.fg_iff_spanRank_eq_spanFinrank.mpr (IsNoetherian.noetherian I)] at hr
    exact Cardinal.nat_le_ofENat.mp hr
  · convert_to! p.height ≤ I.spanRank.toENat
    · symm
      simpa [Submodule.fg_iff_spanRank_eq_spanFinrank] using (IsNoetherian.noetherian I)
    · exact I.height_le_spanRank_toENat_of_mem_minimalPrimes _ hI

name: Ideal.height_le_height_add_spanFinrank_of_le
statement:
lemma Ideal.height_le_height_add_spanFinrank_of_le {I p : Ideal R} [p.IsPrime] (hrp : I ≤ p) :
    p.height ≤ (p.map (Quotient.mk I)).height + I.spanFinrank
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let p' := p.map (algebraMap R (R ⧸ I))
  have : p'.IsPrime := isPrime_map_quotientMk_of_isPrime hrp
  obtain ⟨s, hps, hs⟩ := exists_finset_card_eq_height_of_isNoetherianRing p'
  have hsp' : (s : Set (R ⧸ I)) ⊆ (p' : Set _) := fun _ hx ↦ hps.le (subset_span hx)
  have : Set.SurjOn (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) p s := by
    refine Set.SurjOn.mono subset_rfl hsp' fun x hx ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
    exact ⟨x, by simpa [hrp, sup_of_le_left, p'] using hx⟩
  obtain ⟨o, hsubset, ho, himgo⟩ := s.exists_subset_injOn_image_eq_of_surjOn (p : Set R) this
  have hI : I.FG := IsNoetherian.noetherian I
  let t : Finset R := o ∪ (Submodule.FG.finite_generators hI).toFinset
  suffices h : p.height ≤ t.card by
    refine le_trans h (hs ▸ ?_)
    norm_cast
    have : (Submodule.FG.finite_generators hI).toFinset.card = I.spanFinrank := by
      rw [← Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card (hs := Submodule.FG.finite_generators hI)]
      exact Submodule.FG.generators_ncard hI
    grind
  refine Ideal.height_le_card_of_mem_minimalPrimes_span_finset ?_
  rw [Finset.coe_union, Set.Finite.coe_toFinset, span_union, sup_comm, span,
    Submodule.span_generators]
  refine Ideal.mem_minimalPrimes_sup hrp ?_
  convert! hps
  simp [Ideal.map_span, ← himgo]

name: height_le_ringKrullDim_quotient_add_spanFinrank
statement:
lemma height_le_ringKrullDim_quotient_add_spanFinrank {p I : Ideal R} [p.IsPrime] (h : I ≤ p) :
    p.height ≤ ringKrullDim (R ⧸ I) + I.spanFinrank
proof:
:= by
  trans (p.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).height + I.spanFinrank
  · norm_cast; exact Ideal.height_le_height_add_spanFinrank_of_le h
  · gcongr
    have : (Ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) p).IsPrime :=
      Ideal.isPrime_map_quotientMk_of_isPrime h
    exact Ideal.height_le_ringKrullDim_of_ne_top Ideal.IsPrime.ne_top'

name: ringKrullDim_le_ringKrullDim_quotient_add_spanFinrank
statement:
lemma ringKrullDim_le_ringKrullDim_quotient_add_spanFinrank (I : Ideal R)
    (h : I ≤ Ring.jacobson R) :
    ringKrullDim R ≤ ringKrullDim (R ⧸ I) + I.spanFinrank
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R
  rw [ringKrullDim_le_iff_isMaximal_height_le]
  intro m hm
  exact height_le_ringKrullDim_quotient_add_spanFinrank <|
    le_trans h <| Ring.jacobson_le_of_isMaximal m

name: Ideal.height_le_height_add_encard_of_subset
statement:
lemma Ideal.height_le_height_add_encard_of_subset (s : Set R) {p : Ideal R} [p.IsPrime]
    (hrm : s ⊆ p) : p.height ≤ (p.map (Quotient.mk (span s))).height + s.encard
proof:
:= by
  apply le_trans (Ideal.height_le_height_add_spanFinrank_of_le (I := span s) (p := p) ?_) ?_
  · rwa [span_le]
  · gcongr
    exact Submodule.spanFinrank_span_le_encard _

name: Ideal.height_le_ringKrullDim_quotient_add_encard
statement:
lemma Ideal.height_le_ringKrullDim_quotient_add_encard {p : Ideal R} [p.IsPrime]
    (s : Set R) (hs : s ⊆ p) : p.height ≤ ringKrullDim (R ⧸ span s) + s.encard
proof:
:= by
  refine le_trans (height_le_ringKrullDim_quotient_add_spanFinrank (I := .span s) ?_) ?_
  · simpa [span_le]
  · gcongr; norm_cast; exact Submodule.spanFinrank_span_le_encard _

name: Ideal.height_le_height_add_one_of_mem
statement:
lemma Ideal.height_le_height_add_one_of_mem {r : R} {p : Ideal R} [p.IsPrime] (hrm : r ∈ p) :
    p.height ≤ (p.map (Quotient.mk (span {r}))).height + 1
proof:
:= by
  convert! height_le_height_add_encard_of_subset { r } (p := p) (by simpa)
  simp

name: Ideal.height_le_ringKrullDim_quotient_add_one
statement:
lemma Ideal.height_le_ringKrullDim_quotient_add_one {r : R} {p : Ideal R} [p.IsPrime]
    (hrp : r ∈ p) : p.height ≤ ringKrullDim (R ⧸ span {r}) + 1
proof:
:= by
  convert! Ideal.height_le_ringKrullDim_quotient_add_encard { r } (by simpa)
  simp

name: ringKrullDim_le_ringKrullDim_quotient_add_encard
statement:
lemma ringKrullDim_le_ringKrullDim_quotient_add_encard (s : Set R) (hs : s ⊆ Ring.jacobson R) :
    ringKrullDim R ≤ ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.span s) + s.encard
proof:
:= by
  refine le_trans (ringKrullDim_le_ringKrullDim_quotient_add_spanFinrank (Ideal.span s) ?_) ?_
  · simpa [Ideal.span_le]
  · gcongr; norm_cast; exact Submodule.spanFinrank_span_le_encard _

name: ringKrullDim_le_ringKrullDim_quotient_add_card
statement:
lemma ringKrullDim_le_ringKrullDim_quotient_add_card (s : Finset R)
    (hs : (s : Set R) ⊆ Ring.jacobson R) :
    ringKrullDim R ≤ ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.span (s : Set R)) + s.card
proof:
:= by
  convert! ringKrullDim_le_ringKrullDim_quotient_add_encard s hs
  norm_cast

name: Ideal.height_le_height_add_of_liesOver
statement:
@[stacks 00OM]
lemma Ideal.height_le_height_add_of_liesOver [IsNoetherianRing S] (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime]
      (P : Ideal S) [P.IsPrime] [P.LiesOver p] :
    P.height ≤ p.height +
      (P.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk <| p.map (algebraMap R S))).height
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hp, heq⟩ := p.exists_finset_card_eq_height_of_isNoetherianRing
  let P' := P.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk <| p.map (algebraMap R S))
  obtain ⟨s', hP', heq'⟩ := P'.exists_finset_card_eq_height_of_isNoetherianRing
  have hsP'sub : (s' : Set <| S ⧸ (Ideal.map (algebraMap R S) p)) ⊆ (P' : Set <| S ⧸ _) :=
    fun x hx ↦ hP'.le (Ideal.subset_span hx)
  have : Set.SurjOn (Ideal.Quotient.mk (p.map (algebraMap R S))) P s' := by
    refine Set.SurjOn.mono subset_rfl hsP'sub fun x hx ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Ideal.mem_quotient_iff_mem] at hx
    · use y, hx
    · rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap, Ideal.LiesOver.over (p := p) (P := P)]
  obtain ⟨o, ho, hinj, himgo⟩ := s'.exists_subset_injOn_image_eq_of_surjOn (P : Set S) this
  let t : Finset S := Finset.image (algebraMap R S) s ∪ o
  suffices h : P.height ≤ t.card by
    rw [← heq, ← heq']
    apply le_trans h
    norm_cast
    refine le_trans (Finset.card_union_le _ _) (add_le_add Finset.card_image_le ?_)
    rw [← himgo, Finset.card_image_of_injOn hinj]
  refine Ideal.height_le_card_of_mem_minimalPrimes_span_finset ?_
  have : Ideal.span t = Ideal.map (algebraMap R S) (.span s) ⊔ .span o := by
    simp [t, Ideal.map_span]
  refine this ▸ map_sup_mem_minimalPrimes_of_map_quotientMk_mem_minimalPrimes hp (span_le.mpr ho) ?_
  convert! hP'
  simp [Ideal.map_span, ← himgo]

name: Ideal.height_eq_height_add_of_liesOver_of_hasGoingDown
statement:
@[stacks 00ON]
lemma Ideal.height_eq_height_add_of_liesOver_of_hasGoingDown [IsNoetherianRing S]
    [Algebra.HasGoingDown R S] (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime] (P : Ideal S) [P.IsPrime] [P.LiesOver p] :
    P.height = p.height +
      (P.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk <| p.map (algebraMap R S))).height
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (height_le_height_add_of_liesOver p P) ?_
  obtain ⟨lp, hlp, hlenp⟩ := p.exists_ltSeries_length_eq_height
  obtain ⟨lq, hlq, hlenq⟩ :=
    (P.map (Quotient.mk (p.map (algebraMap R S)))).exists_ltSeries_length_eq_height
  let l' : LTSeries (PrimeSpectrum S) :=
    lq.map (PrimeSpectrum.comap (Quotient.mk (p.map (algebraMap R S))))
      (RingHom.strictMono_comap_of_surjective Quotient.mk_surjective)
  have : l'.head.asIdeal.LiesOver lp.last.asIdeal := by
    simp only [LTSeries.head_map, hlp, l']
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
    · rw [← map_le_iff_le_comap, PrimeSpectrum.comap_asIdeal, ← map_le_iff_le_comap]
      simp
    · conv_rhs => rw [LiesOver.over (p := p) (P := P), under_def]
      refine comap_mono (le_trans (comap_mono (lq.head_le_last)) ?_)
      simp [hlq, map_le_iff_le_comap, LiesOver.over (p := p) (P := P)]
  obtain ⟨lp', hlp'len, hlp', _⟩ := exists_ltSeries_of_hasGoingDown lp l'.head.asIdeal
  have : (lp'.smash l' hlp').length = lp.length + lq.length := by simp [hlp'len, l']
  rw [← hlenp, ← hlenq, ← Nat.cast_add, ← this, (⟨P, ‹_›⟩ : PrimeSpectrum S).height_eq_orderHeight]
  apply Order.length_le_height
  simp [hlq, l', ← PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal_le_asIdeal, map_le_iff_le_comap,
    LiesOver.over (p := p) (P := P)]

name: ringKrullDim_le_spanFinrank_maximalIdeal
statement:
lemma ringKrullDim_le_spanFinrank_maximalIdeal [IsLocalRing R] :
    ringKrullDim R ≤ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank
proof:
:=
  le_of_eq_of_le IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_height_eq_ringKrullDim.symm
    (WithBot.coe_le_coe.mpr (Ideal.height_le_spanFinrank (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)
      Ideal.IsPrime.ne_top'))

name: coe_comap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_comap [RingHomClass F R S] (I : Ideal S) : (comap f I : Set R) = f ⁻¹' I
proof: := rfl

name: comap_coe
statement: lemma comap_coe [RingHomClass F R S] (I : Ideal S) : I.comap (f : R →+* S) = I.comap f
proof: := rfl

name: map_coe
statement: lemma map_coe [RingHomClass F R S] (I : Ideal R) : I.map (f : R →+* S) = I.map f
proof: := rfl

name: map_mono
statement:
@[gcongr]
theorem map_mono (h : I ≤ J) : map f I ≤ map f J
proof:
:=
  span_mono <| Set.image_mono h

name: mem_map_of_mem
statement: theorem mem_map_of_mem (f : F) {I : Ideal R} {x : R} (h : x ∈ I) : f x ∈ map f I
proof:
:=
  subset_span ⟨x, h, rfl⟩

name: apply_coe_mem_map
statement: theorem apply_coe_mem_map (f : F) (I : Ideal R) (x : I) : f x ∈ I.map f
proof:
:=
  mem_map_of_mem f x.2

name: map_le_iff_le_comap
statement: theorem map_le_iff_le_comap [RingHomClass F R S] : map f I ≤ K ↔ I ≤ comap f K
proof:
:=
  span_le.trans Set.image_subset_iff

name: mem_comap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_comap [RingHomClass F R S] {x} : x ∈ comap f K ↔ f x ∈ K
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: comap_mono
statement:
@[gcongr]
theorem comap_mono [RingHomClass F R S] (h : K ≤ L) : comap f K ≤ comap f L
proof:
:=
  Set.preimage_mono fun _ hx => h hx

name: comap_ne_top
statement: theorem comap_ne_top [RingHomClass F R S] (hK : K ≠ ⊤) : comap f K ≠ ⊤
proof:
:=
  (ne_top_iff_one _).2 <| by rw [mem_comap, map_one]; exact (ne_top_iff_one _).1 hK

name: exists_ideal_comap_le_prime
statement:
lemma exists_ideal_comap_le_prime {S} [CommSemiring S] [FunLike F R S] [RingHomClass F R S]
    {f : F} (P : Ideal R) [P.IsPrime] (I : Ideal S) (le : I.comap f ≤ P) :
    ∃ Q ≥ I, Q.IsPrime ∧ Q.comap f ≤ P
proof:
:=
  have ⟨Q, hQ, hIQ, disj⟩ := I.exists_le_prime_disjoint (P.primeCompl.map f) <|
    Set.disjoint_left.mpr fun _ ↦ by rintro hI ⟨r, hp, rfl⟩; exact hp (le hI)
  ⟨Q, hIQ, hQ, fun r hp' ↦ of_not_not fun hp ↦ Set.disjoint_left.mp disj hp' ⟨_, hp, rfl⟩⟩

name: map_le_comap_of_inv_on
statement:
theorem map_le_comap_of_inv_on [RingHomClass G S R] (g : G) (I : Ideal R)
    (hf : Set.LeftInvOn g f I) :
    I.map f ≤ I.comap g
proof:
:= by
  refine Ideal.span_le.2 ?_
  rintro x ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, mem_comap, hf hx]
  exact hx

name: comap_le_map_of_inv_on
statement:
theorem comap_le_map_of_inv_on [RingHomClass F R S] (g : G) (I : Ideal S)
    (hf : Set.LeftInvOn g f (f ⁻¹' I)) :
    I.comap f ≤ I.map g
proof:
:=
  fun x (hx : f x ∈ I) => hf hx ▸ Ideal.mem_map_of_mem g hx

name: map_le_comap_of_inverse
statement:
theorem map_le_comap_of_inverse [RingHomClass G S R] (g : G) (I : Ideal R)
    (h : Function.LeftInverse g f) :
    I.map f ≤ I.comap g
proof:
:=
  map_le_comap_of_inv_on _ _ _ <| h.leftInvOn _

name: eq_bot_of_comap_eq_bot'
statement:
theorem eq_bot_of_comap_eq_bot' {f : R →+* S} (hf : Function.Surjective f)
    {I : Ideal S} (h : I.comap f = ⊥) :
    I = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hf x
  aesop (add norm [Submodule.eq_bot_iff])

name: comap_le_map_of_inverse
statement:
theorem comap_le_map_of_inverse (g : G) (I : Ideal S) (h : Function.LeftInverse g f) :
    I.comap f ≤ I.map g
proof:
:=
  comap_le_map_of_inv_on _ _ _ <| h.leftInvOn _

name: map_top
statement: theorem map_top : map f ⊤ = ⊤
proof:
:=
  (eq_top_iff_one _).2 <| subset_span ⟨1, trivial, map_one f⟩

name: gc_map_comap
statement: theorem gc_map_comap : GaloisConnection (Ideal.map f) (Ideal.comap f)
proof:
:= fun _ _ =>
  Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap

name: comap_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comap_id : I.comap (RingHom.id R) = I
proof:
:=
  Ideal.ext fun _ => Iff.rfl

name: comap_id
statement:
@[simp]
lemma comap_idₐ {R S : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [Semiring S] [Algebra R S] (I : Ideal S) :
    Ideal.comap (AlgHom.id R S) I = I
proof:
:=
  I.comap_id

name: map_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_id : I.map (RingHom.id R) = I
proof:
:=
  (gc_map_comap (RingHom.id R)).l_unique GaloisConnection.id comap_id

name: map_id
statement:
@[simp]
lemma map_idₐ {R S : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [Semiring S] [Algebra R S] (I : Ideal S) :
    Ideal.map (AlgHom.id R S) I = I
proof:
:=
  I.map_id

name: comap_comap
statement:
theorem comap_comap {T : Type*} [Semiring T] {I : Ideal T} (f : R →+* S) (g : S →+* T) :
    (I.comap g).comap f = I.comap (g.comp f)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: comap_comap
statement:
lemma comap_comapₐ {R A B C : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [Semiring A] [Algebra R A] [Semiring B]
    [Algebra R B] [Semiring C] [Algebra R C] {I : Ideal C} (f : A →ₐ[R] B) (g : B →ₐ[R] C) :
    (I.comap g).comap f = I.comap (g.comp f)
proof:
:=
  I.comap_comap f.toRingHom g.toRingHom

name: map_map
statement:
theorem map_map {T : Type*} [Semiring T] {I : Ideal R} (f : R →+* S) (g : S →+* T) :
    (I.map f).map g = I.map (g.comp f)
proof:
:=
  ((gc_map_comap f).compose (gc_map_comap g)).l_unique (gc_map_comap (g.comp f)) fun _ =>
    comap_comap _ _

name: map_map
statement:
lemma map_mapₐ {R A B C : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [Semiring A] [Algebra R A] [Semiring B]
    [Algebra R B] [Semiring C] [Algebra R C] {I : Ideal A} (f : A →ₐ[R] B) (g : B →ₐ[R] C) :
    (I.map f).map g = I.map (g.comp f)
proof:
:=
  I.map_map f.toRingHom g.toRingHom

name: map_span
statement: theorem map_span (s : Set R) : map f (span s) = span (f '' s)
proof:
:= by
  refine (Submodule.span_eq_of_le _ ?_ ?_).symm
  · rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩; exact mem_map_of_mem f (subset_span hx)
  · rw [map_le_iff_le_comap, span_le, coe_comap, ← Set.image_subset_iff]
    exact subset_span

name: map_le_of_le_comap
statement: theorem map_le_of_le_comap : I ≤ K.comap f → I.map f ≤ K
proof:
:=
  (gc_map_comap f).l_le

name: le_comap_of_map_le
statement: theorem le_comap_of_map_le : I.map f ≤ K → I ≤ K.comap f
proof:
:=
  (gc_map_comap f).le_u

name: le_comap_map
statement: theorem le_comap_map : I ≤ (I.map f).comap f
proof:
:=
  (gc_map_comap f).le_u_l _

name: map_comap_le
statement: theorem map_comap_le : (K.comap f).map f ≤ K
proof:
:=
  (gc_map_comap f).l_u_le _

name: comap_top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comap_top : (⊤ : Ideal S).comap f = ⊤
proof:
:=
  (gc_map_comap f).u_top

name: comap_eq_top_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comap_eq_top_iff {I : Ideal S} : I.comap f = ⊤ ↔ I = ⊤
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => I.eq_top_iff_one.mpr (map_one f ▸ mem_comap.mp ((I.comap f).eq_top_iff_one.mp h)),
    fun h => by rw [h, comap_top]⟩

name: map_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_bot : (⊥ : Ideal R).map f = ⊥
proof:
:=
  (gc_map_comap f).l_bot

name: ne_bot_of_map_ne_bot
statement: theorem ne_bot_of_map_ne_bot (hI : map f I ≠ ⊥) : I ≠ ⊥
proof:
:=
  fun h => hI (Eq.mpr (congrArg (fun I ↦ map f I = ⊥) h) map_bot)

name: map_comap_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_comap_map : ((I.map f).comap f).map f = I.map f
proof:
:=
  (gc_map_comap f).l_u_l_eq_l I

name: comap_map_comap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comap_map_comap : ((K.comap f).map f).comap f = K.comap f
proof:
:=
  (gc_map_comap f).u_l_u_eq_u K

name: map_sup
statement: theorem map_sup : (I ⊔ J).map f = I.map f ⊔ J.map f
proof:
:=
  (gc_map_comap f : GaloisConnection (map f) (comap f)).l_sup

name: comap_inf
statement: theorem comap_inf : comap f (K ⊓ L) = comap f K ⊓ comap f L
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: map_iSup
statement: theorem map_iSup (K : ι → Ideal R) : (iSup K).map f = ⨆ i, (K i).map f
proof:
:=
  (gc_map_comap f : GaloisConnection (map f) (comap f)).l_iSup

name: comap_iInf
statement: theorem comap_iInf (K : ι → Ideal S) : (iInf K).comap f = ⨅ i, (K i).comap f
proof:
:=
  (gc_map_comap f : GaloisConnection (map f) (comap f)).u_iInf

name: comap_finsetInf
statement:
theorem comap_finsetInf {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (K : ι → Ideal S) :
    (s.inf K).comap f = s.inf fun i ↦ (K i).comap f
proof:
:= by
  simp [Finset.inf_eq_iInf, comap_iInf]

name: map_sSup
statement: theorem map_sSup (s : Set (Ideal R)) : (sSup s).map f = ⨆ I ∈ s, (I : Ideal R).map f
proof:
:=
  (gc_map_comap f : GaloisConnection (map f) (comap f)).l_sSup

name: comap_sInf
statement: theorem comap_sInf (s : Set (Ideal S)) : (sInf s).comap f = ⨅ I ∈ s, (I : Ideal S).comap f
proof:
:=
  (gc_map_comap f : GaloisConnection (map f) (comap f)).u_sInf

name: comap_sInf'
statement: theorem comap_sInf' (s : Set (Ideal S)) : (sInf s).comap f = ⨅ I ∈ comap f '' s, I
proof:
:=
  _root_.trans (comap_sInf f s) (by rw [iInf_image])

name: comap_isPrime
statement: theorem comap_isPrime [H : IsPrime K] : IsPrime (comap f K)
proof:
:=
  H.comap f

name: map_inf_le
statement: theorem map_inf_le : map f (I ⊓ J) ≤ map f I ⊓ map f J
proof:
:=
  (gc_map_comap f : GaloisConnection (map f) (comap f)).monotone_l.map_inf_le _ _

name: le_comap_sup
statement: theorem le_comap_sup : comap f K ⊔ comap f L ≤ comap f (K ⊔ L)
proof:
:=
  (gc_map_comap f : GaloisConnection (map f) (comap f)).monotone_u.le_map_sup _ _

name: _root_.element_smul_restrictScalars
statement:
theorem _root_.element_smul_restrictScalars {R S M}
    [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S] [Algebra R S] [AddCommMonoid M]
    [Module R M] [Module S M] [IsScalarTower R S M] (r : R) (N : Submodule S M) :
    (algebraMap R S r • N).restrictScalars R = r • N.restrictScalars R
proof:
:=
  SetLike.coe_injective (congrArg (· '' _) (funext (algebraMap_smul S r)))

name: smul_restrictScalars
statement:
theorem smul_restrictScalars {R S M} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S]
    [Algebra R S] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [Module S M]
    [IsScalarTower R S M] (I : Ideal R) (N : Submodule S M) :
    (I.map (algebraMap R S) • N).restrictScalars R = I • N.restrictScalars R
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [map, Submodule.span_smul_eq, ← Submodule.coe_set_smul,
    Submodule.set_smul_eq_iSup, ← element_smul_restrictScalars, iSup_image]
  exact map_iSup₂ (Submodule.restrictScalarsLatticeHom R S M) _

name: smul_top_eq_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_top_eq_map {R S : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S] [Algebra R S]
    (I : Ideal R) : I • (⊤ : Submodule R S) = (I.map (algebraMap R S)).restrictScalars R
proof:
:=
  Eq.trans (smul_restrictScalars I (⊤ : Ideal S)).symm <|
    congrArg _ <| Eq.trans (Ideal.smul_eq_mul _ _) (Ideal.mul_top _)

name: coe_restrictScalars
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_restrictScalars {R S : Type*} [Semiring R] [Semiring S] [Module R S]
    [IsScalarTower R S S] (I : Ideal S) : (I.restrictScalars R : Set S) = ↑I
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: restrictScalars_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem restrictScalars_mul {R S : Type*} [Semiring R] [Semiring S] [Module R S]
    [IsScalarTower R S S] (I J : Ideal S) :
    (I * J).restrictScalars R = I.restrictScalars R * J.restrictScalars R
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: map_comap_of_surjective
statement: theorem map_comap_of_surjective (I : Ideal S) : map f (comap f I) = I
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (map_le_iff_le_comap.2 le_rfl) fun s hsi =>
    let ⟨r, hfrs⟩ := hf s
    hfrs ▸ (mem_map_of_mem f <| show f r ∈ I from hfrs.symm ▸ hsi)

name: map_surjective_of_surjective
statement: theorem map_surjective_of_surjective : Surjective (map f)
proof:
:=
  (giMapComap f hf).l_surjective

name: comap_injective_of_surjective
statement: theorem comap_injective_of_surjective : Injective (comap f)
proof:
:=
  (giMapComap f hf).u_injective

name: map_sup_comap_of_surjective
statement: theorem map_sup_comap_of_surjective (I J : Ideal S) : (I.comap f ⊔ J.comap f).map f = I ⊔ J
proof:
:=
  (giMapComap f hf).l_sup_u _ _

name: map_iSup_comap_of_surjective
statement: theorem map_iSup_comap_of_surjective (K : ι → Ideal S) : (⨆ i, (K i).comap f).map f = iSup K
proof:
:=
  (giMapComap f hf).l_iSup_u _

name: map_inf_comap_of_surjective
statement: theorem map_inf_comap_of_surjective (I J : Ideal S) : (I.comap f ⊓ J.comap f).map f = I ⊓ J
proof:
:=
  (giMapComap f hf).l_inf_u _ _

name: map_iInf_comap_of_surjective
statement: theorem map_iInf_comap_of_surjective (K : ι → Ideal S) : (⨅ i, (K i).comap f).map f = iInf K
proof:
:=
  (giMapComap f hf).l_iInf_u _

name: mem_image_of_mem_map_of_surjective
statement: theorem mem_image_of_mem_map_of_surjective {I : Ideal R} {y} (H : y ∈ map f I) : y ∈ f '' I
proof:
:=
  Submodule.span_induction (hx := H) (fun _ => id) ⟨0, I.zero_mem, map_zero f⟩
    (fun _ _ _ _ ⟨x1, hx1i, hxy1⟩ ⟨x2, hx2i, hxy2⟩ =>
      ⟨x1 + x2, I.add_mem hx1i hx2i, hxy1 ▸ hxy2 ▸ map_add f _ _⟩)
    fun c _ _ ⟨x, hxi, hxy⟩ =>
    let ⟨d, hdc⟩ := hf c
    ⟨d * x, I.mul_mem_left _ hxi, hdc ▸ hxy ▸ map_mul f _ _⟩

name: mem_map_iff_of_surjective
statement: theorem mem_map_iff_of_surjective {I : Ideal R} {y} : y ∈ map f I ↔ ∃ x, x ∈ I ∧ f x = y
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => (Set.mem_image _ _ _).2 (mem_image_of_mem_map_of_surjective f hf h), fun ⟨_, hx⟩ =>
    hx.right ▸ mem_map_of_mem f hx.left⟩

name: le_map_of_comap_le_of_surjective
statement: theorem le_map_of_comap_le_of_surjective : comap f K ≤ I → K ≤ map f I
proof:
:= fun h =>
  map_comap_of_surjective f hf K ▸ map_mono h

name: map_eq_image_of_surjective
statement: theorem map_eq_image_of_surjective : map f I = ⇑f '' ↑I
proof:
:= by
  grind [Ideal.mem_map_iff_of_surjective f hf, SetLike.mem_coe]

name: map_comap_eq_self_of_equiv
statement:
theorem map_comap_eq_self_of_equiv {E : Type*} [EquivLike E R S] [RingEquivClass E R S] (e : E)
    (I : Ideal S) : map e (comap e I) = I
proof:
:=
  I.map_comap_of_surjective e (EquivLike.surjective e)

name: map_eq_submodule_map
statement:
theorem map_eq_submodule_map (f : R →+* S) [h : RingHomSurjective f] (I : Ideal R) :
    I.map f = Submodule.map f.toSemilinearMap I
proof:
:=
  Submodule.ext fun _ => mem_map_iff_of_surjective f h.1

name: IsMaximal.comap_piEvalRingHom
statement:
theorem IsMaximal.comap_piEvalRingHom {ι : Type*} {R : ι → Type*} [∀ i, Semiring (R i)]
    {i : ι} {I : Ideal (R i)} (h : I.IsMaximal) : (I.comap <| Pi.evalRingHom R i).IsMaximal
proof:
:= by
  refine isMaximal_iff.mpr ⟨I.ne_top_iff_one.mp h.ne_top, fun J x le hxI hxJ ↦ ?_⟩
  have ⟨r, y, hy, eq⟩ := h.exists_inv hxI
  classical
  convert!
    J.add_mem (J.mul_mem_left (update 0 i r) hxJ) (b := update 1 i y)
      (le <| by apply update_self i y 1 ▸ hy)
  ext j
  obtain rfl | ne := eq_or_ne j i
  · simpa [eq_comm] using eq
  · simp [update_of_ne ne]

name: comap_le_comap_iff_of_surjective
statement:
theorem comap_le_comap_iff_of_surjective (hf : Function.Surjective f) (I J : Ideal S) :
    comap f I ≤ comap f J ↔ I ≤ J
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => (map_comap_of_surjective f hf I).symm.le.trans (map_le_of_le_comap h), fun h =>
    le_comap_of_map_le ((map_comap_of_surjective f hf I).le.trans h)⟩

name: map_eq_top_or_isMaximal_of_surjective
statement:
theorem map_eq_top_or_isMaximal_of_surjective (hf : Function.Surjective f) {I : Ideal R}
    (H : IsMaximal I) : map f I = ⊤ ∨ IsMaximal (map f I)
proof:
:=
  or_iff_not_imp_left.2 fun ne_top ↦ ⟨⟨ne_top, fun _J hJ ↦ comap_injective_of_surjective f hf <|
    H.1.2 _ (le_comap_map.trans_lt <| (orderEmbeddingOfSurjective f hf).strictMono hJ)⟩⟩

name: map_evalRingHom_pi
statement:
theorem map_evalRingHom_pi {I : Π i, Ideal (R i)} (i : ι) :
    (pi I).map (Pi.evalRingHom R i) = I i
proof:
:= by
  ext r
  rw [mem_map_iff_of_surjective (Pi.evalRingHom R i) (Function.surjective_eval _)]
  classical refine ⟨?_, fun hr ↦ ⟨_, single_mem_pi hr, by simp⟩⟩
  rintro ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩
  exact hr i

name: comap_bot_le_of_injective
statement: theorem comap_bot_le_of_injective (hf : Function.Injective f) : comap f ⊥ ≤ I
proof:
:= by
  refine le_trans (fun x hx => ?_) bot_le
  rw [mem_comap, Submodule.mem_bot, ← map_zero f] at hx
  exact Eq.symm (hf hx) ▸ Submodule.zero_mem ⊥

name: comap_bot_of_injective
statement: theorem comap_bot_of_injective (hf : Function.Injective f) : Ideal.comap f ⊥ = ⊥
proof:
:=
  le_bot_iff.mp (Ideal.comap_bot_le_of_injective f hf)

name: map_of_equiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_of_equiv {I : Ideal R} (f : R ≃+* S) :
    (I.map (f : R →+* S)).map (f.symm : S →+* R) = I
proof:
:= by
  rw [← RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, ← RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, map_map,
    RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingEquiv.symm_comp, map_id]

name: comap_of_equiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comap_of_equiv {I : Ideal R} (f : R ≃+* S) :
    (I.comap (f.symm : S →+* R)).comap (f : R →+* S) = I
proof:
:= by
  rw [← RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, ← RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, comap_comap,
    RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingEquiv.symm_comp, comap_id]

name: map_comap_of_equiv
statement: theorem map_comap_of_equiv {I : Ideal R} (f : R ≃+* S) : I.map (f : R →+* S) = I.comap f.symm
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (Ideal.map_le_comap_of_inverse _ _ _ (Equiv.left_inv' _))
    (Ideal.comap_le_map_of_inverse _ _ _ (Equiv.right_inv' _))

name: comap_symm
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comap_symm {I : Ideal R} (f : R ≃+* S) : I.comap f.symm = I.map f
proof:
:=
  (map_comap_of_equiv f).symm

name: map_symm
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_symm {I : Ideal S} (f : R ≃+* S) : I.map f.symm = I.comap f
proof:
:=
  map_comap_of_equiv (RingEquiv.symm f)

name: symm_apply_mem_of_equiv_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem symm_apply_mem_of_equiv_iff {I : Ideal R} {f : R ≃+* S} {y : S} :
    f.symm y ∈ I ↔ y ∈ I.map f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← comap_symm, mem_comap]

name: apply_mem_of_equiv_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem apply_mem_of_equiv_iff {I : Ideal R} {f : R ≃+* S} {x : R} :
    f x ∈ I.map f ↔ x ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  rw [← comap_symm, Ideal.mem_comap, f.symm_apply_apply]

name: mem_map_of_equiv
statement:
theorem mem_map_of_equiv {E : Type*} [EquivLike E R S] [RingEquivClass E R S] (e : E)
    {I : Ideal R} (y : S) : y ∈ map e I ↔ ∃ x ∈ I, e x = y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    simp_rw [show map e I = _ from map_comap_of_equiv (RingEquivClass.toRingEquiv e : R ≃+* S)] at h
    exact ⟨(EquivLike.toEquiv e).symm y, h, (EquivLike.toEquiv e).apply_symm_apply y⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact mem_map_of_mem e hx

name: map_primeCompl_comap_of_surjective
statement:
lemma map_primeCompl_comap_of_surjective (hf : Function.Surjective f) (p : Ideal S) [p.IsPrime] :
    Submonoid.map f (p.comap f).primeCompl = p.primeCompl
proof:
:= by
  rw [SetLike.ext_iff, hf.forall]
  grind [Submonoid.mem_map, mem_primeCompl_iff, mem_comap]

name: _root_.RingEquiv.map_primeCompl_comap_eq
statement:
lemma _root_.RingEquiv.map_primeCompl_comap_eq (e : R ≃+* S) (p : Ideal S) [p.IsPrime] :
    (p.comap e).primeCompl.map e = p.primeCompl
proof:
:=
  p.map_primeCompl_comap_of_surjective e e.surjective

name: comap_le_iff_le_map
statement: theorem comap_le_iff_le_map : comap f K ≤ I ↔ K ≤ map f I
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => le_map_of_comap_le_of_surjective f hf.right h, fun h =>
    (relIsoOfBijective f hf).right_inv I ▸ comap_mono h⟩

name: map_eq_top_of_bijective
statement: theorem map_eq_top_of_bijective : I.map f = ⊤ ↔ I = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff, ← comap_le_iff_le_map f hf, comap_top, top_le_iff]

name: comap_map_of_bijective
statement: theorem comap_map_of_bijective : (I.map f).comap f = I
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm ((comap_le_iff_le_map f hf).mpr fun _ ↦ id) le_comap_map

name: isMaximal_map_iff_of_bijective
statement: theorem isMaximal_map_iff_of_bijective : IsMaximal (map f I) ↔ IsMaximal I
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [isMaximal_def] using! (relIsoOfBijective _ hf).symm.isCoatom_iff _

name: isMaximal_comap_iff_of_bijective
statement: theorem isMaximal_comap_iff_of_bijective : IsMaximal (comap f K) ↔ IsMaximal K
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [isMaximal_def] using! (relIsoOfBijective _ hf).isCoatom_iff _

name: isMaximal_iff_of_bijective
statement: theorem isMaximal_iff_of_bijective : (⊥ : Ideal R).IsMaximal ↔ (⊥ : Ideal S).IsMaximal
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ map_bot (f := f) ▸ h.map_bijective f hf, fun h ↦ have e := RingEquiv.ofBijective f hf
    map_bot (f := e.symm) ▸ h.map_bijective _ e.symm.bijective⟩

name: comap_map_of_surjective
statement:
theorem comap_map_of_surjective (hf : Function.Surjective f) (I : Ideal R) :
    comap f (map f I) = I ⊔ comap f ⊥
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm
    (fun r h =>
      let ⟨s, hsi, hfsr⟩ := mem_image_of_mem_map_of_surjective f hf h
      Submodule.mem_sup.2
        ⟨s, hsi, r - s, (Submodule.mem_bot S).2 <| by rw [map_sub, hfsr, sub_self],
          add_sub_cancel s r⟩)
    (sup_le (map_le_iff_le_comap.1 le_rfl) (comap_mono bot_le))

name: coheight_comap_of_surjective
statement:
theorem coheight_comap_of_surjective (hf : Function.Surjective f) (I : Ideal S) :
    Order.coheight (I.comap f) = Order.coheight I
proof:
:= by
  let φ := orderEmbeddingOfSurjective f hf
  refine (Order.coheight_eq_of_strictMono φ φ.strictMono (fun J K h ↦ ⟨K.map f, ?_, ?_⟩) I).symm
  · rw [← J.map_comap_of_surjective f hf]
    apply lt_of_le_not_ge (map_mono h.le)
    simpa [map_le_iff_le_comap, φ] using h.not_ge
  · exact (K.comap_map_of_surjective f hf).trans (sup_of_le_left ((comap_mono bot_le).trans h.le))

name: comap_isMaximal_of_surjective
statement:
theorem comap_isMaximal_of_surjective (hf : Function.Surjective f) {K : Ideal S} [H : IsMaximal K] :
    IsMaximal (comap f K)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨comap_ne_top _ H.1.1, fun J hJ => ?_⟩⟩
  suffices map f J = ⊤ by
    have := congr_arg (comap f) this
    rw [comap_top, comap_map_of_surjective _ hf, eq_top_iff] at this
    rw [eq_top_iff]
    exact le_trans this (sup_le (le_of_eq rfl) (le_trans (comap_mono bot_le) (le_of_lt hJ)))
  refine
    H.1.2 (map f J)
      (lt_of_le_of_ne (le_map_of_comap_le_of_surjective _ hf (le_of_lt hJ)) fun h =>
        ne_of_lt hJ (_root_.trans (congr_arg (comap f) h) ?_))
  rw [comap_map_of_surjective _ hf, sup_eq_left]
  exact le_trans (comap_mono bot_le) (le_of_lt hJ)

name: map_mul
statement:
protected theorem map_mul {R} [Semiring R] [FunLike F R S] [RingHomClass F R S]
    (f : F) (I J : Ideal R) :
    map f (I * J) = map f I * map f J
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm
    (map_le_iff_le_comap.2 <|
      mul_le.2 fun r hri s hsj =>
        show (f (r * s)) ∈ map f I * map f J by
          rw [map_mul]; exact mul_mem_mul (mem_map_of_mem f hri) (mem_map_of_mem f hsj))
    (span_mul_span (↑f '' ↑I) (↑f '' ↑J) ▸ (span_le.2 <| by
      rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨r, hri, rfl⟩, _, ⟨s, hsj, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      simp_rw [← map_mul]; exact mem_map_of_mem f (mul_mem_mul hri hsj)))

name: map_pow
statement: protected theorem map_pow (n : ℕ) : map f (I ^ n) = map f I ^ n
proof:
:=
  map_pow (mapHom f) I n

name: comap_radical
statement: theorem comap_radical : comap f (radical K) = radical (comap f K)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp [radical]

name: IsRadical.comap
statement: theorem IsRadical.comap (hK : K.IsRadical) : (comap f K).IsRadical
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hK.radical, comap_radical]
  apply radical_isRadical

name: map_radical_le
statement: theorem map_radical_le : map f (radical I) ≤ radical (map f I)
proof:
:=
  map_le_iff_le_comap.2 fun r ⟨n, hrni⟩ => ⟨n, map_pow f r n ▸ mem_map_of_mem f hrni⟩

name: le_comap_mul
statement: theorem le_comap_mul : comap f K * comap f L ≤ comap f (K * L)
proof:
:=
  map_le_iff_le_comap.1 <|
    (Ideal.map_mul f (comap f K) (comap f L)).symm ▸
      mul_mono (map_le_iff_le_comap.2 <| le_rfl) (map_le_iff_le_comap.2 <| le_rfl)

name: le_comap_pow
statement: theorem le_comap_pow (n : ℕ) : K.comap f ^ n ≤ (K ^ n).comap f
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    rw [pow_zero, pow_zero, Ideal.one_eq_top, Ideal.one_eq_top]
    exact rfl.le
  | succ n n_ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, pow_succ]
    exact (Ideal.mul_mono_left n_ih).trans (Ideal.le_comap_mul f)

name: disjoint_map_primeCompl_iff_comap_le
proof:
:=
  (@Set.disjoint_image_right _ _ f p.primeCompl I).trans disjoint_compl_right_iff

name: comap_map_eq_self_iff_of_isPrime
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hp ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨q, hq₁, hq₂, hq₃⟩ := Ideal.exists_le_prime_disjoint _ _
      (disjoint_map_primeCompl_iff_comap_le.mpr hp.le)
    exact ⟨q, hq₁, le_antisymm (disjoint_map_primeCompl_iff_comap_le.mp hq₃)
      (map_le_iff_le_comap.mp hq₂)⟩
  · rintro ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩
    simp

name: comap_map_eq_self_of_isMaximal
statement:
theorem comap_map_eq_self_of_isMaximal (f : R →+* S) {p : Ideal R} [hP' : p.IsMaximal]
    (hP : Ideal.map f p ≠ ⊤) : (map f p).comap f = p
proof:
:=
  (IsCoatom.le_iff_eq hP'.out (comap_ne_top _ hP)).mp <| le_comap_map

name: mem_ker
statement: @[simp] theorem mem_ker {r} : r ∈ ker f ↔ f r = 0
proof: := by rw [ker, Ideal.mem_comap, Submodule.mem_bot]

name: ker_eq
statement: theorem ker_eq : (ker f : Set R) = Set.preimage f {0}
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: ker_eq_comap_bot
statement: theorem ker_eq_comap_bot (f : F) : ker f = Ideal.comap f ⊥
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: comap_ker
statement: theorem comap_ker (f : S →+* R) (g : T →+* S) : (ker f).comap g = ker (f.comp g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, Ideal.comap_comap, RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot]

name: one_notMem_ker
statement: theorem one_notMem_ker [Nontrivial S] (f : F) : (1 : R) ∉ ker f
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_ker, map_one]
  exact one_ne_zero

name: ker_ne_top
statement: theorem ker_ne_top [Nontrivial S] (f : F) : ker f ≠ ⊤
proof:
:=
  (Ideal.ne_top_iff_one _).mpr <| one_notMem_ker f

name: ker_eq_top_of_subsingleton
statement: lemma ker_eq_top_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton S] (f : F) : ker f = ⊤
proof:
:=
  eq_top_iff.mpr fun _ _ ↦ Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: _root_.Pi.ker_ringHom
statement:
lemma _root_.Pi.ker_ringHom {ι : Type*} {R : ι → Type*} [∀ i, Semiring (R i)]
    (φ : ∀ i, S →+* R i) : ker (RingHom.pi φ) = ⨅ i, ker (φ i)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [mem_ker, funext_iff]

name: ker_rangeSRestrict
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ker_rangeSRestrict (f : R →+* S) : ker f.rangeSRestrict = ker f
proof:
:=
  Ideal.ext fun _ ↦ Subtype.ext_iff

name: ker_coe_equiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ker_coe_equiv (f : R ≃+* S) : ker (f : R →+* S) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp

name: ker_coe_toRingHom
statement: theorem ker_coe_toRingHom : ker (f : R →+* S) = ker f
proof: := rfl

name: ker_equiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ker_equiv {F' : Type*} [EquivLike F' R S] [RingEquivClass F' R S] (f : F') :
    ker f = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp

name: ker_equiv_comp
statement:
lemma ker_equiv_comp (f : R →+* S) (e : S ≃+* T) :
    ker (e.toRingHom.comp f) = RingHom.ker f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← RingHom.comap_ker, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.ker_coe_equiv, RingHom.ker]

name: injective_iff_ker_eq_bot
statement: theorem injective_iff_ker_eq_bot : Function.Injective f ↔ ker f = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [SetLike.ext'_iff, ker_eq, Set.ext_iff]
  exact injective_iff_map_eq_zero' f

name: ker_eq_bot_iff_eq_zero
statement: theorem ker_eq_bot_iff_eq_zero : ker f = ⊥ ↔ ∀ x, f x = 0 → x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← injective_iff_map_eq_zero f, injective_iff_ker_eq_bot]

name: ker_comp_of_injective
statement:
lemma ker_comp_of_injective [Semiring T] (g : T →+* R) {f : R →+* S} (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    ker (f.comp g) = RingHom.ker g
proof:
:= by
  rw [← RingHom.comap_ker, (injective_iff_ker_eq_bot f).mp hf, RingHom.ker]

name: _root_.AlgHom.ker_coe_equiv
statement:
@[simp] theorem _root_.AlgHom.ker_coe_equiv {R A B : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [Semiring A]
    [Semiring B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] (e : A ≃ₐ[R] B) :
    RingHom.ker (e : A →+* B) = ⊥
proof:
:=
  RingHom.ker_coe_equiv (e.toRingEquiv)

name: sub_mem_ker_iff
statement: theorem sub_mem_ker_iff {x y} : x - y ∈ ker f ↔ f x = f y
proof: := by rw [mem_ker, map_sub, sub_eq_zero]

name: ker_rangeRestrict
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ker_rangeRestrict (f : R →+* S) : ker f.rangeRestrict = ker f
proof:
:=
  Ideal.ext fun _ ↦ Subtype.ext_iff

name: ker_isPrime
statement:
theorem ker_isPrime {F : Type*} [Semiring R] [Semiring S] [IsDomain S]
    [FunLike F R S] [RingHomClass F R S] (f : F) :
    (ker f).IsPrime
proof:
:=
  inferInstanceAs (Ideal.comap f ⊥).IsPrime

name: ker_isMaximal_of_surjective
statement:
theorem ker_isMaximal_of_surjective {R K F : Type*} [Ring R] [DivisionRing K]
    [FunLike F R K] [RingHomClass F R K] (f : F)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) : (ker f).IsMaximal
proof:
:=
  have := Ideal.bot_isMaximal (K := K)
  Ideal.comap_isMaximal_of_surjective _ hf

name: Module.mem_annihilator
statement: theorem Module.mem_annihilator {r} : r ∈ Module.annihilator R M ↔ ∀ m : M, r • m = 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ (congr($h ·)), (AddMonoidHom.ext ·)⟩

name: Module.mem_annihilator_iff_lsmul_eq_zero
statement:
lemma Module.mem_annihilator_iff_lsmul_eq_zero {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R]
    [Module R M] {r : R} : r ∈ Module.annihilator R M ↔ LinearMap.lsmul R M r = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [Module.mem_annihilator, LinearMap.ext_iff]

name: LinearMap.annihilator_le_of_injective
statement:
theorem LinearMap.annihilator_le_of_injective (f : M →ₗ[R] M') (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    Module.annihilator R M' ≤ Module.annihilator R M
proof:
:= fun x h ↦ by
  rw [Module.mem_annihilator] at h ⊢; exact fun m ↦ hf (by rw [map_smul, h, f.map_zero])

name: LinearMap.annihilator_le_of_surjective
statement:
theorem LinearMap.annihilator_le_of_surjective (f : M →ₗ[R] M')
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) : Module.annihilator R M ≤ Module.annihilator R M'
proof:
:= fun x h ↦ by
  rw [Module.mem_annihilator] at h ⊢
  intro m; obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hf m
  rw [← map_smul, h, f.map_zero]

name: LinearEquiv.annihilator_eq
statement:
theorem LinearEquiv.annihilator_eq (e : M ≃ₗ[R] M') :
    Module.annihilator R M = Module.annihilator R M'
proof:
:=
  (e.annihilator_le_of_surjective e.surjective).antisymm (e.annihilator_le_of_injective e.injective)

name: Module.comap_annihilator
statement:
theorem Module.comap_annihilator {R₀} [CommSemiring R₀] [Module R₀ M]
    [Algebra R₀ R] [IsScalarTower R₀ R M] :
    (Module.annihilator R M).comap (algebraMap R₀ R) = Module.annihilator R₀ M
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [mem_annihilator]

name: Module.annihilator_eq_bot
statement:
lemma Module.annihilator_eq_bot {R M} [Ring R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] :
    Module.annihilator R M = ⊥ ↔ FaithfulSMul R M
proof:
:= by
  rw [← le_bot_iff]
  refine ⟨fun H ↦ ⟨fun {r s} H' ↦ ?_⟩, fun ⟨H⟩ {a} ha ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [← sub_eq_zero]
    exact H (Module.mem_annihilator (r := r - s).mpr
      (by simp only [sub_smul, H', sub_self, implies_true]))
  · exact @H a 0 (by simp [Module.mem_annihilator.mp ha])

name: Module.annihilator_eq_top_iff
statement: theorem Module.annihilator_eq_top_iff : annihilator R M = ⊤ ↔ Subsingleton M
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨fun m m' ↦ by
      rw [← one_smul R m, ← one_smul R m']
      simp_rw [mem_annihilator.mp (h ▸ Submodule.mem_top)]⟩,
    fun _ ↦ top_le_iff.mp fun _ _ ↦ mem_annihilator.mpr fun _ ↦ Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩

name: Module.annihilator_prod
statement: theorem Module.annihilator_prod : annihilator R (M × M') = annihilator R M ⊓ annihilator R M'
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp_rw [Ideal.mem_inf, mem_annihilator,
    Prod.forall, Prod.smul_mk, Prod.mk_eq_zero, forall_and_left, ← forall_and_right]

name: Module.annihilator_finsupp
statement:
theorem Module.annihilator_finsupp {ι : Type*} [Nonempty ι] :
    annihilator R (ι →₀ M) = annihilator R M
proof:
:= by
  ext r; simp_rw [mem_annihilator]
  constructor <;> intro h
  · refine Nonempty.elim ‹_› fun i : ι ↦ ?_
    simpa using fun m ↦ congr($(h (Finsupp.single i m)) i)
  · intro m; ext i; exact h _

name: Module.annihilator_dfinsupp
statement: theorem Module.annihilator_dfinsupp : annihilator R (Π₀ i, M i) = ⨅ i, annihilator R (M i)
proof:
:= by
  ext r; simp only [mem_annihilator, Ideal.mem_iInf]
  constructor <;> intro h
  · intro i m
    classical simpa using DFunLike.congr_fun (h (DFinsupp.single i m)) i
  · intro m; ext i; exact h i _

name: Module.annihilator_pi
statement: theorem Module.annihilator_pi : annihilator R (Π i, M i) = ⨅ i, annihilator R (M i)
proof:
:= by
  ext r; simp only [mem_annihilator, Ideal.mem_iInf]
  constructor <;> intro h
  · intro i m
    classical simpa using congr_fun (h (Pi.single i m)) i
  · intro m; ext i; exact h i _

name: annihilator_top
statement: theorem annihilator_top : (⊤ : Submodule R M).annihilator = Module.annihilator R M
proof:
:=
  topEquiv.annihilator_eq

name: mem_annihilator
statement: theorem mem_annihilator {r} : r ∈ N.annihilator ↔ ∀ n ∈ N, r • n = (0 : M)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [annihilator, Module.mem_annihilator, Subtype.forall, Subtype.ext_iff]; rfl

name: annihilator_bot
statement: theorem annihilator_bot : (⊥ : Submodule R M).annihilator = ⊤
proof:
:=
  top_le_iff.mp fun _ _ ↦ mem_annihilator.mpr fun _ ↦ by rintro rfl; rw [smul_zero]

name: annihilator_eq_top_iff
statement: theorem annihilator_eq_top_iff : N.annihilator = ⊤ ↔ N = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [annihilator, Module.annihilator_eq_top_iff, Submodule.subsingleton_iff_eq_bot]

name: annihilator_mono
statement: theorem annihilator_mono (h : N ≤ P) : P.annihilator ≤ N.annihilator
proof:
:= fun _ hrp =>
  mem_annihilator.2 fun n hn => mem_annihilator.1 hrp n <| h hn

name: annihilator_iSup
statement:
theorem annihilator_iSup (ι : Sort w) (f : ι → Submodule R M) :
    annihilator (⨆ i, f i) = ⨅ i, annihilator (f i)
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (le_iInf fun _ => annihilator_mono <| le_iSup _ _) fun r H =>
    mem_annihilator.2 fun n hn ↦ iSup_induction f (motive := (r • · = 0)) hn
      (fun i ↦ mem_annihilator.1 <| (mem_iInf _).mp H i) (smul_zero _)
      fun m₁ m₂ h₁ h₂ ↦ by simp_rw [smul_add, h₁, h₂, add_zero]

name: annihilator_sup
statement:
theorem annihilator_sup (N P : Submodule R M) :
    (N ⊔ P).annihilator = N.annihilator ⊓ P.annihilator
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sSup_pair, sSup_eq_iSup, iSup_subtype', annihilator_iSup, ← iInf_pair, iInf_subtype']

name: le_annihilator_iff
statement: theorem le_annihilator_iff {N : Submodule R M} {I : Ideal R} : I ≤ annihilator N ↔ I • N = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← le_bot_iff, smul_le, SetLike.le_def, mem_annihilator]; rfl

name: annihilator_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem annihilator_smul (N : Submodule R M) : annihilator N • N = ⊥
proof:
:=
  eq_bot_iff.2 (smul_le.2 fun _ => mem_annihilator.1)

name: annihilator_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem annihilator_mul (I : Ideal R) : annihilator I * I = ⊥
proof:
:=
  annihilator_smul I

name: mem_annihilator'
statement: theorem mem_annihilator' {r} : r ∈ N.annihilator ↔ N ≤ comap (r • (LinearMap.id : M →ₗ[R] M)) ⊥
proof:
:=
  mem_annihilator.trans ⟨fun H n hn => (mem_bot R).2 <| H n hn, fun H _ hn => (mem_bot R).1 <| H hn⟩

name: mem_annihilator_span
statement:
theorem mem_annihilator_span (s : Set M) (r : R) :
    r ∈ (Submodule.span R s).annihilator ↔ ∀ n : s, r • (n : M) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.mem_annihilator]
  constructor
  · intro h n
    exact h _ (Submodule.subset_span n.prop)
  · intro h n hn
    refine Submodule.span_induction ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hn
    · intro x hx
      exact h ⟨x, hx⟩
    · exact smul_zero _
    · intro x y _ _ hx hy
      rw [smul_add, hx, hy, zero_add]
    · intro a x _ hx
      rw [smul_comm, hx, smul_zero]

name: mem_annihilator_span_singleton
statement:
theorem mem_annihilator_span_singleton (g : M) (r : R) :
    r ∈ (Submodule.span R ({g} : Set M)).annihilator ↔ r • g = 0
proof: := by simp [mem_annihilator_span]

name: annihilator_span
statement:
theorem annihilator_span (s : Set M) :
    (Submodule.span R s).annihilator = ⨅ g : s, ker (toSpanSingleton R M g.1)
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp [mem_annihilator_span]

name: annihilator_span_singleton
statement:
theorem annihilator_span_singleton (g : M) :
    (Submodule.span R {g}).annihilator = ker (toSpanSingleton R M g)
proof:
:= by
  simp [annihilator_span]

name: mul_annihilator
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mul_annihilator (I : Ideal R) : I * annihilator I = ⊥
proof: := by rw [mul_comm, annihilator_mul]

name: restrictScalars_map_smul_eq
statement:
theorem restrictScalars_map_smul_eq {S M : Type*}
    [CommSemiring S] [Algebra S R]
    [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [Module S M] [IsScalarTower S R M]
    (I : Ideal S) (N : Submodule R M) :
    ((I.map (algebraMap S R)) • N).restrictScalars S = I • N.restrictScalars S
proof:
:= by
  have := N.restrictScalars_image_smul_eq (I : Set S)
  rw [coe_set_smul] at this
  rw [Ideal.map, span_smul_eq, ← this]

name: map_eq_bot_iff_le_ker
statement: theorem map_eq_bot_iff_le_ker {I : Ideal R} (f : F) : I.map f = ⊥ ↔ I ≤ RingHom.ker f
proof:
:= by
  rw [RingHom.ker, eq_bot_iff, map_le_iff_le_comap]

name: ker_le_comap
statement: theorem ker_le_comap {K : Ideal S} (f : F) : RingHom.ker f ≤ comap f K
proof:
:= fun _ hx =>
  mem_comap.2 (RingHom.mem_ker.1 hx ▸ K.zero_mem)

name: map_eq_bot_iff_of_injective
statement:
theorem map_eq_bot_iff_of_injective {I : Ideal R} {f : F} (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    I.map f = ⊥ ↔ I = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  simp [map, ← map_zero f, -map_zero, hf.eq_iff, I.eq_bot_iff]

name: map_pointwise_smul
statement:
lemma map_pointwise_smul {R S : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S]
    (r : R) (I : Ideal R) (f : R →+* S) :
    Ideal.map f (r • I) = f r • I.map f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Submodule.ideal_span_singleton_smul, smul_eq_mul, Ideal.map_mul, Ideal.map_span,
    Set.image_singleton, ← smul_eq_mul, Submodule.ideal_span_singleton_smul]

name: comap_map_of_surjective'
statement:
lemma comap_map_of_surjective' (f : F) (hf : Function.Surjective f) (I : Ideal R) :
    (I.map f).comap f = I ⊔ RingHom.ker f
proof:
:=
  comap_map_of_surjective f hf I

name: map_sInf
statement:
theorem map_sInf {A : Set (Ideal R)} {f : F} (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    (∀ J ∈ A, RingHom.ker f ≤ J) → map f (sInf A) = sInf (map f '' A)
proof:
:= by
  refine fun h => le_antisymm (le_sInf ?_) ?_
  · intro j hj y hy
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (mem_map_iff_of_surjective f hf).1 hy
    obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ := (Set.mem_image _ _ _).mp hj
    rw [← hJ.right, ← hx.right]
    exact mem_map_of_mem f (sInf_le_of_le hJ.left (le_of_eq rfl) hx.left)
  · intro y hy
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hf y
    refine hx ▸ mem_map_of_mem f ?_
    have : ∀ I ∈ A, y ∈ map f I := by simpa using hy
    rw [Submodule.mem_sInf]
    intro J hJ
    rcases (mem_map_iff_of_surjective f hf).1 (this J hJ) with ⟨x', hx', rfl⟩
    have : x - x' ∈ J := by
      apply h J hJ
      rw [RingHom.mem_ker, map_sub, hx, sub_self]
    simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using J.add_mem this hx'

name: map_isPrime_of_surjective
statement:
theorem map_isPrime_of_surjective {f : F} (hf : Function.Surjective f) {I : Ideal R} [H : IsPrime I]
    (hk : RingHom.ker f ≤ I) : IsPrime (map f I)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => H.ne_top (eq_top_iff.2 ?_), fun {x y} => ?_⟩
  · replace h := congr_arg (comap f) h
    rw [comap_map_of_surjective _ hf, comap_top] at h
    exact h ▸ sup_le (le_of_eq rfl) hk
  · refine fun hxy => (hf x).recOn fun a ha => (hf y).recOn fun b hb => ?_
    rw [← ha, ← hb, ← map_mul f, mem_map_iff_of_surjective _ hf] at hxy
    rcases hxy with ⟨c, hc, hc'⟩
    rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub] at hc'
    have : a * b ∈ I := by
      convert! I.sub_mem hc (hk (hc' : c - a * b ∈ RingHom.ker f)) using 1
      abel
    exact
      (H.mem_or_mem this).imp (fun h => ha ▸ mem_map_of_mem f h) fun h => hb ▸ mem_map_of_mem f h

name: IsMaximal.map_of_surjective_of_ker_le
statement:
lemma IsMaximal.map_of_surjective_of_ker_le {f : F} (hf : Function.Surjective f) {m : Ideal R}
    [m.IsMaximal] (hk : RingHom.ker f ≤ m) : (m.map f).IsMaximal
proof:
:= by
  refine m.map_eq_top_or_isMaximal_of_surjective f hf ‹_› |>.resolve_left fun h => ?_
  apply congr_arg (comap f) at h
  rw [comap_map_of_surjective _ hf, comap_top, ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, sup_of_le_left hk] at h
  exact IsMaximal.ne_top ‹_› h

name: map_ne_bot_of_ne_bot
statement:
theorem map_ne_bot_of_ne_bot {R S : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [Semiring S] [Algebra R S]
    [FaithfulSMul R S] {I : Ideal R} (h : I ≠ ⊥) : map (algebraMap R S) I ≠ ⊥
proof:
:=
  (map_eq_bot_iff_of_injective (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective R S)).mp.mt h

name: map_eq_iff_sup_ker_eq_of_surjective
statement:
theorem map_eq_iff_sup_ker_eq_of_surjective {I J : Ideal R} (f : R →+* S)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) : map f I = map f J ↔ I ⊔ RingHom.ker f = J ⊔ RingHom.ker f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (comap_injective_of_surjective f hf).eq_iff, comap_map_of_surjective f hf,
    comap_map_of_surjective f hf, RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot]

name: map_radical_of_surjective
statement:
theorem map_radical_of_surjective {f : R →+* S} (hf : Function.Surjective f) {I : Ideal R}
    (h : RingHom.ker f ≤ I) : map f I.radical = (map f I).radical
proof:
:= by
  rw [radical_eq_sInf, radical_eq_sInf]
  have : ∀ J ∈ {J : Ideal R | I ≤ J ∧ J.IsPrime}, RingHom.ker f ≤ J := fun J hJ => h.trans hJ.left
  convert! map_sInf hf this
  ext j
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hj, hj'⟩
    have : j.IsPrime := hj'
    exact
      ⟨comap f j, ⟨⟨map_le_iff_le_comap.1 hj, comap_isPrime f j⟩, map_comap_of_surjective f hf j⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨J, ⟨hJ, hJ'⟩⟩
    have : J.IsPrime := hJ.right
    exact ⟨hJ' ▸ map_mono hJ.left, hJ' ▸ map_isPrime_of_surjective hf (le_trans h hJ.left)⟩

name: liftOfRightInverseAux_comp_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftOfRightInverseAux_comp_apply (hf : Function.RightInverse f_inv f) (g : A →+* C)
    (hg : RingHom.ker f ≤ RingHom.ker g) (a : A) :
    (f.liftOfRightInverseAux f_inv hf g hg) (f a) = g a
proof:
:=
  f.toAddMonoidHom.liftOfRightInverse_comp_apply f_inv hf ⟨g.toAddMonoidHom, hg⟩ a

name: liftOfRightInverse_comp_apply
statement:
theorem liftOfRightInverse_comp_apply (hf : Function.RightInverse f_inv f)
    (g : { g : A →+* C // RingHom.ker f ≤ RingHom.ker g }) (x : A) :
    (f.liftOfRightInverse f_inv hf g) (f x) = g.1 x
proof:
:=
  f.liftOfRightInverseAux_comp_apply f_inv hf g.1 g.2 x

name: liftOfRightInverse_comp
statement:
theorem liftOfRightInverse_comp (hf : Function.RightInverse f_inv f)
    (g : { g : A →+* C // RingHom.ker f ≤ RingHom.ker g }) :
    (f.liftOfRightInverse f_inv hf g).comp f = g
proof:
:=
  RingHom.ext <| f.liftOfRightInverse_comp_apply f_inv hf g

name: eq_liftOfRightInverse
statement:
theorem eq_liftOfRightInverse (hf : Function.RightInverse f_inv f) (g : A →+* C)
    (hg : RingHom.ker f ≤ RingHom.ker g) (h : B →+* C) (hh : h.comp f = g) :
    h = f.liftOfRightInverse f_inv hf ⟨g, hg⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← hh]
  exact ((f.liftOfRightInverse f_inv hf).apply_symm_apply _).symm

name: liftOfSurjective_comp_apply
statement:
theorem liftOfSurjective_comp_apply (hf : Function.Surjective f)
    (g : { g : A →+* C // RingHom.ker f ≤ RingHom.ker g }) (x : A) :
    (f.liftOfSurjective hf) g (f x) = (g : A →+* C) x
proof:
:=
  RingHom.liftOfRightInverse_comp_apply f _ _ g x

name: liftOfSurjective_comp
statement:
theorem liftOfSurjective_comp (hf : Function.Surjective f)
    (g : { g : A →+* C // RingHom.ker f ≤ RingHom.ker g }) :
    ((f.liftOfSurjective hf) g).comp f = (g : A →+* C)
proof:
:=
  RingHom.liftOfRightInverse_comp f _ _ g

name: eq_liftOfSurjective
statement:
theorem eq_liftOfSurjective (hf : Function.Surjective f) (g : A →+* C)
    (hg : RingHom.ker f ≤ RingHom.ker g) (h : B →+* C) (hh : h.comp f = g) :
    h = f.liftOfSurjective hf ⟨g, hg⟩
proof:
:=
  RingHom.eq_liftOfRightInverse f _ _ g _ _ hh

name: RingEquiv.idealComapOrderIso_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma RingEquiv.idealComapOrderIso_symm_apply
    {R S : Type*} [Semiring R] [Semiring S] (e : R ≃+* S) (I : Ideal R) :
    e.idealComapOrderIso.symm I = I.map e
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: ker_coe
statement: lemma ker_coe : RingHom.ker f = RingHom.ker (f : A →+* B)
proof: := rfl

name: coe_ideal_map
statement:
lemma coe_ideal_map (I : Ideal A) :
    Ideal.map f I = Ideal.map (f : A →+* B) I
proof: := rfl

name: comap_ker
statement:
lemma comap_ker {C : Type*} [Semiring C] [Algebra R C] (f : B →ₐ[R] C) (g : A →ₐ[R] B) :
    (RingHom.ker f).comap g = RingHom.ker (f.comp g)
proof:
:=
  RingHom.comap_ker f.toRingHom g.toRingHom

name: idealMap_mul
statement:
@[simp]
lemma idealMap_mul (I : Ideal R) (x y : I) :
    idealMap S I (x * y) = idealMap S I x * idealMap S I y
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp

name: FaithfulSMul.ker_algebraMap_eq_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem FaithfulSMul.ker_algebraMap_eq_bot (R A : Type*) [CommSemiring R] [Semiring A]
    [Algebra R A] [FaithfulSMul R A] : RingHom.ker (algebraMap R A) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp

name: RingHom.ker_evalRingHom
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (fun x hx ↦ ?_) (by simp [Ideal.span_le])
  simp only [RingHom.mem_ker, Pi.evalRingHom_apply] at hx
  rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
  use x + Pi.single i 1
  simp [mul_add, sub_mul, one_mul, ← Pi.single_mul_left, hx]

name: Ideal.exists_of_comap_eq_ker_sup
proof:
:= by
  rcases surj x with ⟨x', hx'⟩
  rw [← hx', ← Ideal.mem_comap, eq] at hx
  rcases Submodule.mem_sup.mp hx with ⟨y, hy, z, hz, hyz⟩
  use z, hz
  simpa [← hx', ← hyz, ← RingHom.mem_ker] using hy

name: Ideal.eq_map_of_comap_eq_ker_sup
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (fun x hx ↦ ?_)
    (Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.mpr (le_of_le_of_eq le_sup_right eq.symm))
  rcases Ideal.exists_of_comap_eq_ker_sup _ surj eq hx with ⟨y, mem, hy⟩
  simpa [← hy] using Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ mem

name: isAugmentation_iff
statement:
lemma isAugmentation_iff [Semiring A] [Algebra R A] (I : Ideal A) :
    I.IsAugmentation R ↔ IsCompl 1 (I.restrictScalars R)
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: isAugmentation_subalgebra_iff
statement:
theorem isAugmentation_subalgebra_iff [CommSemiring A] [Algebra R A]
    {S : Subalgebra R A} {I : Ideal A} :
    I.IsAugmentation S ↔ IsCompl S.toSubmodule (I.restrictScalars R)
proof:
:= by
  simp [Ideal.IsAugmentation, ← Submodule.isCompl_restrictScalars_iff R]

name: coe_prod
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_prod (I : Ideal R) (J : Ideal S) : ↑(prod I J) = (I ×ˢ J : Set (R × S))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: mem_prod
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_prod {x : R × S} : x ∈ prod I J ↔ x.1 ∈ I ∧ x.2 ∈ J
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: _root_.RingHom.ker_prodMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem _root_.RingHom.ker_prodMap {T U : Type*} [Semiring T] [Semiring U] (f : R →+* S)
    (g : T →+* U) : RingHom.ker (f.prodMap g) = (RingHom.ker f).prod (RingHom.ker g)
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨⟩; simp

name: prod_top_top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem prod_top_top : prod (⊤ : Ideal R) (⊤ : Ideal S) = ⊤
proof:
:=
  Ideal.ext <| by simp

name: prod_bot_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem prod_bot_bot : prod (⊥ : Ideal R) (⊥ : Ideal S) = ⊥
proof:
:=
  SetLike.coe_injective <| Set.singleton_prod_singleton

name: prod_mono
statement:
@[gcongr]
theorem prod_mono {I₁ I₂ : Ideal R} {J₁ J₂ : Ideal S} (hI : I₁ ≤ I₂) (hJ : J₁ ≤ J₂) :
    prod I₁ J₁ ≤ prod I₂ J₂
proof:
:=
  Set.prod_mono hI hJ

name: prod_mono_left
statement: theorem prod_mono_left {I₁ I₂ : Ideal R} {J : Ideal S} (hI : I₁ ≤ I₂) : prod I₁ J ≤ prod I₂ J
proof:
:=
  Set.prod_mono_left hI

name: prod_mono_right
statement: theorem prod_mono_right {I : Ideal R} {J₁ J₂ : Ideal S} (hJ : J₁ ≤ J₂) : prod I J₁ ≤ prod I J₂
proof:
:=
  Set.prod_mono_right hJ

name: ideal_prod_eq
statement:
theorem ideal_prod_eq (I : Ideal (R × S)) :
    I = Ideal.prod (map (RingHom.fst R S) I : Ideal R) (map (RingHom.snd R S) I)
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.ext
  rintro ⟨r, s⟩
  rw [mem_prod, mem_map_iff_of_surjective (RingHom.fst R S) Prod.fst_surjective,
    mem_map_iff_of_surjective (RingHom.snd R S) Prod.snd_surjective]
  refine ⟨fun h => ⟨⟨_, ⟨h, rfl⟩⟩, ⟨_, ⟨h, rfl⟩⟩⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨⟨⟨r, s'⟩, ⟨h₁, rfl⟩⟩, ⟨⟨r', s⟩, ⟨h₂, rfl⟩⟩⟩
  simpa using I.add_mem (I.mul_mem_left (1, 0) h₁) (I.mul_mem_left (0, 1) h₂)

name: map_fst_prod
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_fst_prod (I : Ideal R) (J : Ideal S) : map (RingHom.fst R S) (prod I J) = I
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [mem_map_iff_of_surjective (RingHom.fst R S) Prod.fst_surjective]
  exact
    ⟨by
      rintro ⟨x, ⟨h, rfl⟩⟩
      exact h.1, fun h => ⟨⟨x, 0⟩, ⟨⟨h, Ideal.zero_mem _⟩, rfl⟩⟩⟩

name: map_snd_prod
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_snd_prod (I : Ideal R) (J : Ideal S) : map (RingHom.snd R S) (prod I J) = J
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [mem_map_iff_of_surjective (RingHom.snd R S) Prod.snd_surjective]
  exact
    ⟨by
      rintro ⟨x, ⟨h, rfl⟩⟩
      exact h.2, fun h => ⟨⟨0, x⟩, ⟨⟨Ideal.zero_mem _, h⟩, rfl⟩⟩⟩

name: map_prodComm_prod
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_prodComm_prod :
    map ((RingEquiv.prodComm : R × S ≃+* S × R) : R × S →+* S × R) (prod I J) = prod J I
proof:
:= by
  refine Trans.trans (ideal_prod_eq _) ?_
  simp [map_map]

name: idealProdEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem idealProdEquiv_symm_apply (I : Ideal R) (J : Ideal S) :
    idealProdEquiv.symm ⟨I, J⟩ = prod I J
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: span_prod_le
statement:
theorem span_prod_le {s : Set R} {t : Set S} :
    span (s ×ˢ t) ≤ prod (span s) (span t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ideal_prod_eq (span (s ×ˢ t)), map_span, map_span]
  gcongr
  · exact Set.fst_image_prod_subset _ _
  · exact Set.snd_image_prod_subset _ _

name: span_prod
statement:
theorem span_prod {s : Set R} {t : Set S} (hst : s.Nonempty ↔ t.Nonempty) :
    span (s ×ˢ t) = prod (span s) (span t)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [iff_iff_and_or_not_and_not, Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hst
  obtain ⟨hs, ht⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := hst
  · conv_lhs => rw [Ideal.ideal_prod_eq (Ideal.span (s ×ˢ t))]
    congr 1
    · rw [Ideal.map_span]
      simp [Set.fst_image_prod _ ht]
    · rw [Ideal.map_span]
      simp [Set.snd_image_prod hs]
  · simp

name: prod_inj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem prod_inj {I I' : Ideal R} {J J' : Ideal S} :
    prod I J = prod I' J' ↔ I = I' ∧ J = J'
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← idealProdEquiv_symm_apply, idealProdEquiv.symm.injective.eq_iff, Prod.mk_inj]

name: prod_eq_bot_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem prod_eq_bot_iff {I : Ideal R} {J : Ideal S} :
    prod I J = ⊥ ↔ I = ⊥ ∧ J = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [← prod_inj, prod_bot_bot]

name: prod_eq_top_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem prod_eq_top_iff {I : Ideal R} {J : Ideal S} :
    prod I J = ⊤ ↔ I = ⊤ ∧ J = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [← prod_inj, prod_top_top]

name: isPrime_of_isPrime_prod_top
statement:
theorem isPrime_of_isPrime_prod_top {I : Ideal R} (h : (Ideal.prod I (⊤ : Ideal S)).IsPrime) :
    I.IsPrime
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · contrapose h
    rw [h, prod_top_top, isPrime_iff]
    simp
  · intro x y hxy
    have : (⟨x, 1⟩ : R × S) * ⟨y, 1⟩ ∈ prod I ⊤ := by
      rw [Prod.mk_mul_mk, mul_one, mem_prod]
      exact ⟨hxy, trivial⟩
    simpa using h.mem_or_mem this

name: isPrime_of_isPrime_prod_top'
statement:
theorem isPrime_of_isPrime_prod_top' {I : Ideal S} (h : (Ideal.prod (⊤ : Ideal R) I).IsPrime) :
    I.IsPrime
proof:
:= by
  apply isPrime_of_isPrime_prod_top (S := R)
  rw [← map_prodComm_prod]
  
  exact map_isPrime_of_equiv (RingEquiv.prodComm (R := R) (S := S))

name: isPrime_ideal_prod_top
statement:
theorem isPrime_ideal_prod_top {I : Ideal R} [h : I.IsPrime] : (prod I (⊤ : Ideal S)).IsPrime where
  ne_top'
proof:
:= by simpa using h.ne_top
  mem_or_mem' {x y} := by simpa using h.mem_or_mem

name: isPrime_ideal_prod_top'
statement: theorem isPrime_ideal_prod_top' {I : Ideal S} [h : I.IsPrime] : (prod (⊤ : Ideal R) I).IsPrime
proof:
:= by
  let : IsPrime (prod I (⊤ : Ideal R)) := isPrime_ideal_prod_top
  rw [← map_prodComm_prod]
  
  exact map_isPrime_of_equiv (RingEquiv.prodComm (R := S) (S := R))

name: ideal_prod_prime_aux
statement:
theorem ideal_prod_prime_aux {I : Ideal R} {J : Ideal S} :
    (Ideal.prod I J).IsPrime → I = ⊤ ∨ J = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  contrapose!
  simp only [ne_top_iff_one, isPrime_iff, not_and, not_forall, not_or]
  exact fun ⟨hI, hJ⟩ _ => ⟨⟨0, 1⟩, ⟨1, 0⟩, by simp, by simp [hJ], by simp [hI]⟩

name: ideal_prod_prime
statement:
theorem ideal_prod_prime (I : Ideal (R × S)) :
    I.IsPrime ↔
      (∃ p : Ideal R, p.IsPrime ∧ I = Ideal.prod p ⊤) ∨
        ∃ p : Ideal S, p.IsPrime ∧ I = Ideal.prod ⊤ p
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [ideal_prod_eq I]
    intro hI
    rcases ideal_prod_prime_aux hI with (h | h)
    · right
      rw [h] at hI ⊢
      exact ⟨_, ⟨isPrime_of_isPrime_prod_top' hI, rfl⟩⟩
    · left
      rw [h] at hI ⊢
      exact ⟨_, ⟨isPrime_of_isPrime_prod_top hI, rfl⟩⟩
  · rintro (⟨p, ⟨h, rfl⟩⟩ | ⟨p, ⟨h, rfl⟩⟩)
    · exact isPrime_ideal_prod_top
    · exact isPrime_ideal_prod_top'

name: pointwise_smul_def
statement:
theorem pointwise_smul_def {a : M} (S : Ideal R) :
    a • S = S.map (MulSemiringAction.toRingHom _ _ a)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: smul_mem_pointwise_smul
statement: theorem smul_mem_pointwise_smul (m : M) (r : R) (S : Ideal R) : r ∈ S → m • r ∈ m • S
proof:
:=
  fun h => subset_span <| Set.smul_mem_smul_set h

name: smul_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_bot (a : M) : a • (⊥ : Ideal R) = ⊥
proof:
:=
  map_bot

name: smul_sup
statement: theorem smul_sup (a : M) (S T : Ideal R) : a • (S ⊔ T) = a • S ⊔ a • T
proof:
:=

name: smul_closure
statement: theorem smul_closure (a : M) (s : Set R) : a • span s = span (a • s)
proof:
:=
  Ideal.map_span _ _

name: pointwise_smul_toAddSubmonoid
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pointwise_smul_toAddSubmonoid (a : M) (S : Ideal R)
    (ha : Function.Surjective fun r : R => a • r) :
    (a • S).toAddSubmonoid = a • S.toAddSubmonoid
proof:
:= by
  ext
  exact Ideal.mem_map_iff_of_surjective _ <| by exact ha

name: pointwise_smul_toAddSubgroup
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pointwise_smul_toAddSubgroup {R : Type*} [Ring R] [MulSemiringAction M R]
    (a : M) (S : Ideal R) (ha : Function.Surjective fun r : R => a • r) :
    (a • S).toAddSubgroup = a • S.toAddSubgroup
proof:
:= by
  ext
  exact Ideal.mem_map_iff_of_surjective _ <| by exact ha

name: pointwise_smul_eq_comap
statement:
theorem pointwise_smul_eq_comap {a : M} (S : Ideal R) :
    a • S = S.comap (MulSemiringAction.toRingAut _ _ a).symm
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp [pointwise_smul_def]
  rfl

name: smul_mem_pointwise_smul_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_mem_pointwise_smul_iff {a : M} {S : Ideal R} {x : R} : a • x ∈ a • S ↔ x ∈ S
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by simpa using smul_mem_pointwise_smul a⁻¹ _ _ h, smul_mem_pointwise_smul _ _ _⟩

name: mem_pointwise_smul_iff_inv_smul_mem
statement:
theorem mem_pointwise_smul_iff_inv_smul_mem {a : M} {S : Ideal R} {x : R} :
    x ∈ a • S ↔ a⁻¹ • x ∈ S
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by simpa using smul_mem_pointwise_smul a⁻¹ _ _ h,
    fun h => by simpa using smul_mem_pointwise_smul a _ _ h⟩

name: mem_inv_pointwise_smul_iff
statement: theorem mem_inv_pointwise_smul_iff {a : M} {S : Ideal R} {x : R} : x ∈ a⁻¹ • S ↔ a • x ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_pointwise_smul_iff_inv_smul_mem, inv_inv]

name: pointwise_smul_le_pointwise_smul_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pointwise_smul_le_pointwise_smul_iff {a : M} {S T : Ideal R} : a • S ≤ a • T ↔ S ≤ T
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by simpa using smul_mono_right a⁻¹ h, fun h => smul_mono_right a h⟩

name: pointwise_smul_subset_iff
statement: theorem pointwise_smul_subset_iff {a : M} {S T : Ideal R} : a • S ≤ T ↔ S ≤ a⁻¹ • T
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pointwise_smul_le_pointwise_smul_iff (a := a⁻¹), inv_smul_smul]

name: subset_pointwise_smul_iff
statement: theorem subset_pointwise_smul_iff {a : M} {S T : Ideal R} : S ≤ a • T ↔ a⁻¹ • S ≤ T
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pointwise_smul_le_pointwise_smul_iff (a := a⁻¹), inv_smul_smul]

name: IsPrime.smul_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem IsPrime.smul_iff {I : Ideal R} (g : M) : (g • I).IsPrime ↔ I.IsPrime
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun H ↦ inv_smul_smul g I ▸ H.smul g⁻¹, fun H ↦ H.smul g⟩

name: inertia_smul
statement:
theorem inertia_smul {R : Type*} [Ring R] [MulSemiringAction M R]
    (g : M) (I : Ideal R) : (g • I).inertia M = (I.inertia M).map (MulAut.conj g)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp_rw [Subgroup.map_equiv_eq_comap_symm, Subgroup.mem_comap, MonoidHom.coe_coe,
    MulAut.conj_symm_apply, mem_inertia, mem_pointwise_smul_iff_inv_smul_mem]
  rw [← (MulAction.toPerm g).forall_congr_right]
  simp [mul_smul, smul_sub]

name: inertia_le_stabilizer
statement:
theorem inertia_le_stabilizer {R : Type*} [Ring R] (P : Ideal R) [MulSemiringAction M R] :
    inertia M P ≤ MulAction.stabilizer M P
proof:
:= by
  refine fun σ hσ ↦ SetLike.ext fun x ↦ ?_
  rw [Ideal.mem_pointwise_smul_iff_inv_smul_mem,
    ← P.add_mem_iff_left (a := x) ((inv_mem hσ) x), add_sub_cancel]

name: stabilizerEquiv_apply_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem stabilizerEquiv_apply_smul (I : Ideal R) (e : M ≃* N)
    (he : ∀ (m : M) (x : R), (e m) • x = m • x) (m : MulAction.stabilizer M I) (x : R) :
    stabilizerEquiv I e he m • x = m • x
proof:
:= by
  simp [stabilizerEquiv, MulAction.subgroup_smul_def, ← he m x]

name: stabilizerEquiv_symm_apply_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem stabilizerEquiv_symm_apply_smul (I : Ideal R) (e : M ≃* N)
    (he : ∀ (m : M) (x : R), (e m) • x = m • x) (n : MulAction.stabilizer N I) (x : R) :
    (stabilizerEquiv I e he).symm n • x = n • x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (stabilizerEquiv I e he).apply_symm_apply n, stabilizerEquiv_apply_smul,
    (stabilizerEquiv I e he).apply_symm_apply]

name: inertiaEquiv_apply_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inertiaEquiv_apply_smul {R : Type*} [Ring R] [MulSemiringAction M R] [MulSemiringAction N R]
    (I : Ideal R) (e : M ≃* N) (he : ∀ (m : M) (x : R), (e m) • x = m • x) (m : inertia M I)
    (x : R) :
    inertiaEquiv I e he m • x = m • x
proof:
:= by
  simp [inertiaEquiv, MulAction.subgroup_smul_def, ← he m x]

name: inertiaEquiv_symm_apply_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inertiaEquiv_symm_apply_smul {R : Type*} [Ring R] [MulSemiringAction M R]
    [MulSemiringAction N R] (I : Ideal R) (e : M ≃* N) (he : ∀ (m : M) (x : R), (e m) • x = m • x)
    (n : inertia N I) (x : R) :
    (inertiaEquiv I e he).symm n • x = n • x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (inertiaEquiv I e he).apply_symm_apply n, inertiaEquiv_apply_smul,
    (inertiaEquiv I e he).apply_symm_apply]

name: comap_eq_of_scalar_tower_quotient
statement:
theorem comap_eq_of_scalar_tower_quotient [Algebra R S] [Algebra (R ⧸ p) (S ⧸ P)]
    [IsScalarTower R (R ⧸ p) (S ⧸ P)] (h : Function.Injective (algebraMap (R ⧸ p) (S ⧸ P))) :
    comap (algebraMap R S) P = p
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [mem_comap, ← Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, ← Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, Quotient.mk_algebraMap,
    IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R (R ⧸ p) (S ⧸ P), Quotient.algebraMap_eq]
  exact map_eq_zero_iff _ h

name: Quotient.algebraMap_quotient_map_quotient
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Quotient.algebraMap_quotient_map_quotient (x : R) :
    letI f
proof:
:= algebraMap R S
    algebraMap (R ⧸ p) (S ⧸ map f p) (Ideal.Quotient.mk p x) =
    Ideal.Quotient.mk (map f p) (f x) :=
  rfl

name: Quotient.mk_smul_mk_quotient_map_quotient
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Quotient.mk_smul_mk_quotient_map_quotient (x : R) (y : S) :
    letI f
proof:
:= algebraMap R S
    Quotient.mk p x • Quotient.mk (map f p) y = Quotient.mk (map f p) (f x * y) :=
  Algebra.smul_def _ _

name: under_def
statement: theorem under_def : P.under A = Ideal.comap (algebraMap A B) P
proof: := rfl

name: mem_under

name: under_smul
statement:

lemma under_smul [SMulCommClass G A B] : (g • P : Ideal B).under A = P.under A
