name: smul_under
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_under [MulSemiringAction G A] [SMulDistribClass G A B] :
    g • P.under A = (g • P).under A
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [pointwise_smul_eq_comap, ← comap_coe, under_def, comap_comap]
  conv_rhs => rw [pointwise_smul_eq_comap, ← comap_coe, under_def, comap_comap]
  congr
  ext
  simp [algebraMap.smul']

name: under_top
statement: theorem under_top : under A (⊤ : Ideal B) = ⊤
proof: := comap_top

name: over_def
statement: theorem over_def [P.LiesOver p] : p = P.under A
proof: := LiesOver.over

name: mem_of_liesOver
statement: theorem mem_of_liesOver [P.LiesOver p] (x : A) : x ∈ p ↔ algebraMap A B x ∈ P

name: eq_top_iff_of_liesOver

statement: lemma ne_top_iff_of_liesOver [P.LiesOver p] : P ≠ ⊤ ↔ p ≠ ⊤

statement: lemma isPrime_of_liesOver [P.LiesOver p] [P.IsPrime] : p.IsPrime

:= by

name: LiesOver.of_eq_comap
statement:
theorem LiesOver.of_eq_comap [Q.LiesOver p] {F : Type*} [FunLike F B C]
    [AlgHomClass F A B C] (f : F) (h : P = Q.comap f) : P.LiesOver p where
  over
proof:
:= by
    rw [h]
    exact (over_def Q p).trans <|
      congrFun (congrFun (congrArg
        comap ((AlgHom.ofClass f).comp_algebraMap.symm)) _) Q

name: LiesOver.of_eq_map_equiv
statement:
theorem LiesOver.of_eq_map_equiv [P.LiesOver p] {E : Type*} [EquivLike E B C]
    [AlgEquivClass E A B C] (σ : E) (h : Q = P.map σ) : Q.LiesOver p
proof:
:= by
  rw [← show _ = P.map σ from comap_symm (RingEquivClass.toRingEquiv σ)] at h
  exact of_eq_comap p (AlgEquiv.ofClass σ).symm h

name: under_under
statement:
@[simp]
theorem under_under : (𝔓.under B).under A = 𝔓.under A
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [comap_comap, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq]

name: LiesOver.trans
statement:
theorem LiesOver.trans [𝔓.LiesOver P] [P.LiesOver p] : 𝔓.LiesOver p where
  over
proof: := by rw [P.over_def p, 𝔓.over_def P, under_under]

name: LiesOver.tower_bot
statement:
theorem LiesOver.tower_bot [hp : 𝔓.LiesOver p] [hP : 𝔓.LiesOver P] : P.LiesOver p where
  over
proof: := by rw [𝔓.over_def p, 𝔓.over_def P, under_under]

name: map_under_le_under_map
statement:
theorem map_under_le_under_map {C D : Type*} [CommSemiring C] [Semiring D] [Algebra A C]
    [Algebra C D] [Algebra A D] [Algebra B D] [IsScalarTower A C D] [IsScalarTower A B D] :
    map (algebraMap A C) (under A P) ≤ under C (map (algebraMap B D) P)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_comap_of_map_le
  rw [map_map, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq, map_le_iff_le_comap,
    IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq A B D, ← comap_comap]
  exact comap_mono <| le_comap_map

name: under_map_eq_map_under
statement:
theorem under_map_eq_map_under {C D : Type*} [CommSemiring C] [Semiring D] [Algebra A C]
    [Algebra C D] [Algebra A D] [Algebra B D] [IsScalarTower A C D] [IsScalarTower A B D]
    (h₁ : (map (algebraMap A C) (under A P)).IsMaximal) (h₂ : map (algebraMap B D) P ≠ ⊤) :
    under C (map (algebraMap B D) P) = map (algebraMap A C) (under A P)
proof:
:=
  (IsCoatom.le_iff_eq (isMaximal_def.mp h₁) (comap_ne_top (algebraMap C D) h₂)).mp <|
    map_under_le_under_map P

name: disjoint_primeCompl_of_liesOver
statement:
theorem disjoint_primeCompl_of_liesOver [p.IsPrime] [hPp : 𝔓.LiesOver p] :
  Disjoint ((Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid C p.primeCompl) : Set C) (𝔓 : Set C)
proof:
:= by
  rw [liesOver_iff, under_def, SetLike.ext'_iff, coe_comap] at hPp
  simpa only [Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid, primeCompl, hPp, ← le_compl_iff_disjoint_left]
    using! Set.subset_compl_comm.mp (by simp)

name: algebraMapSubmonoid_primeCompl_of_liesOver_surjective

theorem algebraMapSubmonoid_primeCompl_of_liesOver_surjective

name: ne_bot_of_liesOver_of_ne_bot

name: tensorCotangentHom_tmul
statement:
lemma tensorCotangentHom_tmul (t : T) (x : I) :
    tensorCotangentHom R T I (t ⊗ₜ[R] I.toCotangent x) =
      t • (I.map (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom : S →+* T ⊗[R] S)).toCotangent
        ⟨1 ⊗ₜ x, Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ x.2⟩
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: tensorCotangentHom_surjective
statement:
lemma tensorCotangentHom_surjective :
    Function.Surjective (I.tensorCotangentHom R T)
proof:
:= by
  let a : S →+* T ⊗[R] S := Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom
  intro x
  obtain ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, rfl⟩ := Ideal.toCotangent_surjective _ x
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := I.map_includeRight_eq.le hx
  obtain rfl : hx = I.map_includeRight_eq.ge ⟨y, rfl⟩ := rfl
  induction y with
  | add x y hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨a + b, by simp only [map_add, ha, hb]; rfl⟩
  | tmul t x =>
    use t ⊗ₜ I.toCotangent x
    apply Ideal.cotangentToQuotientSquare_injective
    simp [-AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, tensorCotangentHom_tmul, Algebra.smul_def,
      ← Ideal.Quotient.mk_algebraMap, ← map_mul]

name: tensorCotangentHom_injective_of_flat
statement:
lemma tensorCotangentHom_injective_of_flat [Module.Flat R T] :
    Function.Injective (I.tensorCotangentHom R T)
proof:
:= by
  let a : S →+* T ⊗[R] S := Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom
  let f : (I.map a).Cotangent →ₗ[T] T ⊗[R] S ⧸ (I.map a) ^ 2 :=
    (Ideal.cotangentToQuotientSquare _).restrictScalars T
  suffices h : Function.Injective (f ∘ₗ tensorCotangentHom R T I) from .of_comp h
  let g : T ⊗[R] I.Cotangent →ₗ[T] T ⊗[R] (S ⧸ I ^ 2) :=
    AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor T T I.cotangentToQuotientSquare
  let hₐ : T ⊗[R] (S ⧸ I ^ 2) ≃ₐ[T] T ⊗[R] S ⧸ (I.map a) ^ 2 :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.tensorQuotientEquiv _ _ _ _).trans
      (Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq T (Ideal.map_pow _ _ _))
  have : f ∘ₗ tensorCotangentHom R T I = hₐ.toLinearMap ∘ₗ g := by
    ext x
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := I.toCotangent_surjective x
    dsimp [f, g, hₐ]
    rw [tensorCotangentHom_tmul, one_smul, Ideal.toCotangent_to_quotient_square]
    simp
  rw [this, LinearMap.coe_comp]
  apply hₐ.injective.comp
  · apply Module.Flat.lTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap (M := T)
      (I.cotangentToQuotientSquare.restrictScalars R)
    apply cotangentToQuotientSquare_injective

name: tensorCotangentEquiv_tmul
statement:
lemma tensorCotangentEquiv_tmul [Module.Flat R T] (t : T) (x : I) :
    I.tensorCotangentEquiv R T (t ⊗ₜ I.toCotangent x) =
      t • (I.map (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom : S →+* T ⊗[R] S)).toCotangent
        ⟨1 ⊗ₜ x, Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ x.2⟩
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: isPrimary_iff
statement:
lemma isPrimary_iff {I : Ideal R} :
    I.IsPrimary ↔ I ≠ ⊤ ∧ ∀ {x y : R}, x * y ∈ I → x ∈ I ∨ y ∈ radical I
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsPrimary, Submodule.IsPrimary, forall_comm]
  simp only [mul_comm, mem_radical_iff,
    ← Submodule.ideal_span_singleton_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_top, span_singleton_le_iff_mem]

name: IsPrime.isPrimary
statement: theorem IsPrime.isPrimary {I : Ideal R} (hi : IsPrime I) : I.IsPrimary
proof:
:=
  isPrimary_iff.mpr
  ⟨hi.1, fun {_ _} hxy => (hi.mem_or_mem hxy).imp id fun hyi => le_radical hyi⟩

name: isPrime_radical
statement: theorem isPrime_radical {I : Ideal R} (hi : I.IsPrimary) : IsPrime (radical I)
proof:
:=
  I.colon_univ ▸ hi.isPrime_radical_colon

name: isPrimary_of_isMaximal_radical
statement:
theorem isPrimary_of_isMaximal_radical {I : Ideal R} (hi : IsMaximal (radical I)) :
    I.IsPrimary
proof:
:= by
  rw [isPrimary_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    exact (radical_top R ▸ hi).ne_top rfl
  · intro x y hxy
    by_cases h : I + span {y} = ⊤
    · rw [← span_singleton_le_iff_mem, ← mul_top (span {x}), ← h, mul_add,
        span_singleton_mul_span_singleton, add_le_iff, span_singleton_le_iff_mem]
      exact Or.inl ⟨mul_le_right, hxy⟩
    · obtain ⟨m, hm, hy⟩ := exists_le_maximal (I + span {y}) h
      rw [add_le_iff, span_singleton_le_iff_mem, ← hm.isPrime.radical_le_iff] at hy
      exact Or.inr (hi.eq_of_le hm.ne_top hy.1 ▸ hy.2)

name: IsPrimary.inf
statement:
theorem IsPrimary.inf {I J : Ideal R} (hi : I.IsPrimary) (hj : J.IsPrimary)
    (hij : radical I = radical J) : (I ⊓ J).IsPrimary
proof:
:=
  Submodule.IsPrimary.inf hi hj (by simpa)

name: isPrimary_finsetInf
statement:
lemma isPrimary_finsetInf {ι} {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → Ideal R} {i : ι} (hi : i ∈ s)
    (hs : ∀ ⦃y⦄, y ∈ s → (f y).IsPrimary)
    (hs' : ∀ ⦃y⦄, y ∈ s → (f y).radical = (f i).radical) :
    IsPrimary (s.inf f)
proof:
:=
  Submodule.isPrimary_finsetInf hi hs (by simpa)

name: IsPrimary.comap
statement: lemma IsPrimary.comap {I : Ideal S} (hI : I.IsPrimary) (φ : R →+* S) : (I.comap φ).IsPrimary
proof:
:= by
  rw [isPrimary_iff] at hI ⊢
  refine hI.imp (comap_ne_top φ) fun h ↦ ?_
  simp only [mem_comap, map_mul, ← comap_radical]
  exact h

name: isIdempotentElem_iff_of_fg
statement:
theorem isIdempotentElem_iff_of_fg {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) (h : I.FG) :
    IsIdempotentElem I ↔ ∃ e : R, IsIdempotentElem e ∧ I = R ∙ e
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro e
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hr'⟩ :=
      Submodule.exists_mem_and_smul_eq_self_of_fg_of_le_smul I I h
        (by
          rw [smul_eq_mul]
          exact e.ge)
    simp_rw [smul_eq_mul] at hr'
    refine ⟨r, hr' r hr, antisymm ?_ ((Submodule.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _ _).mpr hr)⟩
    intro x hx
    rw [← hr' x hx]
    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mpr ⟨_, mul_comm _ _⟩
  · rintro ⟨e, he, rfl⟩
    simp [IsIdempotentElem, Ideal.span_singleton_mul_span_singleton, he.eq]

name: isIdempotentElem_iff_eq_bot_or_top
statement:
theorem isIdempotentElem_iff_eq_bot_or_top {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] (I : Ideal R)
    (h : I.FG) : IsIdempotentElem I ↔ I = ⊥ ∨ I = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro H
    obtain ⟨e, he, rfl⟩ := (I.isIdempotentElem_iff_of_fg h).mp H
    simp only [Ideal.submodule_span_eq, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot]
    apply Or.imp id _ (IsIdempotentElem.iff_eq_zero_or_one.mp he)
    rintro rfl
    simp
  · rintro (rfl | rfl) <;> simp [IsIdempotentElem]

name: exists_ideal_ge_liesOver_of_le
statement:
lemma exists_ideal_ge_liesOver_of_le [Algebra.HasGoingUp R S]
    {p q : Ideal R} [q.IsPrime] (P : Ideal S) [P.IsPrime] [P.LiesOver p]
    (hle : p ≤ q) :
    ∃ Q, P ≤ Q ∧ Q.IsPrime ∧ Q.LiesOver q
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne p q with rfl | h
  · use P
  · rw [P.over_def p] at hle h
    exact Algebra.HasGoingUp.exists_ideal_ge_liesOver_of_lt P (lt_of_le_of_ne hle h)

name: exists_ideal_gt_liesOver_of_lt
statement:
lemma exists_ideal_gt_liesOver_of_lt [Algebra.HasGoingUp R S]
    {p q : Ideal R} [q.IsPrime] (P : Ideal S) [P.IsPrime] [P.LiesOver p]
    (hpq : p < q) :
    ∃ Q, P < Q ∧ Q.IsPrime ∧ Q.LiesOver q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Q, hPQ, hQ, hQq⟩ := P.exists_ideal_ge_liesOver_of_le (p := p) (q := q) hpq.le
  refine ⟨Q, lt_of_le_of_ne hPQ fun h ↦ ?_, hQ, hQq⟩
  subst Q
  simp [P.over_def p, P.over_def q] at hpq

name: exists_ltSeries_of_hasGoingUp
statement:
lemma exists_ltSeries_of_hasGoingUp [Algebra.HasGoingUp R S]
    (l : LTSeries (PrimeSpectrum R))
    (P : Ideal S) [P.IsPrime]
    [lo : P.LiesOver (RelSeries.head l).asIdeal] :
    ∃ L : LTSeries (PrimeSpectrum S),
      L.length = l.length ∧
      L.head = (⟨P, inferInstance⟩ : PrimeSpectrum S) ∧
      List.map (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S)) (L.toList) = l.toList
proof:
:= by
  induction l using RelSeries.inductionOn generalizing P with
  | singleton q =>
    refine ⟨RelSeries.singleton _ ⟨P, inferInstance⟩, rfl, rfl, ?_⟩
    simpa [PrimeSpectrum.ext_iff] using lo.over.symm
  | cons l q lt ih =>
    simp only [RelSeries.head_cons] at lo
    obtain ⟨Q, PQlt, hQ, Qlo⟩ :=
      Ideal.exists_ideal_gt_liesOver_of_lt P lt
    obtain ⟨L, len, head, spec⟩ := ih Q
    refine ⟨L.cons ⟨P, inferInstance⟩ (by
      simp_all only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
      exact PQlt), by simpa using len, rfl, ?_⟩
    simpa [spec, PrimeSpectrum.ext_iff] using lo.over.symm

name: iff_specializingMap_primeSpectrumComap
statement:
@[stacks 00HW "(2)"]
lemma iff_specializingMap_primeSpectrumComap :
    Algebra.HasGoingUp R S ↔
      SpecializingMap (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun h ↦ ⟨fun {q} hq P hP hlt ↦ ?_⟩⟩
  · intro h P q hq
    simp only [flip] at hq
    rw [← PrimeSpectrum.le_iff_specializes] at hq
    obtain ⟨Q, hle, hQ, h⟩ := P.asIdeal.exists_ideal_ge_liesOver_of_le (q := q.asIdeal)
      (p := P.asIdeal.under R) hq
    refine ⟨⟨Q, hQ⟩, (PrimeSpectrum.le_iff_specializes P _).mp hle, ?_⟩
    ext : 1
    exact h.over.symm
  · have : PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S) ⟨P, hP⟩ ⤳ (⟨q, hq⟩ : PrimeSpectrum R) :=
      (PrimeSpectrum.le_iff_specializes _ _).mp hlt.le
    obtain ⟨Q, hs, heq⟩ := h this
    refine ⟨Q.asIdeal, (PrimeSpectrum.le_iff_specializes _ _).mpr hs, Q.2, ⟨?_⟩⟩
    simpa [PrimeSpectrum.ext_iff] using heq.symm

name: trans
statement:
@[stacks 00HX]
lemma trans (T : Type*) [CommRing T] [Algebra R T] [Algebra S T] [IsScalarTower R S T]
    [Algebra.HasGoingUp R S] [Algebra.HasGoingUp S T] :
    Algebra.HasGoingUp R T
proof:
:= by
  rw [iff_specializingMap_primeSpectrumComap, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R S T]
  simp only [PrimeSpectrum.comap_comp]
  apply SpecializingMap.comp
  · rwa [← iff_specializingMap_primeSpectrumComap]
  · rwa [← iff_specializingMap_primeSpectrumComap]

name: coeff_zero_mem_comap_of_root_mem_of_eval_mem
statement:
theorem coeff_zero_mem_comap_of_root_mem_of_eval_mem {r : S} (hr : r ∈ I) {p : R[X]}
    (hp : p.eval₂ f r ∈ I) : p.coeff 0 ∈ I.comap f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← p.divX_mul_X_add, eval₂_add, eval₂_C, eval₂_mul, eval₂_X] at hp
  refine mem_comap.mpr ((I.add_mem_iff_right ?_).mp hp)
  exact I.mul_mem_left _ hr

name: coeff_zero_mem_comap_of_root_mem
statement:
theorem coeff_zero_mem_comap_of_root_mem {r : S} (hr : r ∈ I) {p : R[X]} (hp : p.eval₂ f r = 0) :
    p.coeff 0 ∈ I.comap f
proof:
:=
  coeff_zero_mem_comap_of_root_mem_of_eval_mem hr (hp.symm ▸ I.zero_mem)

name: exists_coeff_ne_zero_mem_comap_of_non_zero_divisor_root_mem
proof:
:= by
  refine p.recOnHorner ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro h
    contradiction
  · intro p a coeff_eq_zero a_ne_zero _ _ hp
    refine ⟨0, ?_, coeff_zero_mem_comap_of_root_mem hr hp⟩
    simp [coeff_eq_zero, a_ne_zero]
  · intro p p_nonzero ih _ hp
    rw [eval₂_mul, eval₂_X] at hp
    obtain ⟨i, hi, mem⟩ := ih p_nonzero (r_non_zero_divisor hp)
    refine ⟨i + 1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [hi]
    · simpa [hi] using mem

name: injective_quotient_le_comap_map
statement:
theorem injective_quotient_le_comap_map (P : Ideal R[X]) :
    Function.Injective <|
      Ideal.quotientMap
        (Ideal.map (Polynomial.mapRingHom (Quotient.mk (P.comap (C : R →+* R[X])))) P)
        (Polynomial.mapRingHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (P.comap (C : R →+* R[X]))))
        le_comap_map
proof:
:= by
  refine quotientMap_injective' (le_of_eq ?_)
  rw [comap_map_of_surjective (mapRingHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (P.comap (C : R →+* R[X]))))
      (map_surjective (Ideal.Quotient.mk (P.comap (C : R →+* R[X]))) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective)]
  refine le_antisymm (sup_le le_rfl ?_) (le_sup_of_le_left le_rfl)
  refine fun p hp =>
    polynomial_mem_ideal_of_coeff_mem_ideal P p fun n => Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp ?_
  simpa only [coeff_map, coe_mapRingHom] using! ext_iff.mp (Ideal.mem_bot.mp (mem_comap.mp hp)) n

name: quotient_mk_maps_eq
statement:
theorem quotient_mk_maps_eq (P : Ideal R[X]) :
    ((Quotient.mk (map (mapRingHom (Quotient.mk (P.comap (C : R →+* R[X])))) P)).comp C).comp
        (Quotient.mk (P.comap (C : R →+* R[X]))) =
      (Ideal.quotientMap (map (mapRingHom (Quotient.mk (P.comap (C : R →+* R[X])))) P)
            (mapRingHom (Quotient.mk (P.comap (C : R →+* R[X])))) le_comap_map).comp
        ((Quotient.mk P).comp C)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp

name: exists_nonzero_mem_of_ne_bot
statement:
theorem exists_nonzero_mem_of_ne_bot {P : Ideal R[X]} (Pb : P ≠ ⊥) (hP : ∀ x : R, C x ∈ P → x = 0) :
    ∃ p : R[X], p ∈ P ∧ Polynomial.map (Quotient.mk (P.comap (C : R →+* R[X]))) p ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Submodule.nonzero_mem_of_bot_lt (bot_lt_iff_ne_bot.mpr Pb)
  refine ⟨m, Submodule.coe_mem m, fun pp0 => hm (Submodule.coe_eq_zero.mp ?_)⟩
  refine
    (injective_iff_map_eq_zero (Polynomial.mapRingHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk
      (P.comap (C : R →+* R[X]))))).mp
      ?_ _ pp0
  refine map_injective _ ((RingHom.injective_iff_ker_eq_bot (Ideal.Quotient.mk (P.comap C))).mpr ?_)
  rw [mk_ker]
  exact (Submodule.eq_bot_iff _).mpr fun x hx => hP x (mem_comap.mp hx)

name: exists_coeff_ne_zero_mem_comap_of_root_mem
statement:
theorem exists_coeff_ne_zero_mem_comap_of_root_mem [IsDomain S] {r : S} (r_ne_zero : r ≠ 0)
    (hr : r ∈ I) {p : R[X]} :
    p ≠ 0 → p.eval₂ f r = 0 → ∃ i, p.coeff i ≠ 0 ∧ p.coeff i ∈ I.comap f
proof:
:=
  exists_coeff_ne_zero_mem_comap_of_non_zero_divisor_root_mem
    (fun {_} h => Or.resolve_right (mul_eq_zero.mp h) r_ne_zero) hr

name: exists_coeff_mem_comap_sdiff_comap_of_root_mem_sdiff
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hrJ, hrI⟩ := hr
  have rbar_ne_zero : Ideal.Quotient.mk I r ≠ 0 := mt (Quotient.mk_eq_zero I).mp hrI
  have rbar_mem_J : Ideal.Quotient.mk I r ∈ J.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) := mem_map_of_mem _ hrJ
  have quotient_f : ∀ x ∈ I.comap f, (Ideal.Quotient.mk I).comp f x = 0 := by
    simp [Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
  have rbar_root :
    (p.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.comap f))).eval₂ (Quotient.lift (I.comap f) _ quotient_f)
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk I r) =
      0 := by
    convert! Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hpI
    exact _root_.trans (eval₂_map _ _ _) (hom_eval₂ p f (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) r).symm
  obtain ⟨i, ne_zero, mem⟩ :=
    exists_coeff_ne_zero_mem_comap_of_root_mem rbar_ne_zero rbar_mem_J p_ne_zero rbar_root
  rw [coeff_map] at ne_zero mem
  refine ⟨i, (mem_quotient_iff_mem hIJ).mp ?_, mt ?_ ne_zero⟩
  · simpa using mem
  simp [Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]

name: comap_lt_comap_of_root_mem_sdiff
proof:
:=
  let ⟨i, hJ, hI⟩ := exists_coeff_mem_comap_sdiff_comap_of_root_mem_sdiff hIJ hr p_ne_zero hp
  SetLike.lt_iff_le_and_exists.mpr ⟨comap_mono hIJ, p.coeff i, hJ, hI⟩

name: mem_of_one_mem
statement: theorem mem_of_one_mem (h : (1 : S) ∈ I) (x) : x ∈ I
proof:
:=
  (I.eq_top_iff_one.mpr h).symm ▸ mem_top

name: under_lt_under_of_integral_mem_sdiff
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, p_monic, hpx⟩ := integral
  refine comap_lt_comap_of_root_mem_sdiff hIJ mem (map_monic_ne_zero p_monic) ?_
  convert! I.zero_mem

name: comap_ne_bot_of_root_mem
statement:
theorem comap_ne_bot_of_root_mem [IsDomain S] {r : S} (r_ne_zero : r ≠ 0) (hr : r ∈ I) {p : R[X]}
    (p_ne_zero : p ≠ 0) (hp : p.eval₂ f r = 0) : I.comap f ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= fun h =>
  let ⟨_, hi, mem⟩ := exists_coeff_ne_zero_mem_comap_of_root_mem r_ne_zero hr p_ne_zero hp
  absurd (mem_bot.mp (eq_bot_iff.mp h mem)) hi

name: isMaximal_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal_under
statement:
theorem isMaximal_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal_under [Algebra R S] [Algebra.IsIntegral R S]
    (I : Ideal S) [I.IsPrime] (hI : IsMaximal (I.under R)) : IsMaximal I
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨mt comap_eq_top_iff.mpr hI.1.1, fun _ I_lt_J =>
      let ⟨I_le_J, x, hxJ, hxI⟩ := SetLike.lt_iff_le_and_exists.mp I_lt_J
      comap_eq_top_iff.1 <|
        hI.1.2 _ (under_lt_under_of_integral_mem_sdiff I_le_J ⟨hxJ, hxI⟩
          (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x))⟩⟩

name: isMaximal_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal_comap
statement:
theorem isMaximal_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal_comap (f : R →+* S) (hf : f.IsIntegral) (I : Ideal S)
    [I.IsPrime] (hI : IsMaximal (I.comap f)) : IsMaximal I
proof:
:=
  let _ : Algebra R S := f.toAlgebra
  have : Algebra.IsIntegral R S := ⟨hf⟩
  isMaximal_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal_under (R := R) (S := S) I hI

name: under_ne_bot_of_algebraic_mem
statement:
theorem under_ne_bot_of_algebraic_mem [IsDomain S] {x : S} (x_ne_zero : x ≠ 0) (x_mem : x ∈ I)
    (hx : IsAlgebraic R x) : I.under R ≠ ⊥
proof:
:=
  let ⟨_, p_ne_zero, hp⟩ := hx
  comap_ne_bot_of_root_mem x_ne_zero x_mem p_ne_zero hp

name: under_ne_bot_of_integral_mem
statement:
theorem under_ne_bot_of_integral_mem [Nontrivial R] [IsDomain S] {x : S} (x_ne_zero : x ≠ 0)
    (x_mem : x ∈ I) (hx : IsIntegral R x) : I.under R ≠ ⊥
proof:
:=
  under_ne_bot_of_algebraic_mem x_ne_zero x_mem hx.isAlgebraic

name: eq_bot_of_under_eq_bot
statement:
theorem eq_bot_of_under_eq_bot [Nontrivial R] [IsDomain S] [Algebra.IsIntegral R S]
    (hI : I.under R = ⊥) : I = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_bot_iff.2 fun x hx => ?_
  by_cases hx0 : x = 0
  · exact hx0.symm ▸ Ideal.zero_mem ⊥
  · exact absurd hI (under_ne_bot_of_integral_mem hx0 hx (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x))

name: isMaximal_under_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal
statement:
theorem isMaximal_under_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal [Algebra.IsIntegral R S] (I : Ideal S)
    [hI : I.IsMaximal] : IsMaximal (I.under R)
proof:
:= by
  refine Ideal.Quotient.maximal_of_isField _ ?_
  exact isField_of_isIntegral_of_isField
    algebraMap_quotient_injective (by rwa [← Quotient.maximal_ideal_iff_isField_quotient])

name: isMaximal_comap_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal
statement:
theorem isMaximal_comap_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (hf : f.IsIntegral) (I : Ideal S) [I.IsMaximal] : IsMaximal (I.comap f)
proof:
:=
  let _ : Algebra R S := f.toAlgebra
  have : Algebra.IsIntegral R S := ⟨hf⟩
  isMaximal_under_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal (R := R) (S := S) I

name: IsIntegral.under_lt_under
statement:
theorem IsIntegral.under_lt_under {I J : Ideal A} [I.IsPrime] (I_lt_J : I < J) :
    I.under R < J.under R
proof:
:=
  let ⟨I_le_J, x, hxJ, hxI⟩ := SetLike.lt_iff_le_and_exists.mp I_lt_J
  under_lt_under_of_integral_mem_sdiff I_le_J ⟨hxJ, hxI⟩ (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x)

name: IsIntegral.isMaximal_of_isMaximal_under
statement:
theorem IsIntegral.isMaximal_of_isMaximal_under (I : Ideal A) [I.IsPrime]
    (hI : IsMaximal (I.under R)) : IsMaximal I
proof:
:=
  isMaximal_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal_under I hI

name: IsIntegral.mem_minimalPrimes_map_under
statement:
theorem IsIntegral.mem_minimalPrimes_map_under (I : Ideal A) [I.IsPrime] :
    I ∈ ((I.under R).map (algebraMap R A)).minimalPrimes
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨inferInstance, map_comap_le⟩, fun r ⟨hr, hpr⟩ hrq ↦ ?_⟩
  contrapose! hpr
  exact mt map_le_iff_le_comap.mp (not_le_of_gt (IsIntegral.under_lt_under (hrq.lt_of_not_ge hpr)))

name: IsIntegral.under_ne_bot
statement:
theorem IsIntegral.under_ne_bot [Nontrivial R] {I : Ideal A} (I_ne_bot : I ≠ ⊥) :
    I.under R ≠ ⊥
proof:
:=
  let ⟨x, x_mem, x_ne_zero⟩ := I.ne_bot_iff.mp I_ne_bot
  under_ne_bot_of_integral_mem x_ne_zero x_mem (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x)

name: IsIntegral.eq_bot_of_under_eq_bot
statement:
theorem IsIntegral.eq_bot_of_under_eq_bot [Nontrivial R] {I : Ideal A} :
    I.under R = ⊥ → I = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  contrapose
  exact IsIntegral.under_ne_bot R

name: exists_ideal_over_prime_of_isIntegral_of_isDomain
statement:
theorem exists_ideal_over_prime_of_isIntegral_of_isDomain [Algebra.IsIntegral R S] (P : Ideal R)
    [IsPrime P] (hP : RingHom.ker (algebraMap R S) ≤ P) :
    ∃ Q : Ideal S, IsPrime Q ∧ Q.under R = P
proof:
:= by
  have hP0 : (0 : S) ∉ Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid S P.primeCompl := by
    rintro ⟨x, ⟨hx, x0⟩⟩
    exact absurd (hP x0) hx
  let Rₚ := Localization P.primeCompl
  let Sₚ := Localization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid S P.primeCompl)
  let : IsDomain (Localization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid S P.primeCompl)) :=
    IsLocalization.isDomain_localization (le_nonZeroDivisors_of_noZeroDivisors hP0)
  obtain ⟨Qₚ : Ideal Sₚ, Qₚ_maximal⟩ := exists_maximal Sₚ
  have : Algebra.IsIntegral Rₚ Sₚ := ⟨isIntegral_localization⟩
  have Qₚ_max : IsMaximal (Qₚ.under Rₚ) := isMaximal_under_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal Qₚ
  refine ⟨Qₚ.under S, ⟨inferInstance, ?_⟩⟩
  convert! Localization.AtPrime.under_maximalIdeal (I := P)
  rw [under_under, ← IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal Qₚ_max, under_under]

name: exists_ideal_over_prime_of_isIntegral_of_isPrime
statement:
theorem exists_ideal_over_prime_of_isIntegral_of_isPrime
    [Algebra.IsIntegral R S] (P : Ideal R) [IsPrime P]
    (I : Ideal S) [IsPrime I] (hIP : I.under R ≤ P) :
    ∃ Q ≥ I, IsPrime Q ∧ Q.under R = P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Q' : Ideal (S ⧸ I), ⟨Q'_prime, hQ'⟩⟩ :=
    @exists_ideal_over_prime_of_isIntegral_of_isDomain (R ⧸ I.under R) _ (S ⧸ I) _
      Ideal.quotientAlgebra _ _
      (map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.under R)) P)
      (map_isPrime_of_surjective Quotient.mk_surjective (by simp [hIP]))
      (le_trans (le_of_eq ((RingHom.injective_iff_ker_eq_bot _).1 algebraMap_quotient_injective))
        bot_le)
  refine ⟨Q'.under S, le_trans (le_of_eq mk_ker.symm) (ker_le_comap _), ⟨inferInstance, ?_⟩⟩
  rw [under_under]
  refine _root_.trans ?_ (_root_.trans (congr_arg (comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk
    (comap (algebraMap R S) I))) hQ') ?_)
  · rw [comap_comap]
    exact congr_arg (comap · Q') (RingHom.ext fun r => rfl)
  · refine _root_.trans (comap_map_of_surjective _ Quotient.mk_surjective _) (sup_eq_left.2 ?_)
    simpa [← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot] using hIP

name: exists_ideal_over_prime_of_isIntegral
statement:
theorem exists_ideal_over_prime_of_isIntegral [Algebra.IsIntegral R S] (P : Ideal R) [IsPrime P]
    (I : Ideal S) (hIP : I.under R ≤ P) :
    ∃ Q ≥ I, IsPrime Q ∧ Q.under R = P
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨P', hP, hP', hP''⟩ := exists_ideal_comap_le_prime P I hIP
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hQ', hQ''⟩ := exists_ideal_over_prime_of_isIntegral_of_isPrime P P' hP''
  exact ⟨Q, hP.trans hQ, hQ', hQ''⟩

name: exists_ideal_over_maximal_of_isIntegral
statement:
theorem exists_ideal_over_maximal_of_isIntegral [Algebra.IsIntegral R S]
    (P : Ideal R) [P_max : IsMaximal P] (hP : RingHom.ker (algebraMap R S) ≤ P) :
    ∃ Q : Ideal S, IsMaximal Q ∧ Q.under R = P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Q, -, Q_prime, hQ⟩ := exists_ideal_over_prime_of_isIntegral P ⊥ hP
  exact ⟨Q, isMaximal_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal_under _ (hQ.symm ▸ P_max), hQ⟩

name: exists_maximal_ideal_liesOver_of_isIntegral
statement:
theorem exists_maximal_ideal_liesOver_of_isIntegral [Algebra.IsIntegral R S] [FaithfulSMul R S]
    (P : Ideal R) [P.IsMaximal] :
    ∃ (Q : Ideal S), Q.IsMaximal ∧ Q.LiesOver P
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [liesOver_iff, eq_comm (a := P)]
  exact exists_ideal_over_maximal_of_isIntegral P (by
    simp [(RingHom.injective_iff_ker_eq_bot _).mp (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective R S)])

name: map_eq_top_iff_of_ker_le
statement:
lemma map_eq_top_iff_of_ker_le {R S} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) {I : Ideal R} (hf₁ : RingHom.ker f ≤ I) (hf₂ : f.IsIntegral) :
    I.map f = ⊤ ↔ I = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  constructor; swap
  · rintro rfl; exact Ideal.map_top _
  contrapose
  intro h
  obtain ⟨m, _, hm⟩ := Ideal.exists_le_maximal I h
  let _ := f.toAlgebra
  have : Algebra.IsIntegral _ _ := ⟨hf₂⟩
  obtain ⟨m', _, rfl⟩ := exists_ideal_over_maximal_of_isIntegral m (hf₁.trans hm)
  rw [← map_le_iff_le_comap] at hm
  exact (hm.trans_lt (lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr (IsMaximal.ne_top ‹_›))).ne

name: map_eq_top_iff
statement:
lemma map_eq_top_iff {R S} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) {I : Ideal R} (hf₁ : Function.Injective f) (hf₂ : f.IsIntegral) :
    I.map f = ⊤ ↔ I = ⊤
proof:
:=
  map_eq_top_iff_of_ker_le f (by simp [(RingHom.injective_iff_ker_eq_bot f).mp hf₁]) hf₂

name: exists_notMem_dvd_algebraMap_of_primesOver_eq_singleton
statement:
lemma exists_notMem_dvd_algebraMap_of_primesOver_eq_singleton
    {p : Ideal R} [p.IsPrime] {q : Ideal S} [q.IsPrime] (hq : p.primesOver S = {q})
    [Algebra.IsIntegral R S] (x : S) (hx : x ∉ q) : ∃ r ∉ p, x ∣ algebraMap _ _ r
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dvd_def, eq_comm, mul_comm x]
  by_contra!
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hxQ, hQp⟩ := Ideal.exists_le_prime_disjoint (.span {x})
    (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid _ p.primeCompl)
    (by simpa [Set.disjoint_iff_forall_ne, Ideal.mem_span_singleton',
      Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid, @forall_comm S])
  have hQp' : Q.under _ ≤ p := by
    intro x hxQ
    by_contra hxp
    exact Set.subset_compl_iff_disjoint_right.mpr hQp hxQ ⟨x, hxp, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Q', hQ'Q, hQ', hQ'p⟩ := Ideal.exists_ideal_over_prime_of_isIntegral_of_isPrime _ _ hQp'
  obtain rfl : Q' = q := hq.le ⟨hQ', ⟨hQ'p.symm⟩⟩
  exact hx (hQ'Q (hxQ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)))

name: IsMaximal.of_liesOver_isMaximal
statement: theorem IsMaximal.of_liesOver_isMaximal [hpm : p.IsMaximal] [P.IsPrime] : P.IsMaximal
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.over_def p] at hpm
  exact isMaximal_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal_under P hpm

name: IsMaximal.of_isMaximal_liesOver
statement: theorem IsMaximal.of_isMaximal_liesOver [P.IsMaximal] : p.IsMaximal
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.over_def p]
  exact isMaximal_under_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal P

name: eq_bot_of_liesOver_bot
statement:
theorem eq_bot_of_liesOver_bot [Nontrivial A] [IsDomain B] [h : P.LiesOver (⊥ : Ideal A)] :
    P = ⊥
proof:
:=
  eq_bot_of_under_eq_bot <| ((liesOver_iff _ _).mp h).symm

name: under_ne_bot
statement: theorem under_ne_bot [Nontrivial A] [IsDomain B] (hP : P ≠ ⊥) : under A P ≠ ⊥
proof:
:=
  fun h ↦ hP <| eq_bot_of_under_eq_bot h

name: isMaximal_of_mem_primesOver
statement: theorem isMaximal_of_mem_primesOver {P : Ideal B} (hP : P ∈ primesOver p B) : P.IsMaximal

name: primesOver_bot
statement:
lemma primesOver_bot [Module.IsTorsionFree A B] [IsDomain A] [IsDomain B] :
    primesOver (⊥ : Ideal A) B = {⊥}
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  refine ⟨fun ⟨_, ⟨h⟩⟩ ↦ p.eq_bot_of_under_eq_bot h.symm, ?_⟩
