name: mem_pi
statement: theorem mem_pi (r : Π i, R i) : r ∈ pi I ↔ ∀ i, r i ∈ I i
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: pi_span
statement: @[simp] theorem pi_span {r : Π i, R i} : pi (span {r ·}) = span {r}
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp_rw [mem_pi, mem_span_singleton', funext_iff, Classical.skolem, Pi.mul_def]

name: single_mem_pi
statement: theorem single_mem_pi [DecidableEq ι] {i : ι} {r : R i} (hr : r ∈ I i) : Pi.single i r ∈ pi I
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  obtain rfl | ne := eq_or_ne i j
  · simpa
  · simp [ne]

name: pi_le_pi_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem pi_le_pi_iff : pi I ≤ pi J ↔ I ≤ J where
  mp le i r hr
proof:
:= by classical simpa using le (single_mem_pi hr) i
  mpr le r hr i := le i (hr i)

name: add_pow_mem_of_pow_mem_of_le_of_commute
statement:
theorem add_pow_mem_of_pow_mem_of_le_of_commute {m n k : ℕ}
    (ha : a ^ m ∈ I) (hb : b ^ n ∈ I) (hk : m + n ≤ k + 1)
    (hab : Commute a b) :
    (a + b) ^ k ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [hab.add_pow, ← Nat.cast_comm]
  apply I.sum_mem
  intro c _
  apply mul_mem_left
  by_cases h : m ≤ c
  · rw [hab.pow_pow]
    exact I.mul_mem_left _ (I.pow_mem_of_pow_mem ha h)
  · refine I.mul_mem_left _ (I.pow_mem_of_pow_mem hb ?_)
    lia

name: add_pow_add_pred_mem_of_pow_mem_of_commute
proof:
:=
  I.add_pow_mem_of_pow_mem_of_le_of_commute ha hb (by rw [← Nat.sub_le_iff_le_add]) hab

name: add_pow_mem_of_pow_mem_of_le
proof:
:=
  I.add_pow_mem_of_pow_mem_of_le_of_commute ha hb hk (Commute.all ..)

name: add_pow_add_pred_mem_of_pow_mem
proof:
:=
  I.add_pow_add_pred_mem_of_pow_mem_of_commute ha hb (Commute.all ..)

name: pow_multiset_sum_mem_span_pow
statement:
theorem pow_multiset_sum_mem_span_pow [DecidableEq α] (s : Multiset α) (n : ℕ) :
    s.sum ^ (Multiset.card s * n + 1) ∈
    span ((s.map fun (x : α) ↦ x ^ (n + 1)).toFinset : Set α)
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | cons a s hs => ?_
  simp only [Finset.coe_insert, Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.toFinset_cons, Multiset.sum_cons,
    Multiset.card_cons, add_pow]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ ?_
  intro c _hc
  rw [mem_span_insert]
  by_cases! h : n + 1 ≤ c
  · refine ⟨a ^ (c - (n + 1)) * s.sum ^ ((Multiset.card s + 1) * n + 1 - c) *
      ((Multiset.card s + 1) * n + 1).choose c, 0, Submodule.zero_mem _, ?_⟩
    rw [mul_comm _ (a ^ (n + 1))]
    simp_rw [← mul_assoc]
    rw [← pow_add, add_zero, add_tsub_cancel_of_le h]
  · use 0
    simp_rw [zero_mul, zero_add]
    refine ⟨_, ?_, rfl⟩
    replace h : c ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp h
    have : (Multiset.card s + 1) * n + 1 - c = Multiset.card s * n + 1 + (n - c) := by
      rw [add_mul, one_mul, add_assoc, add_comm n 1, ← add_assoc, add_tsub_assoc_of_le h]
    rw [this, pow_add]
    simp_rw [mul_assoc, mul_comm (s.sum ^ (Multiset.card s * n + 1)), ← mul_assoc]
    exact mul_mem_left _ _ hs

name: sum_pow_mem_span_pow
statement:
theorem sum_pow_mem_span_pow {ι} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → α) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, f i) ^ (s.card * n + 1) ∈ span ((fun i => f i ^ (n + 1)) '' s)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simpa only [Multiset.card_map, Multiset.map_map, comp_apply, Multiset.toFinset_map,
    Finset.coe_image, Finset.val_toFinset] using! pow_multiset_sum_mem_span_pow (s.1.map f) n

name: span_pow_eq_top
statement:
theorem span_pow_eq_top (s : Set α) (hs : span s = ⊤) (n : ℕ) :
    span ((fun (x : α) => x ^ n) '' s) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff_one]
  rcases n with - | n
  · obtain rfl | ⟨x, hx⟩ := eq_empty_or_nonempty s
    · rw [Set.image_empty, hs]
      trivial
    · exact subset_span ⟨_, hx, pow_zero _⟩
  rw [eq_top_iff_one, span, Finsupp.mem_span_iff_linearCombination] at hs
  rcases hs with ⟨f, hf⟩
  simp only [Finsupp.linearCombination, Finsupp.coe_lsum, Finsupp.sum, LinearMap.coe_smulRight,
    LinearMap.id_coe, id_eq, smul_eq_mul] at hf
  have := sum_pow_mem_span_pow f.support (fun a => f a * a) n
  rw [hf, one_pow] at this
  refine span_le.mpr ?_ this
  rintro _ hx
  simp_rw [Set.mem_image] at hx
  rcases hx with ⟨x, _, rfl⟩
  have : span ({(x : α) ^ (n + 1)} : Set α) ≤ span ((fun x : α => x ^ (n + 1)) '' s) := by
    rw [span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
    exact subset_span ⟨x, x.prop, rfl⟩
  refine this ?_
  rw [mul_pow, mem_span_singleton]
  exact ⟨f x ^ (n + 1), mul_comm _ _⟩

name: span_range_pow_eq_top
statement:
theorem span_range_pow_eq_top (s : Set α) (hs : span s = ⊤) (n : s → ℕ) :
    span (Set.range fun x ↦ x.1 ^ n x) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨t, hts, mem⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_finite_of_mem_span ((eq_top_iff_one _).mp hs)
  refine top_unique ((span_pow_eq_top _ ((eq_top_iff_one _).mpr mem) <|
    t.attach.sup fun x ↦ n ⟨x, hts x.2⟩).ge.trans <| span_le.mpr ?_)
  rintro _ ⟨x, hxt, rfl⟩
  rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel (Finset.le_sup <| t.mem_attach ⟨x, hxt⟩)]
  simp_rw [pow_add]
  exact mul_mem_left _ _ (subset_span ⟨_, rfl⟩)

name: prod_mem
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Finset.prod_eq_prod_sdiff_singleton_mul hi]
  exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hfi

name: span_single_eq_top
statement:
lemma span_single_eq_top {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [Finite ι] (R : ι → Type*)
    [∀ i, Semiring (R i)] : Ideal.span (Set.range fun i ↦ (Pi.single i 1 : Π i, R i)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [_root_.eq_top_iff]
  rintro x -
  induction x using Pi.single_induction with
  | zero => simp
  | add f g hf hg => exact Ideal.add_mem _ hf hg
  | single i r =>
      rw [show Pi.single i r = Pi.single i r * Pi.single i 1 by simp [← Pi.single_mul_left]]
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)

name: exists_not_isUnit_of_not_isField
statement:
theorem exists_not_isUnit_of_not_isField [Nontrivial R] (hf : ¬IsField R) :
    ∃ (x : R) (_hx : x ≠ (0 : R)), ¬IsUnit x
proof:
:= by
  have : ¬_ := fun h => hf ⟨exists_pair_ne R, mul_comm, h⟩
  simp_rw [isUnit_iff_exists_inv]
  push Not at this ⊢
  obtain ⟨x, hx, not_unit⟩ := this
  exact ⟨x, hx, not_unit⟩

name: isField_iff_maximal_bot
statement: theorem isField_iff_maximal_bot [Nontrivial R] : IsField R ↔ (⊥ : Ideal R).IsMaximal
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ let := h.toSemifield; bot_isMaximal, fun hmax ↦ ?_⟩
  by_contra hf
  obtain ⟨x, hx0, hxu⟩ := exists_not_isUnit_of_not_isField hf
  exact hx0 <| span_singleton_eq_bot.mp (hmax.eq_of_le (span_singleton_ne_top hxu) bot_le).symm

name: exists_maximal_of_not_isField
statement:
theorem exists_maximal_of_not_isField [Nontrivial R] (h : ¬ IsField R) :
    ∃ p : Ideal R, p ≠ ⊥ ∧ p.IsMaximal
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! h
  simp only [← bot_lt_iff_ne_bot] at h
  refine isField_iff_maximal_bot.mpr ⟨⟨bot_ne_top, Ideal.maximal_of_no_maximal h⟩⟩

name: not_isField_of_ne_of_ne
statement:
theorem not_isField_of_ne_of_ne [Nontrivial R] {I : Ideal R} (h_bot : I ≠ ⊥) (h_top : I ≠ ⊤) :
    ¬ IsField R
proof:
:= by
  contrapose h_bot
  exact ((isField_iff_maximal_bot.mp h_bot).eq_of_le h_top bot_le).symm

name: not_isField_iff_exists_ideal_bot_lt_and_lt_top
statement:
theorem not_isField_iff_exists_ideal_bot_lt_and_lt_top [Nontrivial R] :
    ¬IsField R ↔ ∃ I : Ideal R, ⊥ < I ∧ I < ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun ⟨I, h_bot, h_top⟩ ↦ not_isField_of_ne_of_ne h_bot.ne' h_top.ne⟩
  obtain ⟨I, hI, hIm⟩ := exists_maximal_of_not_isField h
  exact ⟨I, bot_lt_iff_ne_bot.mpr hI, lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr hIm.ne_top⟩

name: not_isField_iff_exists_prime
statement:
theorem not_isField_iff_exists_prime [Nontrivial R] :
    ¬IsField R ↔ ∃ p : Ideal R, p ≠ ⊥ ∧ p.IsPrime
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun ⟨I, h_bot, h_top⟩ ↦ not_isField_of_ne_of_ne h_bot h_top.ne_top⟩
  obtain ⟨I, hI, hIm⟩ := exists_maximal_of_not_isField h
  exact ⟨I, hI, hIm.isPrime⟩

name: isField_iff_isSimpleOrder_ideal
statement: theorem isField_iff_isSimpleOrder_ideal : IsField R ↔ IsSimpleOrder (Ideal R)
proof:
:= by
  cases subsingleton_or_nontrivial R
  · exact
      ⟨fun h => (not_isField_of_subsingleton _ h).elim, fun h =>
        (false_of_nontrivial_of_subsingleton <| Ideal R).elim⟩
  rw [← not_iff_not, Ring.not_isField_iff_exists_ideal_bot_lt_and_lt_top]
  contrapose! +distrib
  simp_rw [not_lt_top_iff, not_bot_lt_iff]
  exact ⟨fun h => ⟨h⟩, fun h => h.2⟩

name: ne_bot_of_isMaximal_of_not_isField
statement:
theorem ne_bot_of_isMaximal_of_not_isField [Nontrivial R] {M : Ideal R} (max : M.IsMaximal)
    (not_field : ¬IsField R) : M ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rintro rfl
  obtain ⟨I, hIbot, hItop⟩ := not_isField_iff_exists_ideal_bot_lt_and_lt_top.mp not_field
  exact hIbot.ne (max.eq_of_le hItop.ne bot_le)

name: bot_lt_of_maximal
statement: theorem bot_lt_of_maximal (M : Ideal R) [hm : M.IsMaximal] (non_field : ¬IsField R) : ⊥ < M
proof:
:=
  (Ring.ne_bot_of_isMaximal_of_not_isField hm non_field).bot_lt

name: coe_span_smul
statement:
lemma coe_span_smul {R' M' : Type*} [CommSemiring R'] [AddCommMonoid M'] [Module R' M']
    (s : Set R') (N : Submodule R' M') :
    (Ideal.span s : Set R') • N = s • N
proof:
:=
  set_smul_eq_of_le _ _ _
    (by rintro r n hr hn
        induction hr using Submodule.span_induction with
        | mem _ h => exact mem_set_smul_of_mem_mem h hn
        | zero => rw [zero_smul]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
        | add _ _ _ _ ihr ihs => rw [add_smul]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ ihr ihs
        | smul _ _ hr =>
          rw [mem_span_set] at hr
          obtain ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ := hr
          rw [Finsupp.sum, Finset.smul_sum, Finset.sum_smul]
          refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i hi => ?_
          rw [← mul_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm, mul_smul]
          exact mem_set_smul_of_mem_mem (hc hi) <| Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hn) <|
    set_smul_mono_left _ Submodule.subset_span

name: span_singleton_toAddSubgroup_eq_zmultiples
statement:
lemma span_singleton_toAddSubgroup_eq_zmultiples {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] (a : M) :
    (span ℤ ({a} : Set M)).toAddSubgroup = AddSubgroup.zmultiples a
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp [Submodule.mem_span_singleton, AddSubgroup.mem_zmultiples_iff]

name: _root_.Ideal.span_singleton_toAddSubgroup_eq_zmultiples
statement:
@[simp] lemma _root_.Ideal.span_singleton_toAddSubgroup_eq_zmultiples (a : ℤ) :
    (Ideal.span {a}).toAddSubgroup = AddSubgroup.zmultiples a
proof:
:=
  Submodule.span_singleton_toAddSubgroup_eq_zmultiples _

name: _root_.Ideal.smul_eq_mul
statement: protected theorem _root_.Ideal.smul_eq_mul (I J : Ideal R) : I • J = I * J
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: smul_le_right
statement: theorem smul_le_right : I • N ≤ N
proof:
:=
  smul_le.2 fun r _ _ ↦ N.smul_mem r

name: map_le_smul_top
statement:
theorem map_le_smul_top (I : Ideal R) (f : R →ₗ[R] M) :
    Submodule.map f I ≤ I • (⊤ : Submodule R M)
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  rw [← mul_one y, ← smul_eq_mul, f.map_smul]
  exact smul_mem_smul hy mem_top

name: top_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem top_smul : (⊤ : Ideal R) • N = N
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm smul_le_right fun r hri => one_smul R r ▸ smul_mem_smul mem_top hri

name: mul_smul
statement: protected theorem mul_smul : (I * J) • N = I • J • N
proof:
:=
  Submodule.smul_assoc _ _ _

name: mem_of_span_top_of_smul_mem
statement:
theorem mem_of_span_top_of_smul_mem (M' : Submodule R M) (s : Set R) (hs : Ideal.span s = ⊤) (x : M)
    (H : ∀ r : s, (r : R) • x ∈ M') : x ∈ M'
proof:
:= by
  suffices LinearMap.range (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton R M x) ≤ M' by
    rw [← LinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply_one R M x]
    exact this (LinearMap.mem_range_self _ 1)
  rw [LinearMap.range_eq_map, ← hs, map_le_iff_le_comap, Ideal.span, span_le]
  exact fun r hr ↦ H ⟨r, hr⟩

name: map_smul''
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_smul'' (f : M →ₗ[R] M') : (I • N).map f = I • N.map f
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm
    (map_le_iff_le_comap.2 <|
      smul_le.2 fun r hr n hn =>
        show f (r • n) ∈ I • N.map f from
          (f.map_smul r n).symm ▸ smul_mem_smul hr (mem_map_of_mem hn)) <|
    smul_le.2 fun r hr _ hn =>
      let ⟨p, hp, hfp⟩ := mem_map.1 hn
      hfp ▸ f.map_smul r p ▸ mem_map_of_mem (smul_mem_smul hr hp)

name: mem_smul_top_iff
statement:
theorem mem_smul_top_iff (N : Submodule R M) (x : N) :
    x ∈ I • (⊤ : Submodule R N) ↔ (x : M) ∈ I • N
proof:
:= by
  have : Submodule.map N.subtype (I • ⊤) = I • N := by
    rw [Submodule.map_smul'', Submodule.map_top, Submodule.range_subtype]
  simp [← this, -map_smul'']

name: smul_comap_le_comap_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_comap_le_comap_smul (f : M →ₗ[R] M') (S : Submodule R M') (I : Ideal R) :
    I • S.comap f ≤ (I • S).comap f
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.smul_le.mpr fun r hr x hx => ?_
  rw [Submodule.mem_comap] at hx ⊢
  rw [f.map_smul]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem_smul hr hx

name: comap_smul''
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (by simp)
  conv_lhs => rw [← Submodule.map_comap_eq_self hp, ← Submodule.map_smul'']
  rw [Submodule.comap_map_eq_of_injective hf]

name: mem_smul_span_singleton
statement:
theorem mem_smul_span_singleton [I.IsTwoSided] {m : M} {x : M} :
    x ∈ I • span R ({m} : Set M) ↔ ∃ y ∈ I, y • m = x
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hx =>
    smul_induction_on hx
      (fun r hri _ hnm =>
        let ⟨s, hs⟩ := mem_span_singleton.1 hnm
        ⟨r * s, I.mul_mem_right _ hri, hs ▸ mul_smul r s m⟩)
      fun m1 m2 ⟨y1, hyi1, hy1⟩ ⟨y2, hyi2, hy2⟩ =>
      ⟨y1 + y2, I.add_mem hyi1 hyi2, by rw [add_smul, hy1, hy2]⟩,
    fun ⟨_, hyi, hy⟩ => hy ▸ smul_mem_smul hyi (subset_span <| Set.mem_singleton m)⟩

name: span_smul_span
statement:
theorem span_smul_span [(Ideal.span S).IsTwoSided] :
    Ideal.span S • span R T = span R (S • T)
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (smul_le.mpr fun r hr m hm ↦ by
    revert r
    refine span_induction (fun m hm r hr ↦ span_induction
      (fun r hr ↦ subset_span ⟨r, hr, m, hm, rfl⟩)
      (by rw [zero_smul]; exact zero_mem _)
      (fun _ _ _ _ h₁ h₂ ↦ by rw [add_smul]; exact add_mem h₁ h₂)
      (fun _ _ _ h ↦ by rw [smul_assoc]; exact smul_mem _ _ h) hr)
      (fun _ _ ↦ by rw [smul_zero]; exact zero_mem _)
      (fun _ _ _ _ h₁ h₂ r hr ↦ by rw [smul_add]; exact add_mem (h₁ r hr) (h₂ r hr))
      (fun r' m hm mem r hr ↦ by rw [← mul_smul]; exact mem _ (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ hr)) hm) <|
  span_le.mpr fun m ↦ by
    rintro ⟨s, hs, t, ht, rfl⟩
    exact smul_mem_smul (subset_span hs) (subset_span ht)

name: mem_smul_span
statement:
theorem mem_smul_span {s : Set M} {x : M} :
    x ∈ I • Submodule.span R s ↔ x ∈ Submodule.span R ((I : Set R) • s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← I.span_eq] at *
  rw [Submodule.span_smul_span, I.span_eq]

name: mem_ideal_smul_span_iff_exists_sum
statement:
theorem mem_ideal_smul_span_iff_exists_sum {ι : Type*} (f : ι → M) (x : M) :
    x ∈ I • span R (Set.range f) ↔
      ∃ (a : ι →₀ R) (_ : ∀ i, a i ∈ I), (a.sum fun i c => c • f i) = x
proof:
:= by
  constructor; swap
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun c _ => smul_mem_smul (ha c) <| subset_span <| Set.mem_range_self _
  refine fun hx => span_induction ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ (mem_smul_span.mp hx)
  · rintro x ⟨y, hy, x, ⟨i, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨Finsupp.single i y, fun j => ?_, ?_⟩
    · let := Classical.decEq ι
      rw [Finsupp.single_apply]
      split_ifs
      · assumption
      · exact I.zero_mem
    refine @Finsupp.sum_single_index ι R M _ _ i _ (fun i y => y • f i) ?_
    simp
  · exact ⟨0, fun _ => I.zero_mem, Finsupp.sum_zero_index⟩
  · rintro x y - - ⟨ax, hax, rfl⟩ ⟨ay, hay, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨ax + ay, fun i => I.add_mem (hax i) (hay i), Finsupp.sum_add_index' ?_ ?_⟩ <;>
      intros <;> simp only [zero_smul, add_smul]
  · rintro c x - ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨c • a, fun i => I.mul_mem_left c (ha i), ?_⟩
    rw [Finsupp.sum_smul_index, Finsupp.smul_sum] <;> intros <;> simp only [zero_smul, mul_smul]

name: mem_ideal_smul_span_iff_exists_sum'
statement:
theorem mem_ideal_smul_span_iff_exists_sum' {ι : Type*} (s : Set ι) (f : ι → M) (x : M) :
    x ∈ I • span R (f '' s) ↔
    ∃ (a : s →₀ R) (_ : ∀ i, a i ∈ I), (a.sum fun i c => c • f i) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Submodule.mem_ideal_smul_span_iff_exists_sum, ← Set.image_eq_range]

name: smul_eq_map
statement: theorem smul_eq_map₂ : I • N = Submodule.map₂ (LinearMap.lsmul R M) I N
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (smul_le.mpr fun _m hm _n ↦ Submodule.apply_mem_map₂ _ hm)
    (map₂_le.mpr fun _m hm _n ↦ smul_mem_smul hm)

name: ideal_span_singleton_smul
statement:
theorem ideal_span_singleton_smul (r : R) (N : Submodule R M) :
    (Ideal.span {r} : Ideal R) • N = r • N
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← span_eq N, span_smul_span]
  simpa using span_eq (r • N)

name: mem_of_span_eq_top_of_smul_pow_mem
statement:
theorem mem_of_span_eq_top_of_smul_pow_mem (M' : Submodule R M) (s : Set R) (hs : Ideal.span s = ⊤)
    (x : M) (H : ∀ r : s, ∃ n : ℕ, ((r : R) ^ n : R) • x ∈ M') : x ∈ M'
proof:
:= by
  choose f hf using H
  apply M'.mem_of_span_top_of_smul_mem _ (Ideal.span_range_pow_eq_top s hs f)
  rintro ⟨_, r, hr, rfl⟩
  exact hf r

name: map_pointwise_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_pointwise_smul (r : R) (N : Submodule R M) (f : M →ₗ[R] M') :
    (r • N).map f = r • N.map f
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← ideal_span_singleton_smul, map_smul'']

name: add_eq_sup
statement:
@[simp]
theorem add_eq_sup {I J : Ideal R} : I + J = I ⊔ J
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: zero_eq_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero_eq_bot : (0 : Ideal R) = ⊥
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: sum_eq_sup
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sum_eq_sup {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Ideal R) : s.sum f = s.sup f
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: one_eq_top
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem one_eq_top : (1 : Ideal R) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.one_eq_span, ← Ideal.span, Ideal.span_singleton_one]

name: add_eq_one_iff
statement: theorem add_eq_one_iff : I + J = 1 ↔ ∃ i ∈ I, ∃ j ∈ J, i + j = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [one_eq_top, eq_top_iff_one, add_eq_sup, Submodule.mem_sup]

name: mul_mem_mul
statement: theorem mul_mem_mul {r s} (hr : r ∈ I) (hs : s ∈ J) : r * s ∈ I * J
proof:
:=
  Submodule.smul_mem_smul hr hs

name: bot_pow
statement:
theorem bot_pow {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    (⊥ : Ideal R) ^ n = ⊥
proof: := Submodule.bot_pow hn

name: pow_mem_pow
statement: theorem pow_mem_pow {x : R} (hx : x ∈ I) (n : ℕ) : x ^ n ∈ I ^ n
proof:
:=
  Submodule.pow_mem_pow _ hx _

name: mul_le
statement: theorem mul_le : I * J ≤ K ↔ ∀ r ∈ I, ∀ s ∈ J, r * s ∈ K
proof:
:=
  Submodule.smul_le

name: mul_le_right
statement: theorem mul_le_right : I * J ≤ J
proof:
:=
  mul_le.2 fun _ _ _ => J.mul_mem_left _

name: sup_mul_left_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sup_mul_left_self : I ⊔ J * I = I
proof:
:=
  sup_eq_left.2 mul_le_right

name: mul_left_self_sup
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mul_left_self_sup : J * I ⊔ I = I
proof:
:=
  sup_eq_right.2 mul_le_right

name: mul_le_left
statement: theorem mul_le_left [I.IsTwoSided] : I * J ≤ I
proof:
:=
  mul_le.2 fun _ hr _ _ ↦ I.mul_mem_right _ hr

name: sup_mul_right_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sup_mul_right_self [I.IsTwoSided] : I ⊔ I * J = I
proof:
:=
  sup_eq_left.2 mul_le_left

name: mul_right_self_sup
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mul_right_self_sup [I.IsTwoSided] : I * J ⊔ I = I
proof:
:=
  sup_eq_right.2 mul_le_left

name: mul_assoc
statement: protected theorem mul_assoc : I * J * K = I * (J * K)
proof:
:=
  Submodule.smul_assoc I J K

name: mul_bot
statement: theorem mul_bot : I * ⊥ = ⊥
proof: := by simp

name: bot_mul
statement: theorem bot_mul : ⊥ * I = ⊥
proof: := by simp

name: top_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem top_mul : ⊤ * I = I
proof:
:=
  Submodule.top_smul I

name: mul_mono
statement: theorem mul_mono (hik : I ≤ K) (hjl : J ≤ L) : I * J ≤ K * L
proof:
:=
  Submodule.smul_mono hik hjl

name: mul_mono_left
statement: theorem mul_mono_left (h : I ≤ J) : I * K ≤ J * K
proof:
:=
  Submodule.smul_mono_left h

name: mul_mono_right
statement: theorem mul_mono_right (h : J ≤ K) : I * J ≤ I * K
proof:
:=
  smul_mono_right I h

name: mul_sup
statement: theorem mul_sup : I * (J ⊔ K) = I * J ⊔ I * K
proof:
:=
  Submodule.smul_sup I J K

name: sup_mul
statement: theorem sup_mul : (I ⊔ J) * K = I * K ⊔ J * K
proof:
:=
  Submodule.sup_smul I J K

name: mul_iSup
statement:
theorem mul_iSup {ι : Sort*} (J : ι → Ideal R) :
    I * (⨆ i, J i) = ⨆ i, I * J i
proof:
:=
  Submodule.smul_iSup

name: iSup_mul
statement:
theorem iSup_mul {ι : Sort*} (J : ι → Ideal R) (I : Ideal R) :
    (⨆ i, J i) * I = ⨆ i, J i * I
proof:
:=
  Submodule.iSup_smul

name: pow_le_pow_right
statement: theorem pow_le_pow_right {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n) : I ^ n ≤ I ^ m
proof:
:= by
  obtain _ | m := m
  · rw [Submodule.pow_zero, one_eq_top]; exact le_top
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le h
  rw [add_comm, Submodule.pow_add _ m.add_one_ne_zero]
  exact mul_le_right

name: pow_le_self
statement: theorem pow_le_self {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) : I ^ n ≤ I
proof:
:=
  calc
    I ^ n ≤ I ^ 1 := pow_le_pow_right (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn)
    _ = I := Submodule.pow_one _

name: pow_right_mono
statement: theorem pow_right_mono (e : I ≤ J) (n : ℕ) : I ^ n ≤ J ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [Submodule.pow_zero, Submodule.pow_zero]
  | succ _ hn =>
    rw [Submodule.pow_succ, Submodule.pow_succ]
    exact Ideal.mul_mono hn e

name: mul_one
statement: protected theorem mul_one : I * 1 = I
proof:
:=
  mul_le_left.antisymm
    fun i hi ↦ mul_one i ▸ mul_mem_mul hi (one_eq_top (R := R) ▸ Submodule.mem_top)

name: pow_add
statement: protected theorem pow_add : I ^ (m + n) = I ^ m * I ^ n
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | h := eq_or_ne n 0
  · rw [add_zero, Submodule.pow_zero, IsTwoSided.mul_one]
  · exact Submodule.pow_add _ h

name: pow_succ
statement: protected theorem pow_succ : I ^ (n + 1) = I * I ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm, IsTwoSided.pow_add, Submodule.pow_one]

name: mul_eq_bot
statement: theorem mul_eq_bot [NoZeroDivisors R] : I * J = ⊥ ↔ I = ⊥ ∨ J = ⊥
proof: := Submodule.mul_eq_bot

name: pow_eq_bot
statement: theorem pow_eq_bot [IsReduced R] {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) : I ^ n = ⊥ ↔ I = ⊥
proof:
:=
  Submodule.pow_eq_bot hn

name: span_mul_span
statement:
theorem span_mul_span (S T : Set R) [(span S).IsTwoSided] :
    span S * span T = span (S * T)
proof:
:=
  Submodule.span_smul_span S T

name: span_singleton_mul_span_singleton
statement:
theorem span_singleton_mul_span_singleton (r s : R) [(span {r}).IsTwoSided] :
    span {r} * span {s} = (span {r * s} : Ideal R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [span_mul_span, Set.singleton_mul_singleton]

name: span_singleton_pow
statement:
theorem span_singleton_pow (s : R) [(span {s}).IsTwoSided] (n : ℕ) :
    span {s} ^ n = (span {s ^ n} : Ideal R)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [Submodule.pow_zero, Set.singleton_one]
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain rfl | ne := eq_or_ne n 0; · simp [Submodule.pow_one]
    simp only [Submodule.pow_succ' _ ne, pow_succ', ih, span_singleton_mul_span_singleton]

name: mem_mul_span_singleton
statement:
theorem mem_mul_span_singleton {x y : R} {I : Ideal R} [I.IsTwoSided] :
    x ∈ I * span {y} ↔ ∃ z ∈ I, z * y = x
proof:
:=
  Submodule.mem_smul_span_singleton

name: span_singleton_mul_left_mono
statement:
theorem span_singleton_mul_left_mono [IsDomain R] [I.IsTwoSided] [J.IsTwoSided]
    {x : R} (hx : x ≠ 0) : I * span {x} ≤ J * span {x} ↔ I ≤ J
proof:
:= by
  simp [SetLike.le_def, mem_mul_span_singleton, hx]

name: span_singleton_mul_left_inj
statement:
theorem span_singleton_mul_left_inj [IsDomain R] [I.IsTwoSided] [J.IsTwoSided]
    {x : R} (hx : x ≠ 0) : I * span {x} = J * span {x} ↔ I = J
proof:
:= by
  simp only [le_antisymm_iff, span_singleton_mul_left_mono hx]

name: mul_le_inf
statement: theorem mul_le_inf [I.IsTwoSided] : I * J ≤ I ⊓ J
proof:
:=
  mul_le.2 fun r hri s hsj => ⟨I.mul_mem_right s hri, J.mul_mem_left r hsj⟩

name: inf_ne_bot_of_ne_bot
statement:
lemma inf_ne_bot_of_ne_bot [NoZeroDivisors R] {I J : Ideal R} [I.IsTwoSided]
    (hI : I ≠ ⊥) (hJ : J ≠ ⊥) :
    I ⊓ J ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  grw [← bot_lt_iff_ne_bot, ← mul_le_inf, bot_lt_iff_ne_bot, Ne, mul_eq_bot]
  exact not_or_intro hI hJ

name: sup_mul_eq_of_coprime_left
statement: theorem sup_mul_eq_of_coprime_left [I.IsTwoSided] (h : I ⊔ J = ⊤) : I ⊔ J * K = I ⊔ K
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (sup_le_sup_left mul_le_right _) fun i hi => by
    rw [eq_top_iff_one] at h; rw [Submodule.mem_sup] at h hi ⊢
    obtain ⟨i1, hi1, j, hj, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨i', hi', k, hk, rfl⟩ := hi
    refine ⟨_, add_mem hi' (mul_mem_right k _ hi1), _, mul_mem_mul hj hk, ?_⟩
    rw [add_assoc, ← add_mul, h, one_mul]

name: sup_mul_eq_of_coprime_right
statement: theorem sup_mul_eq_of_coprime_right [J.IsTwoSided] (h : I ⊔ K = ⊤) : I ⊔ J * K = I ⊔ J
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (sup_le_sup_left mul_le_left _) fun i hi ↦ by
    rw [eq_top_iff_one] at h; rw [Submodule.mem_sup] at h hi ⊢
    obtain ⟨i1, hi1, k, hk, h⟩ := h; obtain ⟨i', hi', j, hj, rfl⟩ := hi
    refine ⟨_, add_mem hi' (mul_mem_left _ j hi1), _, mul_mem_mul hj hk, ?_⟩
    rw [add_assoc, ← mul_add, h, mul_one]

name: mul_sup_eq_of_coprime_left
statement: theorem mul_sup_eq_of_coprime_left [J.IsTwoSided] (h : I ⊔ J = ⊤) : I * K ⊔ J = K ⊔ J
proof:
:= by
  rw [sup_comm] at h
  rw [sup_comm, sup_mul_eq_of_coprime_left h, sup_comm]

name: mul_sup_eq_of_coprime_right
statement: theorem mul_sup_eq_of_coprime_right [I.IsTwoSided] (h : K ⊔ J = ⊤) : I * K ⊔ J = I ⊔ J
proof:
:= by
  rw [sup_comm] at h
  rw [sup_comm, sup_mul_eq_of_coprime_right h, sup_comm]

name: sup_iInf_eq_top
statement:
theorem sup_iInf_eq_top {s : Finset ι} {J : ι → Ideal R} [∀ i, (J i).IsTwoSided]
    (h : ∀ i, i ∈ s → I ⊔ J i = ⊤) : (I ⊔ ⨅ i ∈ s, J i) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact s.induction_on' (by simp) fun {i t} his hts hit eq_top ↦ top_unique <| by
    rw [Finset.iInf_insert, inf_comm]
    refine le_trans ?_ (sup_le_sup_left mul_le_inf _)
    simpa only [sup_mul_eq_of_coprime_right (h _ his)] using eq_top.ge

name: iInf_sup_eq_top
statement:
theorem iInf_sup_eq_top {s : Finset ι} {J : ι → Ideal R} [∀ i, (J i).IsTwoSided]
    (h : ∀ i, i ∈ s → J i ⊔ I = ⊤) : (⨅ i ∈ s, J i) ⊔ I = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [sup_comm, sup_iInf_eq_top]; intro i hi; rw [sup_comm, h i hi]

name: sup_pow_eq_top
statement: theorem sup_pow_eq_top [I.IsTwoSided] {n : ℕ} (h : I ⊔ J = ⊤) : I ⊔ J ^ n = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [J.pow_zero]
  | succ n ih => rwa [J.pow_succ, sup_mul_eq_of_coprime_left ih]

name: sup_pow_eq_top'
statement: theorem sup_pow_eq_top' [J.IsTwoSided] {n : ℕ} (h : I ⊔ J = ⊤) : I ⊔ J ^ n = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [J.pow_zero]
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain rfl | hn := eq_or_ne n 0; · simpa [J.pow_one] using h
    rwa [J.pow_succ' hn, sup_mul_eq_of_coprime_right ih]

name: pow_sup_eq_top
statement: theorem pow_sup_eq_top [I.IsTwoSided] {n : ℕ} (h : I ⊔ J = ⊤) : I ^ n ⊔ J = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [sup_comm, sup_pow_eq_top' (sup_comm I J ▸ h)]

name: pow_sup_eq_top'
statement: theorem pow_sup_eq_top' [J.IsTwoSided] {n : ℕ} (h : I ⊔ J = ⊤) : I ^ n ⊔ J = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [sup_comm, sup_pow_eq_top (sup_comm I J ▸ h)]

name: pow_sup_pow_eq_top
statement: theorem pow_sup_pow_eq_top [I.IsTwoSided] {m n : ℕ} (h : I ⊔ J = ⊤) : I ^ m ⊔ J ^ n = ⊤
proof:
:=
  pow_sup_eq_top (sup_pow_eq_top h)

name: pow_sup_pow_eq_top'
statement: theorem pow_sup_pow_eq_top' [J.IsTwoSided] {m n : ℕ} (h : I ⊔ J = ⊤) : I ^ m ⊔ J ^ n = ⊤
proof:
:=
  pow_sup_eq_top' (sup_pow_eq_top' h)

name: mul_top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mul_top [I.IsTwoSided] : I * ⊤ = I
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (mul_le.mpr fun _i hi _r _ ↦ mul_mem_right _ _ hi)
    fun i hi ↦ mul_one i ▸ mul_mem_mul hi Submodule.mem_top

name: span_pair_mul_span_pair
statement:
theorem span_pair_mul_span_pair (w x y z : R) [(span {w, x}).IsTwoSided] :
    (span {w, x} : Ideal R) * span {y, z} = span {w * y, w * z, x * y, x * z}
proof:
:= by
  rw [span_mul_span]; congr; ext r; simp [Set.mem_mul, or_assoc, eq_comm (a := r)]

name: top_pow
statement: theorem top_pow (n : ℕ) : (⊤ ^ n : Ideal R) = ⊤
proof:
:=
  Nat.recOn n one_eq_top fun n ih => by rw [Submodule.pow_succ, ih, top_mul]

name: pow_eq_top_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pow_eq_top_iff {n : ℕ} :
    I ^ n = ⊤ ↔ I = ⊤ ∨ n = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ or_iff_not_imp_right.mpr
      fun hn ↦ (eq_top_iff_one _).mpr <| pow_le_self hn <| (eq_top_iff_one _).mp h, ?_⟩
  rintro (h | h)
  · rw [h, top_pow]
  · rw [h, Submodule.pow_zero, one_eq_top]

name: natCast_eq_top
statement: theorem natCast_eq_top {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) : (n : Ideal R) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact (hn rfl).elim
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain rfl | n := n; · rw [Nat.cast_one, one_eq_top]
    rw [Nat.cast_succ, ih n.succ_ne_zero, add_eq_sup, top_sup_eq]

name: ofNat_eq_top
statement: theorem ofNat_eq_top {n : ℕ} [n.AtLeastTwo] : (ofNat(n) : Ideal R) = ⊤
proof:
:=
  natCast_eq_top (NeZero.ne _)

name: pow_eq_zero_of_mem
statement:
theorem pow_eq_zero_of_mem {I : Ideal R} {n m : ℕ} (hnI : I ^ n = 0) (hmn : n ≤ m) {x : R}
    (hx : x ∈ I) : x ^ m = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa [hnI] using pow_le_pow_right hmn <| pow_mem_pow hx m

name: mul_mem_mul_rev
statement: theorem mul_mem_mul_rev {r s} (hr : r ∈ I) (hs : s ∈ J) : s * r ∈ I * J
proof:
:=
  mul_comm r s ▸ mul_mem_mul hr hs

name: prod_mem_prod
statement:
theorem prod_mem_prod {ι : Type*} {s : Finset ι} {I : ι → Ideal R} {x : ι → R} :
    (∀ i ∈ s, x i ∈ I i) → (∏ i ∈ s, x i) ∈ ∏ i ∈ s, I i
proof:
:= by
  classical
    refine Finset.induction_on s ?_ ?_
    · grind [Submodule.mem_top]
    · grind [mul_mem_mul]

name: sup_pow_add_le_pow_sup_pow
statement: lemma sup_pow_add_le_pow_sup_pow {n m : ℕ} : (I ⊔ J) ^ (n + m) ≤ I ^ n ⊔ J ^ m
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Ideal.add_eq_sup, ← Ideal.add_eq_sup, add_pow, Ideal.sum_eq_sup]
  apply Finset.sup_le
  intro i hi
  by_cases hn : n ≤ i
  · exact (Ideal.mul_le_left.trans (Ideal.mul_le_left.trans
      ((Ideal.pow_le_pow_right hn).trans le_sup_left)))
  · refine (Ideal.mul_le_left.trans (Ideal.mul_le_right.trans
      ((Ideal.pow_le_pow_right ?_).trans le_sup_right)))
    lia

name: mul_comm
statement: protected theorem mul_comm : I * J = J * I
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (mul_le.2 fun _ hrI _ hsJ => mul_mem_mul_rev hsJ hrI)
    (mul_le.2 fun _ hrJ _ hsI => mul_mem_mul_rev hsI hrJ)

name: mem_span_singleton_mul
statement: theorem mem_span_singleton_mul {x y : R} {I : Ideal R} : x ∈ span {y} * I ↔ ∃ z ∈ I, y * z = x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mul_comm, mem_mul_span_singleton]

name: range_mul
statement:
@[simp]
lemma range_mul (A : Type*) [CommSemiring A] [Module R A]
    [SMulCommClass R A A] [IsScalarTower R A A] (a : A) : LinearMap.range (LinearMap.mul R A a) =
    (Ideal.span {a}).restrictScalars R
proof:
:= by
  aesop (add simp Ideal.mem_span_singleton) (add simp dvd_def)

name: range_mul'
statement: lemma range_mul' (a : R) : LinearMap.range (LinearMap.mul R R a) = Ideal.span {a}
proof: := range_mul ..

name: le_span_singleton_mul_iff
statement:
theorem le_span_singleton_mul_iff {x : R} {I J : Ideal R} :
    I ≤ span {x} * J ↔ ∀ zI ∈ I, ∃ zJ ∈ J, x * zJ = zI
proof:
:=
  show (∀ {zI} (_ : zI ∈ I), zI ∈ span {x} * J) ↔ ∀ zI ∈ I, ∃ zJ ∈ J, x * zJ = zI by
    simp only [mem_span_singleton_mul]

name: span_singleton_mul_le_iff
statement:
theorem span_singleton_mul_le_iff {x : R} {I J : Ideal R} :
    span {x} * I ≤ J ↔ ∀ z ∈ I, x * z ∈ J
proof:
:= by
  simp [SetLike.le_def, mem_span_singleton_mul]

name: span_singleton_mul_le_span_singleton_mul
statement:
theorem span_singleton_mul_le_span_singleton_mul {x y : R} {I J : Ideal R} :
    span {x} * I ≤ span {y} * J ↔ ∀ zI ∈ I, ∃ zJ ∈ J, x * zI = y * zJ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [span_singleton_mul_le_iff, mem_span_singleton_mul, eq_comm]

name: span_singleton_mul_right_mono
statement:
theorem span_singleton_mul_right_mono [IsDomain R] {x : R} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    span {x} * I ≤ span {x} * J ↔ I ≤ J
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [span_singleton_mul_le_span_singleton_mul, mul_right_inj' hx,
    exists_eq_right', SetLike.le_def]

name: span_singleton_mul_right_inj
statement:
theorem span_singleton_mul_right_inj [IsDomain R] {x : R} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    span {x} * I = span {x} * J ↔ I = J
proof:
:= by
  simp only [le_antisymm_iff, span_singleton_mul_right_mono hx]

name: span_singleton_mul_right_injective
statement:
theorem span_singleton_mul_right_injective [IsDomain R] {x : R} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    Function.Injective ((span {x} : Ideal R) * ·)
proof:
:= fun _ _ =>
  (span_singleton_mul_right_inj hx).mp

name: span_singleton_mul_left_injective
statement:
theorem span_singleton_mul_left_injective [IsDomain R] {x : R} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    Function.Injective fun I : Ideal R => I * span {x}
proof:
:= fun _ _ =>
  (span_singleton_mul_left_inj hx).mp

name: eq_span_singleton_mul
statement:
theorem eq_span_singleton_mul {x : R} (I J : Ideal R) :
    I = span {x} * J ↔ (∀ zI ∈ I, ∃ zJ ∈ J, x * zJ = zI) ∧ ∀ z ∈ J, x * z ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  simp only [le_antisymm_iff, le_span_singleton_mul_iff, span_singleton_mul_le_iff]

name: span_singleton_mul_eq_span_singleton_mul
statement:
theorem span_singleton_mul_eq_span_singleton_mul {x y : R} (I J : Ideal R) :
    span {x} * I = span {y} * J ↔
      (∀ zI ∈ I, ∃ zJ ∈ J, x * zI = y * zJ) ∧ ∀ zJ ∈ J, ∃ zI ∈ I, x * zI = y * zJ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [le_antisymm_iff, span_singleton_mul_le_span_singleton_mul, eq_comm]

name: prod_span
statement:
theorem prod_span {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (I : ι → Set R) :
    (∏ i ∈ s, Ideal.span (I i)) = Ideal.span (∏ i ∈ s, I i)
proof:
:=
  Submodule.prod_span s I

name: prod_span_singleton
statement:
theorem prod_span_singleton {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (I : ι → R) :
    (∏ i ∈ s, Ideal.span ({I i} : Set R)) = Ideal.span {∏ i ∈ s, I i}
proof:
:=
  Submodule.prod_span_singleton s I

name: multiset_prod_span_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem multiset_prod_span_singleton (m : Multiset R) :
    (m.map fun x => Ideal.span {x}).prod = Ideal.span ({Multiset.prod m} : Set R)
proof:
:=
  Multiset.induction_on m (by simp) fun a m ih => by
    simp only [Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.prod_cons, ih, ← Ideal.span_singleton_mul_span_singleton]

name: finset_inf_span_singleton
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Submodule.mem_finsetInf, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
  exact ⟨Finset.prod_dvd_of_coprime hI, fun h i hi => (Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem _ hi).trans h⟩

name: iInf_span_singleton
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.inf_univ_eq_iInf, finset_inf_span_singleton]
  rwa [Finset.coe_univ, Set.pairwise_univ]

name: iInf_span_singleton_natCast
proof:
:= by
  rw [iInf_span_singleton, Nat.cast_prod]
  exact fun i j h ↦ (hI h).cast

name: sup_eq_top_iff_isCoprime
statement:
theorem sup_eq_top_iff_isCoprime {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] (x y : R) :
    span ({x} : Set R) ⊔ span {y} = ⊤ ↔ IsCoprime x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff_one, Submodule.mem_sup]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u, hu, v, hv, h1⟩
    rw [mem_span_singleton'] at hu hv
    rw [← hu.choose_spec, ← hv.choose_spec] at h1
    exact ⟨_, _, h1⟩
  · exact fun ⟨u, v, h1⟩ =>
      ⟨_, mem_span_singleton'.mpr ⟨_, rfl⟩, _, mem_span_singleton'.mpr ⟨_, rfl⟩, h1⟩

name: multiset_prod_le_inf
statement: theorem multiset_prod_le_inf {s : Multiset (Ideal R)} : s.prod ≤ s.inf
proof:
:= by
  refine s.induction_on ?_ ?_
  · rw [Multiset.inf_zero]
    exact le_top
  intro a s ih
  rw [Multiset.prod_cons, Multiset.inf_cons]
  exact le_trans mul_le_inf (inf_le_inf le_rfl ih)

name: prod_le_inf
statement: theorem prod_le_inf {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → Ideal R} : s.prod f ≤ s.inf f
proof:
:=
  multiset_prod_le_inf

name: mul_eq_inf_of_coprime
statement: theorem mul_eq_inf_of_coprime (h : I ⊔ J = ⊤) : I * J = I ⊓ J
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm mul_le_inf fun r ⟨hri, hrj⟩ =>
    let ⟨s, hsi, t, htj, hst⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 ((eq_top_iff_one _).1 h)
    mul_one r ▸
      hst ▸
        (mul_add r s t).symm ▸ Ideal.add_mem (I * J) (mul_mem_mul_rev hsi hrj) (mul_mem_mul hri htj)

name: sup_prod_eq_top
statement:
theorem sup_prod_eq_top {s : Finset ι} {J : ι → Ideal R} (h : ∀ i, i ∈ s → I ⊔ J i = ⊤) :
    (I ⊔ ∏ i ∈ s, J i) = ⊤
proof:
:=
  Finset.prod_induction _ (fun J => I ⊔ J = ⊤)
    (fun _ _ hJ hK => (sup_mul_eq_of_coprime_left hJ).trans hK)
    (by simp_rw [one_eq_top, sup_top_eq]) h

name: sup_multiset_prod_eq_top
statement:
theorem sup_multiset_prod_eq_top {s : Multiset (Ideal R)} (h : ∀ p ∈ s, I ⊔ p = ⊤) :
    I ⊔ s.prod = ⊤
proof:
:=
  Multiset.prod_induction (I ⊔ · = ⊤) s (fun _ _ hp hq ↦ (sup_mul_eq_of_coprime_left hp).trans hq)
    (by simp only [one_eq_top, le_top, sup_of_le_right]) h

name: prod_sup_eq_top
statement:
theorem prod_sup_eq_top {s : Finset ι} {J : ι → Ideal R} (h : ∀ i, i ∈ s → J i ⊔ I = ⊤) :
    (∏ i ∈ s, J i) ⊔ I = ⊤
proof: := by rw [sup_comm, sup_prod_eq_top]; intro i hi; rw [sup_comm, h i hi]

name: multiset_prod_eq_bot
statement:
@[simp]
lemma multiset_prod_eq_bot {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [IsDomain R] {s : Multiset (Ideal R)} :
    s.prod = ⊥ ↔ ⊥ ∈ s
proof:
:=
  Multiset.prod_eq_zero_iff

name: isCoprime_iff_codisjoint
statement: theorem isCoprime_iff_codisjoint : IsCoprime I J ↔ Codisjoint I J
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsCoprime, codisjoint_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, y, hxy⟩
    rw [eq_top_iff_one]
    apply (show x * I + y * J ≤ I ⊔ J from
      sup_le (mul_le_right.trans le_sup_left) (mul_le_right.trans le_sup_right))
    rw [hxy]
    simp only [one_eq_top, Submodule.mem_top]
  · intro h
    refine ⟨1, 1, ?_⟩
    simpa only [one_eq_top, top_mul, Submodule.add_eq_sup]

name: isCoprime_of_isMaximal
statement: theorem isCoprime_of_isMaximal [I.IsMaximal] [J.IsMaximal] (ne : I ≠ J) : IsCoprime I J
proof:
:= by
  rw [isCoprime_iff_codisjoint, isMaximal_def] at *
  exact IsCoatom.codisjoint_of_ne ‹_› ‹_› ne

name: isCoprime_iff_add
statement: theorem isCoprime_iff_add : IsCoprime I J ↔ I + J = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [isCoprime_iff_codisjoint, codisjoint_iff, add_eq_sup, one_eq_top]

name: isCoprime_iff_exists
statement: theorem isCoprime_iff_exists : IsCoprime I J ↔ ∃ i ∈ I, ∃ j ∈ J, i + j = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← add_eq_one_iff, isCoprime_iff_add]

name: isCoprime_iff_sup_eq
statement: theorem isCoprime_iff_sup_eq : IsCoprime I J ↔ I ⊔ J = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [isCoprime_iff_codisjoint, codisjoint_iff]

name: coprime_of_no_prime_ge
statement:
theorem coprime_of_no_prime_ge {I J : Ideal R} (h : ∀ P, I ≤ P → J ≤ P → ¬IsPrime P) :
    IsCoprime I J
proof:
:= by
  rw [isCoprime_iff_sup_eq]
  by_contra hIJ
  obtain ⟨P, hP, hIJ⟩ := Ideal.exists_le_maximal _ hIJ
  exact h P (le_trans le_sup_left hIJ) (le_trans le_sup_right hIJ) hP.isPrime

name: isCoprime_tfae
statement:
theorem isCoprime_tfae : TFAE [IsCoprime I J, Codisjoint I J, I + J = 1,
    ∃ i ∈ I, ∃ j ∈ J, i + j = 1, I ⊔ J = ⊤]
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isCoprime_iff_codisjoint, ← isCoprime_iff_add, ← isCoprime_iff_exists,
      ← isCoprime_iff_sup_eq]
  simp

name: _root_.IsCoprime.codisjoint
statement: theorem _root_.IsCoprime.codisjoint (h : IsCoprime I J) : Codisjoint I J
proof:
:=
  isCoprime_iff_codisjoint.mp h

name: _root_.IsCoprime.add_eq
statement: theorem _root_.IsCoprime.add_eq (h : IsCoprime I J) : I + J = 1
proof: := isCoprime_iff_add.mp h

name: _root_.IsCoprime.exists
statement: theorem _root_.IsCoprime.exists (h : IsCoprime I J) : ∃ i ∈ I, ∃ j ∈ J, i + j = 1
proof:
:=
  isCoprime_iff_exists.mp h

name: _root_.IsCoprime.sup_eq
statement: theorem _root_.IsCoprime.sup_eq (h : IsCoprime I J) : I ⊔ J = ⊤
proof: := isCoprime_iff_sup_eq.mp h

name: isCoprime_span_singleton_iff
statement:
theorem isCoprime_span_singleton_iff (x y : R) :
    IsCoprime (span <| singleton x) (span <| singleton y) ↔ IsCoprime x y
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [isCoprime_iff_codisjoint, codisjoint_iff, eq_top_iff_one, mem_span_singleton_sup,
    mem_span_singleton]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, _, ⟨b, rfl⟩, e⟩; exact ⟨a, b, mul_comm b y ▸ e⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, b, e⟩; exact ⟨a, _, ⟨b, rfl⟩, mul_comm y b ▸ e⟩

name: isCoprime_biInf
statement:
theorem isCoprime_biInf {J : ι → Ideal R} {s : Finset ι}
    (hf : ∀ j ∈ s, IsCoprime I (J j)) : IsCoprime I (⨅ j ∈ s, J j)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [isCoprime_iff_add, one_eq_top] at hf ⊢
  exact sup_iInf_eq_top hf

name: mul_eq_inf_of_isCoprime
statement: theorem mul_eq_inf_of_isCoprime (coprime : IsCoprime I J) : I * J = I ⊓ J
proof:
:=
  (Ideal.mul_eq_inf_of_coprime coprime.sup_eq)

name: inf_eq_mul_of_isCoprime
statement:
@[deprecated mul_eq_inf_of_isCoprime (since := "2026-03-10")]
theorem inf_eq_mul_of_isCoprime (coprime : IsCoprime I J) : I ⊓ J = I * J
proof:
:=
  (Ideal.mul_eq_inf_of_coprime coprime.sup_eq).symm

name: prod_eq_iInf_of_pairwise_isCoprime
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simp
  | insert a s hs ih =>
    simp_all only [Finset.iInf_insert, Finset.coe_insert, Set.pairwise_insert, SetLike.mem_coe,
      ne_eq, not_false_eq_true, Finset.prod_insert, forall_const]
    obtain ⟨hp1, hp2⟩ := hp
    rw [Ideal.mul_eq_inf_of_isCoprime (isCoprime_biInf (by grind))]

name: mem_radical_iff
statement: theorem mem_radical_iff {r : R} : r ∈ I.radical ↔ ∃ n : ℕ, r ^ n ∈ I
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: le_radical
statement: theorem le_radical : I ≤ radical I
proof: := fun r hri => ⟨1, (pow_one r).symm ▸ hri⟩

name: radical_eq_iff
statement: theorem radical_eq_iff : I.radical = I ↔ I.IsRadical
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_antisymm_iff, and_iff_left le_radical, IsRadical]

name: isRadical_iff_pow_one_lt
statement: theorem isRadical_iff_pow_one_lt (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 < k) : I.IsRadical ↔ ∀ r, r ^ k ∈ I → r ∈ I
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h _r hr ↦ h ⟨k, hr⟩, fun h x ⟨n, hx⟩ ↦
    k.pow_imp_self_of_one_lt hk _ (fun _ _ ↦ .inr ∘ I.smul_mem _) h n x hx⟩

name: radical_top
statement: theorem radical_top : (radical ⊤ : Ideal R) = ⊤
proof:
:=
  (eq_top_iff_one _).2 ⟨0, Submodule.mem_top⟩

name: radical_mono
statement: theorem radical_mono (H : I ≤ J) : radical I ≤ radical J
proof: := fun _ ⟨n, hrni⟩ => ⟨n, H hrni⟩

name: radical_isRadical
statement: theorem radical_isRadical : (radical I).IsRadical
proof:
:= fun r ⟨n, k, hrnki⟩ =>
  ⟨n * k, (pow_mul r n k).symm ▸ hrnki⟩

name: radical_idem
statement:
@[simp]
theorem radical_idem : radical (radical I) = radical I
proof:
:=
  (radical_isRadical I).radical

name: IsRadical.radical_le_iff
statement: theorem IsRadical.radical_le_iff (hJ : J.IsRadical) : I.radical ≤ J ↔ I ≤ J
proof:
:=
  ⟨le_trans le_radical, fun h => hJ.radical ▸ radical_mono h⟩

name: radical_le_radical_iff
statement: theorem radical_le_radical_iff : radical I ≤ radical J ↔ I ≤ radical J
proof:
:=
  (radical_isRadical J).radical_le_iff

name: radical_eq_top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem radical_eq_top : radical I = ⊤ ↔ I = ⊤
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h =>
    (eq_top_iff_one _).2 <|
      let ⟨n, hn⟩ := (eq_top_iff_one _).1 h
      @one_pow R _ n ▸ hn,
    fun h => h.symm ▸ radical_top R⟩

name: IsPrime.isRadical
statement: theorem IsPrime.isRadical (H : IsPrime I) : I.IsRadical
proof:
:= fun _ ⟨n, hrni⟩ =>
  H.mem_of_pow_mem n hrni

name: IsPrime.radical
statement: theorem IsPrime.radical (H : IsPrime I) : radical I = I
proof:
:=
  IsRadical.radical H.isRadical

name: mem_radical_of_pow_mem
statement:
theorem mem_radical_of_pow_mem {I : Ideal R} {x : R} {m : ℕ} (hx : x ^ m ∈ radical I) :
    x ∈ radical I
proof:
:=
  radical_idem I ▸ ⟨m, hx⟩

name: disjoint_powers_iff_notMem
statement:
theorem disjoint_powers_iff_notMem (y : R) (hI : I.IsRadical) :
    Disjoint (Submonoid.powers y : Set R) ↑I ↔ y ∉ I
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => Set.disjoint_left.1 h (Submonoid.mem_powers _),
      fun h => disjoint_iff.mpr (eq_bot_iff.mpr ?_)⟩
  rintro x ⟨⟨n, rfl⟩, hx'⟩
  exact h (hI <| mem_radical_of_pow_mem <| le_radical hx')

name: disjoint_powers_iff_notMem_of_isPrime
statement:
theorem disjoint_powers_iff_notMem_of_isPrime [I.IsPrime] (y : R) :
    Disjoint (Submonoid.powers y : Set R) ↑I ↔ y ∉ I
proof:
:=
  disjoint_powers_iff_notMem y (IsPrime.isRadical ‹_›)

name: radical_sup
statement: theorem radical_sup : radical (I ⊔ J) = radical (radical I ⊔ radical J)
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (radical_mono <| sup_le_sup le_radical le_radical) <|
    radical_le_radical_iff.2 <| sup_le (radical_mono le_sup_left) (radical_mono le_sup_right)

name: radical_inf
statement: theorem radical_inf : radical (I ⊓ J) = radical I ⊓ radical J
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (le_inf (radical_mono inf_le_left) (radical_mono inf_le_right))
    fun r ⟨⟨m, hrm⟩, ⟨n, hrn⟩⟩ =>
    ⟨m + n, (pow_add r m n).symm ▸ I.mul_mem_right _ hrm,
      (pow_add r m n).symm ▸ J.mul_mem_left _ hrn⟩

name: IsRadical.inf
statement: theorem IsRadical.inf (hI : IsRadical I) (hJ : IsRadical J) : IsRadical (I ⊓ J)
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsRadical, radical_inf]; exact inf_le_inf hI hJ

name: isRadical_bot_iff
statement: lemma isRadical_bot_iff : (⊥ : Ideal R).IsRadical ↔ IsReduced R
proof:
:= by
  simp only [IsRadical, SetLike.le_def, Ideal.mem_radical_iff, Ideal.mem_bot,
    forall_exists_index, isReduced_iff, IsNilpotent]

name: isRadical_bot
statement: lemma isRadical_bot [IsReduced R] : (⊥ : Ideal R).IsRadical
proof: := by rwa [isRadical_bot_iff]

name: radicalInfTopHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma radicalInfTopHom_apply (I : Ideal R) : radicalInfTopHom I = radical I
proof: := rfl

name: radical_finset_inf
statement:
lemma radical_finset_inf {ι} {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → Ideal R} {i : ι} (hi : i ∈ s)
    (hs : ∀ ⦃y⦄, y ∈ s → (f y).radical = (f i).radical) :
    (s.inf f).radical = (f i).radical
proof:
:= by
  rw [← radicalInfTopHom_apply, map_finset_inf, ← Finset.inf'_eq_inf ⟨_, hi⟩]
  exact Finset.inf'_eq_of_forall _ _ hs

name: radical_iInf_le
statement: theorem radical_iInf_le {ι} (I : ι → Ideal R) : radical (⨅ i, I i) ≤ ⨅ i, radical (I i)
proof:
:=
  le_iInf fun _ ↦ radical_mono (iInf_le _ _)

name: isRadical_iInf
statement: theorem isRadical_iInf {ι} (I : ι → Ideal R) (hI : ∀ i, IsRadical (I i)) : IsRadical (⨅ i, I i)
proof:
:=
  (radical_iInf_le I).trans (iInf_mono hI)

name: radical_mul
statement: theorem radical_mul : radical (I * J) = radical I ⊓ radical J
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ fun r ⟨⟨m, hrm⟩, ⟨n, hrn⟩⟩ =>
    ⟨m + n, (pow_add r m n).symm ▸ mul_mem_mul hrm hrn⟩
  have := radical_mono <| mul_le_inf (I := I) (J := J)
  simp_rw [radical_inf I J] at this
  assumption

name: IsPrime.radical_le_iff
statement: theorem IsPrime.radical_le_iff (hJ : IsPrime J) : I.radical ≤ J ↔ I ≤ J
proof:
:=
  IsRadical.radical_le_iff hJ.isRadical

name: radical_eq_sInf
statement: theorem radical_eq_sInf (I : Ideal R) : radical I = sInf { J : Ideal R | I ≤ J ∧ IsPrime J }
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (le_sInf fun _ hJ ↦ hJ.2.radical_le_iff.2 hJ.1) fun r hr ↦
    by_contradiction fun hri ↦
      let ⟨m, hIm, hm⟩ :=
        zorn_le_nonempty₀ { K : Ideal R | r ∉ radical K }
          (fun c hc hcc y hyc =>
            ⟨sSup c, fun ⟨n, hrnc⟩ =>
              let ⟨_, hyc, hrny⟩ := (Submodule.mem_sSup_of_directed ⟨y, hyc⟩ hcc.directedOn).1 hrnc
              hc hyc ⟨n, hrny⟩,
              fun _ => le_sSup⟩)
          I hri
      have hrm : r ∉ radical m := hm.prop
      have : ∀ x ∉ m, r ∈ radical (m ⊔ span {x}) := fun x hxm =>
        by_contradiction fun hrmx => hxm <| by
          rw [hm.eq_of_le hrmx le_sup_left]
          exact Submodule.mem_sup_right <| mem_span_singleton_self x
      have : IsPrime m :=
        ⟨by rintro rfl; rw [radical_top] at hrm; exact hrm trivial, fun {x y} hxym =>
          or_iff_not_imp_left.2 fun hxm =>
            by_contradiction fun hym =>
              let ⟨n, hrn⟩ := this _ hxm
              let ⟨p, hpm, q, hq, hpqrn⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hrn
              let ⟨c, hcxq⟩ := mem_span_singleton'.1 hq
              let ⟨k, hrk⟩ := this _ hym
              let ⟨f, hfm, g, hg, hfgrk⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hrk
              let ⟨d, hdyg⟩ := mem_span_singleton'.1 hg
              hrm
                ⟨n + k, by
                  rw [pow_add, ← hpqrn, ← hcxq, ← hfgrk, ← hdyg, add_mul, mul_add (c * x),
                      mul_assoc c x (d * y), mul_left_comm x, ← mul_assoc]
                  refine
                    m.add_mem (m.mul_mem_right _ hpm)
                    (m.add_mem (m.mul_mem_left _ hfm) (m.mul_mem_left _ hxym))⟩⟩
    hrm <|
      this.radical.symm ▸ (sInf_le ⟨hIm, this⟩ : sInf { J : Ideal R | I ≤ J ∧ IsPrime J } ≤ m) hr

name: isRadical_bot_of_noZeroDivisors
statement:
@[deprecated isRadical_bot (since := "2026-08-03")]
theorem isRadical_bot_of_noZeroDivisors {R} [CommSemiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] :
    (⊥ : Ideal R).IsRadical
proof: := isRadical_bot

name: radical_bot_of_isReduced
statement:
@[simp]
theorem radical_bot_of_isReduced {R : Type u} [CommSemiring R] [IsReduced R] :
    radical (⊥ : Ideal R) = ⊥
proof:
:=
  eq_bot_iff.2 isRadical_bot

name: radical_pow
statement:
lemma radical_pow : ∀ {n}, n ≠ 0 → radical (I ^ n) = radical I
  | 1, _ => by simp
  | n + 2, _ => by rw [pow_succ, radical_mul, radical_pow n.succ_ne_zero, inf_idem]

name: IsPrime.mul_le
statement: theorem IsPrime.mul_le {I J P : Ideal R} (hp : IsPrime P) : I * J ≤ P ↔ I ≤ P ∨ J ≤ P
proof:
:= by
  rw [or_comm, Ideal.mul_le]
  simp_rw [hp.mul_mem_iff_mem_or_mem, SetLike.le_def, ← forall_or_left, or_comm, forall_or_left]

name: IsPrime.inf_le
statement: theorem IsPrime.inf_le {I J P : Ideal R} (hp : IsPrime P) : I ⊓ J ≤ P ↔ I ≤ P ∨ J ≤ P
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ hp.mul_le.1 <| mul_le_inf.trans h, fun h ↦ h.elim inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right.trans⟩

name: IsPrime.multiset_prod_le
statement:
theorem IsPrime.multiset_prod_le {s : Multiset (Ideal R)} {P : Ideal R} (hp : IsPrime P) :
    s.prod ≤ P ↔ ∃ I ∈ s, I ≤ P
proof:
:=
  s.induction_on (by simp [hp.ne_top]) fun I s ih ↦ by simp [hp.mul_le, ih]

name: IsPrime.multiset_prod_map_le
statement:
theorem IsPrime.multiset_prod_map_le {s : Multiset ι} (f : ι → Ideal R) {P : Ideal R}
    (hp : IsPrime P) : (s.map f).prod ≤ P ↔ ∃ i ∈ s, f i ≤ P
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [hp.multiset_prod_le, Multiset.mem_map, exists_exists_and_eq_and]

name: IsPrime.multiset_prod_mem_iff_exists_mem
statement:
theorem IsPrime.multiset_prod_mem_iff_exists_mem {I : Ideal R} (hI : I.IsPrime) (s : Multiset R) :
    s.prod ∈ I ↔ ∃ p ∈ s, p ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  simpa using (hI.multiset_prod_map_le (span {·}))

name: IsPrime.pow_le_iff
statement:
theorem IsPrime.pow_le_iff {I P : Ideal R} [hP : P.IsPrime] {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    I ^ n ≤ P ↔ I ≤ P
proof:
:= by
  have h : (Multiset.replicate n I).prod ≤ P ↔ _ := hP.multiset_prod_le
  simp_rw [Multiset.prod_replicate, Multiset.mem_replicate, ne_eq, hn, not_false_eq_true,
    true_and, exists_eq_left] at h
  exact h

name: IsPrime.le_of_pow_le
statement:
theorem IsPrime.le_of_pow_le {I P : Ideal R} [hP : P.IsPrime] {n : ℕ} (h : I ^ n ≤ P) :
    I ≤ P
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · rw [hn, pow_zero, one_eq_top] at h
    exact fun ⦃_⦄ _ ↦ h Submodule.mem_top
  · exact (pow_le_iff hn).mp h

name: IsPrime.prod_le
statement:
theorem IsPrime.prod_le {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → Ideal R} {P : Ideal R} (hp : IsPrime P) :
    s.prod f ≤ P ↔ ∃ i ∈ s, f i ≤ P
proof:
:=
  hp.multiset_prod_map_le f

name: IsPrime.prod_mem_iff
statement:
theorem IsPrime.prod_mem_iff {s : Finset ι} {x : ι → R} {p : Ideal R} [hp : p.IsPrime] :
    ∏ i ∈ s, x i ∈ p ↔ ∃ i ∈ s, x i ∈ p
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← span_singleton_le_iff_mem, ← prod_span_singleton]
  exact hp.prod_le

name: IsPrime.prod_mem_iff_exists_mem
statement:
theorem IsPrime.prod_mem_iff_exists_mem {I : Ideal R} (hI : I.IsPrime) (s : Finset R) :
    s.prod (fun x ↦ x) ∈ I ↔ ∃ p ∈ s, p ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.prod_eq_multiset_prod, Multiset.map_id']
  exact hI.multiset_prod_mem_iff_exists_mem s.val

name: IsPrime.inf_le'
statement:
theorem IsPrime.inf_le' {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → Ideal R} {P : Ideal R} (hp : IsPrime P) :
    s.inf f ≤ P ↔ ∃ i ∈ s, f i ≤ P
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ hp.prod_le.1 <| prod_le_inf.trans h, fun ⟨_, his, hip⟩ ↦ (Finset.inf_le his).trans hip⟩

name: eq_inf_of_isPrime_inf
statement:
theorem eq_inf_of_isPrime_inf {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → Ideal R} (hp : IsPrime (s.inf f)) :
    ∃ i ∈ s, f i = s.inf f
proof:
:=
  (hp.inf_le'.mp le_rfl).imp (fun _ ⟨h1, h2⟩ ↦ ⟨h1, le_antisymm h2 (Finset.inf_le h1)⟩)

name: IsPrime.notMem_of_isCoprime_of_mem
statement:
theorem IsPrime.notMem_of_isCoprime_of_mem {I : Ideal R} [I.IsPrime] {x y : R} (h : IsCoprime x y)
    (hx : x ∈ I) : y ∉ I
proof:
:= fun hy ↦
  have ⟨a, b, e⟩ := h
  Ideal.IsPrime.one_notMem ‹_› (e ▸ I.add_mem (I.mul_mem_left a hx) (I.mul_mem_left b hy))

name: subset_union
statement:
theorem subset_union {R : Type u} [Ring R] {I J K : Ideal R} :
    (I : Set R) ⊆ J ∪ K ↔ I ≤ J ∨ I ≤ K
proof:
:=
  AddSubgroupClass.subset_union

name: subset_union_prime'
proof:
:= by
  suffices
    ((I : Set R) ⊆ f a ∪ f b ∪ ⋃ i ∈ (↑s : Set ι), f i) → I ≤ f a ∨ I ≤ f b ∨ ∃ i ∈ s, I ≤ f i from
    ⟨this, fun h =>
      Or.casesOn h
        (fun h =>
          Set.Subset.trans h <|
            Set.Subset.trans Set.subset_union_left Set.subset_union_left)
        fun h =>
        Or.casesOn h
          (fun h =>
            Set.Subset.trans h <|
              Set.Subset.trans Set.subset_union_right Set.subset_union_left)
          fun ⟨i, his, hi⟩ => by
          refine Set.Subset.trans hi <| Set.Subset.trans ?_ Set.subset_union_right
          exact Set.subset_biUnion_of_mem (u := fun x ↦ (f x : Set R)) (Finset.mem_coe.2 his)⟩
  generalize hn : s.card = n; intro h
  induction n generalizing a b s with
  | zero =>
    clear hp
    rw [Finset.card_eq_zero] at hn
    subst hn
    rw [Finset.coe_empty, Set.biUnion_empty, Set.union_empty, subset_union] at h
    simpa only [exists_prop, Finset.notMem_empty, false_and, exists_false, or_false]
  | succ n ih =>
    classical
    replace hn : ∃ (i : ι) (t : Finset ι), i ∉ t ∧ insert i t = s ∧ t.card = n :=
      Finset.card_eq_succ.1 hn
    rcases hn with ⟨i, t, hit, rfl, hn⟩
    replace hp : IsPrime (f i) ∧ ∀ x ∈ t, IsPrime (f x) := (t.forall_mem_insert _ _).1 hp
    by_cases Ht : ∃ j ∈ t, f j ≤ f i
    · obtain ⟨j, hjt, hfji⟩ : ∃ j ∈ t, f j ≤ f i := Ht
      obtain ⟨u, hju, rfl⟩ : ∃ u, j ∉ u ∧ insert j u = t :=
        ⟨t.erase j, t.notMem_erase j, Finset.insert_erase hjt⟩
      have hp' : ∀ k ∈ insert i u, IsPrime (f k) := by
        rw [Finset.forall_mem_insert] at hp ⊢
        exact ⟨hp.1, hp.2.2⟩
      have hiu : i ∉ u := mt Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hit
      have hn' : (insert i u).card = n := by
        rwa [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem] at hn ⊢
        exacts [hiu, hju]
      have h' : (I : Set R) ⊆ f a ∪ f b ∪ ⋃ k ∈ (↑(insert i u) : Set ι), f k := by
        rw [Finset.coe_insert] at h ⊢
        rw [Finset.coe_insert] at h
        simp only [Set.biUnion_insert] at h ⊢
        rw [← Set.union_assoc (f i : Set R),
            Set.union_eq_self_of_subset_right hfji] at h
        exact h
      specialize ih hp' hn' h'
      refine ih.imp id (Or.imp id (Exists.imp fun k => ?_))
      exact And.imp (fun hk => Finset.insert_subset_insert i (Finset.subset_insert j u) hk) id
    by_cases Ha : f a ≤ f i
    · have h' : (I : Set R) ⊆ f i ∪ f b ∪ ⋃ j ∈ (↑t : Set ι), f j := by
        rw [Finset.coe_insert, Set.biUnion_insert, ← Set.union_assoc,
          Set.union_right_comm (f a : Set R),
          Set.union_eq_self_of_subset_left Ha] at h
        exact h
      specialize ih hp.2 hn h'
      right
      rcases ih with (ih | ih | ⟨k, hkt, ih⟩)
      · exact Or.inr ⟨i, Finset.mem_insert_self i t, ih⟩
      · exact Or.inl ih
      · exact Or.inr ⟨k, Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hkt, ih⟩
    by_cases Hb : f b ≤ f i
    · have h' : (I : Set R) ⊆ f a ∪ f i ∪ ⋃ j ∈ (↑t : Set ι), f j := by
        rw [Finset.coe_insert, Set.biUnion_insert, ← Set.union_assoc,
          Set.union_assoc (f a : Set R),
          Set.union_eq_self_of_subset_left Hb] at h
        exact h
      specialize ih hp.2 hn h'
      rcases ih with (ih | ih | ⟨k, hkt, ih⟩)
      · exact Or.inl ih
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨i, Finset.mem_insert_self i t, ih⟩)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨k, Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hkt, ih⟩)
    by_cases Hi : I ≤ f i
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨i, Finset.mem_insert_self i t, Hi⟩)
    have : ¬I ⊓ f a ⊓ f b ⊓ t.inf f ≤ f i := by
      simp only [hp.1.inf_le, hp.1.inf_le', not_or]
      exact ⟨⟨⟨Hi, Ha⟩, Hb⟩, Ht⟩
    rcases Set.not_subset.1 this with ⟨r, ⟨⟨⟨hrI, hra⟩, hrb⟩, hr⟩, hri⟩
    by_cases HI : (I : Set R) ⊆ f a ∪ f b ∪ ⋃ j ∈ (↑t : Set ι), f j
    · specialize ih hp.2 hn HI
      rcases ih with (ih | ih | ⟨k, hkt, ih⟩)
      · order
      · order
      · right
        right
        exact ⟨k, Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hkt, ih⟩
    exfalso
    rcases Set.not_subset.1 HI with ⟨s, hsI, hs⟩
    rw [Finset.coe_insert, Set.biUnion_insert] at h
    have hsi : s ∈ f i := ((h hsI).resolve_left (mt Or.inl hs)).resolve_right (mt Or.inr hs)
    rcases h (I.add_mem hrI hsI) with (⟨ha | hb⟩ | hi | ht)
    · exact hs (Or.inl <| Or.inl <| add_sub_cancel_left r s ▸ (f a).sub_mem ha hra)
    · exact hs (Or.inl <| Or.inr <| add_sub_cancel_left r s ▸ (f b).sub_mem hb hrb)
    · exact hri (add_sub_cancel_right r s ▸ (f i).sub_mem hi hsi)
    · rw [Set.mem_iUnion₂] at ht
      rcases ht with ⟨j, hjt, hj⟩
      simp only [Finset.inf_eq_iInf, SetLike.mem_coe, Submodule.mem_iInf] at hr
      exact hs <| Or.inr <| Set.mem_biUnion hjt <|
        add_sub_cancel_left r s ▸ (f j).sub_mem hj <| hr j hjt

name: subset_union_prime
statement:
@[stacks 00DS]
theorem subset_union_prime {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → Ideal R} (a b : ι)
    (hp : ∀ i ∈ s, i ≠ a → i ≠ b → IsPrime (f i)) {I : Ideal R} :
    ((I : Set R) ⊆ ⋃ i ∈ (↑s : Set ι), f i) ↔ ∃ i ∈ s, I ≤ f i
proof:
:=
  suffices ((I : Set R) ⊆ ⋃ i ∈ (↑s : Set ι), f i) → ∃ i, i ∈ s ∧ I ≤ f i by
    have aux := fun h => (bex_def.2 <| this h)
    simp_rw [exists_prop] at aux
    refine ⟨aux, fun ⟨i, his, hi⟩ ↦ Set.Subset.trans hi ?_⟩
    apply Set.subset_biUnion_of_mem (show i ∈ (↑s : Set ι) from his)
  fun h : (I : Set R) ⊆ ⋃ i ∈ (↑s : Set ι), f i => by
  classical
    by_cases has : a ∈ s
    · obtain ⟨t, hat, rfl⟩ : ∃ t, a ∉ t ∧ insert a t = s :=
        ⟨s.erase a, Finset.notMem_erase a s, Finset.insert_erase has⟩
      by_cases hbt : b ∈ t
      · obtain ⟨u, hbu, rfl⟩ : ∃ u, b ∉ u ∧ insert b u = t :=
          ⟨t.erase b, Finset.notMem_erase b t, Finset.insert_erase hbt⟩
        have hp' : ∀ i ∈ u, IsPrime (f i) := by
          intro i hiu
          refine hp i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hiu)) ?_ ?_ <;>
              rintro rfl <;>
            solve_by_elim only [Finset.mem_insert_of_mem, *]
        rw [Finset.coe_insert, Finset.coe_insert, Set.biUnion_insert, Set.biUnion_insert, ←
          Set.union_assoc, subset_union_prime' hp'] at h
        rwa [Finset.exists_mem_insert, Finset.exists_mem_insert]
      · have hp' : ∀ j ∈ t, IsPrime (f j) := by
          intro j hj
          refine hp j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj) ?_ ?_ <;> rintro rfl <;>
            solve_by_elim only [Finset.mem_insert_of_mem, *]
        rw [Finset.coe_insert, Set.biUnion_insert, ← Set.union_self (f a : Set R),
          subset_union_prime' hp', ← or_assoc, or_self_iff] at h
        rwa [Finset.exists_mem_insert]
    · by_cases hbs : b ∈ s
      · obtain ⟨t, hbt, rfl⟩ : ∃ t, b ∉ t ∧ insert b t = s :=
          ⟨s.erase b, Finset.notMem_erase b s, Finset.insert_erase hbs⟩
        have hp' : ∀ j ∈ t, IsPrime (f j) := by
          intro j hj
          refine hp j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj) ?_ ?_ <;> rintro rfl <;>
            solve_by_elim only [Finset.mem_insert_of_mem, *]
        rw [Finset.coe_insert, Set.biUnion_insert, ← Set.union_self (f b : Set R),
          subset_union_prime' hp', ← or_assoc, or_self_iff] at h
        rwa [Finset.exists_mem_insert]
      rcases s.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hsne
      · rw [Finset.coe_empty, Set.biUnion_empty] at h
        exact (h I.zero_mem).elim
      · obtain ⟨i, his⟩ := hsne
        obtain ⟨t, _, rfl⟩ : ∃ t, i ∉ t ∧ insert i t = s :=
          ⟨s.erase i, Finset.notMem_erase i s, Finset.insert_erase his⟩
        have hp' : ∀ j ∈ t, IsPrime (f j) := by
          intro j hj
          refine hp j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj) ?_ ?_ <;> rintro rfl <;>
            solve_by_elim only [Finset.mem_insert_of_mem, *]
        rw [Finset.coe_insert, Set.biUnion_insert, ← Set.union_self (f i : Set R),
          subset_union_prime' hp', ← or_assoc, or_self_iff] at h
        rwa [Finset.exists_mem_insert]

name: subset_union_prime_finite
statement:
lemma subset_union_prime_finite {R ι : Type*} [CommRing R] {s : Set ι}
    (hs : s.Finite) {f : ι → Ideal R} (a b : ι)
    (hp : ∀ i ∈ s, i ≠ a → i ≠ b → (f i).IsPrime) {I : Ideal R} :
    ((I : Set R) ⊆ ⋃ i ∈ s, f i) ↔ ∃ i ∈ s, I ≤ f i
proof:
:= by
  rcases Set.Finite.exists_finset hs with ⟨t, ht⟩
  have heq : ⋃ i ∈ s, f i = ⋃ i ∈ t, (f i : Set R) := by
    ext
    simpa using exists_congr (fun i ↦ (and_congr_left fun a ↦ ht i).symm)
  have hmem_union : ((I : Set R) ⊆ ⋃ i ∈ s, f i) ↔ ((I : Set R) ⊆ ⋃ i ∈ (t : Set ι), f i) :=
    (congrArg _ heq).to_iff
  rw [hmem_union, Ideal.subset_union_prime a b (fun i hin ↦ hp i ((ht i).mp hin))]
  exact exists_congr (fun i ↦ and_congr_left fun _ ↦ ht i)

name: subset_iUnion_iff_mem_of_isMaximal_of_finite
statement:
lemma subset_iUnion_iff_mem_of_isMaximal_of_finite
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {M : Ideal R} [M.IsMaximal] {S : Set (Ideal R)}
    (hs : S.Finite) (a b : Ideal R) (hp : ∀ I ∈ S, I ≠ a → I ≠ b → I.IsPrime)
    (ha : a ≠ ⊤) (hb : b ≠ ⊤) : ((M : Set R) ⊆ ⋃ I ∈ S, I) ↔ M ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  refine (subset_union_prime_finite hs a b hp).trans ⟨fun ⟨I, mem, le⟩ ↦ ?_, (⟨M, ·, le_rfl⟩)⟩
  rwa [‹M.IsMaximal›.eq_of_le _ le]
  simp_rw [← or_iff_not_imp_left] at hp
  obtain rfl | rfl | hp := hp I mem
  exacts [ha, hb, hp.ne_top]

name: IsMaximal.exists_inv_pow
statement:
theorem IsMaximal.exists_inv_pow (I : Ideal R) [I.IsMaximal]
    {x : R} (hx : x ∉ I) (n : ℕ) : ∃ (y : R), ∃ i ∈ I ^ n, y * x + i = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, i, hmem, hi⟩ := Ideal.IsMaximal.exists_inv ‹_› hx
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ : ∃ y : R, y * x + i ^ n = 1 := by
    induction n with
    | zero => exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
    | succ n ih =>
      obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := ih
      refine ⟨z * i + y, ?_⟩
      trans z * i * x + i * i ^ n + y * x
      · ring
      · rw [mul_comm z i, mul_assoc, ← mul_add, hz, add_comm]
        simpa
  exact ⟨y, i ^ n, Ideal.pow_mem_pow hmem n, hy⟩

name: IsMaximal.mul_mem_pow
statement:
theorem IsMaximal.mul_mem_pow (I : Ideal R) [I.IsMaximal]
    {a b : R} {n : ℕ} (h : a * b ∈ I ^ n) : a ∈ I ∨ b ∈ I ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [Classical.or_iff_not_imp_left]
  intro ha
  obtain ⟨c, i, hi, hc⟩ := exists_inv_pow I ha n
  obtain hb := congr($hc * b)
  rw [one_mul] at hb
  rw [← hb, add_mul, mul_assoc]
  exact add_mem (mul_mem_left _ _ h) (mul_mem_right _ _ hi)

name: IsMaximal.mem_pow_mul
statement:
theorem IsMaximal.mem_pow_mul {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] (I : Ideal R) [I.IsMaximal]
    {a b : R} {n : ℕ} (h : a * b ∈ I ^ n) : a ∈ I ^ n ∨ b ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm] at h
  rw [or_comm]
  exact mul_mem_pow _ h

name: le_of_dvd
statement:
theorem le_of_dvd {I J : Ideal R} : I ∣ J → J ≤ I

@[simp]

name: isUnit_iff

theorem isUnit_iff {I : Ideal R} : IsUnit I ↔ I = ⊤

name: span_singleton_dvd_span_singleton_iff_dvd

statement:
theorem finsuppTotal_apply (f : ι →₀ I) :
    finsuppTotal ι M I v f = f.sum fun i x => (x : R) • v i

name: range_finsuppTotal
statement:
theorem range_finsuppTotal :
    LinearMap.range (finsuppTotal ι M I v) = I • Submodule.span R (Set.range v)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  rw [Submodule.mem_ideal_smul_span_iff_exists_sum]
  refine ⟨fun ⟨f, h⟩ => ⟨Finsupp.mapRange.linearMap I.subtype f, fun i => (f i).2, h⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
  classical
    refine ⟨a.mapRange (fun r => if h : r ∈ I then ⟨r, h⟩ else 0)
      (by simp only [Submodule.zero_mem, ↓reduceDIte]; rfl), ?_⟩
    rw [finsuppTotal_apply, Finsupp.sum_mapRange_index]
    · apply Finsupp.sum_congr
      intro i _
      rw [dite_eq_left (ha i)]
    · exact fun _ => zero_smul _ _

name: Ideal.exists_subset_radical_span_sup_of_subset_radical_sup
statement:
lemma Ideal.exists_subset_radical_span_sup_of_subset_radical_sup {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R]
    (s : Set R) (I J : Ideal R) (hs : s ⊆ (I ⊔ J).radical) :
    ∃ (t : s → R), Set.range t ⊆ I ∧ s ⊆ (span (Set.range t) ⊔ J).radical
proof:
:= by
  replace hs : ∀ z : s, ∃ (m : ℕ) (a b : R) (ha : a ∈ I) (hb : b ∈ J), a + b = z ^ m := by
    rintro ⟨z, hzs⟩
    simp only [Ideal.radical, Submodule.mem_sup] at hs
    obtain ⟨m, y, hyq, b, hb, hy⟩ := hs hzs
    exact ⟨m, y, b, hyq, hb, hy⟩
  choose m a b ha hb heq using hs
  refine ⟨a, by rwa [Set.range_subset_iff], fun z hz ↦ ⟨m ⟨z, hz⟩, heq ⟨z, hz⟩ ▸ ?_⟩⟩
  exact Ideal.add_mem _ (mem_sup_left (subset_span ⟨⟨z, hz⟩, rfl⟩)) (mem_sup_right <| hb _)

name: injective_lTensor_quotient_iff_inf_eq_mul
statement:
lemma injective_lTensor_quotient_iff_inf_eq_mul (I J : Ideal R) :
    Function.Injective (J.subtype.lTensor (R ⧸ I)) ↔ I ⊓ J = I * J
proof:
:= by
  let f : J ⧸ (I • ⊤ : Submodule R J) →ₗ[R] R ⧸ I :=
    Submodule.mapQ _ _ J.subtype <| by
      simp [← Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap, Ideal.mul_le_left]
  have : J.subtype.lTensor (R ⧸ I) =
      (TensorProduct.rid R (R ⧸ I)).symm ∘ₗ f ∘ₗ TensorProduct.quotTensorEquivQuotSMul J I := by
    ext
    simp [f, ← Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_one_eq_one_tmul]
  rw [this]
  simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, EmbeddingLike.comp_injective,
    EquivLike.injective_comp, ← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, f, Submodule.ker_mapQ,
    ← LinearMap.le_ker_iff_map, Submodule.ker_mkQ,
    ← (Submodule.map_le_map_iff_of_injective J.injective_subtype)]
  simp [inf_comm, le_antisymm_iff, Ideal.mul_le_inf (I := I) (J := J)]

name: Ideal.inf_eq_mul_of_pure
statement:
@[stacks 04PS "(1) => (2)"]
lemma Ideal.inf_eq_mul_of_pure (I J : Ideal R) [I.Pure] :
    I ⊓ J = I * J
proof:
:= by
  rw [← injective_lTensor_quotient_iff_inf_eq_mul]
  apply Module.Flat.lTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap

name: Ideal.Pure.of_isIdempotentElem
statement:
lemma Ideal.Pure.of_isIdempotentElem {I : Ideal R} (h : I.FG) (h' : IsIdempotentElem I) :
    I.Pure
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.isIdempotentElem_iff_of_fg _ h] at h'
  obtain ⟨e, he, rfl⟩ := h'
  have : Module.Flat R ((R ⧸ R ∙ e) × R ⧸ span {1 - e}) :=
    .of_linearEquiv <| AlgEquiv.prodQuotientOfIsIdempotentElem R he he.one_sub (by simp)
      (by grind [IsIdempotentElem]) |>.toLinearEquiv.symm
  apply Module.Flat.of_retract (LinearMap.inl R _ (R ⧸ span {1 - e})) (LinearMap.fst R _ _)
  simp

name: Ideal.Pure.of_inf_eq_mul
statement:
@[stacks 04PS "(3) => (1)"]
lemma Ideal.Pure.of_inf_eq_mul (I : Ideal R) (H : ∀ ⦃J : Ideal R⦄, J.FG → I ⊓ J = I * J) :
    I.Pure
proof:
:= by
  rw [Pure, Module.Flat.iff_lTensor_injective]
  intro J hJ
  rw [injective_lTensor_quotient_iff_inf_eq_mul]
  exact H hJ

name: Ideal.exists_eq_mul_of_pure
statement:
@[stacks 04PS "(1) => (5)"]
lemma Ideal.exists_eq_mul_of_pure {I : Ideal R} [I.Pure] {x : R} (hx : x ∈ I) :
    ∃ y ∈ I, x = x * y
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : x ∈ I * Ideal.span {x} by
    rw [Ideal.mem_mul_span_singleton] at h
    grind
  rw [← I.inf_eq_mul_of_pure]
  exact ⟨hx, subset_span rfl⟩

name: Ideal.le_ker_atPrime_of_forall_exists_eq_mul
statement:
@[stacks 04PS "(5) => (7)"]
lemma Ideal.le_ker_atPrime_of_forall_exists_eq_mul {I : Ideal R}
    (h : ∀ x ∈ I, ∃ y ∈ I, x = x * y) {p : Ideal R} [p.IsPrime] (hle : I ≤ p) :
    I ≤ RingHom.ker (algebraMap R <| Localization.AtPrime p)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨y, hy, heq⟩ := h _ hx
  have : IsUnit (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime p) (1 - y)) := by
    rw [IsLocalization.algebraMap_isUnit_iff p.primeCompl]
    refine ⟨1 - y, fun hz ↦ p.one_notMem ?_, by simp⟩
    rw [← sub_add_cancel 1 y]
    exact Ideal.add_mem _ hz (hle hy)
  have hzero : x * (1 - y) = 0 := by simp [mul_sub, ← heq]
  simp only [RingHom.mem_ker, ← this.mul_left_eq_zero, ← RingHom.map_mul, hzero, RingHom.map_zero]

name: Ideal.ker_piRingHom_atPrime_eq_of_pure
statement:
lemma Ideal.ker_piRingHom_atPrime_eq_of_pure (I : Ideal R) [I.Pure] :
    RingHom.ker
      (RingHom.pi fun p : zeroLocus (I : Set R) ↦
        algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime p.val.asIdeal)) = I
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ fun x hx ↦ ?_
  · rw [Pi.ker_ringHom]
    refine le_trans ?_ I.iInf_ker_le
    simp only [le_iInf_iff]
    exact fun i hi hle ↦ iInf_le_of_le ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, hle⟩ le_rfl
  · rw [RingHom.mem_ker]
    ext p
    rw [RingHom.pi_apply, Pi.zero_apply]
    exact Ideal.le_ker_atPrime_of_forall_exists_eq_mul
      (fun x hx ↦ Ideal.exists_eq_mul_of_pure hx) p.2 hx

name: Ideal.zeroLocus_inj_of_pure
statement:
@[stacks 04PT]
lemma Ideal.zeroLocus_inj_of_pure {I J : Ideal R} [I.Pure] [J.Pure] :
    zeroLocus (I : Set R) = zeroLocus J ↔ I = J
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ h ▸ rfl⟩
  rw [← I.ker_piRingHom_atPrime_eq_of_pure, ← J.ker_piRingHom_atPrime_eq_of_pure]
  generalize hs : zeroLocus (I : Set R) = s
  generalize ht : zeroLocus (J : Set R) = t
  obtain rfl : s = t := by rw [← hs, ← ht, h]
  rfl
