proof: := by simp

name: span_singleton_zero
statement: theorem span_singleton_zero : span ({0} : Set α) = ⊥
proof: := by simp

name: span_singleton_ne_top
statement:
theorem span_singleton_ne_top {α : Type*} [CommSemiring α] {x : α} (hx : ¬IsUnit x) :
    Ideal.span ({x} : Set α) ≠ ⊤
proof:
:=
  (Ideal.ne_top_iff_one _).mpr fun h1 =>
    let ⟨y, hy⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp h1
    hx ⟨⟨x, y, mul_comm y x ▸ hy, hy⟩, rfl⟩

name: span_zero
statement: theorem span_zero : span (0 : Set α) = ⊥
proof: := by simp

name: span_insert_zero
statement: theorem span_insert_zero {s : Set α} : span (insert (0 : α) s) = span s
proof: := by simp

name: span_sdiff_singleton_zero
statement: lemma span_sdiff_singleton_zero {s : Set α} : span (s \ {0}) = span s
proof: := by simp

name: span_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem span_one : span (1 : Set α) = ⊤
proof: := by rw [← Set.singleton_one, span_singleton_one]

name: span_eq_top_iff_finite
statement:
theorem span_eq_top_iff_finite (s : Set α) :
    span s = ⊤ ↔ ∃ s' : Finset α, ↑s' ⊆ s ∧ span (s' : Set α) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [eq_top_iff_one]
  exact ⟨Submodule.mem_span_finite_of_mem_span, fun ⟨s', h₁, h₂⟩ => span_mono h₁ h₂⟩

name: mem_span_singleton_sup
statement:
theorem mem_span_singleton_sup {x y : α} {I : Ideal α} :
    x ∈ Ideal.span {y} ⊔ I ↔ ∃ a : α, ∃ b ∈ I, a * y + b = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.mem_sup]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ya, hya, b, hb, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := mem_span_singleton'.mp hya
    exact ⟨a, b, hb, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, b, hb, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨a * y, Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mpr ⟨a, rfl⟩, b, hb, rfl⟩

name: zero_ne_one_of_proper
statement: theorem zero_ne_one_of_proper {I : Ideal α} (h : I ≠ ⊤) : (0 : α) ≠ 1
proof:
:= fun hz =>
  I.ne_top_iff_one.1 h <| hz ▸ I.zero_mem

name: span_pair_comm
statement: theorem span_pair_comm {x y : α} : (span {x, y} : Ideal α) = span {y, x}
proof:
:= by
  simp only [span_insert, sup_comm]

name: mem_span_pair
statement: theorem mem_span_pair {x y z : α} : z ∈ span ({x, y} : Set α) ↔ ∃ a b, a * x + b * y = z
proof:
:=
  Submodule.mem_span_pair

name: span_pair_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem span_pair_zero (x : α) : span {x, 0} = span {x}
proof:
:= by
  rw [span_pair_comm, span_insert_zero]

name: span_range_eq_iSup
statement: lemma span_range_eq_iSup (x : ι → α) : span (range x) = ⨆ i, span {x i}
proof:
:= by
  rw [← span_iUnion, iUnion_singleton_eq_range]

name: span_range_eq_span_range_support
statement:
lemma span_range_eq_span_range_support (x : ι → α) :
    span (range x) = span (range fun i : x.support ↦ x i.val)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← span_sdiff_singleton_zero (s := range x), Function.support]
  congr
  ext1 a
  simp only [mem_sdiff, mem_range, mem_singleton_iff]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, ha⟩ ↦ ⟨⟨i, mem_ofPred.mpr (hi ▸ ha)⟩, hi⟩,
    fun ⟨j, hj⟩ ↦ ⟨⟨j.val, hj⟩, by grind⟩⟩

name: mem_span_singleton
statement: theorem mem_span_singleton {x y : α} : x ∈ span ({y} : Set α) ↔ y ∣ x
proof:
:=
  mem_span_singleton'.trans <| exists_congr fun _ => by rw [eq_comm, mul_comm]

name: span_singleton_le_span_singleton
statement:
theorem span_singleton_le_span_singleton {x y : α} :
    span ({x} : Set α) ≤ span ({y} : Set α) ↔ y ∣ x
proof:
:=
  span_le.trans <| singleton_subset_iff.trans mem_span_singleton

name: span_singleton_eq_span_singleton
statement:
theorem span_singleton_eq_span_singleton {α : Type u} [CommSemiring α] [IsDomain α] {x y : α} :
    span ({x} : Set α) = span ({y} : Set α) ↔ Associated x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← dvd_dvd_iff_associated, le_antisymm_iff, and_comm]
  apply and_congr <;> rw [span_singleton_le_span_singleton]

name: span_pair_eq_span_left_iff_dvd
statement:
@[simp]
theorem span_pair_eq_span_left_iff_dvd {x y : α} : span {x, y} = span {x} ↔ x ∣ y
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.span_insert, sup_eq_left, span_singleton_le_span_singleton]

name: span_pair_eq_span_right_iff_dvd
statement:
@[simp]
theorem span_pair_eq_span_right_iff_dvd {x y : α} : span {x, y} = span {y} ↔ y ∣ x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.span_insert, sup_eq_right, span_singleton_le_span_singleton]

name: span_singleton_mul_right_unit
statement:
theorem span_singleton_mul_right_unit {a : α} (h2 : IsUnit a) (x : α) :
    span ({x * a} : Set α) = span {x}
proof: := by rw [mul_comm, span_singleton_mul_left_unit h2]

name: span_singleton_eq_top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem span_singleton_eq_top {x} : span ({x} : Set α) = ⊤ ↔ IsUnit x
proof:
:= by
  rw [isUnit_iff_dvd_one, ← span_singleton_le_span_singleton, span_singleton_one, eq_top_iff]

name: factors_decreasing
statement:
theorem factors_decreasing [IsDomain α] (b₁ b₂ : α) (h₁ : b₁ ≠ 0) (h₂ : ¬IsUnit b₂) :
    span ({b₁ * b₂} : Set α) < span {b₁}
proof:
:=
  lt_of_le_not_ge
    (Ideal.span_le.2 <| singleton_subset_iff.2 <| Ideal.mem_span_singleton.2 ⟨b₂, rfl⟩) fun h =>
    h₂ <| isUnit_of_dvd_one <|
        (mul_dvd_mul_iff_left h₁).1 <| by rwa [mul_one, ← Ideal.span_singleton_le_span_singleton]

name: mem_iff_of_associated
statement: lemma mem_iff_of_associated {x y : α} (h : Associated x y) : x ∈ I ↔ y ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := h.symm
  exact I.mul_unit_mem_iff_mem u.isUnit

name: mem_span_insert'
statement: theorem mem_span_insert' : x ∈ span (insert y s) ↔ ∃ a, x + a * y ∈ span s
proof:
:=
  Submodule.mem_span_insert'

name: span_singleton_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem span_singleton_neg : span {-x} = span {x}
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp only [mem_span_singleton']
  exact ⟨fun ⟨y, h⟩ => ⟨-y, h ▸ neg_mul_comm y x⟩, fun ⟨y, h⟩ => ⟨-y, h ▸ neg_mul_neg y x⟩⟩

name: span_insert_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem span_insert_neg : span (insert (-x) s) = span (insert x s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [span_insert, span_singleton_neg, span_insert]

name: span_pair_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem span_pair_neg : span {x, -y} = span {x, y}
proof:
:= by
  rw [span_pair_comm, span_insert_neg, span_pair_comm]

name: span_pair_add_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem span_pair_add_right : span {x + y, y} = span {x, y}
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp_rw [mem_span_pair]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨a, b, h⟩ => ⟨a, b + a, by rw [add_comm b, add_mul, ← add_assoc, ← mul_add, h]⟩,
    fun ⟨a, b, h⟩ => ⟨a, b - a, by rw [mul_add, sub_mul, add_add_sub_cancel, h]⟩⟩

name: span_pair_add_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem span_pair_add_left : span {x, y + x} = span {x, y}
proof:
:= by
  rw [span_pair_comm, span_pair_add_right, span_pair_comm]

name: span_pair_right_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem span_pair_right_add : span {y + x, y} = span {x, y}
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm, span_pair_add_right]

name: span_pair_left_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem span_pair_left_add : span {x, x + y} = span {x, y}
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm, span_pair_add_left]

name: span_pair_sub_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem span_pair_sub_right : span {x - y, y} = span {x, y}
proof:
:= by
  rw [← span_pair_add_right, sub_add_cancel]

name: span_pair_sub_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem span_pair_sub_left : span {x, y - x} = span {x, y}
proof:
:= by
  rw [← span_pair_add_left, sub_add_cancel]

name: span_pair_sub_right'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem span_pair_sub_right' : span {x, x - y} = span {x, y}
proof:
:= by
  rw [← span_pair_sub_left, sub_sub_cancel_left, span_pair_neg]

name: span_pair_sub_left'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem span_pair_sub_left' : span {y - x, y} = span {x, y}
proof:
:= by
  rw [← span_pair_sub_right, sub_sub_cancel_left, span_insert_neg]

name: span_singleton_abs
statement:
@[simp]
theorem span_singleton_abs [LinearOrder α] : span {|x|} = span {x}
proof:
:= by
  obtain h | h := abs_choice x <;>
  simp [h]

name: span_insert_abs
statement:
@[simp]
theorem span_insert_abs [LinearOrder α] : span (insert |x| s) = span (insert x s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [span_insert, span_singleton_abs, span_insert]

name: span_pair_abs
statement:
@[simp]
theorem span_pair_abs [LinearOrder α] : span {x, |y|} = span {x, y}
proof:
:= by
  rw [span_pair_comm, span_insert_abs, span_pair_comm]

name: span_pair_add_right_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem span_pair_add_right_mul : span {x + y * z, y} = span {x, y}
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp_rw [mem_span_pair]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨a, b, h⟩ => ⟨a, b + a * z, by rw [← h]; ring1⟩,
    fun ⟨a, b, h⟩ => ⟨a, b - a * z, by rw [← h]; ring1⟩⟩

name: span_pair_add_left_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem span_pair_add_left_mul : span {x, y + x * z} = span {x, y}
proof:
:= by
  rw [span_pair_comm, span_pair_add_right_mul, span_pair_comm]

name: span_pair_right_mul_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem span_pair_right_mul_add : span {y * z + x, y} = span {x, y}
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm, span_pair_add_right_mul]

name: span_pair_left_mul_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem span_pair_left_mul_add : span {x, x * z + y} = span {x, y}
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm, span_pair_add_left_mul]

name: span_pair_add_mul_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem span_pair_add_mul_right : span {x + z * y, y} = span {x, y}
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm, span_pair_add_right_mul]

name: span_pair_add_mul_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem span_pair_add_mul_left : span {x, y + z * x} = span {x, y}
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm, span_pair_add_left_mul]

name: span_pair_mul_right_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem span_pair_mul_right_add : span {z * y + x, y} = span {x, y}
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm, span_pair_right_mul_add]

name: span_pair_mul_left_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem span_pair_mul_left_add : span {x, z * x + y} = span {x, y}
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm, span_pair_left_mul_add]

name: span_pair_sub_right_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem span_pair_sub_right_mul : span {x - y * z, y} = span {x, y}
proof:
:= by
  rw [← span_pair_add_right_mul, sub_add_cancel]

name: span_pair_sub_left_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem span_pair_sub_left_mul : span {x, y - x * z} = span {x, y}
proof:
:= by
  rw [← span_pair_add_left_mul, sub_add_cancel]

name: span_pair_sub_mul_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem span_pair_sub_mul_right : span {x - z * y, y} = span {x, y}
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm, span_pair_sub_right_mul]

name: span_pair_sub_mul_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem span_pair_sub_mul_left : span {x, y - z * x} = span {x, y}
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm, span_pair_sub_left_mul]

name: ker_toSpanSingleton_eq_span
statement:
theorem ker_toSpanSingleton_eq_span :
    LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton R R e) = Ideal.span {1 - e}
proof:
:= SetLike.ext fun x ↦ by
  rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton']
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨x, by rw [mul_sub, show x * e = 0 from h, mul_one, sub_zero]⟩, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := h
  change x * (1 - e) * e = 0
  rw [mul_assoc, sub_mul, one_mul, he, sub_self, mul_zero]

name: ker_toSpanSingleton_one_sub_eq_span
statement:
theorem ker_toSpanSingleton_one_sub_eq_span :
    LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton R R (1 - e)) = Ideal.span {e}
proof:
:= by
  rw [ker_toSpanSingleton_eq_span he.one_sub, sub_sub_cancel]

name: exists_monic_span
statement:
lemma exists_monic_span {k : Type*} [Field k] (I : Ideal k[X]) (ne : I ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ f, f.Monic ∧ I = Ideal.span {f}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨x, h, spanx⟩ := Ideal.exists_normalized_span_of_isPrincipal I
  refine ⟨x, (Polynomial.normalize_eq_self_iff_monic ?_).mp h, spanx⟩
  by_contra eq0
  simp [eq0, spanx] at ne

name: exists_monic_span_sup_map_eq
proof:
:= by
  let q := p.comap C
  let : Field (R ⧸ q) := Ideal.Quotient.field q
  have ne' : Ideal.map (mapRingHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk q)) p ≠ ⊥ := by
    simp only [ne_eq, map_eq_bot_iff_le_ker, Polynomial.ker_mapRingHom, q, mk_ker]
    exact not_le_of_gt (lt_of_le_of_ne Ideal.map_comap_le ne.symm)
  rcases Polynomial.exists_monic_span _ ne' with ⟨y, mony, hy⟩
  have : y ∈ lifts (Ideal.Quotient.mk q) := map_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective _
  rcases Polynomial.lifts_and_natDegree_eq_and_monic this mony with ⟨f, hf, deg, monf⟩
  use f, monf
  trans comap (mapRingHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk q)) ((span {f}).map (mapRingHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk q)))
  · rw [Ideal.map_span, coe_mapRingHom, Set.image_singleton, hf, ← hy,
      Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective' _ (map_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective)]
    simpa [Polynomial.ker_mapRingHom, q] using Ideal.map_comap_le
  · rw [Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective' _ (map_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective),
      sup_comm, Polynomial.ker_mapRingHom, mk_ker]

name: Finsupp.submodule_smul
statement:
lemma Finsupp.submodule_smul {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (ι : Type*) (p : ι → Submodule R M) (I : Ideal R) :
    Finsupp.submodule (fun i ↦ I • p i) = I • Finsupp.submodule p
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Finsupp.submodule_eq_iSup, Submodule.map_smul'', ← Submodule.smul_iSup]

name: sum_mem
statement:
theorem sum_mem (I : Ideal α) {ι : Type*} {t : Finset ι} {f : ι → α} :
    (∀ c ∈ t, f c ∈ I) → (∑ i ∈ t, f i) ∈ I
proof:
:=
  Submodule.sum_mem I

name: isPrime_iff
statement: theorem isPrime_iff {I : Ideal α} : IsPrime I ↔ I ≠ ⊤ ∧ ∀ {x y : α}, x * y ∈ I → x ∈ I ∨ y ∈ I

name: IsPrime.ne_top
statement: theorem IsPrime.ne_top {I : Ideal α} (hI : I.IsPrime) : I ≠ ⊤

name: notMem_of_isUnit
statement: lemma notMem_of_isUnit (I : Ideal α) [I.IsPrime] {x : α} (hx : IsUnit x) : x ∉ I
proof:
:=
  fun h ↦ ‹I.IsPrime›.ne_top (eq_top_of_isUnit_mem _ h hx)

name: IsPrime.one_notMem
statement: theorem IsPrime.one_notMem {I : Ideal α} (hI : I.IsPrime) : 1 ∉ I
proof:
:=
  notMem_of_isUnit _ isUnit_one

name: one_notMem
statement: theorem one_notMem (I : Ideal α) [hI : I.IsPrime] : 1 ∉ I
proof:
:=
  hI.one_notMem

name: IsPrime.mem_or_mem
statement: theorem IsPrime.mem_or_mem {I : Ideal α} (hI : I.IsPrime) {x y : α} : x * y ∈ I → x ∈ I ∨ y ∈ I

name: IsPrime.mul_notMem
statement:
theorem IsPrime.mul_notMem {I : Ideal α} (hI : I.IsPrime) {x y : α} :
    x ∉ I → y ∉ I → x * y ∉ I
proof:
:= fun hx hy h ↦
  hy ((hI.mem_or_mem h).resolve_left hx)

name: IsPrime.mem_or_mem_of_mul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem IsPrime.mem_or_mem_of_mul_eq_zero {I : Ideal α} (hI : I.IsPrime) {x y : α} (h : x * y = 0) :
    x ∈ I ∨ y ∈ I
proof:
:=
  hI.mem_or_mem (h.symm ▸ I.zero_mem)

name: IsPrime.mem_of_pow_mem
statement:
theorem IsPrime.mem_of_pow_mem {I : Ideal α} (hI : I.IsPrime) {r : α} (n : ℕ) (H : r ^ n ∈ I) :
    r ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    rw [pow_zero] at H
    exact hI.one_notMem.elim H
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ] at H
    exact Or.casesOn (hI.mem_or_mem H) ih id

name: not_isPrime_iff
statement:
theorem not_isPrime_iff {I : Ideal α} :
    ¬I.IsPrime ↔ I = ⊤ ∨ ∃ (x : α) (_hx : x ∉ I) (y : α) (_hy : y ∉ I), x * y ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Ideal.isPrime_iff, not_and_or, Ne, Classical.not_not, not_forall, not_or]
  exact
    or_congr Iff.rfl
      ⟨fun ⟨x, y, hxy, hx, hy⟩ => ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hxy⟩, fun ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hxy⟩ =>
        ⟨x, y, hxy, hx, hy⟩⟩

name: IsPrime.mul_mem_iff_mem_or_mem
statement:
theorem IsPrime.mul_mem_iff_mem_or_mem {I : Ideal α} [I.IsTwoSided] (hI : I.IsPrime) :
    ∀ {x y : α}, x * y ∈ I ↔ x ∈ I ∨ y ∈ I
proof:
:= @fun x y =>
  ⟨hI.mem_or_mem, by
    rintro (h | h)
    exacts [I.mul_mem_right y h, I.mul_mem_left x h]⟩

name: IsPrime.pow_mem_iff_mem
statement:
theorem IsPrime.pow_mem_iff_mem {I : Ideal α} (hI : I.IsPrime) {r : α} (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    r ^ n ∈ I ↔ r ∈ I
proof:
:=
  ⟨hI.mem_of_pow_mem n, fun hr => I.pow_mem_of_mem hr n hn⟩

name: IsPrime.mul_mem_left_iff
statement:
lemma IsPrime.mul_mem_left_iff {I : Ideal α} [I.IsTwoSided] [I.IsPrime]
    {x y : α} (hx : x ∉ I) : x * y ∈ I ↔ y ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  grind [Ideal.IsPrime.mul_mem_iff_mem_or_mem]

name: IsPrime.mul_mem_right_iff
statement:
lemma IsPrime.mul_mem_right_iff {I : Ideal α} [I.IsTwoSided] [I.IsPrime]
    {x y : α} (hx : y ∉ I) : x * y ∈ I ↔ x ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.IsPrime.mul_mem_iff_mem_or_mem] <;> aesop

name: mem_primeCompl_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_primeCompl_iff {P : Ideal α} [P.IsPrime] {x : α} :
    x ∈ P.primeCompl ↔ x ∉ P
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: primeCompl_bot
statement:
theorem primeCompl_bot [Nontrivial α] [NoZeroDivisors α] :
    (⊥ : Ideal α).primeCompl = nonZeroDivisors α
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp

name: IsDomain.of_bot_isPrime
statement: theorem IsDomain.of_bot_isPrime (A : Type*) [Ring A] [hbp : (⊥ : Ideal A).IsPrime] : IsDomain A
proof:
:=
  @NoZeroDivisors.to_isDomain A _ ⟨1, 0, fun h => hbp.one_notMem h⟩ ⟨fun h => hbp.2 h⟩

name: eq_bot_of_prime
statement: theorem eq_bot_of_prime [h : I.IsPrime] : I = ⊥
proof:
:=
  or_iff_not_imp_right.mp I.eq_bot_or_top h.1

name: map_toCotangent_ker
statement: theorem map_toCotangent_ker : (LinearMap.ker I.toCotangent).map I.subtype = I ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.toCotangent, Submodule.ker_mkQ, pow_two, Submodule.map_smul'' I ⊤ (Submodule.subtype I),
    smul_eq_mul, Submodule.map_subtype_top]

name: mem_toCotangent_ker
statement: theorem mem_toCotangent_ker {x : I} : x ∈ LinearMap.ker I.toCotangent ↔ (x : R) ∈ I ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← I.map_toCotangent_ker]
  simp

name: toCotangent_eq
statement: theorem toCotangent_eq {x y : I} : I.toCotangent x = I.toCotangent y ↔ (x - y : R) ∈ I ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero]
  exact I.mem_toCotangent_ker

name: toCotangent_eq_zero
statement: theorem toCotangent_eq_zero (x : I) : I.toCotangent x = 0 ↔ (x : R) ∈ I ^ 2
proof: := I.mem_toCotangent_ker

name: toCotangent_surjective
statement: theorem toCotangent_surjective : Function.Surjective I.toCotangent
proof: := Submodule.mkQ_surjective _

name: toCotangent_range
statement: theorem toCotangent_range : LinearMap.range I.toCotangent = ⊤
proof: := Submodule.range_mkQ _

name: cotangent_subsingleton_iff
statement: theorem cotangent_subsingleton_iff : Subsingleton I.Cotangent ↔ IsIdempotentElem I
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro H
    refine (pow_two I).symm.trans (le_antisymm (Ideal.pow_le_self two_ne_zero) ?_)
    exact fun x hx => (I.toCotangent_eq_zero ⟨x, hx⟩).mp (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
  · exact fun e =>
      ⟨fun x y =>
        Quotient.inductionOn₂' x y fun x y =>
          I.toCotangent_eq.mpr <| ((pow_two I).trans e).symm ▸ I.sub_mem x.prop y.prop⟩

name: to_quotient_square_comp_toCotangent
statement:
theorem to_quotient_square_comp_toCotangent :
    I.cotangentToQuotientSquare.comp I.toCotangent = (I ^ 2).mkQ.comp (Submodule.subtype I)
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext fun _ => rfl

name: toCotangent_to_quotient_square
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toCotangent_to_quotient_square (x : I) :
    I.cotangentToQuotientSquare (I.toCotangent x) = (I ^ 2).mkQ x
proof: := rfl

name: cotangentToQuotientSquare_injective
statement: lemma cotangentToQuotientSquare_injective : Function.Injective I.cotangentToQuotientSquare
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := I.toCotangent_surjective x
  rw [toCotangent_to_quotient_square] at hx
  rwa [Ideal.toCotangent_eq_zero, ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero (I ^ 2)]

name: Cotangent.smul_eq_zero_of_mem
statement:
lemma Cotangent.smul_eq_zero_of_mem {I : Ideal R}
    {x} (hx : x ∈ I) (m : I.Cotangent) : x • m = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Ideal.toCotangent_surjective _ m
  rw [← map_smul, Ideal.toCotangent_eq_zero, pow_two]
  exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul hx m.2

name: isTorsionBySet_cotangent
statement:
lemma isTorsionBySet_cotangent :
    Module.IsTorsionBySet R I.Cotangent I
proof:
:=
  fun m x ↦ m.smul_eq_zero_of_mem x.2

name: cotangentIdeal_square
statement: theorem cotangentIdeal_square (I : Ideal R) : I.cotangentIdeal ^ 2 = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_bot_iff, pow_two I.cotangentIdeal, ← smul_eq_mul]
  intro x hx
  refine Submodule.smul_induction_on hx ?_ ?_
  · rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩; apply (Submodule.Quotient.eq _).mpr _
    rw [sub_zero, pow_two]; exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul hx hy
  · intro x y hx hy; exact add_mem hx hy

name: mk_mem_cotangentIdeal
statement:
lemma mk_mem_cotangentIdeal {I : Ideal R} {x : R} :
    Quotient.mk (I ^ 2) x ∈ I.cotangentIdeal ↔ x ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨y, hy, e⟩ ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ⟨x, h, rfl⟩⟩
  simpa using sub_mem hy (Ideal.pow_le_self two_ne_zero
    ((Ideal.Quotient.mk_eq_mk_iff_sub_mem _ _).mp e))

name: comap_cotangentIdeal
statement:
lemma comap_cotangentIdeal (I : Ideal R) :
    I.cotangentIdeal.comap (Quotient.mk (I ^ 2)) = I
proof:
:=
  Ideal.ext fun _ ↦ mk_mem_cotangentIdeal

name: range_cotangentToQuotientSquare
statement:
theorem range_cotangentToQuotientSquare :
    LinearMap.range I.cotangentToQuotientSquare = I.cotangentIdeal.restrictScalars R
proof:
:= by
  trans LinearMap.range (I.cotangentToQuotientSquare.comp I.toCotangent)
  · rw [LinearMap.range_comp, I.toCotangent_range, Submodule.map_top]
  · rw [to_quotient_square_comp_toCotangent, LinearMap.range_comp, I.range_subtype]; ext; rfl

name: cotangentEquivIdeal_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cotangentEquivIdeal_apply (x : I.Cotangent) :
    ↑(I.cotangentEquivIdeal x) = I.cotangentToQuotientSquare x
proof: := rfl

name: cotangentEquivIdeal_symm_apply
statement:
theorem cotangentEquivIdeal_symm_apply (x : R) (hx : x ∈ I) :
    I.cotangentEquivIdeal.symm ⟨(I ^ 2).mkQ x, Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hx⟩ =
      I.toCotangent ⟨x, hx⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp [I.cotangentEquivIdeal.symm_apply_eq, Subtype.ext_iff]

name: _root_.AlgHom.kerSquareLift_mk
statement: lemma _root_.AlgHom.kerSquareLift_mk (f : A →ₐ[R] B) (x : A) : f.kerSquareLift x = f x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: _root_.AlgHom.ker_kerSquareLift
statement:
theorem _root_.AlgHom.ker_kerSquareLift (f : A →ₐ[R] B) :
    RingHom.ker f.kerSquareLift.toRingHom = (RingHom.ker f.toRingHom).cotangentIdeal
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx; obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x; exact ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩; exact hx

name: mapCotangent_toCotangent
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mapCotangent_toCotangent
    (I₁ : Ideal A) (I₂ : Ideal B) (f : A →ₐ[R] B) (h : I₁ ≤ I₂.comap f) (x : I₁) :
    Ideal.mapCotangent I₁ I₂ f h (Ideal.toCotangent I₁ x) = Ideal.toCotangent I₂ ⟨f x, h x.2⟩
proof: := rfl

name: lift_toCotangent
statement:
@[simp]
lemma lift_toCotangent (f : I →ₗ[R] M) (hf : ∀ (x y : I), f (x * y) = 0) (x : I) :
    Cotangent.lift f hf (I.toCotangent x) = f x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: lift_comp_toCotangent
statement:
@[simp]
lemma lift_comp_toCotangent (f : I →ₗ[R] M) (hf : ∀ (x y : I), f (x * y) = 0) :
    Cotangent.lift f hf ∘ₗ I.toCotangent = f
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: lift_surjective_iff
statement:
lemma lift_surjective_iff (f : I →ₗ[R] M) (hf : ∀ (x y : I), f (x * y) = 0) :
    Function.Surjective (Cotangent.lift f hf) ↔ Function.Surjective f
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [← Cotangent.lift_comp_toCotangent f hf, LinearMap.coe_comp]
    exact Function.Surjective.comp h (toCotangent_surjective I)
  · dsimp [Cotangent.lift]
    exact QuotientAddGroup.lift_surjective_of_surjective _ _ h _

name: equivOfEq_toCotangent
statement:
@[simp]
lemma equivOfEq_toCotangent (I J : Ideal R) (hIJ : I = J) (x : I) :
    Cotangent.equivOfEq I J hIJ (I.toCotangent x) = J.toCotangent (LinearEquiv.ofEq I J hIJ x)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: equivOfEq_symm
statement:
@[simp]
lemma equivOfEq_symm (I J : Ideal R) (hIJ : I = J) :
    (Cotangent.equivOfEq I J hIJ).symm = Cotangent.equivOfEq J I hIJ.symm
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: subsingleton_cotangentSpace_iff
statement:
lemma subsingleton_cotangentSpace_iff [IsNoetherianRing R] :
    Subsingleton (CotangentSpace R) ↔ IsField R
proof:
:= by
  refine (maximalIdeal R).cotangent_subsingleton_iff.trans ?_
  rw [IsLocalRing.isField_iff_maximalIdeal_eq,
    Ideal.isIdempotentElem_iff_eq_bot_or_top_of_isLocalRing]
  simp [(maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top]

name: CotangentSpace.map_eq_top_iff
statement:
lemma CotangentSpace.map_eq_top_iff [IsNoetherianRing R] {M : Submodule R (maximalIdeal R)} :
    M.map (maximalIdeal R).toCotangent = ⊤ ↔ M = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun H ↦ eq_top_iff.mpr ?_, by rintro rfl; simp [Ideal.toCotangent_range]⟩
  refine (Submodule.map_le_map_iff_of_injective (Submodule.injective_subtype _) _ _).mp ?_
  rw [Submodule.map_top, Submodule.range_subtype]
  apply Submodule.le_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson_bot (IsNoetherian.noetherian _)
    (IsLocalRing.jacobson_eq_maximalIdeal _ bot_ne_top).ge
  rw [smul_eq_mul, ← pow_two, ← Ideal.map_toCotangent_ker, ← Submodule.map_sup,
    ← Submodule.comap_map_eq, H, Submodule.comap_top, Submodule.map_top, Submodule.range_subtype]

name: CotangentSpace.span_image_eq_top_iff
statement:
lemma CotangentSpace.span_image_eq_top_iff [IsNoetherianRing R] {s : Set (maximalIdeal R)} :
    Submodule.span (ResidueField R) ((maximalIdeal R).toCotangent '' s) = ⊤ ↔
      Submodule.span R s = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_eq_top_iff, ← (Submodule.restrictScalars_injective R ..).eq_iff,
    Submodule.restrictScalars_span]
  · simp
  · exact Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective

name: rank_cotangentSpace_eq_spanrank_maximalIdeal_of_fg
statement:
theorem rank_cotangentSpace_eq_spanrank_maximalIdeal_of_fg (fg : (maximalIdeal R).FG) :
    Module.rank (ResidueField R) (CotangentSpace R) = (maximalIdeal R).spanRank
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.rank_eq_spanRank_of_free, ← Submodule.spanRank_top (maximalIdeal R)]
  apply le_antisymm
  · obtain ⟨s, hs_card, hs_span⟩ :=
      (⊤ : Submodule R (maximalIdeal R)).exists_span_set_card_eq_spanRank
    have hs_span' : Submodule.span (ResidueField R) ((maximalIdeal R).toCotangent '' s) = ⊤ := by
      rw [← Submodule.restrictScalars_eq_top_iff R,
        Submodule.restrictScalars_span R (ResidueField R) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective,
        ← Submodule.map_span, hs_span, Submodule.map_top, Ideal.toCotangent_range]
    rw [← hs_card, ← hs_span']
    grw [Submodule.spanRank_span_le_card, Cardinal.mk_image_le]
  · obtain ⟨s, hs_card, hs_span⟩ :=
      (⊤ : Submodule (ResidueField R) (CotangentSpace R)).exists_span_set_card_eq_spanRank
    have hs_span' : Submodule.span R s =
        Submodule.map (Submodule.mkQ (maximalIdeal R • (⊤ : Submodule R (maximalIdeal R)))) ⊤ := by
      rw [Submodule.map_top, Submodule.range_mkQ]
      change Submodule.span R s = ⊤
      rw [← Submodule.restrictScalars_span R (ResidueField R)
        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective, hs_span, Submodule.restrictScalars_top]
    obtain ⟨t, ht_inj, ht_image, ht_span⟩ :=
      Submodule.exists_injOn_mkQ_image_span_eq_of_span_eq_map_mkQ_of_le_jacobson_bot s
        ((Submodule.fg_top (maximalIdeal R)).mpr fg)
        (IsLocalRing.jacobson_eq_maximalIdeal _ bot_ne_top).ge
        hs_span'
    rw [← hs_card, ← ht_span, ← ht_image]
    exact le_of_le_of_eq (Submodule.spanRank_span_le_card t)
      (Cardinal.mk_image_eq_of_injOn _ _ ht_inj).symm

name: rank_cotangentSpace_eq_spanrank_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem rank_cotangentSpace_eq_spanrank_maximalIdeal [IsNoetherianRing R] :
    Module.rank (ResidueField R) (CotangentSpace R) = (maximalIdeal R).spanRank
proof:
:=
  rank_cotangentSpace_eq_spanrank_maximalIdeal_of_fg (maximalIdeal R).fg_of_isNoetherianRing

name: finrank_cotangentSpace_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma finrank_cotangentSpace_eq_zero_iff [IsNoetherianRing R] :
    finrank (ResidueField R) (CotangentSpace R) = 0 ↔ IsField R
proof:
:= by
  rw [finrank_zero_iff, subsingleton_cotangentSpace_iff]

name: finrank_cotangentSpace_eq_zero
statement:
lemma finrank_cotangentSpace_eq_zero (R) [Field R] :
    finrank (ResidueField R) (CotangentSpace R) = 0
proof:
:=
  finrank_cotangentSpace_eq_zero_iff.mpr (Field.toIsField R)

name: finrank_cotangentSpace_le_one_iff
statement:
theorem finrank_cotangentSpace_le_one_iff [IsNoetherianRing R] :
    finrank (ResidueField R) (CotangentSpace R) ≤ 1 ↔ (maximalIdeal R).IsPrincipal
proof:
:= by
  rw [Module.finrank_le_one_iff_top_isPrincipal, isPrincipal_iff,
    (maximalIdeal R).toCotangent_surjective.exists, isPrincipal_iff]
  simp_rw [← Set.image_singleton, eq_comm (a := ⊤), CotangentSpace.span_image_eq_top_iff,
    ← (map_injective_of_injective (injective_subtype _)).eq_iff, map_span, Set.image_singleton,
    Submodule.map_top, range_subtype, eq_comm (a := maximalIdeal R)]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨x, h⟩ ↦ ⟨_, h⟩, fun ⟨x, h⟩ ↦ ⟨⟨x, h ▸ subset_span (Set.mem_singleton x)⟩, h⟩⟩

name: Ideal.mapCotangent_surjective_of_comap_eq
statement:
lemma Ideal.mapCotangent_surjective_of_comap_eq (surj : Function.Surjective (algebraMap A B))
    {I : Ideal B} {J : Ideal A} (eq : I.comap (algebraMap A B) = RingHom.ker (algebraMap A B) ⊔ J) :
    Function.Surjective (Ideal.mapCotangent J I (Algebra.ofId A B)
      (le_of_le_of_eq le_sup_right eq.symm))
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  rcases I.toCotangent_surjective x with ⟨x', rfl⟩
  rcases Ideal.exists_of_comap_eq_ker_sup _ surj eq x'.2 with ⟨y', mem, hy'⟩
  use J.toCotangent ⟨y', mem⟩
  simpa using I.toCotangent.congr_arg (SetCoe.ext hy')

name: Ideal.mapCotangent_ker_of_surjective
statement:
lemma Ideal.mapCotangent_ker_of_surjective (surj : Function.Surjective (algebraMap A B))
    {I : Ideal B} {J : Ideal A} (eq : I.comap (algebraMap A B) = RingHom.ker (algebraMap A B) ⊔ J) :
    (Ideal.mapCotangent J I (Algebra.ofId A B) (le_of_le_of_eq le_sup_right eq.symm)).ker =
      (Submodule.comap J.subtype ((RingHom.ker (algebraMap A B)) ⊓ J)).map J.toCotangent
proof:
:= by
  have eqmap := Ideal.eq_map_of_comap_eq_ker_sup _ surj eq
  refine le_antisymm (fun x hx ↦ ?_) ?_
  · rcases J.toCotangent_surjective x with ⟨x', hx'⟩
    have : Function.Surjective (Algebra.ofId A B) := surj
    simp only [← hx', LinearMap.mem_ker, Ideal.mapCotangent_toCotangent,
      Ideal.toCotangent_eq_zero, eqmap, Algebra.ofId_apply] at hx
    rw [← Ideal.map_pow, ← Ideal.mem_comap, Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective' _ surj] at hx
    rcases Submodule.mem_sup.mp hx with ⟨y, hy, z, hz, hyz⟩
    have : y + z ∈ J := by simp [hyz]
    have zmemJ := (Ideal.add_mem_iff_right J (Ideal.pow_le_self (by omega) hy)).mp this
    have xeq : x = J.toCotangent ⟨z, zmemJ⟩ := by simpa [← hx', J.toCotangent_eq, ← hyz] using hy
    rw [xeq]
    exact Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (Submodule.mem_comap.mpr (Ideal.mem_inf.mpr ⟨hz, zmemJ⟩))
  · rw [Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap, ← LinearMap.ker_comp]
    intro x hx
    simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.comp_apply, Ideal.mapCotangent_toCotangent]
    convert! map_zero I.toCotangent
    exact (Ideal.mem_inf.mp hx).1

name: basisSpanSingleton_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem basisSpanSingleton_apply (b : Basis ι R S) {x : S} (hx : x ≠ 0) (i : ι) :
    (basisSpanSingleton b hx i : S) = x * b i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [basisSpanSingleton, Basis.map_apply, LinearEquiv.trans_apply,
    Submodule.restrictScalarsEquiv_apply, LinearEquiv.ofInjective_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_ofEq_apply,
    LinearEquiv.restrictScalars_apply, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply]

name: constr_basisSpanSingleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem constr_basisSpanSingleton {N : Type*} [Semiring N] [Module N S] [SMulCommClass R N S]
    (b : Basis ι R S) {x : S} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    (b.constr N).toFun (((↑) : _ → S) ∘ (basisSpanSingleton b hx)) = Algebra.lmul R S x
proof:
:=
  b.ext fun i => by simp

name: Basis.mem_ideal_iff
statement:
theorem Basis.mem_ideal_iff {ι R S : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [Semiring S] [Algebra R S]
    {I : Ideal S} (b : Basis ι R I) {x : S} :
    x ∈ I ↔ ∃ c : ι →₀ R, x = Finsupp.sum c fun i x => x • (b i : S)
proof:
:=
  (b.map ((I.restrictScalarsEquiv R _ _).restrictScalars R).symm).mem_submodule_iff

name: Basis.mem_ideal_iff'
statement:
theorem Basis.mem_ideal_iff' {ι R S : Type*} [Fintype ι] [CommSemiring R] [Semiring S] [Algebra R S]
    {I : Ideal S} (b : Basis ι R I) {x : S} : x ∈ I ↔ ∃ c : ι → R, x = ∑ i, c i • (b i : S)
proof:
:=
  (b.map ((I.restrictScalarsEquiv R _ _).restrictScalars R).symm).mem_submodule_iff'

name: eq_top_of_unit_mem
statement: theorem eq_top_of_unit_mem (x y : α) (hx : x ∈ I) (h : y * x = 1) : I = ⊤
proof:
:=
  eq_top_iff.2 fun z _ =>
    calc
      z * y * x ∈ I := I.mul_mem_left _ hx
      _ = z * (y * x) := mul_assoc z y x
      _ = z := by rw [h, mul_one]

name: eq_top_of_isUnit_mem
statement: theorem eq_top_of_isUnit_mem {x} (hx : x ∈ I) (h : IsUnit x) : I = ⊤
proof:
:=
  let ⟨y, hy⟩ := h.exists_left_inv
  eq_top_of_unit_mem I x y hx hy

name: eq_top_iff_one
statement: theorem eq_top_iff_one : I = ⊤ ↔ (1 : α) ∈ I
proof:
:=
  ⟨by rintro rfl; trivial, fun h => eq_top_of_unit_mem _ _ 1 h (by simp)⟩

name: ne_top_iff_one
statement: theorem ne_top_iff_one : I ≠ ⊤ ↔ (1 : α) ∉ I
proof:
:=
  not_congr I.eq_top_iff_one

name: mem_sup_left
statement: theorem mem_sup_left {S T : Ideal R} : ∀ {x : R}, x ∈ S → x ∈ S ⊔ T
proof:
:=
  @le_sup_left _ _ S T

name: mem_sup_right
statement: theorem mem_sup_right {S T : Ideal R} : ∀ {x : R}, x ∈ T → x ∈ S ⊔ T
proof:
:=
  @le_sup_right _ _ S T

name: mem_iSup_of_mem
statement: theorem mem_iSup_of_mem {ι : Sort*} {S : ι → Ideal R} (i : ι) : ∀ {x : R}, x ∈ S i → x ∈ iSup S
proof:
:=
  @le_iSup _ _ _ S _

name: mem_sSup_of_mem
statement:
theorem mem_sSup_of_mem {S : Set (Ideal R)} {s : Ideal R} (hs : s ∈ S) :
    ∀ {x : R}, x ∈ s → x ∈ sSup S
proof:
:=
  @le_sSup _ _ _ _ hs

name: mem_sInf
statement: theorem mem_sInf {s : Set (Ideal R)} {x : R} : x ∈ sInf s ↔ ∀ ⦃I⦄, I ∈ s → x ∈ I
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hx I his => hx I ⟨I, iInf_pos his⟩, fun H _I ⟨_J, hij⟩ => hij ▸ fun _S ⟨hj, hS⟩ => hS ▸ H hj⟩

name: mem_inf
statement: theorem mem_inf {I J : Ideal R} {x : R} : x ∈ I ⊓ J ↔ x ∈ I ∧ x ∈ J
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: mem_iInf
statement: theorem mem_iInf {ι : Sort*} {I : ι → Ideal R} {x : R} : x ∈ iInf I ↔ ∀ i, x ∈ I i
proof:
:=
  Submodule.mem_iInf _

name: mem_bot
statement: theorem mem_bot {x : R} : x ∈ (⊥ : Ideal R) ↔ x = 0
proof:
:=
  Submodule.mem_bot _

name: eq_bot_or_top
statement: theorem eq_bot_or_top : I = ⊥ ∨ I = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [or_iff_not_imp_right]
  change _ ≠ _ → _
  rw [Ideal.ne_top_iff_one]
  intro h1
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  intro r hr
  by_cases H : r = 0; · simpa
  simpa [H, h1] using I.mul_mem_left r⁻¹ hr

name: Ideal.height_eq_primeHeight
statement: private lemma Ideal.height_eq_primeHeight [I.IsPrime] : I.height = I.primeHeight
proof:
:= by
  simp [height, primeHeight, Ideal.minimalPrimes_eq_subsingleton_self]

name: PrimeSpectrum.height_eq_orderHeight
statement:
lemma PrimeSpectrum.height_eq_orderHeight (p : PrimeSpectrum R) :
    p.asIdeal.height = Order.height p
proof:
:=
  p.asIdeal.height_eq_primeHeight

name: Ideal.height_eq_inf_minimalPrimes
statement: lemma Ideal.height_eq_inf_minimalPrimes : I.height = ⨅ J ∈ I.minimalPrimes, J.height
proof:
:= by
  apply iInf_congr (fun p ↦ iInf_congr fun hp ↦ ?_)
  have := hp.isPrime
  exact (Ideal.height_eq_primeHeight _).symm

name: Ideal.exists_isPrime_height_eq
statement:
lemma Ideal.exists_isPrime_height_eq {I : Ideal R} {n : ℕ} (hI : I.height = n) :
    ∃ (p : Ideal R) (_ : p.IsPrime) (_  : I ≤ p), p.height = n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Ideal.height, ENat.iInf_eq_natCast_iff] at hI
  rcases hI with ⟨⟨p, ⟨⟨⟨hpp, hIp⟩, _⟩, h⟩, -⟩, -⟩
  exact ⟨p, hpp, hIp, h ▸ p.height_eq_primeHeight⟩

name: Ideal.finiteHeight_iff_lt
statement:
lemma Ideal.finiteHeight_iff_lt {I : Ideal R} :
    Ideal.FiniteHeight I ↔ I = ⊤ ∨ I.height < ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.finiteHeight_iff, lt_top_iff_ne_top]

name: Ideal.height_ne_top
statement:
lemma Ideal.height_ne_top {I : Ideal R} (hI : I ≠ ⊤) [I.FiniteHeight] :
    I.height ≠ ⊤
proof:
:=
  (‹I.FiniteHeight›.eq_top_or_height_ne_top).resolve_left hI

name: Ideal.height_lt_top
statement:
lemma Ideal.height_lt_top {I : Ideal R} (hI : I ≠ ⊤) [I.FiniteHeight] :
    I.height < ⊤
proof:
:=
  (Ideal.height_ne_top hI).lt_top

name: Ideal.height_ne_top_of_isPrime
statement:
lemma Ideal.height_ne_top_of_isPrime {I : Ideal R} [I.FiniteHeight] [I.IsPrime] :
    I.height ≠ ⊤
proof:
:=
  Ideal.height_ne_top ‹I.IsPrime›.ne_top

name: Ideal.primeHeight_ne_top
proof:
:= by
  rw [← I.height_eq_primeHeight]
  exact Ideal.height_ne_top ‹I.IsPrime›.ne_top

name: Ideal.height_lt_top_of_isPrime
statement:
lemma Ideal.height_lt_top_of_isPrime {I : Ideal R} [I.FiniteHeight] [I.IsPrime] :
    I.height < ⊤
proof:
:=
  Ideal.height_lt_top ‹I.IsPrime›.ne_top

name: Ideal.primeHeight_lt_top
proof:
:= by
  rw [← I.height_eq_primeHeight]
  exact Ideal.height_lt_top ‹I.IsPrime›.ne_top

name: Ideal.exists_ltSeries_length_eq_height
statement:
lemma Ideal.exists_ltSeries_length_eq_height (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime] [p.FiniteHeight] :
    ∃ (l : LTSeries (PrimeSpectrum R)),
      RelSeries.last l = ⟨p, inferInstance⟩ ∧ l.length = p.height
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp (p.height_ne_top (IsPrime.ne_top ‹_›))
  rw [Ideal.height_eq_primeHeight, Ideal.primeHeight] at hn ⊢
  obtain ⟨l, last, len⟩ := Order.exists_series_of_height_eq_coe (⟨p, ‹_›⟩ : PrimeSpectrum R) hn.symm
  exact ⟨l, last, len ▸ hn⟩

name: Ideal.height_mono_of_isPrime
statement:
private lemma Ideal.height_mono_of_isPrime {I J : Ideal R} [I.IsPrime] [J.IsPrime] (h : I ≤ J) :
    I.height ≤ J.height
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Ideal.height_eq_primeHeight, Ideal.primeHeight]
  gcongr
  exact h

name: Ideal.primeHeight_mono
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Ideal.height_eq_primeHeight] using Ideal.height_mono_of_isPrime h

name: Ideal.height_add_one_le_of_lt_of_isPrime
statement:
lemma Ideal.height_add_one_le_of_lt_of_isPrime {I J : Ideal R} [I.IsPrime] [J.IsPrime] (h : I < J) :
    I.height + 1 ≤ J.height
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Ideal.height_eq_primeHeight, Ideal.primeHeight]
  exact Order.height_add_one_le h

name: Ideal.primeHeight_add_one_le_of_lt
statement:
@[deprecated "Use `Ideal.height_add_one_le_of_lt_of_isPrime` instead." (since := "2026-04-04")]
private lemma Ideal.primeHeight_add_one_le_of_lt {I J : Ideal R} [I.IsPrime] [J.IsPrime]
    (h : I < J) : I.primeHeight + 1 ≤ J.primeHeight
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Ideal.height_eq_primeHeight] using Ideal.height_add_one_le_of_lt_of_isPrime h

name: Ideal.height_top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Ideal.height_top : (⊤ : Ideal R).height = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  simp [height, minimalPrimes_top]

name: Ideal.height_mono
statement:
@[gcongr]
theorem Ideal.height_mono {I J : Ideal R} (h : I ≤ J) : I.height ≤ J.height
proof:
:= by
  simp only [I.height_eq_inf_minimalPrimes, J.height_eq_inf_minimalPrimes]
  refine le_iInf₂ (fun p hp ↦ ?_)
  have := hp.isPrime
  obtain ⟨q, hq, e⟩ := Ideal.exists_minimalPrimes_le (h.trans hp.le)
  have := hq.isPrime
  exact (iInf₂_le q hq).trans (Ideal.height_mono_of_isPrime e)

name: Ideal.height_strict_mono_of_isPrime
statement:
@[gcongr]
lemma Ideal.height_strict_mono_of_isPrime {I J : Ideal R} [I.IsPrime]
    (h : I < J) [I.FiniteHeight] : I.height < J.height
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hJ : J = ⊤
  · grw [hJ, height_top]
    exact I.height_lt_top IsPrime.ne_top'
  · rw [← ENat.add_one_le_iff (I.height_ne_top IsPrime.ne_top'), J.height_eq_inf_minimalPrimes]
    refine le_iInf₂ (fun K hK ↦ ?_)
    have := hK.isPrime
    have : I < K := lt_of_lt_of_le h hK.le
    exact Ideal.height_add_one_le_of_lt_of_isPrime this

name: Ideal.height_strict_mono_of_isPrime_of_isPrime
statement:
lemma Ideal.height_strict_mono_of_isPrime_of_isPrime {I J : Ideal R} [I.IsPrime] [J.IsPrime]
    (h : I < J) [J.FiniteHeight] : I.height < J.height
proof:
:= by
  have : I.FiniteHeight := I.finiteHeight_iff.mpr
    (Or.inr (lt_of_le_of_lt (Ideal.height_mono h.le) (J.height_lt_top IsPrime.ne_top')).ne)
  exact Ideal.height_strict_mono_of_isPrime h

name: Ideal.primeHeight_strict_mono
statement:
@[deprecated "Use `Ideal.height_strict_mono_of_isPrime_of_isPrime` instead."
  (since := "2026-04-02")]
private lemma Ideal.primeHeight_strict_mono {I J : Ideal R} [I.IsPrime] [J.IsPrime] (h : I < J)
    [J.FiniteHeight] : I.primeHeight < J.primeHeight
proof:
:= by
  simpa [← Ideal.height_eq_primeHeight] using Ideal.height_strict_mono_of_isPrime_of_isPrime h

name: Ideal.height_le_ringKrullDim_of_isPrime
statement:
lemma Ideal.height_le_ringKrullDim_of_isPrime {I : Ideal R} [I.IsPrime] :
    I.height ≤ ringKrullDim R
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.height_eq_primeHeight, Ideal.primeHeight]
  exact Order.height_le_krullDim _

name: Ideal.eq_of_le_of_height_le
statement:
lemma Ideal.eq_of_le_of_height_le [I.IsPrime] [I.FiniteHeight]
    {J : Ideal R} (h : I ≤ J) (h_height : J.height ≤ I.height) : I = J
proof:
:=
  eq_of_le_of_not_lt h fun hlt => not_le.mpr (Ideal.height_strict_mono_of_isPrime hlt) h_height

name: Ideal.primeHeight_le_ringKrullDim
proof: := Order.height_le_krullDim _

name: Ideal.height_le_ringKrullDim_of_ne_top
statement:
lemma Ideal.height_le_ringKrullDim_of_ne_top {I : Ideal R} (h : I ≠ ⊤) :
    I.height ≤ ringKrullDim R
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ : Nonempty (I.minimalPrimes) := Ideal.nonempty_minimalPrimes h
  rw [I.height_eq_inf_minimalPrimes]
  have := hP.isPrime
  refine (WithBot.coe_le_coe.mpr (iInf₂_le _ hP)).trans P.height_le_ringKrullDim_of_isPrime

name: Ideal.exists_isMaximal_height
statement:
lemma Ideal.exists_isMaximal_height [FiniteRingKrullDim R] :
    ∃ (p : Ideal R), p.IsMaximal ∧ p.height = ringKrullDim R
proof:
:= by
  let l := LTSeries.longestOf (PrimeSpectrum R)
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hle⟩ := l.last.asIdeal.exists_le_maximal IsPrime.ne_top'
  refine ⟨m, hm, le_antisymm (height_le_ringKrullDim_of_ne_top IsPrime.ne_top') ?_⟩
  trans (l.last.asIdeal.height : WithBot ℕ∞)
  · rw [Ideal.height_eq_primeHeight]
    exact LTSeries.height_last_longestOf.symm.le
  · norm_cast
    exact height_mono hle

name: Ideal.exists_isPrime_le_height
statement:
lemma Ideal.exists_isPrime_le_height {n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ ringKrullDim R) :
    ∃ (p : Ideal R), p.IsPrime ∧ n ≤ p.height
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ := Order.le_krullDim_iff.mp h
  refine ⟨l.last, PrimeSpectrum.isPrime _, ?_⟩
  grw [PrimeSpectrum.height_eq_orderHeight, ← Order.length_le_height_last]

name: Ideal.ringKrullDim_eq_top_iff
statement:
theorem Ideal.ringKrullDim_eq_top_iff :
    ringKrullDim R = ⊤ ↔ ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ I : Ideal R, I ≠ ⊤ ∧ n ≤ I.height
proof:
:= by
  rw [ENat.WithBot.eq_top_iff_forall_ge]
  refine ⟨fun h n ↦ ?_, fun h m ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨p, hp₁, hp₂⟩ := Ideal.exists_isPrime_le_height (h n)
    exact ⟨p, IsPrime.ne_top', hp₂⟩
  · obtain ⟨I, h₁, h₂⟩ := h m
    grw [← Ideal.height_le_ringKrullDim_of_ne_top h₁]
    norm_cast

name: Ideal.finiteHeight_of_le
statement:
lemma Ideal.finiteHeight_of_le {I J : Ideal R} (e : I ≤ J) (hJ : J ≠ ⊤) [FiniteHeight J] :
    FiniteHeight I where
  eq_top_or_height_ne_top
proof:
:= Or.inr <|
    lt_top_iff_ne_top.mp ((height_mono e).trans_lt (height_lt_top hJ))

name: Ideal.mem_minimalPrimes_of_height_le
statement:
lemma Ideal.mem_minimalPrimes_of_height_le {I J : Ideal R} (e : I ≤ J) [J.IsPrime]
    [FiniteHeight J] (e' : J.height ≤ I.height) : J ∈ I.minimalPrimes
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, h₁, h₂⟩ := Ideal.exists_minimalPrimes_le e
  convert! h₁
  refine (eq_of_le_of_not_lt h₂ fun h₃ ↦ ?_).symm
  have := h₁.isPrime
  have := finiteHeight_of_le h₂ IsPrime.ne_top'
  exact lt_irrefl _ ((height_strict_mono_of_isPrime h₃).trans_le
    (e'.trans <| height_mono h₁.le))

name: Ideal.height_eq_zero_iff
statement: lemma Ideal.height_eq_zero_iff {I : Ideal R} [I.IsPrime] : height I = 0 ↔ I ∈ minimalPrimes R
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.height_eq_primeHeight, Ideal.primeHeight, Order.height_eq_zero,
    minimalPrimes_eq_minimals]
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨‹_›, ?_⟩, fun ⟨hI, hI'⟩ b hb ↦ hI' b.isPrime hb⟩
  by_contra! ⟨P, ⟨hP₁, ⟨hP₂, hP₃⟩⟩⟩
  exact hP₃ (h (b := ⟨P, hP₁⟩) hP₂)

name: Ideal.primeHeight_eq_zero_iff
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Ideal.height_eq_primeHeight, Ideal.height_eq_zero_iff]

name: Ideal.one_le_height_span_singleton_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors
statement:
lemma Ideal.one_le_height_span_singleton_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors
    {x : R} (hx : x ∈ nonZeroDivisors R) : 1 ≤ (span {x}).height
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.height_eq_inf_minimalPrimes]
  refine le_iInf₂ fun q hq => ?_
  have : q.IsPrime := hq.isPrime
  rw [Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero, Ne, height_eq_zero_iff]
  intro hmin
  exact absurd hx <| notMem_nonZeroDivisors_of_mem_mem_minimalPrimes
    (hq.1.2 <| Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr <| dvd_refl x) hmin

name: Ideal.height_bot
statement:
@[simp]
lemma Ideal.height_bot [Nontrivial R] : (⊥ : Ideal R).height = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := Ideal.nonempty_minimalPrimes (R := R) (I := ⊥) top_ne_bot.symm
  rw [Ideal.height_eq_inf_minimalPrimes]
  simp only [ENat.iInf_eq_zero]
  refine ⟨p, hp, haveI := hp.isPrime; height_eq_zero_iff.mpr hp⟩

name: Ideal.height_eq_zero_iff_eq_bot
statement:
@[simp]
lemma Ideal.height_eq_zero_iff_eq_bot [IsDomain R] {I : Ideal R} : I.height = 0 ↔ I = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hI ↦ ?_, fun hI0 ↦ by simp [hI0]⟩
  rcases exists_isPrime_height_eq hI with ⟨p, _, hIp, hp0⟩
  rw [CharP.cast_eq_zero, height_eq_zero_iff, IsDomain.minimalPrimes_eq_singleton_bot,
    Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hp0
  exact bot_unique (hIp.trans_eq hp0)

name: Ideal.ne_bot_of_height_eq_one
statement: theorem Ideal.ne_bot_of_height_eq_one [IsDomain R] {I : Ideal R} (h : I.height = 1) : I ≠ ⊥
proof:
:=
  I.height_eq_zero_iff_eq_bot.not.mp (ne_zero_of_eq_one h)

name: Ideal.height_of_subsingleton
statement:
@[simp, nontriviality]
lemma Ideal.height_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton R] : I.height = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [Subsingleton.elim I ⊤, Ideal.height_top]

name: Ideal.isMaximal_of_height_eq_ringKrullDim
statement:
theorem Ideal.isMaximal_of_height_eq_ringKrullDim {I : Ideal R} [I.IsPrime]
    [FiniteRingKrullDim R] (e : I.height = ringKrullDim R) : I.IsMaximal
proof:
:= by
  have h : I ≠ ⊤ := Ideal.IsPrime.ne_top'
  obtain ⟨M, hM, hM'⟩ := Ideal.exists_le_maximal I h
  rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hM' with (hM' | hM')
  · have h1 := Ideal.height_strict_mono_of_isPrime hM'
    have h2 := e ▸ M.height_le_ringKrullDim_of_ne_top hM.ne_top
    simp [← not_lt, h1] at h2
  · exact hM' ▸ hM

name: Ideal.isMaximal_of_primeHeight_eq_ringKrullDim
statement:
@[deprecated "Use `Ideal.isMaximal_of_height_eq_ringKrullDim` instead." (since := "2026-04-02")]
private theorem Ideal.isMaximal_of_primeHeight_eq_ringKrullDim {I : Ideal R} [I.IsPrime]
    [FiniteRingKrullDim R] (e : I.primeHeight = ringKrullDim R) : I.IsMaximal
proof:
:=
  Ideal.isMaximal_of_height_eq_ringKrullDim (by simpa [Ideal.height_eq_primeHeight])

name: IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_height_eq_ringKrullDim
statement:
@[simp]
theorem IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_height_eq_ringKrullDim [IsLocalRing R] :
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).height = ringKrullDim R
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.height_eq_primeHeight, Ideal.primeHeight]
  exact Order.height_top_eq_krullDim

name: IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_primeHeight_eq_ringKrullDim
statement:
@[deprecated "Use `IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_height_eq_ringKrullDim` instead."
  (since := "2026-04-04")]
private theorem IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_primeHeight_eq_ringKrullDim [IsLocalRing R] :
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).primeHeight = ringKrullDim R
proof:
:= by
  simp [← Ideal.height_eq_primeHeight]

name: Ideal.height_eq_ringKrullDim_iff
statement:
theorem Ideal.height_eq_ringKrullDim_iff [FiniteRingKrullDim R] [IsLocalRing R] {I : Ideal R}
    [I.IsPrime] : I.height = ringKrullDim R ↔ I = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal (Ideal.isMaximal_of_height_eq_ringKrullDim h)
  · rintro rfl
    exact IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_height_eq_ringKrullDim

name: Ideal.primeHeight_eq_ringKrullDim_iff
statement:
@[deprecated "Use `Ideal.height_eq_ringKrullDim_iff` instead." (since := "2026-04-02")]
private theorem Ideal.primeHeight_eq_ringKrullDim_iff [FiniteRingKrullDim R] [IsLocalRing R]
    {I : Ideal R} [I.IsPrime] :
    Ideal.primeHeight I = ringKrullDim R ↔ I = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Ideal.height_eq_primeHeight, Ideal.height_eq_ringKrullDim_iff]

name: Ideal.height_le_iff
statement:
lemma Ideal.height_le_iff {p : Ideal R} {n : ℕ} [p.IsPrime] :
    p.height ≤ n ↔ ∀ q : Ideal R, q.IsPrime → q < p → q.height < n
proof:
:= by
  rw [height_eq_primeHeight, primeHeight, Order.height_le_coe_iff,
    (PrimeSpectrum.equivSubtype R).forall_congr_left, Subtype.forall]
  congr!
  rw [height_eq_primeHeight, primeHeight]
  rfl

name: Ideal.height_le_iff_covBy
statement:
lemma Ideal.height_le_iff_covBy {p : Ideal R} {n : ℕ} [p.IsPrime] [IsNoetherianRing R] :
    p.height ≤ n ↔ ∀ q : Ideal R, q.IsPrime → q < p →
      (∀ q' : Ideal R, q'.IsPrime → q < q' → ¬ q' < p) → q.height < n
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.height_le_iff]
  constructor
  · intro H q hq e _
    exact H q hq e
  · intro H q hq e
    obtain ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hqx, hxp⟩ :=
      @exists_le_covBy_of_lt { I : Ideal R // I.IsPrime } ⟨q, hq⟩ ⟨p, ‹_›⟩ _ _ e
    exact (Ideal.height_mono hqx).trans_lt
      (H _ hx hxp.1 (fun I hI e ↦ hxp.2 (show Subtype.mk x hx < ⟨I, hI⟩ from e)))

name: RingEquiv.height_comap_of_isPrime
statement:
private lemma RingEquiv.height_comap_of_isPrime {S : Type*} [CommRing S] (e : R ≃+* S)
    (p : Ideal S) [p.IsPrime] : (p.comap e).height = p.height
proof:
:= by
  rw [height_eq_primeHeight, height_eq_primeHeight, primeHeight, primeHeight,
    ← Order.height_orderIso (PrimeSpectrum.comapEquiv e.symm) ⟨p, ‹_›⟩]
  have := p.map_comap_of_equiv e.symm
  congr

name: RingEquiv.height_comap
statement:
@[simp]
lemma RingEquiv.height_comap {S : Type*} [CommRing S] (e : R ≃+* S) (I : Ideal S) :
    (I.comap e).height = I.height
proof:
:= by
  refine (Equiv.iInf_congr e.idealComapOrderIso fun J ↦ (Equiv.iInf_congr ?_ fun h ↦ ?_).symm).symm
  · refine .ofIff ?_
    rw [← Ideal.comap_coe,
      Ideal.comap_minimalPrimes_eq_of_surjective (f := (↑e : R →+* S)) e.surjective]
    exact e.idealComapOrderIso.injective.mem_set_image.symm
  · have : J.IsPrime := h.isPrime
    simp only [EquivLike.coe_coe, RingEquiv.idealComapOrderIso_apply,
      ← Ideal.height_eq_primeHeight, RingEquiv.height_comap_of_isPrime]

name: RingEquiv.height_map
statement:
@[simp]
lemma RingEquiv.height_map {S : Type*} [CommRing S] (e : R ≃+* S) (I : Ideal R) :
    (I.map e).height = I.height
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Ideal.comap_symm e, height_comap]

name: ringKrullDim_le_iff_height_le
statement:
lemma ringKrullDim_le_iff_height_le {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (n : WithBot ℕ∞) :
    ringKrullDim R ≤ n ↔ ∀ ⦃p : Ideal R⦄, p.IsPrime → p.height ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [ringKrullDim, Order.krullDim_eq_iSup_height, iSup_le_iff]
  refine ⟨fun h p hp ↦ ?_, fun h p ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [Ideal.height_eq_primeHeight]
    exact h ⟨p, hp⟩
  · specialize h p.2
    rwa [Ideal.height_eq_primeHeight] at h

name: ringKrullDim_le_iff_isMaximal_height_le
statement:
lemma ringKrullDim_le_iff_isMaximal_height_le {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (n : WithBot ℕ∞) :
    ringKrullDim R ≤ n ↔ ∀ ⦃m : Ideal R⦄, m.IsMaximal → m.height ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [ringKrullDim_le_iff_height_le]
  refine ⟨fun h m hm ↦ h hm.isPrime, fun h p hp ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hle⟩ := p.exists_le_maximal hp.ne_top
  refine le_trans ?_ (h hm)
  norm_cast
  exact Ideal.height_mono hle

name: IsLocalization.height_under_eq_of_isPrime
statement:
private theorem IsLocalization.height_under_eq_of_isPrime (S : Submonoid R) {A : Type*} [CommRing A]
    [Algebra R A] [IsLocalization S A] (J : Ideal A) [J.IsPrime] :
    (J.comap (algebraMap R A)).height = J.height
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_comm, Ideal.height_eq_primeHeight, Ideal.height_eq_primeHeight, Ideal.primeHeight,
    Ideal.primeHeight, ← WithBot.coe_inj, Order.height_eq_krullDim_Iic,
    Order.height_eq_krullDim_Iic]
  let e := IsLocalization.orderIsoOfPrime S A
  have H (p : Ideal R) (hp : p ≤ J.comap (algebraMap R A)) : Disjoint (S : Set R) p :=
    Set.disjoint_of_subset_right hp (e ⟨_, ‹J.IsPrime›⟩).2.2
  exact Order.krullDim_eq_of_orderIso
    { toFun I := ⟨⟨I.1.1.comap (algebraMap R A), (e ⟨_, I.1.2⟩).2.1⟩, Ideal.comap_mono I.2⟩
      invFun I := ⟨⟨_, (e.symm ⟨_, I.1.2, H _ I.2⟩).2⟩, Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.mpr I.2⟩
      left_inv I := Subtype.ext <| PrimeSpectrum.ext_iff.mpr <|
        congrArg (fun I ↦ I.1) (e.left_inv ⟨_, I.1.2⟩)
      right_inv I := Subtype.ext <| PrimeSpectrum.ext_iff.mpr <|
        congrArg (fun I ↦ I.1) (e.right_inv ⟨_, I.1.2, H _ I.2⟩)
      map_rel_iff' {I₁ I₂} := @RelIso.map_rel_iff _ _ _ _ e ⟨_, I₁.1.2⟩ ⟨_, I₂.1.2⟩ }

name: IsLocalization.primeHeight_comap
statement:
@[deprecated "Use `Ideal.height_ne_top_of_isPrime` instead." (since := "2026-04-04")]
private theorem IsLocalization.primeHeight_comap (S : Submonoid R) {A : Type*} [CommRing A]
    [Algebra R A] [IsLocalization S A] (J : Ideal A) [J.IsPrime] :
    (J.comap (algebraMap R A)).primeHeight = J.primeHeight
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Ideal.height_eq_primeHeight] using IsLocalization.height_under_eq_of_isPrime S J

name: IsLocalization.height_under
statement:
theorem IsLocalization.height_under (S : Submonoid R) {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    [IsLocalization S A] (J : Ideal A) : (J.under R).height = J.height
proof:
:= by
  rw [(J.comap _).height_eq_inf_minimalPrimes, J.height_eq_inf_minimalPrimes]
  simp only [IsLocalization.minimalPrimes_comap S A, iInf_image]
  apply iInf_congr (fun p ↦ iInf_congr fun hp ↦ ?_)
  have := hp.isPrime
  exact IsLocalization.height_under_eq_of_isPrime S _

name: IsLocalization.AtPrime.ringKrullDim_eq_height
statement:
theorem IsLocalization.AtPrime.ringKrullDim_eq_height (I : Ideal R) [I.IsPrime] (A : Type*)
    [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [IsLocalization.AtPrime A I] :
    ringKrullDim A = I.height
proof:
:= by
  have := IsLocalization.AtPrime.isLocalRing A I
  rw [← IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_height_eq_ringKrullDim,
      ← IsLocalization.height_under I.primeCompl,
      ← IsLocalization.AtPrime.under_maximalIdeal A I]

name: IsLocalization.height_map_of_disjoint
statement:
lemma IsLocalization.height_map_of_disjoint {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] (M : Submonoid R)
    [IsLocalization M S] (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime] (h : Disjoint (M : Set R) (p : Set R)) :
    (p.map <| algebraMap R S).height = p.height
proof:
:= by
  let P := p.map (algebraMap R S)
  have : P.IsPrime := isPrime_of_isPrime_disjoint M S p ‹_› h
  have := isLocalization_isLocalization_atPrime_isLocalization (M := M) (Localization.AtPrime P) P
  simp_rw [P, under_map_of_isPrime_disjoint M S _ h] at this
  have := ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv (IsLocalization.algEquiv p.primeCompl
    (Localization.AtPrime P) (Localization.AtPrime p)).toRingEquiv
  rw [AtPrime.ringKrullDim_eq_height P, AtPrime.ringKrullDim_eq_height p] at this
  exact WithBot.coe_eq_coe.mp this

name: mem_minimalPrimes_of_primeHeight_eq_height
proof:
:= by
  rw [← J.height_eq_primeHeight] at e'
  exact mem_minimalPrimes_of_height_le e (e' ▸ le_refl _)

name: exists_spanRank_le_and_le_height_of_le_height
statement:
lemma exists_spanRank_le_and_le_height_of_le_height [IsNoetherianRing R] (I : Ideal R) (r : ℕ)
    (hr : r ≤ I.height) : ∃ J ≤ I, J.spanRank ≤ r ∧ r ≤ J.height
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => simp
  | succ r ih =>
    obtain ⟨J, h₁, h₂, h₃⟩ := ih ((WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr r.le_succ).trans hr)
    let S := { K | K ∈ J.minimalPrimes ∧ Ideal.height K = r }
    have hS : Set.Finite S := Set.Finite.subset J.finite_minimalPrimes_of_isNoetherianRing
      (fun _ h => h.1)
    have : ¬(I : Set R) ⊆ ⋃ K ∈ hS.toFinset, (K : Set R) := by
      refine (Ideal.subset_union_prime ⊥ ⊥ ?_).not.mpr ?_
      · rintro K hK - -
        rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] at hK
        exact hK.1.isPrime
      · push Not
        intro K hK e
        have := hr.trans (Ideal.height_mono e)
        rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] at hK
        rw [hK.2, ← not_lt] at this
        norm_cast at this
        exact this r.lt_succ_self
    simp_rw [Set.not_subset, Set.mem_iUnion, not_exists, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] at this
    obtain ⟨x, hx₁, hx₂⟩ := this
    refine ⟨J ⊔ Ideal.span {x}, sup_le h₁ ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rwa [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
    · apply Submodule.spanRank_sup_le_sum_spanRank.trans
      push_cast
      exact add_le_add h₂ ((Submodule.spanRank_span_le_card _).trans (by simp))
    · refine le_iInf₂ (fun p hp ↦ ?_)
      have := hp.isPrime
      rw [← p.height_eq_primeHeight]
      by_cases h : p.height = ⊤
      · exact le_of_le_of_eq le_top h.symm
      have : p.FiniteHeight := ⟨Or.inr h⟩
      have := Ideal.height_mono (le_sup_left.trans hp.le)
      suffices h : (r : ℕ∞) ≠ p.height by
        exact Order.add_one_le_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_ne (h₃.trans this) h)
      intro e
      apply hx₂ p
      · refine ⟨mem_minimalPrimes_of_height_le (le_sup_left.trans hp.le) (e.symm.trans_le h₃),
          e.symm⟩
      · apply hp.le <| Ideal.mem_sup_right <| mem_span_singleton_self x

name: Ideal.sup_height_eq_ringKrullDim
statement:
lemma Ideal.sup_height_eq_ringKrullDim [Nontrivial R] :
    ↑(⨆ (I : Ideal R) (_ : I ≠ ⊤), I.height) = ringKrullDim R
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [WithBot.coe_iSup ⟨⊤, fun _ _ => le_top⟩]
    refine iSup_le fun I => ?_
    by_cases h : I = ⊤
    · simp [h, ringKrullDim_nonneg_of_nontrivial]
    · simp [h, height_le_ringKrullDim_of_ne_top]
  · refine iSup_le fun p => WithBot.coe_le_coe.mpr (le_trans (b := p.last.asIdeal.height) ?_ ?_)
    · rw [height_eq_primeHeight, primeHeight, Order.height]
      grw [← le_iSup₂]
      rfl
    · grw [← le_iSup₂]
      exact p.last.isPrime.ne_top'

name: Ideal.sup_isPrime_height_eq_ringKrullDim
statement:
lemma Ideal.sup_isPrime_height_eq_ringKrullDim [Nontrivial R] :
    ↑(⨆ (I : Ideal R) (_ : I.IsPrime), I.height) = ringKrullDim R
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sup_height_eq_ringKrullDim, WithBot.coe_inj]
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact iSup_mono fun I => iSup_mono' fun hI => ⟨hI.ne_top, le_refl _⟩
  · refine iSup_mono' fun I => ?_
    by_cases I_top : I = ⊤
    · exact ⟨⊥, by simp [I_top]⟩
    · obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := Set.nonempty_coe_sort.mp (nonempty_minimalPrimes I_top)
      refine ⟨P, iSup_pos (α := ℕ∞) I_top ▸ le_iSup_of_le (hP.left.left) ?_⟩
      have := hP.isPrime
      exact iInf_le_of_le P (iInf_le_of_le hP (ge_of_eq (Ideal.height_eq_primeHeight P)))

name: Ideal.sup_primeHeight_eq_ringKrullDim
proof:
:= by
  simp [← Ideal.height_eq_primeHeight, Ideal.sup_isPrime_height_eq_ringKrullDim]

name: Ideal.sup_isMaximal_height_eq_ringKrullDim
statement:
lemma Ideal.sup_isMaximal_height_eq_ringKrullDim [Nontrivial R] :
    ↑(⨆ (I : Ideal R) (_ : I.IsMaximal), I.height) = ringKrullDim R
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Ideal.sup_height_eq_ringKrullDim, WithBot.coe_inj]
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact iSup_mono fun I => iSup_mono' fun hI => ⟨hI.isPrime.ne_top , le_rfl⟩
  · refine iSup_mono' fun I => ?_
    obtain rfl | I_top := eq_or_ne I ⊤
    · exact ⟨⊥, by grind [iSup_le_iff, Ideal.IsPrime.ne_top]⟩
    · obtain ⟨M, hM, hIM⟩ := exists_le_maximal I I_top
      exact ⟨M, iSup_mono' (fun hI ↦ ⟨hM, height_mono hIM⟩)⟩

name: Ideal.sup_primeHeight_of_maximal_eq_ringKrullDim
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← Ideal.height_eq_primeHeight, Ideal.sup_isMaximal_height_eq_ringKrullDim]

name: Ring.krullDimLE_of_isLocalization_maximal
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Ring.krullDimLE_iff] at h ⊢
  nontriviality R
  rw [← Ideal.sup_isMaximal_height_eq_ringKrullDim]
  refine (WithBot.coe_le_coe).mpr (iSup₂_le_iff.mpr fun P hP ↦ ?_)
  rw [← WithBot.coe_le_coe, ← IsLocalization.AtPrime.ringKrullDim_eq_height P (Rₚ P)]
  exact h P

name: Ideal.eq_span_singleton_of_height_eq_one
statement:
lemma Ideal.eq_span_singleton_of_height_eq_one [IsDomain R] {p : Ideal R} [p.IsPrime]
    (h1 : p.height = 1) {x : R} (hx : x ∈ p) (hxp : Prime x) : p = span {x}
proof:
:= by
  have : (span {x}).IsPrime := by simp [span_singleton_prime hxp.ne_zero, hxp]
  have : p.FiniteHeight := by simp [p.finiteHeight_iff, h1]
  by_contra! hne
  apply hxp.ne_zero
  rw [← span_singleton_eq_bot, ← height_eq_zero_iff_eq_bot, ← Order.lt_one_iff, ← h1]
  refine height_strict_mono_of_isPrime_of_isPrime (lt_of_le_of_ne ?_ hne.symm)
  simp only [p.span_singleton_le_iff_mem, hx]

name: isMaximal_def
statement: theorem isMaximal_def {I : Ideal α} : I.IsMaximal ↔ IsCoatom I
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => h.1, fun h => ⟨h⟩⟩

name: IsMaximal.ne_top
statement: theorem IsMaximal.ne_top {I : Ideal α} (h : I.IsMaximal) : I ≠ ⊤
proof:
:=
  (isMaximal_def.1 h).1

name: IsMaximal.lt_top
statement: theorem IsMaximal.lt_top {I : Ideal α} (h : I.IsMaximal) : I < ⊤
proof:
:=
  h.ne_top.lt_top

name: isMaximal_iff
statement:
theorem isMaximal_iff {I : Ideal α} :
    I.IsMaximal ↔ (1 : α) ∉ I ∧ ∀ (J : Ideal α) (x), I ≤ J → x ∉ I → x ∈ J → (1 : α) ∈ J
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [isMaximal_def, SetLike.isCoatom_iff, Ideal.ne_top_iff_one, ← Ideal.eq_top_iff_one]

name: IsMaximal.eq_of_le
statement: theorem IsMaximal.eq_of_le {I J : Ideal α} (hI : I.IsMaximal) (hJ : J ≠ ⊤) (IJ : I ≤ J) : I = J
proof:
:=
  eq_iff_le_not_lt.2 ⟨IJ, fun h => hJ (hI.1.2 _ h)⟩

name: IsMaximal.eq_iff_le
statement: theorem IsMaximal.eq_iff_le {I J : Ideal α} (hI : I.IsMaximal) (hJ : J ≠ ⊤) : I = J ↔ I ≤ J
proof:
:=
  ⟨by aesop, Ideal.IsMaximal.eq_of_le hI hJ⟩

name: IsMaximal.coprime_of_ne
statement:
theorem IsMaximal.coprime_of_ne {M M' : Ideal α} (hM : M.IsMaximal) (hM' : M'.IsMaximal)
    (hne : M ≠ M') : M ⊔ M' = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! hne with h
  exact hM.eq_of_le hM'.ne_top (le_sup_left.trans_eq (hM'.eq_of_le h le_sup_right).symm)

name: exists_le_maximal
statement: theorem exists_le_maximal (I : Ideal α) (hI : I ≠ ⊤) : ∃ M : Ideal α, M.IsMaximal ∧ I ≤ M
proof:
:=
  let ⟨m, hm⟩ := (eq_top_or_exists_le_coatom I).resolve_left hI
  ⟨m, ⟨⟨hm.1⟩, hm.2⟩⟩

name: exists_maximal
statement: theorem exists_maximal [Nontrivial α] : ∃ M : Ideal α, M.IsMaximal
proof:
:=
  let ⟨I, ⟨hI, _⟩⟩ := exists_le_maximal (⊥ : Ideal α) bot_ne_top
  ⟨I, hI⟩

name: ne_top_iff_exists_maximal
statement: theorem ne_top_iff_exists_maximal {I : Ideal α} : I ≠ ⊤ ↔ ∃ M : Ideal α, M.IsMaximal ∧ I ≤ M
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨exists_le_maximal I, ?_⟩
  contrapose!
  rintro rfl _ hMmax
  rw [top_le_iff]
  exact IsMaximal.ne_top hMmax

name: maximal_of_no_maximal
statement:
theorem maximal_of_no_maximal {P : Ideal α}
    (hmax : ∀ m : Ideal α, P < m → ¬IsMaximal m) (J : Ideal α) (hPJ : P < J) : J = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hnonmax
  rcases exists_le_maximal J hnonmax with ⟨M, hM1, hM2⟩
  exact hmax M (lt_of_lt_of_le hPJ hM2) hM1

name: IsMaximal.exists_inv
statement:
theorem IsMaximal.exists_inv {I : Ideal α} (hI : I.IsMaximal) {x} (hx : x ∉ I) :
    ∃ y, ∃ i ∈ I, y * x + i = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨H₁, H₂⟩ := isMaximal_iff.1 hI
  rcases mem_span_insert.1
      (H₂ (span (insert x I)) x (Set.Subset.trans (subset_insert _ _) subset_span) hx
        (subset_span (mem_insert _ _))) with
    ⟨y, z, hz, hy⟩
  refine ⟨y, z, ?_, hy.symm⟩
  rwa [← span_eq I]

name: sInf_isPrime_of_isChain
statement:
theorem sInf_isPrime_of_isChain {s : Set (Ideal α)} (hs : s.Nonempty) (hs' : IsChain (· ≤ ·) s)
    (H : ∀ p ∈ s, p.IsPrime) : (sInf s).IsPrime
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun e =>
    let ⟨x, hx⟩ := hs
    (H x hx).ne_top (eq_top_iff.mpr (e.symm.trans_le (sInf_le hx))),
    fun e =>
    or_iff_not_imp_left.mpr fun hx => by
      rw [Ideal.mem_sInf] at hx e ⊢
      push Not at hx
      obtain ⟨I, hI, hI'⟩ := hx
      intro J hJ
      rcases hs'.total hI hJ with h | h
      · exact h (((H I hI).mem_or_mem (e hI)).resolve_left hI')
      · exact ((H J hJ).mem_or_mem (e hJ)).resolve_left fun x => hI' <| h x⟩

name: span_singleton_prime
statement: theorem span_singleton_prime {p : α} (hp : p ≠ 0) : IsPrime (span ({p} : Set α)) ↔ Prime p
proof:
:= by
  simp [isPrime_iff, Prime, span_singleton_eq_top, hp, mem_span_singleton]

name: isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime
statement: theorem isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime {p : α} (hp : Prime p) : (span {p}).IsPrime
proof:
:= by
  simp [Ideal.span_singleton_prime hp.ne_zero, hp]

name: IsMaximal.isPrime
statement: theorem IsMaximal.isPrime {I : Ideal α} (H : I.IsMaximal) : I.IsPrime
proof:
:=
  ⟨H.1.1, @fun x y hxy =>
    or_iff_not_imp_left.2 fun hx => by
      let J : Ideal α := Submodule.span α (insert x ↑I)
      have IJ : I ≤ J := Set.Subset.trans (subset_insert _ _) subset_span
      have xJ : x ∈ J := Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_insert x I)
      obtain ⟨_, oJ⟩ := isMaximal_iff.1 H
      specialize oJ J x IJ hx xJ
      rcases Submodule.mem_span_insert.mp oJ with ⟨a, b, h, oe⟩
      obtain F : y * 1 = y * (a • x + b) := congr_arg (fun g : α => y * g) oe
      rw [← mul_one y, F, mul_add, mul_comm, smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc]
      refine Submodule.add_mem I (I.mul_mem_left a hxy) (Submodule.smul_mem I y ?_)
      rwa [Submodule.span_eq] at h⟩

name: exists_disjoint_powers_of_span_eq_top
statement:
theorem exists_disjoint_powers_of_span_eq_top (s : Set α) (hs : span s = ⊤) (I : Ideal α)
    (hI : I ≠ ⊤) : ∃ r ∈ s, Disjoint (I : Set α) (Submonoid.powers r)
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨M, hM, le⟩ := exists_le_maximal I hI
  have := hM.1.1
  rw [Ne, eq_top_iff, ← hs, span_le, Set.not_subset] at this
  have ⟨a, has, haM⟩ := this
  exact ⟨a, has, Set.disjoint_left.mpr fun x hx ⟨n, hn⟩ ↦
    haM (hM.isPrime.mem_of_pow_mem _ (le <| hn ▸ hx))⟩

name: span_singleton_lt_span_singleton
statement:
theorem span_singleton_lt_span_singleton [IsDomain α] {x y : α} :
    span ({x} : Set α) < span ({y} : Set α) ↔ DvdNotUnit y x
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_iff_le_not_ge, span_singleton_le_span_singleton, span_singleton_le_span_singleton,
    dvd_and_not_dvd_iff]

name: isPrime_of_maximally_disjoint
statement:
lemma isPrime_of_maximally_disjoint (I : Ideal α)
    (S : Submonoid α)
    (disjoint : Disjoint (I : Set α) S)
    (maximally_disjoint : ∀ (J : Ideal α), I < J → ¬ Disjoint (J : Set α) S) :
    I.IsPrime where
  ne_top'
proof:
:= by
    rintro rfl
    have : 1 ∈ (S : Set α) := S.one_mem
    simp_all
  mem_or_mem' {x y} hxy := by
    by_contra! rid
    have hx := maximally_disjoint (I ⊔ span {x}) (Submodule.lt_sup_iff_notMem.mpr rid.1)
    have hy := maximally_disjoint (I ⊔ span {y}) (Submodule.lt_sup_iff_notMem.mpr rid.2)
    simp only [Set.not_disjoint_iff, SetLike.mem_coe, Submodule.mem_sup,
      mem_span_singleton] at hx hy
    obtain ⟨s₁, ⟨i₁, hi₁, ⟨_, ⟨r₁, rfl⟩, hr₁⟩⟩, hs₁⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨s₂, ⟨i₂, hi₂, ⟨_, ⟨r₂, rfl⟩, hr₂⟩⟩, hs₂⟩ := hy
    refine disjoint.ne_of_mem
      (I.add_mem (I.mul_mem_left (i₁ + x * r₁) hi₂) <| I.add_mem (I.mul_mem_right (y * r₂) hi₁) <|
        I.mul_mem_right (r₁ * r₂) hxy)
      (S.mul_mem hs₁ hs₂) ?_
    rw [← hr₁, ← hr₂]
    ring

name: exists_le_prime_disjoint
statement:
theorem exists_le_prime_disjoint (S : Submonoid α) (disjoint : Disjoint (I : Set α) S) :
    ∃ p : Ideal α, p.IsPrime ∧ I ≤ p ∧ Disjoint (p : Set α) S
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨p, hIp, hp⟩ := zorn_le_nonempty₀ {p : Ideal α | Disjoint (p : Set α) S}
    (fun c hc hc' x hx ↦ ?_) I disjoint
  · exact ⟨p, isPrime_of_maximally_disjoint _ _ hp.1 (fun _ ↦ hp.not_prop_of_gt), hIp, hp.1⟩
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty c
  · exact ⟨I, disjoint, fun J hJ ↦ isEmptyElim (⟨J, hJ⟩ : c)⟩
  refine ⟨sSup c, Set.disjoint_left.mpr fun x hx ↦ ?_, fun _ ↦ le_sSup⟩
  have ⟨p, hp⟩ := (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_directed _ hc'.directed).mp (sSup_eq_iSup' c ▸ hx)
  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (hc p.2) hp

name: exists_le_prime_notMem_of_isIdempotentElem
statement:
theorem exists_le_prime_notMem_of_isIdempotentElem (a : α) (ha : IsIdempotentElem a) (haI : a ∉ I) :
    ∃ p : Ideal α, p.IsPrime ∧ I ≤ p ∧ a ∉ p
proof:
:=
  have : Disjoint (I : Set α) (Submonoid.powers a) := Set.disjoint_right.mpr <| by
    rw [ha.coe_powers]
    rintro _ (rfl | rfl)
    exacts [I.ne_top_iff_one.mp (ne_of_mem_of_not_mem' Submodule.mem_top haI).symm, haI]
  have ⟨p, h1, h2, h3⟩ := exists_le_prime_disjoint _ _ this
  ⟨p, h1, h2, Set.disjoint_right.mp h3 (Submonoid.mem_powers a)⟩

name: irreducible_of_isMaximal_of_eq_span_singleton_of_not_isIdempotentElem
statement:
theorem irreducible_of_isMaximal_of_eq_span_singleton_of_not_isIdempotentElem {a : α}
    (max : (Ideal.span {a}).IsMaximal)
    (idem : ∀ x, Ideal.span {a} = Ideal.span {x} → ¬IsIdempotentElem x) :
    Irreducible a
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun _ ↦ max.ne_top (by simpa), fun u v ha ↦ ?_⟩
  by_contra! ⟨hu, hv⟩
  have hu₂ : span {a} = span {u} :=
    (max.eq_of_le (span_singleton_ne_top hu) (by simp [ha, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]))
  have hv₂ : span {a} = span {v} :=
    (max.eq_of_le (span_singleton_ne_top hv) (by simp [ha, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]))
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ : a ∣ u := by simp [← Ideal.mem_span_singleton, hu₂]
  obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ : a ∣ v := by simp [← Ideal.mem_span_singleton, hv₂]
  refine idem (a * (c * d)) ?_ ?_
  · apply le_antisymm <;> rw [span_singleton_le_span_singleton]
    · convert dvd_mul_right (a * (c * d)) a
      grind
    · apply dvd_mul_right
  · rw [isIdempotentElem_iff]
    nth_rw 3 [ha]
    ring

name: irreducible_of_isMaximal_span_singleton
proof:
:=
  ((Ideal.span_singleton_prime ha).1 max.isPrime).irreducible

name: isPrime_iff_of_isPrincipalIdealRing
statement:
theorem isPrime_iff_of_isPrincipalIdealRing {P : Ideal α} (hP : P ≠ ⊥) :
    P.IsPrime ↔ ∃ p, Prime p ∧ P = span {p} where
  mp h
proof:
:= by
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Submodule.IsPrincipal.principal P
    exact ⟨p, (span_singleton_prime (by simp [·] at hP)).mp h, rfl⟩
  mpr := by
    rintro ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
    rwa [span_singleton_prime (by simp [hp.ne_zero])]

name: isPrime_iff_of_isPrincipalIdealRing_of_noZeroDivisors
statement:
theorem isPrime_iff_of_isPrincipalIdealRing_of_noZeroDivisors [NoZeroDivisors α] [Nontrivial α]
    {P : Ideal α} : P.IsPrime ↔ P = ⊥ ∨ ∃ p, Prime p ∧ P = span {p}
proof:
:= by
  rw [or_iff_not_imp_left, ← forall_congr' isPrime_iff_of_isPrincipalIdealRing,
    ← or_iff_not_imp_left, or_iff_right_of_imp]
  rintro rfl; exact isPrime_bot

name: bot_isMaximal
statement: theorem bot_isMaximal : IsMaximal (⊥ : Ideal K)
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨fun h => absurd ((eq_top_iff_one (⊤ : Ideal K)).mp rfl) (by rw [← h]; simp), fun I hI =>
      or_iff_not_imp_left.mp (eq_bot_or_top I) (ne_of_gt hI)⟩⟩

name: mem_isPrincipalSubmonoid_iff
statement:
theorem mem_isPrincipalSubmonoid_iff {I : Ideal R} :

name: associatesEquivIsPrincipal_apply
proof: := rfl

name: associatesEquivIsPrincipal_symm_apply

theorem associatesEquivIsPrincipal_symm_apply {I : Ideal R} (hI : IsPrincipal I) :

theorem associatesEquivIsPrincipal_mul (x y : Associates R) :

proof:

theorem associatesEquivIsPrincipal_map_zero :

name: associatesNonZeroDivisorsEquivIsPrincipal_apply

name: associatesNonZeroDivisorsEquivIsPrincipal_mul

theorem associatesNonZeroDivisorsEquivIsPrincipal_mul (x y : Associates R⁰) :

theorem associatesNonZeroDivisorsEquivIsPrincipal_map_one :

theorem isoBaseOfIsPrincipal_apply {I : Ideal R} [hprinc : I.IsPrincipal] (hI : I ≠ ⊥) (x : R) :

theorem subtype_isoBaseOfIsPrincipal_eq_mul {I : Ideal R}
