name: det_endHom
statement:
theorem det_endHom {α : M →ₗ[R] P} (j : IsBaseChange S α) (f : M →ₗ[R] M) :
    LinearMap.det (endHom j f) = algebraMap R S (LinearMap.det f)
proof:
:= by
  rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial R with hR | hR
  · have : f = 1 := by
      have : Subsingleton M := Module.subsingleton R M
      exact Subsingleton.eq_one f
    simp [this, endHom_one]
  let b := Module.finBasis R M
  rw [← f.det_toMatrix b, ← (j.endHom f).det_toMatrix (j.basis b),
    endHom_toMatrix, ← RingHom.mapMatrix_apply, ← RingHom.map_det]

name: IsBaseChange.of_right_exact
statement:
lemma IsBaseChange.of_right_exact (comm₁ : h₂.comp f = (f'.restrictScalars R).comp h₁)
    (comm₂ : h₃.comp g = (g'.restrictScalars R).comp h₂) (isb₁ : IsBaseChange S h₁)
    (isb₂ : IsBaseChange S h₂) (exact₁ : Function.Exact f g) (surj₁ : Function.Surjective g)
    (exact₂ : Function.Exact f' g') (surj₂ : Function.Surjective g') : IsBaseChange S h₃
proof:
:= by
  simp only [IsBaseChange, IsTensorProduct] at isb₁ isb₂ ⊢
  refine LinearMap.bijective_of_surjective_of_bijective_of_right_exact
    ((f.baseChange S).restrictScalars R) ((g.baseChange S).restrictScalars R)
    (f'.restrictScalars R) (g'.restrictScalars R) _ _ _ ?_ ?_ ?_ exact₂ isb₁.2 isb₂ ?_ surj₂
  · ext s m
    simpa using congr(s • ($comm₁ m)).symm
  · ext s m
    simpa using congr(s • ($comm₂ m)).symm
  · exact lTensor_exact S exact₁ surj₁
  · exact LinearMap.lTensor_surjective S surj₁

name: exp_eq_sum
statement:
theorem exp_eq_sum {a : A} {k : ℕ} (h : a ^ k = 0) :
    exp a = ∑ i ∈ range k, (i.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹ • (a ^ i)
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : ∑ i ∈ range k, (i.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹ • (a ^ i) =
      ∑ i ∈ range (nilpotencyClass a), (i.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹ • (a ^ i) +
        ∑ i ∈ Ico (nilpotencyClass a) k, (i.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹ • (a ^ i) :=
    (sum_range_add_sum_Ico _ (csInf_le' h)).symm
  suffices ∑ i ∈ Ico (nilpotencyClass a) k, (i.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹ • (a ^ i) = 0 by
    dsimp [exp]
    rw [h₁, this, add_zero]
  exact sum_eq_zero fun _ h₂ => by
    rw [pow_eq_zero_of_le (mem_Ico.1 h₂).1 (pow_nilpotencyClass ⟨k, h⟩), smul_zero]

name: exp_smul_eq_sum
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt (nilpotencyClass a) k with h₀ | h₀
  · simp_rw [exp_eq_sum (pow_eq_zero_of_le h₀ (pow_nilpotencyClass hn)), sum_smul, smul_assoc]
  rw [exp, sum_smul, ← sum_range_add_sum_Ico _ (Nat.le_of_succ_le h₀)]
  suffices ∑ i ∈ Ico k (nilpotencyClass a), ((i.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹ • (a ^ i)) • m = 0 by
    simp_rw [this, add_zero, smul_assoc]
  refine sum_eq_zero fun r h₂ ↦ ?_
  rw [smul_assoc, ← pow_sub_mul_pow a (mem_Ico.1 h₂).1, mul_smul, h, smul_zero, smul_zero]

name: exp_add_of_commute
statement:
theorem exp_add_of_commute {a b : A} (h₁ : Commute a b) (h₂ : IsNilpotent a) (h₃ : IsNilpotent b) :
    exp (a + b) = exp a * exp b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n₁, hn₁⟩ := h₂
  obtain ⟨n₂, hn₂⟩ := h₃
  let N := n₁ ⊔ n₂
  have h₄ : a ^ (N + 1) = 0 := pow_eq_zero_of_le (by omega) hn₁
  have h₅ : b ^ (N + 1) = 0 := pow_eq_zero_of_le (by omega) hn₂
  rw [exp_eq_sum (k := 2 * N + 1)
    (Commute.add_pow_eq_zero_of_add_le_succ_of_pow_eq_zero h₁ h₄ h₅ (by lia)),
    exp_eq_sum h₄, exp_eq_sum h₅]
  set R2N := range (2 * N + 1) with hR2N
  set RN := range (N + 1) with hRN
  have s₁ := by
    calc ∑ i ∈ R2N, (i ! : ℚ)⁻¹ • (a + b) ^ i
        = ∑ i ∈ R2N, (i ! : ℚ)⁻¹ • ∑ j ∈ range (i + 1), a ^ j * b ^ (i - j) * i.choose j := ?_
      _ = ∑ i ∈ R2N, (∑ j ∈ range (i + 1),
            ((j ! : ℚ)⁻¹ * ((i - j) ! : ℚ)⁻¹) • (a ^ j * b ^ (i - j))) := ?_
      _ = ∑ ij ∈ R2N ×ˢ R2N with ij.1 + ij.2 ≤ 2 * N,
            ((ij.1 ! : ℚ)⁻¹ * (ij.2 ! : ℚ)⁻¹) • (a ^ ij.1 * b ^ ij.2) := ?_
    · refine sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
      rw [Commute.add_pow h₁ i]
    · simp_rw [smul_sum]
      refine sum_congr rfl fun i hi ↦ sum_congr rfl fun j hj ↦ ?_
      simp only [mem_range] at hi hj
      replace hj := Nat.le_of_lt_succ hj
      suffices (i ! : ℚ)⁻¹ * (i.choose j) = ((j ! : ℚ)⁻¹ * ((i - j)! : ℚ)⁻¹) by
        rw [← Nat.cast_commute (i.choose j), ← this, ← mul_smul_comm, ← nsmul_eq_mul,
          mul_smul, ← smul_assoc, smul_comm, smul_assoc]
        norm_cast
      rw [Nat.choose_eq_factorial_div_factorial hj,
        Nat.cast_div (Nat.factorial_mul_factorial_dvd_factorial hj) (by positivity)]
      simp [field]
    · rw [hR2N, sum_sigma']
      apply sum_bij (fun ⟨i, j⟩ _ ↦ (j, i - j))
      · simp only [mem_sigma, mem_range, mem_filter, mem_product, and_imp]
        lia
      · simp only [mem_sigma, mem_range, Prod.mk.injEq, and_imp]
        rintro ⟨x₁, y₁⟩ - h₁ ⟨x₂, y₂⟩ - h₂ h₃ h₄
        simp_all
        lia
      · simp only [mem_filter, mem_product, mem_range, mem_sigma, exists_prop, Sigma.exists,
          and_imp, Prod.forall, Prod.mk.injEq]
        exact fun x y _ _ _ ↦ ⟨x + y, x, by lia⟩
      · simp only [mem_sigma, mem_range, implies_true]
  have z₁ : ∑ ij ∈ R2N ×ˢ R2N with ¬ ij.1 + ij.2 ≤ 2 * N,
      ((ij.1 ! : ℚ)⁻¹ * (ij.2 ! : ℚ)⁻¹) • (a ^ ij.1 * b ^ ij.2) = 0 :=
    sum_eq_zero fun i hi ↦ by
      rw [mem_filter] at hi
      cases le_or_gt (N + 1) i.1 with
        | inl h => rw [pow_eq_zero_of_le h h₄, zero_mul, smul_zero]
        | inr _ => rw [pow_eq_zero_of_le (by linarith) h₅, mul_zero, smul_zero]
  have split₁ := sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not (R2N ×ˢ R2N)
    (fun ij ↦ ij.1 + ij.2 ≤ 2 * N)
    (fun ij ↦ ((ij.1 ! : ℚ)⁻¹ * (ij.2 ! : ℚ)⁻¹) • (a ^ ij.1 * b ^ ij.2))
  rw [z₁, add_zero] at split₁
  rw [split₁] at s₁
  have z₂ : ∑ ij ∈ R2N ×ˢ R2N with ¬ (ij.1 ≤ N ∧ ij.2 ≤ N),
      ((ij.1 ! : ℚ)⁻¹ * (ij.2 ! : ℚ)⁻¹) • (a ^ ij.1 * b ^ ij.2) = 0 :=
    sum_eq_zero fun i hi ↦ by
    simp only [not_and, not_le, mem_filter] at hi
    cases le_or_gt (N + 1) i.1 with
      | inl h => rw [pow_eq_zero_of_le h h₄, zero_mul, smul_zero]
      | inr h => rw [pow_eq_zero_of_le (hi.2 (Nat.le_of_lt_succ h)) h₅, mul_zero, smul_zero]
  have split₂ := sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not (R2N ×ˢ R2N)
    (fun ij ↦ ij.1 ≤ N ∧ ij.2 ≤ N)
    (fun ij ↦ ((ij.1 ! : ℚ)⁻¹ * (ij.2 ! : ℚ)⁻¹) • (a ^ ij.1 * b ^ ij.2))
  rw [z₂, add_zero] at split₂
  rw [← split₂] at s₁
  have restrict : ∑ ij ∈ R2N ×ˢ R2N with ij.1 ≤ N ∧ ij.2 ≤ N,
      ((ij.1 ! : ℚ)⁻¹ * (ij.2 ! : ℚ)⁻¹) • (a ^ ij.1 * b ^ ij.2) =
        ∑ ij ∈ RN ×ˢ RN, ((ij.1 ! : ℚ)⁻¹ * (ij.2 ! : ℚ)⁻¹) • (a ^ ij.1 * b ^ ij.2) := by
    apply sum_congr
    · ext x
      simp only [mem_filter, mem_product, mem_range, hR2N, hRN]
      lia
    · tauto
  rw [restrict] at s₁
  have s₂ := by
    calc (∑ i ∈ RN, (i ! : ℚ)⁻¹ • a ^ i) * ∑ i ∈ RN, (i ! : ℚ)⁻¹ • b ^ i
        = ∑ i ∈ RN, ∑ j ∈ RN, ((i ! : ℚ)⁻¹ * (j ! : ℚ)⁻¹) • (a ^ i * b ^ j) := ?_
      _ = ∑ ij ∈ RN ×ˢ RN, ((ij.1 ! : ℚ)⁻¹ * (ij.2 ! : ℚ)⁻¹) • (a ^ ij.1 * b ^ ij.2) := ?_
    · rw [sum_mul_sum]
      refine sum_congr rfl fun _ _ ↦ sum_congr rfl fun _ _ ↦ ?_
      rw [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul]
    · rw [sum_sigma']
      apply sum_bijective (fun ⟨i, j⟩ ↦ (i, j))
      · exact ⟨fun ⟨i, j⟩ ⟨i', j'⟩ h ↦ by cases h; rfl, fun ⟨i, j⟩ ↦ ⟨⟨i, j⟩, rfl⟩⟩
      · simp only [mem_sigma, mem_product, implies_true]
      · simp only [implies_true]
  rwa [s₂.symm] at s₁

name: exp_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem exp_zero :
    exp (0 : A) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [exp_eq_sum (pow_one 0)]

name: exp_mul_exp_neg_self
statement:
theorem exp_mul_exp_neg_self {a : A} (h : IsNilpotent a) :
    exp a * exp (-a) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [← exp_add_of_commute (Commute.neg_right rfl) h h.neg]

name: exp_neg_mul_exp_self
statement:
theorem exp_neg_mul_exp_self {a : A} (h : IsNilpotent a) :
    exp (-a) * exp a = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [← exp_add_of_commute (Commute.neg_left rfl) h.neg h]

name: isUnit_exp
statement: theorem isUnit_exp {a : A} (h : IsNilpotent a) : IsUnit (exp a)
proof:
:= by
  apply isUnit_iff_exists.2
  use exp (-a)
  exact ⟨exp_mul_exp_neg_self h, exp_neg_mul_exp_self h⟩

name: map_exp
statement:
theorem map_exp {B F : Type*} [Ring B] [FunLike F A B] [RingHomClass F A B] [Module ℚ B]
    {a : A} (ha : IsNilpotent a) (f : F) :
    f (exp a) = exp (f a)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := ha
  have hk' : (f a) ^ k = 0 := by simp [← map_pow, hk]
  simp [exp_eq_sum hk, exp_eq_sum hk', map_rat_smul]

name: exp_smul
statement:
theorem exp_smul {G : Type*} [Monoid G] [MulSemiringAction G A]
    (g : G) {a : A} (ha : IsNilpotent a) :
    exp (g • a) = g • exp a
proof:
:=
  (map_exp ha (MulSemiringAction.toRingHom G A g)).symm

name: isNilpotent_exp_sub_one
statement: theorem isNilpotent_exp_sub_one {a : A} (ha : IsNilpotent a) : IsNilpotent (exp a - 1)
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality A
  rw [exp, ← Nat.sub_add_cancel (pos_nilpotencyClass_iff.2 ha), Finset.sum_range_succ']
  simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, zero_add, Nat.factorial_zero, Nat.cast_one, inv_one, pow_zero,
    one_smul, add_sub_cancel_right]
  apply Commute.isNilpotent_sum fun _ _ ↦ smul (pow_of_pos ha <| by positivity) _
  simp [Nat.factorial_ne_zero]

name: commute_exp_left_of_commute
statement:
theorem commute_exp_left_of_commute
    {fM : Module.End R M} {fN : Module.End R N} {g : M →ₗ[R] N}
    (hfM : IsNilpotent fM)
    (hfN : IsNilpotent fN)
    (h : fN ∘ₗ g = g ∘ₗ fM) :
    exp fN ∘ₗ g = g ∘ₗ exp fM
proof:
:= by
  ext m
  obtain ⟨k, hfM⟩ := hfM
  obtain ⟨l, hfN⟩ := hfN
  let kl := max k l
  replace hfM : fM ^ kl = 0 := pow_eq_zero_of_le (by omega) hfM
  replace hfN : fN ^ kl = 0 := pow_eq_zero_of_le (by omega) hfN
  have (i : ℕ) : (fN ^ i) (g m) = g ((fM ^ i) m) := by
    simpa using LinearMap.congr_fun (Module.End.commute_pow_left_of_commute h i) m
  simp [exp_eq_sum hfM, exp_eq_sum hfN, this, map_rat_smul]

name: exp_mul_of_derivation
statement:
theorem exp_mul_of_derivation (R B : Type*) [CommRing R] [NonUnitalNonAssocRing B]
    [Module R B] [SMulCommClass R B B] [IsScalarTower R B B] [Module ℚ B]
    (D : B →ₗ[R] B) (h_der : ∀ x y, D (x * y) = x * D y + (D x) * y)
    (h_nil : IsNilpotent D) (x y : B) :
    exp D (x * y) = (exp D x) * (exp D y)
proof:
:= by
  let DL : Module.End R (B ⊗[R] B) := D.lTensor B
  let DR : Module.End R (B ⊗[R] B) := D.rTensor B
  have h_nilL : IsNilpotent DL := h_nil.map <| lTensorAlgHom R B B
  have h_nilR : IsNilpotent DR := h_nil.map <| rTensorAlgHom R B B
  have h_comm : Commute DL DR := by ext; simp [DL, DR]
  set m : B ⊗[R] B →ₗ[R] B := LinearMap.mul' R B with hm
  have h₁ : exp D (x * y) = m (exp (DL + DR) (x ⊗ₜ[R] y)) := by
    suffices exp D ∘ₗ m = m ∘ₗ exp (DL + DR) by simpa using! LinearMap.congr_fun this (x ⊗ₜ[R] y)
    apply commute_exp_left_of_commute (h_comm.isNilpotent_add h_nilL h_nilR) h_nil
    ext
    simp [DL, DR, hm, h_der]
  have h₂ : exp DL = (exp D).lTensor B := (h_nil.map_exp (lTensorAlgHom R B B)).symm
  have h₃ : exp DR = (exp D).rTensor B := (h_nil.map_exp (rTensorAlgHom R B B)).symm
  simp [h₁, exp_add_of_commute h_comm h_nilL h_nilR, h₂, h₃, hm]

name: RingHom.ker_isRadical_iff_reduced_of_surjective
statement:
theorem RingHom.ker_isRadical_iff_reduced_of_surjective {S F} [CommSemiring R] [Semiring S]
    [FunLike F R S] [RingHomClass F R S] {f : F} (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    (RingHom.ker f).IsRadical ↔ IsReduced S
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [isReduced_iff, hf.forall, IsNilpotent, ← map_pow, ← RingHom.mem_ker]
  rfl

name: isRadical_iff_span_singleton
statement:
theorem isRadical_iff_span_singleton [CommSemiring R] :
    IsRadical y ↔ (Ideal.span ({y} : Set R)).IsRadical
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [IsRadical, ← Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
  exact forall_comm.trans (forall_congr' fun r => exists_imp.symm)

name: isNilpotent_iff_zero_mem_powers
statement:
theorem isNilpotent_iff_zero_mem_powers [Monoid R] [Zero R] {x : R} :
    IsNilpotent x ↔ 0 ∈ Submonoid.powers x
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: mem_nilradical
statement: theorem mem_nilradical : x ∈ nilradical R ↔ IsNilpotent x
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: nilradical_eq_sInf
statement:
theorem nilradical_eq_sInf (R : Type*) [CommSemiring R] :
    nilradical R = sInf { J : Ideal R | J.IsPrime }
proof:
:=
  (Ideal.radical_eq_sInf ⊥).trans <| by simp_rw [and_iff_right bot_le]

name: nilpotent_iff_mem_prime
statement: theorem nilpotent_iff_mem_prime : IsNilpotent x ↔ ∀ J : Ideal R, J.IsPrime → x ∈ J
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mem_nilradical, nilradical_eq_sInf, Submodule.mem_sInf]
  rfl

name: nilradical_le_prime
statement: theorem nilradical_le_prime (J : Ideal R) [H : J.IsPrime] : nilradical R ≤ J
proof:
:=
  (nilradical_eq_sInf R).symm ▸ sInf_le H

name: nilradical_eq_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nilradical_eq_zero (R : Type*) [CommSemiring R] [IsReduced R] : nilradical R = 0
proof:
:=
  Ideal.ext fun _ => isNilpotent_iff_eq_zero

name: nilradical_eq_bot_iff
statement: theorem nilradical_eq_bot_iff {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] : nilradical R = ⊥ ↔ IsReduced R
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [eq_bot_iff, SetLike.le_def, Submodule.mem_bot, mem_nilradical, isReduced_iff]

name: isNilpotent_mulLeft_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isNilpotent_mulLeft_iff (a : A) : IsNilpotent (mulLeft R a) ↔ IsNilpotent a
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> rintro ⟨n, hn⟩ <;> use n <;>
      simp only [mulLeft_eq_zero_iff, pow_mulLeft] at hn ⊢ <;>
    exact hn

name: isNilpotent_mulRight_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isNilpotent_mulRight_iff (a : A) : IsNilpotent (mulRight R a) ↔ IsNilpotent a
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> rintro ⟨n, hn⟩ <;> use n <;>
      simp only [mulRight_eq_zero_iff, pow_mulRight] at hn ⊢ <;>
    exact hn

name: isNilpotent_toMatrix_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma isNilpotent_toMatrix_iff (b : Basis ι R M) (f : M →ₗ[R] M) :
    IsNilpotent (toMatrix b b f) ↔ IsNilpotent f
proof:
:= by
  refine exists_congr fun k ↦ ?_
  rw [toMatrix_pow]
  exact (toMatrix b b).map_eq_zero_iff

name: Matrix.isNilpotent_toLin'_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma Matrix.isNilpotent_toLin'_iff {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] [CommSemiring R]
    (A : Matrix ι ι R) :
    IsNilpotent A.toLin' ↔ IsNilpotent A
proof:
:= by
  have : A.toLin'.toMatrix (Pi.basisFun R ι) (Pi.basisFun R ι) = A := LinearMap.toMatrix'_toLin' A
  conv_rhs => rw [← this]
  rw [LinearMap.isNilpotent_toMatrix_iff]

name: isNilpotent_restrict_of_le
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hf
  use n
  ext ⟨x, hx⟩
  replace hn := DFunLike.congr_fun hn ⟨x, h hx⟩
  simp_rw [LinearMap.zero_apply, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero, ZeroMemClass.coe_eq_zero] at hn ⊢
  rw [Module.End.pow_restrict, LinearMap.restrict_apply] at hn ⊢
  ext
  exact (congr_arg Subtype.val hn :)

name: isNilpotent.restrict
statement:
lemma isNilpotent.restrict
    {f : M →ₗ[R] M} {p : Submodule R M} (hf : MapsTo f p p) (hnil : IsNilpotent f) :
    IsNilpotent (f.restrict hf)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hnil
  exact ⟨n, LinearMap.ext fun m ↦ by simp only [Module.End.pow_restrict n, hn,
    LinearMap.restrict_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply]; rfl⟩

name: IsNilpotent.mapQ
statement: theorem IsNilpotent.mapQ (hnp : IsNilpotent f) : IsNilpotent (p.mapQ p f hp)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hnp
  use k
  simp [← p.mapQ_pow, hk]

name: isGeometricallyReduced_field_iff
statement:
lemma isGeometricallyReduced_field_iff (k A : Type*) [Field k] [Ring A] [Algebra k A] :
    IsGeometricallyReduced k A ↔ IsReduced (AlgebraicClosure k ⊗[k] A)
proof:
:= by
  let e (p : Ideal k) [p.IsPrime] : AlgebraicClosure k ≃ₐ[k] AlgebraicClosure p.ResidueField :=
    have := p.algEquivResidueFieldOfField.isAlgebraic
    IsAlgClosure.equiv k _ _
  refine ⟨fun ⟨h⟩ ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ⟨fun p hp ↦ ?_⟩⟩
  · exact isReduced_of_injective _ (Algebra.TensorProduct.congr (e ⊥) AlgEquiv.refl).injective
  · exact isReduced_of_injective _ (Algebra.TensorProduct.congr (e p).symm AlgEquiv.refl).injective

name: IsGeometricallyReduced.of_injective
statement:
lemma IsGeometricallyReduced.of_injective {B : Type*} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] (f : A →ₐ[k] B)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) [IsGeometricallyReduced k B] : IsGeometricallyReduced k A
proof:
:= by
  rw [isGeometricallyReduced_field_iff]
  exact isReduced_of_injective (Algebra.TensorProduct.map 1 f)
    (Module.Flat.lTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap _ hf)

name: isReduced_of_isGeometricallyReduced
statement: theorem isReduced_of_isGeometricallyReduced [IsGeometricallyReduced k A] : IsReduced A
proof:
:=
  isReduced_of_injective
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : A →ₐ[k] (AlgebraicClosure k) ⊗[k] A)
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_injective (RingHom.injective _))

name: IsGeometricallyReduced.of_forall_fg
statement:
@[stacks 030T]
theorem IsGeometricallyReduced.of_forall_fg
    (h : ∀ B : Subalgebra k A, B.FG → IsGeometricallyReduced k B) :
    IsGeometricallyReduced k A
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [isGeometricallyReduced_field_iff] at h ⊢
  exact IsReduced.tensorProduct_of_flat_of_forall_fg h

name: IsNilpotent.neg
statement: theorem IsNilpotent.neg [Ring R] (h : IsNilpotent x) : IsNilpotent (-x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := h
  use n
  rw [neg_pow, hn, mul_zero]

name: not_isNilpotent_neg_one
statement: theorem not_isNilpotent_neg_one [Ring R] [Nontrivial R] : ¬ IsNilpotent (-1 : R)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  simpa [not_isNilpotent_one] using h.neg

name: neg_one_pow_ne_zero
statement: theorem neg_one_pow_ne_zero [Ring R] [Nontrivial R] (n : ℕ) : (-1 : R) ^ n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact not_isNilpotent_neg_one ⟨n, h⟩

name: isNilpotent_neg_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isNilpotent_neg_iff [Ring R] : IsNilpotent (-x) ↔ IsNilpotent x
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => neg_neg x ▸ h.neg, fun h => h.neg⟩

name: IsNilpotent.smul
statement:
lemma IsNilpotent.smul [MonoidWithZero R] [MonoidWithZero S] [MulActionWithZero R S]
    [SMulCommClass R S S] [IsScalarTower R S S] {a : S} (ha : IsNilpotent a) (t : R) :
    IsNilpotent (t • a)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, ha⟩ := ha
  use k
  rw [smul_pow, ha, smul_zero]

name: IsNilpotent.isUnit_sub_one
statement: theorem IsNilpotent.isUnit_sub_one [Ring R] {r : R} (hnil : IsNilpotent r) : IsUnit (r - 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hnil
  refine ⟨⟨r - 1, -∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, r ^ i, ?_, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
  · simp [mul_geom_sum, hn]
  · simp [geom_sum_mul, hn]

name: IsNilpotent.isUnit_one_sub
statement: theorem IsNilpotent.isUnit_one_sub [Ring R] {r : R} (hnil : IsNilpotent r) : IsUnit (1 - r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← IsUnit.neg_iff, neg_sub]
  exact isUnit_sub_one hnil

name: IsNilpotent.isUnit_add_one
statement: theorem IsNilpotent.isUnit_add_one [Ring R] {r : R} (hnil : IsNilpotent r) : IsUnit (r + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← IsUnit.neg_iff, neg_add']
  exact isUnit_sub_one hnil.neg

name: IsNilpotent.isUnit_one_add
statement: theorem IsNilpotent.isUnit_one_add [Ring R] {r : R} (hnil : IsNilpotent r) : IsUnit (1 + r)
proof:
:=
  add_comm r 1 ▸ isUnit_add_one hnil

name: IsNilpotent.isUnit_add_left_of_commute
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Units.isUnit_mul_units _ hu.unit⁻¹, add_mul, IsUnit.mul_val_inv]
  replace h_comm : Commute r (↑hu.unit⁻¹) := Commute.units_inv_right h_comm
  refine IsNilpotent.isUnit_one_add ?_
  exact (hu.unit⁻¹.isUnit.isNilpotent_mul_unit_of_commute_iff h_comm).mpr hnil

name: IsNilpotent.isUnit_add_right_of_commute
proof:
:=
  add_comm r u ▸ hnil.isUnit_add_left_of_commute hu h_comm

name: IsUnit.not_isNilpotent
statement:
lemma IsUnit.not_isNilpotent [Ring R] [Nontrivial R] {x : R} (hx : IsUnit x) :
    ¬ IsNilpotent x
proof:
:= by
  intro H
  simpa using H.isUnit_add_right_of_commute hx.neg (by simp)

name: IsNilpotent.not_isUnit
statement:
lemma IsNilpotent.not_isUnit [Ring R] [Nontrivial R] {x : R} (hx : IsNilpotent x) :
    ¬ IsUnit x
proof:
:=
  mt IsUnit.not_isNilpotent (by simpa only [not_not] using hx)

name: IsIdempotentElem.eq_zero_of_isNilpotent
statement:
lemma IsIdempotentElem.eq_zero_of_isNilpotent [MonoidWithZero R] {e : R}
    (idem : IsIdempotentElem e) (nilp : IsNilpotent e) : e = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨rfl | n, hn⟩ := nilp
  · rw [pow_zero] at hn; rw [← one_mul e, hn, zero_mul]
  · rw [← hn, idem.pow_succ_eq]

name: Prime.isRadical
statement: theorem Prime.isRadical [CommMonoidWithZero R] {y : R} (hy : Prime y) : IsRadical y
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ ↦ hy.dvd_of_dvd_pow

name: zero_isRadical_iff
statement: theorem zero_isRadical_iff [MonoidWithZero R] : IsRadical (0 : R) ↔ IsReduced R
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [isReduced_iff, IsNilpotent, exists_imp, ← zero_dvd_iff]
  exact forall_comm

name: isRadical_zero
statement: lemma isRadical_zero [MonoidWithZero R] [IsReduced R] : _root_.IsRadical (0 : R)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [zero_isRadical_iff]

name: isReduced_iff_pow_one_lt
statement:
theorem isReduced_iff_pow_one_lt [MonoidWithZero R] (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 < k) :
    IsReduced R ↔ ∀ x : R, x ^ k = 0 → x = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← zero_isRadical_iff, isRadical_iff_pow_one_lt k hk, zero_dvd_iff]

name: IsRadical.of_dvd
statement:
theorem IsRadical.of_dvd [CommMonoidWithZero R] [IsCancelMulZero R] {x y : R} (hy : IsRadical y)
    (h0 : y ≠ 0) (hxy : x ∣ y) : IsRadical x
proof:
:= (isRadical_iff_pow_one_lt 2 one_lt_two).2 <| by
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hxy
  refine fun w dvd ↦ ((mul_dvd_mul_iff_right <| right_ne_zero_of_mul h0).mp <| hy 2 _ ?_)
  rw [mul_pow]
  gcongr
  exact dvd_pow_self _ two_ne_zero

name: add_pow_eq_zero_of_add_le_succ_of_pow_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [h_comm.add_pow']
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  rintro ⟨i, j⟩ hij
  suffices x ^ i * y ^ j = 0 by simp only [this, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_zero]
  by_cases hi : m ≤ i
  · rw [pow_eq_zero_of_le hi hx, zero_mul]
  rw [pow_eq_zero_of_le ?_ hy, mul_zero]
  linarith [Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hij]

name: add_pow_add_eq_zero_of_pow_eq_zero
proof:
:=
  h_comm.add_pow_eq_zero_of_add_le_succ_of_pow_eq_zero hx hy <| by rw [← Nat.sub_le_iff_le_add]

name: isNilpotent_add
statement:
theorem isNilpotent_add (h_comm : Commute x y) (hx : IsNilpotent x) (hy : IsNilpotent y) :
    IsNilpotent (x + y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hy
  exact ⟨_, add_pow_add_eq_zero_of_pow_eq_zero h_comm hn hm⟩

name: isNilpotent_sum
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simp
  | insert j s hj ih => ?_
  rw [Finset.sum_insert hj]
  apply Commute.isNilpotent_add
  · exact Commute.sum_right _ _ _ (fun i hi ↦ h_comm _ _ (by simp) (by simp [hi]))
  · apply hnp; simp
  · exact ih (fun i hi ↦ hnp i (by simp [hi]))
      (fun i j hi hj ↦ h_comm i j (by simp [hi]) (by simp [hj]))

name: isNilpotent_finsum
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases h : HasFiniteSupport f
  · rw [finsum_def, dite_eq_left h]
    exact Commute.isNilpotent_sum (fun b _ ↦ hf b) (fun _ _ _ _ ↦ h_comm _ _)
  · simp only [finsum_def, dite_eq_right h, IsNilpotent.zero]

name: isNilpotent_mul_right_iff
statement:
protected lemma isNilpotent_mul_right_iff (h_comm : Commute x y) (hy : y ∈ nonZeroDivisorsRight R) :
    IsNilpotent (x * y) ↔ IsNilpotent x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, h_comm.isNilpotent_mul_right⟩
  rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
  rw [mul_pow h_comm] at hk
  exact ⟨k, (nonZeroDivisorsRight R).pow_mem hy k _ hk⟩

name: isNilpotent_mul_left_iff
statement:
protected lemma isNilpotent_mul_left_iff (h_comm : Commute x y) (hx : x ∈ nonZeroDivisorsLeft R) :
    IsNilpotent (x * y) ↔ IsNilpotent y
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, h_comm.isNilpotent_mul_left⟩
  rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
  rw [mul_pow h_comm] at hk
  exact ⟨k, (nonZeroDivisorsLeft R).pow_mem hx k _ hk⟩

name: isNilpotent_sub
statement:
theorem isNilpotent_sub (h_comm : Commute x y) (hx : IsNilpotent x) (hy : IsNilpotent y) :
    IsNilpotent (x - y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← neg_right_iff] at h_comm
  rw [← isNilpotent_neg_iff] at hy
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
  exact h_comm.isNilpotent_add hx hy

name: isNilpotent_sum
proof:
:=
  Commute.isNilpotent_sum hnp fun _ _ _ _ ↦ Commute.all _ _

name: isNilpotent_finsum
proof:
:=
  Commute.isNilpotent_finsum hf fun _ _ ↦ Commute.all _ _

name: IsNilpotent.map
proof:
:= by
  use hr.choose
  rw [← map_pow, hr.choose_spec, map_zero]

name: IsNilpotent.map_iff
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨k, hk⟩ ↦ ⟨k, (map_eq_zero_iff f hf).mp <| by rwa [map_pow]⟩, fun h ↦ h.map f⟩

name: IsUnit.isNilpotent_mul_unit_of_commute_iff
proof:
:=
  exists_congr fun n ↦ by rw [h_comm.mul_pow, (hu.pow n).mul_left_eq_zero]

name: IsUnit.isNilpotent_unit_mul_of_commute_iff
proof:
:=
  h_comm ▸ hu.isNilpotent_mul_unit_of_commute_iff h_comm

name: isNilpotent_op
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isNilpotent_op [MonoidWithZero R] {x : R} :
    IsNilpotent (MulOpposite.op x) ↔ IsNilpotent x
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [IsNilpotent, ← MulOpposite.op_pow, MulOpposite.op_eq_zero_iff]

name: isNilpotent_unop
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isNilpotent_unop [MonoidWithZero R] {x : Rᵐᵒᵖ} :
    IsNilpotent (MulOpposite.unop x) ↔ IsNilpotent x
proof:
:=
  isNilpotent_op.symm

name: nilpotencyClass_eq_zero_of_subsingleton
statement:
@[simp] lemma nilpotencyClass_eq_zero_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton R] :
    nilpotencyClass x = 0
proof:
:= by
  let s : Set ℕ := {k | x ^ k = 0}
  suffices s = univ by change sInf _ = 0; simp [s] at this; simp [this]
  exact eq_univ_iff_forall.mpr fun k ↦ Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: isNilpotent_of_pos_nilpotencyClass
statement:
lemma isNilpotent_of_pos_nilpotencyClass (hx : 0 < nilpotencyClass x) :
    IsNilpotent x
proof:
:= by
  let s : Set ℕ := {k | x ^ k = 0}
  change s.Nonempty
  change 0 < sInf s at hx
  by_contra contra
  simp [not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp contra] at hx

name: pow_nilpotencyClass
statement: lemma pow_nilpotencyClass (hx : IsNilpotent x) : x ^ (nilpotencyClass x) = 0
proof:
:=
  Nat.sInf_mem hx

name: nilpotencyClass_eq_succ_iff
statement:
lemma nilpotencyClass_eq_succ_iff {k : ℕ} :
    nilpotencyClass x = k + 1 ↔ x ^ (k + 1) = 0 ∧ x ^ k ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let s : Set ℕ := {k | x ^ k = 0}
  have : ∀ k₁ k₂ : ℕ, k₁ ≤ k₂ → k₁ ∈ s → k₂ ∈ s := fun k₁ k₂ h_le hk₁ ↦ pow_eq_zero_of_le h_le hk₁
  simp [s, nilpotencyClass, Nat.sInf_upward_closed_eq_succ_iff this]

name: nilpotencyClass_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma nilpotencyClass_zero [Nontrivial R] :
    nilpotencyClass (0 : R) = 1
proof:
:=
  nilpotencyClass_eq_succ_iff.mpr <| by constructor <;> simp

name: pos_nilpotencyClass_iff
statement:
@[simp] lemma pos_nilpotencyClass_iff [Nontrivial R] :
    0 < nilpotencyClass x ↔ IsNilpotent x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨isNilpotent_of_pos_nilpotencyClass, fun hx ↦ Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun hx' ↦ ?_⟩
  replace hx := pow_nilpotencyClass hx
  rw [hx', pow_zero] at hx
  exact one_ne_zero hx

name: pow_pred_nilpotencyClass
statement:
lemma pow_pred_nilpotencyClass [Nontrivial R] (hx : IsNilpotent x) :
    x ^ (nilpotencyClass x - 1) ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  (nilpotencyClass_eq_succ_iff.mp <| Nat.eq_add_of_sub_eq (pos_nilpotencyClass_iff.mpr hx) rfl).2

name: eq_zero_of_nilpotencyClass_eq_one
statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_nilpotencyClass_eq_one (hx : nilpotencyClass x = 1) :
    x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have : IsNilpotent x := isNilpotent_of_pos_nilpotencyClass (hx ▸ Nat.one_pos)
  rw [← pow_nilpotencyClass this, hx, pow_one]

name: nilpotencyClass_eq_one
statement:
@[simp] lemma nilpotencyClass_eq_one [Nontrivial R] :
    nilpotencyClass x = 1 ↔ x = 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨eq_zero_of_nilpotencyClass_eq_one, fun hx ↦ hx ▸ nilpotencyClass_zero⟩

name: isReduced_mulOpposite_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isReduced_mulOpposite_iff [MonoidWithZero R] : IsReduced Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ IsReduced R
proof:
:= by
  simp [isReduced_iff]

name: isReduced_of_injective
statement:
theorem isReduced_of_injective [MonoidWithZero R] [MonoidWithZero S] {F : Type*}
    [FunLike F R S] [MonoidWithZeroHomClass F R S]
    (f : F) (hf : Function.Injective f) [IsReduced S] :
    IsReduced R
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro x hx
  apply hf
  rw [map_zero]
  exact (hx.map f).eq_zero

name: isRadical_iff_pow_one_lt
statement:
theorem isRadical_iff_pow_one_lt [Monoid R] (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 < k) :
    IsRadical y ↔ ∀ x, y ∣ x ^ k → y ∣ x
proof:
:=
  ⟨(· k), k.pow_imp_self_of_one_lt hk _ fun _ _ h ↦ .inl (dvd_mul_of_dvd_left h _)⟩

name: isNilpotent_mul_right
statement: theorem isNilpotent_mul_right (h_comm : Commute x y) (h : IsNilpotent x) : IsNilpotent (x * y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := h
  use n
  rw [h_comm.mul_pow, hn, zero_mul]

name: isNilpotent_mul_left
statement: theorem isNilpotent_mul_left (h_comm : Commute x y) (h : IsNilpotent y) : IsNilpotent (x * y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [h_comm.eq]
  exact h_comm.symm.isNilpotent_mul_right h

name: IsNoetherianRing.isNilpotent_nilradical
statement:
theorem IsNoetherianRing.isNilpotent_nilradical (R : Type*) [CommSemiring R] [IsNoetherianRing R] :
    IsNilpotent (nilradical R)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Ideal.exists_radical_pow_le_of_fg (⊥ : Ideal R) (IsNoetherian.noetherian _)
  exact ⟨n, eq_bot_iff.mpr hn⟩

name: Ideal.FG.isNilpotent_iff_le_nilradical
statement:
lemma Ideal.FG.isNilpotent_iff_le_nilradical {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] {I : Ideal R}
    (hI : I.FG) : IsNilpotent I ↔ I ≤ nilradical R
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨n, hn⟩ _ hx ↦ ⟨n, hn ▸ Ideal.pow_mem_pow hx n⟩,
    fun h ↦ let ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_pow_le_of_le_radical_of_fg h hI; ⟨n, le_bot_iff.mp hn⟩⟩

name: isNoetherian_of_surjective
statement:
theorem isNoetherian_of_surjective {σ : R →+* S} [RingHomSurjective σ] (f : M →ₛₗ[σ] P)
    (hf : LinearMap.range f = ⊤) [IsNoetherian R M] :
    IsNoetherian S P
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun s ↦
    have : (s.comap f).map f = s := Submodule.map_comap_eq_self <| hf.symm ▸ le_top
    this ▸ (IsNoetherian.noetherian _).map _⟩

name: isNoetherian_of_linearEquiv
statement:
theorem isNoetherian_of_linearEquiv {σ : R →+* S} {σ' : S →+* R} [RingHomInvPair σ σ']
    [RingHomInvPair σ' σ] (f : M ≃ₛₗ[σ] P) [IsNoetherian R M] : IsNoetherian S P
proof:
:=
  isNoetherian_of_surjective f.toLinearMap f.range

name: LinearEquiv.isNoetherian_iff
statement:
theorem LinearEquiv.isNoetherian_iff {σ : R →+* S} {σ' : S →+* R} [RingHomInvPair σ σ']
    [RingHomInvPair σ' σ] (f : M ≃ₛₗ[σ] P) : IsNoetherian R M ↔ IsNoetherian S P
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ ↦ isNoetherian_of_linearEquiv f, fun _ ↦ isNoetherian_of_linearEquiv f.symm⟩

name: isNoetherian_top_iff
statement: theorem isNoetherian_top_iff : IsNoetherian R (⊤ : Submodule R M) ↔ IsNoetherian R M
proof:
:=
  Submodule.topEquiv.isNoetherian_iff

name: isNoetherian_of_injective
proof:
:=
  isNoetherian_of_linearEquiv (LinearEquiv.ofInjective f hf).symm

name: fg_of_injective
proof:
:=
  haveI := isNoetherian_of_injective f hf
  IsNoetherian.noetherian N

name: Finite.of_injective
proof:
:=
  ⟨fg_of_injective f hf⟩

name: isNoetherian_of_ker_bot
proof:
:=
  isNoetherian_of_linearEquiv (LinearEquiv.ofInjective f <| LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp hf).symm

name: fg_of_ker_bot
proof:
:=
  haveI := isNoetherian_of_ker_bot f hf
  IsNoetherian.noetherian N

name: isNoetherian_of_range_eq_ker
statement:
theorem isNoetherian_of_range_eq_ker {P : Type*} [AddCommGroup P] [Module R P] [IsNoetherian R M]
    [IsNoetherian R P] (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (g : N →ₗ[R] P) (h : LinearMap.range f = LinearMap.ker g) :
    IsNoetherian R N
proof:
:=
  isNoetherian_mk <|
    wellFounded_gt_exact_sequence
      (LinearMap.range f)
      (Submodule.map ((LinearMap.ker f).liftQ f le_rfl))
      (Submodule.comap ((LinearMap.ker f).liftQ f le_rfl))
      (Submodule.comap g.rangeRestrict) (Submodule.map g.rangeRestrict)
      (Submodule.gciMapComap <| LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp <| Submodule.ker_liftQ_eq_bot _ _ _ le_rfl)
      (Submodule.giMapComap g.surjective_rangeRestrict)
      (by simp [Submodule.map_comap_eq, inf_comm, Submodule.range_liftQ])
      (by simp [Submodule.comap_map_eq, h])

name: isNoetherian_iff_submodule_quotient
statement:
theorem isNoetherian_iff_submodule_quotient (S : Submodule R N) :
    IsNoetherian R N ↔ IsNoetherian R S ∧ IsNoetherian R (N ⧸ S)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun _ ↦ ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩, fun ⟨_, _⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  apply isNoetherian_of_range_eq_ker S.subtype S.mkQ
  rw [Submodule.ker_mkQ, Submodule.range_subtype]

name: IsNoetherian.induction
statement:
theorem IsNoetherian.induction [IsNoetherian R M] {P : Submodule R M → Prop}
    (hgt : ∀ I, (∀ J > I, P J) → P I) (I : Submodule R M) : P I
proof:
:=
  IsWellFounded.induction _ I hgt

name: LinearMap.isNoetherian_iff_of_bijective
statement:
theorem LinearMap.isNoetherian_iff_of_bijective {S P} [Semiring S] [AddCommMonoid P] [Module S P]
    {σ : R →+* S} [RingHomSurjective σ] (l : M →ₛₗ[σ] P) (hl : Function.Bijective l) :
    IsNoetherian R M ↔ IsNoetherian S P
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [isNoetherian_iff']
  let e := Submodule.orderIsoMapComapOfBijective l hl
  exact ⟨fun _ ↦ e.symm.strictMono.wellFoundedGT, fun _ ↦ e.strictMono.wellFoundedGT⟩

name: Submodule.finite_ne_bot_of_iSupIndep
statement:
lemma Submodule.finite_ne_bot_of_iSupIndep {ι : Type*} {N : ι → Submodule R M} (h : iSupIndep N) :
    Set.Finite {i | N i ≠ ⊥}
proof:
:=
  WellFoundedGT.finite_ne_bot_of_iSupIndep h

name: LinearIndependent.finite_of_isNoetherian
statement:
theorem LinearIndependent.finite_of_isNoetherian [Nontrivial R] {ι} {v : ι → M}
    (hv : LinearIndependent R v) : Finite ι
proof:
:=
  WellFoundedGT.finite_of_iSupIndep hv.iSupIndep_span_singleton fun i _ ↦ hv.ne_zero i (by simp_all)

name: IsNoetherian.subsingleton_of_injective
statement:
theorem IsNoetherian.subsingleton_of_injective {P : Type*} [AddCommMonoid P] [Module R P]
    {f : P × M →ₗ[R] M} (inj : Injective f) : Subsingleton P
proof:
:=
  subsingleton_of_forall_eq 0 fun p ↦ by_contra fun _ ↦
    have ⟨g, inj⟩ := LinearMap.exists_finsupp_nat_of_prod_injective inj
    Infinite.not_finite <| WellFoundedGT.finite_of_iSupIndep
      (g.iSupIndep_map inj (iSupIndep_range_lsingle ℕ R P))
      fun i ↦ (Submodule.ne_bot_iff _).mpr ⟨_, ⟨_, ⟨p, rfl⟩, rfl⟩, by simpa [inj]⟩

name: LinearIndependent.set_finite_of_isNoetherian
statement:
theorem LinearIndependent.set_finite_of_isNoetherian [Nontrivial R] {s : Set M}
    (hi : LinearIndependent R ((↑) : s → M)) : s.Finite
proof:
:=
  hi.finite_of_isNoetherian

name: IsNoetherian.disjoint_partialSups_eventually_bot
statement:
theorem IsNoetherian.disjoint_partialSups_eventually_bot
    (f : ℕ → Submodule R M) (h : ∀ n, Disjoint (partialSups f n) (f (n + 1))) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ m, n ≤ m → f m = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  
  suffices t : ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ m, n ≤ m → f (m + 1) = ⊥ by
    obtain ⟨n, w⟩ := t
    use n + 1
    rintro (_ | m) p
    · cases p
    · apply w
      exact Nat.succ_le_succ_iff.mp p
  obtain ⟨n, w⟩ := monotone_stabilizes_iff_noetherian.mpr inferInstance (partialSups f)
  refine ⟨n, fun m p ↦ (h m).eq_bot_of_ge <| sup_eq_left.mp ?_⟩
  simpa only [partialSups_add_one] using (w (m + 1) <| le_add_right p).symm.trans <| w m p

name: isNoetherian_of_submodule_of_noetherian
statement:
theorem isNoetherian_of_submodule_of_noetherian (R M) [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M]
    (N : Submodule R M) (h : IsNoetherian R M) : IsNoetherian R N
proof:
:=
  isNoetherian_mk ⟨OrderEmbedding.wellFounded (Submodule.MapSubtype.orderEmbedding N).dual h.wf⟩

name: isNoetherian_of_tower
statement:
theorem isNoetherian_of_tower (R) {S M} [Semiring R] [Semiring S] [AddCommMonoid M] [SMul R S]
    [Module S M] [Module R M] [IsScalarTower R S M] (h : IsNoetherian R M) : IsNoetherian S M
proof:
:=
  isNoetherian_mk ⟨(Submodule.restrictScalarsEmbedding R S M).dual.wellFounded h.wf⟩

name: isNoetherian_of_fg_of_noetherian
statement:
theorem isNoetherian_of_fg_of_noetherian {R M} [Ring R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (N : Submodule R M) [I : IsNoetherianRing R] (hN : N.FG) : IsNoetherian R N
proof:
:=
  haveI : Module.Finite R N := .of_fg hN; inferInstance

name: isNoetherian_span_of_finite
statement:
theorem isNoetherian_span_of_finite (R) {M} [Ring R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] {A : Set M} (hA : A.Finite) : IsNoetherian R (Submodule.span R A)
proof:
:=
  isNoetherian_of_fg_of_noetherian _ (Submodule.fg_def.mpr ⟨A, hA, rfl⟩)

name: IsNoetherianRing.of_finite
statement:
theorem IsNoetherianRing.of_finite (R S) [Ring R] [Ring S] [Module R S] [IsScalarTower R S S]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [Module.Finite R S] : IsNoetherianRing S
proof:
:=
  isNoetherian_of_tower R inferInstance

name: isNoetherianRing_of_surjective
statement:
theorem isNoetherianRing_of_surjective (R) [Semiring R] (S) [Semiring S] (f : R →+* S)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) [H : IsNoetherianRing R] : IsNoetherianRing S
proof:
:=
  isNoetherian_mk ⟨OrderEmbedding.wellFounded (Ideal.orderEmbeddingOfSurjective f hf).dual H.wf⟩

name: isNoetherianRing_of_ringEquiv
statement:
theorem isNoetherianRing_of_ringEquiv (R) [Semiring R] {S} [Semiring S] (f : R ≃+* S)
    [IsNoetherianRing R] : IsNoetherianRing S
proof:
:=
  isNoetherianRing_of_surjective R S f.toRingHom f.toEquiv.surjective

name: FG.of_le_of_isNoetherian
statement: theorem FG.of_le_of_isNoetherian {S T : Submodule R M} [IsNoetherian R T] (hST : S ≤ T) : S.FG
proof:
:=
  isNoetherian_submodule.mp inferInstance _ hST

name: FG.of_le
statement: lemma FG.of_le [IsNoetherianRing R] {S T : Submodule R M} (hT : T.FG) (hST : S ≤ T) : S.FG
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Module.Finite.iff_fg] at hT
  exact FG.of_le_of_isNoetherian hST

name: FG.of_disjoint_of_isNoetherian_quotient
statement:
theorem FG.of_disjoint_of_isNoetherian_quotient {S T : Submodule R M} [IsNoetherian R (M ⧸ T)]
    (hST : Disjoint S T) : S.FG
proof:
:=
  Module.Finite.iff_fg.mp <| .of_injective (T.mkQ.domRestrict S) (by simp [hST])

name: Module.exists_finite_presentation
statement:
theorem Module.exists_finite_presentation [Small.{v} R] (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [Module.Finite R M] : ∃ (P : Type v) (_ : AddCommGroup P) (_ : Module R P) (_ : Module.Free R P)
      (_ : Module.Finite R P) (f : P →ₗ[R] M), Function.Surjective f
proof:
:= by
  rcases Module.Finite.exists_fin' R M with ⟨m, f', hf'⟩
  let f := f'.comp ((Finsupp.mapRange.linearEquiv (Shrink.linearEquiv.{v} R R)).trans
      (Finsupp.linearEquivFunOnFinite R R (Fin m))).1
  use (Fin m →₀ Shrink.{v, u} R), inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, f
  simpa [f] using hf'

name: eventuallyConst_of_isNoetherian
statement:
theorem eventuallyConst_of_isNoetherian [IsNoetherian R M] (f : ℕ →o Submodule R M) :
    atTop.EventuallyConst f
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [eventuallyConst_atTop, eq_comm]
  exact (monotone_stabilizes_iff_noetherian.mpr inferInstance) f

name: isNoetherian_def
statement: theorem isNoetherian_def : IsNoetherian R M ↔ ∀ s : Submodule R M, s.FG
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => h.noetherian, IsNoetherian.mk⟩

name: isNoetherian_submodule
statement:
theorem isNoetherian_submodule {N : Submodule R M} :
    IsNoetherian R N ↔ ∀ s : Submodule R M, s ≤ N → s.FG
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨hn⟩ => fun s hs =>
    have : s ≤ LinearMap.range N.subtype := N.range_subtype.symm ▸ hs
    Submodule.map_comap_eq_self this ▸ (hn _).map _,
    fun h => ⟨fun s => ?_⟩⟩
  specialize h (s.map N.subtype) (Submodule.map_subtype_le N s)
  exact Submodule.fg_of_fg_map_injective N.subtype Subtype.val_injective h

name: isNoetherian_submodule_left
statement:
theorem isNoetherian_submodule_left {N : Submodule R M} :
    IsNoetherian R N ↔ ∀ s : Submodule R M, (N ⊓ s).FG
proof:
:=
  isNoetherian_submodule.trans ⟨fun H _ => H _ inf_le_left, fun H _ hs => inf_of_le_right hs ▸ H _⟩

name: isNoetherian_submodule_right
statement:
theorem isNoetherian_submodule_right {N : Submodule R M} :
    IsNoetherian R N ↔ ∀ s : Submodule R M, (s ⊓ N).FG
proof:
:=
  isNoetherian_submodule.trans ⟨fun H _ => H _ inf_le_right, fun H _ hs => inf_of_le_left hs ▸ H _⟩

name: isNoetherian_of_le
statement:
theorem isNoetherian_of_le {s t : Submodule R M} [ht : IsNoetherian R t] (h : s ≤ t) :
    IsNoetherian R s
proof:
:=
  isNoetherian_submodule.mpr fun _ hs' => isNoetherian_submodule.mp ht _ (le_trans hs' h)

name: isNoetherian_iff'
statement: theorem isNoetherian_iff' : IsNoetherian R M ↔ WellFoundedGT (Submodule R M)
proof:
:= by
  refine .trans ?_ (wellFoundedGT_characterisations.out 1 4).symm
  exact
    ⟨fun ⟨h⟩ => fun k => (fg_iff_compact k).mp (h k), fun h =>
      ⟨fun k => (fg_iff_compact k).mpr (h k)⟩⟩

name: isNoetherian_iff
statement:
theorem isNoetherian_iff :
    IsNoetherian R M ↔ WellFounded ((· > ·) : Submodule R M → Submodule R M → Prop)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isNoetherian_iff', ← isWellFounded_iff]

name: isNoetherian_iff_fg_wellFounded
statement:
theorem isNoetherian_iff_fg_wellFounded :
    IsNoetherian R M ↔ WellFoundedGT { N : Submodule R M // N.FG }
proof:
:= by
  let α := { N : Submodule R M // N.FG }
  constructor
  · intro H
    let f : α ↪o Submodule R M := OrderEmbedding.subtype _
    exact OrderEmbedding.wellFoundedLT f.dual
  · intro H
    constructor
    intro N
    obtain ⟨⟨N₀, h₁⟩, e : N₀ ≤ N, h₂⟩ :=
      WellFounded.has_min H.wf { N' : α | N'.1 ≤ N } ⟨⟨⊥, Submodule.fg_bot⟩, @bot_le _ _ _ N⟩
    convert! h₁
    refine (e.antisymm ?_).symm
    by_contra h₃
    obtain ⟨x, hx₁ : x ∈ N, hx₂ : x ∉ N₀⟩ := Set.not_subset.mp h₃
    apply hx₂
    rw [eq_of_le_of_not_lt (le_sup_right : N₀ ≤ _) (h₂
      ⟨_, Submodule.FG.sup ⟨{x}, by rw [Finset.coe_singleton]⟩ h₁⟩ <|
      sup_le ((Submodule.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _ _).mpr hx₁) e)]
    exact (le_sup_left : R ∙ x ≤ _) (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _)

name: set_has_maximal_iff_noetherian
statement:
theorem set_has_maximal_iff_noetherian :
    (∀ a : Set <| Submodule R M, a.Nonempty → ∃ M' ∈ a, ∀ I ∈ a, ¬M' < I) ↔ IsNoetherian R M
proof:
:= by
  rw [isNoetherian_iff, WellFounded.wellFounded_iff_has_min]

name: monotone_stabilizes_iff_noetherian
statement:
theorem monotone_stabilizes_iff_noetherian :
    (∀ f : ℕ →o Submodule R M, ∃ n, ∀ m, n ≤ m → f n = f m) ↔ IsNoetherian R M
proof:
:= by
  rw [isNoetherian_iff', wellFoundedGT_iff_monotone_chain_condition]

name: Module.End.eventually_disjoint_ker_pow_range_pow
statement:
theorem Module.End.eventually_disjoint_ker_pow_range_pow (f : End R M) :
    ∀ᶠ n in atTop, Disjoint (LinearMap.ker (f ^ n)) (LinearMap.range (f ^ n))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn : ∀ m, n ≤ m → LinearMap.ker (f ^ n) = LinearMap.ker (f ^ m)⟩ :=
    monotone_stabilizes_iff_noetherian.mpr inferInstance f.iterateKer
  refine eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨n, fun m hm ↦ disjoint_iff.mpr ?_⟩
  rw [← hn _ hm, Submodule.eq_bot_iff]
  rintro - ⟨hx, ⟨x, rfl⟩⟩
  apply pow_map_zero_of_le hm
  replace hx : x ∈ LinearMap.ker (f ^ (n + m)) := by
    simpa [f.pow_apply n, f.pow_apply m, ← f.pow_apply (n + m), ← iterate_add_apply] using hx
  rwa [← hn _ (n.le_add_right m)] at hx

name: LinearMap.eventually_iSup_ker_pow_eq
statement:
lemma LinearMap.eventually_iSup_ker_pow_eq (f : M →ₗ[R] M) :
    ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ⨆ m, LinearMap.ker (f ^ m) = LinearMap.ker (f ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn : ∀ m, n ≤ m → ker (f ^ n) = ker (f ^ m)⟩ :=
    monotone_stabilizes_iff_noetherian.mpr inferInstance f.iterateKer
  refine eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨n, fun m hm ↦ ?_⟩
  refine le_antisymm (iSup_le fun l ↦ ?_) (le_iSup (fun i ↦ LinearMap.ker (f ^ i)) m)
  rcases le_or_gt m l with h | h
  · rw [← hn _ (hm.trans h), hn _ hm]
  · exact f.iterateKer.monotone h.le

name: isNoetherianRing_iff
statement: theorem isNoetherianRing_iff {R} [Semiring R] : IsNoetherianRing R ↔ IsNoetherian R R
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: isNoetherianRing_iff_ideal_fg
statement:
theorem isNoetherianRing_iff_ideal_fg (R : Type*) [Semiring R] :
    IsNoetherianRing R ↔ ∀ I : Ideal R, I.FG
proof:
:=
  isNoetherianRing_iff.trans isNoetherian_def

name: Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing
statement:
lemma Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing {R : Type*} [Semiring R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (I : Ideal R) :
    I.FG
proof:
:=
  IsNoetherian.noetherian _

name: IsNoetherian.injective_of_surjective_of_injective
statement:
theorem IsNoetherian.injective_of_surjective_of_injective (i f : N →ₗ[R] M)
    (hi : Injective i) (hf : Surjective f) : Injective f
proof:
:= by
  have := isNoetherian_of_injective i hi
  obtain ⟨n, H⟩ := monotone_stabilizes_iff_noetherian.2 ‹_›
    ⟨_, monotone_nat_of_le_succ <| f.iterateMapComap_le_succ i ⊥ (by simp)⟩
  exact LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.1 <| bot_unique <|
    f.ker_le_of_iterateMapComap_eq_succ i ⊥ n (H _ (Nat.le_succ _)) hf hi

name: IsNoetherian.injective_of_surjective_of_submodule
statement:
theorem IsNoetherian.injective_of_surjective_of_submodule
    {N : Submodule R M} (f : N →ₗ[R] M) (hf : Surjective f) : Injective f
proof:
:=
  IsNoetherian.injective_of_surjective_of_injective N.subtype f N.injective_subtype hf

name: IsNoetherian.injective_of_surjective_endomorphism
statement:
theorem IsNoetherian.injective_of_surjective_endomorphism (f : M →ₗ[R] M)
    (s : Surjective f) : Injective f
proof:
:=
  IsNoetherian.injective_of_surjective_of_injective _ f (LinearEquiv.refl _ _).injective s

name: IsNoetherian.bijective_of_surjective_endomorphism
statement:
theorem IsNoetherian.bijective_of_surjective_endomorphism (f : M →ₗ[R] M)
    (s : Surjective f) : Bijective f
proof:
:=
  ⟨IsNoetherian.injective_of_surjective_endomorphism f s, s⟩

name: IsNoetherian.subsingleton_of_prod_injective
statement:
theorem IsNoetherian.subsingleton_of_prod_injective (f : M × N →ₗ[R] M)
    (i : Injective f) : Subsingleton N
proof:
:= .intro fun x y ↦ by
  have h := IsNoetherian.injective_of_surjective_of_injective f _ i LinearMap.fst_surjective
  simpa using h (show LinearMap.fst R M N (0, x) = LinearMap.fst R M N (0, y) from rfl)

name: isOka_fg
statement:
theorem isOka_fg : IsOka (FG (R := R)) where
  top
proof:
:= ⟨{1}, by simp⟩
  oka {I a} hsup hcolon := by
    classical
    obtain ⟨_, f, hf⟩ := Submodule.fg_iff_exists_fin_generating_family.1 hsup
    obtain ⟨_, i, hi⟩ := Submodule.fg_iff_exists_fin_generating_family.1 hcolon
    rw [submodule_span_eq] at hf
    have H k : ∃ r : R, ∃ p ∈ I, r * a + p = f k := by
      apply mem_span_singleton_sup.1
      rw [sup_comm, ← hf]
      exact mem_span_range_self
    choose! r p p_mem_I Hf using H
    refine ⟨image p univ ∪ image (a • i) univ, le_antisymm ?_ (fun y hy ↦ ?_)⟩
    <;> simp only [coe_union, coe_image, coe_univ, image_univ, Pi.smul_apply, span_union]
    · simp only [sup_le_iff, span_le, range_subset_iff, smul_eq_mul]
      exact ⟨p_mem_I, fun _ ↦ mul_comm a _ ▸ mem_colon_span_singleton.1 (hi ▸ mem_span_range_self)⟩
    · rw [Submodule.mem_sup]
      obtain ⟨s, H⟩ := mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun.1 (hf ▸ Ideal.mem_sup_left hy)
      simp_rw [← Hf] at H
      ring_nf at H
      rw [sum_add_distrib, ← sum_mul, add_comm] at H
      refine ⟨(∑ k, s k * p k), sum_mem _ (fun _ _ ↦ mul_mem_left _ _ mem_span_range_self),
        (∑ k, s k * r k) * a, ?_, H⟩
      rw [mul_comm, ← smul_eq_mul, range_smul, ← submodule_span_eq, Submodule.span_smul, hi]
      exact smul_mem_smul_set <| mem_colon_span_singleton.2 <|
        (I.add_mem_iff_right <| I.sum_mem (fun _ _ ↦ mul_mem_left _ _ <| p_mem_I _)).1 (H ▸ hy)

name: IsNoetherianRing.of_prime
statement:
theorem IsNoetherianRing.of_prime (H : ∀ I : Ideal R, I.IsPrime → I.FG) :
    IsNoetherianRing R
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨isOka_fg.forall_of_forall_prime' (fun C hC₁ hC₂ I hI h ↦ ⟨sSup C, ?_, h⟩) H⟩
  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨J, J_mem_C, G_subset_J⟩ : ∃ J ∈ C, (G : Set R) ⊆ J := by
    refine hC₂.directedOn.exists_mem_subset_of_finset_subset_biUnion ⟨I, hI⟩ (fun _ hx ↦ ?_)
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, SetLike.mem_coe, exists_prop]
    exact (Submodule.mem_sSup_of_directed ⟨I, hI⟩ hC₂.directedOn).1 <| hG ▸ subset_span hx
  suffices J_eq_sSup : J = sSup C from J_eq_sSup ▸ J_mem_C
  exact le_antisymm (le_sSup J_mem_C) (hG ▸ Ideal.span_le.2 G_subset_J)

name: IsNoetherianRing.of_prime_ne_bot
statement:
theorem IsNoetherianRing.of_prime_ne_bot (H : ∀ I : Ideal R, I.IsPrime → I ≠ ⊥ → I.FG) :
    IsNoetherianRing R
proof:
:=
  .of_prime fun I hi ↦ (eq_or_ne I ⊥).elim (· ▸ Submodule.fg_bot) <| H _ hi

name: Int.isCoprime_iff_gcd_eq_one
statement: theorem Int.isCoprime_iff_gcd_eq_one {m n : ℤ} : IsCoprime m n ↔ Int.gcd m n = 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, b, h⟩
    refine Nat.dvd_one.mp (Int.gcd_dvd_iff.mpr ⟨a, b, ?_⟩)
    rwa [mul_comm m, mul_comm n, eq_comm]
  · rw [← Int.ofNat_inj, IsCoprime, Int.gcd_eq_gcd_ab, mul_comm m, mul_comm n, Nat.cast_one]
    intro h
    exact ⟨_, _, h⟩

name: Nat.isCoprime_iff_coprime
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem Nat.isCoprime_iff_coprime {m n : ℕ} : IsCoprime (m : ℤ) n ↔ Nat.Coprime m n
proof:
:= by
  rw [Int.isCoprime_iff_gcd_eq_one, Int.gcd_natCast_natCast]

name: Nat.Coprime.cast
statement:
theorem Nat.Coprime.cast {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {a b : ℕ} (h : Nat.Coprime a b) :
    IsCoprime (a : R) (b : R)
proof:
:=
  mod_cast h.isCoprime.intCast

name: Rat.isCoprime_num_den
statement: theorem Rat.isCoprime_num_den (x : ℚ) : IsCoprime x.num x.den
proof:
:=
  x.reduced.cast.of_isCoprime_of_dvd_left Int.dvd_natAbs_self

name: Int.isCoprime_gcdA
statement: theorem Int.isCoprime_gcdA {x y : ℤ} (h : IsCoprime x y) : IsCoprime (x.gcdA y) y
proof:
:= by
  use x, x.gcdB y
  rwa [mul_comm _ y, ← Int.gcd_eq_gcd_ab, Nat.cast_eq_one, ← Int.isCoprime_iff_gcd_eq_one]

name: Int.isCoprime_gcdB
statement: theorem Int.isCoprime_gcdB {x y : ℤ} (h : IsCoprime x y) : IsCoprime (x.gcdB y) x
proof:
:= by
  use y, x.gcdA y
  rwa [add_comm, mul_comm, ← Int.gcd_eq_gcd_ab, Nat.cast_eq_one, ← Int.isCoprime_iff_gcd_eq_one]

name: ne_zero_or_ne_zero_of_nat_coprime
statement:
theorem ne_zero_or_ne_zero_of_nat_coprime {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Nontrivial A] {a b : ℕ}
    (h : Nat.Coprime a b) : (a : A) ≠ 0 ∨ (b : A) ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  IsCoprime.ne_zero_or_ne_zero (R := A) <| by
    simpa only [map_natCast] using IsCoprime.map (Nat.Coprime.isCoprime h) (Int.castRingHom A)

name: IsCoprime.prod_left
statement: theorem IsCoprime.prod_left (h : ∀ i ∈ t, IsCoprime (s i) x) : IsCoprime (∏ i ∈ t, s i) x
proof:
:= by
  induction t using Finset.cons_induction with
  | empty => apply isCoprime_one_left
  | cons b t hbt ih =>
    rw [Finset.prod_cons]
    rw [Finset.forall_mem_cons] at h
    exact h.1.mul_left (ih h.2)

name: IsCoprime.prod_right
statement: theorem IsCoprime.prod_right : (∀ i ∈ t, IsCoprime x (s i)) → IsCoprime x (∏ i ∈ t, s i)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [isCoprime_comm] using IsCoprime.prod_left (R := R)

name: IsCoprime.prod_left_iff
statement: theorem IsCoprime.prod_left_iff : IsCoprime (∏ i ∈ t, s i) x ↔ ∀ i ∈ t, IsCoprime (s i) x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine Finset.induction_on t (iff_of_true isCoprime_one_left fun _ ↦ by simp) fun b t hbt ih ↦ ?_
  rw [Finset.prod_insert hbt, IsCoprime.mul_left_iff, ih, Finset.forall_mem_insert]

name: IsCoprime.prod_right_iff
statement: theorem IsCoprime.prod_right_iff : IsCoprime x (∏ i ∈ t, s i) ↔ ∀ i ∈ t, IsCoprime x (s i)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [isCoprime_comm] using IsCoprime.prod_left_iff (R := R)

name: IsCoprime.of_prod_left
statement:
theorem IsCoprime.of_prod_left (H1 : IsCoprime (∏ i ∈ t, s i) x) (i : I) (hit : i ∈ t) :
    IsCoprime (s i) x
proof:
:=
  IsCoprime.prod_left_iff.1 H1 i hit

name: IsCoprime.of_prod_right
statement:
theorem IsCoprime.of_prod_right (H1 : IsCoprime x (∏ i ∈ t, s i)) (i : I) (hit : i ∈ t) :
    IsCoprime x (s i)
proof:
:=
  IsCoprime.prod_right_iff.1 H1 i hit

name: Finset.prod_dvd_of_coprime
statement:
theorem Finset.prod_dvd_of_coprime
    (Hs : (t : Set I).Pairwise (IsCoprime on s)) (Hs1 : (∀ i ∈ t, s i ∣ z)) :
    (∏ x ∈ t, s x) ∣ z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction t using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert a r har ih =>
    rw [Finset.prod_insert har]
    refine IsCoprime.mul_dvd ?_ ?_ ?_
    · refine IsCoprime.prod_right fun i hir ↦ ?_
      exact Hs (by simp) (by simp [hir]) (ne_of_mem_of_not_mem hir har).symm
    · exact Hs1 a (Finset.mem_insert_self a r)
    · refine ih (Hs.mono ?_) fun i hi ↦ Hs1 i <| Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi
      simp only [Finset.coe_insert, Set.subset_insert]

name: Fintype.prod_dvd_of_coprime
statement:
theorem Fintype.prod_dvd_of_coprime [Fintype I] (Hs : Pairwise (IsCoprime on s))
    (Hs1 : ∀ i, s i ∣ z) : (∏ x, s x) ∣ z
proof:
:=
  Finset.prod_dvd_of_coprime (Hs.set_pairwise _) fun i _ ↦ Hs1 i

name: exists_sum_eq_one_iff_pairwise_coprime
statement:
theorem exists_sum_eq_one_iff_pairwise_coprime [DecidableEq I] (h : t.Nonempty) :
    (∃ μ : I → R, (∑ i ∈ t, μ i * ∏ j ∈ t \ {i}, s j) = 1) ↔
      Pairwise (IsCoprime on fun i : t ↦ s i)
proof:
:= by
  induction h using Finset.Nonempty.cons_induction with
  | singleton =>
    simp [exists_apply_eq, Pairwise, Function.onFun]
  | cons a t hat h ih =>
    rw [pairwise_cons']
    have mem : ∀ x ∈ t, a ∈ insert a t \ {x} := fun x hx ↦ by
      rw [mem_sdiff, mem_singleton]
      exact ⟨mem_insert_self _ _, fun ha ↦ hat (ha ▸ hx)⟩
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨μ, hμ⟩
      rw [sum_cons, cons_eq_insert, sdiff_singleton_eq_erase, erase_insert hat] at hμ
      refine ⟨ih.mp ⟨Pi.single h.choose (μ a * s h.choose) + μ * fun _ ↦ s a, ?_⟩, fun b hb ↦ ?_⟩
      · rw [prod_eq_mul_prod_sdiff_singleton_of_mem h.choose_spec, ← mul_assoc, ←
          @ite_eq_left _ _ h.choose_spec R (_ * _) 0, ← sum_pi_single', ← sum_add_distrib] at hμ
        rw [← hμ, sum_congr rfl]
        intro x hx
        convert! add_mul (R := R) _ _ _ using 2
        · by_cases hx : x = h.choose
          · rw [hx, Pi.single_eq_same, Pi.single_eq_same]
          · rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hx, Pi.single_eq_of_ne hx, zero_mul]
        · convert! (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
          rw [prod_eq_prod_sdiff_singleton_mul (mem x hx), mul_comm, sdiff_sdiff_comm,
            sdiff_singleton_eq_erase a, erase_insert hat]
      · have : IsCoprime (s b) (s a) :=
          ⟨μ a * ∏ i ∈ t \ {b}, s i, ∑ i ∈ t, μ i * ∏ j ∈ t \ {i}, s j, ?_⟩
        · exact ⟨this.symm, this⟩
        rw [mul_assoc, ← prod_eq_prod_sdiff_singleton_mul hb, sum_mul, ← hμ, sum_congr rfl]
        intro x hx
        rw [mul_assoc]
        congr
        rw [prod_eq_prod_sdiff_singleton_mul (mem x hx) _]
        congr 2
        rw [sdiff_sdiff_comm, sdiff_singleton_eq_erase a, erase_insert hat]
    · rintro ⟨hs, Hb⟩
      obtain ⟨μ, hμ⟩ := ih.mpr hs
      obtain ⟨u, v, huv⟩ := IsCoprime.prod_left fun b hb ↦ (Hb b hb).right
      use fun i ↦ if i = a then u else v * μ i
      have hμ' : (∑ i ∈ t, v * ((μ i * ∏ j ∈ t \ {i}, s j) * s a)) = v * s a := by
        rw [← mul_sum, ← sum_mul, hμ, one_mul]
      rw [sum_cons, cons_eq_insert, sdiff_singleton_eq_erase, erase_insert hat]
      simp only [↓reduceIte, ite_mul]
      rw [← huv, ← hμ', sum_congr rfl]
      intro x hx
      rw [mul_assoc, ite_eq_right fun ha : x = a ↦ hat (ha.casesOn hx)]
      rw [mul_assoc]
      congr
      rw [prod_eq_prod_sdiff_singleton_mul (mem x hx) _]
      congr 2
      rw [sdiff_sdiff_comm, sdiff_singleton_eq_erase a, erase_insert hat]

name: exists_sum_eq_one_iff_pairwise_coprime'
statement:
theorem exists_sum_eq_one_iff_pairwise_coprime' [Fintype I] [Nonempty I] [DecidableEq I] :
    (∃ μ : I → R, (∑ i : I, μ i * ∏ j ∈ {i}ᶜ, s j) = 1) ↔ Pairwise (IsCoprime on s)
proof:
:= by
  convert! exists_sum_eq_one_iff_pairwise_coprime Finset.univ_nonempty (s := s) using 1
  simp only [pairwise_subtype_iff_pairwise_finset', coe_univ, Set.pairwise_univ]

name: pairwise_coprime_iff_coprime_prod
statement:
theorem pairwise_coprime_iff_coprime_prod [DecidableEq I] :
    Pairwise (IsCoprime on fun i : t ↦ s i) ↔ ∀ i ∈ t, IsCoprime (s i) (∏ j ∈ t \ {i}, s j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.pairwise_subtype_iff_pairwise_finset']
  refine ⟨fun hp i hi ↦ IsCoprime.prod_right_iff.mpr fun j hj ↦ ?_, fun hp ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_singleton] at hj
    exact (hp hj.1 hi hj.2).symm
  · rintro i hi j hj h
    apply IsCoprime.prod_right_iff.mp (hp i hi)
    exact Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hj, fun f ↦ h (Finset.mem_singleton.mp f).symm⟩

name: IsCoprime.pow_left
statement: theorem IsCoprime.pow_left (H : IsCoprime x y) : IsCoprime (x ^ m) y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.card_range m, ← Finset.prod_const]
  exact IsCoprime.prod_left fun _ _ ↦ H

name: IsCoprime.pow_right
statement: theorem IsCoprime.pow_right (H : IsCoprime x y) : IsCoprime x (y ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.card_range n, ← Finset.prod_const]
  exact IsCoprime.prod_right fun _ _ ↦ H

name: IsCoprime.pow
statement: theorem IsCoprime.pow (H : IsCoprime x y) : IsCoprime (x ^ m) (y ^ n)
proof:
:=
  H.pow_left.pow_right

name: IsCoprime.pow_left_iff
statement: theorem IsCoprime.pow_left_iff (hm : 0 < m) : IsCoprime (x ^ m) y ↔ IsCoprime x y
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, IsCoprime.pow_left⟩
  rw [← Finset.card_range m, ← Finset.prod_const] at h
  exact h.of_prod_left 0 (Finset.mem_range.mpr hm)

name: IsCoprime.pow_right_iff
statement: theorem IsCoprime.pow_right_iff (hm : 0 < m) : IsCoprime x (y ^ m) ↔ IsCoprime x y
proof:
:=
  isCoprime_comm.trans <| (IsCoprime.pow_left_iff hm).trans <| isCoprime_comm

name: IsCoprime.pow_iff
statement: theorem IsCoprime.pow_iff (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n) : IsCoprime (x ^ m) (y ^ n) ↔ IsCoprime x y
proof:
:=
  (IsCoprime.pow_left_iff hm).trans <| IsCoprime.pow_right_iff hn

name: IsRelPrime.prod_left
statement: theorem IsRelPrime.prod_left : (∀ i ∈ t, IsRelPrime (s i) x) → IsRelPrime (∏ i ∈ t, s i) x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine Finset.induction_on t (fun _ ↦ isRelPrime_one_left) fun b t hbt ih H ↦ ?_
  rw [Finset.prod_insert hbt]
  rw [Finset.forall_mem_insert] at H
  exact H.1.mul_left (ih H.2)

name: IsRelPrime.prod_right
statement: theorem IsRelPrime.prod_right : (∀ i ∈ t, IsRelPrime x (s i)) → IsRelPrime x (∏ i ∈ t, s i)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [isRelPrime_comm] using IsRelPrime.prod_left (α := α)

name: IsRelPrime.prod_left_iff
statement: theorem IsRelPrime.prod_left_iff : IsRelPrime (∏ i ∈ t, s i) x ↔ ∀ i ∈ t, IsRelPrime (s i) x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine Finset.induction_on t (iff_of_true isRelPrime_one_left fun _ ↦ by simp) fun b t hbt ih ↦ ?_
  rw [Finset.prod_insert hbt, IsRelPrime.mul_left_iff, ih, Finset.forall_mem_insert]

name: IsRelPrime.prod_right_iff
statement: theorem IsRelPrime.prod_right_iff : IsRelPrime x (∏ i ∈ t, s i) ↔ ∀ i ∈ t, IsRelPrime x (s i)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [isRelPrime_comm] using IsRelPrime.prod_left_iff (α := α)

name: IsRelPrime.of_prod_left
statement:
theorem IsRelPrime.of_prod_left (H1 : IsRelPrime (∏ i ∈ t, s i) x) (i : I) (hit : i ∈ t) :
    IsRelPrime (s i) x
proof:
:=
  IsRelPrime.prod_left_iff.1 H1 i hit

name: IsRelPrime.of_prod_right
statement:
theorem IsRelPrime.of_prod_right (H1 : IsRelPrime x (∏ i ∈ t, s i)) (i : I) (hit : i ∈ t) :
    IsRelPrime x (s i)
proof:
:=
  IsRelPrime.prod_right_iff.1 H1 i hit

name: Finset.prod_dvd_of_isRelPrime
statement:
theorem Finset.prod_dvd_of_isRelPrime :
    (t : Set I).Pairwise (IsRelPrime on s) → (∀ i ∈ t, s i ∣ z) → (∏ x ∈ t, s x) ∣ z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact Finset.induction_on t (fun _ _ ↦ one_dvd z)
    (by
      intro a r har ih Hs Hs1
      rw [Finset.prod_insert har]
      have aux1 : a ∈ (↑(insert a r) : Set I) := Finset.mem_insert_self a r
      refine
        (IsRelPrime.prod_right fun i hir ↦
              Hs aux1 (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hir) <| by
                rintro rfl
                exact har hir).mul_dvd
          (Hs1 a aux1) (ih (Hs.mono ?_) fun i hi ↦ Hs1 i <| Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)
      simp only [Finset.coe_insert, Set.subset_insert])

name: Fintype.prod_dvd_of_isRelPrime
statement:
theorem Fintype.prod_dvd_of_isRelPrime [Fintype I] (Hs : Pairwise (IsRelPrime on s))
    (Hs1 : ∀ i, s i ∣ z) : (∏ x, s x) ∣ z
proof:
:=
  Finset.prod_dvd_of_isRelPrime (Hs.set_pairwise _) fun i _ ↦ Hs1 i

name: pairwise_isRelPrime_iff_isRelPrime_prod
statement:
theorem pairwise_isRelPrime_iff_isRelPrime_prod [DecidableEq I] :
    Pairwise (IsRelPrime on fun i : t ↦ s i) ↔ ∀ i ∈ t, IsRelPrime (s i) (∏ j ∈ t \ {i}, s j)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hp i hi ↦ IsRelPrime.prod_right_iff.mpr fun j hj ↦ ?_, fun hp ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_singleton] at hj
    obtain ⟨hj, ji⟩ := hj
    exact @hp ⟨i, hi⟩ ⟨j, hj⟩ fun h ↦ ji (congrArg Subtype.val h).symm
  · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩ ⟨j, hj⟩ h
    apply IsRelPrime.prod_right_iff.mp (hp i hi)
    grind

name: pow_left
statement: theorem pow_left (H : IsRelPrime x y) : IsRelPrime (x ^ m) y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.card_range m, ← Finset.prod_const]
  exact IsRelPrime.prod_left fun _ _ ↦ H

name: pow_right
statement: theorem pow_right (H : IsRelPrime x y) : IsRelPrime x (y ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.card_range n, ← Finset.prod_const]
  exact IsRelPrime.prod_right fun _ _ ↦ H

name: pow
statement: theorem pow (H : IsRelPrime x y) : IsRelPrime (x ^ m) (y ^ n)
proof:
:=
  H.pow_left.pow_right

name: pow_left_iff
statement: theorem pow_left_iff (hm : 0 < m) : IsRelPrime (x ^ m) y ↔ IsRelPrime x y
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, IsRelPrime.pow_left⟩
  rw [← Finset.card_range m, ← Finset.prod_const] at h
  exact h.of_prod_left 0 (Finset.mem_range.mpr hm)

name: pow_right_iff
statement: theorem pow_right_iff (hm : 0 < m) : IsRelPrime x (y ^ m) ↔ IsRelPrime x y
proof:
:=
  isRelPrime_comm.trans <| (IsRelPrime.pow_left_iff hm).trans <| isRelPrime_comm

name: pow_iff
statement:
theorem pow_iff (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n) :
    IsRelPrime (x ^ m) (y ^ n) ↔ IsRelPrime x y
proof:
:=
  (IsRelPrime.pow_left_iff hm).trans (IsRelPrime.pow_right_iff hn)

name: IsCoprime.symm
statement:
@[symm]
theorem IsCoprime.symm (H : IsCoprime x y) : IsCoprime y x
proof:
:=
  let ⟨a, b, H⟩ := H
  ⟨b, a, by rw [add_comm, H]⟩

name: isCoprime_comm
statement: theorem isCoprime_comm : IsCoprime x y ↔ IsCoprime y x
proof:
:=
  ⟨IsCoprime.symm, IsCoprime.symm⟩

name: isCoprime_self
statement: theorem isCoprime_self : IsCoprime x x ↔ IsUnit x
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨a, b, h⟩ => .of_mul_eq_one (a + b) <| by rwa [mul_comm, add_mul], fun h =>
    let ⟨b, hb⟩ := isUnit_iff_exists_inv'.1 h
    ⟨b, 0, by rwa [zero_mul, add_zero]⟩⟩

name: isCoprime_zero_left
statement: theorem isCoprime_zero_left : IsCoprime 0 x ↔ IsUnit x
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨a, b, H⟩ => .of_mul_eq_one b <| by rwa [mul_zero, zero_add, mul_comm] at H, fun H =>
    let ⟨b, hb⟩ := isUnit_iff_exists_inv'.1 H
    ⟨1, b, by rwa [one_mul, zero_add]⟩⟩

name: isCoprime_zero_right
statement: theorem isCoprime_zero_right : IsCoprime x 0 ↔ IsUnit x
proof:
:=
  isCoprime_comm.trans isCoprime_zero_left

name: not_isCoprime_zero_zero
statement: theorem not_isCoprime_zero_zero [Nontrivial R] : ¬IsCoprime (0 : R) 0
proof:
:=
  mt isCoprime_zero_right.mp not_isUnit_zero

name: IsCoprime.intCast
statement:
lemma IsCoprime.intCast {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {a b : ℤ} (h : IsCoprime a b) :
    IsCoprime (a : R) (b : R)
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨u, v, H⟩
  use u, v
  rw_mod_cast [H]
  exact Int.cast_one

name: IsCoprime.ne_zero
statement: theorem IsCoprime.ne_zero [Nontrivial R] {p : Fin 2 → R} (h : IsCoprime (p 0) (p 1)) : p ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rintro rfl
  exact not_isCoprime_zero_zero h

name: IsCoprime.ne_zero_or_ne_zero
statement: theorem IsCoprime.ne_zero_or_ne_zero [Nontrivial R] (h : IsCoprime x y) : x ≠ 0 ∨ y ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  apply not_or_of_imp
  rintro rfl rfl
  exact not_isCoprime_zero_zero h

name: isCoprime_one_left
statement: theorem isCoprime_one_left : IsCoprime 1 x
proof:
:=
  ⟨1, 0, by rw [one_mul, zero_mul, add_zero]⟩

name: isCoprime_one_right
statement: theorem isCoprime_one_right : IsCoprime x 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨0, 1, by rw [one_mul, zero_mul, zero_add]⟩

name: IsCoprime.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right
statement: theorem IsCoprime.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right (H1 : IsCoprime x z) (H2 : x ∣ y * z) : x ∣ y
proof:
:= by
  let ⟨a, b, H⟩ := H1
  rw [← mul_one y, ← H, mul_add, ← mul_assoc, mul_left_comm]
  exact dvd_add (dvd_mul_left _ _) (H2.mul_left _)

name: IsCoprime.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left
statement: theorem IsCoprime.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left (H1 : IsCoprime x y) (H2 : x ∣ y * z) : x ∣ z
proof:
:= by
  let ⟨a, b, H⟩ := H1
  rw [← one_mul z, ← H, add_mul, mul_right_comm, mul_assoc b]
  exact dvd_add (dvd_mul_left _ _) (H2.mul_left _)

name: IsCoprime.dvd_mul_right_iff
statement: theorem IsCoprime.dvd_mul_right_iff (H : IsCoprime x z) : x ∣ y * z ↔ x ∣ y
proof:
:=
  ⟨H.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right, fun h ↦ h.mul_right z⟩

name: IsCoprime.dvd_mul_left_iff
statement: theorem IsCoprime.dvd_mul_left_iff (H : IsCoprime x y) : x ∣ y * z ↔ x ∣ z
proof:
:=
  ⟨H.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left, fun h ↦ h.mul_left y⟩

name: IsCoprime.mul_left
statement: theorem IsCoprime.mul_left (H1 : IsCoprime x z) (H2 : IsCoprime y z) : IsCoprime (x * y) z
proof:
:=
  let ⟨a, b, h1⟩ := H1
  let ⟨c, d, h2⟩ := H2
  ⟨a * c, a * x * d + b * c * y + b * d * z,
    calc a * c * (x * y) + (a * x * d + b * c * y + b * d * z) * z
      _ = (a * x + b * z) * (c * y + d * z) := by ring
      _ = 1 := by rw [h1, h2, mul_one]
      ⟩

name: IsCoprime.mul_right
statement: theorem IsCoprime.mul_right (H1 : IsCoprime x y) (H2 : IsCoprime x z) : IsCoprime x (y * z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isCoprime_comm] at H1 H2 ⊢
  exact H1.mul_left H2

name: IsCoprime.mul_dvd
statement: theorem IsCoprime.mul_dvd (H : IsCoprime x y) (H1 : x ∣ z) (H2 : y ∣ z) : x * y ∣ z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, h⟩ := H
  rw [← mul_one z, ← h, mul_add]
  apply dvd_add
  · rw [mul_comm z, mul_assoc]
    exact (mul_dvd_mul_left _ H2).mul_left _
  · rw [mul_comm b, ← mul_assoc]
    exact (mul_dvd_mul_right H1 _).mul_right _

name: IsCoprime.of_mul_left_left
statement: theorem IsCoprime.of_mul_left_left (H : IsCoprime (x * y) z) : IsCoprime x z
proof:
:=
  let ⟨a, b, h⟩ := H
  ⟨a * y, b, by rwa [mul_right_comm, mul_assoc]⟩

name: IsCoprime.of_mul_left_right
statement: theorem IsCoprime.of_mul_left_right (H : IsCoprime (x * y) z) : IsCoprime y z
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm] at H
  exact H.of_mul_left_left

name: IsCoprime.of_mul_right_left
statement: theorem IsCoprime.of_mul_right_left (H : IsCoprime x (y * z)) : IsCoprime x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [isCoprime_comm] at H ⊢
  exact H.of_mul_left_left

name: IsCoprime.of_mul_right_right
statement: theorem IsCoprime.of_mul_right_right (H : IsCoprime x (y * z)) : IsCoprime x z
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm] at H
  exact H.of_mul_right_left

name: IsCoprime.mul_left_iff
statement: theorem IsCoprime.mul_left_iff : IsCoprime (x * y) z ↔ IsCoprime x z ∧ IsCoprime y z
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun H => ⟨H.of_mul_left_left, H.of_mul_left_right⟩, fun ⟨H1, H2⟩ => H1.mul_left H2⟩

name: IsCoprime.mul_right_iff
statement: theorem IsCoprime.mul_right_iff : IsCoprime x (y * z) ↔ IsCoprime x y ∧ IsCoprime x z
proof:
:= by
  rw [isCoprime_comm, IsCoprime.mul_left_iff, isCoprime_comm, @isCoprime_comm _ _ z]

name: IsCoprime.of_isCoprime_of_dvd_left
statement: theorem IsCoprime.of_isCoprime_of_dvd_left (h : IsCoprime y z) (hdvd : x ∣ y) : IsCoprime x z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := hdvd
  exact IsCoprime.of_mul_left_left h

name: IsCoprime.of_isCoprime_of_dvd_right
statement: theorem IsCoprime.of_isCoprime_of_dvd_right (h : IsCoprime z y) (hdvd : x ∣ y) : IsCoprime z x
proof:
:=
  (h.symm.of_isCoprime_of_dvd_left hdvd).symm

name: IsCoprime.mono
statement:
@[gcongr]
theorem IsCoprime.mono (h₁ : x ∣ y) (h₂ : z ∣ w) (h : IsCoprime y w) : IsCoprime x z
proof:
:=
  h.of_isCoprime_of_dvd_left h₁ |>.of_isCoprime_of_dvd_right h₂

name: IsCoprime.isUnit_of_dvd
statement: theorem IsCoprime.isUnit_of_dvd (H : IsCoprime x y) (d : x ∣ y) : IsUnit x
proof:
:=
  let ⟨k, hk⟩ := d
  isCoprime_self.1 <| IsCoprime.of_mul_right_left <| show IsCoprime x (x * k) from hk ▸ H

name: IsCoprime.isUnit_of_associated
statement:
theorem IsCoprime.isUnit_of_associated {x y : R} (h₁ : IsCoprime x y) (h₂ : Associated x y) :
    IsUnit x ∧ IsUnit y
proof:
:=
  ⟨h₁.isUnit_of_dvd (h₂.dvd), h₁.symm.isUnit_of_dvd (h₂.dvd')⟩

name: IsCoprime.isUnit_of_dvd'
statement:
theorem IsCoprime.isUnit_of_dvd' {a b x : R} (h : IsCoprime a b) (ha : x ∣ a) (hb : x ∣ b) :
    IsUnit x
proof:
:=
  (h.of_isCoprime_of_dvd_left ha).isUnit_of_dvd hb

name: IsCoprime.isRelPrime
statement: theorem IsCoprime.isRelPrime {a b : R} (h : IsCoprime a b) : IsRelPrime a b
proof:
:=
  fun _ ↦ h.isUnit_of_dvd'

name: IsCoprime.map
statement:
theorem IsCoprime.map (H : IsCoprime x y) {S : Type v} [CommSemiring S] (f : R →+* S) :
    IsCoprime (f x) (f y)
proof:
:=
  let ⟨a, b, h⟩ := H
  ⟨f a, f b, by rw [← f.map_mul, ← f.map_mul, ← f.map_add, h, f.map_one]⟩

name: IsCoprime.of_add_mul_left_left
statement: theorem IsCoprime.of_add_mul_left_left (h : IsCoprime (x + y * z) y) : IsCoprime x y
proof:
:=
  let ⟨a, b, H⟩ := h
  ⟨a, a * z + b, by
    simpa only [add_mul, mul_add, add_assoc, add_comm, add_left_comm, mul_assoc, mul_comm,
      mul_left_comm] using H⟩

name: IsCoprime.of_add_mul_right_left
statement: theorem IsCoprime.of_add_mul_right_left (h : IsCoprime (x + z * y) y) : IsCoprime x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm] at h
  exact h.of_add_mul_left_left

name: IsCoprime.of_add_mul_left_right
statement: theorem IsCoprime.of_add_mul_left_right (h : IsCoprime x (y + x * z)) : IsCoprime x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [isCoprime_comm] at h ⊢
  exact h.of_add_mul_left_left

name: IsCoprime.of_add_mul_right_right
statement: theorem IsCoprime.of_add_mul_right_right (h : IsCoprime x (y + z * x)) : IsCoprime x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm] at h
  exact h.of_add_mul_left_right

name: IsCoprime.of_mul_add_left_left
statement: theorem IsCoprime.of_mul_add_left_left (h : IsCoprime (y * z + x) y) : IsCoprime x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm] at h
  exact h.of_add_mul_left_left

name: IsCoprime.of_mul_add_right_left
statement: theorem IsCoprime.of_mul_add_right_left (h : IsCoprime (z * y + x) y) : IsCoprime x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm] at h
  exact h.of_add_mul_right_left

name: IsCoprime.of_mul_add_left_right
statement: theorem IsCoprime.of_mul_add_left_right (h : IsCoprime x (x * z + y)) : IsCoprime x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm] at h

name: sq_add_sq_ne_zero
statement:
theorem sq_add_sq_ne_zero {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R]
    {a b : R} (h : IsCoprime a b) :
    a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h'
  obtain ⟨ha, hb⟩ := (add_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _)).mp h'
  obtain rfl := eq_zero_of_pow_eq_zero ha
  obtain rfl := eq_zero_of_pow_eq_zero hb
  exact not_isCoprime_zero_zero h

name: Nat.isCoprime_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma Nat.isCoprime_iff {m n : ℕ} : IsCoprime m n ↔ m = 1 ∨ n = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨a, b, H⟩ => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
  · simp_rw [Nat.add_eq_one_iff, mul_eq_one, mul_eq_zero] at H
    exact H.symm.imp (·.1.2) (·.2.2)
  · obtain rfl | rfl := h
    · exact isCoprime_one_left
    · exact isCoprime_one_right

name: Semifield.isCoprime_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma Semifield.isCoprime_iff {R : Type*} [Semifield R] {m n : R} :
    IsCoprime m n ↔ m ≠ 0 ∨ n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hn := eq_or_ne n 0
  · simp [isCoprime_zero_right]
  suffices IsCoprime m n by simpa [hn]
  refine ⟨0, n⁻¹, ?_⟩
  simp [inv_mul_cancel₀ hn]

name: sub_mul_left_left_iff
statement: @[simp] theorem sub_mul_left_left_iff : IsRelPrime (x - y * z) y ↔ IsRelPrime x y

name: sub_mul_right_right_iff

name: mul_sub_left_left_iff
statement: @[simp] theorem mul_sub_left_left_iff : IsRelPrime (y * z - x) y ↔ IsRelPrime x y

name: mul_sub_right_left_iff
statement: @[simp] theorem mul_sub_right_left_iff : IsRelPrime (z * y - x) y ↔ IsRelPrime x y

name: add_one_left_of_dvd
statement: lemma add_one_left_of_dvd (h : y ∣ x) : IsRelPrime (x + 1) y
proof:
