  rcases hI with ⟨I, rfl⟩
  rcases exist_integer_multiples_of_finset S I with ⟨⟨s, hs1⟩, hs⟩
  rw [isFractional_span_iff]
  exact ⟨s, hs1, hs⟩

name: mem_span_mul_finite_of_mem_mul
statement:
theorem mem_span_mul_finite_of_mem_mul {I J : FractionalIdeal S P} {x : P} (hx : x ∈ I * J) :
    ∃ T T' : Finset P, (T : Set P) ⊆ I ∧ (T' : Set P) ⊆ J ∧ x ∈ span R (T * T' : Set P)
proof:
:=
  Submodule.mem_span_mul_finite_of_mem_mul (by simpa using mem_coe.mpr hx)

name: _root_.Units.submodule_isFractional
statement:
lemma _root_.Units.submodule_isFractional [IsLocalization S P] (I : (Submodule R P)ˣ) :
    IsFractional S I.1
proof:
:=
  FractionalIdeal.isFractional_of_fg (fg_unit _)

name: coeIdeal_fg
statement:
theorem coeIdeal_fg (inj : Function.Injective (algebraMap R P)) (I : Ideal R) :
    FG ((I : FractionalIdeal S P) : Submodule R P) ↔ I.FG
proof:
:=
  coeSubmodule_fg _ inj _

name: fg_unit
statement: theorem fg_unit (I : (FractionalIdeal S P)ˣ) : FG (I : Submodule R P)
proof:
:=
  Submodule.fg_unit <| Units.map (coeSubmoduleHom S P).toMonoidHom I

name: fg_of_isUnit
statement: theorem fg_of_isUnit (I : FractionalIdeal S P) (h : IsUnit I) : FG (I : Submodule R P)
proof:
:=
  fg_unit h.unit

name: _root_.Ideal.fg_of_isUnit
statement:
theorem _root_.Ideal.fg_of_isUnit (inj : Function.Injective (algebraMap R P)) (I : Ideal R)
    (h : IsUnit (I : FractionalIdeal S P)) : I.FG
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coeIdeal_fg S inj I]
  exact FractionalIdeal.fg_of_isUnit (R := R) I h

name: mem_canonicalEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_canonicalEquiv_apply {I : FractionalIdeal S P} {x : P'} :
    x ∈ canonicalEquiv S P P' I ↔
      ∃ y ∈ I,
        IsLocalization.map P' (RingHom.id R) (fun y (hy : y ∈ S) => show RingHom.id R y ∈ S from hy)
            (y : P) =
          x
proof:
:= by
  rw [canonicalEquiv, mapEquiv_apply, mem_map]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨y, mem, Eq⟩ => ⟨y, mem, Eq⟩, fun ⟨y, mem, Eq⟩ => ⟨y, mem, Eq⟩⟩

name: canonicalEquiv_symm
statement:
@[simp]
theorem canonicalEquiv_symm : (canonicalEquiv S P P').symm = canonicalEquiv S P' P
proof:
:=
  RingEquiv.ext fun I =>
    SetLike.ext_iff.mpr fun x => by
      rw [mem_canonicalEquiv_apply, canonicalEquiv, mapEquiv_symm, mapEquiv_apply,
        mem_map]
      exact ⟨fun ⟨y, mem, Eq⟩ => ⟨y, mem, Eq⟩, fun ⟨y, mem, Eq⟩ => ⟨y, mem, Eq⟩⟩

name: canonicalEquiv_flip
statement: theorem canonicalEquiv_flip (I) : canonicalEquiv S P P' (canonicalEquiv S P' P I) = I
proof:
:= by
  rw [← canonicalEquiv_symm, RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: canonicalEquiv_canonicalEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem canonicalEquiv_canonicalEquiv (P'' : Type*) [CommRing P''] [Algebra R P'']
    [IsLocalization S P''] (I : FractionalIdeal S P) :
    canonicalEquiv S P' P'' (canonicalEquiv S P P' I) = canonicalEquiv S P P'' I
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp [IsLocalization.map_map]

name: canonicalEquiv_trans_canonicalEquiv
statement:
theorem canonicalEquiv_trans_canonicalEquiv (P'' : Type*) [CommRing P''] [Algebra R P'']
    [IsLocalization S P''] :
    (canonicalEquiv S P P').trans (canonicalEquiv S P' P'') = canonicalEquiv S P P''
proof:
:=
  RingEquiv.ext (canonicalEquiv_canonicalEquiv S P P' P'')

name: canonicalEquiv_coeIdeal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem canonicalEquiv_coeIdeal (I : Ideal R) : canonicalEquiv S P P' I = I
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp [IsLocalization.map_eq]

name: canonicalEquiv_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem canonicalEquiv_self : canonicalEquiv S P P = RingEquiv.refl _
proof:
:= by
  rw [← canonicalEquiv_trans_canonicalEquiv S P P]
  convert! (canonicalEquiv S P P).symm_trans_self
  exact (canonicalEquiv_symm S P P).symm

name: exists_ne_zero_mem_isInteger
statement:
theorem exists_ne_zero_mem_isInteger [Nontrivial R] (hI : I ≠ 0) :
    ∃ x, x ≠ 0 ∧ algebraMap R K x ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y : K, y_mem, y_notMem⟩ :=
    SetLike.exists_of_lt (bot_lt_iff_ne_bot.mpr hI)
  have y_ne_zero : y ≠ 0 := by simpa using y_notMem
  obtain ⟨z, ⟨x, hx⟩⟩ := exists_integer_multiple R⁰ y
  refine ⟨x, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Ne, ← @IsFractionRing.to_map_eq_zero_iff R _ K, hx, Algebra.smul_def]
    exact mul_ne_zero (IsFractionRing.to_map_ne_zero_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors z.2) y_ne_zero
  · rw [hx]
    exact smul_mem _ _ y_mem

name: map_ne_zero
statement: theorem map_ne_zero [Nontrivial R] (hI : I ≠ 0) : I.map h ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, x_ne_zero, hx⟩ := exists_ne_zero_mem_isInteger hI
  contrapose x_ne_zero with map_eq_zero
  refine IsFractionRing.to_map_eq_zero_iff.mp (eq_zero_iff.mp map_eq_zero _ (mem_map.mpr ?_))
  exact ⟨algebraMap R K x, hx, h.commutes x⟩

name: map_eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_eq_zero_iff [Nontrivial R] : I.map h = 0 ↔ I = 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨not_imp_not.mp (map_ne_zero _), fun hI => hI.symm ▸ FractionalIdeal.map_zero h⟩

name: coeIdeal_injective
statement: theorem coeIdeal_injective : Function.Injective (fun (I : Ideal R) ↦ (I : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K))
proof:
:=
  coeIdeal_injective' le_rfl

name: coeIdeal_inj
statement:
theorem coeIdeal_inj {I J : Ideal R} :
    (I : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) = (J : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) ↔ I = J
proof:
:=
  coeIdeal_inj' le_rfl

name: coeIdeal_eq_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeIdeal_eq_zero {I : Ideal R} : (I : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) = 0 ↔ I = ⊥
proof:
:=
  coeIdeal_eq_zero' le_rfl

name: coeIdeal_ne_zero
statement: theorem coeIdeal_ne_zero {I : Ideal R} : (I : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) ≠ 0 ↔ I ≠ ⊥
proof:
:=
  coeIdeal_ne_zero' le_rfl

name: coeIdeal_eq_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeIdeal_eq_one {I : Ideal R} : (I : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) = 1 ↔ I = 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Ideal.one_eq_top] using! coeIdeal_inj

name: coeIdeal_ne_one
statement: theorem coeIdeal_ne_one {I : Ideal R} : (I : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) ≠ 1 ↔ I ≠ 1
proof:
:=
  not_iff_not.mpr coeIdeal_eq_one

name: num_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem num_eq_zero_iff [IsDomain R] {I : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K} : I.num = 0 ↔ I = 0 where
  mp h
proof:
:= zero_of_num_eq_bot zero_notMem_nonZeroDivisors h
  mpr h := h ▸ num_zero_eq (IsFractionRing.injective R K)

name: ne_zero_of_mul_eq_one
statement: theorem ne_zero_of_mul_eq_one (I J : FractionalIdeal R₁⁰ K) (h : I * J = 1) : I ≠ 0
proof:
:= fun hI =>
  zero_ne_one' (FractionalIdeal R₁⁰ K)
    (by
      convert! h
      simp [hI])

name: _root_.IsFractional.div_of_nonzero
statement:
theorem _root_.IsFractional.div_of_nonzero {I J : Submodule R₁ K} :
    IsFractional R₁⁰ I → IsFractional R₁⁰ J → J ≠ 0 → IsFractional R₁⁰ (I / J)
  | ⟨aI, haI, hI⟩, ⟨aJ, haJ, hJ⟩, h => by
    obtain ⟨y, mem_J, notMem_zero⟩
proof:
:=
      SetLike.exists_of_lt (show 0 < J by simpa only using! bot_lt_iff_ne_bot.mpr h)
    obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := hJ y mem_J
    use aI * y'
    constructor
    · apply (nonZeroDivisors R₁).mul_mem haI (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr _)
      intro y'_eq_zero
      have : algebraMap R₁ K aJ * y = 0 := by
        rw [← Algebra.smul_def, ← hy', y'_eq_zero, map_zero]
      have y_zero :=
        (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left
          (mt ((injective_iff_map_eq_zero (algebraMap R₁ K)).1 (IsFractionRing.injective _ _) _)
            (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mp haJ))
      apply notMem_zero
      simpa
    intro b hb
    convert! hI _ (hb _ (Submodule.smul_mem _ aJ mem_J)) using 1
    rw [← hy', mul_comm b, ← Algebra.smul_def, mul_smul]

name: isFractional_div_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem isFractional_div_of_ne_zero {I J : FractionalIdeal R₁⁰ K} (h : J ≠ 0) :
    IsFractional R₁⁰ (I / J : Submodule R₁ K)
proof:
:=
  I.isFractional.div_of_nonzero J.isFractional fun H =>
    h <| coeToSubmodule_injective <| H.trans coe_zero.symm

name: div_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem div_zero {I : FractionalIdeal R₁⁰ K} : I / 0 = 0
proof:
:=
  dite_eq_left rfl

name: div_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem div_of_ne_zero {I J : FractionalIdeal R₁⁰ K} (h : J ≠ 0) :
    I / J = ⟨I / J, isFractional_div_of_ne_zero h⟩
proof:
:=
  dite_eq_right h

name: coe_div
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_div {I J : FractionalIdeal R₁⁰ K} (hJ : J ≠ 0) :
    (↑(I / J) : Submodule R₁ K) = ↑I / (↑J : Submodule R₁ K)
proof:
:=
  congr_arg _ (dite_eq_right hJ)

name: mem_div_iff_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem mem_div_iff_of_ne_zero {I J : FractionalIdeal R₁⁰ K} (h : J ≠ 0) {x} :
    x ∈ I / J ↔ ∀ y ∈ J, x * y ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  rw [div_of_ne_zero h]
  exact Submodule.mem_div_iff_forall_mul_mem

name: mul_one_div_le_one
statement: theorem mul_one_div_le_one {I : FractionalIdeal R₁⁰ K} : I * (1 / I) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hI : I = 0
  · rw [hI, div_zero, mul_zero]
    exact zero_le 1
  · rw [← coe_le_coe, coe_mul, coe_div hI, coe_one]
    apply Submodule.mul_one_div_le_one

name: le_self_mul_one_div
statement:
theorem le_self_mul_one_div {I : FractionalIdeal R₁⁰ K} (hI : I ≤ (1 : FractionalIdeal R₁⁰ K)) :
    I ≤ I * (1 / I)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hI_nz : I = 0
  · rw [hI_nz, div_zero, mul_zero]
  · rw [← coe_le_coe, coe_mul, coe_div hI_nz, coe_one]
    rw [← coe_le_coe, coe_one] at hI
    exact Submodule.le_self_mul_one_div hI

name: le_div_iff_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem le_div_iff_of_ne_zero {I J J' : FractionalIdeal R₁⁰ K} (hJ' : J' ≠ 0) :
    I ≤ J / J' ↔ ∀ x ∈ I, ∀ y ∈ J', x * y ∈ J
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h _ hx => (mem_div_iff_of_ne_zero hJ').mp (h hx), fun h x hx =>
    (mem_div_iff_of_ne_zero hJ').mpr (h x hx)⟩

name: le_div_iff_mul_le
statement:
theorem le_div_iff_mul_le {I J J' : FractionalIdeal R₁⁰ K} (hJ' : J' ≠ 0) :
    I ≤ J / J' ↔ I * J' ≤ J
proof:
:= by
  rw [div_of_ne_zero hJ', ← coe_le_coe (I := I * J') (J := J), coe_mul]
  exact Submodule.le_div_iff_mul_le

name: div_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem div_one {I : FractionalIdeal R₁⁰ K} : I / 1 = I
proof:
:= by
  rw [div_of_ne_zero (one_ne_zero' (FractionalIdeal R₁⁰ K))]
  ext
  constructor <;> intro h
  · simpa using mem_div_iff_forall_mul_mem.mp h 1 ((algebraMap R₁ K).map_one ▸ coe_mem_one R₁⁰ 1)
  · apply mem_div_iff_forall_mul_mem.mpr
    rintro y ⟨y', _, rfl⟩
    convert! Submodule.smul_mem _ y' h using 1
    rw [mul_comm, Algebra.linearMap_apply, ← Algebra.smul_def]

name: eq_one_div_of_mul_eq_one_right
statement:
theorem eq_one_div_of_mul_eq_one_right (I J : FractionalIdeal R₁⁰ K) (h : I * J = 1) :
    J = 1 / I
proof:
:= by
  have hI : I ≠ 0 := ne_zero_of_mul_eq_one I J h
  suffices h' : I * (1 / I) = 1 from
    congr_arg Units.inv <| @Units.ext _ _ (Units.mkOfMulEqOne _ _ h) (Units.mkOfMulEqOne _ _ h') rfl
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply mul_le.mpr _
    intro x hx y hy
    rw [mul_comm]
    exact (mem_div_iff_of_ne_zero hI).mp hy x hx
  rw [← h]
  gcongr
  apply (le_div_iff_of_ne_zero hI).mpr _
  intro y hy x hx
  rw [mul_comm]
  exact mul_mem_mul hy hx

name: mul_div_self_cancel_iff
statement: theorem mul_div_self_cancel_iff {I : FractionalIdeal R₁⁰ K} : I * (1 / I) = 1 ↔ ∃ J, I * J = 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => ⟨1 / I, h⟩, fun ⟨J, hJ⟩ => by rwa [← eq_one_div_of_mul_eq_one_right I J hJ]⟩

name: map_div
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem map_div (I J : FractionalIdeal R₁⁰ K) (h : K ≃ₐ[R₁] K') :
    (I / J).map (h : K →ₐ[R₁] K') = I.map h / J.map h
proof:
:= by
  by_cases H : J = 0
  · rw [H, div_zero, FractionalIdeal.map_zero, div_zero]
  · simp [← coeToSubmodule_inj, div_of_ne_zero H, div_of_ne_zero (map_ne_zero _ H)]

name: map_one_div
statement:
theorem map_one_div (I : FractionalIdeal R₁⁰ K) (h : K ≃ₐ[R₁] K') :
    (1 / I).map (h : K →ₐ[R₁] K') = 1 / I.map h
proof:
:= by
  rw [FractionalIdeal.map_div, FractionalIdeal.map_one]

name: eq_zero_or_one
statement: theorem eq_zero_or_one (I : FractionalIdeal K⁰ L) : I = 0 ∨ I = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [or_iff_not_imp_left]
  intro hI
  simp_rw [@SetLike.ext_iff _ _ _ I 1, mem_one_iff]
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro x_mem
    obtain ⟨n, d, rfl⟩ := IsLocalization.exists_mk'_eq K⁰ x
    refine ⟨n / d, ?_⟩
    rw [map_div₀, IsFractionRing.mk'_eq_div]
  · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨y, y_ne, y_mem⟩ := exists_ne_zero_mem_isInteger hI
    rw [← div_mul_cancel₀ x y_ne, map_mul, ← Algebra.smul_def]
    exact smul_mem (M := L) I (x / y) y_mem

name: eq_zero_or_one_of_isField
statement: theorem eq_zero_or_one_of_isField (hF : IsField R₁) (I : FractionalIdeal R₁⁰ K) : I = 0 ∨ I = 1
proof:
:=
  letI : Field R₁ := hF.toField
  eq_zero_or_one I

name: spanFinset_coe
statement:
@[simp] lemma spanFinset_coe {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → K) :
    (spanFinset R₁ s f : Submodule R₁ K) = Submodule.span R₁ (f '' s)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: spanFinset_eq_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem spanFinset_eq_zero {ι : Type*} {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → K} :
    spanFinset R₁ s f = 0 ↔ ∀ j ∈ s, f j = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← coeToSubmodule_inj, spanFinset_coe, coe_zero, Submodule.span_eq_bot,
    Set.mem_image, Finset.mem_coe, forall_exists_index, and_imp, forall_apply_eq_imp_iff₂]

name: spanFinset_ne_zero
statement:
theorem spanFinset_ne_zero {ι : Type*} {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → K} :
    spanFinset R₁ s f ≠ 0 ↔ ∃ j ∈ s, f j ≠ 0
proof: := by simp

name: isFractional_span_singleton
statement: theorem isFractional_span_singleton (x : P) : IsFractional S (span R {x} : Submodule R P)
proof:
:=
  let ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_integer_multiple S x
  isFractional_span_iff.mpr ⟨a, a.2, fun _ hx' => (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hx').symm ▸ ha⟩

name: coe_spanSingleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_spanSingleton (x : P) : (spanSingleton S x : Submodule R P) = span R {x}
proof:
:= by
  rw [spanSingleton]
  rfl

name: mem_spanSingleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_spanSingleton {x y : P} : x ∈ spanSingleton S y ↔ ∃ z : R, z • y = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [spanSingleton]
  exact Submodule.mem_span_singleton

name: mem_spanSingleton_self
statement: theorem mem_spanSingleton_self (x : P) : x ∈ spanSingleton S x
proof:
:=
  (mem_spanSingleton S).mpr ⟨1, one_smul _ _⟩

name: den_mul_self_eq_num'
statement:
theorem den_mul_self_eq_num' (I : FractionalIdeal S P) :
    spanSingleton S (algebraMap R P I.den) * I = I.num
proof:
:= by
  apply coeToSubmodule_injective
  dsimp only
  rw [coe_mul, ← smul_eq_mul, coe_spanSingleton, smul_eq_mul, Submodule.span_singleton_mul]
  convert! I.den_mul_self_eq_num using 1
  ext
  rw [mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists, mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists]
  simp [smul_eq_mul, Algebra.smul_def, Submonoid.smul_def]

name: spanSingleton_le_iff_mem
statement:
@[simp]
theorem spanSingleton_le_iff_mem {x : P} {I : FractionalIdeal S P} :
    spanSingleton S x ≤ I ↔ x ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coe_le_coe, coe_spanSingleton, Submodule.span_singleton_le_iff_mem, mem_coe]

name: spanSingleton_eq_spanSingleton
statement:
theorem spanSingleton_eq_spanSingleton [IsDomain R] [Module.IsTorsionFree R P] {x y : P} :
    spanSingleton S x = spanSingleton S y ↔ ∃ z : Rˣ, z • x = y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Submodule.span_singleton_eq_span_singleton, spanSingleton, spanSingleton]
  exact Subtype.mk_eq_mk

name: eq_spanSingleton_of_principal
statement:
theorem eq_spanSingleton_of_principal (I : FractionalIdeal S P) [IsPrincipal (I : Submodule R P)] :
    I = spanSingleton S (generator (I : Submodule R P))
proof:
:= by
  
  
  rw [spanSingleton, ← coeToSubmodule_inj, coe_mk, span_singleton_generator]

name: isPrincipal_iff
statement:
theorem isPrincipal_iff (I : FractionalIdeal S P) :
    IsPrincipal (I : Submodule R P) ↔ ∃ x, I = spanSingleton S x
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ => ⟨generator (I : Submodule R P), eq_spanSingleton_of_principal I⟩,
    fun ⟨x, hx⟩ => { principal := ⟨x, Eq.trans (congr_arg _ hx) (coe_spanSingleton _ x)⟩ }⟩

name: spanSingleton_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem spanSingleton_zero : spanSingleton S (0 : P) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp [eq_comm]

name: spanSingleton_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem spanSingleton_eq_zero_iff {y : P} : spanSingleton S y = 0 ↔ y = 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h =>
    span_eq_bot.mp (by simpa using congr_arg Subtype.val h : span R {y} = ⊥) y (mem_singleton y),
    fun h => by simp [h]⟩

name: spanSingleton_ne_zero_iff
statement: theorem spanSingleton_ne_zero_iff {y : P} : spanSingleton S y ≠ 0 ↔ y ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  not_congr spanSingleton_eq_zero_iff

name: spanSingleton_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem spanSingleton_one : spanSingleton S (1 : P) = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext
  refine (mem_spanSingleton S).trans ((exists_congr ?_).trans (mem_one_iff S).symm)
  intro x'
  rw [Algebra.smul_def, mul_one]

name: spanSingleton_mul_spanSingleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem spanSingleton_mul_spanSingleton (x y : P) :
    spanSingleton S x * spanSingleton S y = spanSingleton S (x * y)
proof:
:= by
  apply coeToSubmodule_injective
  simp only [coe_mul, coe_spanSingleton, span_mul_span, singleton_mul_singleton]

name: spanSingleton_pow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem spanSingleton_pow (x : P) (n : ℕ) : spanSingleton S x ^ n = spanSingleton S (x ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero, pow_zero, spanSingleton_one]
  | succ n hn => rw [pow_succ, hn, spanSingleton_mul_spanSingleton, pow_succ]

name: coeIdeal_span_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeIdeal_span_singleton (x : R) :
    (↑(Ideal.span {x} : Ideal R) : FractionalIdeal S P) = spanSingleton S (algebraMap R P x)
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  refine (mem_coeIdeal S).trans (Iff.trans ?_ (mem_spanSingleton S).symm)
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y', hy', rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨x', rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hy'
    use x'
    rw [smul_eq_mul, map_mul, Algebra.smul_def]
  · rintro ⟨y', rfl⟩
    refine ⟨y' * x, Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mpr ⟨y', rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [map_mul, Algebra.smul_def]

name: canonicalEquiv_spanSingleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem canonicalEquiv_spanSingleton {P'} [CommRing P'] [Algebra R P'] [IsLocalization S P']
    (x : P) :
    canonicalEquiv S P P' (spanSingleton S x) =
      spanSingleton S
        (IsLocalization.map P' (RingHom.id R)
          (fun y (hy : y ∈ S) => show RingHom.id R y ∈ S from hy) x)
proof:
:= by
  apply SetLike.ext_iff.mpr
  intro y
  constructor <;> intro h
  · rw [mem_spanSingleton]
    obtain ⟨x', hx', rfl⟩ := (mem_canonicalEquiv_apply _ _ _).mp h
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := (mem_spanSingleton _).mp hx'
    use z
    rw [IsLocalization.map_smul, RingHom.id_apply]
  · rw [mem_canonicalEquiv_apply]
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := (mem_spanSingleton _).mp h
    use z • x
    use (mem_spanSingleton _).mpr ⟨z, rfl⟩
    simp [IsLocalization.map_smul]

name: mem_singleton_mul
statement:
theorem mem_singleton_mul {x y : P} {I : FractionalIdeal S P} :
    y ∈ spanSingleton S x * I ↔ ∃ y' ∈ I, y = x * y'
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine FractionalIdeal.mul_induction_on h ?_ ?_
    · intro x' hx' y' hy'
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (mem_spanSingleton S).mp hx'
      use a • y', Submodule.smul_mem (I : Submodule R P) a hy'
      rw [← ha, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc]
    · rintro _ _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ ⟨y', hy', rfl⟩
      exact ⟨y + y', Submodule.add_mem (I : Submodule R P) hy hy', (mul_add _ _ _).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨y', hy', rfl⟩
    exact mul_mem_mul ((mem_spanSingleton S).mpr ⟨1, one_smul _ _⟩) hy'

name: mk'_mul_coeIdeal_eq_coeIdeal
statement:
theorem mk'_mul_coeIdeal_eq_coeIdeal {I J : Ideal R₁} {x y : R₁} (hy : y ∈ R₁⁰) :
    spanSingleton R₁⁰ (IsLocalization.mk' K x ⟨y, hy⟩) * I = (J : FractionalIdeal R₁⁰ K) ↔
      Ideal.span {x} * I = Ideal.span {y} * J
proof:
:= by
  have :
    spanSingleton R₁⁰ (IsLocalization.mk' _ (1 : R₁) ⟨y, hy⟩) *
        spanSingleton R₁⁰ (algebraMap R₁ K y) =
      1 := by
    rw [spanSingleton_mul_spanSingleton, mul_comm, ← IsLocalization.mk'_eq_mul_mk'_one,
      IsLocalization.mk'_self, spanSingleton_one]
  let y' : (FractionalIdeal R₁⁰ K)ˣ := Units.mkOfMulEqOne _ _ this
  have coe_y' : ↑y' = spanSingleton R₁⁰ (IsLocalization.mk' K (1 : R₁) ⟨y, hy⟩) := rfl
  refine Iff.trans ?_ (y'.mul_right_inj.trans coeIdeal_inj)
  rw [coe_y', coeIdeal_mul, coeIdeal_span_singleton, coeIdeal_mul, coeIdeal_span_singleton, ←
    mul_assoc, spanSingleton_mul_spanSingleton, ← mul_assoc, spanSingleton_mul_spanSingleton,
    mul_comm (mk' _ _ _), ← IsLocalization.mk'_eq_mul_mk'_one, mul_comm (mk' _ _ _), ←
    IsLocalization.mk'_eq_mul_mk'_one, IsLocalization.mk'_self, spanSingleton_one, one_mul]

name: spanSingleton_mul_coeIdeal_eq_coeIdeal
statement:
theorem spanSingleton_mul_coeIdeal_eq_coeIdeal {I J : Ideal R₁} {z : K} :
    spanSingleton R₁⁰ z * (I : FractionalIdeal R₁⁰ K) = J ↔
      Ideal.span {((IsLocalization.sec R₁⁰ z).1 : R₁)} * I =
        Ideal.span {((IsLocalization.sec R₁⁰ z).2 : R₁)} * J
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mk'_mul_coeIdeal_eq_coeIdeal K (IsLocalization.sec R₁⁰ z).2.prop,
    IsLocalization.mk'_sec K z]

name: one_div_spanSingleton
statement: theorem one_div_spanSingleton (x : K) : 1 / spanSingleton R₁⁰ x = spanSingleton R₁⁰ x⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact if h : x = 0 then by simp [h] else (eq_one_div_of_mul_eq_one_right _ _ (by simp [h])).symm

name: div_spanSingleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem div_spanSingleton (J : FractionalIdeal R₁⁰ K) (d : K) :
    J / spanSingleton R₁⁰ d = spanSingleton R₁⁰ d⁻¹ * J
proof:
:= by
  rw [← one_div_spanSingleton]
  by_cases hd : d = 0
  · simp only [hd, spanSingleton_zero, div_zero, zero_mul]
  have h_spand : spanSingleton R₁⁰ d ≠ 0 := mt spanSingleton_eq_zero_iff.mp hd
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    rw [← mem_coe, coe_div h_spand, Submodule.mem_div_iff_forall_mul_mem] at hx
    specialize hx d (mem_spanSingleton_self R₁⁰ d)
    have h_xd : x = d⁻¹ * (x * d) := by field
    rw [← mem_coe, coe_mul, one_div_spanSingleton, h_xd]
    exact Submodule.mul_mem_mul (mem_spanSingleton_self R₁⁰ _) hx
  · rw [le_div_iff_mul_le h_spand, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, one_div_spanSingleton,
      spanSingleton_mul_spanSingleton, inv_mul_cancel₀ hd, spanSingleton_one, mul_one]

name: exists_eq_spanSingleton_mul
statement:
theorem exists_eq_spanSingleton_mul (I : FractionalIdeal R₁⁰ K) :
    ∃ (a : R₁) (aI : Ideal R₁), a ≠ 0 ∧ I = spanSingleton R₁⁰ (algebraMap R₁ K a)⁻¹ * aI
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a_inv, nonzero, ha⟩ := I.isFractional
  have nonzero := mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mp nonzero
  have map_a_nonzero : algebraMap R₁ K a_inv ≠ 0 :=
    mt IsFractionRing.to_map_eq_zero_iff.mp nonzero
  refine
    ⟨a_inv,
      Submodule.comap (Algebra.linearMap R₁ K) ↑(spanSingleton R₁⁰ (algebraMap R₁ K a_inv) * I),
      nonzero, ext fun x => Iff.trans ⟨?_, ?_⟩ mem_singleton_mul.symm⟩
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨x', hx'⟩ := ha x hx
    rw [Algebra.smul_def] at hx'
    refine ⟨algebraMap R₁ K x', (mem_coeIdeal _).mpr ⟨x', mem_singleton_mul.mpr ?_, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    · exact ⟨x, hx, hx'⟩
    · rw [hx', ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ map_a_nonzero, one_mul]
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨x', hx', rfl⟩ := (mem_coeIdeal _).mp hy
    obtain ⟨y', hy', hx'⟩ := mem_singleton_mul.mp hx'
    rw [Algebra.linearMap_apply] at hx'
    rwa [hx', ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ map_a_nonzero, one_mul]

name: ideal_factor_ne_zero
proof:
:= fun h ↦ by
  rw [h, Ideal.zero_eq_bot, coeIdeal_bot, mul_zero] at haJ
  exact hI haJ

name: constant_factor_ne_zero
statement:
theorem constant_factor_ne_zero {R} [CommRing R] {K : Type*} [Field K] [Algebra R K]
    [IsFractionRing R K] {I : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K} (hI : I ≠ 0) {a : R} {J : Ideal R}
    (haJ : I = spanSingleton R⁰ ((algebraMap R K) a)⁻¹ * ↑J) :
    (Ideal.span {a} : Ideal R) ≠ 0
proof:
:= fun h ↦ by
  rw [Ideal.zero_eq_bot, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot] at h
  rw [h, map_zero, inv_zero, spanSingleton_zero, zero_mul] at haJ
  exact hI haJ

name: le_spanSingleton_mul_iff
statement:
theorem le_spanSingleton_mul_iff {x : P} {I J : FractionalIdeal S P} :
    I ≤ spanSingleton S x * J ↔ ∀ zI ∈ I, ∃ zJ ∈ J, x * zJ = zI
proof:
:=
  show (∀ {zI} (_ : zI ∈ I), zI ∈ spanSingleton _ x * J) ↔ ∀ zI ∈ I, ∃ zJ ∈ J, x * zJ = zI by
    simp only [mem_singleton_mul, eq_comm]

name: spanSingleton_mul_le_iff
statement:
theorem spanSingleton_mul_le_iff {x : P} {I J : FractionalIdeal S P} :
    spanSingleton _ x * I ≤ J ↔ ∀ z ∈ I, x * z ∈ J
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mul_le, mem_spanSingleton]
  constructor
  · intro h zI hzI
    exact h x ⟨1, one_smul _ _⟩ zI hzI
  · rintro h _ ⟨z, rfl⟩ zI hzI
    rw [Algebra.smul_mul_assoc]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem J.1 _ (h zI hzI)

name: eq_spanSingleton_mul
statement:
theorem eq_spanSingleton_mul {x : P} {I J : FractionalIdeal S P} :
    I = spanSingleton _ x * J ↔ (∀ zI ∈ I, ∃ zJ ∈ J, x * zJ = zI) ∧ ∀ z ∈ J, x * z ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  simp only [le_antisymm_iff, le_spanSingleton_mul_iff, spanSingleton_mul_le_iff]

name: num_le
statement:
theorem num_le (I : FractionalIdeal S P) :
    (I.num : FractionalIdeal S P) ≤ I
proof:
:= by
  rw [← I.den_mul_self_eq_num', spanSingleton_mul_le_iff]
  intro _ h
  rw [← Algebra.smul_def]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ h

name: isPrincipal_of_isPrincipal_num
statement:
theorem isPrincipal_of_isPrincipal_num [IsDomain R]
    (I : FractionalIdeal R⁰ (FractionRing R)) (hI : I.num.IsPrincipal) :
    (I : Submodule R (FractionRing R)).IsPrincipal
proof:
:=
  Module.isPrincipal_submodule_iff.mp
    <| (FractionalIdeal.equivNumOfIsLocalization I).isPrincipal_iff.mpr
    <| Module.isPrincipal_submodule_iff.mpr hI

name: isNoetherian_zero
statement: theorem isNoetherian_zero : IsNoetherian R₁ (0 : FractionalIdeal R₁⁰ K)
proof:
:=
  isNoetherian_submodule.mpr fun I (hI : I ≤ (0 : FractionalIdeal R₁⁰ K)) => by
    rw [coe_zero, le_bot_iff] at hI
    rw [hI]
    exact fg_bot

name: isNoetherian_iff
statement:
theorem isNoetherian_iff {I : FractionalIdeal R₁⁰ K} :
    IsNoetherian R₁ I ↔ ∀ J ≤ I, (J : Submodule R₁ K).FG
proof:
:=
  isNoetherian_submodule.trans ⟨fun h _ hJ => h _ hJ, fun h J hJ => h ⟨J, isFractional_of_le hJ⟩ hJ⟩

name: isNoetherian_coeIdeal
statement:
theorem isNoetherian_coeIdeal [IsNoetherianRing R₁] (I : Ideal R₁) :
    IsNoetherian R₁ (I : FractionalIdeal R₁⁰ K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isNoetherian_iff]
  intro J hJ
  obtain ⟨J, rfl⟩ := le_one_iff_exists_coeIdeal.mp (le_trans hJ coeIdeal_le_one)
  exact (IsNoetherian.noetherian J).map _

name: isNoetherian_spanSingleton_inv_to_map_mul
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · rw [hx, map_zero, inv_zero, spanSingleton_zero, zero_mul]
    exact isNoetherian_zero
  have h_gx : algebraMap R₁ K x ≠ 0 :=
    mt ((injective_iff_map_eq_zero (algebraMap R₁ K)).mp (IsFractionRing.injective _ _) x) hx
  have h_spanx : spanSingleton R₁⁰ (algebraMap R₁ K x) ≠ 0 := spanSingleton_ne_zero_iff.mpr h_gx
  rw [isNoetherian_iff] at hI ⊢
  intro J hJ
  rw [← div_spanSingleton, le_div_iff_mul_le h_spanx] at hJ
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hI _ hJ
  use s * {(algebraMap R₁ K x)⁻¹}
  rw [Finset.coe_mul, Finset.coe_singleton, ← span_mul_span, hs, ← coe_spanSingleton R₁⁰, ←
    coe_mul, mul_assoc, spanSingleton_mul_spanSingleton, mul_inv_cancel₀ h_gx, spanSingleton_one,
    mul_one]

name: isNoetherian
statement: theorem isNoetherian [IsNoetherianRing R₁] (I : FractionalIdeal R₁⁰ K) : IsNoetherian R₁ I
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, J, _, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_spanSingleton_mul I
  apply isNoetherian_spanSingleton_inv_to_map_mul
  apply isNoetherian_coeIdeal

name: isFractional_adjoin_integral
statement:
theorem isFractional_adjoin_integral (hx : IsIntegral R x) :
    IsFractional S (Subalgebra.toSubmodule (Algebra.adjoin R ({x} : Set P)))
proof:
:=
  isFractional_of_fg hx.fg_adjoin_singleton

name: adjoinIntegral_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem adjoinIntegral_coe (hx : IsIntegral R x) :
    (adjoinIntegral S x hx : Submodule R P) =
      (Subalgebra.toSubmodule (Algebra.adjoin R ({x} : Set P)))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: mem_adjoinIntegral_self
statement: theorem mem_adjoinIntegral_self (hx : IsIntegral R x) : x ∈ adjoinIntegral S x hx
proof:
:=
  Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_singleton x)

name: _root_.IsFractional.mapEquiv
statement:
theorem _root_.IsFractional.mapEquiv {I : Submodule R K} (hI : IsFractional R⁰ I) :
    IsFractional S⁰ (I.map (semilinearEquivOfRingEquiv K L f).toLinearMap)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [IsFractional, mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero, ne_eq, Submodule.mem_map,
    forall_exists_index, and_imp, forall_apply_eq_imp_iff₂] at hI ⊢
  obtain ⟨r, hr0, hr⟩ := hI
  use f r
  refine ⟨by simp [hr0], ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  specialize hr x hx
  simp only [IsLocalization.IsInteger, RingHom.mem_rangeS] at hr ⊢
  obtain ⟨r', hr'⟩ := hr
  use f r'
  simp only [semilinearEquivOfRingEquiv, RingEquiv.toEquiv_eq_coe, Equiv.toFun_as_coe,
    EquivLike.coe_coe, Equiv.invFun_as_coe, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk]
  rw [Algebra.smul_def, ← ringEquivOfRingEquiv_algebraMap f (K := K) (L := L) r,
    ← map_mul, ← Algebra.smul_def, ← hr', ringEquivOfRingEquiv_algebraMap]

name: ringEquivOfRingEquiv_apply
statement:
lemma ringEquivOfRingEquiv_apply (f : R ≃+* S) (I : FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors R) K) :
    ringEquivOfRingEquiv K L f I =
      ⟨Submodule.map (semilinearEquivOfRingEquiv _ _ f).toLinearMap I.val,
        IsFractional.mapEquiv K L f I.prop⟩
proof: := rfl

name: ringEquivOfRingEquiv_apply_val
statement:
lemma ringEquivOfRingEquiv_apply_val (f : R ≃+* S) (I : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) :
    (ringEquivOfRingEquiv K L f I).val =
      I.val.map (semilinearEquivOfRingEquiv _ _ f).toLinearMap
proof: := rfl

name: ringEquivOfRingEquiv_trans
statement:
lemma ringEquivOfRingEquiv_trans {T : Type*} [CommRing T] [IsDomain T] (M : Type*) [CommRing M]
    [Algebra T M] [IsFractionRing T M] (f : R ≃+* S) (g : S ≃+* T) :
    ringEquivOfRingEquiv K M (f.trans g) =
      (ringEquivOfRingEquiv K L f).trans (ringEquivOfRingEquiv L M g)
proof:
:= by
  have : RingHomCompTriple f (g : S →+* T) (f.trans g : R →+* T) := ⟨rfl⟩
  ext1 I
  simp only [ringEquivOfRingEquiv, RingEquiv.coe_ringHom_trans, Function.comp_apply,
    semilinearEquivOfRingEquiv_comp K L f M, LinearEquiv.coe_trans,
    Submodule.map_comp, RingEquiv.coe_mk, Equiv.coe_fn_mk, RingEquiv.coe_trans]

name: ringEquivOfRingEquiv_trans_apply
statement:
lemma ringEquivOfRingEquiv_trans_apply {T : Type*} [CommRing T] [IsDomain T] (M : Type*)
    [CommRing M] [Algebra T M] [IsFractionRing T M]
    (f : R ≃+* S) (g : S ≃+* T) (I : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) :
    ringEquivOfRingEquiv K M (f.trans g) I =
      ringEquivOfRingEquiv L M g (ringEquivOfRingEquiv K L f I)
proof:
:= by
  simp [ringEquivOfRingEquiv_trans K L M]

name: ringEquivOfRingEquiv_refl
statement:
lemma ringEquivOfRingEquiv_refl :
    ringEquivOfRingEquiv K K (RingEquiv.refl R) = RingEquiv.refl (FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)
proof:
:= by
  ext I x
  simp only [ringEquivOfRingEquiv_apply, RingEquiv.coe_ringHom_refl, RingEquiv.symm_refl,
    val_eq_coe, RingEquiv.refl_apply, ← mem_coe]
  simp [semilinearEquivOfRingEquiv]

name: ringEquivOfRingEquiv_spanSingleton
statement:
lemma ringEquivOfRingEquiv_spanSingleton (x : K) :
    FractionalIdeal.ringEquivOfRingEquiv K L f (spanSingleton R⁰ x) =
      spanSingleton S⁰ (IsFractionRing.ringEquivOfRingEquiv (L := L) f x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ringEquivOfRingEquiv, val_eq_coe, RingEquiv.symm_symm, RingEquiv.coe_mk,
    Equiv.coe_fn_mk, coe_spanSingleton, IsFractionRing.ringEquivOfRingEquiv_apply]
  rw [SetLike.ext_iff]
  intro y
  simp only [← FractionalIdeal.mem_coe, coe_mk, mem_map_equiv, coe_spanSingleton,
    Submodule.mem_span_singleton, (semilinearEquivOfRingEquiv K L f).eq_symm_apply]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨r, rfl⟩
    use f r
    exact .symm (map_smulₛₗ _ r x)
  · rintro ⟨s, rfl⟩
    use f.symm s
    simp only [Algebra.smul_def, semilinearEquivOfRingEquiv_apply, map_mul, map_eq, RingHom.coe_coe,
      IsFractionRing.ringEquivOfRingEquiv_apply, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: ringEquivOfRingEquiv_symm_eq
statement:
lemma ringEquivOfRingEquiv_symm_eq :
    (FractionalIdeal.ringEquivOfRingEquiv K L f).symm =
      FractionalIdeal.ringEquivOfRingEquiv L K f.symm
proof:
:= by
  exact (RingEquiv.coe_nonUnitalRingHom_inj_iff (ringEquivOfRingEquiv K L f).symm
          (ringEquivOfRingEquiv L K f.symm)).mpr rfl

name: mem_extended_iff
statement: lemma mem_extended_iff (x : L) : x ∈ I.extended L hf ↔ x ∈ span B (map_f '' I)
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> { intro hx; simpa }

name: coe_extended_eq_span
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coe_extended_eq_span : I.extended L hf = span B (map_f '' I)
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp [mem_coe, mem_extended_iff]

name: extended_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem extended_zero : extended L hf (0 : FractionalIdeal M K) = 0
proof:
:=
  have : ((0 : FractionalIdeal M K) : Set K) = {0} := by ext; simp
  coeToSubmodule_injective (by simp [this])

name: extended_ne_zero
statement:
theorem extended_ne_zero [IsDomain B] (hf' : Function.Injective f) (hI : I ≠ 0) (hN : 0 ∉ N) :
    extended L hf I ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ne_eq, ← coeToSubmodule_inj, coe_extended_eq_span, coe_zero, Submodule.span_eq_bot,
    Set.mem_image, SetLike.mem_coe, forall_exists_index, and_imp, forall_apply_eq_imp_iff₂,
    not_forall]
  obtain ⟨x, hx₁, hx₂⟩ : ∃ x ∈ I, x ≠ 0 := by simpa [ne_eq, eq_zero_iff] using hI
  refine ⟨x, hx₁, ?_⟩
  exact (map_ne_zero_iff _ (IsLocalization.map_injective_of_injective' _ _ _ _ hN hf')).mpr hx₂

name: extended_eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem extended_eq_zero_iff [IsDomain B] (hf' : Function.Injective f) (hN : 0 ∉ N) :
    extended L hf I = 0 ↔ I = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun h ↦ h ▸ extended_zero _ _⟩
  contrapose!
  exact fun h ↦ extended_ne_zero L hf hf' h hN

name: extended_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem extended_one : extended L hf (1 : FractionalIdeal M K) = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine coeToSubmodule_injective <| Submodule.ext fun x ↦ ⟨fun hx ↦ span_induction
    ?_ (zero_mem _) (fun y z _ _ hy hz ↦ add_mem hy hz) (fun b y _ hy ↦ smul_mem _ b hy) hx, ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨b, _, rfl⟩
    rw [Algebra.linearMap_apply, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
    exact smul_mem _ _ <| subset_span ⟨1, by simpa using one_mem_one⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨f a, ha, by rw [Algebra.linearMap_apply, Algebra.linearMap_apply, map_eq]⟩

name: extended_le_one_of_le_one
statement: theorem extended_le_one_of_le_one (hI : I ≤ 1) : extended L hf I ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨J, rfl⟩ := le_one_iff_exists_coeIdeal.mp hI
  intro x hx
  simp only [mem_extended_iff, mem_span_image_iff_exists_fun] at hx
  obtain ⟨s, hs, c, rfl⟩ := hx
  refine Submodule.sum_smul_mem _ _ fun ⟨x, hx⟩ h ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := hI (hs hx)
  exact ⟨f a, by simp [map_eq]⟩

name: one_le_extended_of_one_le
statement: theorem one_le_extended_of_one_le (hI : 1 ≤ I) : 1 ≤ extended L hf I
proof:
:= by
  rw [one_le] at hI ⊢
  exact (mem_extended_iff _ _ _ _).mpr <| subset_span ⟨1, hI, by rw [map_one]⟩

name: extended_add
statement: theorem extended_add : (I + J).extended L hf = (I.extended L hf) + (J.extended L hf)
proof:
:= by
  apply coeToSubmodule_injective
  simp only [coe_extended_eq_span, coe_add, Submodule.add_eq_sup, ← span_union, ← Set.image_union]
  apply Submodule.span_eq_span
  · rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨i, hi, j, hj, rfl⟩ := (mem_add I J y).mp <| SetLike.mem_coe.mp hy
    rw [map_add]
    exact add_mem (Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, Set.mem_union_left _ hi, by simp⟩)
      (Submodule.subset_span ⟨j, Set.mem_union_right _ hj, by simp⟩)
  · rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    suffices y ∈ I + J from SetLike.mem_coe.mpr <| Submodule.subset_span ⟨y, by simp [this]⟩
    exact hy.elim (fun h ↦ (mem_add I J y).mpr ⟨y, h, 0, zero_mem J, add_zero y⟩)
      (fun h ↦ (mem_add I J y).mpr ⟨0, zero_mem I, y, h, zero_add y⟩)

name: extended_mul
statement: theorem extended_mul : (I * J).extended L hf = (I.extended L hf) * (J.extended L hf)
proof:
:= by
  apply coeToSubmodule_injective
  simp only [coe_extended_eq_span, coe_mul, span_mul_span]
  refine Submodule.span_eq_span (fun _ h ↦ ?_) (fun _ h ↦ ?_)
  · rcases h with ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    replace hx : x ∈ (I : Submodule A K) * (J : Submodule A K) := coe_mul I J ▸ hx
    rw [Submodule.mul_eq_span_mul_set] at hx
    refine span_induction (fun y hy ↦ ?_) (by simp) (fun y z _ _ hy hz ↦ ?_)
      (fun a y _ hy ↦ ?_) hx
    · rcases Set.mem_mul.mp hy with ⟨i, hi, j, hj, rfl⟩
      exact subset_span <| Set.mem_mul.mpr
        ⟨map_f i, ⟨i, hi, by simp⟩, map_f j, ⟨j, hj, by simp⟩, by simp⟩
    · exact map_add map_f y z ▸ Submodule.add_mem _ hy hz
    · rw [Algebra.smul_def, map_mul, map_eq, ← Algebra.smul_def]
      exact smul_mem _ (f a) hy
  · rcases Set.mem_mul.mp h with ⟨y, ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩, z, ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨i * j, mul_mem_mul hi hj, by simp⟩

name: extended_extended
statement:
theorem extended_extended {C W : Type*} [CommRing C] [CommRing W] [Algebra C W]
    {P : Submonoid C} [IsLocalization P W] {g : B →+* C} (hg : N ≤ Submonoid.comap g P) :
      (I.extended L hf).extended W hg =
        I.extended W (f := g.comp f) (hf.trans (Submonoid.monotone_comap hg))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coeToSubmodule_inj, coe_extended_eq_span, coe_extended_eq_span]
  refine Submodule.span_eq_span ?_ ?_
  · rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    have hx' : x ∈ span B (IsLocalization.map L f hf '' (I : Set K)) :=
      (mem_extended_iff L hf I x).1 hx
    refine span_induction (fun y hy ↦ ?_) (by simp) (fun y z _ _ hy hz ↦ ?_) (fun b y _ hy ↦ ?_) hx'
    · rcases hy with ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
      exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨z, hz, by rw [IsLocalization.map_map]⟩
    · rw [map_add]
      exact add_mem hy hz
    · rw [IsLocalization.map_smul]
      exact smul_mem _ (g b) hy
  · rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    refine Submodule.subset_span ⟨IsLocalization.map L f hf x, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (mem_extended_iff L hf I _).2 <| Submodule.subset_span ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    · rw [IsLocalization.map_map]

name: extended_coeIdeal_eq_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem extended_coeIdeal_eq_map (I₀ : Ideal A) :
    (I₀ : FractionalIdeal M K).extended L hf = (I₀.map f : FractionalIdeal N L)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.map, Ideal.span, ← coeToSubmodule_inj, Ideal.submodule_span_eq, coe_coeIdeal,
    IsLocalization.coeSubmodule_span, coe_extended_eq_span]
  refine Submodule.span_eq_span ?_ ?_
  · rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact Submodule.subset_span
      ⟨f a, Set.mem_image_of_mem f ha, by rw [Algebra.linearMap_apply, IsLocalization.map_eq hf a]⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact Submodule.subset_span
      ⟨algebraMap A K a, mem_coeIdeal_of_mem M ha, IsLocalization.map_eq hf a⟩

name: extended_spanSingleton
statement:
theorem extended_spanSingleton (x : K) :
    (spanSingleton M x).extended L hf = spanSingleton N (IsLocalization.map L f hf x)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  rw [mem_extended_iff, mem_spanSingleton, ← mem_span_singleton]
  refine ⟨fun hy ↦ span_le.2 ?_ hy, fun hy ↦ span_le.2 (fun _ h ↦ ?_) hy⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := (mem_spanSingleton _).1 hw
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Algebra.smul_def, map_mul, IsLocalization.map_eq, ← Algebra.smul_def]
    exact smul_mem _ _ (mem_span_singleton_self _)
  · exact subset_span ⟨x, SetLike.mem_coe.mpr (mem_spanSingleton_self _ x), h.symm⟩

name: extendedHom'_comp
statement:
theorem extendedHom'_comp {C W : Type*} [CommRing C] [CommRing W] [Algebra C W]
    {P : Submonoid C} [IsLocalization P W] {g : B →+* C} (hg : N ≤ Submonoid.comap g P) :
    (extendedHom' (A := B) (K := L) W hg).comp
      (extendedHom' (A := A) (K := K) L hf) =
        extendedHom' (A := A) (B := C) (f := g.comp f) (K := K) W
          (hf.trans (Submonoid.monotone_comap (f := f) hg))
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro I
  exact extended_extended (A := A) (B := B) (f := f) (K := K) (M := M) (L := L)
    (N := N) (hf := hf) (I := I) (C := C) (W := W) (P := P) (g := g) hg

name: le_one_of_extendedHom_le_one
statement:
theorem le_one_of_extendedHom_le_one [IsIntegrallyClosed A] [IsIntegrallyClosed B]
    (hI : extendedHom L B I ≤ 1) : I ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  contrapose hI
  rw [SetLike.not_le_iff_exists] at hI ⊢
  obtain ⟨x, hx₁, hx₂⟩ := hI
  refine ⟨algebraMap K L x, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [← FractionalIdeal.mem_coe, IsLocalization.algebraMap_eq_map_map_submonoid A⁰ B K L]
      using! subset_span <| Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hx₁
  · contrapose hx₂
    rw [mem_one_iff, ← IsIntegrallyClosed.isIntegral_iff] at hx₂ ⊢
    exact IsIntegral.tower_bot_of_field <| isIntegral_trans _ hx₂

name: extendedHom_le_one_iff
statement:
theorem extendedHom_le_one_iff [IsIntegrallyClosed A] [IsIntegrallyClosed B] :
    extendedHom L B I ≤ 1 ↔ I ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ le_one_of_extendedHom_le_one L B h, fun a ↦ extended_le_one_of_le_one L _ I a⟩

name: one_le_extendedHom_iff
statement: theorem one_le_extendedHom_iff (hI : I ≠ 0) : 1 ≤ extendedHom L B I ↔ 1 ≤ I
proof:
:= by
  rw [← inv_le_inv_iff ((extendedHom_eq_zero_iff _ _).not.mpr hI) (by simp), inv_one, ← map_inv₀,
    extendedHom_le_one_iff, inv_le_comm hI (by simp), inv_one]

name: extendedHom_eq_one_iff
statement: theorem extendedHom_eq_one_iff (hI : I ≠ 0) : extendedHom L B I = 1 ↔ I = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_antisymm_iff, extendedHom_le_one_iff, one_le_extendedHom_iff _ _ hI, ← le_antisymm_iff]

name: extendedHom_injective
statement:
theorem extendedHom_injective :
    Function.Injective (fun I : FractionalIdeal A⁰ K ↦ extendedHom L B I)
proof:
:= by
  intro I J h
  dsimp only at h
  by_cases hI : I = 0
  · rwa [hI, map_zero, eq_comm, extendedHom_eq_zero_iff L B, eq_comm, ← hI] at h
  by_cases hJ : J = 0
  · rwa [hJ, map_zero, extendedHom_eq_zero_iff L B, ← hJ] at h
  rwa [← mul_inv_eq_one₀ ((extendedHom_eq_zero_iff _ _).not.mpr hJ), ← map_inv₀, ← map_mul,
    extendedHom_eq_one_iff _ _ (mul_ne_zero hI (inv_ne_zero hJ)), mul_inv_eq_one₀ hJ] at h

statement:

name: constantCoeff_exp
statement:

name: map_exp

name: derivative_exp
statement:
theorem derivative_exp (A : Type*) [CommRing A] [Algebra ℚ A] :
    d⁄dX (exp A) = exp A
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [coeff_derivative, coeff_exp, coeff_exp]
  have key : (n + 1 : A) = algebraMap ℚ A (n + 1) := by
    rw [map_add, map_natCast, map_one]
  rw [key, ← map_mul, factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_add_one]
  congr 1
  field_simp

name: exp_unique_of_derivative_eq_self
statement:
theorem exp_unique_of_derivative_eq_self [CommRing A] [Algebra ℚ A] [IsAddTorsionFree A]
    {f : PowerSeries A} (hd : d⁄dX f = f) (hc : constantCoeff f = 1) :
    f = exp A
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    rw [coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff, hc, constantCoeff_exp]
  | succ n ih =>
    have eq1 : coeff n (d⁄dX f) = coeff n f := congrArg (coeff n) hd
    rw [coeff_derivative] at eq1
    have eq2 : coeff n (d⁄dX (exp A)) = coeff n (exp A) := congrArg (coeff n) (derivative_exp A)
    rw [coeff_derivative] at eq2
    rw [ih] at eq1
    have h : coeff (n + 1) f * (n + 1) = coeff (n + 1) (exp A) * (n + 1) := by
      rw [eq1, eq2]
    rw [← Nat.cast_succ, mul_comm, ← nsmul_eq_mul, mul_comm, ← nsmul_eq_mul] at h
    exact (smul_right_inj (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)).mp h

name: exp_mul_exp_eq_exp_add
statement:
theorem exp_mul_exp_eq_exp_add [Algebra ℚ A] (a b : A) :
    rescale a (exp A) * rescale b (exp A) = rescale (a + b) (exp A)
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  simp only [coeff_mul, exp, rescale, coeff_mk, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, coe_mk,
    Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ_mk, add_pow, sum_mul]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  rintro x hx
  suffices
    a ^ x * b ^ (n - x) *
        (algebraMap ℚ A (1 / ↑x.factorial) * algebraMap ℚ A (1 / ↑(n - x).factorial)) =
      a ^ x * b ^ (n - x) * (↑(n.choose x) * (algebraMap ℚ A) (1 / ↑n.factorial))
    by convert! this using 1 <;> ring
  congr 1
  rw [← map_natCast (algebraMap ℚ A) (n.choose x), ← map_mul, ← map_mul]
  refine RingHom.congr_arg _ ?_
  rw [mul_one_div (↑(n.choose x) : ℚ), one_div_mul_one_div]
  symm
  rw [div_eq_iff, div_mul_eq_mul_div, one_mul, choose_eq_factorial_div_factorial]
  · norm_cast
    rw [cast_div_charZero]
    apply factorial_mul_factorial_dvd_factorial (mem_range_succ_iff.1 hx)
  · apply mem_range_succ_iff.1 hx
  · rintro h
    apply factorial_ne_zero n
    rw [cast_eq_zero.1 h]

name: exp_mul_exp_neg_eq_one
statement: theorem exp_mul_exp_neg_eq_one [Algebra ℚ A] : exp A * evalNegHom (exp A) = 1
proof:
:= by
  convert! exp_mul_exp_eq_exp_add (1 : A) (-1) <;> simp

name: exp_pow_eq_rescale_exp
statement: theorem exp_pow_eq_rescale_exp [Algebra ℚ A] (k : ℕ) : exp A ^ k = rescale (k : A) (exp A)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    simp only [rescale_zero, constantCoeff_exp, Function.comp_apply, map_one, cast_zero,
      pow_zero (exp A), coe_comp]
  | succ k h =>
    simpa only [succ_eq_add_one, cast_add, ← exp_mul_exp_eq_exp_add (k : A), ← h, cast_one,
      id_apply, rescale_one] using pow_succ (exp A) k

name: exp_pow_sum
statement:
theorem exp_pow_sum [Algebra ℚ A] (n : ℕ) :
    ((Finset.range n).sum fun k => exp A ^ k) =
      PowerSeries.mk fun p => (Finset.range n).sum
        fun k => (k ^ p : A) * algebraMap ℚ A p.factorial⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simp only [exp_pow_eq_rescale_exp, rescale]
  ext
  simp only [one_div, coeff_mk, coe_mk, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk,
    coeff_exp, map_sum]

name: HasSubst.eventually_coeff_pow_eq_zero
statement:
lemma HasSubst.eventually_coeff_pow_eq_zero {f : A⟦X⟧} (hf : HasSubst f) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ᶠ m in .atTop, ∀ n' ≤ n, coeff n' (f ^ m) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := id hf
  refine Filter.eventually_of_mem (Filter.Ici_mem_atTop (k * (n + 1))) fun m hm n' hn' ↦
    coeff_of_lt_order _ ?_
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := le_iff_exists_add.mp (Set.mem_Ici.mp hm)
  grw [pow_add, ← order_mul_ge, pow_mul, ← le_order_pow_of_constantCoeff_eq_zero _
    (by rwa [map_pow]), ← _root_.le_add_right le_rfl, Nat.cast_lt]

name: subst_sub
statement:
theorem subst_sub (ha : HasSubst a) (f g : PowerSeries R) :

proof:

name: subst_smul
statement:
theorem subst_smul [Algebra A S] [IsScalarTower A R S]
    (ha : HasSubst a) (r : A) (f : PowerSeries R) :
    subst a (r • f) = r • (subst a f)
proof:

name: coeff_subst_finite
statement:
theorem coeff_subst_finite (ha : HasSubst a) (f : PowerSeries R) (e : τ →₀ ℕ) :
    (fun (d : ℕ) ↦ coeff d f • MvPowerSeries.coeff e (a ^ d)).HasFiniteSupport
proof:
:= by
  rw [Function.HasFiniteSupport]
  convert (MvPowerSeries.coeff_subst_finite ha.const f e).image
    (Finsupp.uniqueLinearEquiv ℕ ℕ ()).toEquiv
  rw [← Equiv.preimage_eq_iff_eq_image, ← Function.support_comp_eq_preimage]
  apply congr_arg
  rw [← Equiv.eq_comp_symm]
  ext
  simp [coeff]

name: coeff_subst_finite'
statement:
theorem coeff_subst_finite' (hb : HasSubst b) (f : PowerSeries R) (e : ℕ) :
    (fun (d : ℕ) ↦ coeff d f • (PowerSeries.coeff e (b ^ d))).HasFiniteSupport
proof:
:=
  coeff_subst_finite hb f _

name: coeff_subst
statement:
theorem coeff_subst (ha : HasSubst a) (f : PowerSeries R) (e : τ →₀ ℕ) :
    MvPowerSeries.coeff e (subst a f) =
      finsum (fun (d : ℕ) ↦
        coeff d f • (MvPowerSeries.coeff e (a ^ d)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [subst, MvPowerSeries.coeff_subst ha.const f e, ← finsum_comp_equiv
    (Finsupp.uniqueLinearEquiv ℕ ℕ ()).toEquiv.symm]
  apply finsum_congr
  intro
  congr
  simp

name: coeff_subst'
statement:
theorem coeff_subst' {b : S⟦X⟧} (hb : HasSubst b) (f : R⟦X⟧) (e : ℕ) :
    coeff e (f.subst b) =
      finsum (fun (d : ℕ) ↦
        coeff d f • PowerSeries.coeff e (b ^ d))
proof:
:= by
  simp [PowerSeries.coeff, coeff_subst hb]

name: constantCoeff_subst
statement:
theorem constantCoeff_subst (ha : HasSubst a) (f : PowerSeries R) :
    MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (subst a f) =
      finsum (fun d ↦ coeff d f • MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (a ^ d))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← MvPowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, coeff_subst ha f 0]

name: coeff_subst_X_pow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_subst_X_pow {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≠ 0) (f : PowerSeries R) (n : ℕ) :
    coeff n (subst (X ^ k) f) = ite (k ∣ n) (algebraMap R S (coeff (n / k) f)) 0
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [coeff_subst' (.X_pow hk), finsum_eq_single _ (n / k), ← pow_mul, Nat.mul_div_cancel' h,
      coeff_X_pow_self, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
    intro j hj
    rw [← pow_mul, coeff_X_pow, ite_eq_right, smul_zero]
    contrapose hj
    rw [hj, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left j hk.pos]
  · rw [coeff_subst' (.X_pow hk), finsum_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero]
    intro j
    rw [← pow_mul, coeff_X_pow, ite_eq_right, smul_zero]
    contrapose h
    use j

name: constantCoeff_subst_X_pow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem constantCoeff_subst_X_pow {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≠ 0) (f : PowerSeries R) :
    constantCoeff (subst (X ^ k) f) = algebraMap R S f.constantCoeff
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff, coeff_subst_X_pow hk, ite_eq_left (dvd_zero k),
    Nat.zero_div, coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff]

name: constantCoeff_subst_of_constantCoeff_zero
statement:
theorem constantCoeff_subst_of_constantCoeff_zero (ha : a.constantCoeff = 0) (f : PowerSeries R) :
    MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (subst a f) = algebraMap R S f.constantCoeff
proof:
:= by
  rw [constantCoeff_subst (HasSubst.of_constantCoeff_zero ha),
    finsum_eq_single _ 0 (fun d hd ↦ by rw [map_pow, ha, zero_pow hd, smul_zero])]
  simp [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply]

theorem constantCoeff_subst_eq_zero (ha : a.constantCoeff = 0) (f : PowerSeries R)

proof:

proof:

name: le_weightedOrder_subst
statement:
theorem le_weightedOrder_subst (w : τ → ℕ) (ha : HasSubst a) (f : PowerSeries R) :
    f.order * a.weightedOrder w ≤ (f.subst a).weightedOrder w
proof:
:= by
  refine .trans ?_ (MvPowerSeries.le_weightedOrder_subst _ (PowerSeries.hasSubst_iff.mp ha) _)
  simp only [ne_eq, Function.comp_const, le_iInf_iff]
  intro i hi
  trans i () * MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w a
  · exact mul_le_mul_left (f.order_le (i ()) (by delta PowerSeries.coeff; convert! hi; aesop)) _
  · simp [Finsupp.weight_apply, Finsupp.sum_fintype]

name: le_order_subst
statement:
theorem le_order_subst (a : MvPowerSeries τ S) (ha : HasSubst a) (f : PowerSeries R) :
    a.order * f.order ≤ (f.subst a).order
proof:
:= by
  refine .trans ?_ (MvPowerSeries.le_order_subst (PowerSeries.hasSubst_iff.mp ha) _)
  simp [order_eq_order]

name: le_order_subst_left
statement:
theorem le_order_subst_left {f : MvPowerSeries τ R} {φ : PowerSeries R}
    (hf : f.constantCoeff = 0) : φ.order ≤ (φ.subst f).order
proof:
:=
  .trans (ENat.self_le_mul_left φ.order (f.order_ne_zero_iff_constCoeff_eq_zero.mpr hf))
    (PowerSeries.le_order_subst f (HasSubst.of_constantCoeff_zero hf) _)

name: le_order_subst_right
statement:
theorem le_order_subst_right {f : MvPowerSeries τ R} {φ : PowerSeries R}
    (hf : f.constantCoeff = 0) (hφ : φ.constantCoeff = 0) : f.order ≤ (φ.subst f).order
proof:
:=
  .trans (ENat.self_le_mul_right _ (order_ne_zero_iff_constCoeff_eq_zero.mpr hφ))
    (PowerSeries.le_order_subst f (HasSubst.of_constantCoeff_zero hf) _)

name: le_order_subst_left'
statement:
theorem le_order_subst_left' {f φ : PowerSeries R} (hf : f.constantCoeff = 0) :
    φ.order ≤ PowerSeries.order (φ.subst f)
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [order_eq_order]
  exact le_order_subst_left hf

name: le_order_subst_right'
statement:
theorem le_order_subst_right' {f φ : PowerSeries R} (hf : f.constantCoeff = 0)
    (hφ : φ.constantCoeff = 0) : f.order ≤ PowerSeries.order (φ.subst f)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [order_eq_order]
  exact le_order_subst_right hf hφ

name: rescale_eq
statement:
lemma rescale_eq (r : R) (f : PowerSeries R) :
    rescale r f = MvPowerSeries.rescale (fun _ ↦ r) f
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [coeff_rescale, coeff, MvPowerSeries.coeff_rescale]
  simp [pow_zero, Finsupp.prod_single_index]

name: rescale_eq_subst
statement:
lemma rescale_eq_subst (r : R) (f : PowerSeries R) :
    PowerSeries.rescale r f = PowerSeries.subst (r • X : R⟦X⟧) f
proof:
:= by
  rw [rescale_eq, MvPowerSeries.rescale_eq_subst, X, subst, Pi.smul_def']

name: coe_rescaleAlgHom
statement: theorem coe_rescaleAlgHom (r : R) : rescaleAlgHom r = rescale r
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  rw [rescale_eq, RingHom.coe_coe, MvPowerSeries.rescaleAlgHom_apply]

name: subst_rescale_of_degree_eq_one
statement:
lemma subst_rescale_of_degree_eq_one (a : R) {σ : Type*} (p : MvPowerSeries σ R)
    (hp_lin : ∀ d ∈ Function.support p, d.degree = 1) (f : PowerSeries R) :
    subst p (rescale a f) = MvPowerSeries.rescale (Function.const σ a) (subst p f)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : PowerSeries.HasSubst p := by
    apply HasSubst.of_constantCoeff_zero
    rw [← MvPowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, MvPowerSeries.coeff_apply]
    have : (p 0 ≠ 0) → (0 : σ →₀ ℕ).degree = 1 := hp_lin 0
    grind
  rw [rescale_eq_subst, MvPowerSeries.rescale_eq_subst,
    subst_comp_subst_apply (HasSubst.smul_X' a) hp]
  nth_rewrite 3 [subst]
  rw [MvPowerSeries.subst_comp_subst_apply hp.const (MvPowerSeries.HasSubst.smul_X _),
    MvPowerSeries.ext_iff]
  intro _
  rw [subst_smul hp, ← Polynomial.coe_X, subst_coe hp, Polynomial.aeval_X,
    ← MvPowerSeries.rescale_eq_subst, MvPowerSeries.rescale_homogeneous_eq_smul hp_lin,
    subst, pow_one]

name: coeff_subst_sum_C_substInvFun_mul_X_pow_sub_X
statement:
lemma coeff_subst_sum_C_substInvFun_mul_X_pow_sub_X (n : ℕ) :
    coeff n (P.subst (∑ i : Fin (n + 1), C (substInvFun P i.1) * X ^ i.1) - X) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain (_ | _ | n) := n
  · rw [map_sub, coeff_subst']
    · simp +contextual [finsum_eq_single (a := 0), substInvFun, zero_pow_eq, hP]
    · simp [substInvFun, HasSubst]
  · rw [map_sub, coeff_subst']
    · rw [finsum_eq_single (a := 1)]
      · simp [substInvFun]
      · rintro (_ | _ | _) _ <;> simp_all [substInvFun, mul_pow, coeff_mul_X_pow']
    · simp [HasSubst, X, substInvFun]
  · rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    simp only [Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_last, map_sub, substInvFun]
    generalize hB : ∑ i : Fin (n + 2), C (substInvFun P i) * X ^ i.1 = B
    have hB' : B.constantCoeff = 0 := by simp [← hB, zero_pow_eq, substInvFun]
    simp only [neg_mul, map_neg, map_mul, coeff_X, Nat.add_eq_right, Nat.add_eq_zero_iff,
      one_ne_zero, and_false, ↓reduceIte, sub_zero]
    rw [coeff_subst']
    · simp only [smul_eq_mul, ← map_mul]
      generalize hk : ⅟(P.coeff 1) * coeff (n + 1 + 1) (subst B P) = k
      trans ∑ᶠ d, P.coeff d * (coeff (n + 1 + 1) (B ^ d) - if d = 1 then k else 0)
      · refine finsum_congr fun i ↦ ?_
        · congr 1
          obtain (_ | _ | i) := i
          · simp
          · simp [← sub_eq_add_neg]
          · simp only [add_assoc, Nat.reduceAdd]
            rw [add_comm B, add_pow, map_sum, Finset.sum_eq_single (a := 0)]
            · simp
            · rintro (_ | _ | j) hj hj'
              · simp at hj'
              · simp [mul_comm (C k), hB', mul_assoc, coeff_X_pow_mul']
              · rw [← neg_mul, mul_pow, ← pow_mul, mul_comm (_ ^ _)]
                simp [mul_assoc, coeff_X_pow_mul']
            · simp
      · simp_rw [mul_sub]
        rw [finsum_sub_distrib]
        · simp only [mul_ite, mul_zero]
          nth_rw 2 [finsum_eq_single (a := 1)]
          · simp only [↓reduceIte, ← hk, mul_invOf_cancel_left', sub_eq_zero]
            rw [coeff_subst']
            · rfl
            · simp [HasSubst, ← PowerSeries.constantCoeff.eq_def, hB']
          · simp +contextual
        · refine .subset (Set.finite_Iio (n + 3)) fun i ↦ ?_
          obtain ⟨B, rfl⟩ : X ∣ B := by rwa [X_dvd_iff]
          simp +contextual [mul_pow, coeff_X_pow_mul', Nat.lt_succ_iff]
        · exact .subset (Set.finite_singleton 1) (fun _ ↦ by simp +contextual)
    · simp [HasSubst, ← PowerSeries.constantCoeff.eq_def, hB']

name: subst_substInv_right
statement:
lemma subst_substInv_right :
    P.subst (substInv P) = X
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  have := coeff_subst_sum_C_substInvFun_mul_X_pow_sub_X P hP n
  rw [map_sub, sub_eq_zero] at this
  rw [← this, coeff_subst', coeff_subst']
  · congr! 3 with m
    generalize hB : (∑ i : Fin (n + 1), C (substInvFun P ↑i) * X ^ i.1) = B
    have : X ^ (n + 1) ∣ mk (substInvFun P) - B := by
      rw [X_pow_dvd_iff]
      intro m hm
      simp +contextual [← hB, coeff_X_pow, Finset.sum_eq_single (⟨m, hm⟩ : Fin (n + 1)),
        Fin.ext_iff, @eq_comm _ m]
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := this.trans (sub_dvd_pow_sub_pow _ _ m)
    simp [substInv, sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp hQ, coeff_X_pow_mul']
  · simp [HasSubst, X, zero_pow_eq, C, substInvFun]
  · simp [HasSubst, ← constantCoeff.eq_def, substInvFun, substInv]

name: constantCoeff_substInv
statement:
@[simp]
lemma constantCoeff_substInv : P.substInv.constantCoeff = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [substInv, substInvFun]

name: HasSubst.substInv
statement: lemma HasSubst.substInv : HasSubst P.substInv
proof: := by simp [HasSubst, ← constantCoeff.eq_def]

name: coeff_one_substInv
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coeff_one_substInv : P.substInv.coeff 1 = ⅟(P.coeff 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp [substInv, substInvFun]

name: subst_substInv_left
statement: lemma subst_substInv_left : P.substInv.subst P = X
proof:
:= by
  have : Invertible (P.substInv.coeff 1) := by simpa using invertibleInvOf
  let Q := P.substInv.substInv
  have hQ : HasSubst Q := HasSubst.substInv P.substInv
  have eq_aux : P.substInv.subst Q = X := subst_substInv_right P.substInv P.constantCoeff_substInv
  suffices h : Q = P from by simp_rw [← h, eq_aux]
  calc
    _ = PowerSeries.subst Q (P.subst P.substInv) := by
      rw [subst_substInv_right _ hP, subst_X hQ]
    _ = P := by
      simp [subst_comp_subst_apply (HasSubst.substInv P) hQ, eq_aux]

name: substInvOfIsUnit_eq_substInv

lemma substInvOfIsUnit_eq_substInv :
    letI

:= hP'.invertible

name: coeff_one_substInvOfIsUnit
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coeff_one_substInvOfIsUnit : (P.substInvOfIsUnit hP').coeff 1 = hP'.unit⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let := hP'.invertible

name: subst_substInvOfIsUnit_right
statement: lemma subst_substInvOfIsUnit_right : P.subst (substInvOfIsUnit P hP') = X

name: subst_substInvOfIsUnit_left

name: eq_substInvOfIsUnit_of_subst_eq_X
statement:

name: coeff_subst_X_zero_add_X_one
statement:
lemma coeff_subst_X_zero_add_X_one (f : R⟦X⟧) (e : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) :
    MvPowerSeries.coeff e (subst (X₀ + X₁) f) =
      (e 0 + e 1).choose (e 0) * coeff (e 0 + e 1) f
proof:
:= by
  rw [PowerSeries.subst, MvPowerSeries.coeff_subst
    (MvPowerSeries.hasSubst_of_constantCoeff_zero (fun _ ↦ by simp))]
  simp_rw [Finsupp.prod_pow, univ_unique, PUnit.default_eq_unit, prod_singleton,
    smul_eq_mul, ← MvPolynomial.coe_X, ← MvPolynomial.coe_add, ← MvPolynomial.coe_pow,
    MvPolynomial.coeff_coe]
  rw [finsum_eq_single _ (single () (e 0 + e 1)), mul_comm]
  · simp [MvPolynomial.coeff_add_pow, coeff]
  · simp only [MvPolynomial.coeff_add_pow, mem_antidiagonal, cast_ite]
    grind

name: coeff_subst_X_zero_subst_mul_X_one
statement:
lemma coeff_subst_X_zero_subst_mul_X_one (f : R⟦X⟧) (e : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) :
    MvPowerSeries.coeff e (subst X₀ f * subst X₁ f) = coeff (e 0) f * coeff (e 1) f
proof:
:= by
  rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul, Finset.sum_eq_single (single 0 (e 0), single 1 (e 1)) ?_ ?_]
  · grind [coeff_subst_single]
  · intro b hb hb'
    by_contra hmul_ne_zero
    rcases ne_zero_and_ne_zero_of_mul hmul_ne_zero with ⟨h0, h1⟩
    simp only [Fin.isValue, coeff_subst_single, ne_eq, ite_eq_right_iff,
      not_forall, exists_prop] at h0 h1
    apply hb'
    rw [Prod.ext_iff, ← mem_antidiagonal.mp hb, h0.1, h1.1]
    simp
  · intro he
    have he' : single 0 (e 0) + single 1 (e 1) = e := by
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp
    exact absurd (mem_antidiagonal.mpr he') he

name: coeff_inv_aux
statement:
theorem coeff_inv_aux (n : ℕ) (a : R) (φ : R⟦X⟧) :
    coeff n (inv.aux a φ) =
      if n = 0 then a
      else
        -a *
          ∑ x ∈ antidiagonal n,
            if x.2 < n then coeff x.1 φ * coeff x.2 (inv.aux a φ) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff, inv.aux, MvPowerSeries.coeff_inv_aux]
  simp only [Finsupp.single_eq_zero]
  split_ifs; · rfl
  congr 1
  symm
  apply Finset.sum_nbij' (fun (a, b) ↦ (single () a, single () b))
    fun (f, g) ↦ (f (), g ())
  · aesop
  · aesop
  · aesop
  · aesop
  · rintro ⟨i, j⟩ _hij
    obtain H | H := le_or_gt n j
    · aesop
    rw [ite_eq_left H, ite_eq_left]
    · rfl
    refine ⟨?_, fun hh ↦ H.not_ge ?_⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟩
      simpa [Finsupp.single_eq_same] using le_of_lt H
    · simpa [Finsupp.single_eq_same] using hh ()

name: coeff_invOfUnit
statement:
theorem coeff_invOfUnit (n : ℕ) (φ : R⟦X⟧) (u : Rˣ) :
    coeff n (invOfUnit φ u) =
      if n = 0 then ↑u⁻¹
      else
        -↑u⁻¹ *
          ∑ x ∈ antidiagonal n,
            if x.2 < n then coeff x.1 φ * coeff x.2 (invOfUnit φ u) else 0
proof:
:=
  coeff_inv_aux n (↑u⁻¹ : R) φ

name: maximalIdeal_eq_span_X
statement: theorem maximalIdeal_eq_span_X : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (k⟦X⟧) = Ideal.span {X}
proof:
:= by
  have hX : (Ideal.span {(X : k⟦X⟧)}).IsMaximal := by
    rw [Ideal.isMaximal_iff]
    constructor
    · rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
      exact Prime.not_dvd_one X_prime
    · intro I f hI hfX hfI
      rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton, X_dvd_iff] at hfX
      have hfI0 : C (f 0) ∈ I := by
        have : C (f 0) = f - (f - C (f 0)) := by rw [sub_sub_cancel]
        rw [this]
        apply Ideal.sub_mem I hfI
        apply hI
        rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton, X_dvd_iff, map_sub, constantCoeff_C, ←
          coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, sub_eq_zero, coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff]
        rfl
      rw [← Ideal.eq_top_iff_one]
      apply Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem I hfI0 (IsUnit.map C (Ne.isUnit hfX))
  rw [IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hX]

statement: theorem continuous_constantCoeff [Semiring R] : Continuous (constantCoeff (R := R))
proof:
:=
  coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff (R := R) ▸ continuous_coeff R 0

name: tendsto_iff_coeff_tendsto
statement:
theorem tendsto_iff_coeff_tendsto [Semiring R] {ι : Type*}
    (f : ι → PowerSeries R) (u : Filter ι) (g : PowerSeries R) :
    Tendsto f u (nhds g) ↔
    ∀ d : ℕ, Tendsto (fun i => coeff d (f i)) u (nhds (coeff d g))
proof:
:= by
  rw [MvPowerSeries.WithPiTopology.tendsto_iff_coeff_tendsto]
  apply (Finsupp.uniqueLinearEquiv ℕ ℕ ()).toEquiv.forall_congr
  intro d
  simp only [LinearEquiv.coe_toEquiv, Finsupp.uniqueLinearEquiv_apply, coeff]
  apply iff_of_eq
  congr
  · ext _; congr; ext; simp
  · ext; simp

name: tendsto_trunc_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_trunc_atTop [CommSemiring R] (f : R⟦X⟧) :
    Tendsto (fun d ↦ (trunc d f : R⟦X⟧)) atTop (𝓝 f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tendsto_iff_coeff_tendsto]
  intro d
  exact tendsto_atTop_of_eventually_const fun n (hdn : d < n) ↦ (by simp [coeff_trunc, hdn])

name: denseRange_toPowerSeries
statement:
theorem denseRange_toPowerSeries [CommSemiring R] :
    DenseRange (Polynomial.toPowerSeries (R := R))
proof:
:= fun f =>
  mem_closure_of_tendsto (tendsto_trunc_atTop R f) <| .of_forall fun _ ↦ Set.mem_range_self _

name: hasSum_iff_hasSum_coeff
statement:
theorem hasSum_iff_hasSum_coeff {g : R⟦X⟧} :
    HasSum f g ↔ ∀ d, HasSum (fun i ↦ coeff d (f i)) (coeff d g)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [HasSum, ← map_sum]
  apply tendsto_iff_coeff_tendsto

name: summable_iff_summable_coeff
statement:
theorem summable_iff_summable_coeff :
    Summable f ↔ ∀ d : ℕ, Summable (fun i ↦ coeff d (f i))
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Summable, hasSum_iff_hasSum_coeff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, h⟩ n
    exact ⟨coeff n a, h n⟩
  · intro h
    choose a h using h
    exact ⟨mk a, by simpa using h⟩

name: summable_of_tendsto_order_atTop_nhds_top
statement:
theorem summable_of_tendsto_order_atTop_nhds_top [LinearOrder ι] [LocallyFiniteOrderBot ι]
    (h : Tendsto (fun i ↦ (f i).order) atTop (𝓝 ⊤)) : Summable f
proof:
:= by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty ι with hempty | hempty
  · apply summable_empty
  rw [summable_iff_summable_coeff]
  intro n
  simp_rw [ENat.tendsto_nhds_top_iff_natCast_lt, Filter.eventually_atTop] at h
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := h n
  refine summable_of_hasFiniteSupport <| (Set.finite_Iic i).subset ?_
  simp_rw [Function.support_subset_iff, Set.mem_Iic]
  intro k hk
  contrapose! hk
  exact coeff_of_lt_order _ <| by simpa using (hi k hk.le)

name: summable_pow_of_constantCoeff_eq_zero
statement:
theorem summable_pow_of_constantCoeff_eq_zero {f : PowerSeries R} (h : f.constantCoeff = 0) :
    Summable (f ^ ·)
proof:
:=
  MvPowerSeries.WithPiTopology.summable_pow_of_constantCoeff_eq_zero h

name: tsum_pow_mul_one_sub_of_constantCoeff_eq_zero
statement:
theorem tsum_pow_mul_one_sub_of_constantCoeff_eq_zero (h : f.constantCoeff = 0) :
    (∑' (i : ℕ), f ^ i) * (1 - f) = 1
proof:
:=
  (summable_pow_of_constantCoeff_eq_zero h).tsum_pow_mul_one_sub

name: one_sub_mul_tsum_pow_of_constantCoeff_eq_zero
statement:
theorem one_sub_mul_tsum_pow_of_constantCoeff_eq_zero (h : f.constantCoeff = 0) :
    (1 - f) * ∑' (i : ℕ), f ^ i = 1
proof:
:=
  (summable_pow_of_constantCoeff_eq_zero h).one_sub_mul_tsum_pow

name: summable_prod_of_tendsto_order_atTop_nhds_top
statement:
theorem summable_prod_of_tendsto_order_atTop_nhds_top
    (h : Tendsto (fun i ↦ (f i).order) atTop (𝓝 ⊤)) : Summable (∏ i ∈ ·, f i)
proof:
:= by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty ι with hempty | hempty
  · apply Summable.of_finite
  refine (summable_iff_summable_coeff _).mpr fun n ↦ summable_of_hasFiniteSupport ?_
  simp_rw [ENat.tendsto_nhds_top_iff_natCast_lt, eventually_atTop] at h
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := h n
  apply (Finset.Iio i).powerset.finite_toSet.subset
  suffices ∀ s : Finset ι, coeff n (∏ i ∈ s, f i) ≠ 0 → ↑s ⊆ Set.Iio i by simpa
  intro s hs
  contrapose hs
  obtain ⟨x, hxs, hxi⟩ := Set.not_subset.mp hs
  rw [Set.mem_Iio, not_lt] at hxi
  refine coeff_of_lt_order _ <| (hi x hxi).trans_le <| le_trans ?_ (le_order_prod _ _)
  apply Finset.single_le_sum (by simp) hxs

name: multipliable_one_add_of_tendsto_order_atTop_nhds_top
statement:
theorem multipliable_one_add_of_tendsto_order_atTop_nhds_top
    (h : Tendsto (fun i ↦ (f i).order) atTop (nhds ⊤)) : Multipliable (1 + f ·)
proof:
:=
  multipliable_one_add_of_summable_prod <| summable_prod_of_tendsto_order_atTop_nhds_top _ h

name: multipliable_one_sub_X_pow
statement: theorem multipliable_one_sub_X_pow : Multipliable fun n ↦ (1 : R⟦X⟧) - X ^ (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R
  simp_rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
  apply multipliable_one_add_of_tendsto_order_atTop_nhds_top
  refine ENat.tendsto_nhds_top_iff_natCast_lt.mpr (fun n ↦ Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨n, ?_⟩)
  intro m hm
  rw [order_neg, order_X_pow]
  norm_cast
  exact Nat.lt_add_one_iff.mpr hm

name: tprod_one_sub_X_pow_ne_zero
statement:
theorem tprod_one_sub_X_pow_ne_zero [T2Space R] [Nontrivial R] :
    ∏' i, (1 - X ^ (i + 1)) ≠ (0 : R⟦X⟧)
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! h
  obtain h := PowerSeries.ext_iff.mp h 0
  simp [coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff, (multipliable_one_sub_X_pow R).map_tprod _
    (continuous_constantCoeff R)] at h

name: isTopologicallyNilpotent_of_constantCoeff_isNilpotent

theorem isTopologicallyNilpotent_of_constantCoeff_isNilpotent [CommSemiring R]

proof:
:=
  MvPowerSeries.WithPiTopology.isTopologicallyNilpotent_of_constantCoeff_isNilpotent hf

statement:

name: hasSum_of_monomials_self
statement:
theorem hasSum_of_monomials_self (f : PowerSeries R) :
    HasSum (fun d : ℕ => monomial d (coeff d f)) f
proof:

name: coeff_invUnitsSub
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_invUnitsSub (u : Rˣ) (n : ℕ) : coeff n (invUnitsSub u) = 1 /ₚ u ^ (n + 1)
proof:
:=
  coeff_mk _ _

name: constantCoeff_invUnitsSub
statement:
@[simp]
theorem constantCoeff_invUnitsSub (u : Rˣ) : constantCoeff (invUnitsSub u) = 1 /ₚ u
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, coeff_invUnitsSub, zero_add, pow_one]

name: invUnitsSub_mul_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem invUnitsSub_mul_X (u : Rˣ) : invUnitsSub u * X = invUnitsSub u * C (u : R) - 1
proof:
:= by
  ext (_ | n)
  · simp
  · simp [pow_succ']

name: invUnitsSub_mul_sub
statement:
@[simp]
theorem invUnitsSub_mul_sub (u : Rˣ) : invUnitsSub u * (C (u : R) - X) = 1
proof:

  simp [mul_sub, sub_sub_cancel]

name: map_invUnitsSub
statement:
theorem map_invUnitsSub (f : R →+* S) (u : Rˣ) :
    map f (invUnitsSub u) = invUnitsSub (Units.map (f : R →* S) u)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp only [← map_pow, coeff_map, coeff_invUnitsSub, one_divp]
  rfl

name: mk_one_mul_one_sub_eq_one
statement: theorem mk_one_mul_one_sub_eq_one : (mk 1 : S⟦X⟧) * (1 - X) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm, PowerSeries.ext_iff]
  intro n
  cases n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n => simp [sub_mul]

name: mk_neg_one_pow_mul_one_add_eq_one
statement: theorem mk_neg_one_pow_mul_one_add_eq_one : (mk fun n ↦ (-1 : S) ^ n) * (1 + X) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg (rescale (-1 : S)) (mk_one_mul_one_sub_eq_one S)
  simpa [rescale_mk, rescale_neg_one_X, sub_neg_eq_add] using this

name: mk_one_pow_eq_mk_choose_add
statement:
theorem mk_one_pow_eq_mk_choose_add :
    (mk 1 : S⟦X⟧) ^ (d + 1) = (mk fun n => Nat.choose (d + n) d : S⟦X⟧)
proof:
:= by
  induction d with
  | zero => ext; simp
  | succ d hd =>
      ext n
      rw [pow_add, hd, pow_one, mul_comm, coeff_mul]
      simp_rw [coeff_mk, Pi.one_apply, one_mul]
      norm_cast
      rw [Finset.sum_antidiagonal_choose_add, add_right_comm]

name: invOneSubPow_zero
statement: theorem invOneSubPow_zero : invOneSubPow S 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  delta invOneSubPow
  simp only

name: invOneSubPow_val_eq_mk_sub_one_add_choose_of_pos
statement:
theorem invOneSubPow_val_eq_mk_sub_one_add_choose_of_pos (h : 0 < d) :
    (invOneSubPow S d).val = (mk fun n => Nat.choose (d - 1 + n) (d - 1) : S⟦X⟧)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.sub_one_add_one_eq_of_pos h, invOneSubPow, add_tsub_cancel_right]

name: invOneSubPow_val_succ_eq_mk_add_choose
statement:
theorem invOneSubPow_val_succ_eq_mk_add_choose :
    (invOneSubPow S (d + 1)).val = (mk fun n => Nat.choose (d + n) d : S⟦X⟧)
proof: := rfl

name: invOneSubPow_val_one_eq_invUnitSub_one
statement:
theorem invOneSubPow_val_one_eq_invUnitSub_one :
    (invOneSubPow S 1).val = invUnitsSub (1 : Sˣ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [invOneSubPow, invUnitsSub]

name: invOneSubPow_eq_inv_one_sub_pow
statement:
theorem invOneSubPow_eq_inv_one_sub_pow :
    invOneSubPow S d =
      (Units.mkOfMulEqOne (1 - X) (mk 1 : S⟦X⟧) <|
        Eq.trans (mul_comm _ _) (mk_one_mul_one_sub_eq_one S))⁻¹ ^ d
proof:
:= by
  induction d with
  | zero => exact Eq.symm <| pow_zero _
  | succ d _ =>
      rw [inv_pow]
      exact (DivisionMonoid.inv_eq_of_mul _ (invOneSubPow S (d + 1)) <| by
        rw [← Units.val_eq_one, Units.val_mul, Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val]
        exact (invOneSubPow S (d + 1)).inv_val).symm

name: invOneSubPow_inv_eq_one_sub_pow
statement:
theorem invOneSubPow_inv_eq_one_sub_pow :
    (invOneSubPow S d).inv = (1 - X : S⟦X⟧) ^ d
proof:
:= by
  induction d with
  | zero => exact Eq.symm <| pow_zero _
  | succ d => rfl

name: invOneSubPow_inv_zero_eq_one
statement: theorem invOneSubPow_inv_zero_eq_one : (invOneSubPow S 0).inv = 1
proof:
:= by
  delta invOneSubPow
  simp only [Units.inv_eq_val_inv, inv_one, Units.val_one]

name: mk_add_choose_mul_one_sub_pow_eq_one
statement:
theorem mk_add_choose_mul_one_sub_pow_eq_one :
    (mk fun n ↦ Nat.choose (d + n) d : S⟦X⟧) * ((1 - X) ^ (d + 1)) = 1
proof:
:=
  (invOneSubPow S (d + 1)).val_inv

name: invOneSubPow_add
statement:
theorem invOneSubPow_add (e : ℕ) :
    invOneSubPow S (d + e) = invOneSubPow S d * invOneSubPow S e
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [invOneSubPow_eq_inv_one_sub_pow, pow_add]

name: one_sub_pow_mul_invOneSubPow_val_add_eq_invOneSubPow_val
statement:
theorem one_sub_pow_mul_invOneSubPow_val_add_eq_invOneSubPow_val (e : ℕ) :
    (1 - X) ^ e * (invOneSubPow S (d + e)).val = (invOneSubPow S d).val
proof:
:= by
  simp [invOneSubPow_add, Units.val_mul, mul_comm, mul_assoc, ← invOneSubPow_inv_eq_one_sub_pow]

name: one_sub_pow_add_mul_invOneSubPow_val_eq_one_sub_pow
statement:
theorem one_sub_pow_add_mul_invOneSubPow_val_eq_one_sub_pow (e : ℕ) :
    (1 - X) ^ (d + e) * (invOneSubPow S e).val = (1 - X) ^ d
proof:
:= by
  simp [pow_add, mul_assoc, ← invOneSubPow_inv_eq_one_sub_pow S e]
