name: exists_coeff_ne_zero_iff_ne_zero
statement: theorem exists_coeff_ne_zero_iff_ne_zero : (∃ n : ℕ, coeff n φ ≠ 0) ↔ φ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  contrapose!
  simp

name: order_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem order_zero : order (0 : R⟦X⟧) = ⊤
proof:
:=
  dite_eq_left rfl

name: order_finite_iff_ne_zero
statement: theorem order_finite_iff_ne_zero : (order φ < ⊤) ↔ φ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [order]
  split_ifs with h <;> simpa

name: order_eq_top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem order_eq_top {φ : R⟦X⟧} : φ.order = ⊤ ↔ φ = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa using order_finite_iff_ne_zero.not_left

name: coe_toNat_order
statement: theorem coe_toNat_order {φ : R⟦X⟧} (hf : φ ≠ 0) : φ.order.toNat = φ.order
proof:
:= by
  rw [ENat.natCast_toNat_eq_self.mpr (order_eq_top.not.mpr hf)]

name: coeff_order
statement: theorem coeff_order (h : φ ≠ 0) : coeff φ.order.toNat φ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [order, h, not_false_iff, dite_eq_right]
  generalize_proofs h
  exact Nat.find_spec h

name: order_le
statement: theorem order_le (n : ℕ) (h : coeff n φ ≠ 0) : order φ ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [order, dite_eq_right]
  · simpa using ⟨n, le_rfl, h⟩
  · exact exists_coeff_ne_zero_iff_ne_zero.mp ⟨n, h⟩

name: coeff_of_lt_order
statement: theorem coeff_of_lt_order (n : ℕ) (h : ↑n < order φ) : coeff n φ = 0
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! h
  exact order_le _ h

name: coeff_of_lt_order_toNat
statement: theorem coeff_of_lt_order_toNat (n : ℕ) (h : n < φ.order.toNat) : coeff n φ = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h' : φ = 0
  · simp [h']
  · refine coeff_of_lt_order _ ?_
    rwa [← coe_toNat_order h', ENat.natCast_lt_natCast]

name: nat_le_order
statement: theorem nat_le_order (φ : R⟦X⟧) (n : ℕ) (h : ∀ i < n, coeff i φ = 0) : ↑n ≤ order φ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [order]
  split_ifs
  · simp
  · simpa [Nat.le_find_iff]

name: le_order
statement:
theorem le_order (φ : R⟦X⟧) (n : ℕ∞) (h : ∀ i : ℕ, ↑i < n → coeff i φ = 0) :
    n ≤ order φ
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | top => simpa using ext (by simpa using h)
  | coe n =>
    convert! nat_le_order φ n _
    simpa using h

name: order_eq_nat
statement:
theorem order_eq_nat {φ : R⟦X⟧} {n : ℕ} :
    order φ = n ↔ coeff n φ ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ i, i < n → coeff i φ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne φ 0 with (rfl | hφ)
  · simp
  simp [order, dite_eq_right hφ, Nat.find_eq_iff]

name: order_eq
statement:
theorem order_eq {φ : R⟦X⟧} {n : ℕ∞} :
    order φ = n ↔ (∀ i : ℕ, ↑i = n → coeff i φ ≠ 0) ∧ ∀ i : ℕ, ↑i < n → coeff i φ = 0
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | top => simp
  | coe n => simp [order_eq_nat]

name: order_eq_order
statement: theorem order_eq_order {φ : R⟦X⟧} : φ.order = MvPowerSeries.order φ
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_of_le_of_ge ?_ ?_
  · refine MvPowerSeries.le_order fun d hd => by
      have : coeff ↑(Finsupp.degree d) φ = 0 := coeff_of_lt_order _ hd
      have eq_aux : d.degree = d () := Finset.sum_eq_single _ (by simp) (by simp)
      exact (PowerSeries.coeff_def rfl (R := R)) ▸ (eq_aux ▸ this)
  · refine le_order φ (MvPowerSeries.order φ) fun i hi => by
      rw [← Finsupp.degree_single () i] at hi
      exact MvPowerSeries.coeff_of_lt_order hi

name: min_order_le_order_add
statement: theorem min_order_le_order_add (φ ψ : R⟦X⟧) : min (order φ) (order ψ) ≤ order (φ + ψ)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_order _ _ ?_
  simp +contextual [coeff_of_lt_order]

name: order_add_of_order_ne.aux
statement:
private theorem order_add_of_order_ne.aux (φ ψ : R⟦X⟧)
    (H : order φ < order ψ) : order (φ + ψ) ≤ order φ ⊓ order ψ
proof:
:= by
  suffices order (φ + ψ) = order φ by
    rw [le_inf_iff, this]
    exact ⟨le_rfl, le_of_lt H⟩
  rw [order_eq]
  constructor
  · intro i hi
    rw [← hi] at H
    rw [(coeff _).map_add, coeff_of_lt_order i H, add_zero]
    exact (order_eq_nat.1 hi.symm).1
  · intro i hi
    rw [(coeff _).map_add, coeff_of_lt_order i hi, coeff_of_lt_order i (lt_trans hi H),
      zero_add]

name: order_add_of_order_ne
statement:
theorem order_add_of_order_ne (φ ψ : R⟦X⟧) (h : order φ ≠ order ψ) :
    order (φ + ψ) = order φ ⊓ order ψ
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (min_order_le_order_add _ _)
  rcases h.lt_or_gt with (φ_lt_ψ | ψ_lt_φ)
  · apply order_add_of_order_ne.aux _ _ φ_lt_ψ
  · simpa only [add_comm, inf_comm] using order_add_of_order_ne.aux _ _ ψ_lt_φ

name: le_order_map
statement:
theorem le_order_map {S : Type*} [Semiring S] (f : R →+* S) :
    φ.order ≤ (φ.map f).order
proof:
:=
  le_order _ _ fun i hi => by simp [coeff_of_lt_order i hi]

name: le_order_smul
statement:
theorem le_order_smul {a : R} :
    φ.order ≤ (a • φ).order
proof:
:=
  le_order _ φ.order fun i hi => by simp [coeff_of_lt_order i hi]

name: le_order_mul
statement: theorem le_order_mul (φ ψ : R⟦X⟧) : order φ + order ψ ≤ order (φ * ψ)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_order
  intro n hn; rw [coeff_mul, Finset.sum_eq_zero]
  rintro ⟨i, j⟩ hij
  by_cases! hi : ↑i < order φ
  · rw [coeff_of_lt_order i hi, zero_mul]
  by_cases! hj : ↑j < order ψ
  · rw [coeff_of_lt_order j hj, mul_zero]
  rw [mem_antidiagonal] at hij
  exfalso
  apply ne_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le hn <| add_le_add hi hj)
  rw [← Nat.cast_add, hij]

name: le_order_pow
statement: theorem le_order_pow (φ : R⟦X⟧) (n : ℕ) : n • order φ ≤ order (φ ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => grw [add_smul, one_smul, pow_succ, ih, le_order_mul]

name: le_order_prod
statement:
theorem le_order_prod {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] {ι : Type*} (φ : ι → R⟦X⟧) (s : Finset ι) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, (φ i).order ≤ (∏ i ∈ s, φ i).order
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction with
  | empty => simp
  | cons a s ha ih => grw [Finset.sum_cons ha, Finset.prod_cons ha, ih, le_order_mul]

name: one_le_order_iff_constCoeff_eq_zero
statement:
theorem one_le_order_iff_constCoeff_eq_zero :
    1 ≤ φ.order ↔ φ.constantCoeff = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff]
    apply coeff_of_lt_order
    simpa using Order.one_le_iff_pos.mp h
  · intro h
    refine le_order _ _ fun d hd ↦ ?_
    rw [Nat.cast_lt_one] at hd
    simp [hd, h]

name: order_ne_zero_iff_constCoeff_eq_zero
statement:
theorem order_ne_zero_iff_constCoeff_eq_zero {φ : R⟦X⟧} :
    φ.order ≠ 0 ↔ φ.constantCoeff = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero, one_le_order_iff_constCoeff_eq_zero]

name: le_order_pow_of_constantCoeff_eq_zero
statement:
theorem le_order_pow_of_constantCoeff_eq_zero (n : ℕ) (hf : φ.constantCoeff = 0) :
    n ≤ (φ ^ n).order
proof:
:= by
  refine .trans ?_ (le_order_pow _ n)
  simpa using le_mul_of_one_le_right' (one_le_order_iff_constCoeff_eq_zero.mpr hf)

name: order_monomial
statement:
theorem order_monomial (n : ℕ) (a : R) [Decidable (a = 0)] :
    order (monomial n a) = if a = 0 then (⊤ : ℕ∞) else n
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [h, order_eq_top, map_zero]
  · rw [order_eq]
    constructor <;> intro i hi
    · simp only [Nat.cast_inj] at hi
      rwa [hi, coeff_monomial_same]
    · simp only [Nat.cast_lt] at hi
      rw [coeff_monomial, ite_eq_right]
      exact ne_of_lt hi

name: order_monomial_of_ne_zero
statement: theorem order_monomial_of_ne_zero (n : ℕ) (a : R) (h : a ≠ 0) : order (monomial n a) = n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [order_monomial, ite_eq_right h]

name: coeff_mul_of_lt_order
statement:
theorem coeff_mul_of_lt_order {φ ψ : R⟦X⟧} {n : ℕ} (h : ↑n < ψ.order) :
    coeff n (φ * ψ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  suffices coeff n (φ * ψ) = ∑ p ∈ antidiagonal n, 0 by rw [this, Finset.sum_const_zero]
  rw [coeff_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro x hx
  refine mul_eq_zero_of_right (coeff x.fst φ) (coeff_of_lt_order x.snd (lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ h))
  rw [mem_antidiagonal] at hx
  norm_cast
  lia

name: coeff_mul_one_sub_of_lt_order
statement:
theorem coeff_mul_one_sub_of_lt_order {R : Type*} [Ring R] {φ ψ : R⟦X⟧} (n : ℕ)
    (h : ↑n < ψ.order) : coeff n (φ * (1 - ψ)) = coeff n φ
proof:
:= by
  simp [coeff_mul_of_lt_order h, mul_sub]

name: coeff_mul_prod_one_sub_of_lt_order
statement:
theorem coeff_mul_prod_one_sub_of_lt_order {R ι : Type*} [CommRing R] (k : ℕ) (s : Finset ι)
    (φ : R⟦X⟧) (f : ι → R⟦X⟧) :
    (∀ i ∈ s, ↑k < (f i).order) → coeff k (φ * ∏ i ∈ s, (1 - f i)) = coeff k φ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    intro t
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, forall_eq_or_imp] at t
    rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, ← mul_assoc, mul_right_comm, coeff_mul_one_sub_of_lt_order _ t.1]
    exact ih t.2

name: order_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem order_neg {R : Type*} [Ring R] (φ : PowerSeries R) : (-φ).order = φ.order
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! h
  have : φ = 0 := by simpa using (order_add_of_order_ne _ _ h).symm
  simp [this] at h

name: coeff_divXPowOrder
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coeff_divXPowOrder {f : R⟦X⟧} {n : ℕ} :
    coeff n (divXPowOrder f) = coeff (n + f.order.toNat) f
proof:
:=
  coeff_mk _ _

name: divXPowOrder_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma divXPowOrder_zero :
    divXPowOrder (0 : R⟦X⟧) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp

name: constantCoeff_divXPowOrder
statement:
lemma constantCoeff_divXPowOrder {f : R⟦X⟧} :
    constantCoeff (divXPowOrder f) = coeff f.order.toNat f
proof:
:= by
  simp [← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff]

name: constantCoeff_divXPowOrder_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma constantCoeff_divXPowOrder_eq_zero_iff {f : R⟦X⟧} :
    constantCoeff (divXPowOrder f) = 0 ↔ f = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : f = 0
  · simp [h]
  · simp [constantCoeff_divXPowOrder, coeff_order h, h]

name: X_pow_order_mul_divXPowOrder
statement:
theorem X_pow_order_mul_divXPowOrder {f : R⟦X⟧} :
    X ^ f.order.toNat * divXPowOrder f = f
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [coeff_X_pow_mul']
  split_ifs with h
  · simp [h]
  · push Not at h
    rw [coeff_of_lt_order_toNat _ h]

name: X_pow_order_dvd
statement: theorem X_pow_order_dvd : X ^ φ.order.toNat ∣ φ
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [X_pow_dvd_iff] using coeff_of_lt_order_toNat

name: order_eq_emultiplicity_X
statement:
theorem order_eq_emultiplicity_X {R : Type*} [Semiring R] (φ : R⟦X⟧) :
    order φ = emultiplicity X φ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases eq_or_ne φ 0 with (rfl | hφ)
  · simp
  cases ho : order φ with
  | top => simp [hφ] at ho
  | coe n =>
    have hn : φ.order.toNat = n := by simp [ho]
    rw [← hn, eq_comm]
    apply le_antisymm _
    · apply le_emultiplicity_of_pow_dvd
      apply X_pow_order_dvd
    · apply Order.le_of_lt_add_one
      rw [← not_le, ← Nat.cast_one, ← Nat.cast_add, ← pow_dvd_iff_le_emultiplicity]
      rintro ⟨ψ, H⟩
      have := congr_arg (coeff n) H
      rw [X_pow_mul, coeff_mul_of_lt_order, ← hn] at this
      · exact coeff_order hφ this
      · rw [X_pow_eq, order_monomial]
        split_ifs
        · simp
        · rw [← hn, ENat.natCast_lt_natCast]
          simp

name: order_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem order_one : order (1 : R⟦X⟧) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa using order_monomial_of_ne_zero 0 (1 : R) one_ne_zero

name: order_zero_of_isUnit
statement: theorem order_zero_of_isUnit {f : R⟦X⟧} : IsUnit f → f.order = 0
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨⟨u, v, hu, hv⟩, hf⟩
  apply And.left
  rw [← add_eq_zero, ← hf, ← nonpos_iff_eq_zero, ← @order_one R _ _, ← hu]
  exact order_mul_ge _ _

name: order_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem order_X : order (X : R⟦X⟧) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Nat.cast_one] using! order_monomial_of_ne_zero 1 (1 : R) one_ne_zero

name: order_X_pow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem order_X_pow (n : ℕ) : order ((X : R⟦X⟧) ^ n) = n
proof:
:= by
  rw [X_pow_eq, order_monomial_of_ne_zero]
  exact one_ne_zero

name: divXPowOrder_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem divXPowOrder_X :
    divXPowOrder X = (1 : R⟦X⟧)
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  simp [coeff_X]

name: divXPowOrder_one
statement: theorem divXPowOrder_one : divXPowOrder 1 = (1 : R⟦X⟧)
proof:
:= by
  ext k
  simp

name: order_mul
statement: theorem order_mul (φ ψ : R⟦X⟧) : order (φ * ψ) = order φ + order ψ
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm _ (le_order_mul _ _)
  by_cases! h : φ = 0 ∨ ψ = 0
  · rcases h with h | h <;> simp [h]
  · rw [← coe_toNat_order h.1, ← coe_toNat_order h.2, ← ENat.natCast_add]
    apply order_le
    rw [coeff_mul, Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem ⟨φ.order.toNat, ψ.order.toNat⟩ (by simp)]
    · exact mul_ne_zero (coeff_order h.1) (coeff_order h.2)
    · intro ij hij h
      rcases trichotomy_of_add_eq_add (mem_antidiagonal.mp hij) with h' | h' | h'
      · exact False.elim (h (by simp [Prod.ext_iff, h'.1, h'.2]))
      · rw [coeff_of_lt_order_toNat ij.1 h', zero_mul]
      · rw [coeff_of_lt_order_toNat ij.2 h', mul_zero]

name: divXPowOrder_mul
statement:
theorem divXPowOrder_mul {f g : R⟦X⟧} :
    divXPowOrder (f * g) = divXPowOrder f * divXPowOrder g
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! h : f = 0 ∨ g = 0
  · rcases h with (h | h) <;> simp [h]
  apply X_pow_mul_cancel (k := f.order.toNat + g.order.toNat)
  calc
    _ = X ^ ((f * g).order.toNat) * (f * g).divXPowOrder := by
        rw [order_mul, ENat.toNat_add (order_eq_top.not.mpr h.1) (order_eq_top.not.mpr h.2)]
    _ = f * g := by
        simp [X_pow_order_mul_divXPowOrder]
    _ = (X ^ f.order.toNat * f.divXPowOrder) * (X ^ g.order.toNat * g.divXPowOrder) := by
        simp [X_pow_order_mul_divXPowOrder]
    _ = f.divXPowOrder * g.divXPowOrder * X ^ (g.order.toNat + f.order.toNat) := by
        rw [mul_assoc, X_pow_mul, X_pow_mul, ← mul_assoc, mul_assoc, ← pow_add]
    _ = X ^ (f.order.toNat + g.order.toNat) * (f.divXPowOrder * g.divXPowOrder) := by
        rw [X_pow_mul, add_comm]

name: coe_orderHom
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
lemma coe_orderHom : (orderHom : R⟦X⟧ → ℕ∞) = order
proof: := rfl

name: order_pow
statement: theorem order_pow (φ : R⟦X⟧) (n : ℕ) : order (φ ^ n) = n • order φ
proof:
:=
  map_pow orderHom φ n

name: order_prod
statement:
theorem order_prod {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] [Nontrivial R] {ι : Type*}
    (φ : ι → R⟦X⟧) (s : Finset ι) : (∏ i ∈ s, φ i).order = ∑ i ∈ s, (φ i).order
proof:
:=
  map_prod orderHom φ s

name: coe_divXPowOrderHom
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
lemma coe_divXPowOrderHom : (divXPowOrderHom : R⟦X⟧ → R⟦X⟧) = divXPowOrder
proof: := rfl

name: divXPowOrder_pow
statement: theorem divXPowOrder_pow (φ : R⟦X⟧) (n : ℕ) : divXPowOrder (φ ^ n) = (divXPowOrder φ) ^ n
proof:
:=
  map_pow divXPowOrderHom φ n

name: divXPowOrder_prod
statement:
theorem divXPowOrder_prod {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] [Nontrivial R] {ι : Type*}
    (φ : ι → R⟦X⟧) (s : Finset ι) : (∏ i ∈ s, φ i).divXPowOrder = ∏ i ∈ s, (φ i).divXPowOrder
proof:
:=
  map_prod divXPowOrderHom φ s

name: order_toSubring
statement:
@[simp]
theorem order_toSubring : (p.toSubring T hp).order = p.order
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_of_le_of_ge ?_ ?_
  · refine le_order _ _ fun d hd => by simp [coeff_of_lt_order d hd, ← coeff_toSubring p T hp]
  · exact le_order _ _ fun d hd => by
      exact_mod_cast (coeff_toSubring p T hp) ▸ (coeff_of_lt_order d hd)

name: hasEval_def
statement: theorem hasEval_def (a : S) : HasEval a ↔ IsTopologicallyNilpotent a
proof: := .rfl

name: hasEval_iff
statement:
theorem hasEval_iff {a : S} :
    HasEval a ↔ MvPowerSeries.HasEval (fun (_ : Unit) ↦ a)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ha ↦ ⟨fun _ ↦ ha, by simp⟩, fun ha ↦ ha.hpow default⟩

name: hasEval
statement:
theorem hasEval {a : S} (ha : HasEval a) :
    MvPowerSeries.HasEval (fun (_ : Unit) ↦ a)
proof: := hasEval_iff.mp ha

name: HasEval.mono
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hasEval_iff] at ha ⊢
  exact ha.mono h

name: HasEval.zero
statement: theorem HasEval.zero : HasEval (0 : S)
proof:
:= by
    rw [hasEval_iff]; exact MvPowerSeries.HasEval.zero

name: HasEval.add
statement:
theorem HasEval.add [ContinuousAdd S] [IsLinearTopology S S]
    {a b : S} (ha : HasEval a) (hb : HasEval b) : HasEval (a + b)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hasEval_iff] at ha hb ⊢
  exact ha.add hb

name: HasEval.mul_left
statement:
theorem HasEval.mul_left [IsLinearTopology S S]
    (c : S) {x : S} (hx : HasEval x) : HasEval (c * x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hasEval_iff] at hx ⊢
  exact hx.mul_left _

name: HasEval.mul_right
statement:
theorem HasEval.mul_right [IsLinearTopology S S]
    (c : S) {x : S} (hx : HasEval x) : HasEval (x * c)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hasEval_iff] at hx ⊢
  exact hx.mul_right _

name: HasEval.map
statement:
theorem HasEval.map (hφ : Continuous φ) {a : R} (ha : HasEval a) :
    HasEval (φ a)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hasEval_iff] at ha ⊢
  exact ha.map hφ

name: HasEval.X
statement:
protected theorem HasEval.X :
    HasEval (X : R⟦X⟧)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hasEval_iff]
  exact MvPowerSeries.HasEval.X

name: mem_hasEvalIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem mem_hasEvalIdeal_iff {a : S} :
    a ∈ hasEvalIdeal ↔ HasEval a
proof:
:= by
  simp [hasEvalIdeal]

name: eval
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval₂_coe (f : Polynomial R) : eval₂ φ a f = f.eval₂ φ a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (MvPolynomial.uniqueAlgEquiv R Unit).apply_symm_apply f]
  simp only [PowerSeries.eval₂, MvPolynomial.eval₂_const_uniqueAlgEquiv]
  rw [← MvPolynomial.toMvPowerSeries_pUnitAlgEquiv, MvPowerSeries.eval₂_coe]

name: eval
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval₂_C (r : R) :
    eval₂ φ a (C r) = φ r
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Polynomial.coe_C, eval₂_coe, Polynomial.eval₂_C]

name: eval
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval₂_X :
    eval₂ φ a X = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Polynomial.coe_X, eval₂_coe, Polynomial.eval₂_X]

name: coe_eval
statement:
theorem coe_eval₂Hom (hφ : Continuous φ) (ha : HasEval a) :
    ⇑(eval₂Hom hφ ha) = eval₂ φ a
proof:
:=
  MvPowerSeries.coe_eval₂Hom hφ (hasEval ha)

name: uniformContinuous_eval
statement:
theorem uniformContinuous_eval₂ (hφ : Continuous φ) (ha : HasEval a) :
    UniformContinuous (eval₂ φ a)
proof:
:=
  MvPowerSeries.uniformContinuous_eval₂ hφ (hasEval ha)

name: continuous_eval
statement:
theorem continuous_eval₂ (hφ : Continuous φ) (ha : HasEval a) :
    Continuous (eval₂ φ a : PowerSeries R → S)
proof:
:=
  (uniformContinuous_eval₂ hφ ha).continuous

name: hasSum_eval
statement:
theorem hasSum_eval₂ (hφ : Continuous φ) (ha : HasEval a) (f : PowerSeries R) :
    HasSum (fun (d : ℕ) ↦ φ (coeff d f) * a ^ d) (f.eval₂ φ a)
proof:
:= by
  have := MvPowerSeries.hasSum_eval₂ hφ (hasEval ha) f
  simp only [PowerSeries.eval₂]
  rw [← (Finsupp.single_injective ()).hasSum_iff] at this
  · convert this; simp
  · intro d hd
    exact False.elim (hd ⟨d (), by ext; simp⟩)

name: eval
statement:
theorem eval₂_eq_tsum (hφ : Continuous φ) (ha : HasEval a) (f : PowerSeries R) :
    PowerSeries.eval₂ φ a f =
      ∑' d : ℕ, φ (coeff d f) * a ^ d
proof:
:=
  (hasSum_eval₂ hφ ha f).tsum_eq.symm

name: eval
statement:
theorem eval₂_unique (hφ : Continuous φ) (ha : HasEval a)
    {ε : PowerSeries R → S} (hε : Continuous ε)
    (h : ∀ p : Polynomial R, ε p = Polynomial.eval₂ φ a p) :
    ε = eval₂ φ a
proof:
:= by
  refine MvPowerSeries.eval₂_unique hφ (hasEval ha) hε (fun p ↦ ?_)
  rw [MvPolynomial.toMvPowerSeries_pUnitAlgEquiv, h, ← MvPolynomial.eval₂_uniqueAlgEquiv]

name: comp_eval
statement:
theorem comp_eval₂ (hφ : Continuous φ) (ha : HasEval a)
    {T : Type*} [UniformSpace T] [CompleteSpace T] [T2Space T]
    [CommRing T] [IsTopologicalRing T] [IsLinearTopology T T] [IsUniformAddGroup T]
    {ε : S →+* T} (hε : Continuous ε) :
    ε ∘ eval₂ φ a = eval₂ (ε.comp φ) (ε a)
proof:
:= by
  refine eval₂_unique (by simp only [RingHom.coe_comp, hε.comp hφ]) (ha.map hε)
    (hε.comp (continuous_eval₂ hφ ha)) (fun p ↦ ?_)
  simpa [Function.comp_apply, eval₂_coe] using p.hom_eval₂ φ ε a

name: coe_aeval
statement:
theorem coe_aeval (ha : HasEval a) :
    ↑(aeval ha) = eval₂ (algebraMap R S) a
proof:
:=
  MvPowerSeries.coe_aeval (hasEval ha)

name: continuous_aeval
statement:
theorem continuous_aeval (ha : HasEval a) :
    Continuous (aeval ha : PowerSeries R → S)
proof:
:=
  MvPowerSeries.continuous_aeval (hasEval ha)

name: aeval_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem aeval_coe (ha : HasEval a) (p : Polynomial R) :
    aeval ha (p : PowerSeries R) = Polynomial.aeval a p
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_aeval, Polynomial.aeval_def, eval₂_coe]

name: aeval_unique
statement:
theorem aeval_unique {ε : PowerSeries R →ₐ[R] S} (hε : Continuous ε) :
    aeval (HasEval.X.map hε) = ε
proof:
:=
  MvPowerSeries.aeval_unique hε

name: hasSum_aeval
statement:
theorem hasSum_aeval (ha : HasEval a) (f : PowerSeries R) :
    HasSum (fun d ↦ coeff d f • a ^ d) (f.aeval ha)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [coe_aeval, ← algebraMap_smul (R := R) S, smul_eq_mul]
  exact hasSum_eval₂ (continuous_algebraMap R S) ha f

name: aeval_eq_sum
statement:
theorem aeval_eq_sum (ha : HasEval a) (f : PowerSeries R) :
    aeval ha f = tsum fun d ↦ coeff d f • a ^ d
proof:
:=
  (hasSum_aeval ha f).tsum_eq.symm

name: comp_aeval
statement:
theorem comp_aeval (ha : HasEval a)
    {T : Type*} [CommRing T] [UniformSpace T] [IsUniformAddGroup T]
    [IsTopologicalRing T] [IsLinearTopology T T]
    [T2Space T] [Algebra R T] [ContinuousSMul R T] [CompleteSpace T]
    {ε : S →ₐ[R] T} (hε : Continuous ε) :
    ε.comp (aeval ha) = aeval (ha.map hε)
proof:
:=
  MvPowerSeries.comp_aeval (hasEval ha) hε

name: coeff_truncAux
statement:
private theorem coeff_truncAux (m) (n) (φ : R⟦X⟧) :
    (truncAux n φ).coeff m = if m < n then coeff m φ else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [truncAux, Polynomial.coeff_monomial]

name: trunc_apply
statement:
lemma trunc_apply (n : ℕ) (φ : R⟦X⟧) :
    trunc n φ = ∑ m ∈ Ico 0 n, Polynomial.monomial m (coeff m φ)
proof: := rfl

name: coeff_trunc
statement:
theorem coeff_trunc (m) (n) (φ : R⟦X⟧) :
    (trunc n φ).coeff m = if m < n then coeff m φ else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [trunc, coeff_truncAux]

name: trunc_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem trunc_one (n) : trunc (n + 1) (1 : R⟦X⟧) = 1
proof:
:=
  Polynomial.ext fun m => by
    grind [PowerSeries.coeff_trunc, PowerSeries.coeff_one, Polynomial.coeff_one]

name: trunc_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem trunc_C (n) (a : R) : trunc (n + 1) (C a) = Polynomial.C a
proof:
:=
  Polynomial.ext fun m => by
    rw [coeff_trunc, coeff_C, Polynomial.coeff_C]
    split_ifs with H <;> first | rfl | try simp_all

name: trunc_succ
statement:
theorem trunc_succ (f : R⟦X⟧) (n : ℕ) :
    trunc n.succ f = trunc n f + Polynomial.monomial n (coeff n f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [trunc_apply, Ico_zero_eq_range, sum_range_succ, trunc_apply, Ico_zero_eq_range]

name: natDegree_trunc_lt
statement: theorem natDegree_trunc_lt (f : R⟦X⟧) (n) : (trunc (n + 1) f).natDegree < n + 1
proof:
:= by
  simp +contextual [natDegree_le_iff_coeff_eq_zero, coeff_trunc]

name: trunc_zero'
statement: @[simp] lemma trunc_zero' {f : R⟦X⟧} : trunc 0 f = 0
proof: := rfl

name: degree_trunc_lt
statement: theorem degree_trunc_lt (f : R⟦X⟧) (n) : (trunc n f).degree < n
proof:
:= by
  simp +contextual [degree_lt_iff_coeff_zero, coeff_trunc]

name: eval
statement:
theorem eval₂_trunc_eq_sum_range {S : Type*} [Semiring S] (s : S) (G : R →+* S) (n) (f : R⟦X⟧) :
    (trunc n f).eval₂ G s = ∑ i ∈ range n, G (coeff i f) * s ^ i
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    rw [trunc_zero', range_zero, sum_empty, eval₂_zero]
  | succ n =>
    have := natDegree_trunc_lt f n
    rw [eval₂_eq_sum_range' (hn := this)]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro _ h
    rw [mem_range] at h
    congr
    rw [coeff_trunc, ite_eq_left h]

name: trunc_X
statement: @[simp] theorem trunc_X (n) : trunc (n + 2) X = (Polynomial.X : R[X])
proof:
:= by
  ext d
  rw [coeff_trunc, coeff_X]
  split_ifs with h₁ h₂
  · rw [h₂, coeff_X_one]
  · rw [coeff_X_of_ne_one h₂]
  · rw [coeff_X_of_ne_one]
    intro hd
    apply h₁
    rw [hd]
    exact n.one_lt_succ_succ

name: trunc_X_of
statement: lemma trunc_X_of {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) : trunc n X = (Polynomial.X : R[X])
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le' hn
  exact trunc_X n

name: trunc_one_left
statement:
@[simp]
lemma trunc_one_left (p : R⟦X⟧) : trunc (R := R) 1 p = .C (coeff 0 p)

name: trunc_one_X
statement: lemma trunc_one_X : trunc (R := R) 1 X = 0

name: trunc_C_mul

name: eq_shift_mul_X_pow_add_trunc
statement:
lemma eq_shift_mul_X_pow_add_trunc (n : ℕ) (f : R⟦X⟧) :
    f = (mk fun i ↦ coeff (i + n) f) * X ^ n + (f.trunc n : R⟦X⟧)
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  rw [map_add, Polynomial.coeff_coe, coeff_mul_X_pow', coeff_trunc]
  simp_rw [← not_le, ite_not, ite_add_ite]
  simp +contextual

name: eq_X_pow_mul_shift_add_trunc
statement:
lemma eq_X_pow_mul_shift_add_trunc (n : ℕ) (f : R⟦X⟧) :
    f = X ^ n * (mk fun i ↦ coeff (i + n) f) + (f.trunc n : R⟦X⟧)
proof:

  rw [← (commute_X_pow _ n).eq, ← eq_shift_mul_X_pow_add_trunc]

name: trunc_trunc_of_le
statement:
theorem trunc_trunc_of_le {n m} (f : R⟦X⟧) (hnm : n ≤ m := by rfl) :
    trunc n ↑(trunc m f) = trunc n f
proof:
:= by
  ext d
  rw [coeff_trunc, coeff_trunc, coeff_coe]
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [coeff_trunc, ite_eq_left <| lt_of_lt_of_le h hnm]
  · rfl

name: trunc_trunc
statement: @[simp] theorem trunc_trunc {n} (f : R⟦X⟧) : trunc n ↑(trunc n f) = trunc n f
proof:

  trunc_trunc_of_le f

name: trunc_trunc_mul
statement:
@[simp] theorem trunc_trunc_mul {n} (f g : R⟦X⟧) :
    trunc n ((trunc n f) * g : R⟦X⟧) = trunc n (f * g)
proof:
:= by
  ext m
  rw [coeff_trunc, coeff_trunc]
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [coeff_mul, coeff_mul, sum_congr rfl]
    intro _ hab
    have ha := lt_of_le_of_lt (antidiagonal.fst_le hab) h
    rw [coeff_coe, coeff_trunc, ite_eq_left ha]
  · rfl

name: trunc_mul_trunc
statement:

    trunc n (f * (trunc n g) : R⟦X⟧) = trunc n (f * g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm, trunc_trunc_mul, mul_comm]

name: trunc_trunc_mul_trunc
statement:
theorem trunc_trunc_mul_trunc {n} (f g : R⟦X⟧) :
    trunc n (trunc n f * trunc n g : R⟦X⟧) = trunc n (f * g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [trunc_trunc_mul, trunc_mul_trunc]

name: trunc_trunc_pow
statement:
@[simp] theorem trunc_trunc_pow (f : R⟦X⟧) (n a : ℕ) :
    trunc n ((trunc n f : R⟦X⟧) ^ a) = trunc n (f ^ a)
proof:
:= by
  induction a with
  | zero =>
    rw [pow_zero, pow_zero]
  | succ a ih =>
    rw [_root_.pow_succ', _root_.pow_succ', trunc_trunc_mul,
      ← trunc_trunc_mul_trunc, ih, trunc_trunc_mul_trunc]

name: trunc_coe_eq_self
statement: theorem trunc_coe_eq_self {n} {f : R[X]} (hn : natDegree f < n) : trunc n (f : R⟦X⟧) = f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Polynomial.coe_inj]
  ext m
  rw [coeff_coe, coeff_trunc]
  split
  case isTrue h => rfl
  case isFalse h =>
    rw [not_lt] at h
    rw [coeff_coe]; symm
    exact coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt <| lt_of_lt_of_le hn h

name: coeff_coe_trunc_of_lt
statement:
theorem coeff_coe_trunc_of_lt {n m} {f : R⟦X⟧} (h : n < m) :
    coeff n (trunc m f) = coeff n f
proof:
:= by
  rwa [coeff_coe, coeff_trunc, ite_eq_left]

name: coeff_mul_eq_coeff_trunc_mul_trunc
statement:
theorem coeff_mul_eq_coeff_trunc_mul_trunc₂ {n a b} (f g : R⟦X⟧) (ha : n < a) (hb : n < b) :
    coeff n (f * g) = coeff n ((trunc a f : R⟦X⟧) * (trunc b g : R⟦X⟧))
proof:
:= by
  symm
  rw [← coeff_coe_trunc_of_lt n.lt_succ_self, ← trunc_trunc_mul_trunc, trunc_trunc_of_le f ha,
    trunc_trunc_of_le g hb, trunc_trunc_mul_trunc, coeff_coe_trunc_of_lt n.lt_succ_self]

name: coeff_mul_eq_coeff_trunc_mul_trunc
statement:
theorem coeff_mul_eq_coeff_trunc_mul_trunc {d n} (f g) (h : d < n) :
    coeff d (f * g) = coeff d ((trunc n f : R⟦X⟧) * (trunc n g : R⟦X⟧))
proof:
:=
  coeff_mul_eq_coeff_trunc_mul_trunc₂ f g h h

name: isRestricted_iff

name: coeff_largeSchroderSeries
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coeff_largeSchroderSeries (n : ℕ) :
    (coeff n) largeSchroderSeries = largeSchroder n
proof:
:= by
  simp [largeSchroderSeries]

name: constantCoeff_largeSchroderSeries
statement:
@[simp]
lemma constantCoeff_largeSchroderSeries :
    constantCoeff largeSchroderSeries = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, coeff_largeSchroderSeries, largeSchroder_zero]

name: coeff_X_mul_largeSchroderSeries
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coeff_X_mul_largeSchroderSeries (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    coeff n (X * largeSchroderSeries) = largeSchroder (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coeff_mul, coeff_largeSchroderSeries,
    Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ (coeff · X * largeSchroder ·),
    succ_eq_add_one]
  simp only [coeff_X, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul, sum_ite_eq', mem_range, lt_add_iff_pos_left,
    ite_eq_left_iff, not_lt, nonpos_iff_eq_zero]
  rintro rfl
  simp_all only [lt_self_iff_false]

name: coeff_X_mul_largeSchroderSeriesSeries_sq
statement:
lemma coeff_X_mul_largeSchroderSeriesSeries_sq (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    coeff n (X * largeSchroderSeries ^ 2) =
      ∑ i ∈ range n, largeSchroder i * largeSchroder (n - 1 - i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_two, ← mul_assoc, coeff_mul]
  rw [Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ
    (fun x y => (coeff x) (X * largeSchroderSeries) * (coeff y) largeSchroderSeries) n,
    Nat.succ_eq_add_one, sum_range_succ]
  simp only [coeff_largeSchroderSeries, coeff_X_mul_largeSchroderSeries n hn, tsub_self,
    largeSchroder_zero, mul_one]
  have : ∑ x ∈ range n, (coeff x) (X * largeSchroderSeries) * largeSchroder (n - x) =
      ∑ x ∈ range n, if 0 < x then largeSchroder (x - 1) * largeSchroder (n - x) else 0 := by
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro x a
    simp_all only [mem_range]
    split
    next h =>
      simp_all only [mul_eq_mul_right_iff]
      simp [coeff_X_mul_largeSchroderSeries x (by lia)]
    next h =>
      simp_all only [not_lt, nonpos_iff_eq_zero, coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff, map_mul,
      constantCoeff_X, constantCoeff_largeSchroderSeries, mul_one, tsub_zero, zero_mul]
  rw [this, sum_range_eq_add_Ico _ (by lia)]
  simp only [lt_self_iff_false, reduceIte, zero_add]
  have : (∑ x ∈ Ico 1 n, if 0 < x then largeSchroder (x - 1) * largeSchroder (n - x) else 0) =
    ∑ x ∈ Ico 1 n, largeSchroder (x - 1) * largeSchroder (n - x) := by
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intros x hx
    have hx' : 0 < x := by grind
    rw [ite_eq_left hx']
  rw [this, sum_Ico_eq_sum_range, show n = n - 1 + 1 by lia,
    sum_range_succ]
  grind [largeSchroder_zero]

name: largeSchroderSeries_eq_one_add_X_mul_largeSchroderSeries_add_X_mul_largeSchroderSeries_sq
statement:
theorem largeSchroderSeries_eq_one_add_X_mul_largeSchroderSeries_add_X_mul_largeSchroderSeries_sq :
    largeSchroderSeries = 1 + X * largeSchroderSeries + X * largeSchroderSeries ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · aesop
  · have hn' : 0 < n := by omega
    simp only [coeff_largeSchroderSeries, map_add, coeff_one, hn, ↓reduceIte, zero_add]
    rw [coeff_X_mul_largeSchroderSeriesSeries_sq _ hn', coeff_X_mul_largeSchroderSeries _ hn',
      show n = n - 1 + 1 by omega, largeSchroder_succ (n - 1)]
    simp only [add_tsub_cancel_right, Nat.add_left_cancel_iff]
    rw [Iic_eq_Icc, Nat.bot_eq_zero, ← range_succ_eq_Icc_zero]

name: span_X_isPrime

@[grind inj]
theorem C_injective : Function.Injective (C (R := R))
proof: := MvPowerSeries.C_injective

name: subsingleton_iff
statement: protected theorem subsingleton_iff : Subsingleton R⟦X⟧ ↔ Subsingleton R
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun _ ↦ inferInstance⟩
  rw [subsingleton_iff] at h ⊢
  exact fun a b ↦ C_injective (h (C a) (C b))

name: X_eq
statement: theorem X_eq : (X : R⟦X⟧) = monomial 1 1
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: coeff_X
statement: theorem coeff_X (n : ℕ) : coeff n (X : R⟦X⟧) = if n = 1 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [X_eq, coeff_monomial]

name: coeff_zero_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_zero_X : coeff 0 (X : R⟦X⟧) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff, Finsupp.single_zero, X, MvPowerSeries.coeff_zero_X]

name: coeff_one_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_one_X : coeff 1 (X : R⟦X⟧) = 1
proof: := by rw [coeff_X, ite_eq_left rfl]

name: X_ne_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem X_ne_zero [Nontrivial R] : (X : R⟦X⟧) ≠ 0
proof:
:= fun H => by
  simpa only [coeff_one_X, one_ne_zero, map_zero] using congr_arg (coeff 1) H

name: X_pow_eq
statement: theorem X_pow_eq (n : ℕ) : (X : R⟦X⟧) ^ n = monomial n 1
proof:
:=
  MvPowerSeries.X_pow_eq _ n

name: coeff_X_pow
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem coeff_X_pow (m n : ℕ) : coeff m ((X : R⟦X⟧) ^ n) = if m = n then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [X_pow_eq, coeff_monomial]

name: coeff_X_pow_self
statement: theorem coeff_X_pow_self (n : ℕ) : coeff n ((X : R⟦X⟧) ^ n) = 1
proof:

  simp

name: coeff_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_one (n : ℕ) : coeff n (1 : R⟦X⟧) = if n = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:

  coeff_C n 1

name: coeff_zero_one
statement: theorem coeff_zero_one : coeff 0 (1 : R⟦X⟧) = 1
proof:

  coeff_zero_C 1

name: coeff_mul
statement:
theorem coeff_mul (n : ℕ) (φ ψ : R⟦X⟧) :
    coeff n (φ * ψ) = ∑ p ∈ antidiagonal n, coeff p.1 φ * coeff p.2 ψ
proof:
:= by
  
  refine (MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul _ φ ψ).trans ?_
  rw [Finsupp.antidiagonal_single, Finset.sum_map]
  rfl

name: coeff_mul_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_mul_C (n : ℕ) (φ : R⟦X⟧) (a : R) : coeff n (φ * C a) = coeff n φ * a
proof:
:=
  MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul_C _ φ a

name: coeff_C_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_C_mul (n : ℕ) (φ : R⟦X⟧) (a : R) : coeff n (C a * φ) = a * coeff n φ
proof:
:=
  MvPowerSeries.coeff_C_mul _ φ a

name: coeff_mul_natCast
statement:
@[simp] lemma coeff_mul_natCast {φ : R⟦X⟧} {a n : ℕ} :
    coeff n (φ * (a : R⟦X⟧)) = coeff n φ * a
proof: := coeff_mul_C _ _ _

name: coeff_natCast_mul
statement:
@[simp] lemma coeff_natCast_mul {φ : R⟦X⟧} {a n : ℕ} :
    coeff n ((a : R⟦X⟧) * φ) = a * coeff n φ
proof: := coeff_C_mul _ _ _

name: coeff_mul_ofNat
statement:
@[simp] lemma coeff_mul_ofNat {φ : R⟦X⟧} {a n : ℕ} [Nat.AtLeastTwo a] :
    coeff n (φ * ofNat(a)) = coeff n φ * ofNat(a)
proof: := coeff_mul_C _ _ _

name: coeff_ofNat_mul
statement:
@[simp] lemma coeff_ofNat_mul {φ : R⟦X⟧} {a n : ℕ} [Nat.AtLeastTwo a] :
    coeff n (ofNat(a) * φ) = ofNat(a) * coeff n φ
proof: := coeff_C_mul _ _ _

name: coeff_mul_intCast
statement:
@[simp] lemma coeff_mul_intCast {R : Type*} [Ring R] {φ : R⟦X⟧} {a : ℤ} {n : ℕ} :
    coeff n (φ * (a : R⟦X⟧)) = coeff n φ * a
proof:
:= by
  simpa using coeff_mul_C n φ a

name: coeff_intCast_mul
statement:
@[simp] lemma coeff_intCast_mul {R : Type*} [Ring R] {φ : R⟦X⟧} {a : ℤ} {n : ℕ} :
    coeff n ((a : R⟦X⟧) * φ) = a * coeff n φ
proof:
:= by
  simpa using coeff_C_mul n φ a

name: coeff_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_smul {S : Type*} [Semiring S] [Module R S] (n : ℕ) (φ : PowerSeries S) (a : R) :
    coeff n (a • φ) = a • coeff n φ
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: constantCoeff_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem constantCoeff_smul {S : Type*} [Semiring S] [Module R S] (φ : PowerSeries S) (a : R) :
    constantCoeff (a • φ) = a • constantCoeff φ
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: smul_eq_C_mul
statement: theorem smul_eq_C_mul (f : R⟦X⟧) (a : R) : a • f = C a * f
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp

name: coeff_succ_mul_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_succ_mul_X (n : ℕ) (φ : R⟦X⟧) : coeff (n + 1) (φ * X) = coeff n φ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coeff, Finsupp.single_add]
  convert! φ.coeff_add_mul_monomial (single () n) (single () 1) _
  rw [mul_one]

name: coeff_succ_X_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_succ_X_mul (n : ℕ) (φ : R⟦X⟧) : coeff (n + 1) (X * φ) = coeff n φ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coeff, Finsupp.single_add, add_comm n 1]
  convert! φ.coeff_add_monomial_mul (single () 1) (single () n) _
  rw [one_mul]

name: mul_X_cancel
statement: theorem mul_X_cancel {φ ψ : R⟦X⟧} (h : φ * X = ψ * X) : φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  rw [PowerSeries.ext_iff] at h ⊢
  intro n
  simpa using h (n + 1)

name: mul_X_injective
statement: theorem mul_X_injective : Function.Injective (· * X : R⟦X⟧ → R⟦X⟧)
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ ↦ mul_X_cancel

name: mul_X_inj
statement: theorem mul_X_inj {φ ψ : R⟦X⟧} : φ * X = ψ * X ↔ φ = ψ
proof:
:=
  mul_X_injective.eq_iff

name: X_mul_cancel
statement: theorem X_mul_cancel {φ ψ : R⟦X⟧} (h : X * φ = X * ψ) : φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  rw [PowerSeries.ext_iff] at h ⊢
  intro n
  simpa using h (n + 1)

name: X_mul_injective
statement: theorem X_mul_injective : Function.Injective (X * · : R⟦X⟧ → R⟦X⟧)
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ ↦ X_mul_cancel

name: X_mul_inj
statement: theorem X_mul_inj {φ ψ : R⟦X⟧} : X * φ = X * ψ ↔ φ = ψ
proof:
:=
  X_mul_injective.eq_iff

name: constantCoeff_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem constantCoeff_C (a : R) : constantCoeff (C a) = a
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: constantCoeff_comp_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem constantCoeff_comp_C : constantCoeff.comp C = RingHom.id R
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: constantCoeff_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem constantCoeff_zero : constantCoeff (R := R) 0 = 0
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: constantCoeff_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem constantCoeff_one : constantCoeff (R := R) 1 = 1
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: constantCoeff_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem constantCoeff_X : constantCoeff (R := R) X = 0
proof:
:=
  MvPowerSeries.coeff_zero_X _

name: constantCoeff_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem constantCoeff_mk {f : ℕ → R} : constantCoeff (mk f) = f 0
proof: := rfl

name: coeff_zero_mul_X
statement: theorem coeff_zero_mul_X (φ : R⟦X⟧) : coeff 0 (φ * X) = 0
proof: := by simp

name: coeff_zero_X_mul
statement: theorem coeff_zero_X_mul (φ : R⟦X⟧) : coeff 0 (X * φ) = 0
proof: := by simp

name: constantCoeff_surj
statement: theorem constantCoeff_surj : Function.Surjective (constantCoeff (R := R))
proof:
:=
  fun r => ⟨C r, constantCoeff_C r⟩

name: coeff_C_mul_X_pow
statement:
theorem coeff_C_mul_X_pow (x : R) (k n : ℕ) :
    coeff n (C x * X ^ k : R⟦X⟧) = if n = k then x else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [X_pow_eq, coeff_monomial]

name: coeff_mul_X_pow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_mul_X_pow (p : R⟦X⟧) (n d : ℕ) :
    coeff (d + n) (p * X ^ n) = coeff d p
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_mul, Finset.sum_eq_single (d, n), coeff_X_pow, ite_eq_left rfl, mul_one]
  · rintro ⟨i, j⟩ h1 h2
    rw [coeff_X_pow, ite_eq_right, mul_zero]
    rintro rfl
    apply h2
    rw [mem_antidiagonal, add_right_cancel_iff] at h1
    subst h1
    rfl
  · exact fun h1 => (h1 (mem_antidiagonal.2 rfl)).elim

name: coeff_X_pow_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_X_pow_mul (p : R⟦X⟧) (n d : ℕ) :
    coeff (d + n) (X ^ n * p) = coeff d p
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_mul, Finset.sum_eq_single (n, d), coeff_X_pow, ite_eq_left rfl, one_mul]
  · rintro ⟨i, j⟩ h1 h2
    rw [coeff_X_pow, ite_eq_right, zero_mul]
    rintro rfl
    apply h2
    rw [mem_antidiagonal, add_comm, add_right_cancel_iff] at h1
    subst h1
    rfl
  · rw [add_comm]
    exact fun h1 => (h1 (mem_antidiagonal.2 rfl)).elim

name: mul_X_pow_cancel
statement:
theorem mul_X_pow_cancel {k : ℕ} {φ ψ : R⟦X⟧} (h : φ * X ^ k = ψ * X ^ k) :
    φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  rw [PowerSeries.ext_iff] at h ⊢
  intro n
  simpa using h (n + k)

name: mul_X_pow_injective
statement: theorem mul_X_pow_injective {k : ℕ} : Function.Injective (· * X ^ k : R⟦X⟧ → R⟦X⟧)
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ ↦ mul_X_pow_cancel

name: mul_X_pow_inj
statement:
theorem mul_X_pow_inj {k : ℕ} {φ ψ : R⟦X⟧} :
    φ * X ^ k = ψ * X ^ k ↔ φ = ψ
proof:
:=
  mul_X_pow_injective.eq_iff

name: X_pow_mul_cancel
statement:
theorem X_pow_mul_cancel {k : ℕ} {φ ψ : R⟦X⟧} (h : X ^ k * φ = X ^ k * ψ) :
    φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  rw [PowerSeries.ext_iff] at h ⊢
  intro n
  simpa using h (n + k)

name: X_pow_mul_injective
statement: theorem X_pow_mul_injective {k : ℕ} : Function.Injective (X ^ k * · : R⟦X⟧ → R⟦X⟧)
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ ↦ X_pow_mul_cancel

name: X_pow_mul_inj
statement:
theorem X_pow_mul_inj {k : ℕ} {φ ψ : R⟦X⟧} :
    X ^ k * φ = X ^ k * ψ ↔ φ = ψ
proof:
:=
  X_pow_mul_injective.eq_iff

name: coeff_mul_X_pow'
statement:
theorem coeff_mul_X_pow' (p : R⟦X⟧) (n d : ℕ) :
    coeff d (p * X ^ n) = ite (n ≤ d) (coeff (d - n) p) 0
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [← tsub_add_cancel_of_le h, coeff_mul_X_pow, add_tsub_cancel_right]
  · refine (coeff_mul _ _ _).trans (Finset.sum_eq_zero fun x hx => ?_)
    rw [coeff_X_pow, ite_eq_right, mul_zero]
    exact ((le_of_add_le_right (mem_antidiagonal.mp hx).le).trans_lt <| not_le.mp h).ne

name: coeff_X_pow_mul'
statement:
theorem coeff_X_pow_mul' (p : R⟦X⟧) (n d : ℕ) :
    coeff d (X ^ n * p) = ite (n ≤ d) (coeff (d - n) p) 0
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [← tsub_add_cancel_of_le h, coeff_X_pow_mul]
    simp
  · refine (coeff_mul _ _ _).trans (Finset.sum_eq_zero fun x hx => ?_)
    rw [coeff_X_pow, ite_eq_right, zero_mul]
    have := mem_antidiagonal.mp hx
    rw [add_comm] at this
    exact ((le_of_add_le_right this.le).trans_lt <| not_le.mp h).ne

name: isUnit_constantCoeff
statement: theorem isUnit_constantCoeff (φ : R⟦X⟧) (h : IsUnit φ) : IsUnit (constantCoeff φ)
proof:
:=
  MvPowerSeries.isUnit_constantCoeff φ h

name: eq_shift_mul_X_add_const
statement:
theorem eq_shift_mul_X_add_const (φ : R⟦X⟧) :
    φ = (mk fun p => coeff (p + 1) φ) * X + C (constantCoeff φ)
proof:
:= by
  ext (_ | n)
  · simp
  · simp only [coeff_succ_mul_X, coeff_mk, map_add, coeff_C, n.succ_ne_zero,
      ite_false, add_zero]

name: eq_X_mul_shift_add_const
statement:
theorem eq_X_mul_shift_add_const (φ : R⟦X⟧) :
    φ = (X * mk fun p => coeff (p + 1) φ) + C (constantCoeff φ)
proof:
:= by
  ext (_ | n)
  · simp
  · simp only [coeff_succ_X_mul, coeff_mk, map_add, coeff_C, n.succ_ne_zero,
      ite_false, add_zero]

name: map_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_id : (map (RingHom.id R) : R⟦X⟧ → R⟦X⟧) = id
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: map_comp
statement: theorem map_comp : map (g.comp f) = (map g).comp (map f)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: coeff_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_map (n : ℕ) (φ : R⟦X⟧) : coeff n (map f φ) = f (coeff n φ)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: map_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_C (r : R) : map f (C r) = C (f r)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp [coeff_C, apply_ite f]

name: map_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_X : map f X = X
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp [coeff_X, apply_ite f]

name: map_surjective
statement:
theorem map_surjective (f : S →+* T) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    Function.Surjective (PowerSeries.map f)
proof:
:= by
  intro g
  use PowerSeries.mk fun k ↦ Function.surjInv hf (PowerSeries.coeff k g)
  ext k
  simp only [Function.surjInv, coeff_map, coeff_mk]
  exact Classical.choose_spec (hf (coeff k g))

name: map_injective
statement:
theorem map_injective (f : S →+* T) (hf : Function.Injective ⇑f) :
    Function.Injective (PowerSeries.map f)
proof:
:= by
  intro u v huv
  ext k
  apply hf
  rw [← PowerSeries.coeff_map, ← PowerSeries.coeff_map, huv]

name: map_eq_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_eq_zero {R S : Type*} [DivisionSemiring R] [Semiring S] [Nontrivial S] (φ : R⟦X⟧)
    (f : R →+* S) : φ.map f = 0 ↔ φ = 0
proof:
:=
  MvPowerSeries.map_eq_zero _ _

name: X_pow_dvd_iff
statement:
theorem X_pow_dvd_iff {n : ℕ} {φ : R⟦X⟧} :
    (X : R⟦X⟧) ^ n ∣ φ ↔ ∀ m, m < n → coeff m φ = 0
proof:
:= by
  convert! @MvPowerSeries.X_pow_dvd_iff Unit R _ () n φ
  constructor <;> intro h m hm
  · rw [Finsupp.unique_single m]
    convert! h _ hm
  · apply h
    simpa only [Finsupp.single_eq_same] using hm

name: X_dvd_iff
statement: theorem X_dvd_iff {φ : R⟦X⟧} : (X : R⟦X⟧) ∣ φ ↔ constantCoeff φ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pow_one (X : R⟦X⟧), X_pow_dvd_iff, ← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply]
  constructor <;> intro h
  · exact h 0 zero_lt_one
  · intro m hm
    rwa [Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hm)]

name: coeff_toSubring
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_toSubring {n : ℕ} : (p.toSubring T hp).coeff n = p.coeff n
proof:
:= by
  rw [toSubring, coeff_mk]

name: constantCoeff_toSubring
statement:
@[simp]
theorem constantCoeff_toSubring : (p.toSubring T hp).constantCoeff = p.constantCoeff
proof:
:=
  coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply p

name: map_toSubring
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_toSubring : (p.toSubring T hp).map T.subtype = p
proof: := ext fun n => by simp

name: coeff_rescale
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_rescale (f : R⟦X⟧) (a : R) (n : ℕ) :
    coeff n (rescale a f) = a ^ n * coeff n f
proof:
:=
  coeff_mk n (fun n ↦ a ^ n * coeff n f)

name: rescale_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rescale_zero : rescale 0 = (C (R := R)).comp constantCoeff
proof:
:= by
  ext x n
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, RingHom.coe_comp, rescale, RingHom.coe_mk,
    coeff_C]
  split_ifs with h <;> simp [h]

name: rescale_zero_apply
statement: theorem rescale_zero_apply (f : R⟦X⟧) : rescale 0 f = C (constantCoeff f)
proof: := by simp

name: rescale_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rescale_one : rescale 1 = RingHom.id R⟦X⟧
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp [coeff_rescale]

name: rescale_mk
statement: theorem rescale_mk (f : ℕ → R) (a : R) : rescale a (mk f) = mk fun n : ℕ => a ^ n * f n
proof:
:= by
  ext
  rw [coeff_rescale, coeff_mk, coeff_mk]

name: rescale_rescale
statement:
theorem rescale_rescale (f : R⟦X⟧) (a b : R) :
    rescale b (rescale a f) = rescale (a * b) f
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  simp_rw [coeff_rescale]
  rw [mul_pow, mul_comm _ (b ^ n), mul_assoc]

name: rescale_mul
statement: theorem rescale_mul (a b : R) : rescale (a * b) = (rescale b).comp (rescale a)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp [← rescale_rescale]

name: rescale_map
statement:
theorem rescale_map {S : Type*} [CommSemiring S] (φ : R →+* S) (r : R) (f : R⟦X⟧) :
    rescale (φ r) (f.map φ) = (rescale r f).map (φ : R →+* S)
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  simp [coeff_rescale, coeff_map, map_mul, map_pow]

name: rescale_algebraMap_map
statement:
theorem rescale_algebraMap_map {A S : Type*} [CommSemiring A] [Algebra A R] [CommSemiring S]
    [Algebra A S] (φ : R →ₐ[A] S) (a : A) (f : R⟦X⟧) :
    rescale (algebraMap A S a) (f.map φ) = (rescale (algebraMap A R a) f).map φ
proof:
:= by
  convert! rescale_map (φ : R →+* S) _ _
  simp

name: coeff_prod
statement:
theorem coeff_prod [DecidableEq ι] (f : ι → PowerSeries R) (d : ℕ) (s : Finset ι) :
    coeff d (∏ j ∈ s, f j) = ∑ l ∈ finsuppAntidiag s d, ∏ i ∈ s, coeff (l i) (f i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coeff]
  rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_prod, ← Finsupp.uniqueAddEquiv_symm_apply _ d,
    ← mapRange_finsuppAntidiag_eq, sum_map]
  rfl

name: prod_monomial
statement:
theorem prod_monomial (f : ι → ℕ) (g : ι → R) (s : Finset ι) :
    ∏ i ∈ s, monomial (f i) (g i) = monomial (∑ i ∈ s, f i) (∏ i ∈ s, g i)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [monomial, Finsupp.single_finsetSum] using
    MvPowerSeries.prod_monomial (fun i ↦ Finsupp.single () (f i)) g s

name: monomial_pow
statement: theorem monomial_pow (m : ℕ) (a : R) (n : ℕ) : (monomial m a) ^ n = monomial (n * m) (a ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [monomial] using MvPowerSeries.monomial_pow (Finsupp.single () m) a n

name: coeff_pow
statement:
lemma coeff_pow (k n : ℕ) (φ : R⟦X⟧) :
    coeff n (φ ^ k) = ∑ l ∈ finsuppAntidiag (range k) n, ∏ i ∈ range k, coeff (l i) φ
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ (i : ℕ) : Function.const ℕ φ i = φ := rfl
  have h₂ (i : ℕ) : ∏ j ∈ range i, Function.const ℕ φ j = φ ^ i := by
    apply prod_range_induction (fun _ => φ) (fun i => φ ^ i) rfl i (fun _ => congrFun rfl)
  rw [← h₂, ← h₁ k]
  apply coeff_prod (f := Function.const ℕ φ) (d := n) (s := range k)

name: coeff_one_mul
statement:
lemma coeff_one_mul (φ ψ : R⟦X⟧) : coeff 1 (φ * ψ) =
    coeff 1 φ * constantCoeff ψ + coeff 1 ψ * constantCoeff φ
proof:
:= by
  have : Finset.antidiagonal 1 = {(0, 1), (1, 0)} := by exact rfl
  rw [coeff_mul, this, Finset.sum_insert, Finset.sum_singleton, coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff,
    mul_comm, add_comm]
  simp

name: coeff_one_pow
statement:
lemma coeff_one_pow (n : ℕ) (φ : R⟦X⟧) :
    coeff 1 (φ ^ n) = n * coeff 1 φ * (constantCoeff φ) ^ (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with (rfl | hn)
  · simp
  induction n with
  | zero => lia
  | succ n' ih =>
      have h₁ (m : ℕ) : φ ^ (m + 1) = φ ^ m * φ := by exact rfl
      have h₂ : Finset.antidiagonal 1 = {(0, 1), (1, 0)} := by exact rfl
      rw [h₁, coeff_mul, h₂, Finset.sum_insert, Finset.sum_singleton]
      · simp only [coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff, map_pow, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one,
          add_tsub_cancel_right]
        have h₀ : n' = 0 ∨ 1 ≤ n' := by lia
        rcases h₀ with h' | h'
        · by_contra h''
          rw [h'] at h''
          simp only [pow_zero, one_mul, coeff_one, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, zero_mul, add_zero,
            mul_one] at h''
          norm_num at h''
        · rw [ih]
          · conv => lhs; arg 2; rw [mul_comm, ← mul_assoc]
            move_mul [← constantCoeff φ ^ (n' - 1)]
            conv => enter [1, 2, 1, 1, 2]; rw [← pow_one (a := constantCoeff φ)]
            rw [← pow_add (a := constantCoeff φ)]
            conv => enter [1, 2, 1, 1]; rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel h']
            ring
          exact h'
      · decide

name: not_isField
statement: theorem not_isField : ¬IsField A⟦X⟧
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hA : Subsingleton A
  · exact not_isField_of_subsingleton _
  · nontriviality A
    rw [Ring.not_isField_iff_exists_ideal_bot_lt_and_lt_top]
    use Ideal.span {X}
    constructor
    · rw [bot_lt_iff_ne_bot, Ne, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot]
      exact X_ne_zero
    · rw [lt_top_iff_ne_top, Ne, Ideal.eq_top_iff_one, Ideal.mem_span_singleton,
        X_dvd_iff, constantCoeff_one]
      exact one_ne_zero

name: are
statement:
theorem are unique.

- `Polynomial.IsDistinguishedAt.algEquivQuotient`: a distinguished polynomial `g` induces a
  natural isomorphism `A[X] / (g) ≃ₐ[A] A⟦X⟧ / (g)`.

- `PowerSeries.IsWeierstrassFactorizationAt.algEquivQuotient`: a Weierstrass factorization
  `g = f * h` induces a natural isomorphism `A[X] / (f) ≃ₐ[A] A⟦X⟧ / (g)`.

- `PowerSeries.algEquivQuotientWeierstrassDistinguished`:
  if `g` is a power series over a complete local ring,
  such that its image in the residue field is not zero, then there is a natural isomorphism
  `A[X] / (f) ≃ₐ[A] A⟦X⟧ / (g)` where `f` is `PowerSeries.weierstrassDistinguished g`.

## References

- [Washington, Lawrence C. *Introduction to cyclotomic fields.*][washington_cyclotomic]

-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped Polynomial

namespace PowerSeries

variable {A : Type*} [CommRing A]

/-!

## Weierstrass division

-/

section IsWeierstrassDivisionAt

variable (f g q : A⟦X⟧) (r : A[X]) (I : Ideal A)

/
`PowerSeries.IsWeierstrassDivisionAt f g q r I` is a `Prop` which asserts that a power series
`q` and a polynomial `r` of degree `< n` satisfy `f = g * q + r`, where `n` is the order of the
image of `g` in `(A / I)⟦X⟧` (defined to be zero if such image is zero, in which case
it's mathematically not considered). -/
@[mk_iff]
structure IsWeierstrassDivisionAt : Prop where
  degree_lt : r.degree < (g.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).order.toNat
  eq_mul_add : f = g * q + r

/
its maximal ideal. -/
abbrev IsWeierstrassDivision [IsLocalRing A] : Prop
proof:
:=
  f.IsWeierstrassDivisionAt g q r (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)

name: isWeierstrassDivisionAt_zero
statement: theorem isWeierstrassDivisionAt_zero : IsWeierstrassDivisionAt 0 g 0 0 I
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [Polynomial.degree_zero]
    exact WithBot.bot_lt_coe _
  · simp

name: coeff_f_sub_r_mem
statement:
theorem coeff_f_sub_r_mem (H : f.IsWeierstrassDivisionAt g q r I)
    {i : ℕ} (hi : i < (g.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).order.toNat) :
    coeff i (f - r : A⟦X⟧) ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  replace H := H.2
  rw [← sub_eq_iff_eq_add] at H
  rw [H]
  refine coeff_mul_mem_ideal_of_coeff_left_mem_ideal i (fun j hj ↦ ?_) i le_rfl
  have := coeff_of_lt_order_toNat _ (lt_of_le_of_lt hj hi)
  rwa [coeff_map, ← RingHom.mem_ker, Ideal.mk_ker] at this

name: add
statement:
theorem add {f' q' r'} (H : f.IsWeierstrassDivisionAt g q r I)
    (H' : f'.IsWeierstrassDivisionAt g q' r' I) :
    (f + f').IsWeierstrassDivisionAt g (q + q') (r + r') I
proof:
:=
  ⟨(Polynomial.degree_add_le _ _).trans_lt (sup_lt_iff.2 ⟨H.degree_lt, H'.degree_lt⟩), by
    rw [H.eq_mul_add, H'.eq_mul_add, Polynomial.coe_add]; ring⟩

name: smul
statement:
theorem smul (H : f.IsWeierstrassDivisionAt g q r I) (a : A) :
    (a • f).IsWeierstrassDivisionAt g (a • q) (a • r) I
proof:
:=
  ⟨(Polynomial.degree_smul_le a _).trans_lt H.degree_lt, by
    simp [H.eq_mul_add, Algebra.smul_def, mul_add, mul_left_comm]⟩

name: IsWeierstrassDivisor.of_map_ne_zero
statement:
theorem IsWeierstrassDivisor.of_map_ne_zero [IsLocalRing A]
    (hg : g.map (IsLocalRing.residue A) ≠ 0) : g.IsWeierstrassDivisor
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsWeierstrassDivisor, IsWeierstrassDivisorAt, ← IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal]
  have h := coeff_order hg
  contrapose h
  rwa [coeff_map, IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff]

name: _root_.Polynomial.IsDistinguishedAt.isWeierstrassDivisorAt
statement:
theorem _root_.Polynomial.IsDistinguishedAt.isWeierstrassDivisorAt {g : A[X]} {I : Ideal A}
    (H : g.IsDistinguishedAt I) (hI : I ≠ ⊤) : IsWeierstrassDivisorAt g I
proof:
:= by
  have : g.natDegree = _ := congr(ENat.toNat $(H.coe_natDegree_eq_order_map g 1
    (by rwa [constantCoeff_one, ← Ideal.ne_top_iff_one]) (by simp)))
  simp [IsWeierstrassDivisorAt, ← this, H.monic.leadingCoeff]

name: _root_.Polynomial.IsDistinguishedAt.isWeierstrassDivisorAt'
statement:
theorem _root_.Polynomial.IsDistinguishedAt.isWeierstrassDivisorAt' {g : A[X]} {I : Ideal A}
    (H : g.IsDistinguishedAt I) [IsHausdorff I A] : IsWeierstrassDivisorAt g I
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne I ⊤ with rfl | hI
  · have := ‹IsHausdorff ⊤ A›.subsingleton
    exact isUnit_of_subsingleton _
  exact H.isWeierstrassDivisorAt hI

name: coeff_trunc_order_mem
statement:
private theorem coeff_trunc_order_mem (i : ℕ) :
    (g.trunc (g.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).order.toNat).coeff i ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_trunc]
  split_ifs with h
  · simpa [← RingHom.mem_ker] using coeff_of_lt_order_toNat _ h
  · exact zero_mem _

name: isUnit_shift
statement:
theorem isUnit_shift : IsUnit <| mk fun i ↦
    coeff (i + (g.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).order.toNat) g
proof:
:= by
  simpa [isUnit_iff_constantCoeff]

name: coeff_seq_mem
statement:
theorem coeff_seq_mem (k : ℕ) {i : ℕ} (hi : i ≥ (g.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).order.toNat) :
    coeff i (f - g * H.seq f k) ∈ I ^ k
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing hi i with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k hq =>
    rw [seq]
    set q := H.seq f k
    set s := f - g * q
    set n := (g.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).order.toNat
    have hs := s.eq_X_pow_mul_shift_add_trunc n
    set s₀ := s.trunc n
    set s₁ := PowerSeries.mk fun i ↦ coeff (i + n) s
    set q' := q + s₁ * H.isUnit_shift.unit⁻¹
    have key : f - g * q' = (s₀ : A⟦X⟧) - (g.trunc n : A⟦X⟧) * s₁ * H.isUnit_shift.unit⁻¹ := by
      trans s + g * (q - q')
      · simp_rw [s]; ring
      simp_rw [q']
      rw [sub_add_cancel_left, mul_neg, ← mul_assoc, mul_right_comm]
      nth_rw 1 [g.eq_X_pow_mul_shift_add_trunc n]
      rw [add_mul, mul_assoc, IsUnit.mul_val_inv, hs]
      ring
    rw [key, map_sub, Polynomial.coeff_coe, coeff_trunc, ite_eq_right hi.not_gt, zero_sub,
      neg_mem_iff, pow_succ']
    refine coeff_mul_mem_ideal_of_coeff_left_mem_ideal' (fun i ↦ ?_) i
    refine coeff_mul_mem_ideal_mul_ideal_of_coeff_mem_ideal'
      (by simp [n, g.coeff_trunc_order_mem]) (fun i ↦ ?_) i
    rw [coeff_mk]
    exact hq (by simp)

name: coeff_seq_succ_sub_seq_mem
statement:
theorem coeff_seq_succ_sub_seq_mem (k i : ℕ) :
    coeff i (H.seq f (k + 1) - H.seq f k) ∈ I ^ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [seq, add_sub_cancel_left]
  refine coeff_mul_mem_ideal_of_coeff_left_mem_ideal' (fun i ↦ ?_) i
  rw [coeff_mk]
  exact H.coeff_seq_mem f k (by simp)

name: seq_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem seq_zero : H.seq f 0 = 0
proof: := rfl

name: seq_one
statement:
theorem seq_one : H.seq f 1 = (PowerSeries.mk fun i ↦ coeff
    (i + (g.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).order.toNat) f) * H.isUnit_shift.unit⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [seq, mul_zero, zero_add, sub_zero]

name: coeff_div
statement: theorem coeff_div [IsPrecomplete I A] (i : ℕ) : coeff i (H.div f) = (H.divCoeff f i).1
proof:
:= by
  simp [div]

name: coeff_div_sub_seq_mem
statement:
theorem coeff_div_sub_seq_mem [IsPrecomplete I A] (k i : ℕ) :
    coeff i (H.div f - (H.seq f k)) ∈ I ^ k
proof:
:= by
  simpa [coeff_div, SModEq.sub_mem] using ((H.divCoeff f i).2 k).symm

name: isWeierstrassDivisionAt_div_mod
statement:
theorem isWeierstrassDivisionAt_div_mod [IsAdicComplete I A] :
    f.IsWeierstrassDivisionAt g (H.div f) (H.mod f) I
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne I ⊤ with rfl | hI
  · have := ‹IsAdicComplete ⊤ A›.toIsHausdorff.subsingleton
    rw [Subsingleton.elim f 0, Subsingleton.elim (H.div 0) 0, Subsingleton.elim (H.mod 0) 0]
    exact g.isWeierstrassDivisionAt_zero _
  constructor
  · exact degree_trunc_lt _ _
  · rw [mod, add_comm, ← sub_eq_iff_eq_add]
    ext i
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_coe, coeff_trunc]
    split_ifs with hi
    · rfl
    refine IsHausdorff.haus' (I := I) _ fun k ↦ ?_
    rw [SModEq.zero, smul_eq_mul, Ideal.mul_top, show f - g * H.div f =
      f - g * (H.seq f k) - g * (H.div f - (H.seq f k)) by ring, map_sub]
    exact Ideal.sub_mem _ (H.coeff_seq_mem f k (not_lt.1 hi)) <|
      coeff_mul_mem_ideal_of_coeff_right_mem_ideal' (H.coeff_div_sub_seq_mem f k) i

name: eq_zero_of_mul_eq
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_mul_eq [IsHausdorff I A]
    {q : A⟦X⟧} {r : A[X]} (hdeg : r.degree < (g.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).order.toNat)
    (heq : g * q = r) : q = 0 ∧ r = 0
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ k i, coeff i q ∈ I ^ k by
    have hq : q = 0 := by
      ext i
      refine IsHausdorff.haus' (I := I) _ fun k ↦ ?_
      rw [SModEq.zero, smul_eq_mul, Ideal.mul_top]
      exact this _ _
    rw [hq, mul_zero, Eq.comm, Polynomial.coe_eq_zero_iff] at heq
    exact ⟨hq, heq⟩
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [g.eq_X_pow_mul_shift_add_trunc (g.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).order.toNat] at heq
    have h1 : ∀ i, coeff i r ∈ I ^ (k + 1) := fun i ↦ by
      rcases lt_or_ge i (g.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).order.toNat with hi | hi
      · rw [← heq, pow_succ']
        refine coeff_mul_mem_ideal_mul_ideal_of_coeff_mem_ideal i (fun j hj ↦ ?_)
          (fun j _ ↦ ih j) i le_rfl
        rw [map_add, Polynomial.coeff_coe]
        refine Ideal.add_mem _ ?_ (g.coeff_trunc_order_mem I j)
        simp_rw [coeff_X_pow_mul', ite_eq_right (lt_of_le_of_lt hj hi).not_ge, zero_mem]
      simp_rw [Polynomial.coeff_coe,
        Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_degree_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le hdeg (by simpa)), zero_mem]
    rw [add_mul, mul_comm (X ^ _), ← eq_sub_iff_add_eq] at heq
    replace heq := congr(H.isUnit_shift.unit⁻¹ * $heq)
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, IsUnit.val_inv_mul, one_mul] at heq
    intro i
    rw [← coeff_X_pow_mul _ (g.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).order.toNat i, heq]
    refine coeff_mul_mem_ideal_of_coeff_right_mem_ideal' (fun i ↦ ?_) _
    rw [map_sub]
    refine Ideal.sub_mem _ (h1 _) ?_
    rw [pow_succ']
    refine coeff_mul_mem_ideal_mul_ideal_of_coeff_mem_ideal' (fun i ↦ ?_) ih _
    simp_rw [Polynomial.coeff_coe, g.coeff_trunc_order_mem]

name: eq_of_mul_add_eq_mul_add
statement:
theorem eq_of_mul_add_eq_mul_add [IsHausdorff I A] {q q' : A⟦X⟧} {r r' : A[X]}
    (hr : r.degree < (g.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).order.toNat)
    (hr' : r'.degree < (g.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).order.toNat)
    (heq : g * q + r = g * q' + r') : q = q' ∧ r = r'
proof:
:= by
  replace heq : g * (q - q') = ↑(r' - r) := by
    rw [← eq_sub_iff_add_eq] at heq
    rw [Polynomial.coe_sub, mul_sub, heq]
    ring
  have h := H.eq_zero_of_mul_eq (lt_of_le_of_lt (r'.degree_sub_le r) (max_lt hr' hr)) heq
  simp_rw [sub_eq_zero] at h
  exact ⟨h.1, h.2.symm⟩

name: div_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem div_add [IsAdicComplete I A] : H.div (f + f') = H.div f + H.div f'
proof:
:= by
  have H1 := (H.isWeierstrassDivisionAt_div_mod f).add (H.isWeierstrassDivisionAt_div_mod f')
  have H2 := H.isWeierstrassDivisionAt_div_mod (f + f')
  exact (H.eq_of_mul_add_eq_mul_add H2.degree_lt H1.degree_lt
    (H2.eq_mul_add.symm.trans H1.eq_mul_add)).1

name: div_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem div_smul [IsAdicComplete I A] : H.div (a • f) = a • H.div f
proof:
:= by
  have H1 := (H.isWeierstrassDivisionAt_div_mod f).smul a
  have H2 := H.isWeierstrassDivisionAt_div_mod (a • f)
  exact (H.eq_of_mul_add_eq_mul_add H2.degree_lt H1.degree_lt
    (H2.eq_mul_add.symm.trans H1.eq_mul_add)).1

name: div_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem div_zero [IsAdicComplete I A] : H.div 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa using H.div_smul 0 0

name: mod_add
statement:

theorem mod_add [IsAdicComplete I A] : H.mod (f + f') = H.mod f + H.mod f'

name: mod'_mk_eq_mod
statement:

theorem mod'_mk_eq_mod [IsAdicComplete I A] {f : A⟦X⟧} :

proof: := rfl

name: div_coe_eq_zero
statement:
theorem div_coe_eq_zero [IsAdicComplete I A] {r : A[X]}
    (hr : r.degree < (g.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).order.toNat) : H.div r = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := H.isWeierstrassDivisionAt_div_mod r
  exact (H.eq_of_mul_add_eq_mul_add (q := H.div r) (q' := 0) h1 hr (by simpa using h2.symm)).1

name: mod_coe_eq_self
statement:
theorem mod_coe_eq_self [IsAdicComplete I A] {r : A[X]}

proof:
:= by

name: mk_mod'_eq_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_mod'_eq_self [IsAdicComplete I A] {f : A⟦X⟧ ⧸ Ideal.span {g}} :
    Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (H.mod' f : A⟦X⟧) = f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective f
  rw [mod'_mk_eq_mod, Eq.comm, Ideal.Quotient.mk_eq_mk_iff_sub_mem, Ideal.mem_span_singleton']
  use H.div f
  rw [eq_sub_iff_add_eq, mul_comm, (H.isWeierstrassDivisionAt_div_mod f).2.symm]

proof:
:= by
  rw [weierstrassMod]
  split_ifs with hg
  · exact degree_trunc_lt _ _
  · nontriviality A

name: isWeierstrassDivision_weierstrassDiv_weierstrassMod
statement:
theorem isWeierstrassDivision_weierstrassDiv_weierstrassMod

proof:

name: IsWeierstrassDivision.elim

:=

:=

name: map_ne_zero_of_ne_top
statement: theorem map_ne_zero_of_ne_top (hI : I ≠ ⊤) : g.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr hI
  rw [congr(map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) $(H.eq_mul)), map_mul, ← Polynomial.polynomial_map_coe, ne_eq,
    (H.isUnit.map _).mul_left_eq_zero]
  exact_mod_cast f.map_monic_ne_zero (f := Ideal.Quotient.mk I) H.isDistinguishedAt.monic

name: degree_eq_coe_lift_order_map_of_ne_top
statement:
theorem degree_eq_coe_lift_order_map_of_ne_top (hI : I ≠ ⊤) :
    f.degree = (g.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).order.lift
      (order_finite_iff_ne_zero.2 (H.map_ne_zero_of_ne_top hI))
proof:
:= by
  refine H.isDistinguishedAt.degree_eq_coe_lift_order_map g h ?_ H.eq_mul
  contrapose hI
  exact Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem _ hI (isUnit_iff_constantCoeff.1 H.isUnit)

name: natDegree_eq_toNat_order_map_of_ne_top
statement:

:= by
  rw [Polynomial.natDegree, H.degree_eq_coe_lift_order_map_of_ne_top hI,
    ENat.lift_eq_toNat_of_lt_top]

      (H.isDistinguishedAt.isWeierstrassDivisorAt'.mod' <| Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq A
        (by rw [H.eq_mul, Ideal.span_singleton_mul_right_unit H.isUnit]) x)

name: mul
statement:
theorem mul {g' : A⟦X⟧} {f' : A[X]} {h' : A⟦X⟧} (H' : g'.IsWeierstrassFactorizationAt f' h' I) :
    (g * g').IsWeierstrassFactorizationAt (f * f') (h * h') I
proof:
:=
  ⟨H.isDistinguishedAt.mul H'.isDistinguishedAt, H.isUnit.mul H'.isUnit, by
    rw [H.eq_mul, H'.eq_mul, Polynomial.coe_mul]; ring⟩

name: smul
statement: theorem smul {a : A} (ha : IsUnit a) : (a • g).IsWeierstrassFactorizationAt f (a • h) I
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨H.isDistinguishedAt, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Algebra.smul_def]
    exact (ha.map _).mul H.isUnit
  · simp [H.eq_mul]

statement: theorem map_ne_zero : g.map (IsLocalRing.residue A) ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  H.map_ne_zero_of_ne_top (Ideal.IsMaximal.ne_top inferInstance)

name: degree_eq_coe_lift_order_map
statement:
theorem degree_eq_coe_lift_order_map : f.degree = (g.map (IsLocalRing.residue A)).order.lift

name: IsWeierstrassDivision.isUnit_of_map_ne_zero
statement:
theorem IsWeierstrassDivision.isUnit_of_map_ne_zero
    {g q : A⟦X⟧} {r : A[X]} (hg : g.map (IsLocalRing.residue A) ≠ 0)
    (H : (X ^ (g.map (IsLocalRing.residue A)).order.toNat).IsWeierstrassDivision g q r) :
    IsUnit q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨H1 : r.degree < (g.map (IsLocalRing.residue A)).order.toNat, H2⟩ := H
  set n := (g.map (IsLocalRing.residue A)).order.toNat
  replace H2 := congr(coeff n (($H2).map (IsLocalRing.residue A)))
  simp_rw [map_pow, map_X, coeff_X_pow_self, map_add, map_mul, coeff_map,
    Polynomial.coeff_coe, Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_degree_lt H1, map_zero, add_zero] at H2
  rw [isUnit_iff_constantCoeff, ← isUnit_map_iff (IsLocalRing.residue A)]
  rw [coeff_mul, ← Finset.sum_subset (s₁ := {(n, 0)}) (by simp) (fun p hp hnotMem ↦ ?_),
    Finset.sum_singleton, coeff_map, coeff_map, coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff, mul_comm] at H2
  · exact .of_mul_eq_one _ H2.symm
  · rw [coeff_of_lt_order p.1 ?_]
    · rw [zero_mul]
    · rw [← ENat.lt_lift_iff (h := order_finite_iff_ne_zero.2 hg), ENat.lift_eq_toNat_of_lt_top]
      refine (Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal.fst_le hp).lt_of_ne ?_
      contrapose hnotMem
      rwa [Finset.mem_singleton, Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal_congr hp (by simp)]

name: IsWeierstrassDivision.isWeierstrassFactorization
statement:
theorem IsWeierstrassDivision.isWeierstrassFactorization
    {g q : A⟦X⟧} {r : A[X]} (hg : g.map (IsLocalRing.residue A) ≠ 0)
    (H : (X ^ (g.map (IsLocalRing.residue A)).order.toNat).IsWeierstrassDivision g q r) :
    g.IsWeierstrassFactorization
      (Polynomial.X ^ (g.map (IsLocalRing.residue A)).order.toNat - r)
      ↑(H.isUnit_of_map_ne_zero hg).unit⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have H1 : r.degree < (g.map (IsLocalRing.residue A)).order.toNat := H.1
  set n := (g.map (IsLocalRing.residue A)).order.toNat
  set f := Polynomial.X ^ n - r
  replace H1 : r.degree < (Polynomial.X (R := A) ^ n).degree := by rwa [Polynomial.degree_X_pow]
  have hfdeg : f.natDegree = n := by
    suffices f.degree = n by rw [Polynomial.natDegree, this]; rfl
    rw [Polynomial.degree_sub_eq_left_of_degree_lt H1, Polynomial.degree_X_pow]
  refine ⟨⟨⟨fun {i} hi ↦ ?_⟩, .sub_of_left (Polynomial.monic_X_pow _) H1⟩, Units.isUnit _, ?_⟩
  · rw [hfdeg] at hi
    simp_rw [f, Polynomial.coeff_sub, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow, ite_eq_right hi.ne, zero_sub,
      neg_mem_iff]
    have := H.coeff_f_sub_r_mem hi
    rwa [map_sub, coeff_X_pow, ite_eq_right hi.ne, zero_sub, neg_mem_iff,
      Polynomial.coeff_coe] at this
  · have := congr($(H.2) * ↑(H.isUnit_of_map_ne_zero hg).unit⁻¹)
    rw [add_mul, mul_assoc, IsUnit.mul_val_inv, mul_one, ← sub_eq_iff_eq_add] at this
    simp_rw [← this, f, Polynomial.coe_sub, Polynomial.coe_pow, Polynomial.coe_X, sub_mul]

name: IsWeierstrassFactorization.isWeierstrassDivision
statement:
theorem IsWeierstrassFactorization.isWeierstrassDivision
    {g : A⟦X⟧} {f : A[X]} {h : A⟦X⟧} (H : g.IsWeierstrassFactorization f h) :
    (X ^ (g.map (IsLocalRing.residue A)).order.toNat).IsWeierstrassDivision g ↑H.isUnit.unit⁻¹
      (Polynomial.X ^ (g.map (IsLocalRing.residue A)).order.toNat - f)
proof:
:= by
  set n := (g.map (IsLocalRing.residue A)).order.toNat with hn
  constructor
  · refine (Polynomial.degree_sub_lt_left ?_ (Polynomial.monic_X_pow n).ne_zero ?_).trans_eq
      (by simpa)
    · simp_rw [H.degree_eq_coe_lift_order_map, Polynomial.degree_X_pow, n,
        ENat.lift_eq_toNat_of_lt_top]
    · rw [(Polynomial.monic_X_pow n).leadingCoeff, H.isDistinguishedAt.monic.leadingCoeff]
  · simp_rw [H.eq_mul, mul_assoc, IsUnit.mul_val_inv, mul_one, Polynomial.coe_sub,
      Polynomial.coe_pow, Polynomial.coe_X, add_sub_cancel]

name: IsWeierstrassFactorization.elim
statement:
theorem IsWeierstrassFactorization.elim [IsHausdorff (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A]
    {g : A⟦X⟧} {f f' : A[X]} {h h' : A⟦X⟧} (H : g.IsWeierstrassFactorization f h)
    (H2 : g.IsWeierstrassFactorization f' h') : f = f' ∧ h = h'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := H.isWeierstrassDivision.elim H.map_ne_zero H2.isWeierstrassDivision
  rw [← Units.ext_iff, inv_inj, Units.ext_iff] at h1
  exact ⟨by simpa using h2, h1⟩

name: exists_isWeierstrassFactorization
statement:
theorem exists_isWeierstrassFactorization (hg : g.map (IsLocalRing.residue A) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ f h, g.IsWeierstrassFactorization f h
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, r, H⟩ :=
    (X ^ (g.map (IsLocalRing.residue A)).order.toNat).exists_isWeierstrassDivision hg
  exact ⟨_, _, H.isWeierstrassFactorization hg⟩

name: isWeierstrassFactorization_weierstrassDistinguished_weierstrassUnit
statement:
theorem isWeierstrassFactorization_weierstrassDistinguished_weierstrassUnit
    (hg : g.map (IsLocalRing.residue A) ≠ 0) :
    g.IsWeierstrassFactorization (g.weierstrassDistinguished hg) (g.weierstrassUnit hg)
proof:
:=
  (g.exists_isWeierstrassFactorization hg).choose_spec.choose_spec

name: isDistinguishedAt_weierstrassDistinguished
statement:
theorem isDistinguishedAt_weierstrassDistinguished (hg : g.map (IsLocalRing.residue A) ≠ 0) :
    (g.weierstrassDistinguished hg).IsDistinguishedAt (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
proof:
:=
  (g.exists_isWeierstrassFactorization hg).choose_spec.choose_spec.isDistinguishedAt

name: isUnit_weierstrassUnit
statement:
theorem isUnit_weierstrassUnit (hg : g.map (IsLocalRing.residue A) ≠ 0) :
    IsUnit (g.weierstrassUnit hg)
proof:
:=
  (g.exists_isWeierstrassFactorization hg).choose_spec.choose_spec.isUnit

name: eq_weierstrassDistinguished_mul_weierstrassUnit
statement:
theorem eq_weierstrassDistinguished_mul_weierstrassUnit (hg : g.map (IsLocalRing.residue A) ≠ 0) :
    g = g.weierstrassDistinguished hg * g.weierstrassUnit hg
proof:
:=
  (g.exists_isWeierstrassFactorization hg).choose_spec.choose_spec.eq_mul

name: IsWeierstrassFactorization.unique
statement:
theorem IsWeierstrassFactorization.unique
    (H : g.IsWeierstrassFactorization f h) (hg : g.map (IsLocalRing.residue A) ≠ 0) :
    f = g.weierstrassDistinguished hg ∧ h = g.weierstrassUnit hg
proof:
:=
  H.elim (g.isWeierstrassFactorization_weierstrassDistinguished_weierstrassUnit hg)

name: weierstrassDistinguished_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem weierstrassDistinguished_mul (hg : (g * g').map (IsLocalRing.residue A) ≠ 0) :
    (g * g').weierstrassDistinguished hg =
      g.weierstrassDistinguished (fun h ↦ hg (by simp [h])) *
        g'.weierstrassDistinguished (fun h ↦ hg (by simp [h]))
proof:
:= by
  have H := g.isWeierstrassFactorization_weierstrassDistinguished_weierstrassUnit
    (fun h ↦ hg (by simp [h]))
  have H' := g'.isWeierstrassFactorization_weierstrassDistinguished_weierstrassUnit
    (fun h ↦ hg (by simp [h]))
  have H'' := (g * g').isWeierstrassFactorization_weierstrassDistinguished_weierstrassUnit hg
  exact (H''.elim (H.mul H')).1

name: weierstrassUnit_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem weierstrassUnit_mul (hg : (g * g').map (IsLocalRing.residue A) ≠ 0) :
    (g * g').weierstrassUnit hg =
      g.weierstrassUnit (fun h ↦ hg (by simp [h])) *
        g'.weierstrassUnit (fun h ↦ hg (by simp [h]))
proof:
:= by
  have H := g.isWeierstrassFactorization_weierstrassDistinguished_weierstrassUnit
    (fun h ↦ hg (by simp [h]))
  have H' := g'.isWeierstrassFactorization_weierstrassDistinguished_weierstrassUnit
    (fun h ↦ hg (by simp [h]))
  have H'' := (g * g').isWeierstrassFactorization_weierstrassDistinguished_weierstrassUnit hg
  exact (H''.elim (H.mul H')).2

name: weierstrassDistinguished_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem weierstrassDistinguished_smul (hg : (a • g).map (IsLocalRing.residue A) ≠ 0) :
    (a • g).weierstrassDistinguished hg =
      g.weierstrassDistinguished (fun h ↦ hg (by simp [Algebra.smul_def, h]))
proof:
:= by
  have H := g.isWeierstrassFactorization_weierstrassDistinguished_weierstrassUnit
    (fun h ↦ hg (by simp [Algebra.smul_def, h]))
  have H' := (a • g).isWeierstrassFactorization_weierstrassDistinguished_weierstrassUnit hg
  have ha : IsLocalRing.residue A a ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hg (by simp [Algebra.smul_def, h])
  exact (H'.elim (H.smul (by simpa using ha))).1

name: weierstrassUnit_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem weierstrassUnit_smul (hg : (a • g).map (IsLocalRing.residue A) ≠ 0) :
    (a • g).weierstrassUnit hg =
      a • g.weierstrassUnit (fun h ↦ hg (by simp [Algebra.smul_def, h]))
proof:
:= by
  have H := g.isWeierstrassFactorization_weierstrassDistinguished_weierstrassUnit
    (fun h ↦ hg (by simp [Algebra.smul_def, h]))
  have H' := (a • g).isWeierstrassFactorization_weierstrassDistinguished_weierstrassUnit hg
  have ha : IsLocalRing.residue A a ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hg (by simp [Algebra.smul_def, h])
  exact (H'.elim (H.smul (by simpa using ha))).2

name: coeff_derivative
statement:
theorem coeff_derivative (f : R⟦X⟧) (n : ℕ) :
    coeff n (d⁄dX f) = coeff (n + 1) f * (n + 1)
proof:

name: coeff_iterate_derivative
statement:
theorem coeff_iterate_derivative (f : R⟦X⟧) (n k : ℕ) :
    coeff k (d⁄dX^[n] f) = (k + 1).ascFactorial n * coeff (k + n) f
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', coeff_derivative, ih, Nat.ascFactorial_succ,
      ← Nat.succ_ascFactorial]
    grind

name: constantCoeff_iterate_derivative

proof:

name: derivative_coe
statement: theorem derivative_coe (f : R[X]) : d⁄dX (f : R⟦X⟧) = Polynomial.derivative f

name: trunc_derivative
statement:
theorem trunc_derivative (f : R⟦X⟧) (n : ℕ) :
    trunc n (d⁄dX f) = Polynomial.derivative (trunc (n + 1) f)
proof:
:= by
  ext d
  rw [coeff_trunc]
  split_ifs with h
  · have : d + 1 < n + 1 := succ_lt_succ_iff.2 h
    rw [coeff_derivative, Polynomial.coeff_derivative, coeff_trunc, ite_eq_left this]
  · have : ¬d + 1 < n + 1 := by rwa [succ_lt_succ_iff]
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_derivative, coeff_trunc, ite_eq_right this, zero_mul]

name: trunc_derivative'

name: derivative_subst_coe
statement:
private theorem derivative_subst_coe [CommRing R] (p : Polynomial R) {g : R⟦X⟧} (hg : HasSubst g) :
    d⁄dX ((p : R⟦X⟧).subst g) = (d⁄dX (p : R⟦X⟧)).subst g * d⁄dX g
proof:
:= by
  simp [subst_coe hg, derivative_coe, Derivation.comp_aeval_eq (a := g) derivative p,
    smul_eq_mul]

name: derivative_subst
statement:
theorem derivative_subst [CommRing R] {f g : R⟦X⟧} (hg : HasSubst g) :
    d⁄dX (f.subst g) = (d⁄dX f).subst g * d⁄dX g
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := (hg.eventually_coeff_pow_eq_zero (n + 1)).exists_forall_of_atTop
  have : coeff (n + 1) (f.subst g) = coeff (n + 1) ((↑(trunc (m + 1) f) : R⟦X⟧).subst g) := by
    rw [coeff_subst' hg, coeff_subst' hg]
    refine finsum_congr fun d ↦ ?_
    obtain hd | hd := lt_or_ge d m
    · rw [coeff_coe_trunc_of_lt (by lia)]
    · simp [coeff_trunc, hd, hm]
  rw [coeff_derivative, this, ← coeff_derivative, derivative_subst_coe _ hg, coeff_mul, coeff_mul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ⟨i, j⟩ hij ↦ ?_
  congr 1
  simp only [coeff_subst' hg, coeff_derivative, coeff_coe, coeff_trunc]
  exact finsum_congr fun d ↦ by split_ifs <;> simp (disch := grind [Finset.mem_antidiagonal]) [hm]

name: coeff_mul_mem_ideal_mul_ideal_of_coeff_mem_ideal
statement:
theorem coeff_mul_mem_ideal_mul_ideal_of_coeff_mem_ideal (hf : ∀ i ≤ n, coeff i f ∈ I)
    (hg : ∀ i ≤ n, coeff i g ∈ J) : ∀ i ≤ n, coeff i (f * g) ∈ I * J
proof:
:= fun i hi ↦ by
  rw [coeff_mul]
  exact Ideal.sum_mem _ fun p hp ↦ Ideal.mul_mem_mul
    (hf _ ((Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal.fst_le hp).trans hi))

theorem coeff_mul_mem_ideal_mul_ideal_of_coeff_mem_ideal' (hf : ∀ i, coeff i f ∈ I)

proof:
:=
  fun i ↦ coeff_mul_mem_ideal_mul_ideal_of_coeff_mem_ideal i
