name: IsStronglyTranscendental.transcendental
statement:
lemma IsStronglyTranscendental.transcendental {x : S} (h : IsStronglyTranscendental R x)
    [FaithfulSMul R S] : Transcendental R x
proof:
:=
  transcendental_iff.mpr fun p hp ↦ Polynomial.ext <|
    by simpa [Algebra.smul_def, hp, Polynomial.ext_iff] using h 1 p

name: isStronglyTranscendental_iff_of_field
statement:
lemma isStronglyTranscendental_iff_of_field {K : Type*} [Field K] [Algebra R K] [FaithfulSMul R K]
    {x : K} : IsStronglyTranscendental R x ↔ Transcendental R x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ h.transcendental, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  simpa [IsStronglyTranscendental, or_imp, forall_and, @forall_comm K, ← subsingleton_iff_forall_eq,
    not_subsingleton, ext_iff, forall_or_left, ← imp_iff_or_not, transcendental_iff] using h

name: IsStronglyTranscendental.of_map
statement:
lemma IsStronglyTranscendental.of_map {x : S} {f : S →ₐ[R] T} (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (h : IsStronglyTranscendental R (f x)) :
    IsStronglyTranscendental R x
proof:
:= by
  intro u p hp
  have := h (f u) p (by rw [aeval_algHom_apply, ← map_mul, hp, map_zero])
  rwa [← f.comp_algebraMap, ← map_map, ← f.coe_toRingHom, ← map_C, ← Polynomial.map_mul,
    ← coe_mapRingHom, map_eq_zero_iff] at this
  exact map_injective f.toRingHom hf

name: IsStronglyTranscendental.of_isLocalization
statement:
lemma IsStronglyTranscendental.of_isLocalization [Algebra S T] (M : Submonoid S)
    [IsLocalization M T] [IsScalarTower R S T]
    {x : S} (h : IsStronglyTranscendental R x) :
    IsStronglyTranscendental R (algebraMap S T x)
proof:
:= by
  intro u p hp
  obtain ⟨u, s, rfl⟩ := IsLocalization.exists_mk'_eq M u
  obtain ⟨a, haM, e⟩ : ∃ a ∈ M, a * ((aeval x) p * u) = 0 := by
    simpa [aeval_algebraMap_apply, ← Algebra.smul_def, IsLocalization.smul_mk',
      IsLocalization.mk'_eq_zero_iff] using hp
  have : p.map (algebraMap R T) * C (a • algebraMap S T u) = 0 := by
    simpa [map_map, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq, Algebra.smul_def] using
      congr(map (algebraMap S T) $(h (a * u) p (by linear_combination e)))
  refine ((IsLocalization.map_units T (⟨a, haM⟩ * s)).map C).mul_right_cancel ?_
  simpa [mul_assoc, ← map_mul, mul_comm _ (algebraMap _ _ _), ← Algebra.smul_def, mul_smul]

name: IsStronglyTranscendental.of_isLocalization_left
statement:
lemma IsStronglyTranscendental.of_isLocalization_left [Algebra S T] (M : Submonoid R)
    [IsLocalization M S] [IsScalarTower R S T]
    {x : T} (h : IsStronglyTranscendental R x) :
    IsStronglyTranscendental S x
proof:
:= by
  intro t p hp
  obtain ⟨a, ha₁, ha₂⟩ := IsLocalization.integerNormalization_spec M p
  have H : aeval x (IsLocalization.integerNormalization M p) = a • aeval x p := by
    simpa [AlgHom.map_smul_of_tower] using congr(aeval x $ha₂)
  have := h t (IsLocalization.integerNormalization M p) (by simp [H, hp])
  rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R S T, ← map_map, ha₂] at this
  rw [← (((IsLocalization.map_units S ⟨a, ha₁⟩).map (algebraMap S T)).map C).mul_right_inj]
  simpa [Algebra.smul_def, mul_assoc] using this

name: IsStronglyTranscendental.restrictScalars
statement:
lemma IsStronglyTranscendental.restrictScalars [Algebra S T] [IsScalarTower R S T]
    {x : T} (h : IsStronglyTranscendental S x) :
    IsStronglyTranscendental R x
proof:
:= by
  intro t p hp
  simpa [map_map, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq] using h t (p.map (algebraMap R S)) (by simpa)

name: IsStronglyTranscendental.of_surjective_left
statement:
lemma IsStronglyTranscendental.of_surjective_left [Algebra S T] [IsScalarTower R S T]
    {x : T} (h : IsStronglyTranscendental R x) (H : Function.Surjective (algebraMap R S)) :
    IsStronglyTranscendental S x
proof:
:= by
  intro t p hp
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := map_surjective _ H p
  simpa [map_map, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq] using h t p (by simpa using hp)

name: IsStronglyTranscendental.iff_of_isLocalization
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ .of_map (f := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R S T) (IsLocalization.injective _ hM) h,
    fun h ↦ .of_isLocalization M h⟩

name: IsStronglyTranscendental.iff_of_isFractionRing
statement:
lemma IsStronglyTranscendental.iff_of_isFractionRing (K : Type*) [Field K] [Algebra R K]
    [Algebra S K] [IsScalarTower R S K] [FaithfulSMul R S] [IsFractionRing S K] {x : S} :
    IsStronglyTranscendental R x ↔ Transcendental R (algebraMap S K x)
proof:
:= by
  have : FaithfulSMul R K := .trans R S K
  rw [← IsStronglyTranscendental.iff_of_isLocalization (T := K) le_rfl,
    isStronglyTranscendental_iff_of_field]

name: IsStronglyTranscendental.of_transcendental
statement:
lemma IsStronglyTranscendental.of_transcendental {K : Type*} [Field K] [Algebra R K]
    [Algebra S K] [IsScalarTower R S K] [FaithfulSMul R S] [FaithfulSMul S K]
    {x : S} (H : Transcendental R (algebraMap S K x)) :
    IsStronglyTranscendental R x
proof:
:= by
  have : FaithfulSMul R K := .trans R S K
  rw [← isStronglyTranscendental_iff_of_field] at H
  exact .of_map (f := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R S K) (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective _ _) H

name: isStronglyTranscendental_mk_of_mem_minimalPrimes
statement:
@[stacks 00Q0]
lemma isStronglyTranscendental_mk_of_mem_minimalPrimes [IsReduced S]
    {x : S} (hx : IsStronglyTranscendental R x) (q : Ideal S) (hq : q ∈ minimalPrimes S) :
    IsStronglyTranscendental R (Ideal.Quotient.mk q x)
proof:
:= by
  refine Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective.forall.mpr fun u p e ↦ ?_
  rw [← Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq, aeval_algebraMap_apply, Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq,
    ← map_mul, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem] at e
  have := hq.1.1
  have : Ring.KrullDimLE 0 (Localization.AtPrime q) := .of_isLocalization _ hq _
  let : Field (Localization.AtPrime q) := Ring.KrullDimLE.isField_of_isReduced.toField
  obtain ⟨⟨m, hmq⟩, hm⟩ := (IsLocalization.map_eq_zero_iff q.primeCompl (Localization.AtPrime q)
    (aeval x p * u)).mp (by rw [← Ideal.mem_bot, ← IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_eq_bot,
      ← Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal]; exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ e)
  ext i
  simp only [coeff_mul_C, coeff_map, coeff_zero, ← Ideal.Quotient.mk_algebraMap, ← map_mul,
    Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
  have : algebraMap R S (p.coeff i) * u * m = 0 := by
    simpa [← mul_assoc] using congr(($(hx (u * m) p (by linear_combination hm))).coeff i)
  exact (Ideal.IsPrime.mem_or_mem_of_mul_eq_zero ‹_› (by linear_combination this)).resolve_left hmq

name: IsIntegral.isAlgebraic
statement: theorem IsIntegral.isAlgebraic [Nontrivial R] {x : A} : IsIntegral R x → IsAlgebraic R x
proof:
:=
  fun ⟨p, hp, hpx⟩ => ⟨p, hp.ne_zero, hpx⟩

name: isAlgebraic_iff_isIntegral
statement: theorem isAlgebraic_iff_isIntegral {x : A} : IsAlgebraic K x ↔ IsIntegral K x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, IsIntegral.isAlgebraic⟩
  rintro ⟨p, hp, hpx⟩
  refine ⟨_, monic_mul_leadingCoeff_inv hp, ?_⟩
  rw [← aeval_def, map_mul, hpx, zero_mul]

name: Algebra.isAlgebraic_iff_isIntegral
statement:
protected theorem Algebra.isAlgebraic_iff_isIntegral :
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic K A ↔ Algebra.IsIntegral K A
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.isAlgebraic_def, Algebra.isIntegral_def,
      forall_congr' fun _ ↦ isAlgebraic_iff_isIntegral]

name: Algebra.IsAlgebraic.of_isIntegralClosure
statement:
theorem Algebra.IsAlgebraic.of_isIntegralClosure (R B C : Type*) [CommRing R] [Nontrivial R]
    [CommRing B] [CommRing C] [Algebra R B] [Algebra R C] [Algebra B C]
    [IsScalarTower R B C] [IsIntegralClosure B R C] : Algebra.IsAlgebraic R B
proof:
:=
  have := IsIntegralClosure.isIntegral_algebra R (A := B) C
  inferInstance

name: IsAlgebraic.of_finite
statement: theorem IsAlgebraic.of_finite (e : A) [Module.Finite R A] : IsAlgebraic R e
proof:
:=
  (IsIntegral.of_finite R e).isAlgebraic

name: transcendental_aeval_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem transcendental_aeval_iff {r : A} {f : K[X]} :
    Transcendental K (Polynomial.aeval r f) ↔ Transcendental K r ∧ Transcendental K f
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨?_, h.of_aeval⟩, fun ⟨h1, h2⟩ ↦ h1.aeval_of_transcendental h2⟩
  rw [Transcendental] at h ⊢
  contrapose h
  rw [isAlgebraic_iff_isIntegral] at h ⊢
  exact .of_mem_of_fg _ h.fg_adjoin_singleton _ (aeval_mem_adjoin_singleton _ _)

name: exists_integral_multiple
statement: theorem exists_integral_multiple (hz : IsAlgebraic R z) : ∃ y ≠ (0 : R), IsIntegral R (y • z)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases inj : Function.Injective (algebraMap R A); swap
  · rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero] at inj; push Not at inj
    have ⟨r, eq, ne⟩ := inj
    exact ⟨r, ne, by simpa [← algebraMap_smul A, eq, zero_smul] using isIntegral_zero⟩
  have ⟨p, p_ne_zero, px⟩ := hz
  set a := p.leadingCoeff
  have a_ne_zero : a ≠ 0 := mt Polynomial.leadingCoeff_eq_zero.mp p_ne_zero
  have x_integral : IsIntegral R (algebraMap R A a * z) :=
    ⟨p.integralNormalization, monic_integralNormalization p_ne_zero,
      integralNormalization_aeval_eq_zero px fun _ ↦ (map_eq_zero_iff _ inj).mp⟩
  exact ⟨_, a_ne_zero, Algebra.smul_def a z ▸ x_integral⟩

name: _root_.Algebra.IsAlgebraic.exists_integral_multiples
statement:
theorem _root_.Algebra.IsAlgebraic.exists_integral_multiples [NoZeroDivisors R]
    [alg : Algebra.IsAlgebraic R A] (s : Finset A) :
    ∃ y ≠ (0 : R), ∀ z ∈ s, IsIntegral R (y • z)
proof:
:= by
  have := Algebra.IsAlgebraic.nontrivial R A
  choose r hr int using fun x ↦ (alg.1 x).exists_integral_multiple
  refine ⟨∏ x ∈ s, r x, Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun _ _ ↦ hr _, fun _ h ↦ ?_⟩
  classical rw [← Finset.prod_erase_mul _ _ h, mul_smul]
  exact (int _).smul _

name: of_smul_isIntegral
statement:
theorem of_smul_isIntegral {y : R} (hy : ¬ IsNilpotent y)
    (h : IsIntegral R (y • z)) : IsAlgebraic R z
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨p, monic, eval0⟩ := h
  refine ⟨p.comp (C y * X), fun h ↦ ?_, by simpa [aeval_comp, Algebra.smul_def] using! eval0⟩
  apply_fun (coeff · p.natDegree) at h
  have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; exact hy .zero
  rw [coeff_zero, ← mul_one p.natDegree, ← natDegree_C_mul_X y hy0,
    coeff_comp_degree_mul_degree, monic, one_mul, leadingCoeff_C_mul_X] at h
  · exact hy ⟨_, h⟩
  · rw [natDegree_C_mul_X _ hy0]; rintro ⟨⟩

name: of_smul
statement:
theorem of_smul {y : R} (hy : y ∈ nonZeroDivisors R)
    (h : IsAlgebraic R (y • z)) : IsAlgebraic R z
proof:
:=
  have ⟨p, hp, eval0⟩ := h
  ⟨_, mt (comp_C_mul_X_eq_zero_iff hy).mp hp, by simpa [aeval_comp, Algebra.smul_def] using eval0⟩

name: iff_exists_smul_integral
statement:
theorem iff_exists_smul_integral [IsReduced R] :
    IsAlgebraic R z ↔ ∃ y ≠ (0 : R), IsIntegral R (y • z)
proof:
:=
  ⟨(exists_integral_multiple ·), fun ⟨_, hy, int⟩ ↦
    of_smul_isIntegral (by rwa [isNilpotent_iff_eq_zero]) int⟩

name: exists_smul_eq
statement:
lemma exists_smul_eq {x : K} (hx : IsAlgebraic R x) :
    ∃ (r : R) (s : S), r ≠ 0 ∧ r • x = algebraMap S K s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, h⟩ := hx.exists_integral_multiple
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := IsIntegralClosure.isIntegral_iff (A := S) |>.mp h
  exact ⟨r, s, hr, hs.symm⟩

name: exists_nsmul_eq
statement:
lemma exists_nsmul_eq [IsIntegralClosure S ℤ K] {x : K} (hx : IsAlgebraic ℤ x) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (s : S), m ≠ 0 ∧ m • x = algebraMap S K s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, s, ha, h⟩ := hx.exists_smul_eq S
  obtain ⟨n, rfl | rfl⟩ := a.eq_nat_or_neg
  · exact ⟨n, s, mod_cast ha, mod_cast h⟩
  · exact ⟨n, -s, by simpa using ha, by simp [← h]⟩

name: restrictScalars_of_isIntegral
statement:
theorem restrictScalars_of_isIntegral [int : Algebra.IsIntegral R S]
    {a : A} (h : IsAlgebraic S a) : IsAlgebraic R a
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hRS : Function.Injective (algebraMap R S)
  on_goal 2 => exact (Algebra.isAlgebraic_of_not_injective
    fun h ↦ hRS <| .of_comp (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R S A ▸ h)).1 _
  have := hRS.noZeroDivisors _ (map_zero _) (map_mul _)
  have ⟨s, hs, int_s⟩ := h.exists_integral_multiple
  cases subsingleton_or_nontrivial R
  · have := Module.subsingleton R S
    exact (is_transcendental_of_subsingleton _ _ h).elim
  have ⟨r, hr, _, e⟩ := (int.1 s).isAlgebraic.exists_nonzero_dvd (mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero hs)
  refine .of_smul_isIntegral (y := r) (by rwa [isNilpotent_iff_eq_zero]) ?_
  rw [Algebra.smul_def, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R S,
    e, ← Algebra.smul_def, mul_comm, mul_smul]
  exact isIntegral_trans _ (int_s.smul _)

name: restrictScalars
statement:
theorem restrictScalars [Algebra.IsAlgebraic R S]
    {a : A} (h : IsAlgebraic S a) : IsAlgebraic R a
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨p, hp, eval0⟩ := h
  by_cases hRS : Function.Injective (algebraMap R S)
  on_goal 2 => exact (Algebra.isAlgebraic_of_not_injective
    fun h ↦ hRS <| .of_comp (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R S A ▸ h)).1 _
  rw [← faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective] at hRS
  have := NoZeroDivisors.of_faithfulSMul R S
  have := Algebra.nontrivial_of_isAlgebraic R S
  have : IsDomain R := NoZeroDivisors.to_isDomain _
  classical
  have ⟨r, hr, int⟩ := Algebra.IsAlgebraic.exists_integral_multiples R (p.support.image (coeff p))
  let p := (r • p).toSubring (integralClosure R S).toSubring fun s hs ↦ by
    obtain ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩ := mem_coeffs_iff.mp hs
    exact int _ (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ <| support_smul _ _ hn)
  have : IsAlgebraic (integralClosure R S) a := by
    refine ⟨p, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [← Polynomial.map_ne_zero_iff (f := Subring.subtype _) (p := p)
        Subtype.val_injective, p, map_toSubring, smul_ne_zero_iff] using And.intro hr hp
    rw [← eval_map_algebraMap, Subalgebra.algebraMap_eq, ← map_map, ← Subalgebra.toSubring_subtype,
      map_toSubring, eval_map_algebraMap, ← AlgHom.restrictScalars_apply R,
      map_smul, AlgHom.restrictScalars_apply, eval0, smul_zero]
  exact restrictScalars_of_isIntegral _ this

name: _root_.IsIntegral.trans_isAlgebraic
statement:
theorem _root_.IsIntegral.trans_isAlgebraic [alg : Algebra.IsAlgebraic R S]
    {a : A} (h : IsIntegral S a) : IsAlgebraic R a
proof:
:= by
  cases subsingleton_or_nontrivial A
  · have := Algebra.IsAlgebraic.nontrivial R S
    exact Subsingleton.elim a 0 ▸ isAlgebraic_zero
  · have := Module.nontrivial S A
    exact h.isAlgebraic.restrictScalars _

name: neg
statement: protected lemma neg : IsAlgebraic R (-a)
proof:
:=
  have ⟨p, h, eval0⟩ := ha
  ⟨algEquivAevalNegX p, EmbeddingLike.map_ne_zero_iff.mpr h, by simpa [← comp_eq_aeval, aeval_comp]⟩

name: smul
statement: protected lemma smul (r : R) : IsAlgebraic R (r • a)
proof:
:=
  have ⟨_, hp, eval0⟩ := ha
  ⟨_, scaleRoots_ne_zero hp r, Algebra.smul_def r a ▸ scaleRoots_aeval_eq_zero eval0⟩

name: nsmul
statement: protected lemma nsmul (n : ℕ) : IsAlgebraic R (n • a)
proof:
:=
  Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul R n a ▸ ha.smul _

name: zsmul
statement: protected lemma zsmul (n : ℤ) : IsAlgebraic R (n • a)
proof:
:=
  Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul R n a ▸ ha.smul _

name: tmul
statement: lemma tmul [FaithfulSMul R S] : IsAlgebraic S (s ⊗ₜ[R] a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_one s, ← smul_eq_mul, ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
  have ⟨p, h, eval0⟩ := ha
  refine .smul ⟨p.map (algebraMap R S),
    (Polynomial.map_ne_zero_iff <| FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective ..).mpr h, ?_⟩ _
  rw [← Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply, ← AlgHom.coe_toRingHom (A := A),
    ← map_aeval_eq_aeval_map (by ext; simp), eval0, map_zero]

name: mul
statement: protected lemma mul : IsAlgebraic R (a * b)
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨ra, a0, int_a⟩ := ha.exists_integral_multiple
  have ⟨rb, b0, int_b⟩ := hb.exists_integral_multiple
  refine IsAlgebraic.iff_exists_smul_integral.mpr ⟨_, mul_ne_zero a0 b0, ?_⟩
  simp_rw [Algebra.smul_def, map_mul, mul_mul_mul_comm, ← Algebra.smul_def]
  exact int_a.mul int_b

name: add
statement: protected lemma add : IsAlgebraic R (a + b)
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨ra, a0, int_a⟩ := ha.exists_integral_multiple
  have ⟨rb, b0, int_b⟩ := hb.exists_integral_multiple
  refine IsAlgebraic.iff_exists_smul_integral.mpr ⟨_, mul_ne_zero b0 a0, ?_⟩
  rw [smul_add, mul_smul, mul_comm, mul_smul]
  exact (int_a.smul _).add (int_b.smul _)

name: sub
statement: protected lemma sub : IsAlgebraic R (a - b)
proof:
:=
  sub_eq_add_neg a b ▸ ha.add hb.neg

name: pow
statement: protected lemma pow (n : ℕ) : IsAlgebraic R (a ^ n)
proof:
:=
  have := ha.nontrivial
  n.rec (pow_zero a ▸ isAlgebraic_one) fun _ h ↦ pow_succ a _ ▸ h.mul ha

name: IsAlgebraic.trans
statement:
@[stacks 09GJ] theorem IsAlgebraic.trans [Algebra.IsAlgebraic R S] [alg : Algebra.IsAlgebraic S A] :
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic R A
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ ↦ (alg.1 _).restrictScalars _⟩

name: IsIntegral.trans_isAlgebraic
statement:
theorem IsIntegral.trans_isAlgebraic [Algebra.IsIntegral R S] [alg : Algebra.IsAlgebraic S A] :
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic R A
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ ↦ (alg.1 _).restrictScalars_of_isIntegral _⟩

name: IsAlgebraic.trans_isIntegral
statement:
theorem IsAlgebraic.trans_isIntegral [Algebra.IsAlgebraic R S] [int : Algebra.IsIntegral S A] :
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic R A
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ ↦ (int.1 _).trans_isAlgebraic _⟩

name: IsIntegral.isAlgebraic_iff
statement:
protected theorem IsIntegral.isAlgebraic_iff [Algebra.IsIntegral R S] [FaithfulSMul R S]
    {a : A} : IsAlgebraic R a ↔ IsAlgebraic S a
proof:
:=
  ⟨.extendScalars (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective ..), .restrictScalars_of_isIntegral _⟩

name: IsIntegral.isAlgebraic_iff_top
statement:
theorem IsIntegral.isAlgebraic_iff_top [Algebra.IsIntegral R S]
    [FaithfulSMul R S] : Algebra.IsAlgebraic R A ↔ Algebra.IsAlgebraic S A
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Algebra.isAlgebraic_def, Algebra.IsIntegral.isAlgebraic_iff R S]

name: IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic_iff
statement:
protected theorem IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic_iff [Algebra.IsAlgebraic R S] [FaithfulSMul R S]
    {a : A} : IsAlgebraic R a ↔ IsAlgebraic S a
proof:
:=
  ⟨.extendScalars (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective ..), .restrictScalars _⟩

name: IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic_iff_top
statement:
theorem IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic_iff_top [Algebra.IsAlgebraic R S]
    [FaithfulSMul R S] : Algebra.IsAlgebraic R A ↔ Algebra.IsAlgebraic S A
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Algebra.isAlgebraic_def, Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic_iff R S]

name: IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic_iff_bot
statement:
theorem IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic_iff_bot [Algebra.IsAlgebraic S A] [FaithfulSMul S A] :
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic R A ↔ Algebra.IsAlgebraic R S
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ ↦ .tower_bot_of_injective (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective S A), fun _ ↦ .trans R S A⟩

name: Subalgebra.mem_algebraicClosure
statement:
theorem Subalgebra.mem_algebraicClosure [IsDomain R] {x : S} :
    x ∈ algebraicClosure R S ↔ IsAlgebraic R x
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: integralClosure_le_algebraicClosure
statement:
theorem integralClosure_le_algebraicClosure [IsDomain R] :
    integralClosure R S ≤ Subalgebra.algebraicClosure R S
proof:
:=
  fun _ ↦ IsIntegral.isAlgebraic

name: Subalgebra.algebraicClosure_eq_integralClosure
statement:
theorem Subalgebra.algebraicClosure_eq_integralClosure {K} [Field K] [Algebra K S] :
    algebraicClosure K S = integralClosure K S
proof:
:=
  SetLike.ext fun _ ↦ isAlgebraic_iff_isIntegral

name: Algebra.isAlgebraic_adjoin_iff
statement:
theorem Algebra.isAlgebraic_adjoin_iff [IsDomain R] {s : Set S} :
    (adjoin R s).IsAlgebraic ↔ ∀ x ∈ s, IsAlgebraic R x
proof:
:=
  Algebra.adjoin_le_iff (S := Subalgebra.algebraicClosure R S)

name: Algebra.isAlgebraic_adjoin_of_nonempty
statement:
theorem Algebra.isAlgebraic_adjoin_of_nonempty [NoZeroDivisors R] {s : Set S} (hs : s.Nonempty) :
    (adjoin R s).IsAlgebraic ↔ ∀ x ∈ s, IsAlgebraic R x
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h x hx ↦ h _ (subset_adjoin hx), fun h ↦
    have ⟨x, hx⟩ := hs
    have := (isDomain_iff_noZeroDivisors_and_nontrivial _).mpr ⟨‹_›, (h x hx).nontrivial⟩
    isAlgebraic_adjoin_iff.mpr h⟩

name: Algebra.isAlgebraic_adjoin_singleton_iff
statement:
theorem Algebra.isAlgebraic_adjoin_singleton_iff [NoZeroDivisors R] {s : S} :
    (adjoin R {s}).IsAlgebraic ↔ IsAlgebraic R s
proof:
:=
  (isAlgebraic_adjoin_of_nonempty <| Set.singleton_nonempty s).trans forall_eq

name: IsAlgebraic.of_mul
statement:
theorem IsAlgebraic.of_mul [NoZeroDivisors R] {y z : S} (hy : y ∈ nonZeroDivisors S)
    (alg_y : IsAlgebraic R y) (alg_yz : IsAlgebraic R (y * z)) : IsAlgebraic R z
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨t, ht, r, hr, eq⟩ := alg_y.exists_nonzero_eq_adjoin_mul hy
  have := alg_yz.mul (Algebra.isAlgebraic_adjoin_singleton_iff.mpr alg_y _ ht)
  rw [mul_right_comm, eq, ← Algebra.smul_def] at this
  exact this.of_smul (mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero hr)

name: IsAlgebraic.adjoin_of_forall_isAlgebraic
proof:
:= by
  set Rs := adjoin R s
  set Rt := adjoin R t
  let Rts := adjoin Rt s
  let _ : Algebra Rs Rts := (Subalgebra.inclusion
    (T := Rts.restrictScalars R) <| adjoin_le <| by apply subset_adjoin).toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower Rs Rts A := .of_algebraMap_eq fun ⟨a, _⟩ ↦ rfl
  have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic Rt Rts := by
    have := ha.nontrivial
    have := Subtype.val_injective (p := (· ∈ Rs)).nontrivial
    have := (isDomain_iff_noZeroDivisors_and_nontrivial Rt).mpr ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩
    rw [← Subalgebra.isAlgebraic_iff, isAlgebraic_adjoin_iff]
    intro x hs
    by_cases ht : x ∈ t
    · exact isAlgebraic_algebraMap (⟨x, subset_adjoin ht⟩ : Rt)
    exact alg _ ⟨hs, ht⟩
  have : IsAlgebraic Rts a := ha.extendScalars (by apply Subalgebra.inclusion_injective)
  exact this.restrictScalars Rt

name: extendScalars_of_isIntegral
statement:
lemma extendScalars_of_isIntegral [Algebra.IsIntegral R S] :
    Transcendental S a
proof:
:= by
  contrapose ha
  rw [Transcendental, not_not] at ha ⊢
  exact ha.restrictScalars_of_isIntegral _

name: extendScalars
statement: lemma extendScalars [Algebra.IsAlgebraic R S] : Transcendental S a
proof:
:= by
  contrapose ha
  rw [Transcendental, not_not] at ha ⊢
  exact ha.restrictScalars _

name: integralClosure
statement: protected lemma integralClosure : Transcendental (integralClosure R S) a
proof:
:=
  ha.extendScalars_of_isIntegral _

name: subalgebraAlgebraicClosure
statement:
lemma subalgebraAlgebraicClosure [IsDomain R] :
    Transcendental (Subalgebra.algebraicClosure R S) a
proof: := ha.extendScalars _

name: IsIntegral.transcendental_iff
statement:
protected theorem IsIntegral.transcendental_iff [Algebra.IsIntegral R S] :
    Transcendental R a ↔ Transcendental S a
proof:
:=
  ⟨(·.extendScalars_of_isIntegral _), (·.restrictScalars (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective R S))⟩

name: IsAlgebraic.transcendental_iff
statement:
protected theorem IsAlgebraic.transcendental_iff [Algebra.IsAlgebraic R S] :
    Transcendental R a ↔ Transcendental S a
proof:
:=
  ⟨(·.extendScalars _), (·.restrictScalars (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective R S))⟩

name: isBaseChange_of_isFractionRing
statement:
theorem isBaseChange_of_isFractionRing [Module R' S'] [IsScalarTower R R' S'] :
    IsBaseChange R' (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R S S').toLinearMap
proof:
:=
  (isLocalizedModule_iff_isBaseChange R⁰ ..).mp inferInstance

name: lift_rank_of_isFractionRing
statement:
theorem lift_rank_of_isFractionRing :
    Cardinal.lift.{u} (Module.rank R' S') = Cardinal.lift.{v} (Module.rank R S)
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsLocalization.rank_eq R' R⁰ le_rfl,
    IsLocalizedModule.lift_rank_eq R⁰ (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R S S').toLinearMap le_rfl]

name: rank_of_isFractionRing
statement:
theorem rank_of_isFractionRing (S' : Type u) [CommRing S'] [Algebra R S'] [Algebra S S']
    [Module R' S'] [IsScalarTower R R' S'] [IsScalarTower R S S'] [IsFractionRing S S'] :
    Module.rank R' S' = Module.rank R S
proof:
:= by
  simpa using lift_rank_of_isFractionRing R R' S S'

name: rank_fractionRing
statement:
theorem rank_fractionRing [IsDomain S] :
    Module.rank (FractionRing R) (FractionRing S) = Module.rank R S
proof:
:=
  rank_of_isFractionRing ..

name: Module.finrank_mul_finrank'
statement:
theorem Module.finrank_mul_finrank' (T : Type*) [CommRing T] [IsDomain T]
    [Algebra S T] [Algebra R T] [IsScalarTower R S T] [FaithfulSMul S T] :
    Module.finrank R S * Module.finrank S T = Module.finrank R T
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : FaithfulSMul R S
  · have : FaithfulSMul R T := .trans R S T
    have : IsDomain R := (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective R T).isDomain
    have : IsDomain S := (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective S T).isDomain
    rw [← IsFractionRing.finrank_eq R (FractionRing R) S (FractionRing S),
      ← IsFractionRing.finrank_eq S (FractionRing S) T (FractionRing T),
      ← IsFractionRing.finrank_eq R (FractionRing R) T (FractionRing T),
      Module.finrank_mul_finrank (FractionRing R) (FractionRing S) (FractionRing T)]
  · rw [Module.finrank_eq_zero_of_not_faithfulSMul h, zero_mul,
      Module.finrank_eq_zero_of_not_faithfulSMul]
    exact fun _ ↦ h (FaithfulSMul.tower_bot R S T)

name: rank_polynomial_polynomial
statement: theorem rank_polynomial_polynomial : Module.rank R[X] S[X] = Module.rank R S
proof:
:=
  ((Algebra.isPushout_iff ..).mp inferInstance).rank_eq

name: rank_mvPolynomial_mvPolynomial
statement:
theorem rank_mvPolynomial_mvPolynomial (σ : Type u) :
    Module.rank (MvPolynomial σ R) (MvPolynomial σ S) = Cardinal.lift.{u} (Module.rank R S)
proof:
:= by
  have := Algebra.isPushout_iff R (MvPolynomial σ R) S (MvPolynomial σ S)
    |>.mp inferInstance |>.lift_rank_eq
  rwa [Cardinal.lift_id', Cardinal.lift_umax] at this

name: Algebra.IsPushout.isAlgebraic'
statement: theorem Algebra.IsPushout.isAlgebraic' [IsPushout R R' S S'] : Algebra.IsAlgebraic R' S'
proof:
:=
  (equiv R R' S S').isAlgebraic

name: Algebra.IsPushout.isAlgebraic
statement: theorem Algebra.IsPushout.isAlgebraic [h : IsPushout R S R' S'] : Algebra.IsAlgebraic R' S'
proof:
:=
  have := h.symm; (equiv R R' S S').isAlgebraic

name: Polynomial.exists_dvd_map_of_isAlgebraic
statement:
theorem Polynomial.exists_dvd_map_of_isAlgebraic [NoZeroDivisors S] {f : S[X]} (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    ∃ g : R[X], g ≠ 0 ∧ f ∣ g.map (algebraMap R S)
proof:
:=
  (Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic f).exists_nonzero_dvd (mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero hf)

name: MvPolynomial.exists_dvd_map_of_isAlgebraic
proof:
:=
  (Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic f).exists_nonzero_dvd (mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero hf)

name: rank_fractionRing_polynomial
statement:
@[stacks 0G1M] theorem rank_fractionRing_polynomial :
    Module.rank (FractionRing R[X]) (FractionRing S[X]) = Module.rank R S
proof:
:= by
  have := IsDomain.of_faithfulSMul R S
  rw [rank_fractionRing, rank_polynomial_polynomial]

name: rank_fractionRing_mvPolynomial
statement:
@[stacks 0G1M] theorem rank_fractionRing_mvPolynomial (σ : Type u) :
    Module.rank (FractionRing (MvPolynomial σ R)) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial σ S)) =
    lift.{u} (Module.rank R S)
proof:
:= by
  have := IsDomain.of_faithfulSMul R S
  rw [rank_fractionRing, rank_mvPolynomial_mvPolynomial]

name: polynomial_smul_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem polynomial_smul_apply [Semiring R] [SMul R S] (p : R[X]) (f : R → S) (x : R) :
    (p • f) x = eval x p • f x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: polynomial_smul_apply'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem polynomial_smul_apply' [CommSemiring R] [Semiring S] [Algebra R S] [SMul S T]
    (p : R[X]) (f : S → T) (x : S) : (p • f) x = aeval x p • f x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Polynomial.algebraMap_pi_eq_aeval
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Polynomial.algebraMap_pi_eq_aeval :
    (algebraMap R[X] (S → T) : R[X] → S → T) = fun p z => algebraMap _ _ (aeval z p)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Polynomial.algebraMap_pi_self_eq_eval
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Polynomial.algebraMap_pi_self_eq_eval :
    (algebraMap R[X] (R → R) : R[X] → R → R) = fun p z => eval z p
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: is_transcendental_of_subsingleton
statement:
@[nontriviality]
theorem is_transcendental_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton R] (x : A) : Transcendental R x
proof:
:=
  fun ⟨p, h, _⟩ => h <| Subsingleton.elim p 0

name: IsAlgebraic.nontrivial
statement: theorem IsAlgebraic.nontrivial {a : A} (h : IsAlgebraic R a) : Nontrivial R
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! h
  apply is_transcendental_of_subsingleton

name: Algebra.IsAlgebraic.nontrivial
statement: theorem Algebra.IsAlgebraic.nontrivial [alg : Algebra.IsAlgebraic R A] : Nontrivial R
proof:
:=
  (alg.1 0).nontrivial

name: Polynomial.transcendental_X
statement: theorem Polynomial.transcendental_X : Transcendental R (X (R := R))
proof:
:= by
  simp [transcendental_iff]

name: IsAlgebraic.of_aeval
statement:
theorem IsAlgebraic.of_aeval {r : A} (f : R[X]) (hf : f.natDegree ≠ 0)
    (hf' : f.leadingCoeff ∈ R⁰) (H : IsAlgebraic R (aeval r f)) :
    IsAlgebraic R r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, h1, h2⟩ := H
  have : (p.comp f).coeff (p.natDegree * f.natDegree) ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ h1 <| by
    rwa [coeff_comp_degree_mul_degree hf,
      mul_right_mem_nonZeroDivisors_eq_zero_iff (pow_mem hf' _),
      leadingCoeff_eq_zero] at h
  exact ⟨p.comp f, fun h ↦ this (by simp [h]), by rwa [aeval_comp]⟩

name: Transcendental.aeval
statement:
theorem Transcendental.aeval {r : A} (H : Transcendental R r) (f : R[X]) (hf : f.natDegree ≠ 0)
    (hf' : f.leadingCoeff ∈ R⁰) :
    Transcendental R (aeval r f)
proof: := fun h ↦ H (h.of_aeval f hf hf')

name: Transcendental.aeval_of_transcendental
statement:
theorem Transcendental.aeval_of_transcendental {r : A} (H : Transcendental R r)
    {f : R[X]} (hf : Transcendental R f) : Transcendental R (Polynomial.aeval r f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [transcendental_iff] at H hf ⊢
  intro p hp
  exact hf _ (H _ (by rwa [← aeval_comp, comp_eq_aeval] at hp))

name: Transcendental.of_aeval
statement:
theorem Transcendental.of_aeval {r : A} {f : R[X]}
    (H : Transcendental R (Polynomial.aeval r f)) : Transcendental R f
proof:
:= by
  rw [transcendental_iff] at H ⊢
  intro p hp
  exact H p (by rw [← aeval_comp, comp_eq_aeval, hp, map_zero])

name: IsAlgebraic.of_aeval_of_transcendental
statement:
theorem IsAlgebraic.of_aeval_of_transcendental {r : A} {f : R[X]}
    (H : IsAlgebraic R (aeval r f)) (hf : Transcendental R f) : IsAlgebraic R r
proof:
:= by
  contrapose H
  exact Transcendental.aeval_of_transcendental H hf

name: Polynomial.transcendental
statement:
theorem Polynomial.transcendental (f : R[X]) (hf : f.natDegree ≠ 0)
    (hf' : f.leadingCoeff ∈ R⁰) :
    Transcendental R f
proof:
:= by
  simpa using (transcendental_X R).aeval f hf hf'

name: isAlgebraic_iff_not_injective
statement:
theorem isAlgebraic_iff_not_injective {x : A} :
    IsAlgebraic R x ↔ ¬Function.Injective (Polynomial.aeval x : R[X] →ₐ[R] A)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [IsAlgebraic, injective_iff_map_eq_zero, not_forall, and_comm, exists_prop]

name: transcendental_iff_injective
statement:
theorem transcendental_iff_injective {x : A} :
    Transcendental R x ↔ Function.Injective (Polynomial.aeval x : R[X] →ₐ[R] A)
proof:
:=
  isAlgebraic_iff_not_injective.not_left

name: transcendental_iff_ker_eq_bot
statement:
theorem transcendental_iff_ker_eq_bot {x : A} :
    Transcendental R x ↔ RingHom.ker (aeval (R := R) x) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [transcendental_iff_injective, RingHom.injective_iff_ker_eq_bot]

name: Algebra.isAlgebraic_of_not_injective
statement:
theorem Algebra.isAlgebraic_of_not_injective (h : ¬ Function.Injective (algebraMap R A)) :
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic R A where
  isAlgebraic a
proof:
:= isAlgebraic_iff_not_injective.mpr
    fun inj ↦ h <| by convert! inj.comp C_injective; ext; simp

name: Algebra.injective_of_transcendental
statement:
theorem Algebra.injective_of_transcendental [h : Algebra.Transcendental R A] :
    Function.Injective (algebraMap R A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [transcendental_iff_not_isAlgebraic] at h
  contrapose h
  exact isAlgebraic_of_not_injective h

name: isAlgebraic_zero
statement: theorem isAlgebraic_zero [Nontrivial R] : IsAlgebraic R (0 : A)
proof:
:=
  ⟨_, X_ne_zero, aeval_X 0⟩

name: Transcendental.ne_zero
statement:
@[grind →]
theorem Transcendental.ne_zero [Nontrivial R] {x : A} (ht : Transcendental R x) : x ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  fun h ↦ ht (h ▸ isAlgebraic_zero)

name: isAlgebraic_algebraMap
statement: theorem isAlgebraic_algebraMap [Nontrivial R] (x : R) : IsAlgebraic R (algebraMap R A x)
proof:
:=
  ⟨_, X_sub_C_ne_zero x, by rw [map_sub, aeval_X, aeval_C, sub_self]⟩

name: isAlgebraic_one
statement: theorem isAlgebraic_one [Nontrivial R] : IsAlgebraic R (1 : A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_one (algebraMap R A)]
  exact isAlgebraic_algebraMap 1

name: isAlgebraic_natCast
statement: theorem isAlgebraic_natCast [Nontrivial R] (n : ℕ) : IsAlgebraic R (n : A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_natCast (_ : R →+* A) n]
  exact isAlgebraic_algebraMap (Nat.cast n)

name: isAlgebraic_intCast
statement: theorem isAlgebraic_intCast [Nontrivial R] (n : ℤ) : IsAlgebraic R (n : A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_intCast (algebraMap R A)]
  exact isAlgebraic_algebraMap (Int.cast n)

name: isAlgebraic_ratCast
statement:
theorem isAlgebraic_ratCast (R : Type u) {A : Type v} [DivisionRing A] [Field R] [Algebra R A]
    (n : ℚ) : IsAlgebraic R (n : A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_ratCast (algebraMap R A)]
  exact isAlgebraic_algebraMap (Rat.cast n)

name: isAlgebraic_of_mem_rootSet
statement:
theorem isAlgebraic_of_mem_rootSet {R : Type u} {A : Type v} [CommRing R] [Field A] [Algebra R A]
    {p : R[X]} {x : A} (hx : x ∈ p.rootSet A) : IsAlgebraic R x
proof:
:=
  ⟨p, ne_zero_of_mem_rootSet hx, aeval_eq_zero_of_mem_rootSet hx⟩

name: IsLocalization.isAlgebraic
statement:
theorem IsLocalization.isAlgebraic [Nontrivial R] (M : Submonoid R) [IsLocalization M S] :
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic R S where
  isAlgebraic x
proof:
:= by
    obtain rfl | hx := eq_or_ne x 0
    · exact isAlgebraic_zero
    have ⟨⟨r, m⟩, h⟩ := surj M x
    refine ⟨C m.1 * X - C r, fun eq ↦ hx ?_, by simpa [sub_eq_zero, mul_comm x] using h⟩
    rwa [← eq_mk'_iff_mul_eq, show r = 0 by simpa using congr(coeff $eq 0), mk'_zero] at h

name: IsAlgebraic.algebraMap
statement:
protected theorem IsAlgebraic.algebraMap {a : S} :
    IsAlgebraic R a → IsAlgebraic R (algebraMap S A a)
proof:
:= fun ⟨f, hf₁, hf₂⟩ =>
  ⟨f, hf₁, by rw [aeval_algebraMap_apply, hf₂, map_zero]⟩

name: IsAlgebraic.algHom
statement:
protected theorem IsAlgebraic.algHom (f : A →ₐ[R] B) {a : A}
    (h : IsAlgebraic R a) : IsAlgebraic R (f a)
proof:
:=
  let ⟨p, hp, ha⟩ := h
  ⟨p, hp, by rw [aeval_algHom, f.comp_apply, ha, map_zero]⟩

name: isAlgebraic_algHom_iff
statement:
theorem isAlgebraic_algHom_iff (f : A →ₐ[R] B) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    {a : A} : IsAlgebraic R (f a) ↔ IsAlgebraic R a
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨p, hp0, hp⟩ ↦ ⟨p, hp0, hf <| by rwa [map_zero, ← f.comp_apply, ← aeval_algHom]⟩,
    IsAlgebraic.algHom f⟩

name: IsAlgebraic.ringHom_of_comp_eq
statement:
theorem IsAlgebraic.ringHom_of_comp_eq (halg : IsAlgebraic R a)
    (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (h : RingHom.comp (algebraMap S B) f = RingHom.comp g (algebraMap R A)) :
    IsAlgebraic S (g a)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, h1, h2⟩ := halg
  refine ⟨p.map f, (Polynomial.map_ne_zero_iff hf).2 h1, ?_⟩
  change aeval ((g : A →+* B) a) _ = 0
  rw [← map_aeval_eq_aeval_map h, h2, map_zero]

name: Transcendental.of_ringHom_of_comp_eq
statement:
theorem Transcendental.of_ringHom_of_comp_eq (H : Transcendental S (g a))
    (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (h : RingHom.comp (algebraMap S B) f = RingHom.comp g (algebraMap R A)) :
    Transcendental R a
proof: := fun halg ↦ H (halg.ringHom_of_comp_eq f g hf h)

name: Algebra.IsAlgebraic.ringHom_of_comp_eq
statement:
theorem Algebra.IsAlgebraic.ringHom_of_comp_eq [Algebra.IsAlgebraic R A]
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (hg : Function.Surjective g)
    (h : RingHom.comp (algebraMap S B) f = RingHom.comp g (algebraMap R A)) :
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic S B
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun b ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hg b
  exact (Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic a).ringHom_of_comp_eq f g hf h

name: Algebra.Transcendental.of_ringHom_of_comp_eq
statement:
theorem Algebra.Transcendental.of_ringHom_of_comp_eq [H : Algebra.Transcendental S B]
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (hg : Function.Surjective g)
    (h : RingHom.comp (algebraMap S B) f = RingHom.comp g (algebraMap R A)) :
    Algebra.Transcendental R A
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.transcendental_iff_not_isAlgebraic] at H ⊢
  exact fun halg ↦ H (halg.ringHom_of_comp_eq f g hf hg h)

name: IsAlgebraic.of_ringHom_of_comp_eq
statement:
theorem IsAlgebraic.of_ringHom_of_comp_eq (halg : IsAlgebraic S (g a))
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) (hg : Function.Injective g)
    (h : RingHom.comp (algebraMap S B) f = RingHom.comp g (algebraMap R A)) :
    IsAlgebraic R a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, h1, h2⟩ := halg
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := map_surjective (f : R →+* S) hf p
  refine ⟨q, fun h' ↦ by simp [h'] at h1, hg ?_⟩
  change aeval ((g : A →+* B) a) _ = 0 at h2
  change (g : A →+* B) _ = _
  rw [map_zero, map_aeval_eq_aeval_map h, h2]

name: Transcendental.ringHom_of_comp_eq
statement:
theorem Transcendental.ringHom_of_comp_eq (H : Transcendental R a)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) (hg : Function.Injective g)
    (h : RingHom.comp (algebraMap S B) f = RingHom.comp g (algebraMap R A)) :
    Transcendental S (g a)
proof: := fun halg ↦ H (halg.of_ringHom_of_comp_eq f g hf hg h)

name: Algebra.IsAlgebraic.of_ringHom_of_comp_eq
statement:
theorem Algebra.IsAlgebraic.of_ringHom_of_comp_eq [Algebra.IsAlgebraic S B]
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) (hg : Function.Injective g)
    (h : RingHom.comp (algebraMap S B) f = RingHom.comp g (algebraMap R A)) :
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic R A
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun a ↦ (Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic (g a)).of_ringHom_of_comp_eq f g hf hg h⟩

name: Algebra.Transcendental.ringHom_of_comp_eq
statement:
theorem Algebra.Transcendental.ringHom_of_comp_eq [H : Algebra.Transcendental R A]
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) (hg : Function.Injective g)
    (h : RingHom.comp (algebraMap S B) f = RingHom.comp g (algebraMap R A)) :
    Algebra.Transcendental S B
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.transcendental_iff_not_isAlgebraic] at H ⊢
  exact fun halg ↦ H (halg.of_ringHom_of_comp_eq f g hf hg h)

name: isAlgebraic_ringHom_iff_of_comp_eq
statement:
theorem isAlgebraic_ringHom_iff_of_comp_eq
    (hg : Function.Injective g)
    (h : RingHom.comp (algebraMap S B) f = RingHom.comp g (algebraMap R A)) {a : A} :
    IsAlgebraic S (g a) ↔ IsAlgebraic R a
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun H ↦ H.of_ringHom_of_comp_eq f g (EquivLike.surjective f) hg h,
    fun H ↦ H.ringHom_of_comp_eq f g (EquivLike.injective f) h⟩

name: transcendental_ringHom_iff_of_comp_eq
statement:
theorem transcendental_ringHom_iff_of_comp_eq
    (hg : Function.Injective g)
    (h : RingHom.comp (algebraMap S B) f = RingHom.comp g (algebraMap R A)) {a : A} :
    Transcendental S (g a) ↔ Transcendental R a
proof:
:=
  not_congr (isAlgebraic_ringHom_iff_of_comp_eq f g hg h)

name: Algebra.isAlgebraic_ringHom_iff_of_comp_eq
statement:
theorem Algebra.isAlgebraic_ringHom_iff_of_comp_eq
    (h : RingHom.comp (algebraMap S B) f = RingHom.comp g (algebraMap R A)) :
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic S B ↔ Algebra.IsAlgebraic R A
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun H ↦ H.of_ringHom_of_comp_eq f g (EquivLike.surjective f) (EquivLike.injective g) h,
    fun H ↦ H.ringHom_of_comp_eq f g (EquivLike.injective f) (EquivLike.surjective g) h⟩

name: Algebra.transcendental_ringHom_iff_of_comp_eq
statement:
theorem Algebra.transcendental_ringHom_iff_of_comp_eq
    (h : RingHom.comp (algebraMap S B) f = RingHom.comp g (algebraMap R A)) :
    Algebra.Transcendental S B ↔ Algebra.Transcendental R A
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Algebra.transcendental_iff_not_isAlgebraic,
    Algebra.isAlgebraic_ringHom_iff_of_comp_eq f g h]

name: Algebra.IsAlgebraic.of_injective
statement:
theorem Algebra.IsAlgebraic.of_injective (f : A →ₐ[R] B) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic R B] : Algebra.IsAlgebraic R A
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ ↦ (isAlgebraic_algHom_iff f hf).mp (Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic _)⟩

name: AlgEquiv.isAlgebraic
statement:
theorem AlgEquiv.isAlgebraic (e : A ≃ₐ[R] B)
    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic R A] : Algebra.IsAlgebraic R B
proof:
:=
  Algebra.IsAlgebraic.of_injective e.symm.toAlgHom e.symm.injective

name: AlgEquiv.isAlgebraic_iff
statement:
theorem AlgEquiv.isAlgebraic_iff (e : A ≃ₐ[R] B) :
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic R A ↔ Algebra.IsAlgebraic R B
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ ↦ e.isAlgebraic, fun _ ↦ e.symm.isAlgebraic⟩

name: isAlgebraic_algebraMap_iff
statement:
theorem isAlgebraic_algebraMap_iff {a : S} (h : Function.Injective (algebraMap S A)) :
    IsAlgebraic R (algebraMap S A a) ↔ IsAlgebraic R a
proof:
:=
  isAlgebraic_algHom_iff (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R S A) h

name: transcendental_algebraMap_iff
statement:
theorem transcendental_algebraMap_iff {a : S} (h : Function.Injective (algebraMap S A)) :
    Transcendental R (algebraMap S A a) ↔ Transcendental R a
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Transcendental, isAlgebraic_algebraMap_iff h]

name: isAlgebraic_iff_isAlgebraic_val
statement:

name: isAlgebraic_of_isAlgebraic_bot

theorem isAlgebraic_of_isAlgebraic_bot {x : S} (halg : IsAlgebraic (⊥ : Subalgebra R S) x) :

proof:
:=
  halg.of_ringHom_of_comp_eq (algebraMap R (⊥ : Subalgebra R S))

name: isAlgebraic_bot_iff
statement:
theorem isAlgebraic_bot_iff (h : Function.Injective (algebraMap R S)) {x : S} :

proof:
:=

name: algebra_isAlgebraic_of_algebra_isAlgebraic_bot_left

name: IsAlgebraic.invOf

  refine ⟨p.reverse, by simpa using hp, ?_⟩

name: IsAlgebraic.inv_iff

proof:

name: IsAlgebraic.extendScalars

proof:

name: algHom_bijective
statement:
theorem algHom_bijective [IsTorsionFree K L] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic K L] (f : L →ₐ[K] L) :
    Function.Bijective f
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨f.injective, fun b ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨p, hp, he⟩ := Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic (R := K) b
  let f' : p.rootSet L → p.rootSet L := (rootSet_maps_to' (fun x ↦ x) f).restrict f _ _
  have : f'.Surjective := Finite.injective_iff_surjective.1
    fun _ _ h ↦ Subtype.ext <| f.injective <| Subtype.ext_iff.1 h
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := this ⟨b, mem_rootSet.2 ⟨hp, he⟩⟩
  exact ⟨a, Subtype.ext_iff.1 ha⟩

name: algHom_bijective
statement:
theorem algHom_bijective₂ [IsTorsionFree K L] [DivisionRing R] [Algebra K R]
    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic K L] (f : L →ₐ[K] R) (g : R →ₐ[K] L) :
    Function.Bijective f ∧ Function.Bijective g
proof:
:=
  (g.injective.bijective₂_of_surjective f.injective (algHom_bijective <| g.comp f).2).symm

theorem bijective_of_isScalarTower' [Field R] [Algebra K R]

    Function.Bijective f
proof:
:=
  (algHom_bijective₂ f (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom K L R)).1

name: IsAlgebraic.exists_nonzero_coeff_and_aeval_eq_zero
statement:
theorem IsAlgebraic.exists_nonzero_coeff_and_aeval_eq_zero
    {s : S} (hRs : IsAlgebraic R s) (hs : s ∈ S⁰) :
    ∃ q : R[X], q.coeff 0 ≠ 0 ∧ aeval s q = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp0, hp⟩ := hRs
  obtain ⟨q, hpq, hq⟩ := exists_eq_pow_rootMultiplicity_mul_and_not_dvd p hp0 0
  simp only [C_0, sub_zero, X_pow_mul, X_dvd_iff] at hpq hq
  rw [hpq, map_mul, aeval_X_pow] at hp
  exact ⟨q, hq, (S⁰.pow_mem hs (rootMultiplicity 0 p)).2 (aeval s q) hp⟩

name: IsAlgebraic.exists_nonzero_eq_adjoin_mul
statement:
theorem IsAlgebraic.exists_nonzero_eq_adjoin_mul {s : S} (hRs : IsAlgebraic R s) (hs : s ∈ S⁰) :
    ∃ᵉ (t ∈ R[s]) (r ≠ (0 : R)), s * t = algebraMap R S r
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨q, hq0, hq⟩ := hRs.exists_nonzero_coeff_and_aeval_eq_zero hs
  have ⟨p, hp⟩ := X_dvd_sub_C (p := q)
  refine ⟨aeval s p, aeval_mem_adjoin_singleton _ _, _, neg_ne_zero.mpr hq0, ?_⟩
  apply_fun aeval s at hp
  rwa [map_sub, hq, zero_sub, map_mul, aeval_X, aeval_C, ← map_neg, eq_comm] at hp

name: IsAlgebraic.exists_nonzero_dvd
statement:
theorem IsAlgebraic.exists_nonzero_dvd {s : S} (hRs : IsAlgebraic R s) (hs : s ∈ S⁰) :
    ∃ r : R, r ≠ 0 ∧ s ∣ algebraMap R S r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq0, hq⟩ := hRs.exists_nonzero_coeff_and_aeval_eq_zero hs
  have key := map_dvd (aeval s) (X_dvd_sub_C (p := q))
  rw [map_sub, hq, zero_sub, dvd_neg, aeval_X, aeval_C] at key
  exact ⟨q.coeff 0, hq0, key⟩

name: IsAlgebraic.exists_smul_eq_mul
statement:
theorem IsAlgebraic.exists_smul_eq_mul
    (a : S) {b : S} (hRb : IsAlgebraic R b) (hb : b ∈ S⁰) :
    ∃ᵉ (c : S) (d ≠ (0 : R)), d • a = b * c
proof:
:=
  have ⟨r, hr, s, h⟩ := hRb.exists_nonzero_dvd hb
  ⟨s * a, r, hr, by rw [smul_def, h, mul_assoc]⟩

name: Algebra.IsAlgebraic.exists_smul_eq_mul
statement:
theorem Algebra.IsAlgebraic.exists_smul_eq_mul [NoZeroDivisors S] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic R S]
    (a : S) {b : S} (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    ∃ᵉ (c : S) (d ≠ (0 : R)), d • a = b * c
proof:
:=
  (isAlgebraic b).exists_smul_eq_mul a (mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero hb)

name: injective_tower_top
statement: theorem injective_tower_top (inj : Injective (algebraMap R A)) : Injective (algebraMap S A)
proof:
:= by
  refine (injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).mpr fun s eq ↦ of_not_not fun ne ↦ ?_
  have ⟨r, ne, dvd⟩ := (alg.1 s).exists_nonzero_dvd (mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero ne)
  refine ne (inj <| map_zero (algebraMap R A) ▸ zero_dvd_iff.mp ?_)
  simp_rw [← eq, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R S A, map_dvd (algebraMap S A) dvd]

  exact injective_tower_top S ‹_›

name: inv_eq_of_aeval_divX_ne_zero
statement:
theorem inv_eq_of_aeval_divX_ne_zero {x : L} {p : K[X]} (aeval_ne : aeval x (divX p) ≠ 0) :
    x⁻¹ = aeval x (divX p) / (aeval x p - algebraMap _ _ (p.coeff 0))
proof:
:= by
  rw [inv_eq_iff_eq_inv, inv_div, eq_comm, div_eq_iff, sub_eq_iff_eq_add, mul_comm]
  conv_lhs => rw [← divX_mul_X_add p]
  · rw [map_add, map_mul, aeval_X, aeval_C]
  · exact aeval_ne

name: inv_eq_of_root_of_coeff_zero_ne_zero
statement:
theorem inv_eq_of_root_of_coeff_zero_ne_zero {x : L} {p : K[X]} (aeval_eq : aeval x p = 0)
    (coeff_zero_ne : p.coeff 0 ≠ 0) : x⁻¹ = -(aeval x (divX p) / algebraMap _ _ (p.coeff 0))
proof:
:= by
  convert!
    inv_eq_of_aeval_divX_ne_zero (p := p) (L := L)
      (mt (fun h => (algebraMap K L).injective ?_) coeff_zero_ne) using 1
  · rw [aeval_eq, zero_sub, div_neg]
  rw [RingHom.map_zero]
  convert! aeval_eq
  conv_rhs => rw [← divX_mul_X_add p]
  rw [map_add, map_mul, h, zero_mul, zero_add, aeval_C]

name: Subalgebra.inv_mem_of_root_of_coeff_zero_ne_zero
statement:
theorem Subalgebra.inv_mem_of_root_of_coeff_zero_ne_zero {x : A} {p : K[X]}
    (aeval_eq : aeval x p = 0) (coeff_zero_ne : p.coeff 0 ≠ 0) : (x⁻¹ : L) ∈ A
proof:
:= by
  suffices (x⁻¹ : L) = (-p.coeff 0)⁻¹ • aeval x (divX p) by
    rw [this]
    exact A.smul_mem (aeval x _).2 _
  have : aeval (x : L) p = 0 := by rw [Subalgebra.aeval_coe, aeval_eq, Subalgebra.coe_zero]
  rw [inv_eq_of_root_of_coeff_zero_ne_zero this coeff_zero_ne, div_eq_inv_mul, Algebra.smul_def,
    aeval_coe, map_inv₀, map_neg, inv_neg, neg_mul]

name: Subalgebra.inv_mem_of_algebraic
statement:
theorem Subalgebra.inv_mem_of_algebraic {x : A} (hx : IsAlgebraic K (x : L)) :
    (x⁻¹ : L) ∈ A
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, ne_zero, aeval_eq⟩ := hx
  rw [Subalgebra.aeval_coe, Subalgebra.coe_eq_zero] at aeval_eq
  revert ne_zero aeval_eq
  refine p.recOnHorner ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro h
    contradiction
  · intro p a hp ha _ih _ne_zero aeval_eq
    refine A.inv_mem_of_root_of_coeff_zero_ne_zero aeval_eq ?_
    rwa [coeff_add, hp, zero_add, coeff_C, ite_eq_left rfl]
  · intro p hp ih _ne_zero aeval_eq
    rw [map_mul, aeval_X, mul_eq_zero] at aeval_eq
    rcases aeval_eq with aeval_eq | x_eq
    · exact ih hp aeval_eq
    · rw [x_eq, Subalgebra.coe_zero, inv_zero]
      exact A.zero_mem

name: Subalgebra.isField_of_algebraic
statement:
@[stacks 0BID]
theorem Subalgebra.isField_of_algebraic [Algebra.IsAlgebraic K L] : IsField A
proof:
:=
  { show Nontrivial A by infer_instance, Subalgebra.toCommRing A with
    mul_inv_cancel := fun {a} ha =>
      ⟨⟨a⁻¹, A.inv_mem_of_algebraic (Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic (a : L))⟩,
        Subtype.ext (mul_inv_cancel₀ (mt (Subalgebra.coe_eq_zero _).mp ha))⟩ }

name: lift_cardinalMk_le_sigma_polynomial
statement:
theorem lift_cardinalMk_le_sigma_polynomial :
    lift.{u} #L ≤ #(Σ p : R[X], { x : L // x ∈ p.aroots L })
proof:
:= by
  have := @lift_mk_le_lift_mk_of_injective L (Σ p : R[X], {x : L | x ∈ p.aroots L})
    (fun x : L =>
      let p := Classical.indefiniteDescription _ (Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic x)
      ⟨p.1, x, by
        dsimp
        have := (Polynomial.map_ne_zero_iff (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective R L)).2 p.2.1
        rw [Polynomial.mem_roots this, Polynomial.IsRoot, Polynomial.eval_map,
          ← Polynomial.aeval_def, p.2.2]⟩)
    fun x y => by
      intro h
      simp only [Set.coe_ofPred, ne_eq, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Sigma.mk.inj_iff] at h
      refine (Subtype.heq_iff_coe_eq ?_).1 h.2
      simp only [h.1, forall_true_iff]
  rwa [lift_umax, lift_id'.{v}] at this

name: lift_cardinalMk_le_max
statement: theorem lift_cardinalMk_le_max : lift.{u} #L ≤ lift.{v} #R ⊔ ℵ₀
proof:
:=
  calc
    lift.{u} #L ≤ #(Σ p : R[X], { x : L // x ∈ p.aroots L }) :=
      lift_cardinalMk_le_sigma_polynomial R L
    _ = Cardinal.sum fun p : R[X] => #{x : L | x ∈ p.aroots L} := by
      rw [← mk_sigma]; rfl
    _ ≤ Cardinal.sum.{u, v} fun _ : R[X] => ℵ₀ :=
      (sum_le_sum _ _ fun _ => (Multiset.finite_toSet _).lt_aleph0.le)
    _ = lift.{v} #(R[X]) * ℵ₀ := by rw [sum_const, lift_aleph0]
    _ ≤ lift.{v} (#R ⊔ ℵ₀) ⊔ ℵ₀ ⊔ ℵ₀ := (mul_le_max _ _).trans <| by
      gcongr; simp only [lift_le, Polynomial.cardinalMk_le_max]
    _ = _ := by simp

name: cardinalMk_le_sigma_polynomial
statement:
theorem cardinalMk_le_sigma_polynomial :
    #L ≤ #(Σ p : R[X], { x : L // x ∈ p.aroots L })
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [lift_id] using lift_cardinalMk_le_sigma_polynomial R L

name: cardinalMk_le_max
statement:
@[stacks 09GK]
theorem cardinalMk_le_max : #L ≤ max #R ℵ₀
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [lift_id] using lift_cardinalMk_le_max R L

name: transcendental_iff
statement:
theorem transcendental_iff {x : A} :
    Transcendental R x ↔ ∀ p : R[X], aeval x p = 0 → p = 0

name: Subalgebra.isAlgebraic_iff
statement:
theorem Subalgebra.isAlgebraic_iff (S : Subalgebra R A) :
    S.IsAlgebraic ↔ Algebra.IsAlgebraic R S
proof:
:= by
  delta Subalgebra.IsAlgebraic
  rw [Subtype.forall', Algebra.isAlgebraic_def]
  refine forall_congr' fun x => exists_congr fun p => and_congr Iff.rfl ?_
  have h : Function.Injective S.val := Subtype.val_injective
  conv_rhs => rw [← h.eq_iff, map_zero]
  rw [← aeval_algHom_apply, S.val_apply]

name: Algebra.isAlgebraic_iff

name: transcendental_supported_polynomial_aeval_X
statement:
theorem transcendental_supported_polynomial_aeval_X {i : σ} {s : Set σ} (h : i ∉ s)
    {f : R[X]} (hf : Transcendental R f) :
    Transcendental (supported R s) (Polynomial.aeval (X i : MvPolynomial σ R) f)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [transcendental_iff_injective] at hf ⊢
  let g := MvPolynomial.mapAlgHom (R := R) (σ := s) (Polynomial.aeval (R := R) f)
  replace hf : Function.Injective g := MvPolynomial.map_injective _ hf
  let u := (Subalgebra.val _).comp
    ((optionEquivRight R s).symm |>.trans
      (renameEquiv R (Set.subtypeInsertEquivOption h).symm) |>.trans
      (supportedEquivMvPolynomial _).symm).toAlgHom |>.comp
    g |>.comp
    ((optionEquivLeft R s).symm.trans (optionEquivRight R s)).toAlgHom
  let v := ((Polynomial.aeval (R := supported R s)
    (Polynomial.aeval (X i : MvPolynomial σ R) f)).restrictScalars R).comp
      (Polynomial.mapAlgEquiv (supportedEquivMvPolynomial s).symm).toAlgHom
  replace hf : Function.Injective u := by
    simp only [AlgHom.coe_comp, Subalgebra.coe_val,
      AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, AlgEquiv.coe_trans, Function.comp_assoc, u]
    apply Subtype.val_injective.comp
    simp only [EquivLike.comp_injective]
    apply hf.comp
    simp only [EquivLike.comp_injective, EquivLike.injective]
  have h1 : Polynomial.aeval (X i : MvPolynomial σ R) = ((Subalgebra.val _).comp
      (supportedEquivMvPolynomial _).symm.toAlgHom |>.comp
      (Polynomial.aeval (X ⟨i, s.mem_insert i⟩ : MvPolynomial ↑(insert i s) R))) := by
    ext1; simp
  have h2 : u = v := by
    simp only [u, v, g]
    ext1
    · ext1
      simp [Set.subtypeInsertEquivOption, Subalgebra.algebraMap_eq, optionEquivLeft_symm_apply]
    · simp [Set.subtypeInsertEquivOption, h1, optionEquivLeft_symm_apply]
  simpa only [h2, v, AlgHom.coe_comp, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom,
    EquivLike.injective_comp, AlgHom.coe_restrictScalars'] using hf

name: transcendental_polynomial_aeval_X
statement:
theorem transcendental_polynomial_aeval_X (i : σ) {f : R[X]} (hf : Transcendental R f) :
    Transcendental R (Polynomial.aeval (X i : MvPolynomial σ R) f)
proof:
:= by
  have := transcendental_supported_polynomial_aeval_X R (Set.notMem_empty i) hf
  let g := (Algebra.botEquivOfInjective (MvPolynomial.C_injective σ R)).symm.trans
    (Subalgebra.equivOfEq _ _ supported_empty).symm
  rwa [Transcendental, ← isAlgebraic_ringHom_iff_of_comp_eq g (RingHom.id (MvPolynomial σ R))
    Function.injective_id (by ext1; rfl), RingHom.id_apply, ← Transcendental]

name: transcendental_polynomial_aeval_X_iff
statement:
theorem transcendental_polynomial_aeval_X_iff (i : σ) {f : R[X]} :
    Transcendental R (Polynomial.aeval (X i : MvPolynomial σ R) f) ↔ Transcendental R f
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, transcendental_polynomial_aeval_X R i⟩
  simp_rw [Transcendental, not_imp_not]
  exact fun h ↦ h.algHom _

name: transcendental_supported_polynomial_aeval_X_iff
statement:
theorem transcendental_supported_polynomial_aeval_X_iff
    [Nontrivial R] {i : σ} {s : Set σ} {f : R[X]} :
    Transcendental (supported R s) (Polynomial.aeval (X i : MvPolynomial σ R) f) ↔
    i ∉ s ∧ Transcendental R f
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨?_, ?_⟩, fun ⟨h, hf⟩ ↦ transcendental_supported_polynomial_aeval_X R h hf⟩
  · rw [Transcendental] at h
    contrapose h
    refine isAlgebraic_algebraMap (⟨Polynomial.aeval (X i) f, ?_⟩ : supported R s)
    exact Algebra.adjoin_mono (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (Set.mem_image_of_mem _ h))
      (Polynomial.aeval_mem_adjoin_singleton _ _)
  · rw [← transcendental_polynomial_aeval_X_iff R i]
    refine h.restrictScalars fun _ _ heq ↦ MvPolynomial.C_injective σ R ?_
    simp_rw [← MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq]
    exact congr($(heq).1)

name: transcendental_supported_X
statement:

    Transcendental (supported R s) (X i : MvPolynomial σ R)
proof:

  simpa using transcendental_supported_polynomial_aeval_X R h (Polynomial.transcendental_X R)

name: transcendental_X
statement: theorem transcendental_X (i : σ) : Transcendental R (X i : MvPolynomial σ R)

  simpa using transcendental_polynomial_aeval_X R i (Polynomial.transcendental_X R)

name: transcendental_supported_X_iff
statement:
theorem transcendental_supported_X_iff [Nontrivial R] {i : σ} {s : Set σ} :
    Transcendental (supported R s) (X i : MvPolynomial σ R) ↔ i ∉ s
proof:

  simpa [Polynomial.transcendental_X] using
    transcendental_supported_polynomial_aeval_X_iff R (i := i) (s := s) (f := Polynomial.X)

name: Transcendental.linearIndependent_sub_inv
statement:
theorem Transcendental.linearIndependent_sub_inv
    {F E : Type*} [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E] {x : E} (H : Transcendental F x) :
    LinearIndependent F fun a ↦ (x - algebraMap F E a)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [transcendental_iff] at H
  refine linearIndependent_iff'.2 fun s m hm i hi ↦ ?_
  have hnz (a : F) : x - algebraMap F E a ≠ 0 := fun h ↦
    X_sub_C_ne_zero a <| H (.X - .C a) (by simp [h])
  let b := s.prod fun j ↦ x - algebraMap F E j
  have h1 : ∀ i ∈ s, m i • (b * (x - algebraMap F E i)⁻¹) =
      m i • (s.erase i).prod fun j ↦ x - algebraMap F E j := fun i hi ↦ by
    simp_rw [b, ← s.prod_erase_mul _ hi, mul_inv_cancel_right₀ (hnz i)]
  replace hm := congr(b * $(hm))
  simp_rw [mul_zero, Finset.mul_sum, mul_smul_comm, Finset.sum_congr rfl h1] at hm
  let p : Polynomial F := s.sum fun i ↦ .C (m i) * (s.erase i).prod fun j ↦ .X - .C j
  replace hm := congr(Polynomial.aeval i $(H p (by simp_rw [← hm, p, map_sum, map_mul, map_prod,
    map_sub, aeval_X, aeval_C, Algebra.smul_def])))
  have h2 : ∀ j ∈ s.erase i, m j * ((s.erase j).prod fun x ↦ i - x) = 0 := fun j hj ↦ by
    have := Finset.mem_erase_of_ne_of_mem (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hj).symm hi
    simp_rw [← (s.erase j).prod_erase_mul _ this, sub_self, mul_zero]
  simp_rw [map_zero, p, map_sum, map_mul, map_prod, map_sub, aeval_X,
    aeval_C, Algebra.algebraMap_self_apply, ← s.sum_erase_add _ hi,
    Finset.sum_eq_zero h2, zero_add] at hm
  exact eq_zero_of_ne_zero_of_mul_right_eq_zero (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.2 fun j hj ↦
    sub_ne_zero.2 (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hj).symm) hm

name: linearIndepOn_isGroupLikeElem
statement: lemma linearIndepOn_isGroupLikeElem : LinearIndepOn R id {a : A | IsGroupLikeElem R a}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  rw [linearIndepOn_iff_linearIndepOn_finset]
  rintro s hs
  
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction with
  
  | empty => simp
  
  | cons a s has ih =>
  simp only [Finset.cons_eq_insert, Finset.coe_insert, Set.subset_def, Set.mem_insert_iff,
    Finset.mem_coe, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, forall_eq_or_imp] at hs
  obtain ⟨ha, hs⟩ := hs
  specialize ih hs
  
  
  rw [Finset.coe_cons]
  refine ih.id_insert' ?_
  simp only [mem_span_finset, forall_exists_index, and_imp]
  rintro d c - hc
  
  
  replace ih := ih.tmul_of_isDomain ih
  simp_rw [← Finset.coe_product, linearIndepOn_finset_iffₛ, id] at ih
  
  
  have key := calc
        ∑ x ∈ s, ∑ y ∈ s, (if x = y then d * c x else 0) • x ⊗ₜ[R] y
    _ = d • ∑ x ∈ s, c x • x ⊗ₜ[R] x := by simp [Finset.smul_sum, mul_smul]
    _ = d • comul (d • a) := by rw [← hc]; simp +contextual [(hs _ _).comul_eq_tmul_self]
    _ = (d • a) ⊗ₜ (d • a) := by simp [ha.comul_eq_tmul_self, smul_tmul, tmul_smul, -neg_smul]
    _ = ∑ x ∈ s, ∑ y ∈ s, (c x * c y) • x ⊗ₜ[R] y := by
      simp_rw [← hc, sum_tmul, smul_tmul, Finset.smul_sum, tmul_sum, tmul_smul, mul_smul]
  simp_rw [← Finset.sum_product'] at key
  apply ih at key
  
  replace key x (hx : x ∈ s) : c x = 0 := by
    
    by_contra! hcx
    have hcy (y) (hys : y ∈ s) (hyx : y ≠ x) : c y = 0 := by
      simpa [*] using (key (y, x) (by simp [*])).symm
    
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single x (by simp +contextual [hcy]) (by simp [hx])] at hc
    
    have hcxa : d = c x := mul_left_injective₀ hcx (by simpa using (key (x, x) (by simp [*])))
    
    obtain rfl : x = a := by rwa [hcxa, smul_right_inj hcx] at hc
    
    contradiction
  
  simp_all [ha.ne_zero, eq_comm]

name: coassoc
statement:
private lemma coassoc :
    TensorProduct.assoc S (A ⊗[R] B) (A ⊗[R] B) (A ⊗[R] B) ∘ₗ
      (comul (R := S) (A := (A ⊗[R] B))).rTensor (A ⊗[R] B) ∘ₗ
        (comul (R := S) (A := (A ⊗[R] B))) =
    (comul (R := S) (A := (A ⊗[R] B))).lTensor (A ⊗[R] B) ∘ₗ
      (comul (R := S) (A := (A ⊗[R] B)))
proof:
:= by
  ext x y
  let F : A ⊗[S] (A ⊗[S] A) ⊗[R] (B ⊗[R] (B ⊗[R] B)) ≃ₗ[S]
    A ⊗[R] B ⊗[S] (A ⊗[R] B ⊗[S] (A ⊗[R] B)) :=
    AlgebraTensorModule.tensorTensorTensorComm _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ ≪≫ₗ
      AlgebraTensorModule.congr (.refl _ _)
        (AlgebraTensorModule.tensorTensorTensorComm _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _)
  let F' : A ⊗[S] (A ⊗[S] A) ⊗[R] (B ⊗[R] (B ⊗[R] B)) →ₗ[S]
      A ⊗[R] B ⊗[S] (A ⊗[R] B ⊗[S] (A ⊗[R] B)) :=
    TensorProduct.mapOfCompatibleSMul .. ∘ₗ
        TensorProduct.map .id (TensorProduct.mapOfCompatibleSMul ..) ∘ₗ F.toLinearMap
  convert! congr(F ($(Coalgebra.coassoc_apply x) ⊗ₜ[R] $(Coalgebra.coassoc_apply y))) using 1
  · dsimp
    hopf_tensor_induction comul (R := S) x with x₁ x₂
    hopf_tensor_induction comul (R := R) y with y₁ y₂
    dsimp
    hopf_tensor_induction comul (R := S) x₁ with x₁₁ x₁₂
    hopf_tensor_induction comul (R := R) y₁ with y₁₁ y₁₂
    rfl
  · dsimp
    hopf_tensor_induction comul (R := S) x with x₁ x₂
    hopf_tensor_induction comul (R := R) y with y₁ y₂
    dsimp
    hopf_tensor_induction comul (R := S) x₂ with x₂₁ x₂₂
    hopf_tensor_induction comul (R := R) y₂ with y₂₁ y₂₂
    rfl

name: sum_tmul_tmul_eq

lemma sum_tmul_tmul_eq (repr : Repr R a ι)
    (a₁ : (i : ι) → Repr R (repr.left i) (κ i)) (a₂ : (i : ι) → Repr R (repr.right i) (Λ i)) :
    ∑ i ∈ repr.index, ∑ j ∈ (a₁ i).index,
      (a₁ i).left j ⊗ₜ[R] ((a₁ i).right j ⊗ₜ[R] repr.right i)
      = ∑ i ∈ repr.index, ∑ j ∈ (a₂ i).index,
      repr.left i ⊗ₜ[R] ((a₂ i).left j ⊗ₜ[R] (a₂ i).right j)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [(a₂ _).eq, ← (a₁ _).eq, ← TensorProduct.tmul_sum,
    TensorProduct.sum_tmul, ← repr.eq] using congr($(coassoc (R := R)) a)

name: sum_counit_tmul_map_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sum_counit_tmul_map_eq {B : Type*} [AddCommMonoid B] [Module R B]
    {F : Type*} [FunLike F A B] [LinearMapClass F R A B] (f : F) (a : A) {repr : Repr R a ι} :
    ∑ i ∈ repr.index, counit (R := R) (repr.left i) ⊗ₜ f (repr.right i) = 1 ⊗ₜ[R] f a
proof:
:= by
  have := sum_counit_tmul_eq repr
  apply_fun LinearMap.lTensor R (f : A →ₗ[R] B) at this
  simp_all only [map_sum, LinearMap.lTensor_tmul, LinearMap.coe_ofClass]

name: sum_map_tmul_counit_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sum_map_tmul_counit_eq {B : Type*} [AddCommMonoid B] [Module R B]
    {F : Type*} [FunLike F A B] [LinearMapClass F R A B] (f : F) (a : A) {repr : Repr R a ι} :
    ∑ i ∈ repr.index, f (repr.left i) ⊗ₜ counit (R := R) (repr.right i) = f a ⊗ₜ[R] 1
proof:
:= by
  have := sum_tmul_counit_eq repr
  apply_fun LinearMap.rTensor R (f : A →ₗ[R] B) at this
  simp_all only [map_sum, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, LinearMap.coe_ofClass]

name: sum_map_tmul_tmul_eq
statement:
theorem sum_map_tmul_tmul_eq {B : Type*} [AddCommMonoid B] [Module R B]
    {F : Type*} [FunLike F A B] [LinearMapClass F R A B] (f g h : F) (a : A) {repr : Repr R a ι}
    {a₁ : (i : ι) → Repr R (repr.left i) (κ i)} {a₂ : (i : ι) → Repr R (repr.right i) (Λ i)} :
    ∑ i ∈ repr.index, ∑ j ∈ (a₂ i).index,
      f (repr.left i) ⊗ₜ (g ((a₂ i).left j) ⊗ₜ h ((a₂ i).right j)) =
    ∑ i ∈ repr.index, ∑ j ∈ (a₁ i).index,
      f ((a₁ i).left j) ⊗ₜ[R] (g ((a₁ i).right j) ⊗ₜ[R] h (repr.right i))
proof:
:= by
  have := sum_tmul_tmul_eq repr a₁ a₂
  apply_fun TensorProduct.map (f : A →ₗ[R] B)
    (TensorProduct.map (g : A →ₗ[R] B) (h : A →ₗ[R] B)) at this
  simp_all only [map_sum, TensorProduct.map_tmul, LinearMap.coe_ofClass]

  counit_eq_zero
proof:
:= by simp [ha.counit_eq_zero, hb.counit_eq_zero]
  comul_eq_tmul_add_tmul := by
    simp [ha.comul_eq_tmul_add_tmul, hb.comul_eq_tmul_add_tmul, add_tmul, tmul_add,
      add_add_add_comm]

name: map

lemma map [FunLike F A B] [CoalgHomClass F R A B] (f : F) (ha : IsSkewPrimitiveElem R g h a) :

  counit_eq_zero
proof:
:= by simp [ha.counit_eq_zero]
  comul_eq_tmul_add_tmul := by
    simp [ha.comul_eq_tmul_add_tmul, ← CoalgHomClass.map_comp_comul_apply]

name: isSkewPrimitiveElem_map_equiv
statement:
@[simp] lemma isSkewPrimitiveElem_map_equiv [EquivLike F A B] [CoalgEquivClass F R A B] (f : F) :
    IsSkewPrimitiveElem R (f g) (f h) (f a) ↔ IsSkewPrimitiveElem R g h a where
  mp ha
proof:
:=
    let e := CoalgEquivClass.toCoalgEquiv f
    e.symm_apply_apply g ▸ e.symm_apply_apply h ▸ e.symm_apply_apply a ▸ ha.map _
  mpr := .map f

name: counit_eq_zero_of_comul_eq_tmul_add_tmul
statement:
lemma counit_eq_zero_of_comul_eq_tmul_add_tmul (hg : counit (R := R) g = 1)
    (hh : counit (R := R) h = 1) (ha : comul a = g ⊗ₜ[R] a + a ⊗ₜ[R] h) :
    counit (R := R) a = 0
proof:
:= by
  have : counit (R := R) a • h = 0 := by
    simpa [ha, hg] using congr(TensorProduct.lid R A $(rTensor_counit_comul (R := R) a))
  simpa [hh] using congr(counit (R := R) $this)

name: IsSkewPrimitiveElem.of_comul_eq_tmul_add_tmul
statement:
lemma IsSkewPrimitiveElem.of_comul_eq_tmul_add_tmul (hg : counit (R := R) g = 1)
    (hh : counit (R := R) h = 1) (ha : comul a = g ⊗ₜ[R] a + a ⊗ₜ[R] h) :
    IsSkewPrimitiveElem R g h a
proof:
:=
  ⟨counit_eq_zero_of_comul_eq_tmul_add_tmul hg hh ha, ha⟩

name: isSkewPrimitiveElem_iff_comul_eq_tmul_add_tmul
statement:

    (hh : counit (R := R) h = 1) :
    IsSkewPrimitiveElem R g h a ↔ comul a = g ⊗ₜ[R] a + a ⊗ₜ[R] h
proof:
:=
  ⟨IsSkewPrimitiveElem.comul_eq_tmul_add_tmul, .of_comul_eq_tmul_add_tmul hg hh⟩

  comul_eq_tmul_add_tmul := by

name: isSimpleModule_iff_finrank_eq_one

theorem isSimpleModule_iff_finrank_eq_one {R M} [DivisionRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] :
    IsSimpleModule R M ↔ Module.finrank R M = 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ have := h.nontrivial; have ⟨v, hv⟩ := exists_ne (0 : M)
    (finrank_eq_one_iff_of_nonzero' v hv).mpr (IsSimpleModule.toSpanSingleton_surjective R hv),
  (isSimpleModule_iff ..).mpr ∘ is_simple_module_of_finrank_eq_one⟩

name: IsSimpleRing.exists_algEquiv_matrix_of_isAlgClosed
statement:
theorem IsSimpleRing.exists_algEquiv_matrix_of_isAlgClosed
    [IsSimpleRing R] [FiniteDimensional F R] :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (_ : NeZero n), Nonempty (R ≃ₐ[F] Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) F)
proof:
:=
  have := IsArtinianRing.of_finite F R
  have ⟨n, hn, D, _, _, _, ⟨e⟩⟩ := exists_algEquiv_matrix_divisionRing_finite F R
  ⟨n, hn, ⟨e.trans <| .mapMatrix <| .symm <| .ofBijective (Algebra.ofId F D)
    IsAlgClosed.algebraMap_bijective_of_isIntegral⟩⟩

name: IsSemisimpleRing.exists_algEquiv_pi_matrix_of_isAlgClosed
statement:
theorem IsSemisimpleRing.exists_algEquiv_pi_matrix_of_isAlgClosed
    [IsSemisimpleRing R] [FiniteDimensional F R] :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (d : Fin n → ℕ), (∀ i, NeZero (d i)) ∧
      Nonempty (R ≃ₐ[F] Π i, Matrix (Fin (d i)) (Fin (d i)) F)
proof:
:=
  have ⟨n, D, d, _, _, _, hd, ⟨e⟩⟩ := exists_algEquiv_pi_matrix_divisionRing_finite F R
  ⟨n, d, hd, ⟨e.trans <| .piCongrRight fun i ↦ .mapMatrix <| .symm <| .ofBijective
    (Algebra.ofId F (D i)) IsAlgClosed.algebraMap_bijective_of_isIntegral⟩⟩

proof:
:= by
  set f : Submodule R B ≃o Set.Iic B := B.mapIic with hf
  rw [covBy_iff_coatom_Iic hAB, isSimpleModule_iff_isCoatom, ← OrderIso.isCoatom_iff f, hf]
  simp [-OrderIso.isCoatom_iff, Submodule.map_comap_subtype, inf_eq_right.2 hAB]
