:= by
  rw [← range_eq_top, ← span_singleton_eq_range, span_singleton_eq_top R hm]

name: ker_toSpanSingleton_isMaximal
statement:
theorem ker_toSpanSingleton_isMaximal {m : M} (hm : m ≠ 0) :
    Ideal.IsMaximal (ker (toSpanSingleton R M m))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.isMaximal_def, ← isSimpleModule_iff_isCoatom]
  exact congr (quotKerEquivOfSurjective _ <| toSpanSingleton_surjective R hm)

name: isSimpleModule_iff_quot_maximal
statement:
theorem isSimpleModule_iff_quot_maximal :
    IsSimpleModule R M ↔ ∃ I : Ideal R, I.IsMaximal ∧ Nonempty (M ≃ₗ[R] R ⧸ I)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun ⟨I, ⟨coatom⟩, ⟨equiv⟩⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  · have := IsSimpleModule.nontrivial R M
    have ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_ne (0 : M)
    exact ⟨_, ker_toSpanSingleton_isMaximal R hm,
      ⟨(LinearMap.quotKerEquivOfSurjective _ <| toSpanSingleton_surjective R hm).symm⟩⟩
  · convert! congr equiv; rwa [isSimpleModule_iff_isCoatom]

name: IsSimpleModule.annihilator_isMaximal
statement:
theorem IsSimpleModule.annihilator_isMaximal {R} [CommRing R] [Module R M]
    [simple : IsSimpleModule R M] : (Module.annihilator R M).IsMaximal
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨I, max, ⟨e⟩⟩ := isSimpleModule_iff_quot_maximal.mp simple
  rwa [e.annihilator_eq, I.annihilator_quotient]

name: isSimpleModule_iff_toSpanSingleton_surjective
statement:
theorem isSimpleModule_iff_toSpanSingleton_surjective : IsSimpleModule R M ↔
    Nontrivial M ∧ ∀ x : M, x ≠ 0 → Function.Surjective (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton R M x) where
  mp h
proof:
:= ⟨h.nontrivial, fun _ ↦ h.toSpanSingleton_surjective⟩
  mpr := fun ⟨_, h⟩ ↦ (isSimpleModule_iff R M).mpr
    ⟨fun m ↦ or_iff_not_imp_left.mpr fun ne_bot ↦
      have ⟨x, hxm, hx0⟩ := m.ne_bot_iff.mp ne_bot
      top_unique <| fun z _ ↦ by obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := h x hx0 z; exact m.smul_mem _ hxm⟩

name: isSimpleModule_self_iff_isUnit
statement:
theorem isSimpleModule_self_iff_isUnit :
    IsSimpleModule R R ↔ Nontrivial R ∧ ∀ x : R, x ≠ 0 → IsUnit x
proof:
:=
  isSimpleModule_iff_toSpanSingleton_surjective.trans <| and_congr_right fun _ ↦ by
    refine ⟨fun h x hx ↦ ?_, fun h x hx ↦ (h x hx).unit.mulRight_bijective.surjective⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hyx : y * x = 1⟩ := h x hx 1
    have hy : y ≠ 0 := left_ne_zero_of_mul (hyx.symm ▸ one_ne_zero)
    obtain ⟨z, hzy : z * y = 1⟩ := h y hy 1
    exact ⟨⟨x, y, left_inv_eq_right_inv hzy hyx ▸ hzy, hyx⟩, rfl⟩

name: IsSemisimpleModule.of_sSup_simples_eq_top
statement:
theorem IsSemisimpleModule.of_sSup_simples_eq_top
    (h : sSup { m : Submodule R M | IsSimpleModule R m } = ⊤) : IsSemisimpleModule R M where
  __
proof: := complementedLattice_of_sSup_atoms_eq_top (by simp_rw [← h, isSimpleModule_iff_isAtom])

name: of_isComplemented_domain
statement: theorem of_isComplemented_domain (h : IsComplemented m) : Module.Finite R₀ (m →ₗ[R] P)
proof:
:=
  .of_surjective (.lcomp R₀ P ..) (LinearMap.surjective_comp_subtype_of_isComplemented h)

name: of_isComplemented_codomain
statement: theorem of_isComplemented_codomain (h : IsComplemented m) : Module.Finite R₀ (P →ₗ[R] m)
proof:
:=
  .of_surjective (.compRight ..) (LinearMap.surjective_comp_projectionOnto h.choose_spec)

name: eq_bot_or_exists_simple_le
statement:
theorem eq_bot_or_exists_simple_le (N : Submodule R M) [IsSemisimpleModule R N] :
    N = ⊥ ∨ ∃ m ≤ N, IsSimpleModule R m
proof:
:= by
  rw [← N.subsingleton_iff_eq_bot, ← Submodule.subsingleton_iff R, ← subsingleton_iff_bot_eq_top]
  refine (eq_bot_or_exists_atom_le _).imp .symm fun ⟨m, h, _⟩ ↦ ⟨_, N.map_subtype_le m, ?_⟩
  rw [← isSimpleModule_iff_isAtom] at h
  exact .congr (m.equivMapOfInjective _ N.subtype_injective).symm

name: exists_submodule_linearEquiv_quotient
statement:
theorem exists_submodule_linearEquiv_quotient (N : Submodule R M) :
    ∃ (P : Submodule R M), Nonempty (P ≃ₗ[R] M ⧸ N)
proof:
:=
  have ⟨P, compl⟩ := exists_isCompl N; ⟨P, ⟨(N.quotientEquivOfIsCompl P compl).symm⟩⟩

name: exists_quotient_linearEquiv_submodule
statement:
theorem exists_quotient_linearEquiv_submodule (N : Submodule R M) :
    ∃ (P : Submodule R M), Nonempty (N ≃ₗ[R] M ⧸ P)
proof:
:=
  have ⟨P, compl⟩ := exists_isCompl N; ⟨P, ⟨(P.quotientEquivOfIsCompl N compl.symm).symm⟩⟩

name: extension_property
statement:
theorem extension_property {P} [AddCommGroup P] [Module R P] (f : N →ₗ[R] M)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (g : N →ₗ[R] P) :
    ∃ h : M →ₗ[R] P, h ∘ₗ f = g
proof:
:=
  have ⟨m, compl⟩ := exists_isCompl (LinearMap.range f)
  ⟨g ∘ₗ f.linearProjOfIsCompl _ hf compl, by ext; simp⟩

name: lifting_property
statement:
theorem lifting_property {P} [AddCommGroup P] [Module R P] (f : M →ₗ[R] N)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) (g : P →ₗ[R] N) :
    ∃ h : P →ₗ[R] M, f ∘ₗ h = g
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨m, compl⟩ := exists_isCompl (LinearMap.ker f)
  let e := (Submodule.quotientEquivOfIsCompl _ m compl).symm ≪≫ₗ f.quotKerEquivOfSurjective hf
  refine ⟨Submodule.subtype _ ∘ₗ e.symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ g, LinearMap.ext fun x ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨z, eq⟩ := e.surjective (g x)
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, ← eq, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, e.symm_apply_apply]
  simp [e]

name: sSup_simples_le
statement:
theorem sSup_simples_le (N : Submodule R M) :
    sSup { m : Submodule R M | IsSimpleModule R m ∧ m ≤ N } = N
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [isSimpleModule_iff_isAtom] using sSup_atoms_le_eq _

name: exists_simple_submodule
statement: theorem exists_simple_submodule [Nontrivial M] : ∃ m : Submodule R M, IsSimpleModule R m
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [isSimpleModule_iff_isAtom] using IsAtomic.exists_atom _

name: sSup_simples_eq_top
statement: theorem sSup_simples_eq_top : sSup { m : Submodule R M | IsSimpleModule R m } = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [isSimpleModule_iff_isAtom] using sSup_atoms_eq_top

name: exists_sSupIndep_sSup_simples_eq_top
statement:
theorem exists_sSupIndep_sSup_simples_eq_top :
    ∃ s : Set (Submodule R M), sSupIndep s ∧ sSup s = ⊤ ∧ ∀ m ∈ s, IsSimpleModule R m
proof:
:= by
  have := sSup_simples_eq_top R M
  simp_rw [isSimpleModule_iff_isAtom] at this ⊢
  exact exists_sSupIndep_of_sSup_atoms_eq_top this

name: annihilator_isRadical
statement:
theorem annihilator_isRadical (R) [CommRing R] [Module R M] [IsSemisimpleModule R M] :
    (Module.annihilator R M).IsRadical
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Submodule.annihilator_top, ← sSup_simples_eq_top, sSup_eq_iSup', Submodule.annihilator_iSup]
  exact Ideal.isRadical_iInf _ fun i ↦ (i.2.annihilator_isMaximal).isPrime.isRadical

name: congr
statement:
theorem congr (e : N ≃ₗ[R] M) : IsSemisimpleModule R N where
  __
proof: := (Submodule.orderIsoMapComap e.symm).complementedLattice

name: of_injective
statement: theorem of_injective (f : N →ₗ[R] M) (hf : Function.Injective f) : IsSemisimpleModule R N
proof:
:=
  congr (Submodule.topEquiv.symm.trans <| Submodule.equivMapOfInjective f hf _)

name: range
statement: protected theorem range (f : M →ₗ[R] N) : IsSemisimpleModule R (range f)
proof:
:=
  congr (quotKerEquivRange _).symm

name: of_surjective
statement: theorem of_surjective (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (hf : Function.Surjective f) : IsSemisimpleModule R N
proof:
:=
  congr (f.quotKerEquivOfSurjective hf).symm

name: _root_.LinearMap.isSemisimpleModule_iff_of_bijective
statement:
theorem _root_.LinearMap.isSemisimpleModule_iff_of_bijective
    [RingHomSurjective σ] (hl : Function.Bijective l) :
    IsSemisimpleModule R M' ↔ IsSemisimpleModule S N'
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [isSemisimpleModule_iff,
    (Submodule.orderIsoMapComapOfBijective l hl).complementedLattice_iff]

name: LinearEquiv.isSemisimpleModule_iff
statement:
theorem LinearEquiv.isSemisimpleModule_iff (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) :
    IsSemisimpleModule R M ↔ IsSemisimpleModule R N
proof:
:=
  ⟨(·.congr e.symm), (·.congr e)⟩

name: sSup_simples_eq_top_iff_isSemisimpleModule
statement:
theorem sSup_simples_eq_top_iff_isSemisimpleModule :
    sSup { m : Submodule R M | IsSimpleModule R m } = ⊤ ↔ IsSemisimpleModule R M
proof:
:=
  ⟨.of_sSup_simples_eq_top, fun _ ↦ IsSemisimpleModule.sSup_simples_eq_top _ _⟩

name: isSemisimpleModule_of_isSemisimpleModule_submodule
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [isSemisimpleModule_iff] at hp ⊢
  refine complementedLattice_of_complementedLattice_Iic (fun i hi ↦ ?_) hp'
  simpa only [← (p i).mapIic.complementedLattice_iff] using hp i hi

name: isSemisimpleModule_biSup_of_isSemisimpleModule_submodule
proof:
:= by
  refine isSemisimpleModule_of_isSemisimpleModule_submodule
    ((comap_equiv_self_of_inj_of_le (injective_subtype _) ?_).isSemisimpleModule_iff.mpr <| hp · ·)
    (biSup_comap_subtype_eq_top ..)
  simp_rw [range_subtype, le_biSup p ‹_›]

name: isSemisimpleModule_of_isSemisimpleModule_submodule'
proof:
:=
  isSemisimpleModule_of_isSemisimpleModule_submodule (s := Set.univ) (fun i _ ↦ hp i) (by simpa)

name: IsSemisimpleModule.exists_linearEquiv_dfinsupp
statement:
theorem IsSemisimpleModule.exists_linearEquiv_dfinsupp [IsSemisimpleModule R M] :
    ∃ (s : Set (Submodule R M)) (_ : M ≃ₗ[R] Π₀ m : s, m.1),
      sSupIndep s ∧ ∀ m : s, IsSimpleModule R m.1
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨s, ind, sSup, simple⟩ := IsSemisimpleModule.exists_sSupIndep_sSup_simples_eq_top R M
  refine ⟨s, ?_, ind, SetCoe.forall.mpr simple⟩
  rw [sSupIndep_iff] at ind
  exact .symm <| .trans (.ofInjective _ ind.dfinsupp_lsum_injective) <| .trans (.ofEq _ ⊤ <|
    by rw [← Submodule.iSup_eq_range_dfinsupp_lsum, ← sSup, sSup_eq_iSup']) Submodule.topEquiv

name: isSemisimpleModule_iff_exists_linearEquiv_dfinsupp
statement:
theorem isSemisimpleModule_iff_exists_linearEquiv_dfinsupp : IsSemisimpleModule R M ↔
    ∃ (s : Set (Submodule R M)) (_ : M ≃ₗ[R] Π₀ m : s, m.1), ∀ m : s, IsSimpleModule R m.1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun _ ↦ ?_, fun ⟨s, e, h⟩ ↦ .congr e⟩
  have ⟨s, e, h⟩ := IsSemisimpleModule.exists_linearEquiv_dfinsupp R M
  exact ⟨s, e, h.2⟩

name: IsSemisimpleModule.exists_linearEquiv_fin_dfinsupp
statement:
theorem IsSemisimpleModule.exists_linearEquiv_fin_dfinsupp [IsSemisimpleModule R M]
    [Module.Finite R M] : ∃ (n : ℕ) (S : Fin n → Submodule R M)
      (_ : M ≃ₗ[R] Π₀ i : Fin n, S i), ∀ i, IsSimpleModule R (S i)
proof:
:=
  have ⟨s, e, h, simple⟩ := IsSemisimpleModule.exists_linearEquiv_dfinsupp R M
  have := WellFoundedGT.finite_of_iSupIndep ((sSupIndep_iff _).mp h)
    fun S ↦ (S.1.nontrivial_iff_ne_bot).mp <| IsSimpleModule.nontrivial R S
  ⟨_, _, e.trans <| DirectSum.lequivCongrLeft R (Finite.equivFin s), fun _ ↦ simple _⟩

name: IsSemisimpleModule.sup
proof:
:= by
  let f : Bool → Submodule R M := Bool.rec q p
  rw [show p ⊔ q = ⨆ i ∈ Set.univ, f i by rw [iSup_univ, iSup_bool_eq]]
  exact isSemisimpleModule_biSup_of_isSemisimpleModule_submodule
    (by rintro (_ | _) _ <;> assumption)

name: IsSemisimpleRing.exists_linearEquiv_ideal_of_isSimpleModule
statement:
theorem IsSemisimpleRing.exists_linearEquiv_ideal_of_isSimpleModule [IsSemisimpleRing R]
    [h : IsSimpleModule R M] : ∃ I : Ideal R, Nonempty (M ≃ₗ[R] I)
proof:
:=
  have ⟨J, _, ⟨e⟩⟩ := isSimpleModule_iff_quot_maximal.mp h
  have ⟨I, ⟨e'⟩⟩ := IsSemisimpleModule.exists_submodule_linearEquiv_quotient J
  ⟨I, ⟨e.trans e'.symm⟩⟩

name: RingHom.isSemisimpleRing_of_surjective
statement:
theorem RingHom.isSemisimpleRing_of_surjective (f : R →+* S) (hf : Function.Surjective f)
    [IsSemisimpleRing R] : IsSemisimpleRing S
proof:
:= by
  let : Module R S := Module.compHom _ f
  have : RingHomSurjective f := ⟨hf⟩
  let e : S →ₛₗ[f] S := { AddMonoidHom.id S with map_smul' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl }
  rw [IsSemisimpleRing, ← e.isSemisimpleModule_iff_of_bijective Function.bijective_id]
  infer_instance

name: IsSemisimpleRing.ideal_eq_span_idempotent
statement:
theorem IsSemisimpleRing.ideal_eq_span_idempotent [IsSemisimpleRing R] (I : Ideal R) :
    ∃ e : R, IsIdempotentElem e ∧ I = .span {e}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨J, h⟩ := exists_isCompl I
  obtain ⟨f, idem, rfl⟩ := I.isIdempotentElemEquiv.symm (I.isComplEquivProj ⟨J, h⟩)
  exact ⟨f 1, LinearMap.isIdempotentElem_map_one_iff.mpr idem, by
    rw [LinearMap.range_eq_map, ← Ideal.span_one, ← Ideal.submodule_span_eq, LinearMap.map_span,
      Set.image_one, Ideal.submodule_span_eq]⟩

name: injective_or_eq_zero
statement:
theorem injective_or_eq_zero [IsSimpleModule R M] (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    Function.Injective f ∨ f = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ker_eq_bot, ← ker_eq_top]
  apply eq_bot_or_eq_top

name: injective_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem injective_of_ne_zero [IsSimpleModule R M] {f : M →ₗ[R] N} (h : f ≠ 0) :
    Function.Injective f
proof:
:=
  f.injective_or_eq_zero.resolve_right h

name: surjective_or_eq_zero
statement:
theorem surjective_or_eq_zero [IsSimpleModule R N] (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    Function.Surjective f ∨ f = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← range_eq_top, ← range_eq_bot, or_comm]
  apply eq_bot_or_eq_top

name: surjective_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem surjective_of_ne_zero [IsSimpleModule R N] {f : M →ₗ[R] N} (h : f ≠ 0) :
    Function.Surjective f
proof:
:=
  f.surjective_or_eq_zero.resolve_right h

name: bijective_or_eq_zero
statement:
theorem bijective_or_eq_zero [IsSimpleModule R M] [IsSimpleModule R N] (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    Function.Bijective f ∨ f = 0
proof:
:=
  or_iff_not_imp_right.mpr fun h ↦ ⟨injective_of_ne_zero h, surjective_of_ne_zero h⟩

name: bijective_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem bijective_of_ne_zero [IsSimpleModule R M] [IsSimpleModule R N] {f : M →ₗ[R] N} (h : f ≠ 0) :
    Function.Bijective f
proof:
:=
  f.bijective_or_eq_zero.resolve_right h

name: isCoatom_ker_of_surjective
statement:
theorem isCoatom_ker_of_surjective [IsSimpleModule R N] {f : M →ₗ[R] N}
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) : IsCoatom (LinearMap.ker f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isSimpleModule_iff_isCoatom]
  exact IsSimpleModule.congr (f.quotKerEquivOfSurjective hf)

name: linearEquiv_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem linearEquiv_of_ne_zero [IsSemisimpleModule R M] [IsSimpleModule R N]
    {f : M →ₗ[R] N} (h : f ≠ 0) : ∃ S : Submodule R M, Nonempty (N ≃ₗ[R] S)
proof:
:=
  have ⟨m, (_ : IsSimpleModule R m), ne⟩ :=
    exists_ne_zero_of_sSup_eq_top h _ (IsSemisimpleModule.sSup_simples_eq_top ..)
  ⟨m, ⟨.symm <| .ofBijective _ ((bijective_or_eq_zero _).resolve_right ne)⟩⟩

name: jacobson_density
statement:
theorem jacobson_density (f : End (End R M) M) (s : Finset M) :
    ∃ r : R, ∀ m ∈ s, f m = r • m
proof:
:=
  let x := Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm (·.1 : s → M)
  have ⟨_, h⟩ := exists_isCompl (R ∙ x)
  let p := projection _ _ h
  let f := End.ringHomEndFinsupp s f
  have : f (p • x) = f x := congr(f $(projection_apply_left h ⟨x, mem_span_singleton_self x⟩))
  have : f x ∈ R ∙ x := by rw [← this, map_smul, End.smul_def]; apply projection_apply_mem
  have ⟨r, hr⟩ := mem_span_singleton.mp this
  ⟨r, fun m hm ↦ by simpa [x] using! congr($hr ⟨m, hm⟩).symm⟩

name: Module.Finite.toModuleEnd_moduleEnd_surjective
statement:
protected theorem Module.Finite.toModuleEnd_moduleEnd_surjective [Module.Finite (End R M) M] :
    Function.Surjective (Module.toModuleEnd (End R M) (S := R) M)
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨s, hs⟩ := Module.Finite.fg_top (R := End R M) (M := M)
  intro f
  have ⟨r, hr⟩ := jacobson_density f s
  refine ⟨r, LinearMap.ext fun m ↦ ?_⟩
  induction hs.ge (trivial : m ∈ ⊤) using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem m hm => exact (hr m hm).symm
  | zero => simp
  | add _ _ _ _ h₁ h₂ => simpa using congr($h₁ + $h₂)
  | smul g _ _ h => simp_rw [map_smul, h]

name: IsIsotypicOfType.isIsotypic
statement: theorem IsIsotypicOfType.isIsotypic (h : IsIsotypicOfType R M S) : IsIsotypic R M
proof:
:=
  fun m _ m' _ ↦ ⟨(h m').some.trans (h m).some.symm⟩

name: IsIsotypicOfType.of_subsingleton
statement:
@[nontriviality]
theorem IsIsotypicOfType.of_subsingleton [Subsingleton M] : IsIsotypicOfType R M S
proof:
:=
  fun S ↦ have := IsSimpleModule.nontrivial R S
    (not_subsingleton _ S.subtype_injective.subsingleton).elim

name: IsIsotypic.of_subsingleton
statement: @[nontriviality] theorem IsIsotypic.of_subsingleton [Subsingleton M] : IsIsotypic R M
proof:
:=
  fun S ↦ (IsIsotypicOfType.of_subsingleton R M S).isIsotypic S

name: IsIsotypicOfType.of_isSimpleModule
statement: theorem IsIsotypicOfType.of_isSimpleModule [IsSimpleModule R M] : IsIsotypicOfType R M M
proof:
:=
  fun S hS ↦ by
    rw [isSimpleModule_iff_isAtom, isAtom_iff_eq_top] at hS
    exact ⟨.trans (.ofEq _ _ hS) Submodule.topEquiv⟩

name: IsIsotypic.of_self
statement: theorem IsIsotypic.of_self [IsSemisimpleRing R] (h : IsIsotypic R R) : IsIsotypic R M
proof:
:=
  fun m _ m' _ ↦
    have ⟨_, ⟨e⟩⟩ := IsSemisimpleRing.exists_linearEquiv_ideal_of_isSimpleModule R m
    have ⟨_, ⟨e'⟩⟩ := IsSemisimpleRing.exists_linearEquiv_ideal_of_isSimpleModule R m'
    have := IsSimpleModule.congr e.symm
    have := IsSimpleModule.congr e'.symm
    ⟨e'.trans <| (h _ _).some.trans e.symm⟩

name: IsIsotypicOfType.of_linearEquiv_type
statement:
theorem IsIsotypicOfType.of_linearEquiv_type (h : IsIsotypicOfType R M S) (e : S ≃ₗ[R] N) :
    IsIsotypicOfType R M N
proof: := fun m _ ↦ ⟨(h m).some.trans e⟩

name: IsIsotypicOfType.of_injective
statement:
theorem IsIsotypicOfType.of_injective (h : IsIsotypicOfType R N S) (f : M →ₗ[R] N)
    (inj : Function.Injective f) : IsIsotypicOfType R M S
proof:
:= fun m ↦
  have em := m.equivMapOfInjective f inj
  have := IsSimpleModule.congr em.symm
  ⟨em.trans (h (m.map f)).some⟩

name: IsIsotypic.of_injective
statement:
theorem IsIsotypic.of_injective (h : IsIsotypic R N) (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (inj : Function.Injective f) :
    IsIsotypic R M
proof:
:= fun m _ ↦
  have em := (m.equivMapOfInjective f inj).symm
  have := IsSimpleModule.congr em
  ((h (m.map f)).of_injective f inj).of_linearEquiv_type em

name: LinearEquiv.isIsotypicOfType_iff
statement:
theorem LinearEquiv.isIsotypicOfType_iff (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) :
    IsIsotypicOfType R M S ↔ IsIsotypicOfType R N S
proof:
:=
  ⟨(·.of_injective _ e.symm.injective), (·.of_injective _ e.injective)⟩

name: LinearEquiv.isIsotypicOfType_iff_type
statement:
theorem LinearEquiv.isIsotypicOfType_iff_type (e : N ≃ₗ[R] S) :
    IsIsotypicOfType R M N ↔ IsIsotypicOfType R M S
proof:
:=
  ⟨(·.of_linearEquiv_type e), (·.of_linearEquiv_type e.symm)⟩

name: LinearEquiv.isIsotypic_iff
statement: theorem LinearEquiv.isIsotypic_iff (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) : IsIsotypic R M ↔ IsIsotypic R N
proof:
:=
  ⟨(·.of_injective _ e.symm.injective), (·.of_injective _ e.injective)⟩

name: isIsotypicOfType_submodule_iff
statement:
theorem isIsotypicOfType_submodule_iff {N : Submodule R M} :
    IsIsotypicOfType R N S ↔ ∀ m ≤ N, [IsSimpleModule R m] → Nonempty (m ≃ₗ[R] S)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Subtype.forall', ← (Submodule.MapSubtype.orderIso N).forall_congr_right]
  have e := Submodule.equivMapOfInjective _ N.subtype_injective
  simp_rw [Submodule.MapSubtype.orderIso, Equiv.coe_fn_mk, ← (e _).isSimpleModule_iff]
  exact forall₂_congr fun m _ ↦ ⟨fun ⟨e'⟩ ↦ ⟨(e m).symm.trans e'⟩, fun ⟨e'⟩ ↦ ⟨(e m).trans e'⟩⟩

name: isIsotypic_submodule_iff
statement:
theorem isIsotypic_submodule_iff {N : Submodule R M} :
    IsIsotypic R N ↔ ∀ m ≤ N, [IsSimpleModule R m] → IsIsotypicOfType R N m
proof:
:= by
  rw [Subtype.forall', ← (Submodule.MapSubtype.orderIso N).forall_congr_right]
  have e := Submodule.equivMapOfInjective _ N.subtype_injective
  simp_rw [Submodule.MapSubtype.orderIso, Equiv.coe_fn_mk, ← (e _).isSimpleModule_iff,
    ← (e _).isIsotypicOfType_iff_type, IsIsotypic]

name: IsIsotypicOfType.linearEquiv_finsupp
statement:
theorem IsIsotypicOfType.linearEquiv_finsupp (h : IsIsotypicOfType R M S) :
    ∃ ι : Type u, Nonempty (M ≃ₗ[R] ι →₀ S)
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨s, e, _, hs⟩ := IsSemisimpleModule.exists_linearEquiv_dfinsupp R M
  classical exact ⟨s, ⟨e.trans (DFinsupp.mapRange.linearEquiv fun m : s ↦ (h m.1).some)
    |>.trans (finsuppLequivDFinsupp R).symm⟩⟩

name: IsIsotypic.linearEquiv_finsupp
statement:
theorem IsIsotypic.linearEquiv_finsupp [Nontrivial M] (h : IsIsotypic R M) :
    ∃ (ι : Type u) (_ : Nonempty ι) (S : Submodule R M),
      IsSimpleModule R S ∧ Nonempty (M ≃ₗ[R] ι →₀ S)
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨S, hS⟩ := IsAtomic.exists_atom (Submodule R M)
  rw [← isSimpleModule_iff_isAtom] at hS
  have ⟨ι, e⟩ := (h S).linearEquiv_finsupp
  exact ⟨ι, (isEmpty_or_nonempty ι).resolve_left fun _ ↦ not_subsingleton _ (e.some.subsingleton),
    S, hS, e⟩

name: IsIsotypicOfType.linearEquiv_fun
statement:
theorem IsIsotypicOfType.linearEquiv_fun [Module.Finite R M] (h : IsIsotypicOfType R M S) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, Nonempty (M ≃ₗ[R] Fin n → S)
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨n, S, e, hs⟩ := IsSemisimpleModule.exists_linearEquiv_fin_dfinsupp R M
  classical exact ⟨n, ⟨e.trans (DFinsupp.mapRange.linearEquiv fun i ↦ (h (S i)).some)
    |>.trans (finsuppLequivDFinsupp R).symm |>.trans (Finsupp.linearEquivFunOnFinite ..)⟩⟩

name: IsIsotypic.linearEquiv_fun
statement:
theorem IsIsotypic.linearEquiv_fun [Module.Finite R M] [Nontrivial M] (h : IsIsotypic R M) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (_ : NeZero n) (S : Submodule R M),
      IsSimpleModule R S ∧ Nonempty (M ≃ₗ[R] Fin n → S)
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨S, hS⟩ := IsAtomic.exists_atom (Submodule R M)
  rw [← isSimpleModule_iff_isAtom] at hS
  have ⟨n, e⟩ := (h S).linearEquiv_fun
  exact ⟨n, neZero_iff.2 <| by rintro rfl; exact not_subsingleton _ (e.some.subsingleton), S, hS, e⟩

name: IsIsotypic.submodule_linearEquiv_fun
statement:
theorem IsIsotypic.submodule_linearEquiv_fun {m : Submodule R M} [Module.Finite R m] [Nontrivial m]
    (h : IsIsotypic R m) : ∃ (n : ℕ) (_ : NeZero n) (S : Submodule R M),
      S ≤ m ∧ IsSimpleModule R S ∧ Nonempty (m ≃ₗ[R] Fin n → S)
proof:
:=
  have ⟨n, hn, S, _, ⟨e⟩⟩ := h.linearEquiv_fun
  let e' := S.equivMapOfInjective _ m.subtype_injective
  ⟨n, hn, _, m.map_subtype_le S, .congr e'.symm, ⟨e.trans <| .piCongrRight fun _ ↦ e'⟩⟩

name: Submodule.le_isotypicComponent
statement: theorem Submodule.le_isotypicComponent (m : Submodule R M) : m ≤ isotypicComponent R M m
proof:
:=
  le_sSup ⟨.refl ..⟩

name: bot_lt_isotypicComponent
statement:
theorem bot_lt_isotypicComponent (S : Submodule R M) [IsSimpleModule R S] :
    ⊥ < isotypicComponent R M S
proof:
:=
  (bot_lt_iff_ne_bot.mpr <| (S.nontrivial_iff_ne_bot).mp <| IsSimpleModule.nontrivial R S).trans_le
    S.le_isotypicComponent

name: bot_lt_isotypicComponents
statement: theorem bot_lt_isotypicComponents {m : Submodule R M} (h : m ∈ isotypicComponents R M) : ⊥ < m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := h; exact bot_lt_isotypicComponent ..

name: LinearEquiv.isotypicComponent_eq
statement:
theorem LinearEquiv.isotypicComponent_eq (e : N ≃ₗ[R] S) :
    isotypicComponent R M N = isotypicComponent R M S
proof:
:=
  congr_arg sSup <| Set.ext fun _ ↦ Nonempty.congr (·.trans e) (·.trans e.symm)

name: Submodule.le_linearEquiv_of_sSup_eq_top
statement:
theorem Submodule.le_linearEquiv_of_sSup_eq_top [IsSemisimpleModule R M]
    (hs : sSup s = ⊤) : ∃ m ∈ s, ∃ S ≤ m, Nonempty (N ≃ₗ[R] S)
proof:
:= by
  have := IsSimpleModule.nontrivial R N
  have ⟨_, compl⟩ := exists_isCompl N
  have ⟨m, hm, ne⟩ := exists_ne_zero_of_sSup_eq_top (ne_zero_of_surjective
    (projectionOnto_surjective compl)) _ hs
  have ⟨S, ⟨e⟩⟩ := linearEquiv_of_ne_zero ne
  exact ⟨m, hm, _, m.map_subtype_le S, ⟨e.trans (S.equivMapOfInjective _ m.subtype_injective)⟩⟩

name: Submodule.linearEquiv_of_sSup_eq_top
statement:
theorem Submodule.linearEquiv_of_sSup_eq_top [h : ∀ m : s, IsSimpleModule R m]
    (hs : sSup s = ⊤) : ∃ S ∈ s, Nonempty (N ≃ₗ[R] S)
proof:
:=
  have := isSemisimpleModule_of_isSemisimpleModule_submodule' (fun _ ↦ inferInstance)
    (sSup_eq_iSup' s ▸ hs)
  have ⟨m, hm, _S, le, ⟨e⟩⟩ := N.le_linearEquiv_of_sSup_eq_top _ hs
  have := isSimpleModule_iff_isAtom.mp (IsSimpleModule.congr e.symm)
  have := ((isSimpleModule_iff_isAtom.mp <| h ⟨m, hm⟩).le_iff_eq this.1).mp le
  ⟨m, hm, ⟨e.trans (.ofEq _ _ this)⟩⟩

name: Submodule.le_linearEquiv_of_le_sSup
statement:
theorem Submodule.le_linearEquiv_of_le_sSup [hs : ∀ m : s, IsSemisimpleModule R m]
    (hN : N ≤ sSup s) : ∃ m ∈ s, ∃ S ≤ m, Nonempty (N ≃ₗ[R] S)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sSup_eq_iSup] at hN
  have e := LinearEquiv.ofInjective _ (inclusion_injective hN)
  have := IsSimpleModule.congr e.symm
  have := isSemisimpleModule_biSup_of_isSemisimpleModule_submodule fun m hm ↦ hs ⟨m, hm⟩
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩, S, le, ⟨e'⟩⟩ := LinearMap.range (inclusion hN)
      |>.le_linearEquiv_of_sSup_eq_top (comap (⨆ i ∈ s, i).subtype '' s) <| by
    rw [sSup_image, biSup_comap_subtype_eq_top]
  exact ⟨m, hm, _, map_le_iff_le_comap.mpr le,
    ⟨(e.trans e').trans (equivMapOfInjective _ (subtype_injective _) _)⟩⟩

name: Submodule.linearEquiv_of_le_sSup
statement:
theorem Submodule.linearEquiv_of_le_sSup [simple : ∀ m : s, IsSimpleModule R m]
    (hs : N ≤ sSup s) : ∃ S ∈ s, Nonempty (N ≃ₗ[R] S)
proof:
:=
  have ⟨m, hm, _S, le, ⟨e⟩⟩ := N.le_linearEquiv_of_le_sSup _ hs
  have := isSimpleModule_iff_isAtom.mp (.congr e.symm)
  have := ((isSimpleModule_iff_isAtom.mp <| simple ⟨m, hm⟩).le_iff_eq this.1).mp le
  ⟨m, hm, ⟨e.trans (.ofEq _ _ this)⟩⟩

name: IsIsotypicOfType.isotypicComponent
statement:
protected theorem IsIsotypicOfType.isotypicComponent :
    IsIsotypicOfType R (isotypicComponent R M S) S
proof:
:=
  isIsotypicOfType_submodule_iff.mpr fun m h _ ↦
    have ⟨_, ⟨e⟩, ⟨e'⟩⟩ := m.linearEquiv_of_le_sSup _ h
    ⟨e'.trans e⟩

name: IsIsotypic.isotypicComponent
statement: protected theorem IsIsotypic.isotypicComponent : IsIsotypic R (isotypicComponent R M S)
proof:
:=
  (IsIsotypicOfType.isotypicComponent R M S).isIsotypic

name: IsIsotypic.isotypicComponents
statement:
protected theorem IsIsotypic.isotypicComponents {m : Submodule R M}
    (h : m ∈ isotypicComponents R M) : IsIsotypic R m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := h; exact .isotypicComponent R M _

name: eq_isotypicComponent_of_le
statement:
theorem eq_isotypicComponent_of_le {S c : Submodule R M} (hc : c ∈ isotypicComponents R M)
    [IsSimpleModule R S] (le : S ≤ c) : c = isotypicComponent R M S
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S', _, rfl⟩ := hc
  have ⟨e⟩ := isIsotypicOfType_submodule_iff.mp (.isotypicComponent R M S') _ le
  exact e.symm.isotypicComponent_eq

name: sSupIndep_isotypicComponents
statement: theorem sSupIndep_isotypicComponents : sSupIndep (isotypicComponents R M)
proof:
:=
  fun c hc ↦ disjoint_iff.mpr <| of_not_not fun ne ↦ by
    set s := isotypicComponents R M \ {c}
    have : IsSemisimpleModule R c := by obtain ⟨S, _, rfl⟩ := hc; infer_instance
    have := IsSemisimpleModule.of_injective _
      (Submodule.inclusion_injective (inf_le_left : c ⊓ sSup s ≤ c))
    have (c : s) : IsSemisimpleModule R c := by obtain ⟨_, ⟨_, _, rfl⟩, _⟩ := c; infer_instance
    have ⟨S, le, _⟩ := (IsSemisimpleModule.eq_bot_or_exists_simple_le _).resolve_left ne
    have ⟨c', hc', S', le', ⟨e⟩⟩ := S.le_linearEquiv_of_le_sSup _ (le.trans inf_le_right)
    have := IsSimpleModule.congr e.symm
    refine hc'.2 ?_
    rw [eq_isotypicComponent_of_le hc (le.trans inf_le_left), eq_isotypicComponent_of_le hc'.1 le']
    exact e.symm.isotypicComponent_eq

name: IsIsotypicOfType.of_isotypicComponent_eq_top
statement:
theorem IsIsotypicOfType.of_isotypicComponent_eq_top (h : isotypicComponent R M S = ⊤) :
    IsIsotypicOfType R M S
proof:
:=
  fun m _ ↦ have ⟨_, ⟨e⟩, ⟨e'⟩⟩ := m.linearEquiv_of_sSup_eq_top _ h; ⟨e'.trans e⟩

name: Submodule.map_le_isotypicComponent
statement:
theorem Submodule.map_le_isotypicComponent (S : Submodule R M) [IsSimpleModule R S]
    (f : M →ₗ[R] N) : S.map f ≤ isotypicComponent R N S
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← S.range_subtype, ← LinearMap.range_comp]
  obtain inj | eq := (f ∘ₗ S.subtype).injective_or_eq_zero
  · exact le_sSup ⟨.symm <| .ofInjective _ inj⟩
  · simp_rw [eq, LinearMap.range_zero, bot_le]

name: LinearMap.le_comap_isotypicComponent
statement:
theorem LinearMap.le_comap_isotypicComponent (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    isotypicComponent R M S ≤ (isotypicComponent R N S).comap f
proof:
:=
  sSup_le fun m ⟨e⟩ ↦ Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap.mp <|
    have := IsSimpleModule.congr e
    (m.map_le_isotypicComponent f).trans_eq e.isotypicComponent_eq

name: isFullyInvariant_iff_isTwoSided
statement: theorem isFullyInvariant_iff_isTwoSided {I : Ideal R} : I.IsFullyInvariant ↔ I.IsTwoSided
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Submodule.IsFullyInvariant, ← MulOpposite.opEquiv.trans (RingEquiv.moduleEndSelf R
    |>.toEquiv) |>.forall_congr_right, SetLike.le_def, I.isTwoSided_iff] using! forall_comm

name: mem_fullyInvariantSubmodule_iff
statement:
theorem mem_fullyInvariantSubmodule_iff {m : Submodule R M} :
    m ∈ fullyInvariantSubmodule R M ↔ m.IsFullyInvariant
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Submodule.IsFullyInvariant.isotypicComponent
statement:
protected theorem Submodule.IsFullyInvariant.isotypicComponent :
    (isotypicComponent R M S).IsFullyInvariant
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.le_comap_isotypicComponent S

name: Submodule.IsFullyInvariant.of_mem_isotypicComponents
statement:
theorem Submodule.IsFullyInvariant.of_mem_isotypicComponents {m : Submodule R M}
    (h : m ∈ isotypicComponents R M) : m.IsFullyInvariant
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := h; exact .isotypicComponent R M _

name: le_isotypicComponent_iff
statement:
theorem le_isotypicComponent_iff [IsSemisimpleModule R M] {m : Submodule R M} :
    m ≤ isotypicComponent R M S ↔ IsIsotypicOfType R m S where
  mp h
proof:
:= .of_injective (.isotypicComponent R M S) _ (Submodule.inclusion_injective h)
  mpr h := (IsSemisimpleModule.sSup_simples_le m).ge.trans
    (sSup_le_sSup fun S ⟨_, le⟩ ↦ isIsotypicOfType_submodule_iff.mp h S le)

name: isotypicComponent_eq_top_iff
statement:
theorem isotypicComponent_eq_top_iff [IsSemisimpleModule R M] :
    isotypicComponent R M S = ⊤ ↔ IsIsotypicOfType R M S
proof:
:= by
  rw [← top_le_iff, le_isotypicComponent_iff, Submodule.topEquiv.isIsotypicOfType_iff]

name: isFullyInvariant_iff_le_imp_isotypicComponent_le
statement:
theorem isFullyInvariant_iff_le_imp_isotypicComponent_le [IsSemisimpleModule R M]
    {m : Submodule R M} :
    m.IsFullyInvariant ↔ ∀ S ≤ m, [IsSimpleModule R S] → isotypicComponent R M S ≤ m where
  mp h S le _
proof:
:= sSup_le fun S' ⟨e⟩ ↦ by
    have ⟨p, eq⟩ := extension_property _ S.subtype_injective (S'.subtype ∘ₗ e.symm)
    refine le_trans ?_ (Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap.mpr (le.trans (h p)))
    rw [← S.range_subtype, ← LinearMap.range_comp, eq, e.symm.range_comp, S'.range_subtype]
  mpr h f := (sSup_simples_le m).ge.trans <| sSup_le fun S ⟨_, le⟩ ↦
    Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap.mp ((S.map_le_isotypicComponent f).trans (h S le))

name: eq_isotypicComponent_iff
statement:
theorem eq_isotypicComponent_iff [IsSemisimpleModule R M] {m : Submodule R M} (ne : m ≠ ⊥) :
    m = isotypicComponent R M S ↔ IsIsotypicOfType R m S ∧ m.IsFullyInvariant where
  mp
proof:
:= by rintro rfl; exact ⟨.isotypicComponent R M S, .isotypicComponent R M S⟩
  mpr := fun ⟨iso, invar⟩ ↦ (le_isotypicComponent_iff.mpr iso).antisymm <|
    have ⟨S', le, _⟩ := (IsSemisimpleModule.eq_bot_or_exists_simple_le m).resolve_left ne
    (isIsotypicOfType_submodule_iff.mp iso S' le).some.symm.isotypicComponent_eq.trans_le
      (isFullyInvariant_iff_le_imp_isotypicComponent_le.mp invar _ le)

name: isIsotypic_iff_isFullyInvariant_imp_bot_or_top
statement:
theorem isIsotypic_iff_isFullyInvariant_imp_bot_or_top :
    IsIsotypic R M ↔ ∀ N : Submodule R M, N.IsFullyInvariant → N = ⊥ ∨ N = ⊤ where
  mp h N hN
proof:
:= (eq_bot_or_exists_simple_le N).imp_right fun ⟨S, le, _⟩ ↦ top_unique <|
    (isotypicComponent_eq_top_iff.mpr (h S)).ge.trans
    ((isFullyInvariant_iff_le_imp_isotypicComponent_le.mp hN) _ le)
  mpr h S _ := isotypicComponent_eq_top_iff.mp <|
    (h _ (.isotypicComponent R M S)).resolve_left (bot_lt_isotypicComponent S).ne'

name: mem_isotypicComponents_iff
statement:
theorem mem_isotypicComponents_iff {m : Submodule R M} :
    m ∈ isotypicComponents R M ↔ IsIsotypic R m ∧ m.IsFullyInvariant ∧ m ≠ ⊥ where
  mp
proof:
:= by rintro ⟨S, _, rfl⟩; exact ⟨.isotypicComponent R M S,
    .isotypicComponent R M S, (bot_lt_isotypicComponent S).ne'⟩
  mpr := fun ⟨iso, invar, ne⟩ ↦
    have ⟨S, le, simple⟩ := (eq_bot_or_exists_simple_le m).resolve_left ne
    ⟨S, simple, (eq_isotypicComponent_iff ne).mpr ⟨isIsotypic_submodule_iff.mp iso S le, invar⟩⟩

name: isFullyInvariant_iff_sSup_isotypicComponents
statement:
theorem isFullyInvariant_iff_sSup_isotypicComponents {m : Submodule R M} :
    m.IsFullyInvariant ↔ ∃ s ⊆ isotypicComponents R M, m = sSup s
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨OrderIso.setIsotypicComponents.symm ⟨m, h⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩, ?_⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨c, _, rfl⟩; exact c.2
  · convert! Subtype.ext_iff.mp (OrderIso.setIsotypicComponents.right_inv ⟨m, h⟩).symm
    simp [sSup_image, OrderIso.setIsotypicComponents, OrderIso.symm]
  · rintro ⟨_, hs, rfl⟩
    exact (fullyInvariantSubmodule R M).sSupClosed fun _ h ↦ .of_mem_isotypicComponents (hs h)

name: sSup_isotypicComponents
statement: theorem sSup_isotypicComponents : sSup (isotypicComponents R M) = ⊤
proof:
:=
  have ⟨_, h, eq⟩ := isFullyInvariant_iff_sSup_isotypicComponents.mp
    (fullyInvariantSubmodule R M).top_mem
  top_unique <| eq.le.trans (sSup_le_sSup h)

name: IsSimpleRing.tfae
statement:
theorem IsSimpleRing.tfae [IsSimpleRing R] : List.TFAE
    [IsSemisimpleRing R, IsArtinianRing R, ∃ I : Ideal R, IsAtom I]
proof:
:= by
  tfae_have 1 → 2 := fun _ ↦ inferInstance
  tfae_have 2 → 3 := fun _ ↦ IsAtomic.exists_atom _
  tfae_have 3 → 1 := fun ⟨I, hI⟩ ↦ by
    have ⟨_, h⟩ := isSimpleRing_iff_isTwoSided_imp.mp ‹IsSimpleRing R›
    simp_rw [← isFullyInvariant_iff_isTwoSided] at h
    have := isSimpleModule_iff_isAtom.mpr hI
    obtain eq | eq := h _ (.isotypicComponent R R I)
    · exact (hI.bot_lt.not_ge <| (le_sSup <| by exact ⟨.refl ..⟩).trans_eq eq).elim
    exact .congr (.symm <| .trans (.ofEq _ _ eq) Submodule.topEquiv)
  tfae_finish

name: IsSimpleRing.isSemisimpleRing_iff_isArtinianRing
statement:
theorem IsSimpleRing.isSemisimpleRing_iff_isArtinianRing [IsSimpleRing R] :
    IsSemisimpleRing R ↔ IsArtinianRing R
proof: := tfae.out 1 2

name: isSimpleRing_isArtinianRing_iff
statement:
theorem isSimpleRing_isArtinianRing_iff :
    IsSimpleRing R ∧ IsArtinianRing R ↔ IsSemisimpleRing R ∧ IsIsotypic R R ∧ Nontrivial R
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨_, _⟩ ↦ ?_, fun ⟨_, _, _⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  on_goal 1 => have := IsSimpleRing.isSemisimpleRing_iff_isArtinianRing.mpr ‹_›
  all_goals simp_rw [isIsotypic_iff_isFullyInvariant_imp_bot_or_top,
      isFullyInvariant_iff_isTwoSided, isSimpleRing_iff_isTwoSided_imp] at *
  · exact ⟨this, by rwa [and_comm]⟩
  · exact ⟨⟨‹_›, ‹_›⟩, inferInstance⟩

name: isIsotypic
statement: theorem isIsotypic (M) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] : IsIsotypic R M
proof:
:=
  (isSimpleRing_isArtinianRing_iff.mp ⟨‹_›, ‹_›⟩).2.1.of_self M

name: exists_ringEquiv_matrix_end_mulOpposite
statement:
theorem exists_ringEquiv_matrix_end_mulOpposite :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (_ : NeZero n) (I : Ideal R) (_ : IsSimpleModule R I),
      Nonempty (R ≃+* Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) (Module.End R I)ᵐᵒᵖ)
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨n, hn, S, hS, ⟨e⟩⟩ := (isIsotypic R R).linearEquiv_fun
  refine ⟨n, hn, S, hS, ⟨.trans (.opOp R) <| .trans (.op ?_) (.symm .mopMatrix)⟩⟩
  exact .trans (.moduleEndSelf R) <| .trans e.conjRingEquiv (endVecRingEquivMatrixEnd ..)

name: exists_ringEquiv_matrix_divisionRing
statement:
theorem exists_ringEquiv_matrix_divisionRing :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (_ : NeZero n) (D : Type u) (_ : DivisionRing D),
      Nonempty (R ≃+* Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) D)
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨n, hn, I, _, ⟨e⟩⟩ := exists_ringEquiv_matrix_end_mulOpposite R
  classical exact ⟨n, hn, _, _, ⟨e⟩⟩

name: exists_algEquiv_matrix_end_mulOpposite
statement:
theorem exists_algEquiv_matrix_end_mulOpposite :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (_ : NeZero n) (I : Ideal R) (_ : IsSimpleModule R I),
      Nonempty (R ≃ₐ[R₀] Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) (Module.End R I)ᵐᵒᵖ)
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨n, hn, S, hS, ⟨e⟩⟩ := (isIsotypic R R).linearEquiv_fun
  refine ⟨n, hn, S, hS, ⟨.trans (.opOp R₀ R) <| .trans (.op ?_) (.symm .mopMatrix)⟩⟩
  exact .trans (.moduleEndSelf R₀) <| .trans (e.conjAlgEquiv R₀) (endVecAlgEquivMatrixEnd ..)

name: exists_algEquiv_matrix_divisionRing
statement:
theorem exists_algEquiv_matrix_divisionRing :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (_ : NeZero n) (D : Type u) (_ : DivisionRing D) (_ : Algebra R₀ D),
      Nonempty (R ≃ₐ[R₀] Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) D)
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨n, hn, I, _, ⟨e⟩⟩ := exists_algEquiv_matrix_end_mulOpposite R₀ R
  classical exact ⟨n, hn, _, _, _, ⟨e⟩⟩

name: exists_algEquiv_matrix_divisionRing_finite
statement:
theorem exists_algEquiv_matrix_divisionRing_finite [Module.Finite R₀ R] :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (_ : NeZero n) (D : Type u) (_ : DivisionRing D) (_ : Algebra R₀ D)
      (_ : Module.Finite R₀ D), Nonempty (R ≃ₐ[R₀] Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) D)
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨n, hn, I, _, ⟨e⟩⟩ := exists_algEquiv_matrix_end_mulOpposite R₀ R
  have := Module.Finite.equiv e.toLinearEquiv
  classical exact ⟨n, hn, _, _, _, .of_surjective
    (Matrix.entryLinearMap R₀ _ (0 : Fin n) (0 : Fin n)) fun f ↦ ⟨fun _ _ ↦ f, rfl⟩, ⟨e⟩⟩

name: exists_end_algEquiv_pi_matrix_end
statement:
theorem exists_end_algEquiv_pi_matrix_end :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (S : Fin n → Submodule R M) (d : Fin n → ℕ),
      (∀ i, IsSimpleModule R (S i)) ∧ (∀ i, NeZero (d i)) ∧
      Nonempty (End R M ≃ₐ[R₀] Π i, Matrix (Fin (d i)) (Fin (d i)) (End R (S i)))
proof:
:= by
  choose d pos S _ simple e using fun c : isotypicComponents R M ↦
    (IsIsotypic.isotypicComponents c.2).submodule_linearEquiv_fun
  exact ⟨_, _, _, fun _ ↦ simple _, fun _ ↦ pos _, ⟨.trans (endAlgEquiv R₀ R M) <| .trans
    (.piCongrRight fun c ↦ ((e c).some.conjAlgEquiv R₀).trans (endVecAlgEquivMatrixEnd ..)) <|
    (.piCongrLeft' R₀ _ (Finite.equivFin _))⟩⟩

name: exists_end_algEquiv_pi_matrix_divisionRing

name: exists_algEquiv_pi_matrix_divisionRing

name: exists_algEquiv_pi_matrix_divisionRing_finite

name: isCoprime_iff_nat_coprime
statement: theorem isCoprime_iff_nat_coprime {a b : ℤ} : IsCoprime a b ↔ Nat.Coprime a.natAbs b.natAbs
proof:
:= by
  rw [isCoprime_iff_gcd_eq_one, Nat.coprime_iff_gcd_eq_one, gcd_eq_natAbs]

name: gcd_ne_one_iff_gcd_mul_right_ne_one
statement:
theorem gcd_ne_one_iff_gcd_mul_right_ne_one {a : ℤ} {m n : ℕ} :
    a.gcd (m * n) ≠ 1 ↔ a.gcd m ≠ 1 ∨ a.gcd n ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← isCoprime_iff_gcd_eq_one, ← not_and_or, not_iff_not, IsCoprime.mul_right_iff]

name: sq_of_gcd_eq_one
statement:
theorem sq_of_gcd_eq_one {a b c : ℤ} (h : Int.gcd a b = 1) (heq : a * b = c ^ 2) :
    ∃ a0 : ℤ, a = a0 ^ 2 ∨ a = -a0 ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h' : IsUnit (GCDMonoid.gcd a b) := by
    rw [← coe_gcd, h, Int.ofNat_one]
    exact isUnit_one
  obtain ⟨d, ⟨u, hu⟩⟩ := exists_associated_pow_of_mul_eq_pow h' heq
  use d
  rw [← hu]
  rcases Int.units_eq_one_or u with hu' | hu' <;>
    · rw [hu']
      simp

name: sq_of_isCoprime
statement:
theorem sq_of_isCoprime {a b c : ℤ} (h : IsCoprime a b) (heq : a * b = c ^ 2) :
    ∃ a0 : ℤ, a = a0 ^ 2 ∨ a = -a0 ^ 2
proof:
:=
  sq_of_gcd_eq_one (isCoprime_iff_gcd_eq_one.mp h) heq

name: natAbs_euclideanDomain_gcd
statement:
theorem natAbs_euclideanDomain_gcd (a b : ℤ) :
    Int.natAbs (EuclideanDomain.gcd a b) = Int.gcd a b
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.dvd_antisymm <;> rw [← Int.natCast_dvd_natCast]
  · rw [Int.natAbs_dvd]
    exact Int.dvd_coe_gcd (EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_left _ _) (EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_right _ _)
  · rw [Int.dvd_natAbs]
    exact EuclideanDomain.dvd_gcd (Int.gcd_dvd_left ..) (Int.gcd_dvd_right ..)

name: Int.Prime.dvd_mul
statement:
theorem Int.Prime.dvd_mul {m n : ℤ} {p : ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime p) (h : (p : ℤ) ∣ m * n) :
    p ∣ m.natAbs ∨ p ∣ n.natAbs
proof:
:= by
  rwa [← hp.dvd_mul, ← Int.natAbs_mul, ← Int.natCast_dvd]

name: Int.Prime.dvd_mul'
statement:
theorem Int.Prime.dvd_mul' {m n : ℤ} {p : ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime p) (h : (p : ℤ) ∣ m * n) :
    (p : ℤ) ∣ m ∨ (p : ℤ) ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [Int.natCast_dvd, Int.natCast_dvd]
  exact Int.Prime.dvd_mul hp h

name: Int.Prime.dvd_pow
statement:
theorem Int.Prime.dvd_pow {n : ℤ} {k p : ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime p) (h : (p : ℤ) ∣ n ^ k) :
    p ∣ n.natAbs
proof:
:= by
  rw [Int.natCast_dvd, Int.natAbs_pow] at h
  exact hp.dvd_of_dvd_pow h

name: Int.Prime.dvd_pow'
statement:
theorem Int.Prime.dvd_pow' {n : ℤ} {k p : ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime p) (h : (p : ℤ) ∣ n ^ k) :
    (p : ℤ) ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [Int.natCast_dvd]
  exact Int.Prime.dvd_pow hp h

name: prime_two_or_dvd_of_dvd_two_mul_pow_self_two
statement:
theorem prime_two_or_dvd_of_dvd_two_mul_pow_self_two {m : ℤ} {p : ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime p)
    (h : (p : ℤ) ∣ 2 * m ^ 2) : p = 2 ∨ p ∣ Int.natAbs m
proof:
:= by
  rcases Int.Prime.dvd_mul hp h with hp2 | hpp
  · apply Or.intro_left
    exact le_antisymm (Nat.le_of_dvd zero_lt_two hp2) (Nat.Prime.two_le hp)
  · apply Or.intro_right
    rw [sq, Int.natAbs_mul] at hpp
    exact or_self_iff.mp ((Nat.Prime.dvd_mul hp).mp hpp)

name: exists_prime_and_dvd
statement: theorem exists_prime_and_dvd {n : ℤ} (hn : n.natAbs ≠ 1) : ∃ p, Prime p ∧ p ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, pp, pd⟩ := Nat.exists_prime_and_dvd hn
  exact ⟨p, Nat.prime_iff_prime_int.mp pp, Int.natCast_dvd.mpr pd⟩

name: prime_iff_natAbs_prime
statement: theorem prime_iff_natAbs_prime {k : ℤ} : Prime k ↔ Nat.Prime k.natAbs
proof:
:=
  (Int.associated_natAbs k).prime_iff.trans Nat.prime_iff_prime_int.symm

name: span_natAbs

name: isCoprime_two_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isCoprime_two_left {m : ℤ} : IsCoprime 2 m ↔ Odd m
proof:
:= by
  simp [isCoprime_iff_nat_coprime]

name: isCoprime_two_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isCoprime_two_right {m : ℤ} : IsCoprime m 2 ↔ Odd m
proof:
:= by
  simp [isCoprime_iff_nat_coprime]

name: eq_pow_of_mul_eq_pow_odd_left
statement:
theorem eq_pow_of_mul_eq_pow_odd_left {a b c : ℤ} (hab : IsCoprime a b) {k : ℕ} (hk : Odd k)
    (h : a * b = c ^ k) : ∃ d, a = d ^ k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := exists_associated_pow_of_mul_eq_pow' hab h
  replace hd := hd.symm
  rw [associated_iff_natAbs, natAbs_eq_natAbs_iff, ← hk.neg_pow] at hd
  obtain rfl | rfl := hd <;> exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: eq_pow_of_mul_eq_pow_odd_right
statement:
theorem eq_pow_of_mul_eq_pow_odd_right {a b c : ℤ} (hab : IsCoprime a b) {k : ℕ} (hk : Odd k)
    (h : a * b = c ^ k) : ∃ d, b = d ^ k
proof:
:=
  eq_pow_of_mul_eq_pow_odd_left (c := c) hab.symm hk (by rwa [mul_comm] at h)

name: eq_pow_of_mul_eq_pow_odd
statement:
theorem eq_pow_of_mul_eq_pow_odd {a b c : ℤ} (hab : IsCoprime a b) {k : ℕ} (hk : Odd k)
    (h : a * b = c ^ k) : (∃ d, a = d ^ k) ∧ ∃ e, b = e ^ k
proof:
:=
  ⟨eq_pow_of_mul_eq_pow_odd_left hab hk h, eq_pow_of_mul_eq_pow_odd_right hab hk h⟩

name: auxMat_blockTriangular
statement: lemma auxMat_blockTriangular : (auxMat M k).BlockTriangular (· ≠ k)
proof:
:=
  fun i j lt ↦ by
    let := Prop.linearOrder
    simp_rw [lt_iff_not_ge, le_Prop_eq, Classical.not_imp, not_not] at lt
    rw [auxMat, of_apply, ite_eq_left lt.2, ite_eq_right lt.1]

name: auxMat_toSquareBlock_ne
statement: lemma auxMat_toSquareBlock_ne : (auxMat M k).toSquareBlock (· ≠ k) True = M k k • 1
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp [auxMat, toSquareBlock_def, ite_eq_right (of_eq_true i.2), ite_eq_right (of_eq_true j.2),
    Matrix.one_apply, Subtype.ext_iff]

name: auxMat_toSquareBlock_eq
statement: lemma auxMat_toSquareBlock_eq : (auxMat M k).toSquareBlock (· ≠ k) False = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨i, hi⟩ ⟨j, hj⟩
  rw [eq_iff_iff, iff_false, not_not] at hi hj
  simp [auxMat, toSquareBlock_def, ite_eq_left hi, ite_eq_left hj, Matrix.one_apply,
    ite_eq_left (hj ▸ hi)]

name: mul_auxMat_blockTriangular
statement: lemma mul_auxMat_blockTriangular : (M * auxMat M k).BlockTriangular (· = k)
proof:
:=
  fun i j lt ↦ by
    let := Prop.linearOrder
    simp_rw [lt_iff_not_ge, le_Prop_eq, Classical.not_imp] at lt
    simp_rw [Matrix.mul_apply, auxMat, of_apply, ite_eq_right lt.2, mul_ite, mul_neg, mul_zero]
    rw [Finset.sum_ite, Finset.filter_eq', ite_eq_left (Finset.mem_univ _), Finset.sum_singleton,
      Finset.sum_ite_eq', ite_eq_left, lt.1, mul_comm, neg_add_cancel]
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, lt.2⟩

name: mul_auxMat_corner
statement: lemma mul_auxMat_corner : (M * auxMat M k) k k = M k k
proof: := by simp [Matrix.mul_apply, auxMat]

name: mul_auxMat_toSquareBlock_eq
statement:
lemma mul_auxMat_toSquareBlock_eq :
    (M * auxMat M k).toSquareBlock (· = k) True = M k k • 1
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨i, hi⟩ ⟨j, hj⟩
  rw [eq_iff_iff, iff_true] at hi hj
  simp [toSquareBlock_def, hi, hj, mul_auxMat_corner]

name: det_mul_corner_pow
statement:
lemma det_mul_corner_pow :
    M.det * M k k ^ (Fintype.card m - 1) = M k k * (mulAuxMatBlock).det
proof:
:= by
  let := Prop.linearOrder
  trans (M * auxMat M k).det
  · simp [det_mul, (auxMat_blockTriangular M k).det_fintype,
      auxMat_toSquareBlock_ne, auxMat_toSquareBlock_eq]
  rw [(mul_auxMat_blockTriangular M k).det_fintype, Fintype.prod_Prop, mul_auxMat_toSquareBlock_eq]
  simp_rw [det_smul_of_tower, eq_iff_iff, iff_true, Fintype.card_unique,
    pow_one, det_one, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  
  
  convert! rfl

name: polyToMatrix_cornerAddX
statement:
lemma polyToMatrix_cornerAddX :
    f.polyToMatrix (cornerAddX M k k k) = (-f (M k k)).charmatrix
proof:
:= by
  simp [cornerAddX, Matrix.add_apply, charmatrix,
    RingHom.polyToMatrix, -AlgEquiv.symm_toRingEquiv, map_neg]

name: eval_zero_det_det
statement: lemma eval_zero_det_det : eval 0 (f.polyToMatrix (cornerAddX M k).det).det = (f M.det).det
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coe_evalRingHom, RingHom.map_det, ← RingHom.comp_apply,
    evalRingHom_mapMatrix_comp_polyToMatrix, f.comp_apply, RingHom.map_det]
  congr; ext; simp [cornerAddX, diagonal, apply_ite]

name: eval_zero_comp_det
statement:
lemma eval_zero_comp_det :
    eval 0 (comp m m n n R[X] <| (cornerAddX M k).map f.polyToMatrix).det =
      (comp m m n n R <| M.map f).det
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← coe_evalRingHom, RingHom.map_det, ← compRingEquiv_apply, ← RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom,
    ← RingHom.mapMatrix_apply, ← RingHom.comp_apply, ← RingHom.comp_assoc,
    evalRingHom_mapMatrix_comp_compRingEquiv, RingHom.comp_assoc, RingHom.mapMatrix_comp,
    evalRingHom_mapMatrix_comp_polyToMatrix, ← RingHom.mapMatrix_comp, RingHom.comp_apply]
  congr with i j
  simp [cornerAddX, diagonal, apply_ite]

name: comp_det_mul_pow
statement:
theorem comp_det_mul_pow :
    ((M.map f).comp m m n n R).det * (f (M k k)).det ^ (Fintype.card m - 1) =
      (f (M k k)).det * (((mulAuxMatBlock).map f).comp _ _ n n R).det
proof:
:= by
  let := Prop.linearOrder
  trans (((M * auxMat M k).map f).comp m m n n R).det
  · simp_rw [← f.mapMatrix_apply, ← compRingEquiv_apply, map_mul, det_mul, f.mapMatrix_apply,
      compRingEquiv_apply, ((auxMat_blockTriangular M k).map f).comp.det_fintype, Fintype.prod_Prop,
      comp_toSquareBlock (b := (· ≠ k)), det_reindex_self, map_toSquareBlock,
      auxMat_toSquareBlock_eq, auxMat_toSquareBlock_ne, smul_one_eq_diagonal, ← diagonal_one,
      diagonal_map (map_zero _), comp_diagonal, det_reindex_self]
    simp
  · simp_rw [((mul_auxMat_blockTriangular M k).map f).comp.det_fintype, Fintype.prod_Prop,
      comp_toSquareBlock (b := (· = k)), det_reindex_self, map_toSquareBlock,
      mul_auxMat_toSquareBlock_eq, smul_one_eq_diagonal,
      diagonal_map (map_zero _), comp_diagonal, det_reindex_self]
    simp

name: det_det_aux
statement:
lemma det_det_aux
    (ih : ∀ M, (f (det M)).det = ((M.map f).comp {a // (a = k) = False} _ n n R).det) :
    ((f M.det).det - ((M.map f).comp m m n n R).det) *
      (f (M k k)).det ^ (Fintype.card m - 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_mul, comp_det_mul_pow, ← det_pow, ← map_pow, ← det_mul, ← map_mul,
    det_mul_corner_pow, map_mul, det_mul, ih, sub_self]

name: Matrix.det_det
statement:
theorem Matrix.det_det [Fintype m] [Fintype n] (f : S →+* Matrix n n R) :
    (f M.det).det = ((M.map f).comp m m n n R).det
proof:
:= by
  induction l : Fintype.card m generalizing R S m with
  | zero =>
    rw [Fintype.card_eq_zero_iff] at l
    simp_rw [Matrix.det_isEmpty, map_one, det_one]
  | succ l ih =>
    have ⟨k⟩ := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp (Nat.lt_of_sub_eq_succ l)
    let f' := f.polyToMatrix
    let M' := cornerAddX M k
    have : (f' M'.det).det = ((M'.map f').comp m m n n R[X]).det := by
      refine sub_eq_zero.mp <| mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_right.mp
        (pow_mem ?_ _) _ (det_det_aux k fun M ↦ ih _ _ <| by
          grind [Fintype.card_subtype_compl, Fintype.card_unique])
      rw [polyToMatrix_cornerAddX, ← charpoly]
      exact (Matrix.charpoly_monic _).mem_nonZeroDivisors
    rw [← eval_zero_det_det, congr_arg (eval 0) this, eval_zero_comp_det]

name: LinearMap.det_restrictScalars
statement:
theorem LinearMap.det_restrictScalars [AddCommGroup A] [Module R A] [Module S A]
    [IsScalarTower R S A] [Module.Free S A] {f : A →ₗ[S] A} :
    (f.restrictScalars R).det = Algebra.norm R f.det
proof:
:= by
  classical
  nontriviality R
  nontriviality A
  have := Module.nontrivial S A
  let ⟨ιS, bS⟩ := Module.Free.exists_basis (R := R) (M := S)
  let ⟨ιA, bA⟩ := Module.Free.exists_basis (R := S) (M := A)
  have := bS.index_nonempty
  have := bA.index_nonempty
  cases fintypeOrInfinite ιS; swap
  · rw [Algebra.norm_eq_one_of_not_module_finite (Module.not_finite_of_infinite_basis bS),
      det_eq_one_of_not_module_finite (Module.not_finite_of_infinite_basis (bS.smulTower bA))]
  cases fintypeOrInfinite ιA; swap
  · rw [det_eq_one_of_not_module_finite (Module.not_finite_of_infinite_basis bA), map_one,
      det_eq_one_of_not_module_finite (Module.not_finite_of_infinite_basis (bS.smulTower bA))]
  rw [Algebra.norm_eq_matrix_det bS, ← AlgHom.coe_toRingHom, ← det_toMatrix bA, det_det,
    ← det_toMatrix (bS.smulTower' bA), restrictScalars_toMatrix, RingHom.coe_coe]

name: Algebra.norm_norm
statement:
theorem Algebra.norm_norm {A} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] [Algebra S A]
    [IsScalarTower R S A] [Module.Free S A] {a : A} :
    norm R (norm S a) = norm R a
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_apply S, norm_apply R a, ← LinearMap.det_restrictScalars]; rfl

name: isIntegral_norm
statement:
theorem isIntegral_norm [Algebra R L] [Algebra R K] [IsScalarTower R K L] {x : L}
    (hx : IsIntegral R x) : IsIntegral R (norm K x)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : FiniteDimensional K L
  swap
  · simpa [norm_eq_one_of_not_module_finite h] using isIntegral_one
  let F := K⟮x⟯
  rw [← norm_norm (S := F), ← coe_gen K x, ← IntermediateField.algebraMap_apply,
    norm_algebraMap_of_basis (Module.Free.chooseBasis F L) (gen K x), map_pow]
  apply IsIntegral.pow
  rw [← isIntegral_algebraMap_iff (B := AlgebraicClosure K),
    norm_gen_eq_prod_roots _ (IsAlgClosed.splits _)]
  refine IsIntegral.multiset_prod (fun y hy ↦ ⟨minpoly R x, minpoly.monic hx, ?_⟩)
  suffices (aeval y) ((minpoly R x).map (algebraMap R K)) = 0 by simpa
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := minpoly.dvd K x (show aeval x ((minpoly R x).map (algebraMap R K)) = 0 by simp)
  simp [hP, aeval_mul, (mem_aroots'.mp hy).2]

name: norm_eq_norm_adjoin
statement:
theorem norm_eq_norm_adjoin (x : L) :
    norm K x = norm K (AdjoinSimple.gen K x) ^ finrank K⟮x⟯ L
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : FiniteDimensional K L
  swap
  · rw [norm_eq_one_of_not_module_finite h]
    by_cases hx : IsIntegral K x
    · have h₁ : ¬ FiniteDimensional K⟮x⟯ L := fun H ↦ h <| by
        have : FiniteDimensional K K⟮x⟯ := adjoin.finiteDimensional hx
        exact Finite.trans K⟮x⟯ L
      simp [finrank_of_not_finite h₁]
    · rw [norm_eq_one_of_not_module_finite]
      · simp
      · refine fun H ↦ hx ?_
        rw [← isIntegral_gen]
        exact IsIntegral.isIntegral (gen K x)
  let F := K⟮x⟯
  nth_rw 1 [← coe_gen K x]
  rw [← norm_norm (S := F), ← IntermediateField.algebraMap_apply,
    norm_algebraMap_of_basis (Module.Free.chooseBasis F L) (gen K x), map_pow,
    finrank_eq_card_chooseBasisIndex]

name: norm_eq_prod_roots
statement:
theorem norm_eq_prod_roots {x : L} (hF : ((minpoly K x).map (algebraMap K F)).Splits) :
    algebraMap K F (norm K x) =
      ((minpoly K x).aroots F).prod ^ finrank K⟮x⟯ L
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_eq_norm_adjoin K x, map_pow, IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.norm_gen_eq_prod_roots _ hF]

name: norm_eq_prod_embeddings
statement:
theorem norm_eq_prod_embeddings [Algebra.IsSeparable K L] [IsAlgClosed E]
    (x : L) : algebraMap K E (norm K x) = ∏ σ : L →ₐ[K] E, σ x
proof:
:= by
  have hx := Algebra.IsSeparable.isIntegral K x
  rw [norm_eq_norm_adjoin K x, map_pow, ← adjoin.powerBasis_gen hx,
    norm_eq_prod_embeddings_gen E (adjoin.powerBasis hx) (IsAlgClosed.splits _)]
  · exact (prod_embeddings_eq_finrank_pow L (L := K⟮x⟯) E (adjoin.powerBasis hx)).symm
  · have := Algebra.isSeparable_tower_bot_of_isSeparable K K⟮x⟯ L
    exact Algebra.IsSeparable.isSeparable K _

name: norm_eq_prod_automorphisms
statement:
theorem norm_eq_prod_automorphisms [IsGalois K L] (x : L) :
    algebraMap K L (norm K x) = ∏ σ : Gal(L/K), σ x
proof:
:= by
  apply FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective L (AlgebraicClosure L)
  rw [map_prod (algebraMap L (AlgebraicClosure L))]
  rw [← Fintype.prod_equiv (Normal.algHomEquivAut K (AlgebraicClosure L) L)]
  · rw [← norm_eq_prod_embeddings _ _ x, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply]
  · intro σ
    simp only [Normal.algHomEquivAut, AlgHom.restrictNormal', Equiv.coe_fn_mk,
      AlgEquiv.coe_ofBijective, AlgHom.restrictNormal_commutes, algebraMap_self, RingHom.id_apply]

name: PowerBasis.norm_gen_eq_coeff_zero_minpoly
statement:
theorem PowerBasis.norm_gen_eq_coeff_zero_minpoly (pb : PowerBasis R S) :
    norm R pb.gen = (-1) ^ pb.dim * coeff (minpoly R pb.gen) 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_eq_matrix_det pb.basis, det_eq_sign_charpoly_coeff, charpoly_leftMulMatrix,
    Fintype.card_fin]

name: PowerBasis.norm_gen_eq_prod_roots
statement:
theorem PowerBasis.norm_gen_eq_prod_roots [Algebra R F] (pb : PowerBasis R S)
    (hf : ((minpoly R pb.gen).map (algebraMap R F)).Splits) :
    algebraMap R F (norm R pb.gen) = ((minpoly R pb.gen).aroots F).prod
proof:
:= by
  have := Module.nontrivial R F
  have := minpoly.monic pb.isIntegral_gen
  rw [PowerBasis.norm_gen_eq_coeff_zero_minpoly, ← pb.natDegree_minpoly, map_mul,
    ← coeff_map,
    hf.coeff_zero_eq_prod_roots_of_monic (this.map _),
    this.natDegree_map, map_pow, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_pow]
  simp only [map_neg, map_one, neg_mul, neg_neg, one_pow, one_mul]

name: norm_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem norm_zero [Nontrivial S] [Module.Free R S] [Module.Finite R S] : norm R (0 : S) = 0
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality
  rw [norm_apply, coe_lmul_eq_mul, map_zero, LinearMap.det_zero' (Module.Free.chooseBasis R S)]

name: norm_eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem norm_eq_zero_iff [IsDomain R] [IsDomain S] [Module.Free R S] [Module.Finite R S] {x : S} :
    norm R x = 0 ↔ x = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  swap
  · rintro rfl; exact norm_zero
  · let b := Module.Free.chooseBasis R S
    let decEq := Classical.decEq (Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex R S)
    rw [norm_eq_matrix_det b, ← Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff]
    rintro ⟨v, v_ne, hv⟩
    rw [← b.equivFun.apply_symm_apply v, b.equivFun_symm_apply, b.equivFun_apply,
      leftMulMatrix_mulVec_repr] at hv
    refine (mul_eq_zero.mp (b.ext_elem fun i => ?_)).resolve_right (show ∑ i, v i • b i ≠ 0 from ?_)
    · simpa only [map_zero, Pi.zero_apply] using! congr_fun hv i
    · contrapose v_ne with sum_eq
      apply b.equivFun.symm.injective
      rw [b.equivFun_symm_apply, sum_eq, map_zero]

name: norm_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem norm_ne_zero_iff [IsDomain R] [IsDomain S] [Module.Free R S] [Module.Finite R S] {x : S} :
    norm R x ≠ 0 ↔ x ≠ 0
proof: := not_iff_not.mpr norm_eq_zero_iff

name: norm_eq_zero_iff'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem norm_eq_zero_iff' [IsDomain R] [IsDomain S] [Module.Free R S] [Module.Finite R S] {x : S} :
    LinearMap.det (LinearMap.mul R S x) = 0 ↔ x = 0
proof: := norm_eq_zero_iff

name: norm_eq_zero_iff_of_basis
statement:
theorem norm_eq_zero_iff_of_basis [IsDomain R] [IsDomain S] (b : Basis ι R S) {x : S} :
    Algebra.norm R x = 0 ↔ x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have : Module.Free R S := Module.Free.of_basis b
  have : Module.Finite R S := Module.Finite.of_basis b
  exact norm_eq_zero_iff

name: norm_ne_zero_iff_of_basis
statement:
theorem norm_ne_zero_iff_of_basis [IsDomain R] [IsDomain S] (b : Basis ι R S) {x : S} :
    Algebra.norm R x ≠ 0 ↔ x ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  not_iff_not.mpr (norm_eq_zero_iff_of_basis b)

name: norm_inv
statement: theorem norm_inv (x : L) : Algebra.norm K x⁻¹ = (Algebra.norm K x)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · simp [hx]
  exact mul_left_injective₀ (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hx) (by simp [hx, ← map_mul])

name: norm_zpow
statement: theorem norm_zpow (x : L) (n : ℤ) : Algebra.norm K (x ^ n) = Algebra.norm K x ^ n
proof:
:=
  map_zpow' _ norm_inv _ _

name: _root_.IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.norm_gen_eq_one
statement:
theorem _root_.IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.norm_gen_eq_one {x : L} (hx : ¬IsIntegral K x) :
    norm K (AdjoinSimple.gen K x) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_eq_one_of_not_exists_basis]
  contrapose hx
  obtain ⟨s, ⟨b⟩⟩ := hx
  refine .of_mem_of_fg K⟮x⟯.toSubalgebra ?_ x ?_
  · exact (Submodule.fg_iff_finiteDimensional _).mpr (b.finiteDimensional_of_finite)
  · exact IntermediateField.subset_adjoin K _ (Set.mem_singleton x)

name: _root_.IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.norm_gen_eq_prod_roots
statement:
theorem _root_.IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.norm_gen_eq_prod_roots (x : L)
    (hf : ((minpoly K x).map (algebraMap K F)).Splits) :
    (algebraMap K F) (norm K (AdjoinSimple.gen K x)) =
      ((minpoly K x).aroots F).prod
proof:
:= by
  have injKxL := (algebraMap K⟮x⟯ L).injective
  by_cases hx : IsIntegral K x; swap
  · simp [minpoly.eq_zero hx, IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.norm_gen_eq_one hx, aroots_def]
  rw [← adjoin.powerBasis_gen hx, PowerBasis.norm_gen_eq_prod_roots] <;>
    rw [adjoin.powerBasis_gen hx, ← minpoly.algebraMap_eq injKxL] <;>
    simp only [AdjoinSimple.algebraMap_gen _ _, hf]

name: norm_eq_prod_embeddings_gen
statement:
theorem norm_eq_prod_embeddings_gen [Algebra R F] (pb : PowerBasis R S)
    (hE : ((minpoly R pb.gen).map (algebraMap R F)).Splits) (hfx : IsSeparable R pb.gen) :
    algebraMap R F (norm R pb.gen) =
      (@Finset.univ _ (PowerBasis.AlgHom.fintype pb)).prod fun σ => σ pb.gen
proof:
:= by
  let := Classical.decEq F
  rw [PowerBasis.norm_gen_eq_prod_roots pb hE]
  rw [@Fintype.prod_equiv (S →ₐ[R] F) _ _ (PowerBasis.AlgHom.fintype pb) _ _ pb.liftEquiv'
    (fun σ => σ pb.gen) (fun x => x) ?_]
  · rw [Finset.prod_mem_multiset, Finset.prod_eq_multiset_prod, Multiset.toFinset_val,
      Multiset.dedup_eq_self.mpr, Multiset.map_id]
    · exact nodup_roots (.map hfx)
    · intro x; rfl
  · intro σ; simp only [PowerBasis.liftEquiv'_apply_coe]

name: prod_embeddings_eq_finrank_pow
statement:
theorem prod_embeddings_eq_finrank_pow [Algebra L F] [IsScalarTower K L F] [IsAlgClosed E]
    [Algebra.IsSeparable K F] [FiniteDimensional K F] (pb : PowerBasis K L) :
    ∏ σ : F →ₐ[K] E, σ (algebraMap L F pb.gen) =
      ((@Finset.univ _ (PowerBasis.AlgHom.fintype pb)).prod
        fun σ : L →ₐ[K] E => σ pb.gen) ^ finrank L F
proof:
:= by
  have : FiniteDimensional L F := FiniteDimensional.right K L F
  have : Algebra.IsSeparable L F := Algebra.isSeparable_tower_top_of_isSeparable K L F
  let : Fintype (L →ₐ[K] E) := PowerBasis.AlgHom.fintype pb
  rw [Fintype.prod_equiv algHomEquivSigma (fun σ : F →ₐ[K] E => _) fun σ => σ.1 pb.gen,
    ← Finset.univ_sigma_univ, Finset.prod_sigma, ← Finset.prod_pow]
  · refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun σ _ => ?_
    let : Algebra L E := σ.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    simp_rw [Finset.prod_const]
    congr
    exact AlgHom.card L F E
  · intro σ
    simp only [algHomEquivSigma, Equiv.coe_fn_mk, AlgHom.domRestrict, AlgHom.comp_apply,
      IsScalarTower.coe_toAlgHom']

name: norm_eq_of_algEquiv
statement:
lemma norm_eq_of_algEquiv [Ring T] [Algebra R T] (e : S ≃ₐ[R] T) (x) :
    Algebra.norm R (e x) = Algebra.norm R x
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Algebra.norm_apply, ← LinearMap.det_conj _ e.toLinearEquiv]; congr; ext; simp

name: norm_eq_of_ringEquiv
statement:
lemma norm_eq_of_ringEquiv {A B C : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Ring C]
    [Algebra A C] [Algebra B C] (e : A ≃+* B) (he : (algebraMap B C).comp e = algebraMap A C)
    (x : C) :
    e (Algebra.norm A x) = Algebra.norm B x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases h : ∃ s : Finset C, Nonempty (Basis s B C)
  · obtain ⟨s, ⟨b⟩⟩ := h
    let : Algebra A B := RingHom.toAlgebra e
    let : IsScalarTower A B C := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' he.symm
    rw [Algebra.norm_eq_matrix_det b,
      Algebra.norm_eq_matrix_det (b.mapCoeffs e.symm (by simp [Algebra.smul_def, ← he])),
      e.map_det]
    congr
    ext i j
    simp [leftMulMatrix_apply, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply]
  rw [norm_eq_one_of_not_exists_basis _ h, norm_eq_one_of_not_exists_basis, map_one]
  intro ⟨s, ⟨b⟩⟩
  exact h ⟨s, ⟨b.mapCoeffs e (by simp [Algebra.smul_def, ← he])⟩⟩

name: norm_eq_of_equiv_equiv
statement:
lemma norm_eq_of_equiv_equiv {A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ : Type*} [CommRing A₁] [Ring B₁]
    [CommRing A₂] [Ring B₂] [Algebra A₁ B₁] [Algebra A₂ B₂] (e₁ : A₁ ≃+* A₂) (e₂ : B₁ ≃+* B₂)
    (he : RingHom.comp (algebraMap A₂ B₂) ↑e₁ = RingHom.comp ↑e₂ (algebraMap A₁ B₁)) (x) :
    Algebra.norm A₁ x = e₁.symm (Algebra.norm A₂ (e₂ x))
proof:
:= by
  let := (RingHom.comp (e₂ : B₁ →+* B₂) (algebraMap A₁ B₁)).toAlgebra' ?_
  · let e' : B₁ ≃ₐ[A₁] B₂ := { e₂ with commutes' := fun _ ↦ rfl }
    rw [← Algebra.norm_eq_of_ringEquiv e₁ he, ← Algebra.norm_eq_of_algEquiv e']
    simp [e']
  intro c x
  apply e₂.symm.injective
  simp only [RingHom.coe_comp, RingHom.coe_coe, Function.comp_apply, map_mul,
    RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply, commutes]

name: norm_apply
statement: theorem norm_apply (x : S) : norm R x = LinearMap.det (lmul R S x)
proof: := rfl

name: norm_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem norm_self : Algebra.norm R = MonoidHom.id R
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp [norm_apply]

name: norm_eq_one_of_not_exists_basis
statement:
theorem norm_eq_one_of_not_exists_basis (h : ¬∃ s : Finset S, Nonempty (Basis s R S)) (x : S) :
    norm R x = 1
proof: := by rw [norm_apply, LinearMap.det]; split_ifs <;> trivial

name: norm_eq_one_of_not_module_finite
statement: theorem norm_eq_one_of_not_module_finite (h : ¬Module.Finite R S) (x : S) : norm R x = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine norm_eq_one_of_not_exists_basis _ (mt ?_ h) _
  rintro ⟨s, ⟨b⟩⟩
  exact Module.Finite.of_basis b

name: norm_eq_matrix_det
statement:
theorem norm_eq_matrix_det [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (b : Basis ι R S) (s : S) :
    norm R s = Matrix.det (Algebra.leftMulMatrix b s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_apply, ← LinearMap.det_toMatrix b, ← toMatrix_lmul_eq]; rfl

name: norm_algebraMap_of_basis

theorem norm_algebraMap_of_basis [Fintype ι] (b : Basis ι R S) (x : R) :

:= by
  have := Classical.decEq ι

  simp

name: norm_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem norm_algebraMap (x : R) : norm R (algebraMap R S x) = x ^ finrank R S

statement: lemma op_iff {c : RingCon R} {x y : Rᵐᵒᵖ} : c.op x y ↔ c y.unop x.unop

name: RingConGen.Rel.star
statement:
theorem RingConGen.Rel.star (hr : ∀ a b, r a b → r (star a) (star b))
    ⦃a b : R⦄ : Rel r a b → Rel r (star a) (star b)
  | refl _ => .refl _
  | symm h => .symm <| h.star hr
  | trans h1 h2 => .trans  (h1.star hr) (h2.star hr)
  | of _ _ h => .of _ _ (hr _ _ h)
  | mul h1 h2 => by
    rw [star_mul, star_mul]
    exact (h2.star hr).mul (h1.star hr)
  | add h1 h2 => by
    rw [star_add, star_add]
    exact (h1.star hr).add (h2.star hr)

theorem ringConGen_star (hr : ∀ a b, r a b → r (star a) (star b)) ⦃a b : R⦄ :

name: le_ringConGen
statement: theorem le_ringConGen {r : R → R → Prop} : r ≤ ⇑(ringConGen r)
proof:

  RingConGen.Rel.of

name: ringConGen_eq
statement:
theorem ringConGen_eq (r : R → R → Prop) :
    ringConGen r = sInf {s : RingCon R | ∀ x y, r x y → s x y}
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm
    (fun _x _y H =>
      RingConGen.Rel.recOn H (fun _ _ h _ hs => hs _ _ h) (RingCon.refl _)
        (fun _ => RingCon.symm _) (fun _ _ => RingCon.trans _)
        (fun _ _ h1 h2 c hc => c.add (h1 c hc) <| h2 c hc)
        (fun _ _ h1 h2 c hc => c.mul (h1 c hc) <| h2 c hc))
    (sInf_le le_ringConGen)

name: ringConGen_le
statement: theorem ringConGen_le {r : R → R → Prop} {c : RingCon R} : ringConGen r ≤ c ↔ r ≤ ⇑c
proof:
:=
  ⟨le_trans le_ringConGen, ringConGen_eq r ▸ fun h => sInf_le h⟩

name: le_comap_ringConGen
statement:
theorem le_comap_ringConGen {F} [FunLike F R' R] [MulHomClass F R' R] [AddHomClass F R' R]
    (r : R → R → Prop) (f : F) :
    ringConGen (r on f) ≤ (ringConGen r).comap f
proof:
:=
  ringConGen_le.2 fun _ _ h => RingConGen.Rel.of _ _ h

name: comap_injective
statement:
theorem comap_injective {F} [FunLike F R' R] [MulHomClass F R' R] [AddHomClass F R' R]
    (f : F) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    Function.Injective (comap · f)
proof:
:=
  .of_comp (f := toCon) <| (Con.comap_injective f hf <| map_mul f).comp toCon_injective

name: comap_ringConGen_ringEquiv
statement:
theorem comap_ringConGen_ringEquiv {R R'} [NonAssocSemiring R] [NonAssocSemiring R']
    (r : R' → R' → Prop) (f : R ≃+* R') :
    (ringConGen r).comap f = ringConGen (r on f)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (le_comap_ringConGen _ _)
  trans (ringConGen (r on ⇑f) |>.comap f.symm.toNonUnitalRingHom).comap f.toNonUnitalRingHom
  · apply comap_mono
    grw [← le_comap_ringConGen]
    gcongr
    simp [Function.onFun, RingEquiv.coe_toNonUnitalRingHom']
  · rw [← comap_nonUnitalRingHomComp]
    simp

:=
  c.toAddCon.coe_dfinsuppSumAddHom h f

name: mapGen_eq_map_of_surjective
statement:
theorem mapGen_eq_map_of_surjective
    {c : RingCon M} (f : M →+* N) (h : ker f ≤ c) (hf : Surjective f) :
    c.mapGen f = Relation.Map c f f
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ <| (RingCon.gi N).gc.le_u_l _
  have := Relation.map_equivalence c.toSetoid.2 _ hf h
  intro _ _ hg
  induction hg with
  | of _ _ a => exact a
  | refl x => exact this.refl x
  | symm _ h => exact this.symm h
  | trans _ _ h₁ h₂ => exact this.trans h₁ h₂
  | add _ _ h₁ h₂ =>
    rcases h₁ with ⟨a, b, h1, rfl, rfl⟩
    rcases h₂ with ⟨p, q, h2, rfl, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨a + p, b + q, c.add h1 h2, map_add f _ _, map_add f _ _⟩
  | mul _ _ h₁ h₂ =>
    rcases h₁ with ⟨a, b, h1, rfl, rfl⟩
    rcases h₂ with ⟨p, q, h2, rfl, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨a * p, b * q, c.mul h1 h2, map_mul f _ _, map_mul f _ _⟩

    c.mapGen f (f x) (f y) ↔ c x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [mapGen_eq_map_of_surjective f h hf, Relation.map_apply]
  refine ⟨fun ⟨a, b, h₁, h₂, h₃⟩ ↦ ?_, by grind⟩
  exact c.trans (h h₂.symm) <| c.trans h₁ <| h h₃

name: zero_smul
statement: protected theorem zero_smul (x : X[S⁻¹]) : (0 : R[S⁻¹]) • x = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction x with | _ r s
  rw [OreLocalization.zero_def, oreDiv_smul_char 0 r 1 s 0 1 (by simp)]; simp

name: add_smul
statement:
protected theorem add_smul (y z : R[S⁻¹]) (x : X[S⁻¹]) :
    (y + z) • x = y • x + z • x
proof:
:= by
  induction x with | _ r₁ s₁
  induction y with | _ r₂ s₂
  induction z with | _ r₃ s₃
  rcases oreDivAddChar' r₂ r₃ s₂ s₃ with ⟨ra, sa, ha, q⟩
  rw [q]
  clear q
  rw [OreLocalization.expand' r₂ s₂ sa]
  rcases oreDivSMulChar' (sa • r₂) r₁ (sa * s₂) s₁ with ⟨rb, sb, hb, q⟩
  rw [q]
  clear q
  have hs₃rasb : sb * ra * s₃ ∈ S := by
    rw [mul_assoc, ← ha]
    norm_cast
    apply SetLike.coe_mem
  rw [OreLocalization.expand _ _ _ hs₃rasb]
  have ha' : ↑((sb * sa) * s₂) = sb * ra * s₃ := by simp [ha, mul_assoc]
  rw [← Subtype.coe_eq_of_eq_mk ha']
  rcases oreDivSMulChar' ((sb * ra) • r₃) r₁ (sb * sa * s₂) s₁ with ⟨rc, sc, hc, hc'⟩
  rw [hc']
  rw [oreDiv_add_char _ _ 1 sc (by simp [mul_assoc])]
  rw [OreLocalization.expand' (sa • r₂ + ra • r₃) (sa * s₂) (sc * sb)]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul, one_smul, Submonoid.smul_def, mul_add, Submonoid.coe_mul] at hb hc ⊢
  rw [mul_assoc, hb, mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc _ ra, hc, ← mul_assoc, ← add_mul]
  rw [OreLocalization.smul_cancel']
  simp only [add_smul, ← mul_assoc, smul_smul]

statement:

lemma nsmul_eq_nsmul (n : ℕ) (x : X[S⁻¹]) :
    letI inst
proof:
:= OreLocalization.instModuleOfIsScalarTower (R₀ := ℕ) (R := R) (X := X) (S := S)
    HSMul.hSMul (self := @instHSMul _ _ inst.toSMul) n x = n • x := by
  let inst := OreLocalization.instModuleOfIsScalarTower (R₀ := ℕ) (R := R) (X := X) (S := S)
  exact congr($(AddCommMonoid.uniqueNatModule.2 inst).smul n x)

statement:
@[simp]
lemma zsmul_eq_zsmul (n : ℤ) (x : X[S⁻¹]) :
    letI inst
proof:
:= OreLocalization.instModuleOfIsScalarTower (R₀ := ℤ) (R := R) (X := X) (S := S)
    HSMul.hSMul (self := @instHSMul _ _ inst.toSMul) n x = n • x := by
  let inst := OreLocalization.instModuleOfIsScalarTower (R₀ := ℤ) (R := R) (X := X) (S := S)
  exact congr($(AddCommGroup.uniqueIntModule.2 inst).smul n x)

name: numeratorHom_inj
statement:
theorem numeratorHom_inj (hS : S ≤ nonZeroDivisorsLeft R) :
    Function.Injective (numeratorHom : R → R[S⁻¹])
proof:
:=
  fun r₁ r₂ h => by
  rw [numeratorHom_apply, numeratorHom_apply, oreDiv_eq_iff] at h
  rcases h with ⟨u, v, h₁, h₂⟩
  simp only [S.coe_one, mul_one, Submonoid.smul_def, smul_eq_mul] at h₁ h₂
  rw [← h₂, ← sub_eq_zero, ← mul_sub] at h₁
  exact (sub_eq_zero.mp (hS u.2 _ h₁)).symm

name: nonempty_oreSet_iff
statement:
lemma nonempty_oreSet_iff {R : Type*} [Monoid R] {S : Submonoid R} :
    Nonempty (OreSet S) ↔ (∀ (r₁ r₂ : R) (s : S), r₁ * s = r₂ * s → ∃ s' : S, s' * r₁ = s' * r₂) ∧
      (∀ (r : R) (s : S), ∃ (r' : R) (s' : S), s' * r = r' * s)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact fun ⟨_⟩ ↦ ⟨ore_right_cancel, fun r s ↦ ⟨oreNum r s, oreDenom r s, ore_eq r s⟩⟩
  · intro ⟨H, H'⟩
    choose r' s' h using H'
    exact ⟨H, r', s', h⟩

name: nonempty_oreSet_iff_of_noZeroDivisors
statement:
lemma nonempty_oreSet_iff_of_noZeroDivisors {R : Type*} [Ring R] [NoZeroDivisors R]
    {S : Submonoid R} :
    Nonempty (OreSet S) ↔ ∀ (r : R) (s : S), ∃ (r' : R) (s' : S), s' * r = r' * s
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact fun ⟨_⟩ ↦ fun r s ↦ ⟨oreNum r s, oreDenom r s, ore_eq r s⟩
  · intro H
    choose r' s' h using H
    exact ⟨oreSetOfNoZeroDivisors r' s' h⟩

name: zero_oreDiv'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero_oreDiv' (s : S) : (0 : R) /ₒ s = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [OreLocalization.zero_def, oreDiv_eq_iff]
  exact ⟨s, 1, by simp [Submonoid.smul_def]⟩

name: subsingleton_iff
statement:
theorem subsingleton_iff :
    Subsingleton R[S⁻¹] ↔ 0 ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  rw [← subsingleton_iff_zero_eq_one, OreLocalization.one_def,
    OreLocalization.zero_def, oreDiv_eq_iff]
  simp

name: nontrivial_iff
statement:
theorem nontrivial_iff :
    Nontrivial R[S⁻¹] ↔ 0 ∉ S
proof:
:= by
  rw [← not_subsingleton_iff_nontrivial, subsingleton_iff]

name: add''_char
proof:
:= by
  simp only [add'']
  have ha := ore_eq (s₁ : R) s₂
  generalize oreNum (s₁ : R) s₂ = ra at *
  generalize oreDenom (s₁ : R) s₂ = sa at *
  rw [oreDiv_eq_iff]
  rcases oreCondition sb sa with ⟨rc, sc, hc⟩
  have : sc * rb * s₂ = rc * ra * s₂ := by
    rw [mul_assoc rc, ← ha, ← mul_assoc, ← hc, mul_assoc, mul_assoc, hb]
  rcases ore_right_cancel _ _ s₂ this with ⟨sd, hd⟩
  use sd * sc
  use sd * rc
  simp only [smul_add, smul_smul, Submonoid.smul_def, Submonoid.coe_mul]
  constructor
  · rw [mul_assoc _ _ rb, hd, mul_assoc, hc, mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
  · rw [mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc (sc : R), hc, mul_assoc, mul_assoc]

name: oreDiv_add_oreDiv
statement:
theorem oreDiv_add_oreDiv {r r' : X} {s s' : S} :
    r /ₒ s + r' /ₒ s' =
      (oreDenom (s : R) s' • r + oreNum (s : R) s' • r') /ₒ (oreDenom (s : R) s' * s)
proof:
:= by
  with_unfolding_all rfl

name: oreDiv_add_char'
statement:
theorem oreDiv_add_char' {r r' : X} (s s' : S) (rb : R) (sb : R)
    (h : sb * s = rb * s') (h' : sb * s ∈ S) :
    r /ₒ s + r' /ₒ s' = (sb • r + rb • r') /ₒ ⟨sb * s, h'⟩
proof:
:= by
  with_unfolding_all exact add''_char r s r' s' rb sb h h'

name: oreDiv_add_char
statement:
theorem oreDiv_add_char {r r' : X} (s s' : S) (rb : R) (sb : S) (h : sb * s = rb * s') :
    r /ₒ s + r' /ₒ s' = (sb • r + rb • r') /ₒ (sb * s)
proof:
:=
  oreDiv_add_char' s s' rb sb h (sb * s).2

name: add_oreDiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem add_oreDiv {r r' : X} {s : S} : r /ₒ s + r' /ₒ s = (r + r') /ₒ s
proof:
:= by
  simp [oreDiv_add_char s s 1 1 (by simp)]

name: add_assoc
statement: protected theorem add_assoc (x y z : X[S⁻¹]) : x + y + z = x + (y + z)
proof:
:= by
  induction x with | _ r₁ s₁
  induction y with | _ r₂ s₂
  induction z with | _ r₃ s₃
  rcases oreDivAddChar' r₁ r₂ s₁ s₂ with ⟨ra, sa, ha, ha'⟩; rw [ha']; clear ha'
  rcases oreDivAddChar' (sa • r₁ + ra • r₂) r₃ (sa * s₁) s₃ with ⟨rc, sc, hc, q⟩; rw [q]; clear q
  simp only [smul_add, add_assoc]
  simp_rw [← add_oreDiv, ← OreLocalization.expand']
  congr 2
  · rw [OreLocalization.expand r₂ s₂ ra (ha.symm ▸ (sa * s₁).2)]; congr; ext; exact ha
  · rw [OreLocalization.expand r₃ s₃ rc (hc.symm ▸ (sc * (sa * s₁)).2)]; congr; ext; exact hc

name: zero_oreDiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero_oreDiv (s : S) : (0 : X) /ₒ s = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [OreLocalization.zero_def, oreDiv_eq_iff]
  exact ⟨s, 1, by simp⟩

name: zero_add
statement: protected theorem zero_add (x : X[S⁻¹]) : 0 + x = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x
  rw [← zero_oreDiv, add_oreDiv]; simp

name: add_zero
statement: protected theorem add_zero (x : X[S⁻¹]) : x + 0 = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x
  rw [← zero_oreDiv, add_oreDiv]; simp

name: smul_zero
statement: protected theorem smul_zero (x : R[S⁻¹]) : x • (0 : X[S⁻¹]) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction x with | _ r s
  rw [OreLocalization.zero_def, smul_div_one, smul_zero, zero_oreDiv, zero_oreDiv]

name: smul_add
statement:
protected theorem smul_add (z : R[S⁻¹]) (x y : X[S⁻¹]) :
    z • (x + y) = z • x + z • y
proof:
:= by
  induction x with | _ r₁ s₁
  induction y with | _ r₂ s₂
  induction z with | _ r₃ s₃
  rcases oreDivAddChar' r₁ r₂ s₁ s₂ with ⟨ra, sa, ha, ha'⟩; rw [ha']; clear ha'; norm_cast at ha
  rw [OreLocalization.expand' r₁ s₁ sa]
  rw [OreLocalization.expand r₂ s₂ ra (by rw [← ha]; apply SetLike.coe_mem)]
  rw [← Subtype.coe_eq_of_eq_mk ha]
  repeat rw [oreDiv_smul_oreDiv]
  simp only [smul_add, add_oreDiv]

name: add_comm
statement: protected theorem add_comm (x y : X[S⁻¹]) : x + y = y + x
proof:
:= by
  induction x with | _ r s
  induction y with | _ r' s'
  rcases oreDivAddChar' r r' s s' with ⟨ra, sa, ha, ha'⟩
  rw [ha', oreDiv_add_char' s' s _ _ ha.symm (ha ▸ (sa * s).2), add_comm]
  congr; ext; exact ha

name: neg_def
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem neg_def (r : X) (s : S) : -(r /ₒ s) = -r /ₒ s
proof:
:= by

statement: protected theorem neg_add_cancel (x : X[S⁻¹]) : -x + x = 0

statement: theorem cardinalMk (hS : S ≤ nonZeroDivisorsLeft R) : #(OreLocalization S R) = #R

statement:

name: inv_def
statement:
protected theorem inv_def {r : R} {s : R⁰} :
    (r /ₒ s)⁻¹ =
      if hr : r = (0 : R) then (0 : R[R⁰⁻¹])
      else s /ₒ ⟨r, mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero hr⟩
proof:
:= by

name: mul_inv_cancel
statement: protected theorem mul_inv_cancel (x : R[R⁰⁻¹]) (h : x ≠ 0) : x * x⁻¹ = 1
proof:
:= by
  induction x with | _ r s
  rw [OreLocalization.inv_def, OreLocalization.one_def]
  have hr : r ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    simp at h
  simp only [hr]
  with_unfolding_all apply OreLocalization.mul_inv ⟨r, _⟩

name: inv_zero
statement: protected theorem inv_zero : (0 : R[R⁰⁻¹])⁻¹ = 0
proof:

name: fg_unit
statement:
theorem fg_unit {R A : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [Semiring A] [Algebra R A] (I : (Submodule R A)ˣ) :
    (I : Submodule R A).FG
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, T', hT, hT', one_mem⟩ := mem_span_mul_finite_of_mem_mul (I.mul_inv ▸ one_le.mp le_rfl)
  refine ⟨T, span_eq_of_le _ hT ?_⟩
  rw [← one_mul I, ← mul_one (span R (T : Set A))]
  conv_rhs => rw [← I.inv_mul, ← mul_assoc]
  grw [← span_le.mpr hT', Units.val_mul, Units.val_one, span_mul_span, one_le.2 one_mem]

name: FG.map
statement:
theorem FG.map₂ (f : M →ₗ[R] N →ₗ[R] P) {p : Submodule R M} {q : Submodule R N} (hp : p.FG)

proof:
:=
  let ⟨sm, hfm, hm⟩ := fg_def.1 hp
  let ⟨sn, hfn, hn⟩ := fg_def.1 hq
  fg_def.2
    ⟨Set.image2 (fun m n => f m n) sm sn, hfm.image2 _ hfn,
      map₂_span_span R f sm sn ▸ hm ▸ hn ▸ rfl⟩

name: Module.End.isNilpotent_iff_of_finite
statement:
theorem Module.End.isNilpotent_iff_of_finite [Module.Finite R M] {f : End R M} :
    IsNilpotent f ↔ ∀ m : M, ∃ n : ℕ, (f ^ n) m = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨n, hn⟩ m ↦ ⟨n, by simp [hn]⟩, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  rcases Module.Finite.fg_top (R := R) (M := M) with ⟨S, hS⟩
  choose g hg using h
  use Finset.sup S g
  ext m
  have hm : m ∈ Submodule.span R S := by simp [hS]
  induction hm using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx => exact pow_map_zero_of_le (Finset.le_sup hx) (hg x)
  | zero => simp
  | add => simp_all
  | smul => simp_all

statement:
@[simp]
theorem isNilpotent_transpose_iff :
    IsNilpotent Aᵀ ↔ IsNilpotent A
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [IsNilpotent, ← transpose_pow, transpose_eq_zero]

name: isNilpotent_iff
statement:
theorem isNilpotent_iff :
    IsNilpotent A ↔ ∀ v, ∃ n : ℕ, A ^ n *ᵥ v = 0
proof:

    toLin'_apply]

name: isNilpotent_iff_forall_row
statement:
theorem isNilpotent_iff_forall_row :
    IsNilpotent A ↔ ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, (A ^ n).row i = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isNilpotent_transpose_iff, isNilpotent_iff]
  refine ⟨fun h i ↦ ?_, fun h v ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := h (Pi.single i 1)
    exact ⟨n, by simpa [← transpose_pow] using hn⟩
  · choose n hn using h
    suffices ∀ i, (A ^ ⨆ j, n j) i = 0 from ⟨⨆ j, n j, by simp [mulVec_eq_sum, this]⟩
    exact fun i ↦ pow_row_eq_zero_of_le (hn i) (Finite.le_ciSup n i)

statement:

    IsNilpotent A ↔ ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, (A ^ n).col i = 0
proof:

  rw [← isNilpotent_transpose_iff, isNilpotent_iff_forall_row]
  simp_rw [← transpose_pow, row_transpose]

name: Module.Finite.exists_free_surjective
statement:
lemma Module.Finite.exists_free_surjective [Module.Finite R S] :
    ∃ (S' : Type u) (_ : CommRing S') (_ : Algebra R S') (_ : Module.Finite R S')
      (_ : Module.Free R S') (_ : Algebra.FinitePresentation R S')
      (f : S' →ₐ[R] S), Function.Surjective f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : (⊤ : Submodule R S).FG := Module.finite_def.mp inferInstance
  suffices h : ∃ (S' : Type u) (_ : CommRing S') (_ : Algebra R S') (_ : Module.Finite R S')
      (_ : Module.Free R S') (_ : Algebra.FinitePresentation R S')
      (f : S' →ₐ[R] S), (s : Set S) ⊆ AlgHom.range f by
    obtain ⟨S', _, _, _, _, _, f, hsf⟩ := h
    have hf : Function.Surjective f := by
      have := (Submodule.span_le (p := LinearMap.range f.toLinearMap)).mpr hsf
      rwa [hs, top_le_iff, LinearMap.range_eq_top] at this
    use S', ‹_›, ‹_›, ‹_›, ‹_›, ‹_›, f
  clear hs
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty =>
    exact ⟨R, _, _, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, Algebra.ofId R S, by simp⟩
  | insert a s has IH =>
    obtain ⟨S', _, _, _, _, _, f, hsf⟩ := IH
    have ha := Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral (R := R) a
    have := ((minpoly.monic ha).map (algebraMap R S')).finite_adjoinRoot
    have := ((minpoly.monic ha).map (algebraMap R S')).free_adjoinRoot
    algebraize [f.toRingHom]
    refine ⟨AdjoinRoot ((minpoly R a).map (algebraMap R S')), inferInstance, inferInstance,
      .trans S' _, .trans (S := S'), .trans _ S' _,
      (AdjoinRoot.liftAlgHom _ (Algebra.ofId _ _) a
        (by simp [← Polynomial.aeval_def])).restrictScalars R, ?_⟩
    simp only [Finset.coe_insert, AlgHom.coe_range, AlgHom.coe_restrictScalars',
      Set.insert_subset_iff, Set.mem_range]
    exact ⟨⟨.root _, by simp⟩, hsf.trans fun y ⟨x, hx⟩ ↦ ⟨.of _ x, by simpa⟩⟩

name: Module.FinitePresentation.of_finite_of_finitePresentation
statement:
@[stacks 0564 "The case M = S"]
lemma Module.FinitePresentation.of_finite_of_finitePresentation
    [Module.Finite R S] [Algebra.FinitePresentation R S] :
    Module.FinitePresentation R S
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R', _, _, _, _, _, f, hf⟩ := Module.Finite.exists_free_surjective R S
  let := f.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower R R' S := .of_algebraMap_eq' f.comp_algebraMap.symm
  have : Module.FinitePresentation R R' :=
    Module.finitePresentation_of_projective R R'
  have : Module.FinitePresentation R' S :=
    Module.finitePresentation_of_surjective (Algebra.linearMap R' S) hf
      (Algebra.FinitePresentation.ker_fG_of_surjective f hf)
  exact .trans R S R'
