name: integers
statement:
theorem integers : (valuation A K).Integers A where
  hom_inj
proof:
:= IsFractionRing.injective A K
  map_le_one a := (mem_integer_iff _ _ _).mpr ⟨a, rfl⟩
  exists_of_le_one _ h := (mem_integer_iff _ _ _).mp h

name: _root_.PreValuationRing.iff_dvd_total
statement:
theorem _root_.PreValuationRing.iff_dvd_total [Semigroup R] :
    PreValuationRing R ↔ @Std.Total R (· ∣ ·)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun H => ⟨fun a b => ?_⟩, fun H => ⟨fun a b => ?_⟩⟩
  · obtain ⟨c, rfl | rfl⟩ := PreValuationRing.cond a b <;> simp
  · obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ | ⟨c, rfl⟩ := H.total a b <;> use c <;> simp

name: _root_.PreValuationRing.iff_ideal_total
statement:
theorem _root_.PreValuationRing.iff_ideal_total [CommRing R] :
    PreValuationRing R ↔ @Std.Total (Ideal R) (· ≤ ·)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun _ => ⟨le_total⟩, fun H => PreValuationRing.iff_dvd_total.mpr ⟨fun a b => ?_⟩⟩
  have := H.total (Ideal.span {a}) (Ideal.span {b})
  simp_rw [Ideal.span_singleton_le_span_singleton] at this
  exact this.symm

name: dvd_total
statement: theorem dvd_total [Semigroup R] [h : PreValuationRing R] (x y : R) : x ∣ y ∨ y ∣ x
proof:
:=
  (PreValuationRing.iff_dvd_total.mp h).total x y

name: iff_dvd_total
statement: theorem iff_dvd_total : ValuationRing R ↔ @Std.Total R (· ∣ ·)
proof:
:=
  Iff.trans (⟨fun inst ↦ inst.toPreValuationRing, fun _ ↦ .mk⟩)
    PreValuationRing.iff_dvd_total

name: iff_ideal_total
statement: theorem iff_ideal_total : ValuationRing R ↔ @Std.Total (Ideal R) (· ≤ ·)
proof:
:=
  Iff.trans (⟨fun inst ↦ inst.toPreValuationRing, fun _ ↦ .mk⟩)
    PreValuationRing.iff_ideal_total

name: unique_irreducible
statement:
theorem unique_irreducible [PreValuationRing R] ⦃p q : R⦄ (hp : Irreducible p)
    (hq : Irreducible q) : Associated p q
proof:
:= by
  have := dvd_total p q
  rw [Irreducible.dvd_comm hp hq, or_self_iff] at this
  exact associated_of_dvd_dvd (Irreducible.dvd_symm hq hp this) this

name: iff_isInteger_or_isInteger
statement:
theorem iff_isInteger_or_isInteger :
    ValuationRing R ↔ ∀ x : K, IsLocalization.IsInteger R x ∨ IsLocalization.IsInteger R x⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro H x
    obtain ⟨x : R, y, hy, rfl⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective R x
    have := (map_ne_zero_iff _ (IsFractionRing.injective R K)).mpr (nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero hy)
    obtain ⟨s, rfl | rfl⟩ := ValuationRing.cond x y
    · exact Or.inr
        ⟨s, eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left <| by rwa [mul_div, div_eq_one_iff_eq, map_mul, mul_comm]⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨s, by rwa [eq_div_iff, map_mul, mul_comm]⟩
  · intro H
    suffices PreValuationRing R from mk
    constructor
    intro a b
    by_cases ha : a = 0; · subst ha; exact ⟨0, Or.inr <| mul_zero b⟩
    by_cases hb : b = 0; · subst hb; exact ⟨0, Or.inl <| mul_zero a⟩
    replace ha := (map_ne_zero_iff _ (IsFractionRing.injective R K)).mpr ha
    replace hb := (map_ne_zero_iff _ (IsFractionRing.injective R K)).mpr hb
    obtain ⟨c, e⟩ | ⟨c, e⟩ := H (algebraMap R K a / algebraMap R K b)
    · rw [eq_div_iff hb, ← map_mul, (IsFractionRing.injective R K).eq_iff, mul_comm] at e
      exact ⟨c, Or.inr e⟩
    · rw [inv_div, eq_div_iff ha, ← map_mul, (IsFractionRing.injective R K).eq_iff, mul_comm c] at e
      exact ⟨c, Or.inl e⟩

name: isInteger_or_isInteger
statement:
theorem isInteger_or_isInteger [h : ValuationRing R] (x : K) :
    IsLocalization.IsInteger R x ∨ IsLocalization.IsInteger R x⁻¹
proof:
:=
  (iff_isInteger_or_isInteger R K).mp h x

name: iff_local_bezout_domain
statement: theorem iff_local_bezout_domain : ValuationRing R ↔ IsLocalRing R ∧ IsBezout R
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ ↦ ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩, fun ⟨_, _⟩ ↦ inferInstance⟩

name: TFAE
statement:
protected theorem TFAE (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] :
    List.TFAE
      [ValuationRing R,
        ∀ x : FractionRing R, IsLocalization.IsInteger R x ∨ IsLocalization.IsInteger R x⁻¹,
        @Std.Total R (· ∣ ·), @Std.Total (Ideal R) (· ≤ ·), IsLocalRing R ∧ IsBezout R]
proof:
:= by
  tfae_have 1 ↔ 2 := iff_isInteger_or_isInteger R _
  tfae_have 1 ↔ 3 := iff_dvd_total
  tfae_have 1 ↔ 4 := iff_ideal_total
  tfae_have 1 ↔ 5 := iff_local_bezout_domain
  tfae_finish

name: _root_.Function.Surjective.preValuationRing
statement:
theorem _root_.Function.Surjective.preValuationRing {R S : Type*} [Mul R] [PreValuationRing R]
    [Mul S] (f : R →ₙ* S) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    PreValuationRing S
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun a b => by
    obtain ⟨⟨a, rfl⟩, ⟨b, rfl⟩⟩ := hf a, hf b
    obtain ⟨c, rfl | rfl⟩ := PreValuationRing.cond a b
    exacts [⟨f c, Or.inl <| (map_mul _ _ _).symm⟩, ⟨f c, Or.inr <| (map_mul _ _ _).symm⟩]⟩

name: _root_.Function.Surjective.valuationRing
statement:
theorem _root_.Function.Surjective.valuationRing {R S : Type*} [NonAssocSemiring R]
    [PreValuationRing R] [CommRing S] [IsDomain S] (f : R →+* S) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    ValuationRing S
proof:
:=
  have : PreValuationRing S := Function.Surjective.preValuationRing (R := R) f hf
  .mk

name: _root_.isFractionRing_of_exists_eq_algebraMap_or_inv_eq_algebraMap_of_injective
statement:
lemma _root_.isFractionRing_of_exists_eq_algebraMap_or_inv_eq_algebraMap_of_injective
    (h : ∀ (x : K), ∃ a : 𝒪, x = algebraMap 𝒪 K a ∨ x⁻¹ = algebraMap 𝒪 K a)
    (hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap 𝒪 K)) :
    IsFractionRing 𝒪 K
proof:
:= by
  have : IsDomain 𝒪 := hinj.isDomain
  have := (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective ..).2 hinj
  have := IsDomain.of_faithfulSMul 𝒪 K
  refine ⟨by simp, ?_, fun hab ↦ ⟨1, by simpa using hab⟩⟩
  intro x
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := h x
  by_cases h0 : a = 0
  · refine ⟨⟨0, 1⟩, by simpa [h0, eq_comm] using ha⟩
  · have : algebraMap 𝒪 K a ≠ 0 := by simpa using h0
    rw [inv_eq_iff_eq_inv, ← one_div, eq_div_iff this] at ha
    cases ha with
    | inl ha => exact ⟨⟨a, 1⟩, by simpa⟩
    | inr ha => exact ⟨⟨1, ⟨a, mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero h0⟩⟩, by simpa using ha⟩

name: _root_.Valuation.Integers.isFractionRing
statement:
lemma _root_.Valuation.Integers.isFractionRing {v : Valuation K Γ} (hv : v.Integers 𝒪) :
    IsFractionRing 𝒪 K
proof:
:=
  isFractionRing_of_exists_eq_algebraMap_or_inv_eq_algebraMap_of_injective
    hv.eq_algebraMap_or_inv_eq_algebraMap hv.hom_inj

name: of_integers
statement:
theorem of_integers (v : Valuation K Γ) (hh : v.Integers 𝒪) :
    haveI
proof:
:= hh.hom_inj.isDomain
    ValuationRing 𝒪 := by
  have := hh.hom_inj.isDomain
  suffices PreValuationRing 𝒪 from .mk
  constructor
  intro a b
  rcases le_total (v (algebraMap 𝒪 K a)) (v (algebraMap 𝒪 K b)) with h | h
  · obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Valuation.Integers.dvd_of_le hh h
    use c; exact Or.inr hc.symm
  · obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Valuation.Integers.dvd_of_le hh h
    use c; exact Or.inl hc.symm

name: isFractionRing_iff
statement:
theorem isFractionRing_iff [IsDomain 𝒪] [ValuationRing 𝒪] :
    IsFractionRing 𝒪 K ↔
      (∀ (x : K), ∃ a : 𝒪, x = algebraMap 𝒪 K a ∨ x⁻¹ = algebraMap 𝒪 K a) ∧
        Function.Injective (algebraMap 𝒪 K)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨fun x ↦ ?_, IsFractionRing.injective _ _⟩, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain (⟨a, e⟩ | ⟨a, e⟩) := isInteger_or_isInteger 𝒪 x
    exacts [⟨a, .inl e.symm⟩, ⟨a, .inr e.symm⟩]
  · exact isFractionRing_of_exists_eq_algebraMap_or_inv_eq_algebraMap_of_injective h.1 h.2

name: isIntegral_iff_v_le_one
statement:
lemma isIntegral_iff_v_le_one {x : R} :
    IsIntegral O x ↔ v x ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R
  have : Nontrivial O := hv.nontrivial_iff.mpr inferInstance
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, hm, hf⟩
    by_cases hn : f.natDegree = 0
    · rw [Polynomial.natDegree_eq_zero] at hn
      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hn
      simp [map_eq_zero_iff _ hv.hom_inj, hm.ne_zero_of_C] at hf
    simp only [Polynomial.eval₂_eq_sum_range, Finset.sum_range_succ, hm.coeff_natDegree, map_one,
      one_mul, add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg] at hf
    apply_fun v at hf
    simp only [map_neg, map_pow] at hf
    contrapose! hf
    refine ne_of_lt (v.map_sum_lt ?_ ?_)
    · simp [hn, (hf.trans' (zero_lt_one)).ne']
    · simp only [Finset.mem_range, map_mul, map_pow]
      intro _ hi
      exact mul_lt_of_le_one_of_lt (hv.map_le_one _) <| pow_lt_pow_right₀ hf hi
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hv.exists_of_le_one h
    exact ⟨Polynomial.X - .C y, by monicity, by simp⟩

name: mem_of_integral
statement: theorem mem_of_integral {x : R} (hx : IsIntegral O x) : x ∈ v.integer
proof:
:=
  hv.isIntegral_iff_v_le_one.mp hx

name: integralClosure
statement: protected theorem integralClosure : integralClosure O R = ⊥
proof:
:=
  bot_unique fun _ hr =>
    let ⟨x, hx⟩ := hv.3 (hv.mem_of_integral hr)
    Algebra.mem_bot.2 ⟨x, hx⟩

name: isIntegrallyClosed
statement: theorem isIntegrallyClosed : IsIntegrallyClosed O
proof:
:= by
  have : IsFractionRing O K := hv.isFractionRing
  exact
    (IsIntegrallyClosed.integralClosure_eq_bot_iff K).mp (Valuation.Integers.integralClosure hv)

name: Valuation.extendToLocalization_mk'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Valuation.extendToLocalization_mk' (x : A) (y : S) :
    (v.extendToLocalization hS B) (IsLocalization.mk' _ x y) = v x * (v y)⁻¹
proof:
:=
  (Submonoid.LocalizationMap.lift_mk' _ _ _ _).trans (by
    simp [IsUnit.coe_liftRight (v.toMonoidWithZeroHom.domRestrict S)
      (fun y ↦ isUnit_iff_ne_zero.2 (hS y.2)) y])

name: Valuation.extendToLocalization_apply_map_apply
statement:

name: valuation_aeval_monomial_eq_valuation_pow
statement:
lemma valuation_aeval_monomial_eq_valuation_pow (w : B) (n : ℕ) {a : A} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    v ((monomial n a).aeval w) = (v w) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  simp [← C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, map_mul, map_pow, one_mul, hv.eq_one a ha]

name: valuation_aeval_eq_valuation_X_pow_natDegree_of_one_lt_valuation_X
statement:
theorem valuation_aeval_eq_valuation_X_pow_natDegree_of_one_lt_valuation_X (w : B) (hpos : 1 < v w)
    {p : Polynomial A} (hp : p ≠ 0) : v (p.aeval w) = v w ^ p.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  rw [← valuation_aeval_monomial_eq_valuation_pow _ _ (leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hp)]
  nth_rw 1 [as_sum_range p, map_sum]
  apply Valuation.map_sum_eq_of_lt _ (by simp)
  intro i hi
  simp only [Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_range, Nat.lt_add_one_iff, Finset.mem_singleton,
    ← lt_iff_le_and_ne] at hi
  simp only [← C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, map_mul, aeval_C, map_pow, aeval_X, coeff_natDegree]
  by_cases h0 : (p.coeff i) = 0
  · simp [hv.eq_one p.leadingCoeff (leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hp),
      h0, pow_pos (lt_of_le_of_lt zero_le_one hpos) p.natDegree]
  · simp [hv.eq_one p.leadingCoeff (leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hp),
      hv.eq_one _ h0, pow_lt_pow_right₀ hpos hi]

name: Valuation.transcendental_of_ne_one
statement:
theorem Valuation.transcendental_of_ne_one (y : K) (h0 : y ≠ 0) (hy : v y ≠ 1) :
    Transcendental A y
proof:
:= by
  wlog! hlt : 1 < v y generalizing y
  · rw [Transcendental, ← IsAlgebraic.inv_iff]
    apply this _ (by simpa) (by simpa)
    rw [← val_lt_one_iff _ h0]
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne hlt hy
  simp_all only [ne_eq, Transcendental]
  by_contra!
  replace ⟨p, hpnt, hp⟩ : IsAlgebraic A y := .algebraMap this
  suffices v y ^ p.natDegree = 0 by simp_all
  rw [← valuation_aeval_eq_valuation_X_pow_natDegree_of_one_lt_valuation_X _ hlt] <;> simp_all

name: wfDvdMonoid_iff_wellFounded_gt_on_v
statement:
lemma wfDvdMonoid_iff_wellFounded_gt_on_v (hv : Integers v O) :
    WfDvdMonoid O ↔ WellFounded ((· > ·) on (v ∘ algebraMap O F))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun _ ↦ wellFounded_dvdNotUnit.mono ?_, fun h ↦ ⟨h.mono ?_⟩⟩ <;>
  simp [Function.onFun, hv.dvdNotUnit_iff_lt]

name: wellFounded_gt_on_v_iff_discrete_mrange
statement:
lemma wellFounded_gt_on_v_iff_discrete_mrange [Nontrivial (MonoidHom.mrange v)ˣ]
    (hv : Integers v O) :
    WellFounded ((· > ·) on (v ∘ algebraMap O F)) ↔
      Nonempty (MonoidHom.mrange v ≃*o ℤᵐ⁰)
proof:
:= by
  rw [←
    LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero.wellFoundedOn_setOfPred_ge_gt_iff_nonempty_discrete_of_ne_zero
    one_ne_zero, ← Set.wellFoundedOn_range]
  classical
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ (h.mapsTo Subtype.val ?_).mono' (by simp), fun h ↦ (h.mapsTo ?_ ?_).mono' ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨_, x, rfl⟩
    simp only [← Subtype.coe_le_coe, OneMemClass.coe_one, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_range,
      Function.comp_apply]
    intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hv.exists_of_le_one hx
    exact ⟨y, by simp⟩
  · exact fun x ↦ if hx : x ∈ MonoidHom.mrange v then ⟨x, hx⟩ else 1
  · intro
    simp only [Set.mem_range, Function.comp_apply, MonoidHom.mem_mrange, Set.mem_ofPred_eq,
      forall_exists_index]
    rintro x rfl
    simp [← Subtype.coe_le_coe, hv.map_le_one]
  · simp [Function.onFun]

name: isPrincipalIdealRing_iff_not_denselyOrdered
statement:
lemma isPrincipalIdealRing_iff_not_denselyOrdered [MulArchimedean (MonoidHom.mrange v)]
    (hv : Integers v O) :
    IsPrincipalIdealRing O ↔ ¬ DenselyOrdered (Set.range v)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun _ ↦ not_denselyOrdered_of_isPrincipalIdealRing hv, fun H ↦ ?_⟩
  rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial (MonoidHom.mrange v)ˣ with hs | _
  · have := bijective_algebraMap_of_subsingleton_units_mrange hv
    exact .of_surjective _ (RingEquiv.ofBijective _ this).symm.surjective
  have : IsDomain O := hv.hom_inj.isDomain
  have : ValuationRing O := ValuationRing.of_integers v hv
  have := ((IsBezout.TFAE (R := O)).out 2 4)
  rw [this, hv.wfDvdMonoid_iff_wellFounded_gt_on_v, hv.wellFounded_gt_on_v_iff_discrete_mrange,
    LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero.discrete_iff_not_denselyOrdered]
  exact H

name: isPrincipalIdealRing_iff_not_denselyOrdered_mrange
statement:
lemma isPrincipalIdealRing_iff_not_denselyOrdered_mrange [MulArchimedean (MonoidHom.mrange v)]
    (hv : Integers v O) :
    IsPrincipalIdealRing O ↔ ¬ DenselyOrdered (MonoidHom.mrange v)
proof:
:=
  isPrincipalIdealRing_iff_not_denselyOrdered hv

name: ValuationSubring.toLocalSubring_injective
statement:
lemma ValuationSubring.toLocalSubring_injective :
    Function.Injective (ValuationSubring.toLocalSubring (K := K))
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ h ↦ ValuationSubring.toSubring_injective congr(($h).toSubring)

name: LocalSubring.map_maximalIdeal_eq_top_of_isMax
proof:
:= by
  set mR := (maximalIdeal R.toSubring).map (Subring.inclusion hS.le)
  by_contra h_is_not_top
  obtain ⟨M, h_is_max, h_incl⟩ := Ideal.exists_le_maximal _ h_is_not_top
  let fSₘ : LocalSubring K := LocalSubring.ofPrime S M
  have h_RleSₘ : R ≤ fSₘ := by
    refine ⟨hS.le.trans (LocalSubring.le_ofPrime ..), ((local_hom_TFAE _).out 3 1).mp ?_⟩
    conv_rhs => rw [← IsLocalization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal M]
    refine .trans ?_ (Ideal.map_mono h_incl)
    rw [Ideal.map_map]; rfl
  exact (hR.eq_of_le h_RleSₘ ▸ hS).not_ge (LocalSubring.le_ofPrime ..)

name: LocalSubring.mem_of_isMax_of_isIntegral
proof:
:= by
  let S := R.toSubring[x]
  have : Algebra.IsIntegral R.toSubring S := Algebra.IsIntegral.adjoin (by simpa)
  obtain ⟨Q : Ideal S.toSubring, hQ, e⟩ := Ideal.exists_ideal_over_maximal_of_isIntegral
    (S := S) (maximalIdeal R.toSubring) (le_maximalIdeal (by simp))
  have : R = .ofPrime S.toSubring Q := by
    have hRS : R.toSubring ≤ S.toSubring := fun r hr ↦ algebraMap_mem S ⟨r, hr⟩
    refine hR.eq_of_le ⟨hRS.trans (LocalSubring.le_ofPrime _ _), ((local_hom_TFAE _).out 3 1).mp ?_⟩
    conv_rhs => rw [← IsLocalization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal Q]
    refine .trans ?_ (Ideal.map_mono <| Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.mpr e.ge)
    rw [Ideal.map_map]; rfl
  rw [this]
  exact LocalSubring.le_ofPrime _ _ (self_mem_adjoin_singleton _ _)

name: ValuationSubring.isMax_toLocalSubring
statement:
@[stacks 052K]
lemma ValuationSubring.isMax_toLocalSubring (R : ValuationSubring K) :
    IsMax R.toLocalSubring
proof:
:= by
  intro S hS
  refine (LocalSubring.toSubring_injective (hS.1.antisymm fun x hx ↦ (R.2 x).elim id fun h ↦ ?_)).ge
  by_contra h'
  have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; exact h' R.zero_mem
  have : IsUnit (Subring.inclusion hS.1 ⟨x⁻¹, h⟩) :=
    isUnit_iff_exists_inv.mpr ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, Subtype.ext (inv_mul_cancel₀ hx0)⟩
  obtain ⟨x', hx'⟩ := isUnit_iff_exists_inv.mp (hS.2.1 _ this)
  have : x' = x := by simpa [Subtype.ext_iff, inv_mul_eq_iff_eq_mul₀ hx0] using hx'
  exact h' (this ▸ x'.2)

name: LocalSubring.exists_valuationRing_of_isMax
statement:
@[stacks 00IB]
lemma LocalSubring.exists_valuationRing_of_isMax {R : LocalSubring K} (hR : IsMax R) :
    ∃ R' : ValuationSubring K, R'.toLocalSubring = R
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ x ∉ R.toSubring, x⁻¹ ∈ R.toSubring from
    ⟨⟨R.toSubring, fun x ↦ or_iff_not_imp_left.mpr (this x)⟩, rfl⟩
  refine fun x hx ↦ mem_of_isMax_of_isIntegral hR ?_
  have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := fun e ↦ hx (e ▸ zero_mem _)
  let := invertibleOfNonzero hx0
  let S := R.toSubring[x]
  have : R.toSubring < S.toSubring := SetLike.lt_iff_le_and_exists.mpr
    ⟨fun r hr ↦ algebraMap_mem S ⟨r, hr⟩, ⟨x, self_mem_adjoin_singleton _ _, hx⟩⟩
  have ⟨p, hp, hpx⟩ := exists_aeval_invOf_eq_zero_of_idealMap_adjoin_sup_span_eq_top x _
    (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R.toSubring).ne_top
    (top_unique <| (map_maximalIdeal_eq_top_of_isMax hR this).ge.trans le_self_add)
  have H : IsUnit p.leadingCoeff := of_not_not fun h ↦ by simpa using sub_mem h hp
  exact ⟨.C H.unit⁻¹.1 * p, by simp [Polynomial.Monic], by simpa using .inr hpx⟩

name: LocalSubring.isMax_iff
statement:
lemma LocalSubring.isMax_iff {A : LocalSubring K} :
    IsMax A ↔ ∃ B : ValuationSubring K, B.toLocalSubring = A
proof:
:=
  ⟨exists_valuationRing_of_isMax, fun ⟨B, e⟩ ↦ e ▸ B.isMax_toLocalSubring⟩

name: LocalSubring.exists_le_valuationSubring
statement:
@[stacks 00IA]
lemma LocalSubring.exists_le_valuationSubring (A : LocalSubring K) :
    ∃ B : ValuationSubring K, A ≤ B.toLocalSubring
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∃ B, A ≤ B ∧ IsMax B by
    obtain ⟨B, hB, hB'⟩ := this
    obtain ⟨B, rfl⟩ := B.exists_valuationRing_of_isMax hB'
    exact ⟨B, hB⟩
  refine zorn_le_nonempty_Ici₀ _ ?_ _ le_rfl
  intro s hs H y hys
  have inst : Nonempty s := ⟨⟨y, hys⟩⟩
  have hdir := H.directed.mono_comp _ LocalSubring.toSubring_mono
  refine ⟨@LocalSubring.mk _ _ (⨆ i : s, i.1.toSubring) ⟨?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro ⟨a, ha⟩ ⟨b, hb⟩ e
    obtain ⟨A, haA : a ∈ A.1.toSubring⟩ := (Subring.mem_iSup_of_directed hdir).mp ha
    obtain ⟨B, hbB : b ∈ B.1.toSubring⟩ := (Subring.mem_iSup_of_directed hdir).mp hb
    obtain ⟨C, hCA, hCB⟩ := hdir A B
    refine (C.1.2.2 (a := ⟨a, hCA haA⟩) (b := ⟨b, hCB hbB⟩) (Subtype.ext congr(($e).1))).imp ?_ ?_
    · exact fun h ↦ h.map (Subring.inclusion (le_iSup (fun i : s ↦ i.1.toSubring) C))
    · exact fun h ↦ h.map (Subring.inclusion (le_iSup (fun i : s ↦ i.1.toSubring) C))
  · intro A hA
    refine ⟨le_iSup (fun i : s ↦ i.1.toSubring) ⟨A, hA⟩, ⟨?_⟩⟩
    rintro ⟨a, haA⟩ h
    obtain ⟨⟨b, hb⟩, e⟩ := isUnit_iff_exists_inv.mp h
    obtain ⟨B, hbB : b ∈ B.1.toSubring⟩ := (Subring.mem_iSup_of_directed hdir).mp hb
    obtain ⟨C, hCA, hCB⟩ := H.directed ⟨A, hA⟩ B
    apply hCA.2.1
    exact isUnit_iff_exists_inv.mpr ⟨⟨b, hCB.1 hbB⟩, Subtype.ext congr(($e).1)⟩

name: Ideal.image_subset_nonunits_valuationSubring
statement:
lemma Ideal.image_subset_nonunits_valuationSubring {A : Subring K} (I : Ideal A) (hI : I ≠ ⊤) :
    ∃ B : ValuationSubring K, A ≤ B.toSubring ∧ A.subtype '' I ⊆ B.nonunits
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨M, hM, le⟩ := I.exists_le_maximal hI
  have ⟨V, hV⟩ := (LocalSubring.ofPrime A M).exists_le_valuationSubring
  refine ⟨V, (LocalSubring.le_ofPrime ..).trans hV.1, ?_⟩
  rw [← V.image_maximalIdeal]
  refine .trans ?_ (Set.image_mono <| ((local_hom_TFAE _).out 1 3).mp hV.2)
  rw [← IsLocalization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal M, map_map]
  refine .trans ?_ (Set.image_mono <| map_mono le)
  rintro _ ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨_, mem_map_of_mem _ ha, rfl⟩

name: Subring.exists_le_valuationSubring_of_isIntegrallyClosedIn
statement:
@[stacks 090P "part (1)"] lemma Subring.exists_le_valuationSubring_of_isIntegrallyClosedIn
    {x : K} {R : Subring K} (hxR : x ∉ R) [IsIntegrallyClosedIn R K] :
    ∃ V : ValuationSubring K, R ≤ V.toSubring ∧ x ∉ V
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hx0 := eq_or_ne x 0
  · exact (hxR R.zero_mem).elim
  let := invertibleOfNonzero hx0
  let B := R[x⁻¹]
  let xinv : B.toSubring := ⟨x⁻¹, subset_adjoin rfl⟩
  have : Ideal.span {xinv} ≠ ⊤ := fun eq ↦ hxR <|
    have ⟨p, hp, hpx⟩ := exists_aeval_invOf_eq_zero_of_idealMap_adjoin_sup_span_eq_top _
      (⊥ : Ideal R) bot_ne_top (top_unique <| eq.ge.trans le_add_self)
    (Subring.isIntegrallyClosedIn_iff).mp ‹_› ⟨p, by simpa [Monic, sub_eq_zero] using hp, hpx⟩
  have ⟨V, hV⟩ := Ideal.image_subset_nonunits_valuationSubring _ this
  exact ⟨V, fun r hr ↦ hV.1 (B.algebraMap_mem ⟨r, hr⟩),
    (V.inv_mem_nonunits_iff.mp <| hV.2 ⟨_, Ideal.subset_span rfl, rfl⟩).resolve_left hx0⟩

name: LocalSubring.exists_le_valuationSubring_of_isIntegrallyClosedIn
statement:
@[stacks 090P "part (2)"] lemma LocalSubring.exists_le_valuationSubring_of_isIntegrallyClosedIn
    {x : K} {R : LocalSubring K} (hxR : x ∉ R.toSubring) [IsIntegrallyClosedIn R.toSubring K] :
    ∃ V : ValuationSubring K, R ≤ V.toLocalSubring ∧ x ∉ V
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hx0 := eq_or_ne x 0
  · exact (hxR R.toSubring.zero_mem).elim
  let := invertibleOfNonzero hx0
  let B := R.toSubring[x⁻¹]
  let xinv : B.toSubring := ⟨x⁻¹, subset_adjoin rfl⟩
  have : (maximalIdeal R.toSubring).map (algebraMap _ B) + .span {xinv} ≠ ⊤ := fun eq ↦ hxR <|
    have ⟨p, hp, hpx⟩ := exists_aeval_invOf_eq_zero_of_idealMap_adjoin_sup_span_eq_top _ _
      (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R.toSubring).ne_top eq
    have H : IsUnit p.leadingCoeff := of_not_not fun h ↦ by simpa using sub_mem h hp
    (Subring.isIntegrallyClosedIn_iff).mp ‹_›
      ⟨.C H.unit⁻¹.1 * p, by simp [Polynomial.Monic], by simpa using .inr hpx⟩
  have ⟨V, hV⟩ := Ideal.image_subset_nonunits_valuationSubring (A := B.toSubring) _ this
  refine ⟨V, ⟨fun r hr ↦ hV.1 (B.algebraMap_mem ⟨r, hr⟩),
    ((local_hom_TFAE _).out 4 1).mp fun r hr ↦ ?_⟩, (V.inv_mem_nonunits_iff.mp <|
      hV.2 ⟨_, le_add_self (α := Ideal B) (Ideal.subset_span rfl), rfl⟩).resolve_left hx0⟩
  rw [← V.image_maximalIdeal] at hV
  obtain ⟨⟨r, _⟩, hr, rfl⟩ := hV.2 ⟨_, le_self_add (α := Ideal B) (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hr), rfl⟩
  exact hr

name: Subring.eq_iInf_of_isIntegrallyClosedIn
statement:
lemma Subring.eq_iInf_of_isIntegrallyClosedIn {R : Subring K} [IsIntegrallyClosedIn R K] :
    R = ⨅ V : {V : ValuationSubring K // R ≤ V.toSubring}, V.1.toSubring
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (le_iInf fun V ↦ V.2) fun _ h ↦ of_not_not fun hxR ↦
    have ⟨V, hV⟩ := R.exists_le_valuationSubring_of_isIntegrallyClosedIn hxR
    hV.2 (iInf_le_of_le (α := Subring K) ⟨V, hV.1⟩ le_rfl h)

name: LocalSubring.eq_iInf_of_isIntegrallyClosedIn
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (le_iInf fun V ↦ V.2.1) fun _ h ↦ of_not_not fun hxR ↦
    have ⟨V, hV⟩ := R.exists_le_valuationSubring_of_isIntegrallyClosedIn hxR
    hV.2 (iInf_le_of_le (α := Subring K) ⟨V, hV.1⟩ le_rfl h)

name: iInf_valuationSubring_superset
statement:
lemma iInf_valuationSubring_superset {s : Set K} :
    (⨅ V : {V : ValuationSubring K // s ⊆ V.toSubring}, V.1.toSubring) =
    (integralClosure (Subring.closure s) K).toSubring
proof:
:= by
  refine .trans ?_ Subring.eq_iInf_of_isIntegrallyClosedIn.symm
  simp_rw [iInf_subtype]
  congr! with V
  have : IsIntegrallyClosedIn V.toSubring K := inferInstanceAs (IsIntegrallyClosedIn V K)
  rw [Subring.integralClosure_subring_le_iff]
  exact Subring.closure_le.symm

name: bijective_rangeRestrict_comp_of_valuationRing
statement:
lemma bijective_rangeRestrict_comp_of_valuationRing [IsDomain R] [ValuationRing R]
    [IsLocalRing S] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K]
    (f : R →+* S) (g : S →+* K) (h : g.comp f = algebraMap R K) [IsLocalHom f] :
    Function.Bijective (g.rangeRestrict.comp f)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · exact .of_comp (f := Subtype.val) (by convert! (IsFractionRing.injective R K); rw [← h]; rfl)
  · let V : ValuationSubring K :=
      ⟨(algebraMap R K).range, ValuationRing.isInteger_or_isInteger R⟩
    suffices LocalSubring.range g ≤ V.toLocalSubring by
      rintro ⟨_, x, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := this.1 ⟨x, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨y, Subtype.ext (by simpa [← h] using hy)⟩
    apply V.isMax_toLocalSubring
    have H : (algebraMap R K).range ≤ g.range := fun x ⟨a, ha⟩ ↦ ⟨f a, by simp [← ha, ← h]⟩
    refine ⟨H, ⟨?_⟩⟩
    rintro ⟨_, a, rfl⟩ (ha : IsUnit (M := g.range) ⟨algebraMap R K a, _⟩)
    suffices IsUnit a from this.map (algebraMap R K).rangeRestrict
    apply IsUnit.of_map f
    apply (IsLocalHom.of_surjective g.rangeRestrict g.rangeRestrict_surjective).1
    convert! ha
    simp only [← h, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply]
    ext
    simp

name: IsLocalRing.exists_factor_valuationRing
statement:
lemma IsLocalRing.exists_factor_valuationRing [IsLocalRing R] (f : R →+* K) :
    ∃ (A : ValuationSubring K) (h : _), IsLocalHom (f.codRestrict A.toSubring h)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := (LocalSubring.range f).exists_le_valuationSubring
  refine ⟨B, fun x ↦ hB.1 ⟨x, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  exact @RingHom.isLocalHom_comp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hB.2 (.of_surjective _ f.rangeRestrict_surjective)

name: instIsLocalHomValuationInteger
statement:
@[instance]
theorem instIsLocalHomValuationInteger {S ΓS : Type*} [CommRing S]
    [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero ΓS]
    [Algebra R S] [IsLocalHom (algebraMap R S)] {vS : Valuation S ΓS}
    [vR.HasExtension vS] : IsLocalHom (algebraMap vR.integer vS.integer) where
  map_nonunit r hr
proof:
:= by
    apply (Valuation.integer.integers (v := vR)).isUnit_of_one
    · exact (isUnit_map_iff (algebraMap R S) _).mp (hr.map (algebraMap _ S))
    · apply (Valuation.integer.integers (v := vS)).one_of_isUnit at hr
      exact (val_map_eq_one_iff vR vS _).mp hr

name: valuation_eq_one_iff
statement:
theorem valuation_eq_one_iff (a : A) : IsUnit a ↔ A.valuation a = 1 where
  mp h
proof:
:= A.valuation_unit h.unit
  mpr h := by
    have ha : (a : K) ≠ 0 := by
      intro c
      rw [c, A.valuation.map_zero] at h
      exact zero_ne_one h
    have ha' : (a : K)⁻¹ ∈ A := by rw [← valuation_le_one_iff, map_inv₀, h, inv_one]
    refine .of_mul_eq_one ⟨a⁻¹, ha'⟩ ?_
    ext
    simp [field]

proof:
:=
  fun a ha => Subalgebra.mem_toSubring.mpr <| Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ (⟨a, ha⟩ : A)

name: ofPrime_valuation_eq_one_iff_mem_primeCompl
statement:
theorem ofPrime_valuation_eq_one_iff_mem_primeCompl (A : ValuationSubring K) (P : Ideal A)

proof:
:= by
  rw [← IsLocalization.AtPrime.isUnit_to_map_iff (A.ofPrime P) P x, valuation_eq_one_iff]; rfl

name: idealOfLE_ofPrime

@[simp]
theorem idealOfLE_ofPrime (A : ValuationSubring K) (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] :

proof:
:= by
  refine Ideal.ext (fun x => ?_)
  apply IsLocalization.AtPrime.to_map_mem_maximal_iff
  exact isLocalRing (ofPrime A P)

name: ofPrime_idealOfLE
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofPrime_idealOfLE (R S : ValuationSubring K) (h : R ≤ S) :
    ofPrime R (idealOfLE R S h) = S
proof:
:= by
  ext x; constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, r, hr, rfl⟩; apply mul_mem; · exact h a.2
    · rw [← valuation_le_one_iff, map_inv₀, ← inv_one, inv_le_inv₀]
      · exact not_lt.1 ((not_iff_not.2 <| valuation_lt_one_iff S _).1 hr)
      · simpa [Valuation.pos_iff] using fun hr₀ ↦ hr₀ ▸ hr <| Ideal.zero_mem (R.idealOfLE S h)
      · exact zero_lt_one
  · intro hx; by_cases hr : x ∈ R; · exact R.le_ofPrime _ hr
    have : x ≠ 0 := fun h => hr (by rw [h]; exact R.zero_mem)
    replace hr := (R.mem_or_inv_mem x).resolve_left hr
    refine ⟨1, ⟨x⁻¹, hr⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [Ideal.primeCompl, Submonoid.mem_mk, Subsemigroup.mem_mk, Set.mem_compl_iff,
        SetLike.mem_coe, idealOfLE, Ideal.mem_comap, IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff,
        not_not]
      change IsUnit (⟨x⁻¹, h hr⟩ : S)
      refine .of_mul_eq_one (⟨x, hx⟩ : S) ?_
      ext
      simp [field]
    · simp

theorem ofPrime_le_of_le (P Q : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] [Q.IsPrime] (h : P ≤ Q) :

proof: := fun _x ⟨a, s, hs, he⟩ => ⟨a, s, fun c => hs (h c), he⟩

name: idealOfLE_le_of_le
statement:
theorem idealOfLE_le_of_le (R S : ValuationSubring K) (hR : A ≤ R) (hS : A ≤ S) (h : R ≤ S) :
    idealOfLE A S hS ≤ idealOfLE A R hR
proof:
:= fun x hx =>
  (valuation_lt_one_iff R _).2
    (by
      by_contra! c; replace c := monotone_mapOfLE R S h c
      rw [(mapOfLE _ _ _).map_one, mapOfLE_valuation_apply] at c
      apply not_le_of_gt ((valuation_lt_one_iff S _).1 hx) c)

name: eq_self_or_eq_top_of_le

  all_goals

name: mem_valuationSubring_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_valuationSubring_iff (x : K) : x ∈ v.valuationSubring ↔ v x ≤ 1

name: isEquiv_iff_valuationSubring
statement:
theorem isEquiv_iff_valuationSubring :
    v₁.IsEquiv v₂ ↔ v₁.valuationSubring = v₂.valuationSubring
proof:
:= by
  constructor

    simpa using this

name: unitGroup_le_unitGroup
statement: theorem unitGroup_le_unitGroup {A B : ValuationSubring K} : A.unitGroup ≤ B.unitGroup ↔ A ≤ B
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h x hx
    rw [← A.valuation_le_one_iff x, le_iff_lt_or_eq] at hx
    by_cases h_1 : x = 0; · simp only [h_1, zero_mem]
    by_cases h_2 : 1 + x = 0
    · simp only [← add_eq_zero_iff_neg_eq.1 h_2, neg_mem _ _ (one_mem _)]
    rcases hx with hx | hx
    · have := h (show Units.mk0 _ h_2 ∈ A.unitGroup from A.valuation.map_one_add_of_lt hx)
      simpa using
        B.add_mem _ _ (show 1 + x ∈ B from SetLike.coe_mem (B.unitGroupMulEquiv ⟨_, this⟩ : B))
          (B.neg_mem _ B.one_mem)
    · have := h (show Units.mk0 x h_1 ∈ A.unitGroup from hx)
      exact SetLike.coe_mem (B.unitGroupMulEquiv ⟨_, this⟩ : B)
  · rintro h x (hx : A.valuation x = 1)
    apply_fun A.mapOfLE B h at hx
    simpa using hx

statement:
theorem principalUnitGroup_le_principalUnitGroup {A B : ValuationSubring K} :
    B.principalUnitGroup ≤ A.principalUnitGroup ↔ A ≤ B
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h x hx
    by_cases h_1 : x = 0; · simp only [h_1, zero_mem]
    by_cases h_2 : x⁻¹ + 1 = 0
    · rw [add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg, inv_eq_iff_eq_inv, inv_neg, inv_one] at h_2
      simpa only [h_2] using B.neg_mem _ B.one_mem
    · rw [← valuation_le_one_iff, ← not_lt, Valuation.one_lt_val_iff _ h_1,
        ← add_sub_cancel_right x⁻¹, ← Units.val_mk0 h_2, ← mem_principalUnitGroup_iff] at hx ⊢
      simpa only [hx] using @h (Units.mk0 (x⁻¹ + 1) h_2)
  · intro h x hx
    by_contra h_1; exact not_lt.2 (monotone_mapOfLE _ _ h (not_lt.1 h_1)) hx

:= by
  rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker, Units.ext_iff]
  let π := Ideal.Quotient.mk (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
  convert_to! _ ↔ π _ = 1
  rw [← π.map_one, ← sub_eq_zero, ← π.map_sub, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, valuation_lt_one_iff]
  simp [mem_principalUnitGroup_iff]

    v (∑ i ∈ s, f i) ≤ g

  classical
  refine Finset.induction_on s (fun _ => v.map_zero ▸ zero_le) (fun a s has ih hf => ?_) hf

    Finset.induction_on s (fun _ => v.map_zero ▸ (zero_lt_iff.2 hg))
      (fun a s has ih hf => ?_) hf

    v (x - y) = v (x + -y) := by rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
    _ ≤ max (v x) (v <| -y) := v.map_add _ _
    _ = max (v x) (v y) := by rw [map_neg]

name: map_sub_le
statement: theorem map_sub_le {x y g} (hx : v x ≤ g) (hy : v y ≤ g) : v (x - y) ≤ g
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
  exact v.map_add_le hx <| (v.map_neg y).trans_le hy

name: map_sub_lt
statement: theorem map_sub_lt {x y : R} {g : Γ₀} (hx : v x < g) (hy : v y < g) : v (x - y) < g
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
  exact v.map_add_lt hx <| (v.map_neg y).trans_lt hy

name: le_one_of_subsingleton
statement:
@[simp]
lemma le_one_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton R] (v : Valuation R Γ₀) {x : R} :
    v x ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Subsingleton.elim x 1, Valuation.map_one]

name: map_add_of_distinct_val
statement: theorem map_add_of_distinct_val (h : v x ≠ v y) : v (x + y) = max (v x) (v y)
proof:
:= by
  suffices ¬v (x + y) < max (v x) (v y) from
    or_iff_not_imp_right.1 (le_iff_eq_or_lt.1 (v.map_add x y)) this
  intro h'
  wlog vyx : v y < v x generalizing x y
  · refine this h.symm ?_ (h.lt_or_gt.resolve_right vyx)
    rwa [add_comm, max_comm]
  rw [max_eq_left_of_lt vyx] at h'
  apply lt_irrefl (v x)
  calc
    v x = v (x + y - y) := by simp
    _ ≤ max (v <| x + y) (v y) := map_sub _ _ _
    _ < v x := max_lt h' vyx

name: map_add_eq_of_lt_right
statement: theorem map_add_eq_of_lt_right (h : v x < v y) : v (x + y) = v y
proof:
:=
  (v.map_add_of_distinct_val h.ne).trans (max_eq_right_iff.mpr h.le)

name: map_add_eq_of_lt_left
statement: theorem map_add_eq_of_lt_left (h : v y < v x) : v (x + y) = v x
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm]; exact map_add_eq_of_lt_right _ h

name: map_sub_eq_of_lt_right
statement: theorem map_sub_eq_of_lt_right (h : v x < v y) : v (x - y) = v y
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, map_add_eq_of_lt_right, map_neg]
  rwa [map_neg]

name: map_sum_eq_of_lt
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne (v (f j)) 0 with h0 | h0
  · aesop
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_add_sum_sdiff_singleton_of_mem hj]
  exact map_add_eq_of_lt_left _ (map_sum_lt _ h0 hf)

name: map_sub_eq_of_lt_left
statement: theorem map_sub_eq_of_lt_left (h : v y < v x) : v (x - y) = v x
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, map_add_eq_of_lt_left]
  rwa [map_neg]

name: map_eq_of_sub_lt
statement: theorem map_eq_of_sub_lt (h : v (y - x) < v x) : v y = v x
proof:
:= by
  have := Valuation.map_add_of_distinct_val v (ne_of_gt h).symm
  rw [max_eq_right (le_of_lt h)] at this
  simpa using this

name: map_sub_of_left_eq_zero
statement: lemma map_sub_of_left_eq_zero (hx : v x = 0) : v (x - y) = v y
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hy : v y = 0
  · simpa [*] using map_sub v x y
  · simp [*, map_sub_eq_of_lt_right, zero_lt_iff]

name: map_sub_of_right_eq_zero
statement: lemma map_sub_of_right_eq_zero (hy : v y = 0) : v (x - y) = v x
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_sub_swap, map_sub_of_left_eq_zero v hy]

name: map_add_of_left_eq_zero
statement: lemma map_add_of_left_eq_zero (hx : v x = 0) : v (x + y) = v y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_neg_eq_add, map_sub_of_left_eq_zero v hx, map_neg]

name: map_add_of_right_eq_zero
statement: lemma map_add_of_right_eq_zero (hy : v y = 0) : v (x + y) = v x
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm, map_add_of_left_eq_zero v hy]

name: map_one_add_of_lt
statement: theorem map_one_add_of_lt (h : v x < 1) : v (1 + x) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← v.map_one] at h
  simpa only [v.map_one] using v.map_add_eq_of_lt_left h

name: map_one_sub_of_lt
statement: theorem map_one_sub_of_lt (h : v x < 1) : v (1 - x) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← v.map_one, ← v.map_neg] at h
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg 1 x]
  simpa only [v.map_one, v.map_neg] using v.map_add_eq_of_lt_left h

name: OrderMonoidWithZeroHom.ofClass_monotone
statement:
lemma OrderMonoidWithZeroHom.ofClass_monotone {F : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3}
    [LinearOrderedCommMonoidWithZero α] [LinearOrderedCommMonoidWithZero β] [FunLike F α β]
    [MonoidWithZeroHomClass F α β] {f : F} (hf : Monotone f) :
    Monotone (MonoidWithZeroHom.ofClass f)
proof: := hf

name: one_apply_def
statement: lemma one_apply_def (x : R) : (1 : Valuation R Γ₀) x = if x = 0 then 0 else 1
proof: := rfl

name: toMonoidWithZeroHom_one
statement: @[simp] lemma toMonoidWithZeroHom_one : (1 : Valuation R Γ₀).toMonoidWithZeroHom = 1
proof: := rfl

name: one_apply_of_ne_zero
statement: lemma one_apply_of_ne_zero {x : R} (hx : x ≠ 0) : (1 : Valuation R Γ₀) x = 1
proof: := ite_eq_right hx

name: one_apply_eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma one_apply_eq_zero_iff [Nontrivial Γ₀] {x : R} : (1 : Valuation R Γ₀) x = 0 ↔ x = 0
proof:
:=
  MonoidWithZeroHom.one_apply_eq_zero_iff

name: one_apply_le_one
statement: lemma one_apply_le_one (x : R) : (1 : Valuation R Γ₀) x ≤ 1
proof:

name: one_apply_lt_one_iff

@[simp]
lemma one_apply_lt_one_iff [Nontrivial Γ₀] {x : R} : (1 : Valuation R Γ₀) x < 1 ↔ x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [one_apply_def]
  split_ifs <;> simp_all

name: one_apply_eq_one_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma one_apply_eq_one_iff [Nontrivial Γ₀] {x : R} : (1 : Valuation R Γ₀) x = 1 ↔ x ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  MonoidWithZeroHom.one_apply_eq_one_iff

name: map_inv
statement: theorem map_inv {R : Type*} [DivisionRing R] (v : Valuation R Γ₀) : ∀ x, v x⁻¹ = (v x)⁻¹
proof:
:=
  map_inv₀ _

name: map_div
statement: theorem map_div {R : Type*} [DivisionRing R] (v : Valuation R Γ₀) : ∀ x y, v (x / y) = v x / v y
proof:
:=

name: one_lt_val_iff
statement: theorem one_lt_val_iff (v : Valuation K Γ₀) {x : K} (h : x ≠ 0) : 1 < v x ↔ v x⁻¹ < 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [inv_lt_one₀ (v.pos_iff.2 h)]

name: one_le_val_iff
statement: theorem one_le_val_iff (v : Valuation K Γ₀) {x : K} (h : x ≠ 0) : 1 ≤ v x ↔ v x⁻¹ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [inv_le_one₀ (v.pos_iff.2 h)]

name: val_lt_one_iff
statement: theorem val_lt_one_iff (v : Valuation K Γ₀) {x : K} (h : x ≠ 0) : v x < 1 ↔ 1 < v x⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simp [one_lt_inv₀ (v.pos_iff.2 h)]

name: val_le_one_iff
statement: theorem val_le_one_iff (v : Valuation K Γ₀) {x : K} (h : x ≠ 0) : v x ≤ 1 ↔ 1 ≤ v x⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simp [one_le_inv₀ (v.pos_iff.2 h)]

name: val_eq_one_iff
statement: theorem val_eq_one_iff (v : Valuation K Γ₀) {x : K} : v x = 1 ↔ v x⁻¹ = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: val_le_one_or_val_inv_lt_one
statement: theorem val_le_one_or_val_inv_lt_one (v : Valuation K Γ₀) (x : K) : v x ≤ 1 ∨ v x⁻¹ < 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | h := eq_or_ne x 0
  · simp
  · simp only [← one_lt_val_iff v h, le_or_gt]

name: val_le_one_or_val_inv_le_one
statement: theorem val_le_one_or_val_inv_le_one (v : Valuation K Γ₀) (x : K) : v x ≤ 1 ∨ v x⁻¹ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : x = 0
  · simp only [h, map_zero, zero_le, inv_zero, or_self]
  · simp only [← one_le_val_iff v h, le_total]

name: mem_leAddSubgroup_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mem_leAddSubgroup_iff {v : Valuation R Γ₀} {γ : Γ₀} {x : R} :
    x ∈ v.leAddSubgroup γ ↔ v x ≤ γ
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: leAddSubgroup_monotone
statement: lemma leAddSubgroup_monotone (v : Valuation R Γ₀) : Monotone v.leAddSubgroup
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ h _ ↦ h.trans'

name: restrict_def
statement: lemma restrict_def (x : R) : v.restrict x = restrict₀ (.ofClass v) x
proof: := rfl

name: embedding_restrict
statement:
@[simp]
lemma embedding_restrict (x : R) : embedding (v.restrict x) = v x
proof:
:=
  embedding_restrict₀ x

name: restrict_lt_iff_lt_embedding
statement:
lemma restrict_lt_iff_lt_embedding {x : R} {g : ValueGroup₀ (.ofClass v)} :
    v.restrict x < g ↔ v x < embedding g
proof:
:=
  embedding_strictMono.lt_iff_lt.symm.trans (by simp)

name: restrict_le_iff_le_embedding
statement:
lemma restrict_le_iff_le_embedding {x : R} {g : ValueGroup₀ (.ofClass v)} :
    v.restrict x ≤ g ↔ v x ≤ embedding g
proof:
:=
  embedding_strictMono.le_iff_le.symm.trans (by simp)

name: restrict_eq_mk
statement:
lemma restrict_eq_mk {x : R} (hx : v x ≠ 0) : v.restrict x =
    (valueGroup.mk (.ofClass v) 1 x (by simp) hx : ValueGroup₀ (.ofClass v))
proof:
:= by
  simp [restrict_def, restrict₀_apply, valueGroup.mk, hx]

name: restrict_pos_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma restrict_pos_iff (x : R) : 0 < v.restrict x ↔ 0 < v x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [restrict_def, restrict₀_apply]
  split_ifs with h <;> simpa [zero_lt_iff]

name: restrict_lt_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma restrict_lt_iff {x y : R} : v.restrict x < v.restrict y ↔ v x < v y
proof:
:= by
  rw [restrict_lt_iff_lt_embedding, embedding_restrict]

name: restrict_le_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma restrict_le_iff {x y : R} : v.restrict x ≤ v.restrict y ↔ v x ≤ v y
proof:
:= by
  rw [restrict_le_iff_le_embedding, embedding_restrict]

name: restrict_inj
statement:
@[simp]
lemma restrict_inj {x y : R} : v.restrict x = v.restrict y ↔ v x = v y
proof:
:=
  embedding_inj.symm.trans (by simp)

name: isEquiv_restrict
statement: theorem isEquiv_restrict : v.IsEquiv v.restrict
proof: := fun _ _ ↦ v.restrict_le_iff.symm

name: restrict_lt_one_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma restrict_lt_one_iff {x : R} : v.restrict x < 1 ↔ v x < 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [restrict_lt_iff_lt_embedding, map_one]

name: restrict_le_one_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma restrict_le_one_iff {x : R} : v.restrict x ≤ 1 ↔ v x ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [restrict_le_iff_le_embedding, map_one]

name: restrict_eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma restrict_eq_zero_iff {x : R} : v.restrict x = 0 ↔ v x = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [restrict_def, restrict₀_eq_zero_iff]

name: restrict_eq_one_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma restrict_eq_one_iff {x : R} : v.restrict x = 1 ↔ v x = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [restrict_def, restrict₀_eq_one_iff]

name: exists_div_eq_of_unit
statement:
lemma exists_div_eq_of_unit (γ : (ValueGroup₀ (.ofClass v))ˣ) :
    ∃ r s, 0 < v r ∧ 0 < v s ∧ v.restrict r / v.restrict s = γ.1
proof:
:= by
  set u := WithZero.unzero (Units.ne_zero γ) with hu_def
  obtain ⟨a, ⟨ha, x, hax⟩⟩ := (mem_valueGroup_iff_of_comm _).mp u.2
  have hx : 0 < v x := by
    rw [← restrict_pos_iff, restrict_def, WithZero.pos_iff_ne_zero, ne_eq, restrict₀_eq_zero_iff]
    aesop
  use x, a, hx, zero_lt_iff.mpr ha
  have ha0 : v.restrict a ≠ 0 := by simpa using ha
  rw [div_eq_iff ha0, mul_comm, ← embedding_strictMono.injective.eq_iff, map_mul,
    embedding_restrict, embedding_restrict]
  rw [← MonoidWithZeroHom.coe_ofClass, ← hax]
  congr
  rw [← WithZero.coe_unzero (Units.ne_zero γ)]
  exact Eq.refl ..

name: IsEquiv.restrict
statement:
lemma IsEquiv.restrict {Γ₀' : Type*} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀']
    {w : Valuation R Γ₀'} (h : v.IsEquiv w) : v.restrict.IsEquiv w.restrict
proof:
:= by
  simp only [IsEquiv] at h ⊢
  simp [h]

name: mem_ltAddSubgroup_iff
statement:
@[simp] lemma mem_ltAddSubgroup_iff {v : Valuation R Γ₀} {γ x} :
    x ∈ ltAddSubgroup v γ ↔ v x < γ
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: ltAddSubgroup_monotone
statement: lemma ltAddSubgroup_monotone (v : Valuation R Γ₀) : Monotone v.ltAddSubgroup
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ h _ ↦ (Units.val_le_val.mpr h).trans_lt'

name: ltAddSubgroup_le_leAddSubgroup
statement:
lemma ltAddSubgroup_le_leAddSubgroup (v : Valuation R Γ₀) (γ : Γ₀ˣ) :
    v.ltAddSubgroup γ ≤ v.leAddSubgroup γ
proof:
:=
  fun _ h ↦ h.le

name: leAddSubgroup_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma leAddSubgroup_zero {K : Type*} [Field K] (v : Valuation K Γ₀) :

proof:

name: IsNontrivial.nontrivial_codomain
statement:
lemma IsNontrivial.nontrivial_codomain [hv : IsNontrivial v] :
    Nontrivial Γ₀
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx0, hx1⟩ := hv.exists_val_nontrivial
  exact ⟨v x, 1, hx1⟩

name: not_isNontrivial_one
statement:
lemma not_isNontrivial_one [IsDomain R] [DecidablePred fun x : R ↦ x = 0] :
    ¬(1 : Valuation R Γ₀).IsNontrivial
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨⟨x, hx, hx'⟩⟩
  rcases eq_or_ne x 0 with rfl | hx0 <;>
  simp_all [one_apply_of_ne_zero]

name: isNontrivial_iff_exists_unit
statement:
lemma isNontrivial_iff_exists_unit :
    w.IsNontrivial ↔ ∃ x : Kˣ, w x ≠ 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨x, hx0, hx1⟩ ↦
    have : Nontrivial Γ₀ := ⟨w x, 0, hx0⟩
    ⟨Units.mk0 x (w.ne_zero_iff.mp hx0), hx1⟩,
    fun ⟨x, hx⟩ ↦
    have : Nontrivial Γ₀ := ⟨w x, 1, hx⟩
    ⟨x, w.ne_zero_iff.mpr (Units.ne_zero x), hx⟩⟩

name: IsNontrivial.exists_lt_one
statement:
lemma IsNontrivial.exists_lt_one {Γ₀ : Type*} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
    {v : Valuation K Γ₀} [hv : v.IsNontrivial] :
    ∃ x ≠ 0, v x < 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := isNontrivial_iff_exists_unit.mp hv
  rw [ne_iff_lt_or_gt] at hx
  rcases hx with hx | hx
  · use x
    simp [hx]
  · use x⁻¹
    simp [-map_inv₀, ← one_lt_val_iff, hx]

name: isNontrivial_iff_exists_lt_one
statement:
theorem isNontrivial_iff_exists_lt_one {Γ₀ : Type*} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
    (v : Valuation K Γ₀) : v.IsNontrivial ↔ ∃ x ≠ 0, v x < 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ by simpa using h.exists_lt_one (v := v), fun ⟨x, hx0, hx1⟩ ↦ ⟨x, by simp [hx0, hx1.ne]⟩⟩

name: IsNontrivial.exists_one_lt
statement:
lemma IsNontrivial.exists_one_lt {Γ₀ : Type*} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
    {v : Valuation K Γ₀} [hv : v.IsNontrivial] :
    ∃ x, 1 < v x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, h0, h1⟩ := hv.exists_lt_one
  use x⁻¹
  simp [one_lt_inv₀ (zero_lt_iff.mpr (by simp [h0] : v x ≠ 0)), h1]

name: IsNontrivial_iff_exists_one_lt
statement:
lemma IsNontrivial_iff_exists_one_lt {Γ₀ : Type*} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
    {v : Valuation K Γ₀} : v.IsNontrivial ↔ ∃ x, 1 < v x
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ by simpa using h.exists_one_lt (v := v), fun ⟨x, hx1⟩ ↦ ⟨x, by aesop⟩⟩

name: IsTrivialOn.valuation_algebraMap_le_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem IsTrivialOn.valuation_algebraMap_le_one (a : A) : v (algebraMap A B a) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases a = 0 <;> grind [zero_le]

name: refl
statement:
@[refl]
theorem refl : v.IsEquiv v
proof: := fun _ _ => Iff.refl _

name: symm
statement:
@[symm]
theorem symm (h : v₁.IsEquiv v₂) : v₂.IsEquiv v₁
proof: := fun _ _ => Iff.symm (h _ _)

name: trans
statement:
@[trans]
theorem trans (h₁₂ : v₁.IsEquiv v₂) (h₂₃ : v₂.IsEquiv v₃) : v₁.IsEquiv v₃
proof:
:= fun _ _ =>
  Iff.trans (h₁₂ _ _) (h₂₃ _ _)

name: of_eq
statement: theorem of_eq {v' : Valuation R Γ₀} (h : v = v') : v.IsEquiv v'
proof: := by subst h; rfl

name: map
statement:
theorem map {v' : Valuation R Γ₀} (f : Γ₀ →*₀ Γ'₀) (hf : Monotone f) (inf : Injective f)
    (h : v.IsEquiv v') : (v.map f hf).IsEquiv (v'.map f hf)
proof:
:=
  let H : StrictMono f := hf.strictMono_of_injective inf
  fun r s =>
  calc
    f (v r) ≤ f (v s) ↔ v r ≤ v s := by rw [H.le_iff_le]
    _ ↔ v' r ≤ v' s := h r s
    _ ↔ f (v' r) ≤ f (v' s) := by rw [H.le_iff_le]

name: comap
statement:
theorem comap {S : Type*} [Ring S] (f : S →+* R) (h : v₁.IsEquiv v₂) :
    (v₁.comap f).IsEquiv (v₂.comap f)
proof: := fun r s => h (f r) (f s)

name: eq_iff
statement: theorem eq_iff (h : v₁.IsEquiv v₂) {r s : R} : v₁ r = v₁ s ↔ v₂ r = v₂ s
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [le_antisymm_iff] using and_congr (h r s) (h s r)

name: eq_zero
statement: theorem eq_zero (h : v₁.IsEquiv v₂) {r : R} : v₁ r = 0 ↔ v₂ r = 0
proof:
:= by
  have : v₁ r = v₁ 0 ↔ v₂ r = v₂ 0 := h.eq_iff
  rwa [v₁.map_zero, v₂.map_zero] at this

name: ofClass_eq_zero
statement:
lemma ofClass_eq_zero (h : v₁.IsEquiv v₂) {r : R} : (MonoidWithZeroHom.ofClass v₁) r = 0 ↔
  (MonoidWithZeroHom.ofClass v₂) r = 0
proof: := eq_zero h

name: pos_iff
statement: lemma pos_iff (h : v₁.IsEquiv v₂) {x : R} : 0 < v₁ x ↔ 0 < v₂ x
proof:
:= by
  rw [zero_lt_iff, zero_lt_iff, h.eq_zero.ne]

name: le_iff_le
statement:
lemma le_iff_le (h : v₁.IsEquiv v₂) {x y : R} :
    v₁ x ≤ v₁ y ↔ v₂ x ≤ v₂ y
proof: := h x y

name: lt_iff_lt
statement:
lemma lt_iff_lt (h : v₁.IsEquiv v₂) {x y : R} :
    v₁ x < v₁ y ↔ v₂ x < v₂ y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← le_iff_le_iff_lt_iff_lt, h]

name: le_one_iff_le_one
statement:
lemma le_one_iff_le_one (h : v₁.IsEquiv v₂) {x : R} :
    v₁ x ≤ 1 ↔ v₂ x ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← v₁.map_one, h, map_one]

name: one_le_iff_one_le
statement:
lemma one_le_iff_one_le (h : v₁.IsEquiv v₂) {x : R} :
    1 ≤ v₁ x ↔ 1 ≤ v₂ x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← v₁.map_one, h, map_one]

name: eq_one_iff_eq_one
statement:
lemma eq_one_iff_eq_one (h : v₁.IsEquiv v₂) {x : R} :
    v₁ x = 1 ↔ v₂ x = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← v₁.map_one, h.eq_iff, map_one]

name: lt_one_iff_lt_one
statement:
lemma lt_one_iff_lt_one (h : v₁.IsEquiv v₂) {x : R} :
    v₁ x < 1 ↔ v₂ x < 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← v₁.map_one, h.lt_iff_lt, map_one]

proof: := h.eq_one_iff_eq_one.mp (IsTrivialOn.eq_one _ ha)

name: isNontrivial_of_isEquiv

name: valueGroup
statement:
theorem valueGroup₀Fun_spec (h : v.IsEquiv w) {r s : R} (hr : (MonoidWithZeroHom.ofClass v) r ≠ 0)
    (hs : (MonoidWithZeroHom.ofClass v) s ≠ 0)
    (hr' : (MonoidWithZeroHom.ofClass w) r ≠ 0 := h.ofClass_eq_zero.ne.1 hr)
    (hs' : (MonoidWithZeroHom.ofClass w) s ≠ 0 := h.ofClass_eq_zero.ne.1 hs) :
    valueGroup₀Fun h (valueGroup.mk (.ofClass v) r s hr hs) =
      valueGroup.mk (.ofClass w) r s hr' hs'
proof:
:= by
  rw [valueGroup₀Fun, dite_eq_right (by simp)]
  generalize_proofs _ _ _ _ H _
  have c_spec := H.choose_spec
  simp only [MonoidWithZeroHom.coe_ofClass, ne_eq, WithZero.coe_inj, valueGroup.mk_inj] at c_spec ⊢
  rwa [← h.eq_iff, eq_comm]

name: valueGroup
statement: theorem valueGroup₀Fun_zero (h : v.IsEquiv w) : valueGroup₀Fun h 0 = 0
proof: := by simp [valueGroup₀Fun]

name: orderMonoidIso_spec
statement:
@[simp]
theorem orderMonoidIso_spec (h : v.IsEquiv w) (a : R) :
    h.orderMonoidIso (v.restrict a) = w.restrict a
proof:
:= by
  have h_res := h.restrict
  by_cases ha : v a = 0
  · rw [← restrict_eq_zero_iff] at ha
    rwa [ha, map_zero, Eq.comm, ← h_res.eq_zero]
  · rw [(v.restrict_eq_mk ha)]
    simp [orderMonoidIso, valueGroup₀Fun_spec h (hs := ha),
      w.restrict_eq_mk ((eq_zero h.symm).ne.mpr ha)]

name: orderMonoidIso_spec
statement:
lemma orderMonoidIso_spec₀ (h : v.IsEquiv w) (a : R) :
    h.orderMonoidIso (restrict₀ (.ofClass v) a) = restrict₀ (.ofClass w) a
proof:
:=
  orderMonoidIso_spec h a

name: orderMonoidIso_symm
statement:

proof:

name: orderMonoidIso_eq_refl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem orderMonoidIso_eq_refl (h : v.IsEquiv v) :

proof:

  ext x
  obtain (rfl | ⟨x, y, _, _, rfl⟩) := x.zero_or_exists_mk
  · simp
  · simp [orderMonoidIso, valueGroup₀Fun_spec h]

name: orderMonoidIso_trans
statement:

proof:
:= by
  ext x
  obtain (rfl | ⟨x, y, _, _, rfl⟩) := x.zero_or_exists_mk
  · simp

name: isEquiv_of_val_le_one
statement: theorem isEquiv_of_val_le_one (h : ∀ x, v x ≤ 1 ↔ v' x ≤ 1) : v.IsEquiv v'
proof:
:= by
  intro x y
  obtain rfl | hy := eq_or_ne y 0
  · simp
  · rw [← div_le_one₀, ← v.map_div, h, v'.map_div, div_le_one₀] <;>
      rwa [zero_lt_iff, ne_zero_iff]

name: isEquiv_iff_val_le_one
statement: theorem isEquiv_iff_val_le_one : v.IsEquiv v' ↔ ∀ {x}, v x ≤ 1 ↔ v' x ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨IsEquiv.le_one_iff_le_one, isEquiv_of_val_le_one⟩

name: isEquiv_iff_val_eq_one
statement: theorem isEquiv_iff_val_eq_one : v.IsEquiv v' ↔ ∀ {x}, v x = 1 ↔ v' x = 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h x
    rw [h.eq_one_iff_eq_one]
  · intro h
    apply isEquiv_of_val_le_one
    intro x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hx with hx' | hx'
      · have : v (1 + x) = 1 := by
          rw [← v.map_one]
          apply map_add_eq_of_lt_left
          simpa
        rw [h] at this
        rw [show x = -1 + (1 + x) by simp]
        refine le_trans (v'.map_add _ _) ?_
        simp [this]
      · rw [h] at hx'
        exact le_of_eq hx'
    · intro hx
      rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hx with hx' | hx'
      · have : v' (1 + x) = 1 := by
          rw [← v'.map_one]
          apply map_add_eq_of_lt_left
          simpa
        rw [← h] at this
        rw [show x = -1 + (1 + x) by simp]
        refine le_trans (v.map_add _ _) ?_
        simp [this]
      · rw [← h] at hx'
        exact le_of_eq hx'

name: isEquiv_iff_val_lt_one
statement: theorem isEquiv_iff_val_lt_one : v.IsEquiv v' ↔ ∀ {x}, v x < 1 ↔ v' x < 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h x
    rw [h.lt_one_iff_lt_one]
  · rw [isEquiv_iff_val_eq_one]
    intro h x
    by_cases hx : x = 0
    · simp only [(zero_iff _).2 hx, zero_ne_one]
    constructor
    · intro hh
      by_contra h_1
      cases ne_iff_lt_or_gt.1 h_1 with
      | inl h_2 => simpa [hh, lt_self_iff_false] using h.2 h_2
      | inr h_2 =>
          rw [← inv_one, ← inv_eq_iff_eq_inv, ← map_inv₀] at hh
          exact hh.not_lt (h.2 ((one_lt_val_iff v' hx).1 h_2))
    · intro hh
      by_contra h_1
      cases ne_iff_lt_or_gt.1 h_1 with
      | inl h_2 => simpa [hh, lt_self_iff_false] using h.1 h_2
      | inr h_2 =>
        rw [← inv_one, ← inv_eq_iff_eq_inv, ← map_inv₀] at hh
        exact hh.not_lt (h.1 ((one_lt_val_iff v hx).1 h_2))

name: isEquiv_iff_val_sub_one_lt_one
statement:
theorem isEquiv_iff_val_sub_one_lt_one :
    v.IsEquiv v' ↔ ∀ {x}, v (x - 1) < 1 ↔ v' (x - 1) < 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [isEquiv_iff_val_lt_one]
  exact (Equiv.subRight 1).surjective.forall

name: isEquiv_tfae
statement:
theorem isEquiv_tfae :
    [ v.IsEquiv v',
      ∀ {x y}, v x < v y ↔ v' x < v' y,
      ∀ {x}, v x ≤ 1 ↔ v' x ≤ 1,
      ∀ {x}, v x = 1 ↔ v' x = 1,
      ∀ {x}, v x < 1 ↔ v' x < 1,
      ∀ {x}, v (x - 1) < 1 ↔ v' (x - 1) < 1 ].TFAE
proof:
:= by
  tfae_have 1 ↔ 2 := isEquiv_iff_val_lt_val
  tfae_have 1 ↔ 3 := isEquiv_iff_val_le_one
  tfae_have 1 ↔ 4 := isEquiv_iff_val_eq_one
  tfae_have 1 ↔ 5 := isEquiv_iff_val_lt_one
  tfae_have 1 ↔ 6 := isEquiv_iff_val_sub_one_lt_one
  tfae_finish

name: map_add_supp
statement: theorem map_add_supp (a : R) {s : R} (h : s ∈ supp v) : v (a + s) = v a
proof:
:= by
  have aux : ∀ a s, v s = 0 → v (a + s) ≤ v a := by
    intro a' s' h'
    refine le_trans (v.map_add a' s') (max_le le_rfl ?_)
    simp [h']
  apply le_antisymm (aux a s h)
  calc
    v a = v (a + s + -s) := by simp
    _ ≤ v (a + s) := aux (a + s) (-s) (by rwa [← Ideal.neg_mem_iff] at h)

name: nonempty_rankOne_iff_mulArchimedean
statement:
lemma nonempty_rankOne_iff_mulArchimedean {v : Valuation R Γ₀} [v.IsNontrivial] :
    Nonempty v.RankOne ↔ MulArchimedean (ValueGroup₀ (.ofClass v))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain hv := Nonempty.some h
    exact MulArchimedean.comap hv.hom'.toMonoidHom hv.strictMono'
  · intro _
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ :=
      Archimedean.exists_orderAddMonoidHom_real_injective (Additive (ValueGroup₀ (.ofClass v))ˣ)
    let e := AddMonoidHom.toMultiplicativeRight (α := (ValueGroup₀ (.ofClass v))ˣ) (β := ℝ) f
    have he : StrictMono e := by
      simp only [AddMonoidHom.coe_toMultiplicativeRight, AddMonoidHom.coe_coe, e]
      
      exact StrictMono.comp strictMono_id (f.monotone'.strictMono_of_injective hf)
    let rf : Multiplicative ℝ →* ℝ≥0ˣ := {
      toFun x := Units.mk0 (.mk ((2 : ℝ) ^ (log (M := ℝ) x)) (by positivity)) <| by
        simp only [ne_eq, NNReal.eq_iff, NNReal.coe_mk, NNReal.coe_zero]
        positivity
      map_one' := by ext; simp
      map_mul' _ _ := by ext; simp [Real.rpow_add]
      }
    have H : StrictMono (map' (rf.comp e)) := by
      refine map'_strictMono ?_
      intro a b h
      simpa [← Units.val_lt_val, ← NNReal.coe_lt_coe, rf] using he h
    exact ⟨{
      hom' := withZeroUnitsEquiv.toMonoidWithZeroHom.comp <| (map' (rf.comp e)).comp
        withZeroUnitsEquiv.symm.toMonoidWithZeroHom
      strictMono' := withZeroUnitsEquiv_strictMono.comp <| H.comp
        withZeroUnitsEquiv_symm_strictMono
    }⟩

name: strictMono
statement: lemma strictMono : StrictMono (hom v)
proof: := hv.strictMono'

name: nontrivial
statement: lemma nontrivial : ∃ r : R, v r ≠ 0 ∧ v r ≠ 1
proof: := IsNontrivial.exists_val_nontrivial

name: zero_of_hom_zero
statement: theorem zero_of_hom_zero {x : ValueGroup₀ (.ofClass v)} (hx : hom v x = 0) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine (eq_of_le_of_not_lt (zero_le (a := x)) fun h_lt ↦ ?_).symm
  have hs := strictMono v h_lt
  rw [map_zero, hx] at hs
  exact hs.false

statement: theorem hom_eq_zero_iff {x : ValueGroup₀ (.ofClass v)} : hom v x = 0 ↔ x = 0
proof:
:=

name: restrict_RankOne_hom_eq
statement:
@[simp]
lemma restrict_RankOne_hom_eq :
  RankOne.hom v.restrict = (RankOne.hom v).comp embedding
proof: := rfl

name: exists_val_lt
statement: theorem exists_val_lt {γ : ℝ≥0} (hγ : γ ≠ 0) : ∃ x ≠ 0, RankOne.hom v (v.restrict x) < γ
proof:
:= by
  have hγ_pos : 0 < γ := pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hγ
  obtain ⟨x, h⟩ := NNReal.exists_lt_of_strictMono (RankOne.strictMono v.restrict) hγ_pos
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := ValueGroup₀.restrict₀_surjective _ x.val
  refine ⟨k, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [restrict₀_apply, MonoidWithZeroHom.coe_ofClass, restrict_def, map_eq_zero] at hk
    by_contra h0
    rw [dite_eq_left (by simp [h0]), eq_comm] at hk
    simp at hk
  · convert! h
    simp only [restrict_RankOne_hom_eq, coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, ← hk]
    congr 1
    exact (embedding_restrict₀ k).symm

name: exists_val_lt
statement:
theorem exists_val_lt {K : Type*} [DivisionRing K] (v : Valuation K Γ₀) [RankLeOne v] :
    Subsingleton ((ValueGroup₀ (.ofClass v))ˣ) ∨
      ∀ {γ : ℝ≥0} (_ : γ ≠ 0), ∃ (x : K), x ≠ 0 ∧ (RankLeOne.hom' v) (v.restrict x) < γ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ne_eq, or_iff_not_imp_left, not_subsingleton_iff_nontrivial]
  exact fun H ↦ (rankOne_of_nontrivial v H).exists_val_lt

name: ValuativeRel.isRankLeOne_iff_mulArchimedean
statement:
lemma ValuativeRel.isRankLeOne_iff_mulArchimedean :
    IsRankLeOne R ↔ MulArchimedean (ValueGroupWithZero R)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨f, hf⟩⟩
    exact .comap f.toMonoidHom hf
  · intro h
    by_cases H : IsNontrivial R
    · rw [isNontrivial_iff_isNontrivial (valuation R)] at H
      have h' : MulArchimedean (ValueGroup₀ (.ofClass (valuation R))) :=
        MulArchimedean.comap embedding.toMonoidHom embedding_strictMono
      rw [← (valuation R).nonempty_rankOne_iff_mulArchimedean] at h'
      obtain ⟨f⟩ := h'
      exact isRankLeOne_of_rankOne
    · refine ⟨⟨{ emb := 1, strictMono := ?_ }⟩⟩
      intro a b
      contrapose! H
      obtain ⟨H, H'⟩ := H
      rcases eq_or_ne a 0 with rfl | ha
      · simp_all
      rcases eq_or_ne a 1 with rfl | ha'
      · exact ⟨⟨b, (H.trans' zero_lt_one).ne', H.ne'⟩⟩
      · exact ⟨⟨a, ha, ha'⟩⟩

name: ValuativeRel.IsRankLeOne.of_compatible_mulArchimedean
statement:
lemma ValuativeRel.IsRankLeOne.of_compatible_mulArchimedean [MulArchimedean Γ₀]
    (v : Valuation R Γ₀) [v.Compatible] :
    ValuativeRel.IsRankLeOne R
proof:
:= by
  rw [isRankLeOne_iff_mulArchimedean]
  exact MulArchimedean.comap (embedding.toMonoidHom.comp (ValueGroupWithZero.embed v).toMonoidHom)
    (embedding_strictMono.comp (ValueGroupWithZero.embed_strictMono v))

name: nonempty_orderIso_withZeroMul_int_iff
statement:
lemma nonempty_orderIso_withZeroMul_int_iff [Semiring R] [ValuativeRel R] :
    Nonempty (ValueGroupWithZero R ≃*o ℤᵐ⁰) ↔
      IsDiscrete R ∧ IsNontrivial R ∧ MulArchimedean (ValueGroupWithZero R)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨e⟩
    let x := e.symm (exp (-1))
    have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := by simp [x]
    have hx1 : x < 1 := by simp [x, ← lt_map_inv_iff, ← exp_zero]
    refine ⟨⟨x, hx1, fun y hy ↦ ?_⟩, ⟨x, hx0, hx1.ne⟩, .comap e.toMonoidHom e.strictMono⟩
    rcases eq_or_ne y 0 with rfl | hy0
    · simp
    · rw [← map_one e.symm, ← map_inv_lt_iff, ← log_lt_log (by simp [hy0]) (by simp)] at hy
      rw [← map_inv_le_iff, ← log_le_log (by simp [hy0]) (by simp)]
      simp only [OrderMonoidIso.equivLike_inv_eq_symm, OrderMonoidIso.symm_symm, log_one,
        log_exp] at hy ⊢
      linarith
  · rintro ⟨hD, hN, hM⟩
    rw [isNontrivial_iff_nontrivial_units] at hN
    rw [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero.discrete_iff_not_denselyOrdered]
    intro H
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hx'⟩ := hD.has_maximal_element
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hy'⟩ := exists_between hx
    exact hy.not_ge (hx' y hy')

name: IsDiscrete.of_compatible_withZeroMulInt
statement:
lemma IsDiscrete.of_compatible_withZeroMulInt [Ring R] [ValuativeRel R]
    (v : Valuation R ℤᵐ⁰) [v.Compatible] : IsDiscrete R
proof:
:= by
  have : IsRankLeOne R := .of_compatible_mulArchimedean v
  by_cases h : IsNontrivial R
  · by_cases H : DenselyOrdered (ValueGroupWithZero R)
    · classical
      exfalso
      refine (MonoidWithZeroHom.range_nontrivial
        (ValueGroupWithZero.orderMonoidIso v).toMonoidWithZeroHom).not_subsingleton ?_
      rw [← WithZero.denselyOrdered_set_iff_subsingleton]
      exact (ValueGroupWithZero.embed_strictMono v).denselyOrdered_range
    · rw [isNontrivial_iff_nontrivial_units] at h
      rw [← LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero.discrete_iff_not_denselyOrdered] at H
      rw [nonempty_orderIso_withZeroMul_int_iff] at H
      exact H.left
  · rw [isNontrivial_iff_nontrivial_units] at h; push Not at h
    refine ⟨⟨0, zero_lt_one, fun y hy ↦ ?_⟩⟩
    contrapose! hy
    have : 1 = Units.mk0 y hy.ne' := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    exact Units.val_le_val.mpr this.le

name: pow_coeff_zero_ne_zero_of_unit

theorem pow_coeff_zero_ne_zero_of_unit [FiniteDimensional K L] (x : L) (hx : IsUnit x) :

:= by
  have h_alg : Algebra.IsAlgebraic K L := Algebra.IsAlgebraic.of_finite K L
  have hx₀ : IsIntegral K x := (Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic x).isIntegral
  have hdeg := Nat.div_pos (natDegree_le x) (natDegree_pos hx₀)
  rw [ne_eq, pow_eq_zero_iff hdeg.ne.symm, Valuation.zero_iff]
  exact coeff_zero_ne_zero hx₀ hx.ne_zero

name: ascPochhammer_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ascPochhammer_zero : ascPochhammer S 0 = 1
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: ascPochhammer_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ascPochhammer_one : ascPochhammer S 1 = X
proof: := by simp [ascPochhammer]

name: ascPochhammer_succ_left
statement:
theorem ascPochhammer_succ_left (n : ℕ) :
    ascPochhammer S (n + 1) = X * (ascPochhammer S n).comp (X + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ascPochhammer]

name: monic_ascPochhammer
statement:
theorem monic_ascPochhammer (n : ℕ) [Nontrivial S] [NoZeroDivisors S] :
    Monic <| ascPochhammer S n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n hn =>
    have : leadingCoeff (X + 1 : S[X]) = 1 := leadingCoeff_X_add_C 1
    rw [ascPochhammer_succ_left, Monic.def, leadingCoeff_mul,
      leadingCoeff_comp (ne_zero_of_eq_one <| natDegree_X_add_C 1 : natDegree (X + 1) ≠ 0), hn,
      monic_X, one_mul, one_mul, this, one_pow]

name: ascPochhammer_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ascPochhammer_map (f : S →+* T) (n : ℕ) :
    (ascPochhammer S n).map f = ascPochhammer T n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => simp [ih, ascPochhammer_succ_left, map_comp]

name: ascPochhammer_eval
statement:
theorem ascPochhammer_eval₂ (f : S →+* T) (n : ℕ) (t : T) :
    (ascPochhammer T n).eval t = (ascPochhammer S n).eval₂ f t
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ascPochhammer_map f]
  exact eval_map f t

name: ascPochhammer_eval_comp
statement:
theorem ascPochhammer_eval_comp {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] (n : ℕ) (p : R[X]) [Algebra R S]
    (x : S) : ((ascPochhammer S n).comp (p.map (algebraMap R S))).eval x =
    (ascPochhammer S n).eval (p.eval₂ (algebraMap R S) x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ascPochhammer_eval₂ (algebraMap R S), ← eval₂_comp', ← ascPochhammer_map (algebraMap R S),
    ← map_comp, eval_map]

name: ascPochhammer_eval_cast
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem ascPochhammer_eval_cast (n k : ℕ) :
    (((ascPochhammer ℕ n).eval k : ℕ) : S) = ((ascPochhammer S n).eval k : S)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ascPochhammer_map (algebraMap ℕ S), eval_map, ← eq_natCast (algebraMap ℕ S),
      eval₂_at_natCast, Nat.cast_id]

name: ascPochhammer_eval_zero
statement: theorem ascPochhammer_eval_zero {n : ℕ} : (ascPochhammer S n).eval 0 = if n = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  cases n
  · simp
  · simp [X_mul, ascPochhammer_succ_left]

name: ascPochhammer_zero_eval_zero
statement: theorem ascPochhammer_zero_eval_zero : (ascPochhammer S 0).eval 0 = 1
proof: := by simp

name: ascPochhammer_ne_zero_eval_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ascPochhammer_ne_zero_eval_zero {n : ℕ} (h : n ≠ 0) : (ascPochhammer S n).eval 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [ascPochhammer_eval_zero, h]

name: ascPochhammer_succ_right
statement:
theorem ascPochhammer_succ_right (n : ℕ) :
    ascPochhammer S (n + 1) = ascPochhammer S n * (X + (n : S[X]))
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : ascPochhammer ℕ (n + 1) = ascPochhammer ℕ n * (X + (n : ℕ[X])) by
    apply_fun Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℕ S) at h
    simpa only [ascPochhammer_map, Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_add, map_X,
      Polynomial.map_natCast] using h
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    conv_lhs =>
      rw [ascPochhammer_succ_left, ih, mul_comp, ← mul_assoc, ← ascPochhammer_succ_left, add_comp,
          X_comp, natCast_comp, add_assoc, add_comm (1 : ℕ[X]), ← Nat.cast_succ]

name: ascPochhammer_succ_eval
statement:
theorem ascPochhammer_succ_eval {S : Type*} [Semiring S] (n : ℕ) (k : S) :
    (ascPochhammer S (n + 1)).eval k = (ascPochhammer S n).eval k * (k + n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ascPochhammer_succ_right, mul_add, eval_add, eval_mul_X, ← Nat.cast_comm, ← C_eq_natCast,
    eval_C_mul, Nat.cast_comm, ← mul_add]

name: ascPochhammer_succ_comp_X_add_one
statement:
theorem ascPochhammer_succ_comp_X_add_one (n : ℕ) :
    (ascPochhammer S (n + 1)).comp (X + 1) =
      ascPochhammer S (n + 1) + (n + 1) • (ascPochhammer S n).comp (X + 1)
proof:
:= by
  suffices (ascPochhammer ℕ (n + 1)).comp (X + 1) =
      ascPochhammer ℕ (n + 1) + (n + 1) * (ascPochhammer ℕ n).comp (X + 1)
    by simpa [map_comp] using congr_arg (Polynomial.map (Nat.castRingHom S)) this
  nth_rw 2 [ascPochhammer_succ_left]
  rw [← add_mul, ascPochhammer_succ_right ℕ n, mul_comp, mul_comm, add_comp, X_comp, natCast_comp,
    add_comm, ← add_assoc]
  ring

name: ascPochhammer_mul
statement:
theorem ascPochhammer_mul (n m : ℕ) :
    ascPochhammer S n * (ascPochhammer S m).comp (X + (n : S[X])) = ascPochhammer S (n + m)
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [ascPochhammer_succ_right, Polynomial.mul_X_add_natCast_comp, ← mul_assoc, ih,
      ← add_assoc, ascPochhammer_succ_right, Nat.cast_add, add_assoc]

name: ascPochhammer_nat_eq_ascFactorial
statement:
theorem ascPochhammer_nat_eq_ascFactorial (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ k, (ascPochhammer ℕ k).eval n = n.ascFactorial k
  | 0 => by rw [ascPochhammer_zero, eval_one, Nat.ascFactorial_zero]
  | t + 1 => by
    rw [ascPochhammer_succ_right, eval_mul, ascPochhammer_nat_eq_ascFactorial n t, eval_add, eval_X,
      eval_natCast, Nat.cast_id, Nat.ascFactorial_succ, mul_comm]

name: ascPochhammer_nat_eq_natCast_ascFactorial
statement:
theorem ascPochhammer_nat_eq_natCast_ascFactorial (S : Type*) [Semiring S] (n k : ℕ) :

proof:
:= by
  norm_cast
  rw [ascPochhammer_nat_eq_ascFactorial]

name: ascPochhammer_nat_eq_descFactorial
