name: support_opRingEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem support_opRingEquiv (p : R[X]ᵐᵒᵖ) : (opRingEquiv R p).support = (unop p).support
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp

name: natDegree_opRingEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem natDegree_opRingEquiv (p : R[X]ᵐᵒᵖ) : (opRingEquiv R p).natDegree = (unop p).natDegree
proof:
:= by
  by_cases p0 : p = 0
  · simp only [p0, map_zero, natDegree_zero, unop_zero]
  · simp only [p0, natDegree_eq_support_max', Ne, EmbeddingLike.map_eq_zero_iff, not_false_iff,
      support_opRingEquiv, unop_eq_zero_iff]

name: leadingCoeff_opRingEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leadingCoeff_opRingEquiv (p : R[X]ᵐᵒᵖ) :
    (opRingEquiv R p).leadingCoeff = op (unop p).leadingCoeff
proof:
:= by
  rw [leadingCoeff, coeff_opRingEquiv, natDegree_opRingEquiv, leadingCoeff]

name: isLeftCancelMulZero_iff
statement:
theorem isLeftCancelMulZero_iff :
    IsLeftCancelMulZero R[X] ↔ IsLeftCancelMulZero R ∧ IsCancelAdd R where
  mp h
proof:
:= .intro (C_injective.isLeftCancelMulZero _ C_0 fun _ _ ↦ C_mul) <|
    have : IsLeftCancelAdd R := .mk fun a b c eq ↦ by
      nontriviality R
      let trinomial (r : R) : R[X] := a • X ^ 2 + r • X + C a
      have ht r : (X + C 1) * trinomial r = a • X ^ 3 + (a + r) • X ^ 2 + (a + r) • X + C a := by
        simp only [trinomial, mul_add, add_mul, ← C_mul', C_1, one_mul, ← mul_assoc, X_mul_C, C_add]
        noncomm_ring
      simpa [trinomial] using congr_arg (coeff · 1) <|
        h.1 (a₁ := trinomial b) (a₂ := trinomial c) (X_add_C_ne_zero 1) <| by simp_rw [ht, eq]
    AddCommMagma.IsLeftCancelAdd.toIsCancelAdd R
  mpr := fun ⟨_, _⟩ ↦ inferInstance

name: isRightCancelMulZero_iff
statement:
theorem isRightCancelMulZero_iff :
    IsRightCancelMulZero R[X] ↔ IsRightCancelMulZero R ∧ IsCancelAdd R
proof:
:= by
  rw [← MulOpposite.isLeftCancelMulZero_iff, (opRingEquiv R).isLeftCancelMulZero_iff,
    isLeftCancelMulZero_iff, MulOpposite.isLeftCancelMulZero_iff, MulOpposite.isCancelAdd_iff]

name: isCancelMulZero_iff
statement:
protected theorem isCancelMulZero_iff :
    IsCancelMulZero R[X] ↔ IsCancelMulZero R ∧ IsCancelAdd R
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [isCancelMulZero_iff, isLeftCancelMulZero_iff, isRightCancelMulZero_iff]
  rw [and_and_and_comm, and_self]

name: isDomain_iff
statement: theorem isDomain_iff : IsDomain R[X] ↔ IsDomain R ∧ IsCancelAdd R
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [isDomain_iff_cancelMulZero_and_nontrivial, nontrivial_iff,
    Polynomial.isCancelMulZero_iff, and_right_comm]

name: natDegree_preHilbertPoly
statement:
lemma natDegree_preHilbertPoly [CharZero F] (d k : ℕ) :
    (preHilbertPoly F d k).natDegree = d
proof:
:= by
  have hne : (d ! : F) ≠ 0 := by norm_cast; positivity
  rw [preHilbertPoly, natDegree_smul _ (inv_ne_zero hne), natDegree_comp, ascPochhammer_natDegree,
    add_comm_sub, ← C_1, ← map_sub, natDegree_add_C, natDegree_X, mul_one]

name: coeff_preHilbertPoly_self
statement:
lemma coeff_preHilbertPoly_self [CharZero F] (d k : ℕ) :
    (preHilbertPoly F d k).coeff d = (d ! : F)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  delta preHilbertPoly
  have hne : (d ! : F) ≠ 0 := by norm_cast; positivity
  have heq : d = ((ascPochhammer F d).comp (X - C (k : F) + 1)).natDegree :=
    (natDegree_preHilbertPoly F d k).symm.trans (natDegree_smul _ (inv_ne_zero hne))
  nth_rw 3 [heq]
  calc
  _ = (d ! : F)⁻¹ • ((ascPochhammer F d).comp (X - C ((k : F) - 1))).leadingCoeff := by
    simp only [sub_add, ← C_1, ← map_sub, coeff_smul, coeff_natDegree]
  _ = (d ! : F)⁻¹ := by
    simp only [leadingCoeff_comp (ne_of_eq_of_ne (natDegree_X_sub_C _) one_ne_zero), Monic.def.1
      (monic_ascPochhammer _ _), leadingCoeff_X_sub_C, one_pow, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: leadingCoeff_preHilbertPoly
statement:
lemma leadingCoeff_preHilbertPoly [CharZero F] (d k : ℕ) :
    (preHilbertPoly F d k).leadingCoeff = (d ! : F)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [leadingCoeff, natDegree_preHilbertPoly, coeff_preHilbertPoly_self]

name: preHilbertPoly_eq_choose_add_sub
statement:
lemma preHilbertPoly_eq_choose_add_sub [CharZero F] (d : ℕ) {k n : ℕ} (hkn : k ≤ n + d) :
    (preHilbertPoly F d k).eval (n : F) = (n + d - k).choose d
proof:
:= by
  have : (d ! : F) ≠ 0 := by norm_cast; positivity
  rcases le_or_gt k n with h | h
  · calc
    _ = (↑d !)⁻¹ * eval (↑(n - k + 1)) (ascPochhammer F d) := by simp [cast_sub h, preHilbertPoly]
    _ = (n + d - k).choose d := by
      rw [ascPochhammer_nat_eq_natCast_ascFactorial]
      simp [field, ascFactorial_eq_factorial_mul_choose, Nat.sub_add_comm h]
  · rw [Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt (by omega)]
    simpa [preHilbertPoly] using
      Or.inr ⟨k - n - 1, by omega, by rw [Nat.sub_sub, Nat.cast_sub h]; push_cast; ring⟩

name: hilbertPoly_zero_left
statement: lemma hilbertPoly_zero_left (d : ℕ) : hilbertPoly (0 : F[X]) d = 0
proof:
:= by
  delta hilbertPoly; induction d with
  | zero => simp only
  | succ d _ => simp only [coeff_zero, zero_smul, Finset.sum_const_zero]

name: hilbertPoly_zero_right
statement: lemma hilbertPoly_zero_right (p : F[X]) : hilbertPoly p 0 = 0
proof: := rfl

name: hilbertPoly_succ
statement:
lemma hilbertPoly_succ (p : F[X]) (d : ℕ) :
    hilbertPoly p (d + 1) = ∑ i ∈ p.support, (p.coeff i) • preHilbertPoly F d i
proof: := rfl

name: hilbertPoly_X_pow_succ
statement:
lemma hilbertPoly_X_pow_succ (d k : ℕ) :
    hilbertPoly ((X : F[X]) ^ k) (d + 1) = preHilbertPoly F d k
proof:
:= by
  delta hilbertPoly; simp

name: hilbertPoly_add_left
statement:
lemma hilbertPoly_add_left (p q : F[X]) (d : ℕ) :
    hilbertPoly (p + q) d = hilbertPoly p d + hilbertPoly q d
proof:
:= by
  delta hilbertPoly
  induction d with
  | zero => simp only [add_zero]
  | succ d _ =>
      simp only
      rw [← sum_def _ fun _ r => r • _]
      exact sum_add_index _ _ _ (fun _ => zero_smul ..) (fun _ _ _ => add_smul ..)

name: hilbertPoly_smul
statement:
lemma hilbertPoly_smul (a : F) (p : F[X]) (d : ℕ) :
    hilbertPoly (a • p) d = a • hilbertPoly p d
proof:
:= by
  delta hilbertPoly
  induction d with
  | zero => simp only [smul_zero]
  | succ d _ =>
      simp only
      rw [← sum_def _ fun _ r => r • _, ← sum_def _ fun _ r => r • _, Polynomial.smul_sum,
        sum_smul_index' _ _ _ fun i => zero_smul F (preHilbertPoly F d i)]
      simp only [smul_assoc]

name: coeff_mul_invOneSubPow_eq_hilbertPoly_eval
statement:
theorem coeff_mul_invOneSubPow_eq_hilbertPoly_eval
    {p : F[X]} (d : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (hn : p.natDegree < n) :
    (p * invOneSubPow F d : F⟦X⟧).coeff n = (hilbertPoly p d).eval (n : F)
proof:
:= by
  delta hilbertPoly; induction d with
  | zero => simp only [invOneSubPow_zero, Units.val_one, mul_one, coeff_coe, eval_zero]
            exact coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt hn
  | succ d hd =>
      simp only [eval_finsetSum, eval_smul, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [← Finset.sum_coe_sort]
      have h_le (i : p.support) : (i : ℕ) ≤ n :=
        le_trans (le_natDegree_of_ne_zero <| mem_support_iff.1 i.2) hn.le
      have h (i : p.support) : eval ↑n (preHilbertPoly F d ↑i) = (n + d - ↑i).choose d := by
        rw [preHilbertPoly_eq_choose_add_sub _ _ (Nat.le_add_right_of_le (h_le i)),
          Nat.sub_add_comm (h_le i)]
      simp_rw [h]
      rw [Finset.sum_coe_sort _ (fun x => (p.coeff ↑x) * (_ + d - ↑x).choose _),
        PowerSeries.coeff_mul, Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ_mk,
        invOneSubPow_val_eq_mk_sub_one_add_choose_of_pos _ _ (zero_lt_succ d)]
      simp only [coeff_coe, coeff_mk]
      symm
      refine Finset.sum_subset_zero_on_sdiff (fun s hs ↦ ?_) (fun x hx ↦ ?_) (fun x hx ↦ ?_)
      · rw [Finset.mem_range_succ_iff]
        exact h_le ⟨s, hs⟩
      · simp only [Finset.mem_sdiff, mem_support_iff, not_not] at hx
        rw [hx.2, zero_mul]
      · rw [add_comm, Nat.add_sub_assoc (h_le ⟨x, hx⟩), succ_eq_add_one, add_tsub_cancel_right]

name: existsUnique_hilbertPoly
statement:
theorem existsUnique_hilbertPoly (p : F[X]) (d : ℕ) :
    ∃! h : F[X], ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n > N,
      (p * invOneSubPow F d : F⟦X⟧).coeff n = h.eval (n : F)
proof:
:= by
  use hilbertPoly p d; constructor
  · use p.natDegree
    exact fun n => coeff_mul_invOneSubPow_eq_hilbertPoly_eval d
  · rintro h ⟨N, hhN⟩
    apply eq_of_infinite_eval_eq h (hilbertPoly p d)
    apply ((Set.Ioi_infinite (max N p.natDegree)).image cast_injective.injOn).mono
    rintro x ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_Ioi, sup_lt_iff, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hn ⊢
    rw [← coeff_mul_invOneSubPow_eq_hilbertPoly_eval d hn.2, hhN n hn.1]

name: eq_hilbertPoly_of_forall_coeff_eq_eval
statement:
theorem eq_hilbertPoly_of_forall_coeff_eq_eval
    {p h : F[X]} {d : ℕ} (N : ℕ) (hhN : ∀ n > N,
    PowerSeries.coeff (R := F) n (p * invOneSubPow F d) = h.eval (n : F)) :
    h = hilbertPoly p d
proof:
:=
  ExistsUnique.unique (existsUnique_hilbertPoly p d) ⟨N, hhN⟩
    ⟨p.natDegree, fun _ x => coeff_mul_invOneSubPow_eq_hilbertPoly_eval d x⟩

name: hilbertPoly_mul_one_sub_succ
statement:
lemma hilbertPoly_mul_one_sub_succ (p : F[X]) (d : ℕ) :
    hilbertPoly (p * (1 - X)) (d + 1) = hilbertPoly p d
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_hilbertPoly_of_forall_coeff_eq_eval (p * (1 - X)).natDegree
  intro n hn
  have heq : 1 - PowerSeries.X = ((1 - X : F[X]) : F⟦X⟧) := by simp only [coe_sub, coe_one, coe_X]
  rw [← one_sub_pow_mul_invOneSubPow_val_add_eq_invOneSubPow_val F d 1, pow_one, ← mul_assoc, heq,
    ← coe_mul, coeff_mul_invOneSubPow_eq_hilbertPoly_eval (d + 1) hn]

name: hilbertPoly_mul_one_sub_pow_add
statement:
lemma hilbertPoly_mul_one_sub_pow_add (p : F[X]) (d e : ℕ) :
    hilbertPoly (p * (1 - X) ^ e) (d + e) = hilbertPoly p d
proof:
:= by
  induction e with
  | zero => simp
  | succ e he => rw [pow_add, pow_one, ← mul_assoc, ← add_assoc, hilbertPoly_mul_one_sub_succ, he]

name: hilbertPoly_eq_zero_of_le_rootMultiplicity_one
statement:
lemma hilbertPoly_eq_zero_of_le_rootMultiplicity_one
    {p : F[X]} {d : ℕ} (hdp : d ≤ p.rootMultiplicity 1) :
    hilbertPoly p d = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : p = 0
  · rw [hp, hilbertPoly_zero_left]
  · rcases exists_eq_pow_rootMultiplicity_mul_and_not_dvd p hp 1 with ⟨q, hq1, hq2⟩
    have heq : p = q * (-1) ^ p.rootMultiplicity 1 * (1 - X) ^ p.rootMultiplicity 1 := by
      simp only [mul_assoc, ← mul_pow, neg_mul, one_mul, neg_sub]
      exact hq1.trans (mul_comm _ _)
    rw [heq, ← zero_add d, ← Nat.sub_add_cancel hdp, pow_add (1 - X), ← mul_assoc,
      hilbertPoly_mul_one_sub_pow_add, hilbertPoly]

name: natDegree_hilbertPoly_of_ne_zero_of_rootMultiplicity_lt
statement:
theorem natDegree_hilbertPoly_of_ne_zero_of_rootMultiplicity_lt
    {p : F[X]} {d : ℕ} (hp : p ≠ 0) (hpd : p.rootMultiplicity 1 < d) :
    (hilbertPoly p d).natDegree = d - p.rootMultiplicity 1 - 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases exists_eq_pow_rootMultiplicity_mul_and_not_dvd p hp 1 with ⟨q, hq1, hq2⟩
  have heq : p = q * (-1) ^ p.rootMultiplicity 1 * (1 - X) ^ p.rootMultiplicity 1 := by
    simp only [mul_assoc, ← mul_pow, neg_mul, one_mul, neg_sub]
    exact hq1.trans (mul_comm _ _)
  nth_rw 1 [heq, ← Nat.sub_add_cancel (le_of_lt hpd), hilbertPoly_mul_one_sub_pow_add,
    ← Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' <| add_one_le_of_lt hpd)]
  delta hilbertPoly
  apply natDegree_eq_of_le_of_coeff_ne_zero
  · apply natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le _ _ <| fun _ _ => ?_
    apply le_trans (natDegree_smul_le _ _)
    rw [natDegree_preHilbertPoly]
  · have : (fun (x : ℕ) (a : F) => a) = fun x a => a * 1 ^ x := by simp only [one_pow, mul_one]
    simp only [finsetSum_coeff, coeff_smul, smul_eq_mul, coeff_preHilbertPoly_self,
      ← Finset.sum_mul, ← sum_def _ (fun _ a => a), this, ← eval_eq_sum, eval_mul, eval_pow,
      eval_neg, eval_one, _root_.mul_eq_zero, pow_eq_zero_iff', neg_eq_zero, one_ne_zero, ne_eq,
      false_and, or_false, inv_eq_zero, cast_eq_zero, not_or]
    exact ⟨(not_iff_not.2 dvd_iff_isRoot).1 hq2, factorial_ne_zero _⟩

name: natDegree_hilbertPoly_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem natDegree_hilbertPoly_of_ne_zero
    {p : F[X]} {d : ℕ} (hh : hilbertPoly p d ≠ 0) :
    (hilbertPoly p d).natDegree = d - p.rootMultiplicity 1 - 1
proof:
:= by
  have hp : p ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [h] at hh
    exact hh (hilbertPoly_zero_left d)
  have hpd : p.rootMultiplicity 1 < d := by
    by_contra h
    exact hh (hilbertPoly_eq_zero_of_le_rootMultiplicity_one <| not_lt.1 h)
  exact natDegree_hilbertPoly_of_ne_zero_of_rootMultiplicity_lt hp hpd

name: induct
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
protected theorem induct (motive : ℤ → Prop)
    (zero : motive 0)
    (one : motive 1)
    (add_two : ∀ (n : ℕ), motive (↑n + 1) → motive ↑n → motive (↑n + 2))
    (neg_add_one : ∀ (n : ℕ), motive (-↑n) → motive (-↑n + 1) → motive (-↑n - 1)) :
    ∀ (a : ℤ), motive a
proof:
:=
  T.induct motive zero one add_two fun n hn hnm => by
    simpa only [Int.negSucc_eq, neg_add] using! neg_add_one n hn hnm

name: induct'
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
protected theorem induct' (motive : ℤ → Prop)
    (zero : motive 0)
    (one : motive 1)
    (add_two : ∀ (n : ℕ), motive (↑n + 1) → motive ↑n → motive (↑n + 2))
    (neg : ∀ (n : ℤ), motive n → motive (-n)) :
    ∀ (a : ℤ), motive a
proof:
:= by
  refine Chebyshev.induct motive zero one add_two ?_
  have neg' (n : ℤ) (h : motive (-n)) : motive n := by
    convert! neg (-n) h; rw [neg_neg]
  intro n h₀ h₁
  cases n with
  | zero => exact neg 1 h₁
  | succ n =>
    apply neg (n + 2) (add_two n (neg' _ h₀) (neg' n ?_))
    convert! h₁ using 1; omega

name: T_add_two
statement:
@[simp]
theorem T_add_two : ∀ n, T R (n + 2) = 2 * X * T R (n + 1) - T R n
  | (k : ℕ) => T.eq_3 R k
  | -(k + 1 : ℕ) => by linear_combination (norm := (simp [Int.negSucc_eq]; ring_nf)) T.eq_4 R k

name: T_add_one
statement: theorem T_add_one (n : ℤ) : T R (n + 1) = 2 * X * T R n - T R (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  linear_combination (norm := ring_nf) T_add_two R (n - 1)

name: T_sub_two
statement: theorem T_sub_two (n : ℤ) : T R (n - 2) = 2 * X * T R (n - 1) - T R n
proof:
:= by
  linear_combination (norm := ring_nf) T_add_two R (n - 2)

name: T_sub_one
statement: theorem T_sub_one (n : ℤ) : T R (n - 1) = 2 * X * T R n - T R (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  linear_combination (norm := ring_nf) T_add_two R (n - 1)

name: T_eq
statement: theorem T_eq (n : ℤ) : T R n = 2 * X * T R (n - 1) - T R (n - 2)
proof:
:= by
  linear_combination (norm := ring_nf) T_add_two R (n - 2)

name: T_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem T_zero : T R 0 = 1
proof: := by simp [T]

name: T_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem T_one : T R 1 = X
proof: := by simp [T]

name: T_neg_one
statement: theorem T_neg_one : T R (-1) = X
proof:
:= by
  change T R (Int.negSucc 0) = X
  rw [T]
  suffices 2 * X - X = X by simpa
  ring

name: T_two
statement: theorem T_two : T R 2 = 2 * X ^ 2 - 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold T; simp [pow_two, mul_assoc]

name: T_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem T_neg (n : ℤ) : T R (-n) = T R n
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Polynomial.Chebyshev.induct with
  | zero => rfl
  | one => simp only [T_neg_one, T_one]
  | add_two n ih1 ih2 =>
    have h₁ := T_add_two R n
    have h₂ := T_sub_two R (-n)
    linear_combination (norm := ring_nf) (2 * (X : R[X])) * ih1 - ih2 - h₁ + h₂
  | neg_add_one n ih1 ih2 =>
    have h₁ := T_add_one R n
    have h₂ := T_sub_one R (-n)
    linear_combination (norm := ring_nf) (2 * (X : R[X])) * ih1 - ih2 + h₁ - h₂

name: T_natAbs
statement: theorem T_natAbs (n : ℤ) : T R n.natAbs = T R n
proof:
:= by
  obtain h | h := Int.natAbs_eq n <;> nth_rw 2 [h]; simp

name: T_neg_two
statement: theorem T_neg_two : T R (-2) = 2 * X ^ 2 - 1
proof: := by simp [T_two]

name: T_eval_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem T_eval_one (n : ℤ) : (T R n).eval 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Polynomial.Chebyshev.induct with
  | zero => simp
  | one => simp
  | add_two n ih1 ih2 => simp [T_add_two, ih1, ih2]; norm_num
  | neg_add_one n ih1 ih2 => simp [T_sub_one, -T_neg, ih1, ih2]; norm_num

name: T_eval_neg_one
statement: theorem T_eval_neg_one (n : ℤ) : (T R n).eval (-1) = n.negOnePow
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Polynomial.Chebyshev.induct with
  | zero => simp
  | one => simp
  | add_two n ih1 ih2 =>
    simp only [T_add_two, eval_sub, eval_mul, eval_ofNat, eval_X, mul_neg, mul_one, ih1,
      Int.negOnePow_add, Int.negOnePow_one, Units.val_neg, Int.cast_neg, neg_mul, neg_neg, ih2,
      Int.negOnePow_def 2]
    norm_cast
    norm_num
    ring
  | neg_add_one n ih1 ih2 =>
    simp only [T_sub_one, eval_sub, eval_mul, eval_ofNat, eval_X, mul_neg, mul_one, ih1, neg_mul,
      ih2, Int.negOnePow_add, Int.negOnePow_one, Units.val_neg, Int.cast_neg, sub_neg_eq_add,
      Int.negOnePow_sub]
    ring

name: T_eval_zero
statement:
theorem T_eval_zero (n : ℤ) :
    (T R n).eval 0 = (if Even n then (n / 2).negOnePow else 0 : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Polynomial.Chebyshev.induct with
  | zero => simp
  | one => simp
  | add_two n ih1 ih2 =>
    have : ((n : ℤ) + 2) / 2 = (n : ℤ) / 2 + 1 := by lia
    by_cases Even n <;> simp_all [Int.negOnePow_add]
  | neg_add_one n ih1 ih2 =>
    have : (-(n : ℤ) + 1) / 2 = (-(n : ℤ) - 1) / 2 + 1 := by lia
    by_cases Even n <;> simp_all [T_sub_one, ← Int.not_even_iff_odd, Int.negOnePow_add]

name: T_eval_zero_of_even
statement:
@[simp]
theorem T_eval_zero_of_even {n : ℤ} (hn : Even n) : (T R n).eval 0 = (n / 2).negOnePow
proof:
:= by
  simp [T_eval_zero, hn]

name: T_eval_two_mul_zero
statement: theorem T_eval_two_mul_zero (n : ℤ) : (T R (2 * n)).eval 0 = n.negOnePow
proof: := by simp

name: T_eval_zero_of_odd
statement:
@[simp]
theorem T_eval_zero_of_odd {n : ℤ} (hn : Odd n) : (T R n).eval 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [T_eval_zero, ← Int.not_odd_iff_even, hn]

name: degree_T
statement:
@[simp]
theorem degree_T [IsDomain R] [NeZero (2 : R)] (n : ℤ) : (T R n).degree = n.natAbs
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Chebyshev.induct' with
  | zero => simp
  | one => simp
  | add_two n ih1 ih2 =>
    have : (2 * X * T R (n + 1)).degree = ↑(n + 2) := by
      rw [mul_assoc, ← C_ofNat, degree_C_mul two_ne_zero, mul_comm, degree_mul_X, ih1]
      norm_cast
    rw [T_add_two, degree_sub_eq_left_of_degree_lt]
    · rw [this]; norm_cast
    · rw [ih2, this]; tauto
  | neg n ih => simp [ih]

name: natDegree_T
statement:
@[simp]
theorem natDegree_T [IsDomain R] [NeZero (2 : R)] (n : ℤ) : (T R n).natDegree = n.natAbs
proof:
:=
  natDegree_eq_of_degree_eq_some (degree_T R n)

name: leadingCoeff_T
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leadingCoeff_T [IsDomain R] [NeZero (2 : R)] (n : ℤ) :
    (T R n).leadingCoeff = 2 ^ (n.natAbs - 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Chebyshev.induct' with
  | zero => simp
  | one => simp
  | add_two n ih1 ih2 =>
    have : leadingCoeff (2 : R[X]) = 2 := by
      change leadingCoeff (C 2) = 2
      rw [leadingCoeff_C]
    rw [T_add_two, leadingCoeff_sub_of_degree_lt, leadingCoeff_mul, ih1,
      leadingCoeff_mul, leadingCoeff_X, this]
    · norm_cast; simp [pow_add, mul_comm]
    · rw [mul_assoc, ← C_ofNat, degree_C_mul two_ne_zero, mul_comm, degree_mul_X, degree_T,
        degree_T]
      tauto
  | neg n ih => simp [ih]

name: T_eval_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem T_eval_neg (n : ℤ) (x : R) : (T R n).eval (-x) = n.negOnePow * (T R n).eval x
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Chebyshev.induct' with
  | zero => simp
  | one => simp
  | add_two n ih1 ih2 =>
    trans (n + 2 : ℤ).negOnePow * (2 * x * (T R (n + 1)).eval x - (T R n).eval x)
    · simp only [T_add_two, eval_sub, eval_mul, eval_ofNat, eval_X, mul_neg, ih1, Int.negOnePow_add,
        Int.negOnePow_one, Units.val_neg, Int.cast_neg, ih2, Int.negOnePow_even 2 even_two]
      ring_nf
    · simp
  | neg n ih => simp [ih]

name: T_ne_zero
statement: theorem T_ne_zero (n : ℤ) [IsDomain R] [NeZero (2 : R)] : T R n ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  (T R n).degree_ne_bot.mp (by simp [degree_T R n])

name: U_add_two
statement:
@[simp]
theorem U_add_two : ∀ n, U R (n + 2) = 2 * X * U R (n + 1) - U R n
  | (k : ℕ) => U.eq_3 R k
  | -(k + 1 : ℕ) => by linear_combination (norm := (simp [Int.negSucc_eq]; ring_nf)) U.eq_4 R k

name: U_add_one
statement: theorem U_add_one (n : ℤ) : U R (n + 1) = 2 * X * U R n - U R (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  linear_combination (norm := ring_nf) U_add_two R (n - 1)

name: U_sub_two
statement: theorem U_sub_two (n : ℤ) : U R (n - 2) = 2 * X * U R (n - 1) - U R n
proof:
:= by
  linear_combination (norm := ring_nf) U_add_two R (n - 2)

name: U_sub_one
statement: theorem U_sub_one (n : ℤ) : U R (n - 1) = 2 * X * U R n - U R (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  linear_combination (norm := ring_nf) U_add_two R (n - 1)

name: U_eq
statement: theorem U_eq (n : ℤ) : U R n = 2 * X * U R (n - 1) - U R (n - 2)
proof:
:= by
  linear_combination (norm := ring_nf) U_add_two R (n - 2)

name: U_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem U_zero : U R 0 = 1
proof: := by simp [U]

name: U_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem U_one : U R 1 = 2 * X
proof: := by simp [U]

name: U_neg_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem U_neg_one : U R (-1) = 0
proof: := by simpa using U_sub_one R 0

name: U_two
statement: theorem U_two : U R 2 = 4 * X ^ 2 - 1
proof:
:= by
  have := U_add_two R 0
  simp only [zero_add, U_one, U_zero] at this
  linear_combination this

name: U_neg_two
statement:
@[simp]
theorem U_neg_two : U R (-2) = -1
proof:
:= by
  simpa [zero_sub, Int.reduceNeg, U_neg_one, mul_zero, U_zero] using U_sub_two R 0

name: U_neg_sub_one
statement: theorem U_neg_sub_one (n : ℤ) : U R (-n - 1) = -U R (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Polynomial.Chebyshev.induct with
  | zero => simp
  | one => simp
  | add_two n ih1 ih2 =>
    have h₁ := U_add_one R n
    have h₂ := U_sub_two R (-n - 1)
    linear_combination (norm := ring_nf) 2 * (X : R[X]) * ih1 - ih2 + h₁ + h₂
  | neg_add_one n ih1 ih2 =>
    have h₁ := U_eq R n
    have h₂ := U_sub_two R (-n)
    linear_combination (norm := ring_nf) 2 * (X : R[X]) * ih1 - ih2 + h₁ + h₂

name: U_neg
statement: theorem U_neg (n : ℤ) : U R (-n) = -U R (n - 2)
proof: := by simpa [sub_sub] using U_neg_sub_one R (n - 1)

name: U_neg_sub_two
statement:
@[simp]
theorem U_neg_sub_two (n : ℤ) : U R (-n - 2) = -U R n
proof:
:= by
  simpa [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using U_neg R (n + 2)

name: U_eval_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem U_eval_one (n : ℤ) : (U R n).eval 1 = n + 1
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Polynomial.Chebyshev.induct with
  | zero => simp
  | one => simp; norm_num
  | add_two n ih1 ih2 =>
    simp only [U_add_two, eval_sub, eval_mul, eval_ofNat, eval_X, mul_one, ih1,
      Int.cast_add, Int.cast_natCast, Int.cast_one, ih2, Int.cast_ofNat]
    ring
  | neg_add_one n ih1 ih2 =>
    simp only [U_sub_one, eval_sub, eval_mul, eval_ofNat, eval_X, mul_one,
      ih1, Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_natCast, ih2, Int.cast_add, Int.cast_one, Int.cast_sub,
      sub_add_cancel]
    ring

name: U_eval_neg_one
statement: theorem U_eval_neg_one (n : ℤ) : (U R n).eval (-1) = n.negOnePow * (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Polynomial.Chebyshev.induct with
  | zero => simp
  | one => simp; norm_num
  | add_two n ih1 ih2 =>
    simp only [U_add_two, eval_sub, eval_mul, eval_ofNat, eval_X, mul_neg, mul_one, ih1,
      Int.cast_add, Int.cast_natCast, Int.cast_one, neg_mul, ih2, Int.cast_ofNat, Int.negOnePow_add,
      Int.negOnePow_def 2]
    norm_cast
    norm_num
    ring
  | neg_add_one n ih1 ih2 =>
    simp only [U_sub_one, eval_sub, eval_mul, eval_ofNat, eval_X, mul_neg, mul_one, ih1,
      Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_natCast, Int.negOnePow_neg, neg_mul, ih2, Int.cast_add, Int.cast_one,
      Int.cast_sub, sub_add_cancel, Int.negOnePow_sub, Int.negOnePow_add]
    norm_cast
    norm_num
    ring

name: U_eval_zero
statement:
theorem U_eval_zero (n : ℤ) :
    (U R n).eval 0 = (if Even n then (n / 2).negOnePow else 0 : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Polynomial.Chebyshev.induct with
  | zero => simp
  | one => simp
  | add_two n ih1 ih2 =>
    have : ((n : ℤ) + 2) / 2 = (n : ℤ) / 2 + 1 := by lia
    by_cases Even n <;> simp_all [Int.negOnePow_add]
  | neg_add_one n ih1 ih2 =>
    have : (-(n : ℤ) + 1) / 2 = (-(n : ℤ) - 1) / 2 + 1 := by lia
    by_cases Even n <;> simp_all [U_sub_one, ← Int.not_even_iff_odd, Int.negOnePow_add]

name: U_eval_zero_of_even
statement:
@[simp]
theorem U_eval_zero_of_even {n : ℤ} (hn : Even n) : (U R n).eval 0 = (n / 2).negOnePow
proof:
:= by
  simp [U_eval_zero, hn]

name: U_eval_two_mul_zero
statement: theorem U_eval_two_mul_zero (n : ℤ) : (U R (2 * n)).eval 0 = n.negOnePow
proof: := by simp

name: U_eval_zero_of_odd
statement:
@[simp]
theorem U_eval_zero_of_odd {n : ℤ} (hn : Odd n) : (U R n).eval 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [U_eval_zero, ← Int.not_odd_iff_even, hn]

name: degree_U_natCast
statement:
@[simp]
theorem degree_U_natCast [IsDomain R] [NeZero (2 : R)] (n : ℕ) : (U R n).degree = n
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.twoStepInduction with
  | zero => simp
  | one =>
    norm_cast
    rw [U_one, ← C_ofNat, degree_C_mul_X two_ne_zero]
  | more n ih1 ih2 =>
    push_cast; push_cast at ih2
    have : (2 * X * U R (n + 1)).degree = ↑(n + 2) := by
      rw [mul_assoc, ← C_ofNat, degree_C_mul two_ne_zero, mul_comm, degree_mul_X, ih2]
      norm_cast
    rw [U_add_two, degree_sub_eq_left_of_degree_lt]
    · rw [this]; norm_cast
    · rw [ih1, this]; norm_cast; omega

name: natDegree_U_natCast
statement:
@[simp]
theorem natDegree_U_natCast [IsDomain R] [NeZero (2 : R)] (n : ℕ) : (U R n).natDegree = n
proof:
:=
  natDegree_eq_of_degree_eq_some (degree_U_natCast R n)

name: degree_U_neg_one
statement: theorem degree_U_neg_one : (U R (-1)).degree = ⊥
proof: := by simp

name: natDegree_U_neg_one
statement: theorem natDegree_U_neg_one : (U R (-1)).natDegree = 0
proof: := by simp

name: degree_U_of_ne_neg_one
statement:
theorem degree_U_of_ne_neg_one [IsDomain R] [NeZero (2 : R)] (n : ℤ) (hn : n ≠ -1) :
    (U R n).degree = ↑((n + 1).natAbs - 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl | rfl⟩ := n.eq_nat_or_neg
  case inl => rw [degree_U_natCast R m]; norm_cast
  case inr =>
    rw [U_neg, degree_neg]
    cases m with
    | zero => simp
    | succ m =>
      cases m with
      | zero => contradiction
      | succ m =>
        trans (U R m).degree
        · congr; omega
        · rw [degree_U_natCast R m]; norm_cast

name: natDegree_U
statement:
theorem natDegree_U [IsDomain R] [NeZero (2 : R)] (n : ℤ) :
    (U R n).natDegree = (n + 1).natAbs - 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases n = -1
  case pos hn => subst hn; simp
  case neg hn => exact natDegree_eq_of_degree_eq_some (degree_U_of_ne_neg_one R n hn)

name: leadingCoeff_U_natCast
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leadingCoeff_U_natCast [IsDomain R] [NeZero (2 : R)] (n : ℕ) :
    (U R n).leadingCoeff = 2 ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have : leadingCoeff (2 : R[X]) = 2 := by
    rw [← C_ofNat, leadingCoeff_C]
  induction n using Nat.twoStepInduction with
  | zero => simp
  | one => simp [this]
  | more n ih1 ih2 =>
    push_cast; push_cast at ih2
    rw [U_add_two, leadingCoeff_sub_of_degree_lt, leadingCoeff_mul, ih2,
      leadingCoeff_mul, leadingCoeff_X, this]
    · norm_cast; rw [pow_add, pow_add]; ring_nf
    · norm_cast
      rw [mul_assoc, ← C_ofNat, degree_C_mul two_ne_zero, mul_comm, degree_mul_X,
        degree_U_natCast R n, degree_U_natCast R (n + 1)]
      norm_cast; omega

name: U_eval_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem U_eval_neg (n : ℕ) (x : R) : (U R n).eval (-x) = (n : ℤ).negOnePow * (U R n).eval x
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.twoStepInduction with
  | zero => simp
  | one => simp
  | more n ih1 ih2 =>
    trans (n + 2 : ℤ).negOnePow * (2 * x * (U R (n + 1)).eval x - (U R n).eval x)
    · push_cast; push_cast at ih2
      rw [U_add_two, eval_sub, eval_mul, eval_mul, ih1, ih2,
        Int.negOnePow_succ, Int.negOnePow_add, Int.negOnePow_even 2 even_two]
      simp; ring
    · simp

name: U_ne_zero
statement: theorem U_ne_zero (n : ℤ) [IsDomain R] [NeZero (2 : R)] (hn : n ≠ -1) : U R n ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  (U R n).degree_ne_bot.mp (by simp [degree_U_of_ne_neg_one R n hn])

name: U_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem U_eq_zero_iff (n : ℤ) [IsDomain R] [NeZero (2 : R)] :
    U R n = 0 ↔ n = -1
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by contrapose! h; exact U_ne_zero R n h, fun h => by simp [h]⟩

name: U_eq_X_mul_U_add_T
statement: theorem U_eq_X_mul_U_add_T (n : ℤ) : U R (n + 1) = X * U R n + T R (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Polynomial.Chebyshev.induct with
  | zero => simp [two_mul]
  | one => simp [U_two, T_two]; ring
  | add_two n ih1 ih2 =>
    have h₁ := U_add_two R (n + 1)
    have h₂ := U_add_two R n
    have h₃ := T_add_two R (n + 1)
    linear_combination (norm := ring_nf) -h₃ - (X : R[X]) * h₂ + h₁ + 2 * (X : R[X]) * ih1 - ih2
  | neg_add_one n ih1 ih2 =>
    have h₁ := U_add_two R (-n - 1)
    have h₂ := U_add_two R (-n)
    have h₃ := T_add_two R (-n)
    linear_combination (norm := ring_nf) -h₃ + h₂ - (X : R[X]) * h₁ - ih2 + 2 * (X : R[X]) * ih1

name: T_eq_U_sub_X_mul_U
statement: theorem T_eq_U_sub_X_mul_U (n : ℤ) : T R n = U R n - X * U R (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  linear_combination (norm := ring_nf) - U_eq_X_mul_U_add_T R (n - 1)

name: T_eq_X_mul_T_sub_pol_U
statement: theorem T_eq_X_mul_T_sub_pol_U (n : ℤ) : T R (n + 2) = X * T R (n + 1) - (1 - X ^ 2) * U R n
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := U_eq_X_mul_U_add_T R n
  have h₂ := U_eq_X_mul_U_add_T R (n + 1)
  have h₃ := U_add_two R n
  linear_combination (norm := ring_nf) h₃ - h₂ + (X : R[X]) * h₁

name: one_sub_X_sq_mul_U_eq_pol_in_T
statement:
theorem one_sub_X_sq_mul_U_eq_pol_in_T (n : ℤ) :
    (1 - X ^ 2) * U R n = X * T R (n + 1) - T R (n + 2)
proof:
:= by
  linear_combination T_eq_X_mul_T_sub_pol_U R n

name: T_eq_X_mul_U_sub_U
statement: theorem T_eq_X_mul_U_sub_U (n : ℤ) : T R (n + 2) = X * U R (n + 1) - U R n
proof:
:= by
  have h := T_eq_U_sub_X_mul_U (R := R) (-(n + 2))
  rw [T_neg, U_neg, Int.add_sub_cancel, ← neg_add' _ 1, U_neg,
    show n + 2 + 1 - 2 = n + 1 by ring] at h
  linear_combination (norm := ring_nf) h

name: two_mul_T_eq_U_sub_U
statement:
@[dlmf 18.9.E9]
theorem two_mul_T_eq_U_sub_U (n : ℤ) : 2 * T R (n + 2) = U R (n + 2) - U R n
proof:
:= by
  linear_combination (norm := ring_nf) (T_eq_U_sub_X_mul_U R (n + 2)) + (T_eq_X_mul_U_sub_U R n)

name: U_eq_two_mul_T_add_U
statement: theorem U_eq_two_mul_T_add_U (n : ℤ) : U R (n + 2) = 2 * T R (n + 2) + U R n
proof:
:= by
  linear_combination (norm := ring_nf) - (two_mul_T_eq_U_sub_U R n)

name: U_mem_span_T
statement: theorem U_mem_span_T (n : ℕ) : U R n ∈ Submodule.span ℕ ((fun m : ℕ => T R m) '' Set.Icc 0 n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.twoStepInduction with
  | zero => simp
  | one =>
    rw [show U R (1 : ℕ) = 2 * T R 1 by simp, ← smul_eq_mul]; norm_cast
    exact Submodule.smul_of_tower_mem _ 2 (Submodule.mem_span_of_mem ⟨1, by simp⟩)
  | more n h₀ _ =>
    push_cast; rw [U_eq_two_mul_T_add_U, ← smul_eq_mul]; norm_cast
    refine Submodule.add_mem _ ?_ ((Submodule.span_mono (by grind)) h₀)
    · exact Submodule.smul_of_tower_mem _ 2
        (Submodule.mem_span_of_mem ⟨n + 2, by simp⟩)

name: C_add_two
statement:
@[simp]
theorem C_add_two : ∀ n, C R (n + 2) = X * C R (n + 1) - C R n
  | (k : ℕ) => C.eq_3 R k
  | -(k + 1 : ℕ) => by linear_combination (norm := (simp [Int.negSucc_eq]; ring_nf)) C.eq_4 R k

name: C_add_one
statement: theorem C_add_one (n : ℤ) : C R (n + 1) = X * C R n - C R (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  linear_combination (norm := ring_nf) C_add_two R (n - 1)

name: C_sub_two
statement: theorem C_sub_two (n : ℤ) : C R (n - 2) = X * C R (n - 1) - C R n
proof:
:= by
  linear_combination (norm := ring_nf) C_add_two R (n - 2)

name: C_sub_one
statement: theorem C_sub_one (n : ℤ) : C R (n - 1) = X * C R n - C R (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  linear_combination (norm := ring_nf) C_add_two R (n - 1)

name: C_eq
statement: theorem C_eq (n : ℤ) : C R n = X * C R (n - 1) - C R (n - 2)
proof:
:= by
  linear_combination (norm := ring_nf) C_add_two R (n - 2)

name: C_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem C_zero : C R 0 = 2
proof: := by simp [C]

name: C_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem C_one : C R 1 = X
proof: := by simp [C]

name: C_neg_one
statement: theorem C_neg_one : C R (-1) = X
proof:
:= by
  change C R (Int.negSucc 0) = X
  rw [C]
  suffices X * 2 - X = X by simpa
  ring

name: C_two
statement: theorem C_two : C R 2 = X ^ 2 - 2
proof:
:= by
  simpa [pow_two, mul_assoc] using C_add_two R 0

name: C_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem C_neg (n : ℤ) : C R (-n) = C R n
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Polynomial.Chebyshev.induct with
  | zero => rfl
  | one => simp only [C_neg_one, C_one]
  | add_two n ih1 ih2 =>
    have h₁ := C_add_two R n
    have h₂ := C_sub_two R (-n)
    linear_combination (norm := ring_nf) (X : R[X]) * ih1 - ih2 - h₁ + h₂
  | neg_add_one n ih1 ih2 =>
    have h₁ := C_add_one R n
    have h₂ := C_sub_one R (-n)
    linear_combination (norm := ring_nf) (X : R[X]) * ih1 - ih2 + h₁ - h₂

name: C_natAbs
statement: theorem C_natAbs (n : ℤ) : C R n.natAbs = C R n
proof:
:= by
  obtain h | h := Int.natAbs_eq n <;> nth_rw 2 [h]; simp

name: C_neg_two
statement: theorem C_neg_two : C R (-2) = X ^ 2 - 2
proof: := by simp [C_two]

name: C_comp_two_mul_X
statement: theorem C_comp_two_mul_X (n : ℤ) : (C R n).comp (2 * X) = 2 * T R n
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Polynomial.Chebyshev.induct with
  | zero => simp
  | one => simp
  | add_two n ih1 ih2 =>
    simp_rw [C_add_two, T_add_two, sub_comp, mul_comp, X_comp, ih1, ih2]
    ring
  | neg_add_one n ih1 ih2 =>
    simp_rw [C_sub_one, T_sub_one, sub_comp, mul_comp, X_comp, ih1, ih2]
    ring

name: C_eval_two
statement:
@[simp]
theorem C_eval_two (n : ℤ) : (C R n).eval 2 = 2
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Polynomial.Chebyshev.induct with
  | zero => simp
  | one => simp
  | add_two n ih1 ih2 => simp [C_add_two, ih1, ih2]; norm_num
  | neg_add_one n ih1 ih2 => simp [C_sub_one, -C_neg, ih1, ih2]; norm_num

name: C_eval_neg_two
statement:
@[simp]
theorem C_eval_neg_two (n : ℤ) : (C R n).eval (-2) = 2 * n.negOnePow
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Polynomial.Chebyshev.induct with
  | zero => simp
  | one => simp
  | add_two n ih1 ih2 =>
    simp only [C_add_two, eval_sub, eval_mul, eval_X, mul_neg, mul_one, ih1,
      Int.negOnePow_add, Int.negOnePow_one, Units.val_neg, Int.cast_neg, neg_mul, neg_neg, ih2,
      Int.negOnePow_def 2]
    norm_cast
    norm_num
    ring
  | neg_add_one n ih1 ih2 =>
    simp only [C_sub_one, eval_sub, eval_mul, eval_X, mul_neg, mul_one, ih1, neg_mul,
      ih2, Int.negOnePow_add, Int.negOnePow_one, Units.val_neg, Int.cast_neg, sub_neg_eq_add,
      Int.negOnePow_sub]
    ring

name: C_eq_two_mul_T_comp_half_mul_X
statement:
theorem C_eq_two_mul_T_comp_half_mul_X [Invertible (2 : R)] (n : ℤ) :
    C R n = 2 * (T R n).comp (Polynomial.C ⅟2 * X)
proof:
:= by
  have := congr_arg (·.comp (Polynomial.C ⅟2 * X)) (C_comp_two_mul_X R n)
  simp_rw [comp_assoc, mul_comp, ofNat_comp, X_comp, ← mul_assoc, ← C_eq_natCast, ← C_mul,
    Nat.cast_ofNat, mul_invOf_self', map_one, one_mul, comp_X, map_ofNat] at this
  assumption

name: T_eq_half_mul_C_comp_two_mul_X
statement:
theorem T_eq_half_mul_C_comp_two_mul_X [Invertible (2 : R)] (n : ℤ) :
    T R n = Polynomial.C ⅟2 * (C R n).comp (2 * X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [C_comp_two_mul_X, ← mul_assoc, ← map_ofNat Polynomial.C 2, ← map_mul, invOf_mul_self',
    map_one, one_mul]

name: S_add_two
statement:
@[simp]
theorem S_add_two : ∀ n, S R (n + 2) = X * S R (n + 1) - S R n
  | (k : ℕ) => S.eq_3 R k
  | -(k + 1 : ℕ) => by linear_combination (norm := (simp [Int.negSucc_eq]; ring_nf)) S.eq_4 R k

name: S_add_one
statement: theorem S_add_one (n : ℤ) : S R (n + 1) = X * S R n - S R (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  linear_combination (norm := ring_nf) S_add_two R (n - 1)

name: S_sub_two
statement: theorem S_sub_two (n : ℤ) : S R (n - 2) = X * S R (n - 1) - S R n
proof:
:= by
  linear_combination (norm := ring_nf) S_add_two R (n - 2)

name: S_sub_one
statement: theorem S_sub_one (n : ℤ) : S R (n - 1) = X * S R n - S R (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  linear_combination (norm := ring_nf) S_add_two R (n - 1)

name: S_eq
statement: theorem S_eq (n : ℤ) : S R n = X * S R (n - 1) - S R (n - 2)
proof:
:= by
  linear_combination (norm := ring_nf) S_add_two R (n - 2)

name: S_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem S_zero : S R 0 = 1
proof: := by simp [S]

name: S_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem S_one : S R 1 = X
proof: := by simp [S]

name: S_neg_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem S_neg_one : S R (-1) = 0
proof: := by simpa using S_sub_one R 0

name: S_two
statement: theorem S_two : S R 2 = X ^ 2 - 1
proof:
:= by
  have := S_add_two R 0
  simp only [zero_add, S_one, S_zero] at this
  linear_combination this

name: S_neg_two
statement:
@[simp]
theorem S_neg_two : S R (-2) = -1
proof:
:= by
  simpa [zero_sub, Int.reduceNeg, S_neg_one, mul_zero, S_zero] using S_sub_two R 0

name: S_neg_sub_one
statement: theorem S_neg_sub_one (n : ℤ) : S R (-n - 1) = -S R (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Polynomial.Chebyshev.induct with
  | zero => simp
  | one => simp
  | add_two n ih1 ih2 =>
    have h₁ := S_add_one R n
    have h₂ := S_sub_two R (-n - 1)
    linear_combination (norm := ring_nf) (X : R[X]) * ih1 - ih2 + h₁ + h₂
  | neg_add_one n ih1 ih2 =>
    have h₁ := S_eq R n
    have h₂ := S_sub_two R (-n)
    linear_combination (norm := ring_nf) (X : R[X]) * ih1 - ih2 + h₁ + h₂

name: S_neg
statement: theorem S_neg (n : ℤ) : S R (-n) = -S R (n - 2)
proof: := by simpa [sub_sub] using S_neg_sub_one R (n - 1)

name: S_neg_sub_two
statement:
@[simp]
theorem S_neg_sub_two (n : ℤ) : S R (-n - 2) = -S R n
proof:
:= by
  simpa [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using S_neg R (n + 2)

name: S_eval_two
statement:
@[simp]
theorem S_eval_two (n : ℤ) : (S R n).eval 2 = n + 1
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Polynomial.Chebyshev.induct with
  | zero => simp
  | one => simp; norm_num
  | add_two n ih1 ih2 =>
    simp only [S_add_two, eval_sub, eval_mul, eval_X, ih1,
      Int.cast_add, Int.cast_natCast, Int.cast_one, ih2, Int.cast_ofNat]
    ring
  | neg_add_one n ih1 ih2 =>
    simp only [S_sub_one, eval_sub, eval_mul, eval_X,
      ih1, Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_natCast, ih2, Int.cast_add, Int.cast_one, Int.cast_sub,
      sub_add_cancel]
    ring

name: S_eval_neg_two
statement:
@[simp]
theorem S_eval_neg_two (n : ℤ) : (S R n).eval (-2) = n.negOnePow * (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Polynomial.Chebyshev.induct with
  | zero => simp
  | one => simp; norm_num
  | add_two n ih1 ih2 =>
    simp only [S_add_two, eval_sub, eval_mul, eval_X, ih1,
      Int.cast_add, Int.cast_natCast, Int.cast_one, neg_mul, ih2, Int.cast_ofNat, Int.negOnePow_add,
      Int.negOnePow_def 2]
    norm_cast
    norm_num
    ring
  | neg_add_one n ih1 ih2 =>
    simp only [S_sub_one, eval_sub, eval_mul, eval_X, mul_neg, ih1,
      Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_natCast, Int.negOnePow_neg, neg_mul, ih2, Int.cast_add, Int.cast_one,
      Int.cast_sub, sub_add_cancel, Int.negOnePow_sub, Int.negOnePow_add]
    norm_cast
    norm_num
    ring

name: S_comp_two_mul_X
statement: theorem S_comp_two_mul_X (n : ℤ) : (S R n).comp (2 * X) = U R n
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Polynomial.Chebyshev.induct with
  | zero => simp
  | one => simp
  | add_two n ih1 ih2 => simp_rw [U_add_two, S_add_two, sub_comp, mul_comp, X_comp, ih1, ih2]
  | neg_add_one n ih1 ih2 => simp_rw [U_sub_one, S_sub_one, sub_comp, mul_comp, X_comp, ih1, ih2]

name: S_sq_add_S_sq
statement: theorem S_sq_add_S_sq (n : ℤ) : S R n ^ 2 + S R (n + 1) ^ 2 - X * S R n * S R (n + 1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp; ring
  | succ n ih =>
    have h₁ := S_add_two R n
    linear_combination (norm := ring_nf) (S R (2 + n) - S R n) * h₁ + ih
  | pred n ih =>
    have h₁ := S_sub_one R (-n)
    linear_combination (norm := ring_nf) (S R (-1 - n) - S R (1 - n)) * h₁ + ih

name: S_eq_U_comp_half_mul_X
statement:
theorem S_eq_U_comp_half_mul_X [Invertible (2 : R)] (n : ℤ) :
    S R n = (U R n).comp (Polynomial.C ⅟2 * X)
proof:
:= by
  have := congr_arg (·.comp (Polynomial.C ⅟2 * X)) (S_comp_two_mul_X R n)
  simp_rw [comp_assoc, mul_comp, ofNat_comp, X_comp, ← mul_assoc, ← C_eq_natCast, ← C_mul,
    Nat.cast_ofNat, mul_invOf_self', map_one, one_mul, comp_X] at this
  assumption

name: S_eq_X_mul_S_add_C
statement: theorem S_eq_X_mul_S_add_C (n : ℤ) : 2 * S R (n + 1) = X * S R n + C R (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Polynomial.Chebyshev.induct with
  | zero => simp [two_mul]
  | one => simp [S_two, C_two]; ring
  | add_two n ih1 ih2 =>
    have h₁ := S_add_two R (n + 1)
    have h₂ := S_add_two R n
    have h₃ := C_add_two R (n + 1)
    linear_combination (norm := ring_nf) -h₃ - (X : R[X]) * h₂ + 2 * h₁ + (X : R[X]) * ih1 - ih2
  | neg_add_one n ih1 ih2 =>
    have h₁ := S_add_two R (-n - 1)
    have h₂ := S_add_two R (-n)
    have h₃ := C_add_two R (-n)
    linear_combination (norm := ring_nf) -h₃ + 2 * h₂ - (X : R[X]) * h₁ - ih2 + (X : R[X]) * ih1

name: C_eq_S_sub_X_mul_S
statement: theorem C_eq_S_sub_X_mul_S (n : ℤ) : C R n = 2 * S R n - X * S R (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  linear_combination (norm := ring_nf) - S_eq_X_mul_S_add_C R (n - 1)

name: map_T
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_T (f : R →+* R') (n : ℤ) : map f (T R n) = T R' n
proof:
:= by

  | one => simp
  | add_two n ih1 ih2 =>
    simp_rw [T_add_two, Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_ofNat, map_X,
      ih1, ih2]
  | neg_add_one n ih1 ih2 =>
    simp_rw [T_sub_one, Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_ofNat, map_X, ih1,
      ih2]

name: map_U
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_U (f : R →+* R') (n : ℤ) : map f (U R n) = U R' n

      ih2]
  | neg_add_one n ih1 ih2 =>
    simp_rw [U_sub_one, Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_ofNat, map_X, ih1,
      ih2]

name: map_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_C (f : R →+* R') (n : ℤ) : map f (C R n) = C R' n

name: map_S
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_S (f : R →+* R') (n : ℤ) : map f (S R n) = S R' n

name: aeval_T
statement:

theorem aeval_T [Algebra R R'] (x : R') (n : ℤ) : aeval x (T R n) = (T R' n).eval x

name: algebraMap_eval_T
statement:

theorem algebraMap_eval_T [Algebra R R'] (x : R) (n : ℤ) :

name: T_derivative_eq_U
statement:
@[dlmf 18.9.E21]
theorem T_derivative_eq_U (n : ℤ) : derivative (T R n) = n * U R (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Polynomial.Chebyshev.induct with
  | zero => simp
  | one =>
    simp
  | add_two n ih1 ih2 =>
    have h₁ := congr_arg derivative (T_add_two R n)
    have h₂ := U_sub_one R n
    have h₃ := T_eq_U_sub_X_mul_U R (n + 1)
    simp only [derivative_sub, derivative_mul, derivative_ofNat, derivative_X] at h₁
    linear_combination (norm := (push_cast; ring_nf))
      h₁ - ih2 + 2 * (X : R[X]) * ih1 + 2 * h₃ - n * h₂
  | neg_add_one n ih1 ih2 =>
    have h₁ := congr_arg derivative (T_sub_one R (-n))
    have h₂ := U_sub_two R (-n)
    have h₃ := T_eq_U_sub_X_mul_U R (-n)
    simp only [derivative_sub, derivative_mul, derivative_ofNat, derivative_X] at h₁
    linear_combination (norm := (push_cast; ring_nf))
      -ih2 + 2 * (X : R[X]) * ih1 + h₁ + 2 * h₃ + (n + 1) * h₂

name: T_derivative_mem_span_T
statement:
theorem T_derivative_mem_span_T (n : ℕ) :
    derivative (T R n) ∈ Submodule.span ℕ ((fun m : ℕ => T R m) '' Set.Ico 0 n)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! hn : n = 0
  · simp [hn]
  rw [T_derivative_eq_U, ← smul_eq_mul]; norm_cast
  refine Submodule.smul_of_tower_mem _ n ?_
  convert! U_mem_span_T R (n - 1) using 2 <;> grind

name: T_iterate_derivative_mem_span_T
statement:
theorem T_iterate_derivative_mem_span_T (n k : ℕ) :
    derivative^[k] (T R n) ∈ Submodule.span ℕ ((fun m : ℕ => T R m) '' Set.Icc 0 (n - k))
proof:
:= by
  induction k
  case zero =>
    rw [Function.iterate_zero_apply]
    exact Submodule.mem_span_of_mem ⟨n, by simp⟩
  case succ k ih =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
    suffices Submodule.span ℕ ((fun m : ℕ => derivative (T R m)) '' Set.Icc 0 (n - k)) ≤
      Submodule.span ℕ ((fun m : ℕ => T R m) '' Set.Icc 0 (n - (k + 1))) by
      apply this
      convert! Submodule.apply_mem_span_image_of_mem_span (derivative.restrictScalars ℕ) ih using 2
      simp [Set.image]
    refine Submodule.span_le.mpr (fun x hx => ?_)
    obtain ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩ := hx
    refine (Submodule.span_mono (by grind)) (T_derivative_mem_span_T (R := R) m)

name: one_sub_X_sq_mul_derivative_T_eq_poly_in_T
statement:
theorem one_sub_X_sq_mul_derivative_T_eq_poly_in_T (n : ℤ) :
    (1 - X ^ 2) * derivative (T R (n + 1)) = (n + 1 : R[X]) * (T R n - X * T R (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have H₁ := one_sub_X_sq_mul_U_eq_pol_in_T R n
  have H₂ := T_derivative_eq_U (R := R) (n + 1)
  have h₁ := T_add_two R n
  linear_combination (norm := (push_cast; ring_nf))
    (-n - 1) * h₁ + (-(X : R[X]) ^ 2 + 1) * H₂ + (n + 1) * H₁

name: add_one_mul_T_eq_poly_in_U
statement:
theorem add_one_mul_T_eq_poly_in_U (n : ℤ) :
    ((n : R[X]) + 1) * T R (n + 1) = X * U R n - (1 - X ^ 2) * derivative (U R n)
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := congr_arg derivative <| T_eq_X_mul_T_sub_pol_U R n
  simp only [derivative_sub, derivative_mul, derivative_X, derivative_one, derivative_X_pow,
    T_derivative_eq_U, C_eq_natCast] at h₁
  have h₂ := T_eq_U_sub_X_mul_U R (n + 1)
  linear_combination (norm := (push_cast; ring_nf))
    h₁ + (n + 2) * h₂

name: add_one_mul_self_mul_T_eq_poly_in_T
statement:
theorem add_one_mul_self_mul_T_eq_poly_in_T (n : ℤ) :
    ((n + 1) * n : R[X]) * (T R (n + 1)) =
    (n : R[X]) * X * derivative (T R (n + 1)) - (n + 1 : R[X]) * derivative (T R n)
proof:
:= by
  have h := T_eq_X_mul_U_sub_U (R := R) (n - 1)
  rw [T_derivative_eq_U, T_derivative_eq_U]
  linear_combination (norm := (push_cast; ring_nf))
    (n + 1) * n * h

name: one_sub_X_sq_mul_derivative_derivative_T_eq_poly_in_T
statement:
theorem one_sub_X_sq_mul_derivative_derivative_T_eq_poly_in_T (n : ℤ) :
    (1 - X ^ 2) * derivative^[2] (T R n) = X * derivative (T R n) - (n ^ 2 : R[X]) * T R n
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := congr_arg derivative <| one_sub_X_sq_mul_derivative_T_eq_poly_in_T (R := R) (n - 1)
  simp only [derivative_sub, derivative_mul, derivative_X, derivative_one, derivative_X_pow,
    C_eq_natCast, sub_add_cancel, Int.cast_sub, Int.cast_one, derivative_intCast] at h₁
  have h₂ := add_one_mul_self_mul_T_eq_poly_in_T (R := R) (n - 1)
  rw [Function.iterate_succ, Function.iterate_one, Function.comp_apply]
  linear_combination (norm := (push_cast; ring_nf))
    h₁ + h₂

name: one_sub_X_sq_mul_derivative_derivative_U_eq_poly_in_U
statement:
theorem one_sub_X_sq_mul_derivative_derivative_U_eq_poly_in_U (n : ℤ) :
    (1 - X ^ 2) * derivative^[2] (U R n) =
      3 * X * derivative (U R n) - ((n + 2) * n : R[X]) * U R n
proof:
:= by
  have h := congr_arg derivative <| add_one_mul_T_eq_poly_in_U (R := R) n
  simp only [derivative_add, derivative_sub, derivative_mul, derivative_X, derivative_one,
    derivative_X_pow, derivative_intCast, C_eq_natCast, T_derivative_eq_U] at h
  rw [Function.iterate_succ, Function.iterate_one, Function.comp_apply]
  linear_combination (norm := (push_cast; ring_nf)) h

name: one_sub_X_sq_mul_iterate_derivative_T_eq_poly_in_T
statement:
theorem one_sub_X_sq_mul_iterate_derivative_T_eq_poly_in_T (n : ℤ) (k : ℕ) :
    (1 - X ^ 2) * derivative^[k + 2] (T R n) =
      (2 * k + 1 : R[X]) * X * derivative^[k + 1] (T R n) -
      (n ^ 2 - k ^ 2 : R[X]) * derivative^[k] (T R n)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congr_arg derivative^[k] <| one_sub_X_sq_mul_derivative_derivative_T_eq_poly_in_T
    (R := R) n
  norm_cast at h
  rw [sub_mul, iterate_derivative_sub, one_mul, ← Function.iterate_add_apply, mul_comm (X ^ 2),
    iterate_derivative_sub, mul_comm X, iterate_derivative_intCast_mul,
    iterate_derivative_derivative_mul_X_sq, iterate_derivative_derivative_mul_X] at h
  linear_combination (norm := (push_cast; ring_nf)) h
  cases k <;> grind

name: one_sub_X_sq_mul_iterate_derivative_U_eq_poly_in_U
statement:
theorem one_sub_X_sq_mul_iterate_derivative_U_eq_poly_in_U (n : ℤ) (k : ℕ) :
    (1 - X ^ 2) * derivative^[k + 2] (U R n) =
      (2 * k + 3 : R[X]) * X * derivative^[k + 1] (U R n) -
      ((n + 1) ^ 2 - (k + 1) ^ 2 : R[X]) * derivative^[k] (U R n)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congr_arg derivative^[k] <| one_sub_X_sq_mul_derivative_derivative_U_eq_poly_in_U
    (R := R) n
  norm_cast at h
  rw [sub_mul, iterate_derivative_sub, one_mul, ← Function.iterate_add_apply, mul_comm (X ^ 2),
    iterate_derivative_sub, mul_assoc 3, ← Nat.cast_three, iterate_derivative_natCast_mul,
    mul_comm X, iterate_derivative_intCast_mul, iterate_derivative_derivative_mul_X_sq,
    iterate_derivative_derivative_mul_X] at h
  linear_combination (norm := (push_cast; ring_nf)) h
  cases k <;> grind

name: one_sub_X_sq_mul_iterate_derivative_T_eval
statement:
theorem one_sub_X_sq_mul_iterate_derivative_T_eval (n : ℤ) (k : ℕ) (x : R) :
    (1 - x ^ 2) * (derivative^[k + 2] (T R n)).eval x =
      (2 * k + 1) * x * (derivative^[k + 1] (T R n)).eval x -
      (n ^ 2 - k ^ 2) * (derivative^[k] (T R n)).eval x
proof:
:= by
  have h := congr_arg (fun (p : R[X]) => p.eval x) <|
    one_sub_X_sq_mul_iterate_derivative_T_eq_poly_in_T n k
  simp only [eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_one, eval_pow,
    eval_X, eval_add, eval_ofNat, eval_natCast, eval_intCast] at h
  linear_combination (norm := (push_cast; ring_nf)) h

name: one_sub_X_sq_mul_iterate_derivative_U_eval
statement:
theorem one_sub_X_sq_mul_iterate_derivative_U_eval (n : ℤ) (k : ℕ) (x : R) :
    (1 - x ^ 2) * (derivative^[k + 2] (U R n)).eval x =
      (2 * k + 3) * x * (derivative^[k + 1] (U R n)).eval x -
      ((n + 1) ^ 2 - (k + 1) ^ 2) * (derivative^[k] (U R n)).eval x
proof:
:= by
  have h := congr_arg (fun (p : R[X]) => p.eval x) <|
    one_sub_X_sq_mul_iterate_derivative_U_eq_poly_in_U n k
  simp only [eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_one, eval_pow,
    eval_X, eval_add, eval_ofNat, eval_natCast, eval_intCast] at h
  linear_combination (norm := (push_cast; ring_nf)) h

name: iterate_derivative_T_eval_one_recurrence
statement:
theorem iterate_derivative_T_eval_one_recurrence (n : ℤ) (k : ℕ) :
    (2 * k + 1) * (derivative^[k + 1] (T R n)).eval 1 =
      (n ^ 2 - k ^ 2) * (derivative^[k] (T R n)).eval 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := one_sub_X_sq_mul_iterate_derivative_T_eval (R := R) n k 1
  rw [one_pow, sub_self, zero_mul, mul_one] at h
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp h.symm

name: iterate_derivative_U_eval_one_recurrence
statement:
theorem iterate_derivative_U_eval_one_recurrence (n : ℤ) (k : ℕ) :

proof:

  rw [one_pow, sub_self, zero_mul, mul_one] at h
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp h.symm

name: iterate_derivative_T_eval_zero_recurrence
statement:
theorem iterate_derivative_T_eval_zero_recurrence (n : ℤ) (k : ℕ) :
    (derivative^[k + 2] (T R n)).eval 0 =
      -(n ^ 2 - k ^ 2) * (derivative^[k] (T R n)).eval 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := one_sub_X_sq_mul_iterate_derivative_T_eval (R := R) n k 0

name: iterate_derivative_U_eval_zero_recurrence
statement:
theorem iterate_derivative_U_eval_zero_recurrence (n : ℤ) (k : ℕ) :

name: iterate_derivative_T_eval_one
statement:
theorem iterate_derivative_T_eval_one (n : ℤ) (k : ℕ) :
    (∏ l ∈ Finset.range k, (2 * l + 1)) * (derivative^[k] (T R n)).eval 1 =
      ∏ l ∈ Finset.range k, (n ^ 2 - l ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  induction k
  case zero => simp
  case succ k ih =>
    push_cast at ih ⊢
    rw [Finset.range_add_one, Finset.prod_insert Finset.notMem_range_self, mul_comm (2 * _ + 1),
      mul_assoc, iterate_derivative_T_eval_one_recurrence, ← mul_assoc, mul_comm _ (_ ^ 2 - _ ^ 2),
      mul_assoc, ih, Finset.prod_insert Finset.notMem_range_self]

name: iterate_derivative_U_eval_one
statement:
theorem iterate_derivative_U_eval_one (n : ℤ) (k : ℕ) :
    (∏ l ∈ Finset.range k, (2 * l + 3)) * (derivative^[k] (U R n)).eval 1 =
      (∏ l ∈ Finset.range k, ((n + 1) ^ 2 - (l + 1) ^ 2 : ℤ)) * (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction k
  case zero => simp
  case succ k ih =>
    push_cast at ih ⊢
    rw [Finset.range_add_one, Finset.prod_insert Finset.notMem_range_self, mul_comm (2 * _ + 3),
      mul_assoc, iterate_derivative_U_eval_one_recurrence, ← mul_assoc, mul_comm _ (_ ^ 2 - _ ^ 2),
      mul_assoc, ih, Finset.prod_insert Finset.notMem_range_self, mul_assoc]

statement:

name: derivative_U_eval_one
statement:
theorem derivative_U_eval_one (n : ℤ) :
    3 * (derivative (U R n)).eval 1 = (n + 2) * (n + 1) * n
proof:
:= by
  have h := iterate_derivative_U_eval_one (R := R) n 1
  simp only [Finset.range_one, Finset.prod_singleton, Function.iterate_one] at h

name: iterate_derivative_T_eval_one_eq_div
statement:
theorem iterate_derivative_T_eval_one_eq_div [CharZero 𝔽] (n : ℤ) (k : ℕ) :
    (derivative^[k] (T 𝔽 n)).eval 1 =
      (∏ l ∈ Finset.range k, (n ^ 2 - l ^ 2)) / (∏ l ∈ Finset.range k, (2 * l + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_div_iff (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun _ _ => by positivity))),
    mul_comm, iterate_derivative_T_eval_one]

name: iterate_derivative_U_eval_one_eq_div
statement:
theorem iterate_derivative_U_eval_one_eq_div [CharZero 𝔽] (n : ℤ) (k : ℕ) :
    (derivative^[k] (U 𝔽 n)).eval 1 =
      ((∏ l ∈ Finset.range k, ((n + 1) ^ 2 - (l + 1) ^ 2) : ℤ) * (n + 1)) /
      (∏ l ∈ Finset.range k, (2 * l + 3))
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_div_iff (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun _ _ => by positivity))),
    mul_comm, iterate_derivative_U_eval_one]

name: iterate_derivative_T_eval_one_dvd
statement:
theorem iterate_derivative_T_eval_one_dvd (n : ℤ) (k : ℕ) :
    ((∏ l ∈ Finset.range k, (2 * l + 1) : ℕ) : 𝔽) ∣ (∏ l ∈ Finset.range k, (n ^ 2 - l ^ 2) : ℤ)
proof:
:=
  dvd_of_mul_right_eq _ <| iterate_derivative_T_eval_one n k

name: iterate_derivative_U_eval_one_dvd
statement:
theorem iterate_derivative_U_eval_one_dvd (n : ℤ) (k : ℕ) :
    ((∏ l ∈ Finset.range k, (2 * l + 3) : ℕ) : 𝔽) ∣
      ((∏ l ∈ Finset.range k, ((n + 1) ^ 2 - (l + 1) ^ 2) : ℤ) * (n + 1))
proof:
