name: hasSubst_of_constantCoeff_zero
statement:
theorem hasSubst_of_constantCoeff_zero [Finite σ]
    {a : σ → MvPowerSeries τ S} (ha : ∀ s, constantCoeff (a s) = 0) :
    HasSubst a
proof:
:=
  hasSubst_of_constantCoeff_nilpotent (fun s ↦ by simp only [ha s, IsNilpotent.zero])

name: HasSubst.X_X
statement: lemma HasSubst.X_X {i j : σ} : HasSubst (S := R) ![X i, X j]
proof:
:=
  hasSubst_of_constantCoeff_zero (by simp)

name: HasSubst.X_zero
statement: lemma HasSubst.X_zero {i : σ} : HasSubst ![X i (R := R), 0]
proof:
:=
  hasSubst_of_constantCoeff_zero (by simp)

name: HasSubst.zero_X
statement: lemma HasSubst.zero_X {i : σ} : HasSubst ![0, X i (R := R)]
proof:
:=
  hasSubst_of_constantCoeff_zero (by simp)

name: HasSubst.pow
statement:
protected lemma HasSubst.pow {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) {a : σ → MvPowerSeries τ S} (h : HasSubst a) :
    HasSubst (a ^ n)
proof:
:=
  hasSubstIdeal.pow_mem_of_mem h _ (by lia)

name: HasSubst.X_pow
statement:
protected theorem HasSubst.X_pow {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    HasSubst (fun (s : σ) ↦ (X s : MvPowerSeries σ S) ^ n)
proof:
:=
  HasSubst.X.pow (by lia)

name: HasSubst.truncTotal
statement:
lemma HasSubst.truncTotal {a : σ → MvPowerSeries τ S} {x : σ → ℕ} [Finite τ]
    (ha : HasSubst a) : HasSubst (fun i ↦ ((a i).truncTotal (x i)).toMvPowerSeries) where
  const_coeff i
proof:
:= by
    rw [← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, MvPolynomial.coeff_coe,
      ← MvPolynomial.constantCoeff_eq, constantCoeff_truncTotal_eq_ite]
    split_ifs <;> simp [ha.const_coeff i]
  coeff_zero d :=
    (ha.coeff_zero d).subset fun i => by contrapose; simp +contextual [coeff_truncTotal_eq_ite]

name: subst_eq_eval
statement:
theorem subst_eq_eval₂
    [UniformSpace R] [DiscreteUniformity R] [UniformSpace S] [DiscreteUniformity S] :
    (subst : (σ → MvPowerSeries τ S) → (MvPowerSeries σ R) → _) = eval₂ (algebraMap _ _)
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp +instances [subst, DiscreteUniformity.eq_bot]

name: subst_coe
statement:
theorem subst_coe (p : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    subst (R := R) a p = MvPolynomial.aeval a p
proof:
:= by
  let : UniformSpace R := ⊥
  let : UniformSpace S := ⊥
  rw [subst_eq_eval₂, eval₂_coe, MvPolynomial.aeval_def]

name: substAlgHom_eq_aeval
statement:
theorem substAlgHom_eq_aeval
    [UniformSpace R] [DiscreteUniformity R] [UniformSpace S] [DiscreteUniformity S]
    (ha : HasSubst a) :
    (substAlgHom ha : MvPowerSeries σ R → MvPowerSeries τ S) = MvPowerSeries.aeval ha.hasEval
proof:
:= by
  simp only [substAlgHom, coe_aeval ha.hasEval]
  convert! coe_aeval (R := R) (hasSubst_iff_hasEval_of_discreteTopology.mp ha) <;>
  exact DiscreteUniformity.eq_bot.symm

name: coe_substAlgHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_substAlgHom (ha : HasSubst a) :
    ⇑(substAlgHom ha) = subst (R := R) a
proof:
:= by
  let : UniformSpace R := ⊥
  let : UniformSpace S := ⊥
  rw [substAlgHom_eq_aeval, coe_aeval ha.hasEval, subst_eq_eval₂]

name: subst_self
statement: theorem subst_self : subst (MvPowerSeries.X : σ → MvPowerSeries σ R) = id
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coe_substAlgHom HasSubst.X]
  let : UniformSpace R := ⊥
  ext1 f
  simp only [substAlgHom_eq_aeval]
  have := aeval_unique (ε := AlgHom.id R (MvPowerSeries σ R)) continuous_id
  rw [DFunLike.ext_iff] at this
  exact this f

name: substAlgHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem substAlgHom_apply (ha : HasSubst a) (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    substAlgHom ha f = subst a f
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_substAlgHom]

name: subst_add
statement:
theorem subst_add (ha : HasSubst a) (f g : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    subst a (f + g) = subst a f + subst a g
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← substAlgHom_apply ha, map_add]

name: subst_sub
statement:
theorem subst_sub (ha : HasSubst a) (f g : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    subst a (f - g) = subst a f - subst a g
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← substAlgHom_apply ha, map_sub]

name: subst_mul
statement:
theorem subst_mul (ha : HasSubst a) (f g : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    subst a (f * g) = subst a f * subst a g
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← substAlgHom_apply ha, map_mul]

name: subst_pow
statement:
theorem subst_pow (ha : HasSubst a) (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) (n : ℕ) :
    subst a (f ^ n) = (subst a f) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← substAlgHom_apply ha, map_pow]

name: subst_smul
statement:
theorem subst_smul (ha : HasSubst a) (r : A) (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    subst a (r • f) = r • (subst a f)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← substAlgHom_apply ha, AlgHom.map_smul_of_tower]

name: substAlgHom_coe
statement:
theorem substAlgHom_coe (ha : HasSubst a) (p : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    substAlgHom (R := R) ha p = MvPolynomial.aeval a p
proof:
:= by
  simp [substAlgHom]

name: substAlgHom_X
statement:
theorem substAlgHom_X (ha : HasSubst a) (s : σ) :
    substAlgHom (R := R) ha (X s) = a s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← MvPolynomial.coe_X, substAlgHom_coe ha, MvPolynomial.aeval_X]

name: substAlgHom_monomial
statement:
theorem substAlgHom_monomial (ha : HasSubst a) (e : σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R) :
    substAlgHom ha (monomial e r) =
      (algebraMap R (MvPowerSeries τ S) r) * (e.prod (fun s n ↦ (a s) ^ n))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← MvPolynomial.coe_monomial, substAlgHom_coe, MvPolynomial.aeval_monomial]

name: subst_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem subst_C (r : S) :
    (C r).subst a = MvPowerSeries.C r
proof:
:= by
  simp [subst, algebraMap_apply]

name: subst_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem subst_X (ha : HasSubst a) (s : σ) :
    subst (R := R) a (X s) = a s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coe_substAlgHom ha, substAlgHom_X]

name: subst_monomial
statement:
theorem subst_monomial (ha : HasSubst a) (e : σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R) :
    subst a (monomial e r) =
      (algebraMap R (MvPowerSeries τ S) r) * (e.prod (fun s n ↦ (a s) ^ n))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coe_substAlgHom ha, substAlgHom_monomial]

name: continuous_subst
statement:
theorem continuous_subst (ha : HasSubst a)
    [UniformSpace R] [DiscreteUniformity R] [UniformSpace S] [DiscreteUniformity S] :
    Continuous (subst a : MvPowerSeries σ R → MvPowerSeries τ S)
proof:
:= by
  rw [subst_eq_eval₂]
  exact continuous_eval₂ (continuous_algebraMap _ _) ha.hasEval

name: coeff_subst_finite
statement:
theorem coeff_subst_finite (ha : HasSubst a) (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) (e : τ →₀ ℕ) :
    (fun d ↦ coeff d f • (coeff e (d.prod fun s e => (a s) ^ e))).HasFiniteSupport
proof:
:=
  letI : UniformSpace R := ⊥
  letI : UniformSpace S := ⊥
  Summable.hasFiniteSupport_of_discreteTopology _
    ((hasSum_aeval ha.hasEval f).map (coeff e) (continuous_coeff S e)).summable

name: coeff_subst
statement:
theorem coeff_subst (ha : HasSubst a) (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) (e : τ →₀ ℕ) :
    coeff e (subst a f) =
      finsum (fun d ↦ coeff d f • (coeff e (d.prod fun s e => (a s) ^ e)))
proof:
:= by
  let : UniformSpace R := ⊥
  let : UniformSpace S := ⊥
  have := ((hasSum_aeval ha.hasEval f).map (coeff e) (continuous_coeff S e))
  simp [← coe_substAlgHom ha, substAlgHom, ← this.tsum_eq,
    tsum_eq_finsum (coeff_subst_finite ha f e)]

name: constantCoeff_subst
statement:
theorem constantCoeff_subst (ha : HasSubst a) (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    constantCoeff (subst a f) =
      finsum (fun d ↦ coeff d f • (constantCoeff (d.prod fun s e => (a s) ^ e)))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, coeff_subst ha f 0]

name: constantCoeff_subst_eq_zero
statement:
theorem constantCoeff_subst_eq_zero (ha : HasSubst a) (ha' : ∀ i, (a i).constantCoeff = 0)
    {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} (hf : f.constantCoeff = 0) :
    MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (subst a f) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [constantCoeff_subst ha, finsum_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero]
  intro d
  by_cases hd : d = 0
  · simp [hd, hf]
  · have : constantCoeff (d.prod fun s e ↦ a s ^ e) = 0 := by
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i : σ, d i ≠ 0 := by
        by_contra! hc
        exact hd <| Finsupp.ext hc
      simpa [map_finsuppProd, ha'] using!
        Finset.prod_eq_zero (i := i) (by simp [hi]) (by simp [zero_pow hi])
    rw [this, smul_zero]

name: map_algebraMap_eq_subst_X
statement:
theorem map_algebraMap_eq_subst_X (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    map (algebraMap R S) f = subst X f
proof:
:= by
  ext e
  rw [coeff_map, coeff_subst HasSubst.X f e, finsum_eq_single _ e]
  · rw [← MvPowerSeries.monomial_one_eq, coeff_monomial_same,
      algebra_compatible_smul S, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  · intro d hd
    rw [← MvPowerSeries.monomial_one_eq, coeff_monomial_ne hd.symm, smul_zero]

name: map_subst
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  have {r : R} : h r = h.toAddMonoidHom r := rfl
  rw [coeff_subst (ha.map h), coeff_map, coeff_subst ha, this, AddMonoidHom.map_finsum _
    (coeff_subst_finite ha _ _), finsum_congr]
  intro d
  simp [smul_eq_mul, RingHom.toAddMonoidHom_eq_coe, AddMonoidHom.coe_coe, map_mul,
    ← coeff_map, Finsupp.prod]

name: subst_zero_eq_C_constantCoeff
statement:
lemma subst_zero_eq_C_constantCoeff {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} :
    f.subst (0 : σ → MvPowerSeries τ S) = (C f.constantCoeff).map (algebraMap R S)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext n
  rw [coeff_subst (by simp [hasSubst_def]), coeff_map, finsum_eq_single _ 0]
  · by_cases hn : n = 0
    · simp [hn, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
    simp [coeff_C_of_ne_zero hn, coeff_one, hn]
  intro d hd
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : d.support.Nonempty := d.support_nonempty_iff.mpr hd
  simp [Finsupp.prod, Finset.prod_eq_zero hi, coeff_zero, zero_pow <| d.mem_support_iff.mp hi]

name: subst_zero_of_constantCoeff_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma subst_zero_of_constantCoeff_zero {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} (hf : f.constantCoeff = 0) :
    f.subst (0 : σ → MvPowerSeries τ S) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [subst_zero_eq_C_constantCoeff, hf]

name: HasSubst.cons_subst_zero_left
statement:
lemma HasSubst.cons_subst_zero_left {f : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) R} (i j k : σ)
    (hF : constantCoeff f = 0) : HasSubst (![subst ![X i, X j] f, X k]) (S := R)
proof:
:=
  hasSubst_of_constantCoeff_zero fun s => by
    fin_cases s <;> simp_all [constantCoeff_subst_eq_zero .X_X]

name: HasSubst.cons_subst_zero_right
statement:
lemma HasSubst.cons_subst_zero_right {f : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) R} (i j k : σ)
    (hF : constantCoeff f = 0) : HasSubst ![X i, subst ![X j, X k] f] (S := R)
proof:
:=
  hasSubst_of_constantCoeff_zero fun s => by
    fin_cases s <;> simp_all [constantCoeff_subst_eq_zero .X_X]

name: comp_substAlgHom
statement:
theorem comp_substAlgHom
    [UniformSpace R] [DiscreteUniformity R] [UniformSpace S] [DiscreteUniformity S]
    (ha : HasSubst a) (hε : Continuous ε) :
    ε.comp (substAlgHom ha) = aeval (ha.hasEval.map hε)
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  simp only [AlgHom.coe_comp, substAlgHom_eq_aeval ha]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun (comp_aeval ha.hasEval hε) f

name: comp_subst
statement:
theorem comp_subst [UniformSpace R] [DiscreteUniformity R] [UniformSpace S] [DiscreteUniformity S]
    (ha : HasSubst a) (hε : Continuous ε) :
    ε ∘ (subst a) = aeval (R := R) (ha.hasEval.map hε)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← comp_substAlgHom ha hε, AlgHom.coe_comp, coe_substAlgHom]

name: comp_subst_apply
statement:
theorem comp_subst_apply
    [UniformSpace R] [DiscreteUniformity R] [UniformSpace S] [DiscreteUniformity S]
    (ha : HasSubst a) (hε : Continuous ε) (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    ε (subst a f) = aeval (R := R) (ha.hasEval.map hε) f
proof:
:=
  congr_fun (comp_subst ha hε) f

name: eval
statement:
theorem eval₂_subst
    [UniformSpace R] [DiscreteUniformity R] [UniformSpace S] [DiscreteUniformity S]
    (ha : HasSubst a) {b : τ → T} (hb : HasEval b) (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    eval₂ (algebraMap S T) b (subst a f) =
      eval₂ (algebraMap R T) (fun s ↦ eval₂ (algebraMap S T) b (a s)) f
proof:
:= by
  let ε : MvPowerSeries τ S →ₐ[R] T := (aeval hb).restrictScalars R
  have hε : Continuous ε := continuous_aeval hb
  simpa only [AlgHom.coe_restrictScalars', AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe,
    AlgHom.coe_restrictScalars, RingHom.coe_coe, ε, coe_aeval]
    using comp_subst_apply ha hε f

name: IsNilpotent_subst
statement:
lemma IsNilpotent_subst (ha : HasSubst a)
    {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} (hf : IsNilpotent f.constantCoeff) :
    IsNilpotent (constantCoeff (f.subst a))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [constantCoeff_subst ha]
  refine isNilpotent_finsum fun d => ?_
  by_cases hd : d = 0
  · rw [← algebraMap_smul S, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm, ← smul_eq_mul, hd]
    apply IsNilpotent.smul
    simpa using IsNilpotent.map hf (algebraMap R S)
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : d.support.Nonempty := d.support_nonempty_iff.mpr hd
  rw [Finsupp.prod, map_prod, ← Finset.prod_erase_mul _ _ hi, ← algebraMap_smul S,
    smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc, map_pow]
  exact Commute.isNilpotent_mul_left (Commute.all _ _)
    <| (IsNilpotent.pow_iff_pos (d.mem_support_iff.mp hi)).mpr (ha.const_coeff i)

name: IsNilpotent_substAlgHom
statement:
theorem IsNilpotent_substAlgHom (ha : HasSubst a)
    {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} (hf : IsNilpotent (constantCoeff f)) :
    IsNilpotent (constantCoeff (substAlgHom ha f))
proof:
:= by
  simpa using IsNilpotent_subst ha hf

name: HasSubst.comp
statement:
theorem HasSubst.comp (ha : HasSubst a) (hb : HasSubst b) :
    HasSubst (fun s ↦ substAlgHom hb (a s)) where
  const_coeff s
proof:
:= IsNilpotent_substAlgHom hb (ha.const_coeff s)
  coeff_zero := by
    let : UniformSpace S := ⊥
    let : UniformSpace T := ⊥
    rw [← coeff_zero_iff]
    apply Filter.Tendsto.comp _ (ha.hasEval.tendsto_zero)
    simpa [← map_zero (substAlgHom (R := S) hb)] using! (continuous_subst hb).continuousAt

name: substAlgHom_comp_substAlgHom
statement:
theorem substAlgHom_comp_substAlgHom (ha : HasSubst a) (hb : HasSubst b) :
    ((substAlgHom hb).restrictScalars R).comp (substAlgHom ha) = substAlgHom (ha.comp hb)
proof:
:= by
  let : UniformSpace R := ⊥
  let : UniformSpace S := ⊥
  let : UniformSpace T := ⊥
  apply comp_aeval (R := R) (ε := (substAlgHom hb).restrictScalars R) ha.hasEval
  simpa [AlgHom.coe_restrictScalars'] using continuous_subst (R := S) hb

name: substAlgHom_comp_substAlgHom_apply
statement:
theorem substAlgHom_comp_substAlgHom_apply (ha : HasSubst a) (hb : HasSubst b)
    (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    (substAlgHom hb) (substAlgHom ha f) = substAlgHom (ha.comp hb) f
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.congr_fun (substAlgHom_comp_substAlgHom ha hb) f

name: subst_comp_subst
statement:
theorem subst_comp_subst (ha : HasSubst a) (hb : HasSubst b) :
    (subst b) ∘ (subst a) = subst (R := R) (fun s ↦ subst b (a s))
proof:
:= by
  simpa [funext_iff, DFunLike.ext_iff] using substAlgHom_comp_substAlgHom (R := R) ha hb

name: subst_comp_subst_apply
statement:
theorem subst_comp_subst_apply (ha : HasSubst a) (hb : HasSubst b) (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    subst b (subst a f) = subst (fun s ↦ subst b (a s)) f
proof:
:=
  congr_fun (subst_comp_subst (R := R) ha hb) f

name: le_weightedOrder_subst
statement:
theorem le_weightedOrder_subst (ha : HasSubst a) (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    ⨅ (d : σ →₀ ℕ) (_ : coeff d f ≠ 0), d.weight (weightedOrder w ∘ a) ≤
      (f.subst a).weightedOrder w
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPowerSeries.le_weightedOrder
  intro d hd
  rw [coeff_subst ha, finsum_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero]
  intro x
  by_cases hfx : f.coeff x = 0
  · simp [hfx]
  rw [coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_weightedOrder w, smul_zero]
  refine hd.trans_le (((biInf_le _ hfx).trans ?_).trans (le_weightedOrder_prod ..))
  simp only [Finsupp.weight_apply, Finsupp.sum, Function.comp_apply]
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi ↦ .trans (by simp) (le_weightedOrder_pow ..)

name: le_weightedOrder_subst_of_forall_ne_zero
statement:
theorem le_weightedOrder_subst_of_forall_ne_zero
    (ha : HasSubst a) (ha0 : ∀ i, a i ≠ 0) (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    f.weightedOrder (ENat.toNat ∘ weightedOrder w ∘ a) ≤ (f.subst a).weightedOrder w
proof:
:= by
  refine .trans ?_ (le_weightedOrder_subst w ha f)
  simp only [ne_eq, le_iInf_iff]
  refine fun i hi ↦ (weightedOrder_le _ hi).trans ?_
  simp [Finsupp.weight_apply, Finsupp.sum, (ne_zero_iff_weightedOrder_finite _).mp (ha0 _)]

name: le_order_subst
statement:
theorem le_order_subst (ha : HasSubst a) (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    (⨅ i, (a i).order) * f.order ≤ (f.subst a).order
proof:
:= by
  refine .trans ?_ (MvPowerSeries.le_weightedOrder_subst _ ha _)
  simp only [ne_eq, le_iInf_iff]
  intro i hi
  trans (⨅ (i : σ), (order ∘ a) i) * ↑i.degree
  · refine mul_le_mul_right (order_le hi) _
  · simp only [Function.comp_apply, order, Finsupp.degree, AddMonoidHom.coe_mk, ZeroHom.coe_mk,
      Nat.cast_sum, Finset.mul_sum, Finsupp.weight_apply, nsmul_eq_mul]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun j hj => by
      simp [mul_comm, mul_le_mul_right (iInf_le_iff.mpr fun _ a ↦ a j)]

name: truncTotal_subst_eq_truncTotal_subst_truncTotal_of_le
statement:
theorem truncTotal_subst_eq_truncTotal_subst_truncTotal_of_le (ha : HasSubst a)
    (hx : ∀ i, k ≤ x i) :
    (f.subst a).truncTotal k = (f.subst
      fun i ↦ ((a i).truncTotal (x i)).toMvPowerSeries).truncTotal k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext d
  by_cases hd : d.degree < k
  · rw [coeff_truncTotal _ hd, coeff_truncTotal _ hd, coeff_subst ha, coeff_subst, finsum_congr]
    · intro n
      simp_rw [Finsupp.prod, coeff_prod]
      congr! 3 with l hl i hi
      obtain ⟨hl₁, -⟩ := mem_finsuppAntidiag.mp hl
      have : (l i).degree ≤ d.degree :=
        hl₁ ▸ Finsupp.degree_mono (single_le_sum_of_canonicallyOrdered hi)
      exact_mod_cast (coeff_truncTotal_pow _ (by nlinarith [hx i])).symm
    · exact ha.truncTotal
  simp_rw [coeff_truncTotal_eq_zero _ (not_lt.mp hd)]

name: truncTotal_subst_eq_truncTotal_subst_sum
statement:
theorem truncTotal_subst_eq_truncTotal_subst_sum (ha : HasSubst a)
    (ha₁ : ∀ i, (a i).constantCoeff = 0) :
    truncTotal k (f.subst a) =
      ((∑ i ∈ range k, (f.homogeneousComponent i)).subst a).truncTotal k
proof:
:= by
  ext d
  by_cases hd : d.degree < k
  · simp_rw [coeff_truncTotal _ hd, coeff_subst ha]
    have h1 := coeff_subst_finite ha f d
    have h2 := coeff_subst_finite ha (∑ i ∈ range k, (homogeneousComponent i) f) d
    rw [finsum_eq_sum _ h1, finsum_eq_sum _ h2]
    have : h2.toFinset ⊆ h1.toFinset := by simp +contextual [coeff_homogeneousComponent]
    have aux {n : σ →₀ ℕ} : coeff d (n.prod fun s e ↦ a s ^ e) ≠ 0 → n.degree ≤ d.degree := by
      contrapose!
      intro hc
      rw [Finsupp.prod]
      refine coeff_of_lt_order (lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.cast_lt.mpr hc)
        (.trans ?_ (le_order_prod _ n.support)))
      exact_mod_cast sum_le_sum fun i hi => le_order_pow_of_constantCoeff_eq_zero _ (ha₁ i)
    rw [← Finset.sum_subset this]
    · congr! 2 with n hn
      simp only [map_sum, coeff_homogeneousComponent, sum_ite_eq, mem_range, left_eq_ite_iff,
        not_lt]
      have : n.degree ≤ d.degree := by
        simp only [map_sum, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Function.mem_support, ne_eq] at hn
        exact aux (right_ne_zero_of_smul hn)
      grind
    · simp +contextual only [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Function.mem_support, ne_eq, map_sum,
        coeff_homogeneousComponent, sum_ite_eq, mem_range, ite_smul, zero_smul, ite_eq_right_iff,
        imp_false, not_lt, not_le]
      grind [right_ne_zero_of_smul]
  simp_rw [coeff_truncTotal_eq_zero _ (not_lt.mp hd)]

name: truncTotal_subst_eq_truncTotal_sum_subst
statement:
theorem truncTotal_subst_eq_truncTotal_sum_subst (ha : HasSubst a)
    (ha₁ : ∀ i, (a i).constantCoeff = 0) :
    truncTotal k (f.subst a) =
      (∑ i ∈ range k, (f.homogeneousComponent i).subst a).truncTotal k
proof:
:= by
  rw [truncTotal_subst_eq_truncTotal_subst_sum ha ha₁, ← substAlgHom_apply ha, map_sum]
  simp

name: truncTotal_subst_eq_truncTotal_truncTotal_subst
statement:
theorem truncTotal_subst_eq_truncTotal_truncTotal_subst [Finite σ]
    (h : ∀ i, (a i).constantCoeff = 0) :
    truncTotal k (f.subst a) = ((f.truncTotal k).toMvPowerSeries.subst a).truncTotal k
proof:
:= by
  rw [truncTotal_subst_eq_truncTotal_subst_sum (hasSubst_of_constantCoeff_zero h) h,
    truncTotal_eq_sum]

name: truncTotal_subst_eq_truncTotal_sum_subst_truncTotal_of_le
statement:
theorem truncTotal_subst_eq_truncTotal_sum_subst_truncTotal_of_le (ha : HasSubst a)
    (h : ∀ i, (a i).constantCoeff = 0) (hx : ∀ i, k ≤ x i) :
    truncTotal k (f.subst a) = (∑ i ∈ range k, (f.homogeneousComponent i).subst
      (fun i ↦ ((a i).truncTotal (x i)).toMvPowerSeries)).truncTotal k
proof:
:= by
  rw [truncTotal_subst_eq_truncTotal_subst_truncTotal_of_le ha hx]
  exact truncTotal_subst_eq_truncTotal_sum_subst ha.truncTotal fun i => by
    rw [← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, MvPolynomial.coeff_coe,
      ← MvPolynomial.constantCoeff_eq, constantCoeff_truncTotal_eq_ite, h i, ite_self]

name: truncTotal_subst_of_le
statement:
theorem truncTotal_subst_of_le [Finite σ] (h : ∀ i, (a i).constantCoeff = 0) (hx : ∀ i, k ≤ x i) :
    truncTotal k (f.subst a) = ((f.truncTotal k).toMvPowerSeries.subst
      (fun i ↦ ((a i).truncTotal (x i)).toMvPowerSeries)).truncTotal k
proof:
:= by
  rw [truncTotal_subst_eq_truncTotal_sum_subst_truncTotal_of_le
      (hasSubst_of_constantCoeff_zero h) h hx,
    truncTotal_eq_sum, ← substAlgHom_apply
      (hasSubst_of_constantCoeff_zero h).truncTotal, map_sum]
  simp

name: truncTotal_subst
statement:
theorem truncTotal_subst [Finite σ] (h : ∀ i, (a i).constantCoeff = 0) :
    truncTotal k (f.subst a) = ((f.truncTotal k).toMvPowerSeries.subst
      (fun i ↦ ((a i).truncTotal k).toMvPowerSeries)).truncTotal k
proof:
:=
  truncTotal_subst_of_le h fun _ ↦ le_refl k

name: truncTotal_subst_eq_truncTotal_sum_subst_truncTotal
statement:
theorem truncTotal_subst_eq_truncTotal_sum_subst_truncTotal (ha : HasSubst a)
    (h : ∀ i, (a i).constantCoeff = 0) :
    truncTotal k (f.subst a) = (∑ i ∈ range k, (f.homogeneousComponent i).subst
      (fun i ↦ ((a i).truncTotal k).toMvPowerSeries)).truncTotal k
proof:
:=
  truncTotal_subst_eq_truncTotal_sum_subst_truncTotal_of_le ha h fun _ ↦ le_refl k

name: coeff_rescale
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_rescale (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) (a : σ → R) (n : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    coeff n (rescale a f) = (n.prod fun s m ↦ a s ^ m) * f.coeff n
proof:
:= by
  simp [rescale, coeff_apply]

name: rescale_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rescale_zero :
    (rescale 0 : MvPowerSeries σ R →+* MvPowerSeries σ R) = C.comp constantCoeff
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext x n
  simp only [rescale, Pi.zero_apply, RingHom.coe_mk, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk,
    RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, coeff_C]
  split_ifs with h
  · simp [h, coeff_apply, ← @coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, coeff_apply]
  · simp only [coeff_apply]
    convert! zero_mul _
    simp only [DFunLike.ext_iff, not_forall, Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply] at h
    obtain ⟨s, h⟩ := h
    simp only [Finsupp.prod]
    apply Finset.prod_eq_zero (i := s) _ (zero_pow h)
    simpa using h

name: rescale_zero_apply
statement:
theorem rescale_zero_apply (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    rescale 0 f = C (constantCoeff f)
proof: := by simp

name: rescale_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rescale_one : rescale 1 = RingHom.id (MvPowerSeries σ R)
proof:
:= by
  ext f n
  simp [coeff_rescale, Finsupp.prod]

name: rescale_rescale
statement:
theorem rescale_rescale (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) (a b : σ → R) :
    rescale b (rescale a f) = rescale (a * b) f
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  simp [← mul_assoc, mul_pow, mul_comm]

name: rescale_mul
statement: theorem rescale_mul (a b : σ → R) : rescale (a * b) = (rescale b).comp (rescale a)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp [← rescale_rescale]

name: rescale_homogeneous_eq_smul
proof:
:= by
  ext e
  simp only [MvPowerSeries.coeff_rescale, map_smul, Finsupp.prod, Function.const_apply,
    Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum, smul_eq_mul]
  by_cases he : e ∈ f.support
  · rw [← hf e he, Finsupp.degree_apply]
  · simp only [Function.mem_support, ne_eq, not_not] at he
    simp [he, mul_zero, coeff_apply]

name: rescale_eq_subst
statement:
theorem rescale_eq_subst (a : σ → R) (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    rescale a f = subst (a • X) f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext n
  rw [coeff_rescale]
  rw [coeff_subst (HasSubst.smul_X a),
    finsum_eq_sum _ (coeff_subst_finite (HasSubst.smul_X a) f n)]
  simp only [Pi.smul_apply', smul_eq_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single n _ _]
  · simp [mul_comm, ← monomial_eq]
  · intro b hb hbn
    rw [← monomial_eq, coeff_monomial, ite_eq_right (Ne.symm hbn), mul_zero]
  · intro hn
    simpa using hn

name: rescaleAlgHom_apply
statement:
theorem rescaleAlgHom_apply (a : σ → R) (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    rescaleAlgHom a f = rescale a f
proof:
:= by
  simp [rescaleAlgHom, rescale_eq_subst]

name: rescaleAlgHom_mul
statement:
theorem rescaleAlgHom_mul (a b : σ → R) :
    rescaleAlgHom (a * b) = (rescaleAlgHom b).comp (rescaleAlgHom a)
proof:
:= by
  ext1 f
  simp [rescaleAlgHom_apply, rescale_rescale]

name: rescaleAlgHom_one
statement:
theorem rescaleAlgHom_one :
    rescaleAlgHom 1 = AlgHom.id R (MvPowerSeries σ R)
proof:
:= by
  ext1 f
  simp [rescaleAlgHom, subst_self]

name: subst_tsum
statement:
lemma subst_tsum (hx : Summable x) (ha : HasSubst a) :
    (∑' i, x i).subst a = ∑' i, ((x i).subst a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coe_substAlgHom ha, substAlgHom_eq_aeval ha, hx.map_tsum _ <| continuous_aeval _]

name: summable_subst
statement:
lemma summable_subst (hx : Summable x) (ha : HasSubst a) :
    Summable fun i => (x i).subst a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coe_substAlgHom ha, substAlgHom_eq_aeval ha]
  exact hx.map _ <| continuous_aeval ha.hasEval

name: coeff_inv_aux
statement:
theorem coeff_inv_aux [DecidableEq σ] (n : σ →₀ ℕ) (a : R) (φ : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    coeff n (inv.aux a φ) =
      if n = 0 then a
      else
        -a *
          ∑ x ∈ antidiagonal n, if x.2 < n then coeff x.1 φ * coeff x.2 (inv.aux a φ) else 0
proof:
:=
  show inv.aux a φ n = _ by
    cases Subsingleton.elim ‹DecidableEq σ› (Classical.decEq σ)
    rw [inv.aux]
    rfl

name: coeff_invOfUnit
statement:
theorem coeff_invOfUnit [DecidableEq σ] (n : σ →₀ ℕ) (φ : MvPowerSeries σ R) (u : Rˣ) :
    coeff n (invOfUnit φ u) =
      if n = 0 then ↑u⁻¹
      else
        -↑u⁻¹ *
          ∑ x ∈ antidiagonal n,
            if x.2 < n then coeff x.1 φ * coeff x.2 (invOfUnit φ u) else 0
proof:
:= by
  convert! coeff_inv_aux n (↑u⁻¹) φ

name: constantCoeff_invOfUnit
statement:
@[simp]
theorem constantCoeff_invOfUnit (φ : MvPowerSeries σ R) (u : Rˣ) :
    constantCoeff (invOfUnit φ u) = ↑u⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, coeff_invOfUnit, ite_eq_left rfl]

name: mul_invOfUnit
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mul_invOfUnit (φ : MvPowerSeries σ R) (u : Rˣ) (h : constantCoeff φ = u) :
    φ * invOfUnit φ u = 1
proof:
:=
  ext fun n =>
    letI := Classical.decEq (σ →₀ ℕ)
    if H : n = 0 then by
      rw [H]
      simp [h]
    else by
      classical
      have : ((0 : σ →₀ ℕ), n) ∈ antidiagonal n := by rw [mem_antidiagonal, zero_add]
      rw [coeff_one, ite_eq_right H, coeff_mul, ← Finset.insert_erase this,
        Finset.sum_insert (Finset.notMem_erase _ _), coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, h,
        coeff_invOfUnit, ite_eq_right H, neg_mul, mul_neg, Units.mul_inv_cancel_left, ←
        Finset.insert_erase this, Finset.sum_insert (Finset.notMem_erase _ _),
        Finset.insert_erase this, ite_eq_right (not_lt_of_ge <| le_rfl), zero_add, add_comm, ←
        sub_eq_add_neg, sub_eq_zero, Finset.sum_congr rfl]
      rintro ⟨i, j⟩ hij
      rw [Finset.mem_erase, mem_antidiagonal] at hij
      obtain ⟨h₁, rfl⟩ := hij
      rw [ite_eq_left]
      refine lt_add_of_pos_left _ <| pos_iff_ne_zero.2 ?_
      rintro rfl
      simp at h₁

name: invOfUnit_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem invOfUnit_mul (φ : MvPowerSeries σ R) (u : Rˣ) (h : constantCoeff φ = u) :
    invOfUnit φ u * φ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_cancel_right_mem_nonZeroDivisors (r := φ.invOfUnit u), mul_assoc, one_mul,
    mul_invOfUnit _ _ h, mul_one]
  apply mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_constantCoeff
  simp only [constantCoeff_invOfUnit, IsUnit.mem_nonZeroDivisors (Units.isUnit u⁻¹)]

name: isUnit_iff_constantCoeff
statement:
theorem isUnit_iff_constantCoeff {φ : MvPowerSeries σ R} :
    IsUnit φ ↔ IsUnit (constantCoeff φ)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact IsUnit.map _
  · intro ⟨u, hu⟩
    exact ⟨⟨_, φ.invOfUnit u, mul_invOfUnit φ u hu.symm, invOfUnit_mul φ u hu.symm⟩, rfl⟩

name: map.isLocalHom
statement:
@[instance]
theorem map.isLocalHom : IsLocalHom (map (σ := σ) f)
proof:
:=
  ⟨by
    rintro φ ⟨ψ, h⟩
    replace h := congr_arg constantCoeff h
    rw [constantCoeff_map] at h
    have : IsUnit (constantCoeff ψ.val) := isUnit_constantCoeff _ ψ.isUnit
    rw [h] at this
    rcases isUnit_of_map_unit f _ this with ⟨c, hc⟩
    exact .of_mul_eq_one (invOfUnit φ c) (mul_invOfUnit φ c hc.symm)⟩

name: coeff_inv
statement:
theorem coeff_inv [DecidableEq σ] (n : σ →₀ ℕ) (φ : MvPowerSeries σ k) :
    coeff n φ⁻¹ =
      if n = 0 then (constantCoeff φ)⁻¹
      else
        -(constantCoeff φ)⁻¹ *
          ∑ x ∈ antidiagonal n, if x.2 < n then coeff x.1 φ * coeff x.2 φ⁻¹ else 0
proof:
:=
  coeff_inv_aux n _ φ

name: constantCoeff_inv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem constantCoeff_inv (φ : MvPowerSeries σ k) :
    constantCoeff φ⁻¹ = (constantCoeff φ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, coeff_inv, ite_eq_left rfl]

name: inv_eq_zero
statement: protected theorem inv_eq_zero {φ : MvPowerSeries σ k} : φ⁻¹ = 0 ↔ constantCoeff φ = 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by simpa using congr_arg constantCoeff h, fun h =>
    ext fun n => by
      classical
      rw [coeff_inv]
      split_ifs <;>
        simp only [h, map_zero, zero_mul, inv_zero, neg_zero]⟩

name: zero_inv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero_inv : (0 : MvPowerSeries σ k)⁻¹ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [MvPowerSeries.inv_eq_zero, constantCoeff_zero]

name: invOfUnit_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem invOfUnit_eq (φ : MvPowerSeries σ k) (h : constantCoeff φ ≠ 0) :
    invOfUnit φ (Units.mk0 _ h) = φ⁻¹
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: invOfUnit_eq'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem invOfUnit_eq' (φ : MvPowerSeries σ k) (u : Units k) (h : constantCoeff φ = u) :
    invOfUnit φ u = φ⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [← invOfUnit_eq φ (h.symm ▸ u.ne_zero)]
  apply congrArg (invOfUnit φ)
  rw [Units.ext_iff]
  exact h.symm

name: mul_inv_cancel
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem mul_inv_cancel (φ : MvPowerSeries σ k) (h : constantCoeff φ ≠ 0) :
    φ * φ⁻¹ = 1
proof: := by rw [← invOfUnit_eq φ h, mul_invOfUnit φ (Units.mk0 _ h) rfl]

name: inv_mul_cancel
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem inv_mul_cancel (φ : MvPowerSeries σ k) (h : constantCoeff φ ≠ 0) :
    φ⁻¹ * φ = 1
proof: := by rw [mul_comm, φ.mul_inv_cancel h]

name: eq_mul_inv_iff_mul_eq
statement:
protected theorem eq_mul_inv_iff_mul_eq {φ₁ φ₂ φ₃ : MvPowerSeries σ k}
    (h : constantCoeff φ₃ ≠ 0) : φ₁ = φ₂ * φ₃⁻¹ ↔ φ₁ * φ₃ = φ₂
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun k => by simp [k, mul_assoc, MvPowerSeries.inv_mul_cancel _ h], fun k => by
    simp [← k, mul_assoc, MvPowerSeries.mul_inv_cancel _ h]⟩

name: eq_inv_iff_mul_eq_one
statement:
protected theorem eq_inv_iff_mul_eq_one {φ ψ : MvPowerSeries σ k} (h : constantCoeff ψ ≠ 0) :
    φ = ψ⁻¹ ↔ φ * ψ = 1
proof: := by rw [← MvPowerSeries.eq_mul_inv_iff_mul_eq h, one_mul]

name: inv_eq_iff_mul_eq_one
statement:
protected theorem inv_eq_iff_mul_eq_one {φ ψ : MvPowerSeries σ k} (h : constantCoeff ψ ≠ 0) :
    ψ⁻¹ = φ ↔ φ * ψ = 1
proof: := by rw [eq_comm, MvPowerSeries.eq_inv_iff_mul_eq_one h]

name: mul_inv_rev
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem mul_inv_rev (φ ψ : MvPowerSeries σ k) :
    (φ * ψ)⁻¹ = ψ⁻¹ * φ⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : constantCoeff (φ * ψ) = 0
  · rw [MvPowerSeries.inv_eq_zero.mpr h]
    simp only [map_mul, mul_eq_zero] at h
    
    rcases h with h | h <;> simp [MvPowerSeries.inv_eq_zero.mpr h]
  · rw [MvPowerSeries.inv_eq_iff_mul_eq_one h]
    simp only [not_or, map_mul, mul_eq_zero] at h
    rw [← mul_assoc, mul_assoc _⁻¹, MvPowerSeries.inv_mul_cancel _ h.left, mul_one,
      MvPowerSeries.inv_mul_cancel _ h.right]

name: C_inv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem C_inv (r : k) : (C (σ := σ) r)⁻¹ = C r⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne r 0 with (rfl | hr)
  · simp
  rw [MvPowerSeries.inv_eq_iff_mul_eq_one, ← map_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hr, map_one]
  simpa using hr

name: X_inv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem X_inv (s : σ) : (X s : MvPowerSeries σ k)⁻¹ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [MvPowerSeries.inv_eq_zero, constantCoeff_X]

name: smul_inv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_inv (r : k) (φ : MvPowerSeries σ k) : (r • φ)⁻¹ = r⁻¹ • φ⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simp [smul_eq_C_mul, mul_comm]

name: expand_C
statement: theorem expand_C (r : R) : expand p hp (C r : MvPowerSeries σ R) = C r
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← mul_one (C r), ← smul_eq_C_mul, expand, AlgHom.map_smul_of_tower,
    map_one, smul_eq_C_mul, mul_one]

name: expand_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem expand_X (i : σ) : expand p hp (X i : MvPowerSeries σ R) = X i ^ p
proof:
:=
  substAlgHom_X (HasSubst.X_pow hp) i

name: expand_monomial
statement:
@[simp]
theorem expand_monomial (d : σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R) :
    expand p hp (monomial d r) = monomial (p • d) r
proof:
:= by
  rw [expand, substAlgHom_monomial (HasSubst.X_pow hp), monomial_eq', Finsupp.prod,
    Finsupp.prod_of_support_subset _ Finsupp.support_smul]
  · simp [pow_mul, algebraMap_apply, Algebra.algebraMap_self]
  · simp

name: expand_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem expand_one : expand 1 one_ne_zero = AlgHom.id R (MvPowerSeries σ R)
proof:
:= by
  ext1 i
  simp [expand, subst_self]

name: expand_one_apply
statement: theorem expand_one_apply (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) : expand 1 one_ne_zero f = f
proof: := by simp

name: map_expand
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_expand (f : R →+* S) (φ : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    map f (expand p hp φ) = expand p hp (map f φ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [expand, map_subst (HasSubst.X_pow hp)]

name: HasSubst.expand
statement:
theorem HasSubst.expand {f : σ → MvPowerSeries τ S} (hf : HasSubst f) :
    HasSubst fun i ↦ expand p hp (f i)
proof: := comp hf (HasSubst.X_pow hp)

name: expand_comp_substAlgHom
statement:
theorem expand_comp_substAlgHom {f : σ → MvPowerSeries τ S} (hf : HasSubst f) :
    (expand p hp).comp (substAlgHom hf) = substAlgHom (HasSubst.expand p hp hf)
proof:
:= by
  ext1 i
  simp [expand, subst_comp_subst_apply hf (HasSubst.X_pow hp)]

name: expand_substAlgHom
statement:
theorem expand_substAlgHom {f : σ → MvPowerSeries τ S} (hf : HasSubst f) {φ : MvPowerSeries σ S} :
    expand p hp (substAlgHom hf φ) = substAlgHom (HasSubst.expand p hp hf) φ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← AlgHom.comp_apply, expand_comp_substAlgHom]

name: expand_subst
statement:
theorem expand_subst {f : σ → MvPowerSeries τ R} (hf : HasSubst f) {φ : MvPowerSeries σ R} :
    expand p hp (subst f φ) = subst (fun i ↦ (f i).expand p hp) φ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← substAlgHom_apply hf, expand_substAlgHom, substAlgHom_apply]

name: expand_mul_eq_comp
statement:
theorem expand_mul_eq_comp :
    expand (σ := σ) (R := R) (p * q) (p.mul_ne_zero hp hq) = (expand p hp).comp (expand q hq)
proof:
:= by
  ext1 i
  simp [expand, pow_mul, subst_comp_subst_apply (HasSubst.X_pow hq) (HasSubst.X_pow hp),
    subst_pow (HasSubst.X_pow hp), subst_X (HasSubst.X_pow hp)]

name: expand_mul
statement:
theorem expand_mul (φ : MvPowerSeries σ R) : φ.expand (p * q) (p.mul_ne_zero hp hq) =
    (φ.expand q hq).expand p hp
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.congr_fun (expand_mul_eq_comp p hp q hq) φ

name: coeff_expand_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_expand_smul (φ : MvPowerSeries σ R) (m : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    (expand p hp φ).coeff (p • m) = φ.coeff m
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [expand, substAlgHom_apply, coeff_subst (HasSubst.X_pow hp), smul_eq_mul]
  have {d : σ →₀ ℕ} : (d.prod fun s e ↦ (X s (R := R) ^ p) ^ e) = monomial (p • d) 1 := by
    simp [monomial_smul_eq]
  rw [finsum_eq_single _ m]
  · rw [this, coeff_monomial, ite_eq_left rfl, mul_one]
  · intro d hd
    rw [this, coeff_monomial, ite_eq_right _, mul_zero]
    simp [nsmul_right_inj hp, hd.symm]

name: constantCoeff_expand
statement:
@[simp]
theorem constantCoeff_expand (φ : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    (φ.expand p hp).constantCoeff = φ.constantCoeff
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff, ← smul_zero p, coeff_expand_smul]
  simp

name: coeff_expand_of_not_dvd
statement:
theorem coeff_expand_of_not_dvd (φ : MvPowerSeries σ R) {m : σ →₀ ℕ} {i : σ} (h : ¬ p ∣ m i) :
    (expand p hp φ).coeff m = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  contrapose! h
  simp only [expand, substAlgHom_apply, coeff_subst (HasSubst.X_pow hp)] at h
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ : ∃ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), (coeff m) (d.prod fun s e ↦ ((X s (R := R)) ^ p) ^ e) ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra! hc
    rw [finsum_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero fun d => by simp [hc d]] at h
    contradiction
  have : (d.prod fun s e ↦ ((X s (R := R)) ^ p) ^ e) = monomial (p • d) 1 := by
    simp [monomial_smul_eq]
  rw [this, coeff_monomial] at hd
  have meq : m = p • d := by
    by_contra hc
    rw [ite_eq_right hc] at hd
    contradiction
  simp [meq]

name: support_expand_subset
statement:
theorem support_expand_subset (φ : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    (expand p hp φ).support ⊆ φ.support.image (p • ·)
proof:
:= by
  intro d hd
  have : ∀ i, p ∣ d i := fun _ => by_contra fun hc => hd (coeff_expand_of_not_dvd p hp φ hc)
  let m := d.mapRange (fun n => n / p) (Nat.zero_div p)
  have eq_aux : p • m = d := (Finsupp.ext fun a => Nat.eq_mul_of_div_eq_right (this a) rfl).symm
  rw [Function.mem_support, ← eq_aux, ← coeff_apply (expand p hp φ), coeff_expand_smul,
    coeff_apply] at hd
  exact ⟨m, hd, eq_aux⟩

name: support_expand
statement:
theorem support_expand (φ : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    (expand p hp φ).support = φ.support.image (p • ·)
proof:
:= by
  refine (support_expand_subset p hp φ).antisymm ?_
  intro d hd
  obtain ⟨n, hn₁, hn₂⟩ := hd
  simp only [← hn₂, Function.mem_support]
  by_contra hc
  rw [Function.mem_support, ← coeff_apply φ, ← coeff_expand_smul p hp, coeff_apply, hc] at hn₁
  contradiction

name: order_expand
statement:
@[simp]
theorem order_expand (φ : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    (φ.expand p hp).order = p • φ.order
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! hφ : φ = 0
  · simpa [hφ] using (ENat.mul_top (by norm_cast)).symm
  · apply eq_of_le_of_ge
    · obtain ⟨d, hd₁, hd₂⟩ := exists_coeff_ne_zero_and_order (ne_zero_iff_order_finite.mp hφ)
      have : p • φ.order = (p • d).degree := by simp [← hd₂]
      rw [this]
      exact order_le <| (coeff_expand_smul p hp φ _) ▸ hd₁
    · refine MvPowerSeries.le_order fun d hd => ?_
      by_cases! h : ∀ i, p ∣ d i
      · obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m, p • m = d := ⟨d.mapRange (fun a ↦ a / p) (by simp),
          by ext i; simp [(Nat.mul_div_cancel' (h i))]⟩
        rw [← hm, coeff_expand_smul, coeff_of_lt_order]
        simp only [← hm, map_nsmul, smul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_mul, nsmul_eq_mul] at hd
        exact lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left' hd
      · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := h
        exact coeff_expand_of_not_dvd p hp φ hi

name: expand_eq_expand
statement:
@[simp]
theorem expand_eq_expand {φ : MvPolynomial σ R} :
    expand p hp (↑φ) = (φ.expand p : MvPowerSeries σ R)
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  simp only [MvPolynomial.coeff_coe]
  by_cases! h : ∀ i, p ∣ n i
  · obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m, p • m = n := ⟨n.mapRange (fun a ↦ a / p) (by simp),
      by ext i; simp [(Nat.mul_div_cancel' (h i))]⟩
    rw [← hm, coeff_expand_smul p hp _ _, φ.coeff_expand_smul _ hp, φ.coeff_coe]
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := h
    rw [coeff_expand_of_not_dvd p hp _ hi, MvPolynomial.coeff_expand_of_not_dvd _ hi]

name: trunc'_expand
statement:
theorem trunc'_expand [DecidableEq σ] {n : σ →₀ ℕ} (φ : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    trunc' R (p • n) (expand p hp φ) = (trunc' R n φ).expand p
proof:
:= by
  ext d
  by_cases! h : ∀ i, p ∣ d i
  · obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m, p • m = d := ⟨d.mapRange (fun a ↦ a / p) (by simp),
      by ext i; simp [(Nat.mul_div_cancel' (h i))]⟩
    by_cases h_le : m ≤ n
    · rw [← hm, coeff_trunc', ite_eq_left (nsmul_le_nsmul_right h_le p), coeff_expand_smul,
        MvPolynomial.coeff_expand_smul _ hp, coeff_trunc', ite_eq_left h_le]
    · have not_le : ¬ p • m ≤ p • n := by
        obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, m i > n i := by
          by_contra! hc
          exact h_le (Finsupp.coe_le_coe.mp hc)
        have : ¬ p • m i ≤ p • n i := by
          simp [Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hi (p.ne_zero_iff_zero_lt.mp hp)]
        exact Not.intro fun a ↦ this (a i)
      rw [coeff_trunc', ← hm, ite_eq_right not_le, MvPolynomial.coeff_expand_smul _ hp,
        coeff_trunc', ite_eq_right h_le]
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := h
    rw [MvPolynomial.coeff_expand_of_not_dvd _ hi]
    by_cases hd : d ≤ p • n
    · rw [coeff_trunc', ite_eq_left hd, coeff_expand_of_not_dvd _ hp _ hi]
    rw [coeff_trunc', ite_eq_right hd]

name: trunc'_expand_trunc'
statement:
theorem trunc'_expand_trunc' {n m : σ →₀ ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) [DecidableEq σ] (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    (MvPolynomial.expand p) (trunc' R n f) = (trunc' R (p • n))
      ↑((MvPolynomial.expand p) (trunc' R m f))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← expand_eq_expand p hp, trunc'_expand, ← trunc'_trunc' h]

name: map_frobenius_expand
statement:
theorem map_frobenius_expand {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} :
    (f.expand p hp).map (frobenius R p) = f ^ p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [eq_iff_frequently_trunc'_eq, Filter.frequently_atTop]
  intro n
  use (p • n)
  refine ⟨le_self_nsmul zero_le hp, ?_⟩
  · have : (((trunc' R (p • n) f).expand p).map (frobenius R p)).toMvPowerSeries =
      MvPowerSeries.map (frobenius R p) ((trunc' R (p • n) f).expand p) := by
      simp only [MvPolynomial.map_expand, ← expand_eq_expand p hp, map_expand]
      congr
    rw [trunc'_map, trunc'_expand, ← trunc'_trunc'_pow (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr
      (expChar_ne_zero R p)), ← MvPolynomial.coe_pow p, ← MvPolynomial.map_frobenius_expand, this,
        trunc'_map, trunc'_expand_trunc' p hp (le_self_nsmul zero_le hp)]

name: map_iterateFrobenius_expand
statement:
theorem map_iterateFrobenius_expand (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) (n : ℕ) :
    map (iterateFrobenius R p n) (expand (p ^ n) (pow_ne_zero n hp) f) = f ^ p ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [map_id]
  | succ k n_ih =>
    symm
    conv_lhs => rw [pow_succ, pow_mul, ← n_ih]
    simp_rw [← map_frobenius_expand p hp, pow_succ', add_comm k, iterateFrobenius_add,
      ← map_map, ← map_expand, ← expand_mul, iterateFrobenius_one]

name: _root_.FiniteField.MvPowerSeries.expand_card
statement:
theorem _root_.FiniteField.MvPowerSeries.expand_card {K : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype K]
    (f : MvPowerSeries σ K) :
    f.expand (Fintype.card K) Fintype.card_ne_zero = f ^ (Fintype.card K)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := CharP.exists K
  rcases FiniteField.card K p with ⟨⟨n, npos⟩, ⟨hp, hn⟩⟩
  have : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  simp_rw [hn]
  rw [← MvPowerSeries.map_iterateFrobenius_expand _ (NeZero.ne' p).symm, iterateFrobenius_eq_pow,
    FiniteField.frobenius_pow hn, RingHom.one_def, MvPowerSeries.map_id, RingHom.id_apply]

name: tendsto_iff_coeff_tendsto
statement:
theorem tendsto_iff_coeff_tendsto [Semiring R] {ι : Type*}
    (f : ι → MvPowerSeries σ R) (u : Filter ι) (g : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    Tendsto f u (nhds g) ↔

name: tendsto_trunc'_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_trunc'_atTop [DecidableEq σ] [CommSemiring R] (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    Tendsto (fun d ↦ (trunc' R d f : MvPowerSeries σ R)) atTop (𝓝 f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tendsto_iff_coeff_tendsto]
  intro d
  exact tendsto_atTop_of_eventually_const fun n (hdn : d ≤ n) ↦ (by simp [coeff_trunc', hdn])

name: tendsto_trunc_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_trunc_atTop [DecidableEq σ] [CommSemiring R] [Nonempty σ] (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    Tendsto (fun d ↦ (trunc R d f : MvPowerSeries σ R)) atTop (𝓝 f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tendsto_iff_coeff_tendsto]
  intro d
  obtain ⟨s, _⟩ := (exists_const σ).mpr trivial
  apply tendsto_atTop_of_eventually_const (i₀ := d + Finsupp.single s 1)
  intro n hn
  rw [MvPolynomial.coeff_coe, coeff_trunc, ite_eq_left]
  apply lt_of_lt_of_le _ hn
  simpa [Finsupp.lt_def] using ⟨s, by simp⟩

statement:

    DenseRange (MvPolynomial.toMvPowerSeries (R := R) (σ := σ))

  classical
  exact mem_closure_of_tendsto (tendsto_trunc'_atTop f) <| .of_forall fun _ ↦ Set.mem_range_self _

name: instIsTopologicalSemiring
statement:
@[scoped instance]
theorem instIsTopologicalSemiring [Semiring R] [IsTopologicalSemiring R] :
    IsTopologicalSemiring (MvPowerSeries σ R) where
  continuous_add
proof:
:= continuous_pi fun d => continuous_add.comp
    (((continuous_coeff R d).fst').prodMk (continuous_coeff R d).snd')
  continuous_mul := continuous_pi fun _ =>
    continuous_finsetSum _ fun i _ => continuous_mul.comp
      ((continuous_coeff R i.fst).fst'.prodMk (continuous_coeff R i.snd).snd')

name: instIsTopologicalRing
statement:
@[scoped instance]
theorem instIsTopologicalRing [Ring R] [IsTopologicalRing R] :
    IsTopologicalRing (MvPowerSeries σ R)
proof:

  { instIsTopologicalSemiring σ R with
    continuous_neg := continuous_pi fun d ↦ Continuous.comp continuous_neg
      (continuous_coeff R d) }

name: continuous_C
statement:
@[fun_prop]
theorem continuous_C [Semiring R] :
    Continuous (C (σ := σ) (R := R))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  refine fun r ↦ (tendsto_iff_coeff_tendsto _ _ _).mpr fun d ↦ ?_
  simp only [coeff_C]
  split_ifs
  · exact tendsto_id
  · exact tendsto_const_nhds

name: variables_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem variables_tendsto_zero [Semiring R] :
    Tendsto (X · : σ → MvPowerSeries σ R) cofinite (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [tendsto_iff_coeff_tendsto, coeff_X, coeff_zero]
  refine fun d ↦ tendsto_nhds_of_eventually_eq ?_
  by_cases! h : ∃ i, d = Finsupp.single i 1
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := h
    filter_upwards [eventually_cofinite_ne i] with j hj
    simp [hi, Finsupp.single_eq_single_iff, hj.symm]
  · simpa only [ite_eq_right_iff] using
      Eventually.of_forall fun x h' ↦ (h x h').elim

name: isTopologicallyNilpotent_of_constantCoeff_isNilpotent
statement:
theorem isTopologicallyNilpotent_of_constantCoeff_isNilpotent [CommSemiring R]
    {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} (hf : IsNilpotent (constantCoeff f)) :
    IsTopologicallyNilpotent f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hf
  simp_rw [IsTopologicallyNilpotent, tendsto_iff_coeff_tendsto, coeff_zero]
  exact fun d ↦ tendsto_atTop_of_eventually_const fun n hn ↦
    coeff_eq_zero_of_constantCoeff_nilpotent hm hn

name: isTopologicallyNilpotent_of_constantCoeff_zero
statement:
theorem isTopologicallyNilpotent_of_constantCoeff_zero [CommSemiring R]
    {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} (hf : constantCoeff f = 0) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => f ^ n) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply isTopologicallyNilpotent_of_constantCoeff_isNilpotent
  rw [hf]
  exact IsNilpotent.zero

name: isTopologicallyNilpotent_iff_constantCoeff_isNilpotent
statement:
theorem isTopologicallyNilpotent_iff_constantCoeff_isNilpotent
    [CommRing R] [DiscreteTopology R] (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    IsTopologicallyNilpotent f ↔ IsNilpotent (constantCoeff f)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun H ↦ ?_, isTopologicallyNilpotent_of_constantCoeff_isNilpotent⟩
  replace H := H.map (continuous_constantCoeff R)
  simp_rw [IsTopologicallyNilpotent, nhds_discrete, tendsto_pure] at H
  exact H.exists

name: hasSum_iff_hasSum_coeff

    HasSum f g ↔ ∀ d : σ →₀ ℕ, HasSum (fun i ↦ coeff d (f i)) (coeff d g)

name: summable_iff_summable_coeff
statement:
theorem summable_iff_summable_coeff :
    Summable f ↔ ∀ d : σ →₀ ℕ, Summable (fun i ↦ coeff d (f i))
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Summable, hasSum_iff_hasSum_coeff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, h⟩ n
    exact ⟨coeff n a, h n⟩
  · intro h
    choose a h using h
    exact ⟨a, by simpa using! h⟩

name: summable_of_tendsto_weightedOrder_atTop_nhds_top
statement:
theorem summable_of_tendsto_weightedOrder_atTop_nhds_top {w : σ → ℕ}
    (h : Tendsto (fun i ↦ weightedOrder w (f i)) atTop (𝓝 ⊤)) : Summable f
proof:
:= by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty ι with hempty | hempty
  · apply summable_empty
  rw [summable_iff_summable_coeff]
  simp_rw [ENat.tendsto_nhds_top_iff_natCast_lt, Filter.eventually_atTop] at h
  intro d
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := h (Finsupp.weight w d)
  refine summable_of_hasFiniteSupport <| (Set.finite_Iic i).subset ?_
  simp_rw [Function.support_subset_iff, Set.mem_Iic]
  intro k hk
  contrapose! hk
  exact coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_weightedOrder w <| hi k hk.le

name: summable_pow_of_constantCoeff_eq_zero
statement:
theorem summable_pow_of_constantCoeff_eq_zero {f : MvPowerSeries σ R}
    (h : f.constantCoeff = 0) : Summable (f ^ ·)
proof:
:= by
  apply summable_of_tendsto_order_atTop_nhds_top
  simp_rw [ENat.tendsto_nhds_top_iff_natCast_lt, Filter.eventually_atTop]
  refine fun n ↦ ⟨n + 1, fun m hm ↦ lt_of_lt_of_le ?_ (le_order_pow _)⟩
  refine (ENat.natCast_lt_natCast.mpr (Nat.add_one_le_iff.mp hm)).trans_le ?_
  simpa [nsmul_eq_mul] using ENat.self_le_mul_right m (order_ne_zero_iff_constCoeff_eq_zero.mpr h)

name: tsum_pow_mul_one_sub_of_constantCoeff_eq_zero
statement:
theorem tsum_pow_mul_one_sub_of_constantCoeff_eq_zero (h : f.constantCoeff = 0) :
    (∑' (i : ℕ), f ^ i) * (1 - f) = 1
proof:
:=
  (summable_pow_of_constantCoeff_eq_zero h).tsum_pow_mul_one_sub

name: one_sub_mul_tsum_pow_of_constantCoeff_eq_zero
statement:
theorem one_sub_mul_tsum_pow_of_constantCoeff_eq_zero (h : f.constantCoeff = 0) :

proof:
:=
  (summable_pow_of_constantCoeff_eq_zero h).one_sub_mul_tsum_pow

name: summable_prod_of_tendsto_weightedOrder_atTop_nhds_top
statement:
theorem summable_prod_of_tendsto_weightedOrder_atTop_nhds_top {w : σ → ℕ}
    (h : Tendsto (fun i ↦ weightedOrder w (f i)) atTop (𝓝 ⊤)) : Summable (∏ i ∈ ·, f i)
proof:
:= by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty ι with hempty | hempty
  · apply Summable.of_finite
  refine summable_iff_summable_coeff.mpr fun d ↦ summable_of_hasFiniteSupport ?_
  simp_rw [ENat.tendsto_nhds_top_iff_natCast_lt, eventually_atTop] at h
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := h (Finsupp.weight w d)
  apply (Finset.Iio i).powerset.finite_toSet.subset
  suffices ∀ s : Finset ι, coeff d (∏ i ∈ s, f i) ≠ 0 → ↑s ⊆ Set.Iio i by simpa
  intro s hs
  contrapose hs
  obtain ⟨x, hxs, hxi⟩ := Set.not_subset.mp hs
  rw [Set.mem_Iio, not_lt] at hxi
  refine coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_weightedOrder w <| (hi x hxi).trans_le <| ?_
  apply le_trans (Finset.single_le_sum (by simp) hxs) (le_weightedOrder_prod w _ _)

statement:
theorem summable_prod_of_tendsto_order_atTop_nhds_top

proof:

name: multipliable_one_add_of_tendsto_weightedOrder_atTop_nhds_top

name: multipliable_one_add_of_tendsto_order_atTop_nhds_top

  ext; simp [coeff_renameFun, coeff_monomial, eq_comm]

name: renameFunAux
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Finite.subset
    (s := ↑((TendstoCofinite.finite_preimage_singleton (Finsupp.mapDomain f) x).toFinset.sup
    (fun y ↦ Finset.product {y} (Finset.antidiagonal y))))
  · exact Finset.finite_toSet ..
  · intro; simp
    grind

name: renameFunAux'
statement:
private theorem renameFunAux' [DecidableEq τ] (x : τ →₀ ℕ) :
    {p : ((τ →₀ ℕ) × (τ →₀ ℕ)) × (σ →₀ ℕ) × (σ →₀ ℕ) | p.1 ∈ Finset.antidiagonal x
      ∧ p.2 ∈ (TendstoCofinite.finite_preimage_singleton (Finsupp.mapDomain f) p.1.1).toFinset ×ˢ
    (TendstoCofinite.finite_preimage_singleton (Finsupp.mapDomain f) p.1.2).toFinset}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Set.Finite.subset (s := ↑((Finset.antidiagonal x).sup (fun q ↦ Finset.product {q}
    ((TendstoCofinite.finite_preimage_singleton (Finsupp.mapDomain f) q.1).toFinset ×ˢ
      (TendstoCofinite.finite_preimage_singleton (Finsupp.mapDomain f) q.2).toFinset))))
  · exact Finset.finite_toSet ..
  · intro; simp
    grind

name: renameFunAuxImage
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨_, _, _⟩
  simp; grind [Finsupp.mapDomain_add]

name: renameFun_mul
statement:
private theorem renameFun_mul (p q : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    renameFun f (p * q) = renameFun f p * renameFun f q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext x
  simp only [coeff_renameFun, coeff_mul, sum_mul_sum, ← sum_product']
  rw [← sum_finset_product' (renameFunAux f x).toFinset _ _ (by simp),
    ← sum_finset_product' (renameFunAux' f x).toFinset _ _ (by simp),
    ← renameFunAuxImage f x, sum_image fun _ ↦ by simp; grind]

name: coeff_rename
statement:
theorem coeff_rename (p : MvPowerSeries σ R) (x : τ →₀ ℕ) : coeff x (rename f p) =
    (TendstoCofinite.finite_preimage_singleton (Finsupp.mapDomain f) x).toFinset.sum
      (p.coeff ·)
proof: := by rfl

name: rename_monomial
statement:
theorem rename_monomial (x : σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R) : rename f (monomial x r) =
    monomial (mapDomain f x) r
proof: := renameFun_monomial f ..

name: coeff_embDomain_rename
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_embDomain_rename (e : σ ↪ τ) (p : MvPowerSeries σ R) (x : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    coeff (embDomain e x) (rename e p) = p.coeff x
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_rename, Finset.sum_eq_single x _ (by simp [← embDomain_eq_mapDomain])]
  simpa using fun _ h h' ↦ by simp [← embDomain_eq_mapDomain, embDomain_inj, h'] at h

name: coeff_rename_eq_zero
statement:
theorem coeff_rename_eq_zero (p : MvPowerSeries σ R) {x : τ →₀ ℕ}
    (h' : x ∉ Set.range (Finsupp.mapDomain f)) : (rename f p).coeff x = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [coeff_rename, Set.Finite.toFinset, Set.preimage_singleton_eq_empty.mpr h']

name: rename_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rename_C (r : R) : rename f (C r : MvPowerSeries σ R) = C r
proof: := rename_monomial f 0 r

name: rename_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rename_X (i : σ) : rename f (X i : MvPowerSeries σ R) = X (f i)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using! rename_monomial f (single i 1) 1

name: rename_rename
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rename_rename [TendstoCofinite g] (p : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    rename g (rename f p) = rename (g ∘ f) p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext y; simp only [coeff_rename]
  rw [← Finset.sum_finset_product' ((TendstoCofinite.finite_preimage_singleton
    (Finsupp.mapDomain (g ∘ f)) y).toFinset.image (fun u ↦ (Finsupp.mapDomain f u, u))) _ _
      (by simp; grind [mapDomain_comp]), Finset.sum_image (by simp)]

name: rename_comp_rename
statement:
lemma rename_comp_rename [TendstoCofinite g] :
    (rename (R := R) g).comp (rename f) = rename (g ∘ f)
proof:
:=
  AlgHom.ext fun p ↦ rename_rename f g p

name: rename_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rename_id : rename id = AlgHom.id R (MvPowerSeries σ R)
proof:
:= by
  ext _ y
  simpa [coeff_rename] using Finset.sum_eq_single y (by simp) (by simp)

name: rename_id_apply
statement: lemma rename_id_apply (p : MvPowerSeries σ R) : rename id p = p
proof: := by simp

name: constantCoeff_rename
statement:
@[simp]
theorem constantCoeff_rename (p : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    constantCoeff (rename f p) = constantCoeff p
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, ← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply,
    coeff_rename, Finset.sum_eq_single 0 (by
      simp [mapDomain_apply_eq_zero_iff_of_subsingletonAddUnits]) (by simp)]

name: rename_injective
statement: theorem rename_injective (e : σ ↪ τ) : Function.Injective (rename (R := R) e)
proof:
:= by
  intro _ _ h; ext x
  simpa using MvPowerSeries.ext_iff.mp h (embDomain e x)

name: rename_inj
statement:
theorem rename_inj (e : σ ↪ τ) (p q : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    rename e p = rename e q ↔ p = q
proof: := (rename_injective e).eq_iff

name: rename_map
statement:
theorem rename_map (φ : R →+* S) (p : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    rename f (map φ p) = map φ (rename f p)
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp [coeff_rename]

name: rename_coe
statement: theorem rename_coe (p : MvPolynomial σ R) : rename f (p : MvPowerSeries σ R) = p.rename f
proof:
:= by
  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C a => simp
  | add P Q hP hQ => simp [hP, hQ]
  | mul_X P n hP => simp only [MvPolynomial.coe_mul, MvPolynomial.coe_X, map_mul, hP, rename_X,
    MvPolynomial.rename_X]

name: renameEquiv_refl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem renameEquiv_refl : renameEquiv R (Equiv.refl σ) = AlgEquiv.refl
proof: := AlgEquiv.ext (by simp)

name: renameEquiv_symm
statement:
@[simp]
theorem renameEquiv_symm (f : σ ≃ τ) : (renameEquiv R f).symm = renameEquiv R f.symm
proof: := rfl

name: renameEquiv_trans
statement:
@[simp]
theorem renameEquiv_trans (e : σ ≃ τ) (f : τ ≃ γ) : (renameEquiv R e).trans (renameEquiv R f) =
    renameEquiv R (e.trans f)
proof: := AlgEquiv.ext (rename_rename e f)

name: coeff_killComplFun
statement:
private theorem coeff_killComplFun (p : MvPowerSeries τ R) (x : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    coeff x (killComplFun e p) = coeff (embDomain e x) p
proof: := rfl

name: killComplFun_monomial_embDomain
statement:
private theorem killComplFun_monomial_embDomain (x : σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R) :
    killComplFun e (monomial (embDomain e x) r) = monomial x r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext; simp [coeff_killComplFun, coeff_monomial, embDomain_inj]

name: killComplFun_monomial_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem killComplFun_monomial_eq_zero {x : τ →₀ ℕ} (r : R)
    (h : x ∉ Set.range (embDomain e)) : killComplFun e (monomial x r) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext; simp [coeff_killComplFun, coeff_monomial]
  grind

name: killComplFun_mul
statement:
private theorem killComplFun_mul (p q : MvPowerSeries τ R) :
    killComplFun e (p * q) = killComplFun e p * killComplFun e q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext
  simp [coeff_killComplFun, coeff_mul, ← image_prodMap_embDomain_antidiagonal, Finset.sum_image
    ((Function.Injective.injOn (Prod.map_injective.mpr ⟨embDomain_injective e,
      embDomain_injective e⟩)))]

name: coeff_killCompl
statement:
lemma coeff_killCompl (p : MvPowerSeries τ R) (x : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    coeff x (killCompl e p) = coeff (embDomain e x) p
proof: := by rfl

name: killCompl_monomial_embDomain
statement:
lemma killCompl_monomial_embDomain (x : σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R) :
    killCompl e (monomial (embDomain e x) r) = monomial x r
proof:
:=
  killComplFun_monomial_embDomain x r

name: killCompl_monomial_eq_zero
statement:
lemma killCompl_monomial_eq_zero {x : τ →₀ ℕ} (r : R)
    (h : x ∉ Set.range (embDomain e)) : killCompl e (monomial x r) = 0
proof:
:=
  killComplFun_monomial_eq_zero r h

name: killCompl_C
statement:
@[simp]
lemma killCompl_C (r : R) : killCompl e (C r) = C r
proof:
:= by
  simpa using killCompl_monomial_embDomain 0 r

name: killCompl_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem killCompl_X (i : σ) : killCompl (R := R) e (X (e i)) = X i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext; simp [coeff_X, coeff_killCompl, ← embDomain_single]

name: killCompl_X_eq_zero
statement:
theorem killCompl_X_eq_zero {t : τ} (h : t ∉ Set.range e) :
    killCompl (R := R) e (X t) = 0
proof:
:= by
  replace h : single t 1 ∉ Set.range (embDomain e) := by
    rwa [mem_range_embDomain_iff, support_single _ (by simp), Finset.coe_singleton,
      Set.singleton_subset_iff]
  simpa using! killCompl_monomial_eq_zero (1 : R) h

name: killCompl_comp_rename
statement: theorem killCompl_comp_rename : (killCompl e).comp (rename e) = AlgHom.id R _
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp [coeff_killCompl]

name: killCompl_rename_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem killCompl_rename_app (p : MvPowerSeries σ R) : killCompl e (rename e p) = p
proof:
:=
  AlgHom.congr_fun (killCompl_comp_rename) p

name: killCompl_map
statement:
theorem killCompl_map (φ : R →+* S) (p : MvPowerSeries τ R) :
    killCompl e (map φ p) = map φ (killCompl e p)
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp [coeff_killCompl]

name: HasSubst.X_comp
statement:
lemma HasSubst.X_comp : HasSubst (X ∘ f : σ → MvPowerSeries τ R) where
  const_coeff
proof:
:= by simp
  coeff_zero d := Set.Finite.subset (d.support.finite_toSet.biUnion'
    (fun i _ ↦ TendstoCofinite.finite_preimage_singleton f i)) (fun x => by
      contrapose; intro _ _; classical simp_all [coeff_X])

name: rename_eq_subst
statement: theorem rename_eq_subst : rename f p = p.subst (X ∘ f)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext n
  rw [coeff_rename, coeff_subst (HasSubst.X_comp _) p n, finsum_eq_sum _
    (coeff_subst_finite (HasSubst.X_comp _) p n)]
  have (d : σ →₀ ℕ) (hd : (coeff d) p * (coeff n) (d.prod fun s e ↦ X (f s) ^ e) ≠ 0) :
      mapDomain f d = n := by
    simp_rw [← monomial_mapDomain_apply_one] at hd
    exact (eq_of_coeff_monomial_ne_zero (right_ne_zero_of_mul hd)).symm
  refine (Finset.sum_subset_zero_on_sdiff ?_ ?_ (fun x hx => ?_)).symm
  · exact Set.Finite.toFinset_mono this
  · simp +contextual [← monomial_mapDomain_apply_one]
  · simp only [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] at hx
    simp [← this _ hx, ← monomial_mapDomain_apply_one, coeff_monomial_same]

name: ne_zero_iff_exists_coeff_ne_zero_and_weight
statement:
theorem ne_zero_iff_exists_coeff_ne_zero_and_weight :
    f ≠ 0 ↔ (∃ n : ℕ, ∃ d : σ →₀ ℕ, coeff d f ≠ 0 ∧ weight w d = n)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using ne_zero_iff_exists_coeff_ne_zero f

name: weightedOrder_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem weightedOrder_zero : (0 : MvPowerSeries σ R).weightedOrder w = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [weightedOrder, dite_eq_left rfl]

name: ne_zero_iff_weightedOrder_finite
statement:
theorem ne_zero_iff_weightedOrder_finite :
    f ≠ 0 ↔ (f.weightedOrder w).toNat = f.weightedOrder w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [weightedOrder, ne_eq, natCast_toNat_eq_self, dite_eq_left_iff,
    ENat.natCast_ne_top, imp_false, not_not]

name: weightedOrder_eq_top_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem weightedOrder_eq_top_iff :
    f.weightedOrder w = ⊤ ↔ f = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← not_iff_not, ← ne_eq, ← ne_eq, ne_zero_iff_weightedOrder_finite w, natCast_toNat_eq_self]

name: exists_coeff_ne_zero_and_weightedOrder
statement:
theorem exists_coeff_ne_zero_and_weightedOrder
    (h : (toNat (f.weightedOrder w) : ℕ∞) = f.weightedOrder w) :
    ∃ d, coeff d f ≠ 0 ∧ weight w d = f.weightedOrder w
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp_rw [weightedOrder, dite_eq_right ((ne_zero_iff_weightedOrder_finite w).mpr h), Nat.cast_inj]
  generalize_proofs h1
  exact Nat.find_spec h1

name: weightedOrder_le
statement:
theorem weightedOrder_le {d : σ →₀ ℕ} (h : coeff d f ≠ 0) :
    f.weightedOrder w ≤ weight w d
proof:
:= by
  rw [weightedOrder, dite_eq_right]
  · simp only [ne_eq, Nat.cast_le, Nat.find_le_iff]
    exact ⟨weight w d, le_rfl, d, h, rfl⟩
  · exact (f.ne_zero_iff_exists_coeff_ne_zero_and_weight w).mpr ⟨weight w d, d, h, rfl⟩

name: coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_weightedOrder
statement:
theorem coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_weightedOrder {d : σ →₀ ℕ} (h : (weight w d) < f.weightedOrder w) :
    coeff d f = 0
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! h; exact weightedOrder_le w h

name: nat_le_weightedOrder
statement:
theorem nat_le_weightedOrder {n : ℕ} (h : ∀ d, weight w d < n → coeff d f = 0) :
    n ≤ f.weightedOrder w
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! H
  have : (f.weightedOrder w).toNat = f.weightedOrder w := by
    rw [natCast_toNat_eq_self]; exact ne_top_of_lt H
  obtain ⟨d, hfd, hd⟩ := exists_coeff_ne_zero_and_weightedOrder w this
  rw [← hd, Nat.cast_lt] at H
  exact hfd (h d H)

name: le_weightedOrder
statement:
theorem le_weightedOrder {n : ℕ∞} (h : ∀ d : σ →₀ ℕ, weight w d < n → coeff d f = 0) :
    n ≤ f.weightedOrder w
proof:
:= by
  cases n
  · rw [top_le_iff, weightedOrder_eq_top_iff]
    ext d; exact h d (ENat.natCast_lt_top _)
  · apply nat_le_weightedOrder;
    simpa only [ENat.some_eq_natCast, Nat.cast_lt] using h

name: weightedOrder_eq_nat
statement:
theorem weightedOrder_eq_nat {n : ℕ} :
    f.weightedOrder w = n ↔
      (∃ d, coeff d f ≠ 0 ∧ weight w d = n) ∧ ∀ d, weight w d < n → coeff d f = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := f.exists_coeff_ne_zero_and_weightedOrder w (by simp only [h, toNat_natCast])
    exact ⟨⟨d, by simpa [h, Nat.cast_inj, ne_eq] using hd⟩,
      fun e he ↦ f.coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_weightedOrder w (by simp only [h, Nat.cast_lt, he])⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨d, hd', hd⟩, h⟩
    exact le_antisymm (hd.symm ▸ f.weightedOrder_le w hd') (nat_le_weightedOrder w h)

name: weightedOrder_monomial
statement:
theorem weightedOrder_monomial {d : σ →₀ ℕ} {a : R} [Decidable (a = 0)] :
    weightedOrder w (monomial d a) = if a = 0 then (⊤ : ℕ∞) else weight w d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [h, weightedOrder_eq_top_iff, map_zero]
  · rw [weightedOrder_eq_nat]
    constructor
    · use d
      simp only [coeff_monomial_same, ne_eq, h, not_false_eq_true, and_self]
    · intro b hb
      rw [coeff_monomial, ite_eq_right]
      rintro rfl
      exact hb.false

name: weightedOrder_monomial_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem weightedOrder_monomial_of_ne_zero {d : σ →₀ ℕ} {a : R} (h : a ≠ 0) :
    weightedOrder w (monomial d a) = weight w d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [weightedOrder_monomial, ite_eq_right h]

name: weightedOrder_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem weightedOrder_one [Nontrivial R] : (1 : MvPowerSeries σ R).weightedOrder w = 0
proof:
:=
  weightedOrder_monomial_of_ne_zero w one_ne_zero

name: min_weightedOrder_le_add
statement:
theorem min_weightedOrder_le_add :
    min (f.weightedOrder w) (g.weightedOrder w) ≤ (f + g).weightedOrder w
proof:
:= by
  apply le_weightedOrder w
  simp +contextual only
    [coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_weightedOrder w, lt_min_iff, map_add, add_zero,
      imp_true_iff]

name: weightedOrder_add_of_weightedOrder_lt.aux
statement:
private theorem weightedOrder_add_of_weightedOrder_lt.aux
    (H : f.weightedOrder w < g.weightedOrder w) :
    (f + g).weightedOrder w = f.weightedOrder w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn : (n : ℕ∞) = _⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp (ne_top_of_lt H)
  rw [← hn, weightedOrder_eq_nat]
  obtain ⟨d, hd', hd⟩ := ((weightedOrder_eq_nat w).mp hn.symm).1
  constructor
  · refine ⟨d, ?_, hd⟩
    rw [← hn, ← hd] at H
    rw [(coeff _).map_add, coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_weightedOrder w H, add_zero]
    exact hd'
  · intro b hb
    suffices weight w b < weightedOrder w f by
      rw [(coeff _).map_add, coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_weightedOrder w this,
        coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_weightedOrder w (lt_trans this H), add_zero]
    rw [← hn, Nat.cast_lt]
    exact hb

name: weightedOrder_add_of_weightedOrder_ne
statement:
theorem weightedOrder_add_of_weightedOrder_ne (h : f.weightedOrder w ≠ g.weightedOrder w) :
    weightedOrder w (f + g) = weightedOrder w f ⊓ weightedOrder w g
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (min_weightedOrder_le_add w)
  wlog H₁ : f.weightedOrder w < g.weightedOrder w
  · rw [add_comm f g, inf_comm]
    exact this _ h.symm ((le_of_not_gt H₁).lt_of_ne' h)
  simp only [le_inf_iff, weightedOrder_add_of_weightedOrder_lt.aux w H₁]
  exact ⟨le_rfl, le_of_lt H₁⟩

name: le_weightedOrder_mul
statement:
theorem le_weightedOrder_mul :
    f.weightedOrder w + g.weightedOrder w ≤ weightedOrder w (f * g)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply le_weightedOrder
  intro d hd
  rw [coeff_mul, Finset.sum_eq_zero]
  rintro ⟨i, j⟩ hij
  by_cases! hi : weight w i < f.weightedOrder w
  · rw [coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_weightedOrder w hi, zero_mul]
  · by_cases! hj : weight w j < g.weightedOrder w
    · rw [coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_weightedOrder w hj, mul_zero]
    · simp only [Finset.mem_antidiagonal] at hij
      exfalso
      apply ne_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le hd <| add_le_add hi hj)
      rw [← hij, map_add, Nat.cast_add]

name: le_weightedOrder_pow
statement: theorem le_weightedOrder_pow (n : ℕ) : n • f.weightedOrder w ≤ (f ^ n).weightedOrder w
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n hn => grw [succ_nsmul, pow_succ, hn, le_weightedOrder_mul]

name: le_weightedOrder_prod
statement:
theorem le_weightedOrder_prod {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] {ι : Type*} (w : σ → ℕ)
    (f : ι → MvPowerSeries σ R) (s : Finset ι) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, (f i).weightedOrder w ≤ (∏ i ∈ s, f i).weightedOrder w
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction with
  | empty => simp
  | cons a s ha ih => grw [Finset.sum_cons ha, Finset.prod_cons ha, ih, le_weightedOrder_mul]

name: le_weightedOrder_smul
statement:
theorem le_weightedOrder_smul {a : R} :
    f.weightedOrder w ≤ (a • f).weightedOrder w
proof:
:=
  le_weightedOrder _ fun i hi => by simp [coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_weightedOrder _ hi]

name: le_weightedOrder_map
statement:
theorem le_weightedOrder_map (φ : R →+* S) :
    f.weightedOrder w ≤ (f.map φ).weightedOrder w
proof:
:=
  le_weightedOrder w fun i hi => by simp [coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_weightedOrder _ hi]

name: coeff_mul_left_one_sub_of_lt_weightedOrder
statement:
theorem coeff_mul_left_one_sub_of_lt_weightedOrder
    {d : σ →₀ ℕ} (h : (weight w d) < g.weightedOrder w) :
    coeff d (f * (1 - g)) = coeff d f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mul_sub, mul_one, map_sub, sub_eq_self]
  apply coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_weightedOrder w
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_of_lt_of_le h le_add_self) (le_weightedOrder_mul w)

name: coeff_mul_right_one_sub_of_lt_weightedOrder
statement:
theorem coeff_mul_right_one_sub_of_lt_weightedOrder
    {d : σ →₀ ℕ} (h : (weight w d) < g.weightedOrder w) :
    coeff d ((1 - g) * f) = coeff d f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sub_mul, one_mul, map_sub, sub_eq_self]
  apply coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_weightedOrder w
  apply lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_of_lt_of_le h le_self_add) (le_weightedOrder_mul w)

name: coeff_mul_prod_one_sub_of_lt_weightedOrder
statement:
theorem coeff_mul_prod_one_sub_of_lt_weightedOrder {R ι : Type*} [CommRing R] (d : σ →₀ ℕ)
    (s : Finset ι) (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) (g : ι → MvPowerSeries σ R)
    (h : ∀ i ∈ s, (weight w d) < weightedOrder w (g i)) :
    coeff d (f * ∏ i ∈ s, (1 - g i)) = coeff d f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp only [Finset.prod_empty, mul_one]
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, forall_eq_or_imp] at h
    rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, ← mul_assoc, mul_right_comm,
      coeff_mul_left_one_sub_of_lt_weightedOrder w h.1, ih h.2]

name: weightedOrder_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem weightedOrder_neg (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) : (-f).weightedOrder w = f.weightedOrder w
proof:
:= by

  have : f = 0 := by simpa using (weightedOrder_add_of_weightedOrder_ne w h).symm

name: weightedOrder_toSubring
statement:
@[simp]
theorem weightedOrder_toSubring (p : MvPowerSeries σ R) (T : Subring R) (hp : ∀ n, p.coeff n ∈ T) :

proof:

  refine eq_of_le_of_ge ?_ ?_
  · refine le_weightedOrder w fun d hd => by
      simp [coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_weightedOrder w hd, ← p.coeff_toSubring T hp]
  · refine le_weightedOrder w fun d hd => by
      exact_mod_cast (coeff_toSubring p T hp) ▸ (coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_weightedOrder w hd)

name: one_le_order_iff_constCoeff_eq_zero
statement:
theorem one_le_order_iff_constCoeff_eq_zero :
    1 ≤ f.order ↔ f.constantCoeff = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply coeff_of_lt_order
    simpa using Order.one_le_iff_pos.mp h
  · intro h
    refine MvPowerSeries.le_order fun d hd ↦ ?_
    rw [Nat.cast_lt_one] at hd
    simp [(degree_eq_zero_iff d).mp hd, h]

  simpa using le_mul_of_one_le_right' (one_le_order_iff_constCoeff_eq_zero.mpr hf)

name: IsWeightedHomogeneous.coeff_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Classical.not_not] using mt (@hf d) hd

name: IsWeightedHomogeneous.add
proof:
:= fun {d} ↦ by
  rw [not_imp_comm]
  intro hd
  rw [map_add, hf.coeff_eq_zero hd, hg.coeff_eq_zero hd, add_zero]

name: IsWeightedHomogeneous.mul
proof:
:= fun {d} ↦ by
  classical
  rw [not_imp_comm]
  intro hd
  rw [coeff_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro x hx
  rw [Finset.mem_antidiagonal] at hx
  suffices weight w x.1 ≠ p ∨ weight w x.2 ≠ q by
    rcases this with hp | hq
    · rw [hf.coeff_eq_zero hp, zero_mul]
    · rw [hg.coeff_eq_zero hq, mul_zero]
  rw [← not_and_or]
  rintro ⟨hp, hq⟩
  apply hd
  rw [← hx, map_add, hp, hq]

statement:
theorem coeff_weightedHomogeneousComponent (p : ℕ) (d : σ →₀ ℕ) (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) :

name: weightedHomogeneousComponent_of_lt_weightedOrder_eq_zero
statement:
theorem weightedHomogeneousComponent_of_lt_weightedOrder_eq_zero
    {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} {p : ℕ} (hf : p < f.weightedOrder w) :
    f.weightedHomogeneousComponent w p = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext d
  rw [coeff_weightedHomogeneousComponent]
  split_ifs with hd
  · rw [coeff_zero]
    apply coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_weightedOrder w
    rw [hd]
    exact hf
  · rw [map_zero]

name: weightedHomogeneousComponent_of_weightedOrder
statement:
theorem weightedHomogeneousComponent_of_weightedOrder
    {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} {p : ℕ} (hf : p = f.weightedOrder w) :
    f.weightedHomogeneousComponent w p ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hf'
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := f.exists_coeff_ne_zero_and_weightedOrder w (by rw [← hf, toNat_natCast])
  simp only [ne_eq, ← hf, Nat.cast_inj] at hd
  apply hd.1
  rw [MvPowerSeries.ext_iff] at hf'
  specialize hf' d
  simp only [coeff_weightedHomogeneousComponent, coeff_zero, ite_eq_right_iff] at hf'
  exact hf' hd.2

name: isWeightedHomogeneous_weightedHomogeneousComponent
statement:
theorem isWeightedHomogeneous_weightedHomogeneousComponent (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) (p : ℕ) :
    IsWeightedHomogeneous w (f.weightedHomogeneousComponent w p) p
proof:
:= fun {d} ↦ by
  rw [not_imp_comm]
  intro hd
  rw [coeff_weightedHomogeneousComponent, ite_eq_right hd]

name: isWeightedHomogeneous_iff_eq_weightedHomogeneousComponent
statement:
theorem isWeightedHomogeneous_iff_eq_weightedHomogeneousComponent
    {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} {p : ℕ} :
    IsWeightedHomogeneous w f p ↔ f = f.weightedHomogeneousComponent w p
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hf
    ext d
    rw [coeff_weightedHomogeneousComponent]
    split_ifs with hd
    · rfl
    · exact hf.coeff_eq_zero hd
  · intro hf
    rw [hf]
    exact isWeightedHomogeneous_weightedHomogeneousComponent w f p

name: weightedHomogeneousComponent_mul_of_le_weightedOrder
statement:
theorem weightedHomogeneousComponent_mul_of_le_weightedOrder {f g : MvPowerSeries σ R} {p q : ℕ}
    (hf : p ≤ f.weightedOrder w) (hg : q ≤ g.weightedOrder w) :
    weightedHomogeneousComponent w (p + q) (f * g) =
      weightedHomogeneousComponent w p f * weightedHomogeneousComponent w q g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext d
  rw [coeff_weightedHomogeneousComponent]
  split_ifs with hd
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro x hx
    rw [Finset.mem_antidiagonal] at hx
    rw [← hx, map_add] at hd
    simp only [coeff_weightedHomogeneousComponent]
    rcases trichotomy_of_add_eq_add hd with h | h | h
    · rw [ite_eq_left h.1, ite_eq_left h.2]
    · rw [ite_eq_right (ne_of_lt h), zero_mul]
      rw [← ENat.natCast_lt_natCast] at h
      rw [coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_weightedOrder w (lt_of_lt_of_le h hf), zero_mul]
    · rw [ite_eq_right (ne_of_lt h), mul_zero]
      rw [← ENat.natCast_lt_natCast] at h
      rw [coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_weightedOrder w (lt_of_lt_of_le h hg), mul_zero]
  · symm
    apply IsWeightedHomogeneous.coeff_eq_zero _ hd
    exact IsWeightedHomogeneous.mul
      (isWeightedHomogeneous_weightedHomogeneousComponent w f p)
      (isWeightedHomogeneous_weightedHomogeneousComponent w g q)

name: _root_.MvPolynomial.toMvPowerSeries_uniformContinuous
statement:
theorem _root_.MvPolynomial.toMvPowerSeries_uniformContinuous
    [IsUniformAddGroup R] [IsUniformAddGroup S] [IsLinearTopology S S]
    (hφ : Continuous φ) (ha : HasEval a) :
    UniformContinuous (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom φ a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply uniformContinuous_of_continuousAt_zero
  rw [ContinuousAt, map_zero, IsLinearTopology.hasBasis_ideal.tendsto_right_iff]
  intro I hI
  let n : σ → ℕ := fun s ↦ sInf {n : ℕ | (a s) ^ n.succ ∈ I}
  have hn_ne : ∀ s, Set.Nonempty {n : ℕ | (a s) ^ n.succ ∈ I} := fun s ↦ by
    rcases ha.hpow s |>.eventually_mem hI |>.exists_forall_of_atTop with ⟨n, hn⟩
    use n
    simpa using hn n.succ n.le_succ
  have hn : Set.Finite (n.support) := by
    change n =ᶠ[cofinite] 0
    filter_upwards [ha.tendsto_zero.eventually_mem hI] with s has
    simpa [n, Pi.zero_apply, Nat.sInf_eq_zero, or_iff_left (hn_ne s).ne_empty] using has
  let n₀ : σ →₀ ℕ := .ofSupportFinite n hn
  let D := Iic n₀
  have hD : Set.Finite D := finite_Iic _
  have : ∀ d ∈ D, ∀ᶠ (p : MvPolynomial σ R) in 𝓝 0, φ (p.coeff d) ∈ I := fun d hd ↦ by
    have : Tendsto (φ ∘ coeff d ∘ toMvPowerSeries) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0) :=
      hφ.comp (continuous_coeff R d) |>.comp continuous_induced_dom |>.tendsto' 0 0 (map_zero _)
    filter_upwards [this.eventually_mem hI] with f hf
    simpa using hf
  rw [← hD.eventually_all] at this
  filter_upwards [this] with p hp
  rw [coe_eval₂Hom, SetLike.mem_coe, eval₂_eq]
  apply Ideal.sum_mem
  intro d _
  by_cases hd : d ∈ D
  · exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (hp d hd)
  · apply Ideal.mul_mem_left
    simp only [mem_Iic, D, Finsupp.le_iff] at hd
    push Not at hd
    rcases hd with ⟨s, hs', hs⟩
    exact I.prod_mem hs' (I.pow_mem_of_pow_mem (Nat.sInf_mem (hn_ne s)) hs)
