:= by
  rw [← coe_eval₂Hom hφ ha]
  exact uniformContinuous_uniformly_extend
    toMvPowerSeries_isUniformInducing
    denseRange_toMvPowerSeries
    (toMvPowerSeries_uniformContinuous hφ ha)

name: continuous_eval
statement:
theorem continuous_eval₂ (hφ : Continuous φ) (ha : HasEval a) :
    Continuous (eval₂ φ a : MvPowerSeries σ R → S)
proof:
:=
  (uniformContinuous_eval₂ hφ ha).continuous

name: hasSum_eval
statement:
theorem hasSum_eval₂ (hφ : Continuous φ) (ha : HasEval a) (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    HasSum
    (fun (d : σ →₀ ℕ) ↦ φ (coeff d f) * (d.prod fun s e => (a s) ^ e))
    (MvPowerSeries.eval₂ φ a f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coe_eval₂Hom hφ ha, eval₂Hom_eq_extend hφ ha]
  convert! (hasSum_of_monomials_self f).map (eval₂Hom hφ ha) (?_) with d
  · simp only [Function.comp_apply, coe_eval₂Hom, ← MvPolynomial.coe_monomial,
      eval₂_coe, eval₂_monomial]
  · rw [coe_eval₂Hom]; exact continuous_eval₂ hφ ha

name: eval
statement:
theorem eval₂_eq_tsum (hφ : Continuous φ) (ha : HasEval a) (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    MvPowerSeries.eval₂ φ a f =
      ∑' (d : σ →₀ ℕ), φ (coeff d f) * (d.prod fun s e => (a s) ^ e)
proof:
:=
  (hasSum_eval₂ hφ ha f).tsum_eq.symm

name: eval
statement:
theorem eval₂_unique (hφ : Continuous φ) (ha : HasEval a)
    {ε : MvPowerSeries σ R → S} (hε : Continuous ε)
    (h : ∀ p : MvPolynomial σ R, ε p = MvPolynomial.eval₂ φ a p) :
    ε = eval₂ φ a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coe_eval₂Hom hφ ha]
  exact (toMvPowerSeries_isDenseInducing.extend_unique h hε).symm

name: comp_eval
statement:
theorem comp_eval₂ (hφ : Continuous φ) (ha : HasEval a)
    {T : Type*} [UniformSpace T] [CompleteSpace T] [T2Space T]
    [CommRing T] [IsTopologicalRing T] [IsLinearTopology T T] [IsUniformAddGroup T]
    {ε : S →+* T} (hε : Continuous ε) :
    ε ∘ eval₂ φ a = eval₂ (ε.comp φ) (ε ∘ a)
proof:
:= by
  apply eval₂_unique _ (ha.map hε)
  · exact Continuous.comp hε (continuous_eval₂ hφ ha)
  · intro p
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, eval₂_coe]
    rw [← MvPolynomial.coe_eval₂Hom, ← comp_apply, MvPolynomial.comp_eval₂Hom,
      MvPolynomial.coe_eval₂Hom]
  · simp only [coe_comp, Continuous.comp hε hφ]

name: coe_aeval
statement:
theorem coe_aeval (ha : HasEval a) :
    ↑(aeval ha) = eval₂ (algebraMap R S) a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [aeval, AlgHom.coe_mk, coe_eval₂Hom]

name: continuous_aeval
statement:
theorem continuous_aeval (ha : HasEval a) :
    Continuous (aeval ha : MvPowerSeries σ R → S)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_aeval]
  exact continuous_eval₂ (continuous_algebraMap R S) ha

name: aeval_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem aeval_coe (ha : HasEval a) (p : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    aeval ha (p : MvPowerSeries σ R) = p.aeval a
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_aeval, aeval_def, eval₂_coe]

name: aeval_unique
statement:
theorem aeval_unique {ε : MvPowerSeries σ R →ₐ[R] S} (hε : Continuous ε) :
    aeval (HasEval.X.map hε) = ε
proof:
:= by
  apply DFunLike.ext'
  rw [coe_aeval]
  refine (eval₂_unique (continuous_algebraMap R S) (HasEval.X.map hε) hε ?_).symm
  intro p
  trans ε.comp (coeToMvPowerSeries.algHom R) p
  · simp
  conv_lhs => rw [← p.aeval_X_left_apply, MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply, MvPolynomial.aeval_def]
  simp

name: hasSum_aeval
statement:
theorem hasSum_aeval (ha : HasEval a) (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    HasSum (fun (d : σ →₀ ℕ) ↦ (coeff d f) • (d.prod fun s e => (a s) ^ e))
      (MvPowerSeries.aeval ha f)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [coe_aeval, ← algebraMap_smul (R := R) S, smul_eq_mul]
  exact hasSum_eval₂ (continuous_algebraMap R S) ha f

name: aeval_eq_sum
statement:
theorem aeval_eq_sum (ha : HasEval a) (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    MvPowerSeries.aeval ha f =
      tsum (fun (d : σ →₀ ℕ) ↦ (coeff d f) • (d.prod fun s e => (a s) ^ e))
proof:
:=
  (hasSum_aeval ha f).tsum_eq.symm

name: comp_aeval
statement:
theorem comp_aeval (ha : HasEval a)
    {T : Type*} [CommRing T] [UniformSpace T] [IsUniformAddGroup T]
    [IsTopologicalRing T] [IsLinearTopology T T]
    [T2Space T] [Algebra R T] [ContinuousSMul R T] [CompleteSpace T]
    {ε : S →ₐ[R] T} (hε : Continuous ε) :
    ε.comp (aeval ha) = aeval (ha.map hε)
proof:
:= by
  apply DFunLike.ext'
  simp only [AlgHom.coe_comp, coe_aeval ha]
  rw [← RingHom.coe_coe,
    comp_eval₂ (continuous_algebraMap R S) ha (show Continuous (ε : S →+* T) from hε), coe_aeval]
  congr!
  simp only [AlgHom.comp_algebraMap_of_tower]

name: truncFinset_apply
statement:
theorem truncFinset_apply (p : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    truncFinset R s p = ∑ x ∈ s, MvPolynomial.monomial x (p.coeff x)
proof: := by rfl

name: coeff_truncFinset_of_mem
statement:
@[grind =]
theorem coeff_truncFinset_of_mem {x : σ →₀ ℕ} (p : MvPowerSeries σ R) (h : x ∈ s) :
    (truncFinset R s p).coeff x = p.coeff x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [truncFinset_apply, h]

name: coeff_truncFinset_eq_zero
statement:
@[grind =]
theorem coeff_truncFinset_eq_zero {x : σ →₀ ℕ} (p : MvPowerSeries σ R) (h : x ∉ s) :
    (truncFinset R s p).coeff x = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [truncFinset_apply, h]

name: coeff_truncFinset
statement:
lemma coeff_truncFinset [DecidableEq σ] {x : σ →₀ ℕ} (p : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    (truncFinset R s p).coeff x = if x ∈ s then p.coeff x else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [truncFinset_apply]

name: truncFinset_monomial
statement:
theorem truncFinset_monomial {x : σ →₀ ℕ} (r : R) (h : x ∈ s) :
    truncFinset R s (monomial x r) = MvPolynomial.monomial x r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext
  grind [coeff_monomial, MvPolynomial.coeff_monomial]

name: truncFinset_monomial_eq_zero
statement:
theorem truncFinset_monomial_eq_zero {x : σ →₀ ℕ} (r : R) (h : x ∉ s) :
    truncFinset R s (monomial x r) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext; simp [truncFinset, coeff_monomial]
  grind

name: truncFinset_C
statement: theorem truncFinset_C (h : 0 ∈ s) (r : R) : truncFinset R s (C r) = MvPolynomial.C r
proof:
:=
  truncFinset_monomial r h

name: truncFinset_one
statement: theorem truncFinset_one (h : 0 ∈ s) : truncFinset R s (1 : MvPowerSeries σ R) = 1
proof:
:=
  truncFinset_C h 1

name: truncFinset_truncFinset
statement:
theorem truncFinset_truncFinset {t : Finset (σ →₀ ℕ)} (h : s ⊆ t) (p : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    truncFinset R s (truncFinset R t p) = truncFinset R s p
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  by_cases x ∈ s <;> grind [MvPolynomial.coeff_coe]

name: truncFinset_map
statement:
theorem truncFinset_map [CommSemiring S] (f : R →+* S) (p : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    truncFinset S s (map f p) = MvPolynomial.map f (truncFinset R s p)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  by_cases x ∈ s <;> grind [coeff_map, MvPolynomial.coeff_map]

name: coeff_truncFinset_mul_truncFinset_eq_coeff_mul
statement:
theorem coeff_truncFinset_mul_truncFinset_eq_coeff_mul₂ {t : Finset (σ →₀ ℕ)}
    (hs : IsLowerSet (s : Set (σ →₀ ℕ))) (ht : IsLowerSet (t : Set (σ →₀ ℕ)))
    {x : σ →₀ ℕ} (f g : MvPowerSeries σ R) (hxs : x ∈ s) (hxt : x ∈ t) :
      (truncFinset R s f * truncFinset R t g).coeff x = coeff x (f * g)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul, MvPolynomial.coeff_mul]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  rintro ⟨i, j⟩ hij
  simp only [mem_antidiagonal] at hij
  rw [coeff_truncFinset_of_mem _ (hs (show i ≤ x by simp [← hij]) hxs),
    coeff_truncFinset_of_mem _ (ht (show j ≤ x by simp [← hij]) hxt)]

name: coeff_truncFinset_mul_truncFinset_eq_coeff_mul
statement:
theorem coeff_truncFinset_mul_truncFinset_eq_coeff_mul (hs : IsLowerSet (s : Set (σ →₀ ℕ)))
    {x : σ →₀ ℕ} (f g : MvPowerSeries σ R) (hx : x ∈ s) :
      (truncFinset R s f * truncFinset R s g).coeff x = coeff x (f * g)
proof:
:=
  coeff_truncFinset_mul_truncFinset_eq_coeff_mul₂ hs hs f g hx hx

name: truncFinset_truncFinset_pow
statement:
theorem truncFinset_truncFinset_pow (hs : IsLowerSet (s : Set (σ →₀ ℕ))) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (p : MvPowerSeries σ R) : truncFinset R s ((truncFinset R s p) ^ k) =
      truncFinset R s (p ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  induction k, hk using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => simp [truncFinset_truncFinset]
  | succ n hmn ih =>
    ext x; by_cases hx : x ∈ s
    · rw [coeff_truncFinset_of_mem _ hx, coeff_truncFinset_of_mem _ hx, pow_succ,
        ← coeff_truncFinset_mul_truncFinset_eq_coeff_mul hs _ _ hx, ih, truncFinset_truncFinset
        (by rfl), pow_succ, coeff_truncFinset_mul_truncFinset_eq_coeff_mul hs _ _ hx]
    simp [coeff_truncFinset_eq_zero _ hx]

name: support_truncFinset_subset
statement: theorem support_truncFinset_subset (p : MvPowerSeries σ R) : (truncFinset R s p).support ⊆ s
proof:
:= by
  intro; contrapose
  simpa using coeff_truncFinset_eq_zero p

name: totalDegree_truncFinset
statement:
lemma totalDegree_truncFinset (p : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    (truncFinset R s p).totalDegree ≤ s.sup degree
proof:
:= by
  simpa [MvPolynomial.totalDegree] using! sup_mono (support_truncFinset_subset p)

name: truncFinset_coe_eq_self_iff
statement:
lemma truncFinset_coe_eq_self_iff (p : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    truncFinset R s p = p ↔ p.support ⊆ s
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ MvPolynomial.ext _ _ fun x ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [← h]
    exact support_truncFinset_subset ..
  by_cases x ∈ s <;> grind [MvPolynomial.coeff_coe]

name: coeff_trunc
statement:
theorem coeff_trunc (m n : σ →₀ ℕ) (φ : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    (trunc R n φ).coeff m = if m < n then coeff m φ else 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa using! coeff_truncFinset (s := Iio n) (x := m) φ

name: trunc_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem trunc_one (n : σ →₀ ℕ) (hnn : n ≠ 0) : trunc R n 1 = 1
proof:
:=
  truncFinset_one (by simpa using pos_of_ne_zero hnn)

name: trunc_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem trunc_C (n : σ →₀ ℕ) (hnn : n ≠ 0) (a : R) : trunc R n (C a) = MvPolynomial.C a
proof:
:=
  truncFinset_C (by simpa using pos_of_ne_zero hnn) a

name: trunc_C_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem trunc_C_mul (n : σ →₀ ℕ) (a : R) (p : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    trunc R n (C a * p) = MvPolynomial.C a * trunc R n p
proof:
:= by
  ext m; simp [coeff_trunc]

name: trunc_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem trunc_map [CommSemiring S] (n : σ →₀ ℕ) (f : R →+* S) (p : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    trunc S n (map f p) = MvPolynomial.map f (trunc R n p)
proof: := truncFinset_map f p

name: coeff_trunc_mul_trunc_eq_coeff_mul
statement:
theorem coeff_trunc_mul_trunc_eq_coeff_mul₂ (n₁ n₂ : σ →₀ ℕ)
    (f g : MvPowerSeries σ R) {m : σ →₀ ℕ} (h₁ : m < n₁) (h₂ : m < n₂) :
    (trunc R n₁ f * trunc R n₂ g).coeff m = coeff m (f * g)
proof:
:=
  coeff_truncFinset_mul_truncFinset_eq_coeff_mul₂ (by grind [IsLowerSet]) (by grind [IsLowerSet])
    f g (by simpa) (by simpa)

name: coeff_trunc_mul_trunc_eq_coeff_mul
statement:
theorem coeff_trunc_mul_trunc_eq_coeff_mul (n : σ →₀ ℕ)
    (f g : MvPowerSeries σ R) {m : σ →₀ ℕ} (h : m < n) :
    (trunc R n f * trunc R n g).coeff m = coeff m (f * g)
proof:
:=
  coeff_trunc_mul_trunc_eq_coeff_mul₂ n n f g h h

name: coeff_trunc'
statement:
theorem coeff_trunc' (m n : σ →₀ ℕ) (φ : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    (trunc' R n φ).coeff m = if m ≤ n then coeff m φ else 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa using! coeff_truncFinset (s := Iic n) (x := m) φ

name: trunc'_trunc'
statement:
theorem trunc'_trunc' {n m : σ →₀ ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) (φ : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    trunc' R n (trunc' R m φ) = trunc' R n φ
proof:
:=
  truncFinset_truncFinset (Iic_subset_Iic.mpr h) φ

name: trunc'_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem trunc'_one (n : σ →₀ ℕ) : trunc' R n 1 = 1
proof: := truncFinset_one (by simp)

name: trunc'_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem trunc'_C (n : σ →₀ ℕ) (a : R) : trunc' R n (C a) = MvPolynomial.C a
proof:
:=
  truncFinset_C (by simp) a

name: coeff_trunc'_mul_trunc'_eq_coeff_mul
statement:
theorem coeff_trunc'_mul_trunc'_eq_coeff_mul₂ (n₁ n₂ : σ →₀ ℕ)
    (f g : MvPowerSeries σ R) {m : σ →₀ ℕ} (h₁ : m ≤ n₁) (h₂ : m ≤ n₂) :
    (trunc' R n₁ f * trunc' R n₂ g).coeff m = coeff m (f * g)
proof:
:=
  coeff_truncFinset_mul_truncFinset_eq_coeff_mul₂ (by grind [IsLowerSet]) (by grind [IsLowerSet])
    f g (by simpa) (by simpa)

name: coeff_trunc'_mul_trunc'_eq_coeff_mul
statement:
theorem coeff_trunc'_mul_trunc'_eq_coeff_mul (n : σ →₀ ℕ)
    (f g : MvPowerSeries σ R) {m : σ →₀ ℕ} (h : m ≤ n) :
    (trunc' R n f * trunc' R n g).coeff m = coeff m (f * g)
proof:
:=
  coeff_trunc'_mul_trunc'_eq_coeff_mul₂ n n f g h h

name: trunc'_trunc'_pow
statement:
theorem trunc'_trunc'_pow {n : σ →₀ ℕ} {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (φ : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    trunc' R n ((trunc' R n φ) ^ k) = trunc' R n (φ ^ k)
proof:
:=
  truncFinset_truncFinset_pow (by intro; grind) hk φ

name: trunc'_C_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem trunc'_C_mul (n : σ →₀ ℕ) (a : R) (p : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    trunc' R n (C a * p) = MvPolynomial.C a * trunc' R n p
proof:
:= by
  ext m; simp [coeff_trunc']

name: trunc'_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem trunc'_map [CommSemiring S] (n : σ →₀ ℕ) (f : R →+* S) (p : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    trunc' S n (map f p) = MvPolynomial.map f (trunc' R n p)
proof: := truncFinset_map f p

name: totalDegree_trunc'
statement:
theorem totalDegree_trunc' {n : σ →₀ ℕ} (φ : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    (trunc' R n φ).totalDegree ≤ n.degree
proof:
:= by
  simpa [← sup_Iic_of_monotone degree_mono] using! totalDegree_truncFinset φ

name: ext_trunc'
statement: theorem ext_trunc' {f g : MvPowerSeries σ R} : f = g ↔ ∀ n, trunc' R n f = trunc' R n g
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => by simp [h], fun h => ?_⟩
  ext n
  specialize h n
  have {f' : MvPowerSeries σ R} : f'.coeff n = (trunc' R n f').coeff n := by
    rw [coeff_trunc', ite_eq_left le_rfl]
  simp_rw [this, h]

name: eq_iff_frequently_trunc'_eq
statement:
theorem eq_iff_frequently_trunc'_eq {f g : MvPowerSeries σ R} :
    f = g ↔ ∃ᶠ m in atTop, trunc' R m f = trunc' R m g
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => by simp [h, atTop_neBot], fun h => ?_⟩
  ext n
  obtain ⟨m, hm₁, hm₂⟩ := h.forall_exists_of_atTop n
  have {f' : MvPowerSeries σ R} : f'.coeff n = (trunc' R m f').coeff n := by
    rw [coeff_trunc', ite_eq_left hm₁]
  simp [this, hm₂]

name: coeff_truncTotal
statement:
theorem coeff_truncTotal (h : degree x < n) :
    (truncTotal n p).coeff x = p.coeff x
proof: := coeff_truncFinset_of_mem p (by simpa)

name: coeff_truncTotal_eq_zero
statement:
theorem coeff_truncTotal_eq_zero (h : n ≤ degree x) :
    (truncTotal n p).coeff x = 0
proof: := coeff_truncFinset_eq_zero p (by simpa)

name: coeff_truncTotal_eq_ite
statement:
theorem coeff_truncTotal_eq_ite :
    (truncTotal n p).coeff x = if x.degree < n then p.coeff x else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : x.degree < n
  · rw [ite_eq_left h, coeff_truncTotal _ h]
  · rw [ite_eq_right h, coeff_truncTotal_eq_zero _ (not_lt.mp h)]

name: constantCoeff_truncTotal_eq_ite
statement:
theorem constantCoeff_truncTotal_eq_ite :
    (truncTotal n p).constantCoeff = if 0 < n then p.constantCoeff else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [MvPolynomial.constantCoeff_eq, coeff_truncTotal_eq_ite]

name: truncTotal_eq_sum
statement: theorem truncTotal_eq_sum : p.truncTotal n = ∑ i ∈ range n, p.homogeneousComponent i
proof:
:= by
  ext d
  simp [coeff_homogeneousComponent, coeff_truncTotal_eq_ite]

name: truncTotal_one
statement: lemma truncTotal_one (h : n ≠ 0) : truncTotal n (1 : MvPowerSeries σ R) = 1
proof:
:=
  truncFinset_one (by revert h; contrapose; simp)

name: coeff_truncTotal_mul_truncTotal_eq_coeff_mul
statement:
lemma coeff_truncTotal_mul_truncTotal_eq_coeff_mul (hx : degree x < n) :
    (p.truncTotal n * q.truncTotal n).coeff x =
      (coeff x) (p * q)
proof:
:= coeff_truncFinset_mul_truncFinset_eq_coeff_mul
  (fun _ _ h ↦ by simp; grind [degree_mono h]) p q (by simpa)

name: coeff_truncTotal_pow
statement:
lemma coeff_truncTotal_pow (h : x.degree < n) :
    ((p.truncTotal n ^ m)).coeff x = (p ^ m).coeff x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction m using Nat.caseStrongRecOn generalizing x with
  | zero => grind [coeff_one, MvPolynomial.coeff_one]
  | ind k ih =>
    simp_rw [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, pow_add, pow_one, MvPolynomial.coeff_mul, coeff_mul]
    congr! 2 with _ _
    · exact ih _ k.le_refl (by grind [mem_antidiagonal])
    · exact coeff_truncTotal _ (by grind [mem_antidiagonal])

name: truncTotal_pow_eq_truncTotal_truncTotal_pow
statement:
lemma truncTotal_pow_eq_truncTotal_truncTotal_pow :
    (p ^ m).truncTotal n = ((p.truncTotal n).toMvPowerSeries ^ m).truncTotal n
proof:
:= by
  ext d
  by_cases hd : d.degree < n
  · simp_rw [coeff_truncTotal _ hd]
    exact_mod_cast (coeff_truncTotal_pow _ hd).symm
  simp_rw [coeff_truncTotal_eq_zero _ (not_lt.mp hd)]

name: totalDegree_truncTotal_lt
statement:
theorem totalDegree_truncTotal_lt (h : n ≠ 0) :
    (truncTotal n p).totalDegree < n
proof:
:= by
  apply (totalDegree_truncFinset p).trans_lt
  simp [Finset.sup_lt_iff (Nat.lt_of_sub_ne_zero h)]

name: truncTotal_coe_eq_self_iff
statement:
theorem truncTotal_coe_eq_self_iff (p : MvPolynomial σ R) (h : n ≠ 0) :
    truncTotal n p = p ↔ p.totalDegree < n
proof:
:= by
  rw [truncTotal, truncFinset_coe_eq_self_iff, Set.Finite.subset_toFinset,
    MvPolynomial.totalDegree, Finset.sup_lt_iff (bot_lt_iff_ne_bot.mpr h), Set.subset_def]
  simp [degree, sum]

name: isRestricted_abs_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma isRestricted_abs_iff (c : σ → ℝ) (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    IsRestricted |c| f ↔ IsRestricted c f
proof:
:= by
  simp [IsRestricted, NormedAddGroup.tendsto_nhds_zero, Finsupp.prod]

name: isRestricted_zero
statement: lemma isRestricted_zero (c : σ → ℝ) : IsRestricted c (0 : MvPowerSeries σ R)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [IsRestricted] using tendsto_const_nhds

name: isRestricted_monomial
statement:
lemma isRestricted_monomial (c : σ → ℝ) (n : σ →₀ ℕ) (a : R) :
    IsRestricted c (monomial n a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine tendsto_nhds_of_eventually_eq (Set.Subsingleton.finite ?_)
  simp [Set.Subsingleton, coeff_monomial]

name: isRestricted_one
statement: lemma isRestricted_one (c : σ → ℝ) : IsRestricted c (1 : MvPowerSeries σ R)
proof:
:=
  isRestricted_monomial c 0 1

name: isRestricted_C
statement: lemma isRestricted_C (c : σ → ℝ) (a : R) : IsRestricted c (C a)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [monomial_zero_eq_C_apply] using isRestricted_monomial c 0 a

name: isRestricted.add
statement:
lemma isRestricted.add (c : σ → ℝ) {f g : MvPowerSeries σ R} (hf : IsRestricted c f)
    (hg : IsRestricted c g) : IsRestricted c (f + g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isRestricted_abs_iff, IsRestricted] at *
  refine tendsto_const_nhds.squeeze (add_zero (0 : ℝ) ▸ hf.add hg) (fun n ↦ ?_) fun n ↦ ?_
  · dsimp [Finsupp.prod]; positivity 
  rw [← add_mul]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (norm_add_le ..) (by dsimp [Finsupp.prod]; positivity)

name: isRestricted.neg
statement:
lemma isRestricted.neg (c : σ → ℝ) {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} (hf : IsRestricted c f) :
    IsRestricted c (-f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isRestricted_abs_iff, IsRestricted] at *
  simpa [IsRestricted] using hf

name: tendsto_antidiagonal
statement:
lemma tendsto_antidiagonal {M S : Type*} [AddMonoid M] [Finset.HasAntidiagonal M] [NormedRing S]
    [IsUltrametricDist S] {C : M → ℝ} (hC : ∀ a b, C (a + b) = C a * C b) {f g : M → S}
    (hf : Tendsto (fun i ↦ ‖f i‖ * C i) cofinite (𝓝 0))
    (hg : Tendsto (fun i ↦ ‖g i‖ * C i) cofinite (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun a ↦ ‖∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal a, (f p.1 * g p.2)‖ * C a) cofinite (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  wlog hC' : 0 ≤ C generalizing C
  · rw [tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero]
    simpa using this (C := |C|) (by simp [hC]) (by simpa using hf.norm)
      (by simpa using hg.norm) (fun _ => by simp)
  refine .squeeze tendsto_const_nhds
    (tendsto_sup'_antidiagonal_cofinite (tendsto_mul_cofinite_nhds_zero hf hg))
    (fun x ↦ mul_nonneg (by simp) (hC' x)) fun a ↦ ?_
  have : 0 ≤ C a := hC' a
  grw [(nonempty_antidiagonal _).norm_sum_le_sup'_norm, Finset.sup'_mul₀ this]
  refine Finset.sup'_mono_fun fun x hx ↦ ?_
  grw [mul_mul_mul_comm, ← hC, Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hx, ← norm_mul_le]

name: isRestricted.mul
statement:
lemma isRestricted.mul [IsUltrametricDist R] (c : σ → ℝ) {f g : MvPowerSeries σ R}
    (hf : IsRestricted c f) (hg : IsRestricted c g) : IsRestricted c (f * g)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← isRestricted_abs_iff, IsRestricted] at *
  exact tendsto_antidiagonal (by simp [Finsupp.prod_add_index', pow_add]) hf hg

name: mem_nonZeroDivisorsRight_of_constantCoeff
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro x hx
  ext d
  apply WellFoundedLT.induction d
  intro e he
  rw [map_zero, ← mul_right_mem_nonZeroDivisorsRight_eq_zero_iff hφ,
    ← map_zero (f := coeff e), ← hx]
  convert! (coeff_mul e x φ).symm
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (e, 0), coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff]
  · rintro ⟨u, _⟩ huv _
    suffices u < e by simp only [he u this, zero_mul, map_zero]
    apply lt_of_le_of_ne
    · simp only [← mem_antidiagonal.mp huv, le_add_iff_nonneg_right, zero_le]
    · rintro rfl
      simp_all
  · simp

name: mem_nonZeroDivisorsLeft_of_constantCoeff
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro x hx
  ext d
  apply WellFoundedLT.induction d
  intro e he
  rw [map_zero, ← mul_left_mem_nonZeroDivisorsLeft_eq_zero_iff hφ,
    ← map_zero (f := coeff e), ← hx]
  convert! (coeff_mul e φ x).symm
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (0, e), coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff]
  · rintro ⟨_, u⟩ huv _
    suffices u < e by simp only [he u this, mul_zero, map_zero]
    apply lt_of_le_of_ne
    · simp only [← mem_antidiagonal.mp huv, le_add_iff_nonneg_left, zero_le]
    · rintro rfl
      simp_all
  · simp only [mem_antidiagonal, zero_add, not_true_eq_false, coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff,
      false_implies]

name: mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_constantCoeff
proof:
:=
  ⟨mem_nonZeroDivisorsLeft_of_constantCoeff hφ.1, mem_nonZeroDivisorsRight_of_constantCoeff hφ.2⟩

name: monomial_mem_nonzeroDivisorsLeft
statement:
lemma monomial_mem_nonzeroDivisorsLeft {n : σ →₀ ℕ} {r} :
    monomial n r ∈ nonZeroDivisorsLeft (MvPowerSeries σ R) ↔ r ∈ nonZeroDivisorsLeft R
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro H s hrs
    have := H (C s) (by rw [← monomial_zero_eq_C, monomial_mul_monomial]; ext; simp [hrs])
    simpa using congr(coeff 0 $(this))
  · intro H p hrp
    ext i
    have := congr(coeff (i + n) $hrp)
    rw [coeff_monomial_mul, ite_eq_left le_add_self, add_tsub_cancel_right] at this
    simpa using H _ this

name: monomial_mem_nonzeroDivisorsRight
statement:
lemma monomial_mem_nonzeroDivisorsRight {n : σ →₀ ℕ} {r} :
    monomial n r ∈ nonZeroDivisorsRight (MvPowerSeries σ R) ↔ r ∈ nonZeroDivisorsRight R
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro H s hrs
    have := H (C s) (by rw [← monomial_zero_eq_C, monomial_mul_monomial]; ext; simp [hrs])
    simpa using congr(coeff 0 $(this))
  · intro H p hrp
    ext i
    have := congr(coeff (i + n) $hrp)
    rw [coeff_mul_monomial, ite_eq_left le_add_self, add_tsub_cancel_right] at this
    simpa using H _ this

name: monomial_mem_nonzeroDivisors
statement:
lemma monomial_mem_nonzeroDivisors {n : σ →₀ ℕ} {r} :
    monomial n r ∈ (MvPowerSeries σ R)⁰ ↔ r ∈ R⁰
proof:
:=
  monomial_mem_nonzeroDivisorsLeft.and monomial_mem_nonzeroDivisorsRight

name: X_mem_nonzeroDivisors
statement:
lemma X_mem_nonzeroDivisors {i : σ} :
    X i ∈ (MvPowerSeries σ R)⁰
proof:
:= by
  rw [X, monomial_mem_nonzeroDivisors]
  exact Submonoid.one_mem R⁰

name: weightedOrder_mul
statement:
theorem weightedOrder_mul (w : σ → ℕ) (f g : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    (f * g).weightedOrder w = f.weightedOrder w + g.weightedOrder w
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm _ (le_weightedOrder_mul w)
  by_cases hf : f.weightedOrder w < ⊤
  · by_cases hg : g.weightedOrder w < ⊤
    · let p := (f.weightedOrder w).toNat
      have hp : p = f.weightedOrder w := by
        simpa only [p, ENat.natCast_toNat_eq_self, ← lt_top_iff_ne_top]
      let q := (g.weightedOrder w).toNat
      have hq : q = g.weightedOrder w := by
        simpa only [q, ENat.natCast_toNat_eq_self, ← lt_top_iff_ne_top]
      have : f.weightedHomogeneousComponent w p * g.weightedHomogeneousComponent w q ≠ 0 := by
        simp only [ne_eq, mul_eq_zero]
        intro H
        rcases H with H | H <;>
        · refine weightedHomogeneousComponent_of_weightedOrder ?_ H
          simp only [ENat.natCast_toNat_eq_self, ne_eq, weightedOrder_eq_top_iff, p, q]
          rw [← ne_eq, ne_zero_iff_weightedOrder_finite w]
          exact ENat.natCast_toNat (ne_top_of_lt (by simpa))
      rw [← weightedHomogeneousComponent_mul_of_le_weightedOrder
          (le_of_eq hp) (le_of_eq hq)] at this
      rw [← hp, ← hq, ← Nat.cast_add, ← not_lt]
      intro H
      apply this
      apply weightedHomogeneousComponent_of_lt_weightedOrder_eq_zero H
    · rw [not_lt_top_iff] at hg
      simp [hg]
  · rw [not_lt_top_iff] at hf
    simp [hf]

name: weightedOrder_prod
statement:
theorem weightedOrder_prod {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] [Nontrivial R]
    {ι : Type*} (w : σ → ℕ) (f : ι → MvPowerSeries σ R) (s : Finset ι) :
    (∏ i ∈ s, f i).weightedOrder w = ∑ i ∈ s, (f i).weightedOrder w
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction with
  | empty => simp
  | cons a s ha ih => rw [Finset.sum_cons ha, Finset.prod_cons ha, weightedOrder_mul, ih]

name: order_mul
statement:
theorem order_mul (f g : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    (f * g).order = f.order + g.order
proof:
:=
  weightedOrder_mul _ f g

name: order_prod
statement:
theorem order_prod {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] [Nontrivial R]
    {ι : Type*} (f : ι → MvPowerSeries σ R) (s : Finset ι) :
    (∏ i ∈ s, f i).order = ∑ i ∈ s, (f i).order
proof: := weightedOrder_prod _ _ _

name: coeff_apply
statement: theorem coeff_apply (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) (d : σ →₀ ℕ) : coeff d f = f d
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem ext {φ ψ : MvPowerSeries σ R} (h : ∀ n : σ →₀ ℕ, coeff n φ = coeff n ψ) : φ = ψ
proof:
:=
  funext h

name: monomial_def
statement:
theorem monomial_def [DecidableEq σ] (n : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    monomial n = LinearMap.single R (fun _ ↦ R) n
proof:
:= by
  rw [monomial]
  
  convert! rfl

name: coeff_monomial
statement:
theorem coeff_monomial [DecidableEq σ] (m n : σ →₀ ℕ) (a : R) :
    coeff m (monomial n a) = if m = n then a else 0
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [coeff, MvPowerSeries]
  rw [monomial_def, LinearMap.proj_apply (i := m), LinearMap.single_apply, Pi.single_apply]

name: coeff_monomial_same
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_monomial_same (n : σ →₀ ℕ) (a : R) : coeff n (monomial n a) = a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [monomial_def]
  exact Pi.single_eq_same _ _

name: coeff_monomial_ne
statement: theorem coeff_monomial_ne {m n : σ →₀ ℕ} (h : m ≠ n) (a : R) : coeff m (monomial n a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [monomial_def]
  exact Pi.single_eq_of_ne h _

name: eq_of_coeff_monomial_ne_zero
statement:
theorem eq_of_coeff_monomial_ne_zero {m n : σ →₀ ℕ} {a : R} (h : coeff m (monomial n a) ≠ 0) :
    m = n
proof:
:=
  by_contra fun h' => h <| coeff_monomial_ne h' a

name: coeff_comp_monomial
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_comp_monomial (n : σ →₀ ℕ) : (coeff (R := R) n).comp (monomial n) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext <| coeff_monomial_same n

name: coeff_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_zero (n : σ →₀ ℕ) : coeff n (0 : MvPowerSeries σ R) = 0
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: eq_zero_iff_forall_coeff_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_iff_forall_coeff_zero {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} :
    f = 0 ↔ (∀ d : σ →₀ ℕ, coeff d f = 0)
proof:
:=
  MvPowerSeries.ext_iff

name: ne_zero_iff_exists_coeff_ne_zero
statement:
theorem ne_zero_iff_exists_coeff_ne_zero (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    f ≠ 0 ↔ (∃ d : σ →₀ ℕ, coeff d f ≠ 0)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [MvPowerSeries.ext_iff, ne_eq, coeff_zero, not_forall]

name: coeff_one
statement: theorem coeff_one [DecidableEq σ] : coeff n (1 : MvPowerSeries σ R) = if n = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:=
  coeff_monomial _ _ _

name: coeff_zero_one
statement: theorem coeff_zero_one : coeff (R := R) (0 : σ →₀ ℕ) 1 = 1
proof:
:=
  coeff_monomial_same 0 1

name: monomial_zero_one
statement: theorem monomial_zero_one : monomial (R := R) (0 : σ →₀ ℕ) 1 = 1
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: coeff_mul
statement:
theorem coeff_mul [DecidableEq σ] :
    coeff n (φ * ψ) = ∑ p ∈ antidiagonal n, coeff p.1 φ * coeff p.2 ψ
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.sum_congr ?_ fun _ _ => rfl
  rw [Subsingleton.elim (Classical.decEq σ) ‹DecidableEq σ›]

name: zero_mul
statement: protected theorem zero_mul : (0 : MvPowerSeries σ R) * φ = 0
proof:
:=
  ext fun n => by classical simp [coeff_mul]

name: mul_zero
statement: protected theorem mul_zero : φ * 0 = 0
proof:
:=
  ext fun n => by classical simp [coeff_mul]

name: coeff_monomial_mul
statement:
theorem coeff_monomial_mul (a : R) :
    coeff m (monomial n a * φ) = if n ≤ m then a * coeff (m - n) φ else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have :
    ∀ p ∈ antidiagonal m,
      coeff (p : (σ →₀ ℕ) × (σ →₀ ℕ)).1 (monomial n a) * coeff p.2 φ ≠ 0 → p.1 = n :=
    fun p _ hp => eq_of_coeff_monomial_ne_zero (left_ne_zero_of_mul hp)
  rw [coeff_mul, ← Finset.sum_filter_of_ne this, Finset.HasAntidiagonal.filter_fst_eq_antidiagonal
    _ n, Finset.sum_ite_index]
  simp only [Finset.sum_singleton, coeff_monomial_same, Finset.sum_empty]

name: coeff_mul_monomial
statement:
theorem coeff_mul_monomial (a : R) :
    coeff m (φ * monomial n a) = if n ≤ m then coeff (m - n) φ * a else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have :
    ∀ p ∈ antidiagonal m,
      coeff (p : (σ →₀ ℕ) × (σ →₀ ℕ)).1 φ * coeff p.2 (monomial n a) ≠ 0 → p.2 = n :=
    fun p _ hp => eq_of_coeff_monomial_ne_zero (right_ne_zero_of_mul hp)
  rw [coeff_mul, ← Finset.sum_filter_of_ne this, Finset.HasAntidiagonal.filter_snd_eq_antidiagonal
    _ n, Finset.sum_ite_index]
  simp only [Finset.sum_singleton, coeff_monomial_same, Finset.sum_empty]

name: coeff_add_monomial_mul
statement:
theorem coeff_add_monomial_mul (a : R) :
    coeff (m + n) (monomial m a * φ) = a * coeff n φ
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_monomial_mul, ite_eq_left, add_tsub_cancel_left]
  exact le_add_right le_rfl

name: coeff_add_mul_monomial
statement:
theorem coeff_add_mul_monomial (a : R) :
    coeff (m + n) (φ * monomial n a) = coeff m φ * a
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_mul_monomial, ite_eq_left, add_tsub_cancel_right]
  exact le_add_left le_rfl

name: commute_monomial
statement:
@[simp]
theorem commute_monomial {a : R} {n} :
    Commute φ (monomial n a) ↔ ∀ m, Commute (coeff m φ) a
proof:
:= by
  rw [commute_iff_eq, MvPowerSeries.ext_iff]
  refine ⟨fun h m => ?_, fun h m => ?_⟩
  · have := h (m + n)
    rwa [coeff_add_mul_monomial, add_comm, coeff_add_monomial_mul] at this
  · rw [coeff_mul_monomial, coeff_monomial_mul]
    split_ifs <;> [apply h; rfl]

name: one_mul
statement: protected theorem one_mul : (1 : MvPowerSeries σ R) * φ = φ
proof:
:=
  ext fun n => by simpa using! coeff_add_monomial_mul 0 n φ 1

name: mul_one
statement: protected theorem mul_one : φ * 1 = φ
proof:
:=
  ext fun n => by simpa using! coeff_add_mul_monomial n 0 φ 1

name: mul_add
statement: protected theorem mul_add (φ₁ φ₂ φ₃ : MvPowerSeries σ R) : φ₁ * (φ₂ + φ₃) = φ₁ * φ₂ + φ₁ * φ₃
proof:
:=
  ext fun n => by
    classical simp only [coeff_mul, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib, map_add]

name: add_mul
statement: protected theorem add_mul (φ₁ φ₂ φ₃ : MvPowerSeries σ R) : (φ₁ + φ₂) * φ₃ = φ₁ * φ₃ + φ₂ * φ₃
proof:
:=
  ext fun n => by
    classical simp only [coeff_mul, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, map_add]

name: mul_assoc
statement: protected theorem mul_assoc (φ₁ φ₂ φ₃ : MvPowerSeries σ R) : φ₁ * φ₂ * φ₃ = φ₁ * (φ₂ * φ₃)
proof:
:= by
  ext1 n
  classical
  simp only [coeff_mul, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_sigma']
  apply Finset.sum_nbij' (fun ⟨⟨_i, j⟩, ⟨k, l⟩⟩ ↦ ⟨(k, l + j), (l, j)⟩)
    (fun ⟨⟨i, _j⟩, ⟨k, l⟩⟩ ↦ ⟨(i + k, l), (i, k)⟩) <;> aesop (add simp [add_assoc, mul_assoc])

name: monomial_mul_monomial
statement:
theorem monomial_mul_monomial (m n : σ →₀ ℕ) (a b : R) :
    monomial m a * monomial n b = monomial (m + n) (a * b)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext k
  simp only [coeff_mul_monomial, coeff_monomial]
  split_ifs with h₁ h₂ h₃ h₃ h₂ <;> try rfl
  · rw [← h₂, tsub_add_cancel_of_le h₁] at h₃
    exact (h₃ rfl).elim
  · rw [h₃, add_tsub_cancel_right] at h₂
    exact (h₂ rfl).elim
  · exact zero_mul b
  · rw [h₂] at h₁
    exact (h₁ <| le_add_left le_rfl).elim

name: monomial_zero_eq_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem monomial_zero_eq_C : ⇑(monomial (R := R) (0 : σ →₀ ℕ)) = C
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: monomial_zero_eq_C_apply
statement: theorem monomial_zero_eq_C_apply (a : R) : monomial (0 : σ →₀ ℕ) a = C a
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: coeff_C
statement:
theorem coeff_C [DecidableEq σ] (n : σ →₀ ℕ) (a : R) :
    coeff n (C a) = if n = 0 then a else 0
proof:
:=
  coeff_monomial _ _ _

name: coeff_zero_C
statement: theorem coeff_zero_C (a : R) : coeff (0 : σ →₀ ℕ) (C a) = a
proof:
:=
  coeff_monomial_same 0 a

name: coeff_C_of_ne_zero
statement: theorem coeff_C_of_ne_zero {n : σ →₀ ℕ} (h : n ≠ 0) (a : R) : coeff n (C a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical rw [coeff_C, ite_eq_right h]

name: coeff_add_single_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_add_single_C {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] {n : σ →₀ ℕ} (a : R) (i : σ) :
    coeff (n + single i m) (C a) = 0
proof:
:=
  coeff_C_of_ne_zero (fun H ↦ by simpa [NeZero.ne] using congr($(H) i)) a

name: C_injective
statement:
@[grind inj]
theorem C_injective : Function.Injective (C : R → MvPowerSeries σ R)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b h
  rw [← coeff_zero_C a, h, coeff_zero_C]

name: C_surjective
statement: theorem C_surjective [IsEmpty σ] : Function.Surjective (C : R → MvPowerSeries σ R)
proof:
:=
  fun p => ⟨p 0, by ext n; simpa [coeff_C, Subsingleton.eq_zero n] using! coeff_apply _ _⟩

name: C_inj
statement: @[simp] theorem C_inj (r s : R) : (C r : MvPowerSeries σ R) = C s ↔ r = s
proof: := (C_injective).eq_iff

name: coeff_X
statement:
theorem coeff_X [DecidableEq σ] (n : σ →₀ ℕ) (s : σ) :
    coeff n (X s : MvPowerSeries σ R) = if n = single s 1 then 1 else 0
proof:
:=
  coeff_monomial _ _ _

name: coeff_index_single_X
statement:
theorem coeff_index_single_X [DecidableEq σ] (s t : σ) :
    coeff (single t 1) (X s : MvPowerSeries σ R) = if t = s then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coeff_X, single_left_inj (one_ne_zero : (1 : ℕ) ≠ 0)]

name: coeff_index_single_self_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_index_single_self_X (s : σ) : coeff (single s 1) (X s : MvPowerSeries σ R) = 1
proof:
:=
  coeff_monomial_same _ _

name: coeff_zero_X
statement: theorem coeff_zero_X (s : σ) : coeff (0 : σ →₀ ℕ) (X s : MvPowerSeries σ R) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [coeff_X, ite_eq_right]
  intro h
  exact one_ne_zero (single_eq_zero.mp h.symm)

name: commute_X
statement: theorem commute_X (φ : MvPowerSeries σ R) (s : σ) : Commute φ (X s)
proof:
:=
  φ.commute_monomial.mpr fun _m => Commute.one_right _

name: X_mul
statement: theorem X_mul {φ : MvPowerSeries σ R} {s : σ} : X s * φ = φ * X s
proof:
:=
  φ.commute_X s |>.symm.eq

name: commute_X_pow
statement: theorem commute_X_pow (φ : MvPowerSeries σ R) (s : σ) (n : ℕ) : Commute φ (X s ^ n)
proof:
:=
  φ.commute_X s |>.pow_right _

name: X_pow_mul
statement: theorem X_pow_mul {φ : MvPowerSeries σ R} {s : σ} {n : ℕ} : X s ^ n * φ = φ * X s ^ n
proof:
:=
  φ.commute_X_pow s n |>.symm.eq

name: X_def
statement: theorem X_def (s : σ) : X s = monomial (single s 1) (1 : R)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: X_pow_eq
statement: theorem X_pow_eq (s : σ) (n : ℕ) : (X s : MvPowerSeries σ R) ^ n = monomial (single s n) 1
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ, ih, Finsupp.single_add, X, monomial_mul_monomial, one_mul]

name: coeff_X_pow
statement:
theorem coeff_X_pow [DecidableEq σ] (m : σ →₀ ℕ) (s : σ) (n : ℕ) :
    coeff m ((X s : MvPowerSeries σ R) ^ n) = if m = single s n then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [X_pow_eq s n, coeff_monomial]

name: coeff_mul_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_mul_C (n : σ →₀ ℕ) (φ : MvPowerSeries σ R) (a : R) :

name: X_pow_dvd_iff
statement:
theorem X_pow_dvd_iff {s : σ} {n : ℕ} {φ : MvPowerSeries σ R} :
    (X s : MvPowerSeries σ R) ^ n ∣ φ ↔ ∀ m : σ →₀ ℕ, m s < n → coeff m φ = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨φ, rfl⟩ m h
    rw [coeff_mul, Finset.sum_eq_zero]
    rintro ⟨i, j⟩ hij
    rw [coeff_X_pow, ite_eq_right, zero_mul]
    contrapose! h
    dsimp at h
    subst i
    rw [mem_antidiagonal] at hij
    rw [← hij, Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_same]
    exact Nat.le_add_right n _
  · intro h
    refine ⟨fun m => coeff (m + single s n) φ, ?_⟩
    ext m
    by_cases H : m - single s n + single s n = m
    · rw [coeff_mul, Finset.sum_eq_single (single s n, m - single s n)]
      · rw [coeff_X_pow, ite_eq_left rfl, one_mul]
        simpa using! congr_arg (fun m : σ →₀ ℕ => coeff m φ) H.symm
      · rintro ⟨i, j⟩ hij hne
        rw [mem_antidiagonal] at hij
        rw [coeff_X_pow]
        split_ifs with hi
        · exfalso
          apply hne
          rw [← hij, ← hi, Prod.mk_inj]
          refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
          ext t
          simp only [add_tsub_cancel_left]
        · exact zero_mul _
      · intro hni
        exfalso
        apply hni
        rwa [mem_antidiagonal, add_comm]
    · rw [h, coeff_mul, Finset.sum_eq_zero]
      · rintro ⟨i, j⟩ hij
        rw [mem_antidiagonal] at hij
        rw [coeff_X_pow]
        split_ifs with hi
        · exfalso
          apply H
          rw [← hij, hi]
          ext
          rw [coe_add, coe_add, Pi.add_apply, Pi.add_apply, add_tsub_cancel_left, add_comm]
        · exact zero_mul _
      · contrapose! H
        ext t
        by_cases hst : s = t
        · subst t
          simpa using! tsub_add_cancel_of_le H
        · simp [hst]

name: X_dvd_iff
statement:
theorem X_dvd_iff {s : σ} {φ : MvPowerSeries σ R} :
    (X s : MvPowerSeries σ R) ∣ φ ↔ ∀ m : σ →₀ ℕ, m s = 0 → coeff m φ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pow_one (X s : MvPowerSeries σ R), X_pow_dvd_iff]
  constructor <;> intro h m hm
  · exact h m (hm.symm ▸ zero_lt_one)
  · exact h m (Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero <| Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hm)

name: coeff_prod
statement:
theorem coeff_prod [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq σ]
    (f : ι → MvPowerSeries σ R) (d : σ →₀ ℕ) (s : Finset ι) :
    coeff d (∏ j ∈ s, f j) =
      ∑ l ∈ finsuppAntidiag s d,
        ∏ i ∈ s, coeff (l i) (f i)
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.induction_on generalizing d with
  | empty =>
    simp only [prod_empty, sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one, coeff_one, finsuppAntidiag_empty]
    split_ifs
    · simp only [card_singleton, Nat.cast_one]
    · simp only [card_empty, Nat.cast_zero]
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    rw [finsuppAntidiag_insert ha, prod_insert ha, coeff_mul, sum_biUnion]
    · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      simp only [mem_antidiagonal, sum_map, Function.Embedding.coeFn_mk, coe_update, Prod.forall]
      rintro u v rfl
      rw [ih, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_attach]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      simp only [mem_attach, Finset.prod_insert ha, Function.update_self, forall_true_left,
        Subtype.forall]
      rintro x -
      rw [Finset.prod_congr rfl]
      intro i hi
      rw [Function.update_of_ne]
      exact ne_of_mem_of_not_mem hi ha
    · simp only [Set.PairwiseDisjoint, Set.Pairwise, mem_coe, mem_antidiagonal, ne_eq,
        disjoint_left, mem_map, mem_attach, Function.Embedding.coeFn_mk, true_and, Subtype.exists,
        exists_prop, not_exists, not_and, forall_exists_index, and_imp, forall_apply_eq_imp_iff₂,
        Prod.forall, Prod.mk.injEq]
      rintro u v rfl u' v' huv h k - l - hkl
      obtain rfl : u' = u := by
        simpa only [Finsupp.coe_update, Function.update_self] using DFunLike.congr_fun hkl a
      simp only [add_right_inj] at huv
      exact h rfl huv.symm

name: prod_monomial
statement:
theorem prod_monomial (f : ι → σ →₀ ℕ) (g : ι → R) (s : Finset ι) :
    ∏ i ∈ s, monomial (f i) (g i) = monomial (∑ i ∈ s, f i) (∏ i ∈ s, g i)
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction with
  | empty => simp
  | cons a s ha h => simp [h, monomial_mul_monomial]

name: coeff_pow
statement:
theorem coeff_pow [DecidableEq σ] (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) {n : ℕ} (d : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    coeff d (f ^ n) =
      ∑ l ∈ finsuppAntidiag (Finset.range n) d,
        ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, coeff (l i) f
proof:
:= by
  suffices f ^ n = (Finset.range n).prod fun _ ↦ f by
    rw [this, coeff_prod]
  rw [Finset.prod_const, card_range]

name: monomial_pow
statement:
theorem monomial_pow (m : σ →₀ ℕ) (a : R) (n : ℕ) :
    (monomial m a) ^ n = monomial (n • m) (a ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.pow_eq_prod_const, prod_monomial, ← Finset.nsmul_eq_sum_const,
    ← Finset.pow_eq_prod_const]

name: coeff_eq_zero_of_constantCoeff_nilpotent
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [coeff_pow]
  apply sum_eq_zero
  intro k hk
  rw [mem_finsuppAntidiag] at hk
  set s := {i ∈ range n | k i = 0} with hs_def
  have hs : s ⊆ range n := filter_subset _ _
  have hs' (i : ℕ) (hi : i ∈ s) : coeff (k i) f = constantCoeff f := by
    simp only [hs_def, mem_filter] at hi
    rw [hi.2, coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff]
  have hs'' (i : ℕ) (hi : i ∈ s) : k i = 0 := by
    simp only [hs_def, mem_filter] at hi
    rw [hi.2]
  rw [← prod_sdiff (s₁ := s) (filter_subset _ _)]
  apply mul_eq_zero_of_right
  rw [prod_congr rfl hs', prod_const]
  suffices m ≤ #s by
    obtain ⟨m', hm'⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le this
    rw [hm', pow_add, hf, zero_mul]
  rw [← Nat.add_le_add_iff_right, add_comm #s,
    Finset.card_sdiff_add_card_eq_card (filter_subset _ _), card_range]
  apply le_trans _ hn
  simp only [add_comm m, Nat.add_le_add_iff_right, ← hk.1,
    ← sum_sdiff (hs), sum_eq_zero (s := s) hs'', add_zero]
  rw [← hs_def]
  convert! Finset.card_nsmul_le_sum (range n \ s) (fun x ↦ degree (k x)) 1 _
  · simp only [smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  · simp only [degree_eq_weight_one, map_sum]
  · simp only [hs_def, mem_filter, mem_sdiff, mem_range, not_and, and_imp]
    intro i hi hi'
    rw [← not_lt, Nat.lt_one_iff, degree_eq_zero_iff]
    exact hi' hi

name: _root_.MvPowerSeries.prod_smul_X_eq_smul_monomial_one
statement:
theorem _root_.MvPowerSeries.prod_smul_X_eq_smul_monomial_one
    {A : Type*} [CommSemiring A] [Algebra A R] (e : σ →₀ ℕ) (a : σ → A) :
    e.prod (fun s n ↦ ((a s • MvPowerSeries.X s) ^ n))
      = (e.prod fun s n ↦ (a s) ^ n) • MvPowerSeries.monomial (R := R) e 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finsupp.prod_congr
    (g2 := fun s n ↦ ((MvPowerSeries.C (algebraMap A R (a s)) * (MvPowerSeries.X s)) ^ n))]
  · have (a : A) (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) : a • f =
      MvPowerSeries.C ((algebraMap A R) a) * f := by
      rw [← MvPowerSeries.smul_eq_C_mul, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul]
    simp only [mul_pow, Finsupp.prod_mul, ← map_pow, ← MvPowerSeries.monomial_one_eq, this]
    simp only [map_finsuppProd, map_pow]
  · intro x _
    rw [algebra_compatible_smul R, MvPowerSeries.smul_eq_C_mul]

statement:
theorem coeff_pderivFun {i : σ} (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) (d : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    coeff d (f.pderivFun i) = coeff (d + single i 1) f * (d i + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: pderivFun_add
statement:
theorem pderivFun_add {i : σ} (f g : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    pderivFun i (f + g) = pderivFun i f + pderivFun i g
proof:
:= by
  ext
  rw [coeff_pderivFun, map_add, map_add, coeff_pderivFun, coeff_pderivFun, add_mul]

name: pderivFun_C
statement: theorem pderivFun_C {i : σ} (r : R) : pderivFun i (C r) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [coeff_pderivFun, coeff_add_single_C, zero_mul, (coeff n).map_zero]

name: pderivFun_one
statement: theorem pderivFun_one {i : σ} : pderivFun i (1 : MvPowerSeries σ R) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_one C, pderivFun_C (1 : R)]

name: pderivFun_coe
statement:
private theorem pderivFun_coe {i : σ} (f : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    (f : MvPowerSeries σ R).pderivFun i = f.pderiv i
proof:
:= by
  ext
  rw [coeff_pderivFun, coeff_coe, coeff_coe, coeff_pderiv]

name: trunc_pderivFun
statement:
private theorem trunc_pderivFun [DecidableEq σ] {i : σ} (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) (n : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    trunc R n (pderivFun i f) = pderiv i (trunc R (n + single i 1) f)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  rw [coeff_trunc]
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [coeff_pderivFun, coeff_pderiv, coeff_trunc, ite_eq_left (add_lt_add_left h _)]
  · rw [coeff_pderiv, coeff_trunc, ite_eq_right ((add_lt_add_iff_right _).not.mpr h), zero_mul]

name: pderivFun_coe_mul_coe
statement:
private theorem pderivFun_coe_mul_coe {i : σ} (f g : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    pderivFun i (f * g : MvPowerSeries σ R) = f * pderiv i g + g * pderiv i f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coe_mul, pderivFun_coe, pderiv_mul, add_comm, mul_comm _ g, ← coe_mul, ← coe_mul,
    MvPolynomial.coe_add]

name: pderivFun_mul
statement:
private theorem pderivFun_mul {i : σ} (f g : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    pderivFun i (f * g) = f • g.pderivFun i + g • f.pderivFun i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext n
  have h₁ : n < n + single i 1 := lt_def.mpr ⟨self_le_add_right _ _, i, by simp⟩
  have h₂ : n + single i 1 < n + single i 1 + single i 1 :=
    lt_def.mpr ⟨self_le_add_right _ _, i, by simp⟩
  have h₃ : n < n + single i 1 + single i 1 := lt_trans h₁ h₂
  rw [coeff_pderivFun, map_add, ← coeff_trunc_mul_trunc_eq_coeff_mul _ _ _ h₂, smul_eq_mul,
    smul_eq_mul, ← coeff_trunc_mul_trunc_eq_coeff_mul₂ _ _ g (f.pderivFun i) h₃ h₁,
    ← coeff_trunc_mul_trunc_eq_coeff_mul₂ _ _ f (g.pderivFun i) h₃ h₁, trunc_pderivFun,
    trunc_pderivFun, ← coeff_coe, ← coeff_coe, ← coeff_coe, ← map_add, coe_mul, coe_mul, coe_mul,
    ← pderivFun_coe_mul_coe, coeff_pderivFun]

name: pderivFun_smul
statement:
private theorem pderivFun_smul {i : σ} (r : R) (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    pderivFun i (r • f) = r • pderivFun i f
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_eq_C_mul, smul_eq_C_mul, pderivFun_mul, pderivFun_C, smul_zero, add_zero, smul_eq_mul]

name: pderiv_C
statement: @[simp] theorem pderiv_C {i : σ} {r : R} : pderiv i (C r) = 0
proof: := pderivFun_C r

name: pderiv_one
statement: theorem pderiv_one {i : σ} : pderiv i (1 : MvPowerSeries σ R) = 0
proof: := pderiv_C

name: coeff_pderiv
statement:
theorem coeff_pderiv {i : σ} (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) (n : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    coeff n (pderiv i f) = coeff (n + single i 1) f * (n i + 1)
proof:
:=
  coeff_pderivFun f n

name: pderiv_coe
statement:
theorem pderiv_coe {i : σ} (f : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    pderiv i (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) = MvPolynomial.pderiv i f
proof: := pderivFun_coe f

name: pderiv_X_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pderiv_X_self {i : σ} : pderiv i (X i) = (1 : MvPowerSeries σ R)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext n
  simp only [coeff_pderiv, coeff_X, boole_mul, add_eq_right, coeff_one]
  split_ifs <;> simp_all

name: pderiv_X_of_ne
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pderiv_X_of_ne {i j : σ} (h : j ≠ i) : pderiv i (X j) = (0 : MvPowerSeries σ R)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext n
  simpa only [coeff_pderiv, coeff_X, boole_mul, coeff_zero] using
    ite_eq_right (ne_iff.mpr ⟨i, by grind [Finsupp.add_apply]⟩)

name: pderiv_X
statement:
theorem pderiv_X [DecidableEq σ] (i j : σ) :
    pderiv i (X j) = Pi.single (M := fun _ => MvPowerSeries σ R) i 1 j
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : i = j
  · subst h; simp only [pderiv_X_self, Pi.single_eq_same]
  · grind [pderiv_X_of_ne]

name: trunc_pderiv
statement:
theorem trunc_pderiv [DecidableEq σ] {i : σ} (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) (n : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    trunc R n (pderiv i f) = MvPolynomial.pderiv i (trunc R (n + single i 1) f)
proof:
:=
  trunc_pderivFun ..

name: pderiv_pow
statement:
theorem pderiv_pow {i : σ} (g : MvPowerSeries σ R) (n : ℕ) :
    pderiv i (g ^ n) = n * g ^ (n - 1) * pderiv i g
proof:
:= by
  rw [Derivation.leibniz_pow, smul_eq_mul, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_assoc]

name: pderiv.ext
statement:
theorem pderiv.ext [CommRing R] [IsAddTorsionFree R] {f g : MvPowerSeries σ R}
    (hD : ∀ i, pderiv i f = pderiv i g) (hc : constantCoeff f = constantCoeff g) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  by_cases h : n = 0
  · rw [h, coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff, hc]
  obtain ⟨i, hi : n i ≠ 0⟩ := ne_iff.mp h
  have : single i 1 ≤ n := fun j ↦ by
    by_cases hj : j = i <;> grind [single_eq_same, single_eq_of_ne]
  have e := congr(coeff (n - single i 1) $(hD i))
  rwa [coeff_pderiv, coeff_pderiv, tsub_add_cancel_of_le this, coe_tsub, Pi.sub_apply,
    single_eq_same, Nat.cast_sub (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hi), Nat.cast_one, sub_add_cancel,
    mul_comm, ← nsmul_eq_mul, mul_comm, ← nsmul_eq_mul, smul_right_inj hi] at e

name: pderiv_inv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pderiv_inv {i : σ} [CommRing R] (f : (MvPowerSeries σ R)ˣ) :
    pderiv i ↑f⁻¹ = -(↑f⁻¹ : MvPowerSeries σ R) ^ 2 * pderiv i f
proof:
:=
  (pderiv i).leibniz_of_mul_eq_one f.inv_mul

name: pderiv_invOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pderiv_invOf {i : σ} [CommRing R] (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) [Invertible f] :
    pderiv i ⅟f = -⅟f ^ 2 * pderiv i f
proof:
:=
  (pderiv i).leibniz_invOf f

name: pderiv_inv'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pderiv_inv' {i : σ} [Field R] (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    pderiv i f⁻¹ = -f⁻¹ ^ 2 * pderiv i f
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : constantCoeff f = 0
  · suffices f⁻¹ = 0 by
      rw [this, pow_two, zero_mul, neg_zero, zero_mul, map_zero]
    rwa [MvPowerSeries.inv_eq_zero]
  apply Derivation.leibniz_of_mul_eq_one
  exact MvPowerSeries.inv_mul_cancel (h := h)

name: coeff_mem_of_mem_map_C
statement: theorem coeff_mem_of_mem_map_C (h : p ∈ I.map C) : ∀ m : σ →₀ ℕ, p.coeff m ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine Submodule.span_induction (fun f hf n => ?_) ?_ ?_ (fun f g _ hg n => ?_) h
  · obtain ⟨x, _, hx⟩ := (Set.mem_image _ _ _).mp hf
    rw [← hx, coeff_C]
    by_cases h : n = 0
    <;> simp_all
  · simp
  · exact fun f g _ _ hf hg n => by simp [I.add_mem (hf n) (hg n)]
  · exact I.sum_mem fun c _ => I.mul_mem_left (f.coeff c.fst) (hg c.snd)

name: mem_map_C_of_forall_coeff_mem
statement:
theorem mem_map_C_of_forall_coeff_mem (hI : I.FG) (hf : ∀ m : σ →₀ ℕ, p.coeff m ∈ I) :
    p ∈ I.map C
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := hI
  have (m : σ →₀ ℕ) : ∃ r : S → R, p.coeff m = ∑ a ∈ S.attach, r a * a := by
    have h_mem : p.coeff m ∈ Submodule.span R (Set.range (fun a : S => a.val)) := by
      convert hf m using 1
      simp [hS]
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Finsupp.mem_span_range_iff_exists_finsupp.mp h_mem
    exact ⟨c, by simp_all [Finsupp.sum_fintype]⟩
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g : S → MvPowerSeries σ R,
      ∀ m, p.coeff m = ∑ a ∈ S.attach, (g a).coeff m * a.val := by
    choose r hr using this
    exact ⟨fun a m => r m a, hr⟩
  have h_sum : p = ∑ a ∈ S.attach, g a * C a.val := by
    simp [MvPowerSeries.ext_iff, hg]
  rw [← hS, h_sum]
  exact sum_mem _ fun a _ => mul_mem_left _ _ (mem_map_of_mem _ (subset_span a.2))

name: mem_map_C_iff_of_fg
statement:
theorem mem_map_C_iff_of_fg (hI : I.FG) :
    p ∈ I.map C ↔ ∀ m, p.coeff m ∈ I
proof:
:=
  ⟨coeff_mem_of_mem_map_C, mem_map_C_of_forall_coeff_mem hI⟩

name: ker_map_of_fg
statement:
theorem ker_map_of_fg (f : R →+* S) (hf : (RingHom.ker f).FG) :
    RingHom.ker (map f (σ := σ)) = Ideal.map C (RingHom.ker f)
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp [mem_map_C_iff_of_fg hf, MvPowerSeries.ext_iff]

name: ker_mapAlgHom_of_fg
statement:
lemma ker_mapAlgHom_of_fg (f : S₁ →ₐ[R] S₂) (hf : (RingHom.ker f).FG) :
    RingHom.ker (mapAlgHom (σ := σ) f) = Ideal.map C (RingHom.ker f)
proof:
:=
  ker_map_of_fg f.toRingHom hf

name: gaussNorm_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gaussNorm_zero (vZero : v 0 = 0) : gaussNorm v c 0 = 0
proof: := by simp [gaussNorm, vZero]

name: le_gaussNorm
statement:
lemma le_gaussNorm (hbd : HasGaussNorm v c f) (t : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    v (coeff t f) * t.prod (c · ^ ·) ≤ gaussNorm v c f
proof:
:= by
  apply le_ciSup hbd

name: gaussNorm_nonneg
statement: lemma gaussNorm_nonneg (vNonneg : ∀ a, v a ≥ 0) : 0 ≤ gaussNorm v c f
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaussNorm]
  by_cases h : HasGaussNorm v c f
  · trans v (constantCoeff f)
    · simp [vNonneg]
    · convert! (le_gaussNorm v c f h 0)
      simp
  · simp [h]

name: gaussNorm_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma gaussNorm_eq_zero_iff (vZero : v 0 = 0) (vNonneg : ∀ a, v a ≥ 0)
    (h_eq_zero : ∀ x : R, v x = 0 → x = 0) (hc : ∀ i, 0 < c i) (hbd : HasGaussNorm v c f) :
    gaussNorm v c f = 0 ↔ f = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun hf ↦ by simp [hf, vZero]⟩
  contrapose!
  intro hf
  apply ne_of_gt
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (MvPowerSeries.ne_zero_iff_exists_coeff_ne_zero f).mp hf
  calc
  0 < v (f.coeff n) * ∏ i ∈ n.support, (c i) ^ (n i) := by
    apply mul_pos _ (by exact Finset.prod_pos fun i a ↦ (fun i ↦ pow_pos (hc i) (n i)) i)
    specialize h_eq_zero (f.coeff n)
    grind
  _ ≤ _ := le_gaussNorm v c f hbd n

name: gaussNorm_add_le_max
statement:
lemma gaussNorm_add_le_max (f g : MvPowerSeries σ R) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (vNonneg : ∀ a, v a ≥ 0) (hv : IsNonarchimedean v)
    (hbfd : HasGaussNorm v c f) (hbgd : HasGaussNorm v c g) :
    gaussNorm v c (f + g) ≤ max (gaussNorm v c f) (gaussNorm v c g)
proof:
:= by
  have H (t : σ →₀ ℕ) : 0 ≤ ∏ i ∈ t.support, c i ^ t i :=
    Finset.prod_nonneg (fun i hi ↦ pow_nonneg (hc i) (t i))
  have Final (t : σ →₀ ℕ) : v ((coeff t) (f + g)) * ∏ i ∈ t.support, c ↑i ^ t ↑i ≤
      max (v ((coeff t) f) * ∏ i ∈ t.support, c ↑i ^ t ↑i)
      (v ((coeff t) g) * ∏ i ∈ t.support, c ↑i ^ t ↑i) := by
    specialize hv (coeff t f) (coeff t g)
    rcases max_choice (v ((coeff t) f)) (v ((coeff t) g)) with h | h
    · have : max (v ((coeff t) f) * ∏ i ∈ t.support, c ↑i ^ t ↑i)
          (v ((coeff t) g) * ∏ i ∈ t.support, c ↑i ^ t ↑i) =
          (v ((coeff t) f) * ∏ i ∈ t.support, c ↑i ^ t ↑i) := by
        simp only [sup_eq_left]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg (by aesop) (by aesop) (by aesop) (H t)
      simp_rw [this]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg (by aesop) (by aesop) (by aesop) (H t)
    · have : max (v ((coeff t) f) * ∏ i ∈ t.support, c ↑i ^ t ↑i)
          (v ((coeff t) g) * ∏ i ∈ t.support, c ↑i ^ t ↑i) =
          (v ((coeff t) g) * ∏ i ∈ t.support, c ↑i ^ t ↑i) := by
        simp only [sup_eq_right]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg (by aesop) (by aesop) (by aesop) (H t)
      simp_rw [this]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg (by aesop) (by aesop) (by aesop) (H t)
  refine Real.iSup_le ?_ ?_
  · refine fun t ↦ calc
    _ ≤ _ := Final t
    _ ≤ max (gaussNorm v c f) (gaussNorm v c g) := by
      simp only [le_sup_iff]
      rcases max_choice (v ((coeff t) f) * ∏ i ∈ t.support, c i ^ t i)
        (v ((coeff t) g) * ∏ i ∈ t.support, c i ^ t i) with h | h
      · left
        simpa [h] using! le_gaussNorm v c f hbfd t
      · right
        simpa [h] using! le_gaussNorm v c g hbgd t
  · simp only [le_sup_iff]
    left
    exact gaussNorm_nonneg v c f vNonneg

name: c_prod_nonneg
statement: private lemma c_prod_nonneg (hc : 0 ≤ c) (t : σ →₀ ℕ) : 0 ≤ t.prod (c · ^ ·)
proof:
:=
  Finset.prod_nonneg (fun i _ ↦ pow_nonneg (hc i) (t i))

name: gaussNorm_mul_le
statement:
lemma gaussNorm_mul_le (f g : MvPowerSeries σ R) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (vNonneg : ∀ a, v a ≥ 0)
    (vMul : ∀ a b, v (a * b) ≤ v a * v b) (vna : IsNonarchimedean v)
    (vZero : v 0 = 0) (hbfd : HasGaussNorm v c f) (hbgd : HasGaussNorm v c g) :
    gaussNorm v c (f * g) ≤ gaussNorm v c f * gaussNorm v c g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine Real.iSup_le ?_ ?_
  · intro t
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hsum⟩ := vna.finset_image_add _ (Finset.antidiagonal t)
      (fun x ↦ vZero.le.trans (vNonneg x))
    have hk' : k.1 + k.2 = t := by
      simpa [Finset.mem_antidiagonal] using hk (Finset.nonempty_def.mpr ⟨(t, 0), by simp⟩)
    have hprod : t.prod (c · ^ ·) = k.1.prod (c · ^ ·) * k.2.prod (c · ^ ·) := by
      simp [← hk', Finsupp.prod_add_index' (h := (c · ^ ·)) (by grind) (by grind)]
    rw [hprod]
    refine (mul_le_mul hsum (by rfl) (mul_nonneg (c_prod_nonneg c hc k.1) (c_prod_nonneg c hc k.2))
      (vNonneg _)).trans ?_
    have : v ((coeff k.1) f * (coeff k.2) g) * (k.1.prod (c · ^ ·) * k.2.prod (c · ^ ·)) ≤
        (v (coeff k.1 f) * k.1.prod (c · ^ ·)) * (v (coeff k.2 g) * k.2.prod (c · ^ ·)) := by
      calc
      _ ≤ v (coeff k.1 f) * v (coeff k.2 g) * (k.1.prod (c · ^ ·) * k.2.prod (c · ^ ·)) :=
        mul_le_mul (vMul _ _) (by rfl) (mul_nonneg (c_prod_nonneg c hc k.1)
          (c_prod_nonneg c hc k.2)) (mul_nonneg (vNonneg _) (vNonneg _))
      _ = _ := by ring
    exact this.trans (mul_le_mul (le_gaussNorm v c f hbfd k.1) (le_gaussNorm v c g hbgd k.2)
      (mul_nonneg (vNonneg _) (c_prod_nonneg c hc k.2)) (gaussNorm_nonneg v c f vNonneg))
  · exact mul_nonneg (gaussNorm_nonneg v c f vNonneg) (gaussNorm_nonneg v c g vNonneg)

name: gaussNorm_neg
statement:
lemma gaussNorm_neg (vNeg : ∀ x, v (-x) = v x) (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    gaussNorm v c (-f) = gaussNorm v c f
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [gaussNorm]
  have (t : σ →₀ ℕ) : (coeff t) (-f) = - (coeff t) f := by rfl
  simp_rw [this, vNeg]

name: ultrametric_strict
statement:
lemma ultrametric_strict (na : IsNonarchimedean f)
    (Neg : ∀ a, f a = f (-a)) {a b : α} (hne : f a ≠ f b) : f (a + b) = max (f a) (f b)
proof:
:= by
  wlog hab : f a > f b generalizing a b with H
  · simpa [add_comm, max_comm] using (H hne.symm ((not_lt.mp hab).lt_of_ne hne))
  apply le_antisymm (na a b)
  rcases le_max_iff.mp (na (a + b) (-b)) with h | h
  · simpa [max_eq_left (le_of_lt hab)] using h
  · exact absurd h (not_le.mpr (by simpa [Neg b] using hab))

name: Finset.Nonempty.map_sum_le_sup'_map
statement:
lemma Finset.Nonempty.map_sum_le_sup'_map
    {α S : Type*} [LinearOrder S] [AddCommMonoid α] (g : α → S)
    {ι : Type*} {s : Finset ι} (hs : s.Nonempty) (f : ι → α)
    (na : ∀ a b, g (a + b) ≤ max (g a) (g b)) :
    g (∑ i ∈ s, f i) ≤ s.sup' hs fun x ↦ g (f x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Finset.le_sup'_iff]
  induction hs using Finset.Nonempty.cons_induction with
  | singleton j => simp only [Finset.mem_singleton, Finset.sum_singleton, exists_eq_left, le_refl]
  | cons j s hj _ IH =>
      simp only [Finset.sum_cons, Finset.mem_cons, exists_eq_or_imp]
      refine (le_total (g (∑ i ∈ s, f i)) (g (f j))).imp ?_ ?_ <;> intro h
      · exact (na _ _).trans (max_eq_left h).le
      · exact ⟨_, IH.choose_spec.left, (na _ _).trans <|
          ((max_eq_right h).le.trans IH.choose_spec.right)⟩

name: antidiagonal_dominant
statement:
lemma antidiagonal_dominant (i j : σ →₀ ℕ) (vna : IsNonarchimedean v)
    (vMulEq : ∀ a b, v (a * b) = v a * v b) (vNeg : ∀ a, v a = v (-a))
    (hdom : ∀ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal (i + j), p ≠ (i, j) →
      v (coeff p.1 f * coeff p.2 g) < v (coeff i f) * v (coeff j g)) :
    v (coeff (i + j) (f * g))  = v (coeff i f * coeff j g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← vMulEq] at hdom
  rw [coeff_mul, vna.apply_sum_eq_of_lt _ (by grind) (s := Finset.antidiagonal (i + j))
    (Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mpr rfl) hdom]

name: gaussNorm_le_mul
statement:
lemma gaussNorm_le_mul (vMulEq : ∀ a b, v (a * b) = v a * v b)
    (vna : IsNonarchimedean v) (vNeg : ∀ a, v a = v (-a))
    (hbfg : HasGaussNorm v c (f * g))
    (hdom : ∃ i j, AchievesGaussNorm v c f i ∧ AchievesGaussNorm v c g j ∧
      ∀ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal (i + j), p ≠ (i, j) →
        v (coeff p.1 f * coeff p.2 g) < v (coeff i f) * v (coeff j g)) :
    gaussNorm v c f * gaussNorm v c g ≤ gaussNorm v c (f * g)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i₀, j₀, hi₀, hj₀, hdom'⟩ := hdom
  unfold AchievesGaussNorm at hi₀ hj₀
  calc
    _  = (v (coeff i₀ f) * i₀.prod (c · ^ ·)) * (v (coeff j₀ g) * j₀.prod (c · ^ ·)) := by
          rw [← hi₀, ← hj₀]
    _ = v (coeff i₀ f) * v (coeff j₀ g) * ((i₀ + j₀).prod (c · ^ ·)) := by
          have hprod : (i₀ + j₀).prod (c · ^ ·) = i₀.prod (c · ^ ·) * j₀.prod (c · ^ ·) := by
            simp [Finsupp.prod_add_index', pow_add]
          rw [hprod]; ring
    _ = v (coeff i₀ f * coeff j₀ g) * (i₀ + j₀).prod (c · ^ ·) := by rw [vMulEq]
    _ = v (coeff (i₀ + j₀) (f * g)) * (i₀ + j₀).prod (c · ^ ·) := by
      rw [antidiagonal_dominant v f g i₀ j₀ vna vMulEq vNeg hdom']
    _ ≤ gaussNorm v c (f * g) := le_gaussNorm v c (f * g) hbfg (i₀ + j₀)

name: gaussNorm_mul_eq_mul
statement:
lemma gaussNorm_mul_eq_mul (f g : MvPowerSeries σ R) (hf : HasGaussNorm v c f)
    (hg : HasGaussNorm v c g) (hfg : HasGaussNorm v c (f * g))
    (vNonneg : ∀ a, v a ≥ 0) (vZero : v 0 = 0) (vNA : IsNonarchimedean v)
    (vMulEq : ∀ (a b : R), v (a * b) = v a * v b) (vNeg : ∀ (a : R), v (-a) = v a)
    (h_eq_zero : ∀ (x : R), v x = 0 → x = 0) (hc : ∀ (i : σ), 0 < c i)
    (hdom : ∃ i j, AchievesGaussNorm v c f i ∧ AchievesGaussNorm v c g j ∧
      ∀ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal (i + j), p ≠ (i, j) → v (coeff p.1 f * coeff p.2 g) <
      v (coeff i f) * v (coeff j g)) :
    gaussNorm v c (f * g) = gaussNorm v c f * gaussNorm v c g
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf' : f = 0
  · simp [hf', gaussNorm_zero v c vZero]
  by_cases hg' : g = 0
  · simp [hg', gaussNorm_zero v c vZero]
  have hf1 : gaussNorm v c f ≠ 0 := by
    convert gaussNorm_eq_zero_iff v c f vZero vNonneg h_eq_zero hc hf
    grind
  have hg1 : gaussNorm v c g ≠ 0 := by
    convert gaussNorm_eq_zero_iff v c g vZero vNonneg h_eq_zero hc hg
    grind
  apply ge_antisymm_iff.mpr
  constructor
  · exact gaussNorm_le_mul v c f g vMulEq vNA (by grind) hfg hdom
  · exact gaussNorm_mul_le v c f g (StrongLT.le hc) vNonneg (by grind) vNA vZero hf hg

name: coeff_coeff_optionFunLeft
statement:
private lemma coeff_coeff_optionFunLeft (p : MvPowerSeries (Option σ) R) (n : ℕ) (x : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    coeff x (PowerSeries.coeff n (optionFunLeft σ R p)) = coeff (x.optionElim n) p
proof:
:= by
  rw [optionFunLeft, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
  exact LinearMap.proj_apply ..

name: optionFunLeft_monomial
statement:
private theorem optionFunLeft_monomial (x : Option σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R) :
    optionFunLeft σ R (monomial x r) = PowerSeries.monomial (x none) (monomial x.some r)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext n y
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_monomial, coeff_coeff_optionFunLeft, coeff_monomial]
  split_ifs with h1 h2 h3
  · simp [← h1]
  · absurd h2
    rw [← optionElim_apply_none n, h1]
  · replace h1 : ¬ y = x.some := fun h ↦ by
      absurd h1; ext u
      cases u <;> simp_all
    rw [coeff_monomial, ite_eq_right h1]
  · rw [coeff_zero]

name: optionFunLeft_mul
statement:
private lemma optionFunLeft_mul (p q : MvPowerSeries (Option σ) R) :
    optionFunLeft σ R (p * q) = optionFunLeft σ R p * optionFunLeft σ R q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext k x
  simp only [coeff_coeff_optionFunLeft, coeff_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_mul, map_sum, sum_sigma']
  refine sum_bij (fun y _ ↦ ⟨(y.1 none, y.2 none), (y.1.some, y.2.some)⟩) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intros; simp_all [Finsupp.ext_iff]
  · intros; ext t <;> cases t
    all_goals simp_all [Finsupp.ext_iff]
  · rintro ⟨⟨m, n⟩, ⟨u, v⟩⟩ h
    suffices ∃ a b, (a none = m ∧ b none = n) ∧ a.some = u ∧ a + b = optionElim k x ∧
      b.some = v by simpa
    use u.optionElim m, v.optionElim n
    suffices optionElim m u + optionElim n v = optionElim k x by simp_all
    ext t; cases t <;> simp_all [Finsupp.ext_iff]
  · intros; simp_all [Finsupp.ext_iff]

name: coeff_optionInvFunLeft
statement:
private lemma coeff_optionInvFunLeft (p : PowerSeries (MvPowerSeries σ R)) (x : Option σ →₀ ℕ) :
    coeff x (optionInvFunLeft σ R p) = (p.coeff (x none)).coeff x.some
proof: := rfl

name: coeff_coeff_optionEquivLeft
statement:
lemma coeff_coeff_optionEquivLeft (p : MvPowerSeries (Option σ) R) (n : ℕ) (x : σ →₀ ℕ) :

name: optionEquivLeft_monomial

name: truncTotal_sub_truncTotal_mem_pow_idealOfVars
statement:
lemma truncTotal_sub_truncTotal_mem_pow_idealOfVars {l m n : ℕ} (h : l ≤ m) (h' : l ≤ n)
    (p : MvPowerSeries σ R) : p.truncTotal m - p.truncTotal n ∈
      MvPolynomial.idealOfVars σ R ^ l
proof:
:= by
  refine (MvPolynomial.mem_pow_idealOfVars_iff' ..).mpr (fun x hx ↦ ?_)
  rw [MvPolynomial.coeff_sub, sub_eq_zero, coeff_truncTotal _ (by lia),
    coeff_truncTotal _ (by lia)]

      MvPolynomial.idealOfVars σ R ^ n
proof:
:= by
  refine (MvPolynomial.mem_pow_idealOfVars_iff' ..).mpr (fun x hx ↦ ?_)
  rw [MvPolynomial.coeff_sub, sub_eq_zero, coeff_truncTotal _ hx,
    coeff_truncTotal_mul_truncTotal_eq_coeff_mul _ _ hx]

name: toAdicCompletion_apply_eq_mk_truncTotal
statement:
lemma toAdicCompletion_apply_eq_mk_truncTotal {n : ℕ} {p : MvPowerSeries σ R} :
    (toAdicCompletion σ R p).val n = truncTotal n p
proof: := by rfl

name: coeff_toAdicCompletion_val_apply_out
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coeff_truncTotal _ hx, ← sub_eq_zero, ← MvPolynomial.coeff_sub]
  apply (MvPolynomial.mem_pow_idealOfVars_iff' n _).mp
  · rw [toAdicCompletion_apply_eq_mk_truncTotal, smul_eq_mul]
    nth_rw 1 [← Ideal.mul_top (MvPolynomial.idealOfVars σ R ^ n), ← Ideal.Quotient.eq,
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_out]
  exact hx

name: toAdicCompletion_coe
statement:
theorem toAdicCompletion_coe (p : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    toAdicCompletion σ R p = .of (MvPolynomial.idealOfVars σ R) (MvPolynomial σ R) p
proof:
:= by
  symm; ext n
  suffices p - (truncTotal n) p ∈ MvPolynomial.idealOfVars σ R ^ n by
    simpa [toAdicCompletion, AdicCompletion.liftAlgHom, AdicCompletion.liftRingHom,
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_eq_mk_iff_sub_mem]
  exact (MvPolynomial.mem_pow_idealOfVars_iff' ..).mpr fun x hx ↦ by simp [coeff_truncTotal _ hx]

name: coeff_toAdicCompletionInv
proof: := by rfl

name: mk_truncTotal_toAdicCompletionInv
statement:
theorem mk_truncTotal_toAdicCompletionInv {n : ℕ}
    {f : AdicCompletion (MvPolynomial.idealOfVars σ R) (MvPolynomial σ R)} :
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (MvPolynomial.idealOfVars σ R ^ n • ⊤)
    ((truncTotal n) (toAdicCompletionInv σ R f)) = f.val n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Ideal.Quotient.mk_out (f.val n), Ideal.Quotient.mk_eq_mk_iff_sub_mem]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul, Ideal.mul_top, MvPolynomial.mem_pow_idealOfVars_iff',
    MvPolynomial.coeff_sub]
  intro x h
  rw [coeff_truncTotal _ h, coeff_toAdicCompletionInv, ← MvPolynomial.coeff_sub]
  apply (MvPolynomial.mem_pow_idealOfVars_iff' (degree x + 1) _).mp
  · nth_rw 1 [← Ideal.mul_top (MvPolynomial.idealOfVars σ R ^ (degree x + 1)),
      ← smul_eq_mul, ← Ideal.Quotient.eq]
    simp only [Submodule.mapQ_eq_factor, Submodule.factor_eq_factor, Ideal.Quotient.mk_out]
    rw [← AdicCompletion.transitionMap_ideal_mk _ (Nat.lt_iff_add_one_le.mp h), eq_comm]
    convert! f.prop h; simp
  simp

name: mem_basis_iff
statement:
theorem mem_basis_iff {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} {Jd : TwoSidedIdeal R × (σ →₀ ℕ)} :
    f ∈ basis σ R Jd ↔ ∀ e ≤ Jd.2, coeff e f ∈ Jd.1
proof:
:= by
  simp [basis]

name: basis_le
statement:
theorem basis_le {Jd Ke : TwoSidedIdeal R × (σ →₀ ℕ)} (hJK : Jd.1 ≤ Ke.1) (hed : Ke.2 ≤ Jd.2) :
    basis σ R Jd ≤ basis σ R Ke
proof:
:=
  fun _ ↦ forall_imp (fun _ h hue ↦ hJK (h (le_trans hue hed)))

name: basis_le_iff
statement:
theorem basis_le_iff {J K : TwoSidedIdeal R} {d e : σ →₀ ℕ} (hK : K ≠ ⊤) :
    basis σ R ⟨J, d⟩ ≤ basis σ R ⟨K, e⟩ ↔ J ≤ K ∧ e ≤ d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · simp only [basis, TwoSidedIdeal.le_iff, TwoSidedIdeal.coe_mk', ofPred_subset_ofPred]
    intro h
    constructor
    · intro x hx
      have (d' : _) : coeff d' (C (σ := σ) x) ∈ J := by
        rw [coeff_C]; split_ifs <;> [exact hx; exact J.zero_mem]
      simpa using h (C x) (fun _ _ ↦ this _) _ zero_le
    · by_contra h'
      apply hK
      rw [eq_top_iff]
      intro x _
      have (d') (hd'_le : d' ≤ d) : coeff d' (monomial e x) ∈ J := by
        rw [coeff_monomial]
        split_ifs with hd' <;> [exact (h' (hd' ▸ hd'_le)).elim; exact J.zero_mem]
      simpa using h (monomial e x) this _ le_rfl
  · rintro ⟨hJK, hed⟩
    exact basis_le hJK hed

name: hasBasis_nhds_zero
statement:
lemma hasBasis_nhds_zero [IsLinearTopology R R] [IsLinearTopology Rᵐᵒᵖ R] :
    (𝓝 0 : Filter (MvPowerSeries σ R)).HasBasis
      (fun Id : TwoSidedIdeal R × (σ →₀ ℕ) ↦ (Id.1 : Set R) ∈ 𝓝 0)
      (fun Id ↦ basis _ _ Id)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [nhds_pi]
  refine IsLinearTopology.hasBasis_twoSidedIdeal.pi_self.to_hasBasis ?_ ?_
  · intro ⟨D, I⟩ ⟨hD, hI⟩
    refine ⟨⟨I, Finset.sup hD.toFinset id⟩, hI, fun f hf d hd ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, mem_basis_iff] at hf
    convert! hf _ <| Finset.le_sup (hD.mem_toFinset.mpr hd)
  · intro ⟨I, d⟩ hI
    refine ⟨⟨Iic d, I⟩, ⟨finite_Iic d, hI⟩, ?_⟩
    simpa [basis, coeff_apply, Iic, Set.pi] using! subset_rfl

name: isTopologicallyNilpotent_of_constantCoeff
statement:
theorem isTopologicallyNilpotent_of_constantCoeff
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [TopologicalSpace R] [IsLinearTopology R R]
    {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} (hf : IsTopologicallyNilpotent (constantCoeff f)) :
    IsTopologicallyNilpotent f
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [IsTopologicallyNilpotent, tendsto_iff_coeff_tendsto, coeff_zero,
    IsLinearTopology.hasBasis_ideal.tendsto_right_iff]
  intro d I hI
  replace hf := hf.eventually_mem hI
  simp_rw [eventually_atTop, SetLike.mem_coe, ← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem,
    map_pow, ← coeff_map, ← constantCoeff_map] at hf ⊢
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hf
  use N + d.degree
  intro n hn
  simpa only [map_pow] using coeff_eq_zero_of_constantCoeff_nilpotent (hN N le_rfl) hn

name: isTopologicallyNilpotent_iff_constantCoeff
statement:
theorem isTopologicallyNilpotent_iff_constantCoeff
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [TopologicalSpace R] [IsLinearTopology R R] (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => f ^ n) atTop (nhds 0) ↔
      IsTopologicallyNilpotent (constantCoeff f)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun H ↦ ?_, isTopologicallyNilpotent_of_constantCoeff⟩
  replace H : Tendsto (fun n ↦ constantCoeff (f ^ n)) atTop (nhds 0) :=
    continuous_constantCoeff R |>.tendsto' 0 0 constantCoeff_zero |>.comp H
  simpa only [map_pow] using! H

name: lexOrder_def_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem lexOrder_def_of_ne_zero {φ : MvPowerSeries σ R} (hφ : φ ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (ne : Set.Nonempty (toLex '' φ.support)),
      lexOrder φ = WithTop.some ((@wellFounded_lt (Lex (σ →₀ ℕ))
        (instLTLex) (Lex.wellFoundedLT)).min (toLex '' φ.support) ne)
proof:
:= by
  suffices ne : Set.Nonempty (toLex '' φ.support) by
    use ne
    unfold lexOrder
    simp only [dite_eq_right hφ]
  exact (Function.support_nonempty_iff.mpr hφ).image _

name: lexOrder_zero
