name: of_field
statement:
theorem of_field [Field K] [Algebra R K] [FaithfulSMul R K]
    (surj : ∀ z : K, ∃ x y, z = algebraMap R K x / algebraMap R K y) :
    IsFractionRing R K
proof:
:=
  have inj := FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective R K
  have := inj.noZeroDivisors _ (map_zero _) (map_mul _)
  have := Module.nontrivial R K

name: of_ringEquiv_left
statement:
theorem of_ringEquiv_left {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] {S : Type*} [CommSemiring S]
    {K : Type*} [CommSemiring K] [Algebra R K] (e : R ≃+* S) [Algebra S K]
    (h : ∀ x, algebraMap R K x = algebraMap S K (e x)) [IsFractionRing S K] :
    IsFractionRing R K
proof: := IsLocalization.of_ringEquiv_left e (MulEquivClass.map_nonZeroDivisors e) h

name: to_map_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem to_map_eq_zero_iff {x : R} : algebraMap R K x = 0 ↔ x = 0
proof:
:=
  IsLocalization.to_map_eq_zero_iff _ le_rfl

name: injective
statement: protected theorem injective : Function.Injective (algebraMap R K)
proof:
:=
  IsLocalization.injective _ (le_of_eq rfl)

name: nonZeroDivisors_eq_isUnit
statement: theorem nonZeroDivisors_eq_isUnit : K⁰ = IsUnit.submonoid K
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (fun x hx ↦ ?_) (isUnit_le_nonZeroDivisors K)
  have ⟨r, eq⟩ := surj R⁰ x
  let r' : R⁰ := ⟨r.1, mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_injective (IsFractionRing.injective R K)
    (eq ▸ mul_mem hx (map_units ..).mem_nonZeroDivisors)⟩
  exact isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_left <| eq ▸ map_units K r'

name: idem
statement: theorem idem : IsFractionRing K K
proof: := IsLocalization.self (nonZeroDivisors_eq_isUnit R K).le

name: trans
statement:
theorem trans (L) [CommRing L] [Algebra K L] [IsFractionRing K L] [Algebra R L]
    [IsScalarTower R K L] : IsFractionRing R L
proof:
:=
  isLocalization_of_algEquiv _ <| (algEquiv R K L).restrictScalars R

name: self_iff_nonZeroDivisors_eq_isUnit
statement:
theorem self_iff_nonZeroDivisors_eq_isUnit : IsFractionRing R R ↔ R⁰ = IsUnit.submonoid R where
  mp _
proof:
:= nonZeroDivisors_eq_isUnit R R
  mpr h := IsLocalization.self h.le

name: self_iff_nonZeroDivisors_le_isUnit
statement: theorem self_iff_nonZeroDivisors_le_isUnit : IsFractionRing R R ↔ R⁰ ≤ IsUnit.submonoid R
proof:
:= by
  rw [self_iff_nonZeroDivisors_eq_isUnit, le_antisymm_iff,
    and_iff_left (isUnit_le_nonZeroDivisors R)]

name: self_iff_bijective
statement:
theorem self_iff_bijective : IsFractionRing R R ↔ Function.Bijective (algebraMap R K) where
  mp h
proof:
:= (atUnits R _ <| self_iff_nonZeroDivisors_le_isUnit.mp h).bijective
  mpr h := isLocalization_of_algEquiv _ (AlgEquiv.ofBijective (Algebra.ofId R K) h).symm

name: self_iff_surjective
statement: theorem self_iff_surjective : IsFractionRing R R ↔ Function.Surjective (algebraMap R K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [self_iff_bijective K, Function.Bijective, and_iff_right (IsFractionRing.injective R K)]

name: coe_inj
statement:
@[norm_cast]
theorem coe_inj {a b : R} : (↑a : K) = ↑b ↔ a = b
proof:
:=
  algebraMap.coe_inj _ _

name: to_map_ne_zero_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors
statement:
protected theorem to_map_ne_zero_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors [Nontrivial R] {x : R}
    (hx : x ∈ nonZeroDivisors R) : algebraMap R K x ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  IsLocalization.to_map_ne_zero_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors _ le_rfl hx

name: isDomain
statement: protected theorem isDomain : IsDomain K
proof:
:=
  isDomain_of_le_nonZeroDivisors _ (le_refl (nonZeroDivisors A))

name: mul_inv_cancel
statement: protected theorem mul_inv_cancel (x : K) (hx : x ≠ 0) : x * IsFractionRing.inv A x = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsFractionRing.inv, dite_eq_right hx, ←
    IsUnit.mul_left_inj
      (map_units K
        ⟨(sec _ x).1,
          mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.2 fun h0 =>
            hx <| eq_zero_of_fst_eq_zero (sec_spec (nonZeroDivisors A) x) h0⟩),
    one_mul, mul_assoc]
  rw [mk'_spec, ← eq_mk'_iff_mul_eq]
  exact (mk'_sec _ x).symm

name: surjective_iff_isField
statement:
lemma surjective_iff_isField [IsDomain R] : Function.Surjective (algebraMap R K) ↔ IsField R where
  mp h
proof:
:= (RingEquiv.ofBijective (algebraMap R K)
      ⟨IsFractionRing.injective R K, h⟩).toMulEquiv.isField (IsFractionRing.toField R).toIsField
  mpr h :=
    letI := h.toField
    (IsLocalization.atUnits R _ (S := K)
      (fun _ hx ↦ Ne.isUnit (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mp hx))).surjective

name: mk'_mk_eq_div
statement:
theorem mk'_mk_eq_div {r s} (hs : s ∈ nonZeroDivisors A) :
    mk' K r ⟨s, hs⟩ = algebraMap A K r / algebraMap A K s
proof:
:=
  haveI := (algebraMap A K).domain_nontrivial
  mk'_eq_iff_eq_mul.2 <|
    (div_mul_cancel₀ (algebraMap A K r)
        (IsFractionRing.to_map_ne_zero_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors hs)).symm

name: mk'_eq_div
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk'_eq_div {r} (s : nonZeroDivisors A) : mk' K r s = algebraMap A K r / algebraMap A K s
proof:
:=
  mk'_mk_eq_div s.2

name: div_surjective
statement:
theorem div_surjective (z : K) :
    ∃ x y : A, y ∈ nonZeroDivisors A ∧ algebraMap _ _ x / algebraMap _ _ y = z
proof:
:=
  let ⟨x, ⟨y, hy⟩, h⟩ := exists_mk'_eq (nonZeroDivisors A) z
  ⟨x, y, hy, by rwa [mk'_eq_div] at h⟩

name: isUnit_map_of_injective
statement:
theorem isUnit_map_of_injective (hg : Function.Injective g) (y : nonZeroDivisors A) :
    IsUnit (g y)
proof:
:=
  haveI := g.domain_nontrivial
  IsUnit.mk0 (g y) <|
    show g.toMonoidWithZeroHom y ≠ 0 from map_ne_zero_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors g hg y.2

name: mk'_eq_zero_iff_eq_zero
statement:
theorem mk'_eq_zero_iff_eq_zero [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K] {x : R} {y : nonZeroDivisors R} :
    mk' K x y = 0 ↔ x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := (algebraMap R K).domain_nontrivial
  simp [nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero]

name: mk'_eq_one_iff_eq
statement: theorem mk'_eq_one_iff_eq {x : A} {y : nonZeroDivisors A} : mk' K x y = 1 ↔ x = y
proof:
:= by
  have := (algebraMap A K).domain_nontrivial
  refine ⟨?_, fun hxy => by rw [hxy, mk'_self']⟩
  intro hxy
  have hy : (algebraMap A K) ↑y ≠ (0 : K) :=
    IsFractionRing.to_map_ne_zero_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors y.property
  rw [IsFractionRing.mk'_eq_div, div_eq_one_iff_eq hy] at hxy
  exact IsFractionRing.injective A K hxy

name: of_algHom
statement: theorem of_algHom [Algebra A L] (f : L →ₐ[A] K) : IsFractionRing A L
proof:
:= by
  refine IsFractionRing.of_algEquiv <| .symm <| .ofBijective f ⟨f.injective, fun x ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨x, y, hy, rfl⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective A x
  exact ⟨algebraMap A L x / algebraMap A L y, by simp⟩

name: algHom_commutes
statement:
theorem algHom_commutes (e : K₁ →ₐ[A] K₂) (f : L₁ →ₐ[B] L₂) (x : K₁) :
    algebraMap K₂ L₂ (e x) = f (algebraMap K₁ L₁ x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, s, hs, rfl⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective A x
  simp_rw [map_div₀, AlgHom.commutes, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply,
    IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A B L₁, AlgHom.commutes, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply]

name: algEquiv_commutes
statement:
theorem algEquiv_commutes (e : K₁ ≃ₐ[A] K₂) (f : L₁ ≃ₐ[B] L₂) (x : K₁) :
    algebraMap K₂ L₂ (e x) = f (algebraMap K₁ L₁ x)
proof:
:= by
  exact algHom_commutes e.toAlgHom f.toAlgHom _

name: closure_range_algebraMap
statement: theorem closure_range_algebraMap : Subfield.closure (Set.range (algebraMap A K)) = ⊤
proof:
:=
  top_unique fun z _ ↦ by
    obtain ⟨_, _, -, rfl⟩ := div_surjective A z
    apply div_mem <;> exact Subfield.subset_closure ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: ringHom_fieldRange_eq_of_comp_eq
statement:
theorem ringHom_fieldRange_eq_of_comp_eq (h : RingHom.comp f (algebraMap A K) = g) :
    f.fieldRange = Subfield.closure g.range
proof:
:= by
  rw [f.fieldRange_eq_map, ← closure_range_algebraMap A K,
    f.map_field_closure, ← Set.range_comp, ← f.coe_comp, h, g.coe_range]

name: ringHom_fieldRange_eq_of_comp_eq_of_range_eq

theorem ringHom_fieldRange_eq_of_comp_eq_of_range_eq (h : RingHom.comp f (algebraMap A K) = g)
    {s : Set L} (hs : g.range = Subring.closure s) : f.fieldRange = Subfield.closure s
proof:
:= by
  rw [ringHom_fieldRange_eq_of_comp_eq h, hs]
  ext
  simp_rw [Subfield.mem_closure_iff, Subring.closure_eq]

proof:

  obtain ⟨x, y, hy, rfl⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective A z

lemma semilinearEquivOfRingEquiv_algebraMap (a : A) :

name: semilinearEquivOfRingEquiv_symm_apply

lemma semilinearEquivOfRingEquiv_symm_apply (x : L) :

name: semilinearEquivOfRingEquiv_comp
proof:
:= ⟨rfl⟩
    let : RingHomCompTriple g.symm (f.symm : B →+* A) ((f.trans g).symm : C →+* A) := ⟨rfl⟩
    (semilinearEquivOfRingEquiv K M (f.trans g)) =
      LinearEquiv.trans (σ₁₃ := (f.trans g)) (σ₃₁ := (f.trans g).symm)
      (semilinearEquivOfRingEquiv K L f)
      (semilinearEquivOfRingEquiv L M g) := by
  ext a
  simp [-RingEquiv.coe_ringHom_trans, semilinearEquivOfRingEquiv_apply,
    semilinearEquivOfRingEquiv_apply K M, ringEquivOfRingEquiv_comp K L M]

name: isFractionRing_iff_of_base_ringEquiv

  delta IsFractionRing
  convert! isLocalization_iff_of_base_ringEquiv (nonZeroDivisors R) S h

name: nontrivial_iff_nontrivial
statement: theorem nontrivial_iff_nontrivial : Nontrivial R ↔ Nontrivial S
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! ⟨_, _⟩ | ⟨_, _⟩
  · obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := h.exists_of_eq (x := 1) (y := 0) (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
    simp at hc
  · apply (h.map_units S 1).ne_zero
    rw [Subsingleton.eq_zero ((1 : nonZeroDivisors R) : R), map_zero]

name: nontrivial

name: faithfulSMul
statement: protected theorem faithfulSMul [FaithfulSMul G B] : FaithfulSMul G L
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ eq_of_smul_eq_smul fun x ↦ by simpa [← algebraMap.coe_smul'] using h (algebraMap B L x)⟩

name: smulCommClass
statement: protected theorem smulCommClass [SMulCommClass G A B] : SMulCommClass G K L
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun g x y ↦ by
    obtain ⟨a, b, hb, rfl⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective A x
    obtain ⟨c, d, hd, rfl⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective B y
    simp [Algebra.smul_def, map_div₀, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A K L,
      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A B L, smul_mul', smul_div₀',
      ← algebraMap.coe_smul', smul_algebraMap]⟩

name: fixingSubgroup_range_algebraMap
statement:
theorem fixingSubgroup_range_algebraMap :
    fixingSubgroup G (Set.range (algebraMap A B)) =
      fixingSubgroup G (Set.range (algebraMap K L))
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Subgroup.ext_iff, mem_fixingSubgroup_iff, Set.forall_mem_range]
  refine fun g ↦ ⟨fun h x ↦ ?_, fun h x ↦ FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective B L ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨a, b, _, rfl⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective A x
    simp_rw [map_div₀, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply,
      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A B L, smul_div₀', ← algebraMap.smul', h]
  · simp_rw [algebraMap.smul', ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply,
      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A K L, h]

name: algebraMap_injective_of_field_isFractionRing
statement:
theorem algebraMap_injective_of_field_isFractionRing (K L : Type*) [Field K] [Semiring L]
    [Nontrivial L] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K] [Algebra S L] [Algebra K L] [Algebra R L]
    [IsScalarTower R S L] [IsScalarTower R K L] : Function.Injective (algebraMap R S)
proof:
:= by
  refine Function.Injective.of_comp (f := algebraMap S L) ?_
  rw [← RingHom.coe_comp, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R K L]
  exact (algebraMap K L).injective.comp (IsFractionRing.injective R K)

name: FaithfulSMul.of_field_isFractionRing
statement:
theorem FaithfulSMul.of_field_isFractionRing (K L : Type*) [Field K] [Semiring L]
    [Nontrivial L] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K] [Algebra S L] [Algebra K L] [Algebra R L]
    [IsScalarTower R S L] [IsScalarTower R K L] : FaithfulSMul R S
proof:
:=
  (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective R S).mpr <|
    algebraMap_injective_of_field_isFractionRing R S K L

proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp

name: support_hsum_subset
statement: theorem support_hsum_subset {s : SummableFamily Γ R α} : s.hsum.support ⊆ ⋃ a : α, (s a).support
proof:
:=
  fun g hg => by
  rw [mem_support, coeff_hsum, finsum_eq_sum _ (s.finite_co_support _)] at hg
  obtain ⟨a, _, h2⟩ := exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hg
  rw [Set.mem_iUnion]
  exact ⟨a, h2⟩

name: hsum_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem hsum_add {s t : SummableFamily Γ R α} : (s + t).hsum = s.hsum + t.hsum
proof:
:= by
  ext g
  simp only [coeff_hsum, coeff_add, add_apply]
  exact finsum_add_distrib (s.finite_co_support _) (t.finite_co_support _)

name: coeff_hsum_eq_sum_of_subset
statement:
theorem coeff_hsum_eq_sum_of_subset {s : SummableFamily Γ R α} {g : Γ} {t : Finset α}
    (h : { a | (s a).coeff g ≠ 0 } ⊆ t) : s.hsum.coeff g = ∑ i ∈ t, (s i).coeff g
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coeff_hsum, finsum_eq_sum _ (s.finite_co_support _)]
  exact sum_subset (Set.Finite.toFinset_subset.mpr h) (by simp)

name: coeff_hsum_eq_sum
statement:
theorem coeff_hsum_eq_sum {s : SummableFamily Γ R α} {g : Γ} :
    s.hsum.coeff g = ∑ i ∈ (s.coeff g).support, (s i).coeff g
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coeff_hsum, finsum_eq_sum _ (s.finite_co_support _), coeff_support]

name: hsum_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem hsum_single {ι} [DecidableEq ι] (i : ι) (x : R⟦Γ⟧) : (single i x).hsum = x
proof:
:= by
  ext g
  rw [coeff_hsum, finsum_eq_single _ i, single_toFun, Pi.single_eq_same]
  simp +contextual

name: hsum_unique
statement:
@[simp]
theorem hsum_unique {ι} [Unique ι] (x : SummableFamily Γ R ι) : x.hsum = x default
proof:
:= by
  ext g
  simp only [coeff_hsum, finsum_unique]

name: hsum_equiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem hsum_equiv (e : α ≃ β) (s : SummableFamily Γ R α) : (Equiv e s).hsum = s.hsum
proof:
:= by
  ext g
  simp only [coeff_hsum, Equiv_toFun]
  exact finsum_eq_of_bijective e.symm (Equiv.bijective e.symm) fun x => rfl

name: hsum_smulFamily
statement:
theorem hsum_smulFamily [AddCommMonoid V] [SMulWithZero R V] (f : α → R)
    (s : SummableFamily Γ V α) (g : Γ) :
    (smulFamily f s).hsum.coeff g = ∑ᶠ i, (f i) • ((s i).coeff g)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: le_hsum_support_mem
statement:
theorem le_hsum_support_mem {s : SummableFamily Γ R α} {g g' : Γ}
    (hg : ∀ b : α, ∀ g' ∈ (s b).support, g ≤ g') (hg' : g' ∈ s.hsum.support) : g ≤ g'
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_support, coeff_hsum_eq_sum] at hg'
  obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hg'
  exact hg i g' hi

name: hsum_orderTop_of_le
statement:
theorem hsum_orderTop_of_le {s : SummableFamily Γ R α} {g : Γ} {a : α} (ha : g = (s a).orderTop)
    (hg : ∀ b : α, ∀ g' ∈ (s b).support, g ≤ g') (hna : ∀ b : α, b ≠ a → (s b).coeff g = 0) :
    s.hsum.orderTop = g
proof:
:=
  orderTop_eq_of_le (ne_of_eq_of_ne (by rw [coeff_hsum, finsum_eq_single (fun i ↦ (s i).coeff g) a
    hna]) (coeff_orderTop_ne ha.symm)) fun _ hg' => le_hsum_support_mem hg hg'

name: hsum_leadingCoeff_of_le
statement:
theorem hsum_leadingCoeff_of_le {s : SummableFamily Γ R α} {g : Γ} {a : α} (ha : g = (s a).orderTop)
    (hg : ∀ b : α, ∀ g' ∈ (s b).support, g ≤ g') (hna : ∀ b : α, b ≠ a → (s b).coeff g = 0) :
    s.hsum.leadingCoeff = (s a).coeff g
proof:
:= by
  have := hsum_orderTop_of_le ha hg hna
  rw [orderTop] at this
  have hs : s.hsum ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    simp [h] at this
  simp only [hs, ↓reduceDIte, WithTop.coe_eq_coe] at this
  simp only [leadingCoeff_of_ne_zero hs, coeff_hsum, untop_orderTop_of_ne_zero hs, this]
  rw [finsum_eq_single (fun i ↦ (s i).coeff g) a hna]

theorem coe_neg (s : SummableFamily Γ R α) : ⇑(-s) = -s

theorem coe_sub (s t : SummableFamily Γ R α) : ⇑(s - t) = s - t

name: smul_support_subset_prod
statement:
theorem smul_support_subset_prod (s : SummableFamily Γ R α)
    (t : SummableFamily Γ' V β) (gh : Γ × Γ') :
    (Function.support fun (i : α × β) ↦ (s i.1).coeff gh.1 • (t i.2).coeff gh.2) ⊆
    ((s.finite_co_support' gh.1).prod (t.finite_co_support' gh.2)).toFinset
proof:
:= by
  intro _ hab
  simp_all only [Function.mem_support, ne_eq, Set.Finite.coe_toFinset, Set.mem_prod,
    Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
  exact ⟨left_ne_zero_of_smul hab, right_ne_zero_of_smul hab⟩

name: hasFiniteSupport_smul
statement:
theorem hasFiniteSupport_smul (s : SummableFamily Γ R α)
    (t : SummableFamily Γ' V β) (gh : Γ × Γ') :
    (fun (i : α × β) ↦ (s i.1).coeff gh.1 • (t i.2).coeff gh.2).HasFiniteSupport
proof:
:=
  Set.Finite.subset (Set.toFinite ((s.finite_co_support' gh.1).prod
    (t.finite_co_support' gh.2)).toFinset) (smul_support_subset_prod s t gh)

name: isPWO_iUnion_support_prod_smul
statement:
theorem isPWO_iUnion_support_prod_smul {s : α → R⟦Γ⟧} {t : β → V⟦Γ'⟧}
    (hs : (⋃ a, (s a).support).IsPWO) (ht : (⋃ b, (t b).support).IsPWO) :
    (⋃ (a : α × β), ((fun a ↦ (of R).symm
      ((s a.1) • (of R) (t a.2))) a).support).IsPWO
proof:
:= by
  apply (hs.vadd ht).mono
  have hsupp : ∀ ab : α × β, support ((fun ab ↦ (of R).symm (s ab.1 • (of R) (t ab.2))) ab) ⊆
      (s ab.1).support +ᵥ (t ab.2).support := by
    intro ab
    refine Set.Subset.trans (fun x hx => ?_) (support_vaddAntidiagonal_subset_vadd fun a ↦
      Set.VAddAntidiagonal.finite_of_isPWO (s ab.1).isPWO_support (t ab.2).isPWO_support a)
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    contrapose! hx
    rw [mem_support, not_not, HahnModule.coeff_smul, hx, sum_empty]
  refine Set.Subset.trans (Set.iUnion_mono fun a => (hsupp a)) ?_
  simp_all only [Set.iUnion_subset_iff, Prod.forall]
  exact fun a b => Set.vadd_subset_vadd (Set.subset_iUnion_of_subset a fun x y ↦ y)
    (Set.subset_iUnion_of_subset b fun x y ↦ y)

name: finite_co_support_prod_smul
statement:
theorem finite_co_support_prod_smul (s : SummableFamily Γ R α)
    (t : SummableFamily Γ' V β) (g : Γ') :
    Finite {(ab : α × β) |
      ((fun (ab : α × β) ↦ (of R).symm (s ab.1 • (of R) (t ab.2))) ab).coeff g ≠ 0}
proof:
:= by
  apply ((VAddAntidiagonal g (Set.VAddAntidiagonal.finite_of_isPWO s.isPWO_iUnion_support
    t.isPWO_iUnion_support g)).finite_toSet.biUnion'
    (fun gh _ => hasFiniteSupport_smul s t gh)).subset _
  exact fun ab hab => by
    simp only [ne_eq, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hab
    obtain ⟨ij, hij⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hab
    simp only [mem_coe, mem_vaddAntidiagonal, Set.mem_iUnion, mem_support, ne_eq,
      Function.mem_support, exists_prop, Prod.exists]
    exact ⟨ij.1, ij.2, ⟨⟨ab.1, left_ne_zero_of_smul hij.2⟩, ⟨ab.2, right_ne_zero_of_smul hij.2⟩,
      ((mem_vaddAntidiagonal _ _).mp hij.1).2.2⟩, hij.2⟩

name: sum_vAddAntidiagonal_eq
statement:
theorem sum_vAddAntidiagonal_eq (s : SummableFamily Γ R α) (t : SummableFamily Γ' V β) (g : Γ')
    (a : α × β) :
    ∑ x ∈ VAddAntidiagonal g (Set.VAddAntidiagonal.finite_of_isPWO (s a.1).isPWO_support'
      (t a.2).isPWO_support' g), (s a.1).coeff x.1 • (t a.2).coeff x.2 =
    ∑ x ∈ VAddAntidiagonal g (Set.VAddAntidiagonal.finite_of_isPWO s.isPWO_iUnion_support'
      t.isPWO_iUnion_support' g), (s a.1).coeff x.1 • (t a.2).coeff x.2
proof:
:= by
  refine sum_subset (fun gh hgh => ?_) fun gh hgh h => ?_
  · simp_all only [mem_vaddAntidiagonal, Function.mem_support, Set.mem_iUnion, mem_support]
    exact ⟨Exists.intro a.1 hgh.1, Exists.intro a.2 hgh.2.1, trivial⟩
  · by_cases hs : (s a.1).coeff gh.1 = 0
    · exact smul_eq_zero_of_left hs ((t a.2).coeff gh.2)
    · simp_all

name: coeff_smul
statement:
theorem coeff_smul {R} {V} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid V] [Module R V]
    (s : SummableFamily Γ R α) (t : SummableFamily Γ' V β) (g : Γ') :
    (smul s t).hsum.coeff g =
    ∑ gh ∈ VAddAntidiagonal g (Set.VAddAntidiagonal.finite_of_isPWO s.isPWO_iUnion_support
      t.isPWO_iUnion_support g), (s.hsum.coeff gh.1) • (t.hsum.coeff gh.2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_hsum]
  simp only [coeff_hsum_eq_sum, smul_toFun, HahnModule.coeff_smul, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  simp_rw [sum_vAddAntidiagonal_eq, Finset.smul_sum, Finset.sum_smul]
  rw [← sum_finsum_comm _ _ <| fun gh _ => hasFiniteSupport_smul s t gh]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun gh _ => ?_
  rw [finsum_eq_sum _ (hasFiniteSupport_smul s t gh), ← sum_product_right']
  refine sum_subset (fun ab hab => ?_) (fun ab _ hab => by simp_all)
  have hsupp := smul_support_subset_prod s t gh
  simp_all only [mem_vaddAntidiagonal, Set.mem_iUnion, mem_support, ne_eq, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset,
    Function.mem_support, Set.Finite.coe_toFinset, support_subset_iff, Set.mem_prod,
    Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Prod.forall, coeff_support, mem_product]
  exact hsupp ab.1 ab.2 hab

name: smul_hsum
statement:
theorem smul_hsum {R} {V} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid V] [Module R V]
    (s : SummableFamily Γ R α) (t : SummableFamily Γ' V β) :
    (smul s t).hsum = (of R).symm (s.hsum • (of R) (t.hsum))
proof:
:= by
  ext g
  rw [coeff_smul s t g, HahnModule.coeff_smul, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  refine Eq.symm (sum_of_injOn (fun a ↦ a) (fun _ _ _ _ h ↦ h) (fun _ hgh => ?_)
    (fun gh _ hgh => ?_) fun _ _ => by simp)
  · simp_all only [mem_coe, mem_vaddAntidiagonal, mem_support, ne_eq, Set.mem_iUnion, and_true]
    constructor
    · rw [coeff_hsum_eq_sum] at hgh
      have h' := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hgh.1
      simpa using h'
    · by_contra hi
      simp_all
  · simp only [Set.image_id', mem_coe, mem_vaddAntidiagonal, mem_support, ne_eq, not_and] at hgh
    by_cases h : s.hsum.coeff gh.1 = 0
    · exact smul_eq_zero_of_left h (t.hsum.coeff gh.2)
    · simp_all

name: smul_eq
statement:
theorem smul_eq {x : R⟦Γ⟧} {t : SummableFamily Γ' V β} :

:=

name: smul_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_apply {x : R⟦Γ⟧} {s : SummableFamily Γ' V α} {a : α} :

name: hsum_smul_module
statement:
@[simp]
theorem hsum_smul_module {R} {V} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid V] [Module R V] {x : R⟦Γ⟧}
    {s : SummableFamily Γ' V α} :
    (x • s).hsum = (of R).symm (x • of R s.hsum)
proof:

  rw [smul_eq, hsum_equiv, smul_hsum, hsum_unique, const_toFun]

name: hsum_smul
statement:
theorem hsum_smul {x : R⟦Γ⟧} {s : SummableFamily Γ R α} :
    (x • s).hsum = x * s.hsum
proof:
:= by
  rw [hsum_smul_module, of_symm_smul_of_eq_mul]

name: hsum_sub
statement:
@[simp]
theorem hsum_sub {R : Type*} [Ring R] {s t : SummableFamily Γ R α} :
    (s - t).hsum = s.hsum - t.hsum
proof:
:= by

name: isPWO_iUnion_support_prod_mul
proof:
:=
  isPWO_iUnion_support_prod_smul hs ht

name: finite_co_support_prod_mul
proof:
:=
  finite_co_support_prod_smul s t g

name: mul_eq_smul
statement:
theorem mul_eq_smul (s : SummableFamily Γ R α) (t : SummableFamily Γ R β) :

name: coeff_hsum_mul
statement:
theorem coeff_hsum_mul (s : SummableFamily Γ R α) (t : SummableFamily Γ R β) (g : Γ) :
    (mul s t).hsum.coeff g = ∑ gh ∈ antidiagonal s.isPWO_iUnion_support
      t.isPWO_iUnion_support g, (s.hsum.coeff gh.1) * (t.hsum.coeff gh.2)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← smul_eq_mul, mul_eq_smul]
  exact coeff_smul s t g

name: hsum_mul
statement:
theorem hsum_mul (s : SummableFamily Γ R α) (t : SummableFamily Γ R β) :

name: coe_ofFinsupp

name: hsum_ofFinsupp

theorem hsum_ofFinsupp {f : α →₀ R⟦Γ⟧} : (ofFinsupp f).hsum = f.sum fun _ => id

name: hsum_embDomain

name: support_pow_subset_closure
statement:
theorem support_pow_subset_closure [AddCommMonoid Γ] [PartialOrder Γ] [IsOrderedCancelAddMonoid Γ]
    [Semiring R] (x : R⟦Γ⟧)
    (n : ℕ) : support (x ^ n) ⊆ AddSubmonoid.closure (support x)
proof:
:= by
  intro g hn
  induction n generalizing g with
  | zero =>
    simp only [pow_zero, mem_support, coeff_one, ne_eq, ite_eq_right_iff, Classical.not_imp] at hn
    simp only [hn, SetLike.mem_coe]
    exact AddSubmonoid.zero_mem _
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨i, hi, j, hj, rfl⟩ := support_mul_subset hn
    exact SetLike.mem_coe.2 (AddSubmonoid.add_mem _ (ih hi) (AddSubmonoid.subset_closure hj))

name: isPWO_iUnion_support_powers
statement:
theorem isPWO_iUnion_support_powers [AddCommMonoid Γ] [LinearOrder Γ] [IsOrderedCancelAddMonoid Γ]
    [Semiring R]
    {x : R⟦Γ⟧} (hx : 0 ≤ x.order) :
    (⋃ n : ℕ, (x ^ n).support).IsPWO
proof:
:=
  (x.isPWO_support'.addSubmonoid_closure
    fun _ hg => le_trans hx (order_le_of_coeff_ne_zero (Function.mem_support.mp hg))).mono
    (Set.iUnion_subset fun n => support_pow_subset_closure x n)

name: co_support_zero
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Set.subset_singleton_iff, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
  intro n hn
  by_contra h'
  simp_all only [ne_eq, not_false_eq_true, zero_pow, coeff_zero, not_true_eq_false]

name: pow_finite_co_support
statement:
theorem pow_finite_co_support {x : R⟦Γ⟧} (hx : 0 < x.orderTop) (g : Γ) :
    Set.Finite {a | ((fun n ↦ x ^ n) a).coeff g ≠ 0}
proof:
:= by
  have hpwo : Set.IsPWO (⋃ n, support (x ^ n)) :=
    isPWO_iUnion_support_powers (zero_le_orderTop_iff.mp <| le_of_lt hx)
  by_cases h0 : x = 0; · exact h0 ▸ Set.Finite.subset (Set.finite_singleton 0) (co_support_zero g)
  by_cases hg : g ∈ ⋃ n : ℕ, { g | (x ^ n).coeff g ≠ 0 }
  swap; · exact Set.finite_empty.subset fun n hn => hg (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨n, hn⟩)
  apply hpwo.isWF.induction hg
  intro y ys hy
  refine ((((antidiagonal x.isPWO_support hpwo y).finite_toSet.biUnion
    fun ij hij => hy ij.snd (mem_antidiagonal.1 (mem_coe.1 hij)).2.1 ?_).image Nat.succ).union
      (Set.finite_singleton 0)).subset ?_
  · obtain ⟨hi, _, rfl⟩ := mem_antidiagonal.1 (mem_coe.1 hij)
    exact lt_add_of_pos_left ij.2 <| lt_of_lt_of_le ((zero_lt_orderTop_iff h0).mp hx) <|
      order_le_of_coeff_ne_zero <| Function.mem_support.mp hi
  · rintro (_ | n) hn
    · exact Set.mem_union_right _ (Set.mem_singleton 0)
    · obtain ⟨i, hi, j, hj, rfl⟩ := support_mul_subset hn
      refine Set.mem_union_left _ ⟨n, Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨⟨j, i⟩, Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨?_, hi⟩⟩, rfl⟩
      simp only [mem_coe, mem_antidiagonal, mem_support, ne_eq, Set.mem_iUnion]
      exact ⟨hj, ⟨n, hi⟩, add_comm j i⟩

name: powers_of_orderTop_pos
statement:
theorem powers_of_orderTop_pos {x : R⟦Γ⟧} (hx : 0 < x.orderTop) (n : ℕ) :
    powers x n = x ^ n
proof:
:= by

name: powers_of_not_orderTop_pos
statement:
theorem powers_of_not_orderTop_pos {x : R⟦Γ⟧} (hx : ¬ 0 < x.orderTop) :
    powers x = .single 0 1

name: powers_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem powers_zero : powers (0 : R⟦Γ⟧) = .single 0 1
proof:

  ext n
  rw [powers_of_orderTop_pos (by simp)]
  obtain rfl | ha := eq_or_ne n 0 <;> simp [*]

name: coe_powers
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_powers : ⇑(powers x) = HPow.hPow x

  ext1 n

name: embDomain_succ_smul_powers
statement:
theorem embDomain_succ_smul_powers :

      powers x - ofFinsupp (Finsupp.single 0 1)
proof:

  apply SummableFamily.ext
  rintro (_ | n)
  · simp [hx]
  · 
    simp [embDomain_apply, of_symm_smul_of_eq_mul, powers_of_orderTop_pos hx, pow_succ',
      -smul_eq_mul]

name: one_sub_self_mul_hsum_powers
statement: theorem one_sub_self_mul_hsum_powers : (1 - x) * (powers x).hsum = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hsum_smul, sub_smul 1 x (powers x), one_smul, hsum_sub, ←
    hsum_embDomain (x • powers x) ⟨Nat.succ, Nat.succ_injective⟩, embDomain_succ_smul_powers hx]

name: one_minus_single_neg_mul
statement:
theorem one_minus_single_neg_mul {x y : R⟦Γ⟧} {r : R} (hr : r * x.leadingCoeff = 1)
    (hxy : x = y + single x.order x.leadingCoeff) (oinv : Γ) (hxo : oinv + x.order = 0) :
    1 - single oinv r * x = -(single oinv r * y)
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 1 [hxy]
  rw [mul_add, single_mul_single, hr, hxo,
    sub_add_eq_sub_sub_swap, sub_eq_neg_self, sub_eq_zero_of_eq single_zero_one.symm]

name: unit_aux
statement:
theorem unit_aux (x : R⟦Γ⟧) {r : R} (hr : r * x.leadingCoeff = 1)
    (oinv : Γ) (hxo : oinv + x.order = 0) :
    0 < (1 - single oinv r * x).orderTop
proof:
:= by
  let y := (x - single x.order x.leadingCoeff)
  by_cases hy : y = 0
  · have hrx : (single oinv) r * x = 1 := by
      rw [eq_of_sub_eq_zero hy, single_mul_single, hxo, hr, single_zero_one]
    simp only [hrx, sub_self, orderTop_zero, WithTop.top_pos]
  · have hr' : IsRegular r := IsUnit.isRegular <| .of_mul_eq_one x.leadingCoeff hr
    have hy' : 0 < (single oinv r * y).order := by
      rw [(order_single_mul_of_isRegular hr' hy)]
      refine pos_of_lt_add_right (a := x.order) ?_
      rw [← add_assoc, add_comm x.order, hxo, zero_add]
      exact order_lt_order_of_eq_add_single (sub_add_cancel x _).symm hy
    rw [one_minus_single_neg_mul hr (sub_add_cancel x _).symm _ hxo, orderTop_neg]
    exact zero_lt_orderTop_of_order hy'

name: isUnit_of_isUnit_leadingCoeff_AddUnitOrder
statement:
theorem isUnit_of_isUnit_leadingCoeff_AddUnitOrder {x : R⟦Γ⟧} (hx : IsUnit x.leadingCoeff)
    (hxo : IsAddUnit x.order) : IsUnit x
proof:
:= by
  let ⟨⟨u, i, ui, iu⟩, h⟩ := hx
  rw [Units.val_mk] at h
  rw [h] at iu
  have h' := SummableFamily.one_sub_self_mul_hsum_powers (unit_aux x iu _ hxo.addUnit.neg_add)
  rw [sub_sub_cancel] at h'
  exact isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_right (.of_mul_eq_one _ h')

name: isUnit_of_orderTop_pos
statement:
theorem isUnit_of_orderTop_pos {x : R⟦Γ⟧} (h : 0 < (x - 1).orderTop) :
    IsUnit x
proof:
:= by
  obtain _ | _ := subsingleton_or_nontrivial R
  · exact isUnit_of_subsingleton x
  · refine isUnit_of_isUnit_leadingCoeff_AddUnitOrder ?_ ?_
    · rw [(x.orderTop_self_sub_one_pos_iff.mp h).2]
      exact isUnit_one
    · have := (x.orderTop_self_sub_one_pos_iff.mp h).1
      rw [← order_eq_orderTop_of_ne_zero
        (fun h ↦ WithTop.top_ne_zero (orderTop_eq_top.mpr h ▸ this)), WithTop.coe_eq_zero] at this
      rw [this]
      exact isAddUnit_zero

name: isUnit_iff
statement: theorem isUnit_iff {x : R⟦Γ⟧} : IsUnit x ↔ IsUnit (x.leadingCoeff)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨u, i, ui, iu⟩, rfl⟩
    refine
      .of_mul_eq_one (i.leadingCoeff)
        ((coeff_mul_order_add_order u i).symm.trans ?_)
    rw [ui, coeff_one, ite_eq_left]
    rw [← order_mul (left_ne_zero_of_mul_eq_one ui) (right_ne_zero_of_mul_eq_one ui), ui, order_one]
  · rintro ⟨⟨u, i, ui, iu⟩, hx⟩
    rw [Units.val_mk] at hx
    rw [hx] at iu
    have h :=
      SummableFamily.one_sub_self_mul_hsum_powers (unit_aux x iu _ (neg_add_cancel x.order))
    rw [sub_sub_cancel] at h
    exact isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_right (.of_mul_eq_one _ h)

name: hahnEmbedding_isOrderedModule_rat
statement:
theorem hahnEmbedding_isOrderedModule_rat :
    ∃ f : M →ₗ[ℚ] Lex ℝ⟦FiniteArchimedeanClass M⟧, StrictMono f ∧
      ∀ a, .mk a = FiniteArchimedeanClass.withTopOrderIso M (ofLex (f a)).orderTop
proof:
:= by
  apply hahnEmbedding_isOrderedModule

name: hahnEmbedding_isOrderedAddMonoid
statement:
theorem hahnEmbedding_isOrderedAddMonoid :
    ∃ f : M →+o Lex ℝ⟦FiniteArchimedeanClass M⟧, Function.Injective f ∧
      ∀ a, .mk a = FiniteArchimedeanClass.withTopOrderIso M (ofLex (f a)).orderTop
proof:
:= by
  /-
  The desired embedding is the composition of three functions:

      Group type                                    `ArchimedeanClass` / `HahnSeries.orderTop` type

      `M`                                           `ArchimedeanClass M`
  `f₁` ↓+o                                           ↓o~
      `D-Hull M`                                    `ArchimedeanClass (D-Hull M)`
  `f₂` ↓+o                                           ↓o~
      `Lex ℝ⟦F-A-Class (D-Hull M)⟧`                 `WithTop (F-A-Class (D-Hull M))`
  `f₃` ↓+o(~)                                        ↓o~
      `Lex ℝ⟦F-A-Class M⟧`                          `WithTop (F-A-Class M)`
  -/
  let f₁ := DivisibleHull.coeOrderAddMonoidHom M
  have hf₁ : Function.Injective f₁ := DivisibleHull.coe_injective
  have hf₁class (a : M) : mk a = (DivisibleHull.archimedeanClassOrderIso M).symm (mk (f₁ a)) := by
    simp [f₁]
  obtain ⟨f₂', hf₂', hf₂class'⟩ := hahnEmbedding_isOrderedModule_rat (DivisibleHull M)
  let f₂ := OrderAddMonoidHom.mk f₂'.toAddMonoidHom hf₂'.monotone
  have hf₂ : Function.Injective f₂ := hf₂'.injective
  have hf₂class (a : DivisibleHull M) :
      mk a = (FiniteArchimedeanClass.withTopOrderIso (DivisibleHull M)) (ofLex (f₂ a)).orderTop :=
    hf₂class' a
  let f₃ : Lex ℝ⟦FiniteArchimedeanClass (DivisibleHull M)⟧ →+o Lex ℝ⟦FiniteArchimedeanClass M⟧ :=
    HahnSeries.embDomainOrderAddMonoidHom
    (FiniteArchimedeanClass.congrOrderIso (DivisibleHull.archimedeanClassOrderIso M).symm)
  have hf₃ : Function.Injective f₃ := HahnSeries.embDomainOrderAddMonoidHom_injective _
  have hf₃class (a : Lex ℝ⟦FiniteArchimedeanClass (DivisibleHull M)⟧) :
      (ofLex a).orderTop = OrderIso.withTopCongr
      ((FiniteArchimedeanClass.congrOrderIso (DivisibleHull.archimedeanClassOrderIso M)))
      (ofLex (f₃ a)).orderTop := by
    rw [← OrderIso.symm_apply_eq]
    simp [f₃, ← OrderIso.withTopCongr_symm]
  refine ⟨f₃.comp (f₂.comp f₁), hf₃.comp (hf₂.comp hf₁), ?_⟩
  intro a
  simp_rw [hf₁class, hf₂class, hf₃class, OrderAddMonoidHom.comp_apply]
  cases (ofLex (f₃ (f₂ (f₁ a)))).orderTop with
  | top => simp
  | coe x => simp [-DivisibleHull.archimedeanClassOrderIso_apply]

name: lt_iff
statement:
theorem lt_iff (a b : Lex R⟦Γ⟧) :
    a < b ↔ ∃ (i : Γ), (∀ (j : Γ), j < i → (ofLex a).coeff j = (ofLex b).coeff j)
    ∧ (ofLex a).coeff i < (ofLex b).coeff i
proof: := by rfl

name: leadingCoeff_pos_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leadingCoeff_pos_iff {x : Lex R⟦Γ⟧} : 0 < (ofLex x).leadingCoeff ↔ 0 < x
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_iff]
  constructor
  · intro hpos
    have hne : (ofLex x) ≠ 0 := leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mp hpos.ne.symm
    have htop : (ofLex x).orderTop ≠ ⊤ := orderTop_ne_top.2 hne
    refine ⟨(ofLex x).orderTop.untop htop, ?_, by simpa [coeff_untop_eq_leadingCoeff] using hpos⟩
    intro j hj
    simpa using (coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_orderTop ((WithTop.lt_untop_iff htop).mp hj)).symm
  · intro ⟨i, hj, hi⟩
    have horder : (ofLex x).orderTop = WithTop.some i := by
      apply orderTop_eq_of_le
      · simpa using hi.ne.symm
      · intro g hg
        contrapose! hg
        simpa using (hj g hg).symm
    have htop : (ofLex x).orderTop ≠ ⊤ := WithTop.ne_top_iff_exists.mpr ⟨i, horder.symm⟩
    have hne : ofLex x ≠ 0 := orderTop_ne_top.1 htop
    have horder' : (ofLex x).orderTop.untop htop = i := (WithTop.untop_eq_iff _).mpr horder
    rw [leadingCoeff_of_ne_zero hne, horder']
    simpa using hi

name: leadingCoeff_nonneg_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leadingCoeff_nonneg_iff {x : Lex R⟦Γ⟧} : 0 ≤ (ofLex x).leadingCoeff ↔ 0 ≤ x
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro h
  · obtain heq | hlt := h.eq_or_lt
    · exact le_of_eq (leadingCoeff_eq_zero.mp heq.symm).symm
    · exact (leadingCoeff_pos_iff.mp hlt).le
  · obtain rfl | hlt := h.eq_or_lt
    · simp
    · exact (leadingCoeff_pos_iff.mpr hlt).le

name: leadingCoeff_neg_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leadingCoeff_neg_iff {x : Lex R⟦Γ⟧} : (ofLex x).leadingCoeff < 0 ↔ x < 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [← not_le]

name: leadingCoeff_nonpos_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leadingCoeff_nonpos_iff {x : Lex R⟦Γ⟧} : (ofLex x).leadingCoeff ≤ 0 ↔ x ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [← not_lt]

name: support_abs
statement:
@[simp]
theorem support_abs (x : Lex R⟦Γ⟧) : (ofLex |x|).support = (ofLex x).support
proof:
:= by
  obtain hle | hge := le_total x 0
  · rw [abs_eq_neg_self.mpr hle]
    simp
  · rw [abs_eq_self.mpr hge]

name: orderTop_abs
statement:
@[simp]
theorem orderTop_abs (x : Lex R⟦Γ⟧) : (ofLex |x|).orderTop = (ofLex x).orderTop
proof:
:= by
  obtain hle | hge := le_total x 0
  · rw [abs_eq_neg_self.mpr hle, ofLex_neg, orderTop_neg]
  · rw [abs_eq_self.mpr hge]

name: order_abs
statement: theorem order_abs [Zero Γ] (x : Lex R⟦Γ⟧) : (ofLex |x|).order = (ofLex x).order
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hne := eq_or_ne x 0
  · simp
  · have hne' : ofLex x ≠ 0 := hne
    have habs : ofLex |x| ≠ 0 := by simpa using hne
    apply WithTop.coe_injective
    rw [order_eq_orderTop_of_ne_zero habs, order_eq_orderTop_of_ne_zero hne']
    apply orderTop_abs

name: leadingCoeff_abs
statement:
theorem leadingCoeff_abs (x : Lex R⟦Γ⟧) :
    (ofLex |x|).leadingCoeff = |(ofLex x).leadingCoeff|
proof:
:= by
  obtain hlt | rfl | hgt := lt_trichotomy x 0
  · obtain hlt' := leadingCoeff_neg_iff.mpr hlt
    rw [abs_eq_neg_self.mpr hlt.le, abs_eq_neg_self.mpr hlt'.le, ofLex_neg, leadingCoeff_neg]
  · simp
  · obtain hgt' := leadingCoeff_pos_iff.mpr hgt
    rw [abs_eq_self.mpr hgt.le, abs_eq_self.mpr hgt'.le]

name: abs_lt_abs_of_orderTop_ofLex
statement:
theorem abs_lt_abs_of_orderTop_ofLex {x y : Lex R⟦Γ⟧}
    (h : (ofLex y).orderTop < (ofLex x).orderTop) : |x| < |y|
proof:
:= by
  rw [← orderTop_abs x, ← orderTop_abs y] at h
  refine (lt_iff _ _).mpr ⟨(ofLex |y|).orderTop.untop h.ne_top, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp +contextual [-orderTop_abs, coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_orderTop, h.trans']
  · simpa [-orderTop_abs, coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_orderTop, coeff_untop_eq_leadingCoeff, h]
      using h.ne_top

name: archimedeanClassMk_le_archimedeanClassMk_iff_of_orderTop_ofLex
statement:
theorem archimedeanClassMk_le_archimedeanClassMk_iff_of_orderTop_ofLex {x y : Lex R⟦Γ⟧}
    (h : (ofLex x).orderTop = (ofLex y).orderTop) :
    ArchimedeanClass.mk x ≤ .mk y ↔
      ArchimedeanClass.mk (ofLex x).leadingCoeff ≤ .mk (ofLex y).leadingCoeff
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [ArchimedeanClass.mk_le_mk]
  obtain rfl | hy := eq_or_ne y 0
  · 
    simp_all
  
  have hx : x ≠ 0 := by simpa using orderTop_ne_top.1 <| h ▸ orderTop_ne_top.2 (by simpa using hy)
  have h' : (ofLex |x|).orderTop = (ofLex |y|).orderTop := by simpa using h
  constructor
  · 
    intro ⟨n, hn⟩
    refine ⟨n + 1, ?_⟩
    have hn' : |y| < (n + 1) • |x| :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt hn <| nsmul_lt_nsmul_left (by simpa using hx) (by simp)
    obtain ⟨j, hj, hi⟩ := (lt_iff _ _).mp hn'
    simp_rw [ofLex_smul, coeff_smul] at hj hi
    simp_rw [← leadingCoeff_abs]
    rw [leadingCoeff_of_ne_zero (by simpa using hy), leadingCoeff_of_ne_zero (by simpa using hx)]
    simp_rw [← h']
    obtain hjlt | hjeq | hjgt := lt_trichotomy (WithTop.some j) (ofLex |x|).orderTop
    · 
      have hjlt' : j < (ofLex |y|).orderTop := h'.symm ▸ hjlt
      simp [coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_orderTop hjlt, coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_orderTop hjlt'] at hi
    · convert! hi.le <;> exact (WithTop.untop_eq_iff _).mpr hjeq.symm
    · exact (hj _ ((WithTop.untop_lt_iff _).mpr hjgt)).le
  · 
    intro ⟨n, hn⟩
    refine ⟨n + 1, ((lt_iff _ _).mpr ?_).le⟩
    refine ⟨(ofLex x).orderTop.untop (by simpa using hx), ?_, ?_⟩
    · 
      intro j hj
      trans 0
      · apply coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_orderTop
        simpa [← h] using hj
      · suffices (ofLex |x|).coeff j = 0 by simp [this]
        apply coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_orderTop
        simpa using hj
    
    rw [ofLex_smul, coeff_smul]
    suffices |(ofLex y).leadingCoeff| < (n + 1) • |(ofLex x).leadingCoeff| by
      simp_rw [← leadingCoeff_abs] at this
      rw [leadingCoeff_of_ne_zero (by simpa using hy), leadingCoeff_of_ne_zero (by simpa using hx)]
        at this
      convert! this using 3 <;> simp [h]
    refine lt_of_le_of_lt hn <| nsmul_lt_nsmul_left ?_ (by simp)
    rwa [abs_pos, leadingCoeff_ne_zero]

name: archimedeanClassMk_le_archimedeanClassMk_iff
statement:
theorem archimedeanClassMk_le_archimedeanClassMk_iff {x y : Lex R⟦Γ⟧} :
    ArchimedeanClass.mk x ≤ .mk y ↔
      (ofLex x).orderTop < (ofLex y).orderTop ∨
        (ofLex x).orderTop = (ofLex y).orderTop ∧
          ArchimedeanClass.mk (ofLex x).leadingCoeff ≤ .mk (ofLex y).leadingCoeff
proof:
:= by
  obtain hlt | heq | hgt := lt_trichotomy (ofLex x).orderTop (ofLex y).orderTop
  · 
    simpa [ArchimedeanClass.mk_le_mk, hlt] using
      ⟨1, by simpa using (abs_lt_abs_of_orderTop_ofLex hlt).le⟩
  · 
    
    simpa [heq] using archimedeanClassMk_le_archimedeanClassMk_iff_of_orderTop_ofLex heq
  
  simp_rw [ArchimedeanClass.mk_le_mk]
  refine ⟨?_, by simp [hgt.not_gt, hgt.ne']⟩
  intro ⟨n, hn⟩
  contrapose! hn
  rw [← abs_nsmul]
  have hgt' : (ofLex y).orderTop < (ofLex (n • x)).orderTop := by
    apply lt_of_lt_of_le hgt
    simpa using orderTop_smul_not_lt n (ofLex x)
  exact abs_lt_abs_of_orderTop_ofLex hgt'

name: archimedeanClassMk_eq_archimedeanClassMk_iff
statement:
theorem archimedeanClassMk_eq_archimedeanClassMk_iff {x y : Lex R⟦Γ⟧} :
    ArchimedeanClass.mk x = ArchimedeanClass.mk y ↔
    (ofLex x).orderTop = (ofLex y).orderTop ∧
    ArchimedeanClass.mk (ofLex x).leadingCoeff = ArchimedeanClass.mk (ofLex y).leadingCoeff
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_antisymm_iff, archimedeanClassMk_le_archimedeanClassMk_iff,
    archimedeanClassMk_le_archimedeanClassMk_iff]
  constructor
  · simpa +contextual [or_imp, ne_of_gt, le_of_lt] using fun _ ↦ le_antisymm
  · intro ⟨horder, hcoeff⟩
    exact ⟨.inr ⟨horder, hcoeff.le⟩, .inr ⟨horder.symm, hcoeff.ge⟩⟩

name: ofPowerSeries_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofPowerSeries_C (r : R) : ofPowerSeries Γ R (PowerSeries.C r) = HahnSeries.C r
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  simp only [ofPowerSeries_apply, C, RingHom.coe_mk, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk,
    coeff_single]
  split_ifs with hn
  · subst hn
    convert! embDomain_coeff (a := 0) <;> simp
  · rw [embDomain_notin_image_support]
    simp only [not_exists, Set.mem_image, toPowerSeries_symm_apply_coeff, mem_support,
      PowerSeries.coeff_C]
    intro

name: min_le_min_add
statement:
protected theorem min_le_min_add {Γ} [LinearOrder Γ] {x y : R⟦Γ⟧} (hx : x ≠ 0)
    (hy : y ≠ 0) (hxy : x + y ≠ 0) :
    min (Set.IsWF.min x.isWF_support (support_nonempty_iff.2 hx))
      (Set.IsWF.min y.isWF_support (support_nonempty_iff.2 hy)) ≤
      Set.IsWF.min (x + y).isWF_support (support_nonempty_iff.2 hxy)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Set.IsWF.min_union]
  exact Set.IsWF.min_le_min_of_subset (support_add_subset (x := x) (y := y))

name: min_orderTop_le_orderTop_add
statement:
theorem min_orderTop_le_orderTop_add {Γ} [LinearOrder Γ] {x y : R⟦Γ⟧} :
    min x.orderTop y.orderTop ≤ (x + y).orderTop
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x = 0; · simp [hx]
  by_cases hy : y = 0; · simp [hy]
  by_cases hxy : x + y = 0; · simp [hxy]
  rw [orderTop_of_ne_zero hx, orderTop_of_ne_zero hy, orderTop_of_ne_zero hxy, ← WithTop.coe_min,
    WithTop.coe_le_coe]
  exact HahnSeries.min_le_min_add hx hy hxy

statement:
theorem min_order_le_order_add {Γ} [Zero Γ] [LinearOrder Γ] {x y : R⟦Γ⟧}

proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x = 0; · simp [hx]
  by_cases hy : y = 0; · simp [hy]
  rw [order_of_ne hx, order_of_ne hy, order_of_ne hxy]
  exact HahnSeries.min_le_min_add hx hy hxy

name: orderTop_add_eq_left
statement:
theorem orderTop_add_eq_left {Γ} [LinearOrder Γ] {x y : R⟦Γ⟧}
    (hxy : x.orderTop < y.orderTop) : (x + y).orderTop = x.orderTop
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x ≠ 0 := orderTop_ne_top.1 hxy.ne_top
  let g : Γ := Set.IsWF.min x.isWF_support (support_nonempty_iff.2 hx)
  have hcxyne : (x + y).coeff g ≠ 0 := by
    rw [coeff_add, coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_orderTop (lt_of_eq_of_lt (orderTop_of_ne_zero hx).symm hxy),
      add_zero]
    exact coeff_orderTop_ne (orderTop_of_ne_zero hx)
  have hxyx : (x + y).orderTop ≤ x.orderTop := by
    rw [orderTop_of_ne_zero hx]
    exact orderTop_le_of_coeff_ne_zero hcxyne
  exact le_antisymm hxyx (le_of_eq_of_le (min_eq_left_of_lt hxy).symm min_orderTop_le_orderTop_add)

name: orderTop_add_eq_right
statement:
theorem orderTop_add_eq_right {Γ} [LinearOrder Γ] {x y : R⟦Γ⟧}
    (hxy : y.orderTop < x.orderTop) : (x + y).orderTop = y.orderTop
proof:
:= by
  simpa [← map_add, ← AddOpposite.op_add, hxy] using orderTop_add_eq_left
    (x := addOppositeEquiv.symm (.op y))
    (y := addOppositeEquiv.symm (.op x))

name: leadingCoeff_add_eq_left
statement:
theorem leadingCoeff_add_eq_left {Γ} [LinearOrder Γ] {x y : R⟦Γ⟧}
    (hxy : x.orderTop < y.orderTop) : (x + y).leadingCoeff = x.leadingCoeff
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x ≠ 0 := orderTop_ne_top.1 hxy.ne_top
  have ho : (x + y).orderTop = x.orderTop := orderTop_add_eq_left hxy
  by_cases h : x + y = 0
  · rw [h, orderTop_zero] at ho
    rw [h, orderTop_eq_top.mp ho.symm]
  · simp_rw [leadingCoeff_of_ne_zero h, leadingCoeff_of_ne_zero hx, ho, coeff_add]
    rw [coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_orderTop (x := y) (by simpa using hxy), add_zero]

name: leadingCoeff_add_eq_right
statement:
theorem leadingCoeff_add_eq_right {Γ} [LinearOrder Γ] {x y : R⟦Γ⟧}
    (hxy : y.orderTop < x.orderTop) : (x + y).leadingCoeff = y.leadingCoeff
proof:
:= by
  simpa [← map_add, ← AddOpposite.op_add, hxy] using leadingCoeff_add_eq_left
    (x := addOppositeEquiv.symm (.op y))
    (y := addOppositeEquiv.symm (.op x))

name: ne_zero_of_eq_add_single
statement:
theorem ne_zero_of_eq_add_single [Zero Γ] {x y : R⟦Γ⟧}
    (hxy : x = y + single x.order x.leadingCoeff) (hy : y ≠ 0) : x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  simp only [h, order_zero, leadingCoeff_zero, map_zero, add_zero] at hxy
  exact hy hxy.symm

name: coeff_order_of_eq_add_single
statement:
theorem coeff_order_of_eq_add_single {R} [AddCancelCommMonoid R] [Zero Γ] {x y : R⟦Γ⟧}
    (hxy : x = y + single x.order x.leadingCoeff) : y.coeff x.order = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa [← leadingCoeff_eq] using congr(($hxy).coeff x.order)

name: order_lt_order_of_eq_add_single
statement:
theorem order_lt_order_of_eq_add_single {R} {Γ} [LinearOrder Γ] [Zero Γ] [AddCancelCommMonoid R]
    {x y : R⟦Γ⟧} (hxy : x = y + single x.order x.leadingCoeff) (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    x.order < y.order
proof:
:= by
  have : x.order ≠ y.order := by
    intro h
    have hyne : single y.order y.leadingCoeff ≠ 0 := single_ne_zero <| leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hy
    rw [leadingCoeff_eq, ← h, coeff_order_of_eq_add_single hxy, single_eq_zero] at hyne
    exact hyne rfl
  refine lt_of_le_of_ne ?_ this
  simp only [order, ne_zero_of_eq_add_single hxy hy, ↓reduceDIte, hy]
  refine Set.IsWF.min_le_min_of_subset fun g hg ↦ ?_
  obtain rfl | hgx := eq_or_ne g x.order
  · simpa using coeff_order_eq_zero.not.2 <| ne_zero_of_eq_add_single hxy hy
  · have : x.coeff g = (y + (single x.order) x.leadingCoeff).coeff g := by rw [← hxy]
    rw [coeff_add, coeff_single_of_ne hgx, add_zero] at this
    simpa [this] using hg

  have hx : x ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ by simp_all [orderTop_zero, WithTop.top_ne_coe]
  rw [orderTop_of_ne_zero hx, WithTop.coe_eq_coe] at hxg
  have hy : y ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ by simp_all [orderTop_zero, WithTop.top_ne_coe]

    untop_orderTop_of_ne_zero hy, hxg, hyg] at hxyc

name: support_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem support_one [MulZeroOneClass R] [Nontrivial R] : support (1 : R⟦Γ⟧) = {0}
proof:
:=
  support_single_of_ne one_ne_zero

name: orderTop_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem orderTop_one [Zero R] [One R] [NeZero (1 : R)] : orderTop (1 : R⟦Γ⟧) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← single_zero_one, orderTop_single one_ne_zero, WithTop.coe_eq_zero]

name: order_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem order_one [MulZeroOneClass R] : order (1 : R⟦Γ⟧) = 0
proof:

  cases subsingleton_or_nontrivial R
  · rw [Subsingleton.elim (1 : R⟦Γ⟧) 0, order_zero]
  · exact order_single one_ne_zero

name: leadingCoeff_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leadingCoeff_one [MulZeroOneClass R] : (1 : R⟦Γ⟧).leadingCoeff = 1

name: map_one
statement:
@[simp]
protected lemma map_one [MonoidWithZero R] [MonoidWithZero S] (f : R →*₀ S) :

proof:
:=
  HahnSeries.map_single (a := (0 : Γ)) f.toZeroHom |>.trans <| congrArg _ <| f.map_one

name: ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem ext (x y : HahnModule Γ R V) (h : ((of R).symm x).coeff = ((of R).symm y).coeff) : x = y
proof:
:=
  (of R).symm.injective <| HahnSeries.coeff_inj.1 h

name: of_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem of_zero [Zero V] : of R (0 : V⟦Γ⟧) = 0

@[simp] theorem of_add [AddCommMonoid V] (x y : V⟦Γ⟧) :

@[simp] theorem of_sub [AddCommGroup V] (x y : V⟦Γ⟧) :

name: coeff_smul
statement:
theorem coeff_smul (x : R⟦Γ⟧) (y : HahnModule Γ' R V) (a : Γ') :
    ((of R).symm <| x • y).coeff a =
      ∑ ij ∈ VAddAntidiagonal a
        (Set.VAddAntidiagonal.finite_of_isPWO x.isPWO_support ((of R).symm y).isPWO_support a),
        x.coeff ij.fst • ((of R).symm y).coeff ij.snd
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: of_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem of_smul [SMulZeroClass R V] (r : R) (x : V⟦Γ⟧) :
    (of R) (r • x) = r • (of R) x
proof: := rfl

name: of_symm_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem of_symm_smul [SMulZeroClass R V] (r : R) (x : HahnModule Γ R V) :
    (of R).symm (r • x) = r • (of R).symm x
proof: := rfl

name: coeff_smul_right
statement:
theorem coeff_smul_right [SMulZeroClass R V] {x : R⟦Γ⟧} {y : HahnModule Γ' R V} {a : Γ'}
    {s : Set Γ'} (hs : s.IsPWO) (hys : ((of R).symm y).support ⊆ s) :
    ((of R).symm <| x • y).coeff a =
      ∑ ij ∈ VAddAntidiagonal a (Set.VAddAntidiagonal.finite_of_isPWO x.isPWO_support hs a),
        x.coeff ij.fst • ((of R).symm y).coeff ij.snd
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [coeff_smul]
  apply sum_subset_zero_on_sdiff (vaddAntidiagonal_mono_right _ _ _ hys) _ fun _ _ => rfl
  intro b hb
  simp only [not_and, mem_sdiff, mem_vaddAntidiagonal, HahnSeries.mem_support, not_imp_not] at hb
  rw [hb.2 hb.1.1 hb.1.2.2, smul_zero]

name: coeff_smul_left
statement:
theorem coeff_smul_left [SMulWithZero R V] {x : R⟦Γ⟧}
    {y : HahnModule Γ' R V} {a : Γ'} {s : Set Γ}
    (hs : s.IsPWO) (hxs : x.support ⊆ s) :
    ((of R).symm <| x • y).coeff a =
      ∑ ij ∈ VAddAntidiagonal a
      (Set.VAddAntidiagonal.finite_of_isPWO hs ((of R).symm y).isPWO_support a),
      x.coeff ij.fst • ((of R).symm y).coeff ij.snd
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [coeff_smul]
  apply sum_subset_zero_on_sdiff (vaddAntidiagonal_mono_left _ hxs _ _) _ fun _ _ => rfl
  intro b hb
  simp only [not_and', mem_sdiff, mem_vaddAntidiagonal, HahnSeries.mem_support, not_ne_iff] at hb
  rw [hb.2 ⟨hb.1.2.1, hb.1.2.2⟩, zero_smul]

name: smul_add
statement:
theorem smul_add [Zero R] [DistribSMul R V] (x : R⟦Γ⟧) (y z : HahnModule Γ' R V) :
    x • (y + z) = x • y + x • z
proof:
:= by
  ext k
  have hwf := ((of R).symm y).isPWO_support.union ((of R).symm z).isPWO_support
  rw [coeff_smul_right hwf, of_symm_add]
  · simp_all only [HahnSeries.coeff_add', Pi.add_apply, of_symm_add]
    rw [coeff_smul_right hwf Set.subset_union_right,
      coeff_smul_right hwf Set.subset_union_left]
    simp_all [sum_add_distrib]
  · intro b
    simp_all only [Set.isPWO_union, HahnSeries.isPWO_support, and_self, of_symm_add,
      HahnSeries.coeff_add', Pi.add_apply, ne_eq, Set.mem_union, HahnSeries.mem_support]
    contrapose!
    intro h
    rw [h.1, h.2, add_zero]

name: add_smul
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  have hwf := x.isPWO_support.union y.isPWO_support
  rw [coeff_smul_left hwf, HahnSeries.coeff_add', of_symm_add]
  · simp_all only [Pi.add_apply, HahnSeries.coeff_add']
    rw [coeff_smul_left hwf Set.subset_union_right,
      coeff_smul_left hwf Set.subset_union_left]
    simp only [sum_add_distrib]
  · exact support_add_subset _ _

name: coeff_single_smul_vadd
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hr : r = 0
  · simp_all only [map_zero, zero_smul, coeff_smul, HahnSeries.support_zero, HahnSeries.coeff_zero,
    sum_const_zero]
  simp only [hr, coeff_smul, coeff_smul, HahnSeries.support_single_of_ne, ne_eq, not_false_iff]
  by_cases hx : ((of R).symm x).coeff a = 0
  · simp only [hx, smul_zero]
    rw [sum_congr _ fun _ _ => rfl, sum_empty]
    ext ⟨a1, a2⟩
    simp only [notMem_empty, not_and, Set.mem_singleton_iff,
      mem_vaddAntidiagonal, iff_false]
    rintro rfl h2 h1
    rw [IsCancelVAdd.left_cancel a1 a2 a h1] at h2
    exact h2 hx
  trans ∑ ij ∈ {(b, a)},
    (HahnSeries.single b r).coeff ij.fst • ((of R).symm x).coeff ij.snd
  · apply sum_congr _ fun _ _ => rfl
    ext ⟨a1, a2⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff, Prod.mk_inj, mem_vaddAntidiagonal, mem_singleton]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨rfl, _, h1⟩
      exact ⟨rfl, IsCancelVAdd.left_cancel a1 a2 a h1⟩
    · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨rfl, by exact hx, rfl⟩
  · simp

name: coeff_single_zero_smul
statement:
theorem coeff_single_zero_smul {Γ} [AddCommMonoid Γ] [PartialOrder Γ] [AddAction Γ Γ']
    [IsOrderedCancelVAdd Γ Γ'] [MulZeroClass R] [SMulWithZero R V] {r : R}
    {x : HahnModule Γ' R V} {a : Γ'} :
    ((of R).symm ((HahnSeries.single 0 r : R⟦Γ⟧) • x)).coeff a =
    r • ((of R).symm x).coeff a
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 1 [← zero_vadd Γ a]
  exact coeff_single_smul_vadd

name: single_zero_smul_eq_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem single_zero_smul_eq_smul (Γ) [AddCommMonoid Γ] [PartialOrder Γ] [AddAction Γ Γ']
    [IsOrderedCancelVAdd Γ Γ'] [MulZeroClass R] [SMulWithZero R V] {r : R}
    {x : HahnModule Γ' R V} :
    (HahnSeries.single (0 : Γ) r) • x = r • x
proof:
:= by
  ext
  exact coeff_single_zero_smul

name: zero_smul'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero_smul' [Zero R] [SMulWithZero R V] {x : HahnModule Γ' R V} : (0 : R⟦Γ⟧) • x = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp [coeff_smul]

name: one_smul'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem one_smul' {Γ} [AddCommMonoid Γ] [PartialOrder Γ] [AddAction Γ Γ'] [IsOrderedCancelVAdd Γ Γ']
    [MonoidWithZero R] [MulActionWithZero R V] {x : HahnModule Γ' R V} : (1 : R⟦Γ⟧) • x = x
proof:
:= by
  ext g
  exact coeff_single_zero_smul.trans (one_smul R (x.coeff g))

name: support_smul_subset_vadd_support'
proof:
:= by
  refine Set.Subset.trans (fun x hx => ?_) (support_vaddAntidiagonal_subset_vadd
    fun a ↦ Set.VAddAntidiagonal.finite_of_isPWO x.isPWO_support ((of R).symm y).isPWO_support a)
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
  contrapose! hx
  simp [coeff_smul, hx]

name: support_smul_subset_vadd_support
proof:
:= by
  exact support_smul_subset_vadd_support'

name: orderTop_vAdd_le_orderTop_smul
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x = 0; · simp_all
  by_cases hy : y = 0; · simp_all
  have hhy : ((of R).symm y) ≠ 0 := hy
  rw [HahnSeries.orderTop_of_ne_zero hx, HahnSeries.orderTop_of_ne_zero hhy, ← h,
      ← Set.IsWF.min_vadd]
  by_cases hxy : (of R).symm (x • y) = 0
  · rw [hxy, HahnSeries.orderTop_zero]
    exact OrderTop.le_top (α := WithTop Γ') _
  · rw [HahnSeries.orderTop_of_ne_zero hxy, WithTop.coe_le_coe]
    exact Set.IsWF.min_le_min_of_subset support_smul_subset_vadd_support

name: coeff_smul_order_add_order
statement:
theorem coeff_smul_order_add_order {Γ}
    [AddCommMonoid Γ] [LinearOrder Γ] [IsOrderedCancelAddMonoid Γ] [Zero R]
    [SMulWithZero R V] (x : R⟦Γ⟧) (y : HahnModule Γ R V) :
    ((of R).symm (x • y)).coeff (x.order + ((of R).symm y).order) =
    x.leadingCoeff • ((of R).symm y).leadingCoeff
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x = (0 : R⟦Γ⟧); · simp [HahnSeries.coeff_zero, hx]
  by_cases hy : (of R).symm y = 0; · simp [hy, coeff_smul]
  rw [HahnSeries.order_of_ne hx, HahnSeries.order_of_ne hy, coeff_smul,
    HahnSeries.leadingCoeff_of_ne_zero hx, HahnSeries.leadingCoeff_of_ne_zero hy, ← vadd_eq_add,
    Finset.vaddAntidiagonal_min_vadd_min, Finset.sum_singleton]
  simp [HahnSeries.orderTop, hx, hy]

name: of_symm_smul_of_eq_mul
statement:
theorem of_symm_smul_of_eq_mul [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring R] {x y : R⟦Γ⟧} :
    (HahnModule.of R).symm (x • HahnModule.of R y) = x * y
proof: := rfl

name: coeff_mul
statement:
theorem coeff_mul [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring R] {x y : R⟦Γ⟧} {a : Γ} :
    (x * y).coeff a =
      ∑ ij ∈ antidiagonal x.isPWO_support y.isPWO_support a, x.coeff ij.fst * y.coeff ij.snd
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: map_mul
statement:
protected lemma map_mul [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring R] [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring S] (f : R →ₙ+* S)
    {x y : R⟦Γ⟧} : (x * y).map f = (x.map f : S⟦Γ⟧) * (y.map f)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp only [map_coeff, coeff_mul, map_sum, map_mul]
  refine Eq.symm (sum_subset (fun gh hgh => ?_) (fun gh hgh hz => ?_))
  · simp_all only [mem_antidiagonal, mem_support, map_coeff, ne_eq, and_true]
    exact ⟨fun h => hgh.1 (map_zero f ▸ congrArg f h), fun h => hgh.2.1 (map_zero f ▸ congrArg f h)⟩
  · simp_all only [mem_antidiagonal, mem_support, ne_eq, map_coeff, and_true,
      not_and, not_not]
    by_cases h : f (x.coeff gh.1) = 0
    · exact mul_eq_zero_of_left h (f (y.coeff gh.2))
    · exact mul_eq_zero_of_right (f (x.coeff gh.1)) (hz h)

name: coeff_mul_left'
statement:
theorem coeff_mul_left' [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring R] {x y : R⟦Γ⟧} {a : Γ} {s : Set Γ}
    (hs : s.IsPWO) (hxs : x.support ⊆ s) :
    (x * y).coeff a =
      ∑ ij ∈ antidiagonal hs y.isPWO_support a, x.coeff ij.fst * y.coeff ij.snd
proof:
:=
  HahnModule.coeff_smul_left hs hxs

name: coeff_mul_right'
statement:
theorem coeff_mul_right' [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring R] {x y : R⟦Γ⟧} {a : Γ} {s : Set Γ}
    (hs : s.IsPWO) (hys : y.support ⊆ s) :
    (x * y).coeff a =
      ∑ ij ∈ antidiagonal x.isPWO_support hs a, x.coeff ij.fst * y.coeff ij.snd
proof:
:=
  HahnModule.coeff_smul_right hs hys

name: coeff_single_mul_add
statement:
theorem coeff_single_mul_add [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring R] {r : R} {x : R⟦Γ⟧} {a : Γ}
    {b : Γ} : (single b r * x).coeff (a + b) = r * x.coeff a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← of_symm_smul_of_eq_mul, add_comm, ← vadd_eq_add]
  exact HahnModule.coeff_single_smul_vadd

name: coeff_mul_single_add
statement:
theorem coeff_mul_single_add [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring R] {r : R} {x : R⟦Γ⟧} {a : Γ}
    {b : Γ} : (x * single b r).coeff (a + b) = x.coeff a * r
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hr : r = 0
  · simp [hr, coeff_mul]
  simp only [hr, coeff_mul, support_single_of_ne, Ne, not_false_iff]
  by_cases hx : x.coeff a = 0
  · simp only [hx, zero_mul]
    rw [sum_congr _ fun _ _ => rfl, sum_empty]
    ext ⟨a1, a2⟩
    simp only [notMem_empty, not_and, Set.mem_singleton_iff,
      mem_antidiagonal, iff_false]
    rintro h2 rfl h1
    rw [← add_right_cancel h1] at hx
    exact h2 hx
  trans ∑ ij ∈ {(a, b)}, x.coeff ij.fst * (single b r).coeff ij.snd
  · apply sum_congr _ fun _ _ => rfl
    ext ⟨a1, a2⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff, Prod.mk_inj, mem_antidiagonal, mem_singleton]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨_, rfl, h1⟩
      exact ⟨add_right_cancel h1, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      simp [hx]
  · simp

name: coeff_single_mul
statement:
theorem coeff_single_mul [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring R] [PartialOrder Γ'] [AddCommGroup Γ']
    [IsOrderedAddMonoid Γ'] {r : R} {x : R⟦Γ'⟧} {a b : Γ'} :
    (single b r * x).coeff a = r * x.coeff (a - b)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using coeff_single_mul_add (a := a - b) (b := b)

name: coeff_mul_single
statement:
theorem coeff_mul_single [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring R] [PartialOrder Γ'] [AddCommGroup Γ']
    [IsOrderedAddMonoid Γ'] {r : R} {x : R⟦Γ'⟧} {a b : Γ'} :
    (x * single b r).coeff a = x.coeff (a - b) * r
proof:
:= by
  simpa using coeff_mul_single_add (a := a - b) (b := b)

name: coeff_mul_single_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_mul_single_zero [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring R] {r : R} {x : R⟦Γ⟧} {a : Γ} :
    (x * single 0 r).coeff a = x.coeff a * r
proof: := by rw [← add_zero a, coeff_mul_single_add, add_zero]

name: coeff_single_zero_mul
statement:
theorem coeff_single_zero_mul [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring R] {r : R} {x : R⟦Γ⟧} {a : Γ} :
    ((single 0 r : R⟦Γ⟧) * x).coeff a = r * x.coeff a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← add_zero a, coeff_single_mul_add, add_zero]

name: single_zero_mul_eq_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem single_zero_mul_eq_smul [Semiring R] {r : R} {x : R⟦Γ⟧} : single 0 r * x = r • x
proof:
:= by
  ext
  exact coeff_single_zero_mul

name: support_mul_subset
statement:
theorem support_mul_subset [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring R] {x y : R⟦Γ⟧} :
    support (x * y) ⊆ support x + support y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← of_symm_smul_of_eq_mul, ← vadd_eq_add]
  exact HahnModule.support_smul_subset_vadd_support

name: coeff_mul_order_add_order
statement:
theorem coeff_mul_order_add_order (x y : R⟦Γ⟧) :
    (x * y).coeff (x.order + y.order) = x.leadingCoeff * y.leadingCoeff
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← of_symm_smul_of_eq_mul]
  exact HahnModule.coeff_smul_order_add_order x y

name: orderTop_mul_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem orderTop_mul_of_ne_zero {x y : R⟦Γ⟧} (h : x.leadingCoeff * y.leadingCoeff ≠ 0) :
    (x * y).orderTop = x.orderTop + y.orderTop
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x = 0; · simp [hx]
  by_cases hy : y = 0; · simp [hy]
  have : (x * y).coeff (x.order + y.order) ≠ 0 := by rwa [coeff_mul_order_add_order x y]
  have hxy : x * y ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ (by simp [h] at this)
  rw [← order_eq_orderTop_of_ne_zero hx, ← order_eq_orderTop_of_ne_zero hy,
    ← order_eq_orderTop_of_ne_zero hxy, ← WithTop.coe_add, WithTop.coe_eq_coe]
  refine le_antisymm (order_le_of_coeff_ne_zero this) ?_
  rw [HahnSeries.order_of_ne hx, HahnSeries.order_of_ne hy, HahnSeries.order_of_ne hxy,
    ← Set.IsWF.min_add]
  exact Set.IsWF.min_le_min_of_subset support_mul_subset

name: orderTop_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem orderTop_mul (x y : R⟦Γ⟧) [NoZeroDivisors R] :
    (x * y).orderTop = x.orderTop + y.orderTop
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x = 0; · simp [hx]
  by_cases hy : y = 0; · simp [hy]
  apply orderTop_mul_of_ne_zero
  simp_all

name: orderTop_add_le_mul
statement: theorem orderTop_add_le_mul {x y : R⟦Γ⟧} : x.orderTop + y.orderTop ≤ (x * y).orderTop
proof:
:= by
  rw [← smul_eq_mul]
  exact HahnModule.orderTop_vAdd_le_orderTop_smul fun i j : Γ ↦ rfl

name: order_mul_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem order_mul_of_ne_zero {x y : R⟦Γ⟧}
    (h : x.leadingCoeff * y.leadingCoeff ≠ 0) : (x * y).order = x.order + y.order
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x.leadingCoeff ≠ 0 := by aesop
  have hy : y.leadingCoeff ≠ 0 := by aesop
  have hxy : (x * y).coeff (x.order + y.order) ≠ 0 :=
    ne_of_eq_of_ne (coeff_mul_order_add_order x y) h
  refine le_antisymm (order_le_of_coeff_ne_zero
    (Eq.mpr (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a ≠ 0) (coeff_mul_order_add_order x y)) h)) ?_
  rw [order_of_ne <| leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mp hx, order_of_ne <| leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mp hy,
    order_of_ne <| ne_zero_of_coeff_ne_zero hxy, ← Set.IsWF.min_add]
  exact Set.IsWF.min_le_min_of_subset support_mul_subset

name: leadingCoeff_mul_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem leadingCoeff_mul_of_ne_zero {x y : R⟦Γ⟧} (h : x.leadingCoeff * y.leadingCoeff ≠ 0) :
    (x * y).leadingCoeff = x.leadingCoeff * y.leadingCoeff
proof:
:= by
  simp only [leadingCoeff_eq, order_mul_of_ne_zero h, coeff_mul_order_add_order]

name: leadingCoeff_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leadingCoeff_mul (x y : R⟦Γ⟧) [NoZeroDivisors R] :
    (x * y).leadingCoeff = x.leadingCoeff * y.leadingCoeff
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x = 0; · simp [hx]
  by_cases hy : y = 0; · simp [hy]
  apply leadingCoeff_mul_of_ne_zero
  simp_all

name: order_single_mul_of_isRegular
statement:
theorem order_single_mul_of_isRegular {g : Γ} {r : R} (hr : IsRegular r)
    {x : R⟦Γ⟧} (hx : x ≠ 0) : (((single g) r) * x).order = g + x.order
proof:
:= by
  obtain _ | _ := subsingleton_or_nontrivial R
  · exact (hx <| Subsingleton.eq_zero x).elim
  have hrx : ((single g) r).leadingCoeff * x.leadingCoeff ≠ 0 := by
    rwa [leadingCoeff_of_single, ne_eq, hr.left.mul_left_eq_zero_iff, leadingCoeff_eq_zero]
  rw [order_mul_of_ne_zero hrx, order_single <| IsRegular.ne_zero hr]

name: mul_assoc'
statement: private theorem mul_assoc' [NonUnitalSemiring R] (x y z : R⟦Γ⟧) : x * y * z = x * (y * z)
proof:
:= by
  ext b
  rw [coeff_mul_left' (x.isPWO_support.add y.isPWO_support) support_mul_subset,
    coeff_mul_right' (y.isPWO_support.add z.isPWO_support) support_mul_subset]
  simp only [coeff_mul, sum_mul, mul_sum, sum_sigma']
  apply Finset.sum_nbij' (fun ⟨⟨_i, j⟩, ⟨k, l⟩⟩ ↦ ⟨(k, l + j), (l, j)⟩)
    (fun ⟨⟨i, _j⟩, ⟨k, l⟩⟩ ↦ ⟨(i + k, l), (i, k)⟩) <;>
    aesop (add safe Set.add_mem_add) (add simp [add_assoc, mul_assoc])

name: orderTop_nsmul_le_orderTop_pow
statement:
theorem orderTop_nsmul_le_orderTop_pow [AddCommMonoid Γ] [LinearOrder Γ]
    [IsOrderedCancelAddMonoid Γ] [Semiring R] {x : R⟦Γ⟧} {n : ℕ} :
    n • x.orderTop ≤ (x ^ n).orderTop
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    simp only [zero_smul, pow_zero]
    by_cases h : NeZero (1 : R)
    · simp
    · have : Subsingleton R := not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton.mp fun _ ↦ h NeZero.one
      simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [add_nsmul, pow_add]
    calc
      n • x.orderTop + 1 • x.orderTop ≤ (x ^ n).orderTop + 1 • x.orderTop := by gcongr
      (x ^ n).orderTop + 1 • x.orderTop = (x ^ n).orderTop + x.orderTop := by rw [one_nsmul]
      (x ^ n).orderTop + x.orderTop ≤ (x ^ n * x).orderTop := orderTop_add_le_mul
      (x ^ n * x).orderTop ≤ (x ^ n * x ^ 1).orderTop := by rw [pow_one]

name: orderTop_self_sub_one_pos_iff
statement:
theorem orderTop_self_sub_one_pos_iff [LinearOrder Γ] [Zero Γ] [NonAssocRing R] [Nontrivial R]
    (x : R⟦Γ⟧) :
    0 < (x - 1).orderTop ↔ x.orderTop = 0 ∧ x.leadingCoeff = 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    constructor
    · rw [← sub_add_cancel x 1, add_comm, ← orderTop_one (R := R)]
      exact orderTop_add_eq_left (Γ := Γ) (R := R) (orderTop_one (R := R) (Γ := Γ) ▸ hx)
    · rw [← sub_add_cancel x 1, add_comm, ← leadingCoeff_one (Γ := Γ) (R := R)]
      exact leadingCoeff_add_eq_left (Γ := Γ) (R := R) (orderTop_one (R := R) (Γ := Γ) ▸ hx)
  · intro h
    refine lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_eq_of_le (by simp_all)
      (min_orderTop_le_orderTop_sub (Γ := Γ) (R := R))) <| Ne.symm <|
      orderTop_sub_ne h.1 orderTop_one ?_
    rw [h.2, leadingCoeff_one]

name: orderTop_sub_pos
statement:
theorem orderTop_sub_pos [PartialOrder Γ] [Zero Γ] [AddCommGroup R] [One R] {g : Γ} (hg : 0 < g)
    (r : R) :
    0 < ((1 + single g r) - 1).orderTop
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hr : r = 0 <;> simp [hr, hg]

name: mem_orderTopSubOnePos_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_orderTopSubOnePos_iff [LinearOrder Γ] [AddCommMonoid Γ] [IsOrderedCancelAddMonoid Γ]
    [CommRing R] (x : R⟦Γ⟧ˣ) :
    x ∈ orderTopSubOnePos Γ R ↔ 0 < (x.val - 1).orderTop
proof: := .rfl

name: mul_smul'
statement:
private theorem mul_smul' [Semiring R] [Module R V] (x y : R⟦Γ⟧)
    (z : HahnModule Γ' R V) : (x * y) • z = x • (y • z)
proof:
:= by
  ext b
  rw [coeff_smul_left (x.isPWO_support.add y.isPWO_support)
    HahnSeries.support_mul_subset, coeff_smul_right
    (y.isPWO_support.vadd ((of R).symm z).isPWO_support) support_smul_subset_vadd_support]
  simp only [HahnSeries.coeff_mul, coeff_smul, sum_smul, smul_sum, sum_sigma']
  apply Finset.sum_nbij' (fun ⟨⟨_i, j⟩, ⟨k, l⟩⟩ ↦ ⟨(k, l +ᵥ j), (l, j)⟩)
    (fun ⟨⟨i, _j⟩, ⟨k, l⟩⟩ ↦ ⟨(i + k, l), (i, k)⟩) <;>
    aesop (add safe [Set.vadd_mem_vadd, Set.add_mem_add]) (add simp [add_vadd, mul_smul])

name: single_mul_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem single_mul_single {a b : Γ} {r s : R} :
    single a r * single b s = single (a + b) (r * s)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  by_cases h : x = a + b
  · rw [h, coeff_mul_single_add]
    simp
  · rw [coeff_single_of_ne h, coeff_mul, sum_eq_zero]
    simp_rw [mem_antidiagonal]
    rintro ⟨y, z⟩ ⟨hy, hz, rfl⟩
    rw [eq_of_mem_support_single hy, eq_of_mem_support_single hz] at h
    exact (h rfl).elim

name: single_pow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem single_pow (a : Γ) (n : ℕ) (r : R) : single a r ^ n = single (n • a) (r ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => ext; simp only [pow_zero, coeff_one, zero_smul, coeff_single]
  | succ n IH => rw [pow_succ, pow_succ, IH, single_mul_single, succ_nsmul]

name: C_zero

name: map_C
statement:
theorem map_C [NonAssocSemiring S] (a : R) (f : R →+* S) :

proof:

name: C_injective
statement: theorem C_injective : Function.Injective (C : R → R⟦Γ⟧)
proof:
:= by
  intro r s rs
  rw [HahnSeries.ext_iff, funext_iff] at rs
  have h := rs 0
  rwa [C_apply, coeff_single_same, C_apply, coeff_single_same] at h

name: C_ne_zero
statement: theorem C_ne_zero {r : R} (h : r ≠ 0) : (C r : R⟦Γ⟧) ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  C_injective.ne_iff' C_zero |>.mpr h

name: order_C
statement: theorem order_C {r : R} : order (C r : R⟦Γ⟧) = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : r = 0
  · rw [h, C_zero, order_zero]
  · exact order_single h

name: C_mul_eq_smul
statement: theorem C_mul_eq_smul {r : R} {x : R⟦Γ⟧} : C r * x = r • x
proof:
:=
  single_zero_mul_eq_smul

name: embDomain_mul
statement:
theorem embDomain_mul [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring R] (f : Γ ↪o Γ')
    (hf : ∀ x y, f (x + y) = f x + f y) (x y : R⟦Γ⟧) :
    embDomain f (x * y) = embDomain f x * embDomain f y
proof:
:= by
  ext g
  by_cases hg : g ∈ Set.range f
  · obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := hg
    simp only [coeff_mul, embDomain_coeff]
    trans
      ∑ ij ∈
        (antidiagonal x.isPWO_support y.isPWO_support g).map
          (f.toEmbedding.prodMap f.toEmbedding),
        (embDomain f x).coeff ij.1 * (embDomain f y).coeff ij.2
    · simp
    apply sum_subset
    · rintro ⟨i, j⟩ hij
      simp only [mem_map, mem_antidiagonal,
        Function.Embedding.coe_prodMap, mem_support, Prod.exists] at hij
      obtain ⟨i, j, ⟨hx, hy, rfl⟩, rfl, rfl⟩ := hij
      simp [hx, hy, hf]
    · rintro ⟨_, _⟩ h1 h2
      contrapose! h2
      obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := support_embDomain_subset (ne_zero_and_ne_zero_of_mul h2).1
      obtain ⟨j, _, rfl⟩ := support_embDomain_subset (ne_zero_and_ne_zero_of_mul h2).2
      simp only [mem_map, mem_antidiagonal,
        Function.Embedding.coe_prodMap, mem_support, Prod.exists]
      simp only [mem_antidiagonal, embDomain_coeff, mem_support, ← hf,
        OrderEmbedding.eq_iff_eq] at h1
      exact ⟨i, j, h1, rfl⟩
  · rw [embDomain_of_notMem_range hg, eq_comm]
    contrapose! hg
    obtain ⟨_, hi, _, hj, rfl⟩ := support_mul_subset ((mem_support _ _).2 hg)
    obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := support_embDomain_subset hi
    obtain ⟨j, _, rfl⟩ := support_embDomain_subset hj
    exact ⟨i + j, hf i j⟩

name: embDomain_one
statement:
theorem embDomain_one [NonAssocSemiring R] (f : Γ ↪o Γ') (hf : f 0 = 0) :
    embDomain f (1 : R⟦Γ⟧) = (1 : R⟦Γ'⟧)
proof:
:=
  embDomain_single.trans <| hf.symm ▸ rfl

name: embDomainRingHom_C
statement:
theorem embDomainRingHom_C [NonAssocSemiring R] {f : Γ →+ Γ'} {hfi : Function.Injective f}
    {hf : ∀ g g' : Γ, f g ≤ f g' ↔ g ≤ g'} {r : R} : embDomainRingHom f hfi hf (C r) = C r
proof:
:=
  embDomain_single.trans (by simp)

name: order_mul
statement:
@[simp]
lemma order_mul (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) : (x * y).order = x.order + y.order
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply order_le_of_coeff_ne_zero
    simp [coeff_mul_order_add_order x y, *]
  · rw [order_of_ne hx, order_of_ne hy, order_of_ne (mul_ne_zero hx hy), ← Set.IsWF.min_add]
    exact Set.IsWF.min_le_min_of_subset support_mul_subset

name: order_pow
statement:
@[simp] lemma order_pow [NoZeroDivisors R] (x : R⟦Γ⟧) : ∀ n, (x ^ n).order = n • x.order
  | 0 => by simp
  | n + 1 => by
    obtain rfl | hx
proof: := eq_or_ne x 0 <;> simp [pow_succ, succ_nsmul, order_pow, pow_ne_zero, *]

name: coeff_injective

name: orderTop_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem orderTop_zero : orderTop (0 : R⟦Γ⟧) = ⊤
proof:
:=
  dite_eq_left rfl

name: orderTop_of_subsingleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem orderTop_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton R] : x.orderTop = ⊤
proof:
:=
  (Subsingleton.eq_zero x) ▸ orderTop_zero

name: orderTop_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem orderTop_of_ne_zero (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    orderTop x = x.isWF_support.min (support_nonempty_iff.2 hx)
proof:
:=
  dite_eq_right hx

name: orderTop_eq_top
statement: @[simp] lemma orderTop_eq_top : orderTop x = ⊤ ↔ x = 0
proof: := by simp [orderTop]

name: orderTop_lt_top
statement: @[simp] lemma orderTop_lt_top : orderTop x < ⊤ ↔ x ≠ 0
proof: := by simp [lt_top_iff_ne_top]
