name: ValueGroupWithZero.mk_eq_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ValueGroupWithZero.mk_eq_zero (x : R) (y : posSubmonoid R) :
    ValueGroupWithZero.mk x y = 0 ↔ x ≤ᵥ 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by simpa using ValueGroupWithZero.mk_eq_mk.mp h,
    fun h => ValueGroupWithZero.sound (by simpa using h) (by simp)⟩

name: ValueGroupWithZero.mk_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ValueGroupWithZero.mk_zero (x : posSubmonoid R) : ValueGroupWithZero.mk 0 x = 0
proof:
:=
  (ValueGroupWithZero.mk_eq_zero 0 x).mpr .rfl

name: ValueGroupWithZero.mk_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ValueGroupWithZero.mk_self (x : posSubmonoid R) : ValueGroupWithZero.mk (x : R) x = 1
proof:
:=
  ValueGroupWithZero.sound (by simp) (by simp)

name: ValueGroupWithZero.mk_one_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ValueGroupWithZero.mk_one_one : ValueGroupWithZero.mk (1 : R) 1 = 1
proof:
:=
  ValueGroupWithZero.sound (by simp) (by simp)

name: ValueGroupWithZero.mk_eq_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ValueGroupWithZero.mk_eq_one (x : R) (y : posSubmonoid R) :
    ValueGroupWithZero.mk x y = 1 ↔ x ≤ᵥ y ∧ y ≤ᵥ x
proof:
:= by
  simp [← mk_one_one, mk_eq_mk]

name: ValueGroupWithZero.lift_zero
statement:
theorem ValueGroupWithZero.lift_zero {α : Sort*} (f : R → posSubmonoid R → α)
    (hf : ∀ (x y : R) (t s : posSubmonoid R), x * t ≤ᵥ y * s → y * s ≤ᵥ x * t → f x s = f y t) :
    ValueGroupWithZero.lift f hf 0 = f 0 1
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: ValueGroupWithZero.lift_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ValueGroupWithZero.lift_one {α : Sort*} (f : R → posSubmonoid R → α)
    (hf : ∀ (x y : R) (t s : posSubmonoid R), x * t ≤ᵥ y * s → y * s ≤ᵥ x * t → f x s = f y t) :
    ValueGroupWithZero.lift f hf 1 = f 1 1
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: ValueGroupWithZero.mk_mul_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ValueGroupWithZero.mk_mul_mk (a b : R) (c d : posSubmonoid R) :
    ValueGroupWithZero.mk a c * ValueGroupWithZero.mk b d = ValueGroupWithZero.mk (a * b) (c * d)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: ValueGroupWithZero.lift_mul
statement:
theorem ValueGroupWithZero.lift_mul {α : Type*} [Mul α] (f : R → posSubmonoid R → α)
    (hf : ∀ (x y : R) (t s : posSubmonoid R), x * t ≤ᵥ y * s → y * s ≤ᵥ x * t → f x s = f y t)
    (hdist : ∀ (a b r s), f (a * b) (r * s) = f a r * f b s)
    (a b : ValueGroupWithZero R) :
    ValueGroupWithZero.lift f hf (a * b) =
      ValueGroupWithZero.lift f hf a * ValueGroupWithZero.lift f hf b
proof:
:= by
  induction a using ValueGroupWithZero.ind
  induction b using ValueGroupWithZero.ind
  simpa using hdist _ _ _ _

name: ValueGroupWithZero.mk_le_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ValueGroupWithZero.mk_le_mk (x y : R) (t s : posSubmonoid R) :
    ValueGroupWithZero.mk x t ≤ ValueGroupWithZero.mk y s ↔ x * s ≤ᵥ y * t
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: ValueGroupWithZero.mk_lt_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ValueGroupWithZero.mk_lt_mk (x y : R) (t s : posSubmonoid R) :
    ValueGroupWithZero.mk x t < ValueGroupWithZero.mk y s ↔ x * s <ᵥ y * t
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_iff_not_ge, ← not_vle, mk_le_mk]

name: ValueGroupWithZero.mk_pos
statement:
@[simp]
lemma ValueGroupWithZero.mk_pos {s : posSubmonoid R} :
    0 < ValueGroupWithZero.mk x s ↔ 0 <ᵥ x
proof: := by rw [← mk_zero 1]; simp [-mk_zero]

name: ValueGroupWithZero.bot_eq_zero
statement: theorem ValueGroupWithZero.bot_eq_zero : (⊥ : ValueGroupWithZero R) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: ValueGroupWithZero.inv_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ValueGroupWithZero.inv_mk (x : R) (y : posSubmonoid R) (hx : ¬x ≤ᵥ 0) :
    (ValueGroupWithZero.mk x y)⁻¹ = ValueGroupWithZero.mk (y : R) ⟨x, hx⟩
proof: := dite_eq_right hx

name: ValueGroupWithZero.lift_valuation
statement:
@[simp]
lemma ValueGroupWithZero.lift_valuation {α : Sort*} (f : R → posSubmonoid R → α)
    (hf : ∀ (x y : R) (t s : posSubmonoid R), x * t ≤ᵥ y * s → y * s ≤ᵥ x * t → f x s = f y t)
    (x : R) :
    ValueGroupWithZero.lift f hf (valuation R x) = f x 1
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: valuation_eq_zero_iff
statement: lemma valuation_eq_zero_iff : valuation R x = 0 ↔ x ≤ᵥ 0
proof:
:=
  ValueGroupWithZero.mk_eq_zero _ _

name: valuation_posSubmonoid_ne_zero
statement:
lemma valuation_posSubmonoid_ne_zero (x : posSubmonoid R) :
    valuation R (x : R) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ne_eq, valuation_eq_zero_iff]
  exact x.prop

name: ValueGroupWithZero.mk_eq_div
statement:
lemma ValueGroupWithZero.mk_eq_div (r : R) (s : posSubmonoid R) :
    ValueGroupWithZero.mk r s = valuation R r / valuation R (s : R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_div_iff (valuation_posSubmonoid_ne_zero _)]
  simp [valuation, mk_eq_mk]

name: _root_.Valuation.Compatible.ofValuation
statement:
lemma _root_.Valuation.Compatible.ofValuation
    {S Γ : Type*} [Ring S]
    [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ]
    (v : Valuation S Γ) :
    letI
proof:
:= ValuativeRel.ofValuation v  
    Valuation.Compatible v :=
  letI := ValuativeRel.ofValuation v
  ⟨fun _ _ ↦ Iff.rfl⟩

name: isEquiv
statement:
lemma isEquiv {Γ₁ Γ₂ : Type*}
    [LinearOrderedCommMonoidWithZero Γ₁]
    [LinearOrderedCommMonoidWithZero Γ₂]
    (v₁ : Valuation R Γ₁)
    (v₂ : Valuation R Γ₂)
    [v₁.Compatible] [v₂.Compatible] :
    v₁.IsEquiv v₂
proof:
:= by
  intro x y
  simp_rw [← Valuation.Compatible.vle_iff_le]

name: vle_iff_le
statement: lemma vle_iff_le : x ≤ᵥ y ↔ v x ≤ v y
proof:
:=
  Compatible.vle_iff_le _ _

name: vlt_iff_lt
statement: lemma vlt_iff_lt : x <ᵥ y ↔ v x < v y
proof:
:= by
  simp [lt_iff_not_ge, ← Compatible.vle_iff_le]

name: veq_iff_eq
statement: lemma veq_iff_eq : x =ᵥ y ↔ v x = v y
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [veq_def, vle_iff_le v, antisymm_iff]

name: vle_one_iff
statement: lemma vle_one_iff : x ≤ᵥ 1 ↔ v x ≤ 1
proof: := by simp [v.vle_iff_le]

name: vlt_one_iff
statement: lemma vlt_one_iff : x <ᵥ 1 ↔ v x < 1
proof: := by simp [v.vlt_iff_lt]

name: one_vle_iff
statement: lemma one_vle_iff : 1 ≤ᵥ x ↔ 1 ≤ v x
proof: := by simp [v.vle_iff_le]

name: one_vlt_iff
statement: lemma one_vlt_iff : 1 <ᵥ x ↔ 1 < v x
proof: := by simp [v.vlt_iff_lt]

name: apply_posSubmonoid_ne_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma apply_posSubmonoid_ne_zero (x : posSubmonoid R) : v (x : R) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [(isEquiv v (valuation R)).eq_zero, valuation_posSubmonoid_ne_zero]

name: apply_posSubmonoid_pos
statement:
@[simp]
lemma apply_posSubmonoid_pos (x : posSubmonoid R) : 0 < v x
proof:
:=
  zero_lt_iff.mpr <| v.apply_posSubmonoid_ne_zero x

name: supp_def
statement:
@[simp]
lemma supp_def (x : R) : x ∈ supp R ↔ x ≤ᵥ 0
proof: := Iff.refl _

name: supp_eq_valuation_supp
statement:
lemma supp_eq_valuation_supp {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [ValuativeRel R] :
    supp R = (valuation R).supp
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simpa using valuation_eq_zero_iff.symm

name: mul_vlt_mul_of_vlt_of_vle
statement:
lemma mul_vlt_mul_of_vlt_of_vle (hab : a <ᵥ b) (hcd : c ≤ᵥ d) (hd : 0 <ᵥ d) :
    a * c <ᵥ b * d
proof:
:=
  (mul_vle_mul_right hcd _).trans_vlt (mul_vlt_mul_left hd hab)

name: mul_vlt_mul_of_vle_of_vlt
statement:
lemma mul_vlt_mul_of_vle_of_vlt (hab : a ≤ᵥ b) (hcd : c <ᵥ d) (ha : 0 <ᵥ a) :
    a * c <ᵥ b * d
proof:
:=
  (mul_vlt_mul_right ha hcd).trans_vle (mul_vle_mul_left hab _)

name: mul_vlt_mul
statement:
@[gcongr]
lemma mul_vlt_mul (hab : a <ᵥ b) (hcd : c <ᵥ d) : a * c <ᵥ b * d
proof:
:=
  (mul_vle_mul_right hcd.vle _).trans_vlt (mul_vlt_mul_left ((zero_vle c).trans_vlt hcd) hab)

name: pow_vle_pow
statement: lemma pow_vle_pow (hab : a ≤ᵥ b) (n : ℕ) : a ^ n ≤ᵥ b ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ _ hn => simp [pow_succ, mul_vle_mul hn hab]

name: pow_vlt_pow
statement: lemma pow_vlt_pow (hab : a <ᵥ b) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) : a ^ n <ᵥ b ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.twoStepInduction with
  | zero => contradiction
  | one => simpa
  | more _ _ => simp_all [pow_succ, mul_vlt_mul]

name: pow_vle_pow_of_vle_one
statement: lemma pow_vle_pow_of_vle_one (ha : a ≤ᵥ 1) {n m : ℕ} (hnm : n ≤ m) : a ^ m ≤ᵥ a ^ n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := exists_add_of_le hnm
  simpa [pow_add] using mul_vle_mul_right (pow_vle_pow ha m) _

name: pow_vle_pow_of_one_vle
statement: lemma pow_vle_pow_of_one_vle (ha : 1 ≤ᵥ a) {n m : ℕ} (hnm : n ≤ m) : a ^ n ≤ᵥ a ^ m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := exists_add_of_le hnm
  simpa [pow_add] using mul_vle_mul_right (pow_vle_pow ha m) _

name: vle_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma vle_zero_iff : a ≤ᵥ 0 ↔ a = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← supp_def, Ideal.eq_bot_of_prime (supp K), Ideal.mem_bot]

name: zero_vlt_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma zero_vlt_iff : 0 <ᵥ a ↔ a ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [vlt]

name: zero_veq_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma zero_veq_iff : a =ᵥ 0 ↔ a = 0 where
  mp h
proof:
:= vle_zero_iff.1 h.1
  mpr := by simp +contextual

name: veq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma veq_zero_iff : 0 =ᵥ a ↔ 0 = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [veq_comm, eq_comm, zero_veq_iff]

name: vle_div_iff
statement: lemma vle_div_iff (hc : c ≠ 0) : a ≤ᵥ b / c ↔ a * c ≤ᵥ b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_vle_mul_iff_left (by simpa), div_mul_cancel₀ _ (by lia)]

name: div_vle_iff
statement: lemma div_vle_iff (hc : c ≠ 0) : a / c ≤ᵥ b ↔ a ≤ᵥ b * c
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_vle_mul_iff_left (by simpa), div_mul_cancel₀ _ (by lia)]

name: one_vle_div_iff
statement: lemma one_vle_div_iff (hb : b ≠ 0) : 1 ≤ᵥ a / b ↔ b ≤ᵥ a
proof:
:= by
  simp [vle_div_iff hb]

name: div_vle_one_iff
statement: lemma div_vle_one_iff (hb : b ≠ 0) : a / b ≤ᵥ 1 ↔ a ≤ᵥ b
proof:
:= by
  simp [div_vle_iff hb]

name: one_vle_inv
statement: lemma one_vle_inv (hx : x ≠ 0) : 1 ≤ᵥ x⁻¹ ↔ x ≤ᵥ 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa using one_vle_div_iff (a := 1) hx

name: inv_vle_one
statement: lemma inv_vle_one (hx : x ≠ 0) : x⁻¹ ≤ᵥ 1 ↔ 1 ≤ᵥ x
proof:
:= by
  simpa using div_vle_one_iff (a := 1) hx

name: inv_vlt_one
statement: lemma inv_vlt_one (hx : x ≠ 0) : x⁻¹ <ᵥ 1 ↔ 1 <ᵥ x
proof:
:=
  (one_vle_inv hx).not

name: one_vlt_inv
statement: lemma one_vlt_inv (hx : x ≠ 0) : 1 <ᵥ x⁻¹ ↔ x <ᵥ 1
proof:
:=
  (inv_vle_one hx).not

name: IsNontrivial.exists_lt_one
statement:
lemma IsNontrivial.exists_lt_one [IsNontrivial R] :
    ∃ γ : ValueGroupWithZero R, 0 < γ ∧ γ < 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨γ, h0, h1⟩ := IsNontrivial.condition (R := R)
  obtain h1 | h1 := lt_or_lt_iff_ne.mpr h1
  · exact ⟨γ, zero_lt_iff.mpr h0, h1⟩
  · exact ⟨γ⁻¹, by simpa [zero_lt_iff], by simp [inv_lt_one_iff₀, h0, h1]⟩

name: isNontrivial_iff_nontrivial_units
statement:
lemma isNontrivial_iff_nontrivial_units :
    IsNontrivial R ↔ Nontrivial (ValueGroupWithZero R)ˣ
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨γ, hγ, hγ'⟩
    refine ⟨Units.mk0 _ hγ, 1, ?_⟩
    simp [← Units.val_eq_one, hγ']
  · rintro ⟨r, s, h⟩
    rcases eq_or_ne r 1 with rfl | hr
    · exact ⟨s.val, by simp, by simpa using h.symm⟩
    · exact ⟨r.val, by simp, by simpa using hr⟩

name: isNontrivial_iff_isNontrivial
statement:
lemma isNontrivial_iff_isNontrivial
    {Γ₀ : Type*} [LinearOrderedCommMonoidWithZero Γ₀] (v : Valuation R Γ₀) [v.Compatible] :
    IsNontrivial R ↔ v.IsNontrivial
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨r, hr, hr'⟩
    induction r using ValueGroupWithZero.ind with | mk r s
    have hγ : v r ≠ 0 := by simpa [Valuation.Compatible.vle_iff_le (v := v)] using hr
    have hγ' : v r ≤ v s → v r < v s := by
      simpa [Valuation.Compatible.vle_iff_le (v := v)] using hr'
    by_cases hr : v r = 1
    · exact ⟨s, by simp, fun h ↦ by simp [h, hr] at hγ'⟩
    · exact ⟨r, by simpa using hγ, hr⟩
  · rintro ⟨r, hr, hr'⟩
    exact ⟨valuation R r, (isEquiv v (valuation R)).eq_zero.ne.mp hr,
      by simpa [(isEquiv v (valuation R)).eq_one_iff_eq_one] using hr'⟩

name: ValueGroupWithZero.mk_eq_valuation
statement:
lemma ValueGroupWithZero.mk_eq_valuation {K : Type*} [DivisionRing K] [ValuativeRel K]
    (x : K) (y : posSubmonoid K) :
    ValueGroupWithZero.mk x y = valuation K (x / y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Valuation.map_div, ValueGroupWithZero.mk_eq_div]

name: exists_valuation_div_valuation_eq
statement:
lemma exists_valuation_div_valuation_eq (γ : ValueGroupWithZero R) :
    ∃ (a : R) (b : posSubmonoid R), valuation _ a / valuation _ (b : R) = γ
proof:
:= by
  induction γ using ValueGroupWithZero.ind with | mk a b
  use a, b
  simp [valuation, div_eq_mul_inv, ValueGroupWithZero.inv_mk (b : R) 1 b.prop]

name: exists_valuation_posSubmonoid_div_valuation_posSubmonoid_eq
statement:
lemma exists_valuation_posSubmonoid_div_valuation_posSubmonoid_eq (γ : (ValueGroupWithZero R)ˣ) :
    ∃ (a b : posSubmonoid R), valuation R a / valuation _ (b : R) = γ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := exists_valuation_div_valuation_eq γ.val
  lift a to posSubmonoid R using by
    contrapose! hab
    rw [posSubmonoid_def, not_vlt, ← valuation_eq_zero_iff] at hab
    simp [hab, eq_comm]
  use a, b

name: valuation_surjective
statement:
theorem valuation_surjective {K : Type*} [DivisionRing K] [ValuativeRel K] :
    Function.Surjective (valuation K)
proof:
:=
  ValueGroupWithZero.ind (ValueGroupWithZero.mk_eq_valuation · · ▸ ⟨_, rfl⟩)

name: uniformizer_lt_one
statement:
lemma uniformizer_lt_one [IsDiscrete R] :
    uniformizer R < 1
proof: := IsDiscrete.has_maximal_element.choose_spec.1

name: le_uniformizer_iff
statement:
lemma le_uniformizer_iff [IsDiscrete R] {a : ValueGroupWithZero R} :
    a ≤ uniformizer R ↔ a < 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ h.trans_lt uniformizer_lt_one,
    IsDiscrete.has_maximal_element.choose_spec.2 a⟩

name: uniformizer_pos
statement:
lemma uniformizer_pos [IsDiscrete R] [IsNontrivial R] :
    0 < uniformizer R
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ, hγ'⟩ := IsNontrivial.exists_lt_one (R := R)
  exact hγ.trans_le (le_uniformizer_iff.mpr hγ')

name: uniformizer_ne_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma uniformizer_ne_zero [IsDiscrete R] [IsNontrivial R] :
    uniformizer R ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  uniformizer_pos.ne'

name: uniformizer_inv_le_iff
statement:
lemma uniformizer_inv_le_iff [IsDiscrete R] [IsNontrivial R] {a : ValueGroupWithZero R} :
    (uniformizer R)⁻¹ ≤ a ↔ 1 < a
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : a = 0
  · simp [ha]
  replace ha : 0 < a := bot_lt_iff_ne_bot.mpr ha
  rw [inv_le_comm₀ uniformizer_pos ha, le_uniformizer_iff, inv_lt_one₀ ha]

name: embed_mk
statement:
@[simp]
lemma embed_mk [v.Compatible] (x : R) (s : posSubmonoid R) :
    embed v (.mk x s) = (restrict₀ (.ofClass v) x / (restrict₀ (.ofClass v) s))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: embed_valuation_eq_restrict
statement:
@[simp]
lemma embed_valuation_eq_restrict₀ [v.Compatible] (x : R) :
    embed v (valuation R x) = ValueGroup₀.restrict₀ (.ofClass v) x
proof:
:= by
  convert! embed_mk v x 1
  simp

name: embedding_embed_valuation_eq
statement:
@[simp]
lemma embedding_embed_valuation_eq (γ : ValueGroupWithZero R) :
    embedding (embed (valuation R) γ) = γ
proof:
:= by
  induction γ using ValueGroupWithZero.ind
  simp [mk_eq_div]

name: embed_strictMono
statement: lemma embed_strictMono [v.Compatible] : StrictMono (embed v)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b h
  obtain ⟨a, r, rfl⟩ := exists_valuation_div_valuation_eq a
  obtain ⟨b, s, rfl⟩ := exists_valuation_div_valuation_eq b
  rw [← embedding_strictMono.lt_iff_lt]
  simp only [map_div₀]
  rw [div_lt_div_iff₀] at h ⊢
  any_goals simp only [zero_lt_iff, ne_eq, Valuation.apply_posSubmonoid_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true]
  · rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, (isEquiv (valuation R) v).lt_iff_lt] at h
    simp only [embed, coe_mk, ZeroHom.coe_mk, lift_valuation,
      OneMemClass.coe_one, map_one, div_one]
    rw [embedding_restrict₀ a, embedding_restrict₀ b, embedding_restrict₀ r.1,
      embedding_restrict₀ s.1]
    simpa using h
  · simp [restrict₀_apply, embed]
  · simp [restrict₀_apply, embed]

name: orderMonoidIso_embed
statement:
@[simp]
theorem orderMonoidIso_embed [v.Compatible] {Γ' : Type*} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ']
    (w : Valuation R Γ') [w.Compatible] (x : ValueGroupWithZero R) (h : w.IsEquiv v) :
    h.orderMonoidIso
    (embed w x) = embed v x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [embed, coe_mk, ZeroHom.coe_mk]
  induction x using ValueGroupWithZero.ind with
  | mk r s => simp [Valuation.IsEquiv.orderMonoidIso_spec₀]

name: orderMonoidIso_mk
statement:
@[simp]
lemma orderMonoidIso_mk [v.Compatible] (x : R) (s : posSubmonoid R) :
    orderMonoidIso v (.mk x s) = restrict₀ (.ofClass v) x / (restrict₀ (.ofClass v) s)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: orderMonoidIso_valuation_eq_restrict
statement:
@[simp]
lemma orderMonoidIso_valuation_eq_restrict₀ [v.Compatible] (x : R) :
    orderMonoidIso v (valuation R x) = restrict₀ (.ofClass v) x
proof:
:=
  embed_valuation_eq_restrict₀ v x

name: embedding_orderMonoidIso_valuation_eq
statement:
@[simp]
lemma embedding_orderMonoidIso_valuation_eq (γ : ValueGroupWithZero R) :
    embedding (orderMonoidIso (valuation R) γ) = γ
proof:
:=
  embedding_embed_valuation_eq γ

name: orderMonoidIso_strictMono
statement: lemma orderMonoidIso_strictMono [v.Compatible] : StrictMono (orderMonoidIso v)
proof:
:=
  embed_strictMono v

name: leftInverse_embedding_orderMonoidIso
statement:
lemma leftInverse_embedding_orderMonoidIso : Function.LeftInverse embedding
    (orderMonoidIso (valuation R))
proof:
:=
  embedding_orderMonoidIso_valuation_eq

name: valuation_lt_symm_orderMonoidIso
statement:
@[simp]
lemma valuation_lt_symm_orderMonoidIso [v.Compatible] (γ : ValueGroup₀ (.ofClass v)) (x : R) :
    valuation R x < (orderMonoidIso v).symm γ ↔ v.restrict x < γ
proof:
:=
  calc
    _ ↔ orderMonoidIso v _ < orderMonoidIso v _ := (map_lt_map_iff (orderMonoidIso v)).symm
    _ ↔ _ := by simp [v.restrict_def x]

name: restrict_lt_orderMonoidIso
statement:
@[simp]
lemma restrict_lt_orderMonoidIso [v.Compatible] (γ : ValueGroupWithZero R) (x : R) :
    v.restrict x < (orderMonoidIso v) γ ↔ (valuation R) x < γ
proof:
:= by
  simpa using (valuation_lt_symm_orderMonoidIso v (orderMonoidIso v γ) x).symm

name: one_apply_posSubmonoid
statement:
lemma one_apply_posSubmonoid [Nontrivial R] [NoZeroDivisors R] [DecidablePred fun x : R ↦ x = 0]
    (x : posSubmonoid R) : (1 : Valuation R Γ) x = 1
proof:
:=
  Valuation.one_apply_of_ne_zero (by simp)

name: vlt_iff_vlt
statement: lemma vlt_iff_vlt {a b : A} : algebraMap A B a <ᵥ algebraMap A B b ↔ a <ᵥ b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← not_vle, vle_iff_vle, not_vle]

name: mapValueGroupWithZero_mk
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mapValueGroupWithZero_mk (r : A) (s : posSubmonoid A) :
    mapValueGroupWithZero A B (.mk r s) = .mk (algebraMap A B r) (mapPosSubmonoid A B s)
proof:
:= by
  simp [mapValueGroupWithZero, mk_eq_div (R := B)]

name: mapValueGroupWithZero_valuation
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mapValueGroupWithZero_valuation (a : A) :
    mapValueGroupWithZero A B (valuation _ a) = valuation _ (algebraMap _ _ a)
proof:
:= by
  simp [valuation]

name: mapValueGroupWithZero_strictMono
statement: lemma mapValueGroupWithZero_strictMono : StrictMono (mapValueGroupWithZero A B)
proof:
:=
  embedding_strictMono.comp (embed_strictMono _)

name: _root_.ValuativeRel.IsRankLeOne.of_valuativeExtension
statement: lemma _root_.ValuativeRel.IsRankLeOne.of_valuativeExtension [IsRankLeOne B] : IsRankLeOne A
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨f, hf⟩⟩ := IsRankLeOne.nonempty (R := B)
  exact ⟨⟨f.comp (mapValueGroupWithZero _ _), hf.comp mapValueGroupWithZero_strictMono⟩⟩

name: exists_notMem_one_of_ne_bot
statement:
theorem exists_notMem_one_of_ne_bot [IsDedekindDomain A] {I : Ideal A} (hI0 : I ≠ ⊥)
    (hI1 : I ≠ ⊤) : ∃ x ∈ (I⁻¹ : FractionalIdeal A⁰ K), x ∉ (1 : FractionalIdeal A⁰ K)
proof:
:=
  Set.not_subset.1 <| not_inv_le_one_of_ne_bot hI0 hI1

name: dvd_span_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dvd_span_singleton {I : Ideal A} {x : A} : I ∣ span {x} ↔ x ∈ I
proof:
:=
  dvd_iff_le.trans (span_le.trans Set.singleton_subset_iff)

name: isPrime_of_prime
statement: theorem isPrime_of_prime {P : Ideal A} (h : Prime P) : IsPrime P
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun hxy => ?_⟩
  · rintro rfl
    rw [← one_eq_top] at h
    exact h.not_isUnit isUnit_one
  · simp only [← dvd_span_singleton, ← span_singleton_mul_span_singleton] at hxy ⊢
    exact h.dvd_or_dvd hxy

name: prime_of_isPrime
statement: theorem prime_of_isPrime {P : Ideal A} (hP : P ≠ ⊥) (h : IsPrime P) : Prime P
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hP, mt isUnit_iff.mp h.ne_top, fun I J hIJ => ?_⟩
  simpa only [dvd_iff_le] using h.mul_le.mp (le_of_dvd hIJ)

name: prime_of_mem_primesOver
proof:
:=
  prime_of_isPrime (ne_bot_of_mem_primesOver hp hP) hP.1

name: prime_iff_isPrime
statement: theorem prime_iff_isPrime {P : Ideal A} (hP : P ≠ ⊥) : Prime P ↔ IsPrime P
proof:
:=
  ⟨isPrime_of_prime, prime_of_isPrime hP⟩

name: isPrime_iff_bot_or_prime
statement: theorem isPrime_iff_bot_or_prime {P : Ideal A} : IsPrime P ↔ P = ⊥ ∨ Prime P
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hp => (eq_or_ne P ⊥).imp_right fun hp0 => prime_of_isPrime hp0 hp, fun hp =>
    hp.elim (fun h => h.symm ▸ isPrime_bot) isPrime_of_prime⟩

name: prime_span_singleton_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem prime_span_singleton_iff {a : A} : Prime (span {a}) ↔ Prime a
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne a 0 with rfl | ha
  · rw [Set.singleton_zero, span_zero, ← zero_eq_bot, ← not_iff_not]
    simp only [not_prime_zero, not_false_eq_true]
  · have ha' : span {a} ≠ ⊥ := by simpa only [ne_eq, span_singleton_eq_bot] using ha
    rw [prime_iff_isPrime ha', span_singleton_prime ha]

name: prime_generator_of_prime
statement:
theorem prime_generator_of_prime {P : Ideal A} (h : Prime P) [P.IsPrincipal] :
    Prime (generator P)
proof:
:=
  have : IsPrime P := isPrime_of_prime h
  prime_generator_of_isPrime _ h.ne_zero

name: mem_primesOver_iff_mem_normalizedFactors
statement:
theorem mem_primesOver_iff_mem_normalizedFactors {p : Ideal R} [h : p.IsMaximal]
    [Algebra R A] [IsDomain R] [IsTorsionFree R A] (hp : p ≠ ⊥) {P : Ideal A} :
    P ∈ p.primesOver A ↔ P ∈ normalizedFactors (map (algebraMap R A) p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [primesOver, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, mem_normalizedFactors_iff (map_ne_bot_of_ne_bot hp),
    liesOver_iff, under_def, and_congr_right_iff, map_le_iff_le_comap]
  intro hP
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ le_of_eq h, fun h' ↦ ((IsCoatom.le_iff_eq (isMaximal_def.mp h) ?_).mp h').symm⟩
  exact comap_ne_top (algebraMap R A) (IsPrime.ne_top hP)

name: pow_right_strictAnti
statement:
theorem pow_right_strictAnti (I : Ideal A) (hI0 : I ≠ ⊥) (hI1 : I ≠ ⊤) :
    StrictAnti (I ^ · : ℕ → Ideal A)
proof:
:=
  strictAnti_nat_of_succ_lt fun e =>
    dvdNotUnit_iff_lt.mp ⟨pow_ne_zero _ hI0, I, mt isUnit_iff.mp hI1, pow_succ I e⟩

name: pow_lt_self
statement:
theorem pow_lt_self (I : Ideal A) (hI0 : I ≠ ⊥) (hI1 : I ≠ ⊤) (e : ℕ) (he : 2 ≤ e) :
    I ^ e < I
proof:
:= by
  convert! I.pow_right_strictAnti hI0 hI1 he
  dsimp only
  rw [pow_one]

name: exists_mem_pow_notMem_pow_succ
statement:
theorem exists_mem_pow_notMem_pow_succ (I : Ideal A) (hI0 : I ≠ ⊥) (hI1 : I ≠ ⊤) (e : ℕ) :
    ∃ x ∈ I ^ e, x ∉ I ^ (e + 1)
proof:
:=
  SetLike.exists_of_lt (I.pow_right_strictAnti hI0 hI1 e.lt_succ_self)

name: eq_prime_pow_of_succ_lt_of_le
statement:
theorem eq_prime_pow_of_succ_lt_of_le {P I : Ideal A} [P_prime : P.IsPrime] (hP : P ≠ ⊥)
    {i : ℕ} (hlt : P ^ (i + 1) < I) (hle : I ≤ P ^ i) : I = P ^ i
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm hle ?_
  have P_prime' := prime_of_isPrime hP P_prime
  have h1 : I ≠ ⊥ := (lt_of_le_of_lt bot_le hlt).ne'
  have := pow_ne_zero i hP
  have h3 := pow_ne_zero (i + 1) hP
  rw [← dvdNotUnit_iff_lt, dvdNotUnit_iff_normalizedFactors_lt_normalizedFactors h1 h3,
    normalizedFactors_pow, normalizedFactors_irreducible P_prime'.irreducible,
    Multiset.nsmul_singleton, Multiset.lt_replicate_succ] at hlt
  rw [← dvd_iff_le, dvd_iff_normalizedFactors_le_normalizedFactors, normalizedFactors_pow,
    normalizedFactors_irreducible P_prime'.irreducible, Multiset.nsmul_singleton]
  all_goals assumption

name: pow_succ_lt_pow
statement:
theorem pow_succ_lt_pow {P : Ideal A} [P_prime : P.IsPrime] (hP : P ≠ ⊥) (i : ℕ) :
    P ^ (i + 1) < P ^ i
proof:
:=
  lt_of_le_of_ne (pow_le_pow_right (Nat.le_succ _))
    (mt (pow_inj_of_not_isUnit (mt isUnit_iff.mp P_prime.ne_top) hP).mp i.succ_ne_self)

name: Associates.le_singleton_iff
statement:
theorem Associates.le_singleton_iff (x : A) (n : ℕ) (I : Ideal A) :
    Associates.mk I ^ n ≤ Associates.mk (Ideal.span {x}) ↔ x ∈ I ^ n
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← Associates.dvd_eq_le, ← Associates.mk_pow, Associates.mk_dvd_mk,
    Ideal.dvd_span_singleton]

name: le_inv_comm
statement:
lemma le_inv_comm {I J : FractionalIdeal A⁰ K} (hI : I ≠ 0) (hJ : J ≠ 0) :
    I ≤ J⁻¹ ↔ J ≤ I⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [inv_eq, inv_eq, le_div_iff_mul_le hI, le_div_iff_mul_le hJ, mul_comm]

name: inv_le_comm
statement:
lemma inv_le_comm {I J : FractionalIdeal A⁰ K} (hI : I ≠ 0) (hJ : J ≠ 0) :
    I⁻¹ ≤ J ↔ J⁻¹ ≤ I
proof:
:= by
  simpa using le_inv_comm (A := A) (K := K) (inv_ne_zero hI) (inv_ne_zero hJ)

name: inv_le_inv_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inv_le_inv_iff {I J : FractionalIdeal A⁰ K} (hI : I ≠ 0) (hJ : J ≠ 0) :
    I⁻¹ ≤ J⁻¹ ↔ J ≤ I
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_inv_comm (inv_ne_zero hI) hJ, inv_inv]

name: exist_integer_multiples_notMem
statement:
theorem exist_integer_multiples_notMem {J : Ideal A} (hJ : J ≠ ⊤) {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (f : ι → K) {j} (hjs : j ∈ s) (hjf : f j ≠ 0) :
    ∃ a : K,
      (∀ i ∈ s, IsLocalization.IsInteger A (a * f i)) ∧
        ∃ i ∈ s, a * f i ∉ (J : FractionalIdeal A⁰ K)
proof:
:= by
  
  let I : FractionalIdeal A⁰ K := spanFinset A s f
  have hI0 : I ≠ 0 := spanFinset_ne_zero.mpr ⟨j, hjs, hjf⟩
  
  suffices ↑J / I < I⁻¹ by
    obtain ⟨_, a, hI, hpI⟩ := SetLike.lt_iff_le_and_exists.mp this
    rw [mem_inv_iff hI0] at hI
    refine ⟨a, fun i hi => ?_, ?_⟩
    
    
    · exact (mem_one_iff _).mp (hI (f i) (Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_image_of_mem f hi)))
    · contrapose! hpI
      
      
      refine (mem_div_iff_of_ne_zero hI0).mpr fun y hy => Submodule.span_induction ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hy
      · rintro _ ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩; exact hpI i hi
      · rw [mul_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
      · intro x y _ _ hx hy; rw [mul_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
      · intro b x _ hx; rw [mul_smul_comm]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ b hx
  
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
  refine mul_lt_of_lt_one_left (by simpa [pos_iff_ne_zero]) ?_
  rw [← coeIdeal_top]
  
  exact
    strictMono_of_le_iff_le (fun _ _ => (coeIdeal_le_coeIdeal K).symm)
      (lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr hJ)

name: mul_iInf
statement:
lemma mul_iInf (I : Ideal A) {ι : Type*} [Nonempty ι] (J : ι → Ideal A) :
    I * ⨅ i, J i = ⨅ i, I * J i
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hI : I = 0
  · simp [hI]
  refine (le_iInf fun i ↦ mul_mono_right (iInf_le _ _)).antisymm ?_
  have H : ⨅ i, I * J i ≤ I := (iInf_le _ (Nonempty.some ‹_›)).trans mul_le_left
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := dvd_iff_le.mpr H
  grw [hK, le_iInf (a := K) fun i ↦ ?_]
  rw [← mul_le_mul_iff_of_pos_left (a := I), ← hK]
  · exact iInf_le _ _
  · exact bot_lt_iff_ne_bot.mpr hI

name: iInf_mul
statement:
lemma iInf_mul (I : Ideal A) {ι : Type*} [Nonempty ι] (J : ι → Ideal A) :
    (⨅ i, J i) * I = ⨅ i, J i * I
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mul_iInf, mul_comm _ I]

name: mul_inf
statement: lemma mul_inf (I J K : Ideal A) : I * (J ⊓ K) = I * J ⊓ I * K
proof:
:= by
  rw [inf_eq_iInf, mul_iInf, inf_eq_iInf]
  congr! 2 with ⟨⟩

name: inf_mul
statement: lemma inf_mul (I J K : Ideal A) : (I ⊓ J) * K = I * K ⊓ J * K
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mul_inf, mul_comm _ K]

name: FractionalIdeal.mul_inf
statement: lemma FractionalIdeal.mul_inf (I J K : FractionalIdeal A⁰ K) : I * (J ⊓ K) = I * J ⊓ I * K
proof:
:=
  mul_inf₀ (zero_le _) _ _

name: FractionalIdeal.inf_mul
statement: lemma FractionalIdeal.inf_mul (I J K : FractionalIdeal A⁰ K) : (I ⊓ J) * K = I * K ⊓ J * K
proof:
:=
  inf_mul₀ (zero_le _) _ _

name: sup_mul_inf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sup_mul_inf (I J : Ideal A) : (I ⊔ J) * (I ⊓ J) = I * J
proof:
:= by
  let := UniqueFactorizationMonoid.toNormalizedGCDMonoid (Ideal A)
  have hgcd : gcd I J = I ⊔ J := by
    rw [gcd_eq_normalize _ _, normalize_eq]
    · rw [dvd_iff_le, sup_le_iff, ← dvd_iff_le, ← dvd_iff_le]
      exact ⟨gcd_dvd_left _ _, gcd_dvd_right _ _⟩
    · rw [dvd_gcd_iff, dvd_iff_le, dvd_iff_le]
      simp
  have hlcm : lcm I J = I ⊓ J := by
    rw [lcm_eq_normalize _ _, normalize_eq]
    · rw [lcm_dvd_iff, dvd_iff_le, dvd_iff_le]
      simp
    · rw [dvd_iff_le, le_inf_iff, ← dvd_iff_le, ← dvd_iff_le]
      exact ⟨dvd_lcm_left _ _, dvd_lcm_right _ _⟩
  rw [← hgcd, ← hlcm, associated_iff_eq.mp (gcd_mul_lcm _ _)]

name: gcd_eq_sup
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gcd_eq_sup (I J : Ideal A) : gcd I J = I ⊔ J
proof: := rfl

name: lcm_eq_inf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lcm_eq_inf (I J : Ideal A) : lcm I J = I ⊓ J
proof: := rfl

name: isCoprime_iff_gcd
statement: theorem isCoprime_iff_gcd {I J : Ideal A} : IsCoprime I J ↔ gcd I J = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [isCoprime_iff_codisjoint, codisjoint_iff, one_eq_top, gcd_eq_sup]

name: factors_span_eq
statement: theorem factors_span_eq {p : K[X]} : factors (span {p}) = (factors p).map (fun q ↦ span {q})
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne p 0 with rfl | hp; · simpa [Set.singleton_zero] using! normalizedFactors_zero
  have : ∀ q ∈ (factors p).map (fun q ↦ span {q}), Prime q := fun q hq ↦ by
    obtain ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hq
    exact prime_span_singleton_iff.mpr <| prime_of_factor r hr
  rw [← span_singleton_eq_span_singleton.mpr (factors_prod hp), ← multiset_prod_span_singleton,
    factors_eq_normalizedFactors, normalizedFactors_prod_of_prime this]

name: FractionalIdeal.sup_mul_inf
statement:
lemma FractionalIdeal.sup_mul_inf (I J : FractionalIdeal A⁰ K) :
    (I ⊓ J) * (I ⊔ J) = I * J
proof:
:= by
  apply mul_left_injective₀ (b := spanSingleton A⁰ (algebraMap A K
    (I.den.1 * I.den.1 * J.den.1 * J.den.1))) (by simp [spanSingleton_eq_zero_iff])
  have := Ideal.sup_mul_inf (Ideal.span {J.den.1} * I.num) (Ideal.span {I.den.1} * J.num)
  simp only [← coeIdeal_inj (K := K), coeIdeal_mul, coeIdeal_sup, coeIdeal_inf,
    ← den_mul_self_eq_num', coeIdeal_span_singleton] at this
  rw [mul_left_comm, ← mul_add, ← mul_add, ← mul_inf₀ (FractionalIdeal.zero_le _),
    ← mul_inf₀ (FractionalIdeal.zero_le _)] at this
  simp only [FractionalIdeal.sup_eq_add, _root_.map_mul, ← spanSingleton_mul_spanSingleton]
  convert! this using 1 <;> ring

name: prod_normalizedFactors_eq_self
statement: theorem prod_normalizedFactors_eq_self (hI : I ≠ ⊥) : (normalizedFactors I).prod = I
proof:
:=
  associated_iff_eq.1 (prod_normalizedFactors hI)

name: count_le_of_ideal_ge
statement:
theorem count_le_of_ideal_ge
    {I J : Ideal T} (h : I ≤ J) (hI : I ≠ ⊥) (K : Ideal T) :
    count K (normalizedFactors J) ≤ count K (normalizedFactors I)
proof:
:=
  le_iff_count.1 ((dvd_iff_normalizedFactors_le_normalizedFactors (ne_bot_of_le_ne_bot hI h) hI).1
    (dvd_iff_le.2 h))
    _

name: sup_eq_prod_inf_factors
statement:
theorem sup_eq_prod_inf_factors (hI : I ≠ ⊥) (hJ : J ≠ ⊥) :
    I ⊔ J = (normalizedFactors I ∩ normalizedFactors J).prod
proof:
:= by
  have := prod_inter_normalizedFactors_ne_zero I J
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [sup_le_iff, ← dvd_iff_le, ← dvd_iff_le]
    constructor <;>
      rw [dvd_iff_normalizedFactors_le_normalizedFactors this (by assumption),
        normalizedFactors_prod_inter_eq_inter]
    exacts [inf_le_left, inf_le_right]
  · rw [← dvd_iff_le, dvd_iff_normalizedFactors_le_normalizedFactors ?H this,
      normalizedFactors_prod_inter_eq_inter, le_iff_count]
    case H => exact ne_bot_of_le_ne_bot hI le_sup_left
    intro a
    rw [Multiset.count_inter]
    exact le_min (count_le_of_ideal_ge le_sup_left hI a) (count_le_of_ideal_ge le_sup_right hJ a)

name: irreducible_pow_sup
statement:
theorem irreducible_pow_sup (hI : I ≠ ⊥) (hJ : Irreducible J) (n : ℕ) :
    J ^ n ⊔ I = J ^ min ((normalizedFactors I).count J) n
proof:
:= by
  rw [sup_eq_prod_inf_factors (pow_ne_zero n hJ.ne_zero) hI, min_comm,
    normalizedFactors_of_irreducible_pow hJ, normalize_eq J, replicate_inter, prod_replicate]

name: irreducible_pow_sup_of_le
statement:
theorem irreducible_pow_sup_of_le (hJ : Irreducible J) (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ emultiplicity J I) :
    J ^ n ⊔ I = J ^ n
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hI : I = ⊥
  · simp_all
  rw [irreducible_pow_sup hI hJ, min_eq_right]
  rw [emultiplicity_eq_count_normalizedFactors hJ hI, normalize_eq J] at hn
  exact_mod_cast hn

name: irreducible_pow_sup_of_ge
statement:
theorem irreducible_pow_sup_of_ge (hI : I ≠ ⊥) (hJ : Irreducible J) (n : ℕ)
    (hn : emultiplicity J I ≤ n) : J ^ n ⊔ I = J ^ multiplicity J I
proof:
:= by
  rw [irreducible_pow_sup hI hJ, min_eq_left]
  · congr
    rw [← Nat.cast_inj (R := ℕ∞), ← FiniteMultiplicity.emultiplicity_eq_multiplicity,
      emultiplicity_eq_count_normalizedFactors hJ hI, normalize_eq J]
    rw [← emultiplicity_lt_top]
    apply hn.trans_lt
    simp
  · rw [emultiplicity_eq_count_normalizedFactors hJ hI, normalize_eq J] at hn
    exact_mod_cast hn

name: eq_prime_pow_mul_coprime
statement:
theorem eq_prime_pow_mul_coprime {I : Ideal T} (hI : I ≠ ⊥)
    (P : Ideal T) [hpm : P.IsMaximal] :
    ∃ Q : Ideal T, P ⊔ Q = ⊤ ∧ I = P ^ (Multiset.count P (normalizedFactors I)) * Q
proof:
:= by
  use (filter (¬ P = ·) (normalizedFactors I)).prod
  constructor
  · refine P.sup_multiset_prod_eq_top (fun p hpi ↦ ?_)
    have hp : Prime p := prime_of_normalized_factor p (filter_subset _ (normalizedFactors I) hpi)
    exact hpm.coprime_of_ne ((isPrime_of_prime hp).isMaximal hp.ne_zero) (of_mem_filter hpi)
  · nth_rw 1 [← prod_normalizedFactors_eq_self hI, ← filter_add_not (P = ·) (normalizedFactors I)]
    rw [prod_add, pow_count]

name: map_prime_of_equiv
statement:
theorem map_prime_of_equiv {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDedekindDomain R]
    (f : T ≃+* R) {I : Ideal T} (hI : Prime I) (h : I ≠ ⊥) : Prime (I.map f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [prime_iff_isPrime h] at hI
  exact (prime_iff_isPrime <| (I.map_eq_bot_iff_of_injective f.injective).not.2 h).2
    (map_isPrime_of_equiv _)

name: prime
statement: theorem prime : Prime v.asIdeal
proof: := Ideal.prime_of_isPrime v.ne_bot v.isPrime

name: asIdeal_injective
statement: lemma asIdeal_injective : (HeightOneSpectrum.asIdeal (R := R)).Injective
proof:
:=
  fun ⦃_ _⦄ h ↦ HeightOneSpectrum.ext h

name: ofPrime_prime
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofPrime_prime : ofPrime v.prime = v
proof: := rfl

name: irreducible
statement: theorem irreducible : Irreducible v.asIdeal
proof:
:=
  UniqueFactorizationMonoid.irreducible_iff_prime.mpr v.prime

name: associates_irreducible
statement: theorem associates_irreducible : Irreducible <| Associates.mk v.asIdeal
proof:
:=
  Associates.irreducible_mk.mpr v.irreducible

name: ideal_ne_top_iff_exists
statement:
theorem ideal_ne_top_iff_exists (hR : ¬IsField R) (I : Ideal R) :
    I ≠ ⊤ ↔ ∃ P : HeightOneSpectrum R, I ≤ P.asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.ne_top_iff_exists_maximal]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨M, hMmax, hIM⟩
    exact ⟨(equivMaximalSpectrum hR).symm ⟨M, hMmax⟩, hIM⟩
  · rintro ⟨P, hP⟩
    exact ⟨((equivMaximalSpectrum hR) P).asIdeal, ((equivMaximalSpectrum hR) P).isMaximal, hP⟩

name: isCoprime_of_ne
statement: theorem isCoprime_of_ne (P Q : HeightOneSpectrum R) (hPQ : P ≠ Q) : IsCoprime P.asIdeal Q.asIdeal
proof:
:=
  Ideal.isCoprime_iff_sup_eq.mpr (Ideal.IsMaximal.coprime_of_ne P.isMaximal Q.isMaximal
    (by simpa [HeightOneSpectrum.ext_iff] using hPQ))

name: isCoprime_pow_of_ne
statement:
theorem isCoprime_pow_of_ne (P Q : HeightOneSpectrum R) (hPQ : P ≠ Q) (n m : ℕ) :
    IsCoprime (P.asIdeal ^ n) (Q.asIdeal ^ m)
proof:
:=
  Ideal.isCoprime_iff_sup_eq.mpr (Ideal.pow_sup_pow_eq_top (P.isCoprime_of_ne Q hPQ).sup_eq)

name: iInf_localization_eq_bot
statement:
theorem iInf_localization_eq_bot [Algebra R K] [hK : IsFractionRing R K] :
    (⨅ v : HeightOneSpectrum R,
        Localization.subalgebra.ofField K _ v.asIdeal.primeCompl_le_nonZeroDivisors) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [Algebra.mem_iInf]
  constructor
  on_goal 1 => by_cases hR : IsField R
  · rcases Function.bijective_iff_has_inverse.mp
      (IsField.localization_map_bijective (Rₘ := K) (flip nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero rfl : 0 ∉ R⁰) hR)
      with ⟨algebra_map_inv, _, algebra_map_right_inv⟩
    exact fun _ => Algebra.mem_bot.mpr ⟨algebra_map_inv x, algebra_map_right_inv x⟩
  all_goals rw [← MaximalSpectrum.iInf_localization_eq_bot, Algebra.mem_iInf]
  · exact fun hx ⟨v, hv⟩ => hx ((equivMaximalSpectrum hR).symm ⟨v, hv⟩)
  · exact fun hx ⟨v, hv, hbot⟩ => hx ⟨v, hv.isMaximal hbot⟩

name: RingEquiv.nontrivial_heightOneSpectrum
statement:
theorem RingEquiv.nontrivial_heightOneSpectrum {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [Nontrivial (HeightOneSpectrum S)] (e : R ≃+* S) : Nontrivial (HeightOneSpectrum R)
proof:
:=
  (equivOfRingEquiv e).surjective.nontrivial

name: idealFactorsFunOfQuotHom_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem idealFactorsFunOfQuotHom_id :
    idealFactorsFunOfQuotHom (RingHom.id (A ⧸ J)).surjective = OrderHom.id
proof:
:=
  OrderHom.ext _ _
    (funext fun X => by
      simp only [idealFactorsFunOfQuotHom, map_id, OrderHom.coe_mk, OrderHom.id_coe, id,
        comap_map_of_surjective (Ideal.Quotient.mk J) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective, ←
        RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot (Ideal.Quotient.mk J), mk_ker,
        sup_eq_left.mpr (dvd_iff_le.mp X.prop), Subtype.coe_eta])

name: idealFactorsFunOfQuotHom_comp
statement:
theorem idealFactorsFunOfQuotHom_comp {f : R ⧸ I →+* A ⧸ J} {g : A ⧸ J →+* B ⧸ L}
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) (hg : Function.Surjective g) :
    (idealFactorsFunOfQuotHom hg).comp (idealFactorsFunOfQuotHom hf) =
      idealFactorsFunOfQuotHom (show Function.Surjective (g.comp f) from hg.comp hf)
proof:
:= by
  refine OrderHom.ext _ _ (funext fun x => ?_)
  rw [idealFactorsFunOfQuotHom, idealFactorsFunOfQuotHom, OrderHom.comp_coe, OrderHom.coe_mk,
    OrderHom.coe_mk, Function.comp_apply, idealFactorsFunOfQuotHom, OrderHom.coe_mk,
    Subtype.mk_eq_mk, Subtype.coe_mk, map_comap_of_surjective (Ideal.Quotient.mk J)
    Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective, map_map]

name: idealFactorsEquivOfQuotEquiv_symm
statement:
theorem idealFactorsEquivOfQuotEquiv_symm :
    (idealFactorsEquivOfQuotEquiv f).symm = idealFactorsEquivOfQuotEquiv f.symm
proof: := rfl

name: idealFactorsEquivOfQuotEquiv_is_dvd_iso
statement:
theorem idealFactorsEquivOfQuotEquiv_is_dvd_iso {L M : Ideal R} (hL : L ∣ I) (hM : M ∣ I) :
    (idealFactorsEquivOfQuotEquiv f ⟨L, hL⟩ : Ideal A) ∣ idealFactorsEquivOfQuotEquiv f ⟨M, hM⟩ ↔
      L ∣ M
proof:
:= by
  suffices
    idealFactorsEquivOfQuotEquiv f ⟨M, hM⟩ ≤ idealFactorsEquivOfQuotEquiv f ⟨L, hL⟩ ↔
      (⟨M, hM⟩ : { p : Ideal R | p ∣ I }) ≤ ⟨L, hL⟩
    by rw [dvd_iff_le, dvd_iff_le, Subtype.coe_le_coe, this, Subtype.mk_le_mk]
  exact (idealFactorsEquivOfQuotEquiv f).le_iff_le

name: idealFactorsEquivOfQuotEquiv_mem_normalizedFactors_of_mem_normalizedFactors
statement:
theorem idealFactorsEquivOfQuotEquiv_mem_normalizedFactors_of_mem_normalizedFactors (hJ : J ≠ ⊥)
    {L : Ideal R} (hL : L ∈ normalizedFactors I) :
    ↑(idealFactorsEquivOfQuotEquiv f ⟨L, dvd_of_mem_normalizedFactors hL⟩)
      ∈ normalizedFactors J
proof:
:= by
  have hI : I ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro hI
    rw [hI, bot_eq_zero, normalizedFactors_zero, ← Multiset.empty_eq_zero] at hL
    exact Finset.notMem_empty _ hL
  refine mem_normalizedFactors_factor_dvd_iso_of_mem_normalizedFactors hI hJ hL
    (d := (idealFactorsEquivOfQuotEquiv f).toEquiv) ?_
  rintro ⟨l, hl⟩ ⟨l', hl'⟩
  rw [Subtype.coe_mk, Subtype.coe_mk]
  apply idealFactorsEquivOfQuotEquiv_is_dvd_iso f

name: normalizedFactorsEquivOfQuotEquiv_symm
statement:
@[simp]
theorem normalizedFactorsEquivOfQuotEquiv_symm (hI : I ≠ ⊥) (hJ : J ≠ ⊥) :
    (normalizedFactorsEquivOfQuotEquiv f hI hJ).symm =
      normalizedFactorsEquivOfQuotEquiv f.symm hJ hI
proof: := rfl

name: normalizedFactorsEquivOfQuotEquiv_emultiplicity_eq_emultiplicity
statement:
theorem normalizedFactorsEquivOfQuotEquiv_emultiplicity_eq_emultiplicity (hI : I ≠ ⊥) (hJ : J ≠ ⊥)
    (L : Ideal R) (hL : L ∈ normalizedFactors I) :
    emultiplicity (↑(normalizedFactorsEquivOfQuotEquiv f hI hJ ⟨L, hL⟩)) J = emultiplicity L I
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalizedFactorsEquivOfQuotEquiv, Equiv.coe_fn_mk, Subtype.coe_mk]
  refine emultiplicity_factor_dvd_iso_eq_emultiplicity_of_mem_normalizedFactors hI hJ hL
    (d := (idealFactorsEquivOfQuotEquiv f).toEquiv) ?_
  exact fun ⟨l, hl⟩ ⟨l', hl'⟩ => idealFactorsEquivOfQuotEquiv_is_dvd_iso f hl hl'

name: Ring.DimensionLeOne.prime_le_prime_iff_eq
statement:
theorem Ring.DimensionLeOne.prime_le_prime_iff_eq [Ring.DimensionLEOne R] {P Q : Ideal R}
    [hP : P.IsPrime] [hQ : Q.IsPrime] (hP0 : P ≠ ⊥) : P ≤ Q ↔ P = Q
proof:
:=
  ⟨(hP.isMaximal hP0).eq_of_le hQ.ne_top, Eq.le⟩

name: IsPrime.mul_mem_pow
statement:
theorem IsPrime.mul_mem_pow (I : Ideal R) [hI : I.IsPrime] {a b : R} {n : ℕ}
    (h : a * b ∈ I ^ n) : a ∈ I ∨ b ∈ I ^ n
proof:
:= by
  cases n; · simp
  by_cases hI0 : I = ⊥; · simpa [pow_succ, hI0] using h
  have : I.IsMaximal := hI.isMaximal hI0
  exact IsMaximal.mul_mem_pow I h

name: IsPrime.mem_pow_mul
statement:
theorem IsPrime.mem_pow_mul (I : Ideal R) [hI : I.IsPrime] {a b : R} {n : ℕ}
    (h : a * b ∈ I ^ n) : a ∈ I ^ n ∨ b ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm] at h
  rw [or_comm]
  exact IsPrime.mul_mem_pow _ h

name: count_normalizedFactors_eq
statement:
theorem count_normalizedFactors_eq {p x : Ideal R} [hp : p.IsPrime] {n : ℕ} (hle : x ≤ p ^ n)
    (hlt : ¬x ≤ p ^ (n + 1)) : (normalizedFactors x).count p = n
proof:
:=
  count_normalizedFactors_eq' ((isPrime_iff_bot_or_prime.mp hp).imp_right Prime.irreducible)
    (normalize_eq _) (dvd_iff_le.mpr hle) (mt le_of_dvd hlt)

name: count_associates_factors_eq
statement:
theorem count_associates_factors_eq
    {I J : Ideal R} (hI : I ≠ 0) (hJ : J.IsPrime) (hJ₀ : J ≠ ⊥) :
    (Associates.mk J).count (Associates.mk I).factors = Multiset.count J (normalizedFactors I)
proof:
:= by
  replace hI : Associates.mk I ≠ 0 := Associates.mk_ne_zero.mpr hI
  have hJ' : Irreducible (Associates.mk J) := by
    simpa only [Associates.irreducible_mk] using (prime_of_isPrime hJ₀ hJ).irreducible
  apply (count_normalizedFactors_eq (p := J) (x := I) _ _).symm
  all_goals
    rw [← dvd_iff_le, ← Associates.mk_dvd_mk, Associates.mk_pow]
    simp only [Associates.dvd_eq_le]
    rw [Associates.prime_pow_dvd_iff_le hI hJ']
  lia

name: count_associates_eq
statement:
theorem count_associates_eq
    {a a₀ x : R} {n : ℕ} (hx : Prime x) (ha : ¬x ∣ a) (heq : a₀ = x ^ n * a) :
    (Associates.mk (span {x})).count (Associates.mk (span {a₀})).factors = n
proof:
:= by
  have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := Prime.ne_zero hx
  rw [count_associates_factors_eq, UniqueFactorizationMonoid.count_normalizedFactors_eq]
  · exact (prime_span_singleton_iff.mpr hx).irreducible
  · exact normalize_eq _
  · simp only [span_singleton_pow, heq, dvd_span_singleton]
    exact mul_mem_right _ _ (mem_span_singleton_self (x ^ n))
  · simp only [span_singleton_pow, heq, dvd_span_singleton, mem_span_singleton]
    rw [pow_add, pow_one, mul_dvd_mul_iff_left (pow_ne_zero n hx0)]
    exact ha
  · simp only [Submodule.zero_eq_bot, ne_eq, span_singleton_eq_bot]
    aesop
  · exact (span_singleton_prime hx0).mpr hx
  · simp only [ne_eq, span_singleton_eq_bot]; exact hx0

name: count_associates_eq'
statement:
theorem count_associates_eq'
    {a x : R} (hx : Prime x) {n : ℕ} (hle : x ^ n ∣ a) (hlt : ¬x ^ (n + 1) ∣ a) :
    (Associates.mk (span {x})).count (Associates.mk (span {a})).factors = n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hle
  apply count_associates_eq hx _ hq
  contrapose hlt with hdvd
  obtain ⟨q', hq'⟩ := hdvd
  use q'
  rw [hq, hq']
  ring

name: le_mul_of_no_prime_factors
statement:
theorem le_mul_of_no_prime_factors {I J K : Ideal R}
    (coprime : ∀ P, J ≤ P → K ≤ P → ¬IsPrime P) (hJ : I ≤ J) (hK : I ≤ K) : I ≤ J * K
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← dvd_iff_le] at coprime hJ hK ⊢
  by_cases hJ0 : J = 0
  · simpa only [hJ0, zero_mul] using hJ
  obtain ⟨I', rfl⟩ := hK
  rw [mul_comm]
  refine mul_dvd_mul_left K
    (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right_of_no_prime_factors (b := K) hJ0 ?_ hJ)
  exact fun hPJ hPK => mt isPrime_of_prime (coprime _ hPJ hPK)

name: HeightOneSpectrum.inf_pow_eq_prod
statement:
theorem HeightOneSpectrum.inf_pow_eq_prod (s : Finset ι) (e : ι → ℕ)
    (f : ι → HeightOneSpectrum R) (coprime : ∀ᵉ (i ∈ s) (j ∈ s), i ≠ j → f i ≠ f j) :
    (s.inf fun i => (f i).asIdeal ^ e i) = ∏ i ∈ s, (f i).asIdeal ^ e i
proof:
:= by
  rw [prod_eq_iInf_of_pairwise_isCoprime]
  · rw [Finset.inf_eq_iInf s fun i ↦ (f i).asIdeal ^ e i]
  · intro i hi j hj hij
    exact HeightOneSpectrum.isCoprime_pow_of_ne _ _ (coprime i hi j hj hij) _ _

name: inf_pow_eq_prod_of_prime
statement:
theorem inf_pow_eq_prod_of_prime (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Ideal R)
    (e : ι → ℕ) (prime : ∀ i ∈ s, Prime (f i)) (coprime : ∀ᵉ (i ∈ s) (j ∈ s), i ≠ j → f i ≠ f j) :
    (s.inf fun i => f i ^ e i) = ∏ i ∈ s, f i ^ e i
proof:
:= by
  rw [prod_eq_iInf_of_pairwise_isCoprime, Finset.inf_eq_iInf s fun i ↦ (f i) ^ e i]
  intro i hi j hj hij
  exact Ideal.isCoprime_iff_sup_eq.mpr (pow_sup_pow_eq_top (IsMaximal.coprime_of_ne
    (IsPrime.isMaximal (isPrime_of_prime (prime i hi)) (prime i hi).ne_zero)
    (IsPrime.isMaximal (isPrime_of_prime (prime j hj)) (prime j hj).ne_zero)
    (coprime i hi j hj hij)))

name: quotientEquivPiFactors_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quotientEquivPiFactors_mk {I : Ideal R} (hI : I ≠ ⊥) (x : R) :
    quotientEquivPiFactors hI (Ideal.Quotient.mk I x) = fun _P =>
      Ideal.Quotient.mk _ x
proof: := rfl

name: exists_representative_mod_finset
statement:
theorem exists_representative_mod_finset {ι : Type*} {s : Finset ι}
    (P : ι → Ideal R) (e : ι → ℕ) (prime : ∀ i ∈ s, Prime (P i))
    (coprime : ∀ᵉ (i ∈ s) (j ∈ s), i ≠ j → P i ≠ P j) (x : ∀ i : s, R ⧸ P i ^ e i) :
    ∃ y, ∀ (i) (hi : i ∈ s), Ideal.Quotient.mk (P i ^ e i) y = x ⟨i, hi⟩
proof:
:= by
  let f := quotientEquivPiOfFinsetProdEq _ P e prime coprime rfl
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := f.surjective x
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective y
  exact ⟨z, fun i _hi => rfl⟩

name: exists_forall_sub_mem_ideal
statement:
theorem exists_forall_sub_mem_ideal {ι : Type*} {s : Finset ι} (P : ι → Ideal R)
    (e : ι → ℕ) (prime : ∀ i ∈ s, Prime (P i))
    (coprime : ∀ᵉ (i ∈ s) (j ∈ s), i ≠ j → P i ≠ P j) (x : s → R) :
    ∃ y, ∀ (i) (hi : i ∈ s), y - x ⟨i, hi⟩ ∈ P i ^ e i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ :=
    exists_representative_mod_finset P e prime coprime fun i =>
      Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (x i)
  exact ⟨y, fun i hi => Ideal.Quotient.eq.mp (hy i hi)⟩

name: emultiplicity_span_eq_emultiplicity
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_span_eq_emultiplicity {a b : R} :
    emultiplicity (span {a}) (span ({b} : Set R)) = emultiplicity a b
proof:
:= by
  rw [emultiplicity_eq_emultiplicity_iff]
  simp [span_singleton_pow, span_singleton_dvd_span_singleton_iff_dvd]

name: multiplicity_span_eq_multiplicity
statement:
theorem multiplicity_span_eq_multiplicity {a b : R} :
    multiplicity (span {a}) (span ({b} : Set R)) = multiplicity a b
proof:
:=
  multiplicity_eq_of_emultiplicity_eq emultiplicity_span_eq_emultiplicity

name: squarefree_span_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem squarefree_span_singleton {a : R} :
    Squarefree (span {a}) ↔ Squarefree a
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h x hx ↦ ?_, fun h I hI ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [← span_singleton_dvd_span_singleton_iff_dvd, ← span_singleton_mul_span_singleton] at hx
    simpa using h _ hx
  · rw [← span_singleton_generator I, span_singleton_mul_span_singleton,
      span_singleton_dvd_span_singleton_iff_dvd] at hI
    exact isUnit_iff.mpr <| eq_top_of_isUnit_mem _ (Submodule.IsPrincipal.generator_mem I) (h _ hI)

name: singleton_span_mem_normalizedFactors_of_mem_normalizedFactors
statement:
theorem singleton_span_mem_normalizedFactors_of_mem_normalizedFactors [NormalizationMonoid R]
    {a b : R} (ha : a ∈ normalizedFactors b) :
    span ({a} : Set R) ∈ normalizedFactors (span ({b} : Set R))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hb : b = 0
  · rw [span_singleton_eq_bot.mpr hb, bot_eq_zero, normalizedFactors_zero]
    rw [hb, normalizedFactors_zero] at ha
    exact absurd ha (Multiset.notMem_zero a)
  · suffices Prime (span ({a} : Set R)) by
      obtain ⟨c, hc, hc'⟩ := exists_mem_normalizedFactors_of_dvd ?_ this.irreducible
          (dvd_iff_le.mpr (span_singleton_le_span_singleton.mpr (dvd_of_mem_normalizedFactors ha)))
      rwa [associated_iff_eq.mp hc']
    · by_contra h
      exact hb (span_singleton_eq_bot.mp h)
    rw [prime_iff_isPrime]
    · exact (span_singleton_prime (prime_of_normalized_factor a ha).ne_zero).mpr
        (prime_of_normalized_factor a ha)
    · by_contra h
      exact (prime_of_normalized_factor a ha).ne_zero (span_singleton_eq_bot.mp h)

name: emultiplicity_normalizedFactorsEquivSpanNormalizedFactors_eq_emultiplicity
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_normalizedFactorsEquivSpanNormalizedFactors_eq_emultiplicity {r d : R}
    (hr : r ≠ 0) (hd : d ∈ normalizedFactors r) :
    emultiplicity d r =
      emultiplicity (normalizedFactorsEquivSpanNormalizedFactors hr ⟨d, hd⟩ : Ideal R)
        (span {r})
proof:
:= by
  simp only [normalizedFactorsEquivSpanNormalizedFactors, emultiplicity_span_eq_emultiplicity,
    Subtype.coe_mk, Equiv.ofBijective_apply]

name: emultiplicity_normalizedFactorsEquivSpanNormalizedFactors_symm_eq_emultiplicity
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_normalizedFactorsEquivSpanNormalizedFactors_symm_eq_emultiplicity {r : R}
    (hr : r ≠ 0) (I : { I : Ideal R | I ∈ normalizedFactors (span ({r} : Set R)) }) :
    emultiplicity ((normalizedFactorsEquivSpanNormalizedFactors hr).symm I : R) r =
      emultiplicity (I : Ideal R) (span {r})
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (normalizedFactorsEquivSpanNormalizedFactors hr).surjective I
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := x
  rw [hx.symm, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, Subtype.coe_mk,
    emultiplicity_normalizedFactorsEquivSpanNormalizedFactors_eq_emultiplicity hr ha]

name: count_span_normalizedFactors_eq
statement:
theorem count_span_normalizedFactors_eq {r X : R} (hr : r ≠ 0) (hX : Prime X) :
    Multiset.count (span {X} : Ideal R) (normalizedFactors (span {r})) =
        Multiset.count (normalize X) (normalizedFactors r)
proof:
:= by
  have := emultiplicity_span_eq_emultiplicity (R := R) (a := X) (b := r)
  rw [emultiplicity_eq_count_normalizedFactors (Prime.irreducible hX) hr,
    emultiplicity_eq_count_normalizedFactors (Prime.irreducible ?_), normalize_apply,
    normUnit_eq_one, Units.val_one, one_eq_top, mul_top, Nat.cast_inj] at this
  · simp only [normalize_apply, this]
  · simp only [Submodule.zero_eq_bot, ne_eq, span_singleton_eq_bot, hr, not_false_eq_true]
  · simpa only [prime_span_singleton_iff]

name: count_span_normalizedFactors_eq_of_normUnit
statement:
theorem count_span_normalizedFactors_eq_of_normUnit {r X : R}
    (hr : r ≠ 0) (hX₁ : normUnit X = 1) (hX : Prime X) :
      Multiset.count (span {X} : Ideal R) (normalizedFactors (span {r})) =
        Multiset.count X (normalizedFactors r)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [hX₁, normalize_apply] using count_span_normalizedFactors_eq hr hX

name: coe_primesOverFinset
statement: theorem coe_primesOverFinset : primesOverFinset p B = primesOver p B
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simpa using (mem_primesOver_iff_mem_normalizedFactors _ hpb).symm

name: mem_primesOverFinset_iff
statement: theorem mem_primesOverFinset_iff {P : Ideal B} : P ∈ primesOverFinset p B ↔ P ∈ primesOver p B
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.mem_coe, coe_primesOverFinset hpb]

name: IsLocalRing.primesOverFinset_eq
proof:
:= by
  have : IsDomain R := .of_faithfulSMul R A
  rw [← Finset.coe_eq_singleton, IsDedekindDomain.coe_primesOverFinset hp0,
    IsLocalRing.primesOver_eq A hp0]

name: equivPrimesOver_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem equivPrimesOver_apply (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (v : {v : HeightOneSpectrum B // v.asIdeal ∣ map (algebraMap A B) p}) :
    equivPrimesOver B hp v = v.1.asIdeal
proof: := rfl

name: primesOver_finite
statement: theorem primesOver_finite : (primesOver p B).Finite
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hpb : p = ⊥
  · rw [hpb] at hpm ⊢
    have : IsDomain A := IsDomain.of_bot_isPrime A
    rw [primesOver_bot A B]
    exact Set.finite_singleton ⊥
  · rw [← coe_primesOverFinset hpb B]
    exact (primesOverFinset p B).finite_toSet

name: primesOver_ncard_ne_zero
statement: theorem primesOver_ncard_ne_zero : (primesOver p B).ncard ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases exists_maximal_ideal_liesOver_of_isIntegral (S := B) p with ⟨P, hPm, hp⟩
  exact Set.ncard_ne_zero_of_mem ⟨hPm.isPrime, hp⟩ (primesOver_finite p B)

name: one_le_primesOver_ncard
statement: theorem one_le_primesOver_ncard : 1 ≤ (primesOver p B).ncard
proof:
:=
  Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (primesOver_ncard_ne_zero p B)

name: Algebra.IsIntegral.nontrivial_heightOneSpectrum
statement:
lemma Algebra.IsIntegral.nontrivial_heightOneSpectrum [IsDomain A] [Algebra R A]
    [FaithfulSMul R A] [Algebra.IsIntegral R A] [Nontrivial (HeightOneSpectrum R)] :
    Nontrivial (HeightOneSpectrum A)
proof:
:= by
  have := (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective R A).isDomain
  let f (p : HeightOneSpectrum A) : HeightOneSpectrum R := p.under R
  have : Function.Surjective f := fun ⟨p, _, hp⟩ ↦ by
    obtain ⟨P, hP, rfl⟩ := p.exists_ideal_over_prime_of_isIntegral_of_isDomain (S := A) (by simp)
    exact ⟨⟨P, hP, by aesop⟩, rfl⟩
  exact this.nontrivial

name: FractionalIdeal.adjoinIntegral_eq_one_of_isUnit
statement:
theorem FractionalIdeal.adjoinIntegral_eq_one_of_isUnit (x : K)
    (hx : IsIntegral A x) (hI : IsUnit (adjoinIntegral A⁰ x hx)) : adjoinIntegral A⁰ x hx = 1
proof:
:= by
  set I := adjoinIntegral A⁰ x hx
  have mul_self : IsIdempotentElem I := by
    apply coeToSubmodule_injective
    simp only [coe_mul, adjoinIntegral_coe, I]
    rw [(Algebra.adjoin A {x}).isIdempotentElem_toSubmodule]
  convert! congr_arg (· * I⁻¹) mul_self <;>
    simp only [(mul_inv_cancel_iff_isUnit K).mpr hI, mul_assoc, mul_one]

name: FractionalIdeal.one_mem_inv_coe_ideal
statement:
theorem FractionalIdeal.one_mem_inv_coe_ideal [IsDomain A] {I : Ideal A} (hI : I ≠ ⊥) :
    (1 : K) ∈ (I : FractionalIdeal A⁰ K)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_inv_iff (coeIdeal_ne_zero.mpr hI)]
  intro y hy
  rw [one_mul]
  exact coeIdeal_le_one hy

name: PrimeSpectrum.exists_multiset_prod_cons_le_and_prod_not_le
statement:
theorem PrimeSpectrum.exists_multiset_prod_cons_le_and_prod_not_le [IsDedekindDomain A]
    (hNF : ¬IsField A) {I M : Ideal A} (hI0 : I ≠ ⊥) (hIM : I ≤ M) [hM : M.IsMaximal] :
    ∃ Z : Multiset (PrimeSpectrum A),
      (M ::ₘ Z.map asIdeal).prod ≤ I ∧
        ¬Multiset.prod (Z.map asIdeal) ≤ I
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨Z₀, hZ₀⟩ := exists_primeSpectrum_prod_le_and_ne_bot_of_domain hNF hI0
  obtain ⟨Z, ⟨hZI, hprodZ⟩, h_eraseZ⟩ :=
    wellFounded_lt.has_min
      {Z | (Z.map asIdeal).prod ≤ I ∧ (Z.map asIdeal).prod ≠ ⊥}
      ⟨Z₀, hZ₀.1, hZ₀.2⟩
  obtain ⟨_, hPZ', hPM⟩ := hM.isPrime.multiset_prod_le.mp (hZI.trans hIM)
  
  obtain ⟨P, hPZ, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hPZ'
  classical
    have := Multiset.map_erase asIdeal (fun _ _ => PrimeSpectrum.ext) P Z
    obtain ⟨hP0, hZP0⟩ : P.asIdeal ≠ ⊥ ∧ ((Z.erase P).map asIdeal).prod ≠ ⊥ := by
      rwa [Ne, ← Multiset.cons_erase hPZ', Multiset.prod_cons, Ideal.mul_eq_bot, not_or, ←
        this] at hprodZ
    
    have hPM' := (P.isPrime.isMaximal hP0).eq_of_le hM.ne_top hPM
    subst hPM'
    
    refine ⟨Z.erase P, ?_, ?_⟩
    · convert! hZI
      rw [this, Multiset.cons_erase hPZ']
    · refine fun h => h_eraseZ (Z.erase P) ⟨h, ?_⟩ (Multiset.erase_lt.mpr hPZ)
      exact hZP0

name: not_inv_le_one_of_ne_bot
statement:
lemma not_inv_le_one_of_ne_bot (hI0 : I ≠ ⊥) (hI1 : I ≠ ⊤) :
    ¬(I⁻¹ : FractionalIdeal A⁰ K) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hNF : ¬IsField A := fun h ↦ letI := h.toField; (eq_bot_or_eq_top I).elim hI0 hI1
  wlog hM : I.IsMaximal generalizing I
  · rcases I.exists_le_maximal hI1 with ⟨M, hmax, hIM⟩
    have hMbot : M ≠ ⊥ := (M.bot_lt_of_maximal hNF).ne'
    refine mt (le_trans <| inv_anti_mono ?_ ?_ ?_) (this hMbot hmax.ne_top hmax) <;>
      simpa only [coeIdeal_ne_zero, coeIdeal_le_coeIdeal]
  have hI0 : ⊥ < I := I.bot_lt_of_maximal hNF
  obtain ⟨⟨a, haI⟩, ha0⟩ := Submodule.nonzero_mem_of_bot_lt hI0
  replace ha0 : a ≠ 0 := Subtype.coe_injective.ne ha0
  let J : Ideal A := Ideal.span {a}
  have hJ0 : J ≠ ⊥ := mt Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot.mp ha0
  have hJI : J ≤ I := I.span_singleton_le_iff_mem.2 haI
  
  
  obtain ⟨Z, hle, hnle⟩ := PrimeSpectrum.exists_multiset_prod_cons_le_and_prod_not_le hNF hJ0 hJI
  
  obtain ⟨b, hbZ, hbJ⟩ := SetLike.not_le_iff_exists.mp hnle
  have hnz_fa : algebraMap A K a ≠ 0 :=
    mt ((injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).mp (IsFractionRing.injective A K) a) ha0
  
  refine Set.not_subset.2 ⟨algebraMap A K b * (algebraMap A K a)⁻¹, (mem_inv_iff ?_).mpr ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact coeIdeal_ne_zero.mpr hI0.ne'
  · rintro y₀ hy₀
    obtain ⟨y, h_Iy, rfl⟩ := (mem_coeIdeal _).mp hy₀
    rw [mul_comm, ← mul_assoc, ← map_mul]
    have h_yb : y * b ∈ J := by
      apply hle
      rw [Multiset.prod_cons]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem_smul h_Iy hbZ
    rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at h_yb
    rcases h_yb with ⟨c, hc⟩
    rw [← hc, map_mul, mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hnz_fa, mul_one]
    apply coe_mem_one
  · refine mt (mem_one_iff _).mp ?_
    rintro ⟨x', h₂_abs⟩
    rw [← div_eq_mul_inv, eq_div_iff_mul_eq hnz_fa, ← map_mul] at h₂_abs
    have := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mpr ⟨x', IsFractionRing.injective A K h₂_abs⟩
    contradiction

name: mul_inv_cancel_of_le_one
statement:
theorem mul_inv_cancel_of_le_one (hI0 : I ≠ ⊥) (hI : (I * (I : FractionalIdeal A⁰ K)⁻¹)⁻¹ ≤ 1) :
    I * (I : FractionalIdeal A⁰ K)⁻¹ = 1
proof:
:= by
  
  
  obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ : ∃ J : Ideal A, (J : FractionalIdeal A⁰ K) = I * (I : FractionalIdeal A⁰ K)⁻¹ :=
    le_one_iff_exists_coeIdeal.mp mul_one_div_le_one
  by_cases hJ0 : J = ⊥
  · subst hJ0
    refine absurd ?_ hI0
    rw [eq_bot_iff, ← coeIdeal_le_coeIdeal K, hJ]
    exact coe_ideal_le_self_mul_inv K I
  by_cases hJ1 : J = ⊤
  · rw [← hJ, hJ1, coeIdeal_top]
  exact (not_inv_le_one_of_ne_bot (K := K) hJ0 hJ1 (hJ ▸ hI)).elim

name: coe_ideal_mul_inv
statement: theorem coe_ideal_mul_inv (I : Ideal A) (hI0 : I ≠ ⊥) : I * (I : FractionalIdeal A⁰ K)⁻¹ = 1
proof:
:= by
  
  apply mul_inv_cancel_of_le_one hI0
  by_cases hJ0 : I * (I : FractionalIdeal A⁰ K)⁻¹ = 0
  · rw [hJ0, inv_zero']; exact zero_le _
  intro x hx
  
  suffices x ∈ integralClosure A K by
    rwa [IsIntegrallyClosed.integralClosure_eq_bot, Algebra.mem_bot, Set.mem_range,
      ← mem_one_iff] at this
  
  
  rw [mem_integralClosure_iff_mem_fg]
  have x_mul_mem : ∀ b ∈ (I⁻¹ : FractionalIdeal A⁰ K), x * b ∈ (I⁻¹ : FractionalIdeal A⁰ K) := by
    intro b hb
    rw [mem_inv_iff (coeIdeal_ne_zero.mpr hI0)]
    rw [mem_inv_iff hJ0] at hx
    simp_rw [mul_assoc, mul_comm b]
    exact fun y hy ↦ hx _ (mul_mem_mul hy hb)
  
  refine ⟨AlgHom.range (Polynomial.aeval x : A[X] →ₐ[A] K),
    isNoetherian_submodule.mp (isNoetherian (I : FractionalIdeal A⁰ K)⁻¹) _ fun y hy => ?_,
    ⟨Polynomial.X, Polynomial.aeval_X x⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := (AlgHom.mem_range _).mp hy
  rw [Polynomial.aeval_eq_sum_range]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i hi => Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_
  clear hi
  induction i with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero]; exact one_mem_inv_coe_ideal hI0
  | succ i ih => rw [pow_succ']; exact x_mul_mem _ ih

name: isDedekindDomainInv_iff
statement:
theorem isDedekindDomainInv_iff [IsDomain A] :
    IsDedekindDomainInv A ↔ ∀ I ≠ (⊥ : FractionalIdeal A⁰ K), I * I⁻¹ = 1
proof:
:= by
  let h : FractionalIdeal A⁰ (FractionRing A) ≃+* FractionalIdeal A⁰ K :=
    FractionalIdeal.mapEquiv (FractionRing.algEquiv A K)
  refine h.toEquiv.forall_congr (fun {x} => ?_)
  rw [← h.toEquiv.apply_eq_iff_eq]
  simp [h]

name: isNoetherianRing
statement: theorem isNoetherianRing : IsNoetherianRing A
proof:
:= by
  let := h.commGroupWithZero (FractionRing A)
  refine isNoetherianRing_iff.mpr ⟨fun I : Ideal A => ?_⟩
  by_cases hI : I = ⊥
  · rw [hI]; apply Submodule.fg_bot
  have hI : (I : FractionalIdeal A⁰ (FractionRing A)) ≠ 0 := coeIdeal_ne_zero.mpr hI
  exact I.fg_of_isUnit (IsFractionRing.injective A (FractionRing A)) hI.isUnit

name: integrallyClosed
statement: theorem integrallyClosed : IsIntegrallyClosed A
proof:
:= by
  let := h.commGroupWithZero (FractionRing A)
  
  
  refine (isIntegrallyClosed_iff (FractionRing A)).mpr (fun {x hx} => ?_)
  rw [← Set.mem_range, ← Algebra.mem_bot, ← Subalgebra.mem_toSubmodule, Algebra.toSubmodule_bot,
    Submodule.one_eq_span, ← coe_spanSingleton A⁰ (1 : FractionRing A), spanSingleton_one, ←
    FractionalIdeal.adjoinIntegral_eq_one_of_isUnit x hx (Ne.isUnit _)]
  · exact mem_adjoinIntegral_self A⁰ x hx
  · exact fun h => one_ne_zero (eq_zero_iff.mp h 1 (Algebra.adjoin A {x}).one_mem)

name: dimensionLEOne
statement: theorem dimensionLEOne : DimensionLEOne A
proof:
:= by
  
  
  let := h.commGroupWithZero (K := FractionRing A)
  constructor
  rintro P P_ne hP
  refine Ideal.isMaximal_def.mpr ⟨hP.ne_top, fun M hM => ?_⟩
  
  have P'_ne : (P : FractionalIdeal A⁰ (FractionRing A)) ≠ 0 := coeIdeal_ne_zero.mpr P_ne
  have M'_ne : (M : FractionalIdeal A⁰ (FractionRing A)) ≠ 0 := coeIdeal_ne_zero.mpr hM.ne_bot
  
  suffices (M⁻¹ : FractionalIdeal A⁰ (FractionRing A)) * P ≤ P by
    rw [eq_top_iff, ← coeIdeal_le_coeIdeal (FractionRing A), coeIdeal_top]
    calc
      (1 : FractionalIdeal A⁰ (FractionRing A)) = (↑M)⁻¹ * P * ((↑P)⁻¹ * M) := by
        simp [mul_assoc, *]
      _ ≤ P * ((↑P)⁻¹ * M) := by gcongr
      _ = M := by simp [*]
  
  intro x hx
  have le_one : (M⁻¹ : FractionalIdeal A⁰ (FractionRing A)) * P ≤ 1 := by
    rw [← inv_mul_cancel₀ M'_ne]; gcongr
  obtain ⟨y, _hy, rfl⟩ := (mem_coeIdeal _).mp (le_one hx)
  
  obtain ⟨z, hzM, hzp⟩ := SetLike.exists_of_lt hM
  
  have zy_mem := mul_mem_mul (mem_coeIdeal_of_mem A⁰ hzM) hx
  rw [← map_mul, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ M'_ne, one_mul] at zy_mem
  obtain ⟨zy, hzy, zy_eq⟩ := (mem_coeIdeal A⁰).mp zy_mem
  rw [IsFractionRing.injective A (FractionRing A) zy_eq] at hzy
  
  exact mem_coeIdeal_of_mem A⁰ (Or.resolve_left (hP.mem_or_mem hzy) hzp)

name: isDedekindDomain_iff_isDedekindDomainInv
statement:
theorem isDedekindDomain_iff_isDedekindDomainInv [IsDomain A] :
    IsDedekindDomain A ↔ IsDedekindDomainInv A
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun _ I hI => ?_, fun h =>
    { h.isNoetherianRing, h.dimensionLEOne, h.integrallyClosed with }⟩
  obtain ⟨a, J, ha, hJ⟩ := exists_eq_spanSingleton_mul (K := FractionRing A) I
  suffices h₂ : I * (spanSingleton A⁰ (algebraMap _ _ a) * (J : FractionalIdeal A⁰ _)⁻¹) = 1 by
    rw [mul_inv_cancel_iff]
    exact ⟨spanSingleton A⁰ (algebraMap _ _ a) * (J : FractionalIdeal A⁰ _)⁻¹, h₂⟩
  subst hJ
  rw [mul_assoc, mul_left_comm (J : FractionalIdeal A⁰ _), coe_ideal_mul_inv, mul_one,
    spanSingleton_mul_spanSingleton, inv_mul_cancel₀, spanSingleton_one]
  · exact mt ((injective_iff_map_eq_zero (algebraMap A _)).mp (IsFractionRing.injective A _) _) ha
  · exact coeIdeal_ne_zero.mp (right_ne_zero_of_mul hI)

name: mul_left_strictMono
statement: lemma mul_left_strictMono {I : FractionalIdeal A⁰ K} (hI : I ≠ 0) : StrictMono (· * I)
proof:
:=
  fun _J _K hJK ↦ mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hJK <| pos_iff_ne_zero.2 hI

name: mul_right_strictMono
statement: lemma mul_right_strictMono {I : FractionalIdeal A⁰ K} (hI : I ≠ 0) : StrictMono (I * ·)
proof:
:=
  fun _J _K hJK ↦ mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hJK <| pos_iff_ne_zero.2 hI

name: Ideal.dvd_iff_le
statement: theorem Ideal.dvd_iff_le {I J : Ideal A} : I ∣ J ↔ J ≤ I
proof:
:=
  ⟨Ideal.le_of_dvd, fun h => by
    by_cases hI : I = ⊥
    · have hJ : J = ⊥ := by rwa [hI, ← eq_bot_iff] at h
      rw [hI, hJ]
    have hI' : (I : FractionalIdeal A⁰ (FractionRing A)) ≠ 0 := coeIdeal_ne_zero.mpr hI
    have : (I : FractionalIdeal A⁰ (FractionRing A))⁻¹ * J ≤ 1 := by
      rw [← inv_mul_cancel₀ hI']; gcongr
    obtain ⟨H, hH⟩ := le_one_iff_exists_coeIdeal.mp this
    use H
    refine coeIdeal_injective (show (J : FractionalIdeal A⁰ (FractionRing A)) = ↑(I * H) from ?_)
    rw [coeIdeal_mul, hH, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hI', one_mul]⟩

name: Ideal.liesOver_iff_dvd_map
statement:
theorem Ideal.liesOver_iff_dvd_map [Algebra R A] {p : Ideal R} {P : Ideal A} (hP : P ≠ ⊤)
    [p.IsMaximal] :
    P.LiesOver p ↔ P ∣ Ideal.map (algebraMap R A) p
proof:
:= by
  rw [liesOver_iff, dvd_iff_le, under_def, map_le_iff_le_comap,
    IsCoatom.le_iff_eq (by rwa [← isMaximal_def]) (comap_ne_top _ hP), eq_comm]

name: Ideal.dvdNotUnit_iff_lt
statement: theorem Ideal.dvdNotUnit_iff_lt {I J : Ideal A} : DvdNotUnit I J ↔ J < I
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨hI, H, hunit, hmul⟩ =>
    lt_of_le_of_ne (Ideal.dvd_iff_le.mp ⟨H, hmul⟩)
      (mt
        (fun h =>
          have : H = 1 := mul_left_cancel₀ hI (by rw [← hmul, h, mul_one])
          show IsUnit H from this.symm ▸ isUnit_one)
        hunit),
    fun h =>
    dvdNotUnit_of_dvd_of_not_dvd (Ideal.dvd_iff_le.mpr (le_of_lt h))
      (mt Ideal.dvd_iff_le.mp (not_le_of_gt h))⟩

name: IsIntegral.isUnit
statement:
theorem IsIntegral.isUnit [Field R] [Ring S] [IsDomain S] [Algebra R S] {x : S}
    (int : IsIntegral R x) (h0 : x ≠ 0) : IsUnit x
proof:
:=
  have : FiniteDimensional R (R[x]) := .of_fg int.fg_adjoin_singleton
  (FiniteDimensional.isUnit R (K := R[x])
    (x := ⟨x, subset_adjoin rfl⟩) <| mt Subtype.ext_iff.mp h0).map (R[x]).val

name: isField_of_isIntegral_of_isField'
statement:
theorem isField_of_isIntegral_of_isField' [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [IsDomain S]
    [Algebra R S] [Algebra.IsIntegral R S] (hR : IsField R) : IsField S where
  exists_pair_ne
proof:
:= ⟨0, 1, zero_ne_one⟩
  mul_comm := mul_comm
  mul_inv_cancel {x} hx := by
    let := hR.toField
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral (R := R) x).isUnit hx
    exact ⟨y.inv, y.val_inv⟩

name: IsIntegral.inv_mem_adjoin
statement: theorem IsIntegral.inv_mem_adjoin (int : IsIntegral R x) : x⁻¹ ∈ R[x]
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | h0 := eq_or_ne x 0
  · rw [inv_zero]; exact Subalgebra.zero_mem _
  have : FiniteDimensional R (R[x]) := .of_fg int.fg_adjoin_singleton
  obtain ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, h1⟩ := FiniteDimensional.exists_mul_eq_one R
    (K := R[x]) (x := ⟨x, subset_adjoin rfl⟩) (mt Subtype.ext_iff.mp h0)
  rwa [← mul_left_cancel₀ h0 ((Subtype.ext_iff.mp h1).trans (mul_inv_cancel₀ h0).symm)]

name: IsIntegral.inv_mem
statement: theorem IsIntegral.inv_mem (int : IsIntegral R x) (hx : x ∈ A) : x⁻¹ ∈ A
proof:
:=
  adjoin_le (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hx) int.inv_mem_adjoin

name: Algebra.IsIntegral.inv_mem
statement: theorem Algebra.IsIntegral.inv_mem [Algebra.IsIntegral R A] (hx : x ∈ A) : x⁻¹ ∈ A
proof:
:=
  ((isIntegral_algHom_iff A.val Subtype.val_injective).mpr <|
    Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral (⟨x, hx⟩ : A)).inv_mem hx

name: IsIntegral.inv
statement: theorem IsIntegral.inv (int : IsIntegral R x) : IsIntegral R x⁻¹
proof:
:=
  .of_mem_of_fg _ int.fg_adjoin_singleton _ int.inv_mem_adjoin

name: IsIntegral.mem_of_inv_mem
statement: theorem IsIntegral.mem_of_inv_mem (int : IsIntegral R x) (inv_mem : x⁻¹ ∈ A) : x ∈ A
proof:
:= by
  rw [← inv_inv x]; exact int.inv.inv_mem inv_mem

name: Algebra.IsIntegral.finite
statement:
theorem Algebra.IsIntegral.finite [Algebra.IsIntegral R A] [h' : Algebra.FiniteType R A] :
    Module.Finite R A
proof:
:=
  have ⟨s, hs⟩ := h'
  ⟨by apply hs ▸ fg_adjoin_of_finite s.finite_toSet fun x _ ↦ Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x⟩

name: Algebra.finite_iff_isIntegral_and_finiteType
statement:
theorem Algebra.finite_iff_isIntegral_and_finiteType :
    Module.Finite R A ↔ Algebra.IsIntegral R A ∧ Algebra.FiniteType R A
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ ↦ ⟨⟨.of_finite R⟩, inferInstance⟩, fun ⟨h, _⟩ ↦ h.finite⟩

name: RingHom.IsIntegral.to_finite
statement: theorem RingHom.IsIntegral.to_finite (h : f.IsIntegral) (h' : f.FiniteType) : f.Finite
proof:
:=
  let _ := f.toAlgebra
  let _ : Algebra.IsIntegral R S := ⟨h⟩
  Algebra.IsIntegral.finite (h' := h')

name: RingHom.finite_iff_isIntegral_and_finiteType
statement: theorem RingHom.finite_iff_isIntegral_and_finiteType : f.Finite ↔ f.IsIntegral ∧ f.FiniteType
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨h.to_isIntegral, h.to_finiteType⟩, fun ⟨h, h'⟩ ↦ h.to_finite h'⟩

name: mem_integralClosure_iff_mem_fg
statement:
theorem mem_integralClosure_iff_mem_fg {r : A} :
    r ∈ integralClosure R A ↔ ∃ M : Subalgebra R A, M.toSubmodule.FG ∧ r ∈ M
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hr =>
    ⟨Algebra.adjoin R {r}, hr.fg_adjoin_singleton, Algebra.subset_adjoin rfl⟩,
    fun ⟨M, Hf, hrM⟩ => .of_mem_of_fg M Hf _ hrM⟩

name: adjoin_le_integralClosure
statement:
theorem adjoin_le_integralClosure {x : A} (hx : IsIntegral R x) :
    Algebra.adjoin R {x} ≤ integralClosure R A
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.adjoin_le_iff]
  simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
  exact hx

name: le_integralClosure_iff_isIntegral
statement:
theorem le_integralClosure_iff_isIntegral {S : Subalgebra R A} :
    S ≤ integralClosure R A ↔ Algebra.IsIntegral R S
proof:
:=
  SetLike.forall.symm.trans <|
    (forall_congr' fun _ ↦ isIntegral_algebraMap_iff).trans Algebra.isIntegral_def.symm

name: Algebra.IsIntegral.adjoin
statement:
theorem Algebra.IsIntegral.adjoin {S : Set A} (hS : ∀ x ∈ S, IsIntegral R x) :
    Algebra.IsIntegral R (adjoin R S)
proof:
:=
  le_integralClosure_iff_isIntegral.mp <| adjoin_le hS

name: integralClosure_eq_top_iff
statement: theorem integralClosure_eq_top_iff : integralClosure R A = ⊤ ↔ Algebra.IsIntegral R A
proof:
:= by
  rw [← top_le_iff, le_integralClosure_iff_isIntegral,
      (Subalgebra.topEquiv (R := R) (A := A)).isIntegral_iff]

name: Algebra.isIntegral_sup
statement:
theorem Algebra.isIntegral_sup {S T : Subalgebra R A} :
    Algebra.IsIntegral R (S ⊔ T : Subalgebra R A) ↔
      Algebra.IsIntegral R S ∧ Algebra.IsIntegral R T
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← le_integralClosure_iff_isIntegral, sup_le_iff]

name: Algebra.isIntegral_iSup
statement:
theorem Algebra.isIntegral_iSup {ι} (S : ι → Subalgebra R A) :
    Algebra.IsIntegral R ↑(iSup S) ↔ ∀ i, Algebra.IsIntegral R (S i)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← le_integralClosure_iff_isIntegral, iSup_le_iff]

name: integralClosure_map_algEquiv
statement:
theorem integralClosure_map_algEquiv [Algebra R S] (f : A ≃ₐ[R] S) :
    (integralClosure R A).map (f : A →ₐ[R] S) = integralClosure R S
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  rw [Subalgebra.mem_map]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact hx.map f
  · intro hy
    use f.symm y, hy.map (f.symm : S →ₐ[R] A)
    simp

name: AlgHom.coe_mapIntegralClosure
statement:
@[simp]
theorem AlgHom.coe_mapIntegralClosure [Algebra R S] (f : A →ₐ[R] S)
    (x : integralClosure R A) : (f.mapIntegralClosure x : S) = f (x : A)
proof: := rfl

name: AlgEquiv.coe_mapIntegralClosure
statement:
@[simp]
theorem AlgEquiv.coe_mapIntegralClosure [Algebra R S] (f : A ≃ₐ[R] S)
    (x : integralClosure R A) : (f.mapIntegralClosure x : S) = f (x : A)
proof: := rfl

name: integralClosure.isIntegral
statement: theorem integralClosure.isIntegral (x : integralClosure R A) : IsIntegral R x
proof:
:=
  let ⟨p, hpm, hpx⟩ := x.2
  ⟨p, hpm,
    Subtype.ext <| by
      rwa [← aeval_def, ← Subalgebra.val_apply, aeval_algHom_apply] at hpx⟩

name: IsIntegral.of_mul_unit
statement:
theorem IsIntegral.of_mul_unit {x y : B} {r : R} (hr : algebraMap R B r * y = 1)
    (hx : IsIntegral R (x * y)) : IsIntegral R x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, p_monic, hp⟩ := hx
  refine ⟨scaleRoots p r, (monic_scaleRoots_iff r).2 p_monic, ?_⟩
  convert! scaleRoots_aeval_eq_zero hp
  rw [Algebra.commutes] at hr ⊢
  rw [mul_assoc, hr, mul_one]; rfl

name: RingHom.IsIntegralElem.of_mul_unit
statement:
theorem RingHom.IsIntegralElem.of_mul_unit (x y : S) (r : R) (hr : f r * y = 1)
    (hx : f.IsIntegralElem (x * y)) : f.IsIntegralElem x
proof:
:=
  letI : Algebra R S := f.toAlgebra
  IsIntegral.of_mul_unit hr hx

name: IsIntegral.of_mem_closure'
statement:
theorem IsIntegral.of_mem_closure' (G : Set A) (hG : ∀ x ∈ G, IsIntegral R x) :
    ∀ x ∈ Subring.closure G, IsIntegral R x
proof:
:= fun _ hx ↦
  Subring.closure_induction hG isIntegral_zero isIntegral_one (fun _ _ _ _ ↦ IsIntegral.add)
    (fun _ _ ↦ IsIntegral.neg) (fun _ _ _ _ ↦ IsIntegral.mul) hx

name: IsIntegral.of_mem_closure''
statement:
theorem IsIntegral.of_mem_closure'' {S : Type*} [CommRing S] {f : R →+* S} (G : Set S)
    (hG : ∀ x ∈ G, f.IsIntegralElem x) : ∀ x ∈ Subring.closure G, f.IsIntegralElem x
proof:
:= fun x hx =>
  @IsIntegral.of_mem_closure' R S _ _ f.toAlgebra G hG x hx

name: IsIntegral.pow
statement: theorem IsIntegral.pow {x : B} (h : IsIntegral R x) (n : ℕ) : IsIntegral R (x ^ n)
proof:
:=
  .of_mem_of_fg _ h.fg_adjoin_singleton _ <|
    Subalgebra.pow_mem _ (by exact Algebra.subset_adjoin rfl) _

name: IsIntegral.nsmul
statement: theorem IsIntegral.nsmul {x : B} (h : IsIntegral R x) (n : ℕ) : IsIntegral R (n • x)
proof:
:=
  h.smul n

name: IsIntegral.zsmul
statement: theorem IsIntegral.zsmul {x : B} (h : IsIntegral R x) (n : ℤ) : IsIntegral R (n • x)
proof:

name: IsIntegral.multiset_prod
statement:
theorem IsIntegral.multiset_prod {s : Multiset A} (h : ∀ x ∈ s, IsIntegral R x) :
    IsIntegral R s.prod
proof:
:=
  (integralClosure R A).multiset_prod_mem h

name: IsIntegral.multiset_sum
statement:
theorem IsIntegral.multiset_sum {s : Multiset A} (h : ∀ x ∈ s, IsIntegral R x) :
    IsIntegral R s.sum
proof:
:=
  (integralClosure R A).multiset_sum_mem h

name: IsIntegral.prod
statement:
theorem IsIntegral.prod {α : Type*} {s : Finset α} (f : α → A) (h : ∀ x ∈ s, IsIntegral R (f x)) :
    IsIntegral R (∏ x ∈ s, f x)
proof:
:=
  (integralClosure R A).prod_mem h

name: IsIntegral.sum
statement:
theorem IsIntegral.sum {α : Type*} {s : Finset α} (f : α → A) (h : ∀ x ∈ s, IsIntegral R (f x)) :
    IsIntegral R (∑ x ∈ s, f x)
proof:
