name: exist_mem_one_of_mem_maximal_ideal
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hn : x ∈ p₀.1
  · exact ⟨p₁, h₀.le hn, h₀, h₁⟩
  let e := p₀.1.primeSpectrumQuotientOrderIsoZeroLocus.symm
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := (p₀.1 + span {x}).nonempty_minimalPrimes <|
    sup_le (IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal_of_isPrime p₀.1) ((span_singleton_le_iff_mem 𝔪).mpr hx)
      |>.trans_lt (IsMaximal.isPrime' 𝔪).1.lt_top |>.ne
  let q : PrimeSpectrum R := ⟨q, hq.1.1⟩
  have : q.1.IsPrime := q.2
  have hxq : x ∈ q.1 := le_sup_right.trans hq.1.2 (mem_span_singleton_self x)
  refine ⟨q, hxq, lt_of_le_not_ge (le_sup_left.trans hq.1.2) fun h ↦ hn (h hxq), ?_⟩
  refine lt_of_le_of_ne (IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal_of_isPrime q.1) fun hqm ↦ ?_
  have h : (e ⟨q, le_sup_left.trans hq.1.2⟩).1.height ≤ 1 :=
    map_height_le_one_of_mem_minimalPrimes hq
  simp_rw [show q = closedPoint R from PrimeSpectrum.ext hqm] at h
  have hph : (e ⟨p₁, h₀.le⟩).1.height ≤ 0 :=
    Order.lt_one_iff_nonpos.mp (height_le_iff.mp h _ inferInstance (by simpa using h₁))
  refine not_lt_zero (a := (e ⟨p₀, le_refl p₀⟩).1.height) (height_le_iff.mp hph _ inferInstance ?_)
  simpa using h₀

name: exist_mem_one_of_mem_two
proof:
:= by
  let e := IsLocalization.AtPrime.primeSpectrumOrderIso (Localization.AtPrime p₂.1) p₂.1
  have hm : closedPoint (Localization.AtPrime p₂.1) =
    e.symm ⟨p₂, le_refl p₂⟩ := (PrimeSpectrum.ext Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal).symm
  obtain ⟨q, hxq, h₀, h₁⟩ :=
    @exist_mem_one_of_mem_maximal_ideal (Localization.AtPrime p₂.1) _ _ _
      (e.symm ⟨p₁, h₁.le⟩) (e.symm ⟨p₀, (h₀.trans h₁).le⟩) (e.symm.lt_iff_lt.mpr h₀)
        (by simp [hm, h₁]) (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime p₂.1) x) <| by
          rw [← Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal]
          exact mem_map_of_mem (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime p₂.1)) hx
  rw [← e.symm_apply_apply q] at h₀ h₁ hxq
  have hq : (e q).1 < p₂ := by
    have h : e.symm (e q) < e.symm ⟨p₂, le_refl p₂⟩ :=
      h₁.trans_eq Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal.symm
    rwa [OrderIso.lt_iff_lt, Subtype.mk_lt_mk] at h
  exact Exists.intro (e q).1
    ⟨(p₂.1.under_map_of_isLocalizationAtPrime hq.le).le hxq, e.symm.lt_iff_lt.mp h₀, hq⟩

name: exist_ltSeries_mem_one_of_mem_last
statement:
theorem exist_ltSeries_mem_one_of_mem_last (p : LTSeries (PrimeSpectrum R))
    {x : R} (hx : x ∈ p.last.asIdeal) : ∃ q : LTSeries (PrimeSpectrum R),
    x ∈ (q 1).asIdeal ∧ p.length = q.length ∧ p.head = q.head ∧ p.last = q.last
proof:
:= by
  generalize hp : p.length = n
  induction n generalizing p with
  | zero =>
    use RelSeries.singleton _ p.last
    simp only [RelSeries.singleton_toFun, hx, RelSeries.singleton_length, RelSeries.head,
      RelSeries.last_singleton, and_true, true_and]
    rw [show 0 = Fin.last p.length from Fin.zero_eq_mk.mpr hp, RelSeries.last]
  | succ n hn => ?_
  by_cases h0 : n = 0
  · use p
    have h1 : 1 = Fin.last p.length := by
      rw [Fin.last, hp, h0, zero_add]
      exact Fin.natCast_eq_mk (Nat.one_lt_succ_succ 0)
    simpa [h1, hp] using! hx
  obtain ⟨q, hxq, h2, hq⟩ : ∃ q : PrimeSpectrum R, x ∈ q.1 ∧ p ⟨p.length - 2, _⟩ < q ∧ q < p.last :=
    (p ⟨p.length - 1, p.length.sub_lt_succ 1⟩).exist_mem_one_of_mem_two
      (p.strictMono (Nat.pred_lt (by simpa [hp]))) (p.strictMono (Nat.pred_lt (by simp [hp]))) hx
  obtain ⟨Q, hx, hQ, hh, hl⟩ := hn (p.eraseLast.eraseLast.snoc q h2) (by simpa using! hxq) <| by
    simpa [hp] using! Nat.succ_pred_eq_of_ne_zero h0
  have h1 : 1 < Q.length + 1 := Nat.lt_of_sub_ne_zero (hQ.symm.trans_ne h0)
  have h : 1 = (1 : Fin (Q.length + 1)).castSucc := by simp [Fin.one_eq_mk_of_lt h1]
  exact ⟨Q.snoc p.last (by simpa [← hl] using! hq), by simpa [h], by simpa, by simp [← hh], by simp⟩

name: PrimeSpectrum.continuous_tensorProductTo
statement:
@[fun_prop]
lemma PrimeSpectrum.continuous_tensorProductTo : Continuous (tensorProductTo R S T)
proof:
:=
  (continuous_comap _).prodMk (continuous_comap _)

name: PrimeSpectrum.isEmbedding_tensorProductTo_of_surjectiveOnStalks_aux
statement:
lemma PrimeSpectrum.isEmbedding_tensorProductTo_of_surjectiveOnStalks_aux
    (p₁ p₂ : PrimeSpectrum (S ⊗[R] T))
    (h : tensorProductTo R S T p₁ = tensorProductTo R S T p₂) :
    p₁ ≤ p₂
proof:
:= by
  let g : T →+* S ⊗[R] T := Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom
  intro x hxp₁
  by_contra hxp₂
  obtain ⟨t, r, a, ht, e⟩ := hRT.exists_mul_eq_tmul x
    (p₂.asIdeal.comap g) inferInstance
  have h₁ : a ⊗ₜ[R] t ∈ p₁.asIdeal := e ▸ p₁.asIdeal.mul_mem_left (1 ⊗ₜ[R] (r • t)) hxp₁
  have h₂ : a ⊗ₜ[R] t ∉ p₂.asIdeal := e ▸ p₂.asIdeal.primeCompl.mul_mem ht hxp₂
  rw [← mul_one a, ← one_mul t, ← Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul] at h₁ h₂
  have h₃ : t ∉ p₂.asIdeal.comap g := fun h ↦ h₂ (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ h)
  have h₄ : a ∉ p₂.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap S (S ⊗[R] T)) :=
    fun h ↦ h₂ (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ h)
  replace h₃ : t ∉ p₁.asIdeal.comap g := by
    rwa [show p₁.asIdeal.comap g = p₂.asIdeal.comap g from congr($h.2.1)]
  replace h₄ : a ∉ p₁.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap S (S ⊗[R] T)) := by
    rwa [show p₁.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap S (S ⊗[R] T)) = p₂.asIdeal.comap _ from congr($h.1.1)]
  exact p₁.asIdeal.primeCompl.mul_mem h₄ h₃ h₁

name: PrimeSpectrum.isEmbedding_tensorProductTo_of_surjectiveOnStalks
statement:
lemma PrimeSpectrum.isEmbedding_tensorProductTo_of_surjectiveOnStalks :
    IsEmbedding (tensorProductTo R S T)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun p₁ p₂ e ↦
    (isEmbedding_tensorProductTo_of_surjectiveOnStalks_aux R S T hRT p₁ p₂ e).antisymm
      (isEmbedding_tensorProductTo_of_surjectiveOnStalks_aux R S T hRT p₂ p₁ e.symm)⟩
  let g : T →+* S ⊗[R] T := Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom
  refine ⟨(continuous_tensorProductTo ..).le_induced.antisymm (isBasis_basic_opens.le_iff.mpr ?_)⟩
  rintro _ ⟨f, rfl⟩
  rw [@isOpen_iff_forall_mem_open]
  rintro J (hJ : f ∉ J.asIdeal)
  obtain ⟨t, r, a, ht, e⟩ := hRT.exists_mul_eq_tmul f
    (J.asIdeal.comap g) inferInstance
  refine ⟨_, ?_, ⟨_, (basicOpen a).2.prod (basicOpen t).2, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  · rintro x ⟨hx₁ : a ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : T) ∉ x.asIdeal, hx₂ : (1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R] t ∉ x.asIdeal⟩
      (hx₃ : f ∈ x.asIdeal)
    apply x.asIdeal.primeCompl.mul_mem hx₁ hx₂
    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, mul_one, one_mul, ← e]
    exact x.asIdeal.mul_mem_left _ hx₃
  · have : a ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : T) * (1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R] t ∉ J.asIdeal := by
      rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, mul_one, one_mul, ← e]
      exact J.asIdeal.primeCompl.mul_mem ht hJ
    rwa [J.isPrime.mul_mem_iff_mem_or_mem.not, not_or] at this

name: isOpen_iff
statement: theorem isOpen_iff (U : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)) : IsOpen U ↔ ∃ s, Uᶜ = zeroLocus s
proof:
:= by
  simp only [@eq_comm _ Uᶜ]; rfl

name: isClosed_iff_zeroLocus
statement: theorem isClosed_iff_zeroLocus (Z : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)) : IsClosed Z ↔ ∃ s, Z = zeroLocus s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isOpen_compl_iff, isOpen_iff, compl_compl]

name: isClosed_iff_zeroLocus_ideal
statement:
theorem isClosed_iff_zeroLocus_ideal (Z : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)) :
    IsClosed Z ↔ ∃ I : Ideal R, Z = zeroLocus I
proof:
:=
  (isClosed_iff_zeroLocus _).trans
    ⟨fun ⟨s, hs⟩ => ⟨_, (zeroLocus_span s).substr hs⟩, fun ⟨I, hI⟩ => ⟨I, hI⟩⟩

name: isClosed_iff_zeroLocus_radical_ideal
statement:
theorem isClosed_iff_zeroLocus_radical_ideal (Z : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)) :
    IsClosed Z ↔ ∃ I : Ideal R, I.IsRadical ∧ Z = zeroLocus I
proof:
:=
  (isClosed_iff_zeroLocus_ideal _).trans
    ⟨fun ⟨I, hI⟩ => ⟨_, I.radical_isRadical, (zeroLocus_radical I).substr hI⟩, fun ⟨I, _, hI⟩ =>
      ⟨I, hI⟩⟩

name: isClosed_zeroLocus
statement: theorem isClosed_zeroLocus (s : Set R) : IsClosed (zeroLocus s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isClosed_iff_zeroLocus]
  exact ⟨s, rfl⟩

name: zeroLocus_vanishingIdeal_eq_closure
statement:
theorem zeroLocus_vanishingIdeal_eq_closure (t : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)) :
    zeroLocus (vanishingIdeal t : Set R) = closure t
proof:
:= by
  rcases isClosed_iff_zeroLocus (closure t) |>.mp isClosed_closure with ⟨I, hI⟩
  rw [subset_antisymm_iff, (isClosed_zeroLocus _).closure_subset_iff, hI,
      subset_zeroLocus_iff_subset_vanishingIdeal, (gc R).u_l_u_eq_u,
      ← subset_zeroLocus_iff_subset_vanishingIdeal, ← hI]
  exact ⟨subset_closure, subset_zeroLocus_vanishingIdeal t⟩

name: vanishingIdeal_closure
statement:
theorem vanishingIdeal_closure (t : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)) :
    vanishingIdeal (closure t) = vanishingIdeal t
proof:
:=
  zeroLocus_vanishingIdeal_eq_closure t ▸ (gc R).u_l_u_eq_u t

name: closure_singleton
statement: theorem closure_singleton (x) : closure ({x} : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)) = zeroLocus x.asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  rw [← zeroLocus_vanishingIdeal_eq_closure, vanishingIdeal_singleton]

name: isClosed_singleton_iff_isMaximal
statement:
theorem isClosed_singleton_iff_isMaximal (x : PrimeSpectrum R) :
    IsClosed ({x} : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)) ↔ x.asIdeal.IsMaximal
proof:
:= by
  rw [← closure_subset_iff_isClosed, ← zeroLocus_vanishingIdeal_eq_closure,
      vanishingIdeal_singleton]
  constructor <;> intro H
  · rcases x.asIdeal.exists_le_maximal x.2.1 with ⟨m, hm, hxm⟩
    exact (congr_arg asIdeal (@H ⟨m, hm.isPrime⟩ hxm)) ▸ hm
  · exact fun p hp ↦ PrimeSpectrum.ext (H.eq_of_le p.2.1 hp).symm

name: isRadical_vanishingIdeal
statement: theorem isRadical_vanishingIdeal (s : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)) : (vanishingIdeal s).IsRadical
proof:
:= by
  rw [← vanishingIdeal_closure, ← zeroLocus_vanishingIdeal_eq_closure,
    vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus_eq_radical]
  apply Ideal.radical_isRadical

name: zeroLocus_eq_iff
statement:
theorem zeroLocus_eq_iff {I J : Ideal R} :
    zeroLocus (I : Set R) = zeroLocus J ↔ I.radical = J.radical
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h; simp_rw [← vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus_eq_radical, h]
  · intro h; rw [← zeroLocus_radical, h, zeroLocus_radical]

name: vanishingIdeal_anti_mono_iff
statement:
theorem vanishingIdeal_anti_mono_iff {s t : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)} (ht : IsClosed t) :
    s ⊆ t ↔ vanishingIdeal t ≤ vanishingIdeal s
proof:
:=
  ⟨vanishingIdeal_anti_mono, fun h => by
    rw [← ht.closure_subset_iff, ← ht.closure_eq]
    convert! ← zeroLocus_anti_mono_ideal h <;> apply zeroLocus_vanishingIdeal_eq_closure⟩

name: vanishingIdeal_strict_anti_mono_iff
statement:
theorem vanishingIdeal_strict_anti_mono_iff {s t : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)} (hs : IsClosed s)
    (ht : IsClosed t) : s ⊂ t ↔ vanishingIdeal t < vanishingIdeal s
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.ssubset_def, vanishingIdeal_anti_mono_iff hs, vanishingIdeal_anti_mono_iff ht,
    lt_iff_le_not_ge]

name: t1Space_iff_isField
statement: theorem t1Space_iff_isField [IsDomain R] : T1Space (PrimeSpectrum R) ↔ IsField R
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun h => ?_⟩
  · intro h
    exact
      Classical.not_not.1
        (mt
          (Ring.ne_bot_of_isMaximal_of_not_isField <|
            (isClosed_singleton_iff_isMaximal _).1 (T1Space.t1 ⟨⊥, inferInstance⟩))
          (by simp))
  · refine ⟨fun x => (isClosed_singleton_iff_isMaximal x).2 ?_⟩
    by_cases hx : x.asIdeal = ⊥
    · let := h.toSemifield
      exact hx.symm ▸ Ideal.bot_isMaximal
    · exact absurd h (Ring.not_isField_iff_exists_prime.2 ⟨x.asIdeal, ⟨hx, x.2⟩⟩)

name: isIrreducible_zeroLocus_iff_of_radical
statement:
theorem isIrreducible_zeroLocus_iff_of_radical (I : Ideal R) (hI : I.IsRadical) :
    IsIrreducible (zeroLocus (I : Set R)) ↔ I.IsPrime
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.isPrime_iff, IsIrreducible]
  apply and_congr
  · rw [Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty, Ne, zeroLocus_empty_iff_eq_top]
  · trans ∀ x y : Ideal R, Z(I) ⊆ Z(x) ∪ Z(y) → Z(I) ⊆ Z(x) ∨ Z(I) ⊆ Z(y)
    · simp_rw [isPreirreducible_iff_isClosed_union_isClosed, isClosed_iff_zeroLocus_ideal]
      constructor
      · rintro h x y
        exact h _ _ ⟨x, rfl⟩ ⟨y, rfl⟩
      · rintro h _ _ ⟨x, rfl⟩ ⟨y, rfl⟩
        exact h x y
    · simp_rw [← zeroLocus_inf, subset_zeroLocus_iff_le_vanishingIdeal,
        vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus_eq_radical, hI.radical]
      constructor
      · simp_rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, ← Set.singleton_subset_iff, ← Ideal.span_le, ←
          Ideal.span_singleton_mul_span_singleton]
        refine fun h x y h' => h _ _ ?_
        rw [← hI.radical_le_iff] at h' ⊢
        simpa only [Ideal.radical_inf, Ideal.radical_mul] using h'
      · simp_rw [or_iff_not_imp_left, SetLike.not_le_iff_exists]
        rintro h s t h' ⟨x, hx, hx'⟩ y hy
        exact h (h' ⟨Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ hx, Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hy⟩) hx'

name: isIrreducible_zeroLocus_iff
statement:
theorem isIrreducible_zeroLocus_iff (I : Ideal R) :
    IsIrreducible (zeroLocus (I : Set R)) ↔ I.radical.IsPrime
proof:
:=
  zeroLocus_radical I ▸ isIrreducible_zeroLocus_iff_of_radical _ I.radical_isRadical

name: isIrreducible_iff_vanishingIdeal_isPrime
statement:
theorem isIrreducible_iff_vanishingIdeal_isPrime {s : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)} :
    IsIrreducible s ↔ (vanishingIdeal s).IsPrime
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isIrreducible_iff_closure, ← zeroLocus_vanishingIdeal_eq_closure,
    isIrreducible_zeroLocus_iff_of_radical _ (isRadical_vanishingIdeal s)]

name: vanishingIdeal_isIrreducible
statement:
lemma vanishingIdeal_isIrreducible :
    vanishingIdeal (R := R) '' {s | IsIrreducible s} = {P | P.IsPrime}
proof:
:=
  Set.ext fun I ↦ ⟨fun ⟨_, hs, e⟩ ↦ e ▸ isIrreducible_iff_vanishingIdeal_isPrime.mp hs,
    fun h ↦ ⟨zeroLocus I, (isIrreducible_zeroLocus_iff_of_radical _ h.isRadical).mpr h,
      (vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus_eq_radical I).trans h.radical⟩⟩

name: vanishingIdeal_isClosed_isIrreducible
statement:
lemma vanishingIdeal_isClosed_isIrreducible :
    vanishingIdeal (R := R) '' {s | IsClosed s ∧ IsIrreducible s} = {P | P.IsPrime}
proof:
:= by
  refine (subset_antisymm ?_ ?_).trans vanishingIdeal_isIrreducible
  · exact Set.image_mono fun _ ↦ And.right
  rintro _ ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨closure s, ⟨isClosed_closure, hs.closure⟩, vanishingIdeal_closure s⟩

name: irreducibleSpace_iff_isPrime_nilradical
statement:
lemma irreducibleSpace_iff_isPrime_nilradical :
    IrreducibleSpace (PrimeSpectrum R) ↔ (nilradical R).IsPrime
proof:
:= by
  simp [irreducibleSpace_def, isIrreducible_iff_vanishingIdeal_isPrime]

name: discreteTopology_iff_finite_and_krullDimLE_zero
statement:
theorem discreteTopology_iff_finite_and_krullDimLE_zero : DiscreteTopology (PrimeSpectrum R) ↔
    Finite (PrimeSpectrum R) ∧ Ring.KrullDimLE 0 R
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ ↦ ⟨finite_of_compact_of_discrete, .mk₀ fun I h ↦ isClosed_singleton_iff_isMaximal ⟨I, h⟩
    |>.mp <| discreteTopology_iff_forall_isClosed.mp ‹_› _⟩, fun ⟨_, _⟩ ↦
    .of_finite_of_isClosed_singleton fun p ↦ (isClosed_singleton_iff_isMaximal p).mpr inferInstance⟩

name: discreteTopology_iff_finite_isMaximal_and_sInf_le_nilradical
statement:
theorem discreteTopology_iff_finite_isMaximal_and_sInf_le_nilradical :
    letI s
proof:
:= {I : Ideal R | I.IsMaximal}
    DiscreteTopology (PrimeSpectrum R) ↔ Finite s ∧ sInf s ≤ nilradical R := by
  rw [discreteTopology_iff_finite_and_krullDimLE_zero, Ring.krullDimLE_zero_iff,
    (equivSubtype R).finite_iff, ← Set.coe_ofPred, Set.finite_coe_iff, Set.finite_coe_iff]
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨h.1.subset fun _ h ↦ h.isPrime, nilradical_eq_sInf R ▸ sInf_le_sInf h.2⟩,
    fun ⟨fin, le⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  have hpm (I : Ideal R) (hI : I.IsPrime) : I.IsMaximal := by
    replace le := le.trans (nilradical_le_prime I)
    rw [← fin.coe_toFinset, ← Finset.inf_id_eq_sInf, hI.inf_le'] at le
    have ⟨M, hM, hMI⟩ := le
    rw [fin.mem_toFinset] at hM
    rwa [← hM.eq_of_le hI.1 hMI]
  exact ⟨fin.subset hpm, hpm⟩

name: discreteTopology_of_toLocalization_surjective
statement:
theorem discreteTopology_of_toLocalization_surjective
    (surj : Function.Surjective (toPiLocalization R)) :
    DiscreteTopology (PrimeSpectrum R)
proof:
:=
  discreteTopology_iff_finite_and_krullDimLE_zero.mpr ⟨finite_of_toPiLocalization_surjective
    surj, .mk₀ fun I prime ↦ isMaximal_of_toPiLocalization_surjective surj ⟨I, prime⟩⟩

name: continuous_comap
statement:
@[fun_prop]
lemma continuous_comap (f : R →+* S) : Continuous (comap f)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [continuous_iff_isClosed, isClosed_iff_zeroLocus]
  rintro _ ⟨s, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨_, preimage_comap_zeroLocus_aux f s⟩

name: localization_comap_injective
statement:
theorem localization_comap_injective [Algebra R S] (M : Submonoid R) [IsLocalization M S] :
    Function.Injective (comap (algebraMap R S))
proof:
:= by
  intro p q h
  replace h := _root_.congr_arg (fun x : PrimeSpectrum R => Ideal.map (algebraMap R S) x.asIdeal) h
  dsimp only [comap] at h
  rw [IsLocalization.map_under M S, IsLocalization.map_under M S] at h
  ext1
  exact h

name: localization_comap_range
statement:
theorem localization_comap_range [Algebra R S] (M : Submonoid R) [IsLocalization M S] :
    Set.range (comap (algebraMap R S)) = { p | Disjoint (M : Set R) p.asIdeal }
proof:
:= by
  refine Set.ext fun x ↦ ⟨?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨p, rfl⟩
    exact ((IsLocalization.isPrime_iff_isPrime_disjoint ..).mp p.2).2
  · use ⟨x.asIdeal.map (algebraMap R S), IsLocalization.isPrime_of_isPrime_disjoint M S _ x.2 h⟩
    ext1
    exact IsLocalization.under_map_of_isPrime_disjoint M S x.2 h

name: localization_comap_isInducing
statement:
theorem localization_comap_isInducing [Algebra R S] (M : Submonoid R) [IsLocalization M S] :
    IsInducing (comap (algebraMap R S))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨TopologicalSpace.ext_isClosed fun Z ↦ ?_⟩
  simp_rw [isClosed_induced_iff, isClosed_iff_zeroLocus, @eq_comm _ _ (zeroLocus _),
    exists_exists_eq_and, preimage_comap_zeroLocus]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨s, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨(Ideal.span s).comap (algebraMap R S), ?_⟩
    rw [← zeroLocus_span, ← zeroLocus_span s, ← Ideal.map, IsLocalization.map_under M S]
  · rintro ⟨s, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: localization_comap_isEmbedding
statement:
theorem localization_comap_isEmbedding [Algebra R S] (M : Submonoid R) [IsLocalization M S] :
    IsEmbedding (comap (algebraMap R S))
proof:
:=
  ⟨localization_comap_isInducing S M, localization_comap_injective S M⟩

name: comap_isInducing_of_surjective
statement:
theorem comap_isInducing_of_surjective (hf : Surjective f) : IsInducing (comap f) where
  eq_induced
proof:
:= by
    simp only [TopologicalSpace.ext_iff, ← isClosed_compl_iff, isClosed_iff_zeroLocus,
      isClosed_induced_iff]
    refine fun s =>
      ⟨fun ⟨F, hF⟩ =>
        ⟨zeroLocus (f ⁻¹' F), ⟨f ⁻¹' F, rfl⟩, by
          rw [preimage_comap_zeroLocus, Function.Surjective.image_preimage hf, hF]⟩,
        ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨-, ⟨F, rfl⟩, hF⟩
    exact ⟨f '' F, hF.symm.trans (preimage_comap_zeroLocus f F)⟩

name: isEmbedding_comap_of_surjective
statement: theorem isEmbedding_comap_of_surjective (hf : Surjective f) : IsEmbedding (comap f)
proof:
:=
  (isEmbedding_iff _).2 ⟨comap_isInducing_of_surjective _ _ hf, comap_injective_of_surjective f hf⟩

name: isHomeomorph_comap_of_bijective
statement:
lemma isHomeomorph_comap_of_bijective {f : R →+* S} (hf : Function.Bijective f) :
    IsHomeomorph (comap f)
proof: := (homeomorphOfRingEquiv (.ofBijective f hf)).symm.isHomeomorph

name: comap_singleton_isClosed_of_surjective
statement:
theorem comap_singleton_isClosed_of_surjective (f : R →+* S) (hf : Function.Surjective f)
    (x : PrimeSpectrum S) (hx : IsClosed ({x} : Set (PrimeSpectrum S))) :
    IsClosed ({comap f x} : Set (PrimeSpectrum R))
proof:
:=
  haveI : x.asIdeal.IsMaximal := (isClosed_singleton_iff_isMaximal x).1 hx
  (isClosed_singleton_iff_isMaximal _).2 (Ideal.comap_isMaximal_of_surjective f hf)

name: comap_quotientMk_bijective_of_le_nilradical
statement:
lemma comap_quotientMk_bijective_of_le_nilradical {I : Ideal R} (hle : I ≤ nilradical R) :
    Function.Bijective (comap <| Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨comap_injective_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective, ?_⟩
  simpa [← Set.range_eq_univ, range_comap_of_surjective _ _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective,
    zeroLocus_eq_univ_iff]

name: isClosed_range_comap_of_surjective
statement:
theorem isClosed_range_comap_of_surjective (hf : Surjective f) :
    IsClosed (Set.range (comap f))
proof:
:= by
  rw [range_comap_of_surjective _ f hf]
  exact isClosed_zeroLocus _

name: isClosedEmbedding_comap_of_surjective
statement:
lemma isClosedEmbedding_comap_of_surjective (hf : Surjective f) : IsClosedEmbedding (comap f) where
  toIsInducing
proof:
:= comap_isInducing_of_surjective S f hf
  injective := comap_injective_of_surjective f hf
  isClosed_range := isClosed_range_comap_of_surjective S f hf

name: primeSpectrumProd_symm_inl
statement:
lemma primeSpectrumProd_symm_inl (x) :
    (primeSpectrumProd R S).symm (.inl x) = comap (RingHom.fst R S) x
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp [Ideal.prod]

name: primeSpectrumProd_symm_inr
statement:
lemma primeSpectrumProd_symm_inr (x) :
    (primeSpectrumProd R S).symm (.inr x) = comap (RingHom.snd R S) x
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp [Ideal.prod]

name: range_comap_fst
statement:
lemma range_comap_fst :
    Set.range (comap (RingHom.fst R S)) = zeroLocus (RingHom.ker (RingHom.fst R S))
proof:
:= by
  refine Set.ext fun p ↦ ⟨?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨I, hI, rfl⟩; exact Ideal.comap_mono bot_le
  obtain ⟨p, hp, eq⟩ | ⟨p, hp, eq⟩ := p.1.ideal_prod_prime.mp p.2
  · exact ⟨⟨p, hp⟩, PrimeSpectrum.ext <| by simpa [Ideal.prod] using eq.symm⟩
  · refine (hp.ne_top <| (Ideal.eq_top_iff_one _).mpr ?_).elim
    simpa [eq] using h (show (0, 1) ∈ RingHom.ker (RingHom.fst R S) by simp)

name: range_comap_snd
statement:
lemma range_comap_snd :
    Set.range (comap (RingHom.snd R S)) = zeroLocus (RingHom.ker (RingHom.snd R S))
proof:
:= by
  refine Set.ext fun p ↦ ⟨?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨I, hI, rfl⟩; exact Ideal.comap_mono bot_le
  obtain ⟨p, hp, eq⟩ | ⟨p, hp, eq⟩ := p.1.ideal_prod_prime.mp p.2
  · refine (hp.ne_top <| (Ideal.eq_top_iff_one _).mpr ?_).elim
    simpa [eq] using h (show (1, 0) ∈ RingHom.ker (RingHom.snd R S) by simp)
  · exact ⟨⟨p, hp⟩, PrimeSpectrum.ext <| by simpa [Ideal.prod] using eq.symm⟩

name: isTopologicalBasis_basic_opens

theorem isTopologicalBasis_basic_opens :
    TopologicalSpace.IsTopologicalBasis
      (Set.range fun r : R => (basicOpen r : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)))
proof:
:= by
  apply TopologicalSpace.isTopologicalBasis_of_isOpen_of_nhds
  · rintro _ ⟨r, rfl⟩
    exact isOpen_basicOpen
  · rintro p U hp ⟨s, hs⟩
    rw [← compl_compl U, Set.mem_compl_iff, ← hs, mem_zeroLocus, Set.not_subset] at hp
    obtain ⟨f, hfs, hfp⟩ := hp
    refine ⟨basicOpen f, ⟨f, rfl⟩, hfp, ?_⟩
    rw [← Set.compl_subset_compl, ← hs, basicOpen_eq_zeroLocus_compl, compl_compl]
    exact zeroLocus_anti_mono (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hfs)

    nilpotent_iff_mem_prime, Set.compl_empty_iff, mem_zeroLocus, SetLike.mem_coe]

name: localization_away_comap_range
statement:
theorem localization_away_comap_range (S : Type v) [CommSemiring S] [Algebra R S] (r : R)
    [IsLocalization.Away r S] : Set.range (comap (algebraMap R S)) = basicOpen r
proof:
:= by
  rw [localization_comap_range S (Submonoid.powers r)]
  ext x
  simp only [mem_zeroLocus, basicOpen_eq_zeroLocus_compl, SetLike.mem_coe, Set.mem_ofPred_eq,
    Set.singleton_subset_iff, Set.mem_compl_iff, disjoint_iff_inf_le]
  constructor
  · intro h₁ h₂
    exact h₁ ⟨Submonoid.mem_powers r, h₂⟩
  · rintro h₁ _ ⟨⟨n, rfl⟩, h₃⟩
    exact h₁ (x.2.mem_of_pow_mem _ h₃)

  toIsEmbedding
proof:
:= localization_comap_isEmbedding S (Submonoid.powers r)
  isOpen_range := by
    rw [localization_away_comap_range S r]
    exact isOpen_basicOpen

name: iSup_basicOpen_eq_top_iff
statement:
lemma iSup_basicOpen_eq_top_iff {ι : Type*} {f : ι → R} :
    (⨆ i : ι, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (f i)) = ⊤ ↔ Ideal.span (Set.range f) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [SetLike.ext'_iff, Opens.coe_iSup]
  simp only [PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen_eq_zeroLocus_compl, Opens.coe_top, ← Set.compl_iInter,
    ← PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus_iUnion]
  rw [← PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus_empty_iff_eq_top, compl_involutive.eq_iff]
  simp only [Set.iUnion_singleton_eq_range, Set.compl_univ, PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus_span]

name: iSup_basicOpen_eq_top_iff'
statement:

proof:

  conv_rhs => rw [← Subtype.range_val (s := s), ← iSup_basicOpen_eq_top_iff]

name: isLocalization_away_iff_atPrime_of_basicOpen_eq_singleton
statement:
theorem isLocalization_away_iff_atPrime_of_basicOpen_eq_singleton [Algebra R S]
    {f : R} {p : PrimeSpectrum R} (h : (basicOpen f).1 = {p}) :
    IsLocalization.Away f S ↔ IsLocalization.AtPrime S p.1
proof:
:=
  have : IsLocalization.AtPrime (Localization.Away f) p.1 := by
    refine .of_le_of_exists_dvd (.powers f) _
      (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr <| by apply h ▸ Set.mem_singleton p) fun r hr ↦ ?_
    contrapose! hr
    simp_rw [← Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hr
    have ⟨q, prime, le, disj⟩ := Ideal.exists_le_prime_disjoint (Ideal.span {r})
      (.powers f) (Set.disjoint_right.mpr hr)
    have : ⟨q, prime⟩ ∈ (basicOpen f).1 := Set.disjoint_right.mp disj (Submonoid.mem_powers f)
    rw [h, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at this
    rw [← this]
    exact not_not.mpr (q.span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mp le)
  IsLocalization.isLocalization_iff_of_isLocalization _ _ (Localization.Away f)

name: range_comap_algebraMap_localization_compl_eq_range_comap_quotientMk
statement:
lemma range_comap_algebraMap_localization_compl_eq_range_comap_quotientMk
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (c : R) :
    letI
proof:
:= (mapRingHom (algebraMap R (Away c))).toAlgebra
    (range (comap (algebraMap R[X] (Away c)[X])))ᶜ
      = range (comap (mapRingHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (.span {c})))) := by
  let := (mapRingHom (algebraMap R (Away c))).toAlgebra
  have := Polynomial.isLocalization (.powers c) (Away c)
  rw [Submonoid.map_powers] at this
  have surj : Function.Surjective (mapRingHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (.span {c}))) :=
    Polynomial.map_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  rw [range_comap_of_surjective _ _ surj, localization_away_comap_range _ (C c)]
  simp [Polynomial.ker_mapRingHom, Ideal.map_span]

name: comap_evalRingHom_basicOpen
statement:
lemma comap_evalRingHom_basicOpen [DecidableEq ι] (i : ι) (f : R i) :
    comap (Pi.evalRingHom R i) '' basicOpen f = basicOpen (Pi.single i f)
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
    simpa
  · intro hp
    have : p ∈ Set.range (PrimeSpectrum.comap (Pi.evalRingHom R i)) := by
      rw [range_comap_of_surjective _ _ (RingHom.surjective _), mem_zeroLocus,
        SetLike.coe_subset_coe]
      intro x hx
      rw [RingHom.mem_ker, Pi.evalRingHom_apply] at hx
      have : Pi.single i f * x = 0 := by
        ext j
        by_cases h : i = j
        · subst h
          simp [hx]
        · simp [h]
      obtain (h | h) := Ideal.IsPrime.mem_or_mem_of_mul_eq_zero p.isPrime this <;> tauto
    obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := this
    exact ⟨q, by simpa using hp, by ext; simp⟩

name: isOpenEmbedding_sigmaToPi

    intro i
    exact continuous_comap (Pi.evalRingHom R i)
  · exact sigmaToPi_injective R
  · rw [isOpenMap_sigma]
    intro i
    simp only [sigmaToPi_apply, PrimeSpectrum.isTopologicalBasis_basic_opens.isOpenMap_iff]
    rintro - ⟨f, rfl⟩

name: toPiLocalization_surjective_of_discreteTopology
statement:
theorem toPiLocalization_surjective_of_discreteTopology :
    Function.Surjective (toPiLocalization R)
proof:
:= fun x ↦ by
  have (p : PrimeSpectrum R) : ∃ f, (basicOpen f : Set _) = {p} :=
    have ⟨_, ⟨f, rfl⟩, hpf, hfp⟩ := isTopologicalBasis_basic_opens.isOpen_iff.mp
      (isOpen_discrete {p}) p rfl
    ⟨f, hfp.antisymm <| Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hpf⟩
  choose f hf using this
  let e := Equiv.ofInjective f fun p q eq ↦ Set.singleton_injective (hf p ▸ eq ▸ hf q)
  have loc a : IsLocalization.AtPrime (Localization.Away a.1) (e.symm a).1 :=
    (isLocalization_away_iff_atPrime_of_basicOpen_eq_singleton <| hf _).mp <| by
      simp_rw [e, Equiv.apply_ofInjective_symm]; infer_instance
  let algE a := IsLocalization.algEquiv (e.symm a).1.primeCompl
    (Localization.AtPrime (e.symm a).1) (Localization.Away a.1)
  have span_eq : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = ⊤ := iSup_basicOpen_eq_top_iff.mp <| top_unique
    fun p _ ↦ TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨p, (hf p).ge rfl⟩
  replace hf a : (basicOpen a.1 : Set _) = {e.symm a} := by
    simp_rw [e, ← hf, Equiv.apply_ofInjective_symm]
  obtain ⟨r, eq, -⟩ := Localization.existsUnique_algebraMap_eq_of_span_eq_top _ span_eq
    (fun a ↦ algE a (x _)) fun a b ↦ by
      obtain rfl | ne := eq_or_ne a b; · rfl
      have nil : IsNilpotent (a * b : R) := (basicOpen_eq_bot_iff _).mp <| by
        simp_rw [basicOpen_mul, SetLike.ext'_iff, TopologicalSpace.Opens.coe_inf, hf]
        exact bot_unique (fun _ ⟨ha, hb⟩ ↦ ne <| e.symm.injective (ha.symm.trans hb))
      apply (IsLocalization.subsingleton (M := .powers (a * b : R)) nil).elim
  refine ⟨r, funext fun I ↦ ?_⟩
  have := eq (e I)
  rwa [← AlgEquiv.symm_apply_eq, AlgEquiv.commutes, e.symm_apply_apply] at this

name: isClosed_image_of_stableUnderSpecialization
statement:
lemma isClosed_image_of_stableUnderSpecialization
    (Z : Set (PrimeSpectrum S)) (hZ : IsClosed Z)
    (hf : StableUnderSpecialization (comap f '' Z)) :
    IsClosed (comap f '' Z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨I, rfl⟩ := (PrimeSpectrum.isClosed_iff_zeroLocus_ideal Z).mp hZ
  refine (isClosed_iff_zeroLocus _).mpr ⟨I.comap f, le_antisymm ?_ fun p hp ↦ ?_⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩
    exact Ideal.comap_mono hq
  · obtain ⟨q, hqI, hq, hqle⟩ := p.asIdeal.exists_ideal_comap_le_prime I hp
    exact hf ((le_iff_specializes ⟨q.comap f, inferInstance⟩ p).mp hqle) ⟨⟨q, hq⟩, hqI, rfl⟩

  rw [Set.image_preimage_eq s h₁, ← stableUnderGeneralization_compl_iff]
  convert! h₂.stableUnderGeneralization_image hsc.isOpen_compl.stableUnderGeneralization
  rw [← Set.preimage_compl, Set.image_preimage_eq _ h₁]

name: vanishingIdeal_range_comap
statement:
lemma vanishingIdeal_range_comap :
    vanishingIdeal (Set.range (comap f)) = (RingHom.ker f).radical
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, ← Ideal.comap_radical, Ideal.radical_eq_sInf]
  simp only [mem_vanishingIdeal, Set.mem_range, forall_exists_index, forall_apply_eq_imp_iff,
    comap_asIdeal, Ideal.mem_comap, bot_le, true_and, Submodule.mem_sInf, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
  exact ⟨fun H I hI ↦ H ⟨I, hI⟩, fun H I ↦ H I.1 I.2⟩

name: closure_range_comap
statement:
lemma closure_range_comap :
    closure (Set.range (comap f)) = zeroLocus (RingHom.ker f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← zeroLocus_vanishingIdeal_eq_closure, vanishingIdeal_range_comap, zeroLocus_radical]

name: denseRange_comap_iff_ker_le_nilRadical
statement:
lemma denseRange_comap_iff_ker_le_nilRadical :
    DenseRange (comap f) ↔ RingHom.ker f ≤ nilradical R
proof:
:= by
  rw [denseRange_iff_closure_range, closure_range_comap, zeroLocus_eq_univ_iff,
    SetLike.coe_subset_coe]

name: denseRange_comap_iff_minimalPrimes
statement:
@[stacks 00FL]
lemma denseRange_comap_iff_minimalPrimes :
    DenseRange (comap f) ↔ ∀ I (h : I ∈ minimalPrimes R), ⟨I, h.1.1⟩ ∈ Set.range (comap f)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro H I hI
    have : I ∈ (RingHom.ker f).minimalPrimes := by
      rw [denseRange_comap_iff_ker_le_nilRadical] at H
      simp only [Set.mem_ofPred, Ideal.IsMinimalPrime] at hI ⊢
      convert! hI using 2 with p
      exact ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨h.1, bot_le⟩, fun h ↦ ⟨h.1, H.trans (h.1.radical_le_iff.mpr bot_le)⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨p, hp, _, rfl⟩ := Ideal.exists_comap_eq_of_mem_minimalPrimes f (I := ⊥) I this
    exact ⟨⟨p, hp⟩, rfl⟩
  · intro H p
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hq'⟩ := Ideal.exists_minimalPrimes_le (J := p.asIdeal) bot_le
    exact ((le_iff_specializes ⟨q, hq.1.1⟩ p).mp hq').mem_closed isClosed_closure
      (subset_closure (H q hq))

name: stableUnderSpecialization_singleton
statement:
lemma stableUnderSpecialization_singleton {x : PrimeSpectrum R} :
    StableUnderSpecialization {x} ↔ x.asIdeal.IsMaximal
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← isMax_iff, StableUnderSpecialization, ← le_iff_specializes, Set.mem_singleton_iff,
    @forall_comm _ (_ = _), forall_eq]
  exact ⟨fun H a h ↦ (H a h).le, fun H a h ↦ le_antisymm (H h) h⟩

name: stableUnderGeneralization_singleton
statement:
lemma stableUnderGeneralization_singleton {x : PrimeSpectrum R} :
    StableUnderGeneralization {x} ↔ x.asIdeal ∈ minimalPrimes R
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← isMin_iff, StableUnderGeneralization, ← le_iff_specializes, Set.mem_singleton_iff,
    @forall_comm _ (_ = _), forall_eq]
  exact ⟨fun H a h ↦ (H a h).ge, fun H a h ↦ le_antisymm h (H h)⟩

name: isCompact_isOpen_iff
statement:
lemma isCompact_isOpen_iff {s : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)} :
    IsCompact s ∧ IsOpen s ↔ ∃ t : Finset R, (zeroLocus t)ᶜ = s
proof:
:= by
  rw [isCompact_open_iff_eq_finite_iUnion_of_isTopologicalBasis _
    isTopologicalBasis_basic_opens isCompact_basicOpen]
  simp only [basicOpen_eq_zeroLocus_compl, ← Set.compl_iInter₂, ← zeroLocus_iUnion₂,
    Set.biUnion_of_singleton]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨s, hs, e⟩ ↦ ⟨hs.toFinset, by simpa using e.symm⟩,
    fun ⟨s, e⟩ ↦ ⟨s, s.finite_toSet, by simpa using e.symm⟩⟩

name: isCompact_isOpen_iff_ideal
statement:
lemma isCompact_isOpen_iff_ideal {s : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)} :
    IsCompact s ∧ IsOpen s ↔ ∃ I : Ideal R, I.FG ∧ (zeroLocus I)ᶜ = s
proof:
:= by
  rw [isCompact_isOpen_iff]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨s, e⟩ ↦ ⟨.span s, ⟨s, rfl⟩, by simpa using e⟩,
    fun ⟨I, ⟨s, hs⟩, e⟩ ↦ ⟨s, by simpa [hs.symm] using e⟩⟩

name: basicOpen_eq_zeroLocus_of_mul_add
statement:
lemma basicOpen_eq_zeroLocus_of_mul_add (e f : R) (mul : e * f = 0) (add : e + f = 1) :
    basicOpen e = zeroLocus {f}
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  suffices e ∉ p.asIdeal ↔ f ∈ p.asIdeal by simpa
  refine ⟨(p.2.mem_or_mem_of_mul_eq_zero mul).resolve_left, fun h₁ h₂ ↦ p.2.1 ?_⟩
  rw [Ideal.eq_top_iff_one, ← add]
  exact add_mem h₂ h₁

name: zeroLocus_eq_basicOpen_of_mul_add
statement:
lemma zeroLocus_eq_basicOpen_of_mul_add (e f : R) (mul : e * f = 0) (add : e + f = 1) :
    zeroLocus {e} = basicOpen f
proof:
:= by
  rw [basicOpen_eq_zeroLocus_of_mul_add f e] <;> simp only [mul, add, mul_comm, add_comm]

name: isClopen_basicOpen_of_mul_add
statement:
lemma isClopen_basicOpen_of_mul_add (e f : R) (mul : e * f = 0) (add : e + f = 1) :
    IsClopen (basicOpen e : Set (PrimeSpectrum R))
proof:
:=
  ⟨basicOpen_eq_zeroLocus_of_mul_add e f mul add ▸ isClosed_zeroLocus _, (basicOpen e).2⟩

name: basicOpen_injOn_isIdempotentElem
statement:
lemma basicOpen_injOn_isIdempotentElem :
    {e : R | IsIdempotentElem e}.InjOn basicOpen
proof:
:= fun x hx y hy eq ↦ by
  by_contra! ne
  wlog ne' : x * y ≠ x generalizing x y
  · apply this y hy x hx eq.symm ne.symm
    rwa [mul_comm, of_not_not ne']
  have : x ∉ Ideal.span {y} := fun mem ↦ ne' <| by
    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp mem
    rw [mul_assoc, hy]
  have ⟨p, prime, le, notMem⟩ := Ideal.exists_le_prime_notMem_of_isIdempotentElem _ x hx this
  exact ne_of_mem_of_not_mem' (a := ⟨p, prime⟩) notMem
    (not_not.mpr <| p.span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mp le) eq

name: exists_mul_eq_zero_add_eq_one_basicOpen_eq_of_isClopen
statement:
lemma exists_mul_eq_zero_add_eq_one_basicOpen_eq_of_isClopen {s : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)}
    (hs : IsClopen s) : ∃ e f : R, e * f = 0 ∧ e + f = 1 ∧ s = basicOpen e ∧ sᶜ = basicOpen f
proof:
:= by
  cases subsingleton_or_nontrivial R
  · refine ⟨0, 0, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> apply Subsingleton.elim
  obtain ⟨I, hI, hI'⟩ := isCompact_isOpen_iff_ideal.mp ⟨hs.1.isCompact, hs.2⟩
  obtain ⟨J, hJ, hJ'⟩ := isCompact_isOpen_iff_ideal.mp
    ⟨hs.2.isClosed_compl.isCompact, hs.1.isOpen_compl⟩
  simp only [compl_eq_iff_isCompl, ← eq_compl_iff_isCompl, compl_compl] at hI' hJ'
  have : I * J ≤ nilradical R := by
    refine Ideal.radical_le_radical_iff.mp (le_of_eq ?_)
    rw [← zeroLocus_eq_iff, Ideal.zero_eq_bot, zeroLocus_bot,
      zeroLocus_mul, hI', hJ', Set.compl_union_self]
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Ideal.exists_pow_le_of_le_radical_of_fg this (Submodule.FG.mul hI hJ)
  have hnz : n ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hn
  rw [mul_pow, Ideal.zero_eq_bot] at hn
  have : I ^ n ⊔ J ^ n = ⊤ := by
    rw [eq_top_iff, ← Ideal.span_pow_eq_top (I ∪ J : Set R) _ n, Ideal.span_le, Set.image_union,
      Set.union_subset_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩; exact Ideal.mem_sup_left (Ideal.pow_mem_pow hx n)
    · rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩; exact Ideal.mem_sup_right (Ideal.pow_mem_pow hx n)
    · rw [Ideal.span_union, Ideal.span_eq, Ideal.span_eq, ← zeroLocus_empty_iff_eq_top,
        zeroLocus_sup, hI', hJ', Set.compl_inter_self]
  rw [Ideal.eq_top_iff_one, Submodule.mem_sup] at this
  obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, add⟩ := this
  have mul : x * y = 0 := hn (Ideal.mul_mem_mul hx hy)
  have : s = basicOpen x := by
    refine subset_antisymm ?_ ?_
    · rw [← hJ', basicOpen_eq_zeroLocus_of_mul_add _ _ mul add]
      exact zeroLocus_anti_mono (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr <| Ideal.pow_le_self hnz hy)
    · rw [basicOpen_eq_zeroLocus_compl, Set.compl_subset_comm, ← hI']
      exact zeroLocus_anti_mono (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr <| Ideal.pow_le_self hnz hx)
  refine ⟨x, y, mul, add, this, ?_⟩
  rw [this, basicOpen_eq_zeroLocus_of_mul_add _ _ mul add, basicOpen_eq_zeroLocus_compl]

name: exists_idempotent_basicOpen_eq_of_isClopen
statement:
lemma exists_idempotent_basicOpen_eq_of_isClopen {s : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)}
    (hs : IsClopen s) : ∃ e : R, IsIdempotentElem e ∧ s = basicOpen e
proof:
:=
  have ⟨e, _, mul, add, eq, _⟩ := exists_mul_eq_zero_add_eq_one_basicOpen_eq_of_isClopen hs
  ⟨e, (IsIdempotentElem.of_mul_add mul add).1, eq⟩

name: existsUnique_idempotent_basicOpen_eq_of_isClopen
proof:
:= by
  refine existsUnique_of_exists_of_unique (exists_idempotent_basicOpen_eq_of_isClopen hs) ?_
  rintro x y ⟨hx, rfl⟩ ⟨hy, eq⟩
  exact basicOpen_injOn_isIdempotentElem hx hy (SetLike.ext' eq)

name: isClopen_iff_mul_add
statement:
lemma isClopen_iff_mul_add {s : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)} :
    IsClopen s ↔ ∃ e f : R, e * f = 0 ∧ e + f = 1 ∧ s = basicOpen e
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · have ⟨e, f, h⟩ := exists_mul_eq_zero_add_eq_one_basicOpen_eq_of_isClopen h
    exact ⟨e, f, by simp only [h, and_self]⟩
  rintro ⟨e, f, mul, add, rfl⟩
  exact isClopen_basicOpen_of_mul_add e f mul add

name: isClopen_iff_mul_add_zeroLocus
statement:
lemma isClopen_iff_mul_add_zeroLocus {s : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)} :
    IsClopen s ↔ ∃ e f : R, e * f = 0 ∧ e + f = 1 ∧ s = zeroLocus {e}
proof:
:= by
  rw [isClopen_iff_mul_add, exists_comm]
  refine exists₂_congr fun e f ↦ ?_
  rw [mul_comm, add_comm, ← and_assoc, ← and_assoc, and_congr_right]
  intro ⟨mul, add⟩
  rw [zeroLocus_eq_basicOpen_of_mul_add e f mul add]

name: isRetrocompact_zeroLocus_compl
statement:
lemma isRetrocompact_zeroLocus_compl {s : Set R} (hs : s.Finite) :
    IsRetrocompact (zeroLocus s)ᶜ
proof:
:=
  (QuasiSeparatedSpace.isRetrocompact_iff_isCompact (isClosed_zeroLocus _).isOpen_compl).mpr
    (isCompact_isOpen_iff.mpr ⟨hs.toFinset, by simp⟩).1

name: isRetrocompact_zeroLocus_compl_of_fg
statement:
lemma isRetrocompact_zeroLocus_compl_of_fg {I : Ideal R} (hI : I.FG) :
    IsRetrocompact (zeroLocus (I : Set R))ᶜ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := hI
  rw [zeroLocus_span]
  exact isRetrocompact_zeroLocus_compl s.finite_toSet

name: isRetrocompact_basicOpen
statement:
lemma isRetrocompact_basicOpen {f : R} :
    IsRetrocompact (basicOpen f : Set (PrimeSpectrum R))
proof:
:= by
  simpa using isRetrocompact_zeroLocus_compl (Set.finite_singleton f)

name: isConstructible_basicOpen
statement:
lemma isConstructible_basicOpen {f : R} :
    IsConstructible (basicOpen f : Set (PrimeSpectrum R))
proof:
:=
  isRetrocompact_basicOpen.isConstructible (basicOpen f).2

name: isClosedMap_comap_of_isIntegral
statement:
theorem isClosedMap_comap_of_isIntegral (hf : f.IsIntegral) :
    IsClosedMap (comap f)
proof:
:= by
  refine fun s hs ↦ isClosed_image_of_stableUnderSpecialization _ _ hs ?_
  rintro _ y e ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  algebraize [f]
  obtain ⟨q, hq₁, hq₂, hq₃⟩ := Ideal.exists_ideal_over_prime_of_isIntegral y.asIdeal x.asIdeal
    ((le_iff_specializes _ _).mpr e)
  refine ⟨⟨q, hq₂⟩, ((le_iff_specializes _ ⟨q, hq₂⟩).mp hq₁).mem_closed hs hx,
    PrimeSpectrum.ext hq₃⟩

name: isClosed_comap_singleton_of_isIntegral
statement:
theorem isClosed_comap_singleton_of_isIntegral (hf : f.IsIntegral)
    (x : PrimeSpectrum S) (hx : IsClosed ({x} : Set (PrimeSpectrum S))) :
    IsClosed ({comap f x} : Set (PrimeSpectrum R))
proof:
:= by
  simpa using isClosedMap_comap_of_isIntegral f hf _ hx

name: closure_image_comap_zeroLocus
statement:
lemma closure_image_comap_zeroLocus (I : Ideal S) :
    closure (comap f '' zeroLocus I) = zeroLocus (I.comap f)
proof:
:= by
  apply subset_antisymm
  · rw [(isClosed_zeroLocus _).closure_subset_iff, Set.image_subset_iff, preimage_comap_zeroLocus]
    exact zeroLocus_anti_mono (Set.image_preimage_subset _ _)
  · rintro x (hx : I.comap f ≤ x.asIdeal)
    obtain ⟨q, hq₁, hq₂⟩ := Ideal.exists_minimalPrimes_le hx
    obtain ⟨p', hp', hp'', rfl⟩ := Ideal.exists_comap_eq_of_mem_minimalPrimes f _ hq₁
    let p'' : PrimeSpectrum S := ⟨p', hp'⟩
    apply isClosed_closure.stableUnderSpecialization ((le_iff_specializes
      (comap f ⟨p', hp'⟩) x).mp hq₂) (subset_closure (by exact ⟨_, hp'', rfl⟩))

name: isIntegral_of_isClosedMap_comap_mapRingHom
statement:
lemma isIntegral_of_isClosedMap_comap_mapRingHom (h : IsClosedMap (comap (mapRingHom f))) :
    f.IsIntegral
proof:
:= by
  algebraize [f]
  suffices Algebra.IsIntegral R S by rwa [Algebra.isIntegral_def] at this
  nontriviality R
  nontriviality S
  constructor
  intro r
  let p : S[X] := C r * X - 1
  have : (1 : R[X]) ∈ Ideal.span {X} ⊔ (Ideal.span {p}).comap (mapRingHom f) := by
    have H := h _ (isClosed_zeroLocus {p})
    rw [← zeroLocus_span, ← closure_eq_iff_isClosed, closure_image_comap_zeroLocus] at H
    rw [← Ideal.eq_top_iff_one, sup_comm, ← zeroLocus_empty_iff_eq_top, zeroLocus_sup, H]
    suffices ∀ (a : PrimeSpectrum S[X]), p ∈ a.asIdeal → X ∉ a.asIdeal by
      simpa [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
    intro q hpq hXq
    have : 1 ∈ q.asIdeal := by simpa [p] using! (sub_mem (q.asIdeal.mul_mem_left (C r) hXq) hpq)
    exact q.2.ne_top (q.asIdeal.eq_top_iff_one.mpr this)
  obtain ⟨a, b, hb, e⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton_sup.mp this
  obtain ⟨c, hc : b.map (algebraMap R S) = _⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp hb
  refine ⟨b.reverse * X ^ (1 + c.natDegree), ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine Monic.mul ?_ (by simp)
    have h : b.coeff 0 = 1 := by simpa using! congr(($e).coeff 0)
    have : b.natTrailingDegree = 0 := by simp [h]
    rw [Monic.def, reverse_leadingCoeff, trailingCoeff, this, h]
  · have : p.natDegree ≤ 1 := by simpa using! natDegree_linear_le (a := r) (b := -1)
    rw [eval₂_eq_eval_map, reverse, Polynomial.map_mul, ← reflect_map, Polynomial.map_pow,
      map_X, ← revAt_zero (1 + _), ← reflect_monomial,
      ← reflect_mul _ _ natDegree_map_le (by simp), pow_zero, mul_one, hc,
      ← add_assoc, reflect_mul _ _ (this.trans (by simp)) le_rfl,
      eval_mul, reflect_sub, reflect_mul _ _ (by simp) (by simp)]
    simp [← pow_succ']

name: _root_.Algebra.IsIntegral.comap_surjective
statement:
lemma _root_.Algebra.IsIntegral.comap_surjective [Algebra R S] [Algebra.IsIntegral R S]
    [FaithfulSMul R S] :
    Function.Surjective (comap (algebraMap R S))
proof:
:= by
  intro ⟨p, hp⟩
  have hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap R S) := FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective _ _
  obtain ⟨Q, _, hQ, rfl⟩ := Ideal.exists_ideal_over_prime_of_isIntegral p (⊥ : Ideal S)
    (by simp [Ideal.comap_bot_of_injective (algebraMap R S) hinj])
  exact ⟨⟨Q, hQ⟩, rfl⟩

name: _root_.RingHom.IsIntegral.comap_surjective
statement:
lemma _root_.RingHom.IsIntegral.comap_surjective {f : R →+* S} (hf : f.IsIntegral)
    (hinj : Function.Injective f) : Function.Surjective (comap f)
proof:
:= by
  algebraize [f]
  have : FaithfulSMul R S := (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective R S).mpr hinj
  exact Algebra.IsIntegral.comap_surjective _ _

name: vanishingIdeal_irreducibleComponents
statement:
lemma vanishingIdeal_irreducibleComponents :
    vanishingIdeal '' (irreducibleComponents <| PrimeSpectrum R) = minimalPrimes R
proof:
:= by
  rw [irreducibleComponents_eq_maximals_closed, minimalPrimes_eq_minimals,
    image_antitone_setOfPred_maximal (fun s t hs _ ↦ (vanishingIdeal_anti_mono_iff hs.1).symm),
    ← funext (@Set.mem_ofPred_eq _ · Ideal.IsPrime), ← vanishingIdeal_isClosed_isIrreducible]
  rfl

name: zeroLocus_minimalPrimes
statement:
lemma zeroLocus_minimalPrimes :
    zeroLocus ∘ (↑) '' minimalPrimes R = irreducibleComponents (PrimeSpectrum R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← vanishingIdeal_irreducibleComponents, ← Set.image_comp, Set.EqOn.image_eq_self]
  intro s hs
  simpa [zeroLocus_vanishingIdeal_eq_closure, closure_eq_iff_isClosed]
    using isClosed_of_mem_irreducibleComponents s hs

name: vanishingIdeal_mem_minimalPrimes
statement:
lemma vanishingIdeal_mem_minimalPrimes {s : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)} :
    vanishingIdeal s ∈ minimalPrimes R ↔ closure s ∈ irreducibleComponents (PrimeSpectrum R)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [← zeroLocus_minimalPrimes, ← zeroLocus_vanishingIdeal_eq_closure]
    exact Set.mem_image_of_mem _
  · rw [← vanishingIdeal_irreducibleComponents, ← vanishingIdeal_closure]
    exact Set.mem_image_of_mem _

name: zeroLocus_ideal_mem_irreducibleComponents
statement:
lemma zeroLocus_ideal_mem_irreducibleComponents {I : Ideal R} :
    zeroLocus I ∈ irreducibleComponents (PrimeSpectrum R) ↔ I.radical ∈ minimalPrimes R
proof:
:= by
  rw [← vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus_eq_radical]
  conv_lhs => rw [← (isClosed_zeroLocus _).closure_eq]
  exact vanishingIdeal_mem_minimalPrimes.symm

name: PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal_top
statement:

theorem isLocalHom_iff_comap_closedPoint {S : Type v} [CommSemiring S] [IsLocalRing S]

name: comap_closedPoint

@[simp]
theorem comap_closedPoint {S : Type v} [CommSemiring S] [IsLocalRing S] (f : R →+* S)

name: specializes_closedPoint

name: closedPoint_mem_iff
statement:
theorem closedPoint_mem_iff (U : TopologicalSpace.Opens <| PrimeSpectrum R) :
    closedPoint R ∈ U ↔ U = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [eq_top_iff]
    exact fun h x _ => (specializes_closedPoint x).mem_open U.2 h
  · rintro rfl
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_top _

name: closed_point_mem_iff
statement:
lemma closed_point_mem_iff {U : TopologicalSpace.Opens (PrimeSpectrum R)} :
    closedPoint R ∈ U ↔ U = ⊤
proof:

  ⟨(eq_top_iff.mpr fun x _ ↦ (specializes_closedPoint x).mem_open U.2 ·), (· ▸ trivial)⟩

name: PrimeSpectrum.comap_residue

name: basicOpen_eq_zeroLocus_of_isIdempotentElem
statement:
@[stacks 00EC]
lemma basicOpen_eq_zeroLocus_of_isIdempotentElem
    (e : R) (he : IsIdempotentElem e) :
    basicOpen e = zeroLocus {1 - e}
proof:
:=
  basicOpen_eq_zeroLocus_of_mul_add _ _ (by simp [mul_sub, he.eq]) (by simp)

name: zeroLocus_eq_basicOpen_of_isIdempotentElem
statement:
@[stacks 00EC]
lemma zeroLocus_eq_basicOpen_of_isIdempotentElem
    (e : R) (he : IsIdempotentElem e) :

:= by

name: isClopen_iff
statement:
lemma isClopen_iff {s : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)} :
    IsClopen s ↔ ∃ e : R, IsIdempotentElem e ∧ s = basicOpen e
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨exists_idempotent_basicOpen_eq_of_isClopen, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨e, he, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨?_, (basicOpen e).2⟩
  rw [PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen_eq_zeroLocus_of_isIdempotentElem e he]
  exact isClosed_zeroLocus _

name: isClopen_iff_zeroLocus
statement:
lemma isClopen_iff_zeroLocus {s : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)} :
    IsClopen s ↔ ∃ e : R, IsIdempotentElem e ∧ s = zeroLocus {e}
proof:
:=
  isClopen_iff.trans <| ⟨fun ⟨e, he, h⟩ ↦ ⟨1 - e, he.one_sub,
    h.trans (basicOpen_eq_zeroLocus_of_isIdempotentElem e he)⟩,
    fun ⟨e, he, h⟩ ↦ ⟨1 - e, he.one_sub, h.trans (zeroLocus_eq_basicOpen_of_isIdempotentElem e he)⟩⟩

name: basicOpen_isIdempotentElemEquivClopens_symm
statement:
lemma basicOpen_isIdempotentElemEquivClopens_symm (s) :
    basicOpen (isIdempotentElemEquivClopens (R := R).symm s).1 = s.toOpens
proof:
:=
  Opens.ext <| congr_arg (·.1) (isIdempotentElemEquivClopens.apply_symm_apply s)

name: coe_isIdempotentElemEquivClopens_apply
statement:
lemma coe_isIdempotentElemEquivClopens_apply (e) :
    (isIdempotentElemEquivClopens e : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)) = basicOpen (e.1 : R)
proof: := rfl

name: isIdempotentElemEquivClopens_apply_toOpens
statement:
lemma isIdempotentElemEquivClopens_apply_toOpens (e) :
    (isIdempotentElemEquivClopens e).toOpens = basicOpen (e.1 : R)
proof: := rfl

name: isIdempotentElemEquivClopens_mul
statement:
lemma isIdempotentElemEquivClopens_mul (e₁ e₂ : {e : R | IsIdempotentElem e}) :
    isIdempotentElemEquivClopens ⟨_, e₁.2.mul e₂.2⟩ =
      isIdempotentElemEquivClopens e₁ ⊓ isIdempotentElemEquivClopens e₂
proof:
:=
  map_inf ..

name: isIdempotentElemEquivClopens_one_sub
statement:
lemma isIdempotentElemEquivClopens_one_sub (e : {e : R | IsIdempotentElem e}) :
    isIdempotentElemEquivClopens ⟨_, e.2.one_sub⟩ = (isIdempotentElemEquivClopens e)ᶜ
proof:
:=
  map_compl ..

name: isIdempotentElemEquivClopens_symm_inf
statement:
lemma isIdempotentElemEquivClopens_symm_inf (s₁ s₂) :
    letI e
proof:
:= isIdempotentElemEquivClopens (R := R).symm
    e (s₁ ⊓ s₂) = ⟨_, (e s₁).2.mul (e s₂).2⟩ :=
  map_inf ..

name: isIdempotentElemEquivClopens_symm_compl
statement:
lemma isIdempotentElemEquivClopens_symm_compl (s : Clopens (PrimeSpectrum R)) :
    isIdempotentElemEquivClopens.symm sᶜ = ⟨_, (isIdempotentElemEquivClopens.symm s).2.one_sub⟩
proof:
:=
  map_compl ..

name: isIdempotentElemEquivClopens_symm_top
statement:
lemma isIdempotentElemEquivClopens_symm_top :
    isIdempotentElemEquivClopens.symm ⊤ = ⟨(1 : R), .one⟩
proof:
:=
  map_top _

name: isIdempotentElemEquivClopens_symm_bot
statement:
lemma isIdempotentElemEquivClopens_symm_bot :
    isIdempotentElemEquivClopens.symm ⊥ = ⟨(0 : R), .zero⟩
proof:
:=
  map_bot _

name: isIdempotentElemEquivClopens_symm_sup
statement:
lemma isIdempotentElemEquivClopens_symm_sup (s₁ s₂ : Clopens (PrimeSpectrum R)) :
    letI e
proof:
:= isIdempotentElemEquivClopens (R := R).symm
    e (s₁ ⊔ s₂) = ⟨_, (e s₁).2.add_sub_mul (e s₂).2⟩ :=
  map_sup ..

name: nonempty_iff_nontrivial
statement: lemma nonempty_iff_nontrivial : Nonempty (PrimeSpectrum R) ↔ Nontrivial R
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨p⟩ ↦ ⟨0, 1, fun h ↦ p.2.ne_top ?_⟩, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · simp [Ideal.eq_top_iff_one p.asIdeal, ← h]
  · obtain ⟨I, hI⟩ := Ideal.exists_maximal R
    exact ⟨⟨I, hI.isPrime⟩⟩

name: isEmpty_iff_subsingleton
statement: lemma isEmpty_iff_subsingleton : IsEmpty (PrimeSpectrum R) ↔ Subsingleton R
proof:
:= by
  contrapose!; exact nonempty_iff_nontrivial

name: nontrivial
statement: lemma nontrivial (p : PrimeSpectrum R) : Nontrivial R
proof:
:=
  nonempty_iff_nontrivial.mp ⟨p⟩

name: range_asIdeal
statement: theorem range_asIdeal : Set.range PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal = {J : Ideal R | J.IsPrime}
proof:
:=
  Set.ext fun J ↦
    ⟨fun hJ ↦ let ⟨j, hj⟩ := Set.mem_range.mp hJ; Set.mem_ofPred.mpr <| hj ▸ j.isPrime,
      fun hJ ↦ Set.mem_range.mpr ⟨⟨J, Set.mem_ofPred.mp hJ⟩, rfl⟩⟩

name: primeSpectrumProd_symm_inl_asIdeal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem primeSpectrumProd_symm_inl_asIdeal (x : PrimeSpectrum R) :
    ((primeSpectrumProd R S).symm <| Sum.inl x).asIdeal = Ideal.prod x.asIdeal ⊤
proof:
:= by
  cases x
  rfl

name: primeSpectrumProd_symm_inr_asIdeal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem primeSpectrumProd_symm_inr_asIdeal (x : PrimeSpectrum S) :
    ((primeSpectrumProd R S).symm <| Sum.inr x).asIdeal = Ideal.prod ⊤ x.asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  cases x
  rfl

name: mem_zeroLocus
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_zeroLocus (x : PrimeSpectrum R) (s : Set R) : x ∈ zeroLocus s ↔ s ⊆ x.asIdeal
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: zeroLocus_span
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zeroLocus_span (s : Set R) : zeroLocus (Ideal.span s : Set R) = zeroLocus s
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  exact (Submodule.gi R R).gc s x.asIdeal

name: coe_vanishingIdeal
statement:
theorem coe_vanishingIdeal (t : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)) :
    (vanishingIdeal t : Set R) = { f : R | ∀ x ∈ t, f ∈ x.asIdeal }
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  rw [vanishingIdeal, SetLike.mem_coe, Submodule.mem_iInf]
  apply forall_congr'; intro x
  rw [Submodule.mem_iInf]

name: mem_vanishingIdeal
statement:
theorem mem_vanishingIdeal (t : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)) (f : R) :
    f ∈ vanishingIdeal t ↔ ∀ x ∈ t, f ∈ x.asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, coe_vanishingIdeal, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]

name: vanishingIdeal_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem vanishingIdeal_singleton (x : PrimeSpectrum R) :
    vanishingIdeal ({x} : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)) = x.asIdeal
proof: := by simp [vanishingIdeal]

name: subset_zeroLocus_iff_le_vanishingIdeal
statement:
theorem subset_zeroLocus_iff_le_vanishingIdeal (t : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)) (I : Ideal R) :
    t ⊆ zeroLocus I ↔ I ≤ vanishingIdeal t
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h _ k => (mem_vanishingIdeal _ _).mpr fun _ j => (mem_zeroLocus _ _).mpr (h j) k, fun h =>
    fun x j => (mem_zeroLocus _ _).mpr (le_trans h fun _ h => ((mem_vanishingIdeal _ _).mp h) x j)⟩

name: gc
proof:
:=
  fun I t => subset_zeroLocus_iff_le_vanishingIdeal t I

name: gc_set
proof:
:= by
  have ideal_gc : GaloisConnection Ideal.span _ := (Submodule.gi R R).gc
  simpa [zeroLocus_span, Function.comp_def] using ideal_gc.compose (gc R)

name: subset_zeroLocus_iff_subset_vanishingIdeal
statement:
theorem subset_zeroLocus_iff_subset_vanishingIdeal (t : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)) (s : Set R) :
    t ⊆ zeroLocus s ↔ s ⊆ vanishingIdeal t
proof:
:=
  (gc_set R) s t

name: subset_vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus
statement: theorem subset_vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus (s : Set R) : s ⊆ vanishingIdeal (zeroLocus s)
proof:
:=
  (gc_set R).le_u_l s

name: le_vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus
statement: theorem le_vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus (I : Ideal R) : I ≤ vanishingIdeal (zeroLocus I)
proof:
:=
  (gc R).le_u_l I

name: vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus_eq_radical
statement:
@[simp]
theorem vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus_eq_radical (I : Ideal R) :
    vanishingIdeal (zeroLocus (I : Set R)) = I.radical
proof:
:=
  Ideal.ext fun f => by
    rw [mem_vanishingIdeal, Ideal.radical_eq_sInf, Submodule.mem_sInf]
    exact ⟨fun h x hx => h ⟨x, hx.2⟩ hx.1, fun h x hx => h x.1 ⟨hx, x.2⟩⟩

name: nilradical_eq_iInf
statement: theorem nilradical_eq_iInf : nilradical R = iInf asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  apply range_asIdeal R ▸ nilradical_eq_sInf R

name: vanishingIdeal_univ
statement: @[simp] theorem vanishingIdeal_univ : vanishingIdeal Set.univ = nilradical R
proof:
:= by
  rw [vanishingIdeal, iInf_univ, nilradical_eq_iInf]

name: zeroLocus_radical
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zeroLocus_radical (I : Ideal R) : zeroLocus (I.radical : Set R) = zeroLocus I
proof:
:=
  vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus_eq_radical I ▸ (gc R).l_u_l_eq_l I

name: subset_zeroLocus_vanishingIdeal
statement:
theorem subset_zeroLocus_vanishingIdeal (t : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)) :
    t ⊆ zeroLocus (vanishingIdeal t)
proof:
:=
  (gc R).l_u_le t

name: zeroLocus_anti_mono
statement: theorem zeroLocus_anti_mono {s t : Set R} (h : s ⊆ t) : zeroLocus t ⊆ zeroLocus s
proof:
:=
  (gc_set R).monotone_l h

name: zeroLocus_anti_mono_ideal
statement:
theorem zeroLocus_anti_mono_ideal {s t : Ideal R} (h : s ≤ t) :
    zeroLocus (t : Set R) ⊆ zeroLocus (s : Set R)
proof:
:=
  (gc R).monotone_l h

name: vanishingIdeal_anti_mono
statement:
theorem vanishingIdeal_anti_mono {s t : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)} (h : s ⊆ t) :
    vanishingIdeal t ≤ vanishingIdeal s
proof:
:=
  (gc R).monotone_u h

name: zeroLocus_subset_zeroLocus_iff
statement:
theorem zeroLocus_subset_zeroLocus_iff (I J : Ideal R) :
    zeroLocus (I : Set R) ⊆ zeroLocus (J : Set R) ↔ J ≤ I.radical
proof:
:= by
  rw [subset_zeroLocus_iff_le_vanishingIdeal, vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus_eq_radical]

name: zeroLocus_subset_zeroLocus_singleton_iff
statement:
theorem zeroLocus_subset_zeroLocus_singleton_iff (f g : R) :
    zeroLocus ({f} : Set R) ⊆ zeroLocus {g} ↔ g ∈ (Ideal.span ({f} : Set R)).radical
proof:
:= by
  rw [← zeroLocus_span {f}, ← zeroLocus_span {g}, zeroLocus_subset_zeroLocus_iff, Ideal.span_le,
    Set.singleton_subset_iff, SetLike.mem_coe]

name: zeroLocus_bot
statement: theorem zeroLocus_bot : zeroLocus ((⊥ : Ideal R) : Set R) = Set.univ
proof:
:=
  (gc R).l_bot

name: zeroLocus_nilradical
statement:
@[simp]
lemma zeroLocus_nilradical : zeroLocus (nilradical R : Set R) = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  rw [nilradical, zeroLocus_radical, Ideal.zero_eq_bot, zeroLocus_bot]

name: zeroLocus_singleton_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zeroLocus_singleton_zero : zeroLocus ({0} : Set R) = Set.univ
proof:
:=
  zeroLocus_bot

name: zeroLocus_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zeroLocus_empty : zeroLocus (∅ : Set R) = Set.univ
proof:
:=
  (gc_set R).l_bot

name: vanishingIdeal_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem vanishingIdeal_empty : vanishingIdeal (∅ : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  simpa using! (gc R).u_top

name: zeroLocus_empty_of_one_mem
statement: theorem zeroLocus_empty_of_one_mem {s : Set R} (h : (1 : R) ∈ s) : zeroLocus s = ∅
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
  intro x hx
  rw [mem_zeroLocus] at hx
  have x_prime : x.asIdeal.IsPrime := by infer_instance
  have eq_top : x.asIdeal = ⊤ := by
    rw [Ideal.eq_top_iff_one]
    exact hx h
  apply x_prime.ne_top eq_top

name: zeroLocus_singleton_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zeroLocus_singleton_one : zeroLocus ({1} : Set R) = ∅
proof:
:=
  zeroLocus_empty_of_one_mem (Set.mem_singleton (1 : R))

name: zeroLocus_empty_iff_eq_top
statement: theorem zeroLocus_empty_iff_eq_top {I : Ideal R} : zeroLocus (I : Set R) = ∅ ↔ I = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · contrapose!
    intro h
    rcases Ideal.exists_le_maximal I h with ⟨M, hM, hIM⟩
    exact ⟨⟨M, hM.isPrime⟩, hIM⟩
  · rintro rfl
    apply zeroLocus_empty_of_one_mem
    trivial

name: zeroLocus_univ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zeroLocus_univ : zeroLocus (Set.univ : Set R) = ∅
proof:
:=
  zeroLocus_empty_of_one_mem (Set.mem_univ 1)

name: vanishingIdeal_eq_top_iff
statement: theorem vanishingIdeal_eq_top_iff {s : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)} : vanishingIdeal s = ⊤ ↔ s = ∅
proof:
:= by
  rw [← top_le_iff, ← subset_zeroLocus_iff_le_vanishingIdeal, Submodule.top_coe, zeroLocus_univ,
    Set.subset_empty_iff]

name: zeroLocus_eq_univ_iff
statement:
theorem zeroLocus_eq_univ_iff (s : Set R) :
    zeroLocus s = Set.univ ↔ s ⊆ nilradical R
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Set.univ_subset_iff, subset_zeroLocus_iff_subset_vanishingIdeal, vanishingIdeal_univ]

name: zeroLocus_sup
statement:
theorem zeroLocus_sup (I J : Ideal R) :
    zeroLocus ((I ⊔ J : Ideal R) : Set R) = zeroLocus I ∩ zeroLocus J
proof:
:=
  (gc R).l_sup

name: zeroLocus_union
statement: theorem zeroLocus_union (s s' : Set R) : zeroLocus (s ∪ s') = zeroLocus s ∩ zeroLocus s'
proof:
:=
  (gc_set R).l_sup

name: vanishingIdeal_union
statement:
theorem vanishingIdeal_union (t t' : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)) :
    vanishingIdeal (t ∪ t') = vanishingIdeal t ⊓ vanishingIdeal t'
proof:
:=
  (gc R).u_inf

name: zeroLocus_iSup
statement:
theorem zeroLocus_iSup {ι : Sort*} (I : ι → Ideal R) :
    zeroLocus ((⨆ i, I i : Ideal R) : Set R) = ⋂ i, zeroLocus (I i)
proof:
:=
  (gc R).l_iSup

name: zeroLocus_iUnion
statement:
theorem zeroLocus_iUnion {ι : Sort*} (s : ι → Set R) :
    zeroLocus (⋃ i, s i) = ⋂ i, zeroLocus (s i)
proof:
:=
  (gc_set R).l_iSup

name: zeroLocus_iUnion
statement:
theorem zeroLocus_iUnion₂ {ι : Sort*} {κ : (i : ι) → Sort*} (s : ∀ i, κ i → Set R) :
    zeroLocus (⋃ (i) (j), s i j) = ⋂ (i) (j), zeroLocus (s i j)
proof:
:=
  (gc_set R).l_iSup₂

name: zeroLocus_bUnion
statement:
theorem zeroLocus_bUnion (s : Set (Set R)) :
    zeroLocus (⋃ s' ∈ s, s' : Set R) = ⋂ s' ∈ s, zeroLocus s'
proof: := by simp only [zeroLocus_iUnion]

name: vanishingIdeal_iUnion
statement:
theorem vanishingIdeal_iUnion {ι : Sort*} (t : ι → Set (PrimeSpectrum R)) :
    vanishingIdeal (⋃ i, t i) = ⨅ i, vanishingIdeal (t i)
proof:
:=
  (gc R).u_iInf

name: zeroLocus_inf
statement:
theorem zeroLocus_inf (I J : Ideal R) :
    zeroLocus ((I ⊓ J : Ideal R) : Set R) = zeroLocus I ∪ zeroLocus J
proof:
:=
  Set.ext fun x => x.2.inf_le

name: union_zeroLocus
statement:
theorem union_zeroLocus (s s' : Set R) :
    zeroLocus s ∪ zeroLocus s' = zeroLocus (Ideal.span s ⊓ Ideal.span s' : Ideal R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [zeroLocus_inf]
  simp

name: zeroLocus_mul
statement:
theorem zeroLocus_mul (I J : Ideal R) :
    zeroLocus ((I * J : Ideal R) : Set R) = zeroLocus I ∪ zeroLocus J
proof:
:=
  Set.ext fun x => x.2.mul_le

name: zeroLocus_singleton_mul
statement:
theorem zeroLocus_singleton_mul (f g : R) :
    zeroLocus ({f * g} : Set R) = zeroLocus {f} ∪ zeroLocus {g}
proof:
:=
  Set.ext fun x => by simpa using x.2.mul_mem_iff_mem_or_mem

name: zeroLocus_pow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zeroLocus_pow (I : Ideal R) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    zeroLocus ((I ^ n : Ideal R) : Set R) = zeroLocus I
proof:
:=
  zeroLocus_radical (I ^ n) ▸ (I.radical_pow hn).symm ▸ zeroLocus_radical I

name: zeroLocus_singleton_pow
proof:
:=
  Set.ext fun x => by simpa using x.2.pow_mem_iff_mem n hn

name: sup_vanishingIdeal_le
statement:
theorem sup_vanishingIdeal_le (t t' : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)) :
    vanishingIdeal t ⊔ vanishingIdeal t' ≤ vanishingIdeal (t ∩ t')
proof:
:= by
  intro r
  rw [Submodule.mem_sup, mem_vanishingIdeal]
  rintro ⟨f, hf, g, hg, rfl⟩ x ⟨hxt, hxt'⟩
  rw [mem_vanishingIdeal] at hf hg
  apply Submodule.add_mem <;> solve_by_elim

name: mem_compl_zeroLocus_iff_notMem
statement:
theorem mem_compl_zeroLocus_iff_notMem {f : R} {I : PrimeSpectrum R} :
    I ∈ (zeroLocus {f} : Set (PrimeSpectrum R))ᶜ ↔ f ∉ I.asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.mem_compl_iff, mem_zeroLocus, Set.singleton_subset_iff]; rfl

name: zeroLocus_insert_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma zeroLocus_insert_zero (s : Set R) : zeroLocus (insert 0 s) = zeroLocus s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Set.union_singleton, zeroLocus_union, zeroLocus_singleton_zero, Set.inter_univ]

name: zeroLocus_sdiff_singleton_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma zeroLocus_sdiff_singleton_zero (s : Set R) : zeroLocus (s \ {0}) = zeroLocus s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← zeroLocus_insert_zero, ← zeroLocus_insert_zero (s := s)]; simp

name: zeroLocus_smul_of_isUnit
statement:
lemma zeroLocus_smul_of_isUnit {r : R} (hr : IsUnit r) (s : Set R) :
    zeroLocus (r • s) = zeroLocus s
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp [Set.subset_def, ← Set.image_smul, Ideal.unit_mul_mem_iff_mem _ hr]

name: asIdeal_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem asIdeal_bot [IsDomain R] : (⊥ : PrimeSpectrum R).asIdeal = ⊥
proof: := rfl

name: isMax_iff
statement:
lemma isMax_iff {x : PrimeSpectrum R} :
    IsMax x ↔ x.asIdeal.IsMaximal
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hx ↦ ⟨⟨x.2.ne_top, fun I hI ↦ ?_⟩⟩, fun hx y e ↦ (hx.eq_of_le y.2.ne_top e).ge⟩
  by_contra e
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hm'⟩ := Ideal.exists_le_maximal I e
  exact hx.not_lt (show x < ⟨m, hm.isPrime⟩ from hI.trans_le hm')

name: zeroLocus_eq_singleton
statement:
lemma zeroLocus_eq_singleton (m : Ideal R) [m.IsMaximal] :
    zeroLocus m = {⟨m, inferInstance⟩}
proof:
:= by
  ext I
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · simp only [mem_zeroLocus, SetLike.coe_subset_coe] at h
    simpa using PrimeSpectrum.ext_iff.mpr (Ideal.IsMaximal.eq_of_le ‹_› I.2.ne_top h).symm
  · simp [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp h]

name: isMin_iff
statement:
lemma isMin_iff {x : PrimeSpectrum R} :
    IsMin x ↔ x.asIdeal ∈ minimalPrimes R
proof:
:= by
  change IsMin _ ↔ Minimal (fun q : Ideal R ↦ q.IsPrime ∧ ⊥ ≤ q) _
  simp only [IsMin, Minimal, x.2, bot_le, and_self, and_true, true_and]
  exact ⟨fun H y hy e ↦ @H ⟨y, hy⟩ e, fun H y e ↦ H y.2 e⟩

name: exists_primeSpectrum_prod_le
statement:
theorem exists_primeSpectrum_prod_le (I : Ideal R) :
    ∃ Z : Multiset (PrimeSpectrum R), Multiset.prod (Z.map asIdeal) ≤ I
proof:
:= by
  induction I using IsNoetherian.induction with | hgt M hgt =>
  change Ideal R at M
  by_cases h_prM : M.IsPrime
  · use {⟨M, h_prM⟩}
    rw [Multiset.map_singleton, Multiset.prod_singleton]
  by_cases htop : M = ⊤
  · rw [htop]
    exact ⟨0, le_top⟩
  have lt_add : ∀ z ∉ M, M < M + span R {z} := by
    intro z hz
    refine lt_of_le_of_ne le_sup_left fun m_eq => hz ?_
    rw [m_eq]
    exact Ideal.mem_sup_right (mem_span_singleton_self z)
  obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hxy⟩ := (Ideal.not_isPrime_iff.mp h_prM).resolve_left htop
  obtain ⟨Wx, h_Wx⟩ := hgt (M + span R {x}) (lt_add _ hx)
  obtain ⟨Wy, h_Wy⟩ := hgt (M + span R {y}) (lt_add _ hy)
  use Wx + Wy
  rw [Multiset.map_add, Multiset.prod_add]
  apply le_trans (mul_le_mul' h_Wx h_Wy)
  rw [add_mul]
  apply sup_le (show M * (M + span R {y}) ≤ M from Ideal.mul_le_left)
  rw [mul_add]
  apply sup_le (show span R {x} * M ≤ M from Ideal.mul_le_right)
  rwa [span_mul_span, Set.singleton_mul_singleton, span_singleton_le_iff_mem]

name: exists_primeSpectrum_prod_le_and_ne_bot_of_domain
statement:
theorem exists_primeSpectrum_prod_le_and_ne_bot_of_domain (h_fA : ¬IsField A) {I : Ideal A}
    (h_nzI : I ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ Z : Multiset (PrimeSpectrum A),
      Multiset.prod (Z.map asIdeal) ≤ I ∧ Multiset.prod (Z.map asIdeal) ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  induction I using IsNoetherian.induction with | hgt M hgt =>
  change Ideal A at M
  have hA_nont : Nontrivial A := IsDomain.toNontrivial
  by_cases h_topM : M = ⊤
  · rcases h_topM with rfl
    obtain ⟨p_id, h_nzp, h_pp⟩ : ∃ p : Ideal A, p ≠ ⊥ ∧ p.IsPrime := by
      apply Ring.not_isField_iff_exists_prime.mp h_fA
    use ({⟨p_id, h_pp⟩} : Multiset (PrimeSpectrum A)), le_top
    rwa [Multiset.map_singleton, Multiset.prod_singleton]
  by_cases h_prM : M.IsPrime
  · use ({⟨M, h_prM⟩} : Multiset (PrimeSpectrum A))
    rw [Multiset.map_singleton, Multiset.prod_singleton]
    exact ⟨le_rfl, h_nzI⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, h_xy⟩ := (Ideal.not_isPrime_iff.mp h_prM).resolve_left h_topM
  have lt_add : ∀ z ∉ M, M < M + span A {z} := by
    intro z hz
    refine lt_of_le_of_ne le_sup_left fun m_eq => hz ?_
    rw [m_eq]
    exact mem_sup_right (mem_span_singleton_self z)
  obtain ⟨Wx, h_Wx_le, h_Wx_ne⟩ := hgt (M + span A {x}) (lt_add _ hx) (ne_bot_of_gt (lt_add _ hx))
  obtain ⟨Wy, h_Wy_le, h_Wx_ne⟩ := hgt (M + span A {y}) (lt_add _ hy) (ne_bot_of_gt (lt_add _ hy))
  use Wx + Wy
  rw [Multiset.map_add, Multiset.prod_add]
  refine ⟨le_trans (mul_le_mul' h_Wx_le h_Wy_le) ?_, mt Ideal.mul_eq_bot.mp ?_⟩
  · rw [add_mul]
    apply sup_le (show M * (M + span A {y}) ≤ M from Ideal.mul_le_left)
    rw [mul_add]
    apply sup_le (show span A {x} * M ≤ M from Ideal.mul_le_right)
    rwa [span_mul_span, Set.singleton_mul_singleton, span_singleton_le_iff_mem]
  · rintro (hx | hy) <;> contradiction

name: sigmaToPi_injective
statement: theorem sigmaToPi_injective : (sigmaToPi R).Injective
proof:
:= fun ⟨i, p⟩ ⟨j, q⟩ eq ↦ by
  classical
  obtain rfl | ne := eq_or_ne i j
  · congr; ext x
    simpa using congr_arg (Function.update (0 : ∀ i, R i) i x ∈ ·.asIdeal) eq
  · refine (p.1.ne_top_iff_one.mp p.2.ne_top ?_).elim
    have : Function.update (1 : ∀ i, R i) j 0 ∈ (sigmaToPi R ⟨j, q⟩).asIdeal := by simp
    simpa [← eq, Function.update_of_ne ne]

name: exists_maximal_notMem_range_sigmaToPi_of_infinite
statement:
theorem exists_maximal_notMem_range_sigmaToPi_of_infinite :
    ∃ (I : Ideal (Π i, R i)) (_ : I.IsMaximal), ⟨I, inferInstance⟩ ∉ Set.range (sigmaToPi R)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let J : Ideal (Π i, R i) := 
  { __ := AddMonoidHom.mrange DFinsupp.coeFnAddMonoidHom
    smul_mem' := by
      rintro r _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨.mk x.support fun i ↦ r i * x i, funext fun i ↦ show dite _ _ _ = _ from ?_⟩
      simp_rw +instances [DFinsupp.coeFnAddMonoidHom]
      refine dite_eq_left_iff.mpr fun h ↦ ?_
      rw [DFinsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp h, mul_zero] }
  have ⟨I, max, le⟩ := J.exists_le_maximal <| (Ideal.ne_top_iff_one _).mpr <| by
    
    rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    have ⟨i, hi⟩ := x.support.exists_notMem
    simpa [DFinsupp.coeFnAddMonoidHom, DFinsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hi] using congr_fun hx i
  refine ⟨I, max, fun ⟨⟨i, p⟩, eq⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  
  have : ⇑(DFinsupp.single i 1) ∉ (sigmaToPi R ⟨i, p⟩).asIdeal := by
    simpa using p.1.ne_top_iff_one.mp p.2.ne_top
  rw [eq] at this
  exact this (le ⟨.single i 1, rfl⟩)

name: sigmaToPi_not_surjective_of_infinite
statement: theorem sigmaToPi_not_surjective_of_infinite : ¬ (sigmaToPi R).Surjective
proof:
:= fun surj ↦
  have ⟨_, _, notMem⟩ := exists_maximal_notMem_range_sigmaToPi_of_infinite R
  (Set.range_eq_univ.mpr surj ▸ notMem) ⟨⟩

name: exists_comap_evalRingHom_eq
statement:
lemma exists_comap_evalRingHom_eq
    {ι : Type*} {R : ι → Type*} [∀ i, CommRing (R i)] [Finite ι]
    (p : PrimeSpectrum (Π i, R i)) :
    ∃ (i : ι) (q : PrimeSpectrum (R i)), comap (Pi.evalRingHom R i) q = p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases nonempty_fintype ι
  let e (i) : Π i, R i := Function.update 1 i 0
  have H : ∏ i, e i = 0 := by
    ext j
    rw [Finset.prod_apply, Pi.zero_apply, Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ j)]
    simp [e]
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, e i ∈ p.asIdeal := by
    simpa [← H, Ideal.IsPrime.prod_mem_iff] using p.asIdeal.zero_mem
  let h₁ : Function.Surjective (Pi.evalRingHom R i) := RingHomSurjective.is_surjective
  have h₂ : RingHom.ker (Pi.evalRingHom R i) ≤ p.asIdeal := by
    intro x hx
    convert! p.asIdeal.mul_mem_left x hi
    ext j
    by_cases hj : i = j
    · subst hj; simpa [e]
    · simp [e, Function.update_of_ne (.symm hj)]
  have : (p.asIdeal.map (Pi.evalRingHom R i)).comap (Pi.evalRingHom R i) = p.asIdeal := by
    rwa [Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective _ h₁, sup_eq_left]
  exact ⟨i, ⟨_, Ideal.map_isPrime_of_surjective h₁ h₂⟩, PrimeSpectrum.ext this⟩

name: sigmaToPi_bijective
statement:
lemma sigmaToPi_bijective {ι : Type*} (R : ι → Type*) [∀ i, CommRing (R i)] [Finite ι] :
    Function.Bijective (sigmaToPi R)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨sigmaToPi_injective R, ?_⟩
  intro q
  obtain ⟨i, q, rfl⟩ := exists_comap_evalRingHom_eq q
  exact ⟨⟨i, q⟩, rfl⟩

name: iUnion_range_comap_comp_evalRingHom
statement:
lemma iUnion_range_comap_comp_evalRingHom
    {ι : Type*} {R : ι → Type*} [∀ i, CommRing (R i)] [Finite ι]
    {S : Type*} [CommRing S] (f : S →+* Π i, R i) :
    ⋃ i, Set.range (comap ((Pi.evalRingHom R i).comp f)) = Set.range (comap f)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [comap_comp]
  apply subset_antisymm
  · exact Set.iUnion_subset fun _ ↦ Set.range_comp_subset_range _ _
  · rintro _ ⟨p, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨i, p, rfl⟩ := exists_comap_evalRingHom_eq p
    exact Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem i ⟨p, rfl⟩

name: image_comap_zeroLocus_eq_zeroLocus_comap
statement:
theorem image_comap_zeroLocus_eq_zeroLocus_comap (hf : Surjective f) (I : Ideal S) :
    comap f '' zeroLocus I = zeroLocus (I.comap f)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Set.ext_iff, Set.mem_image, mem_zeroLocus, SetLike.coe_subset_coe]
  refine fun p => ⟨?_, fun h_I_p => ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ a ha
    exact hp ha
  · have hp : ker f ≤ p.asIdeal := (Ideal.comap_mono bot_le).trans h_I_p
    refine ⟨⟨p.asIdeal.map f, Ideal.map_isPrime_of_surjective hf hp⟩, fun x hx => ?_, ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨x', rfl⟩ := hf x
      exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem f (h_I_p hx)
    · ext x
      rw [comap_asIdeal, Ideal.mem_comap, Ideal.mem_map_iff_of_surjective f hf]
      refine ⟨?_, fun hx => ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩⟩
      rintro ⟨x', hx', heq⟩
      rw [← sub_sub_cancel x' x]
      refine p.asIdeal.sub_mem hx' (hp ?_)
      rwa [mem_ker, map_sub, sub_eq_zero]

name: range_comap_of_surjective
statement:
theorem range_comap_of_surjective (hf : Surjective f) :
    Set.range (comap f) = zeroLocus (ker f)
proof:

  convert! image_comap_zeroLocus_eq_zeroLocus_comap _ _ hf _
  rw [zeroLocus_bot]

name: PrimeSpectrum.mem_range_comap_iff
statement:
lemma PrimeSpectrum.mem_range_comap_iff {p : PrimeSpectrum R} :
    p ∈ Set.range (comap f) ↔ (p.asIdeal.map f).comap f = p.asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨q, hq⟩ ↦ by simp [← hq], ?_⟩
  rw [Ideal.comap_map_eq_self_iff_of_isPrime]
  rintro ⟨q, _, hq⟩
  exact ⟨⟨q, inferInstance⟩, PrimeSpectrum.ext hq⟩

name: PrimeSpectrum.nontrivial_iff_mem_rangeComap
statement:
lemma PrimeSpectrum.nontrivial_iff_mem_rangeComap {S : Type*} [CommRing S]
    [Algebra R S] (p : PrimeSpectrum R) :
    Nontrivial (p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[R] S) ↔ p ∈ Set.range (comap (algebraMap R S))
proof:
:= by
  let k := p.asIdeal.ResidueField
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Ideal.exists_maximal (k ⊗[R] S)
    use PrimeSpectrum.comap (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight).toRingHom ⟨m, hm.isPrime⟩
    ext : 1
    rw [← PrimeSpectrum.comap_comp_apply,
      ← Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom_comp_algebraMap, comap_comp_apply]
    simp [Ideal.eq_bot_of_prime, k, ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot]
  · obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := h
    let f : k ⊗[R] S →ₐ[R] q.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
      Algebra.TensorProduct.lift (Ideal.ResidueField.mapₐ _ _ (Algebra.ofId _ _) rfl)
        (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom _ _ _) (fun _ _ ↦ Commute.all ..)
    exact RingHom.domain_nontrivial f.toRingHom

name: IsLocalHom.of_comap_surjective
statement:
theorem IsLocalHom.of_comap_surjective [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S] (f : R →+* S)
    (hf : Function.Surjective (comap f)) : IsLocalHom f where
  map_nonunit x hfx
proof:
:= by
    by_contra hx
    obtain ⟨p, hp, _⟩ := exists_max_ideal_of_mem_nonunits hx
    obtain ⟨⟨q, hqp⟩, hq⟩ := hf ⟨p, hp.isPrime⟩
    simp only [PrimeSpectrum.ext_iff, comap_asIdeal] at hq
    exact hqp.ne_top (q.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem (q.mem_comap.mp (by rwa [hq])) hfx)

name: mem_freeLocus
statement:

    Module.Free (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) (LocalizedModule p.asIdeal.primeCompl M)
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: mem_freeLocus_of_isLocalization
statement:
lemma mem_freeLocus_of_isLocalization (p : PrimeSpectrum R)
    (Rₚ Mₚ) [CommRing Rₚ] [Algebra R Rₚ] [IsLocalization.AtPrime Rₚ p.asIdeal]
    [AddCommGroup Mₚ] [Module R Mₚ] (f : M →ₗ[R] Mₚ) [IsLocalizedModule p.asIdeal.primeCompl f]
    [Module Rₚ Mₚ] [IsScalarTower R Rₚ Mₚ] :
    p ∈ freeLocus R M ↔ Module.Free Rₚ Mₚ
proof:
:= by
  set e := (IsLocalization.algEquiv p.asIdeal.primeCompl
      (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) Rₚ).toRingEquiv
  apply Module.Free.iff_of_equiv (σ := e)
  refine { __ := IsLocalizedModule.iso p.asIdeal.primeCompl f, map_smul' := ?_ }
  intro r x
  obtain ⟨r, s, rfl⟩ := IsLocalization.exists_mk'_eq p.asIdeal.primeCompl r
  apply ((Module.End.isUnit_iff _).mp (IsLocalizedModule.map_units f s)).1
  simp [e, ← map_smul, ← smul_assoc]
